import { Component, EventEmitter, forwardRef, Input, OnInit, Output, AfterViewInit } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ControlValueAccessor,
  UntypedFormBuilder,
  UntypedFormGroup,
  NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR,
  ValidationErrors,
  Validator,
  NG_VALIDATORS,
} from '@angular/forms';
import { Observable, Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { tap } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { EntityRefCompare } from '../../mixins/EntityRefCompare';
import { StreetSuffixService } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/streetSuffix.service';
import { StreetSuffixEntityDtoEntityRef } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/streetSuffixEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { CountriesService } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/countries.service';
import { DictService } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/tenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { domesticExtendedLotNumberAddressForm } from '../../generated/forms/locations/domesticExtendedLotNumberAddressForm';
import { AddressType } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/addressType';
import { SettlementsService } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/settlements.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-address',
  templateUrl: './address.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./address.component.css'],
  providers: [
    {
      provide: NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR,
      useExisting: forwardRef(() => AddressComponent),
      multi: true,
    },
    {
      provide: NG_VALIDATORS,
      useExisting: forwardRef(() => AddressComponent),
      multi: true,
    },
    {
      provide: 'AddressComponent',
      useExisting: forwardRef(() => AddressComponent),
    },
  ],
})
export class AddressComponent
  extends EntityRefCompare
  implements OnInit, AfterViewInit, ControlValueAccessor, Validator
{
  propagateChange = (_: any) => {};

  private _errors!: ValidationErrors;
  private _form!: UntypedFormGroup;
  private isSettlementBeingUpdatedProgrammatically = false;
  private isZipCodeBeingUpdatedProgrammatically = false;

  get form(): UntypedFormGroup {
    return this._form;
  }

  get errors(): ValidationErrors {
    return this._errors!;
  }

  @Input() set errors(value: ValidationErrors) {
    this.validateErrors(value);
  }

  validateErrors(errors: ValidationErrors): void {
    this._errors = errors;
    if (!this.form) {
      return;
    }
    if (errors && errors.innerErrors) {
      Object.keys(errors.innerErrors).forEach((key) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          const control = this.form.get(key);
          if (control) {
            control.markAsDirty();
            control.markAsTouched();
            control.setErrors({
              serverError: errors.innerErrors[key],
            });
          }
        }, 1);
      });
    }
  }

  @Input()
  public legend?: string;

  @Input()
  public required = false;

  @Input()
  public validationSub?: Subject<any>;

  @Output()
  get isValid() {
    if (this.form) return this.form.valid;
    return false;
  }

  @Output() addressvaliditychange = new EventEmitter<boolean>(true);

  @Input() address: any;
  @Output() addressChange = new EventEmitter<any>(true);

  AddressType = AddressType;
  private _streetSuffixes: StreetSuffixEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];

  get streetSuffixes(): StreetSuffixEntityDtoEntityRef[] {
    return this._streetSuffixes;
  }

  set streetSuffixes(value: StreetSuffixEntityDtoEntityRef[]) {
    this._streetSuffixes = value;
    // Force a tick of change detection
    setTimeout(() => {}, 0);
  }

  counties: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
  countyDistricts: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];

  getZipCodeEntityRefBySettlement?: (search: any) => Observable<any[]>;
  getSettlementEntityRefByZipCode?: (search: any) => Observable<any[]>;
  settlementsGetSettlements?: (search: any) => Observable<any[]>;
  getCountyAndCountyDistrictBySettlement?: (settlement: string) => Observable<any>;

  private isDisabledVariable = false;

  constructor(
    private dictService: DictService,
    public settlementsService: SettlementsService,
    private streetSuffixService: StreetSuffixService,
    public countriesService: CountriesService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
  ) {
    super();
  }

  writeValue(obj: any): void {
    this.address = obj;
    if (this.address) {
      const targetForm = this.form;
      if (targetForm) {
        targetForm.patchValue(this.address);
      }
    }
  }
  registerOnChange(fn: any): void {
    this.propagateChange = fn;
  }
  registerOnTouched(fn: any): void {}

  validate(): ValidationErrors | null {
    return this.form && this.form.valid ? null : { invalidAddress: true };
  }

  streetSuffixInputEvent($event: any) {
    if (this.form.get('streetSuffix')?.value) {
      this.form.get('streetSuffix')?.setErrors({ invalid: true });
      this.addressvaliditychange.emit(this.isValid);
    }
  }

  setDisabledState?(isDisabled: boolean): void {
    this.isDisabledVariable = isDisabled;
    if (isDisabled) {
      this.form.disable();
    } else {
      this.form.enable();

      // Always keep county and countyDistrict disabled since they're only populated programmatically
      if (this.form.get('county')) {
        this.form.get('county')?.disable();
      }
      if (this.form.get('countyDistrict')) {
        this.form.get('countyDistrict')?.disable();
      }
    }
  }

  get isDisabled(): boolean {
    return this.isDisabledVariable;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Load select lists first, before setting up form subscriptions
    this.loadSelectListItems();

    // Define the filter functions
    this.getZipCodeEntityRefBySettlement = (search) =>
      this.settlementsService.settlementsGetZipCodeSelectListBySettlement(
        search,
        this.form.get('settlement')?.value ? this.form.get('settlement')?.value.entityDisplayName : '',
      );
    this.getSettlementEntityRefByZipCode = (search) =>
      this.settlementsService.settlementsGetSettlementSelectListByZipCode(
        search,
        this.form.get('zipCode')?.value ? this.form.get('zipCode')?.value.entityDisplayName : '',
      );
    this.settlementsGetSettlements = (search) => this.settlementsService.settlementsGetSettlements(search);
    this.getCountyAndCountyDistrictBySettlement = (settlementId: string) =>
      this.settlementsService.settlementsGetCountyAndCountyDistrictBySettlement(settlementId);

    // Create the form group
    const addressFormGroup = this.formBuilder.group(domesticExtendedLotNumberAddressForm.get());

    // Force county and countyDistrict to be disabled
    const countyControl = addressFormGroup.get('county');
    const countyDistrictControl = addressFormGroup.get('countyDistrict');

    if (countyControl) {
      countyControl.disable();
    }

    if (countyDistrictControl) {
      countyDistrictControl.disable();
    }

    this._form = addressFormGroup;

    // Make sure county and countyDistrict are always disabled from initialization
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.form) {
        if (this.form.get('county')) {
          this.form.get('county')?.disable();
        }
        if (this.form.get('countyDistrict')) {
          this.form.get('countyDistrict')?.disable();
        }
      }
    });

    // Add subscription to settlement changes to update county and countyDistrict
    if (this.form) {
      const settlementControl = this.form.get('settlement');
      settlementControl?.valueChanges.subscribe((settlement) => {
        // If settlement is now null or undefined, clear the county and district
        if (!settlement) {
          this.counties = [];
          this.countyDistricts = [];
          this.form.get('county')?.setValue(null);
          this.form.get('countyDistrict')?.setValue(null);
          return;
        }

        // Only update zipCode if settlement was changed by user input, not by zipCode subscription
        if (!this.isSettlementBeingUpdatedProgrammatically) {
          this.isZipCodeBeingUpdatedProgrammatically = true;
          this.settlementsService
            .settlementsGetZipCodeSelectListBySettlement('', settlement.entityDisplayName)
            .subscribe(
              (result) => {
                if (result && result.length === 1) {
                  this.form.get('zipCode')?.setValue(result[0]);
                }
                // Reset the flag after a small delay to ensure valueChanges has completed
                this.isZipCodeBeingUpdatedProgrammatically = false;
              },
              () => {
                this.isZipCodeBeingUpdatedProgrammatically = false;
              },
            );
        }

        if (settlement && settlement.entityDisplayName) {
          // Then fetch and set new values
          this.getCountyAndCountyDistrictBySettlement!(settlement.entityDisplayName).subscribe(
            (result) => {
              if (result) {
                // Store the county and district objects in our arrays
                this.counties = result.county ? [result.county] : [];
                this.countyDistricts = result.countyDistrict ? [result.countyDistrict] : [];

                // Set the form values with the object values directly
                this.form.get('county')?.setValue(result.county);
                this.form.get('countyDistrict')?.setValue(result.countyDistrict);
              }
            },
            (error) => {
              console.error('Error getting county data:', error);
            },
          );
        } else {
          // Clear values if settlement is cleared
          this.clearSettlementData();
        }
      });

      const zipCodeControl = this.form.get('zipCode');
      zipCodeControl?.valueChanges.subscribe((zipCode) => {
        if (!zipCode) {
          return;
        }

        // Only update settlement if zipCode was changed by user input, not by settlement subscription
        if (!this.isZipCodeBeingUpdatedProgrammatically) {
          // Handle both string values and entity references
          const zipCodeValue =
            typeof zipCode === 'string'
              ? zipCode
              : zipCode.entityDisplayName
              ? zipCode.entityDisplayName
              : zipCode.entityId
              ? zipCode.entityId
              : zipCode;

          this.isSettlementBeingUpdatedProgrammatically = true;
          this.settlementsService.settlementsGetSettlementSelectListByZipCode('', zipCodeValue).subscribe(
            (result) => {
              if (result && result.length === 1) {
                this.form.get('settlement')?.setValue(result[0]);
              }
              // Reset the flag after a small delay to ensure valueChanges has completed
              this.isSettlementBeingUpdatedProgrammatically = false;
            },
            () => {
              this.isSettlementBeingUpdatedProgrammatically = false;
            },
          );
        }
      });
    }

    // Subscribe to value changes
    if (this.form) {
      this.form.valueChanges
        .pipe(
          tap(() => {
            // Check if settlement is empty but county/district still have values
            const settlementValue = this.form.get('settlement')?.value;
            if (!settlementValue && (this.counties.length > 0 || this.countyDistricts.length > 0)) {
              this.clearSettlementData();
            }

            this.address = this.form.value;
            this.address.addressType = AddressType.DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddress;
            this.propagateChange(this.address);
            this.addressChange.emit(this.address);
            this.addressvaliditychange.emit(this.isValid);

            this.propagateChange(this.address);
          }),
        )
        .subscribe();

      this.form.statusChanges.subscribe(() => {
        this.propagateChange(this.address);
      });
    }

    this.addressChange.emit(this.address);
    this.addressvaliditychange.emit(this.isValid);

    //Validáció trigger hackelés
    this.validationSub?.subscribe(() => {
       this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    });
  }

  ngAfterViewInit() {
    // Find and monitor the settlement field's clear button
    setTimeout(() => {
      const settlementInputs = document.querySelectorAll(
        'app-common-input-filter-select[ng-reflect-title="Település"]',
      );
      settlementInputs.forEach((input) => {
        const clearButtons = input.querySelectorAll('.ng-clear-wrapper');
        clearButtons.forEach((button) => {
          button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Force immediate clearing of county and district
            setTimeout(() => {
              this.clearSettlementData();
            }, 10);
          });
        });
      });

      // Reinitialize street suffixes if needed
      if (this.streetSuffixes.length === 0) {
        this.loadSelectListItems();
      }
    }, 500);
  }

  loadSelectListItems(): void {
    this.streetSuffixService.streetSuffixGetStreetSuffexes().subscribe(
      (data: StreetSuffixEntityDtoEntityRef[]) => {
        // Ensure we have the correct data format
        if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) {
          // Make a shallow copy of the array to ensure change detection
          this.streetSuffixes = [...data];
        } else {
          this.streetSuffixes = [];
        }
      },
      () => {
        this.streetSuffixes = [];
      },
    );
  }

  hasSettlement(): boolean {
    const settlementRef = this.form.get('settlement')?.value;
    if (settlementRef) return true;
    else return false;
  }

  hasZipCode(): boolean {
    const zipCode = this.form.get('zipCode')?.value;
    if (zipCode) return true;
    else return false;
  }

  clearSettlementData(): void {
    const form = this.form;

    // Clear the counties and countyDistricts arrays
    this.counties = [];
    this.countyDistricts = [];

    // Clear the form values
    form.get('county')?.setValue(null);
    form.get('countyDistrict')?.setValue(null);
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }
}

import { Directive, forwardRef, Host, Input, OnInit, Optional, SkipSelf, Inject, AfterViewInit } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControlDirective, ControlContainer, UntypedFormControl, NgControl } from '@angular/forms';

export const controlNameBinding: any = {
  provide: NgControl,
  useExisting: forwardRef(() => AddressFormControlName),
};

@Directive({ selector: 'app-address[formControlName], app-address[formControl]', providers: [controlNameBinding] })
export class AddressFormControlName extends AbstractControlDirective implements OnInit, AfterViewInit {
  /**
   * @description
   * Tracks the `FormControl` instance bound to the directive.
   */
  readonly control!: UntypedFormControl;

  @Input('formControlName') name!: string | number | null;
  @Input() formControl!: UntypedFormControl;

  /**
   * @description
   * The top-level directive for this group if present, otherwise null.
   */
  get formDirective(): any {
    return this.parent ? this.parent.formDirective : null;
  }

  constructor(
    @Inject('AddressComponent')
    private readonly address: any,
    @Optional() @Host() @SkipSelf() private parent: ControlContainer,
  ) {
    super();
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this._setUpControl();
    this.control.statusChanges.subscribe(() => {
      this.address.errors = this.control.errors;
    });
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {}

  private _setUpControl() {
    if (this.formControl) 
      (this as { control: UntypedFormControl }).control = this.formControl;
    else
      (this as { control: UntypedFormControl }).control = this.formDirective.form.get(
        this.parent.path!.join('.') ? this.parent.path!.join('.') + '.' + this.name : this.name,
      );
  }
}

import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { provideHttpClient, withInterceptorsFromDi } from '@angular/common/http';
import { NgModule } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { BaseModule } from 'src/app/core/base/base.module';

import { NgxEchartsModule } from 'ngx-echarts';
import * as echarts from 'echarts/core';
import { BarChart, LineChart, CustomChart } from 'echarts/charts';

import { AfterViewInit, Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { FormControl, FormGroup, ValidatorFn } from '@angular/forms';
import { aggregations, periods, valueTypes } from '../select-lists';
import { Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { AggregationLevel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/aggregationLevel';
import moment from 'moment';
import { ISelectListItem } from 'src/app/core/models/select/select-list-item';
import { ChartFilterDefaultValueModel } from 'src/app/core/models/chart/chart-filter-default-value.model';
import { ChartFilterModel } from 'src/app/core/models/chart/chart-filter.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'chart-filter',
  templateUrl: './chart-filter.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./chart-filter.component.scss'],
})
export class ChartFilterComponent implements OnInit, AfterViewInit {
  @Input() form = new FormGroup({
    period: new FormControl(),
    aggregation: new FormControl(),
    from: new FormControl(),
    to: new FormControl(),
    valueType: new FormControl(),
  });

  periods = periods;
  valueTypes = valueTypes;
  aggregations = aggregations;
  allAggregations = aggregations;
  tooltipInfo = '';

  chartFilterModel = {} as ChartFilterModel;

  @Input() title = '';
  @Input() onLoad = true;
  @Input() hasRefreshButton = false;
  @Input() filterDefaultValues?: ChartFilterDefaultValueModel;
  @Input() filterVisibilities = {
    period: false,
    from: false,
    to: false,
    aggregation: false,
    valueType: false,
  };
  @Input() excludedValueTypes?: string[];
  @Input() excludedAggregationTypes: AggregationLevel[] = [];
  @Input() excludedAggregationTypesSubject = new Subject<AggregationLevel[]>();

  @Input() validators?: Record<string, ValidatorFn[]>;
  @Input() errors!: any;

  // eslint-disable-next-line @angular-eslint/no-output-rename
  @Output('refreshForm') refreshEvent = new EventEmitter();

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.excludedAggregationTypesSubject) {
      this.excludedAggregationTypesSubject.subscribe((data) => {
        this.excludedAggregationTypes = data;
        const from = this.form.get('from');
        const to = this.form.get('to');

        const fromDate = moment(from?.value);
        const toDate = moment(to?.value);
        this.setAggregation(fromDate.toDate(), toDate.toDate());
      });
      if(this.validators){
        Object.entries(this.validators).forEach(([key, validators]) => {
          this.form.get(key)?.addValidators(validators);
        });
      }
    }

    const setDatetimeValidation = () => {
      const to = this.form.get('to');
      const from = this.form.get('from');
      to?.setErrors(null);

      if (from?.value && to?.value && from.value > to.value) {
        to.setErrors(['A kezdeti dátum távolabbra mutat, mint a vég dátum!']);
      }

      // Convert the from date normally
      this.chartFilterModel.from = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(from?.value);

      // For the to date, if it's set, ensure it's at the end of the day (23:59:59)
      if (to?.value) {
        // First set to end of day, then convert to local
        const toDateEndOfDay = moment(to.value).endOf('day').toDate();
        to.setValue(toDateEndOfDay, { emitEvent: false }); // Update without triggering another valueChanges event
        this.chartFilterModel.to = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(toDateEndOfDay);
      } else {
        this.chartFilterModel.to = undefined;
      }

      this.chartFilterModel.valueType = [];
      //this.chartModel.valueType.push('power');
      this.dateChanges();

      this.setAggregation(from?.value, to?.value);

      if (to?.dirty || from?.dirty) {
        const periodControl = this.form.get('period');
        periodControl?.setValue(periods[periods.length - 1]);
        to?.markAsPristine();
        from?.markAsPristine();
      }
    };

    this.form.get('from')?.valueChanges.subscribe(() => setDatetimeValidation());
    this.form.get('to')?.valueChanges.subscribe(() => setDatetimeValidation());
    this.form.get('aggregation')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value: ISelectListItem) => this.aggregationChange(value));
    this.form.get('valueType')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value: ISelectListItem[]) => this.valueTypeChange(value));
    this.form.get('period')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value: ISelectListItem) => this.periodChange(value));

    // Érték típusok közül van-e mit kitiltani az aktuális grafikonon?
    if (this.excludedValueTypes && this.excludedValueTypes.length > 0)
      this.valueTypes = this.valueTypes.filter((v) => this.excludedValueTypes!.indexOf(v.code) === -1);

    // Dropdown-ok/dátumválasztók előtöltése alapértelmezett értékekkel
    this.setChartFilterDefaultValues();
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    if (this.onLoad) {
      this.onLoad = false;
      this.refreshChart();
    }
  }

  private dateChanges() {
    const to = this.form.get('to');
    const from = this.form.get('from');
    const setDatetime = (from: Date, to: Date) => {
      const fromDate = moment(from);
      // Set the to date to the end of the day
      const toDate = moment(to).endOf('day');

      // Update chartModel with local dates
      if (from) {
        this.chartFilterModel.from = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(from);
      }

      if (to) {
        // Update the form value without emitting an event
        const toDateEndOfDay = toDate.toDate();
        this.form.get('to')?.setValue(toDateEndOfDay, { emitEvent: false });
        this.chartFilterModel.to = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(toDateEndOfDay);
      }

      this.setAggregation(fromDate.toDate(), toDate.toDate());
    };

    if (from?.value && to?.value) setDatetime(from.value, to.value);
  }

  private convertUTCDateToLocalDate(date: any) {
    if (!date) return date;

    // Check if it's a Moment object
    if (date._isAMomentObject) {
      // Convert Moment object to JavaScript Date and account for timezone
      return new Date(date.valueOf());
    }

    // Handle standard JavaScript Date object
    if (date instanceof Date) {
      const newDate = new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60 * 1000);
      return newDate;
    }

    // If all else fails, try to create a new Date
    try {
      return new Date(date);
    } catch {
      console.error('Invalid date format:', date);
      // return null;
    }
  }

  // Adott szűrő láthatóságával visszatér. Ha nincs beállítva, akkor látható
  getFilterVisibility(field: string): boolean {
    if (field) {
      const value: boolean = (this.filterVisibilities as any)[field];
      return value ?? true;
    }
    return true;
  }

  setChartFilterDefaultValues() {
    if (this.filterDefaultValues) {
      // Perdiódus dropdown
      if (this.filterDefaultValues?.period) {
        const periodListItem: ISelectListItem | undefined = this.periods.find(
          (x) => x.code === this.filterDefaultValues?.period,
        );
        if (periodListItem) {
          this.form.get('period')?.setValue(periodListItem);
        }
      }

      // Periódus kezdete dátumválasztó
      // Normál esetben a Perdiódus dropdown kiválasztás beállítja ezeket is.
      if (this.filterDefaultValues?.from) {
        const sourceDate = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(this.filterDefaultValues?.from);
        if (sourceDate) {
          this.form.get('from')?.setValue(sourceDate);
          this.chartFilterModel.from = sourceDate; // Also set in the chartModel
        }
      }

      // Periódus vége dátumválasztó
      // Normál esetben a Perdiódus dropdown kiválasztás beállítja ezeket is.
      if (this.filterDefaultValues?.to) {
        // Set the to date to the end of the day (23:59:59)
        //const toDate = moment(this.filterDefaultValues.to).endOf('day').toDate();
        const toDate = moment(this.filterDefaultValues.to).toDate();
        const sourceDate = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(toDate);
        if (sourceDate) {
          this.form.get('to')?.setValue(sourceDate);
          this.chartFilterModel.to = sourceDate; // Also set in the chartModel
        }
      }

      // Aggregáció dropdown
      if (this.filterDefaultValues?.aggregation) {
        const aggregationListItem: ISelectListItem | undefined = this.aggregations.find(
          (x) => x.code === this.filterDefaultValues?.aggregation,
        );
        if (aggregationListItem) {
          this.form.get('aggregation')?.setValue(aggregationListItem);
        }
      }

      // Érték típusa/ValueType dropdown
      if (this.filterDefaultValues?.valueType) {
        const valueTypeListItem: ISelectListItem[] = [];
        // Ha nincs a kitiltott típusok között, és a kódját megtaláljuk
        if (this.filterDefaultValues.valueType && this.filterDefaultValues.valueType.length > 0)
          this.filterDefaultValues.valueType.forEach((y: any) => {
            valueTypeListItem.push(this.valueTypes.find((x) => x.code === y)!);
          });
        if (valueTypeListItem) {
          this.form.get('valueType')?.setValue(valueTypeListItem);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  periodChange(item: ISelectListItem) {
    const fromControl = this.form.get('from');
    const toControl = this.form.get('to');
    const now = () => moment();
    const setDatetime = (from: moment.Moment, to: moment.Moment) => {
      const fromDate = from.toDate();
      // Set the time to the end of the day (23:59:59) for the "to" date
      const toDate = to.endOf('day').toDate();
      fromControl?.setValue(fromDate);
      toControl?.setValue(toDate);

      // Also update chartModel with local dates
      this.chartFilterModel.from = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(fromDate);
      this.chartFilterModel.to = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(toDate);
    };

    this.valueTypeChange(this.form.get('valueType')?.value);

    switch (item.code) {
      case 'lastHour':
        setDatetime(now().local(true).subtract(1, 'hours'), now().local(true));
        break;
      case 'today':
        setDatetime(now().local(true).startOf('day'), now().local(true));
        break;
      case 'yesterday':
        setDatetime(now().local(true).subtract(1, 'days').startOf('day'), now().local(true).subtract(1, 'days'));
        break;
      case 'lastWeek':
        setDatetime(
          now().local(true).subtract(1, 'weeks').startOf('isoWeek').startOf('day'),
          now().local(true).subtract(1, 'weeks').endOf('isoWeek'),
        );
        break;
      case 'actualWeek':
        setDatetime(now().local(true).startOf('isoWeek'), now().local(true).endOf('isoWeek'));
        break;
      case 'lastMonth':
        setDatetime(
          now().local(true).subtract(1, 'months').startOf('month').startOf('day'),
          now().local(true).subtract(1, 'months').endOf('month'),
        );
        break;
      case 'actualMonth':
        setDatetime(now().local(true).startOf('month').startOf('day'), now().local(true).endOf('month'));
        break;
      case 'lastYear':
        setDatetime(
          now().local(true).subtract(1, 'years').startOf('year').startOf('day'),
          now().local(true).subtract(1, 'years').endOf('year'),
        );
        break;
      case 'actualYear':
        setDatetime(now().local(true).startOf('year').startOf('day'), now().local(true).endOf('year'));
        break;
      case 'other':
        break;
    }
  }

  aggregationChange(value: ISelectListItem): void {
    this.chartFilterModel.aggregation = value.code as AggregationLevel;
  }

  valueTypeChange(value: ISelectListItem[]): void {
    this.chartFilterModel.valueType = [];
    if (value)
      value.forEach((x) => {
        this.chartFilterModel.valueType.push(x.code);
      });

    const to = this.form.get('to');
    const from = this.form.get('from');

    const fromDate = moment(from?.value);
    const toDate = moment(to?.value);
    this.setAggregation(fromDate.toDate(), toDate.toDate());
  }

  refreshChart() {
    this.chartFilterModel.valueType = [];

    if (this.form.get('valueType')?.value)
      this.form.get('valueType')?.value.forEach((x: any) => {
        this.chartFilterModel.valueType.push(x.code);
      });

    // Make sure we're sending local dates, not UTC
    const from = this.form.get('from')?.value;
    const to = this.form.get('to')?.value;

    if (from) {
      this.chartFilterModel.from = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(from);
    }

    if (to) {
      // Set to date to end of day (23:59:59)
      const toDateEndOfDay = moment(to).endOf('day').toDate();
      // Update the form value without emitting an event
      this.form.get('to')?.setValue(toDateEndOfDay, { emitEvent: false });
      this.chartFilterModel.to = this.convertUTCDateToLocalDate(toDateEndOfDay);
    }

    this.refreshEvent.emit(this.chartFilterModel);
  }

  removeItem(array: any, itemToRemove: any) {
    return array.filter((v: any) => v.code !== itemToRemove);
  }

  private setAggregation(fromDate: Date, toDate: Date) {
    if (toDate == undefined || toDate == null || fromDate == undefined || fromDate == null) return;
    // const millisecondsPerDay = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24;
    // const millisBetween = new Date(toDate).getTime() - new Date(fromDate).getTime();
    // const days = millisBetween / millisecondsPerDay;

    this.aggregations = Object.assign([], this.allAggregations);
    this.tooltipInfo = '';

    // if (days <= 7) {
    //   this.aggregations = Object.assign([], this.allAggregations);
    //   this.tooltipInfo = '';
    // }
    // else if (days > 183) {
    //   this.aggregations = Object.assign([], this.allAggregations);
    //   this.aggregations = this.aggregations.filter(x => x.code != AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes && x.code != AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes && x.code != AggregationLevel.OneHour);

    //   if (this.excludedAggregationTypes && (this.excludedAggregationTypes.includes(AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes) || this.excludedAggregationTypes.includes(AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes)))
    //     this.tooltipInfo = '';
    //   else
    //     this.tooltipInfo = '5 és 15 perces és órás felbontás nem választható 183 napot meghaladó időszak esetén';
    // }
    // else if (days > 31) {
    //   this.aggregations = Object.assign([], this.allAggregations);
    //   this.aggregations = this.aggregations.filter(x => x.code != AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes && x.code != AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes);

    //   if (this.excludedAggregationTypes && (this.excludedAggregationTypes.includes(AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes) || this.excludedAggregationTypes.includes(AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes)))
    //     this.tooltipInfo = '';
    //   else
    //     this.tooltipInfo = '5 és 15 perces felbontás nem választható 31 napot meghaladó időszak esetén';
    // }
    // else if (days >= 7) {
    //   this.aggregations = Object.assign([], this.allAggregations);
    //   this.aggregations = this.aggregations.filter(x => x.code != AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);

    //   if (this.excludedAggregationTypes && this.excludedAggregationTypes.includes(AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes))
    //     this.tooltipInfo = '';
    //   else
    //     this.tooltipInfo = '5 perces felbontás nem választható 7 napot meghaladó időszak esetén';
    // }

    // var hasProduced = null;
    // var valueType = this.form.get('valueType').value;
    // if (valueType)
    //   hasProduced = valueType.filter(x => x.code == "energyProduced" || x.code == "production");

    // if ((hasProduced && hasProduced.length > 0)  || this.chartModel.valueType && (this.chartModel.valueType.includes('energyProduced') || this.chartModel.valueType.includes('production'))) {
    //   this.aggregations = this.aggregations.filter(x => x.code != AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);

    //   if (this.excludedAggregationTypes && (this.excludedAggregationTypes.includes(AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes)))
    //     this.tooltipInfo = '';
    //   else
    //     this.tooltipInfo = '5 perces felbontás nem választható termelési érték típus esetén';
    // }

    // Optional Exclude
    if (this.excludedAggregationTypes && this.excludedAggregationTypes.length > 0) {
      this.excludedAggregationTypes.forEach((excludedAggregationType: any) => {
        this.aggregations = this.aggregations.filter((x) => x.code != excludedAggregationType);
      });
    }

    if (!this.onLoad) {
      if (this.aggregations.includes(this.form.controls['aggregation'].value) == false)
        this.form.controls['aggregation'].setValue(this.aggregations[0]);
    }
  }

  private setSelectableValueTypes(value: ISelectListItem) {
    this.chartFilterModel.valueType = [];
    if (this.form.get('valueType')?.value)
      this.form.get('valueType')?.value.forEach((x: any) => {
        this.chartFilterModel.valueType.push(x.code);
      });

    if (this.chartFilterModel.deviceChange) {
      //this.form.get('valueType').setValue(null);
      if (!this.form.get('valueType')?.value) this.form.get('valueType')?.setValue(null);
      else if (
        this.chartFilterModel.iOtDeviceCode != undefined &&
        this.chartFilterModel.iOtDeviceCode == 'consumption_meter'
      ) {
        const valueTypeListItem: ISelectListItem[] = [];
        const items = this.valueTypes.filter(
          (x) =>
            x.code === 'voltage' || x.code === 'amperage' || x.code === 'power' || x.code === 'relativeConsumption',
        );
        items.forEach((x) => {
          if (this.form.get('valueType')?.value.includes(x)) valueTypeListItem.push(x);
        });
        this.form.get('valueType')?.setValue(valueTypeListItem);
      } else if (this.chartFilterModel.iOtDeviceCode != undefined) {
        const valueTypeListItem: ISelectListItem[] = [];
        const items = this.valueTypes.filter((x) => x.code === 'energyProduced' || x.code === 'production');
        items.forEach((x) => {
          if (this.form.get('valueType')?.value.includes(x)) valueTypeListItem.push(x);
        });
        this.form.get('valueType')?.setValue(valueTypeListItem);
      }
      this.chartFilterModel.deviceChange = false;

      return false;
    }

    if (this.form.get('valueType')?.value.length == 0 && !this.chartFilterModel.iOtDeviceCode) return false;

    if (
      this.chartFilterModel.valueType &&
      this.chartFilterModel.valueType.length > 0 &&
      this.chartFilterModel.iOtDeviceCode == undefined
    ) {
      if (this.chartFilterModel.valueType.includes('power') || this.chartFilterModel.valueType.includes('production')) {
        if (value.code == 'power' || value.code == 'production') return false;
        else return true;
      } else if (
        this.chartFilterModel.valueType.includes('relativeConsumption') ||
        this.chartFilterModel.valueType.includes('energyProduced')
      ) {
        if (value.code == 'energyProduced' || value.code == 'relativeConsumption') return false;
        else return true;
      } else if (this.chartFilterModel.valueType.includes(value.code)) {
        return false;
      } else return true;
    } else if (this.chartFilterModel.iOtDeviceCode == 'consumption_meter') {
      if (this.chartFilterModel.valueType && this.chartFilterModel.valueType.length > 0) {
        if (value.code == 'energyProduced' || value.code == 'production') return true;
        else if (this.chartFilterModel.valueType.includes(value.code)) return false;
        else return true;
      } else {
        if (value.code == 'energyProduced' || value.code == 'production') return true;
        else return false;
      }
    } else {
      if (this.chartFilterModel.valueType && this.chartFilterModel.valueType.length > 0) {
        if (
          value.code == 'voltage' ||
          value.code == 'amperage' ||
          value.code == 'power' ||
          value.code == 'relativeConsumption'
        )
          return true;
        else if (value.code == 'energyProduced' || value.code == 'production') return false;
        else return true;
      } else if (value.code == 'production' || value.code == 'energyProduced') return false;
      else return true;
    }
  }
}

import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, Input, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { ECharts, EChartsOption, LegendComponentOption, SeriesOption } from 'echarts';
import { TitleOption, YAXisOption } from 'echarts/types/dist/shared';
import { ChartModel, ChartType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';
import { defaultChartOptions } from 'src/app/core/mixins/chart/default-chart-options';

@Component({
  selector: 'echarts-diagram',
  templateUrl: './echarts-diagram.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./echarts-diagram.component.scss'],
})
export class EchartsDiagramComponent implements OnInit {
  private echartIstance?: ECharts;
  private _downloadImgSrc = '';

  @Input() options?: EChartsOption;
  @Input() model?: ChartModel;

  constructor() {
    if (!this.options && !this.model) {
      this.options = { ...defaultChartOptions };
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.processModel();
  }

  get downloadImgSrc() {
    return this._downloadImgSrc;
  }

  public processModel(params?: { model?: ChartModel; options?: EChartsOption }) {
    this.echartIstance?.clear();

    if (params && params.model) {
      this.model = params.model;
    }

    if (params && params.options) {
      this.options = params.options;
    }

    if (this.model) {
      const unit = this.model.unit;

      (this.options?.title as TitleOption).text = this.model.title;

      this.options!.series = [];

      this.model.items?.forEach((item) => {
        const series: SeriesOption = {
          data: item.datas?.map((data) => {
            return { value: data, unit: unit };
          }),
          type: this.getChartTypeFromEnum(item.chartType!),
          name: item.name,
          areaStyle: item.chartType === ChartType.Area ? {} : undefined,
          connectNulls: item.connectNulls,
          markLine: {
            silent: true,
            data: [],
          },
        };

        if (this.model!.minValue) {
          series.markLine.data.push({
            yAxis: this.model!.minValue,
            lineStyle: {
              color: 'blue',
            },
          });
        }

        if (this.model!.maxValue) {
          series.markLine.data.push({
            yAxis: this.model!.maxValue,
            lineStyle: {
              color: 'red',
            },
          });
        }

        (this.options!.series! as SeriesOption[]).push(series);
      });

      this.drawnIntermediateArea();

      (this.options!.legend as LegendComponentOption).data = this.model.items?.map((item) => item.name!) || [];

      // Configure legend positioning to be below the chart
      const legend = this.options!.legend as LegendComponentOption;
      legend.type = 'scroll'; // Enable scrollable legend for many items
      legend.bottom = 0; // Position at bottom of chart
      legend.orient = 'horizontal'; // Horizontal layout for bottom positioning
      legend.left = 'center'; // Center the legend horizontally

      const yAxis = this.options!.yAxis as YAXisOption;
      yAxis.axisLabel = {
        formatter: this.getYAxisFormatter(unit),
      };

      const xAxis = this.options!.xAxis;
      if (xAxis && 'data' in xAxis) {
        xAxis.data = this.model.xAxisValues;
      }
    }

    if (this.options) {
      this.echartIstance?.setOption(this.options);
    }
  }

  onChartInit(ec: ECharts) {
    this.echartIstance = ec;

    this.echartIstance!.on('rendered', () => {
      this._downloadImgSrc = this.echartIstance!.getDataURL({
        pixelRatio: 2,
        backgroundColor: '#fff',
      });
    });
  }

  private getYAxisFormatter(unit?: string) {
    return (val: number) => {
      return `${new DecimalPipe('hu-HU').transform(val ?? '', '0.0-3')}` + (unit ? ` ${unit}` : '');
    };
  }

  private drawnIntermediateArea(): void {
    if (!this.model?.intermediateArea) return;

    this.model.intermediateArea.forEach(i => {
      const lineA = this.model!.items![Number(i.index1)];
      const lineB = this.model!.items![Number(i.index2)];
      const xVals = this.model!.xAxisValues;

      if (!xVals) return;

      // polygonData összeállítása itt, mert át kell adni a series.data-nak
      const polygonData = xVals.map((x, j) => {
        const valA = lineA?.datas?.[j] ?? 0;
        const valB = lineB?.datas?.[j] ?? 0;
        return {
          top: [x, Math.max(valA, valB)],
          bottom: [x, Math.min(valA, valB)]
        };
      });

      // Itt adjuk át az adatot a data-ban, így params.data-ban meg fog jelenni!
      const customArea: SeriesOption = {
        name: `Kitöltés ${lineA?.name} & ${lineB?.name}`,
        type: 'custom',
        renderItem: (params, api) => {
          // Az adatot az api.value(0) segítségével érjük el, mivel params.data nem létezik
          const polygon = (api.value(0) as unknown as { top: [number, number]; bottom: [number, number]; }[]);

          // pontokat átalakítjuk pixel koordinátára minden rendernél (zoom/scroll is jó lesz)
          const pointsTop = polygon.map(p => api.coord(p.top));
          const pointsBottom = polygon.map(p => api.coord(p.bottom)).reverse();
          const coords = pointsTop.concat(pointsBottom);

          return {
            type: 'polygon',
            shape: { points: coords },
            style: api.style({
              fill: 'rgba(0, 136, 212, 0.2)',
              stroke: '#0088d4',
              lineWidth: 1,
            }),
          };
        },
        data: [
          [polygonData]
        ],
        z: 0,
      };

      (this.options!.series as SeriesOption[]).push(customArea);
    });
  }

  private getChartTypeFromEnum(chartType: ChartType) {
    switch (chartType) {
      case ChartType.Area:
      case ChartType.Line:
      case ChartType.IntermediateArea:
        return 'line';
      case ChartType.Bar:
        return 'bar';
    }

    return 'line';
  }
}

import { Pipe, PipeTransform } from '@angular/core';

// key:type , value:mat_icon_name
const ICONS = new Map<string, string>([
  ['battery', 'battery_charging_full'],
  ['consumption_meter', 'timer'],
  ['halozat', 'electric_bolt'],
  ['weather', 'sunny_snowing'],
  ['solar_panel', 'solar_power'],
  ['Site', 'location_city'],
  ['SiteLocation', 'home'],
  ['Device', 'charging_station'],
  ['Invoice', 'receipt_long'],
  ['Institution', 'business'],
  ['MeasurementPoint', 'dashboard'],
  ['Contract', 'insert_drive_file'],
  ['Floor', 'location_city'],
  ['BuildingPart', 'location_city'],
  ['Building', 'location_city'],
  ['Room', 'location_city'],
]);

@Pipe({
  name: 'typeToIcon',
})
export class TypeToIconPipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(type: string): string {
    return ICONS.has(type) ? ICONS.get(type)! : 'no_accounts';
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit, ElementRef, Input, Output, EventEmitter, TemplateRef } from '@angular/core';
import { FormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { ImportErrorsDialogComponent } from './import-errors-dialog/import-errors-dialog.component';
import { SuccessDialogComponent } from './success-dialog/success-dialog.component';

/**
 * Generic interface for import job results
 */
export interface ImportJobResult {
  id: number | string;
  fileName: string;
  initiationDate: string | Date;
  status: string;
  errorList?: any[];
  [key: string]: any; // Allow additional properties
}

/**
 * Configuration for column display in the jobs table
 */
export interface DataImportColumn {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  format?: 'date' | 'text' | 'custom';
  dateFormat?: string;
  customTemplate?: TemplateRef<any>;
  show?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Configuration for job actions
 */
export interface DataImportAction {
  key: string;
  icon: string;
  tooltip: string;
  color?: string;
  showCondition: (job: ImportJobResult) => boolean;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-data-import',
  templateUrl: './data-import.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./data-import.component.scss']
})
export class DataImportComponent implements OnInit {
  // File upload
  fileControl = new FormControl<File | null>(null);
  selectedFile: File | null = null;

  // Import jobs
  importJobs: ImportJobResult[] = [];
  displayedColumns: string[] = [];

  // Progress tracking
  isLoading = false;
  progressRef: any = null;

  // Configuration inputs
  @Input() templateDownloadPath = '';
  @Input() acceptedFileExtensions: string[] = ['xlsx'];
  @Input() translationPrefix = 'DATA_IMPORT';
  @Input() columns: DataImportColumn[] = [];
  @Input() actions: DataImportAction[] = [];
  
  // Functions for data operations
  @Input() fetchJobsFunction!: () => Observable<{ items: ImportJobResult[] }>;
  @Input() uploadFileFunction!: (file: File) => Observable<any>;
  @Input() deleteJobFunction!: (jobId: number | string) => Observable<any>;
  @Input() finalizeJobFunction!: (jobId: number | string) => Observable<any>;
  @Input() viewErrorsFunction!: (jobId: number | string) => Observable<any[]>;
  
  // Display options
  @Input() useSuccessDialog = false; // Whether to use dialog or snackbar for success messages
  @Input() errorDialogWidth = '1200px';
  @Input() successDialogWidth = '400px';
  
  // Custom templates
  @Input() statusTemplate?: TemplateRef<any>;
  
  // Event outputs
  @Output() fileSelected = new EventEmitter<File | null>();
  @Output() uploadSuccess = new EventEmitter<any>();
  @Output() uploadError = new EventEmitter<any>();
  @Output() jobDeleted = new EventEmitter<ImportJobResult>();
  @Output() jobFinalized = new EventEmitter<ImportJobResult>();
  @Output() rowClick = new EventEmitter<ImportJobResult>();

  constructor(
    private dialog: MatDialog,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
    private loaderService: LoaderService,
    private elRef: ElementRef,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.setupDisplayColumns();
    this.refreshJobsList();
  }

  /**
   * Configure which columns to display in the table
   */
  private setupDisplayColumns(): void {
    // Setup displayed columns based on the configuration
    this.displayedColumns = this.columns
      .filter(col => col.show !== false)
      .map(col => col.key);
    
    // If status template is provided, update status column to use custom template
    if (this.statusTemplate) {
      const statusColumn = this.columns.find(col => col.key === 'status');
      if (statusColumn) {
        statusColumn.format = 'custom';
        statusColumn.customTemplate = this.statusTemplate;
      }
    }
    
    // Add actions column if there are actions defined
    if (this.actions && this.actions.length > 0) {
      this.displayedColumns.push('actions');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Handle files loaded event from file upload control
   */
  filesLoaded(files: FileList | File[]): void {
    if (files && files.length > 0) {
      const file = files[0];
      const fileExtension = file.name.split('.').pop()!.toLowerCase();

      // Check if file extension is accepted
      if (!this.acceptedFileExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {
        // Invalid file format
        this.selectedFile = null;
        this.fileControl.reset();
        this.fileControl.setErrors({
          invalidFileFormat: true,
        });
        this.fileSelected.emit(null);
        return;
      }

      // Valid file
      this.selectedFile = file;
      this.fileControl.setValue(file);
      this.fileSelected.emit(file);
    } else {
      this.selectedFile = null;
      this.fileControl.reset();
      this.fileSelected.emit(null);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Trigger file upload process
   */
  uploadFile(): void {
    if (!this.selectedFile) {
      return;
    }

    if (!this.uploadFileFunction) {
      console.warn('uploadFileFunction is not defined');
      return;
    }

    // Show loading indicator
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.progressRef = this.loaderService.showProgress(this.elRef);

    // Upload file using the provided function
    this.uploadFileFunction(this.selectedFile).subscribe({
      next: (response) => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.loaderService.detach(this.progressRef);
        
        // Reset file selection
        this.selectedFile = null;
        this.fileControl.reset();
        
        // Refresh the jobs list
        this.refreshJobsList();
        
        // Emit success event
        this.uploadSuccess.emit(response);
        
        // Show success message
        if (this.useSuccessDialog) {
          this.showSuccessDialog(
            'UPLOAD_SUCCESS_TITLE',
            'UPLOAD_COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY'
          );
        } else {
          this.snackBar.open(
            this.translateService.instant(`${this.translationPrefix}.UPLOAD_COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY`),
            this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
            { duration: 3000 }
          );
        }
      },
      error: (error) => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.loaderService.detach(this.progressRef);
        
        // Emit error event
        this.uploadError.emit(error);
        
        // Show error message
        this.showErrorDialog(error, this.selectedFile?.name);
        
        // Reset file selection
        this.selectedFile = null;
        this.fileControl.reset();
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Load the list of import jobs
   */
  refreshJobsList(): void {
    if (!this.fetchJobsFunction) {
      console.warn('fetchJobsFunction is not defined');
      return;
    }

    // Show loading indicator
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.progressRef = this.loaderService.showProgress(this.elRef);

    // Fetch jobs using the provided function
    this.fetchJobsFunction().subscribe({
      next: (response) => {
        if (response && response.items) {
          this.importJobs = response.items;
        } else {
          this.importJobs = [];
        }
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.loaderService.detach(this.progressRef);
      },
      error: (error) => {
        this.importJobs = [];
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.loaderService.detach(this.progressRef);

        this.snackBar.open(
          this.translateService.instant(`${this.translationPrefix}.LOAD_JOBS_FAILED`),
          this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
          { duration: 5000, panelClass: ['error-snackbar'] }
        );
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * View errors for a job
   */
  viewErrors(job: ImportJobResult): void {
    if (!this.viewErrorsFunction) {
      console.warn('viewErrorsFunction is not defined');
      return;
    }

    if (job.errorList && job.errorList.length > 0) {
      // Show the built-in error dialog
      this.openErrorsDialog(job, job.errorList);
      // Also emit for backward compatibility
      this.rowClick.emit(job);
    } else {
      // Fetch errors if they're not already available
      this.viewErrorsFunction(job.id).subscribe(errors => {
        // Show the built-in error dialog
        this.openErrorsDialog(job, errors);
        
        // Also emit for backward compatibility
        const enrichedJob = { ...job, errorList: errors };
        this.rowClick.emit(enrichedJob);
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Open the errors dialog with the given errors
   */
  private openErrorsDialog(job: ImportJobResult, errors: any[]): void {
    this.dialog.open(ImportErrorsDialogComponent, {
      width: this.errorDialogWidth,
      data: {
        jobId: job.id,
        fileName: job.fileName,
        errors: errors,
        translationPrefix: this.translationPrefix
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Show a success dialog
   */
  private showSuccessDialog(titleKey: string, messageKey: string): void {
    this.dialog.open(SuccessDialogComponent, {
      width: this.successDialogWidth,
      data: {
        title: titleKey,
        message: messageKey,
        translationPrefix: this.translationPrefix
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Show an error dialog for upload errors
   */
  private showErrorDialog(error: any, fileName?: string): void {
    // For now, just show a snackbar for upload errors
    // We could enhance this later to show more details in a dialog if needed
    this.snackBar.open(
      this.translateService.instant(`${this.translationPrefix}.UPLOAD_FAILED`),
      this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
      { duration: 5000, panelClass: ['error-snackbar'] }
    );
  }

  /**
   * Delete a job
   */
  deleteJob(job: ImportJobResult): void {
    if (!this.deleteJobFunction) {
      console.warn('deleteJobFunction is not defined');
      return;
    }

    this.deleteJobFunction(job.id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        if (this.useSuccessDialog) {
          this.showSuccessDialog(
            'DELETE_SUCCESS_TITLE',
            'DELETE_JOB_SUCCESS'
          );
        } else {
          this.snackBar.open(
            this.translateService.instant(`${this.translationPrefix}.DELETE_JOB_SUCCESS`),
            this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
            { duration: 3000 }
          );
        }
        this.jobDeleted.emit(job);
        this.refreshJobsList();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.snackBar.open(
          this.translateService.instant(`${this.translationPrefix}.DELETE_JOB_ERROR`),
          this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
          { duration: 3000, panelClass: ['error-snackbar'] }
        );
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Finalize a job
   */
  finalizeJob(job: ImportJobResult): void {
    if (!this.finalizeJobFunction) {
      console.warn('finalizeJobFunction is not defined');
      return;
    }

    this.finalizeJobFunction(job.id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        if (this.useSuccessDialog) {
          this.showSuccessDialog(
            'FINALIZE_SUCCESS_TITLE',
            'FINALIZE_JOB_SUCCESS'
          );
        } else {
          this.snackBar.open(
            this.translateService.instant(`${this.translationPrefix}.FINALIZE_JOB_SUCCESS`),
            this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
            { duration: 3000 }
          );
        }
        this.jobFinalized.emit(job);
        this.refreshJobsList();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.snackBar.open(
          this.translateService.instant(`${this.translationPrefix}.FINALIZE_JOB_ERROR`),
          this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
          { duration: 3000, panelClass: ['error-snackbar'] }
        );
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Handle row click in the jobs table
   */
  onRowClick(job: ImportJobResult): void {
    this.rowClick.emit(job);
  }

  /**
   * Handle action button click
   */
  onActionClick(action: DataImportAction, job: ImportJobResult, event: Event): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    
    switch (action.key) {
      case 'delete':
        this.deleteJob(job);
        break;
      case 'finalize':
        this.finalizeJob(job);
        break;
      case 'viewErrors':
        this.viewErrors(job);
        break;
      default:
        // For custom actions, emit the row click event with action info
        this.rowClick.emit({ ...job, actionTriggered: action.key });
        break;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Trackby function for the jobs table
   */
  trackByFn(index: number, item: ImportJobResult): number | string {
    return item.id;
  }
}

'use strict';

import { Pipe, PipeTransform } from '@angular/core';
import moment from 'moment';

@Pipe({ name: 'mDate' })
export class MDatePipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(value: Date | string, format = 'YYYY. MM. DD.'): string {
    return value ? moment(value).format(format) : '';
  }
}

import { animate, state, style, transition, trigger } from '@angular/animations';
import { Component, ContentChild, EventEmitter, Input, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { FilterFormTemplateDirective } from '../mat-datatable/directives/filter-form-template.directive';
import { HeaderActionTemplateDirective } from '../mat-datatable/directives/header-action-template.directive';
import { OtherItemTemplateDirective } from '../mat-datatable/directives/other-item-template.directive';
import { SearchTemplateDirective } from '../mat-datatable/directives/search-template.directive';

@Component({
  selector: 'datatable-header-root',
  templateUrl: 'datatable-header.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./datatable-header.component.scss'],
  animations: [
    trigger('openClose', [
      state(
        'open',
        style({
          width: '20%',
          opacity: '100%',
        }),
      ),
      state(
        'closed',
        style({
          width: '0%',
          opacity: '0%',
        }),
      ),
      transition('open => closed', [animate('0.1s')]),
      transition('closed => open', [animate('0.1s')]),
    ]),
  ],
})
export class DatatableHeaderComponent {
  @Input() title = '';
  @Input() searchAvailable = false;
  @Output('filter') filterEventEmitter = new EventEmitter<boolean>(false);
  @Output('resetFilter') resetFilterEventEmitter = new EventEmitter<boolean>(false);

  @Output() searchFieldEmitter: EventEmitter<string> = new EventEmitter<string>();

  @ContentChild(FilterFormTemplateDirective) formTemplate: FilterFormTemplateDirective | undefined;
  @ContentChild(HeaderActionTemplateDirective) actionTemplate: HeaderActionTemplateDirective | undefined;
  @ContentChild(OtherItemTemplateDirective) otherItemTemplate: OtherItemTemplateDirective | undefined;
  @ContentChild(SearchTemplateDirective) searchTemplate: SearchTemplateDirective | undefined;

  isFilterContainerOpen = false;
  isSearchOpen = false;
  searchField = new UntypedFormControl();

  constructor() {}

  toggleFilterContainer() {
    this.isFilterContainerOpen = !this.isFilterContainerOpen;
  }

  doFilter() {
    this.filterEventEmitter.emit(true);
    this.toggleFilterContainer();
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.resetFilterEventEmitter.emit(true);
  }

  toggleSearch() {
    if (!this.searchField.value) {
      this.searchField.setValue('');
    }
    this.isSearchOpen = !this.isSearchOpen;
  }
}

import { TemplateRef } from '@angular/core';

export enum ColumnType {
  Text = 0,
  Select = 1,
  Checkbox = 2,
  Button = 3,
  Dropdown = 4,
  Date = 5,
  Number = 6,
  Custom = 100,
  DateTime = 7,
}

export interface IColumnDefinition {
  columnName: string;
  sortable: boolean;
  filterable: boolean;
  filterValue: any;
  displayName: string;
  columnType: ColumnType;
  columnTemplate: TemplateRef<any>;
  filterTemplate: TemplateRef<any>;
  routerLink: (any: any) => any[];
  parameters: ITypeParam | IDateTimeTypeParam | INumberTypeParam;
}

export class ColumnDefinition {
  columnName = 'undefined';
  sortable = false;
  filterable = false;
  filterValue: any;
  displayName = '';
  columnType: ColumnType = ColumnType.Text;
  columnTemplate: TemplateRef<any> | undefined;
  filterTemplate: TemplateRef<any> | undefined;
  routerLink: Function = (row: any) => {
    return [] as any[];
  };
}

export interface ITypeParam {}

export interface INumberTypeParam extends ITypeParam {
  postFix: string;
}

export interface IDateTimeTypeParam extends ITypeParam {
  format: string;
}

import {
  AfterViewInit,
  Component,
  ContentChild,
  ContentChildren,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  OnInit,
  Optional,
  Output,
  QueryList,
  ViewChild,
} from '@angular/core';
import {
  ColumnDefinition,
  ColumnType,
  IColumnDefinition,
  IDateTimeTypeParam,
  INumberTypeParam,
} from '../definitions/column-definition';
import { UntypedFormControl, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { SelectionModel } from '@angular/cdk/collections';
import { merge } from 'rxjs';
import { debounceTime, tap } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { ColumnTemplateDirective } from './directives/column-template.directive';
import { ActionTemplateDirective } from './directives/action-template.directive';
import { Platform } from '@angular/cdk/platform';
import { AbstractFormComponent } from 'src/app/core/base/abstract-form-component';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { IEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/core/entity-ref';
import { SortDirection } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { SortDirection as APISortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { MatSort, SortDirection as MatSortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { HeaderTemplateDirective } from './directives/header-template.directive';
import moment from 'moment';
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { MatTableDataSource } from '@angular/material/table';
import { MatPaginator } from '@angular/material/paginator';

type IFormControlList = Record<string, UntypedFormGroup | UntypedFormControl>;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-mat-datatable-old',
  templateUrl: './mat-datatable-old.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./mat-datatable.component.scss'],
})
export class MatDatatableOldComponent implements OnInit, AfterViewInit {
  private dataResponse: IDataTableResponse | undefined;
  private _multiple = false;

  multipleSelection: SelectionModel<any> | undefined;
  singleSelection: SelectionModel<any> | undefined;

  dataSource: MatTableDataSource<any> = new MatTableDataSource<any>();
  columnType = ColumnType;
  filters: IFormControlList = {} as IFormControlList;
  selection: SelectionModel<any> | undefined;
  hasFilter = false;
  showHistoricalData = false;

  onDoubleClickCallback: ((ctx: any, row: any, event: any, i: any) => void)[] = [];
  onToogleCallbacks: ((row: any) => void)[] = [];

  @Input('readonly') _readonly = false;
  @Input() serverSide = true;
  @Input() columns: ColumnDefinition[] | undefined;
  @Input() sortActive = '';
  @Input() sortDirection: MatSortDirection = 'asc';
  @Input('pageIndex') _pageIndex = 0;
  @Input('pageSize') _pageSize = 10;
  @Input() isLoading = false;
  @Input('borderLess') borderless = false;
  @Input()
  set multiple(value: boolean) {
    if (this._multiple != value) {
      if (value) this.selection = this.multipleSelection;
      else this.selection = this.singleSelection;
    }
    this._multiple = value;
  }
  get multiple(): boolean {
    return this._multiple;
  }

  @Input() selected: IEntityRef[] = [];

  @ViewChild(MatSort, { static: true }) protected sort: MatSort | null = null;
  @ViewChild(MatPaginator, { static: false }) protected paginator: MatPaginator | null = null;

  @ContentChild(ActionTemplateDirective) actionTemplate: ActionTemplateDirective | undefined;
  @ContentChild(HeaderTemplateDirective) headerTemplate: HeaderTemplateDirective | undefined;
  @ContentChildren(ColumnTemplateDirective) customColumnTemplates: QueryList<ColumnTemplateDirective> | undefined;

  @Output() change = new EventEmitter<any>();
  @Output() rowsRendered = new EventEmitter<any>();

  get pageIndex(): number {
    return this.paginator?.pageIndex ?? 0;
  }

  get pageSize(): number {
    return this.paginator?.pageSize ?? 10;
  }

  @Input() set data(value: IDataTableResponse | undefined) {
    if (value) {
      if (this.pageIndex * this.pageSize > value.recordsTotal) {
        if (this.paginator !== null) {
          this.paginator.pageIndex = Math.floor(value.recordsTotal / this.pageSize);
          if (value.recordsTotal % this.pageSize === 0) this.paginator.pageIndex--;
        }
        this.change.emit();
      }
      this.dataSource.data = value.items;
      this.dataResponse = value;
    }
  }

  get data(): IDataTableResponse | undefined {
    return this.dataResponse;
  }

  @Input() set dataArray(value: any[]) {
    if (value) {
      this.dataResponse = {
        items: value,
        recordsTotal: value.length,
      } as IDataTableResponse;
      this.refresh();
    }
  }

  get count(): number {
    return this.dataResponse ? this.dataResponse.recordsTotal : 0;
  }

  readonly isEmpty = false;

  @Input() noPaging = false;

  get displayedColumns(): string[] {
    const columns: string[] = new Array<string>();
    if (this.columns !== undefined)
      for (const column of this.columns) {
        if (column.columnName) columns.push(column.columnName);
      }
    return columns;
  }

  get displayedFilterColumns(): string[] {
    const columns: string[] = new Array<string>();
    if (this.columns !== undefined)
      for (const column of this.columns) {
        columns.push(`${column.columnName}-filter`);
      }
    return columns;
  }

  get readonly() {
    return this._readonly || this.parent?.readonly || false;
  }

  constructor(public platform: Platform, @Optional() protected parent?: AbstractFormComponent) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.singleSelection = new SelectionModel(false, this.selected);
    this.multipleSelection = new SelectionModel(true, this.selected);
    if (this.multiple) this.selection = this.multipleSelection;
    else this.selection = this.singleSelection;
    if (this.columns !== undefined)
      for (const column of this.columns) {
        if (column.filterable) {
          this.hasFilter = true;
          let filter;
          if (column.columnType == ColumnType.Date)
            filter = new UntypedFormGroup({
              start: new UntypedFormControl(
                column.filterValue && column.filterValue.start ? column.filterValue.start : '',
              ),
              end: new UntypedFormControl(column.filterValue && column.filterValue.end ? column.filterValue.end : ''),
            });
          else
            filter = new UntypedFormControl(
              column.columnType === this.columnType.Dropdown ? column.filterValue || [] : column.filterValue || '',
            );
          filter.valueChanges.pipe(debounceTime(100)).subscribe((x) => {
            this.change.emit();
          });
          if (column.columnName) this.filters[column.columnName] = filter;
        }
      }
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    if (!this.serverSide) {
      this.dataSource.sort = this.sort;
      this.dataSource.sortData = (items: any[], sort: MatSort) => this.clientSideSorting(items, sort, this.columns!);
      this.dataSource.paginator = this.paginator;
    }
    if (this.sort && this.paginator)
      merge(this.sort.sortChange, this.paginator.page)
        .pipe(tap(() => this.change.emit()))
        .subscribe();
  }

  public refresh() {
    if (this.dataResponse) {
      this.dataSource.data = this.dataResponse.items;
    } else this.dataSource.data = [];

    this.afterRowsAreRendered();
  }

  public setPageIndex(index: number) {
    if (this.paginator) this.paginator.pageIndex = index;
  }

  public setPageSize(size: number) {
    if (this.paginator) this.paginator.pageSize = size;
  }

  public getSort(): string {
    return this.sort?.active ? this.sort.active : '';
  }

  public setSort(column: string) {
    if (this.sort) this.sort.active = column;
  }

  public getSortDirection(): SortDirection | undefined {
    return this.sort?.direction === 'asc' ? SortDirection?.Ascending : SortDirection?.Descending;
  }

  public getApiSortDirection(): APISortDirection {
    return this.sort?.direction === 'asc' ? APISortDirection.Ascending : APISortDirection.Descending;
  }

  public setSortDirection(sortDirection: SortDirection) {
    if (this.sort) this.sort.direction = sortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending ? 'asc' : 'desc';
  }

  public getFormGroup(columnName?: string): UntypedFormGroup {
    if (columnName === undefined) throw 'columnName is undefined.';
    return this.filters[columnName] as UntypedFormGroup;
  }

  public getFormControl(columnName?: string): UntypedFormControl {
    if (columnName === undefined) throw 'columnName is undefined.';
    return this.filters[columnName] as UntypedFormControl;
  }

  public addClickCallback(callBack: (row: any) => void): void {
    this.onToogleCallbacks.push(callBack);
  }

  public setActionRowVisibility() {
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.mat-row');
    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const actionColumn = row.querySelector('.datatable-action-row');
      if (actionColumn) {
        row.addEventListener(
          'mouseover',
          () => {
            if (!row.classList.contains('no-action-on-datatable-row'))
              (actionColumn as any)['style'].visibility = 'visible';
          },
          false,
        );
        row.addEventListener(
          'mouseout',
          () => {
            (actionColumn as any)['style'].visibility = 'hidden';
          },
          false,
        );
      }
    });
  }

  toggleRow(row: any) {
    this.onToogleCallbacks.filter((cb) => cb && typeof cb === 'function').forEach((cb) => cb(row));

    if (this.selection) {
      if (row.hasOwnProperty!('id')) {
        if (this.selection?.selected)
          for (const s of this.selection.selected) {
            if (s.id === (row as any).id) {
              this.selection.toggle(s);
              return;
            }
          }
        this.selection.toggle(row);
      } else this.selection.toggle(row);
    }
  }

  select(row: any) {
    if (this.selection) {
      if (row.hasOwnProperty!('id')) {
        if (this.selection?.selected)
          for (const s of this.selection.selected) {
            if (s.id === (row as any).id) {
              this.selection.select(s);
              return;
            }
          }
        this.selection.select(row);
      } else this.selection.select(row);
    }
  }

  isSelected(row: any) {
    if (this.selection) {
      if (row.hasOwnProperty!('id'))
        for (const s of this.selection.selected) {
          if (s.id === (row as any).id) {
            return true;
          }
        }
      else return this.selection.isSelected(row);
    }
    return false;
  }

  isAllSelected() {
    let isAllSelected = !!this.dataSource.data.length;
    this.dataSource.data.forEach((row) => (isAllSelected = isAllSelected && this.isSelected(row)));
    return isAllSelected;
  }

  masterToggle() {
    if (this.selection) {
      if (this.isAllSelected()) {
        this.selection.clear();
      } else {
        this.dataSource.data.forEach((row) => this.selection?.select(row));
      }
    }
  }

  dblClickOnRow(row: any, $event: any, i: any) {
    this.onDoubleClickCallback.filter((cb) => cb && typeof cb === 'function').forEach((cb) => cb(null, row, $event, i));
  }

  clientSideSorting(items: any[], sort: MatSort, columns: ColumnDefinition[]) {
    const active = sort?.active ?? -1;

    if (!sort.active || sort.direction === '') {
      return items;
    }

    if (sort != undefined && items && items.length > 0 && (active || (active as any) != -1)) {
      const column = columns.find((x) => x.columnName == sort?.active);

      if (sort.direction == 'asc') {
        if (column!.columnType == ColumnType.Date) {
          items = items.sort((a, b) =>
            a[active] == b[active]
              ? 0
              : a[active] == null
              ? 1
              : b[active] == null
              ? -1
              : new Date(a[active]).getTime() > new Date(b[active]).getTime()
              ? -1
              : 1,
          );
        } else if (column!.columnType == ColumnType.Number) {
          items = items.sort((a, b) => (a[active] == b[active] ? 0 : a[active] > b[active] ? 1 : -1));
        } else
          items = items.sort((a, b) =>
            a[active] == b[active]
              ? 0
              : a[active] == null
              ? 1
              : b[active] == null
              ? -1
              : a[active].localeCompare(b[active], 'hu'),
          );
      } else {
        if (column!.columnType == ColumnType.Date) {
          items = items.sort((a, b) =>
            (
              a[active] == b[active]
                ? 0
                : a[active] == null
                ? -1
                : b[active] == null
                ? 1
                : new Date(a[active]).getTime() > new Date(b[active]).getTime()
            )
              ? 1
              : -1,
          );
        } else if (column!.columnType == ColumnType.Number) {
          items = items.sort((a, b) => (a[active] == b[active] ? 0 : b[active] > a[active] ? 1 : -1));
        } else
          items = items.sort((a, b) =>
            a[active] == b[active]
              ? 0
              : a[active] == null
              ? -1
              : b[active] == null
              ? 1
              : b[active].localeCompare(a[active], 'hu'),
          );
      }
    }
    return items;
  }

  afterRowsAreRendered() {
    const data = this.dataSource.data;
    const renderedRows = document.getElementsByClassName('mat-datatable-row-custom');

    const timeout = setInterval(() => {
      if (data.length > 0 && (this.pageSize == renderedRows.length || data.length == renderedRows.length)) {
        clearInterval(timeout);
        this.rowsRendered.emit();
      }
    }, 20);
  }

  formattedData(column: IColumnDefinition, value: any) {
    let formatted = value;
    const params = column.parameters;

    switch (column.columnType) {
      case ColumnType.DateTime: {
        if (!value) break;

        const format = (params as IDateTimeTypeParam)?.format || 'yyyy.MM.DD HH:mm';
        formatted = moment(value).format(format);
        break;
      }
      case ColumnType.Number:
        formatted = new DecimalPipe('hu-HU').transform(formatted, '0.0-3');
        if (params) {
          const format = (params as INumberTypeParam).postFix;
          formatted = `${formatted} ${format}`;
        }
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }

    return formatted;
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\core\components\datatable\mat-datatable\mat-datatable.component.ts
