import { Component, ContentChild, ContentChildren, EventEmitter, Input, OnInit, Optional, Output, QueryList, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ColumnDefinition,
  ColumnType,
  IColumnDefinition,
  IDateTimeTypeParam,
  INumberTypeParam,
} from '../definitions/column-definition';
import { UntypedFormControl, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { SelectionModel } from '@angular/cdk/collections';
import { debounceTime, switchMap, tap } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { ColumnTemplateDirective } from './directives/column-template.directive';
import { ActionTemplateDirective } from './directives/action-template.directive';
import { Platform } from '@angular/cdk/platform';
import { AbstractFormComponent } from 'src/app/core/base/abstract-form-component';
import { IEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/core/entity-ref';
import { IDataTableRequest, SortDirection as DTSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { MatSort, Sort, SortDirection as MatSortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { HeaderTemplateDirective } from './directives/header-template.directive';
import moment from 'moment';
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { MatTableDataSource } from '@angular/material/table';
import { MatPaginator, PageEvent } from '@angular/material/paginator';
import { Observable, Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';

type IFormControlList = Record<string, UntypedFormGroup | UntypedFormControl>;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-mat-datatable',
  templateUrl: './mat-datatable.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./mat-datatable.component.scss'],
})
export class MatDatatableComponent implements OnInit {
  private _multiple = false;

  private _refresh$ = new Subject();

  multipleSelection: SelectionModel<any> | undefined;
  singleSelection: SelectionModel<any> | undefined;

  dataSource: MatTableDataSource<any> = new MatTableDataSource<any>();
  columnType = ColumnType;
  filters: IFormControlList = {} as IFormControlList;
  selection: SelectionModel<any> | undefined;
  hasFilter: boolean = false;
  showHistoricalData: boolean = false;
  isLoading: boolean = false;
  isFirstLoadCompleted: boolean = false;

  onDoubleClickCallback: ((ctx: any, row: any, event: any, i: any) => void)[] = [];
  onToogleCallbacks: ((row: any) => void)[] = [];

  itemsCount = 0;
  dataTableRequest: IDataTableRequest = {
    sortColumn: undefined,
    sortDirection: DTSortDirection.Ascending,
    pageSize: 10,
    pageIndex: 0,
    isDeleted: false,
  };

  @Input() dataRequest!: (params: IDataTableRequest) => Observable<IDataTableResponse>;

  @Input('readonly') _readonly = false;
  @Input() serverSide = true;
  @Input() classNames: string[] = [];
  @Input() columns: ColumnDefinition[] | undefined;
  @Input('borderLess') borderless = false;
  @Input()
  set multiple(value: boolean) {
    if (this._multiple != value) {
      if (value) this.selection = this.multipleSelection;
      else this.selection = this.singleSelection;
    }
    this._multiple = value;
  }
  get multiple(): boolean {
    return this._multiple;
  }

  @Input() selected: IEntityRef[] = [];

  @ViewChild(MatSort, { static: true }) protected sort: MatSort | null = null;
  @ViewChild(MatPaginator, { static: false })
  protected paginator: MatPaginator | null = null;

  @ContentChild(ActionTemplateDirective) actionTemplate: ActionTemplateDirective | undefined;
  @ContentChild(HeaderTemplateDirective) headerTemplate: HeaderTemplateDirective | undefined;
  @ContentChildren(ColumnTemplateDirective) customColumnTemplates: QueryList<ColumnTemplateDirective> | undefined;

  readonly isEmpty = false;

  @Input() noPaging = false;
  
  /**
   * DataTable-ból vissza lehessen kapni a sorokat
   */
  @Output() responseEvent = new EventEmitter();
  @Output() responseErrorEvent = new EventEmitter();

  get displayedColumns(): string[] {
    const columns: string[] = new Array<string>();
    if (this.columns !== undefined)
      for (const column of this.columns) {
        if (column.columnName) columns.push(column.columnName);
      }
    return columns;
  }

  get displayedFilterColumns(): string[] {
    const columns: string[] = new Array<string>();
    if (this.columns !== undefined)
      for (const column of this.columns) {
        columns.push(`${column.columnName}-filter`);
      }
    return columns;
  }

  get readonly() {
    return this._readonly || this.parent?.readonly || false;
  }

  constructor(public platform: Platform, @Optional() protected parent?: AbstractFormComponent) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.singleSelection = new SelectionModel(false, this.selected);
    this.multipleSelection = new SelectionModel(true, this.selected);
    if (this.multiple) this.selection = this.multipleSelection;
    else this.selection = this.singleSelection;
    if (this.columns !== undefined)
      for (const column of this.columns) {
        if (column.filterable) {
          this.hasFilter = true;
          let filter;
          if (column.columnType == ColumnType.Date)
            filter = new UntypedFormGroup({
              start: new UntypedFormControl(
                column.filterValue && column.filterValue.start ? column.filterValue.start : '',
              ),
              end: new UntypedFormControl(column.filterValue && column.filterValue.end ? column.filterValue.end : ''),
            });
          else
            filter = new UntypedFormControl(
              column.columnType === this.columnType.Dropdown ? column.filterValue || [] : column.filterValue || '',
            );
          filter.valueChanges.pipe(debounceTime(100)).subscribe((x) => {
            this.refreshEvent();
          });
          if (column.columnName) this.filters[column.columnName] = filter;
        }
      }

    this.subscribeToRefresh();
    this.refreshEvent();
  }

  private subscribeToRefresh() {
    this._refresh$
      .pipe(
        tap(() => {
          this.isLoading = true;
        }),
        debounceTime(200),
        switchMap(() => this.dataRequest(this.dataTableRequest)),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (data) => {
          this.isLoading = false;
          this.dataSource.data = data.items;
          this.itemsCount = data.recordsTotal;
          if (!this.isFirstLoadCompleted) this.isFirstLoadCompleted = true;

          this.responseEvent.emit(this.dataSource.data);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.isLoading = false;
          console.error(error)
          this.responseErrorEvent.emit(error);
          // Ha a stream hibára fut, akkor a feliratkozás megszűnik, így újra fel kell iratkozni.
          this.subscribeToRefresh();
          if (!this.isFirstLoadCompleted) this.isFirstLoadCompleted = true;
        },
      });
  }

  get sortDirection(): MatSortDirection {
    return this.dataTableRequest.sortDirection === DTSortDirection.Ascending ? 'asc' : 'desc';
  }

  sortTable(sort: Sort) {
    if (sort.direction === '') {
      sort.direction = 'asc';
    }

    this.dataTableRequest.sortColumn = sort.active;
    this.dataTableRequest.sortDirection =
      sort.direction === 'asc' ? DTSortDirection.Ascending : DTSortDirection.Descending;

    this.refreshEvent();
  }

  pageChange(pageEvent: PageEvent) {
    this.dataTableRequest.pageIndex = pageEvent.pageIndex;
    this.dataTableRequest.pageSize = pageEvent.pageSize;

    this.refreshEvent();
  }

  refreshEvent() {
    this._refresh$.next(null);
  }

  public getFormGroup(columnName?: string): UntypedFormGroup {
    if (columnName === undefined) throw 'columnName is undefined.';
    return this.filters[columnName] as UntypedFormGroup;
  }

  public getFormControl(columnName?: string): UntypedFormControl {
    if (columnName === undefined) throw 'columnName is undefined.';
    return this.filters[columnName] as UntypedFormControl;
  }

  toggleRow(row: any) {
    this.onToogleCallbacks.filter((cb) => cb && typeof cb === 'function').forEach((cb) => cb(row));

    if (this.selection) {
      if (row.hasOwnProperty('id')) {
        if (this.selection?.selected)
          for (const s of this.selection.selected) {
            if (s.id === (row as any).id) {
              this.selection.toggle(s);
              return;
            }
          }
        this.selection.toggle(row);
      } else this.selection.toggle(row);
    }
  }

  isSelected(row: any) {
    if (this.selection) {
      if (row.hasOwnProperty('id'))
        for (const s of this.selection.selected) {
          if (s.id === (row as any).id) {
            return true;
          }
        }
      else return this.selection.isSelected(row);
    }
    return false;
  }

  isAllSelected() {
    let isAllSelected = !!this.dataSource.data.length;
    this.dataSource.data.forEach((row) => (isAllSelected = isAllSelected && this.isSelected(row)));
    return isAllSelected;
  }

  masterToggle() {
    if (this.selection)
      this.isAllSelected()
        ? this.selection.clear()
        : this.dataSource.data.forEach((row) => this.selection?.select(row));
  }

  dblClickOnRow(row: any, $event: any, i: any) {
    this.onDoubleClickCallback.filter((cb) => cb && typeof cb === 'function').forEach((cb) => cb(null, row, $event, i));
  }

  formattedData(column: IColumnDefinition, value: any) {
    let formatted = value;
    const params = column.parameters;

    switch (column.columnType) {
      case ColumnType.DateTime:
        if (!value) break;

        const format = (params as IDateTimeTypeParam)?.format || 'yyyy.MM.DD HH:mm';
        formatted = moment(value).format(format);
        break;
      case ColumnType.Number:
        formatted = new DecimalPipe('hu-HU').transform(formatted, '0.0-3');
        if (params) {
          const format = (params as INumberTypeParam).postFix;
          formatted = `${formatted} ${format}`;
        }
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }

    return formatted;
  }
}

import { Directive, Host, HostListener, Optional, Renderer2, Self, ViewContainerRef } from '@angular/core';
import { MatPaginator, PageEvent } from '@angular/material/paginator';

//https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-wyx2ue-ayitwa?file=app%2Fpaginator-overview-example.html

@Directive({
  selector: '[appStylePaginator]',
})
export class StylePaginatorDirective {
  @HostListener('page', ['$event'])
  onChange(event: PageEvent) {
    this.initPageSizes();
  }

  constructor(
    @Host() @Self() @Optional() private matPag: MatPaginator,
    private vr: ViewContainerRef,
    private ren: Renderer2,
  ) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.initPageSizes();
    }, 0);
  }

  private initPageSizes(): void {
    const element = this.vr.element.nativeElement.querySelector('div.mat-paginator-page-size');
    element.innerHTML = '';

    for (let i = 0; i < this.matPag.pageSizeOptions.length; i++) {
      this.ren.appendChild(element, this.createPageSizeButton(this.matPag.pageSizeOptions[i], this.matPag.pageSize));
    }
  }

  private createPageSizeButton(n: number, pageSize: number): any {
    const button = this.ren.createElement('button');
    this.ren.listen(button, 'click', (evt) => {
      this.switchPageSize(n);
    });
    const text = this.ren.createText('' + n);
    button.classList.add(
      'btn',
      'mat-focus-indicator',
      'mat-button',
      'mat-flat-button',
      'mat-button-base',
      'mat-page-size-button',
      'p-0',
    );
    if (n === pageSize) {
      button.classList.add('mat-primary');
    }
    this.ren.appendChild(button, text);
    return button;
  }

  private switchPageSize(i: number): void {
    if (this.matPag.pageSize !== i) {
      this.matPag.pageSize = i;
      this.matPag._changePageSize(this.matPag.pageSize);
    }
  }
}

import { Pipe, PipeTransform, QueryList, TemplateRef } from '@angular/core';
import { ColumnTemplateDirective } from '../directives/column-template.directive';

@Pipe({
  name: 'getCustomTemplate',
})
export class GetCustomTemplatePipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(customColumnTemplates?: QueryList<ColumnTemplateDirective>, name?: string): TemplateRef<any> | null {
    return customColumnTemplates?.find((item) => item.name == name)?.templateRef ?? null;
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\core\components\datatable\mat-datatable\pipes\has-column-template.pipe.ts
====================================================================================================

import { Pipe, PipeTransform, QueryList } from '@angular/core';
import { ColumnTemplateDirective } from '../directives/column-template.directive';

@Pipe({
  name: 'hasColumnTemplate',
})
export class HasColumnTemplatePipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(customColumnTemplates?: QueryList<ColumnTemplateDirective>, name?: string): boolean {
    if (!customColumnTemplates) {
      return true;
    }
    return customColumnTemplates?.find((item) => item.name === name) ? true : false;
  }
}

import { Component, Inject, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
export interface MatDialogData {
  message?: string;
  confirmButtonText?: string;
  cancelButtonText?: string;
  isDelete?: boolean;
  showConfirmButton?: boolean;
  showCancelBtn?: boolean;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-confirm-dialog',
  templateUrl: './confirm-dialog.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./confirm-dialog.component.scss'],
})
export class ConfirmDialogComponent implements OnInit {
  message = 'GLOBAL.CONFIRM_DIALOG.MESSAGE';
  confirmButtonText = 'GLOBAL.CONFIRM_DIALOG.YES';
  cancelButtonText = 'GLOBAL.CONFIRM_DIALOG.NO';
  isDelete = true;
  showConfirmButton = true;
  showCancelBtn = true;

  constructor(@Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) data: MatDialogData, private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<ConfirmDialogComponent>) {
    if (data) {
      this.message = data.message || this.message;
      this.confirmButtonText = data.confirmButtonText || this.confirmButtonText;
      this.cancelButtonText = data.cancelButtonText || this.cancelButtonText;
      this.isDelete = data.isDelete || this.isDelete;
      if (data.showConfirmButton != undefined) this.showConfirmButton = data.showConfirmButton;
      if (data.showCancelBtn != undefined) this.showCancelBtn = data.showCancelBtn;
    }
  }

  onConfirmClick(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close(true);
  }

  ngOnInit() {}

  showCancelButton(): boolean {
    return this.showCancelBtn;
  }

  showOkButton(): boolean {
    return this.showConfirmButton;
  }
}

export function openConfirmDialog(dialog: MatDialog, message: string): Observable<any> {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.data = { message: message };

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { Component, Inject, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { ConfirmRequest } from './ConfirmRequest';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';

export interface DoubleConfirmDialogData {
  messageKey: any;
  confirmationKey: any;
  messageParam: any;
  elementId: any;
  service: any;
  deleteFunc: any;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-double-confirm-dialog',
  templateUrl: './double-confirm-dialog.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./double-confirm-dialog.component.scss'],
})
export class DoubleConfirmDialogComponent implements OnInit {
  firstTry = true;

  messageKey?: string;
  confirmationKey?: string;
  messageParam?: string;
  elementId?: number;
  service: any;
  deleteFunc?: (id: number, body?: ConfirmRequest) => any;

  constructor(
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) data: DoubleConfirmDialogData,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<DoubleConfirmDialogComponent>,
  ) {
    if (data) {
      this.messageKey = data.messageKey;
      this.confirmationKey = data.confirmationKey;
      this.messageParam = data.messageParam;
      this.elementId = data.elementId;
      this.service = data.service;
      this.deleteFunc = data.deleteFunc;
    }
  }

  onConfirmClick(): void {
    this.deleteFunc?.call(this.service, this.elementId!, { id: this.elementId!, confirmed: !this.firstTry }).subscribe({
      next: () => this.dialogRef.close(true),
      error: () => {
        this.firstTry = false;
      },
    });

    // this.service.
    //
    // this.service.deleteFunc(this.elementId, {id: this.elementId, confirmed: !this.firstTry}).subscribe({
    //   next: () => this.dialogRef.close(true),
    //   error: () => {
    //     this.firstTry = false;
    //   }
    // })
  }

  ngOnInit() {}
}

export function openDoubleConfirmDialog(
  dialog: MatDialog,
  messageKey: string,
  confirmationKey: string,
  messageParam: string,
  elementId: number,
  service: any,
  deleteFunc: (id: number, body?: ConfirmRequest) => Observable<any>,
): Observable<any> {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.data = {
    messageKey: messageKey,
    confirmationKey: confirmationKey,
    messageParam: messageParam,
    elementId: elementId,
    service: service,
    deleteFunc: deleteFunc,
  } as DoubleConfirmDialogData;

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(DoubleConfirmDialogComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { Component, Inject } from '@angular/core';
import { FormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

export interface InstitutionHierarchyFormDialogData {
  form: FormGroup;
  formArrayIndex?: number;
  useMeasureEndpointSeparator: boolean;
  useMeasureEndpoint: boolean;
  useMeasureData: boolean;
  useMeasureProperty: boolean;
  isReadonly: boolean;
  isCreate: boolean;
  instantLoad: boolean;
  isBilling: boolean;
  title: string;
}

@Component({
  templateUrl: './institution-hierarchy-form-dialog.component.html',
})
export class InstitutionHierarchyFormDialogComponent {
  form!: FormGroup;
  useMeasureEndpointSeparator = false;
  useMeasureEndpoint = true;
  useMeasureData = false;
  useMeasureProperty = true;
  isReadonly = false;
  isCreate = false;
  instantLoad = false;
  isBilling = false;
  formArrayIndex?: number;
  title: string = '';

  constructor(
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) data: InstitutionHierarchyFormDialogData,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<InstitutionHierarchyFormDialogComponent>,
  ) {
    this.form = data.form;
    this.formArrayIndex = data.formArrayIndex;
    this.useMeasureEndpointSeparator = data.useMeasureEndpointSeparator;
    this.useMeasureEndpoint = data.useMeasureEndpoint;
    this.useMeasureData = data.useMeasureData;
    this.useMeasureProperty = data.useMeasureProperty;
    this.isReadonly = data.isReadonly;
    this.isCreate = data.isCreate;
    this.instantLoad = data.instantLoad;
    this.isBilling = data.isBilling;
    this.title = data.title;
  }

  saveHandler() {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.valid) {
      this.dialogRef.close({ form: this.form, formArrayIndex: this.formArrayIndex });
    }
  }

  closeHandler() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }
}

export function openInstitutionHierarchyFormDialog(
  dialog: MatDialog,
  data: InstitutionHierarchyFormDialogData,
): Observable<{ form: FormGroup; formArrayIndex: number | undefined } | undefined> {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.maxWidth = '40%';
  config.minWidth = '600px';
  config.data = data;

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(InstitutionHierarchyFormDialogComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { Component, Inject, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

export interface MatNotificationDetailDialogData {
  title: string;
  detail: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-notification-detail-dialog',
  templateUrl: './notification-detail-dialog.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./notification-detail-dialog.component.scss'],
})
export class NotificationDetailDialogComponent implements OnInit {
  detail: string;
  title: string;
  constructor(
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) data: MatNotificationDetailDialogData,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<NotificationDetailDialogComponent>,
  ) {
    this.title = data.title;
    this.detail = data.detail;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  onConfirmClick(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close(true);
  }
}

export function openNotificationDetailDialog(dialog: MatDialog, detail: string, title: string): Observable<any> {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.maxWidth = '40%';
  config.minWidth = '400px';
  config.data = { detail: detail, title: title } as MatNotificationDetailDialogData;

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(NotificationDetailDialogComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { Component, Inject, Injector, OnDestroy, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable, Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import {
  NotificationModel,
  NotificationService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { openNotificationDetailDialog } from '../notification-detail-dialog/notification-detail-dialog.component';
import { WorkerStore } from 'src/app/core/worker-data-store/worker-store';
import {
  MAT_DIALOG_DATA,
  MatDialog,
  MatDialogConfig,
  MatDialogRef,
} from '@angular/material/dialog';

export interface MatNotificationListDialogData {
  notifications: NotificationModel[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-notification-list-dialog',
  templateUrl: './notification-list-dialog.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./notification-list-dialog.component.scss'],
})
export class NotificationListDialogComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  notifications: NotificationModel[];
  protected dialog: MatDialog;
  private subs = new Subscription();

  constructor(
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) data: MatNotificationListDialogData,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<NotificationListDialogComponent>,
    injector: Injector,
    private workerStore: WorkerStore,
    private notificationService: NotificationService
  ) {
    this.notifications = data.notifications;
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.subs.add(
      this.workerStore.execChange.subscribe((items: NotificationModel[]) => {
        this.notifications = items;
      })
    );
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  onConfirmClick(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close(true);
  }

  openNotification(notification: any) {
    openNotificationDetailDialog(
      this.dialog,
      notification.description,
      notification.title
    );

    if (!notification.isRead) {
      this.notificationService
        .notificationSetNotificationRead(notification.id)
        .subscribe(() => this.getNotifications());
      this.workerStore.notificationChange(this.notifications);
    }
  }

  getNotifications() {
    this.notificationService
      .notificationsGetNotifications()
      .subscribe((value) => {
        this.notifications = value;
      });
  }
}

export function openNotificationListDialog(
  dialog: MatDialog,
  notifications: NotificationModel[]
): Observable<any> {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.maxWidth = '40%';
  config.minWidth = '400px';
  config.data = {
    notifications: notifications,
  } as MatNotificationListDialogData;

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(NotificationListDialogComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { Component, Inject, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { AuthenticateService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/authenticate.service';
import { SelectListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/selectListItemDto';

export interface TenantSelectionDialogData {
  tenants: SelectListItemDto[];
  selectedTenantCode?: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tenant-selection-dialog',
  templateUrl: './tenant-selection-dialog.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./tenant-selection-dialog.component.scss'],
})
export class TenantSelectionDialogComponent implements OnInit {
  tenants: SelectListItemDto[] = [];
  selectedTenantCode: string | null = null;

  constructor(
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<TenantSelectionDialogComponent>,
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) public data: TenantSelectionDialogData,
    private authenticateService: AuthenticateService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.data?.tenants) {
      this.tenants = this.data.tenants;
    }
    if (this.data?.selectedTenantCode) {
      this.selectedTenantCode = this.data.selectedTenantCode;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send selected tenant code to parent component
   */
  selectTenant(): void {
    // We can have a null tenant selection which is valid
    if (this.selectedTenantCode !== undefined) {
      if (this.selectedTenantCode === null) {
        // For null tenant, find it in the list or create a mock tenant object with proper name
        const nullTenant = this.tenants.find((t) => t.code === null);
        if (nullTenant) {
          // Use the actual null tenant from the list with its server-provided name
          this.dialogRef.close(nullTenant);
        } else {
          // Fallback if somehow null tenant isn't in the list
          const fallbackNullTenant: SelectListItemDto = {
            code: undefined,
            name: 'No Tenant',
          };
          this.dialogRef.close(fallbackNullTenant);
        }
      } else {
        // For regular tenants, find the tenant in the list
        const selectedTenant = this.tenants.find((t) => t.code === this.selectedTenantCode);
        this.dialogRef.close(selectedTenant);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Close dialog without selecting a tenant
   */
  cancel(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-field-error-message',
  templateUrl: './field-error-message.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./field-error-message.component.css'],
})
export class FieldErrorMessageComponent implements OnInit {
  // eslint-disable-next-line @angular-eslint/no-input-rename
  @Input('for')
  set setFormControl(value: UntypedFormControl) {
    if (value) {
      this.formControl = value;
    }
  }
  formControl!: UntypedFormControl;
  // eslint-disable-next-line @angular-eslint/no-input-rename
  @Input('innerError') innerErrorKey!: string;
  // @Output() click = new EventEmitter<any>();

  get hasInnerError() {
    return !!this.formControl.errors && !!this.formControl.errors['innerErrors'];
  }

  get uniqueServerError(): any[] {
    if (
      !!this.formControl?.errors &&
      !!this.formControl?.errors['serverError'] &&
      Array.isArray(this.formControl.errors['serverError'])
    )
      return [...new Set(this.formControl.errors['serverError'].map((item) => item))];
    return this.formControl?.errors ? this.formControl?.errors['serverError'] : [];
  }

  get innerError(): string {
    if (!this.hasInnerError) return '';
    const pathArray = this.innerErrorKey.split('.');
    let value;
    let part = this.formControl.errors!['innerErrors'];
    let keyPrefix = '';
    for (const key of pathArray) {
      let k = key;
      if (keyPrefix) k = keyPrefix + k;
      value = part[k];
      if (!value) keyPrefix = k + '.';
      else part = value;
    }
    return value || '';
  }

  constructor() {}

  ngOnInit(): void {}
}

import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnInit, Output, OnChanges } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FavouritesService } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/favourites.service';
import { FavouriteEntityListItemDto, FavouritesRequest } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/models';
import { ConfirmDialogComponent } from '../dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Component({
  selector: 'favourite-quickaccess',
  templateUrl: './favourite-quickaccess.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./favourite-quickaccess.component.scss'],
})
export class FavouriteQuickaccessComponent implements OnInit, OnChanges {
  items = Array<FavouriteEntityListItemDto>();
  isDeleteOn = false;
  private formBuilder!: UntypedFormBuilder;
  public form: UntypedFormGroup = null as any;
  @Output() changeEmitter: EventEmitter<any> = new EventEmitter<any>();
  @Output() refreshEmitter: EventEmitter<boolean> = new EventEmitter<boolean>();
  @Input() refresh!: boolean;

  constructor(private favouritesService: FavouritesService, private dialog: MatDialog, private router: Router) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getItems();
  }

  edit() {
    this.isDeleteOn = !this.isDeleteOn;
  }

  delete(item: FavouriteEntityListItemDto) {
    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, {
      width: '300px',
      panelClass: 'confirm-dialog-container',
      disableClose: false,
      data: {
        message: 'Biztosan törli?',
        confirmButtonText: 'Igen',
        cancelButtonText: 'Mégse',
        isDelete: true,
      },
    });

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.favouritesService.favouritesDeleteFavourite(item.id!).subscribe(() => {
          this.getItems();
          this.isDeleteOn = false;
          this.changeEmitter.emit();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  getItems() {
    this.items = [];
    this.favouritesService
      .favouritesGetAll({
        type: 'Device',
      } as FavouritesRequest)
      .subscribe((favourites) => {
        this.items = [...this.items, ...favourites];
      });
  }

  navigateToItem(item: FavouriteEntityListItemDto) {
    if (!this.isDeleteOn && item) {
      switch (item.type) {
        case 'Device':
          this.router.navigate(['devices/iot/' + item.identifier + '/view']);
          break;
        case 'Site':
          this.router.navigate(['partner/sites/' + item.identifier + '/edit']);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnChanges() {
    if (this.refresh) {
      this.getItems();
      this.refreshEmitter.emit(true);
    }
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Input, Output, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { Constants } from '../../constants';
import { MatFormFieldAppearance } from '@angular/material/form-field';

/**
 * File(ok) kezeléséhez használt közös control komponens.
 *
 * @usageNotes
 * Egyszerű felhasználás 1 file feltöltéséhez:
 * ```html
 * <app-file-upload-control
 *  [labelName]="Csatolmány"
 *  [control]="form.controls.files"
 * ></app-file-upload-control>
 * ```
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-file-upload-control',
  templateUrl: './file-upload-control.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./file-upload-control.component.scss'],
})
export class FileUploadControlComponent {
  @Input() control: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl();
  @Input() appearance: MatFormFieldAppearance = Constants.FORMFIELD_APPEARANCE;
  @Input() labelName?: string;

  /**
   * <mat-form-field> tagnek megadott statikus class attribútuma. _(sima 'class' attribútum)_
   */
  @Input() classString = '';

  /**
   * Egy vagy több filet lehet-e kijelölni. _(input mező 'multiple' attribútuma)_
   *
   * @notes
   * Default: `false`.
   */
  @Input() multiple = false;

  /**
   * Esemény amikor kiválasztjuk a fileokat. `ThrDokumentum[]` típust ad vissza.
   */
  @Output() filesLoaded = new EventEmitter<File[]>();

  chipControl = new UntypedFormControl();
  fileListNames = '';
  documentList: File[] = [];

  constructor() {}

  fileChangedHandler(event: Event) {
    const fileList = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).files;

    if (!fileList) return;

    // Clear the existing documentList before adding new files
    this.documentList = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < fileList?.length; i++) {
      this.documentList.push(fileList.item(i)!);
    }

    this.control.setValue(this.documentList);
    this.filesLoaded.emit(this.documentList);
  }

  removeChip(file: File, index: number) {
    this.documentList.splice(index, 1);
    this.control.setValue(this.documentList);
  }

  getFileName(file: File) {
    // TODO ha túl hosszú akkor kipontozni a szöveget és a file size jobbra igazítva mindig látszódjon.
    return `${file.name} (${Math.round(file.size / 1024)} Kb)`;
  }

  @ViewChild('fileUpload') fileUpload!: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  clearInputValue() {
    this.documentList = [];
    this.control.setValue(null);
    this.filesLoaded.emit([]);

    // Reset the file input element to allow selecting the same file again
    if (this.fileUpload) {
      this.fileUpload.nativeElement.value = '';
    }
  }
}

====================================================================================================

import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnChanges, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl, UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { debounceTime, filter, Observable, ReplaySubject, Subject, takeUntil, tap } from 'rxjs';
import { EntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/core/entity-ref';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-common-input-filter-select',
  templateUrl: './common-input-filter-select.component.html',
})
export class CommonInputFilterSelectComponent implements OnInit, OnChanges {
  @Input() control!: AbstractControl;

  @Input() multiple = false;
  @Input() filterEvent?: (string: string, paramId?: string) => Observable<any>;
  @Input() paramId?: string; // egyes api hívásoknál kell?
  @Input() allowEmptyFilter = false;
  @Input() triggerDropdown = false;
  @Input() bindLabel!: string;
  @Input() title? = 'Kérem válasszon';
  @Input() inputSize = '';

  @Output() dropdownEvent = new EventEmitter<any>();

  filteringCtrl = new UntypedFormControl();
  searching = false;
  _onDestroy = new Subject<void>();
  options: ReplaySubject<EntityRef[]> = new ReplaySubject<EntityRef[]>(1);

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (!this.multiple) {
      this.control.valueChanges.subscribe(() => this.filteringCtrl.patchValue(''));
    }

    this.filteringCtrl.valueChanges
      .pipe(
        filter((search) => !!search || this.allowEmptyFilter),
        tap(() => (this.searching = true)),
        debounceTime(500),
        takeUntil(this._onDestroy),
      )
      .subscribe(
        (search: string) => {
          if (this.filterEvent)
            this.filterEvent(search, this.paramId ? this.paramId : undefined).subscribe((data: EntityRef[]) => {
              if (!data) data = [];
              if (this.control.value && this.multiple) {
                data = this.filterSelectedFromData(this.control.value, data);
              } else if (this.control.value) {
                data = this.filterSelectedFromData([this.control.value], data);
              }
              this.searching = false;

              this.options.next(data);
            });
        },
        (_error) => {
          this.searching = false;
        },
      );
  }

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    if (this.control.value) {
      if (this.multiple) this.options.next(this.control!.value);
      else {
        this.options.next([this.control!.value]);
      }
    }
  }

  private filterSelectedFromData(value: any, data: EntityRef[]) {
    value.forEach((item: EntityRef) => {
      data = data.filter((dataItem) => dataItem.id !== item.id);
    });
    data = value.concat(data);
    return data;
  }

  triggerDropdownEvent(event: any): void {
    if (this.triggerDropdown) this.filteringCtrl.setValue('');
    this.dropdownEvent.emit(event);
  }

  clearValue(event: any) {
    this.control.patchValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
    event.stopPropagation();
  }

  getLabel(option: EntityRef) {
    return option.entityDisplayName;
  }
}

import { LiveAnnouncer } from '@angular/cdk/a11y';
import { COMMA, ENTER } from '@angular/cdk/keycodes';
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  inject,
  Input,
  OnInit,
} from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl, FormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatChipEditedEvent, MatChipInputEvent } from '@angular/material/chips';

@Component({
  selector: 'common-input-chips',
  templateUrl: './common-input-chips.component.html',
  styleUrl: './common-input-chips.component.scss',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class CommonInputChipsComponent implements OnInit {
  @Input() control!: AbstractControl;
  @Input() labelName!: string;
  @Input() items: string[] = [];

  data: string[] = [];
  disabled = false;

  readonly addOnBlur = true;
  readonly separatorKeysCodes = [ENTER, COMMA] as const;
  readonly announcer = inject(LiveAnnouncer);

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Inicializáljuk a chip-listát
    this.data = [...this.items];
    this.disabled = this.control.disabled;

    // Ha a control üres, állítsuk be a kezdeti értéket
    if (!this.control.value || !Array.isArray(this.control.value)) {
      this.control.setValue([...this.data]);
    }
  }

  add(event: MatChipInputEvent): void {
    const value = (event.value || '').trim();

    if (value) {
      const newItem = value;
      this.data.push(newItem);
      this.control.setValue([...this.data]);
      this.control.markAsDirty();
    }

    event.chipInput?.clear();
  }

  remove(item: any): void {
    const index = this.data.indexOf(item);
    if (index >= 0) {
      this.data.splice(index, 1);
      this.control.setValue([...this.data]);
      this.control.markAsDirty();
      this.announcer.announce(`Removed ${item.name}`);
    }
  }

  edit(item: any, event: MatChipEditedEvent): void {
    const value = event.value.trim();
    const index = this.data.indexOf(item);

    if (!value) {
      this.remove(item);
    } else if (index >= 0) {
      this.data[index] = value;
      this.control.setValue([...this.data]);
      this.control.markAsDirty();
    }
  }
}

import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { MAT_MOMENT_DATE_ADAPTER_OPTIONS, MomentDateAdapter } from '@angular/material-moment-adapter';
import { DateAdapter, MAT_DATE_FORMATS, MAT_DATE_LOCALE } from '@angular/material/core';
import { MatDatepicker, MatDatepickerInputEvent } from '@angular/material/datepicker';
import _moment from 'moment';
import { default as _rollupMoment, Moment } from 'moment';

const moment = _rollupMoment || _moment;

export const MY_FORMATS = {
  parse: {
    dateInput: 'MM/YYYY',
  },
  display: {
    dateInput: 'MM/YYYY',
    monthYearLabel: 'MMM YYYY',
    dateA11yLabel: 'LL',
    monthYearA11yLabel: 'MMMM YYYY',
  },
};

@Component({
  selector: 'app-common-input-month-year',
  templateUrl: './common-input-month-year.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./common-input-month-year.component.scss'],
  providers: [
    {
      provide: DateAdapter,
      useClass: MomentDateAdapter,
      deps: [MAT_DATE_LOCALE, MAT_MOMENT_DATE_ADAPTER_OPTIONS],
    },

    { provide: MAT_DATE_FORMATS, useValue: MY_FORMATS },
  ],
})
export class CommonInputMonthYearComponent implements OnInit {
  @Input() title: string | undefined;
  @Input() control!: UntypedFormControl;
  @Input() name: string | undefined;
  @Input() placeholder: string | undefined;
  @Input() inputSize = '';

  @Output() change = new EventEmitter<Moment>();

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (!this.control) this.control = new UntypedFormControl(this._transformValue(moment()));
    else {
      this.control.setValue(this._transformValue(moment(this.control.value)));
    }
  }

  setMonthAndYear(normalizedMonthAndYear: Moment, datepicker: MatDatepicker<Moment>) {
    datepicker.close();

    const value = this._transformValue(normalizedMonthAndYear)!;
    this.control.setValue(value);
    this.change.emit(value);
  }

  private _transformValue(moment: Moment): Moment | null {
    if (!moment.isValid()) return null;

    moment.date(1);

    return moment;
  }

  changeEvent(event: MatDatepickerInputEvent<any>) {
    const value = this._transformValue(moment(event.value))!;
    this.control.setValue(value);
    this.change.emit(value);
  }
}

import { Component, Input, AfterViewInit } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl, UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-common-input-number',
  templateUrl: './common-input-number.component.html',
})
export class CommonInputNumberComponent implements AfterViewInit {
  get postfix(): string | undefined {
    if (this._postfix) return ' ' + this._postfix;

    return this._postfix;
  }

  @Input()
  set postfix(value: string | undefined) {
    this._postfix = value;
  }

  @Input() title: string | undefined;
  @Input() control: AbstractControl = new UntypedFormControl();
  @Input() name: string | undefined;
  @Input() placeholder: string | undefined;
  @Input() inputSize = '';
  private _postfix: string | undefined;

  ngAfterViewInit() {
    this.control.patchValue(this.control.value ? Number(this.control.value) : null, {
      emitEvent: false,
      emitModelToViewChange: false,
    });
    this.subscribeToValueChange();
  }

  private subscribeToValueChange() {
    this.control.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      this.control.patchValue(value ? Number(String(value)) : null, { emitEvent: false, emitModelToViewChange: false });
    });
  }
}

import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatRadioChange } from '@angular/material/radio';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-common-input-radio',
  templateUrl: './common-input-radio.component.html',
})
export class CommonInputRadioComponent implements OnInit {
  @Input() layout = 'column';
  @Input() control!: AbstractControl;
  @Input() bindLabel!: string;
  @Input() isEnum = false;
  @Input() disabled = false;
  @Input()
  set options(value: any[]) {
    this._options = value;

    if (this.control) {
      const realValue = this.getVal(this.control.value);
      if (realValue !== undefined)
        this.control.setValue(realValue, {
          emitEvent: false,
        });
    }
  }

  get options(): any[] {
    return this._options;
  }

  @Output() change = new EventEmitter<MatRadioChange>();

  private _options!: any[];
  private static index = 0;
  private readonly _name;

  constructor() {
    this._name = 'opionListGroup_' + CommonInputRadioComponent.index++;
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    this.control.valueChanges.subscribe((newValue) => {
      const realValue = this.getVal(newValue);
      if (realValue !== undefined)
        this.control.setValue(realValue, {
          emitEvent: false,
        });
    });

    if (this.control.value != null && this.control.value != undefined) {
      const realValue = this.getVal(this.control.value);
      if (realValue !== undefined)
        this.control.setValue(realValue, {
          emitEvent: false,
        });
    }
  }

  get name() {
    return this._name;
  }

  changeEvent(event: MatRadioChange) {
    this.change.emit(event);
  }

  private getVal(val: any): any {
    let out: any;

    if (this.options)
      this.options.forEach((option) => {
        const a1 = JSON.stringify(option);
        const b = JSON.stringify(val);

        if (a1 === b) {
          out = option;
        }
      });
    return out;
  }
}

import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatSelectChange } from '@angular/material/select';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-common-input-select',
  templateUrl: './common-input-select.component.html',
})
export class CommonInputSelectComponent implements OnInit {
  @Input() options!: any[];
  @Input() control!: AbstractControl;
  @Input() title? = 'Kérem válasszon';
  @Input() isMultiple = false;
  @Input() bindLabel!: string;
  @Input() bindValue!: string;
  @Input() inputSize = '';
  @Input() disabled = false;
  @Input() setFirstValue = false;
  @Input() valueClearable = true;

  @Output() change = new EventEmitter<MatSelectChange>();

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.setFirstValue) {
      this.control.setValue(this.options[0][this.bindValue]);
    }
  }

  public entityRefComparisonFunction = (option: any, value: any) => {
    return (
      value &&
      ((!!option.id && option.id === value.id) ||
        (!!option.value && option.value === value) ||
        (!!option.value && option.code === value) ||
        (!!option.identifier && option.identifier === value.identifier) ||
        (!!this.bindValue && option === value) ||
        option === value)
    );
  };

  clearValue(event: any) {
    this.control.patchValue(null, { emitEvent: true });
    event.stopPropagation();

    this.change.emit({ value: null } as MatSelectChange);
  }

  changeEvent(event: MatSelectChange) {
    this.change.emit(event);
  }
}

import { Component, Input, OnInit, ViewChild, AfterViewInit, ElementRef } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { map, Observable, startWith } from 'rxjs';
import { MatAutocompleteTrigger } from '@angular/material/autocomplete';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-common-input-select-autocomplete',
  templateUrl: './common-input-select-autocomplete.component.html',
})
export class CommonInputSelectAutocompleteComponent implements OnInit, AfterViewInit {
  @Input() control!: AbstractControl;
  @Input() options!: any[];
  @Input() bindLabel!: string;
  @Input() title? = 'Kérem válasszon';
  @Input() inputSize = '';
  @Input() openOnFocus = true;

  @ViewChild(MatAutocompleteTrigger) autocompleteTrigger!: MatAutocompleteTrigger;
  @ViewChild('autocompleteInput') autocompleteInput!: ElementRef;

  filteredOptions!: Observable<any>;
  private selectionJustMade = false;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.filteredOptions = this.control.valueChanges.pipe(
      startWith(''),
      map((value) => {
        // Check if this is a value change from selection
        if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
          this.selectionJustMade = true;
          // Reset flag after a short delay
          setTimeout(() => {
            this.selectionJustMade = false;
          }, 300);
        }
        
        // Always return all options on initial load
        if (value === '') {
          return this.options || [];
        }
        return this.filterValue(value && value[this.bindLabel] ? value[this.bindLabel] : value || '');
      }),
    );
  }

  ngAfterViewInit() {
    // Add a small delay to ensure component is fully initialized
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.autocompleteTrigger && this.openOnFocus) {
        // Trigger initial filtering to show all options
        this.control.updateValueAndValidity();
      }
    }, 100);
  }

  displayFn(option: any) {
    return option ? option[this.bindLabel] : undefined;
  }

  clearValue() {
    this.control.setValue('');
  }

  // Focus handler to open dropdown
  onFocus() {
    // Don't open dropdown if selection was just made
    if (this.openOnFocus && !this.selectionJustMade) {
      // Force an empty value to show all options
      const currentValue = this.control.value;

      // Add multiple timeouts to ensure it works consistently
      setTimeout(() => {
        // First force a panel open
        if (this.autocompleteTrigger) {
          this.autocompleteTrigger.openPanel();

          // Then try a different approach if needed
          setTimeout(() => {
            // If panel still not open, try updating form control
            this.control.updateValueAndValidity();
            this.autocompleteTrigger.openPanel();

            // Restore original value if needed
            if (currentValue !== this.control.value) {
              this.control.setValue(currentValue, { emitEvent: false });
            }
          }, 50);
        }
      }, 20);
    }
  }

  private filterValue(value: string): any {
    if (!value || value === '') {
      // Return all options when no input value
      return this.options || [];
    }

    const filterValue = value.toLowerCase();
    return this.options.filter((option) => option[this.bindLabel]?.toLowerCase().includes(filterValue));
  }
}

import { Component, Input, Output, EventEmitter, OnInit, OnChanges, SimpleChanges } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl, FormControl } from '@angular/forms';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-common-input-switch',
  templateUrl: './common-input-switch.component.html',
})
export class CommonInputSwitchComponent implements OnInit, OnChanges {
  @Input() label: string | undefined;
  @Input() control: AbstractControl | null = null;
  @Input() checked = false;
  @Input() disabled = false;

  @Output() change = new EventEmitter<boolean>();

  internalControl: FormControl = new FormControl(false);

  ngOnInit() {
    if (this.control) {
      this.internalControl = this.control as FormControl;
    } else {
      this.internalControl.setValue(this.checked, { emitEvent: false });

      this.internalControl.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
        this.change.emit(value);
      });
    }

    // Apply disabled state to the control
    if (this.disabled) {
      this.internalControl.disable();
    } else {
      this.internalControl.enable();
    }
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges) {
    if (changes['checked'] && !this.control) {
      this.internalControl.setValue(this.checked, { emitEvent: false });
    }

    // Handle changes to the disabled property
    if (changes['disabled']) {
      if (this.disabled) {
        this.internalControl.disable();
      } else {
        this.internalControl.enable();
      }
    }
  }
}

import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl, UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-common-input-text',
  styleUrls: ['./common-input-text.component.scss'],
  templateUrl: './common-input-text.component.html',
})
export class CommonInputTextComponent implements OnInit {
  // For handling null values
  // private handleNullValues(): void {
  //   if (this.control?.value === null || this.control?.value === undefined || this.control?.value === 'null') {
  //     this.control.setValue('', { emitEvent: false });

  @Input() placeholder: string | undefined;
  @Input() maxlength: number | undefined;
  @Input() allowNumbers = true;
  @Input() isPhone = false;
  @Input() isEmail = false;
  @Input() inputSize = '';
  @Input() type = '';
  @Input() isVisibilitiyIcon = false;
  @Input() isCancelIcon = false;
  @Input() hide = true;
  @Input() isPwInput = false;
  @Input() tooltip: string | undefined;
  @Input() latitue = false;
  @Input() longitude = false;
  @Input() disabled = false;
  @Input() mask?: string;
  @Input() showMaskTyped = true;
  @Input() userName = false;
  @Input() personName = false;
  @Input() isTaxId = false;
  @Input() isCompanyRegNum = false;

  pwStengthText = '';
  prefix?: string;

  bar0?: string;
  bar1?: string;
  bar2?: string;
  bar3?: string;

  @Output() hidePwdEmitter = new EventEmitter<boolean>();

  private EMAIL_REGEX =
    /^(([^<>()[\]\\.,;:\s@áéíóöőúüű"]+(\.[^<>()[\]\\.,;:\s@áéíóöőúüű"]+)*)|(".+"))@((\[[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\])|(([a-zA-Z\-0-9]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}))$/;
  private PHONE_REGEX = /^(?:-|\()?(\d{1,2})(?:-|\))?(\d{3})-?(\d{3,4})$/;
  private LATITUDE = /^-?([1-8]?\d(?:\.\d{1,7})?|90(?:\.0{1,6})?)$/;
  private LONGITUDE = /^-?((?:1[0-7]|[1-9])?\d(?:\.\d{1,7})?|180(?:\.0{1,})?)$/;
  private USERNAME = /^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,63}$/;
  private NAME = /^[a-zA-Zá-űÁ-Ű ]{1,63}$/;
  // Regex patterns for values with hyphens
  private TAX_ID_REGEX = /^\d{8}-\d-\d{2}$/; // Format with hyphens: 25978221-2-42
  private COMPANY_REG_REGEX = /^\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{6}$/; // Format with hyphens: 01-01-123456

  // Regex patterns for raw numeric values (without hyphens)
  private TAX_ID_REGEX_RAW = /^\d{11}$/; // Format without hyphens: 25978221242
  private COMPANY_REG_REGEX_RAW = /^\d{10}$/; // Format without hyphens: 0101123456

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Handle null values before applying any formatting
    //this.handleNullValues();
    const strength = {
      0: 'Rossz',
      1: 'Nagyon gyenge',
      2: 'Gyenge',
      3: 'Jó',
      4: 'Erős',
    };

    const createPatternValidator = (pattern?: RegExp) => {
      return (control: AbstractControl): Record<string, any> | null => {
        const value = control.value;
        const valueToCheck = typeof value === 'object' && value?.value ? value.value : value;

        if (!valueToCheck) {
          return null;
        }

        // For tax ID and company reg number fields, check both formatted and raw patterns
        if (this.isTaxId) {
          // Check if the value has enough characters to be complete
          // Remove all non-digit characters for comparison with raw pattern
          const numericValue = valueToCheck.replace(/\D/g, '');

          // Valid if it matches either the formatted pattern (with hyphens) OR raw pattern (just digits)
          if (this.TAX_ID_REGEX.test(valueToCheck) || this.TAX_ID_REGEX_RAW.test(numericValue)) {
            return null; // Valid
          } else {
            return { pattern: { requiredPattern: this.TAX_ID_REGEX.toString(), actualValue: value } };
          }
        } else if (this.isCompanyRegNum) {
          // Check if the value has enough characters to be complete
          // Remove all non-digit characters for comparison with raw pattern
          const numericValue = valueToCheck.replace(/\D/g, '');

          // Valid if it matches either the formatted pattern (with hyphens) OR raw pattern (just digits)
          if (this.COMPANY_REG_REGEX.test(valueToCheck) || this.COMPANY_REG_REGEX_RAW.test(numericValue)) {
            return null; // Valid
          } else {
            return { pattern: { requiredPattern: this.COMPANY_REG_REGEX.toString(), actualValue: value } };
          }
        } else {
          // Normal validation for other field types
          return pattern?.test(valueToCheck)
            ? null
            : { pattern: { requiredPattern: pattern?.toString(), actualValue: value } };
        }
      };
    };

    const validators = this.control.validator;

    if (validators) {
      if (this.isEmail) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.EMAIL_REGEX), validators]);
      } else if (this.isPhone) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.PHONE_REGEX), validators]);
      } else if (this.latitue) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.LATITUDE), validators]);
      } else if (this.longitude) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.LONGITUDE), validators]);
      } else if (this.userName) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.USERNAME), validators]);
      } else if (this.personName) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.NAME), validators]);
      } else if (this.isTaxId) {
        // For Tax ID, we pass null as the pattern since our validation logic is custom
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(undefined), validators]);
      } else if (this.isCompanyRegNum) {
        // For Company Reg Num, we pass null as the pattern since our validation logic is custom
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(undefined), validators]);
      } else {
        this.control.setValidators([validators]);
      }
    } else {
      if (this.isEmail) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.EMAIL_REGEX)]);
      } else if (this.isPhone) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.PHONE_REGEX)]);
      } else if (this.latitue) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.LATITUDE)]);
      } else if (this.longitude) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.LONGITUDE)]);
      } else if (this.userName) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.USERNAME)]);
      } else if (this.personName) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.NAME)]);
      } else if (this.isTaxId) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.TAX_ID_REGEX)]);
      } else if (this.isCompanyRegNum) {
        this.control.setValidators([createPatternValidator(this.COMPANY_REG_REGEX)]);
      }
    }

    this.control.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (this.isPhone) {
      this.mask = '999999999';
      this.prefix = '+36';
    }

    if (this.isTaxId) {
      this.prefix = '';
      this.mask = '00000000-0-00';
    }

    if (this.isCompanyRegNum) {
      this.prefix = '';
      this.mask = '00-00-000000';
    }

    if (this.isPwInput) {
      this.control.valueChanges.subscribe(() => {
        const zxcvbn = require('zxcvbn');
        const result = zxcvbn(this.control.value);

        if (!this.control.value) {
          this.bar0 = '';
          this.bar1 = '';
          this.bar2 = '';
          this.bar3 = '';
        } else {
          switch (result.score) {
            case 0:
              this.bar0 = 'red';
              this.bar1 = '';
              this.bar2 = '';
              this.bar3 = '';
              break;
            case 1:
              this.bar0 = 'red';
              this.bar1 = '';
              this.bar2 = '';
              this.bar3 = '';
              break;
            case 2:
              this.bar0 = 'yellow';
              this.bar1 = 'yellow';
              this.bar2 = '';
              this.bar3 = '';
              break;
            case 3:
              this.bar0 = 'orange';
              this.bar1 = 'orange';
              this.bar2 = 'orange';
              this.bar3 = '';
              break;
            case 4:
              this.bar0 = 'green';
              this.bar1 = 'green';
              this.bar2 = 'green';
              this.bar3 = 'green';
              break;
          }
        }
        if (this.control.value !== '') {
          this.pwStengthText = (strength as any)[result.score];
        } else {
          this.pwStengthText = '';
        }
      });
    }
  }

  hidePwd(value: boolean) {
    this.hidePwdEmitter.emit(value);
  }

  resetInput() {
    this.control.reset();
    // When resetting, ensure we don't show 'null'
    //this.handleNullValues();
  }
}

import { Directive, ElementRef, HostListener } from '@angular/core';
import { NgControl } from '@angular/forms';

@Directive({
  selector: '[forbidNumbersDirective]',
})
export class ForbidNumbersDirective {
  constructor(
    private elementRef: ElementRef,
    private control: NgControl,
  ) {}

  @HostListener('input', ['$event']) onInputChange(event: InputEvent) {
    const initalValue = this.elementRef.nativeElement.value;
    this.elementRef.nativeElement.value = initalValue.replace(/[0-9]/g, '');
    if (initalValue !== this.elementRef.nativeElement.value) {
      event.stopPropagation();
    }
    if (this.control && this.control.control) {
      this.control.control.patchValue(this.elementRef.nativeElement.value);
    }
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\core\components\input\common-input-text\trimOnPasteDirective.ts

import { Directive, HostListener, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';

@Directive({
  selector: '[trimOnPaste]',
})
export class TrimOnPasteDirective {
  @Input() formControl!: UntypedFormControl;

  @HostListener('paste', ['$event'])
  onPaste(event: any): void {
    let pastedInput: string;
    if ((window as any).clipboardData) {
      // Browser is IE
      pastedInput = (window as any).clipboardData.getData('text');
      this.formControl.setValue(pastedInput.trim(), { emitEvent: false });
      event.preventDefault();
    } else if (event.clipboardData && event.clipboardData.getData) {
      // Other browsers
      pastedInput = event.clipboardData.getData('text/plain');
      this.formControl.setValue(pastedInput.trim(), { emitEvent: false });
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }
}

import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { MAT_MOMENT_DATE_ADAPTER_OPTIONS, MomentDateAdapter } from '@angular/material-moment-adapter';
import { DateAdapter, MAT_DATE_FORMATS, MAT_DATE_LOCALE } from '@angular/material/core';
import { MatDatepicker, MatDatepickerInputEvent } from '@angular/material/datepicker';
import _moment from 'moment';
import { default as _rollupMoment, Moment } from 'moment';

const moment = _rollupMoment || _moment;

export const MY_FORMATS = {
  parse: {
    dateInput: 'YYYY',
  },
  display: {
    dateInput: 'YYYY',
    monthYearLabel: 'YYYY',
    dateA11yLabel: 'LL',
    monthYearA11yLabel: 'YYYY',
  },
};

@Component({
  selector: 'app-common-input-year',
  templateUrl: './common-input-year.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./common-input-year.component.scss'],
  providers: [
    {
      provide: DateAdapter,
      useClass: MomentDateAdapter,
      deps: [MAT_DATE_LOCALE, MAT_MOMENT_DATE_ADAPTER_OPTIONS],
    },

    { provide: MAT_DATE_FORMATS, useValue: MY_FORMATS },
  ],
})
export class CommonInputYearComponent implements OnInit {
  @Input() title: string | undefined;
  @Input() control?: UntypedFormControl;
  @Input() name: string | undefined;
  @Input() placeholder: string | undefined;
  @Input() inputSize = '';

  @Output() change = new EventEmitter<Moment>();

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (!this.control) this.control = new UntypedFormControl(this._transformValue(moment()));
    else {
      this.control.setValue(this._transformValue(moment(this.control.value)));
    }
  }

  setYear(normalizedMonthAndYear: Moment, datepicker: MatDatepicker<Moment>) {
    datepicker.close();

    const value = this._transformValue(normalizedMonthAndYear);
    this.control!.setValue(value);
    this.change.emit(value!);
  }

  private _transformValue(moment: Moment): Moment | null {
    if (!moment.isValid()) return null;

    moment.date(1);
    moment.month(0);

    return moment;
  }

  changeEvent(event: MatDatepickerInputEvent<any>) {
    const value = this._transformValue(moment(event.value));
    this.control!.setValue(value);
    this.change.emit(value!);
  }
}

import { Pipe, PipeTransform } from '@angular/core';

@Pipe({
  name: 'bindValue',
})
export class BindValuePipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(value: any, bindValue: string): string {
    if (!bindValue) return value;
    return value ? value[bindValue] : undefined;
  }
}
