import { Component, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import {
  InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef,
  SiteEntityDtoEntityRef,
  SiteLocationEntityDtoGuidEntityRef,
  BuildingEntityDtoEntityRef,
  BuildingPartEntityDtoEntityRef,
  FloorEntityDtoEntityRef,
  RoomEntityDtoEntityRef,
  TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef,
  MeasuredPropertyEntityDtoEntityRef,
  ChannelListItemDto,
  BuildingPartsService,
  BuildingsService,
  DictService,
  FloorsService,
  InstitutionsService,
  MeasurementPointsService,
  RoomsService,
  MeasurementPointEntityDtoEntityRef,
  MeasurementPointEdmChannelIdDto,
  DeviceCategoryModel,
  DeviceTypeModel,
} from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { MeasuredEndpointEntityDtoEntityRef } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/measuredEndpointEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { FormControl, FormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { Subject } from 'rxjs';

@Component({
  selector: 'institution-hierarchy-form',
  templateUrl: './institution-hierarchy-form.component.html',
})
export class InstitutionHierarchyFormComponent implements OnInit {
  @Input() form!: FormGroup;
  @Input() useMeasureEndpointSeparator = false;
  @Input() useMeasureEndpoint = true;
  @Input() useMeasureData = false;
  @Input() useMeasureProperty = true;
  @Input() useDevice = false;
  @Input() isReadonly = false;
  @Input() isCreate = false;
  @Input() instantLoad = false;
  @Input() isBilling? = false;
  @Output() valueChanged = new Subject<void>();

  measureEndpointSeparatorOptions = [
    { text: 'Mérési pont', value: 1 },
    { text: 'Szenzor', value: 2 },
  ];

  institutionRefs?: InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  siteRefs?: SiteEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  siteLocationRefs?: SiteLocationEntityDtoGuidEntityRef[];
  buildingRefs?: BuildingEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  buildingPartRefs?: BuildingPartEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  floorRefs?: FloorEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  roomRefs?: RoomEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  measureEndpointRefs?: MeasuredEndpointEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  chartTitle?: string;
  siteLocationIdentifier?: string;
  measuredDataRefs?: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  measuredPropertyRefs?: MeasuredPropertyEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  deviceCategoryRefs?: DeviceCategoryModel[];
  deviceTypeRefs?: DeviceTypeModel[];
  channelRefs?: ChannelListItemDto[];

  constructor(
    private institutionsService: InstitutionsService,
    private buildingsService: BuildingsService,
    private buildingPartsService: BuildingPartsService,
    private floorsService: FloorsService,
    private roomsService: RoomsService,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private measurementPointsService: MeasurementPointsService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.useMeasureEndpointSeparator) {
      this.form.addControl('measureEndpointSeparator', new FormControl({ value: 1, disabled: this.isReadonly }));
    }

    if (this.isReadonly) {
      this.institutionRefs = [this.form.get('institution')?.value];
      this.siteRefs = [this.form.get('site')?.value];
      this.buildingRefs = [this.form.get('building')?.value];
      this.buildingPartRefs = [this.form.get('buildingPart')?.value];
      this.floorRefs = [this.form.get('floor')?.value];
      this.roomRefs = [this.form.get('room')?.value];
      this.measureEndpointRefs = [this.form.get('measureEndpoint')?.value];
      if (this.useDevice) {
        this.deviceCategoryRefs = [this.form.get('deviceCategory')?.value];
        this.deviceTypeRefs = [this.form.get('deviceType')?.value];
      }
      if (this.useMeasureProperty) this.measuredPropertyRefs = [this.form.get('measuredProperty')?.value];
    } else {
      if (!this.isCreate || this.instantLoad) {
        const controlNames = [
          'institution',
          'site',
          'building',
          'buildingPart',
          'floor',
          'room',
          'measuredData',
          'measureEndpoint',
        ];

        if (this.useMeasureProperty) {
          controlNames.push('measuredProperty');
        }

        if (this.useDevice) {
          controlNames.push('deviceCategory');
          controlNames.push('deviceType');
        }

        let foundFirstNullControl = false;

        controlNames.forEach((controlName) => {
          const control = this.form.get(controlName);

          if (control?.value) {
            control.enable();
          } else if (!foundFirstNullControl && control) {
            control.enable();
            foundFirstNullControl = true;
          }

          switch (controlName) {
            case 'institution': {
              this.getInstitutionRefs(control?.value);
              break;
            }
            case 'site': {
              const institutionValue = this.form.get('institution')!.value;
              if (institutionValue) this.getSiteRefs(institutionValue);
              break;
            }
            case 'building': {
              const siteValue = this.form.get('site')!.value;
              if (siteValue) this.getBuildingRefs(siteValue);
              break;
            }
            case 'buildingPart': {
              const buildingValue = this.form.get('building')!.value;
              if (buildingValue) this.getBuildingPartRefs(buildingValue);
              break;
            }
            case 'floor': {
              const buildingValue = this.form.get('building')!.value;
              if (buildingValue) this.getFloorRefs(buildingValue);
              break;
            }
            case 'room': {
              const floorValue = this.form.get('floor')!.value;
              if (floorValue) this.getRoomRefs(floorValue);
              break;
            }
            case 'measureEndpoint': {
              this.getMeasureEndpointRefs();
              break;
            }
            case 'measuredData': {
              this.getMeasuredDataRefs();
              break;
            }
            case 'measuredProperty': {
              const measureEndpointValue = this.form.get('measureEndpoint')!.value;
              if (measureEndpointValue) this.getMeasuredPropertyRefs(measureEndpointValue.id);
              break;
            }
            case 'deviceCategory': {
              const measuredDataValue = this.form.get('measuredData')!.value;
              const measuredPropertyValue = this.form.get('measuredProperty')!.value;
              this.getDeviceCategoryRefs(measuredDataValue?.id, measuredPropertyValue?.id);
              break;
            }
            case 'deviceType': {
              const measuredDataValue = this.form.get('measuredData')!.value;
              const measuredPropertyValue = this.form.get('measuredProperty')!.value;
              this.getDeviceTypeRefs(measuredDataValue?.id, measuredPropertyValue?.id);
              break;
            }
          }
        });
      } else {
        this.getInstitutionRefs();
        this.getMeasuredDataRefs();
      }

      this.subscribeToValueChanges();
    }
  }

  private getInstitutionRefs(selectedInstitution?: InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef): void {
    if (!this.institutionRefs) {
      this.institutionsService.institutionsGetInstitutionEntityRef().subscribe((institutionRefs) => {
        this.institutionRefs = institutionRefs;

        if (!selectedInstitution) this.form.get('institution')?.setValue(this.institutionRefs[0]);
      });
    }
  }

  private getSiteRefs(selectedInstitution: InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef): void {
    this.institutionsService.institutionsGetSitesEntityRef(selectedInstitution.id!).subscribe((siteRefs) => {
      this.siteRefs = siteRefs;
    });
  }

  private getBuildingRefs(selectedSite: SiteEntityDtoEntityRef): void {
    this.buildingsService.buildingsGetBuildingEntityRef(selectedSite.id).subscribe((buildingRefs) => {
      this.buildingRefs = buildingRefs;
    });
  }

  private getBuildingPartRefs(selectedBuilding: BuildingEntityDtoEntityRef): void {
    this.buildingPartsService
      .buildingPartsGetBuildingPartEntityRef(selectedBuilding.id)
      .subscribe((buildingPartRefs) => {
        this.buildingPartRefs = buildingPartRefs;
      });
  }

  private getFloorRefs(selectedBuilding: BuildingEntityDtoEntityRef): void {
    this.floorsService.floorsGetFloorEntityRef(selectedBuilding.id).subscribe((floorRefs) => {
      this.floorRefs = floorRefs;
    });
  }

  private getRoomRefs(selectedFloor: FloorEntityDtoEntityRef): void {
    this.roomsService.roomsGetRoomEntityRef(selectedFloor.id).subscribe((roomRefs) => {
      this.roomRefs = roomRefs;
    });
  }

  private getMeasuredDataRefs(): void {
    if (!this.measuredDataRefs) {
      this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('measured_data_label').subscribe((dictItems) => {
        this.measuredDataRefs = dictItems;
      });
    }
  }

  private getMeasuredPropertyRefs(measureEndpointId: number | null): void {

    

    const baseHandler = () => {
      if( measureEndpointId ){
        this.measurementPointsService
          .measurementPointsGetMeasuredPropertiesOfMeasurementPoint(measureEndpointId)
          .subscribe((items) => {
            this.measuredPropertyRefs = items;
          });
      }
      else{
      this.measurementPointsService.measurementPointsGetMeasuredProperties().subscribe((items) => {
        this.measuredPropertyRefs = items;
      });
    }
    };

    if (this.useMeasureEndpointSeparator) {
      if (this.fc.measureEndpointSeparator.value == 1) {
        baseHandler();
      } else {
        //TODO mockolt adat
        this.measuredPropertyRefs = [
          { id: 1, entityDisplayName: 'Hőmérséklet' },
          { id: 2, entityDisplayName: 'Páratartalom' },
          { id: 3, entityDisplayName: 'Csapadék mennyisége' },
        ] as MeasuredPropertyEntityDtoEntityRef[];
      }
    } else {
      baseHandler();
    }
  }

  private getMeasureEndpointRefs(): void {
    const orgunitId = this.fc.room.value?.id
      ? this.fc.room.value?.id
      : this.fc.floor.value?.id
      ? this.fc.floor.value?.id
      : this.fc.buildingPart.value?.id
      ? this.fc.buildingPart.value?.id
      : this.fc.building.value?.id
      ? this.fc.building.value?.id
      : this.fc.site.value?.id
      ? this.fc.site.value?.id
      : this.fc.institution.value?.id
      ? this.fc.institution.value?.id
      : null;

    const baseHandler = () =>
      this.measurementPointsService
        .measurementPointsGetMeasurementPointsByOrgunit(orgunitId, this.isBilling)
        .subscribe((measureEndpointRefs) => {
          this.measureEndpointRefs = measureEndpointRefs;
        });

    if (orgunitId) {
      if (this.useMeasureEndpointSeparator) {
        if (this.fc.measureEndpointSeparator.value == 1) {
          baseHandler();
        } else {
          //TODO mockolt adat
          this.measureEndpointRefs = [
            // { id: 1, entityDisplayName: 'TemperatureSensor1' },
            // { id: 2, entityDisplayName: 'HumiditySensor17' },
            // { id: 3, entityDisplayName: 'PrecipitationSensor35' },
          ] as MeasurementPointEntityDtoEntityRef[];
        }
      } else {
        baseHandler();
      }
    } else {
      this.measureEndpointRefs = [];
    }
  }

  private getChannelRefs(measureEndpointId: number, measuredPropertyId: number): void {
    if (this.isBilling) {
      this.measurementPointsService
        .measurementPointsGetMeasurementPointEdmChannelId(measureEndpointId, measuredPropertyId)
        .subscribe((channel) => {
          const channelIdentifierFormControl = this.form.get('channelIdentifier');
          if (channelIdentifierFormControl) {
            channelIdentifierFormControl.setValue(channel.channelId);
          }
        });
    } else {
      this.measurementPointsService
        .measurementPointsGetMeasuredPropertyChannels(measureEndpointId, measuredPropertyId)
        .subscribe((channelRefs) => {
          this.channelRefs = channelRefs;

          const channelIdentifierFormControl = this.form.get('channelIdentifier');
          if (channelIdentifierFormControl && channelRefs.length > 0) {
            channelIdentifierFormControl.setValue(channelRefs[0].identifier);
          }
        });
    }
  }

  private getDeviceCategoryRefs(measuredDataId: number, measuredPropertyId: number): void {
    const orgunitId = this.fc.room.value?.id
      ? this.fc.room.value?.id
      : this.fc.floor.value?.id
      ? this.fc.floor.value?.id
      : this.fc.buildingPart.value?.id
      ? this.fc.buildingPart.value?.id
      : this.fc.building.value?.id
      ? this.fc.building.value?.id
      : this.fc.site.value?.id
      ? this.fc.site.value?.id
      : this.fc.institution.value?.id
      ? this.fc.institution.value?.id
      : null;

    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetDeviceCategoriesByOrgUnit(orgunitId, undefined, undefined, measuredPropertyId, measuredDataId)
      .subscribe((deviceCategories) => {
        this.deviceCategoryRefs = deviceCategories;
      });
  }

  private getDeviceTypeRefs(measuredDataId: number, measuredPropertyId: number): void {
    const orgunitId = this.fc.room.value?.id
      ? this.fc.room.value?.id
      : this.fc.floor.value?.id
      ? this.fc.floor.value?.id
      : this.fc.buildingPart.value?.id
      ? this.fc.buildingPart.value?.id
      : this.fc.building.value?.id
      ? this.fc.building.value?.id
      : this.fc.site.value?.id
      ? this.fc.site.value?.id
      : this.fc.institution.value?.id
      ? this.fc.institution.value?.id
      : null;

    this.measurementPointsService.measurementPointsGetDeviceTypesByOrgUnit(orgunitId,undefined,undefined,measuredPropertyId, measuredDataId).subscribe((deviceTypes) => {
      this.deviceTypeRefs = deviceTypes;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves the measurement point location data for the selected endpoint
   * Updates latitude and longitude form controls with the values from the measurement point
   */
  private getMeasurementPointLocation(measureEndpointId: number): void {
    if (!measureEndpointId) return;

    this.measurementPointsService.measurementPointsGet(measureEndpointId).subscribe({
      next: (response) => {
        if (
          response &&
          response.lat !== undefined &&
          response.lat !== null &&
          response.lon !== undefined &&
          response.lon !== null
        ) {
          // Only set values when both lat and lon are valid
          this.fc.latitude?.setValue(response.lat);
          this.fc.longitude?.setValue(response.lon);
        } else {
          // Clear values if no location data is available
          this.fc.latitude?.setValue(null);
          this.fc.longitude?.setValue(null);
        }
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error retrieving measurement point location:', error);
        // Clear values on error
        this.fc.latitude?.setValue(null);
        this.fc.longitude?.setValue(null);
      },
    });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  private subscribeToValueChanges() {
    this.fc.measureEndpointSeparator?.valueChanges.subscribe(() => {
      this.fc.measureEndpoint.setValue(null);
      if (this.useMeasureProperty) {
        this.fc.measuredProperty.setValue(null);
      }

      this.getMeasureEndpointRefs();
    });

    this.fc.institution.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value) {
        this.getSiteRefs(value);
        this.fc.site.enable({ emitEvent: false });

        this.getMeasureEndpointRefs();
        this.fc.measureEndpoint?.enable({ emitEvent: false });

        this.getMeasuredDataRefs();
        this.fc.measuredData?.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        if(this.useDevice){
          this.getMeasuredPropertyRefs(null);
          this.fc.measuredProperty?.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        }
      } else {
        this.siteRefs = [];
        this.fc.site.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.fc.site.disable({ emitEvent: false });

        this.fc.measureEndpoint.setValue(null, { emitEvent: true });
        this.fc.measureEndpoint.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        
        this.measuredDataRefs = [];
        this.fc.measuredData?.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.fc.measuredData?.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        if(this.useDevice){
          this.measuredPropertyRefs = [];
          this.fc.measuredProperty?.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
          this.fc.measuredProperty?.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        }
      }
      this.fc.building.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.building.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.buildingPart.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.buildingPart.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.floor.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.floor.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.room.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.room.disable({ emitEvent: false });

      this.valueChanged.next();
      if(this.useDevice){
        this.getDeviceCategoryRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceCategory.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.fc.deviceCategory.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.getDeviceTypeRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceType.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.fc.deviceType.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      }
    });
    this.fc.site.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value) {
        this.getBuildingRefs(value);
        this.fc.building.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      } else {
        this.buildingRefs = [];
        this.fc.building.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.fc.building.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      }
      this.fc.buildingPart.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.buildingPart.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.floor.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.floor.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.room.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.room.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.measureEndpoint.setValue(null, { emitEvent: true });
      this.valueChanged.next();
      this.getMeasureEndpointRefs();
      if(this.useDevice){
        this.getDeviceCategoryRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceCategory.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.getDeviceTypeRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceType.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      }
    });

    this.fc.building.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value) {
        this.getBuildingPartRefs(value);
        this.fc.buildingPart.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.fc.buildingPart.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      } else {
        this.buildingPartRefs = [];
        this.fc.buildingPart.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.fc.buildingPart.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      }
      this.fc.floor.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.floor.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.room.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.room.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.measureEndpoint.setValue(null, { emitEvent: true });
      this.valueChanged.next();
      this.getMeasureEndpointRefs();
      if(this.useDevice){
        this.getDeviceCategoryRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceCategory.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.getDeviceTypeRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceType.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      }
    });

    this.fc.buildingPart.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value) {
        this.fc.floor.enable({ emitEvent: false });
        this.getFloorRefs(value);
        this.fc.floor.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      } else {
        this.floorRefs = [];
        this.fc.floor.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.fc.floor.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      }
      this.fc.room.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.room.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.measureEndpoint.setValue(null, { emitEvent: true });
      this.valueChanged.next();
      this.getMeasureEndpointRefs();
      if(this.useDevice){
        this.getDeviceCategoryRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceCategory.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.getDeviceTypeRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceType.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      }
    });

    this.fc.floor.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value) {
        this.getRoomRefs(value);
        this.fc.room.enable({ emitEvent: false });
      } else {
        this.roomRefs = [];
        this.fc.room.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.fc.room.disable({ emitEvent: false });
      }
      this.valueChanged.next();
      this.getMeasureEndpointRefs();
      if(this.useDevice){
        this.getDeviceCategoryRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceCategory.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.getDeviceTypeRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceType.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      }
    });

    this.fc.room.valueChanges.subscribe(() => {
      this.valueChanged.next();
      this.getMeasureEndpointRefs();
      if(this.useDevice){
        this.getDeviceCategoryRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceCategory.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        this.getDeviceTypeRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        this.fc.deviceType.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      }
    });

    this.fc.measureEndpoint.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value) {
        if (this.useMeasureProperty) {
          this.getMeasuredPropertyRefs(value?.id);
          this.fc.measuredProperty.enable();
        }
        // Get location data for selected measurement endpoint
        this.getMeasurementPointLocation(value?.id);
      } else {
        if (this.useMeasureProperty && !this.useDevice) {
          this.fc.measuredProperty.setValue(null);
          this.fc.measuredProperty.disable();
        }
        // Clear location values when no endpoint is selected
        this.fc.latitude?.setValue(null);
        this.fc.longitude?.setValue(null);
        this.valueChanged.next();
      }
    });

    if (this.useMeasureProperty) {
      this.fc.measuredProperty.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
        if (value) {
          this.getDeviceCategoryRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, value?.id);
          this.fc.deviceCategory.enable();
          this.getDeviceTypeRefs(this.fc.measuredData.value?.id, value?.id);
          this.fc.deviceType.enable();
          this.getChannelRefs(this.fc.measureEndpoint.value?.id, value.id);
        }
        else{
          this.deviceCategoryRefs = [];
          this.fc.deviceCategory?.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
          this.fc.deviceCategory?.disable({ emitEvent: false });
          this.deviceTypeRefs = [];
          this.fc.deviceType?.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
          this.fc.deviceType?.disable({ emitEvent: false });
          this.channelRefs = [];
          this.fc.channel?.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
          this.fc.channel?.disable({ emitEvent: false });
        }
        this.valueChanged.next();
      });
    }

    if (this.useMeasureData) {
      this.fc.measuredData.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
        if (value) {
          if (this.useDevice) {
            this.fc.deviceCategory.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
            this.getDeviceCategoryRefs(value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
            this.fc.deviceType.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
            this.getDeviceTypeRefs(value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
          }
          this.getChannelRefs(this.fc.measureEndpoint.value?.id, this.fc.measuredProperty.value?.id);
        }
        else{
          this.deviceCategoryRefs = [];
          this.fc.deviceCategory?.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
          this.deviceTypeRefs = [];
          this.fc.deviceType?.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
          this.channelRefs = [];
          this.fc.channel?.setValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
        }
        this.valueChanged.next();
      }); 
    }
  }
}

import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { InstitutionModel } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/institutionModel';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-institutions-cards',
  templateUrl: './institutions-cards.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./institutions-cards.component.scss'],
})
export class InstitutionsCardsComponent {
  @Input() institutions!: InstitutionModel[];
  @Output() cardClickedEmitter: EventEmitter<InstitutionModel> = new EventEmitter<InstitutionModel>();

  constructor(private router: Router) {}

  newInstitutionClicked() {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/institutions/create']);
  }
}

import { Component, ViewChild, ElementRef, AfterViewInit, Input, OnInit, Optional, OnChanges, SimpleChanges } from '@angular/core';
import * as L from 'leaflet';
import { FormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { EmitService } from '../../services/emit.service';
import { MapCoordinatesInfoModel } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

export interface MapComponentInput {
  lat: number;
  long: number;
  name: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-map',
  templateUrl: './map.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./map.component.scss'],
})
export class MapComponent implements OnInit, AfterViewInit, OnChanges {
  
  @Input() latControl = new FormControl(47.4979); // Default value for latitude
  @Input() longControl = new FormControl(19.0402);
  @Input() multiple = false;
  @Input() data: MapCoordinatesInfoModel[] = [];
  @Input() mapResizeEvent? : Subject<void>;
  @ViewChild('map')
  mapElementRef: ElementRef = null!;
  currentMarker: L.Marker | null = null;
  markers: L.Marker[] = [];

  private customIcon = L.divIcon({
    className: 'custom-div-icon',
    html: `
      <div style="
        width: 40px;
        height: 52px;
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;">
        <div style="
          width: 36px;
          height: 48px;
          background-color: #2196F3;
          border: 2px solid white;
          position: relative;
          clip-path: path('M18 2 C26.2843 2 33 8.71573 33 17 C33 25 18 46 18 46 C18 46 3 25 3 17 C3 8.71573 9.71573 2 18 2 Z');">
          <div style="
            position: absolute;
            top: 9px;
            left: calc(50% - 6px);
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            background-color: white;
            border-radius: 50%;">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`,
    iconSize: [40, 52],
    iconAnchor: [20, 52], // Anchor at the bottom tip
  });

  // Predefined color palette for markers
  private colorPalette: string[] = [
    '#FF5733', // Red-orange
    '#33FF57', // Green
    '#3357FF', // Blue
    '#FF33F5', // Pink
    '#33FFF5', // Cyan
    '#F5FF33', // Yellow
    '#FF8333', // Orange
    '#8333FF', // Purple
    '#33FF99', // Mint
    '#FF3333'  // Red
  ];

  // Map to store consistent colors for marker names
  private markerColors: Map<string, string> = new Map<string, string>();

  private getRandomColor(): string {
    return this.colorPalette[Math.floor(Math.random() * this.colorPalette.length)];
  }

  private getColorForMarker(name: string, index: number): string {
    // If we already assigned a color to this name, return it for consistency
    if (this.markerColors.has(name)) {
      return this.markerColors.get(name)!;
    }
    
    // Otherwise, either use the palette based on index or generate a random color
    let color;
    if (index < this.colorPalette.length) {
      color = this.colorPalette[index];
    } else {
      color = this.getRandomColor();
    }
    
    // Store for future reference
    this.markerColors.set(name, color);
    return color;
  }

  private getCustomIcon(color: string): L.DivIcon {
    return L.divIcon({
      className: 'custom-div-icon',
      html: `
        <div style="
          width: 40px;
          height: 52px;
          position: relative;
          display: flex;
          justify-content: center;
          align-items: center;">
          <div style="
            width: 36px;
            height: 48px;
            background-color: ${color};
            border: 2px solid white;
            position: relative;
            clip-path: path('M18 2 C26.2843 2 33 8.71573 33 17 C33 25 18 46 18 46 C18 46 3 25 3 17 C3 8.71573 9.71573 2 18 2 Z');">
            <div style="
              position: absolute;
              top: 9px;
              left: calc(50% - 6px);
              width: 12px;
              height: 12px;
              background-color: white;
              border-radius: 50%;">
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>`,
      iconSize: [40, 52],
      iconAnchor: [20, 52], // Anchor at the bottom tip
    });
  }

  map: L.Map = null!;
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.mapResizeEvent?.subscribe(() => {
      this.map.invalidateSize();
    });
  }
  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    // Fix Leaflet's default icon path
    L.Icon.Default.imagePath = 'assets/images/';
    this.configureMap();
    
    if (this.multiple) {
      this.renderMultipleMarkers();
    } else {
      this.configureMarkers();

      this.latControl.valueChanges.subscribe((lat: any) => {
        this.updateMarker(lat, this.longControl!.value!);
      });

      this.longControl.valueChanges.subscribe((long: any) => {
        this.updateMarker(this.latControl.value!, long);
      });
    }
  }

  constructor(@Optional() private emitService: EmitService) {
    if(this.emitService) {
      this.emitService.emitSubject.subscribe(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          this.map.invalidateSize();
        });
      });
    }
  }
  
  configureMap(): void {
    let lat = this.multiple && this.data.length > 0 ? this.data[0].latitude : this.latControl.value;
    let long = this.multiple && this.data.length > 0 ? this.data[0].longitude : this.longControl.value;
    if (lat === null) {
      lat = 47.4979;
    }
    if (long === null) {
      long = 19.0402;
    }
    this.map = L.map(this.mapElementRef.nativeElement).setView([lat, long], 14);

    this.map.attributionControl.setPrefix('');

    L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
      maxZoom: 19,
      attribution: '&copy; <a href="http://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>',
    }).addTo(this.map);

    // Add a small delay to ensure the map container is fully sized
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.map.invalidateSize();
    }, 100);
  }

  configureMarkers(): void {
    let lat = this.latControl.value;
    let long = this.longControl.value;
    if (lat === null) {
      lat = 47.4979;
    }
    if (long === null) {
      long = 19.0402;
    }
    this.currentMarker = L.marker([lat, long], { icon: this.customIcon })
      .bindTooltip('Selected Location', { direction: 'top', opacity: 0.9 })
      .bindPopup('Selected Location')
      .addTo(this.map);
  }

  updateMarker(lat: number, long: number): void {
    // Use default coordinates if null values are provided
    const validLat = lat !== null ? lat : 47.4979;
    const validLong = long !== null ? long : 19.0402;

    this.map.setView([validLat, validLong], 14);
    if (this.currentMarker) {
      this.map.removeLayer(this.currentMarker);
    }

    // Add a new marker and store its reference
    this.currentMarker = L.marker([validLat, validLong], { icon: this.customIcon })
      .bindTooltip('Selected Location', { direction: 'top', opacity: 0.9 })
      .bindPopup('Selected Location')
      .addTo(this.map);
  }

  renderMultipleMarkers(): void {
    if (!this.multiple || !this.data || this.data.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    // Clear existing markers
    this.clearAllMarkers();
    // Add all markers from the data array
    this.markers = this.data.map((point, index) => {
      const markerName = point.name || 'Location';
      const color = this.getColorForMarker(markerName, index);
      
      const marker = L.marker([point.latitude, point.longitude], { 
        icon: this.getCustomIcon(color) 
      })
        .bindTooltip(markerName, { direction: 'top', opacity: 0.9 })
        .bindPopup(markerName)
        .addTo(this.map);
      return marker;
    });

    // Fit the map bounds to include all markers if there are multiple markers
    if (this.markers.length > 1) {
      const group = new L.FeatureGroup(this.markers);
      this.map.fitBounds(group.getBounds(), { padding: [30, 30] });
    } else if (this.markers.length === 1) {
      // If there's only one marker, center on it
      this.map.setView([this.data[0].latitude, this.data[0].longitude], 14);
    }
  }

  clearAllMarkers(): void {
    // Remove single marker if it exists
    if (this.currentMarker) {
      this.map.removeLayer(this.currentMarker);
      this.currentMarker = null;
    }

    // Remove all markers from the array
    this.markers.forEach(marker => {
      this.map.removeLayer(marker);
    });
    this.markers = [];
  }

  // Method to update markers when data changes
  updateMarkers(data: MapCoordinatesInfoModel[]): void {
    this.data = data;
    if (this.map) {
      this.renderMultipleMarkers();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Public method to force reload of markers from current data
   * This is useful when you need to refresh the map without changing the data reference
   */
  reloadMarkers(): void {
    if (this.map && this.multiple) {
      this.renderMultipleMarkers();
    }
  }

  // NgOnChanges lifecycle hook to detect changes to the data array
  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes.data && !changes.data.firstChange && this.map) {
      this.renderMultipleMarkers();
    }
    
    if (changes.multiple && !changes.multiple.firstChange && this.map) {
      if (this.multiple) {
        this.renderMultipleMarkers();
      } else {
        this.clearAllMarkers();
        this.configureMarkers();
      }
    }
  }
}

import { Pipe, PipeTransform } from '@angular/core';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';

@Pipe({
  name: 'appTimeToString',
})
export class AppTimeToStringPipe implements PipeTransform {
  constructor(private datePipe: DatePipe) {}

  transform(date?: Date) {
    return date ? this.datePipe.transform(date, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm') : undefined;
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\core\components\pipes\sort-array.pipe.ts
====================================================================================================

import { Pipe, PipeTransform } from '@angular/core';

@Pipe({
  name: 'sort',
})
export class SortArrayPipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(array: any, field: string): any[] {
    if (!Array.isArray(array)) {
      return [];
    }
    array.sort((a: any, b: any) => {
      if (a[field] < b[field]) {
        return -1;
      } else if (a[field] > b[field]) {
        return 1;
      } else {
        return 0;
      }
    });
    return array;
  }
}

import { Component, Input, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { IEntityWithRecurrence } from './IEntityWithRecurrence';
import { RecurrenceType } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/recurrenceType';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-recurrence-descriptor',
  templateUrl: './recurrence-descriptor.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./recurrence-descriptor.component.scss'],
})
export class RecurrenceDescriptorComponent implements OnInit {
  @Input() entity!: IEntityWithRecurrence;

  RecurrenceType = RecurrenceType;

  private dayOptions = [
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.DAYS.MONDAY',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.DAYS.TUESDAY',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.DAYS.WEDNESDAY',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.DAYS.THURSDAY',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.DAYS.FRIDAY',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.DAYS.SATURDAY',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.DAYS.SUNDAY',
  ];

  private monthOptions = [
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.JAN',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.FEBR',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.MARC',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.APRIL',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.MAY',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.JUNE',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.JULY',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.AUG',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.SEPT',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.OCT',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.NOV',
    'GLOBAL.ENUMS.MONTHS.DEC',
  ];

  constructor(private translateService: TranslateService) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  getTime(): Date {
    const time = this.toHoursAndMinutes(this.entity.recurrenceTime!);
    return new Date(2022, 10, 27, time.hours, time.minutes);
  }

  getDay(): string {
    let dayIndex = this.entity.recurrenceDay! - 1;
    if (dayIndex == -1) dayIndex = 6;
    return this.translateService.instant(this.dayOptions[dayIndex]);
  }

  getMonth(): string {
    return this.translateService.instant(this.monthOptions[this.entity.recurrenceMonth! - 1]);
  }

  private toHoursAndMinutes(totalMinutes: number) {
    const hours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
    const minutes = totalMinutes % 60;
    return { hours, minutes };
  }
}

import { Component, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { StateBadge } from './state-badge-enum';

@Component({
  selector: 'state-badge-root',
  templateUrl: './state-badge.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./state-badge.component.scss'],
})
export class StateBadgeComponent {
  StateBadge = StateBadge;

  _stateBadge: StateBadge = null as any;
  get stateBadge(): StateBadge {
    return this._stateBadge;
  }
  @Input() set stateBadge(value: number) {
    switch (value) {
      case 1:
        this._stateBadge = StateBadge.active;
        break;
      case 2:
        this._stateBadge = StateBadge.inActive;
        break;
      case 3:
        this._stateBadge = StateBadge.error;
        break;
      case 4:
        this._stateBadge = StateBadge.locked;
        break;
    }
    this._stateBadge = value;
  }

  constructor() {}
}

import {
  Component,
  ContentChildren,
  EventEmitter,
  Input,
  Output,
  QueryList,
  ViewChild,
  OnInit,
  AfterViewInit,
} from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormArray, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatStepper } from '@angular/material/stepper';
import { StepTemplateDirective } from './directives/step-template.directive';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-stepper',
  templateUrl: './stepper.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./stepper.component.scss'],
})
export class StepperComponent implements OnInit, AfterViewInit {
  @Input() parentFormGroup!: UntypedFormGroup;
  @Input() stepLabels!: string[];
  @Input() orientation = 'horizontal';
  @Input() saveBtnLabel!: string;
  @Input() isView = false;
  disabledSaveBtn = false;
  @Input() selectedStep = 0;
  @ContentChildren(StepTemplateDirective) templates!: QueryList<StepTemplateDirective>;

  @Output() parentFormGroupValueEmitter: EventEmitter<any> = new EventEmitter<any>();
  @ViewChild('stepper') stepper!: MatStepper;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.parentFormGroupValueEmitter.subscribe(() => (this.disabledSaveBtn = true));
    this.parentFormGroup.valueChanges.subscribe(() => (this.disabledSaveBtn = false));
  }

  emitValues() {
    this.parentFormGroupValueEmitter.emit(this.parentFormGroup.getRawValue());
  }

  get parentForm() {
    return (this.parentFormGroup.controls.parentFormArray as UntypedFormArray).controls;
  }

  ngAfterViewInit() {
    this.stepper.selectedIndex = this.selectedStep;
  }
}

import { TemplateRef } from '@angular/core';
import { Pipe, PipeTransform, QueryList } from '@angular/core';
import { StepTemplateDirective } from '../directives/step-template.directive';

@Pipe({
  name: 'stepTemplate',
})
export class StepTemplatePipe implements PipeTransform {
  transform(templates: QueryList<StepTemplateDirective>, index: number): TemplateRef<any> {
    return templates.toArray()[index].template;
  }
}

import { Directive, Input, OnInit, TemplateRef, ViewContainerRef } from '@angular/core';
import { AuthService } from '../../services/security/auth.service';

export interface IRightDefinition {
  requiredSecOperations?: string[];
  currentOrgUnitType?: string;
  requiredRoleType?: string;
}

@Directive({
  selector: '[hasRight],[reqSecOp],[reqRoleType]',
})
export class SecurityHasRightDirective implements OnInit {
  @Input() hasRight?: IRightDefinition;
  @Input()
  set reqSecOp(value: string[]) {
    this.hasRight = {
      currentOrgUnitType: undefined,
      requiredSecOperations: value || [],
      requiredRoleType: undefined,
    };
  }
  @Input()
  set reqRoleType(value: string) {
    this.hasRight = {
      requiredSecOperations: undefined,
      currentOrgUnitType: undefined,
      requiredRoleType: value,
    };
  }

  constructor(
    private templateRef: TemplateRef<any>,
    private viewContainer: ViewContainerRef,
    private authService: AuthService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.updateView();
    this.authService.onChanged().subscribe(() => {
      this.updateView();
    });
  }

  private updateView() {
    this.viewContainer.clear();
    if (this.checkPermission()) {
      this.viewContainer.createEmbeddedView(this.templateRef);
    }
  }

  private checkPermission() {
    if (!this.authService.secOperationMatrix) return false;

    let hasPermission = true;

    if (this.authService.secOperationMatrix) {
      if (this.hasRight?.requiredSecOperations) {
        for (const secOperation of this.hasRight.requiredSecOperations) {
          const secOperationVector = this.authService.secOperationMatrix!.secOperationList!.find(
            (x) => x.secOperation === secOperation,
          );
          let permissionFound = null;
          if (secOperationVector) {
            for (const role of this.authService.user?.roles || []) {
              permissionFound = secOperationVector.secRoleList!.find((x) => x.toUpperCase() === role.toUpperCase());
              if (permissionFound) {
                break;
              }
            }
          } else {
            permissionFound = false;
          }
          if (!permissionFound) hasPermission = false;
        }
      }
    }
    if (this.hasRight?.requiredRoleType) {
      const permissionFound = !!this.authService.user!.roleTypes!.find(
        (x) => x.toLowerCase() == this.hasRight!.requiredRoleType!.toLowerCase(),
      );
      if (!permissionFound) hasPermission = false;
    }

    return hasPermission;
  }
}

import { AbstractControl, ValidationErrors } from '@angular/forms';

export class ErrorHelper {
  static serverErrorHandler(error: any, form: AbstractControl, onErrorCallback: (n: any[]) => void) {
    const lowerFirstLetter = (str: string) => {
      return str.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + str.slice(1);
    };

    const data = error.error;
    if (data && data.errors) {
      let hasGlobalError = false;
      const globalErrors: ValidationErrors = {};
      onErrorCallback(data.errors);
      Object.keys(data.errors).forEach((prop) => {
        // array hack
        const errorKey = prop;
        prop = lowerFirstLetter(prop);
        let globalError = true;
        prop = prop.replace('[', '.');
        prop = prop.replace(']', '');
        const formControl = form.get(prop);
        if (formControl) {
          // activate the error message
          formControl.setErrors({
            serverError: data.errors[errorKey],
          });
          formControl.markAsDirty();
          formControl.markAsTouched();
          globalError = false;
        }
        let propPartial = prop;
        while (propPartial.lastIndexOf('.') >= 0) {
          const propName = (propPartial = propPartial.substr(0, propPartial.lastIndexOf('.')));
          const formControl = form.get(propName);
          if (formControl) {
            // activate the error message
            let errors: ValidationErrors = formControl.errors as any;
            if (!errors) errors = {};
            if (!errors['innerErrors']) errors['innerErrors'] = {};
            const innerErrors: ValidationErrors = errors['innerErrors'];
            for (let key in data.errors) {
              key = lowerFirstLetter(key);
              let propKey = key;
              propKey = propKey.replace('[', '.');
              propKey = propKey.replace(']', '');
              if (propKey.startsWith(propPartial)) {
                innerErrors[propKey.substr(propPartial.length + 1)] = data.errors[key];
              }
            }
            if (!errors['serverError']) errors['serverError'] = [];
            errors['serverError'] = errors['serverError'].concat(data.errors[errorKey]);
            errors['innerErrors'] = innerErrors;
            formControl.setErrors(errors);
            formControl.markAsDirty();
            formControl.markAsTouched();
            globalError = false;
          }
        }
        if (data.type === 'BackEnd') globalError = true;
        if (globalError) {
          globalErrors[errorKey] = data.errors[errorKey];
          hasGlobalError = true;
        }
      });
      if (hasGlobalError) {
        form.setErrors(globalErrors);
      }
    }
  }
}

export interface ConfigurationParameters {
    apiKeys?: {[ key: string ]: string};
    username?: string;
    password?: string;
    accessToken?: string | (() => string);
    basePath?: string;
    withCredentials?: boolean;
}

export class Configuration {
    apiKeys?: {[ key: string ]: string};
    username?: string;
    password?: string;
    accessToken?: string | (() => string);
    basePath?: string;
    withCredentials?: boolean;

    constructor(configurationParameters: ConfigurationParameters = {}) {
        this.apiKeys = configurationParameters.apiKeys;
        this.username = configurationParameters.username;
        this.password = configurationParameters.password;
        this.accessToken = configurationParameters.accessToken;
        this.basePath = configurationParameters.basePath;
        this.withCredentials = configurationParameters.withCredentials;
    }

    /**
     * Select the correct content-type to use for a request.
     * Uses {@link Configuration#isJsonMime} to determine the correct content-type.
     * If no content type is found return the first found type if the contentTypes is not empty
     * @param contentTypes - the array of content types that are available for selection
     * @returns the selected content-type or <code>undefined</code> if no selection could be made.
     */
    public selectHeaderContentType (contentTypes: string[]): string | undefined {
        if (contentTypes.length == 0) {
            return undefined;
        }

        let type = contentTypes.find(x => this.isJsonMime(x));
        if (type === undefined) {
            return contentTypes[0];
        }
        return type;
    }

    /**
     * Select the correct accept content-type to use for a request.
     * Uses {@link Configuration#isJsonMime} to determine the correct accept content-type.
     * If no content type is found return the first found type if the contentTypes is not empty
     * @param accepts - the array of content types that are available for selection.
     * @returns the selected content-type or <code>undefined</code> if no selection could be made.
     */
    public selectHeaderAccept(accepts: string[]): string | undefined {
        if (accepts.length == 0) {
            return undefined;
        }

        let type = accepts.find(x => this.isJsonMime(x));
        if (type === undefined) {
            return accepts[0];
        }
        return type;
    }

    /**
     * Check if the given MIME is a JSON MIME.
     * JSON MIME examples:
     *   application/json
     *   application/json; charset=UTF8
     *   APPLICATION/JSON
     *   application/vnd.company+json
     * @param mime - MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions)
     * @return True if the given MIME is JSON, false otherwise.
     */
    public isJsonMime(mime: string): boolean {
        const jsonMime: RegExp = new RegExp('^(application\/json|[^;/ \t]+\/[^;/ \t]+[+]json)[ \t]*(;.*)?$', 'i');
        return mime != null && (jsonMime.test(mime) || mime.toLowerCase() === 'application/json-patch+json');
    }
}

    import { HttpUrlEncodingCodec } from '@angular/common/http';

/**
* CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec
* Fix plus sign (+) not encoding, so sent as blank space
* See: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/11058#issuecomment-247367318
*/
export class CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec extends HttpUrlEncodingCodec {
    encodeKey(k: string): string {
        k = super.encodeKey(k);
        return k.replace(/\+/gi, '%2B');
    }
    encodeValue(v: string): string {
        v = super.encodeValue(v);
        return v.replace(/\+/gi, '%2B');
    }
}

#!/bin/sh
# ref: https://help.github.com/articles/adding-an-existing-project-to-github-using-the-command-line/
#
# Usage example: /bin/sh ./git_push.sh wing328 swagger-petstore-perl "minor update"

git_user_id=$1
git_repo_id=$2
release_note=$3

if [ "$git_user_id" = "" ]; then
    git_user_id="GIT_USER_ID"
    echo "[INFO] No command line input provided. Set \$git_user_id to $git_user_id"
fi

if [ "$git_repo_id" = "" ]; then
    git_repo_id="GIT_REPO_ID"
    echo "[INFO] No command line input provided. Set \$git_repo_id to $git_repo_id"
fi

if [ "$release_note" = "" ]; then
    release_note="Minor update"
    echo "[INFO] No command line input provided. Set \$release_note to $release_note"
fi

# Initialize the local directory as a Git repository
git init

# Adds the files in the local repository and stages them for commit.
git add .

# Commits the tracked changes and prepares them to be pushed to a remote repository. 
git commit -m "$release_note"

# Sets the new remote
git_remote=`git remote`
if [ "$git_remote" = "" ]; then # git remote not defined

    if [ "$GIT_TOKEN" = "" ]; then
        echo "[INFO] \$GIT_TOKEN (environment variable) is not set. Using the git credential in your environment."
        git remote add origin https://github.com/${git_user_id}/${git_repo_id}.git
    else
        git remote add origin https://${git_user_id}:${GIT_TOKEN}@github.com/${git_user_id}/${git_repo_id}.git
    fi

fi

git pull origin master

# Pushes (Forces) the changes in the local repository up to the remote repository
echo "Git pushing to https://github.com/${git_user_id}/${git_repo_id}.git"
git push origin master 2>&1 | grep -v 'To https'

export interface ConfigurationParameters {
    apiKeys?: {[ key: string ]: string};
    username?: string;
    password?: string;
    accessToken?: string | (() => string);
    basePath?: string;
    withCredentials?: boolean;
}

export class Configuration {
    apiKeys?: {[ key: string ]: string};
    username?: string;
    password?: string;
    accessToken?: string | (() => string);
    basePath?: string;
    withCredentials?: boolean;

    constructor(configurationParameters: ConfigurationParameters = {}) {
        this.apiKeys = configurationParameters.apiKeys;
        this.username = configurationParameters.username;
        this.password = configurationParameters.password;
        this.accessToken = configurationParameters.accessToken;
        this.basePath = configurationParameters.basePath;
        this.withCredentials = configurationParameters.withCredentials;
    }

    /**
     * Select the correct content-type to use for a request.
     * Uses {@link Configuration#isJsonMime} to determine the correct content-type.
     * If no content type is found return the first found type if the contentTypes is not empty
     * @param contentTypes - the array of content types that are available for selection
     * @returns the selected content-type or <code>undefined</code> if no selection could be made.
     */
    public selectHeaderContentType (contentTypes: string[]): string | undefined {
        if (contentTypes.length == 0) {
            return undefined;
        }

        let type = contentTypes.find(x => this.isJsonMime(x));
        if (type === undefined) {
            return contentTypes[0];
        }
        return type;
    }

    /**
     * Select the correct accept content-type to use for a request.
     * Uses {@link Configuration#isJsonMime} to determine the correct accept content-type.
     * If no content type is found return the first found type if the contentTypes is not empty
     * @param accepts - the array of content types that are available for selection.
     * @returns the selected content-type or <code>undefined</code> if no selection could be made.
     */
    public selectHeaderAccept(accepts: string[]): string | undefined {
        if (accepts.length == 0) {
            return undefined;
        }

        let type = accepts.find(x => this.isJsonMime(x));
        if (type === undefined) {
            return accepts[0];
        }
        return type;
    }

    /**
     * Check if the given MIME is a JSON MIME.
     * JSON MIME examples:
     *   application/json
     *   application/json; charset=UTF8
     *   APPLICATION/JSON
     *   application/vnd.company+json
     * @param mime - MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions)
     * @return True if the given MIME is JSON, false otherwise.
     */
    public isJsonMime(mime: string): boolean {
        const jsonMime: RegExp = new RegExp('^(application\/json|[^;/ \t]+\/[^;/ \t]+[+]json)[ \t]*(;.*)?$', 'i');
        return mime != null && (jsonMime.test(mime) || mime.toLowerCase() === 'application/json-patch+json');
    }
}

    import { HttpUrlEncodingCodec } from '@angular/common/http';

/**
* CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec
* Fix plus sign (+) not encoding, so sent as blank space
* See: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/11058#issuecomment-247367318
*/
export class CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec extends HttpUrlEncodingCodec {
    encodeKey(k: string): string {
        k = super.encodeKey(k);
        return k.replace(/\+/gi, '%2B');
    }
    encodeValue(v: string): string {
        v = super.encodeValue(v);
        return v.replace(/\+/gi, '%2B');
    }
}

#!/bin/sh
# ref: https://help.github.com/articles/adding-an-existing-project-to-github-using-the-command-line/
#
# Usage example: /bin/sh ./git_push.sh wing328 swagger-petstore-perl "minor update"

git_user_id=$1
git_repo_id=$2
release_note=$3

if [ "$git_user_id" = "" ]; then
    git_user_id="GIT_USER_ID"
    echo "[INFO] No command line input provided. Set \$git_user_id to $git_user_id"
fi

if [ "$git_repo_id" = "" ]; then
    git_repo_id="GIT_REPO_ID"
    echo "[INFO] No command line input provided. Set \$git_repo_id to $git_repo_id"
fi

if [ "$release_note" = "" ]; then
    release_note="Minor update"
    echo "[INFO] No command line input provided. Set \$release_note to $release_note"
fi

# Initialize the local directory as a Git repository
git init

# Adds the files in the local repository and stages them for commit.
git add .

# Commits the tracked changes and prepares them to be pushed to a remote repository. 
git commit -m "$release_note"

# Sets the new remote
git_remote=`git remote`
if [ "$git_remote" = "" ]; then # git remote not defined

    if [ "$GIT_TOKEN" = "" ]; then
        echo "[INFO] \$GIT_TOKEN (environment variable) is not set. Using the git credential in your environment."
        git remote add origin https://github.com/${git_user_id}/${git_repo_id}.git
    else
        git remote add origin https://${git_user_id}:${GIT_TOKEN}@github.com/${git_user_id}/${git_repo_id}.git
    fi

fi

git pull origin master

# Pushes (Forces) the changes in the local repository up to the remote repository
echo "Git pushing to https://github.com/${git_user_id}/${git_repo_id}.git"
git push origin master 2>&1 | grep -v 'To https'

export interface ConfigurationParameters {
    apiKeys?: {[ key: string ]: string};
    username?: string;
    password?: string;
    accessToken?: string | (() => string);
    basePath?: string;
    withCredentials?: boolean;
}

export class Configuration {
    apiKeys?: {[ key: string ]: string};
    username?: string;
    password?: string;
    accessToken?: string | (() => string);
    basePath?: string;
    withCredentials?: boolean;

    constructor(configurationParameters: ConfigurationParameters = {}) {
        this.apiKeys = configurationParameters.apiKeys;
        this.username = configurationParameters.username;
        this.password = configurationParameters.password;
        this.accessToken = configurationParameters.accessToken;
        this.basePath = configurationParameters.basePath;
        this.withCredentials = configurationParameters.withCredentials;
    }

    /**
     * Select the correct content-type to use for a request.
     * Uses {@link Configuration#isJsonMime} to determine the correct content-type.
     * If no content type is found return the first found type if the contentTypes is not empty
     * @param contentTypes - the array of content types that are available for selection
     * @returns the selected content-type or <code>undefined</code> if no selection could be made.
     */
    public selectHeaderContentType (contentTypes: string[]): string | undefined {
        if (contentTypes.length == 0) {
            return undefined;
        }

        let type = contentTypes.find(x => this.isJsonMime(x));
        if (type === undefined) {
            return contentTypes[0];
        }
        return type;
    }

    /**
     * Select the correct accept content-type to use for a request.
     * Uses {@link Configuration#isJsonMime} to determine the correct accept content-type.
     * If no content type is found return the first found type if the contentTypes is not empty
     * @param accepts - the array of content types that are available for selection.
     * @returns the selected content-type or <code>undefined</code> if no selection could be made.
     */
    public selectHeaderAccept(accepts: string[]): string | undefined {
        if (accepts.length == 0) {
            return undefined;
        }

        let type = accepts.find(x => this.isJsonMime(x));
        if (type === undefined) {
            return accepts[0];
        }
        return type;
    }

    /**
     * Check if the given MIME is a JSON MIME.
     * JSON MIME examples:
     *   application/json
     *   application/json; charset=UTF8
     *   APPLICATION/JSON
     *   application/vnd.company+json
     * @param mime - MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions)
     * @return True if the given MIME is JSON, false otherwise.
     */
    public isJsonMime(mime: string): boolean {
        const jsonMime: RegExp = new RegExp('^(application\/json|[^;/ \t]+\/[^;/ \t]+[+]json)[ \t]*(;.*)?$', 'i');
        return mime != null && (jsonMime.test(mime) || mime.toLowerCase() === 'application/json-patch+json');
    }
}

    import { HttpUrlEncodingCodec } from '@angular/common/http';

/**
* CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec
* Fix plus sign (+) not encoding, so sent as blank space
* See: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/11058#issuecomment-247367318
*/
export class CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec extends HttpUrlEncodingCodec {
    encodeKey(k: string): string {
        k = super.encodeKey(k);
        return k.replace(/\+/gi, '%2B');
    }
    encodeValue(v: string): string {
        v = super.encodeValue(v);
        return v.replace(/\+/gi, '%2B');
    }
}

#!/bin/sh
# ref: https://help.github.com/articles/adding-an-existing-project-to-github-using-the-command-line/
#
# Usage example: /bin/sh ./git_push.sh wing328 swagger-petstore-perl "minor update"

git_user_id=$1
git_repo_id=$2
release_note=$3

if [ "$git_user_id" = "" ]; then
    git_user_id="GIT_USER_ID"
    echo "[INFO] No command line input provided. Set \$git_user_id to $git_user_id"
fi

if [ "$git_repo_id" = "" ]; then
    git_repo_id="GIT_REPO_ID"
    echo "[INFO] No command line input provided. Set \$git_repo_id to $git_repo_id"
fi

if [ "$release_note" = "" ]; then
    release_note="Minor update"
    echo "[INFO] No command line input provided. Set \$release_note to $release_note"
fi

# Initialize the local directory as a Git repository
git init

# Adds the files in the local repository and stages them for commit.
git add .

# Commits the tracked changes and prepares them to be pushed to a remote repository. 
git commit -m "$release_note"

# Sets the new remote
git_remote=`git remote`
if [ "$git_remote" = "" ]; then # git remote not defined

    if [ "$GIT_TOKEN" = "" ]; then
        echo "[INFO] \$GIT_TOKEN (environment variable) is not set. Using the git credential in your environment."
        git remote add origin https://github.com/${git_user_id}/${git_repo_id}.git
    else
        git remote add origin https://${git_user_id}:${GIT_TOKEN}@github.com/${git_user_id}/${git_repo_id}.git
    fi

fi

git pull origin master

# Pushes (Forces) the changes in the local repository up to the remote repository
echo "Git pushing to https://github.com/${git_user_id}/${git_repo_id}.git"
git push origin master 2>&1 | grep -v 'To https'

import { NotFoundResponse } from '../model/notFoundResponse';
import { ProblemDetails } from '../model/problemDetails';
import { SyncSecUserRequest } from '../model/syncSecUserRequest';

import { BASE_PATH, COLLECTION_FORMATS }                     from '../variables';
import { Configuration }                                     from '../configuration';


@Injectable()
export class UsersService {

    protected basePath = 'https://localhost:7288';
    public defaultHeaders = new HttpHeaders();
    public configuration = new Configuration();

    constructor(protected httpClient: HttpClient, @Optional()@Inject(BASE_PATH) basePath: string, @Optional() configuration: Configuration) {
        if (basePath) {
            this.basePath = basePath;
        }
        if (configuration) {
            this.configuration = configuration;
            this.basePath = basePath || configuration.basePath || this.basePath;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param consumes string[] mime-types
     * @return true: consumes contains 'multipart/form-data', false: otherwise
     */
    private canConsumeForm(consumes: string[]): boolean {
        const form = 'multipart/form-data';
        for (const consume of consumes) {
            if (form === consume) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }


    /**
     * 
     * 
     * @param body 
     * @param observe set whether or not to return the data Observable as the body, response or events. defaults to returning the body.
     * @param reportProgress flag to report request and response progress.
     */
    public usersSyncUser(body?: SyncSecUserRequest, observe?: 'body', reportProgress?: boolean): Observable<any>;
    public usersSyncUser(body?: SyncSecUserRequest, observe?: 'response', reportProgress?: boolean): Observable<HttpResponse<any>>;
    public usersSyncUser(body?: SyncSecUserRequest, observe?: 'events', reportProgress?: boolean): Observable<HttpEvent<any>>;
    public usersSyncUser(body?: SyncSecUserRequest, observe: any = 'body', reportProgress: boolean = false ): Observable<any> {


        let headers = this.defaultHeaders;

        // authentication (Bearer) required
        if (this.configuration.accessToken) {
            const accessToken = typeof this.configuration.accessToken === 'function'
                ? this.configuration.accessToken()
                : this.configuration.accessToken;
            headers = headers.set('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + accessToken);
        }
        // to determine the Accept header
        let httpHeaderAccepts: string[] = [
            'application/json'
        ];
        const httpHeaderAcceptSelected: string | undefined = this.configuration.selectHeaderAccept(httpHeaderAccepts);
        if (httpHeaderAcceptSelected != undefined) {
            headers = headers.set('Accept', httpHeaderAcceptSelected);
        }

        // to determine the Content-Type header
        const consumes: string[] = [
            'application/json-patch+json',
            'application/json',
            'text/json',
            'application/_*+json'
        ];
        const httpContentTypeSelected: string | undefined = this.configuration.selectHeaderContentType(consumes);
        if (httpContentTypeSelected != undefined) {
            headers = headers.set('Content-Type', httpContentTypeSelected);
        }

        return this.httpClient.request<any>('post',`${this.basePath}/api/users/sync-user`,
            {
                body: body,
                withCredentials: this.configuration.withCredentials,
                headers: headers,
                observe: observe,
                reportProgress: reportProgress
            }
        );
    }

}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\core\guards\tenant-selection.guard.ts
====================================================================================================

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { CanActivate, ActivatedRouteSnapshot, RouterStateSnapshot, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { AuthService } from '../services/security/auth.service';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class TenantSelectionGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    private authService: AuthService,
    private router: Router,
  ) {}

  canActivate(route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot, state: RouterStateSnapshot): boolean {
    // Check if user is authenticated
    const isAuthenticated = Object.keys(this.authService.getAuthToken()).length !== 0;

    // Check if a tenant is selected - IMPORTANT: null is a valid tenant selection!
    const tenantCode = this.authService.getCurrentTenant();
    // Modified to consider null as a valid tenant selection
    const hasTenant = tenantCode !== undefined;

    // Check if this is the login or tenant selection page
    const isLoginRoute = state.url.includes('/login');
    const isTenantSelectionRoute = state.url === '/scope-selection';

    // CRITICAL CHECK: If we're on the login page, NEVER redirect
    if (isLoginRoute) {
      return true;
    }

    // CRITICAL CHECK: If we're already on the tenant selection page, always allow access
    if (isTenantSelectionRoute) {
      return true;
    }

    // If authenticated but no tenant selection has been made at all (undefined), redirect to tenant selection
    if (isAuthenticated && !hasTenant) {
      // Store current URL to return to after tenant selection
      localStorage.setItem('returnUrl', state.url);
      this.router.navigate(['/scope-selection']);
      return false;
    }

    // Allow access if authenticated and has a tenant selection (including null)
    if (isAuthenticated && hasTenant) {
      return true;
    }

    // Otherwise redirect to login
    this.router.navigate(['/login']);
    return false;
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { CanDeactivate, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { TwoFactorQrComponent } from '../../pages/login/two-factor-qr/two-factor-qr.component';
import { AuthService } from '../services/security/auth.service';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class TwoFactorSetupGuard implements CanDeactivate<TwoFactorQrComponent> {
  constructor(
    private authService: AuthService,
    private router: Router,
  ) {}

  canDeactivate(component: TwoFactorQrComponent): boolean {
    // If 2FA setup is in progress, prevent navigation unless explicitly completed
    if (this.authService.isTwoFactorSetupInProgress()) {
      // User trying to leave - log them out for security
      this.authService.logout();

      // Navigate back to login page
      this.router.navigate(['/login']);
      return true;
    }

    // If 2FA setup is not in progress or is complete, allow navigation
    return true;
  }
}

export function deepMerge<T extends object, U extends object>(target: T, source: U): T & U {
  const result: any = { ...target };

  for (const key in source) {
    if (
      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(source, key)
    ) {
      const sourceValue = source[key];
      const targetValue = result[key];

      if (
        typeof sourceValue === 'object' &&
        sourceValue !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(sourceValue)
      ) {
        result[key] = (typeof targetValue === 'object' &&
          targetValue !== null &&
          !Array.isArray(targetValue))
          ? deepMerge(targetValue, sourceValue)
          : deepMerge({}, sourceValue);
      } else {
        result[key] = sourceValue;
      }
    }
  }

  return result;
}

import { HttpResponse } from '@angular/common/http';

export class FileHandler {
  /**
   * C# FileResult típusból kiszedi a file nevét.
   * @param response FileResult típusa C#-ből.
   * @returns File Utf-8 neve, vagy 'Letöltés' ha nem található a responseban.
   */
  public static getFileName(response: HttpResponse<Blob>): string {
    const contentDisposition = response.headers.get('content-disposition');

    if (contentDisposition) {
      // UTF-8 filename kell, hogy ékezetek is megjelenjenek a file nevében.
      const filename = contentDisposition.match(/filename\*=UTF-8''([^;\r\n"']*)['"]?;?/);
      if (filename) {
        return decodeURI(filename[1]);
      }
    }

    return 'Letöltés';
  }

  /**
   * Assets/downloads mappában lévő fileok letöltéséhez helper function.
   * @param fileName Assets mappában lévő file neve.
   */
  public static downloadFromAssets(fileName: string) {
    window.location.href = `/assets/downloads/${fileName}`;
  }

  /**
   * File méretét adja vissza MB-ban lefelé kerekítve.
   */
  public static getFileSizeInMB(size: number) {
    // B / KB / MB
    return Math.floor(size / 1024 / 1024);
  }

  public static getFileExtension(fileName: string): string {
    const extension = fileName.split('.').pop();
    return extension ? '.' + extension : '';
  }
}

import { AbstractControl, UntypedFormGroup, ValidationErrors, ValidatorFn } from '@angular/forms';

export class HelperService {}

export function getOrFalse(value: any): any {
  return value ? value : false;
}

export function getOrTrue(value: any): any {
  return value ? value : true;
}

export function getOrNull(value: any): any {
  return value != null ? value : null;
}

export function getOrEmptyString(value: any): any {
  return value != null ? value : '';
}

export function getOrZero(value: any): any {
  return value != null ? value : 0;
}

export function getOrDefaultValue(value: any, defaultValue: any): any {
  return value != null ? value : defaultValue;
}

export function enableControlsOf(formGroup: UntypedFormGroup, controls: string[]) {
  controls.forEach((control) => {
    Object.keys(formGroup.controls).forEach((key) => {
      if (control === key) {
        formGroup.controls[key].enable();
      }
    });
  });
}

export function enableControlsAndSetValidatorsOf(
  formGroup: UntypedFormGroup,
  controls: string[],
  validators: ValidatorFn[],
) {
  controls.forEach((control) => {
    Object.keys(formGroup.controls).forEach((key) => {
      if (control === key) {
        formGroup.controls[key].setValidators(validators);
        formGroup.controls[key].enable();
      }
    });
  });
}

export function disableControlsAndClearValidatorsOf(formGroup: UntypedFormGroup, controls: string[], value = null) {
  controls.forEach((control) => {
    Object.keys(formGroup.controls).forEach((key) => {
      if (control === key) {
        formGroup.controls[key].reset(value);
        formGroup.controls[key].disable();
        formGroup.controls[key].setValidators(null);
      }
    });
  });
}

export function resetControlsOf(formGroup: UntypedFormGroup, controls: string[]) {
  controls.forEach((control) => {
    Object.keys(formGroup.controls).forEach((key) => {
      if (control === key) {
        formGroup.controls[key].reset(null);
      }
    });
  });
}

export function setControlValidatorsOf(formGroup: UntypedFormGroup, controls: string[], validators: ValidatorFn[]) {
  controls.forEach((control) => {
    Object.keys(formGroup.controls).forEach((key) => {
      if (control === key) {
        formGroup.controls[key].setValidators(validators);
      }
    });
  });
}

export function updateValueAndValidityOf(formGroup: UntypedFormGroup, controls: string[]) {
  controls.forEach((control) => {
    Object.keys(formGroup.controls).forEach((key) => {
      if (control === key) {
        formGroup.controls[key].updateValueAndValidity();
      }
    });
  });
}

export function updateAllControlValueAndValidityOf(formGroup: UntypedFormGroup) {
  Object.keys(formGroup.controls).forEach((key) => {
    formGroup.controls[key].updateValueAndValidity();
  });
}

export function mustBeEarlierDateThanNow(control: AbstractControl): Record<string, boolean> | null {
  const currentDate = new Date();
  if (control.value > currentDate) {
    return { mustBeEarlierDateThanNow: true };
  }
  return null;
}

export function mustBeLaterDateThan(date: Date): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): Record<string, any> | null =>
    control?.value && new Date(control.value).setHours(0, 0, 0, 0) < date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
      ? { mustBeLaterThanDate: true, date: date }
      : null;
}

export function atLeastOne(validator: ValidatorFn, controls: string[], group: UntypedFormGroup) {
  return (): ValidationErrors | null => {
    if (!controls) {
      controls = Object.keys(group.controls);
    }
    const hasAtLeastOne = group && group.controls && controls.some((k) => !validator(group.controls[k]));

    return hasAtLeastOne
      ? null
      : {
          atLeastOne: true,
        };
  };
}

export function amountMustBeEqualTo(comparedControlName: string, firstControlName: string, secondControlName: string) {
  return (formGroup: UntypedFormGroup): ValidationErrors | null => {
    if (formGroup.controls[firstControlName].errors || formGroup.controls[secondControlName].errors) {
      return null;
    }

    const comparedControlValue = +formGroup.controls[comparedControlName].value;
    const firstControlValue = +formGroup.controls[firstControlName].value;
    const secondControlValue = +formGroup.controls[secondControlName].value;

    if (firstControlValue + secondControlValue != comparedControlValue) {
      formGroup.controls[firstControlName].setErrors({ amountMustBeEqualTo: true, maxValue: comparedControlValue });
      formGroup.controls[secondControlName].setErrors({ amountMustBeEqualTo: true, maxValue: comparedControlValue });
    } else {
      formGroup.controls[firstControlName].setErrors(null);
      formGroup.controls[secondControlName].setErrors(null);
    }
    
    return null;
  };
}

export function mustBeBiggerValueThanOrOtherNull(controlName: string, comparedControlName: string) {
  return (formGroup: UntypedFormGroup) => {
    const control = formGroup.controls[controlName];
    const controlValue = formGroup.controls[controlName].value;
    const comparedControlValue = formGroup.controls[comparedControlName].value;
    if (control.errors && !control.errors.mustBeBiggerValueThanOrOtherNull) {
      return;
    }
    if (controlValue && controlValue < comparedControlValue) {
      control.setErrors({ mustBeBiggerValueThanOrOtherNull: true });
    } else {
      control.setErrors(null);
    }
  };
}

export function enableOrDisableControlsOf(
  formGroup: UntypedFormGroup,
  controlNames: string[],
  logic: boolean,
  clearValue = false,
) {
  controlNames.forEach((controlName) => {
    Object.keys(formGroup.controls).forEach((key) => {
      if (controlName === key) {
        if (logic) {
          formGroup.controls[key].enable({ emitEvent: false });
        } else {
          const control = formGroup.controls[key];
          control.disable({ emitEvent: false });
          if (clearValue) {
            control.setValue(null);
          }
        }
      }
    });
  });
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class PasswordStrengthService {
  // Calculate password strength on a scale of 0-100
  calculatePasswordStrength(password: string): { strength: number; feedback: string } {
    if (!password) {
      return { strength: 0, feedback: '' };
    }

    let strength = 0;

    // Length check
    if (password.length >= 8) strength += 20;
    if (password.length >= 12) strength += 10;

    // Character type checks
    if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) strength += 15; // Uppercase
    if (/[a-z]/.test(password)) strength += 15; // Lowercase
    if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) strength += 15; // Numbers
    if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) strength += 15; // Special characters

    // Complexity
    if (/^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[0-9])(?=.*[^A-Za-z0-9]).{10,}$/.test(password)) {
      strength += 10; // Contains all character types and is at least 10 chars
    }

    const finalStrength = Math.min(100, strength);

    // Set feedback message
    let feedback = '';
    if (finalStrength < 40) {
      feedback = 'Gyenge erősségű jelszó';
    } else if (finalStrength < 70) {
      feedback = 'Közepes erősségű jelszó';
    } else {
      feedback = 'Megfelelő erősségű jelszó';
    }

    return { strength: finalStrength, feedback };
  }

  getPasswordStrengthClass(strength: number): string {
    if (strength < 40) return 'strength-weak';
    if (strength < 70) return 'strength-fair';
    if (strength < 90) return 'strength-good';
    return 'strength-strong';
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import { RoomTypeModel, MOCK_ROOM_TYPES } from '../models/room-type/room-type.model';

/**
 * Interface for RoomType EntityRef object
 */
export interface RoomTypeEntityRef {
  id: number;
  entityDisplayName: string;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class RoomTypeService {
  constructor() {}

  /**
   * Get all room types as EntityRef objects
   * @returns Observable with array of RoomTypeEntityRef objects
   */
  public getAllRoomTypesEntityRef(): Observable<RoomTypeEntityRef[]> {
    // Convert mock data to EntityRef format
    const entityRefs = MOCK_ROOM_TYPES.map((profile) => this.convertToEntityRef(profile));
    return of(entityRefs);
  }

  /**
   * Get active room types as EntityRef objects
   * @returns Observable with array of active RoomTypeEntityRef objects
   */
  public getActiveRoomTypesEntityRef(): Observable<RoomTypeEntityRef[]> {
    // Filter only active profiles and convert to EntityRef format
    const activeEntityRefs = MOCK_ROOM_TYPES.filter((profile) => profile.active).map((profile) =>
      this.convertToEntityRef(profile),
    );
    return of(activeEntityRefs);
  }

  /**
   * Get a room type by ID
   * @param id Room type ID
   * @returns Observable with RoomTypeModel or undefined if not found
   */
  public getRoomTypeById(id: number): Observable<RoomTypeModel | undefined> {
    const profile = MOCK_ROOM_TYPES.find((p) => p.id === id);
    return of(profile);
  }

  /**
   * Convert RoomTypeModel to RoomTypeEntityRef
   * @param profile RoomTypeModel to convert
   * @returns RoomTypeEntityRef object
   */
  private convertToEntityRef(profile: RoomTypeModel): RoomTypeEntityRef {
    return {
      id: profile.id,
      entityDisplayName: profile.name,
    };
  }
}

@Pipe({ name: 'ListaTipusString' })

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\core\services\chart-table-utils.service.ts
