import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ColumnDefinition,
  ColumnType,
  IColumnDefinition,
  INumberTypeParam,
  ITypeParam,
} from '../components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { ChartTableItemModel, ChartTableItemValueModel } from '../generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';
import { StringChartTableItemModel, StringChartTableItemValueModel } from '../generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class ChartTableUtilsService {
  constructor(private datePipe: DatePipe) {}

  /**
   * Creates dynamic column definitions based on the measurement point names in the first item
   * @param firstItem The first ChartTableItemModel from the API response
   * @returns Array of IColumnDefinition objects
   */
  public createColumnDefinitions(firstItem: ChartTableItemModel | StringChartTableItemModel): IColumnDefinition[] {
    // Initialize columns array with timestamp column
    const columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
      {
        columnName: 'timestamp',
        displayName: 'Dátum',
        columnType: ColumnType.DateTime,
        sortable: true,
        parameters: {} as ITypeParam,
      } as IColumnDefinition,
    ];

    // Extract all measurement point names from the first item's values
    if (firstItem?.values && Array.isArray(firstItem.values)) {
      // Create a column for each unique measurement point
      firstItem.values.forEach((value: ChartTableItemValueModel | StringChartTableItemValueModel) => {
        // Type guard to check for measurementPointName or columnName
        const columnName =
          'measurementPointName' in value && value.measurementPointName
            ? value.measurementPointName
            : ('columnName' in value ? value.columnName : undefined);

        if (columnName) {
          // Create a column definition for this measurement point
          const column: IColumnDefinition = {
            columnName: columnName,
            displayName: columnName,
            columnType: columnName === 'measurementPointName' ? ColumnType.Number : ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: false,
            parameters: {
              fractionDigits: 2,
              postFix: '',
            } as INumberTypeParam,
          } as IColumnDefinition;

          columns.push(column);
        }
      });
    }

    return columns;
  }
  /**
   * Transforms the ChartTableItemModel array from the API into row objects for the table
   * @param items Array of ChartTableItemModel objects from the API
   * @returns Array of row objects keyed by column name
   */
  public transformChartTableToRows(items: ChartTableItemModel[] | StringChartTableItemModel[] | undefined): any[] {
    if (!items || items.length === 0) return [];

    // Transform each time point into a row object
    return items.map((item) => {
      // Create the row object with timestamp
      const row: Record<string, any> = {
        timestamp: this.datePipe.transform(item.dateTime, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),
      };

      // Add each measurement point value to the row
      if (item.values && Array.isArray(item.values)) {
        item.values.forEach((value: ChartTableItemValueModel | StringChartTableItemValueModel) => {
          const key =
            'measurementPointName' in value && value.measurementPointName
              ? value.measurementPointName
              : ('columnName' in value ? value.columnName : undefined);

          if (key) {
            // Use the measurement point name or column name as the key for the value
            row[key] = value.value;
          }
        });
      }

      return row;
    });
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\core\services\clientAPI.service.ts

import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { SnackBarColor } from '../base/page-component-base';
import { share } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { SettingsService } from './settings/settings.service';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';

export class ClientAPIService {
  constructor(
    protected apiName: string,
    protected http: HttpClient,
    protected _snackBar: MatSnackBar,
    protected settingsService: SettingsService,
  ) {}

  getApiName() {
    return this.apiName;
  }

  get = (id?: number, params?: any) => {
    const get = this.http
      .get(this.createCompleteRoute(id ? `${this.apiName}/${id}` : `${this.apiName}`), {
        params: new HttpParams({ fromObject: params }),
        headers: new HttpHeaders({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
      })
      .pipe(share());
    get.subscribe(
      (data) => {},
      (error) => this.errorHandler(error),
    );
    return get;
  };

  post = (body: any) => {
    const post = this.http.post(this.createCompleteRoute(this.apiName), body).pipe(share());
    post.subscribe(
      (data) => this.successHandler(data),
      (error) => this.errorHandler(error),
    );
    return post;
  };

  put = (id: number, body: any) => {
    const put = this.http
      .put(this.createCompleteRoute(`${this.apiName}/${id}`), body, this.generateHeaders())
      .pipe(share());
    put.subscribe(
      (data) => this.successHandler(data),
      (error) => this.errorHandler(error),
    );
    return put;
  };

  delete = (id: number) => {
    const deleteApi = this.http.delete(this.createCompleteRoute(`${this.apiName}/${id}`)).pipe(share());
    deleteApi.subscribe(
      (data) => this.deleteHandler(data),
      (error) => this.errorHandler(error),
    );
    return deleteApi;
  };

  protected createCompleteRoute(route: string): string {
    return `${this.settingsService.baseUrls.framework}/${route}`;
  }

  private generateHeaders = () => {
    return {
      headers: new HttpHeaders({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
    };
  };

  protected errorHandler(error: any) {
    if (error && error.error && error.error.title && error.error.title.includes('InvalidToken')) return null;
    else if (error && error.error && (error.error.title || error.error.Title)) {
      const errorInfo = error.error;
      const color = error.status == 400 ? SnackBarColor.Warning : SnackBarColor.Error;
      this._snackBar.open(errorInfo.title ? errorInfo.title : errorInfo.Title, 'Ok', {
        duration: 120000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${color}`],
      });
    } else {
      let errorMessage = 'Hiba történt a művelet során.';
      if (error.error && error.error.isDeleteError == true) {
        errorMessage = error.error.error;
      }

      this._snackBar.open(errorMessage, 'Ok', {
        duration: 120000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Error}`],
      });
    }
  }

  protected setUpErrorHandler<T>(request: Observable<T>): Observable<T> {
    const requestWithErrorHandler = request.pipe(share());
    requestWithErrorHandler.subscribe(
      (data) => {},
      (error) => this.errorHandler(error),
    );
    return requestWithErrorHandler;
  }

  protected successHandler(data: any, showSuccessMessage = true, isModify = false) {
    if (data.error) {
      data.error = data.error || 'hiba';
      this._snackBar.open(`${data.error} ${data.details}`, 'OK', {
        duration: 120000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Error}`],
      });
    }
    if (data) {
      if (showSuccessMessage) {
        const msg = isModify ? 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.' : 'Sikeres mentés.';
        this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
          duration: 5000,
          panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
          horizontalPosition: 'end',
          verticalPosition: 'top',
        });
      }
    }
  }

  protected deleteHandler(data: any) {
    this._snackBar.open('Sikeres törlés.', 'Ok', {
      duration: 5000,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
    });
  }
}

import { Inject, Injectable, Optional } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders, HttpParams, HttpResponse, HttpEvent } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { BASE_PATH } from '../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/variables';

@Injectable()

  public modelResultsExportModelResultValues(
    modelResultFilter?: number,
    name?: string,
    code?: string,
    description?: string,
    createdDate?: Date,
    searchText?: string,
    startPage?: number,
    pageSize?: number,
    sortColumn?: string,
    sortDirection?: SortDirection,
    isDeleted?: boolean,
    observe?: 'events',
    reportProgress?: boolean,
  ): Observable<HttpEvent<any>>;
  public modelResultsExportModelResultValues(
    modelResultFilter?: number,
    name?: string,
    code?: string,
    description?: string,
    createdDate?: Date,
    searchText?: string,
    startPage?: number,
    pageSize?: number,
    sortColumn?: string,
    sortDirection?: SortDirection,
    isDeleted?: boolean,
    observe: any = 'body',
    reportProgress = false,
  ): Observable<any> {
    let queryParameters = new HttpParams({ encoder: new CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec() });
    if (modelResultFilter !== undefined && modelResultFilter !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('ModelResultFilter', modelResultFilter as any);
    }
    if (name !== undefined && name !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('Name', name as any);
    }
    if (code !== undefined && code !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('Code', code as any);
    }
    if (description !== undefined && description !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('Description', description as any);
    }
    if (createdDate !== undefined && createdDate !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('CreatedDate', createdDate as any);
    }
    if (searchText !== undefined && searchText !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('SearchText', searchText as any);
    }
    if (startPage !== undefined && startPage !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('StartPage', startPage as any);
    }
    if (pageSize !== undefined && pageSize !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('PageSize', pageSize as any);
    }
    if (sortColumn !== undefined && sortColumn !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('SortColumn', sortColumn as any);
    }
    if (sortDirection !== undefined && sortDirection !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('SortDirection', sortDirection as any);
    }
    if (isDeleted !== undefined && isDeleted !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('IsDeleted', isDeleted as any);
    }

    let headers = this.defaultHeaders;

    // authentication (Bearer) required
    if (this.configuration.accessToken) {
      const accessToken =
        typeof this.configuration.accessToken === 'function'
          ? this.configuration.accessToken()
          : this.configuration.accessToken;
      headers = headers.set('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + accessToken);
    }
    // to determine the Accept header
    const httpHeaderAccepts: string[] = ['application/json'];
    const httpHeaderAcceptSelected: string | undefined = this.configuration.selectHeaderAccept(httpHeaderAccepts);
    if (httpHeaderAcceptSelected != undefined) {
      headers = headers.set('Accept', httpHeaderAcceptSelected);
    }

    // to determine the Content-Type header
    // const consumes: string[] = [];

    return this.httpClient.get(`${this.basePath}/api/${this.modelResultsController}/model-result-value/export`, {
      params: queryParameters,
      withCredentials: this.configuration.withCredentials,
      headers: headers,
      observe: observe,
      reportProgress: reportProgress,
      responseType: 'blob',
    });
  }

  /**
   * Export consumption data to Excel
   * @param request The ConsumptionChartRequest containing all parameters
   * @param observe Set the return type ('body', 'response', or 'events')
   * @param reportProgress Whether to report progress events
   * @returns Observable with the exported data based on the observe parameter
   */
  public getMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataExcelExport(
    request: ConsumptionChartRequest,
    observe: 'body' | 'response' | 'events' = 'body',
    reportProgress = false,
  ): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    // Validate the request
    if (!request || !request.orgUnitSelections || request.orgUnitSelections.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Valid consumption chart request with org unit selections is required');
    }

    // Validate date range if both from and to are provided
    if (request.from && request.to && new Date(request.from) > new Date(request.to)) {
      throw new Error('The "from" date cannot be after the "to" date');
    }

    // Determine the endpoint URL
    const path = `${this.monitoringBasePath}/api/${this.consumptionController}/GetMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataExcelExport`;

    // Set headers
    const headers = new HttpHeaders({
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Accept: 'application/octet-stream',
    });

  /**
   * Export consumption data to PDF
   * @param request The ConsumptionChartRequest containing filter parameters
   * @param imageForPdf Image file for PDF chart visualization
   * @param observe Set the return type ('body', 'response', or 'events')
   * @param reportProgress Whether to report progress events
   * @returns Observable with the exported PDF data
   */
  public getMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataPdfExport(
    request: ConsumptionChartRequest,
    imageForPdf?: File,
    observe: 'body' | 'response' | 'events' = 'body',
    reportProgress = false,
  ): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    // Validate the request
    if (!request || !request.orgUnitSelections || request.orgUnitSelections.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Valid consumption chart request with org unit selections is required');
    }

    // Validate date range if both from and to are provided
    if (request.from && request.to && new Date(request.from) > new Date(request.to)) {
      throw new Error('The "from" date cannot be after the "to" date');
    }

    // Create FormData
    const formData = new FormData();


    //formData.append('orgUnitSelections', JSON.stringify(request.orgUnitSelections));

    request.orgUnitSelections.forEach(({ orgUnitId, measurementPointId, measuredDataId }, index) => {
      if (orgUnitId !== undefined) formData.append(`orgUnitSelections[${index}].orgUnitId`, orgUnitId.toString());
      if (measurementPointId !== undefined) formData.append(`orgUnitSelections[${index}].measurementPointId`, measurementPointId.toString());
      if (measuredDataId !== undefined) formData.append(`orgUnitSelections[${index}].measuredDataId`, measuredDataId.toString());
    });

    // Add other properties
    const propsToAdd = [
      { key: 'measuredPropertyId', value: request.measuredPropertyId?.toString() },
      { key: 'from', value: request.from ? new Date(request.from).toISOString() : undefined },
      { key: 'to', value: request.to ? new Date(request.to).toISOString() : undefined },
      { key: 'aggregation', value: request.aggregation },
      { key: 'pageIndex', value: request.pageIndex?.toString() },
      { key: 'pageSize', value: request.pageSize?.toString() }
    ];

    propsToAdd.forEach(({ key, value }) => {
      if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
        formData.append(key, value);
      }
    });

    // Add the chart image file if provided
    if (imageForPdf) {
      formData.append('imageForPdf', imageForPdf);
    }

    // Endpoint URL
    const path = `${this.monitoringBasePath}/api/${this.consumptionController}/GetMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataPdfExport`;

    // // Log the form data for debugging
    // console.log('FormData contents:');
    // for (const pair of (formData as any).entries()) {
    //  console.log(`${pair[0]}:`, pair[1]);
    // }

    // Make the request
    return this.httpClient.post(path, formData, {
      responseType: 'blob',
      observe: observe as any,
      reportProgress: reportProgress
    });
  }

  /**
   *
   *
   * @param identifiers
   * @param aggregation
   * @param from
   * @param to
   * @param spatialAggregation
   * @param siteLocation
   * @param site
   * @param iotDevice
   * @param measureEndpoint
   * @param valueType
   * @param needProductionData
   * @param onlyProductionData
   * @param startPage
   * @param pageSize
   * @param sortColumn
   * @param sortDirection
   * @param isDeleted
   * @param observe set whether or not to return the data Observable as the body, response or events. defaults to returning the body.
   * @param reportProgress flag to report request and response progress.
   */
  /**
   * Export consumption data to a file
   * @param identifiers Single identifier or array of identifiers
   * @param from Start date
   * @param to End date
   * @param aggregation Aggregation level
   * @param startPage Page number (0-based)
   * @param pageSize Number of items per page
   * @param sortColumn Column to sort by
   * @param sortDirection Sort direction
   * @param observe Set the return type ('body', 'response', or 'events')
   * @param reportProgress Whether to report progress events
   * @returns Observable with the exported data based on the observe parameter
   */
  public exportEdmConsumptionDataTable(
    channelId?: number,
    from?: Date,
    to?: Date,
    aggregation?: AggregationLevel,
    startPage?: number,
    pageSize?: number,
    sortColumn?: string,
    sortDirection?: SortDirection,
    observe: 'body' | 'response' | 'events' = 'body',
    reportProgress = false,
  ): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    // Validate and normalize identifiers
    if (channelId === undefined && channelId === null) {
      throw new Error('At least one valid identifier is required');
    }

    // Validate date range if both from and to are provided
    if (from && to && from > to) {
      throw new Error('The "from" date cannot be after the "to" date');
    }

    // Build query parameters
    let queryParameters = new HttpParams({ encoder: new CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec() });

    // Helper function to safely set query parameters
    const setParam = (key: string, value: any): void => {
      if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
        if (value instanceof Date) {
          queryParameters = queryParameters.set(key, value.toISOString());
        } else {
          queryParameters = queryParameters.set(key, value.toString());
        }
      }
    };

    // Append identifiers
    setParam('ChannelId', channelId);

    // Set all other parameters
    setParam('Aggregation', aggregation);
    setParam('From', from);
    setParam('To', to);
    setParam('StartPage', startPage);
    setParam('PageSize', pageSize);
    setParam('SortColumn', sortColumn);
    setParam('SortDirection', sortDirection);

    // Set up headers
    let headers = this.defaultHeaders;

    // Add authentication token if available
    if (this.configuration?.accessToken) {
      const accessToken =
        typeof this.configuration.accessToken === 'function'
          ? this.configuration.accessToken()
          : this.configuration.accessToken;
      if (accessToken) {
        headers = headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`);
      }
    }

    // Set accept header for blob response
    headers = headers.set('Accept', 'application/octet-stream');

    // Create request options with common parameters
    const requestOptions = {
      params: queryParameters,
      headers,
      reportProgress,
      withCredentials: this.configuration?.withCredentials,
    };

    // Handle different observe modes
    const url = `${this.monitoringBasePath}/api/${this.consumptionController}/edmconsumptiondatatable/export`;

    if (observe === 'events') {
      return this.httpClient.get(url, {
        ...requestOptions,
        observe: 'events',
        responseType: 'blob' as const,
      }) as Observable<HttpEvent<Blob>>;
    } else if (observe === 'response') {
      return this.httpClient.get(url, {
        ...requestOptions,
        observe: 'response' as const,
        responseType: 'blob' as const,
      }) as Observable<HttpResponse<Blob>>;
    } else {
      // Default to 'body' observe mode
      return this.httpClient.get(url, {
        ...requestOptions,
        responseType: 'blob' as const,
      }) as Observable<Blob>;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Export consumption data to PDF
   * @param imageForPdf Image for PDF
   * @param channelId Channel identifier

   * @param startPage Page number (0-based)
   * @param pageSize Number of items per page
   * @param sortColumn Column to sort by
   * @param sortDirection Sort direction
   * @param observe Set the return type ('body', 'response', or 'events')
   * @param reportProgress Whether to report progress events
   * @returns Observable with the exported PDF data
   */
  public exportToPdfConsumptionDataTableForm(
    imageForPdf?: Blob,
    channelId?: string,
    from?: Date,
    to?: Date,
    aggregation?: AggregationLevel,
    startPage?: number,
    pageSize?: number,
    sortColumn?: string,
    sortDirection?: SortDirection,
    observe: 'body' | 'response' | 'events' = 'body',
    reportProgress = false,
  ): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    // Validate and normalize channelId
    if (channelId === undefined && channelId === null) {
      throw new Error('At least one valid identifier is required');
    }

    // Validate date range if both from and to are provided
    if (from && to && from > to) {
      throw new Error('The "from" date cannot be after the "to" date');
    }

    // Build query parameters
    let queryParameters = new HttpParams({ encoder: new CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec() });

    // Helper function to safely set query parameters
    const setParam = (key: string, value: any): void => {
      if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
        if (value instanceof Date) {
          queryParameters = queryParameters.set(key, value.toISOString());
        } else {
          queryParameters = queryParameters.set(key, value.toString());
        }
      }
    };

    // Append identifiers
    setParam('ChannelId', channelId);

    // Set all other parameters
    setParam('Aggregation', aggregation);
    setParam('From', from);
    setParam('To', to);
    setParam('StartPage', startPage);
    setParam('PageSize', pageSize);
    setParam('SortColumn', sortColumn);
    setParam('SortDirection', sortDirection);

    // Set up headers
    let headers = this.defaultHeaders;

    // Add authentication token if available
    if (this.configuration?.accessToken) {
      const accessToken =
        typeof this.configuration.accessToken === 'function'
          ? this.configuration.accessToken()
          : this.configuration.accessToken;
      if (accessToken) {
        headers = headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`);
      }
    }

    // Set accept header for blob response
    headers = headers.set('Accept', 'application/pdf');

    // Create form data (empty since we're not sending an image)
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('imageForPdf', imageForPdf!);
    // If you need to send an empty file, uncomment the following line:
    // formData.append("imageForPdf", new Blob());

    // Create request options
    const requestOptions = {
      params: queryParameters,
      headers: headers,
      reportProgress,
      withCredentials: this.configuration?.withCredentials,
      responseType: 'blob' as const,
    };

    const url = `${this.monitoringBasePath}/api/${this.consumptionController}/consumptiondatatable/pdfexport`;

    if (observe === 'events') {
      return this.httpClient.post(url, formData, {
        ...requestOptions,
        observe: 'events',
      }) as Observable<HttpEvent<Blob>>;
    } else if (observe === 'response') {
      return this.httpClient.post(url, formData, {
        ...requestOptions,
        observe: 'response',
      }) as Observable<HttpResponse<Blob>>;
    } else {
      // Default to 'body' observe mode
      return this.httpClient.post(url, formData, requestOptions) as Observable<Blob>;
    }
  }

  public modelResultsExportToCsvModelResultValues(

    isDeleted?: boolean,

  ): Observable<HttpResponse<any>>;
  public modelResultsExportToCsvModelResultValues(
    modelResultFilter?: number,
    searchText?: string,
    startPage?: number,
    pageSize?: number,
    sortColumn?: string,
    sortDirection?: SortDirection,
    isDeleted?: boolean,
    observe?: 'events',
    reportProgress?: boolean,
  ): Observable<HttpEvent<any>>;
  public modelResultsExportToCsvModelResultValues(
    modelResultFilter?: number,
    searchText?: string,
    startPage?: number,
    pageSize?: number,
    sortColumn?: string,
    sortDirection?: SortDirection,
    isDeleted?: boolean,
    observe: any = 'body',
    reportProgress = false,
  ): Observable<any> {
    let queryParameters = new HttpParams({ encoder: new CustomHttpUrlEncodingCodec() });
    if (modelResultFilter !== undefined && modelResultFilter !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('ModelResultFilter', modelResultFilter as any);
    }
    if (searchText !== undefined && searchText !== null) {
      queryParameters = queryParameters.set('SearchText', searchText as any);
    }

  createBlobImageFile(diagram: any) {
    const blob = this.dataURItoBlob(diagram);
    const imageFile = new File([blob], 'chart', {
      type: 'image/png',
    });
    return imageFile;
  }
  dataURItoBlob(diagram: any) {
    const byteCharacters = atob(diagram.downloadImgSrc.replace(/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|jpg);base64,/, ''));
    const byteNumbers = new Array(byteCharacters.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < byteCharacters.length; i++) {
      byteNumbers[i] = byteCharacters.charCodeAt(i);
    }

    const byteArray = new Uint8Array(byteNumbers);
    const blob = new Blob([byteArray], {
      type: undefined,
    });
    return blob;
  }

  /**
   * 
   * @param request 
   * @param observe 
   * @param reportProgress 
   * @returns 
   */
  public getDsoDataTableExport(
    request?: ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest,
    observe: 'body' | 'response' | 'events' = 'body',
    reportProgress = false,
  ): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    // Validate the request
    if (request?.subMeasurementPointIdentifiers?.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Valid consumption chart request with org unit selections is required');
    }

    // Validate date range if both from and to are provided
    if (request?.from && request?.to && new Date(request.from) > new Date(request.to)) {
      throw new Error('The "from" date cannot be after the "to" date');
    }

    // Determine the endpoint URL
    const path = `${this.monitoringBasePath}/api/${this.consumptionController}/dsodatatable/export`;

    // Set headers
    const headers = new HttpHeaders({
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Accept: 'application/octet-stream',
    });

    // Handle reporting progress if required
    const httpRequestOptions = {
      headers,
      observe: observe as any,
      reportProgress: reportProgress,
      responseType: 'blob' as 'json',
    };

    // Make POST request with the entire request object
    return this.httpClient.post<Blob>(path, request, httpRequestOptions);
  }
  /**
   * 
   * @param request 
   * @param imageForPdf 
   * @param observe 
   * @param reportProgress 
   * @returns 
   */
  public getDsoDataTablePdfExport(
    request?: ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest,
    imageForPdf?: File,
    observe: 'body' | 'response' | 'events' = 'body',
    reportProgress = false,
  ): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    // Validate the request
    if (request?.subMeasurementPointIdentifiers?.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Valid consumption selections is required');
    }

    // Validate date range if both from and to are provided
    if (request?.from && request?.to && new Date(request?.from) > new Date(request?.to)) {
      throw new Error('The "from" date cannot be after the "to" date');
    }

    if (!imageForPdf) {
      throw new Error('Valid consumption selections is required');
    }

    // Determine the endpoint URL
    const path = `${this.monitoringBasePath}/api/${this.consumptionController}/dsodatatable/pdfexport`;

    // // Set headers
    // const headers = new HttpHeaders({
    //   'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    //   Accept: 'application/octet-stream',
    // });

    // Create FormData
    const formData = new FormData();

    request!.subMeasurementPointIdentifiers!.forEach((data, index) => {
      formData.append(`subMeasurementPointIdentifiers[${index}]`, data);
    });

    // Add other properties
    const propsToAdd = [
      { key: 'measuredPropertyId', value: request!.measuredPropertyId?.toString() },
      { key: 'from', value: request!.from ? moment(new Date(request!.from)).format('YYYY-MM-DD') : undefined },
      { key: 'to', value: request!.to ? moment(new Date(request!.to)).format('YYYY-MM-DD') : undefined },
      { key: 'aggregation', value: request!.aggregation },
      { key: 'startPage', value: request!.startPage?.toString() },
      { key: 'pageSize', value: request!.pageSize?.toString() },
      { key: 'measurementPointIdentifier', value: request!.measurementPointIdentifier },
      { key: 'sortColumn', value: request!.sortColumn },
      { key: 'sortDirection', value: request!.sortDirection },
      { key: 'isDeleted', value: request!.isDeleted?.toString() }
    ];

    propsToAdd.forEach(({ key, value }) => {
      if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
        formData.append(key, value);
      }
    });

    // Add the chart image file if provided
    if (imageForPdf) {
      formData.append('imageForPdf', imageForPdf);
    }

    // FIGYELEM: Ne adjunk meg Content-Type fejlécet! A browser automatikusan beállítja a megfelelő multipart/form-data boundary-t.
    return this.httpClient.post(path, formData, {
      responseType: 'blob',
      observe: observe as any,
      reportProgress: reportProgress
    });
  }
}

import { ElementRef, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ComponentPortal } from '@angular/cdk/portal';
import { timer, Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { OverlayRef } from '@angular/cdk/overlay';
import { DynamicOverlay } from '../overlays/dynamic-overlay.service';
import { LoadingComponent } from '../components/loading/loading.component';

@Injectable()
export class LoaderService {
  constructor(private dynamicOverlay: DynamicOverlay) {}

  public showProgress(elRef: ElementRef) {
    if (elRef) {
      const result: ProgressRef = { subscription: null as any, overlayRef: null as any };
      result.subscription = timer(100).subscribe(() => {
        this.dynamicOverlay.setContainerElement(elRef.nativeElement);
        const positionStrategy = this.dynamicOverlay.position().global().centerHorizontally().centerVertically();
        result.overlayRef = this.dynamicOverlay.create({
          positionStrategy: positionStrategy,
          hasBackdrop: true,
        });
        result.overlayRef.attach(new ComponentPortal(LoadingComponent));
      });
      return result;
    } else {
      return null;
    }
  }

  detach(result: ProgressRef) {
    if (result) {
      result.subscription.unsubscribe();
      if (result.overlayRef) {
        result.overlayRef.detach();
      }
    }
  }
}

export declare interface ProgressRef { subscription: Subscription; overlayRef: OverlayRef }

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\core\services\breadcrumb\breadcrumb.service.ts
====================================================================================================

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { IBreadcrumbItem } from './IBreadcrumbItem';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class BreadcrumbService {
  private stack: IBreadcrumbItem[] = [];
  private maxItemsCount = 10;

  get currentItem(): IBreadcrumbItem {
    if (this.stack.length > 0) return this.stack[this.stack.length - 1];
    return null as any;
  }

  get length() {
    return this.stack.length;
  }

  constructor(private router: Router) {
    this.stack = [];
  }

  getItems(): IBreadcrumbItem[] {
    return this.stack;
  }

  pop(): IBreadcrumbItem | undefined {
    if (this.stack.length > 0) {
      return this.stack.pop();
    }
  }

  push(item: IBreadcrumbItem) {
    if (this.stack.length < this.maxItemsCount) {
      this.stack.push(item);
    }
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.stack.length = 0;
  }

  jumpTo(idx: number, $event: any = null) {
    while (this.stack.length > idx + 2) {
      this.pop();
    }
    const path = this.getFullPathTo(idx);
    this.router.navigate([path]);
    if ($event) $event.preventDefault();
  }

  getFullPathTo(toIndex: number): string {
    if (toIndex < 0 || toIndex > this.stack.length - 1) throwError('Az index nem megfelelő!');

    let path = '/';

    this.stack
      .filter((_, idx) => idx <= toIndex)
      .forEach((item, idx) => {
        let part = item.path;

        if (idx != this.stack.length - 1) part += '/';
        if (part.startsWith('/')) path = '';
        return (path += part);
      });

    return path;
  }
}

import { lastValueFrom, of } from 'rxjs';
import { catchError } from 'rxjs/operators';
import AccessTokenModel from './access-token-model';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { AuthenticateApiService } from './authenticate-api-service';
import TokenApiService from './token-api-service';
import tokenValid from './token-valid';
import { AuthenticateService } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/authenticate.service';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class AuthGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    private tokenApiService: TokenApiService,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private authenticateApiService: AuthenticateApiService,
    private authenticateService: AuthenticateService,
    private router: Router,
  ) {}

  async canActivate(route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot, state: RouterStateSnapshot) {
    const tokenModel = this.authService.getAuthToken();

    // Special case for login and tenant selection routes
    const isLoginRoute = state.url.includes('/login');
    // const isTenantSelectionRoute = state.url === '/scope-selection';

    // Check if 2FA setup is in progress
    if (this.authService.isTwoFactorSetupInProgress()) {
      // If 2FA setup is in progress but user is trying to access a non-login route,
      // force them back to login for security without showing any dialog
      if (!isLoginRoute) {
        this.authService.logout();
        this.router.navigate(['/login']);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    }

    // For login route, if already authenticated and not in 2FA setup, allow direct navigation
    if (isLoginRoute && tokenModel && tokenValid(tokenModel)) {
      return true;
    }

    // Normal authentication check
    if (tokenModel && tokenValid(tokenModel)) {
      // Check user status (2FA setup and lock status) before allowing access
      return await this.checkUserStatus(isLoginRoute);
    }

    // Try to refresh the token
    const isRefreshSuccess = await this.refreshingTokens(tokenModel.token);

    if (!isRefreshSuccess) {
      // If not on login route and authentication failed, redirect to login
      if (!isLoginRoute) {
        this.router.navigate(['/login']);
        return false;
      }

      // For login route, allow access (to show the login form)
      return true;
    }

    // Token refresh successful
    if (!this.authService.user) {
      await this.authService.getCurrentUser();
    }

    // Check user status (2FA setup and lock status) before allowing access
    return await this.checkUserStatus(isLoginRoute);
  }

  /**
   * Checks the current user's status and handles 2FA configuration and account locking
   * @param isLoginRoute Whether the current route is the login route
   * @returns True if the user can proceed, false otherwise
   */
  private async checkUserStatus(isLoginRoute: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      // Only check status for non-login routes, as login route needs to handle these conditions itself
      if (!isLoginRoute) {
        const userStatus = await lastValueFrom(
          this.authenticateService.userAuthenticateGetCurrentUserStatus().pipe(
            catchError((error) => {
              console.error('Error checking user status:', error);
              return of(null);
            }),
          ),
        );

        // If we couldn't get user status, default to safe behavior
        if (!userStatus) {
          this.authService.logout();
          this.router.navigate(['/login']);
          return false;
        }

        // Case 1: Account is locked - log out regardless of 2FA status
        if (userStatus.isLocked) {
          console.warn('User account is locked. Logging out.');
          this.authService.logout();
          this.router.navigate(['/login']);
          return false;
        }

        // Case 2: 2FA is enabled but not configured for the user
        if (userStatus.twoFactorAuthenticationEnabled && !userStatus.twoFactorAuthenticationConfiguredForUser) {
          console.warn('Two-factor authentication is required but not set up. Redirecting to login.');
          this.authService.logout();
          this.router.navigate(['/login']);
          return false;
        }
      }

      // Allow access in all other cases
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error in checkUserStatus:', error);
      // Default to safe behavior on error
      if (!isLoginRoute) {
        this.authService.logout();
        this.router.navigate(['/login']);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    }
  }

  private async refreshingTokens(token: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!token) {
      return false;
    }

    let isRefreshSuccess: boolean;
    try {
      const response = await lastValueFrom(this.tokenApiService.getRefreshToken(token));
      const newTokenModel = response as AccessTokenModel;
      this.authService.setAuthToken(newTokenModel);
      isRefreshSuccess = true;
    } catch (ex) {
      console.error('AuthGuard: token refresh failed', ex);
      isRefreshSuccess = false;
    }
    return isRefreshSuccess;
  }
}

import { HttpErrorResponse, HttpEvent, HttpHandler, HttpInterceptor, HttpRequest } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, firstValueFrom, from, Observable, switchMap, throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { AuthGuard } from './auth-guard';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { AuthenticateApiService } from './authenticate-api-service';
import TokenApiService from './token-api-service';
import tokenValid from './token-valid';
import AccessTokenModel from './access-token-model';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class AuthInterceptorService implements HttpInterceptor {
  constructor(
    private authService: AuthService,
    private authenticateApiService: AuthenticateApiService,
    private authGuard: AuthGuard,
    private tokenApiService: TokenApiService,
    private router: Router,
  ) {}

  intercept(request: HttpRequest<any>, next: HttpHandler): Observable<HttpEvent<any>> {
    // console.log('intercept', request.url);
    // Skip token validation for authentication-related endpoints
    if (this.isAuthEndpoint(request.url)) {
      return this.addTokenAndContinue(request, next);
    }

    // Check if the current request is coming from an authentication-exempt page like registration
    if (this.isFromPublicRoute()) {
      return next.handle(request);
    }

    const tokenModel = this.authService.getAuthToken();

    // If no token exists, just continue with the request
    if (!tokenModel) {
      return next.handle(request);
    }

    // If token is valid, add it to the request and continue
    if (!tokenValid(tokenModel)) {
      // console.log('token expired');
      // console.log('tokenAPiService', this.tokenApiService);
      const authInterceptorServiceInstant = this;
      return from(this.handleTokenRefresh()).pipe(
        switchMap(() => authInterceptorServiceInstant.addTokenAndContinue(request, next)),
      );
    } else {
      return this.addTokenAndContinue(request, next);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Add token to request headers and continue with the request
   */
  private addTokenAndContinue(request: HttpRequest<any>, next: HttpHandler): Observable<HttpEvent<any>> {
    const tokenModel = this.authService.getAuthToken();

    if (tokenModel) {
      // If we have a token, we set it to the header
      request = request.clone({
        setHeaders: { Authorization: `Bearer ${tokenModel.token}` },
      });
    }

    return next.handle(request).pipe(
      catchError((err) => {
        if (err instanceof HttpErrorResponse) {
          if (err.status === 401) {
            // Handle token refresh directly here instead of using canActivate
            // console.log('HTTP Interceptor: 401 Unauthorized error - handling token refresh');

            // Try to refresh the token or logout if it fails
            this.handleTokenRefresh();
          }
        }
        return throwError(err);
      }),
    );
  }

  /**
   * Check if the request URL is for an authentication-related endpoint
   */
  private isAuthEndpoint(url: string): boolean {
    // console.log('Checking if URL is auth endpoint:', url);
    const authEndpoints = [
      '/api/authenticate/login',
      '/api/users/token',
      '/refresh-token',
      '/api/authenticate/twofactor_login',
      '/api/authenticate/twofactor_register',
      '/api/authenticate/twofactor_register_confirm',
    ];

    // Check if the URL contains any of the auth endpoints
    const matches = authEndpoints.filter((endpoint) => url.includes(endpoint));
    const isAuth = matches.length > 0;
    // console.log(`URL ${url} is auth endpoint: ${isAuth}`, matches.length > 0 ? `Matched: ${matches[0]}` : 'No match');
    return isAuth;
  }

  /**
   * Check if the current request is coming from an authentication-exempt page like registration
   * This is to prevent redirects to login when accessing public pages
   */
  private isFromPublicRoute(): boolean {
    // Check if we're on a page that should be accessible without auth
    const publicRoutes = ['registration', 'forgotten-password'];
    const currentUrl = window.location.href.toLowerCase();

    const isPublicRoute = publicRoutes.some((route) => currentUrl.includes(route));
    // console.log(`Current URL is public route: ${isPublicRoute}`, currentUrl);
    return isPublicRoute;
  }

  /**
   * Handle token refresh for unauthorized requests
   */
  private async handleTokenRefresh(): Promise<void> {
    const tokenModel = this.authService.getAuthToken();

    // If we don't have a token and we're on a public route, don't logout
    if ((!tokenModel || !tokenModel.token) && this.isFromPublicRoute()) {
      // console.log('HTTP Interceptor: No token available, but on public route - skipping logout');
      return;
    }

    // If we don't have a token, logout immediately
    if (!tokenModel || !tokenModel.token) {
      // console.log('HTTP Interceptor: No token available, logging out');
      this.authenticateApiService.logout();
      return;
    }

    // If token is still valid, no need to refresh
    if (tokenValid(tokenModel)) {
      // console.log('HTTP Interceptor: Token is still valid');
      return;
    }

    // Try to refresh the token
    try {
      // console.log('HTTP Interceptor: Attempting to refresh token');
      const response = await firstValueFrom(this.tokenApiService.getRefreshToken(tokenModel.token));
      // Cast the response to AccessTokenModel to fix type error
      this.authService.setAuthToken(response as AccessTokenModel);
      // console.log('HTTP Interceptor: Token refreshed successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      // console.error('HTTP Interceptor: Token refresh failed', error);
      this.authenticateApiService.logout();
    }
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable, Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { AuthenticateService } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/authenticate.service';
import { SecOperationMatrixModel } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secOperationMatrixModel';
import { SelectListItemDto } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/selectListItemDto';
import { UserAuthModel } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/userAuthModel';
import { LocalStorageRefService } from '../localStorage/local-storage.service';
import AccessTokenModel from './access-token-model';
import { SecRoleType } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secRoleType';
import { UsersService } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class AuthService {
  private _user?: UserAuthModel;
  private _userChanged = new Subject<UserAuthModel | undefined>();

  // Flag to track whether 2FA setup is required and in progress
  private _twoFactorSetupInProgress = false;

  // Temporary token for API calls during 2FA setup
  private _temporaryToken?: AccessTokenModel;

  public secOperationMatrix!: SecOperationMatrixModel;
  public get user(): UserAuthModel | undefined {
    return this._user;
  }
  public set user(value: UserAuthModel | undefined) {
    this._user = value;
  }

  constructor(
    private localStorageRef: LocalStorageRefService,
    private authenticateService: AuthenticateService,
    private usersService: UsersService,
  ) {

  }
  init(){
    // Initialize by getting current user data
    this.authenticateService.authenticateGetSecOperationMatrix().subscribe((secOperationMatrix) => {
      this.secOperationMatrix = secOperationMatrix;
      this.authenticateService.authenticateCurrent().subscribe((user) => {
        this._user = user;
        if (user) {
          this._userChanged.next(user);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  public onChanged(): Observable<UserAuthModel | undefined> {
    return this._userChanged.asObservable();
  }

  getAuthToken(): AccessTokenModel {
    // If we have a temporary token and 2FA setup is in progress, return the temporary token
    // This allows API calls to work during 2FA setup without allowing actual navigation
    if (this._temporaryToken && this.isTwoFactorSetupInProgress()) {
      return this._temporaryToken;
    }

    const tokenStr = this.localStorageRef.localStorage.getItem('token') || '{}';
    const token = JSON.parse(tokenStr) as AccessTokenModel;
    return token;
  }

  setAuthToken(token: AccessTokenModel, temporary = false) {
    if (temporary) {
      // Store only in memory - not in localStorage
      this._temporaryToken = token;
      return;
    }

    // Clear any temporary token when setting a permanent one
    this._temporaryToken = undefined;

    // Store in localStorage for normal operation
    const tokenStr = JSON.stringify(token);
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.setItem('token', tokenStr);
  }

  setForgottenPW(isForgotten = true) {
    const forgottenPw = JSON.stringify(isForgotten);
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.setItem('forgottenPw', forgottenPw);
  }

  getForgottenPW(): boolean {
    const forgottenPw = this.localStorageRef.localStorage.getItem('forgottenPw') || '{}';
    const isForgotten = JSON.parse(forgottenPw) as boolean;
    return isForgotten;
  }

  removeForgottenPW() {
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.removeItem('forgottenPw');
  }

  setChangePW(changePwRoute: string) {
    const changePw = JSON.stringify(changePwRoute);
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.setItem('changePw', changePw);
  }

  getChangePW(): string {
    const changePwRoute = this.localStorageRef.localStorage.getItem('changePw') || '';
    return changePwRoute;
  }

  removeChangePW() {
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.removeItem('changePw');
  }

  setAuthUser(userGuid: string) {
    const tokenStr = JSON.stringify(userGuid);
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.setItem('userGuid', tokenStr);
  }

  getAuthuser(): string {
    const tokenStr = this.localStorageRef.localStorage.getItem('userGuid') || '{}';
    const userGuid = JSON.parse(tokenStr) as string;
    return userGuid;
  }

  removeAuthuser() {
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.removeItem('userGuid');
  }

  public async getCurrentUser(): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      this.authenticateService.authenticateGetSecOperationMatrix().subscribe((secOperationMatrix) => {
        this.secOperationMatrix = secOperationMatrix;
        this.authenticateService.authenticateCurrent().subscribe((user) => {
          this.user = user;
          resolve();
        });
      });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Az aktuális felhasználó rendelkezik-e adott Role-ral.
   */
  public async hasRole(role: SecRoleType): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this._user) {
      await this.getCurrentUser();
    }

    return (this._user && (role === null || this._user.roleTypes?.includes(role))) || false;
  }

  /**
   *
   * @returns Az aktuális felhasználó szerepkörei.
   */
  public async getRoles(): Promise<SecRoleType[]> {
    if (!this._user) {
      await this.getCurrentUser();
    }

    return this._user?.roleTypes || [];
  }

  public async isTenantIndependentUserWithRole(roleName?: string): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this._user) {
      await this.getCurrentUser();
    }

    return (
      (this._user && this._user.tenantCode == null && (!roleName || this._user.roles?.includes(roleName))) || false
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get available tenants for the authenticated user
   * @returns Observable of available tenants
   */
  public getTenants(): Observable<SelectListItemDto[]> {
    return this.authenticateService.userAuthenticateGetTenants();
  }

  /**
   * Login to the selected tenant
   * @param tenantCode The tenant code to login to
   * @returns Observable of login response
   */
  public loginToSelectedTenant(tenantCode: string): Observable<any> {
    // Clear any existing return URL to ensure we always go to home after tenant selection
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.removeItem('returnUrl');

    // Call the API to login to the selected tenant
    return this.authenticateService.userAuthenticateLoginToSelectedTenant(tenantCode);
  }

  /**
   * Get the current tenant code from local storage
   * @returns The current tenant code, null if explicitly set to null/removed, or empty string if not set
   */
  public getCurrentTenant(): string | null {
    // Check if tenant code exists in localStorage
    const hasStoredTenantCode = this.localStorageRef.localStorage.getItem('tenantCode') !== null;
    const tenantCode = this.localStorageRef.localStorage.getItem('tenantCode');

    // If tenantCode is explicitly removed/null, it means we want null tenant
    if (!hasStoredTenantCode) {
      return null;
    }

    // Otherwise return whatever value we have (might be the actual string value)
    return tenantCode;
  }

  /**
   * Get the current tenant name from localStorage
   * @returns The current tenant name or empty string if not found
   */
  public getCurrentTenantName(): string {
    return this.localStorageRef.localStorage.getItem('tenantName') || '';
  }

  /**
   * Set the current tenant code and name in localStorage
   * @param tenantCode The tenant code to set (can be null for null tenant)
   * @param tenantName The tenant name to set
   */
  public setCurrentTenant(tenantCode: string | null, tenantName: string): void {
    if (tenantCode === null) {
      // For null tenant, remove tenantCode but still store the name
      this.localStorageRef.localStorage.removeItem('tenantCode');
    } else {
      this.localStorageRef.localStorage.setItem('tenantCode', tenantCode);
    }

    // Always store the tenant name, even for null tenant
    if (tenantName) {
      this.localStorageRef.localStorage.setItem('tenantName', tenantName);
    } else {
      // If no name is provided but we have a null tenant, set a default
      if (tenantCode === null) {
        this.localStorageRef.localStorage.setItem('tenantName', 'No Tenant');
      }
    }

    // Update user object with tenant info if it exists
    if (this._user) {
      // Create a copy to ensure change detection triggers
      const updatedUser = { ...this._user };

      // Update the tenant properties
      updatedUser.tenantName = tenantName || (tenantCode === null ? 'No Tenant' : '');
      updatedUser.tenantCode = tenantCode!;

      // Set the updated user
      this._user = updatedUser;

      // Emit event for tenant change to notify other components
      this._userChanged.next(updatedUser);
    } else {
      // Emit event for tenant change to notify other components
      this._userChanged.next(this._user);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Set whether two-factor authentication setup is in progress
   * @param inProgress True if 2FA setup is in progress, false otherwise
   */
  public setTwoFactorSetupInProgress(inProgress: boolean): void {
    this._twoFactorSetupInProgress = inProgress;
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.setItem('twoFactorSetupInProgress', JSON.stringify(inProgress));
  }

  /**
   * Check if two-factor authentication setup is in progress
   * @returns True if 2FA setup is in progress, false otherwise
   */
  public isTwoFactorSetupInProgress(): boolean {
    // First check the in-memory flag
    if (this._twoFactorSetupInProgress) {
      return true;
    }

    // Then check localStorage as fallback (useful after page refreshes)
    const value = this.localStorageRef.localStorage.getItem('twoFactorSetupInProgress');
    return value ? JSON.parse(value) : false;
  }

  /**
   * Mark two-factor setup as complete
   */
  public completeTwoFactorSetup(): void {
    this.setTwoFactorSetupInProgress(false);
    this._temporaryToken = undefined;
  }

  /**
   * Log the user out and clear all authentication data
   */
  public logout(): void {
    // Clear auth token
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.removeItem('token');
    this._temporaryToken = undefined;

    // Clear user guid
    this.removeAuthuser();

    // Clear 2FA setup state
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.removeItem('twoFactorSetupInProgress');
    this._twoFactorSetupInProgress = false;

    // Clear user and notify subscribers
    this._user = undefined;
    this._userChanged.next(undefined);

    // Clear any return URL
    this.localStorageRef.localStorage.removeItem('returnUrl');
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { lastValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import AccessTokenModel from './access-token-model';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import TokenApiService from './token-api-service';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class AuthenticateApiService {
  constructor(private router: Router, private tokenApiService: TokenApiService, private authService: AuthService) {}

  async login(username: string, password: string) {
    //TODO: get token & and store it in localstorage
    const loginModel = JSON.stringify({ username, password });
    const response = await lastValueFrom(this.tokenApiService.getAccessToken(loginModel));
    const tokenModel = response as AccessTokenModel;
    this.authService.setAuthToken(tokenModel);
  }

  logout() {
    this.authService.setAuthToken({} as AccessTokenModel);
    this.authService.user = undefined; // Kijelentkezéskor nem nullozuk ki a usert.
    //this.router.navigate(["logout"]);
    const isForgottenPw = this.authService.getForgottenPW();
    const changePwRoute = this.authService.getChangePW();
    const href = window.location.href;
    console.log('isForgottenPw', isForgottenPw);
    if (isForgottenPw === true) this.router.navigate(['forgotten-password']);
    //else if (changePwRoute && changePwRoute != '') this.router.navigate(['password-change/?' + changePwRoute]);
    else if (href.includes('password-change')) {
      const route = href.split('/?');
      const param = route[1].split('token=');
      const params = param[1].replace('&', '').split('tenant=');
      this.changePassword(params[0], params[1]);
    } else this.router.navigate(['login']);

    //let loginUrl = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/login";
    //window.location.href = loginUrl;
  }

  changePassword(token: string, tenant: string) {
    this.authService.setAuthToken({} as AccessTokenModel);
    this.router.navigate(['password-change'], { queryParams: { token: token, tenant: tenant } });
  }

  forgottenPassword() {
    console.log('ForgottenPassword method called', new Date().toISOString());

    // Set forgotten password flag first
    this.authService.setForgottenPW(true);
    console.log('ForgottenPW flag set to true');

    // Clear auth token - do this AFTER setting the flag
    this.authService.setAuthToken({} as AccessTokenModel);
    console.log('Auth token cleared');

    // Use setTimeout to delay navigation slightly, avoiding navigation race conditions
    setTimeout(() => {
      console.log('Attempting navigation to forgotten-password after delay');
      // Use navigateByUrl which is more direct than navigate
      this.router.navigateByUrl('/forgotten-password').then(
        (success) => console.log('Navigation result:', success),
        (error) => console.error('Navigation error:', error),
      );
    }, 50); // Short delay to avoid navigation conflicts

    return false; // Return false to prevent any default link behavior
  }
  isUserLoggedIn(): boolean {
    return Object.keys(this.authService.getAuthToken()).length !== 0;
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class InitSuccessGuard {
  constructor(
    private settingsService: SettingsService,
    private router: Router,
  ) {}

  canActivate() {
    const canActivate = this.settingsService.isSettings;

    if (!canActivate) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl('init-error');
    }

    return canActivate;
  }
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class InitErrorGuard {
  constructor(
    private settingsService: SettingsService,
    private router: Router,
  ) {}

  canActivate() {
    const canActivate = !this.settingsService.isSettings;

    if (!canActivate) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl('');
    }

    return canActivate;
  }
}

import { HttpEvent, HttpHandler, HttpInterceptor, HttpRequest } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Injectable, Injector } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { EMPTY, Observable, throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { catchError, map } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { SnackBarColor } from '../../base/page-component-base';
import { openErrorDetailDialog } from '../../components/dialog/error-detail-dialog/error-detail-dialog.component';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Injectable()
export class HttpClientResponseInterceptor implements HttpInterceptor {
  private snackBar: MatSnackBar;
  private dialog: MatDialog;

  constructor(private router: Router, private injector: Injector) {
    this.snackBar = injector.get(MatSnackBar);
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
  }

  intercept(req: HttpRequest<any>, next: HttpHandler): Observable<HttpEvent<any>> {
    return next.handle(req).pipe(
      map((event: HttpEvent<any>) => {
        return event;
      }),
      catchError((err: any) => {
        if (err.error != null && err.error.title != undefined && err.error.title == 'DoubleConfirmDialog') return EMPTY;
        if (err.error != null && err.error.title != undefined && err.error.title == 'Unauthorized') {
          this.openSnackBar('Sikertelen bejelentkezés', SnackBarColor.Error);
          return throwError(() => err);
        }
        if (err.error != null && err.error.RenewInvalidToken) return throwError(() => err);
        if (err.error != null && err.error.TwoFactorChecker) return throwError(() => err);

        if (
          err.error != null &&
          err.error.instance &&
          err.error.instance != undefined &&
          err.error.instance === 'InvalidToken'
        ) {
          this.openSnackBar(
            'Munkaideje lejárt, ezért kiléptettük! A folytatáshoz jelentkezzen be újra!',
            SnackBarColor.Error,
          );
          return throwError(() => err);
        }
        if (err.error != null && err.error.detail != null && err.error.detail != undefined) {
          console.log('details', err.error.detail);
          openErrorDetailDialog(this.dialog, err.error.detail, err.error.title);
        } else if (err.error != null && err.error.error != null && err.error.error != undefined) {
          this.openSnackBar(err.error.error, SnackBarColor.Error);
        } else if (err.error != null)
          this.openSnackBar('Hiba történt a művelet végrahajtása során!', SnackBarColor.Error);
        //this.catchResponseError(err, req, next);
        return throwError(() => err);
      }),
    );
  }

  private openSnackBar(message: string, snackBarColor: SnackBarColor, action = 'Ok', duration = 5000) {
    this.snackBar.open(message, action, {
      duration: duration,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${snackBarColor}`],
    });
  }

  // todo: 404 page
  // private catchResponseError(err: HttpErrorResponse, req: HttpRequest<any>, next: HttpHandler) {
  //     if (err instanceof HttpErrorResponse) {
  //         if (err.status === 404) {
  //             this.router.navigate(['/404']);
  //         }
  //     }
  // }
}

import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ClientAPIService } from '../clientAPI.service';
import { SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export default class TokenApiService extends ClientAPIService {
  constructor(http: HttpClient, _snackBar: MatSnackBar, settingsService: SettingsService) {
    super('authenticate', http, _snackBar, settingsService);
  }

  getAccessToken(loginModel: any) {
    const url = `${this.settingsService.baseUrls.framework}/${this.apiName}/login`;
    return this.setUpErrorHandler(
      this.http.post(url, loginModel, {
        headers: new HttpHeaders({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
      }),
    );
  }

  getRefreshToken(token: string) {
    const url = `${this.settingsService.baseUrls.framework}/api/${this.apiName}/${token}/refresh-token`;
    return this.setUpErrorHandler(
      this.http.post(
        url,
        {},
        {
          headers: new HttpHeaders({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

import moment from 'moment';
import AccessTokenModel from './access-token-model';

export default function tokenValid(token: AccessTokenModel) {
  const now = moment.utc();
  const expiry = moment(token.expiration).utc();
  return now.isBefore(expiry);
}

import { Injectable, Injector } from '@angular/core';
import { SettingsModel } from '../../models/settings/settings.model';
import { CommonDetailsService } from '../../generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { forkJoin } from 'rxjs';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SettingsService {
  private settings?: SettingsModel;

  get isSettings() {
    return !!this.settings;
  }

  constructor(private commonDetailsService: CommonDetailsService, private injector: Injector) {}

  initializeApp(): Promise<void> {
    const translateService = this.injector.get(TranslateService);

    return forkJoin({
      translateUse: translateService.use('hu'),
      apiUrls: this.commonDetailsService.commonDetailsGetApiUrls(),
    })
      .toPromise()
      .then((results) => {
        this.settings = results!.apiUrls as SettingsModel;
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('APP_INITIALIZER failed', err);
        return; // fallback, Angular így is továbbmegy
      });
  }

  get baseUrls() {
    return this.settings!.baseUrls;
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\core\services\validators\date.validator.ts

import { AbstractControl, ValidationErrors, ValidatorFn } from '@angular/forms';
import moment from 'moment';

export class DateValidator {
  static maxValidator(
    currentControlName: string,
    maxControlName: string,
    error: string,
    displayErrorBothControls = false,
  ): ValidatorFn {
    return (formGroup: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
      const currentDateFormControl = formGroup.get(currentControlName)!;
      const maxDateFormControl = formGroup.get(maxControlName)!;

      this.validateMax(currentDateFormControl, maxDateFormControl, error, displayErrorBothControls);

      return null;
    };
  }

  static maxValidatorByMaxControl(
    currentControlName: string,
    maxDateFormControl: AbstractControl,
    error: string,
    displayErrorBothControls = false,
  ): ValidatorFn {
    return (formGroup: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
      const currentDateFormControl = formGroup.get(currentControlName)!;
      this.validateMax(currentDateFormControl, maxDateFormControl, error, displayErrorBothControls);

      return null;
    };
  }

  static minValidator(
    currentControlName: string,
    minControlName: string,
    error: string,
    displayErrorBothControls = false,
  ): ValidatorFn {
    return (formGroup: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
      const currentDateFormControl = formGroup.get(currentControlName)!;
      const minDateFormControl = formGroup.get(minControlName)!;

      this.validateMin(currentDateFormControl, minDateFormControl, error, displayErrorBothControls);

      return null;
    };
  }

  static minValidatorByMinControl(
    currentControlName: string,
    minDateFormControl: AbstractControl,
    error: string,
    displayErrorBothControls = false,
  ): ValidatorFn {
    return (formGroup: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
      const currentDateFormControl = formGroup.get(currentControlName)!;
      this.validateMin(currentDateFormControl, minDateFormControl, error, displayErrorBothControls);

      return null;
    };
  }

  /**
   * Validátor, hogy a kiválasztott datetime control elem értéke csak az adott időpillanatot követő egész percnél nem lehet korábbi.
   * @param currentControlName A dátumérték, amelyre vizsgálunk.
   * @param error A hiba szövege, ha nem jövőbeli értéket állítottunk be. Ha nem állítjuk be, az alapértelmezett értéke: "Csak jövőbeli időpont adható meg!".
   * @param additionalMiliseconds A jövőbeliség, hogy az aktuális időpillanat, plusz a paraméterben átadott milisecundum időhöz képest későbbi dátumértéket várunk!".
   */
  static futureDateValidator(
    currentDateFormControl: AbstractControl,
    error = 'Csak jövőbeli időpont adható meg!',
    additionalMiliseconds = 60000,
  ): ValidatorFn {
    return (formGroup: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
      if (currentDateFormControl == null) {
        return null;
      }

      const currentDateValue = currentDateFormControl.value;
      // Aktuális idő beállítása, de a másodperc, milliszekundum lekerekítve 0-ra.
      const now = new Date();
      now.setMilliseconds(0);

      // 60000 milliseconds = 1 minute
      const additionalTime = additionalMiliseconds >= 0 ? additionalMiliseconds | 0 : 0;
      const nowPlusOneMinute = new Date(now.getTime() + additionalTime);

      if (currentDateValue) {
        const selectedDate = moment(currentDateValue);
        const nowDate = moment(nowPlusOneMinute);
        if (selectedDate < nowDate) {
          return { serverError: error };
        }
      }
      return null;
    };
  }


  static maxDateValidator(maxDate: Date, error = 'Csak múltbeli időpont adható meg!'): ValidatorFn {
    return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null  => {
      if (!control.value) return null;

      const inputDate = new Date(control.value);
      const max = new Date(maxDate);

      // Nullázzuk az időrészeket, csak a napra legyünk érzékenyek
      inputDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      max.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      if(inputDate > max){
        return { serverError: error };
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }

  private static validateMin(
    currentDateFormControl: AbstractControl,
    minDateFormControl: AbstractControl,
    error: string,
    displayErrorBothControls: boolean,
  ) {
    const currentDateValue = currentDateFormControl.value;
    const minDateValue = minDateFormControl.value;

    if (minDateValue && currentDateValue) {
      currentDateFormControl.markAllAsTouched();
      minDateFormControl.markAllAsTouched();

      const currentDate = moment(currentDateValue);
      const minDate = moment(minDateValue);
      if (currentDate < minDate) {
        currentDateFormControl.setErrors({ serverError: error });
        if (displayErrorBothControls) {
          minDateFormControl.setErrors({ serverError: error });
        }
      } else {
        this.removeCustomErrors(currentDateFormControl, minDateFormControl, error, displayErrorBothControls);
      }
    } else {
      this.removeCustomErrors(currentDateFormControl, minDateFormControl, error, displayErrorBothControls);
    }
  }

  private static validateMax(
    currentDateFormControl: AbstractControl,
    maxDateFormControl: AbstractControl,
    error: string,
    displayErrorBothControls: boolean,
  ) {
    const currentDateValue = currentDateFormControl.value;
    const maxDateValue = maxDateFormControl.value;

    if (maxDateValue && currentDateValue) {
      currentDateFormControl.markAllAsTouched();
      maxDateFormControl.markAllAsTouched();

      const currentDate = moment(currentDateValue);
      const maxDate = moment(maxDateValue);
      if (currentDate > maxDate) {
        currentDateFormControl.setErrors({ serverError: error });
        if (displayErrorBothControls) {
          maxDateFormControl.setErrors({ serverError: error });
        }
      } else {
        this.removeCustomErrors(currentDateFormControl, maxDateFormControl, error, displayErrorBothControls);
      }
    } else {
      this.removeCustomErrors(currentDateFormControl, maxDateFormControl, error, displayErrorBothControls);
    }
  }

  private static removeCustomErrors(
    currentControl: AbstractControl,
    maxControl: AbstractControl,
    error: string,
    displayErrorBothControls: boolean,
  ) {
    if (currentControl.errors && currentControl.errors['serverError'] == error) {
      delete currentControl.errors['serverError'];
      currentControl.updateValueAndValidity();
    }

    if (displayErrorBothControls && maxControl.errors && maxControl.errors['serverError'] == error) {
      delete maxControl.errors['serverError'];
      maxControl.updateValueAndValidity();
    }
  }

  private static removeFutureErrors(currentControl: AbstractControl, error: string) {
    if (currentControl.errors && currentControl.errors['serverError'] == error) {
      delete currentControl.errors['serverError'];
      currentControl.updateValueAndValidity();
    }
  }
}

  filter,
  interval,
  map,
  mergeMap,
  Observable,
  startWith,
  Subscription,
  switchMap,

import { BreadcrumbService } from '../../core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
