import { NotificationModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';
import { MatNotificationDetailDialogData } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/notification-detail-dialog/notification-detail-dialog.component';
import {
  MatNotificationListDialogData,
  NotificationListDialogComponent,
} from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/notification-list-dialog/notification-list-dialog.component';
import { AuthenticateApiService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/authenticate-api-service';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';
import { Title } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import {
  DialogPosition,
  MatDialog,
  MatDialogConfig,
} from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { SelectListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/selectListItemDto';
import { TenantSelectionDialogComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/tenant-selection-dialog/tenant-selection-dialog.component';
import { NgxSpinnerService } from 'ngx-spinner';

@Component({
  selector: 'navbar-cmp',
  templateUrl: 'navbar.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./navbar.component.scss'],
})
export class NavbarComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('navbar-cmp', { static: false }) button: any;

  location: Location;
  title?: string;
  subRouteTitle?: string;
  ROUTES = TOP_ROUTES;
  isCollapsed = true;
  breadcrumbItems: any[] = [];
  pageTitle: string | undefined;
  isButtonVisible?: boolean;
  navbarButtonText?: string;
  navbarButtonIcon?: string;
  navBarSecOp?: string;
  notificationsCount?: number;
  private dialog: MatDialog;

  private subs = new Subscription();
  private toggleButton: any;
  private sidebarVisible: boolean;
  timeval?: Subscription;
  notifications?: NotificationModel[];
  isValidUser = true;
  private workers: Worker[] = new Array<Worker>();
  public tenantCode?: string;
  public tenantName?: string;

  constructor(
    location: Location,
    public router: Router,
    public breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    public navbarService: NavbarService,
    private element: ElementRef,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private workerStore: WorkerStore,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private injector: Injector,
    private authenticateApiService: AuthenticateApiService,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private titleService: Title,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
    private spinner: NgxSpinnerService,
  ) {
    this.location = location;
    this.sidebarVisible = false;
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
  }

  //TODO: NAVBAR SERVICE REF 0 LEVENNI
  navBarActionButton() {
    this.navbarService.navbarButtonClicked();
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    this.subs.add(
      this.navbarService.visible$.subscribe((isVisible) => {
        this.isButtonVisible = isVisible;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
      })
    );
    this.subs.add(
      this.navbarService.buttonText$.subscribe((buttonText) => {
        this.navbarButtonText = buttonText;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
      })
    );
    this.subs.add(
      this.navbarService.icon$.subscribe((icon) => {
        this.navbarButtonIcon = icon;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
      })
    );
    this.subs.add(
      this.navbarService.secOp$.subscribe((secOp) => {
        this.navBarSecOp = secOp;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
      })
    );
    this.subs.add(
      this.router.events.subscribe((val) => {
        if (val instanceof NavigationStart) {
          this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonVisibility(false);
          this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonText(undefined);
        }
      }),
    );

    // Set tenant info immediately from localStorage on component init
    this.tenantCode = this.authService.getCurrentTenant() || undefined;
    this.tenantName = this.authService.getCurrentTenantName();

    // Then load full user data asynchronously
    this.getCurrentUserData();
    this.subscribeToRouteChangeEvents();
    this.getBreadcrumbItems();
    const navbar: HTMLElement = this.element.nativeElement;
    this.toggleButton = navbar.getElementsByClassName('navbar-toggle')[0];
    this.router.events.subscribe(() => {
      this.sidebarClose();
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      this.sidebarClose();
    });

    this.workerStore.execChange.subscribe((value) => {
      this.notificationsCount = value
        ? (value as NotificationModel[]).filter(
            (x) => x.isRead != null && x.isRead == false
          ).length > 0
          ? (value as NotificationModel[]).filter(
              (x) => x.isRead != null && x.isRead == false
            ).length
          : undefined
        : undefined;
    });

    this.workerStore.userChange.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value != undefined && value === false) this.authenticateApiService.logout();
    });

    // Subscribe to tenant changes from the AuthService
    this.subs.add(
      this.authService.onChanged().subscribe((res) => {
        if (res) {
          // Update tenant info from the UserAuthModel
          this.tenantName = res.tenantName || '';

          // Also get the current tenant code from localStorage since it's not in UserAuthModel
          this.tenantCode = this.authService.getCurrentTenant() || undefined;
          this.cdr.detectChanges();
        }
      })
    );
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
    this.dialog.closeAll();
  }

  getBreadcrumbItems() {
    this.breadcrumbItems = this.breadcrumbService.getItems();
  }

  sidebarToggle() {
    if (this.sidebarVisible === false) {
      this.sidebarOpen();
    } else {
      this.sidebarClose();
    }
  }

  sidebarOpen() {
    const toggleButton = this.toggleButton;
    const html = document.getElementsByTagName('html')[0];
    const mainPanel = <HTMLElement>(
      document.getElementsByClassName('main-panel')[0]
    );
    setTimeout(function () {
      toggleButton.classList.add('toggled');
    }, 500);

    html.classList.add('nav-open');
    if (window.innerWidth < 991) {
      mainPanel.style.position = 'fixed';
    }
    this.sidebarVisible = true;
  }

  sidebarClose() {
    const html = document.getElementsByTagName('html')[0];
    const mainPanel = <HTMLElement>(
      document.getElementsByClassName('main-panel')[0]
    );
    if (window.innerWidth < 991) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        mainPanel.style.position = '';
      }, 500);
    }
    this.toggleButton.classList.remove('toggled');
    this.sidebarVisible = false;
    html.classList.remove('nav-open');
  }

  collapse() {
    this.isCollapsed = !this.isCollapsed;
    const navbar = document.getElementsByTagName('nav')[0];
    if (!this.isCollapsed) {
      navbar.classList.remove('navbar-transparent');
      navbar.classList.add('bg-white');
    } else {
      navbar.classList.add('navbar-transparent');
      navbar.classList.remove('bg-white');
    }
  }

  toHome() {
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.router.navigate(['']);
  }

  info() {
    alert('Info');
  }

  openNotifications() {
    this.openNotificationListDialog(this.dialog, this.notifications || []);
  }

  openNotificationListDialog(
    dialog: MatDialog,
    notifications: NotificationModel[]
  ): Observable<any> {
    const config = new MatDialogConfig();
    config.autoFocus = true;
    config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
    config.maxWidth = '300px';
    config.minWidth = '300px';
    config.maxHeight = '600px';
    config.position = { right: '6rem', top: '3.5rem' } as DialogPosition;
    config.data = {
      notifications: notifications,
    } as MatNotificationListDialogData;

    const dialogRef = dialog.open(NotificationListDialogComponent, config);

    return dialogRef.afterClosed();
  }

  private subscribeToRouteChangeEvents() {
    const latestRoute = this.getLatestChild(this.activatedRoute);
    if (latestRoute) {
      latestRoute.data.subscribe((elem) => {
        this.setTitleFromRouteData(elem);
      });
    }
    this.subs.add(
      this.router.events
        .pipe(
          filter((event) => event instanceof NavigationEnd),
          map(() => this.activatedRoute),
          map((route) => this.getLatestChild(route)),
          filter((route) => route.outlet === 'primary'),
          mergeMap((route) => route.data)
        )
        .subscribe((event) => {
          this.setTitleFromRouteData(event);
        })
    );
  }

  private getLatestChild(route: ActivatedRoute): ActivatedRoute {
    while (route.firstChild) {
      route = route.firstChild;
    }
    return route;
  }

  private setTitleFromRouteData(routeData: any) {
    this.pageTitle = routeData.pageTitle;

    if (this.pageTitle) this.titleService.setTitle(this.translateService.instant(this.pageTitle));
  }

  workerCheckers(checkNotofication: boolean) {
    if (typeof Worker !== 'undefined') {
      if (checkNotofication) {
        const worker = new Worker(
          new URL('src/app/web-worker.worker.ts', import.meta.url)
        );
        this.workers.push(worker);

        this.timeval = interval(3000)
          .pipe(
            startWith(0),
            switchMap(async () => this.updateNotif(worker))
          )
          .subscribe((error) => {});
      }

      //   const userWorker = new Worker(new URL('src/app/web-worker.worker.ts', import.meta.url));
      //   this.workers.push(userWorker);

      //   this.timeval =
      //     interval(60000)
      //       .pipe(
      //         startWith(0),
      //         switchMap(async () => this.userChecker(userWorker))
      //       )
      //       .subscribe(
      //         error => { }
      //       );
    }
  }

  async updateNotif(worker: Worker) {
    const tokenModel = this.authService.getAuthToken();

    if (tokenModel == null || tokenModel.token == null) this.stop();
    else {
      worker.onmessage = ({ data }) => {
        this.notifications = data as NotificationModel[];
        this.workerStore.notificationChange(this.notifications);
      };
      worker.postMessage(tokenModel.token);
    }
  }

  async userChecker(/*worker: Worker*/) {
    // const tokenModel = this.authService.getAuthToken();
    // if (tokenModel == null || tokenModel.token == null)
    //   this.stop();
    // else {
    //   worker.onmessage = ({ data }) => {
    //     this.workerStore.userValidationChange(data as boolean);
    //   };
    //   var params = [];
    //   params.push("userChecker");
    //   params.push(tokenModel.token);
    //   worker.postMessage(params);
    // }
  }

  public stop(): void {
    this.workers.forEach((w) => w.terminate());
    this.timeval?.unsubscribe();
  }

  private getCurrentUserData(): void {
    // First try to get tenant info from localStorage as an immediate solution
    const tenantCode = this.authService.getCurrentTenant();
    const tenantName = this.authService.getCurrentTenantName();

    // Always set the tenant values from localStorage, even for null tenant
    if (tenantName) {
      this.tenantCode = tenantCode!;
      this.tenantName = tenantName;
      this.cdr.detectChanges(); // Force UI update
    }

    // Also make the API call to ensure we have the latest data
    this.userService.usersGetCurrentUser().subscribe({
      next: (data: any) => {
        if (data) {
          // Make sure we have a proper tenant name, either from API or localStorage
          let updatedTenantName = data.tenantName;
          if (!updatedTenantName && tenantName) {
            // If API doesn't return a name but we have one in localStorage, keep using it
            updatedTenantName = tenantName;
          }

          // Always set both values regardless of whether tenantCode is null
          this.tenantCode = data.tenantCode; // This can be null for null tenant
          this.tenantName = updatedTenantName || '';

          // Always update localStorage to ensure consistency
          this.authService.setCurrentTenant(this.tenantCode || null, this.tenantName || '');
          this.cdr.detectChanges(); // Force UI update
          this.workerCheckers(true);
        }
      },
      error: (error) => {
        // On error, ensure we at least display what we have in localStorage
        if (tenantName && !this.tenantName) {
          this.tenantName = tenantName;
          this.cdr.detectChanges();
        }
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Check if the user is authenticated
   * @returns True if the user is authenticated
   */
  isAuthenticated(): boolean {
    // Use the authenticateApiService to check if the user is logged in
    return this.authenticateApiService.isUserLoggedIn();
  }

  /**
   * Opens tenant selection using a dialog
   */
  openTenantSelection(): void {
    this.spinner.show();

    // Get current tenant code for pre-selection
    const currentTenantCode = this.authService.getCurrentTenant();

    // First fetch the available tenants
    this.authService.getTenants().subscribe({
      next: (tenants) => {
        this.spinner.hide();

        // Open the tenant selection dialog with the list of tenants
        const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(TenantSelectionDialogComponent, {
          width: '600px',
          height: '500px',
          data: {
            tenants: tenants,
            selectedTenantCode: currentTenantCode,
          },
        });

        dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((selectedTenant) => {
          if (selectedTenant) {
            this.spinner.show();
            // If a tenant was selected, handle similar to tenant-selection.component.ts
            const tenantCode = selectedTenant.code;
            const tenantName = selectedTenant.name;

            // Ensure tenant name is not empty
            if (!tenantName && tenantCode === null) {
              // Provide a fallback name if somehow the null tenant has no name
              selectedTenant.name = 'No Tenant';
            }

            // All tenants (including null) should use loginToSelectedTenant
            this.authService.loginToSelectedTenant(tenantCode).subscribe({
              next: (response) => {
                // Update the auth token with the response
                this.authService.setAuthToken(response);

                // Set the tenant with its name - do this AFTER setting the auth token
                this.authService.setCurrentTenant(
                  tenantCode,
                  selectedTenant.name
                );

                // Update the local component state immediately
                this.tenantCode = tenantCode;
                this.tenantName = selectedTenant.name;
                this.cdr.detectChanges();

                // Navigate using Angular router instead of forcing page reload
                this.router.navigate(['/']);
              },
              error: (error) => {
                this.spinner.hide();
                console.error('Error selecting tenant:', error);
              },
            });
          }
        });
      },
      error: (error) => {
        this.spinner.hide();
        console.error('Error loading tenants:', error);
      },
    });
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { NavigationEnd, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';
import { AuthenticateService } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/authenticate.service';
import { SitesService } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sites.service';
import { SecOperationMatrixModel } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secOperationMatrixModel';
import { AuthenticateApiService } from '../../core/services/security/authenticate-api-service';
import { environment } from '../../../environments/environment';
import { SecRoleType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { UsersService } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';

export interface SecOpAuthorization {
  tenantUser?: boolean;
  reqRoles: SecRoleType[];
}

export interface RouteInfo extends SecOpAuthorization {
  path?: string;
  title: string;
  icon: string;
  class?: string;
  subRoutes?: SubRouteInfo[];
  subRoutesCollapsed?: boolean;
}

export interface SubRouteInfo extends SecOpAuthorization {
  path: string[];
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  class?: string;
  subRoutes?: SubRouteInfo[];
  subRoutesCollapsed?: boolean;
}

const enviroment_dependent_menu_items: string[] = ['SIDEBAR.DEVICE_SUB_ROUTES.INTERFACES'];

@Component({
  selector: 'sidebar-cmp',
  templateUrl: 'sidebar.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./sidebar.component.scss'],
})
export class SidebarComponent implements OnInit {
  private RECORDS = 2;
  private MONITORING = 5;

  public topMenuItems: RouteInfo[] = [];
  public bottomMenuItems: RouteInfo[] = [];
  public secOperationMatrix?: SecOperationMatrixModel;

  public userSecRoles?: SecRoleType[];
  public userSecRoleAvailable?: Promise<boolean>;

  public secOperationMatrixAvailable?: Promise<boolean>;
  tenantName?: string;
  tenantCode?: string;

  constructor(
    private authService: AuthService,
    private router: Router,
    private authenticateApiService: AuthenticateApiService,
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private authenticateService: AuthenticateService,
    private usersService: UsersService,
  ) {
    this.router.events.subscribe((val) => {
      if (val instanceof NavigationEnd) {
        this.routeChanged();
      }
    });
  }

  public isActive(base: string): boolean {
    return this.router.url.startsWith(base);
  }

  /**
   * Checks if a menu item or any of its submenu items is active
   * @param menuItem The menu item to check
   * @returns true if the menu item or any submenu item is active
   */
  public isMenuActive(menuItem: RouteInfo): boolean {
    // Check if the menu item itself is active
    if (this.isActive(menuItem.path!)) {
      return true;
    }
    
    // Check if any submenu item is active
    if (menuItem.subRoutes) {
      for (const subRoute of menuItem.subRoutes) {
        if (subRoute.path && this.isActive(subRoute.path[0])) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
    
    return false;
  }

  public get isTenantUser() {
    // For reliable tenant status detection, get the tenant code directly from the auth service
    const tenantCode = this.authService.getCurrentTenant();
    // A user is a tenant user if they have a non-null tenant code
    return tenantCode !== null;
  }

  /**
   *
   * @returns Van-e jogunk a monitoring menü megjelenítésére?
   */
  private isMonitoringShowable(): boolean {
    const route = TOP_ROUTES.find((x) => x.path == '/monitoring');
    if (route && this.userSecRoleAvailable) return this.hasRight(route);

    return false;
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    // Directly get the tenant name from localStorage
    this.tenantName = this.authService.getCurrentTenantName();

    // Still subscribe to changes for future updates
    this.authService.onChanged().subscribe((res) => {
      if (res && res.tenantName) {
        this.tenantName = res.tenantName;
      }
    });

    this.topMenuItems = TOP_ROUTES.filter((menuItem) => menuItem);
    this.bottomMenuItems = BOTTOM_ROUTES.filter((menuItem) => menuItem);

    /**
     * Az aktuális felhasználó szerepköreinek lekérdezése.
     */
    this.authService.getRoles().then((result) => {
      this.userSecRoles = result;
      this.userSecRoleAvailable = Promise.resolve(true);

      this.authenticateService.authenticateGetSecOperationMatrix().subscribe((secOperationMatrix) => {
        this.secOperationMatrix = secOperationMatrix;
        // this.secOperationMatrix.secOperationList.forEach(function (value) {});

        this.clearSitesFromMonitoringSubRouteArray();

        // SitesService hívás, csak akkor, ha rendelkezünk legalább SiteRead joggal.
        if (this.hasRightBySecOpCode('SiteRead') && this.isMonitoringShowable()) {
          // this.sitesService.sitesGetSitesGuidEntityRef().subscribe((sites: SiteEntityDtoGuidEntityRef[]) => {
          //   sites.forEach(site => {
          //     // Csak akkor tegyük be a menü elemek közé, ha még nem szerepelnek benne. (duplikáció-védelem)
          //     if (!this.hasSubRouteInfoPathIdentifier(this.topMenuItems[this.MONITORING].subRoutes, site.identifier)) {
          //       this.topMenuItems[this.MONITORING].subRoutes.push(<SubRouteInfo>{
          //         path: ['monitoring', 'overview', site.identifier],
          //         title: site.entityDisplayName,
          //         reqRoles: []
          //       });
          //     }
          //   });
          //   this.routeChanged();
          // });
        }
      });

      this.secOperationMatrixAvailable = Promise.resolve(true);
    });

    this.getCurrentUserData();
  }

  private clearSitesFromMonitoringSubRouteArray() {
    let monitoringSubRoutes = this.topMenuItems[this.MONITORING].subRoutes;
    const elementsToClear: SubRouteInfo[] = [];

    monitoringSubRoutes?.forEach((value: SubRouteInfo) => {
      if (value.path && value.path.length > 2) elementsToClear.push(value);
    });

    monitoringSubRoutes = monitoringSubRoutes?.filter((item) => !elementsToClear.includes(item));
  }

  /**
   * A subRouteInfo tömbön végigmegyünk, és path azonosító alapján
   * keresünk. Ha megtaláltuk, akkor visszatérünk igaz értékkel, egyébként hamissal.
   */
  // private hasSubRouteInfoPathIdentifier(subRouteArray: SubRouteInfo[], identifier: string): boolean {
  //   for (let i = 0; i < subRouteArray.length; i++) {
  //     const value = subRouteArray[i];
  //     if (value.path && value.path.length > 2 && value.path[2] == identifier) return true;
  //   }
  //   return false;
  // }

  public setMenuItems(
    activeElement: RouteInfo | SubRouteInfo,
    parentSubRouteInfo: RouteInfo | SubRouteInfo | null = null,
  ) {
    if ('subRoutes' in activeElement) {
      activeElement.subRoutesCollapsed = !activeElement?.subRoutesCollapsed;
      if (parentSubRouteInfo === null) {
        this.topMenuItems.forEach((menuElement) => {
          if (menuElement.title != activeElement.title) {
            menuElement.subRoutesCollapsed = true;

            if (menuElement.subRoutes) {
              menuElement.subRoutes.forEach((subSubelement) => {
                subSubelement.subRoutesCollapsed = true;
              });
            }
          }
        });
      } else {
        // Az azonos szinten lévő többi subMenuItem (aminek vannak subsubmenuitemjei) becsukása.
        parentSubRouteInfo.subRoutes!.forEach((menuElement) => {
          if (menuElement.title != activeElement.title) {
            menuElement.subRoutesCollapsed = true;
          }
        });
      }
    }
  }

  public clearBreadcrumb() {
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
  }

  private routeChanged() {
    this.topMenuItems.forEach(() => {
      //menuElement.subRoutesCollapsed = !this.isActive(menuElement.path);
    });
    this.bottomMenuItems.forEach(() => {
      //menuElement.subRoutesCollapsed = !this.isActive(menuElement.path);
    });
  }

  getClass(itemClass: string): string {
    return itemClass == null ? '' : itemClass;
  }

  logout() {
    this.authenticateApiService.logout();
    this.router.navigate([`/login`]);
  }

  hasRight(menuItem: SecOpAuthorization) {
    // const availableSecops = this.secOperationMatrix?.secOperationList?.map((secOp) => secOp.secOperation);
    let hasRight = false;

    if (
      environment.production &&
      enviroment_dependent_menu_items.filter((x) => x == (menuItem as RouteInfo).title).length > 0
    )
      return false;

    menuItem.reqRoles.forEach((reqRole) => {
      hasRight = hasRight || this.userSecRoles?.includes(reqRole) || false;
    });

    if (menuItem.reqRoles.length == 0) hasRight = true;

    if (menuItem.tenantUser === true && !this.isTenantUser) {
      hasRight = false;
    } else if (menuItem.tenantUser === false && this.isTenantUser) {
      hasRight = false;
    }

    return hasRight;
  }

  /**
   * HasRight megvalósítás string bemenetre.
   * @param reqSecOp A secOp kódja, stringként átadva.
   */
  hasRightBySecOpCode(reqSecOp: string): boolean {
    const availableSecops = this.secOperationMatrix?.secOperationList?.map((secOp) => secOp.secOperation);
    return availableSecops?.includes(reqSecOp) || false;
  }

  /**
   * Egy menüItem alatti almenük közül legalább egy megjeleníthető-e? (Ha nem, akkor a főmenü se jelenjen meg!)
   * @param menuItem A főmenü, mint paraméter.
   */
  anySubMenuShowable(menuItem: RouteInfo): boolean {
    let anySubMenuShowable = false;
    menuItem.subRoutes!.forEach((subMenuItem) => {
      anySubMenuShowable = anySubMenuShowable || this.hasRight(subMenuItem);
    });
    return anySubMenuShowable;
  }

  anySubSubMenuShowable(menuItem: RouteInfo): boolean {
    let anySubSubMenuShowable = false;
    menuItem.subRoutes!.forEach((subMenuItem) => {
      subMenuItem.subRoutes!.forEach((subSubMenuItem) => {
        anySubSubMenuShowable = anySubSubMenuShowable || this.hasRight(subSubMenuItem);
      });
    });
    return anySubSubMenuShowable;
  }

  /**
   * Gets the current user data including tenant information
   * This is a direct approach like in the navbar component
   */
  private getCurrentUserData(): void {
    this.usersService.usersGetCurrentUser().subscribe({
      next: (data: any) => {
        // Check if there's a tenant code (not just tenant name)
        if (data && data.tenantCode) {
          this.tenantCode = data.tenantCode;
          this.tenantName = data.tenantName || '';
        } else {
          // Reset tenant values to null for code, empty string for name
          this.tenantCode = undefined;
          this.tenantName = '';
        }
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('SidebarComponent - Error getting current user data:', error);
        // Reset tenant values on error
        this.tenantCode = undefined;
        this.tenantName = '';
      },
    });
  }
}

import { Component, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { openVersionDialog } from './version-modal/version-modal.component';
import { HomeService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/home.service';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-version',
  templateUrl: './version.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./version.component.scss'],
})
export class VersionComponent implements OnInit {
  version!: string;
  private readonly dialog: MatDialog;

  constructor(injector: Injector, private homeService: HomeService) {
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.homeService.homeGetVersion().subscribe((version) => {
      this.version = 'v' + version.version;
    });
  }

  openVersionModal() {
    openVersionDialog(this.dialog);
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { VersionModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { HomeService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/home.service';
import { HomeService as DataReceiverHomeService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/home.service';
import { HomeService as MonitoringHomeService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/home.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-confirm-dialog',
  templateUrl: './version-modal.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./version-modal.component.scss'],
})
export class VersionModalComponent implements OnInit {
  frameworkVersion!: string;
  dataReceiverVersion!: string;
  monitoringVersion!: string;
  reportingVersion!: string;

  frameworkEnvironment!: string;
  dataReceiverEnvironment!: string;
  monitoringEnvironment!: string;
  reportingEnvironment!: string;

  constructor(
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<VersionModalComponent>,
    private homeService: HomeService,
    private dataReceiverHomeService: DataReceiverHomeService,
    private monitoringHomeService: MonitoringHomeService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.homeService.homeGetVersion().subscribe((versionModel) => {
      this.frameworkVersion = this.getFormattedVersion(versionModel);
      this.frameworkEnvironment = this.getFormattedEnvironment(versionModel);
    });
    this.dataReceiverHomeService.homeGetVersion().subscribe((versionModel) => {
      this.dataReceiverVersion = this.getFormattedVersion(versionModel);
      this.frameworkEnvironment = this.getFormattedEnvironment(versionModel);
    });
    this.monitoringHomeService.homeGetVersion().subscribe((versionModel) => {
      this.monitoringVersion = this.getFormattedVersion(versionModel);
      this.frameworkEnvironment = this.getFormattedEnvironment(versionModel);
    });
  }

  private getFormattedVersion(versionModel: VersionModel) {
    return `v${versionModel.version}`;
  }

  private getFormattedEnvironment(versionModel: VersionModel) {
    if (versionModel.environment === null) return '';
    return `(${versionModel.environment})`;
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }
}

export function openVersionDialog(dialog: MatDialog): Observable<any> {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(VersionModalComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRouteSnapshot, Router, RouterStateSnapshot } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { DevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/devices.service';
import { SingleDeviceModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/singleDeviceModel';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class DeviceItemResolver {
  constructor(private devicesService: DevicesService, private router: Router) {}

  resolve(route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot, state: RouterStateSnapshot): Observable<SingleDeviceModel> {
    return this.devicesService.deviceGet(route.paramMap.get('deviceIdentifier')!).pipe(
      catchError((err) => {
        this.router.navigateByUrl('/devices/iot');
        return err;
      }),
    ) as Observable<SingleDeviceModel>;
  }
}

import { DevicesService } from './../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/devices.service';
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterStateSnapshot, ActivatedRouteSnapshot } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { SingleChannelModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/models';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class MeasureEndpointResolver {
  constructor(private devicesService: DevicesService, private router: Router) {}

  resolve(route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot, state: RouterStateSnapshot): Observable<SingleChannelModel[]> {
    return this.devicesService
      .devicesGetChannel(route.paramMap.get('deviceIdentifier')!, Number(route.paramMap.get('measuredEndpointId')!))
      .pipe(
        catchError((err) => {
          this.router.navigateByUrl('/iot/' + Number(route.paramMap.get('deviceIdentifier')));
          return err;
        }),
      ) as Observable<SingleChannelModel[]>;
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRouteSnapshot, Router, RouterStateSnapshot } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { SiteLocationsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/siteLocations.service';
import { SiteLocationModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteLocationModel';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class SiteLocationResolver {
  constructor(
    private siteLocationsService: SiteLocationsService,
    private router: Router,
  ) {}

  resolve(route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot, state: RouterStateSnapshot): Observable<SiteLocationModel> {
    return this.siteLocationsService.siteLocationsGetSiteLocation(Number(route.paramMap.get('siteId'))).pipe(
      catchError((err) => {

      }),
    ) as Observable<SiteLocationModel>;
  }
}

import { Component, Inject, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormArray } from '@angular/forms';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { IoTDevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/ioTDevices.service';
import { LoaderService, ProgressRef } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-device-connection-result',
  templateUrl: './device-connection-result.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./device-connection-result.component.scss'],
})
export class DeviceConnectionResultDialogComponent implements OnInit {
  isConnectionSuccessfull: boolean;
  configsForm: UntypedFormArray;

  @ViewChild('deviceConnectionResultContent') elRef: any;
  progressRef: ProgressRef = null as any;

  constructor(
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<DeviceConnectionResultDialogComponent>,
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) deviceConnectionResultDialogData: DeviceConnectionResultDialogData,
    private ioTDevicesService: IoTDevicesService,
    private loaderService: LoaderService,
  ) {
    this.isConnectionSuccessfull = deviceConnectionResultDialogData.isConnectionSuccessfull;
    this.configsForm = deviceConnectionResultDialogData.configsForm;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  cancel() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  reTest() {
    this.progressRef = this.loaderService.showProgress(this.elRef) as any;
    this.ioTDevicesService.ioTDevicesHealthcheck('smappee', this.configsForm.value).subscribe(
      (result) => {
        this.isConnectionSuccessfull = result.success!;
      },
      () => {},
      () => {
        this.loaderService.detach(this.progressRef);
      },
    );
  }
}

export interface DeviceConnectionResultDialogData {
  isConnectionSuccessfull: boolean;
  configsForm: UntypedFormArray;
}

export function openDeviceConnectionResultDialog(
  dialog: MatDialog,
  isConnectionSuccessfull: boolean,
  configsForm: UntypedFormArray,
) {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.data = {
    configsForm,
    isConnectionSuccessfull,
  } as DeviceConnectionResultDialogData;

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(DeviceConnectionResultDialogComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\device\device-item\device-item.component.ts

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit, ViewChild, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SingleDeviceModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/singleDeviceModel';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { NavbarService } from 'src/app/layout/navbar/navbar-service';
import { openModifyDeviceDialog } from '../device-modify/device-modify.component';
import { DeviceItemBaseDataComponent } from './device-item-base-data/device-item-base-data.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-device-item',
  templateUrl: './device-item.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./device-item.component.scss'],
})
export class DeviceItemComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('itemBase') itemBaseRef!: DeviceItemBaseDataComponent;

  device = {} as SingleDeviceModel;
  isEdit = true;
  deviceName: string | undefined;
  private subs = new Subscription();

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private navbarService: NavbarService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = 'devices';

    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('IoT Eszközök', '/devices')];
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.setNavbarButton();
    this.subscribeToRouteParams();
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  setCardDeviceName(deviceName: string) {
    this.deviceName = deviceName;
  }

  private subscribeToRouteParams() {
    this.device = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.device;
    this.isEdit =
      this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE ||
      this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT;
  }

  private setNavbarButton() {
    this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonVisibility(true);
    this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonText('DEVICE.DEVICE_ITEM.NAVBAR_ACTION_BUTTON');
    this.navbarService.setNavbarIcon('change_circle');
    this.navbarService.setNavbarSecOp('DeviceConfigValueModify');
    this.subs.add(
      this.navbarService.navbarButton$.subscribe(() => {
        this.openDialog();
      }),
    );
  }

  openDialog() {
    openModifyDeviceDialog(this.dialog, this.device).subscribe((isSaved: boolean) =>
      this.refreshDeviceItemBase(isSaved),
    );
  }

  refreshDeviceItemBase(isSaved: boolean) {
    if (!isSaved) return;
    this.itemBaseRef.refresh();
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { modifyDeviceRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/devices/modifyDeviceRequestForm';
import { DevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/devices.service';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { IoTDeviceTypesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/ioTDeviceTypes.service';
import { SitesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sites.service';
import { IoTDeviceTypeModelEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/ioTDeviceTypeModelEntityRef';
import {
  SiteEntityDtoEntityRef,
  SiteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef,
  TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/models';
import { SingleDeviceModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/singleDeviceModel';
import { enableOrDisableControlsOf } from 'src/app/core/helper/helper.service';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { createDeviceRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/devices/createDeviceRequestForm';
import { EntityRef } from 'src/app/core/models/core/entity-ref';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-device-item-base-data',
  templateUrl: './device-item-base-data.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./device-item-base-data.component.scss'],
})
export class DeviceItemBaseDataComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() device!: SingleDeviceModel;

  @Output() deviceName = new EventEmitter<string>();

  @Input() isEdit = true;

  optionsRadio = [
    { label: 'Fogyasztó', value: 1 },
    { label: 'Termelő', value: 2 },
  ];

  deviceTypes!: Observable<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  sites!: Observable<SiteEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  siteLocations!: Observable<SiteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  ioTDeviceTypes!: Observable<IoTDeviceTypeModelEntityRef[]>;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.BACK, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private siteService: SitesService,
    private devicesService: DevicesService,
    private IoTDeviceTypesService: IoTDeviceTypesService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getDeviceTypes();
    this.getSites();
    this.createForm(this.device);
  }

  edit() {
    this.toggleForm(true);
  }

  cancel() {
    this.toggleForm(false);
  }

  back() {
    this.router.navigateByUrl('/devices/iot');
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    if (this.device) {
      return this.devicesService.devicesPut(this.form.value.id, this.form.value);
    } else {
      return this.devicesService.devicesPost(this.form.value);
    }
  }

  private toggleForm(toggle: boolean) {
    enableOrDisableControlsOf(
      this.form,
      [
        'name',
        'deviceCategory',
        'ioTDeviceType',
        'site',
        'siteLocation',
        'description',
        'serialNumber',
        'isAggregationPoint',
      ],
      toggle,
    );
    this.isEdit = toggle;
  }

  private createForm(device: SingleDeviceModel) {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(!device?.id ? createDeviceRequestForm.get() : modifyDeviceRequestForm.get());

    this.form.addControl('deviceCategory', new UntypedFormControl(null, [Validators.required]));
    this.form.addControl('site', new UntypedFormControl(null, [Validators.required]));

    //this.fc.site.valueChanges.subscribe((v) => { if (v) this.getSiteLocations(v) });
    this.fc.deviceCategory.valueChanges.subscribe((v) => {
      if (v) this.getIoTDeviceType(v);
    });
    this.setControlValues(this.device);

    this.fc.name.valueChanges.subscribe((v) => {
      if (v) this.deviceName.emit(v);
    });

    enableOrDisableControlsOf(
      this.form,
      [
        'name',
        'deviceCategory',
        'ioTDeviceType',
        'site',
        'siteLocation',
        'description',
        'serialNumber',
        'isAggregationPoint',
        'radioInput',
        'lat',
        'lon',
      ],
      this.isEdit,
    );
  }

  private setControlValues(device: SingleDeviceModel) {
    if (device) {
      this.form.patchValue(device);
    } else {
      this.toggleForm(true);
    }
  }

  private getDeviceTypes() {
    this.deviceTypes = this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('iot_device_category');
  }

  private getSites(): void {
    this.sites = this.siteService.sitesGetSitesEntityRef();
  }

  // private getSiteLocations(selectedSite: SiteEntityDtoEntityRef) {
  //   this.siteLocations = this.siteService.sitesGetSiteLocationsEntityRef(selectedSite.id);
  // }

  private getIoTDeviceType(v: EntityRef) {
    this.ioTDeviceTypes = this.IoTDeviceTypesService.ioTDeviceTypesGetDevicesRefByDeviceCategoryId(v.id);
  }

  /**
   * Az eszköz cseréje gomb hatására az itemBase componens frissül a friss db állapot szerint.
   */
  refresh(): void {
    this.devicesService.deviceGet(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('deviceIdentifier')!).subscribe((x) => {
      this.device = x;
      this.form.patchValue(x);
    });
  }
}

import { Component, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormArray, UntypedFormControl, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { SingleDeviceModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/singleDeviceModel';
import { IoTDevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/ioTDevices.service';
import { openDeviceConnectionResultDialog } from '../../device-connection-result/device-connection-result.component';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-device-item-card',
  templateUrl: './device-item-card.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./device-item-card.component.scss'],
})
export class DeviceItemCardComponent {
  @Input() device!: SingleDeviceModel;
  @Input() deviceName!: string;

  configsForm = new UntypedFormArray([]);

  constructor(private ioTDevicesService: IoTDevicesService, private dialog: MatDialog) {}

  public connectionTest() {
    this.device.configValues!.forEach((cv) => {
      this.configsForm.clear();
      this.configsForm.push(
        new UntypedFormGroup({
          code: new UntypedFormControl(cv.code),
          value: new UntypedFormControl(cv.value),
        }),
      );
    });

    this.ioTDevicesService.ioTDevicesHealthcheck('smappee', this.configsForm.value).subscribe((result) => {
      openDeviceConnectionResultDialog(this.dialog, result.success!, this.configsForm);
    });
  }
}

  deviceIdentifier: string;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = 'name';
  isFilterContainerOpen = false;
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  @ViewChild('deviceItemMeasurementPointsStaticDatatable', { static: true })
  protected deviceItemMeasurementPointsStaticDatatable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  @ViewChild('deviceItemMeasurementPointsStaticDatatable') table!: MatTable<any>;

  constructor(
    injector: Injector,
    protected router: Router,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private deviceService: DevicesService,
  ) {
    this.deviceIdentifier = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('deviceIdentifier')!;
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
  }

  showRow(element: DeviceMeasuredEndpointDto) {
    this.router.navigate([
      'devices/iot/' +
        this.deviceIdentifier +
        '/' +
        this.device.ioTDeviceType!.id +
        '/measure-endpoint/' +
        element.id +
        '/view',
    ]);
  }

  editRow(element: DeviceMeasuredEndpointDto) {
    this.router.navigate([
      'devices/iot/' +
        this.deviceIdentifier +
        '/' +
        this.device.ioTDeviceType!.id +
        '/' +
        '/measure-endpoint/' +
        element.id +
        '/edit',
    ]);
  }

  deleteRow(element: DeviceMeasuredEndpointDto) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.name}' mérési pontot?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.deviceService.devicesDeleteChannel(this.deviceIdentifier, element.id!).subscribe(() => this.getData());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  addMeasurementPoint() {
    openDeviceItemMeasurementPointCreateDialog(
      this.dialog,
      this.device.ioTDeviceType!.id!,
      this.deviceIdentifier,
    ).subscribe(() => {
      this.getData();
    });
  }

  getData() {
    this.deviceService.deviceGet(this.deviceIdentifier).subscribe((v) => {
      this.data.items = v.channels!;
      this.data.recordsTotal = v.channels?.length || 0;
      this.deviceItemMeasurementPointsStaticDatatable.refresh();
    });
  }

  importData(element: DeviceMeasuredEndpointDto) {
    const config = new MatDialogConfig();

    const typeId = this.device.ioTDeviceType!.id;

    config.disableClose = true;
    config.autoFocus = true;
    config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
    config.data = {
      deviceIdentifier: this.deviceIdentifier,
      measuredEndpointIdentifier: element.identifier,
      timeUnit:
        typeId == 1
          ? AggregationLevelDisplayName[0]
          : typeId == 4
          ? AggregationLevelDisplayName[1]
          : AggregationLevelDisplayName[0],
      unit: Unit.W,
    } as UploadIoTDataImportRequest;

    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ImportIoTDataDialogComponent, config);

    return dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe({
      next: (res: any) => {
        if (res) {
          openNotificationDetailDialog(
            this.dialog,
            'Dokumentum feltöltve',
            "A feltöltést megkezdtük! Az adatok importálása eltarthat egy ideig. Az importálás állapotát, illetve eredményét a Mérési pont adatlap 'Adatimportok' listában tekintheti meg!",
          ).subscribe({
            next: () => {
              localStorage.setItem('scrollPos', 'imports');
              this.router.navigate(
                [
                  'devices/iot/' +
                    this.deviceIdentifier +
                    '/' +
                    this.device.ioTDeviceType!.id +
                    '/measure-endpoint/' +
                    element.id +
                    '/view',
                ],
                { fragment: 'imports' },
              );
            },
            error: () => {
              //console.log(error);
            },
          });
        }
      },
      error: () => {
        //console.log(error);
      },
    });
  }
}

import { Component, Inject, OnDestroy, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormArray, UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { DeviceConfigsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/deviceConfigs.service';
import { DevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/devices.service';
import { CreateMeasuredEndpointRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/createMeasuredEndpointRequest';
import { DeviceConfigCodeModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/deviceConfigCodeModel';
import { configurationForm } from '../device-item-measurement-point-view-edit/device-item-measurement-point-view-edit.component';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';

export interface MatMeasurementPointCreateDialogData {
  ioTDeviceTypeId: number;
  deviceIdentifier: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-device-item-measurement-point-create-dialog-stepper',
  templateUrl: './device-item-measurement-point-create-dialog-stepper.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./device-item-measurement-point-create-dialog-stepper.component.scss'],
})
export class DeviceItemMeasurementPointCreateDialogStepperComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  parentFormGroup!: UntypedFormGroup;
  stepLabels = ['DEVICE.MEASURED_ENDPOINTS.BASE_DATA', 'DEVICE.MEASURED_ENDPOINTS.PROPERTIES'];
  ioTDeviceTypeId!: number;
  configuration!: DeviceConfigCodeModel[];
  controlsAdded = false;
  deviceIdentifier!: string;

  constructor(
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) data: MatMeasurementPointCreateDialogData,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<DeviceItemMeasurementPointCreateDialogStepperComponent>,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private deviceConfigsService: DeviceConfigsService,
    private deviceService: DevicesService,
  ) {
    if (data) {
      this.ioTDeviceTypeId = data.ioTDeviceTypeId;
      this.deviceIdentifier = data.deviceIdentifier;
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.createForm();
    this.getConfiguration();
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  cancel() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  parentFormGroupValueHandler(value: any) {
    const createMeasuredEndpointRequest = {} as CreateMeasuredEndpointRequest;
    createMeasuredEndpointRequest.name = value.parentFormArray[0].name;
    createMeasuredEndpointRequest.description = value.parentFormArray[0].description;
    createMeasuredEndpointRequest.installationDate = value.parentFormArray[0].installationDate;
    createMeasuredEndpointRequest.configuration = value.parentFormArray[1].configuration;
    this.deviceService.devicesPostChannel(this.deviceIdentifier, createMeasuredEndpointRequest).subscribe(() => {
      this.dialogRef.close();
    });
  }

  private createForm() {
    const fa = new UntypedFormArray([]);

    this.parentFormGroup = this.formBuilder.group({
      parentFormArray: this.formBuilder.array([
        this.formBuilder.group({
          name: ['', [Validators.required]],
          description: [null, [Validators.required]],
          installationDate: [null, [Validators.required]],
        }),
        this.formBuilder.group({
          configuration: fa,
        }),
      ]),
    });
  }

  private getConfiguration() {
    this.deviceConfigsService
      .deviceConfigsGetMeasuredEndpointDeviceConfigListById(this.ioTDeviceTypeId)
      .subscribe((cfg) => {
        this.configuration = cfg;
        this.addControls(this.configuration);
      });
  }

  private addControls(cfg: DeviceConfigCodeModel[]) {
    const fa = ((this.parentFormGroup.controls.parentFormArray as UntypedFormArray).controls[1] as UntypedFormGroup)
      .controls.configuration as UntypedFormArray;
    fa.controls = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < cfg.length; index++) {
      fa.push(this.formBuilder.group(configurationForm.get()));
      (fa.controls[index] as UntypedFormGroup).get('code')?.patchValue(cfg[index].code);
    }
    this.controlsAdded = true;
  }
}

export function openDeviceItemMeasurementPointCreateDialog(
  dialog: MatDialog,
  ioTDeviceTypeId: number,
  deviceIdentifier: string,
) {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.data = {
    ioTDeviceTypeId: ioTDeviceTypeId,
    deviceIdentifier: deviceIdentifier,
  } as MatMeasurementPointCreateDialogData;

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(DeviceItemMeasurementPointCreateDialogStepperComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-device-item-measurement-point-view-edit',
  templateUrl: './device-item-measurement-point-view-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./device-item-measurement-point-view-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class DeviceItemMeasurementPointViewEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('endpointUnitDatatable', { static: true }) protected endpointUnitDatatable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  @ViewChild('endpointUnitDatatable') table!: MatTable<any>;

  protected dialog: MatDialog;
  private subs = new Subscription();

  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [
    ActionButtonType.BACK,
    ActionButtonType.CANCEL,
    ActionButtonType.EDIT,
    ActionButtonType.SAVE,
    ActionButtonType.DELETE,
  ];
  sites!: SiteEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  siteLocations!: SiteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  ioTDeviceTypes!: DeviceModelEntityRef[];
  measuredEndpoint!: SingleMeasuredEndpointModel;
  statusEnum = DeviceStatus;
  deviceIdentifier!: string;
  deviceTypeId!: number;
  configuration!: DeviceConfigCodeModel[];
  endpointUnitTypes = Object.keys(EndpointUnitType);
  controlsAdded = false;

  searchForm!: UntypedFormGroup;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';
  data: EndpointUnitListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'deviceName',
      displayName: 'DEVICE.MEASURED_ENDPOINTS.NAME',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'type',
      displayName: 'DEVICE.MEASURED_ENDPOINTS.TYPE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'id',
      displayName: 'ID',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private siteService: SitesService,
    private siteLocationsService: SiteLocationsService,
    private deviceService: DevicesService,
    private navbarService: NavbarService,
    private deviceConfigsService: DeviceConfigsService,
    private endpointUnitsService: EndpointUnitsService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
    this.subscribeToRouteParams();
    this.createForm();
    this.setTableData();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
    this.setNavbarButton();
    this.setCustomPageTitle(' - ' + this.measuredEndpoint.name, true);
    this.getConfiguration();
    this.getSites();
    this.subscribeToSiteValueChange();
    this.subscribeToSiteLocationValueChange();
    this.subscribeToDeviceValueChange();
    this.setValues(this.measuredEndpoint);
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  openDialog() {
    openMeasurementPointDialog(this.dialog, this.measuredEndpoint.id!, undefined, true).subscribe(() =>
      this.setTableData(),
    );
  }

  importData() {
    const config = new MatDialogConfig();

    config.disableClose = true;
    config.autoFocus = true;
    config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
    config.data = {
      deviceIdentifier: this.deviceIdentifier,
      measuredEndpointIdentifier: this.measuredEndpoint.identifier,
      timeUnit:
        this.deviceTypeId == 1
          ? AggregationLevelDisplayName[0]
          : this.deviceTypeId == 4
          ? AggregationLevelDisplayName[1]
          : AggregationLevelDisplayName[0],
      unit: Unit.W,
    } as UploadIoTDataImportRequest;

    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ImportIoTDataDialogComponent, config);

    return dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe({
      next: (res: any) => {
        if (res) {
          openNotificationDetailDialog(
            this.dialog,
            'Dokumentum feltöltve',
            "A feltöltést megkezdtük! Az adatok importálása eltarthat egy ideig. Az importálás állapotát, illetve eredményét a Mérési pont adatlap 'Adatimportok' listában tekintheti meg!",
          ).subscribe({
            next: () => {
              // localStorage.setItem('scrollPos', "imports");
              // window.location.reload();
            },
            error: () => {
              //console.log(error);
            },
          });
        }
      },
      error: () => {
        //console.log(error);
      },
    });
  }

  importListChanged() {
    if (localStorage.scrollPos) {
      const element = document.getElementById(localStorage.scrollPos);
      this.delay(1000).then(() => {
        window.scrollTo(0, element!.offsetTop);
        localStorage.removeItem('scrollPos');
      });
    }
  }

  delay(time: any) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, time));
  }

  edit() {
    this.toggleForm(true);
    this.enableDisabelConfigurationControls(true);
  }

  back() {
    this.router.navigateByUrl('/devices/iot/' + this.deviceIdentifier + '/view');
  }

  cancel() {
    this.toggleForm(false);
    this.enableDisabelConfigurationControls(false);
  }

  showRow(element: EndpointUnitListItemDto) {
    openMeasurementPointDialog(this.dialog, this.measuredEndpoint.id!, element.id, false).subscribe(() =>
      this.setTableData(),
    );
  }

  editRow(element: EndpointUnitListItemDto) {
    openMeasurementPointDialog(this.dialog, this.measuredEndpoint.id!, element.id, true).subscribe(() =>
      this.setTableData(),
    );
  }

  deleteRow(element: EndpointUnitListItemDto) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.deviceName}' mérési végpontot?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.endpointUnitsService.endpointUnitsDeleteEndpointUnit(element.id!).subscribe(() => this.setTableData());
        }
        this.setTableData();
      },
    );
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }

  get cfc() {
    return (this.form.controls.configuration as UntypedFormArray).controls;
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const modifyMeasuredEndpointRequest = {} as ModifyMeasuredEndpointRequest;
    modifyMeasuredEndpointRequest.name = this.fc.name.value;
    modifyMeasuredEndpointRequest.description = this.fc.description.value;
    modifyMeasuredEndpointRequest.installationDate = this.fc.installationDate.value;
    modifyMeasuredEndpointRequest.configuration = this.fc.configuration.value;
    modifyMeasuredEndpointRequest.siteLocation = this.fc.siteLocation.value;
    this.toggleForm(false);
    this.enableDisabelConfigurationControls(false);
    return this.deviceService.devicesPutChannel(
      this.deviceIdentifier,
      this.measuredEndpoint.id!,
      modifyMeasuredEndpointRequest,
    );
  }

  private toggleForm(toggle: boolean) {
    enableOrDisableControlsOf(
      this.form,
      ['name', 'description', 'installationDate', 'status', 'configuration'],
      toggle,
    );
    this.isEdit = toggle;
  }

  private getSites(): void {
    this.siteService.sitesGetSitesEntityRef().subscribe((sites) => {
      this.sites = sites;
    });
  }

  // private getSiteLocations(site: SiteEntityDtoEntityRef) {
  //   if (site) {
  //     this.siteService.sitesGetSiteLocationsEntityRef(site.id).subscribe((siteLocations) => { this.siteLocations = siteLocations });
  //   }
  // }

  private getIoTDevice(siteLocation: EntityRef) {
    if (siteLocation) {
      this.siteLocationsService
        .siteLocationsGetDeviceRefsBySiteLocationId(siteLocation.id!)
        .subscribe((deviceTypes) => {
          this.ioTDeviceTypes = deviceTypes;
        });
    }
  }

  private subscribeToSiteValueChange() {
    // this.fc.site.valueChanges.subscribe(value => {
    //   if (value) {
    //     this.getSiteLocations(value as EntityRef);
    //   }
    // });
  }

  private subscribeToSiteLocationValueChange() {
    this.fc.siteLocation.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value) {
        this.getIoTDevice(value as EntityRef);
      }
    });
  }

  private subscribeToDeviceValueChange() {
    this.fc.device.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value) {
        this.getConfigurationByDeviceId(value.id);
      }
    });
  }

  private createForm() {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(modifyMeasuredEndpointRequestForm.get());
    this.form.addControl('site', new UntypedFormControl(null, [Validators.required]));
    this.form.addControl('device', new UntypedFormControl(null, [Validators.required]));
    this.form.addControl('configuration', new UntypedFormArray([]));
    this.form.addControl('status', new UntypedFormControl(null));

    enableOrDisableControlsOf(
      this.form,
      ['name', 'description', 'installationDate', 'status', 'configuration'],
      this.isEdit,
    );

    this.form.get('site')?.disable();
    this.form.get('siteLocation')?.disable();
    this.form.get('device')?.disable();

    this.searchForm = this.formBuilder.group({
      searchText: [null],
      typeFilter: [null],
    });
  }

  private setValues(measuredEndpoint: SingleMeasuredEndpointModel) {
    this.form.patchValue(measuredEndpoint);
  }

  private getConfigurationByDeviceId(deviceId: number) {
    this.deviceService.deviceConfigsGetChannelConfigListById(deviceId).subscribe((cfg) => {
      this.configuration = cfg;
      this.addControls(this.configuration);
    });
  }

  private getConfiguration() {
    this.deviceConfigsService
      .deviceConfigsGetMeasuredEndpointDeviceConfigListById(this.deviceTypeId)
      .subscribe((cfg) => {
        this.configuration = cfg;
        this.addControls(this.configuration);
      });
  }

  private addControls(cfg: DeviceConfigCodeModel[]) {
    const fa = this.form.controls.configuration as UntypedFormArray;
    fa.controls = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < cfg.length; index++) {
      fa.push(this.formBuilder.group(configurationForm.get()));
      (fa.controls[index] as UntypedFormGroup).get('code')?.patchValue(cfg[index].code);

      if (this.measuredEndpoint?.configuration && this.measuredEndpoint.configuration[index]) {
        const group = fa.controls[index] as UntypedFormGroup;
        group.get('value')?.patchValue(this.measuredEndpoint.configuration[index].value);
        group.get('id')?.patchValue(this.measuredEndpoint.configuration[index].id);
      }
    }
    this.controlsAdded = true;
    this.enableDisabelConfigurationControls(this.isEdit);
  }

  private enableDisabelConfigurationControls(toggle: boolean) {
    const array = (this.form.controls.configuration as UntypedFormArray).controls;

    array.forEach((element: any) => {
      if (toggle) {
        element.enable();
      } else {
        element.disable();
      }
    });
  }

  private subscribeToRouteParams() {
    this.deviceTypeId = +this.activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('deviceTypeId')!;
    this.deviceIdentifier = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('deviceIdentifier')!;
    this.measuredEndpoint = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.measuredEndpoint;
    this.isEdit =
      this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE ||
      this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT;
  }

  private setNavbarButton() {
    this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonVisibility(true);
    this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonText('DEVICE.MEASURED_ENDPOINTS.ADD_ENDPOINT');
    this.navbarService.setNavbarIcon('add');
    this.subs.add(
      this.navbarService.navbarButton$.subscribe(() => {
        this.openDialog();
      }),
    );
  }

  setTableData() {
    const startPage = this.endpointUnitDatatable?.pageIndex ?? this.pageIndex;
    const pageSize = this.endpointUnitDatatable?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize;
    const sortColumn = this.endpointUnitDatatable?.getSort() ?? this.sortActive;
    const sortDirection = this.endpointUnitDatatable?.getSortDirection() ?? EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
        ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
        : ApiSortDirection.Descending;
    this.endpointUnitsService
      .endpointUnitGetEndpointUnitListItems(
        this.sfc.searchText?.value,
        this.sfc.typeFilter?.value,
        this.measuredEndpoint.id,
        startPage,
        pageSize,
        sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
        false,
      )
      .subscribe((data: EndpointUnitListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
        this.data = data;
        this.endpointUnitDatatable.refresh();
      });
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.searchForm.get('searchText')?.setValue(null);
    this.searchForm.get('typeFilter')?.setValue(null);
  }
}

export class configurationForm {
  //TODO: get form form BE

  public static get(): any {
    return {
      code: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []],
      value: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []],
      id: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []],
    };
  }
}

import { Component, Inject, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormControl, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { first } from 'rxjs';
import { UploadIoTDataImportRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/uploadIoTDataImportRequest';
import { EndpointUnitType, IoTDataImportService, Unit } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver';
import { Constants } from 'src/app/core/constants';
import { AggregationLevelDisplayName } from 'src/app/core/aggregationLevel';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-import-iotdata-dialog',
  templateUrl: './import-iotdata-dialog.component.html',
})
export class ImportIoTDataDialogComponent implements OnInit {
  form!: UntypedFormGroup;

  selectedFiles: File[] = [];

  units = Object.keys(Unit);
  timeUnits = AggregationLevelDisplayName;
  //timeUnits = Object.keys(AggregationLevel);
  endpointTypes = Object.keys(EndpointUnitType);

  constructor(
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) public data: UploadIoTDataImportRequest,
    public dialogRef: MatDialogRef<ImportIoTDataDialogComponent>,
    private apiService: IoTDataImportService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = new UntypedFormGroup({
      deviceIdentifier: new UntypedFormControl(Constants.GUID_EMPTY, [Validators.required]),
      timeUnit: new UntypedFormControl(AggregationLevelDisplayName[0], [Validators.required]),
      unit: new UntypedFormControl(Unit.W, [Validators.required]),
    });
    this.form.patchValue(this.data);
  }

  filesLoaded($event: any) {
    this.selectedFiles = $event;
  }

  upload() {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.valid) {
      const formValues = this.form.value as UploadIoTDataImportRequest;
      formValues.timeUnit = this.form.controls.timeUnit.value.id;

      this.apiService.ioTDataImportPostForm(formValues.deviceIdentifier, formValues.timeUnit, formValues.unit, this.selectedFiles[0]).pipe(first()).subscribe({
        next: () => this.dialogRef.close(true),
        error: (error) => {
            //console.log(error);
          },
        });
    }
  }

  close() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }
}

import {
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  EventEmitter,
  Injector,
  Input,
  OnDestroy,
  OnInit,
  Output,
  ViewChild,
  OnChanges,
} from '@angular/core';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import {
  IoTDataImportListItemDto,
  IoTDataImportListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult,
  IoTDataImportService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { ChannelModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { SortDirection as APISortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { saveAs } from 'file-saver';
import { IoTDataImportDownloadService } from 'src/app/core/services/iotdata-import-dowmload.service';
import { ChannelService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/sortDirection';
import { SortDirection as EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-iotdata-import-list',
  templateUrl: './iotdata-import-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./iotdata-import-list.component.scss'],
})
export class IoTDataImportListComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input() deviceIdentifier: string | undefined;
  @Output() changeEmitter: EventEmitter<void> = new EventEmitter();
  protected dialog: MatDialog;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private service: IoTDataImportService,
    private downloadService: IoTDataImportDownloadService,
    private measuredEndpointService: ChannelService,
  ) {
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: any) {
    this.changeEmitter.emit();
  }

  private searchField = ''; // A keresési mező értékének letárolására.

  @ViewChild('importDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'createDate',
      displayName: 'Létrehozás időpontja',
      columnType: ColumnType.DateTime,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'fileName',
      displayName: 'Fájlnév',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'status',
      displayName: 'Import státusz',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = 'createDate';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems: IoTDataImportListItemDto[] = [];

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getItems();
  }

  rejected(element: any): boolean {
    return element.status == 'Visszautasítva';
  }

  notImported(element: any): boolean {
    return element.status != 'Beimportálva';
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
  }

  getItems() {
    if (!this.deviceIdentifier) return;

    this.isLoading = true;
    let startPage = this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex || this.pageIndex;
    let pageSize = this.dataDataTable?.pageSize || this.pageSize;
    let sortColumn = this.dataDataTable?.getSort() || this.sortActive;
    let sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.getSortDirection() || EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending;
    let apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection = (sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending);
    this.service.ioTDataImportGetList(this.deviceIdentifier, undefined,undefined, this.searchField ?? '', startPage, pageSize, sortColumn, apiSortDirection, false)
      .subscribe((data: IoTDataImportListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
        this.allItems = []
        this.allItems = data.items!;
        this.data.items = this.allItems;
        this.data.recordsTotal = data.recordsTotal!;
        this.dataDataTable.refresh();
        this.isLoading = false;
      }); 
  }

  search(searchText: string) {
    this.searchField = searchText; // Searchfield mező beállítása a keresés mező értékével. Így egy change esemény futásakor is megőrizzük a keresés szűrést.
    this.getItems();
  }

  download(element: any) {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.downloadService.ioTDataImportDownloadResult(element.id, 'response').subscribe({
      next: (response: any) => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        saveAs(response.body!, element.fileName); // FileHandler.getFileName(response));
      },
      error: () => {
        this.isLoading = false;
      },
    });
  }

  delete(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a választott adatimportot?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.service.ioTDataImportDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => this.getItems());
        }
      },
    );
  }
}
