import { Component, Inject, OnDestroy, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormArray, UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { EMPTY, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { EndpointUnitsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/endpointUnits.service';
import { EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/endpointUnitMetaDataPropertyModel';
import { EndpointUnitWithSchemaModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/endpointUnitWithSchemaModel';
import { ModifyEndpointUnitRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/modifyEndpointUnitRequest';
import { CreateEndpointUnitRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/createEndpointUnitRequest';
import { EndpointUnitTypeDisplayName } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/devices/endpointUnitType';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';

export interface MatMeasurementEndPointDialogData {
  measuredEndpointId: number;
  endpointUnitId: number;
  enableInputs: boolean;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-measurement-end-point-dialog-stepper',
  templateUrl: './measurement-end-point-dialog-stepper.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./measurement-end-point-dialog-stepper.component.scss'],
})
export class MeasurementEndPointDialogStepperComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  parentFormGroup!: UntypedFormGroup;
  stepLabels = ['DEVICE.MEASURED_ENDPOINTS.BASE_DATA', 'DEVICE.MEASURED_ENDPOINTS.PROPERTIES'];
  controlsAdded = false;
  properties!: EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyModel[];
  measuredEndpointId!: number;
  endpointUnitId!: number;
  enableInputs!: boolean;
  endpointUnit!: EndpointUnitWithSchemaModel;

  constructor(
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) data: MatMeasurementEndPointDialogData,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<MeasurementEndPointDialogStepperComponent>,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private endpointUnitsService: EndpointUnitsService,
  ) {
    if (data) {
      this.measuredEndpointId = data.measuredEndpointId;
      this.endpointUnitId = data.endpointUnitId;
      this.enableInputs = data.enableInputs;
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.createForm();
    this.getEndpointData(this.endpointUnitId).subscribe((endpointUnit: EndpointUnitWithSchemaModel) => {
      this.endpointUnit = endpointUnit;
      this.patchControlValues(endpointUnit);
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  cancel() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  parentFormGroupValueHandler(value: any) {
    // MODIFY
    if (this.endpointUnitId && this.endpointUnitId > 0) {
      const modifyEndpointUnitRequest = {} as ModifyEndpointUnitRequest;
      modifyEndpointUnitRequest.measuredEndpointId = this.measuredEndpointId;
      modifyEndpointUnitRequest.deviceName = value.parentFormArray[0].name;
      modifyEndpointUnitRequest.type = value.parentFormArray[0].type.id;
      modifyEndpointUnitRequest.schema = value.parentFormArray[0].schema;
      modifyEndpointUnitRequest.endpointUnitMetaDataSchemaModels =
        value.parentFormArray[1].endpointUnitMetaDataSchemaModels;
      this.endpointUnitsService
        .endpointUnitsModifyEndpointUnit(this.endpointUnitId, modifyEndpointUnitRequest)
        .subscribe(() => {
          this.dialogRef.close();
        });
    }
    // CREATE
    else {
      const createEndpointUnitRequest = {} as CreateEndpointUnitRequest;
      createEndpointUnitRequest.measuredEndpointId = this.measuredEndpointId;
      createEndpointUnitRequest.deviceName = value.parentFormArray[0].name;
      createEndpointUnitRequest.type = value.parentFormArray[0].type.id;
      createEndpointUnitRequest.schema = value.parentFormArray[0].schema;
      createEndpointUnitRequest.endpointUnitMetaDataSchemaModels =
        value.parentFormArray[1].endpointUnitMetaDataSchemaModels;
      this.endpointUnitsService.endpointUnitsPost(createEndpointUnitRequest).subscribe(() => {
        this.dialogRef.close();
      });
    }
  }

  private getEndpointData(id: number): Observable<EndpointUnitWithSchemaModel> {
    if (id) {
      return this.endpointUnitsService.endpointUnitsGetEndpointUnit(id);
    } else {
      return EMPTY;
    }
  }

  private patchControlValues(endpointUnit: EndpointUnitWithSchemaModel) {
    const baseFormControls = (this.parentFormGroup.get('parentFormArray') as UntypedFormArray)
      .controls[0] as UntypedFormGroup;
    baseFormControls.controls.name.patchValue(endpointUnit.deviceName);
    const endpoints = EndpointUnitTypeDisplayName;
    baseFormControls.controls.type.patchValue(endpoints.filter((x) => x.id == endpointUnit.type)[0]);
    baseFormControls.controls.schema.patchValue(endpointUnit.schema);

    this.enableDisableParentFormGroup(baseFormControls, this.enableInputs);
  }

  private createForm() {
    const fa = new UntypedFormArray([]);

    this.parentFormGroup = this.formBuilder.group({
      parentFormArray: this.formBuilder.array([
        this.formBuilder.group({
          name: ['', [Validators.required]],
          type: [null, [Validators.required]],
          schema: [null, [Validators.required]],
        }),
        this.formBuilder.group({
          endpointUnitMetaDataSchemaModels: fa,
        }),
      ]),
    });
    this.subscribeToSchemaValueChanges();
  }

  private getEndpointUnitMetaDataPropertiesBySchemaId(schemaId: number) {
    this.endpointUnitsService
      .endpointUnitssGetEndpointUnitMetaDataPropertiesBySchemaId(schemaId)
      .subscribe((values: EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyModel[]) => {
        this.addControls(values);
        this.properties = values;
      });
  }

  private subscribeToSchemaValueChanges() {
    (
      (this.parentFormGroup.get('parentFormArray') as UntypedFormArray).controls[0] as UntypedFormGroup
    ).controls.schema.valueChanges.subscribe((v) => {
      this.getEndpointUnitMetaDataPropertiesBySchemaId(v.id);
    });
  }

  private addControls(values: EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyModel[]) {
    const array = ((this.parentFormGroup.controls.parentFormArray as UntypedFormArray).controls[1] as UntypedFormGroup)
      .controls.endpointUnitMetaDataSchemaModels as UntypedFormArray;
    array.controls = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      array.push(this.formBuilder.group(endpointUnitMetaDataSchemaForm.get()), { emitEvent: false });
      (array.controls[i] as UntypedFormGroup).get('code')?.patchValue(values[i].code, { emitEvent: false });
      if (this.endpointUnit) {
        const metaDataSchema = this.endpointUnit.schemaValues!.find((x) => x.code === values[i].code);
        (array.controls[i] as UntypedFormGroup).get('value')?.patchValue(metaDataSchema?.value, { emitEvent: false });
      }
    }

    if (this.enableInputs) {
      array.controls.forEach((fc) => fc.enable());
    } else {
      array.controls.forEach((fc) => fc.disable());
    }

    this.controlsAdded = true;
  }

  private enableDisableParentFormGroup(fg: UntypedFormGroup, toggle: boolean) {
    if (toggle) {
      fg.controls.name.enable();
      fg.controls.type.enable();
      fg.controls.schema.enable({ emitEvent: false });
    } else {
      fg.controls.name.disable();
      fg.controls.type.disable();
      fg.controls.schema.disable({ emitEvent: false });
    }
  }
}

export function openMeasurementPointDialog(
  dialog: MatDialog,
  measuredEndpointId: number,
  endpointUnitId: number | undefined,
  enableInputs: boolean,
): Observable<any> {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.data = { measuredEndpointId: measuredEndpointId, endpointUnitId: endpointUnitId, enableInputs: enableInputs };

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(MeasurementEndPointDialogStepperComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

export class endpointUnitMetaDataSchemaForm {
  //TODO: get form form BE

  public static get(): any {
    return {
      code: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []],
      value: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []],
    };
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit, ViewChild, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { CommonDetailsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/commonDetails.service';
import { DevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/devices.service';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { CommonCardDetailsModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/commonCardDetailsModel';
import { DeviceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/deviceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult';
import { DeviceStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/deviceStatus';
import { SiteEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { SiteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/tenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { CreateFavouriteRequest, FavouritesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-device-list',
  templateUrl: './device-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./device-list.component.scss'],
})
export class DeviceListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;

  protected dialog: MatDialog;
  needRefresh = false;

  //todo add searchForminit
  searchForm = this.fb.group({
    siteFilter: [],
    siteLocationFilter: [],
    deviceTypeFilter: [],
    statusFilter: [],
  });

  isLoading = false;

  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';
  devices?: DeviceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult;

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'deviceName',
      displayName: 'Név',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'deviceTypeCategoryName',
      displayName: 'Típus',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'siteLocationName',
      displayName: 'Mérési hely',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'deviceStatus',
      displayName: 'Állapot',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  sites?: Observable<SiteEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  siteLocations?: Observable<SiteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  deviceTypes?: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  statuses = Object.keys(DeviceStatus);

  cards: CommonCardDetailsModel[] = [];

  item?: number;
  private subs = new Subscription();

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private deviceService: DevicesService,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private commonDetailsService: CommonDetailsService,
    private favouritesService: FavouritesService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    this.rootPath = 'devices';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
    this.getDevices();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getSites();
    //this.sfc.siteFilter.valueChanges.subscribe((v) => { if (v) this.getSiteLocations(v) })
    this.getDeviceTypes();
    this.getCards();
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate(['devices/iot/' + element.deviceIdentifier + '/view']);
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate(['devices/iot/' + element.deviceIdentifier + '/edit']);
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.deviceName}' IOT eszközt?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.deviceService.devicesDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => this.getDevices());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  addQuickAccess(element: any) {
    const req = {} as CreateFavouriteRequest;
    req.identifier = element.deviceIdentifier;
    req.type = 'Device';

    this.favouritesService.favouritePost(req).subscribe(() => {
      this.needRefresh = true;
      this.getDevices();
    });
  }

  refreshChange(element: boolean) {
    if (element) this.needRefresh = false;
  }

  isHidden(element: any) {
    if (element.isInFavourites) return true;
    else return false;
  }

  addNew() {
    this.router.navigate(['devices/iot/new']);
  }

  getSites(): void {
    //this.sites = this.siteService.sitesGetAll();
  }

  getDeviceTypes() {
    this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('iot_device_category').subscribe((res) => (this.deviceTypes = res));
  }

  getDevices(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;

    const startPage = this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex ?? this.pageIndex;
    const pageSize = this.dataDataTable?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize;
    const sortColumn = this.dataDataTable?.getSort() ?? this.sortActive;
    const sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.getSortDirection() ?? ApiSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    this.deviceService
      .devicesGet(
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value?.id,
        this.sfc.siteLocationFilter?.value?.id,
        this.sfc.deviceTypeFilter?.value?.id,
        DeviceStatus[this.sfc.statusFilter?.value as keyof typeof DeviceStatus],
        startPage,
        pageSize,
        sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      )
      .subscribe((data: DeviceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
        this.devices = data;
        this.dataDataTable.refresh();
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  cardClikedHander(card: CommonCardDetailsModel) {
    this.sfc.deviceTypeFilter.patchValue(this.deviceTypes?.find((deviceType) => deviceType.id === card.id));
    this.getDevices();
  }

  favouriteChange() {
    this.getDevices();
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }

  private getCards() {
    this.commonDetailsService.commonDetailsGetDeviceCategories().subscribe((cards) => {
      this.cards = cards;
    });
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.sfc.siteFilter.setValue(null);
    this.sfc.siteLocationFilter.setValue(null);
    this.sfc.deviceTypeFilter.setValue(null);
    this.sfc.statusFilter.setValue(null);
  }
}

export class DeviceModifyComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {

  deviceCategoryForm = new UntypedFormControl('', [
    /*Validators.required*/
  ]);
  ioTDeviceTypeForm = new UntypedFormControl('', [
    /*Validators.required*/
  ]);
  configsForm = new UntypedFormArray([]);
  singleDeviceModel?: SingleDeviceModel;
  coreFormGroup = this.formBuilder.group({
    name: ['', [Validators.required]],
    description: ['', []],
    deviceCategory: this.deviceCategoryForm,
    ioTDeviceType: this.ioTDeviceTypeForm,
    serialNumber: ['', []],
    isAggregationPoint: [false, []],
  });
  configValuesFormGroup = this.formBuilder.group({
    configValues: this.configsForm,
  });

  dataConnFormGroup = this.formBuilder.group({
    /*
          dataInterfaceType: ['', []],
          macAddress: ['', []],
          ipAddress: ['', []]
    */
  });
  numOfConfigs?: number;

  parentFormGroup = this.formBuilder.group({
    parentFormArray: this.formBuilder.array([
      this.coreFormGroup,
      this.configValuesFormGroup /*,
        this.dataConnFormGroup*/,
    ]),
  });

  constructor(

    loaderService: LoaderService,

    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createDeviceRequestForm.get());
    this.form.addControl('configValues', new UntypedFormArray([]));
    // this.siteForm.valueChanges.subscribe(value => {

      this.getIoTDeviceType(value as EntityRef);
    });
    this.getDeviceCategories();
    this.ioTDeviceTypeForm.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      deviceConfigsService.deviceConfigsGetDeviceDeviceConfigListById(value.id).subscribe((configs) => {
        this.numOfConfigs = configs.length;
        for (const config of configs) {
          this.configsForm.clear();
          const valueModel = this.singleDeviceModel!.configValues!.find((v) => v.code == config.code) || null;
          this.configsForm.push(
            new UntypedFormGroup({
              code: new UntypedFormControl(config.code),
              value: new UntypedFormControl(valueModel?.value),
              name: new UntypedFormControl(config.name),
            }),
          );
        }
      });
    });
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.singleDeviceModel = this.data;
    this.coreFormGroup.patchValue(this.singleDeviceModel);
    //this.dataConnFormGroup.patchValue(this.singleDeviceModel);
    this.configValuesFormGroup.patchValue(this.singleDeviceModel?.configValues as any);
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  public connectionTest() {
    this.ioTDevicesService.ioTDevicesHealthcheck('smappee', this.configsForm.value).subscribe((result) => {
      openDeviceConnectionResultDialog(this.dialog, result.success!, this.configsForm);
    });
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    // let model = {...this.coreFormGroup.value, ...this.configValuesFormGroup.value};

    //   configValues: model.configValues
    // } as ReplaceDeviceRequest;
    // return this.devicesService.devicesReplace(this.singleDeviceModel.id, resultModel);
    return of({});
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close(true);
    //this.connectionTest();
  }

  parentFormGroupValueHandler(value: any) {
    this.data.configValues = value.parentFormArray[1].configValues as ConfigValueModel[]; // TODO: Ezt nem patcheli bele a form-ba!
    this.data.description = value.parentFormArray[0].description;
    this.data.deviceCategory = value.parentFormArray[0].deviceCategory;
    this.data.description = value.parentFormArray[0].description;
    this.data.ioTDeviceType = value.parentFormArray[0].ioTDeviceType;
    this.data.isAggregationPoint = value.parentFormArray[0].isAggregationPoint;
    this.data.serialNumber = value.parentFormArray[0].serialNumber;
    this.form.patchValue(this.data);

    while ((this.form.controls.configValues as UntypedFormArray).length !== 0) {
      (this.form.controls.configValues as UntypedFormArray).removeAt(0);
    }

    for (const config of this.data.configValues) {
      (this.form.controls.configValues as UntypedFormArray).push(
        new UntypedFormGroup({
          code: new UntypedFormControl(config.code),
          value: new UntypedFormControl(config?.value),
        }),
      );
    }

    this.onSubmit(false);
  }

  getSites() {
    this.sites = this.sitesService.sitesGetSitesEntityRef();
  }

  // getSiteLocations(v: EntityRef) {
  //   this.siteLocations = this.sitesService.sitesGetSiteLocationsEntityRef(v.id);
  // }

  private getDeviceCategories() {
    this.deviceCategories = this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('iot_device_category');
  }

  private getIoTDeviceType(v: EntityRef) {
    this.ioTDeviceTypes = this.ioTDeviceTypesService.ioTDeviceTypesGetDevicesRefByDeviceCategoryId(v.id!);
  }

  cancel() {
    this.dialogRef.close(false);
  }

  add() {}
}

export function openModifyDeviceDialog(dialog: MatDialog, model: SingleDeviceModel) {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.data = model;

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(DeviceModifyComponent, config);
  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { SiteLocationsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/api';

  locations: any = [];

    this.getSiteCards();

    this.router.navigate(['devices/measure-sites/' + id + '/edit']);
  }

  siteLocationMonitoring(id: number) {
    console.log(id);
  }

    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.name}' mérési helyet?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.siteLocationsService.siteLocationsDelete(element.id!).subscribe(() => this.getSiteCards());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  private getSiteCards() {
    // var observable = this.sitesService.sitesGetSiteCards();
    // observable.subscribe(cards => {
    //   this.siteCards = cards as SiteCardModel[];

  }

  private setNavbarButton() {

import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { SiteLocationsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/siteLocations.service';
import { SiteLocationCardModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteLocationCardModel';
import { SiteLocationModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteLocationModel';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-measure-site-view-edit',
  templateUrl: './measure-site-view-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./measure-site-view-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class MeasureSiteViewEditComponent implements OnInit {
  siteLocation = {} as SiteLocationModel;
  card?: SiteLocationCardModel;
  isEdit = false;

  constructor(
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private siteLocationsService: SiteLocationsService,
  ) {
    this.siteLocation = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.siteLocation;
    this.isEdit =
      this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE ||
      this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.subscribeToRouteParams();
    this.getSiteLocationCard();
  }

  private subscribeToRouteParams() {
    this.siteLocation = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.siteLocation;
    this.isEdit =
      this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE ||
      this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT;
  }

  private getSiteLocationCard() {
    this.siteLocationsService
      .siteLocationGetSiteLocationCard(this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.siteLocation.id)
      .subscribe((c) => {
        this.card = c as SiteLocationCardModel;
      });
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { modifySiteLocationRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/modifySiteLocationRequestForm';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { SiteLocationsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/siteLocations.service';
import { SitesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sites.service';
import { SiteLocationListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteLocationListItemDto';
import { SiteLocationListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteLocationListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult';
import { SiteLocationModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteLocationModel';
import { TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/tenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { enableOrDisableControlsOf } from 'src/app/core/helper/helper.service';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { FormComponentBase } from './../../../../../core/base/form-component-base';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-measure-site-base-data',
  templateUrl: './measure-site-base-data.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./measure-site-base-data.component.scss'],
})
export class MeasureSiteBaseDataComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() siteLocation = {} as SiteLocationModel;
  @Input() isEdit = true;

  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.BACK, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  siteLocationTypes?: Observable<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  siteLocations?: Observable<SiteLocationListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult>;
  siteItems?: Observable<SiteLocationListItemDto[]>;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private siteLocationsService: SiteLocationsService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getSiteLocations();
    this.getSiteLocationType();
    this.createFrom(this.siteLocation);
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    return this.siteLocationsService.siteLocationsPut(this.siteLocation.id!, this.form.getRawValue());
  }

  override onSaved() {
    this.toggleForm(false);
  }

  edit() {
    this.toggleForm(true);
  }

  back() {
    super.cancel(null);
  }

  cancel() {
    this.toggleForm(false);
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  private getSiteLocations() {
    this.siteItems = this.sitesService.sitesGetSitesEntityRef();
  }

  private getSiteLocationType() {
    this.siteLocationTypes = this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('site_location_type');
  }

  private toggleForm(toggle: boolean) {
    enableOrDisableControlsOf(this.form, ['name', 'isAggregationPoint', 'site', 'type', 'lat', 'lon'], toggle);
    this.isEdit = toggle;
  }

  private createFrom(site: SiteLocationModel) {
    const formDef = modifySiteLocationRequestForm.get();
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(formDef);
    this.form.addControl('id', new UntypedFormControl('', []));
    this.form.addControl('identifier', new UntypedFormControl('', []));

    this.setControlValues(site);
    this.form.get('id')?.disable();
    this.form.get('identifier')?.disable();

    enableOrDisableControlsOf(this.form, ['name', 'isAggregationPoint', 'site', 'type', 'lat', 'lon'], this.isEdit);
  }

  private setControlValues(site: SiteLocationModel) {
    if (site) {
      this.form.patchValue(this.siteLocation);
    } else {
      this.toggleForm(true);
    }
  }
}

      columnName: 'deviceTypeCategoryName',
      displayName: 'DEVICE.MEASURE_SITES.TYPE_MEASURE_VIEW',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'siteLocationName',
      displayName: 'DEVICE.MEASURE_SITES.DATA_INTERFACE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'deviceStatus',
      displayName: 'DEVICE.MEASURE_SITES.CONDITION',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';

  searchForm?: UntypedFormGroup;
  devices?: DeviceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult;
  sites?: Observable<SiteEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  siteLocations?: Observable<SiteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  deviceTypes?: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  statuses = Object.keys(DeviceStatus);

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private deviceService: DevicesService,
    private siteService: SitesService,
    private dictService: DictService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.stepForward();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.createForm();
    this.getDevices();
    this.getSites();
    //this.sfc.siteFilter.valueChanges.subscribe((v) => { if (v) this.getSiteLocations(v) })
    this.getDeviceTypes();
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm!.controls;
  }

  getDevices(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;

    let sortDirection = ApiSortDirection.Ascending;
    switch (this.dataDataTable.getSortDirection()) {
      case DTSortDirection.Ascending:
        sortDirection = ApiSortDirection.Ascending;
        break;
      case DTSortDirection.Descending:
        sortDirection = ApiSortDirection.Descending;
        break;
    }

    this.deviceService
      .devicesGet(
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value?.id,
        this.siteLocation.id,
        this.sfc.deviceTypeFilter?.value?.id,
        DeviceStatus[this.sfc.statusFilter?.value as keyof typeof DeviceStatus],
        this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex ? this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex : this.pageIndex,
        this.dataDataTable?.pageSize ? this.dataDataTable?.pageSize : this.pageSize,
        this.dataDataTable?.getSort() ? this.dataDataTable?.getSort() : this.sortActive,
        sortDirection,
      )
      .subscribe((data: DeviceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
        this.devices = data;
        this.dataDataTable.refresh();
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate(['devices/iot/' + element.deviceIdentifier + '/view']);
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate(['devices/iot/' + element.deviceIdentifier + '/edit']);
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja az '${element.deviceName}' eszközt?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.deviceService.devicesDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => this.getDevices());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  private createForm() {
    this.searchForm = this.formBuilder.group({
      siteFilter: [],
      deviceTypeFilter: [],
      statusFilter: [],
    });
  }

  private getSites(): void {
    //this.sites = this.siteService.sitesGetAll();
  }

  private getDeviceTypes() {
    this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('iot_device_category').subscribe((res) => (this.deviceTypes = res));
  }

  // private getSiteLocations(selectedSite: SiteEntityDtoEntityRef) {
  //   this.siteLocations = this.siteService.sitesGetSiteLocationsEntityRef(selectedSite.id);
  // }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Inject, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createSiteLocationRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/createSiteLocationRequestForm';
import { DevicesService, DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/api';
import { SitesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sites.service';
import {
  IoTDeviceTypeModelEntityRef,
  SiteModel,
  TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/models';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

export interface MatDialogDataMeasureSiteCreate {
  identifier?: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-mesure-site-create',
  templateUrl: './mesure-site-create.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./mesure-site-create.component.scss'],
})
export class MesureSiteCreateComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  identifier?: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) data: MatDialogDataMeasureSiteCreate,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<MesureSiteCreateComponent>,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private siteService: SitesService,
    private devicesService: DevicesService,
    private dictService: DictService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    if (data) {
      this.identifier = data.identifier;
    }
  }

  sites?: Observable<SiteModel[]>;
  devices?: Observable<IoTDeviceTypeModelEntityRef[]>;
  siteLocationTypes?: Observable<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getDevices();
    this.getSites();
    this.getSiteLocationType();
    this.createForm();
  }

  private createForm() {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createSiteLocationRequestForm.get());
    this.form.get('isAggregationPoint')?.setValue(false);
    this.sites?.subscribe((sites) => {
      this.form.controls.site.patchValue(
        sites.find((site) => site.identifier === this.identifier),
        { emitEvent: false },
      );
    });
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.cancel();
  }

  private getSites(): void {
    // this.sites = this.siteService.sitesGetAll();
  }

  private getDevices(): void {
    // this.devices = this.devicesService.devicesGetSoloEfDevices();
  }

  private getSiteLocationType() {
    this.siteLocationTypes = this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('site_location_type');
  }

  protected save() {
    return this.siteService.sitesPostSiteLocation(this.form.controls.site.value.id, this.form.value);
  }

  cancel() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  removeDeviceFromSelected(deviceId: number) {
    this.fc.connectedDevices.setValue(this.fc.connectedDevices.value.filter((v: any) => v.id !== deviceId));
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }
}

export function openNewMesureSiteDialog(dialog: MatDialog, identifier?: string) {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-mesure-site-create';
  if (identifier) {
    config.data = { identifier: identifier };
  }
  const dialogRef = dialog.open(MesureSiteCreateComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

          >delete</mat-icon
        >
      </div>
    </ng-template>
  </app-mat-datatable-old>
</div>

import { Component, OnInit, ViewChild, AfterViewInit } from '@angular/core';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { FormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { Co2eFactorsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/co2eFactors.service';
import { Co2eFactorListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/co2eFactorListItemDto';
import { Co2eFactorCategory } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/co2eFactorCategory';
import { Co2FactorModalComponent } from './co2-factor-modal/co2-factor-modal.component';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/sortDirection';
import { SortDirection as EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-co2-factor',
  templateUrl: './co2-factor.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./co2-factor.component.scss'],
})
export class Co2FactorComponent implements OnInit, AfterViewInit {
  @ViewChild('co2FactorDataTable', { static: false }) co2FactorDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'validFrom',
      displayName: 'Érvényesség kezdete',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: false,
      filterable: false,
      filterValue: null,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'validTo',
      displayName: 'Érvényesség vége',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: false,
      filterable: false,
      filterValue: null,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'category',
      displayName: 'Kategória',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
      filterable: false,
      filterValue: null,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'factor',
      displayName: 'Faktor',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
      filterable: false,
      filterValue: null,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
      filterable: false,
      filterValue: null,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  isLoading = false;
  pageSize = 10;
  pageIndex = 0;
  sortActive = 'validFrom';
  sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'asc';
  data: any[] = [];
  dataResponse: any = { items: [], recordsTotal: 0 };

  categoryOptions = [
    { id: Co2eFactorCategory.Consumption, name: 'Fogyasztás' },
    { id: Co2eFactorCategory.Production, name: 'Termelés' },
  ];

  constructor(private co2eFactorsService: Co2eFactorsService, private dialog: MatDialog, private fb: FormBuilder) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadData();
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    // When the table is initialized, load the data with the correct sort
    setTimeout(() => {
      // Initial load of data after the view is initialized
      this.loadData();
    }, 0);
  }

  loadData(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;

    //const startPage = this.co2FactorDataTable?.pageIndex ? this.co2FactorDataTable?.pageIndex : this.pageIndex;
    //const pageSize = this.co2FactorDataTable?.pageSize ? this.co2FactorDataTable?.pageSize : this.pageSize;

    const startPage = this.co2FactorDataTable?.pageIndex ?? this.pageIndex;
    const pageSize = this.co2FactorDataTable?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize;
    const sortColumn = this.co2FactorDataTable?.getSort() ?? this.sortActive;
    const sortDirection = this.co2FactorDataTable?.getSortDirection() ?? EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
        ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
        : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    // Attempt to load data from API
    this.co2eFactorsService
      .co2eFactorsGetCo2eFactorsList(
        undefined, // category
        undefined, // validFrom
        undefined, // validTo
        undefined, // isActive
        startPage, // startPage
        pageSize, // pageSize
        sortColumn, // sortColumn
        apiSortDirection, // sortDirection
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          if (result && result.items && result.items.length > 0) {
            // Create a proper response object for the data table
            this.dataResponse = {
              items: result.items.filter((item) => item && item.id),
              recordsTotal: result.recordsTotal,
            };
          } else {
            this.dataResponse = {
              items: [],
              recordsTotal: 0,
            };
          }

          // Keep data array for compatibility
          this.data = this.dataResponse.items;

          // Force a refresh of the data table
          if (this.co2FactorDataTable) {
            this.co2FactorDataTable.refresh();
          }

          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error('Error loading CO2 factors:', error);

          // Handle error case
          this.dataResponse = {
            items: [],
            recordsTotal: 0,
          };

          this.data = this.dataResponse.items;

          // Force a refresh of the data table
          if (this.co2FactorDataTable) {
            this.co2FactorDataTable.refresh();
          }

          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });
  }

  openAddDialog(): void {
    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(Co2FactorModalComponent, {
      width: '500px',
      disableClose: false,
      autoFocus: false,
      data: { isEdit: false },
    });

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((result) => {
      if (result) {
        this.loadData();
      }
    });
  }

  editItem(element: Co2eFactorListItemDto): void {
    if (element && element.id) {
      const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(Co2FactorModalComponent, {
        width: '500px',
        disableClose: false,
        autoFocus: false,
        data: { isEdit: true, item: element },
      });

      dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((result) => {
        if (result) {
          this.loadData();
        }
      });
    }
  }

  deleteItem(element: Co2eFactorListItemDto): void {
    // Only allow deleting the last non-deleted recorded item in the list
    if (element && element.id && !element.isDeleted && element.isLastActiveByCategory) {
      openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a CO2 kibocsátási tényezőt?`).subscribe((confirmed) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.isLoading = true;

          this.co2eFactorsService.co2eFactorsDeleteCo2eFactor(element.id!).subscribe({
            next: () => {
              this.loadData();
            },
            error: (error) => {
              console.error('Error deleting CO2 factor:', error);
              this.isLoading = false;
            },
          });
        }
      });
    }
  }

  getCategoryName(category: Co2eFactorCategory | undefined): string {
    if (!category) return '';
    // Map the enum values to Hungarian display names
    switch (category) {
      case Co2eFactorCategory.Consumption:
        return 'Fogyasztás';
      case Co2eFactorCategory.Production:
        return 'Termelés';
      default:
        return category;
    }
  }
}

import { Component, Inject, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatDialogRef, MAT_DIALOG_DATA } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Co2eFactorsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/co2eFactors.service';
import { Co2eFactorCategory } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/co2eFactorCategory';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ModifyCo2eFactorRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

interface Co2FactorFormData {
  category: Co2eFactorCategory;
  factor: number;
  validFrom: Date | string | null;
  validTo: Date | string | null;
  id?: number;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-co2-factor-modal',
  templateUrl: './co2-factor-modal.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./co2-factor-modal.component.scss'],
})
export class Co2FactorModalComponent implements OnInit {
  form: FormGroup;
  isEdit: boolean;
  categories = Co2eFactorCategory;
  title: string;
  loading = false;
  serverErrors: string[] = [];

  constructor(
    private fb: FormBuilder,
    private co2eFactorsService: Co2eFactorsService,
    public dialogRef: MatDialogRef<Co2FactorModalComponent>,
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) public data: any,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
  ) {
    this.isEdit = data.isEdit;
    this.title = this.isEdit
      ? this.translateService.instant('DICT.CO2_FACTOR.EDIT')
      : this.translateService.instant('DICT.CO2_FACTOR.ADD');

    this.form = this.fb.group({
      category: [{ value: null, disabled: this.isEdit }, Validators.required],
      factor: [null, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0), Validators.pattern(/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/)]],
      validFrom: [{ value: null, disabled: this.isEdit }, Validators.required],
      validTo: [{ value: null, disabled: true }],
      id: [null],
    });

    if (this.isEdit && data.item) {
      this.form.patchValue({
        category: data.item.category,
        factor: data.item.factor,
        validFrom: data.item.validFrom ? new Date(data.item.validFrom) : null,
        validTo: data.item.validTo ? new Date(data.item.validTo) : null,
        id: data.item.id,
      });
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  limitDecimalPlaces(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const value = input.value;

    // Check if the value has more than 2 decimal places
    if (value.includes('.')) {
      const parts = value.split('.');
      if (parts[1] && parts[1].length > 2) {
        // Truncate to 2 decimal places
        input.value = parseFloat(value).toFixed(2);
        // Update the form control value
        this.form.get('factor')?.setValue(parseFloat(input.value), { emitEvent: false });
      }
    }
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.form.valid) {
      this.loading = true;
      const formData: Co2FactorFormData = this.form.getRawValue();

      // Format dates in yyyy-MM-dd format
      const payload = {
        ...formData,
        validFrom: formData.validFrom ? this.formatDate(formData.validFrom) : null,
        validTo: formData.validTo ? this.formatDate(formData.validTo) : null,
      } as ModifyCo2eFactorRequest;
      if (this.isEdit) {
        this.co2eFactorsService.co2eFactorsUpdateCo2eFactor((payload as any).id, payload).subscribe(
          () => {
            this.loading = false;
            this.dialogRef.close(true);
          },
          (error) => {
            console.error('Error updating CO2 factor:', error);
            this.handleError(error);
            this.loading = false;
          },
        );
      } else {
        this.co2eFactorsService.co2eFactorsCreateCo2eFactor(payload as any).subscribe(
          () => {
            this.loading = false;
            this.dialogRef.close(true);
          },
          (error) => {
            console.error('Error creating CO2 factor:', error);
            this.handleError(error);
            this.loading = false;
          },
        );
      }
    }
  }

  onCancel(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close(false);
  }

  /**
   * Handles error responses from the server
   * @param error The error response from the server
   */
  private handleError(error: any): void {
    this.serverErrors = [];

    if (error && error.error && error.error.errors) {
      // Check for general errors under empty string key
      if (error.error.errors[''] && Array.isArray(error.error.errors[''])) {
        this.serverErrors = [...this.serverErrors, ...error.error.errors['']];
      }

      // Add all field-specific validation errors from any property
      Object.keys(error.error.errors).forEach((key) => {
        if (key !== '' && Array.isArray(error.error.errors[key])) {
          // For field specific errors, we can add the field name for clarity
          const fieldErrors = error.error.errors[key].map((err: string) => err);
          this.serverErrors = [...this.serverErrors, ...fieldErrors];
        }
      });
    }

    // If we couldn't extract specific errors, add a generic one
    if (this.serverErrors.length === 0) {
      this.serverErrors = ['An error occurred while processing your request.'];
    }
  }

  /**
   * Formats a date to yyyy-MM-dd format
   * @param dateInput The date to format (can be Date object or string)
   * @returns Formatted date string in yyyy-MM-dd format
   */
  private formatDate(dateInput: any): string | null {
    if (!dateInput) return null;

    // Ensure we're working with a Date object
    const date = new Date(dateInput);
    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
      console.error('Invalid date:', dateInput);
      return null;
    }

    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, FormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { EntityRef } from 'src/app/core/models/core/entity-ref';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as DataReceiverDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as MonitoringDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/dict.service';
import { DictModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/dictModel';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { DictPageType } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/DictPageType';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-dict',
  templateUrl: './dict.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./dict.component.scss'],
})
export class DictComponent extends FormComponentBase {
  filterForm?: FormGroup;
  tenantName?: string;
  private readonly dictCode?: string;
  private dictService?: DictService | DataReceiverDictService | MonitoringDictService;
  public dictType: DictPageType;
  public dictSelector: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private formBuilder: FormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.dictSelector = route.snapshot.data['dictSelector'];
    this.dictType = route.snapshot.data['dictType'];
    switch (this.dictType) {
      case DictPageType.Framework:
        this.dictService = injector.get(DictService);
        break;
      case DictPageType.DataReceiver:
        this.dictService = injector.get(DataReceiverDictService);
        break;
      case DictPageType.Monitoring:
        this.dictService = injector.get(MonitoringDictService);
        break;
    }

    this.rootPath = '/dict';
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Szótár', '')];
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
    this.dictCode = this._route.snapshot.paramMap.get('dictCode')!;
  }

  override ngOnInit() {
    super.ngOnInit();

    this.getItems();
    this.authService.onChanged().subscribe((res) => {
      this.tenantName = res!.tenantName;
    });
    const filterFormFields = {
      code: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []] as any,
      name: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []] as any,
    };
    this.filterForm = this.formBuilder.group(filterFormFields);

    this.dataDataTable.addClickCallback((row: DictModel) => {
      if (row.id === this.selectedDict?.id) {
        this.selectedDict = undefined;
      } else {
        this.selectedDict = row;
      }
    });

    if (this.dictCode) {
      this.dictService!.dictsGet(this.dictCode).subscribe((model: DictModel) => {
        this.selectedDict = model;
        this._selectedDictRef = { id: model.id } as EntityRef;
        this.dataDataTable.select({ id: model.id });
      });
    }
  }

  @ViewChild('dictDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'select',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Select,
      filterable: false,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'code',
      displayName: 'Kód',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'name',
      displayName: 'Érték',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'isSystem',
      displayName: 'Rendszer-e?',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = 'code';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems: DictModel[] = [];
  selectedDict?: DictModel;
  _selectedDictRef?: EntityRef;

  get selected(): EntityRef[] {
    if (!this._selectedDictRef) return [];

    return [this._selectedDictRef];
  }

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.dictService!.dictsGetAll().subscribe((data: DictModel[]) => {
      this.allItems = data;
      this.data.items = this.allItems;
      this.data.recordsTotal = this.allItems.length;
      this.dataDataTable.refresh();
      this.isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  dbFilter() {
    const configNameFilter = this.filterForm?.get('code')?.value;
    const nameFilter = this.filterForm?.get('name')?.value;
    this.data.items = this.allItems;
    if (configNameFilter) this.data.items = this.data.items.filter((d) => d.code && d.code.includes(configNameFilter));
    if (nameFilter) this.data.items = this.data.items.filter((d) => d.name && d.name.includes(nameFilter));
    this.data.recordsTotal = this.data.items.length;

    this.dataDataTable.refresh();
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.filterForm?.get('code')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm?.get('name')?.setValue(null);
  }
}

import { Component, Injector, Input, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { DictModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/dictModel';
import { DictItemModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/dictItemModel';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { DictPageType } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/DictPageType';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as DataReceiverDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as MonitoringDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/dict.service';
import { DictItemsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dictItems.service';
import { DictItemsService as DataReceiverDictItemsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/dictItems.service';
import { DictItemsService as MonitoringDictItemsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/dictItems.service';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-dict-item',
  templateUrl: './dict-item.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./dict-item.component.scss'],
})
export class DictItemComponent implements OnInit {
  private _dict?: DictModel;
  public dictType: DictPageType;
  public dictBaseUrl: string;
  private dictService?: DictService | DataReceiverDictService | MonitoringDictService;
  private dictItemService?: DictItemsService | DataReceiverDictItemsService | MonitoringDictItemsService;
  protected dialog: MatDialog;

  @Input()
  set dict(value: DictModel) {
    this._dict = value;
    if (value) {
      this.getItems();
    }
  }

  get dict(): DictModel | undefined {
    return this._dict;
  }

  constructor(
    injector: Injector,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private dataReceiverDictItemService: DataReceiverDictItemsService,
    private router: Router,
  ) {
    this.dictBaseUrl = route.snapshot.data['dictBaseUrl'];
    this.dictType = route.snapshot.data['dictType'];
    switch (this.dictType) {
      case DictPageType.Framework:
        this.dictService = injector.get(DictService);
        this.dictItemService = injector.get(DictItemsService);
        break;
      case DictPageType.DataReceiver:
        this.dictService = injector.get(DataReceiverDictService);
        this.dictItemService = injector.get(DataReceiverDictItemsService);
        break;
      case DictPageType.Monitoring:
        this.dictService = injector.get(MonitoringDictService);
        this.dictItemService = injector.get(MonitoringDictItemsService);
        break;
    }
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  @ViewChild('dictItemDataTable', { static: false }) protected dictItemDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'code',
      displayName: 'Kód',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'value',
      displayName: 'Érték',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = 'code';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems: DictItemModel[] = [];

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.dictService!.dictsGetAllDictItemsForDict(this.dict!.code).subscribe((data: DictItemModel[]) => {
      this.allItems = data;
      this.data.items = this.allItems;
      this.data.recordsTotal = this.allItems.length;
      this.dictItemDataTable.refresh();
      this.isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  deleteRow(element: DictItemModel) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.code}' konfigurációs beállítást?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.dictItemService!.dictItemsDelete(element.id!).subscribe(() => this.getItems());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  editRow(element: DictItemModel) {
    this.router.navigate(['/dict', this.dictBaseUrl, this.dict!.code, 'edit', element.code]);
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, FormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs/internal/Observable';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { DictModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/dictModel';
import { DictPageType } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/DictPageType';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as DataReceiverDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as MonitoringDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/dict.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-dict-item-create',
  templateUrl: './dict-item-create.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./dict-item-create.component.scss'],
})
export class DictItemCreateComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  private readonly dictCode: string;
  dict?: DictModel;
  private dictService?: DictService | DataReceiverDictService | MonitoringDictService;
  public dictType: DictPageType;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private formBuilder: FormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    const dictBaseUrl = route.snapshot.data['dictBaseUrl'];
    this.rootPath = '/dict/' + dictBaseUrl;
    this.dictType = route.snapshot.data['dictType'];
    switch (this.dictType) {
      case DictPageType.Framework:
        this.dictService = injector.get(DictService);
        break;
      case DictPageType.DataReceiver:
        this.dictService = injector.get(DataReceiverDictService);
        break;
      case DictPageType.Monitoring:
        this.dictService = injector.get(MonitoringDictService);
        break;
    }

    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Szótár', '')];
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    this.dictCode = this._route.snapshot.paramMap.get('dictCode')!;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();

    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      code: [''],
      value: [''],
    });

    this.dictService!.dictsGet(this.dictCode).subscribe((model: DictModel) => {
      this.dict = model;
      this.form.addControl('dictId', new FormControl(this.dict.id));
    });
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    return this.dictService!.dictsPostDictItem(this.dict!.id!, this.form.value);
  }
}

import { FormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs/internal/Observable';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { DictItemModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/dictItemModel';
import { DictPageType } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/DictPageType';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as DataReceiverDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as MonitoringDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/dict.service';
import { DictItemsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dictItems.service';
import { DictItemsService as DataReceiverDictItemsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/dictItems.service';
import { DictItemsService as MonitoringDictItemsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/dictItems.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-dict-edit',
  templateUrl: './dict-item-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./dict-item-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class DictItemEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  private readonly dictCode: string;
  private readonly dictItemCode: string;
  dictItem?: DictItemModel;
  private dictService?: DictService | DataReceiverDictService | MonitoringDictService; //| ReportingDictService;
  private dictItemService?: DictItemsService | DataReceiverDictItemsService | MonitoringDictItemsService; //| ReportingDictItemsService;
  public dictType: DictPageType;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    private formBuilder: FormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Szótár', '')];
    this.dictType = route.snapshot.data['dictType'];
    switch (this.dictType) {
      case DictPageType.Framework:
        this.dictService = injector.get(DictService);
        this.dictItemService = injector.get(DictItemsService);
        break;
      case DictPageType.DataReceiver:
        this.dictService = injector.get(DataReceiverDictService);
        this.dictItemService = injector.get(DataReceiverDictItemsService);
        break;
      case DictPageType.Monitoring:
        this.dictService = injector.get(MonitoringDictService);
        this.dictItemService = injector.get(MonitoringDictItemsService);
        break;
    }

    this.numberOfBreadcrumbGoBacks = 2;
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    this.dictCode = this._route.snapshot.paramMap.get('dictCode')!;
    this.dictItemCode = this._route.snapshot.paramMap.get('dictItemCode')!;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();

    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      code: [''],

    });

    this.dictService!.dictsGetDictItemByCodeForDict(this.dictCode, this.dictItemCode).subscribe(
      (model: DictItemModel) => {
        this.dictItem = model;
        this.form.patchValue({
          id: model.id,
          code: model.code,
          value: model.value,
        });
      },
    );
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    return this.dictItemService!.dictItemsPut(this.dictItem!.id!, this.form.value);
  }
}

import { Component, Inject, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { MaintainersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/maintainers.service';
import { MaintainerModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/maintainerModel';
import { CreateMaintainerRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/createMaintainerRequest';
import { EditMaintainerRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/editMaintainerRequest';
import { MaintainerItem } from '../maintainer-list/maintainer-list.component';

export interface MaintainerEditData {
  maintainerId?: number;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-maintainer-edit',
  templateUrl: './maintainer-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./maintainer-edit.component.scss']
})
export class MaintainerEditComponent implements OnInit {
  // Form definition
  maintainerForm: FormGroup;
  
  // Track if we're in edit mode
  isEditMode = false;
  
  // Title of the dialog based on mode
  dialogTitle = '';

  constructor(
    private fb: FormBuilder,
    private maintainersService: MaintainersService,
    public dialogRef: MatDialogRef<MaintainerEditComponent>,
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) public data: MaintainerEditData
  ) {
    // Initialize the form
    this.maintainerForm = this.fb.group({
      name: ['', Validators.required]
    });
    
    // Set edit mode if maintainer ID is provided
    this.isEditMode = !!data.maintainerId;
    this.dialogTitle = this.isEditMode ? 'DICT.MAINTAINER.EDIT' : 'DICT.MAINTAINER.ADD';
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.isEditMode && this.data.maintainerId) {
      // Load maintainer data if in edit mode
      this.loadMaintainerData();
    }
  }

  // Load maintainer data for editing
  private loadMaintainerData(): void {
    if (this.data && this.data.maintainerId) {
      // Load maintainer data for editing
      this.maintainersService.maintainersGetMaintainer(this.data.maintainerId).subscribe((maintainer: MaintainerModel) => {
        if (maintainer) {
          this.maintainerForm.patchValue({
            name: maintainer.name || ''
          });
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // Save the maintainer (create or update)
  save(): void {
    if (this.maintainerForm.invalid) {
      return;
    }

    const formData = this.maintainerForm.value;
    
    if (this.data && this.data.maintainerId) {
      // Update existing maintainer
      const request: EditMaintainerRequest = {
        name: formData.name
      };
      
      this.maintainersService.maintainersEditMaintainer(this.data.maintainerId, request).subscribe(
        (result: MaintainerModel) => {
          const updatedItem: MaintainerItem = {
            id: this.data.maintainerId,
            name: result.name || formData.name
          };
          this.dialogRef.close(updatedItem);
        },
        (error: any) => {
          console.error('Error updating maintainer', error);
          // Handle error appropriately
        }
      );
    } else {
      // Create new maintainer
      const request: CreateMaintainerRequest = {
        name: formData.name
      };
      
      this.maintainersService.maintainersCreateMaintainer(request).subscribe(
        (result: MaintainerModel) => {
          // For newly created items, we need to get the ID from somewhere
          // Since the API response might not directly include the ID, we'll handle this case
          const createdItem: MaintainerItem = {
            // We'll need to get the ID from the response or via other means
            id: (result as any).id, // Cast to any to access possible ID
            name: result.name || formData.name
          };
          this.dialogRef.close(createdItem);
        },
        (error: any) => {
          console.error('Error creating maintainer', error);
          // Handle error appropriately
        }
      );
    }
  }

  // Cancel and close the dialog
  cancel(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, FormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { MatDatatableComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable.component';
import { MaintainerEditComponent } from '../maintainer-edit/maintainer-edit.component';
import { ColumnDefinition, ColumnType } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { IDataTableRequest, SortDirection } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { Observable, map } from 'rxjs';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { MaintainersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/maintainers.service';
import { SortDirection as APISortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { MaintainerListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/maintainerListItemDto';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

// Interface for the maintainer item
export interface MaintainerItem {
  id?: number;
  name: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-maintainer-list',
  templateUrl: './maintainer-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./maintainer-list.component.scss']
})
export class MaintainerListComponent implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true })
  protected dataDataTable: MatDatatableComponent | undefined;

  // Column definitions
  columns: ColumnDefinition[] = [];

  // Search form
  searchForm = this.fb.group({
    nameFilter: [null]
  });

  // Form for filtering
  filterForm: FormGroup;
  nameFilter = '';

  constructor(
    private maintainersService: MaintainersService, 
    private fb: FormBuilder,
    private dialog: MatDialog,
    private translateService: TranslateService
  ) {
    // Initialize filter form
    this.filterForm = this.fb.group({
      name: ['']
    });
    // Initialize columns
    this.initializeColumns();
  }
  
  // Create the name column with proper configuration
  private createNameColumn(): ColumnDefinition {
    const column = new ColumnDefinition();
    column.columnName = 'name';
    column.displayName = 'DICT.MAINTAINER.NAME';
    column.columnType = ColumnType.Text;
    column.sortable = true;
    column.filterable = false;
    return column;
  }
  
  // Create the actions column
  private createActionsColumn(): ColumnDefinition {
    const column = new ColumnDefinition();
    column.columnName = 'actions';
    column.displayName = '';
    column.columnType = ColumnType.Custom;
    column.sortable = false;
    column.filterable = false;
    return column;
  }
  
  // Initialize columns
  private initializeColumns(): void {
    this.columns = [
      this.createNameColumn(),
      this.createActionsColumn()
    ];
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Initialize component
    this.loadData();
  }
  
  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }

  loadData(): void {
    // The nameFilter is now handled directly in the dataRequest function
    // No need to store it in a service
    
    // The dataRequest will handle fetching the data when the datatable calls it
  }
  
  // Reset filter values and reload data
  resetFilter(): void {
    this.sfc.nameFilter.setValue(null);
    this.loadData();
  }
  
  // Data request function that will be passed to the datatable
  dataRequest = (params: IDataTableRequest): Observable<IDataTableResponse> => {
    // Convert datatable's numeric SortDirection to API's string SortDirection
    let apiSortDirection: APISortDirection;
    if (params.sortDirection === SortDirection.Ascending) {
      apiSortDirection = APISortDirection.Ascending;
    } else {
      apiSortDirection = APISortDirection.Descending;
    }

    // Get name filter from the form
    const nameFilter = this.sfc.nameFilter?.value as string | null;

    // Call the API directly
    return this.maintainersService.maintainersGetMaintainers(
      nameFilter || '',
      params.pageIndex,
      params.pageSize,
      params.sortColumn,
      apiSortDirection,
      params.isDeleted
    ).pipe(
      map(response => ({
        items: response.items?.map(item => ({
          id: item.id,
          name: item.name || ''
        })) || [],
        recordsTotal: response.recordsTotal || 0,
        recordsFiltered: response.recordsTotal || 0
      }))
    );
  }
  
  // Create new maintainer
  onCreateClick() {
    // Open dialog to create new maintainer
    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(MaintainerEditComponent, {
      width: '600px',
      data: {} // No maintainerId means create mode
    });
    
    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((result: MaintainerItem | undefined) => {
      if (result) {
        // Refresh the data
        if (this.dataDataTable) {
          this.dataDataTable.refreshEvent();
        }
      }
    });
  }
  
  // Edit maintainer
  editRow(item: MaintainerItem) {
    // Open dialog to edit maintainer
    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(MaintainerEditComponent, {
      width: '600px',
      data: { maintainerId: item.id } // Pass maintainerId for edit mode
    });
    
    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((result: MaintainerItem | undefined) => {
      if (result) {
        // Refresh the data
        if (this.dataDataTable) {
          this.dataDataTable.refreshEvent();
        }
      }
    });
  }
  
  // Delete maintainer
  deleteRow(item: MaintainerItem) {
    const msg = this.translateService.instant('DICT.MAINTAINER.DELETE_MESSAGE');
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, msg).subscribe(
      (confirmed) => {
        if (confirmed && item.id) {
          this.maintainersService.maintainersDeleteMaintainer(item.id).subscribe(
            () => {
              // Deletion successful
              if (this.dataDataTable) {
                this.dataDataTable.refreshEvent();
              }
            },
            (error: any) => {
              console.error('Error deleting maintainer', error);
            }
          );
        }
      }
    );
  }


}
