import { Component, ElementRef, Inject, Injector, OnInit, ViewChild, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import {
  DictService,
  TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef,
  RoomProfilesService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { Observable, Subject, map, startWith, takeUntil } from 'rxjs';
import { COMMA, ENTER } from '@angular/cdk/keycodes';
import { MatChipInputEvent } from '@angular/material/chips';
import { MatAutocompleteSelectedEvent } from '@angular/material/autocomplete';
import { MatAutocomplete } from '@angular/material/autocomplete';
import { RoomProfileListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/roomProfileListItemDto';
import { CreateRoomProfileRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/createRoomProfileRequest';
import { ModifyRoomProfileRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/modifyRoomProfileRequest';
import { RoomProfileModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/roomProfileModel';

interface DialogData {
  isNew: boolean;
  roomType: RoomProfileListItemDto | RoomProfileModel;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-room-type-edit',
  templateUrl: './room-type-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./room-type-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class RoomTypeEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('buildingProfileInput') buildingProfileInput!: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @ViewChild('auto') matAutocomplete!: MatAutocomplete;

  isNew: boolean;
  dialogTitle: string;

  // For autocomplete with chips
  separatorKeysCodes: number[] = [ENTER, COMMA];
  buildingProfileCtrl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  filteredBuildingProfiles: Observable<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  selectedBuildingProfiles: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
  allBuildingProfiles: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];

  // Subject for handling component destruction
  private destroy$ = new Subject<void>();

  constructor(
    protected override router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<RoomTypeEditComponent>,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private roomProfilesService: RoomProfilesService,
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) public data: DialogData,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.isNew = data.isNew;
    this.dialogTitle = this.isNew ? 'Helyiségtípus létrehozása' : 'Helyiségtípus szerkesztése';

    // Initialize filtered building profiles
    this.filteredBuildingProfiles = this.buildingProfileCtrl.valueChanges.pipe(
      takeUntil(this.destroy$),
      startWith(null),
      map((profile: string | null) => (profile ? this._filter(profile) : this._getUnselectedProfiles())),
    );
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      id: [this.data.roomType.id],
      name: [this.data.roomType.name, Validators.required],
      buildingProfiles: [[]], // Initialize with empty array, we'll handle the profiles separately
    });

    // Load building profiles from dictionary service
    this.loadBuildingProfiles();
  }

  loadBuildingProfiles(): void {
    this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('building_profile').subscribe(
      (profiles) => {
        this.allBuildingProfiles = profiles;

        // If editing an existing room profile, process building profiles
        if (!this.isNew && this.data.roomType.buildingProfiles) {
          // For RoomProfileModel, buildingProfiles is already an array of TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef
          if (Array.isArray(this.data.roomType.buildingProfiles)) {
            // We need to properly cast and ensure type safety
            this.selectedBuildingProfiles = this.data.roomType
              .buildingProfiles as TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[];

            // Just for visual representation in form - not actually used in submit
            const profileIds = this.selectedBuildingProfiles.map((p) => p.id!.toString());
            this.form.get('buildingProfiles')?.setValue(profileIds);
          }
        }
      },
      (error) => {
        console.error('Error loading building profiles:', error);
      },
    );
  }

  // Get all building profiles that are not already selected
  private _getUnselectedProfiles(): TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] {
    return this.allBuildingProfiles.filter(
      (profile) => !this.selectedBuildingProfiles.some((selected) => selected.id === profile.id),
    );
  }

  // Filter building profiles based on input
  private _filter(value: string): TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] {
    const filterValue = typeof value === 'string' ? value.toLowerCase() : '';

    // Filter profiles that match the search term AND have not been selected yet
    return this.allBuildingProfiles.filter(
      (profile) =>
        profile.entityDisplayName!.toLowerCase().includes(filterValue) &&
        !this.selectedBuildingProfiles.some((selected) => selected.id === profile.id),
    );
  }

  // Add a building profile from input (only when not matched with autocomplete)
  addBuildingProfile(event: MatChipInputEvent): void {
    // Don't add when autocomplete is open
    if (this.matAutocomplete && this.matAutocomplete.isOpen) {
      return;
    }

    const value = (event.value || '').trim();

    // Find if there's a matching building profile in our list
    if (value) {
      const matchedProfile = this.allBuildingProfiles.find(
        (profile) => profile.entityDisplayName!.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase(),
      );

      if (matchedProfile && !this.selectedBuildingProfiles.some((p) => p.id === matchedProfile.id)) {
        this.selectedBuildingProfiles.push(matchedProfile);

        // Update form value
        this.form.get('buildingProfiles')?.setValue(this.selectedBuildingProfiles.map((p) => p.id!.toString()));
      }
    }

    // Clear the input value
    event.chipInput!.clear();
    this.buildingProfileCtrl.setValue(null);
  }

  // Remove a building profile
  removeBuildingProfile(profile: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef): void {
    const index = this.selectedBuildingProfiles.indexOf(profile);

    if (index >= 0) {
      this.selectedBuildingProfiles.splice(index, 1);

      // Update form value
      this.form.get('buildingProfiles')?.setValue(this.selectedBuildingProfiles.map((p) => p.id!.toString()));

      // Force refresh the filtered list
      this.buildingProfileCtrl.setValue(this.buildingProfileCtrl.value);
    }
  }

  // Select from autocomplete
  selectBuildingProfile(event: MatAutocompleteSelectedEvent): void {
    const selectedProfile = event.option.value as TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef;

    // Check if already selected
    if (!this.selectedBuildingProfiles.some((profile) => profile.id === selectedProfile.id)) {
      this.selectedBuildingProfiles.push(selectedProfile);

      // Update form value
      this.form.get('buildingProfiles')?.setValue(this.selectedBuildingProfiles.map((p) => p.id!.toString()));
    }

    // Clear the input and force refresh the filtered list
    if (this.buildingProfileInput) {
      this.buildingProfileInput.nativeElement.value = '';
    }

    // Use a timeout to ensure Angular change detection completes
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.buildingProfileCtrl.setValue(null);
    });
  }

  // Show all unselected building profiles when input receives focus
  onBuildingProfileInputFocus(): void {
    // Set the value to empty string to trigger the valueChanges observable
    // This will display all unselected building profiles in the dropdown
    this.buildingProfileCtrl.setValue('');

    // Open the autocomplete dropdown programmatically
    if (this.matAutocomplete && !this.matAutocomplete.isOpen) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        // Using setTimeout to ensure Angular change detection completes
        // before trying to open the dropdown
        this.buildingProfileInput.nativeElement.focus();
      });
    }
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.form.valid) {
      // Set loading state
      this.isLoading = true;

      const formData = this.form.value;

      // For both create and update, we need to prepare the building profiles in the correct format
      const buildingProfiles = this.selectedBuildingProfiles.map((profile) => {
        return {
          id: profile.id,
          entityDisplayName: profile.entityDisplayName,
        } as TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef;
      });

      if (this.isNew) {
        // Create new room profile
        const createRequest: CreateRoomProfileRequest = {
          name: formData.name,
          buildingProfiles: buildingProfiles,
        };

        this.roomProfilesService.roomProfilesCreateRoomProfile(createRequest).subscribe({
          next: (response) => {
            this.isLoading = false;
            this.dialogRef.close(response);
          },
          error: (error) => {
            console.error('Error creating room profile:', error);
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
        });
      } else {
        // Update existing room profile
        const updateRequest: ModifyRoomProfileRequest = {
          name: formData.name,
          buildingProfiles: buildingProfiles,
        };

        this.roomProfilesService.roomProfilesUpdateRoomProfile(formData.id, updateRequest).subscribe({
          next: (response) => {
            this.isLoading = false;
            this.dialogRef.close(response);
          },
          error: (error) => {
            console.error('Error updating room profile:', error);
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
        });
      }
    }
  }

  onCancel(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { FormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { RoomTypeEditComponent } from '../room-type-edit/room-type-edit.component';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { RoomProfilesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/roomProfiles.service';
import { RoomProfileListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/roomProfileListItemDto';
import { SortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-room-type-list',
  templateUrl: './room-type-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./room-type-list.component.scss'],
})
export class RoomTypeListComponent implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('roomTypeDataTable', { static: false }) roomTypeDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'name',
      displayName: 'DICT.ROOM_TYPE.NAME',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
      filterable: false,
      filterValue: null,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'BuildingProfiles',
      displayName: 'DICT.ROOM_TYPE.BUILDING_PROFILES',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
      filterable: false,
      filterValue: null,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'isDeleted',
      displayName: 'DICT.ROOM_TYPE.ACTIVE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: true,
      filterable: false,
      filterValue: null,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
      filterable: false,
      filterValue: null,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  isLoading = false;
  pageSize = 10;
  data: any[] = [];
  dataResponse: any = { items: [], recordsTotal: 0 };

  activeOptions = [
    { id: true, name: 'Aktív' },
    { id: false, name: 'Inaktív' },
  ];

  searchForm = this.fb.group({
    nameFilter: [null],
    active: [{ id: true, name: 'Aktív' }],
  });

  constructor(private dialog: MatDialog, private roomProfilesService: RoomProfilesService, private fb: FormBuilder) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadData();
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }

  loadData(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;

    // Store the search values in local variables for proper typing
    const nameFilter = this.sfc.nameFilter?.value as string | null;

    // We need to invert the active value because the API uses isActive but the model uses isDeleted
    let activeStatus = this.sfc.active?.value?.id as boolean | null;

    // If activeStatus has a value, invert it because isActive is the opposite of isDeleted
    if (activeStatus !== null) {
      activeStatus = !activeStatus;
    }

    this.roomProfilesService
      .roomProfilesGetRoomProfilesList(nameFilter!, activeStatus!, 0, 100, 'name', SortDirection.Ascending, undefined)
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          console.log('Raw API response:', result);
          if (result && result.items) {
            // Create a proper response object for the data table
            this.dataResponse = {
              items: result.items.filter((item) => item && item.id),
              recordsTotal: result.recordsTotal,
            };

            // Keep data array for compatibility
            this.data = this.dataResponse.items;
          } else {
            this.dataResponse = { items: [], recordsTotal: 0 };
            this.data = [];
          }
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error('Error loading room profiles:', error);
          this.isLoading = false;
          this.dataResponse = { items: [], recordsTotal: 0 };
          this.data = [];
        },
      });
  }

  openAddDialog(): void {
    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(RoomTypeEditComponent, {
      width: '600px',
      height: '500px',
      disableClose: false,
      autoFocus: false,
      panelClass: 'no-scroll-dialog',
      data: {
        isNew: true,
        roomType: {
          id: 0,
          name: '',
          isDeleted: false,
          buildingProfiles: '',
        },
      },
    });

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((result) => {
      if (result) {
        this.loadData();
      }
    });
  }

  editRow(element: RoomProfileListItemDto): void {
    console.log('Editing room profile:', element);
    if (element.id) {
      this.isLoading = true;

      this.roomProfilesService.roomProfilesGetRoomProfileById(element.id).subscribe({
        next: (roomProfile) => {
          this.isLoading = false;

          const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(RoomTypeEditComponent, {
            width: '600px',
            height: '500px',
            disableClose: false,
            autoFocus: false,
            panelClass: 'no-scroll-dialog',
            data: {
              isNew: false,
              roomType: roomProfile,
            },
          });

          dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((result) => {
            if (result) {
              this.loadData();
            }
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error('Error loading room profile:', error);
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  deleteRow(element: RoomProfileListItemDto): void {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a(z) ${element.name} helyiség típust?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed) => {
        if (confirmed && element.id) {
          this.isLoading = true;

          this.roomProfilesService.roomProfilesDeleteRoomProfile(element.id).subscribe({
            next: () => {
              this.loadData();
            },
            error: (error) => {
              console.error('Error deleting room profile:', error);
              this.isLoading = false;
            },
          });
        }
      },
    );
  }

  // Reset filter values and reload data
  resetFilter(): void {
    this.sfc.nameFilter.setValue(null);
    this.sfc.active.setValue(null);
    this.loadData();
  }

  /**
   * Truncates building profiles text to ensure it doesn't extend too far
   * @param text Building profiles text to truncate
   * @returns Truncated text suitable for display in the table
   */
  truncateBuildingProfiles(text: string | undefined): string {
    if (!text) return '';

    // Split by commas to count the number of profiles
    const profiles = text.split(',');

    // If there are more than 5 profiles, truncate and add ellipsis
    if (profiles.length > 5) {
      return profiles.slice(0, 5).join(', ') + '...';
    }

    // If the text is too long, truncate with ellipsis
    if (text.length > 100) {
      return text.substring(0, 50) + '...';
    }

    return text;
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { ConfirmDialogComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { ErrorHelper } from 'src/app/core/errors/error-helper';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'forgotten-password',
  templateUrl: './forgotten-password.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./forgotten-password.component.scss'],
})
export class ForgottenPasswordComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  token?: string;
  username?: string;
  tenantCode?: string;
  formFields: any;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  showSites = false;
  isVisibilityIcon = true;
  hide = true;
  hidepw = true;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SEND];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private authService: AuthService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Ensure we're not immediately redirected
    if (this.authService.getForgottenPW() !== true) {
      this.authService.setForgottenPW(true);
    }

    this.form = this.formBuilder.group([]);
    this.form.addControl('email', new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: false }, Validators.required));
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  public cancel(): void {
    this.authService.removeForgottenPW();
    this.router.navigate(['login']);
  }

  onSubmit() {
    if (this.form?.valid) {
      const email = this.form.get('email')?.value;

      this.userService.usersForgottenpassword(email).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, {
            data: {
              message:
                'Ha ez az e-mail cím regisztrálva van a rendszerünkben, akkor hamarosan kapni fog egy e-mailt a további utasításokkal.',
              cancelButtonText: 'Rendben',
              showConfirmButton: false,
            },
          });

          dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
            if (!confirmed) {
              this.authService.removeForgottenPW();
              this.router.navigate(['login']);
            }
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          ErrorHelper.serverErrorHandler(error, this.form, (errors: any) => {
            this.openSnackBar('A mentés nem hajtható végre, az űrlap hibás adatokat tartalmaz.', SnackBarColor.Warning);
            this.onServerError(errors);
          });
        },
      });
    }
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from '../../core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from '../../core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from '../../core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { IoTDataService } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/ioTData.service';
import { IoTDataListItemDto } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/ioTDataListItemDto';
import { IoTDataPagedEntityQueryResult } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/ioTDataPagedEntityQueryResult';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/sortDirection';
import { SortDirection as EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection } from '../../core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { IDataTableResponse } from '../../core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { BreadcrumbService } from '../../core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from '../../core/services/loader.service';
import { DictItemModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { DictService } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/dict.service';
@Component({
  selector: 'iot-data',
  templateUrl: './iot-data.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./iot-data.component.scss'],
})
export class IoTDataComponent extends FormComponentBase {
  public errorMessage?: string;
  from?: Date;
  to?: Date;

  filterForm: UntypedFormGroup;
  isProcessed = [
    { label: 'Összes', value: null },
    { label: 'Igen', value: true },
    { label: 'Nem', value: false },
  ];
  dictItems?: DictItemModel[];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private ioTDataService: IoTDataService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    const filterFormFields = {
      deviceName: [null],
      from: [null],
      to: [null],
      proc: [null],
      dataType: [null],
    };
    this.filterForm = this.formBuilder.group(filterFormFields);

    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      data_type: [''],
      from: new UntypedFormControl(),
      to: new UntypedFormControl(),
    });

    this.rootPath = 'iot-data';
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
    this.getItems();

    this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsForDict('iot_data_source_type').subscribe((dictItems: DictItemModel[]) => {
      this.dictItems = dictItems;
    });

    const setDatetimeValidation = () => {
      const to = this.form.get('to');
      const from = this.form.get('from');

      to?.setErrors(null);
      this.errorMessage = undefined;

      if (from?.value && to?.value && from.value > to.value) {
        to.setErrors(['A kezdeti dátum távolabbra mutat, mint a vég dátum!']);
        this.errorMessage = 'A kezdeti dátum távolabbra mutat, mint a vég dátum!';
      }
      this.from = from!.value;
      this.to = to!.value;
      this.getItems();
    };

    this.form.get('from')?.valueChanges.subscribe(() => setDatetimeValidation());
    this.form.get('to')?.valueChanges.subscribe(() => setDatetimeValidation());
  }

  private searchField = ''; // A keresési mező értékének letárolására.

  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'DeviceName',
      displayName: 'Eszköz',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'DeviceIdentifier',
      displayName: 'Eszköz azonosító',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'IoTDataType',
      displayName: 'Adat típusa',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'IoTDataSourceType',
      displayName: 'Adatforrás típusa',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'MeasurementDate',
      displayName: 'Mérés időpontja',
      columnType: ColumnType.DateTime,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'CreateDate',
      displayName: 'Létrehozás időpontja',
      columnType: ColumnType.DateTime,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Processed',
      displayName: 'Feldolgozott-e?',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems: IoTDataListItemDto[] = [];

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;
    const startPage = this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex ?? this.pageIndex;
    const pageSize = this.dataDataTable?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize;
    const sortColumn = this.dataDataTable?.getSort() ?? this.sortActive;
    const sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.getSortDirection() ?? EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
        ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
        : ApiSortDirection.Descending;
    const dN = this.filterForm?.get('deviceName')?.value;
    const from = this.form?.get('from')?.value;
    const to = this.form?.get('to')?.value;
    const proc = this.filterForm?.get('proc')?.value;
    const dataTypeId = this.filterForm?.get('dataType')?.value?.id;

    this.ioTDataService
      .ioTDataGet(
        from,
        to,
        dN,
        proc,
        dataTypeId,
        this.searchField ?? '',
        startPage,
        pageSize,
        sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
        false,
      )
      .subscribe((data: IoTDataPagedEntityQueryResult) => {
        this.allItems = [];
        data.items!.forEach((value) => {
          this.allItems.push({
            DeviceName: value.deviceName,
            DeviceIdentifier: value.deviceIdentifier,
            IoTDataType: value.ioTDataType,
            IoTDataSourceType: value.ioTDataSourceType,
            MeasurementDate: value.measurementDate,
            CreateDate: value.createDate,
            Processed: value.processed,
          } as IoTDataListItemDto);
        });
        this.data.items = this.allItems;
        this.data.recordsTotal = data.recordsTotal!;
        this.dataDataTable.refresh();
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  search(searchText: string) {
    this.searchField = searchText; // Searchfield mező beállítása a keresés mező értékével. Így egy change esemény futásakor is megőrizzük a keresés szűrést.
    this.getItems();
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.filterForm.get('deviceName')?.setValue(null);
    this.form.get('from')?.setValue(null);
    this.form.get('to')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('proc')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('dataType')?.setValue(null);
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { AuthenticateService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/authenticate.service';
import { LoginModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/loginModel';
import AccessTokenModel from 'src/app/core/services/security/access-token-model';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';
import { NgxSpinnerService } from 'ngx-spinner';
import { AuthenticateApiService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/authenticate-api-service';
import { TwoFactorLoginModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'login-root',
  templateUrl: './login.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./login.component.css'],
})
export class LoginComponent implements OnInit {
  form!: UntypedFormGroup;
  authenticationForm!: UntypedFormGroup;
  hide = true;
  wrongCredentials = false;
  isVisibilityIcon = true;
  isCancelIcon = true;
  twoFactorCheck = false;
  showQrCode = false;
  authenticationFieldMask = '000000';

  constructor(
    private router: Router,
    private spinner: NgxSpinnerService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private authenticateService: AuthenticateService,
    private authenticateApiService: AuthenticateApiService,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
  ) {
    // Only check if already has token before navigating
    const token = this.authService.getAuthToken();
    const isAuthenticated = Object.keys(token).length !== 0;

    if (isAuthenticated) {
      const hasTenant = !!this.authService.getCurrentTenant();
      if (hasTenant) {
        // Only navigate to home if both authenticated and has tenant
        this.router.navigate(['']);
      } else {
        // Redirect to tenant selection if authenticated but no tenant
        this.router.navigate(['/scope-selection']);
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const loginFormFields = {
      email: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, [Validators.required]],
      password: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, [Validators.required]],
    };
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(loginFormFields);

    const authenticationFormFields = {
      authenticationcode: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, [Validators.required]],
    };
    this.authenticationForm = this.formBuilder.group(authenticationFormFields);
  }

  // We no longer need to store the token here since we're using the auth service's temporary token functionality

  onSubmit() {
    if (this.form?.valid) {
      this.spinner.show();
      const model = this.form?.value;
      const loginModel = {
        email: model.email,
        password: model.password,
      } as LoginModel;
      this.authenticateService.userAuthenticateLogin(loginModel).subscribe({
        next: (tokenModel: AccessTokenModel) => {
          this.spinner.hide();
          if (tokenModel.twoFactorEnabled) {
            // If 2FA is enabled, store token temporarily for API calls but don't save it to localStorage yet
            this.authService.setAuthToken(tokenModel, true); // true means temporary token
            // Mark that 2FA setup is in progress
            this.authService.setTwoFactorSetupInProgress(true);
            this.showQrCode = true;
          } else {
            // For non-2FA users, store token normally and navigate to tenant selection
            this.authService.setAuthToken(tokenModel);
            this.router.navigate(['/scope-selection']);
          }
        },
        error: (error) => {
          if (error.error.RenewInvalidToken) {
            const renewInfo = error.error.RenewInvalidToken[0].split('.');
            this.authenticateApiService.changePassword(renewInfo[0], renewInfo[1]);
          } else if (error.error.TwoFactorChecker) {
            const userGuid = error.error.TwoFactorChecker[0];
            this.authService.setAuthUser(userGuid);

            // If this is a two-factor auth case, check if QR code needs to be shown first
            if (error.error.TwoFactorSetup && error.error.TwoFactorSetup[0] === 'true') {
              this.showQrCode = true;
            } else {
              this.twoFactorCheck = true;
            }
            this.spinner.hide();
          } else {
            this.wrongCredentials = true;
            // Show error snackbar instead of using the wrongCredentials flag
            this.showErrorSnackBar('LOGIN.ERROR');
            this.spinner.hide();
            console.log(error);
          }
        },
      });
    }
  }

  submitCode() {
    if (this.authenticationForm?.valid) {
      this.spinner.show();
      const model = this.authenticationForm?.value;
      const userHash = this.authService.getAuthuser();
      const loginModel = {
        authenticationcode: model.authenticationcode,
        userhash: userHash,
      } as TwoFactorLoginModel;
      this.authenticateService.userAuthenticateTwofactorLogin(loginModel).subscribe({
        next: (tokenModel: AccessTokenModel) => {
          // Store the token but don't navigate to home
          this.authService.setAuthToken(tokenModel);
          this.authService.removeAuthuser();
          // Mark 2FA setup as complete
          this.authService.completeTwoFactorSetup();
          this.spinner.hide();

          // Navigate to tenant selection after successful two-factor login
          this.router.navigate(['/scope-selection']);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.wrongCredentials = true;
          this.spinner.hide();
          console.log(error);
        },
      });
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  get afc() {
    return this.authenticationForm.controls;
  }

  changeType() {
    this.hide = !this.hide;
  }

  /**
   * Show an error snackbar with a translated message
   * @param messageKey Translation key for the error message
   */
  showErrorSnackBar(messageKey: string): void {
    this.translateService.get(messageKey).subscribe((message: string) => {
      this.snackBar.open(message, 'OK', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: ['error-snackbar'],
        horizontalPosition: 'center',
        verticalPosition: 'bottom',
      });
    });
  }

  forgottenPassword() {
    this.authenticateApiService.forgottenPassword();
  }

  /**
   * Handle proceeding to verification after QR code is shown
   */
  onQrNextStep(): void {
    this.showQrCode = false;
    this.twoFactorCheck = true;

    // Now convert the temporary token to a permanent one
    // We'll use the current auth token which might be temporary
    const currentToken = this.authService.getAuthToken();
    if (currentToken && Object.keys(currentToken).length > 0) {
      // Set it as permanent now (not temporary)
      this.authService.setAuthToken(currentToken);
    }
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\login\two-factor-qr\two-factor-qr.component.ts

import { Component, EventEmitter, OnInit, OnDestroy, Output, HostListener } from '@angular/core';
import { AuthenticateService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/authenticate.service';
import { NgxSpinnerService } from 'ngx-spinner';
import { SafeUrl, DomSanitizer } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-two-factor-qr',
  templateUrl: './two-factor-qr.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./two-factor-qr.component.css'],
})
export class TwoFactorQrComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Output() nextStep = new EventEmitter<void>();

  qrCodeImage: SafeUrl | null = null;
  isLoading = true;
  loadError = false;

  // Flag to track if 2FA setup has been completed successfully
  private setupComplete = false;

  constructor(
    private authenticateService: AuthenticateService,
    private spinner: NgxSpinnerService,
    private sanitizer: DomSanitizer,
    private authService: AuthService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Mark 2FA setup as in progress when component is initialized
    this.authService.setTwoFactorSetupInProgress(true);
    this.loadQrCode();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    // If component is destroyed without completing setup, log out for security
    if (!this.setupComplete && this.authService.isTwoFactorSetupInProgress()) {
      this.authService.logout();
    }
  }

  // Handle browser refresh/close events without dialog
  @HostListener('window:beforeunload', ['$event'])
  beforeUnloadHandler(event: BeforeUnloadEvent): void {
    // No dialog, but we still need to handle cleanup if the user refreshes/closes browser
    if (this.authService.isTwoFactorSetupInProgress() && !this.setupComplete) {
      // We don't need to set return value since we're not showing a dialog
      this.authService.logout();
    }
  }

  loadQrCode(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.spinner.show();

    this.authenticateService.userAuthenticateGetTwoFactorQrCode().subscribe({
      next: (response: any) => {
        // The API returns a base64 encoded image
        if (response && response.qrCodeBase64) {
          const base64Image = 'data:image/png;base64,' + response.qrCodeBase64;
          this.qrCodeImage = this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustUrl(base64Image);
          this.authService.setAuthUser(response.userHash);
        }
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.spinner.hide();
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error loading QR code:', error);
        this.loadError = true;
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.spinner.hide();
      },
    });
  }

  onNext(): void {
    // Mark 2FA setup as complete
    this.setupComplete = true;
    this.authService.completeTwoFactorSetup();
    this.nextStep.emit();
  }
}

﻿import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { MeasurementDataListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/measurementDataListItemDto';
import { MeasurementDataPagedEntityQueryResult } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/measurementDataPagedEntityQueryResult';
import { FormComponentBase } from '../../core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from '../../core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from '../../core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/sortDirection';
import { SortDirection as EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection } from '../../core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { IDataTableResponse } from '../../core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { BreadcrumbService } from '../../core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from '../../core/services/loader.service';
import { MeasurementDataService } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/measurementData.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'measurement-data',
  templateUrl: './measurement-data.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./measurement-data.component.scss'],
})
export class MeasurementDataComponent extends FormComponentBase {
  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private measurementDataService: MeasurementDataService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = 'measurement-data';
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
    this.getItems();
  }

  private searchField = ''; // A keresési mező értékének letárolására.

  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    ({
      columnName: 'deviceName',
      displayName: 'Eszköz',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false, // Hibára fut, join kellene a működéséhez, de nem így lett megvalósítva.
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'deviceIdentifier',
      displayName: 'Eszköz azonosító',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false, // Hibára fut, join kellene a működéséhez, de nem így lett megvalósítva.
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'measuredEndpointIdentifier',
      displayName: 'Mérési pont azonosító',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'dataCatalogCode',
      displayName: 'Séma',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'data',
      displayName: 'Mért adat',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'measurementDate',
      displayName: 'Mérés időpontja',
      columnType: ColumnType.DateTime,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems: MeasurementDataListItemDto[] = [];

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;
    const startPage = this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex ?? this.pageIndex;
    const pageSize = this.dataDataTable?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize;
    const sortColumn = this.dataDataTable?.getSort() ?? this.sortActive;
    const sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.getSortDirection() ?? EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
        ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
        : ApiSortDirection.Descending;
    // TODO measuredEndpointIdentifier != null
    // TODO from - to
    this.measurementDataService
      .measurementDataGet(
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.searchField ?? '',
        startPage,
        pageSize,
        sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
        false,
      )
      .subscribe((data: MeasurementDataPagedEntityQueryResult) => {
        this.allItems = [];
        this.allItems = data.items!;
        this.data.items = this.allItems!;
        this.data.recordsTotal = data.recordsTotal!;
        this.dataDataTable.refresh();
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  search(searchText: string) {
    this.searchField = searchText; // Searchfield mező beállítása a keresés mező értékével. Így egy change esemény futásakor is megőrizzük a keresés szűrést.
    this.getItems();
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, FormControl, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { BreadcrumbService } from '../../../core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from '../../../core/services/loader.service';
import { ExportsService } from '../../../core/services/exports-api.service';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import {
  ConsumptionService,
  DevicesAggregatedDataTableRequest,
  DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel,
  DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder,
  SummaryTableDatatModel,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs/operators';
import saveAs from 'file-saver';
import { AggregationLevel } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/aggregationLevel';
import { AggregationLevelDisplayName, AggregationLevelStringPipe } from 'src/app/core/aggregationLevel';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-aggregated-data',
  templateUrl: './aggregated-data.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./aggregated-data.component.scss'],
})
export class AggregatedDataComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  hierarchyForm!: FormGroup;
  formChanged: boolean = false;
  showResults: boolean = false;
  dataLoaded: boolean = false;
  aggregatedData: DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel[] = [];
  summaryTableData: SummaryTableDatatModel[] = [];
  summaryTableLoading: boolean = false;
  isCreate: boolean = true;

  // Display options for time periods
  // showTodayData is always true and disabled in the UI
  showTodayData: boolean = true;
  showYesterdayData: boolean = true;
  showLastWeekData: boolean = true;

  // Sort order - using enum values directly
  listOrderOption: string = DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder.TopologyThenDevice;

  // Fixed aggregation level for the disabled select
  aggregationLevel: AggregationLevel = AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private fb: FormBuilder,
    private consumptionService: ConsumptionService,
    private exportsService: ExportsService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.initForm();
  }

  initForm(): void {
    this.hierarchyForm = new FormGroup({
      institution: new FormControl(null, Validators.required),
      site: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      building: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      buildingPart: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      floor: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      room: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      measureEndpoint: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      measuredProperty: new FormControl(null),
      measuredData: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      deviceCategory: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      deviceType: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
    });
  }

  onHierarchyFormValueChanged(): void {
    this.formChanged = true;
  }

  onDisplayOptionsChanged(): void {
    // This method will be called when any of the time period checkboxes change
    // We don't need to do anything special here since we're passing the values directly to the child component
    // Ensure showTodayData is always true
    this.showTodayData = true;
  }

  search(): void {
    this.loadAggregatedData();
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.hierarchyForm.reset();
    this.dataLoaded = false;
  }

  /**
   * Export the aggregated data to Excel
   */
  exportToExcel(): void {
    // Show loader
    this.showLoader();

    const docStyle = document.documentElement.style;
    docStyle.setProperty('cursor', 'wait');
    // Prepare the same request used for data loading
    const request: DevicesAggregatedDataTableRequest = {
      institutionId: this.hierarchyForm.get('institution')?.value?.id,
      siteId: this.hierarchyForm.get('site')?.value?.id,
      buildingId: this.hierarchyForm.get('building')?.value?.id,
      buildingPartId: this.hierarchyForm.get('buildingPart')?.value?.id,
      floorId: this.hierarchyForm.get('floor')?.value?.id,
      roomId: this.hierarchyForm.get('room')?.value?.id,
      measuredProperty: this.hierarchyForm.get('measuredProperty')?.value,
      technology: this.hierarchyForm.get('measuredData')?.value,
      deviceCategory: this.hierarchyForm.get('deviceCategory')?.value,
      deviceType: this.hierarchyForm.get('deviceType')?.value,
      // Include aggregation options based on checkboxes
      aggregationYesterday: this.showYesterdayData,
      aggregationLast7Days: this.showLastWeekData,
      // Set listOrder based on radio button selection
      listOrder: this.listOrderOption as DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder,
    };
    // Call the export service - use 'body' observe type to ensure we get a Blob
    this.exportsService
      .getDevicesAggregatedDataExcelExport(request, 'body')
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => {
          this.hideLoader();
        }),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (data) => {
          const exportFileName = 'aggregated_data';
          saveAs(data as Blob, `${exportFileName}_export.xlsx`, { autoBom: true });
          docStyle.setProperty('cursor', '');
        },
        error: () => {
          docStyle.setProperty('cursor', '');
        },
      });
  }

  private loadAggregatedData(): void {
    // Prepare request from form values
    const request: DevicesAggregatedDataTableRequest = {
      institutionId: this.hierarchyForm.get('institution')?.value?.id,
      siteId: this.hierarchyForm.get('site')?.value?.id,
      buildingId: this.hierarchyForm.get('building')?.value?.id,
      buildingPartId: this.hierarchyForm.get('buildingPart')?.value?.id,
      floorId: this.hierarchyForm.get('floor')?.value?.id,
      roomId: this.hierarchyForm.get('room')?.value?.id,
      measuredProperty: this.hierarchyForm.get('measuredProperty')?.value,
      technology: this.hierarchyForm.get('measuredData')?.value,
      deviceCategory: this.hierarchyForm.get('deviceCategory')?.value,
      deviceType: this.hierarchyForm.get('deviceType')?.value,
      // Include aggregation options based on checkboxes
      aggregationYesterday: this.showYesterdayData,
      aggregationLast7Days: this.showLastWeekData,
      // Set listOrder based on radio button selection
      listOrder: this.listOrderOption as DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder,
    };

    this.showLoader();
    this.summaryTableLoading = true;

    // Load both aggregated data and summary table data
    this.consumptionService
      .getDevicesAggregatedData(request)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => {
          this.hideLoader();
        }),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (response: any) => {
          // Use the data as it comes from the API
          this.aggregatedData = response || [];
          this.dataLoaded = true;
          this.showResults = true;
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error('Error loading aggregated data:', error);
          // Set empty array instead of null
          this.aggregatedData = [];
          this.dataLoaded = true;
          this.showResults = true;
        },
      });

    // Load summary table data
    this.consumptionService
      .getSummaryTableData(request)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => {
          this.summaryTableLoading = false;
        }),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (response: SummaryTableDatatModel[]) => {
          console.log('Summary table data:', response);
          this.summaryTableData = response || [];
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error('Error loading summary table data:', error);
          this.summaryTableData = [];
        },
      });
  }


}

import { Component, Input, OnChanges, OnInit, SimpleChanges, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { MatTable } from '@angular/material/table';
import { MatTableDataSource } from '@angular/material/table';
import { DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

interface ColumnGroup {
  name: string;
  columns: string[];
  colspan: number;
  visible?: boolean;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-aggregated-data-list',
  templateUrl: './aggregated-data-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./aggregated-data-list.component.scss']
})
export class AggregatedDataListComponent implements OnInit, OnChanges {
  @Input() aggregatedData: DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel[] = [];
  @Input() showToday: boolean = true;
  @Input() showYesterday: boolean = true;
  @Input() showLastWeek: boolean = true;

  @ViewChild(MatTable) table!: MatTable<any>;

  dataSource = new MatTableDataSource<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel>([]);
  
  // Base columns (always visible)
  baseColumns: string[] = [
    'topologyData.institutionName',
    'topologyData.siteName',
    'topologyData.buildingName',
    'topologyData.buildingPartName',
    'topologyData.floorName',
    'topologyData.roomName',
    'deviceData.deviceCategoryName',
    'deviceData.deviceTypeName',
    'deviceData.aggregationMethod',
    'measurementPointData.identifier',
    'measurementPointData.name',
    'measurementPointData.measuredProperty',
    'measurementPointData.technology'
  ];

  // Today's data columns
  todayColumns: string[] = [
    'todaysData.lastMasuredValue',
    'todaysData.aggregatedValue',
    'todaysData.minValue',
    'todaysData.maxValue'
  ];

  // Yesterday's data columns
  yesterdayColumns: string[] = [
    'lastDaysData.aggregatedValue',
    'lastDaysData.minValue',
    'lastDaysData.maxValue',
    'lastDaysData.averageValue'
  ];

  // Last week's data columns
  lastWeekColumns: string[] = [
    'last7DaysData.aggregatedValue',
    'last7DaysData.minValue',
    'last7DaysData.maxValue',
    'last7DaysData.averageValue'
  ];
  
  // All columns that will be displayed (will be calculated dynamically)
  displayedColumns: string[] = [];

  // Column groupings for the top header row
  columnGroups: ColumnGroup[] = [
    { name: 'Intézményi hierarchia', columns: [
      'topologyData.institutionName',
      'topologyData.siteName',
      'topologyData.buildingName',
      'topologyData.buildingPartName',
      'topologyData.floorName',
      'topologyData.roomName'
    ], colspan: 6, visible: true },
    { name: 'Eszköz', columns: [
      'deviceData.deviceCategoryName',
      'deviceData.deviceTypeName',
      'deviceData.aggregationMethod'
    ], colspan: 3, visible: true },
    { name: 'Mérési pont', columns: [
      'measurementPointData.identifier',
      'measurementPointData.name',
      'measurementPointData.measuredProperty',
      'measurementPointData.technology'
    ], colspan: 4, visible: true },
    { name: 'Mai nap', columns: [
      'todaysData.lastMasuredValue',
      'todaysData.aggregatedValue',
      'todaysData.minValue',
      'todaysData.maxValue'
    ], colspan: 4, visible: true },
    { name: 'Előző nap', columns: [
      'lastDaysData.aggregatedValue',
      'lastDaysData.minValue',
      'lastDaysData.maxValue',
      'lastDaysData.averageValue'
    ], colspan: 4, visible: true },
    { name: 'Előző hét', columns: [
      'last7DaysData.aggregatedValue',
      'last7DaysData.minValue',
      'last7DaysData.maxValue',
      'last7DaysData.averageValue'
    ], colspan: 4, visible: true }
  ];

  // Column IDs for the group header row
  groupHeaderColumns: string[] = [];

  constructor(private translateService: TranslateService) {
    this.updateDisplayedColumns();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.updateDisplayedColumns();
    this.updateDataSource();
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    // Update displayed columns when visibility changes
    if (changes['showToday'] || changes['showYesterday'] || changes['showLastWeek']) {
      this.updateDisplayedColumns();
      this.updateGroupHeaderColumns();
    }
    
    // Update data source when data changes
    if (changes['aggregatedData']) {
      this.updateDataSource();
    }
  }

  updateDataSource(): void {
    this.dataSource = new MatTableDataSource<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel>(this.aggregatedData);
  }

  updateDisplayedColumns(): void {
    // Start with base columns
    this.displayedColumns = [...this.baseColumns];

    // Add columns based on visibility settings
    if (this.showToday) {
      this.displayedColumns = [...this.displayedColumns, ...this.todayColumns];
    }
    if (this.showYesterday) {
      this.displayedColumns = [...this.displayedColumns, ...this.yesterdayColumns];
    }
    if (this.showLastWeek) {
      this.displayedColumns = [...this.displayedColumns, ...this.lastWeekColumns];
    }

    // Update group visibility
    this.columnGroups[3].visible = this.showToday;     // Today
    this.columnGroups[4].visible = this.showYesterday; // Yesterday
    this.columnGroups[5].visible = this.showLastWeek;  // Last week

    // Update group header columns
    this.updateGroupHeaderColumns();
  }

  updateGroupHeaderColumns(): void {
    // Only include headers for visible column groups
    this.groupHeaderColumns = this.columnGroups
      .filter(group => group.visible)
      .map(group => 'group_' + group.name);
  }
  
  // Helper method to get nested property value from object
  getNestedPropertyValue(obj: any, path: string): any {
    const parts = path.split('.');
    let value = obj;
    
    for (const part of parts) {
      if (value === null || value === undefined) {
        return '';
      }
      value = value[part];
    }
    
    return value;
  }
  
  // Get the second-level column name (for display in the second header row)
  getColumnDisplayName(column: string): string {
    const parts = column.split('.');
    let translationKey = '';
    
    if (parts.length > 1) {
      // For nested properties, create a translation key based on the property name
      const propertyName = parts[parts.length - 1];
      translationKey = `AGGREGATED_DATA.COLUMNS.${propertyName.toUpperCase()}`;
    } else {
      // For simple properties
      translationKey = `AGGREGATED_DATA.COLUMNS.${column.toUpperCase()}`;
    }
    
    // Try to get translation, fall back to formatted property name if not found
    const translation = this.translateService.instant(translationKey);
    if (translation === translationKey) {
      // Translation not found, use old formatting logic as fallback
      return this.formatColumnName(parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : column);
    }
    
    return translation;
  }
  
  // Format column names for display (capitalize, add spaces) - kept as fallback
  private formatColumnName(name: string): string {
    // Convert camelCase to Title Case with spaces
    return name
      .replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1')
      .replace(/^./, str => str.toUpperCase());
  }
}

    let value = obj;
    
    for (const part of parts) {
      if (value === null || value === undefined) {
        return '';
      }
      value = value[part];
    }
    
    return value;
  }

  // Get the column display name for translation
  getColumnDisplayName(column: string): string {
    const parts = column.split('.');
    let translationKey = '';
    
    if (parts.length > 1) {
      // For nested properties, create a translation key based on the property name
      const propertyName = parts[parts.length - 1];
      translationKey = `AGGREGATED_DATA.COLUMNS.${propertyName.toUpperCase()}`;
    } else {
      // For simple properties
      translationKey = `AGGREGATED_DATA.COLUMNS.${column.toUpperCase()}`;
    }
    
    // Try to get translation, fall back to formatted property name if not found
    const translation = this.translateService.instant(translationKey);
    if (translation === translationKey) {
      // Translation not found, use formatting logic as fallback
      return this.formatColumnName(parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : column);
    }
    
    return translation;
  }

  // Format column names for display (capitalize, add spaces) - kept as fallback
  private formatColumnName(name: string): string {
    // Convert camelCase to Title Case with spaces
    return name
      .replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1')
      .replace(/^./, str => str.toUpperCase());
  }

  // Get topology data title
  getTopologyTitle(topologyData: any): string {
    if (!topologyData) {
      return 'Összesítő táblázat';
    }
    
    // Build title from available topology data
    const parts = [];
    if (topologyData.institutionName) parts.push(topologyData.institutionName);
    if (topologyData.siteName) parts.push(topologyData.siteName);
    if (topologyData.buildingName) parts.push(topologyData.buildingName);
    if (topologyData.buildingPartName) parts.push(topologyData.buildingPartName);
    if (topologyData.floorName) parts.push(topologyData.floorName);
    if (topologyData.roomName) parts.push(topologyData.roomName);
    
    return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(' - ') : 'Összesítő táblázat';
  }

  // Create data source for a specific summary table
  createDataSource(detailData: SummaryTableDetailDatatModel[]): MatTableDataSource<SummaryTableDetailDatatModel> {
    return new MatTableDataSource<SummaryTableDetailDatatModel>(detailData || []);
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { FormControl, FormGroup, UntypedFormControl, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import moment from 'moment';
import { BehaviorSubject, forkJoin, Observable, catchError, map, of, Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { MonitoringBaseComponent } from 'src/app/core/base/monitoring-base';
import { EchartsDiagramComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/chart/echarts-diagram/echarts-diagram.component';
import {
  MeasuredPropertyEntityDtoEntityRef,
  MeasurementPointModel,
  MeasurementPointsService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import {
  AggregatedDataWithinDayDataTableRequest,
  AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest,
  ConsumptionService as DataReceiverConsumptionService,
  StringChartTableModel,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver';
import {
  AggregationLevel,
  ChartModel,
  ChartTableModel,
  ConsumptionChartRequest,
  ConsumptionService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { ExportsService } from 'src/app/core/services/exports-api.service';
import { ChartTableUtilsService } from 'src/app/core/services/chart-table-utils.service';
import { aggregations } from 'src/app/core/components/chart/select-lists';
import { ISelectListItem } from 'src/app/core/models/select/select-list-item';
import { IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { HttpEvent, HttpResponse } from '@angular/common/http';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-aggregation-level-in-day',
  templateUrl: './aggregation-level-in-day.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./aggregation-level-in-day.component.scss'],
})
/**
 * Aggregált adatok napon belül
 */
export class AggregationLevelInDayComponent extends MonitoringBaseComponent implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild(EchartsDiagramComponent, { static: true }) protected echartsDiagram!: EchartsDiagramComponent;
  // Az EChart-on megjelenítésre kerülő szúrők, és a szűrőkben alapértelmezetten betöltődő értékek beállítása:
  filterVisibilities = { period: true, from: true, to: true, aggregation: true, valueType: false };
  filterDefaultValues = {
    period: 'today',
    from: null,
    to: null,
    aggregation: 'FiveMinutes',
    valueType: [],
  };
  excludedAggregationTypesSubject = new BehaviorSubject<AggregationLevel[]>([]);

  measuredPropertyRefs?: MeasuredPropertyEntityDtoEntityRef[];

  chartFilterForm = new FormGroup({
    period: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
    aggregation: new FormControl<ISelectListItem | undefined | null>({ value: null, disabled: true }),
    from: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
    to: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
    valueType: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
  });

  // locationSelectionForm: UntypedFormGroup = new UntypedFormGroup({
  //     institution: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null }, Validators.required),
  //     site: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }, Validators.required),
  //     building: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
  //     buildingPart: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
  //     floor: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
  //     room: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
  //     measureEndpoint: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }, Validators.required),
  //     latitude: new UntypedFormControl(null),
  //     longitude: new UntypedFormControl(null),
  //     measuredData: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null }),
  //     channelIdentifier: new UntypedFormControl(null)
  // });

  aggregationLevel?: ISelectListItem;
  aggregations = aggregations;
  measurementPoints: number[] = [];
  isYesterdayNeededControl = new FormControl();

  refreshSub = new Subject<boolean>();
  chartTableRefreshSub = new Subject<boolean>();

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    matDialog: MatDialog,
    consumptionService: ConsumptionService,
    exportsService: ExportsService,
    measurementPointsService: MeasurementPointsService,
    chartTableUtilsService: ChartTableUtilsService,
    private apiService: MeasurementPointsService,
    private dataReceiverConsumptionService: DataReceiverConsumptionService,
  ) {
    super(
      router,
      injector,
      elRef,
      loaderService,
      breadcrumbService,
      matDialog,
      consumptionService,
      exportsService,
      measurementPointsService,
      chartTableUtilsService,
    );

    this.rootPath = 'monitoring/aggregation-level';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();

    this.apiService.measurementPointsGetMeasuredProperties().subscribe((items) => {
      this.measuredPropertyRefs = items;
    });
  }

  getAggregationLevel(measureEndpoint?: number, measuredProperty?: number) {
    if (measureEndpoint && measuredProperty) {
      this.dataReceiverConsumptionService.getAggregationLevel(measureEndpoint, measuredProperty).subscribe((result) => {
        this.aggregationLevel = this.aggregations.find((x) => x.code === result);

        this.chartFilterForm.get('aggregation')?.setValue(this.aggregationLevel);
        this.chartFilterForm.get('aggregation')?.updateValueAndValidity();
        this.chartFilterForm.get('aggregation')?.markAsTouched();
      });
    }
  }

  onRefreshDiagram() {
    if (this.echartsDiagram) {
      const currentModel = this.echartsDiagram['model'];
      if (currentModel) {
        this.echartsDiagram.processModel({ model: currentModel });
      }
    }

    if (this.dataTable) {
      this.dataTable.dataTableRequest.pageIndex = 0;
      this.dataTable.refreshEvent();
    }
  }

  updateAggregationTypesSubject(data: AggregationLevel[]) {
    this.excludedAggregationTypesSubject.next(data);
  }

  /**
   * Builds a complete monitoring request model from the current form state
   * @param options Optional parameters to override default values (like pagination)
   * @returns ConsumptionChartRequest model ready for API calls
   */
  protected buildDataReceiverRequest(options?: Partial<ConsumptionChartRequest>): AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest {
    // Get organization unit selections
    const orgUnitSelections = this.mapItemsToOrgUnitSelections();

    // Get measured property ID
    const measuredPropertyId = this.form.get('measuredProperty')?.value?.id as number;

    // Build request object with all filter parameters
    const request: AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest = {
      orgUnitSelections,
      measuredPropertyId,
      isYesterdayNeeded: this.isYesterdayNeededControl?.value ?? false,
    };

    // Override with any provided options
    if (options) {
      Object.assign(request, options);
    }

    return request;
  }

  getDiagramItems() {
    this.showLoader();
    const request = this.buildDataReceiverRequest();
    const aggregatedSub = this.dataReceiverConsumptionService.getAggregatedDataWithinDayDiagram(request).subscribe({
      next: (chartModel: ChartModel) => {
        this.hideLoader();
        this.echartsDiagram.processModel({ model: chartModel });
        aggregatedSub.unsubscribe();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.hideLoader();
        aggregatedSub.unsubscribe();
      },
    });
  }

  aggregationLevelInDayMeasuredPropertyList(event: any[]) {
    this.measurementPoints = event
      .map((x) => {
        return x.get('measureEndpoint').value?.id;
      })
      .filter((x) => x);
  }

  onGetDatas() {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid) {
      return;
    }
    this.dataLoaded = true;

    this.getDiagramItems();
    if (this.dataTable) {
      this.dataTable.dataTableRequest.pageIndex = 0;
      this.dataTable.refreshEvent();
    }
  }

  getItems(params: IDataTableRequest) {
    const request = this.buildDataReceiverRequest({ pageIndex: params.pageIndex, pageSize: params.pageSize });

    // Make the API call to get chart table data
    return this.dataReceiverConsumptionService.getAggregatedDataWithinDayChartTableData(request).pipe(
      map((response: StringChartTableModel) => {
        if (response && response.items && response.items.length > 0) {
          this.columns = this.chartTableUtilsService.createColumnDefinitions(response.items[0]);
        }

        // Transform the API response data into table rows
        //const rows = this.transformChartTableToRows(response);
        const rows = this.chartTableUtilsService.transformChartTableToRows(response.items);
console.log(rows);
        // Create and return the expected IDataTableResponse format
        return {
          items: rows,
          recordsTotal: response.recordsTotal, // Use actual count from API if available
        };
      }),
      catchError((error) => {
        console.error('Error fetching data table:', error);
        // Return an empty response on error
        return of({
          items: [],
          recordsTotal: 0,
        });
      }),
    );
  }

    
  /**
   * Implementation of abstract performExport method for AggregationLevelInDayComponent
   * Calls the datareceiver API endpoint for XLSX export
   * @returns Observable with the XLSX data as Blob
   */
  protected performExport(): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    const request = this.buildDataReceiverRequest();
    return this.exportsService.getAggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExport(request);
  }

  /**
   * Implementation of abstract performPdfExport method for MainMeasurementComponent
   * Calls the main meter API endpoint for PDF export
   * @param request The monitoring request parameters
   * @returns Observable with the PDF data as Blob
   */
  protected performPdfExport(
    request: AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest,
    imageForPdf?: File,
  ): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    const dataReceiverRequest = this.buildDataReceiverRequest();
    return this.exportsService.getAggregatedDataWithinDayTableDataPdfExport(dataReceiverRequest, imageForPdf);
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\monitoring\alert\alert.resolver.ts
====================================================================================================

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ActivatedRouteSnapshot,
  Router,
  RouterStateSnapshot,
} from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import {
  AlertGetModel,
  AlertsService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class AlertResolver {
  constructor(private service: AlertsService, private router: Router) {}

  resolve(
    route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot,
    state: RouterStateSnapshot
  ): Observable<AlertGetModel> {
    return this.service.alertsGet(Number(route.paramMap.get('id'))).pipe(
      catchError((err) => {
        this.router.navigateByUrl('../');
        return err;
      })
    ) as Observable<AlertGetModel>;
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormControl, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import {
  AlertDataType,
  AlertGetModel,
  AlertModel,
  AlertOperator,
  AlertsService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';

export class ConfigDefinition {
  id?: number;
  label?: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-alert-form',
  templateUrl: './alert-form.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./alert-form.component.scss'],
})
export class AlertFormComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  operators: Observable<any[]> | undefined;
  subscribedUsers: any[] = [];
  externalEmailAddresses: any[] = [];
  pageMode: PageMode;
  PageMode = PageMode;
  isEdit = true;
  initialiedDone = false;
  hierarchiaInstantLoad = false;

  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.BACK];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    private location: Location,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private apiService: AlertsService,
    private usersService: UsersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.pageMode = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode;
    this.isEdit = this.pageMode !== PageMode.VIEW;

    //this.form = this.formBuilder.group(AlertRequestForm.get());
    //MOC
    this.form = new FormGroup({
      id: new FormControl(null),
      //Hierarchia//
      institution: new FormControl(null, [Validators.required]),
      site: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }, [Validators.required]),
      building: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      buildingPart: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      floor: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      room: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      measureEndpoint: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }, [Validators.required]),
      measurementType: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }, [Validators.required]),
      measuredProperty: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }, [Validators.required]),
      //Mérési pont + Mért jellemző alapján kérjük le
      channelIdentifier: new FormControl(null, [Validators.required]),
      //////////////
      operator: new FormControl(null, [Validators.required]),
      dataType: new FormControl(AlertDataType.Consumption, [Validators.required]),
      threshold: new FormControl(null, [Validators.required]),
      name: new FormControl(null, [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(8)]),
      description: new FormControl(null, [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(8)]),
      alertText: new FormControl(null, [Validators.required]),
      validFromUtc: new FormControl(null, [Validators.required]),
      validToUtc: new FormControl(null),
      subscribedUsers: new FormControl(null, [Validators.required]),
      externalEmailAddresses: new FormControl(null),
      //Generált adat
      alertIdentifier: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      //Generált adat
      modifiedBy: new FormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
      isActive: new FormControl(false),
    });
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
    let title: string;
    if (this.isCreate) {
      title = 'Riasztás létrehozása';
    } else {
      if (this.isReadonly) {
        title = 'Riasztás megtekintése';
      } else {
        title = 'Riasztás szerkesztése';
      }
    }

    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem(title, this.rootPath!)];
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    this.loadSubscribedUsers();

    //TODO, ha a generátort rendbe tettük, majd onnan jönnek ezek az értékek
    this.operators = of([
      {
        id: AlertOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual,
        entityDisplayName: 'Nagyobb vagy egyenlő',
      },
      {
        id: AlertOperator.LessThanOrEqual,
        entityDisplayName: 'Kissebb vagy egyenlő',
      },
    ]);

    const item = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data['alert'] as AlertGetModel | undefined;

    if (item) {
      this.form.patchValue(item);

      if (this.isCreate) {
        this.form.get('id')?.setValue(null);
        this.hierarchiaInstantLoad = true;
      }

      if (item.institutionId)
        this.form.get('institution')?.setValue({
          id: item.institutionId,
          entityDisplayName: item.institutionName,
        });
      if (item.siteId)
        this.form.get('site')?.setValue({
          id: item.siteId,
          entityDisplayName: item.siteName,
        });
      if (item.buildingId)
        this.form.get('building')?.setValue({
          id: item.buildingId,
          entityDisplayName: item.buildingName,
        });
      if (item.buildingPartId)
        this.form.get('buildingPart')?.setValue({
          id: item.buildingPartId,
          entityDisplayName: item.buildingPartName,
        });
      if (item.floorId)
        this.form.get('floor')?.setValue({
          id: item.floorId,
          entityDisplayName: item.floorName,
        });
      if (item.roomId)
        this.form.get('room')?.setValue({
          id: item.roomId,
          entityDisplayName: item.roomName,
        });
      if (item.measurementPointId)
        this.form.get('measureEndpoint')?.setValue({
          id: item.measurementPointId,
          entityDisplayName: item.measurementPointName,
        });
      if (item.measuredPropertyId)
        this.form.get('measuredProperty')?.setValue({
          id: item.measuredPropertyId,
          entityDisplayName: item.measuredPropertyName,
        });

      this.externalEmailAddresses = item.externalEmailAddresses ?? [];
    }

    if (this.isReadonly) {
      this.form.disable();
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    if (this.isCreate) {
      return this.apiService.alertsPost(this.form.getRawValue());
    } else {
      return this.apiService.alertsPut(this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params['id']!, this.form.getRawValue());
    }
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/monitoring/alert']);
  }

  navigateToEdit() {
    this.router.navigate([`../edit`], { relativeTo: this.activatedRoute });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.location.back();
  }

  private loadSubscribedUsers(): void {
    this.usersService.usersGetAllEntityRef().subscribe((users) => {
      this.subscribedUsers = users;
    });
  }
}
