import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import {
  SortDirection as DTSortDirection,
  IDataTableRequest,
  SortDirection,
} from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { MatDatatableComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable.component';
import { AlertsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-alert-list',
  templateUrl: './alert-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./alert-list.component.scss'],
})
export class AlertListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true })
  protected dataDataTable: MatDatatableComponent | undefined;

  private subs = new Subscription();

  searchForm = this.fb.group({
    alertIdentifier: [],
    isActive: [],
    modifierUserEmail: [],
    name: [],
    measurementPointName: [],
    dataPointName: [],
  });

  statuses = [
    {
      value: true,
      text: 'Aktív',
    },
    {
      value: false,
      text: 'Inaktív',
    },
  ];

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'alertIdentifier',
      displayName: 'Riasztás azonosító',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'isActive',
      displayName: 'Riasztás státusza',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'name',
      displayName: 'Riasztás megnevezése',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'measurementPointName',
      displayName: 'Almérési pont',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'modifierUserEmail',
      displayName: 'Módosította',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private apiService: AlertsService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    this.rootPath = 'Alert';
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.dataDataTable!.dataTableRequest.sortColumn = 'alertIdentifier';
    this.dataDataTable!.dataTableRequest.sortDirection = SortDirection.Descending;
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  createNew() {
    let selectedId = this.dataDataTable?.selection?.selected.length && this.dataDataTable?.selection?.selected[0].id;

    if (selectedId) {
      this.router.navigate([`./${selectedId}/create`], {
        relativeTo: this.route,
      });
    } else {
      this.router.navigate([`./create`], { relativeTo: this.route });
    }
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`./${element.id}/view`], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`./${element.id}/edit`], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.name}' riasztást?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.apiService.alertsDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => {
            this.dataDataTable?.refreshEvent();
          });
        }
      },
    );
  }

  statusChange(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(
      this.dialog,
      `Biztosan ${!element.isActive ? 'aktiválni' : 'inaktiválni'} kívánja a '${element.name}'-t?`,
    ).subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.apiService.alertsAlertActivateDeactivate(element.id, !element.isActive).subscribe(() => {
          element.isActive = !element.isActive;
        });
      }
    });
  }

  getItems(params: IDataTableRequest) {
    let apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      params.sortDirection == DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    return this.apiService.alertsGetAlertsList(
      "",
      "",
      "",
      "",
      "",
      "",
      this.searchForm.get('measurementPointName')!.value,
      this.searchForm.get('dataPointName')!.value,
      this.searchForm.get('alertIdentifier')!.value,
      this.searchForm.get('isActive')!.value,
      this.searchForm.get('name')!.value,
      this.searchForm.get('modifierUserEmail')!.value,
      params.pageIndex,
      params.pageSize,
      params.sortColumn,
      apiSortDirection,
      false,
    );
  }

  get secOpCreate(): string {
    return 'AlertCreate';
  }
  get secOpRead(): string {
    return 'AlertRead';
  }
  get secOpModify(): string {
    return 'AlertModify';
  }
  get secOpDelete(): string {
    return 'AlertDelete';
  }
}

  private siteSetup() {
    let idx = -1;
    if (this.identifier) {
      idx = this.sites.findIndex((x) => x.identifier == this.identifier);
    } else {
      idx = -1;
    }
    this.onTabChanged(idx);
    let thisSiteRef: SiteEntityDtoGuidEntityRef | undefined;

    console.log(this.identifier);
    if (this.siteRefs) {
      if (!this.identifier) this.identifier = this.siteRefs[0].identifier;
      thisSiteRef = this.siteRefs.find((x) => x.identifier == this.identifier);
      this.fc.site.setValue(thisSiteRef);
      this.chartTitle = thisSiteRef?.entityDisplayName;
    } else {
      this.sitesService.sitesGetSitesGuidEntityRef().subscribe((siteRefs) => {
        if (!this.identifier) this.identifier = this.siteRefs![0].identifier;
        this.siteRefs = siteRefs;
        thisSiteRef = this.siteRefs.find((x) => x.identifier == this.identifier);
        this.fc.site.setValue(thisSiteRef);
        this.chartTitle = thisSiteRef!.entityDisplayName;
      });
    }
  }

  siteChangedReload(sid: string) {
    this.identifier = sid;
    this.deviceGuidIdentifiers = [];
    this.deviceGuidIdentifiersBySite = [];
    //this.allItems = [];
    this.siteSetup();
  }

  onTabChanged(tabIdx: number) {
    if (this.sites) {
      //this.siteName = this.sites[tabIdx]?.name ?? '';
      this.showDataTable = false;
      if (tabIdx >= 0) {
        this.deviceGuidIdentifiers = [];
        this.deviceGuidIdentifiersBySite = [];
        this.deviceGuidIdentifiers.push(this.sites[tabIdx]!.identifier!);
        this.deviceGuidIdentifiersBySite.push(this.sites[tabIdx]!.identifier!);
        this.aggregation = this.chartFilterModel?.aggregation ?? AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes;
        this.showDataTable = true;
        this.getItems();
        this.setOptions(defaultChartOptions);
      } else {
        this.deviceGuidIdentifiers = [];
        this.deviceGuidIdentifiersBySite = [];
        this.aggregation = this.chartFilterModel?.aggregation ?? AggregationLevel.OneHour;
        this.showDataTable = true;
        this.getItems();
        this.setOptions(defaultChartOptions);
      }
    }
  }

  private getAggregationNumber(aggregation: string) {
    if (aggregation == 'FiveMinutes') return 60 / 5;
    else if (aggregation == 'FifteenMinutes') return 60 / 15;
    else if (aggregation == 'OneHour') return 1;
    else if (aggregation == 'OneDay') return 1 / 24;

    return null;
  }

  private GetColumnNameWithUnit(columnName: string): string {
    if (this.columns) {
      const column = this.columns.find((c) => c.columnName == columnName);
      return column?.displayName + ' (' + (column?.parameters as any)?.postFix + ')';
    }
    return columnName;
  }

  createBlobImageFile() {
    const blob = this.dataURItoBlob();
    const imageFile = new File([blob], 'chart', {
      type: 'image/png',
    });
    return imageFile;
  }

  dataURItoBlob() {
    const byteCharacters = atob(this.echartsDiagram.downloadImgSrc.replace(/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|jpg);base64,/, ''));
    const byteNumbers = new Array(byteCharacters.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < byteCharacters.length; i++) {
      byteNumbers[i] = byteCharacters.charCodeAt(i);
    }

    const byteArray = new Uint8Array(byteNumbers);
    const blob = new Blob([byteArray], {
      type: undefined,
    });
    return blob;
  }

  /**

    //   .subscribe((data: ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {

    //     this.dataDataTable?.refresh();
    //   });
  }

  /**
   * A diagram hely szintű (telephely/mérési hely/eszköz/mérési végpont) szűrése.
   * Jelenleg a végpont az diagramértékek megjelenítéséhez egy device identifier listát vár bemenő
   * adatként. Ezt a listát állítjuk elő, illetve a diagram title szövegét a dropdown
   * választások szerint. Végül a diagram újrarajzolását kérjük.
   */
  setChartTitle() {
    const siteDisplayName = (this.fc.site.value as SiteEntityDtoGuidEntityRef)?.entityDisplayName;
    const siteLocationDisplayName = (this.fc.siteLocation.value as SiteLocationEntityDtoGuidEntityRef)
      ?.entityDisplayName;
    const deviceDisplayName = (this.fc.ioTDevice.value as DeviceModelGuidEntityRef)?.entityDisplayName;
    const measureEndpointDisplayName = (this.fc.measureEndpoint.value as MeasuredEndpointEntityDtoGuidEntityRef)
      ?.entityDisplayName;

    if (measureEndpointDisplayName) {
      this.chartTitle =
        siteDisplayName +
        ' | ' +
        siteLocationDisplayName +
        ' | ' +
        deviceDisplayName +
        ' | ' +
        measureEndpointDisplayName;
      // Az iot adatok device szinten jönnek vissza, hiába szűrűnk measurement endpointra.
      this.deviceGuidIdentifiers = [];
      this.deviceGuidIdentifiers.push(
        (this.fc.measureEndpoint.value as MeasuredEndpointEntityDtoGuidEntityRef).identifier!,
      );
      this.spatialAggregation = SpatialAggregationLevel.MeasuredEndpoint;
    } else if (deviceDisplayName) {
      this.chartTitle = siteDisplayName + ' | ' + siteLocationDisplayName + ' | ' + deviceDisplayName;
      this.deviceGuidIdentifiers = [];
      this.deviceGuidIdentifiers.push((this.fc.ioTDevice.value as DeviceModelGuidEntityRef).identifier!);
      this.spatialAggregation = SpatialAggregationLevel.Device;
    } else if (siteLocationDisplayName) {
      this.chartTitle = siteDisplayName + ' | ' + siteLocationDisplayName;
      this.deviceGuidIdentifiers = [];
      const siteLocIdentifier = (this.fc.siteLocation.value as SiteLocationEntityDtoGuidEntityRef).identifier;
      this.deviceGuidIdentifiers.push(siteLocIdentifier!);
      this.spatialAggregation = SpatialAggregationLevel.SiteLocation;
    } else if (siteDisplayName) {
      this.chartTitle = siteDisplayName;
      this.deviceGuidIdentifiers = [];
      const siteIdentifier = (this.fc.site.value as SiteEntityDtoGuidEntityRef).identifier;
      this.deviceGuidIdentifiers.push(siteIdentifier!);
      this.spatialAggregation = SpatialAggregationLevel.Site;
    } else {
      this.chartTitle = 'Szervezet-szintű értékek';
      this.deviceGuidIdentifiers = [];
      this.spatialAggregation = SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant;
    }
  }

  private addLocationControls() {
    this.locationSelectionForm.addControl('site', new UntypedFormControl(null));
    this.locationSelectionForm.addControl('siteLocation', new UntypedFormControl(null));
    this.locationSelectionForm.addControl('ioTDevice', new UntypedFormControl(null));
    this.locationSelectionForm.addControl('measureEndpoint', new UntypedFormControl(null));
  }

  /**
   * FormControl lekérdezése a hely-szintű dropdownok kezeléséhez.
   */
  get fc() {
    return this.locationSelectionForm.controls;
  }

  private getSiteRefs(): void {
    if (!this.siteRefs) {
      this.sitesService.sitesGetSitesGuidEntityRef().subscribe((siteRefs) => {
        this.siteRefs = siteRefs;
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Mérési helyek lekérdezése adott telephely alapján
   */
  private getSiteLocations(selectedSite: SiteEntityDtoGuidEntityRef) {
    this.sitesService
      .sitesGetSiteLocationsGuidEntityRefBySiteIdentifier(selectedSite.identifier!)
      .subscribe((siteLocationRefs) => {
        this.siteLocationRefs = siteLocationRefs;
      });
  }

  /**
   * Eszközök lekérdezése adott mérési hely alapján
   */
  private getIoTDevice(selectedSiteLocation: SiteLocationEntityDtoGuidEntityRef) {
    // Napelemes (energiatermelő) eszközökre nem lehetett szűrni.
    this.deviceService
      .devicesDeviceGuidEntityRefsBySiteLocationIdentifier(selectedSiteLocation.identifier!)
      .subscribe((iotDeviceRefs) => {
        this.iotDeviceRefs = iotDeviceRefs;
      });
  }

  /**
   * Mérési végpontok lekérdezése adott eszköz alapján
   */
  private getMeasureEndpoints(selectedDevice: DeviceModelGuidEntityRef) {
    this.deviceService
      .devicesGetChannelGuidRefsByDeviceIdentifier(selectedDevice.identifier!)
      .subscribe((measureEndpointRefs) => {
        this.measureEndpointRefs = measureEndpointRefs.map((x) => x.measuredEndpointGuidRefs as any);
        this.chartFilterModel!.iOtDeviceCode = measureEndpointRefs[0].iotDeviceTypeCode!;
      });
  }

  /**
   * Hely-szintű dropdown-ok állítgatásának eseményei
   */

  private subscribeToValueChanges() {
    this.fc.site.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      // Telephelyváltozás!
      if (value) {
        this.getSiteLocations(value);
      } else {
        this.siteLocationRefs = [];
      }
      this.fc.siteLocation.patchValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.ioTDevice.patchValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.measureEndpoint.patchValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.setChartTitle();
    });

    this.fc.siteLocation.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      // Mérési hely változás!
      if (value) {
        this.getIoTDevice(value);
      }
      this.fc.ioTDevice.patchValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.fc.measureEndpoint.patchValue(null, { emitEvent: false });

      this.setChartTitle();
    });

    this.fc.ioTDevice.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      // IoT eszköz változás!
      if (value) {
        this.getMeasureEndpoints(value);
      } else {
        // IoT eszköz kiválasztás törölve => fallback-eljünk a "szülő" Mérési helyhez tartozó idősoros adatokra!
        const parentSiteLocation = this.fc.siteLocation.value as SiteLocationEntityDtoGuidEntityRef;
        if (parentSiteLocation?.identifier) {
          this.getIoTDevice(parentSiteLocation);
        }
      }
      this.fc.measureEndpoint.patchValue(null, { emitEvent: false });
      this.setChartTitle();
    });

    this.fc.measureEndpoint.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      // Mérési pont változás!
      if (value) {
        this.measureEndpointRefs = [];
        this.measureEndpointRefs.push(value);
      } else {
        // Mérési pont kiválasztás törölve => fallback-eljünk a "szülő" IoT eszközhöz tartozó idősoros adatokra!
        const parentIoTDevice = this.fc.ioTDevice.value as DeviceModelGuidEntityRef;
        if (parentIoTDevice?.identifier) {
          this.getMeasureEndpoints(parentIoTDevice);
        }
      }
      this.setChartTitle();
    });
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, ViewChild, OnInit, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import {
  MeasurementPointsService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import {
  ChartModel,
  ChartTableModel,
  ConsumptionChartRequest,
  ConsumptionService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';
import {
  IDataTableRequest,
} from '../../../core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { catchError, map, Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { ExportsService } from 'src/app/core/services/exports-api.service';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { ChartTableUtilsService } from 'src/app/core/services/chart-table-utils.service';
import { MonitoringBaseComponent } from 'src/app/core/base/monitoring-base';
import { HttpEvent, HttpResponse } from '@angular/common/http';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-main-measurement',
  templateUrl: './main-measurement.component.html',
  styleUrl: './main-measurement.component.scss',
})
export class MainMeasurementComponent extends MonitoringBaseComponent implements OnInit {
  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    matDialog: MatDialog,
    consumptionService: ConsumptionService,
    exportsService: ExportsService,
    measurementPointsService: MeasurementPointsService,
    chartTableUtilsService: ChartTableUtilsService,
  ) {
    super(
      router,
      injector,
      elRef,
      loaderService,
      breadcrumbService,
      matDialog,
      consumptionService,
      exportsService,
      measurementPointsService,
      chartTableUtilsService,
    );

    this.rootPath = 'monitoring/main-measurement';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.isBilling = true;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
  }

  /**
   * Diagram frissítése
   */
  onRefreshDiagram() {
    if (this.echartsDiagram) {
      const currentModel = this.echartsDiagram['model'];
      if (currentModel) {
        this.echartsDiagram.processModel({ model: currentModel });
      }
    }
    
    if (this.dataTable) {
      this.dataTable.dataTableRequest.pageIndex = 0;
      this.dataTable.refreshEvent();
    }
  }
  onGetDatas() {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid) {
      return;
    }
    this.dataLoaded = true;

    this.getDiagramItems();
    if (this.dataTable) {
      this.dataTable.dataTableRequest.pageIndex = 0;
      this.dataTable.refreshEvent();
    }
    this.getMapCoorinates();
  }

  public getDiagramItems() {
    this.showLoader();
    const request = this.buildMonitoringRequest();
    this.consumptionService.getMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionDiagramData(request).subscribe({
      next: (chartModel: ChartModel) => {
        this.hideLoader();
        this.echartsDiagram.processModel({ model: chartModel });
      },
      error: () => {
        this.hideLoader();
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Datatable értékek lekérdezése, datatable szűrések
   */
  getItems(params: IDataTableRequest) {
    const request = this.buildMonitoringRequest({pageIndex: params.pageIndex, pageSize: params.pageSize});

    // Make the API call to get chart table data
    return this.consumptionService.getMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableData(request).pipe(
      map((response: ChartTableModel) => {
        if (response && response.items && response.items.length > 0) {
          this.columns = this.chartTableUtilsService.createColumnDefinitions(response.items[0]);
        }

        // Transform the API response data into table rows
        //const rows = this.transformChartTableToRows(response);
        const rows = this.chartTableUtilsService.transformChartTableToRows(response.items);

        // Create and return the expected IDataTableResponse format
        return {
          items: rows,
          recordsTotal: response.recordsTotal, // Use actual count from API if available
        };
      }),
      catchError((error) => {
        console.error('Error fetching data table:', error);
        // Return an empty response on error
        return of({
          items: [],
          recordsTotal: 0,
        });
      }),
    );
  }

  protected performExport(request: ConsumptionChartRequest): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    return this.exportsService.getMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataExcelExport(request);
  }
  /**
   * Implementation of abstract performPdfExport method for MainMeasurementComponent
   * Calls the main meter API endpoint for PDF export
   * @param request The monitoring request parameters
   * @returns Observable with the PDF data as Blob
   */
  protected performPdfExport(request: ConsumptionChartRequest, imageForPdf?: File): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    return this.exportsService.getMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataPdfExport(request, imageForPdf);
  }

  /**
   * Get timestamp format based on selected aggregation level
   * @returns Date format string for timestamp display
   */
  getTimestampFormat(): string {
    const aggregation = this.form.get('aggregation')?.value;
    if (aggregation && (aggregation.code === 'FiveMinutes' || aggregation.code === 'FifteenMinutes' || aggregation.code === 'OneHour')) {
      return 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss';
    }
    return 'yyyy-MM-dd';
  }

}

import { Component, Injector, OnDestroy, OnInit, AfterViewInit } from '@angular/core';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { openNotificationDetailDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/notification-detail-dialog/notification-detail-dialog.component';
import { NotificationService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/notification.service';
import { NotificationModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/notificationModel';
import { WorkerStore } from 'src/app/core/worker-data-store/worker-store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-notification',
  templateUrl: 'notification.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['notification.component.scss'],
})
export class NotificationComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, AfterViewInit {
  notifications: NotificationModel[] = [];
  private dialog: MatDialog;

  constructor(
    private notificationService: NotificationService,
    private injector: Injector,
    private workerStore: WorkerStore,
  ) {
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
    this.getNotifications();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getNotifications();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
  }

  ngAfterViewInit() {
    this.workerStore.execChange.subscribe((value) => {
      this.notifications = value;
    });
  }

  readNotification(notification: NotificationModel) {
    openNotificationDetailDialog(this.dialog, notification.description!, notification.title!).subscribe(() => {
      if (!notification.isRead) {
        this.notificationService
          .notificationSetNotificationRead(notification.id!)
          .subscribe(() => this.getNotifications());
        this.workerStore.notificationChange(this.notifications);
      }
    });
  }

  getNotifications() {
    this.notificationService.notificationsGetNotifications().subscribe((value) => {
      this.notifications = value;
    });
  }

  openDialog() {}
}

import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';

  ChartModel,
  ChartTableModel,
  ConsumptionChartRequest,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/model/models';

  MeasurementPointsService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-overview',
  templateUrl: './monitoring-overview.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./monitoring-overview.component.scss'],
  providers: [DatePipe],
})
export class MonitoringOverviewComponent extends MonitoringBaseComponent implements OnInit {
  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,

  ) {
    super(
      router,

      elRef,
      loaderService,
      breadcrumbService,
      matDialog,
      consumptionService,
      exportsService,
      measurementPointsService,

    );

    this.rootPath = 'monitoring/main-measurement';

    this.isBilling = false;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
  }

  /**
   * Diagram frissítése
   */
  onRefreshDiagram() {
    if (this.echartsDiagram) {
      const currentModel = this.echartsDiagram['model'];
      if (currentModel) {
        this.echartsDiagram.processModel({ model: currentModel });
      }
    }
    
    if (this.dataTable) {
      this.dataTable.dataTableRequest.pageIndex = 0;
      this.dataTable.refreshEvent();
    }
  }
  onGetDatas() {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid) {
      return;
    }
    this.dataLoaded = true;

    this.getDiagramItems();
    if (this.dataTable) {
      this.dataTable.dataTableRequest.pageIndex = 0;
      this.dataTable.refreshEvent();
    }

    this.getMapCoorinates();
  }

  public getDiagramItems() {

    this.consumptionService.getSubMeterAggregatedConsumptionDiagramData(request).subscribe({
      next: (chartModel: ChartModel) => {
        this.hideLoader();
        this.echartsDiagram.processModel({ model: chartModel });
      },
      error: () => {
        this.hideLoader();
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Datatable értékek lekérdezése, datatable szűrések
   */
  getItems(params: IDataTableRequest) {
    const request = this.buildMonitoringRequest({pageIndex: params.pageIndex, pageSize: params.pageSize});

    // Make the API call to get chart table data
    return this.consumptionService.getSubMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableData(request).pipe(
      map((response: ChartTableModel) => {
        if (response && response.items && response.items.length > 0) {
          this.columns = this.chartTableUtilsService.createColumnDefinitions(response.items[0]);
        }

        // Transform the API response data into table rows
        //const rows = this.transformChartTableToRows(response);
        const rows = this.chartTableUtilsService.transformChartTableToRows(response.items);

        // Create and return the expected IDataTableResponse format
        return {
          items: rows,
          recordsTotal: response.recordsTotal, // Use actual count from API if available
        };
      }),
      catchError((error) => {
        console.error('Error fetching data table:', error);
        // Return an empty response on error
        return of({
          items: [],
          recordsTotal: 0,
        });
      }),
    );
  }

  protected performExport(request: ConsumptionChartRequest): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    return this.exportsService.getSubMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataExcelExport(request);
  }
  /**
   * Implementation of abstract performPdfExport method for MainMeasurementComponent
   * Calls the main meter API endpoint for PDF export
   * @param request The monitoring request parameters
   * @returns Observable with the PDF data as Blob
   */
  protected performPdfExport(request: ConsumptionChartRequest, imageForPdf?: File): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
    return this.exportsService.getSubMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataPdfExport(request, imageForPdf);
  }

  /**
   * Get timestamp format based on selected aggregation level
   * @returns Date format string for timestamp display
   */
  getTimestampFormat(): string {
    const aggregation = this.form.get('aggregation')?.value;
    if (aggregation && (aggregation.code === 'FiveMinutes' || aggregation.code === 'FifteenMinutes' || aggregation.code === 'OneHour')) {
      return 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss';
    }
    return 'yyyy-MM-dd';
  }

}

import { AggregationLevel, ChartModel, ConsumptionService, ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest, ResidualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequest } from "src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring";

import { BreadcrumbService } from "src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service";
import { LoaderService } from "src/app/core/services/loader.service";
import { DateValidator } from "src/app/core/services/validators/date.validator";

@Component({
    selector: 'app-residual-consumption',
    templateUrl: './residual-consumption.component.html',
    styleUrls: ['./residual-consumption.component.scss'],
})
/**
 * Maradékfogyasztás
 */
export class ResidualConsumptionComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
    @ViewChild(EchartsDiagramComponent, { static: true }) protected echartsDiagram!: EchartsDiagramComponent;
    yesterday = new Date(moment(new Date().setDate(new Date().getDate() - 1)).format('YYYY-MM-DD'));
    // Az EChart-on megjelenítésre kerülő szúrők, és a szűrőkben alapértelmezetten betöltődő értékek beállítása:
    filterVisibilities = { period: true, from: true, to: true, aggregation: true, valueType: false };
    filterDefaultValues = {
        period: 'today',
        from: this.yesterday,
        to: this.yesterday,
        aggregation: 'FifteenMinutes',
        valueType: ['relativeConsumption', 'energyProduced'],
    };
    excludedAggregationTypesSubject = new BehaviorSubject<AggregationLevel[]>([]);

    residualChartDataTableRequest!: ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest;
    residualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequest!: ResidualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequest;
    residualConsumptionListExportDataTableRequest!: ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest;

    refreshSubject = new Subject<boolean>();
    refreshSummarySubject = new Subject<boolean>();
    refreshChartSubject = new Subject<boolean>();
    isSearched = false;

    chartFilterForm = new FormGroup({
        period: new FormControl(),
        aggregation: new FormControl(),
        from: new FormControl(),
        to: new FormControl(),
        valueType: new FormControl(),
    });

    locationSelectionForm: UntypedFormGroup = new UntypedFormGroup({
        institution: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null }, Validators.required),
        site: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }, Validators.required),
        building: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
        buildingPart: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
        floor: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
        room: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }),
        measureEndpoint: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }, Validators.required),
        latitude: new UntypedFormControl(null),
        longitude: new UntypedFormControl(null),
        measuredData: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null }),
        measuredProperty: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }, Validators.required),
        channelIdentifier: new UntypedFormControl(null)
    });


    dateValidatorsRecords: Record<string, ValidatorFn[]> = {
        from: [DateValidator.maxDateValidator(this.yesterday)],
        to: [DateValidator.maxDateValidator(this.yesterday)],
    }
    errors: any;

    constructor(
        router: Router,
        injector: Injector,
        elRef: ElementRef,
        loaderService: LoaderService,
        breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
        private apiService: MeasurementPointsService,
        private consumptionService: ConsumptionService
    ) {
        super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

        this.rootPath = 'monitoring/residual-consumption';
        this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    }

    ngOnInit(): void {
        super.ngOnInit();
    }

    updateAggregationTypesSubject(data: AggregationLevel[]) {
        this.excludedAggregationTypesSubject.next(data);
    }

    search() {
        this.chartFilterForm.updateValueAndValidity();
        this.locationSelectionForm.updateValueAndValidity();

        this.chartFilterForm.markAllAsTouched();
        this.locationSelectionForm.markAllAsTouched();

        if (this.chartFilterForm.valid && this.locationSelectionForm.valid) {
            this.isSearched = true;
            this.errors = null;
            this.refreshSubject.next(true);
        }
    }


    getDiagramItems(measureEndpointIdentifier?: string, subMeasurementPointIdentifiers?: string[] | undefined) {
        this.showLoader();

        this.consumptionService.getResidualConsumptionDiagram(
            moment(this.chartFilterForm.get('from')?.value).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
            moment(this.chartFilterForm.get('to')?.value).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
            this.chartFilterForm.get('aggregation')?.value?.code,
            measureEndpointIdentifier ?? '',
            subMeasurementPointIdentifiers ?? [],
            this.locationSelectionForm.get('measuredProperty')?.value?.id
        ).subscribe({
            next: (chartModel: ChartModel) => {
                this.hideLoader();
                this.echartsDiagram.processModel({ model: chartModel });
            },
            error: () => {
                this.hideLoader();
            },
        });
    }

    dataTableResposeEvent(event: any[]) {
        this.apiService.measurementPointsGet(this.locationSelectionForm.get('measureEndpoint')?.value?.id).subscribe((measureEndpointRes) => {
            const apis = event.map(x => { return this.apiService.measurementPointsGet(x.id) });

            forkJoin(apis).subscribe(apiResponses => {
                const identifiers = apiResponses?.map(x => { return x.identifier });
                const filteredSubMeasurementPointIdentifiers: string[] | undefined = identifiers
                    ? identifiers.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === 'string')
                    : undefined;

                this.getDiagramItems(measureEndpointRes.identifier, filteredSubMeasurementPointIdentifiers);


                //DataTable requestek összepakolása
                this.residualChartDataTableRequest = {
                    from: moment(this.chartFilterForm.get('from')?.value).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    to: moment(this.chartFilterForm.get('to')?.value).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    aggregation: this.chartFilterForm.get('aggregation')?.value?.code,
                    measurementPointIdentifier: measureEndpointRes.identifier,
                    subMeasurementPointIdentifiers: filteredSubMeasurementPointIdentifiers,
                    measuredPropertyId: this.locationSelectionForm.get('measuredProperty')?.value?.id
                } as ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest;

                this.residualConsumptionListExportDataTableRequest = {
                    from: moment(this.chartFilterForm.get('from')?.value).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    to: moment(this.chartFilterForm.get('to')?.value).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    aggregation: this.chartFilterForm.get('aggregation')?.value?.code,
                    measurementPointIdentifier: measureEndpointRes.identifier,
                    subMeasurementPointIdentifiers: filteredSubMeasurementPointIdentifiers,
                    measuredPropertyId: this.locationSelectionForm.get('measuredProperty')?.value?.id,
                    isDeleted: false,
                } as ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest;

                this.residualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequest = {
                    from: moment(this.chartFilterForm.controls?.from?.value).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    to: moment(this.chartFilterForm.controls?.to?.value).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    aggregation: this.chartFilterForm.get('aggregation')?.value?.code,
                    measurementPointIdentifier: measureEndpointRes.identifier,
                    subMeasurementPointIdentifiers: filteredSubMeasurementPointIdentifiers,
                    measuredPropertyId: this.locationSelectionForm.get('measuredProperty')?.value?.id,
                } as ResidualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequest;

                this.refreshChartSubject.next(true);
                this.refreshSummarySubject.next(true);
            });
        });
    }

    dataTableErrorResposeEvent(error: any) {
        this.errors = deepMerge(error, this.errors);
        ErrorHelper.serverErrorHandler(error, this.chartFilterForm, error => {});
    }
}

import { AfterViewChecked, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, OnDestroy, OnInit, Output, ViewChild } from "@angular/core";
import { MatDialog } from "@angular/material/dialog";
import { Router } from "@angular/router";
import { catchError, map, Observable, of, Subject, Subscription } from "rxjs";
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from "src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition";
import { ChartTableItemModel, ChartTableModel, ConsumptionChartRequest, ConsumptionService, ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest } from "src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring";
import { IDataTableRequest, SortDirection as DTSortDirection } from "src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request";
import { SortDirection as EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection } from '../../../../core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { MatDatatableComponent } from "src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable.component";
import { MonitoringBaseComponent } from "src/app/core/base/monitoring-base";
import { HttpResponse, HttpEvent } from "@angular/common/http";
import { LoaderService } from "src/app/core/services/loader.service";
import { BreadcrumbService } from "src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service";
import { ExportsService } from "src/app/core/services/exports-api.service";
import { MeasurementPointsService } from "src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi";
import { ChartTableUtilsService } from "src/app/core/services/chart-table-utils.service";

@Component({
    selector: 'app-residual-consumption-chart-list',
    templateUrl: './residual-consumption-chart-list.component.html',
    styleUrls: ['./residual-consumption-chart-list.component.scss'],
})
/**
 * Maradékfogyasztás lista
 */
export class ResidualConsumptionChartListComponent extends MonitoringBaseComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, AfterViewChecked {

    @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: false }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableComponent;
    @Input() dataTableRequest!: ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest;
    @Input() refreshSubject!: Subject<boolean>;

    @Output() dataTableErrorResposeEvent = new EventEmitter();

    protected dialog: MatDialog;

    columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
        {
            columnName: 'institutionName',
            displayName: 'Intézmény neve',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
    ];

    private subs = new Subscription();

    exportFileName = 'maradek-fogyasztas-adatok';

    constructor(
        injector: Injector,
        router: Router,
        apiService: ConsumptionService,
        private changeDetectorRef: ChangeDetectorRef,
        elRef: ElementRef,
        loaderService: LoaderService,
        breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
        matDialog: MatDialog,
        exportsService: ExportsService,
        measurementPointsService: MeasurementPointsService,
        chartTableUtilsService: ChartTableUtilsService,
    ) {
        super(
            router,
            injector,
            elRef,
            loaderService,
            breadcrumbService,
            matDialog,
            apiService,
            exportsService,
            measurementPointsService,
            chartTableUtilsService,
        );
        this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
    }


    ngOnInit(): void {
        this.refreshSubject.subscribe(() => {
            this.dataDataTable.dataTableRequest.pageIndex = 0;
            this.dataDataTable.dataTableRequest.pageSize = 10;
            
            this.dataDataTable.refreshEvent();
        })
    }

    ngOnDestroy() {
        this.dialog.closeAll();
        this.subs?.unsubscribe();
    }

    ngAfterViewChecked(): void {
        this.changeDetectorRef.detectChanges();
    }

    loadingCursor(isLoading = true): void {
        const docStyle = document.documentElement.style;
        if (isLoading) {
            docStyle.setProperty('cursor', 'wait');
        } else {
            docStyle.setProperty('cursor', '');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Datatable értékek lekérdezése, datatable szűrések
     */
    getItems(params: IDataTableRequest) {
        const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
            params.sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
                ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
                : ApiSortDirection.Descending;


        this.dataTableRequest.startPage = params.pageIndex;
        this.dataTableRequest.pageSize = params.pageSize;
        this.dataTableRequest.sortColumn = params.sortColumn;
        this.dataTableRequest.sortDirection = apiSortDirection;
        this.dataTableRequest.isDeleted = false;


        // Make the API call to get chart table data
        return this.consumptionService.getResidualConsumptionChartTableData(this.dataTableRequest).pipe(
            map((response: ChartTableModel) => {
                if (response && response.items && response.items.length > 0) {
                    this.columns = this.chartTableUtilsService.createColumnDefinitions(response.items[0]);
                    // Transform the API response data into table rows
                    //const rows = this.transformChartTableToRows(response);
                    const rows = this.chartTableUtilsService.transformChartTableToRows(response.items);

                    // Create and return the expected IDataTableResponse format
                    return {
                        items: rows,
                        recordsTotal: response.recordsTotal, // Use actual count from API if available
                    };
                } else {
                    return null;
                }
            }),
            catchError((error) => {
                console.error('Error fetching data table:', error);
                // Return an empty response on error
                return of({
                    items: [],
                    recordsTotal: 0,
                });
            }),
        );
    }

    protected performExport(request: ConsumptionChartRequest): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
        return this.exportsService.getMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataExcelExport(request);
    }
    /**
     * Implementation of abstract performPdfExport method for MainMeasurementComponent
     * Calls the main meter API endpoint for PDF export
     * @param request The monitoring request parameters
     * @returns Observable with the PDF data as Blob
     */
    protected performPdfExport(request: ConsumptionChartRequest, imageForPdf?: File): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
        return this.exportsService.getMainMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataPdfExport(request, imageForPdf);
    }
    
    onRefreshDiagram(): void {}

    getDiagramItems(): void {}
}

import { AfterViewChecked, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, OnDestroy, OnInit, Output, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Observable, Subject, Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection, IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { GetMeasurementChildrenDataTableRequest, MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult, MeasurementPointsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { ExportsService } from 'src/app/core/services/exports-api.service';
import saveAs from 'file-saver';
import { SortDirection as EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection } from '../../../../core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { EchartsDiagramComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/chart/echarts-diagram/echarts-diagram.component';
import { MatDatatableComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable.component';
import { ConsumptionChartRequest, ConsumptionService, ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';
import { MonitoringBaseComponent } from 'src/app/core/base/monitoring-base';
import { HttpResponse, HttpEvent } from '@angular/common/http';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { ChartTableUtilsService } from 'src/app/core/services/chart-table-utils.service';

@Component({
    selector: 'app-residual-consumption-list',
    templateUrl: './residual-consumption-list.component.html',
    styleUrls: ['./residual-consumption-list.component.scss'],
})
/**
 * Maradékfogyasztás almérők lista
 */
export class ResidualConsumptionListComponent extends MonitoringBaseComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, AfterViewChecked {
    onRefreshDiagram(): void {}
    getDiagramItems(): void {}

    @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: false }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableComponent;
    @Input() chartFilterForm!: UntypedFormGroup;
    @Input() locationSelectionForm!: UntypedFormGroup;
    @Input() echartsDiagram!: EchartsDiagramComponent;
    @Input() refreshSubject!: Subject<boolean>;
    @Input() exportDataTable!: ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest;

    @Output() dataTableResposeEvent = new EventEmitter();
    @Output() dataTableErrorResposeEvent = new EventEmitter();

    protected dialog: MatDialog;

    isLoading = false;

    pageIndex = 0;
    pageSize = 10;
    sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
    sortActive = '';
    items!: MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult;

    columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
        {
            columnName: 'institutionName',
            displayName: 'Intézmény',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'siteName',
            displayName: 'Telephely',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'buildingName',
            displayName: 'Épület',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'buildingPartName',
            displayName: 'Épületrész',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'floorName',
            displayName: 'Szint',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'roomName',
            displayName: 'Helyiség',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'measurementPointName',
            displayName: 'Mérési pont neve',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'identifier',
            displayName: 'Mérési pont azonosítója',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'measuredProperties',
            displayName: 'Mért jellemzők',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'measuredDataLabel',
            displayName: 'Technológia',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
    ];

    private subs = new Subscription();

    exportFileName = 'maradek-fogyasztas-adatok';

    constructor(
        protected injector: Injector,
        router: Router,
        elRef: ElementRef,
        private changeDetectorRef: ChangeDetectorRef,
        protected exportsService: ExportsService,
        protected loaderService: LoaderService,
        protected breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
        matDialog: MatDialog,
        protected consumptionService: ConsumptionService,
        protected measurementPointsService: MeasurementPointsService,
        protected chartTableUtilsService: ChartTableUtilsService
    ) {
        super(router, injector,elRef,loaderService,breadcrumbService,matDialog,consumptionService,exportsService,measurementPointsService,chartTableUtilsService);
        this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
    }

    ngOnInit(): void {
        this.refreshSubject.subscribe(() => {
            this.dataDataTable.dataTableRequest.pageIndex = 0;
            this.dataDataTable.dataTableRequest.pageSize = 10;

            this.dataDataTable.refreshEvent();
        })
    }

    ngOnDestroy() {
        this.dialog.closeAll();
        this.subs?.unsubscribe();
    }

    ngAfterViewChecked(): void {
        this.changeDetectorRef.detectChanges();
    }

    /**
     * Datatable értékek lekérdezése, datatable szűrések
     */
    getItems(params: IDataTableRequest) {
        const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
            params.sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
                ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
                : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

        const measurementPointId = this.locationSelectionForm.get('measureEndpoint')?.value?.id;
        const measuredPropertyId = this.locationSelectionForm.get('measuredProperty')?.value?.id;
        const measuredDataLabelId = this.locationSelectionForm.get('measuredData')?.value?.id;

        const body = {
                measuredPropertyId: measuredPropertyId,
                measuredDataLabelId: measuredDataLabelId,
                startPage: params.pageIndex,
                pageSize: params.pageSize,
                sortColumn: params.sortColumn,
                sortDirection: apiSortDirection,
                isDeleted: false
        } as GetMeasurementChildrenDataTableRequest;

        return this.measurementPointsService.measurementPointsGetChildren(
            measurementPointId,
            body
        );
    }

    loadingCursor(isLoading = true): void {
        const docStyle = document.documentElement.style;
        if (isLoading) {
            docStyle.setProperty('cursor', 'wait');
        } else {
            docStyle.setProperty('cursor', '');
        }
    }

    protected performExport(request: ConsumptionChartRequest): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
        const exportRequest = structuredClone(this.exportDataTable);
        exportRequest.pageSize = request.pageSize;
        exportRequest.startPage = request.pageIndex;

        return this.exportsService
            .getDsoDataTableExport(
                exportRequest
            )
    }
    protected performPdfExport(request: ConsumptionChartRequest, imageForPdf?: File): Observable<Blob | HttpResponse<Blob> | HttpEvent<Blob>> {
        const chartImg = this.exportsService.createBlobImageFile(this.echartsDiagram);
        const exportRequest = structuredClone(this.exportDataTable);
        exportRequest.pageSize = request.pageSize;
        exportRequest.startPage = request.pageIndex;

        return this.exportsService
            .getDsoDataTablePdfExport(
                exportRequest,    
                chartImg
            );
    }

    get getSortDirection() {
        const sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.dataTableRequest?.sortDirection ?? ApiSortDirection.Ascending;
        const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection = (sortDirection == DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending);
        return apiSortDirection;
    }
}

import { AfterViewChecked, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnDestroy, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Subject, Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { ConsumptionService, ResidualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring';


@Component({
    selector: 'app-residual-consumption-summary-list',
    templateUrl: './residual-consumption-summary-list.component.html',
    styleUrls: ['./residual-consumption-summary-list.component.scss'],
})
/**
 * Maradékfogyasztás almérők lista
 */
export class ResidualConsumptionSummaryListComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, AfterViewChecked {
    @Input() refreshSubject!: Subject<boolean>;
    @Input() dataTableRequest!: ResidualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequest;

    @Output() dataTableErrorResposeEvent = new EventEmitter();

    isLoading = false;

    pageIndex = 0;
    pageSize = 10;
    sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
    sortActive = '';
    items!: MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult;

    totalConsumptionSum = 0;
    totalConsumptionPercentage = 0;

    differenceConsumptionSum = 0;
    differenceConsumptionPercentage = 0;

    columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
        {
            columnName: 'meter',
            displayName: 'Név',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'site',
            displayName: 'Telephely',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'building',
            displayName: 'Épület',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'buildingPart',
            displayName: 'Épületrész',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'floor',
            displayName: 'Szint',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'room',
            displayName: 'Helyiség',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'identifier',
            displayName: 'Mérési pont azonosító',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'consumptionSum',
            displayName: 'Fogyasztás összesen, kWh',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
        {
            columnName: 'consumptionPercentage',
            displayName: '%',
            columnType: ColumnType.Text,
            sortable: true
        } as IColumnDefinition,
    ];

    private subs = new Subscription();

    dataTableData?: any;

    constructor(
        private apiService: ConsumptionService,
        private changeDetectorRef: ChangeDetectorRef,
    ) {
    }

    ngOnInit(): void {
        this.refreshSubject.subscribe(() => {
            this.getItems();
        });
        this.getItems();
    }

    ngOnDestroy() {
        this.subs?.unsubscribe();
    }

    ngAfterViewChecked(): void {
        this.changeDetectorRef.detectChanges();
    }

    getItems() {
        this.dataTableRequest.startPage = 999;
        this.dataTableRequest.pageSize = 0;
        this.dataTableRequest.sortColumn = this.columns[0].columnName;
        this.dataTableRequest.sortDirection = ApiSortDirection.Ascending;
        this.dataTableRequest.isDeleted = false;

        this.apiService.getResidualConsumptionSummaryTableData(
            this.dataTableRequest
        ).subscribe({
            next: (result) => {
                this.dataTableData = result.items;
                this.tableLoad(this.dataTableData);
            },
            error: (error) => {
                this.dataTableErrorResposeEvent.emit(error);
            }
        });
    }

    tableLoad(event: any[]) {
        this.totalConsumptionSum = parseFloat((event
            .filter(x => !x.isBillingPoint)
            .reduce((sum: number, item: any) => sum + item.consumptionSum, 0)).toFixed(2));
        this.totalConsumptionPercentage = parseFloat((event
            .filter(x => !x.isBillingPoint)
            .reduce((sum: number, item: any) => sum + item.consumptionPercentage, 0)).toFixed(2));

        this.differenceConsumptionSum = parseFloat((event
            .find(x => x.isBillingPoint).consumptionSum - event
                .filter(x => !x.isBillingPoint)
                .reduce((sum: number, item: any) => sum + item.consumptionSum, 0)).toFixed(2));
        this.differenceConsumptionPercentage = parseFloat((100 - event
            .find(x => x.isBillingPoint).consumptionPercentage - event
                .filter(x => !x.isBillingPoint)
                .reduce((sum: number, item: any) => sum + item.consumptionPercentage, 0)).toFixed(2));
    }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit, AfterViewInit } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { openNotificationDetailDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/notification-detail-dialog/notification-detail-dialog.component';
import { NotificationModel, NotificationService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';
import { WorkerStore } from 'src/app/core/worker-data-store/worker-store';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-notifications',
  templateUrl: './notifications.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./notifications.component.scss'],
})
export class NotificationsComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, AfterViewInit {
  notifications: NotificationModel[] = [];
  private workers: Worker[] = new Array<Worker>();

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private workerStore: WorkerStore,
    private notificationService: NotificationService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.stepForward();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getNotifications();
  }

  ngAfterViewInit() {
    this.workerStore.execChange.subscribe((value) => {
      this.notifications = value;
    });
  }

  openNotification(notification: any) {
    openNotificationDetailDialog(this.dialog, notification.description, notification.title).subscribe(() => {
      if (!notification.isRead) {
        this.notificationService
          .notificationSetNotificationRead(notification.id)
          .subscribe(() => this.getNotifications());
        this.workerStore.notificationChange(this.notifications);
      }
    });
  }

  getNotifications() {
    this.notificationService.notificationsGetNotifications().subscribe((value) => {
      this.notifications = value;
    });
  }

  /*notificationDetailDialog(dialog: MatDialog, detail: string, title: string): Observable<any> {
    const config = new MatDialogConfig();
  
    config.autoFocus = true;
    config.panelClass = "app-dialog-container";
    config.maxWidth = '40%';
    config.minWidth= '400px';
    config.data = { detail: detail, title: title } as MatNotificationDetailDialogData;
  
    const dialogRef = dialog.open(NotificationDetailDialogComponent, config);
  
    return dialogRef.afterClosed();
  }*/
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { TenantService, TenantStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-administration',
  templateUrl: './partner-administration.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-administration.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerAdministrationComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  partnerId: string;
  tenantPartnerId: string;
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantStatus: TenantStatus = TenantStatus.Error;

  isLoading = false;
  tenantDataHasChanged = false;
  pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  constructor(
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.partnerId = route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!;
    this.tenantPartnerId = route.snapshot.paramMap.get('tenantPartnerId')!;
    console.log(this.partnerId);
    console.log(this.tenantPartnerId);
    this.rootPath = 'partner';
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
    this.tenantDataHasChanged = route.snapshot.data.tenantDataHasChanged;
    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data.pageMode;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.partnerId) {
      this.tenantService.tenantGetStatusByPartnerId(+this.partnerId).subscribe((status: TenantStatus) => {
        this.tenantStatus = status;
      });
    }
  }

  back() {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner']);
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from "@angular/core";
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from "@angular/forms";
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from "@angular/router";
import moment from "moment";
import { Observable } from "rxjs";
import { FormComponentBase } from "src/app/core/base/form-component-base";
import { ActionButtonType } from "src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component";
import { createEnergyConsumptionDeviceRequestForm } from "src/app/core/generated/forms/energiamenedzsment/framework/shared/models/createEnergyConsumptionDeviceRequestForm";
import { DictService, DictType, EnergyConsumptionDevicesService } from "src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi";
import { PageMode } from "src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode";
import { BreadcrumbService } from "src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service";
import { LoaderService } from "src/app/core/services/loader.service";

@Component({
    selector: 'app-partner-energy-consumption-device-form',
    templateUrl: './partner-energy-consumption-device-form.component.html',
    styleUrl: './partner-energy-consumption-device-form.component.scss',
})
export class PartnerEnergyConsumptionDeviceFormComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
    pageMode: PageMode;
    pageModeEnum = PageMode;
    idOfElement: number;

    actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.CANCEL];

    types = this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType.ConsumtionDeviceType);
    typeOfEnergyCarriers = this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType.EnergyCarrierType);
    establishedSubMeterings = this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType.EstablishedSubMetering);
    remoteControls = this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType.RemoteControl);

    title: string;
    orgunitId: number;

    selectedIndex = 0;

    constructor(
        router: Router,
        injector: Injector,
        breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
        elRef: ElementRef,
        private route: ActivatedRoute,
        loaderService: LoaderService,
        private apiService: EnergyConsumptionDevicesService,
        private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
        private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
        private dictService: DictService
    ) {
        super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
        
        this.pageMode = this._route.snapshot.data.pageMode;
        this.idOfElement = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.elem?.id;
        this.title = this._route.snapshot.data.pageTitle;
        this.orgunitId = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params?.orgunitId;

        this.setCustomPageTitle(this.title);
        this.setBreadcrumbs();
        if (this.isCreate) {
            this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createEnergyConsumptionDeviceRequestForm.get());
        } else {
            this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createEnergyConsumptionDeviceRequestForm.get());
        }
    }

    ngOnInit() {
        super.ngOnInit();
        this.form.patchValue(this.route.snapshot.data.elem);
    }
    cancel() {
        history.back();
    }
    save(): Observable<object> | null {
        this.form.get('inspectionDate')?.setValue(moment(this.form.get('inspectionDate')?.value).format('YYYY-MM-DD'));
        const energyContract = this.form.value;

        if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
            return this.apiService.energyConsumptionDevicesCreateEnergyConsumptionDevice(this.orgunitId, energyContract);
        }
        if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT) {
            return this.apiService.energyConsumptionDevicesEditEnergyConsumptionDevice(this.idOfElement!, energyContract);
        }

    return null;
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\partners\partner-energy-consumption-device\partner-energy-consumption-device-form.resolver.ts

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ActivatedRouteSnapshot,
  Router,
  RouterStateSnapshot,
} from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel, EnergyConsumptionDevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class EnergyConsumptionDeviceDetailsResolver {
  constructor(private service: EnergyConsumptionDevicesService, private router: Router) {}

  resolve(
    route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot,
    state: RouterStateSnapshot
  ): Observable<EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel> {
    return this.service.energyConsumptionDevicesGetEnergyConsumptionDevice(Number(route.paramMap.get('id'))).pipe(
      catchError((err) => {
        this.router.navigateByUrl('../');
        return err;
      })
    ) as Observable<EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel>;
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\partners\partner-measurement-list\partner-measurement-list.component.ts

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, ViewChild, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { BuildingsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/buildings.service';
import { BuildingPartsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/buildingParts.service';
import { FloorsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/floors.service';
import { SitesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sites.service';
import { CommonCardDetailsModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/commonCardDetailsModel';
import { DeviceStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/deviceStatus';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { OrgunitType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/orgunitType';
import { MeasurementPointListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/measurementPointListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { NavbarService } from 'src/app/layout/navbar/navbar-service';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-measurement-list',
  templateUrl: './partner-measurement-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-measurement-list.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerMeasurementListMainComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  // Added comment to trigger re-compilation
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;

  // Parent entity inputs
  @Input() institutionId?: number;
  @Input() siteId?: number;
  @Input() buildingId?: number;
  @Input() buildingPartId?: number;
  @Input() floorId?: number;
  @Input() roomId?: number;

  protected dialog: MatDialog;
  needRefresh = false;

  // Navigation properties
  sourceUrl?: string;
  currentUrl?: string;

  isLoading = false;

  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';
  measurementPoints?: MeasurementPointListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult;

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'name',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.MEASUREMENT_POINTS.LIST.NAME',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'identifier',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.MEASUREMENT_POINTS.LIST.IDENTIFIER',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'isAggregationPoint',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.MEASUREMENT_POINTS.LIST.IS_AGGREGATION',
      columnType: ColumnType.Checkbox,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'orgunitType',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.MEASUREMENT_POINTS.LIST.ORGUNIT_TYPE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  orgunitTypes = Object.keys(OrgunitType);
  statuses = Object.keys(DeviceStatus);
  cards: CommonCardDetailsModel[] = [];
  item?: number;
  private subs = new Subscription();

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private buildingsService: BuildingsService,
    private buildingPartsService: BuildingPartsService,
    private floorsService: FloorsService,
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private navbarService: NavbarService,
    private location: Location,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    this.rootPath = 'partner/measurementpoints';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    // Store current URL for navigation context
    this.currentUrl = this.location.path();

    // Determine source URL based on parent entity
    if (this.buildingId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/buildings/${this.buildingId}/view`;
    } else if (this.buildingPartId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/buildingparts/${this.buildingPartId}/view`;
    } else if (this.floorId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/floors/${this.floorId}/view`;
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/sites/${this.siteId}/view`;
    } else if (this.institutionId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/institutions/${this.institutionId}/view`;
    }

    // Check navigation state for source URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.sourceUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getMeasurementPoints();
    this.setNavbarButton();
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  // Method to get the appropriate service method based on parent entity
  getMeasurementPoints() {
    this.isLoading = true;

    let apiSortDir: ApiSortDirection;
    if (this.sortDirection === 'asc') {
      apiSortDir = ApiSortDirection.Ascending;
    } else {
      apiSortDir = ApiSortDirection.Descending;
    }

    let subscription: Subscription | null = null;

    if (this.siteId) {
      subscription = this.sitesService
        .sitesGetMeasurementPoints(this.siteId, this.pageIndex, this.pageSize, this.sortActive, apiSortDir, false)
        .subscribe({
          next: (result) => {
            this.measurementPoints = result;
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
          error: (error) => {
            console.error('Error fetching measurement points:', error);
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
        });
    } else if (this.buildingId) {
      subscription = this.buildingsService
        .buildingsGetMeasurementPoints(
          this.buildingId,
          this.pageIndex,
          this.pageSize,
          this.sortActive,
          apiSortDir,
          false,
        )
        .subscribe({
          next: (result) => {
            this.measurementPoints = result;
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
          error: (error) => {
            console.error('Error fetching measurement points:', error);
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
        });
    } else if (this.buildingPartId) {
      subscription = this.buildingPartsService
        .buildingPartsGetMeasurementPoints(
          this.buildingPartId,
          this.pageIndex,
          this.pageSize,
          this.sortActive,
          apiSortDir,
          false,
        )
        .subscribe({
          next: (result) => {
            this.measurementPoints = result;
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
          error: (error) => {
            console.error('Error fetching measurement points for building part:', error);
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
        });
    } else if (this.floorId) {
      subscription = this.floorsService
        .floorGetMeasurementPoints(this.floorId, this.pageIndex, this.pageSize, this.sortActive, apiSortDir, false)
        .subscribe({
          next: (result) => {
            this.measurementPoints = result;
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
          error: (error) => {
            console.error('Error fetching measurement points for floor:', error);
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
        });
    } else {
      // For now, handle only buildingId, buildingPartId, and floorId
      this.measurementPoints = { items: [], recordsTotal: 0 };
      this.isLoading = false;
    }

    // Add subscription to the collection for proper cleanup
    if (subscription) {
      this.subs.add(subscription);
    }
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    // Navigate based on the orgunitType
    const baseUrl = this.getBaseUrlForOrgunitType(element.orgunitType);
    if (baseUrl) {
      this.router.navigate([`${baseUrl}/${element.id}/view`], {
        state: { returnUrl: this.sourceUrl || this.currentUrl },
      });
    } else {
      console.error(`Unsupported orgunitType: ${element.orgunitType}`);
    }
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    // Navigate based on the orgunitType
    const baseUrl = this.getBaseUrlForOrgunitType(element.orgunitType);
    if (baseUrl) {
      this.router.navigate([`${baseUrl}/${element.id}/edit`], {
        state: { returnUrl: this.sourceUrl || this.currentUrl },
      });
    } else {
      console.error(`Unsupported orgunitType: ${element.orgunitType}`);
    }
  }

  // Helper method to get the base URL for navigation based on orgunitType
  private getBaseUrlForOrgunitType(orgunitType: OrgunitType): string | null {
    switch (orgunitType) {
      case OrgunitType.Institution:
        return '/partner/institutions';
      case OrgunitType.Site:
        return '/partner/sites';
      case OrgunitType.Building:
        return '/partner/buildings';
      case OrgunitType.BuildingPart:
        return '/partner/buildingparts';
      case OrgunitType.Floor:
        return '/partner/floors';
      case OrgunitType.Room:
        return '/partner/rooms';
      default:
        return null;
    }
  }

  refreshChange(element: boolean) {
    if (element) {
      this.needRefresh = false;
    }
  }

  private setNavbarButton() {
    this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonVisibility(false);
  }

  formatParentNames(parentNames: string[]): string {
    return parentNames ? parentNames.join(', ') : '';
  }

  getBooleanText(value: boolean): string {
    return value ? 'GLOBAL.YES' : 'GLOBAL.NO';
  }

  // Override the abstract method from FormComponentBase
  public setBreadcrumbs() {
    // Set appropriate breadcrumbs based on parent entity
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.breadcrumbService.push({
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.MEASUREMENT_POINTS.LIST.TITLE',
      path: this.currentUrl || '',
      stateInfo: {},
    });
  }
}
