import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl, UntypedFormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { MeasurementPointsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/measurementPoints.service';
import { CreateMeasurementPointRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/createMeasurementPointRequest';
import { ModifyMeasurementPointRequest } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/modifyMeasurementPointRequest';
import { UtilityType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/utilityType';
import { OrgunitType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/orgunitType';
import { OrgunitParentsModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/orgunitParentsModel';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { catchError, of } from 'rxjs';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ConfirmDialogComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { MeasurementPointModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-measurement-point-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-measurement-point-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-measurement-point-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerMeasurementPointEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() measurementPointId: number;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  isLoading = false;
  isEditMode = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];

  measurementPoint?: MeasurementPointModel;

  // Store the orgUnitBaseId from URL params as a backup
  private _orgUnitBaseId = 0;

  // Use getter to ensure we always have a value for orgUnitBaseId
  get orgUnitBaseId(): number {
    // Access the correct property: orgunitBase.id instead of orgUnitBaseId
    const id = this._orgUnitBaseId || this.orgunitBaseId;
    return id;
  }
  get isBillingValue(): boolean {
    return this.form?.get('isBilling')?.value === 'true';
  }
  orgunitBaseId: number;
  utilityTypes: any[] = [];
  // Options will be set in ngOnInit with translated values
  isBillingOptions: any[] = [];
  isPodEnabled = false;
  orgUnitType: OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Room; // Using Room as closest type since MeasurementPoint isn't in the enum
  currentUrl: string;
  originalReturnUrl: string; // Store the original return URL to the parent orgUnit page
  orgunitData?: OrgunitParentsModel;

  // Dropdown options with proper format following the pattern used by isBillingOptions
  measuredProperties: any[] = [];
  measuredDataLabels: any[] = [];
  measurementPoints: any[] = [];

  // Property to control POD ID field disabled state
  isPodIdDisabled = true;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    public activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private measurementPointsService: MeasurementPointsService,
    private translate: TranslateService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    protected _snackBar: MatSnackBar,
    protected dialog: MatDialog
  ) { 
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.rootPath = 'partner/measurement-points';

    this.measurementPointId = +activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!;
    this.orgunitBaseId = +(
      activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('orgUnitId') ??
      activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('orgunitBaseId') ??
      0
    );
    this.pageMode = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data['pageMode'] || PageMode.CREATE;
    this.isEditMode = this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT || this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW;

    this.currentUrl = this.router.url;

    // Capture the original return URL from router state (URL to parent OrgUnit page)
    const state = window.history.state;
    this.originalReturnUrl = state && state.returnUrl ? state.returnUrl : null;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
    this.initializeForm();
    this.setupUtilityTypes();

    // Use string values instead of boolean for better compatibility with dropdown component
    this.isBillingOptions = [
      { value: 'true', label: this.translate.instant('COMMON.YES') },
      { value: 'false', label: this.translate.instant('COMMON.NO') },
    ];

    // Initialize isBillingOptions

    // Important: Load measurement points data first, since we need it for the dropdown
    // This ensures measurementPoints dropdown has data before we try to set a value
    this.loadMeasurementPointsData();

    // Then load other dropdown data
    this.loadMeasuredPropertiesData();
    this.loadMeasuredDataLabelsData();

    // If we have an orgunitBaseId, fetch the organization unit data
    if (this.orgunitBaseId) {
      this.loadOrgunitData();
    }

    // Load the actual measurement point data last
    // This ensures the dropdowns have their options before we set the values
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW || this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        // Small delay to ensure measurement points dropdown data is loaded
        this.loadMeasurementPoint();
      }, 500);
    }

    // Add listener to isBilling field to manage podId and measurementPoint fields
    this.form.get('isBilling')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      // Convert string value to boolean for the dependent fields state
      const boolValue = value === 'true';
      this.updateDependentFieldsState(boolValue);
    });

    // Initialize dependent fields based on initial isBilling value
    const initialValue = this.form.get('isBilling')?.value;
    // Convert string value to boolean for the dependent fields state
    const initialBoolValue = initialValue === 'true';
    this.updateDependentFieldsState(initialBoolValue);
  }

  private setupUtilityTypes(): void {
    // Convert the UtilityType enum to a format usable by our custom select component
    // Currently there's only 'Undefined' in the enum based on our model inspection
    this.utilityTypes = [
      { id: UtilityType.ElectricPower, name: this.translate.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.UTILITY_TYPE.ELECTRIC_POWER') },
      {
        id: UtilityType.HydroelectricPower,
        name: this.translate.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.UTILITY_TYPE.HYDROELECTRIC_POWER'),
      },
      {
        id: UtilityType.NaturalGasEnergy,
        name: this.translate.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.UTILITY_TYPE.NATURAL_GAS_ENERGY'),
      },
      // Add more utility types here when they become available in the API
    ];
  }

  private initializeForm(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      name: ['', Validators.required],
      externalId: [''],
      isBilling: ['false'], // Using string 'false' to match our dropdown options
      podId:['', [Validators.required,
        // POD ID format validation
        (control: AbstractControl) => {
          if (!control.value) return null;
          const podIdRegex = /^HU.{31}$/;
          return podIdRegex.test(control.value) ? null : { 
            formatInvalid: { 
              expected: this.translate.instant('GLOBAL.VALIDATION.INVALID_POD_ID')
            }
          };
        }
      ]],
      lat: [null, [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.min(-90),
        Validators.max(90)
      ]],
      lon: [null, [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.min(-180),
        Validators.max(180)
      ]],
      utilityType: [null, Validators.required],

      // New form controls for selects
      measuredProperties: [[]], // Multi-select, so initialized with empty array
      measuredDataLabels: [[]], // Multi-select, so initialized with empty array
      measurementPoint: [null], // Single select

      // Organization unit fields - these are read-only display fields
      institutionName: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      siteName: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      buildingName: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      buildingPartName: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      floorName: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      roomName: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
    });

  }



  
  protected loadMeasurementPoint(): void {
    if (!this.measurementPointId) {
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;

    // First make sure the parent dropdown data is loaded
    this.measurementPointsService.measurementPointsGetMeasurementPoints().subscribe(
      (points) => {
        // Process available measurement points
        this.measurementPoints = points || [];

        // Now load the current measurement point data
        this.measurementPointsService
          .measurementPointsGet(this.measurementPointId)
          .pipe(
            finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
            catchError(() => {
              this._snackBar.open('Error loading measurement point data', 'Close', {
                duration: 3000,
                panelClass: ['error-snackbar'],
              });
              return of(null);
            }),
          )
          .subscribe((data) => {
            if (data) {
              // Store the data directly without any transformations
              this.measurementPoint = data;

              // If there's a parent measurement point in the data but it's not in the dropdown options,
              // add it to ensure it can be selected
              if (data.parentMeasurementPoint && data.parentMeasurementPoint.id) {
                const parentExists = this.measurementPoints.some((mp) => mp.id === data.parentMeasurementPoint!.id);
                if (!parentExists) {
                  this.measurementPoints.push({
                    id: data.parentMeasurementPoint.id,
                    entityDisplayName: data.parentMeasurementPoint.entityDisplayName,
                  });
                }
              }

              // Convert boolean values explicitly to avoid null/undefined issues
              const booleanValue = data.isBilling === undefined ? false : !!data.isBilling;
              // Convert to string for the dropdown which now uses string values
              const isBillingValue = booleanValue ? 'true' : 'false';

              // First set all other form values except isBilling
              this.form.patchValue({
                name: data.name,
                externalId: data.identifier,
                podId: data.podId || '',
                lat: data.lat || null,
                lon: data.lon || null,
                utilityType: data.utilityType || null,

                // Set the measured properties directly from the data
                measuredProperties: data.measuredProperties ? data.measuredProperties.map((p) => p.id) : [],

                // Set the labels directly from the data
                measuredDataLabels: data.labels ? data.labels.map((l) => l.id) : [],
              });

              // Set isBilling value directly - we're using string values now
              this.form.get('isBilling')?.setValue(isBillingValue, { emitEvent: true });

              // Use the boolean value we computed earlier for the dependent fields
              this.updateDependentFieldsState(booleanValue);

              // Set parent measurement point in a separate step for better visibility
              if (data.parentMeasurementPoint && data.parentMeasurementPoint.id) {
                // Use timeout to ensure the form control is ready
                setTimeout(() => {
                  this.form.get('measurementPoint')?.setValue(data.parentMeasurementPoint!.id);
                }, 0);
              }

              // Apply any business rules based on the loaded data
              this.updateDependentFieldsState(isBillingValue);

              // Disable form in view mode
              if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
                this.form.disable();
              }
            }
          });
      },
      () => {
        this.measurementPoints = [];
        this.isLoading = false;
      },
    );
  }

  /**
   * Loads measurement points for the parent dropdown and ensures the list is ready
   * Returns a promise that resolves when the data is loaded
   */
  private loadMeasurementPointsForParentDropdown(): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      // If we already have measurement points loaded, resolve immediately
      if (this.measurementPoints && this.measurementPoints.length > 0) {
        resolve();
        return;
      }

      // Otherwise load the measurement points
      this.isLoading = true;
      this.measurementPointsService
        .measurementPointsGetMeasurementPoints()
        .pipe(
          finalize(() => {
            this.isLoading = false;
            resolve(); // Resolve the promise when the data is loaded
          }),
          catchError(() => {
            this.measurementPoints = [];
            resolve(); // Resolve even on error
            return of([]);
          }),
        )
        .subscribe((points) => {
          this.measurementPoints = points || [];
        });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Sets the parent measurement point in the form
   * This is a separate method to ensure it's handled correctly
   */
  private setParentMeasurementPoint(parentMeasurementPoint: any): void {
    if (!parentMeasurementPoint) {
      return;
    }

    const parentId = parentMeasurementPoint.id;

    // Manually insert the parent into the dropdown options if it doesn't exist
    const parentExists = this.measurementPoints.some((mp) => mp.id === parentId);
    if (!parentExists && parentMeasurementPoint.entityDisplayName) {
      this.measurementPoints.push({
        id: parentId,
        entityDisplayName: parentMeasurementPoint.entityDisplayName,
      });
    }

    // Set the parent measurement point value in the form
    setTimeout(() => {
      const control = this.form.get('measurementPoint');
      if (control) {
        control.setValue(parentId);
      }
    }, 0);
  }

  protected updateForm(): void {
    if (!this.measurementPoint) return;

    // Ensure boolean fields are explicitly set to boolean values
    const isBillingValue = this.measurementPoint.isBilling === undefined ? false : !!this.measurementPoint.isBilling;
    const parentId = this.measurementPoint.parentMeasurementPoint?.id;

    // Check if the parent ID exists in the measurementPoints dropdown
    let parentExists = false;
    if (parentId && this.measurementPoints && this.measurementPoints.length > 0) {
      parentExists = this.measurementPoints.some((mp) => mp.id === parentId);
    }

    // Update form controls with data from API
    const formValues = {
      name: this.measurementPoint.name,
      externalId: this.measurementPoint.identifier,
      isBilling: isBillingValue, // Use the explicitly processed boolean value
      podId: this.measurementPoint.podId || '',
      lat: this.measurementPoint.lat || null,
      lon: this.measurementPoint.lon || null,
      utilityType: this.measurementPoint.utilityType || null,

      // For the multi-select fields, process the data from the API
      // If we have measuredProperties in the model, set them in the form
      measuredProperties: this.measurementPoint.measuredProperties
        ? this.measurementPoint.measuredProperties.map((p) => p.id)
        : [],

      // If we have labels in the model, set them in the form
      measuredDataLabels: this.measurementPoint.labels ? this.measurementPoint.labels.map((l) => l.id) : [],

      // Set parent measurement point properly - only if it exists in the dropdown
      measurementPoint: parentExists ? parentId : null,

      // These are display-only fields that show the OrgUnit hierarchy
      institutionName: '',
      siteName: '',
      buildingName: '',
      buildingPartName: '',
      floorName: '',
      roomName: '',
    };

    // Update form with all values
    this.form.patchValue(formValues);

    // After patching values, update the enabled/disabled state of dependent fields
    this.updateDependentFieldsState(isBillingValue);

    // Disable form controls in view mode
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      this.form.disable();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Loads organization unit data when an orgunitBaseId is available
   */
  private loadOrgunitData(): void {
    if (!this.orgunitBaseId) {
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetOrgunitNames(this.orgunitBaseId)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError(() => {
          return of(null);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((data) => {
        if (data) {
          this.orgunitData = data;
          // Update the form with organization unit data
          this.updateOrgunitFormFields();
        }
      });
  }

  /**
   * Updates the organization unit form fields with data from the API
   */
  private updateOrgunitFormFields(): void {
    if (!this.orgunitData) {
      return;
    }

    // Patch the form with organization unit data
    this.form.patchValue({
      institutionName: this.orgunitData.instiutionName || '', // Note: API model has a typo 'instiutionName'
      siteName: this.orgunitData.siteName || '',
      buildingName: this.orgunitData.buildingName || '',
      buildingPartName: this.orgunitData.buildingPartName || '',
      floorName: this.orgunitData.floorName || '',
      roomName: this.orgunitData.roomName || '',
    });
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.form.invalid || this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const formValue = this.form.getRawValue();
    this.isLoading = true;
    if (this.isEditMode) {
      // Create modify request object with orgunitBaseId property
      const modifyRequest: ModifyMeasurementPointRequest = {
        orgunitBaseId: this.orgunitBaseId,
        name: formValue.name,
        isBilling: formValue.isBilling,
        podId: formValue.podId,
        lat: formValue.lat,
        lon: formValue.lon,
        utilityType: formValue.utilityType,
        measuredPropertyIds: formValue.measuredProperties,
        measuredDataLabelIds: formValue.measuredDataLabels,
        measurementPointId: formValue.measurementPoint ?? 0,
      };
      this.updateMeasurementPoint(modifyRequest);
    } else {
      // Create new request object with orgunitBaseId property
      const createRequest: CreateMeasurementPointRequest = {
        orgunitBaseId: this.orgunitBaseId,
        name: formValue.name,
        isBilling: formValue.isBilling,
        podId: formValue.podId,
        lat: formValue.lat,
        lon: formValue.lon,
        utilityType: formValue.utilityType,
        measuredPropertyIds: formValue.measuredProperties,
        measuredDataLabelIds: formValue.measuredDataLabels,
        measurementPointId: formValue.measurementPoint ?? 0,
      };
      this.createMeasurementPoint(createRequest);
    }
  }

  protected createMeasurementPoint(request: CreateMeasurementPointRequest): void {
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsPost(request)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError(() => {
          this._snackBar.open(
            this.translate.instant('COMMON.ERROR.SAVE_DATA'),
            this.translate.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'),
            {
              duration: 3000,
              panelClass: ['error-snackbar'],
            },
          );
          return of(null);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((response) => {
        if (response) {
          this._snackBar.open(
            this.translate.instant('COMMON.SUCCESS.SAVE_DATA'),
            this.translate.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'),
            {
              duration: 3000,
              panelClass: ['success-snackbar'],
            },
          );
          this.navigateBack();
        }
      });
  }

  protected updateMeasurementPoint(request: ModifyMeasurementPointRequest): void {
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsPut(this.measurementPointId, request)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError(() => {
          this._snackBar.open(
            this.translate.instant('COMMON.ERROR.SAVE_DATA'),
            this.translate.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'),
            {
              duration: 3000,
              panelClass: ['error-snackbar'],
            },
          );
          return of(null);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((response) => {
        if (response) {
          this._snackBar.open(
            this.translate.instant('COMMON.SUCCESS.SAVE_DATA'),
            this.translate.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'),
            {
              duration: 3000,
              panelClass: ['success-snackbar'],
            },
          );
          this.navigateBack();
        }
      });
  }

  onCancel(): void {
    this.navigateBack();
  }

  onEdit(): void {
    // Use absolute path for navigation
    this.router.navigate([`/partner/measurement-points/${this.measurementPointId}/edit/${this.orgunitBaseId}`], {
      state: { returnUrl: this.originalReturnUrl }, // Pass the original return URL to maintain the chain
    });
  }

  /**
   * Handles the deletion of the measurement point after user confirmation
   */
  onDelete(): void {
    // Get translation keys for confirmation dialog
    const confirmTitle = this.translate.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.DELETE_CONFIRMATION');
    const confirmMessage = this.translate.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.DELETE_CONFIRMATION');
    const confirmYes = this.translate.instant('COMMON.YES');
    const confirmNo = this.translate.instant('COMMON.NO');

    // Show confirmation dialog using MatDialog
    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, {
      width: '400px',
      data: { title: confirmTitle, message: confirmMessage, yes: confirmYes, no: confirmNo }
    });

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe(result => {
      if (result) {
        // User confirmed the deletion
        this.isLoading = true;
        this.measurementPointsService.measurementPointsDelete(this.measurementPointId)
          .pipe(
            finalize(() => this.isLoading = false),
            catchError(error => {
              this._snackBar.open(this.translate.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.DELETE_ERROR_MSG'), 
                this.translate.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'), {
                duration: 3000,
                panelClass: ['error-snackbar']
              });
              return of(null);
            })
          )
          .subscribe(response => {
            // Show success message
            this._snackBar.open(this.translate.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.DELETE_SUCCESS_MSG'), 
              this.translate.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'), {
              duration: 3000,
              panelClass: ['success-snackbar']
            });
            
            // Navigate back to the list
            this.navigateBack();
          });
      }
    });
  }

  protected navigateBack(): void {
    // Use exact navigation logic based on page mode
    switch (this.pageMode) {
      case PageMode.EDIT:
        // From edit mode, navigate to view mode using absolute path
        this.router.navigate([`/partner/measurement-points/${this.measurementPointId}/view/${this.orgunitBaseId}`], {
          state: { returnUrl: this.originalReturnUrl }, // Preserve the original return URL
        });
        break;

      case PageMode.VIEW:
      case PageMode.CREATE:
      default:
        // From view or create mode, go directly back to the originating page
        if (this.originalReturnUrl) {
          // Use the stored original return URL to jump directly back to parent page
          this.router.navigateByUrl(this.originalReturnUrl);
        } else {
          // Fallback to browser history if no return URL is available
          window.history.back();
        }
        break;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Loads measured properties data for the multi-select dropdown
   */
  private loadMeasuredPropertiesData(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetMeasuredProperties()
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError((error) => {
          console.error('Hiba történt az adatok lekérésekor:', error);
          // Use empty array as fallback
          this.measuredProperties = [];
          return of([]);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((properties) => {
        // Simply use the API response directly - create objects with id and entityDisplayName
        this.measuredProperties = [];
        if (properties && properties.length > 0) {
          properties.forEach((property) => {
            this.measuredProperties.push({
              id: property.id,
              entityDisplayName: property.entityDisplayName,
            });
          });
        }
      });
  }

  /**
   * Updates the state (enabled/disabled) of fields that depend on isBilling value
   * @param isBillingValue The current value of the isBilling field, can be boolean or string 'true'/'false'
   */
  private updateDependentFieldsState(isBillingValue: boolean | string): void {
    const podIdControl = this.form.get('podId');
    const measurementPointControl = this.form.get('measurementPoint');

    if (!podIdControl || !measurementPointControl) {
      return;
    }

    // Convert to boolean - handle both string and boolean inputs
    const boolValue = typeof isBillingValue === 'string' ? isBillingValue === 'true' : !!isBillingValue;

    // The measurementPoint control should always be enabled regardless of isBilling value
    measurementPointControl.enable();

    if (boolValue === true) {
      // Enable podId field when isBilling is true
      podIdControl.enable();
    } else {
      // Disable and clear podId field when isBilling is false
      podIdControl.disable();
      podIdControl.setValue('');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Loads measured data labels for the multi-select dropdown
   */
  private loadMeasuredDataLabelsData(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetMeasuredDataLabels()
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError(() => {
          // Use empty array as fallback
          this.measuredDataLabels = [];
          return of([]);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((dataLabels) => {
        // Use the API response directly - TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef already has id and entityDisplayName
        this.measuredDataLabels = dataLabels;
      });
  }

  /**
   * Loads measurement points for the single-select dropdown
   * Returns an observable that emits when the data is loaded
   */
  private loadMeasurementPointsData(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    // Pass the orgunitBaseId if available to filter measurement points by organization unit
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetMeasurementPoints()
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError((error) => {
          console.error('Hiba történt az adatok lekérésekor:', error);
          // Use empty array as fallback
          this.measurementPoints = [];
          return of([]);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((points) => {
        // Use the API response directly - MeasurementPointEntityDtoEntityRef already has id and entityDisplayName
        this.measurementPoints = points;

        // If we already have a measurement point loaded and it has a parent, try to set it now
        if (this.measurementPoint && this.measurementPoint.parentMeasurementPoint) {
          const parentId = this.measurementPoint.parentMeasurementPoint.id;

          // Check if this parent ID exists in our dropdown options
          const parentExists = this.measurementPoints.some((mp) => mp.id === parentId);

          if (parentExists) {
            // We need to update the form control directly since updateForm may have already run
            const measurementPointControl = this.form.get('measurementPoint');
            if (measurementPointControl) {
              measurementPointControl.setValue(parentId);
            }
          }
        }
      });
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup, AbstractControl, UntypedFormArray } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { finalize, catchError } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';
import { MatSelectChange } from '@angular/material/select';
import { of } from 'rxjs';

// Import the generated API services and models
import { DevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/devices.service';
import { MeasurementPointsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/measurementPoints.service';
import { DeviceDtoModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/deviceDtoModel';
import { OrgunitParentsModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/orgunitParentsModel';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-measurement-point-device-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-measurement-point-device-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-measurement-point-device-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerMeasurementPointDeviceEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  // Page properties
  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  isLoading = false;
  deviceId: number;
  orgUnitBaseId: number;
  measurementPointId: number;

  // Device data
  deviceData?: DeviceDtoModel;

  // Org unit data for display purposes
  orgunitData?: OrgunitParentsModel;

  // Measurement point data
  measurementPointData: any = null;

  // Channel data for the device
  channels: any[] = [];
  channelsForm?: UntypedFormArray;
  selectedChannelIndex = -1;

  // Technology labels for display in chips
  consumptionTechnologiesLabel: string[] = [];
  measurementPropertiesLabel: string[] = [];

  // Measurement properties for selection in the UI
  measurementProperties: any[] = [];

  // Track if any channel's measurement property has been changed
  anyChannelPropertyChanged = false;
  // Index of the channel that has been modified
  modifiedChannelIndex = -1;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    public activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    public formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private deviceService: DevicesService,
    private measurementPointsService: MeasurementPointsService,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.rootPath = 'partner/measurement-points';

    this.pageMode = activatedRoute.snapshot.data['pageMode'] || PageMode.VIEW;

    // Get all required parameters from the route
    // IMPORTANT: Use the exact parameter names as defined in the route config
    this.deviceId = +(activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('id') || 0);

    // Try all possible parameter names for orgUnitBaseId to ensure we get it
    this.orgUnitBaseId = +(
      activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('orgUnitBaseId') ||
      activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('orgunitBaseId') ||
      activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('orgUnitId') ||
      0
    );

    this.measurementPointId = +(activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('measurementPointId') || 0);

    // If we still don't have an orgUnitBaseId, try extracting it from the last segment of the URL
    if (!this.orgUnitBaseId) {
      const urlSegments = this.router.url.split('/');
      const lastSegment = urlSegments[urlSegments.length - 1];
      if (!isNaN(+lastSegment)) {
        this.orgUnitBaseId = +lastSegment;
      }
    }

    // Device ID and OrgUnit Base ID extracted from route parameters
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.initializeForm();

    // Initialize an empty channel form array
    this.channelsForm = this.formBuilder.array([]);

    // Load orgunit data if orgUnitBaseId is available
    if (this.orgUnitBaseId) {
      this.loadOrgunitData();
    }

    this.loadDeviceData();

    // Load measurement properties and labels if measurement point ID is available
    if (this.measurementPointId) {
      this.loadMeasuredPropertiesAndLabels();
      this.loadDeviceChannels(); // Load real channel data
      this.loadMeasurementPointData(); // Load measurement point data
    }
  }

  /**
   * Loads organization unit data when an orgUnitBaseId is available
   */
  private loadOrgunitData(): void {
    if (!this.orgUnitBaseId) {
      this.snackBar.open('Mérési hely azonosító nem elérhető', 'Close', {
        duration: 3000,
      });
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetOrgunitNames(this.orgUnitBaseId)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError(() => {
          this.snackBar.open('Hiba történt az Mérési hely adatok betöltése során', 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
            panelClass: ['error-snackbar'],
          });
          return of(null);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((data) => {
        if (data) {
          this.orgunitData = data;
          // If device data is already loaded, update the form with the org unit data
          if (this.deviceData) {
            this.updateForm();
          }
        }
      });
  }

  private initializeForm(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      // Device information - all fields are disabled in this view
      deviceType: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      manufacturer: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      serialNumber: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      installationDate: [{ value: null, disabled: true }],
      removalDate: [{ value: null, disabled: true }],
      description: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],

      // Measurement point information - all fields are disabled
      name: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      measurementPointExternalId: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      parentMeasurementPoint: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],

      // Organization unit information - all fields are disabled
      institution: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      site: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      building: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      buildingPart: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      floor: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      room: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],

      // Additional properties - all fields are disabled
      measurementProperty: [{ value: '', disabled: true }],
      consumptionTechnologies: [{ value: [], disabled: true }],
      productionTechnologies: [{ value: [], disabled: true }],
    });

    // Initialize channels form array
    this.channelsForm = this.formBuilder.array([]);

    // If we already have orgunit data available, update form values
    if (this.orgunitData) {
      this.form.patchValue({
        institution: this.orgunitData.instiutionName || '', // Note: API model has a typo 'instiutionName'
        site: this.orgunitData.siteName || '',
        building: this.orgunitData.buildingName || '',
        buildingPart: this.orgunitData.buildingPartName || '',
        floor: this.orgunitData.floorName || '',
        room: this.orgunitData.roomName || '',
      });
    }
  }

  // Initialize channel forms with mock data
  initializeChannelForms(): void {
    // Clear existing forms
    while (this.channelsForm?.length) {
      this.channelsForm.removeAt(0);
    }

    // Add form for each channel
    this.channels.forEach((channel) => {
      const channelForm = this.createChannelFormGroup(channel);
      // Add listener for measurement property changes
      channelForm.get('measurementPropertyId')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
        if (value) {
          this.selectedChannelIndex = this.channelsForm!.controls.indexOf(channelForm);
          // this.updateOtherChannelsState();
        }

        // Update disabled status for other channels
        // this.updateChannelPropertyDisableStatus();
      });

      this.channelsForm?.push(channelForm);
    });
  }

  // Create a form group for a channel
  private createChannelFormGroup(channel: any): UntypedFormGroup {
    return this.formBuilder.group({
      channelId: [{ value: channel.id || channel.channelId, disabled: true }],
      name: [{ value: channel.name, disabled: true }],
      identifier: [{ value: channel.identifier || '', disabled: true }],
      type: [{ value: channel.type, disabled: true }],
      unit: [{ value: channel.unit, disabled: true }],
      minValue: [{ value: channel.minValue || '', disabled: true }],
      maxValue: [{ value: channel.maxValue || '', disabled: true }],
      measurementPropertyId: [{ value: channel.measurementPropertyId || '', disabled: false }], // Not disabled
    });
  }

  // Update state of other channels when one is selected
  // updateOtherChannelsState(): void {
  //   if (this.selectedChannelIndex >= 0) {
  //     this.anyChannelPropertyChanged = true;
  //     this.modifiedChannelIndex = this.selectedChannelIndex;
  //     this.updateChannelPropertyDisableStatus();
  //   }
  // }

  // Update the disabled state of measurement properties based on the current state
  // updateChannelPropertyDisableStatus(): void {

  //     // Disable all other channel measurement properties
  //     this.channelsForm.controls.forEach((control, index) => {
  //       if (index !== this.modifiedChannelIndex) {

  //     this.channelsForm.controls.forEach(control => {
  //       control.get('measurementPropertyId').enable();

  loadDeviceData(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;

    // Load device master data using the correct API method
    this.deviceService
      .measurementPointsGetDeviceMasterData(this.deviceId)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => {
          this.isLoading = false;
        }),
        catchError(() => {
          this.snackBar.open('Hiba történt az eszköz adatok betöltése során', 'Close', { duration: 3000 });
          this.navigateBack();
          return of(null);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((device) => {
        if (device) {
          this.deviceData = device;
          this.updateForm();
        } else {
          this.snackBar.open('Eszköz nem található', 'Close', { duration: 3000 });
          this.navigateBack();
        }
      });
  }

  updateForm(): void {
    if (!this.deviceData) return;
    // Base form values update
    const formValues = {
      deviceType: this.deviceData.deviceType || '',
      manufacturer: this.deviceData.manufacturer || '',
      serialNumber: this.deviceData.serialNumber || '',
      installationDate: this.deviceData.installationDate || null,
      removalDate: this.deviceData.removalDate || null,
      description: this.deviceData.description || '',

      // Measurement point data - defaults
      name: '',
      measurementPointId: '',
      parentMeasurementPoint: '',

      // Organization unit data - defaults if not loaded from API
      institution: '',
      site: '',
      building: '',
      buildingPart: '',
      floor: '',
      room: '',

      // Additional data
      measurementProperty: '',
      consumptionTechnologies: [],
      productionTechnologies: [],
    };

    // Update organization unit form fields if we have the data from API
    if (this.orgunitData) {
      formValues.institution = this.orgunitData.instiutionName || ''; // Note: API model has a typo 'instiutionName'
      formValues.site = this.orgunitData.siteName || '';
      formValues.building = this.orgunitData.buildingName || '';
      formValues.buildingPart = this.orgunitData.buildingPartName || '';
      formValues.floor = this.orgunitData.floorName || '';
      formValues.room = this.orgunitData.roomName || '';
    }

    // Update form with all values
    this.form.patchValue(formValues);

    // If we already have measurement point data, update those fields
    if (this.measurementPointData) {
      this.updateMeasurementPointFields();
    }

    // Initialize the label arrays if not already populated by the API
    if (!this.consumptionTechnologiesLabel || this.consumptionTechnologiesLabel.length === 0) {
      this.consumptionTechnologiesLabel = [];
    }

    if (!this.measurementPropertiesLabel || this.measurementPropertiesLabel.length === 0) {
      this.measurementPropertiesLabel = [];
    }
  }

  /**
   * Load measurement properties and labels from the API for the given measurement point ID
   */
  private loadMeasuredPropertiesAndLabels(): void {
    if (!this.measurementPointId) {
      return;
    }

    // First, load the labels and properties from the specific endpoint
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetMeasuredPropertiesAndLabels(this.measurementPointId)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError(() => {
          this.snackBar.open('Error loading measurement properties and labels', 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
            panelClass: ['error-snackbar'],
          });
          return of(null);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((data) => {
        if (data) {
          // Set the labels for consumption technologies and measurement properties
          this.consumptionTechnologiesLabel = data.labels || [];
          this.measurementPropertiesLabel = data.measuredProperties || [];
        }

        // After loading labels, load the measurement properties for selection
        this.loadMeasurementProperties();
      });
  }

  /**
   * Loads measurement properties data for the dropdown selection
   */
  private loadMeasurementProperties(): void {
    if (!this.measurementPointId) {
      this.snackBar.open('Mérési pont azonosító nem elérhető', 'Close', {
        duration: 3000,
      });
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetMeasuredPropertiesOfMeasurementPoint(this.measurementPointId)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError((error) => {
          console.error('Error loading measured properties:', error);
          this.snackBar.open('Hiba történt az adatok betöltése során', 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
          });
          this.measurementProperties = [];
          return of([]);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((properties) => {
        this.measurementProperties = [];
        if (properties && properties.length > 0) {
          properties.forEach((property) => {
            this.measurementProperties.push({
              id: property.id,
              name: property.entityDisplayName || '',
            });
          });
        }
      });
  }

  /**
   * Load real channel data for the device from the API
   */
  loadDeviceChannels(): void {
    if (!this.deviceId) {
      this.snackBar.open('Eszköz azonosító nem elérhető', 'Close', { duration: 3000 });
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;
    this.deviceService
      .measurementPointsGetChannelMasterData(this.deviceId)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError((error) => {
          this.snackBar.open('Hiba történt az adócsatorna adatok betöltése során', 'Close', { duration: 3000 });
          console.error('Error loading channel data:', error);
          return of([]);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((channels) => {
        if (channels && channels.length > 0) {
          this.channels = channels.map((channel) => ({
            id: channel.id,
            channelId: channel.id, // Use id as channelId
            name: channel.channelName || `Channel ${channel.id}`,
            identifier: channel.identifier || '',
            type: channel.dateReceivingFrequency || '',
            unit: channel.unit || '',
            minValue: channel.minValue || 0,
            maxValue: channel.maxValue || 100,
            measurementPropertyId: channel.measuredProperty?.id || '',
          }));
        } else {
          // If no channels are returned, provide a message
          this.snackBar.open('Az eszközhöz nem tartoznak adócsatornák', 'Close', { duration: 3000 });
          this.channels = [];
        }

        // Initialize forms for the channels
        this.initializeChannelForms();
      });
  }

  // Save the measurement property for a specific channel
  saveChannelMeasurementProperty(index: number): void {
    if (!this.channelsForm || index < 0 || index >= this.channelsForm.length) return;

    const channelForm = this.channelsForm.at(index) as UntypedFormGroup;
    const channelId = channelForm.get('channelId')?.value;
    const measurementPropertyId = channelForm.get('measurementPropertyId')?.value;

    if (!measurementPropertyId) {
      this.snackBar.open('Nem kiválasztott mérési tulajdonság', 'Close', {
        duration: 3000,
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!this.measurementPointId) {
      this.snackBar.open('Mérési hely azonosító nem elérhető', 'Close', {
        duration: 3000,
      });
      return;
    }

    // Get the measurement property name for display
    const measurementProperty = this.measurementProperties.find((p) => p.id === measurementPropertyId);

    // Create the request payload
    const requestPayload = {
      measuredPropertyId: measurementPropertyId,
      channelId: channelId,
    };

    this.isLoading = true;

    // Call the API to save the measurement property pairing
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsPairMeasuredProperty(this.measurementPointId, requestPayload)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError((error) => {
          console.error('Error saving measurement property pairing:', error);
          this.snackBar.open('Hiba történt az adatok mentése során', 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
            panelClass: ['error-snackbar'],
          });
          return of(null);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((response) => {
        if (response) {
          // Successfully saved the measurement property pairing
          this.snackBar.open(
            `Adócsatorna ${channelId} mérési tulajdonság sikeresen mentve: ${measurementProperty?.name || 'Unknown'}`,
            'Close',
            { duration: 3000 },
          );

          // Reset the change tracking flags
          this.anyChannelPropertyChanged = false;
          this.modifiedChannelIndex = -1;
        }
      });
  }

  // Check if a channel's measurement property has been changed
  // isChannelPropertyChanged(index: number): boolean {
  //   return this.anyChannelPropertyChanged && this.modifiedChannelIndex === index;
  // }

  // Check if a save button should be enabled for a specific channel

  // Helper method to get the selected measurement property name for display
  getSelectedPropertyName(channelControl: AbstractControl): string {
    const measurementPropertyId = channelControl.get('measurementPropertyId')?.value;
    if (!measurementPropertyId) return 'Nem kiválasztott';

    const property = this.measurementProperties.find((p) => p.id === measurementPropertyId);
    return property ? property.name : 'Nem kiválasztott';
  }

  navigateBack(): void {
    window.history.back();
  }

  onMeasurementPropertyChange(event: MatSelectChange, index: number): void {
    if (index >= 0 && index < this.channelsForm!.length) {
      // Set the selected channel index
      this.selectedChannelIndex = index;

      // Enable the save button for this channel
      this.anyChannelPropertyChanged = true;
      this.modifiedChannelIndex = index;

      // const selectedValue = event.value;
      // const selectedProperty = this.measurementProperties.find((p) => p.id === selectedValue);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Loads measurement point data from the API
   */
  private loadMeasurementPointData(): void {
    if (!this.measurementPointId) {
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;
    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGet(this.measurementPointId)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => (this.isLoading = false)),
        catchError((error) => {
          console.error('Error loading measurement point data:', error);
          this.snackBar.open('Hiba történt az adatok betöltése során', 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
          });
          return of(null);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((data) => {
        if (data) {
          this.measurementPointData = data;
          this.updateMeasurementPointFields();
        }
      });
  }

  /**
   * Updates the form with measurement point data from the API
   */
  private updateMeasurementPointFields(): void {
    if (!this.measurementPointData) return;

    // Update the measurement point fields in the form
    this.form.patchValue({
      name: this.measurementPointData.name || '',
      measurementPointExternalId: this.measurementPointData.identifier || '',
      parentMeasurementPoint: this.measurementPointData.parentMeasurementPoint?.entityDisplayName || '',
    });
  }

  // Form controls getter for easy access in template
  get fc(): Record<string, AbstractControl> {
    return this.form.controls;
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, OnChanges, SimpleChanges, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private translate: TranslateService,
    private deviceService: DevicesService,
    private iotDataImportService: IoTDataImportService,
    public activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    // if (changes.orgUnitBaseId && !changes.orgUnitBaseId.firstChange) {
    // }

    // If measurementPointId or isActive change, reload devices
    if (
      (changes.measurementPointId && !changes.measurementPointId.firstChange) ||
      (changes.isActive && !changes.isActive.firstChange)
    ) {
      this.loadDevices();
    }
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Try to extract the orgUnitBaseId from the URL if not provided via Input
    if (!this.orgUnitBaseId) {
      const urlSegments = this.router.url.split('/');

      // Look for orgUnitBaseId in URL segments
      for (let i = 0; i < urlSegments.length; i++) {
        if (urlSegments[i] === 'edit' && i < urlSegments.length - 1) {
          const possibleOrgUnitBaseId = parseInt(urlSegments[i + 1]);
          if (!isNaN(possibleOrgUnitBaseId)) {
            this._orgUnitBaseId = possibleOrgUnitBaseId;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    this.loadDevices();

    // Setup row click handler to load channels
    this.deviceDataTable.addClickCallback((row: DeviceListItemDto) => {
      if (row.id === this.selectedDevice?.id) {
        this.selectedDevice = undefined;
        this.channelData.items = [];
        this.channelData.recordsTotal = 0;
        if (this.channelDataTable) {
          this.channelDataTable.refresh();
        }

      } else {
        this.selectedDevice = row;
        this.loadChannels(row.id!);
      }
    });
  }


  loadDevices(): void {
    if (!this.measurementPointId) {
      console.warn('No measurement point ID provided, skipping device load');
      this.data.items = [];
      this.data.recordsTotal = 0;
      if (this.deviceDataTable) {
        this.deviceDataTable.refresh();
      }
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;
    // Load devices by measurement point ID
    this.deviceService.measurementPointsGetDevicesByMeasurementPoint(this.measurementPointId, this.isActive).subscribe(
      (devices) => {
        this.data.items = devices;
        this.data.recordsTotal = devices.length;
        if (this.deviceDataTable) {
          this.deviceDataTable.refresh();
        }

        // Clear selected device and channels when loading new data
        this.selectedDevice = undefined;
        this.channelData.items = [];
        this.channelData.recordsTotal = 0;
        this.isLoading = false;
      },
      (error) => {
        console.error('Error loading devices:', error);
        this.isLoading = false;
        this.data.items = [];
        this.data.recordsTotal = 0;
        if (this.deviceDataTable) {
          this.deviceDataTable.refresh();
        }
      },
    );
  }

  loadChannels(deviceId: number): void {
    if (!deviceId) {
      console.warn('No device ID provided, skipping channel load');
      this.channelData.items = [];
      this.channelData.recordsTotal = 0;
      if (this.channelDataTable) {
        this.channelDataTable.refresh();
      }
      return;
    }

    // Get the device identifier first, then load channels
    this.deviceService.measurementPointsGetChannelsByDeviceId(deviceId).subscribe(
      (channels) => {
        this.channelData.items = channels;
        this.channelData.recordsTotal = channels.length;
        if (this.channelDataTable) {
          this.channelDataTable.refresh();
        }
      },
      () => {
        // Error handling for channel loading
        this.channelData.items = [];
        this.channelData.recordsTotal = 0;
        if (this.channelDataTable) {
          this.channelDataTable.refresh();
        }
      },
    );
  }

  // Navigate to device edit page
  editDevice(device: DeviceListItemDto): void {
    // Use the exact same navigation pattern as the parent component
    // Looking at the route definition: 'measurement-points-device/:id/edit/:orgunitBaseId/:measurementPointId'
    // Note that when using string literals in router.navigate, we must put the entire path in one segment
    this.router.navigate([
      `/partner/measurement-points-device/${device.id}/edit/${this.orgUnitBaseId || 0}/${this.measurementPointId || 0}`,
    ]);
  }

  importData(device: DeviceListItemDto): void {

    const config = new MatDialogConfig();

    config.disableClose = true;
    config.autoFocus = true;
    config.panelClass = "app-dialog-container";
    config.data = {
      deviceIdentifier: device.identifier,
      timeUnit:AggregationLevelDisplayName[0],
      unit: Unit.W,
    } as UploadIoTDataImportRequest;


    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ImportIoTDataDialogComponent, config);

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe({
      next: (res: any) => {
        if (res) {
          openNotificationDetailDialog(
            this.dialog,
            "Dokumentum feltöltve",
            "A feltöltést megkezdtük! Az adatok importálása eltarthat egy ideig. Az importálás állapotát, illetve eredményét a Mérési pont adatlap 'Adatimportok' listában tekintheti meg!",
          ).subscribe({
            next: () => {
             if(this.importsList){
              this.importsList.getItems();
              this.scrolltoImport();
             }

            },
            error: (error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
              //console.log(error);
            }
          });
        }
      },
      error: (error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        //console.log(error);
      }
    });

    // this.router.navigate([`/partner/measurement-points-device/${device.id}/import/${this.orgUnitBaseId || 0}/${this.measurementPointId || 0}`]);
  }

  scrolltoImport() {
    const importsElement = document.getElementById('imports');
    if (importsElement) {
      importsElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }
  }
  importListChanged() {
  
  }

  delay(time: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, time));
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, OnDestroy, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, Subscription, of } from 'rxjs';
import { catchError, finalize } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';

import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';

@Component({

export class PartnerMeasurementPointListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;

        {

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    protected activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private navbarService: NavbarService,
    private measurementPointsService: MeasurementPointsService,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
    protected _snackBar: MatSnackBar,
    protected dialog: MatDialog
  ) { 
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.rootPath = 'partner/measurement-points';
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    // Get orgUnitId from route if available
    this.orgUnitId = +activatedRoute.snapshot.paramMap.get('orgUnitId')!;
    this.currentUrl = this.router.url;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
    this.setNavbarButton();
    this.getMeasurementPoints();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    if (this.subs) {
      this.subs.unsubscribe();
    }
  }

  protected getMeasurementPoints(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;

    // Convert MatSort direction to API SortDirection
    const apiSortDir: ApiSortDirection =
      this.sortDirection === 'asc' ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    const subscription = this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetPagedMeasurementPoints(
        this.orgUnitId,
        undefined, // name
        this.pageIndex,
        this.pageSize,
        this.sortActive,
        apiSortDir,
        false, // isDeleted
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.measurementPoints = result;
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error('Hiba adatok lekérésekor:', error);
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });

    // Add subscription to the collection for proper cleanup
    if (subscription) {
      this.subs.add(subscription);
    }
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`${this.rootPath}/${element.id}/view/${this.orgUnitId}`], {
      state: { returnUrl: this.sourceUrl || this.currentUrl },
    });
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`${this.rootPath}/${element.id}/edit/${this.orgUnitId}`], {
      state: { returnUrl: this.sourceUrl || this.currentUrl },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Deletes a measurement point after confirmation
   * @param element The measurement point to delete
   */
  deleteRow(element: any): void {
    // Get translation keys for confirmation dialog
    const confirmTitle = this.translateService.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.DELETE_CONFIRMATION');
    const confirmMessage = this.translateService.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.DELETE_CONFIRMATION');
    const confirmYes = this.translateService.instant('COMMON.YES');
    const confirmNo = this.translateService.instant('COMMON.NO');

    // Show confirmation dialog
    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, {
      width: '400px',
      data: { title: confirmTitle, message: confirmMessage, yes: confirmYes, no: confirmNo }
    });

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe(result => {
      if (result) {
        // User confirmed the deletion
        this.isLoading = true;
        this.measurementPointsService.measurementPointsDelete(element.id)
          .pipe(
            finalize(() => this.isLoading = false),
            catchError(error => {
              const errorMessage = error.error?.title || this.translateService.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.DELETE_ERROR_MSG');
              this._snackBar.open(errorMessage, 
                this.translateService.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'), {
                duration: 3000,
                panelClass: ['error-snackbar']
              });
              return of(null);
            })
          )
          .subscribe(response => {
            if (response) { 
              this._snackBar.open(this.translateService.instant('MEASUREMENT_POINT.DELETE_SUCCESS_MSG'), 
              this.translateService.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'), {
              duration: 3000,
              panelClass: ['success-snackbar']
            });
            
            // Refresh the list
            this.getMeasurementPoints();
            }
          });
      }
    });
  }

  addNew() {
    this.router.navigate([`${this.rootPath}/new/${this.orgUnitId}`], {
      state: { returnUrl: this.currentUrl },
    });
  }

  refreshChange(element: boolean) {
    if (element) {
      this.needRefresh = false;
      this.getMeasurementPoints();
    }
  }

  private setNavbarButton() {
    this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonVisibility(true);
    this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonText('PARTNERS.MEASUREMENT_POINTS.LIST.ACTIONS.ADD_NEW');

    // Subscribe to the navbarButton$ Observable (not the navbarButtonClicked method)
    const clickSubscription = this.navbarService.navbarButton$.subscribe(() => {
      this.addNew();
    });

    if (clickSubscription) {
      this.subs.add(clickSubscription);
    }
  }

  formatUtilityType(value: UtilityType): string {
    switch (value) {
      case UtilityType.ElectricPower:
        return 'MEASUREMENT_POINT.UTILITY_TYPE.ElectricPower';
      case UtilityType.HydroelectricPower:
        return 'MEASUREMENT_POINT.UTILITY_TYPE.HydroelectricPower';
      case UtilityType.NaturalGasEnergy:
        return 'MEASUREMENT_POINT.UTILITY_TYPE.NaturalGasEnergy';
      default:
        return 'MEASUREMENT_POINT.UTILITY_TYPE.Undefined';
    }
  }

  // Override the abstract method from FormComponentBase
  public setBreadcrumbs() {
    // Set appropriate breadcrumbs
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.breadcrumbService.push({
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.MEASUREMENT_POINTS.LIST.TITLE',
      path: this.currentUrl || '',
      stateInfo: {},
    });
  }


}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, ViewChild, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { OrgunitType, MeasurementPointsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { FormControl } from '@angular/forms';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-orgunit-edm-device-list',
  templateUrl: './partner-orgunit-edm-device-list.component.html',
})
export class PartnerOrgUnitEdmDevicesListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  @Input() orgUnitId?: number;
  @Input() orgUnitType?: OrgunitType;

  needRefresh = false;

  isLoading = false;

  activeOnlyFilter = new FormControl(false);

  edmDevices?: IDataTableResponse;

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'podID',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.EDM_DEVICES.LIST.POD_ID',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'serialNumber',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.EDM_DEVICES.LIST.SERIAL_NUMBER',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'deviceType',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.EDM_DEVICES.LIST.DEVICE_TYPE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'installationDate',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.EDM_DEVICES.LIST.INSTALLATION_DATE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'removalDate',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.EDM_DEVICES.LIST.REMOVAL_DATE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'measurementDescriptors',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.EDM_DEVICES.LIST.MEASUREMENT_DESCRIPTORS',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private measurementPointsService: MeasurementPointsService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
    if (this.orgUnitId) {
      this.getEdmDevices();
    } else {
      console.warn('Missing required inputs: orgUnitId');
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
  }

  refreshChange() {
    this.getEdmDevices();
  }

  getEdmDevices(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    if (this.orgUnitId) {
      const serviceCall = this.measurementPointsService.measurementPointsGetEdmDevicesByOrgunitBaseId(
        this.orgUnitId,
        this.activeOnlyFilter.value!,
      );

      serviceCall.subscribe({
        next: (data) => {
          const tableData = {
            items: [...data],
            recordsTotal: data.length,
            recordsFiltered: data.length,
          };
          this.edmDevices = tableData;
          this.isLoading = false;
          this.dataDataTable.refresh();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });
    }
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit, ViewChild, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection, IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { PartnersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/partners.service';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { PartnerListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/partnerListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { MatDatatableComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable.component';
import { MaintainerEntityDtoEntityRef, MaintainersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partners',
  templateUrl: './partners.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partners.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnersComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableComponent;

  protected dialog: MatDialog;
  private subs = new Subscription();
  maintainers: MaintainerEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];

  searchForm = this.fb.group({
    nameFilter: [],
    maintainerFilter: [null],
    headquartersFilter: [],
  });

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'name',
      displayName: 'Intézményfenntartó neve',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'maintainer',
      displayName: 'Központi fenntartó',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'headquarters',
      displayName: 'Székhely',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'tenantStatus',
      displayName: 'Státusz',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private partnerService: PartnersService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private maintainersService: MaintainersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    this.rootPath = 'partners';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadMaintainers();
  }

  loadMaintainers() {
    this.maintainersService.maintainersGetMaintainersEntityRef().subscribe((res) => {
      console.log(res);
      this.maintainers = res;
    });
  }
  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`./${element.id}/edit`], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`./${element.id}/edit`], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan inaktiválni kívánja a '${element.name}' intézményfenntartót?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.partnerService.partnersDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => this.dataDataTable!.refreshEvent());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  addNew() {
    this.router.navigate([`./new`], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }

  getPartners(params: IDataTableRequest) {
    let sortDirection = ApiSortDirection.Ascending;
    switch (params.sortDirection) {
      case DTSortDirection.Ascending:
        sortDirection = ApiSortDirection.Ascending;
        break;
      case DTSortDirection.Descending:
        sortDirection = ApiSortDirection.Descending;
        break;
    }

    return this.partnerService.partnersGetPartners(
      this.sfc.nameFilter?.value?.id,
      this.sfc.maintainerFilter?.value?.id,
      this.sfc.headquartersFilter?.value?.id,
      params.pageIndex,
      params.pageSize,
      params.sortColumn,
      sortDirection,
    );
  }
}
