import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, ViewChild, ViewChildren, QueryList, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatTabGroup } from '@angular/material/tabs';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import {
  BuildingPartModel,
  BuildingPartsService,
  BuildingPartValidityEntityDto,
  MeasurementPointsService,
  PeakValueCardDetailsModel,
  TenantStatus,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import { EmitService } from 'src/app/core/services/emit.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-part-details-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-part-details-edit.component.html',
  styleUrl: './partner-building-part-details-edit.component.scss',
  providers: [EmitService],
})
export class PartnerBuildingPartDetailsEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() buildingPartId: number;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];

  // Tab indices for each tab group
  tabSelectedIndex = 0; // Keeping for backwards compatibility
  tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroup2SelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroup3SelectedIndex = 0;
  validityTabSelectedIndex = 0;

  isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne: boolean = false;

  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantCode?: string;
  isAddingNewValidity = false;
  activeEditingValidityId: number | null = null;
  buildingPart?: BuildingPartModel;
  buildingPartValidities: BuildingPartValidityEntityDto[] = [];
  returnUrl?: string;
  sourceUrl?: string;

  measurementPointCards: PeakValueCardDetailsModel[] = [];

  @ViewChildren(MatTabGroup) tabGroups?: QueryList<MatTabGroup>;
  @ViewChild(MatTabGroup) tabGroup?: MatTabGroup;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private buildingPartsService: BuildingPartsService,
    private measurementPointService: MeasurementPointsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private location: Location,
    private emitService: EmitService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.rootPath = 'partner/buildingparts';

    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
    this.buildingPartValidities = [];
    this.buildingPartId = +route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!;

    // Check for navigation state that might contain a return URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.returnUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }

    // If we don't have a returnUrl from state, try to get it from browser history
    if (!this.returnUrl) {
      const previousUrl = this.location.path();
      // Check if we came from a building details page
      if (previousUrl.includes('/partner/buildings/')) {
        this.sourceUrl = previousUrl;
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    super.ngOnInit();
    this.loadBuildingPartValidities();
    this.loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards();
  }

  private loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards() {
    if (this.buildingPartId) {
      this.measurementPointService.measurementPointsGetOrgunitPeakValueCards(this.buildingPartId).subscribe({
        next: (cardData) => {
          this.measurementPointCards = cardData;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private loadBuildingPartValidities() {
    if (this.buildingPartId) {
      this.isLoading = true;
      this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsGetById(this.buildingPartId).subscribe({
        next: (buildingPart) => {
          this.buildingPart = buildingPart;
          this.buildingPartValidities = buildingPart.buildingPartValidities || [];
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: () => {
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  addNewValidity() {
    const lastValidity = this.buildingPartValidities[this.buildingPartValidities.length - 1];
    let validFromDate = new Date();

    if (lastValidity && lastValidity.validTo) {
      // Parse the validTo date string and add one day
      validFromDate = new Date(lastValidity.validTo);
      validFromDate.setDate(validFromDate.getDate() + 1);
    }

    const newValidity: any /*BuildingPartValidityEntityDto */ = {
      buildingPart: { id: this.buildingPartId },
      id: 0,
      name: lastValidity?.name ? lastValidity.name : '',
      validFrom: validFromDate,
      validTo: null,
      businessIdentifier: lastValidity?.businessIdentifier ? lastValidity.businessIdentifier : '',
      eMail: lastValidity?.eMail ? lastValidity.eMail : '',
      telephone: lastValidity?.telephone ? lastValidity.telephone : '',
      contactPersonName: lastValidity?.contactPersonName ? lastValidity.contactPersonName : '',
      contactPerson: lastValidity?.contactPerson ? lastValidity.contactPerson : null,
      lat: lastValidity?.lat ? lastValidity.lat : null,
      lon: lastValidity?.lon ? lastValidity.lon : null,
    };
    this.buildingPartValidities = [...this.buildingPartValidities, newValidity];
    this.isAddingNewValidity = true;
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 1; // Switch to validities tab
    this.validityTabSelectedIndex = this.buildingPartValidities.length - 1; // Select the newly added validity
  }

  // Handle navigation based on available information
  private navigateBack(): void {
    // First, try to use the returnUrl from state if available
    if (this.returnUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.returnUrl);
      return;
    }

    // If we have a sourceUrl, use that
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.sourceUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Default fallback to building parts list
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/buildingparts']);
  }

  onBaseDataSaved() {}

  onBaseDataCancelled() {
    this.navigateBack();
  }

  onBaseDataEditStarted() {}

  onBaseDataDeleted() {
    this.navigateBack();
  }

  onValiditySaved() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadBuildingPartValidities();
  }

  onValidityCancelled() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadBuildingPartValidities();
  }

  onValidityEditStarted(validityId: number) {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = validityId;
  }

  onValidityDeleted(validityId: number) {
    this.buildingPartValidities = this.buildingPartValidities.filter((v) => v.id !== validityId);
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadBuildingPartValidities();
  }

  onTabGroup1Change(selectedIndex: number): void {
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
    if (selectedIndex == 1 && !this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne) {
      this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne = true;
      this.emitService.emit();
    }
  }

  onPodSaved() {
    // Refresh data if needed after pod is saved
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, Output, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { modifyBuildingPartRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/buildingpart/modifyBuildingPartRequestForm';
import {
  BuildingPartModel,
  BuildingPartsService,
  OrgunitType,
  TenantStatus,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-part-details-edit-base-data',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-part-details-edit-base-data.component.html',
  styleUrl: './partner-building-part-details-edit-base-data.component.scss',
})
export class PartnerBuildingPartDetailsEditBaseDataComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() buildingPart?: BuildingPartModel;
  @Input() buildingPartId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  @Input() isNew = false;
  @Input() isEditDisabled = false;
  public identifier?: string;

  @Output() baseDataSaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() baseDataCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() baseDataEditStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() baseDataDeleted = new EventEmitter<number>();

  isLoading = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;

  private orgUnitTypeMapping = [
    OrgunitType.Institution,
    OrgunitType.Site,
    OrgunitType.Building,
    OrgunitType.BuildingPart,
    OrgunitType.Floor,
    OrgunitType.Room
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private buildingPartsService: BuildingPartsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(modifyBuildingPartRequestForm.get());

    this.form.disable();

    if (this.buildingPart && this.form) {
      this.form.patchValue(this.buildingPart);
      this.form.get('type')?.setValue(this.buildingPart.orgunitType);
      this.identifier = this.buildingPart.identifier;
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  delete() {
    this.form.disable();

    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.BUILDING_PARTS.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsDelete(this.buildingPartId!).subscribe(() => {
            this.baseDataDeleted.emit();
          });
        }
      },
    );
  }

  // Helper method to convert OrgUnitType string to index
  private getOrgUnitTypeIndex(orgUnitType: OrgunitType): number {
    return this.orgUnitTypeMapping.findIndex((type) => type === orgUnitType);
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, Output, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createOrUpdateBuildingPartValidityRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/buildingpart/createOrUpdateBuildingPartValidityRequestForm';
import {
  BuildingPartValidityEntityDto,
  BuildingPartsService,
  SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef,
  TenantStatus,
  UsersService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-part-details-edit-validity',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-part-details-edit-validity.component.html',
  styleUrl: './partner-building-part-details-edit-validity.component.scss',
})
export class PartnerBuildingPartDetailsEditValidityComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() validity?: BuildingPartValidityEntityDto;
  @Input() buildingPartId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  @Input() isNew = false;
  @Input() isEditDisabled = false;

  @Output() validitySaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() validityCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() editStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() validityDeleted = new EventEmitter<number>();

  public pageMode?: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  validityId?: number;
  users?: Observable<SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  email: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  phone: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private buildingPartsService: BuildingPartsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private userService: UsersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createOrUpdateBuildingPartValidityRequestForm.get());
    if (this.isNew) {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.CREATE;
      this.isEdit = true;
    } else {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
      this.isEdit = false;

      this.form.disable();
    }
    if (this.validity && this.form) {
      this.validityId = this.validity.id;
      this.form.patchValue(this.validity);

      // Check if a contactPerson is initially selected and disable fields accordingly
      if (this.validity.contactPerson?.id) {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
        this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
      }
    }

    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();

    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        //this.contactmessage = null;
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
          //this.form.get('contactPerson').setValue(value);
          // Disable email and phone fields when contactPerson is selected
          this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
          this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
        //this.form.get('contactPerson').setValue(value);
        // Enable email and phone fields when no contactPerson is selected
        this.form.get('eMail')?.enable();
        this.form.get('telephone')?.enable();
      }
    });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.enable();
    this.editStarted.emit(this.validity!.id);
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    if (!this.buildingPartId) {
      this.cancel();
    } else {
      this.cancel();
      const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
      this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    const saveObservable = this.isNew
      ? this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsPostBuildingPartValidity(this.buildingPartId!, formValues)
      : this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsPutBuildingPartValidity(
          this.buildingPartId!,
          this.validityId!,
          formValues,
        );

    return new Observable((observer) => {
      saveObservable.subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.validitySaved.emit();
          observer.next(result);
          observer.complete();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          observer.error(error);
          observer.complete();
        },
      });
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
    this.validityCancelled.emit();
  }

  deleteValidity() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
    this.buildingPartsService
      .buildingPartsDeleteBuildingPartValidity(this.buildingPartId!, this.validityId!)
      .subscribe(() => {
        this.validityDeleted.emit();
      });
  }

  getLatTooltip() {
    return 'Latitude : min/max -90,0000000 to 90,0000000';
  }
  getLongTooltip() {
    return 'Longitude : min/max -180,0000000 to 180,0000000';
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createBuildingPartRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/buildingpart/createBuildingPartRequestForm';
import {
  BuildingPartsService,
  BuildingsService,
  SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef,
  BuildingEntityDtoEntityRef,
  UsersService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-part-details-new',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-part-details-new.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-building-part-details-new.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerBuildingPartDetailsNewComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  buildings?: Observable<BuildingEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  users?: Observable<SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  institution: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  site: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.BACK, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  idOfElement;
  buildingId?: number;
  sourceRoute?: string;
  returnUrl?: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private buildingPartService: BuildingPartsService,
    private buildingService: BuildingsService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private location: Location,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.idOfElement = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.id;
    this.buildingId = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.buildingId;
    this.institution.disable();
    this.site.disable();

    // Get the source route from query params
    this.activatedRoute.queryParams.subscribe((params) => {
      if (params['sourceRoute']) {
        this.sourceRoute = params['sourceRoute'];
      }
    });

    // Check for navigation state that might contain a return URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.returnUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }

    // If we don't have a returnUrl from state, try to get it from browser history
    if (!this.returnUrl) {
      const previousUrl = this.location.path();
      // Check if we came from a building details page
      if (previousUrl.includes('/partner/buildings/')) {
        this.returnUrl = previousUrl;
      }
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createBuildingPartRequestForm.get());
    this.edit();
    this.getBuildings();
    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();
    this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
      }
    });

    this.form.get('building')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        this.buildingService.buildingGetBuildingParentsEntityRefModelById(value.id).subscribe((result) => {
          this.institution.setValue(result.institution?.entityDisplayName);
          this.site.setValue(result.site?.entityDisplayName);
        });
      } else {
        this.institution.setValue(null);
        this.site.setValue(null);
      }
    });

    if (this.buildingId) {
      this.buildingService.buildingGetBuildingParentsEntityRefModelById(this.buildingId).subscribe((building) => {
        this.institution.setValue(building.institution?.entityDisplayName);
        this.site.setValue(building.site?.entityDisplayName);
        this.form.get('building')?.setValue(building.building);
      });
      this.form.get('building')?.disable();
    }
  }

  getBuildings() {
    this.buildings = this.buildingService.buildingsGetBuildingEntityRef();
  }

  save() {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    return this.buildingPartService.buildingPartsPost(formValues);
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.enable();
    this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
  }

  // Handle navigation based on available information
  private navigateBack(): void {
    // First, try to use the returnUrl from state if available
    if (this.returnUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.returnUrl);
      return;
    }

    // If we have a source route, use that
    if (this.sourceRoute) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl('/' + this.sourceRoute);
      return;
    }

    // If we have a buildingId, return to that building's details
    if (this.buildingId) {
      this.router.navigate(['/partner/buildings', this.buildingId, 'view']);
      return;
    }

    // Default fallback to building parts list
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/buildingparts']);
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.navigateBack();
    const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
    this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
      duration: 5000,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
      horizontalPosition: 'end',
      verticalPosition: 'top',
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.navigateBack();
  }

  back() {
    this.navigateBack();
  }

  getLatTooltip(): string {
    return 'Latitude coordinate (e.g. 47.497912)';
  }

  getLongTooltip(): string {
    return 'Longitude coordinate (e.g. 19.040235)';
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable.component';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection, IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

import { BuildingPartsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-part-list',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-part-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-building-part-list.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerBuildingPartListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true })
  protected dataDataTable: MatDatatableComponent | undefined;
  @Input() institutionId: number | undefined;
  @Input() siteId: number | undefined;
  @Input() buildingId: number | undefined;

  protected dialog: MatDialog;

  // Navigation properties
  sourceUrl: string | undefined;
  currentUrl: string | undefined;

  //todo add searchForminit
  searchForm = this.fb.group({
    nameFilter: [null],
    institutionFilter: [null],
    siteFilter: [null],
    buildingFilter: [null],
    addressFilter: [null],
    active: [{ id: true, name: 'Aktív' }],
  });

  activeOptions = [
    { id: true, name: 'Aktív' },
    { id: false, name: 'Inaktív' },
  ];

  private subs = new Subscription();

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'name',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.BUILDING_PARTS.LIST.NAME_FULL',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'institutionName',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.BUILDING_PARTS.LIST.INSTITUTION',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'siteName',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.BUILDING_PARTS.LIST.SITE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'buildingName',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.BUILDING_PARTS.LIST.BUILDING',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'isDeleted',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.BUILDING_PARTS.LIST.STATUS',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private buildingPartsService: BuildingPartsService,
    private location: Location,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    this.rootPath = 'partner/buildingparts';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    // Store current URL for navigation context
    this.currentUrl = this.location.path();

    // If we're embedded within a building view, save that as the source URL
    if (this.buildingId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/buildings/${this.buildingId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a building edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/buildings/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/sites/${this.siteId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a site edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/sites/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    }

    // Check navigation state for source URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      this.sourceUrl = navigation.extras.state['sourceUrl'] || this.sourceUrl;
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/buildingparts/${element.id}/view`]);
  }
  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/buildingparts/${element.id}/edit`]);
  }
  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.BUILDING_PARTS.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => this.dataDataTable!.refreshEvent());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  addNew() {
    if (this.buildingId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/buildingparts/new/${this.buildingId}`]);
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/buildingparts/new/${this.siteId}`]);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['partner/buildingparts/new']);
    }
  }

  // Navigate back to the source URL if available
  goBack() {
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.sourceUrl);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['/partner/buildingparts']);
    }
  }

  getBuildingParts(params: IDataTableRequest) {
    let apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      params.sortDirection == DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    if (this.buildingId) {
      return this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsGetBuildingParts(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        this.buildingId,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
        false,
      );
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      return this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsGetBuildingParts(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        this.siteId,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else if (this.institutionId) {
      return this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsGetBuildingParts(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.institutionId,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else {
      return this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsGetBuildingParts(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    }
  }

  shouldShowAddButton(): boolean {
    // Show if all IDs are null or if buildingId has a value
    return (!this.institutionId && !this.siteId && !this.buildingId) || !!this.buildingId;
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, ViewChild, ViewChildren, QueryList, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatTabGroup } from '@angular/material/tabs';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { number } from 'echarts';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import {
  AddressEntityDto,
  AddressType,
  BuildingModel,
  BuildingsService,
  BuildingValidityEntityDto,
  MeasurementPointsService,
  OrgunitType,
  PeakValueCardDetailsModel,
  TenantStatus,
  //generikusság miatt lett ez a generált type név
  RoomValidityEntityDtoRoomValidityWarningContextEntityWarningModelBase as RoomValidityWarning,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { EmitService } from 'src/app/core/services/emit.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ConfirmDialogComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
//import { ErrorDetailDialogComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/error-detail-dialog/error-detail-dialog.component';

//import { SuccessDialogComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/data-import/success-dialog/success-dialog.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-details-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-details-edit.component.html',
  styleUrl: './partner-building-details-edit.component.scss',
  providers: [EmitService],
})
export class PartnerBuildingDetailsEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() buildingId: number;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];

  // Tab indices for each tab group
  tabSelectedIndex = 0; // Keeping for backwards compatibility
  tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroup2SelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroup3SelectedIndex = 0;
  validityTabSelectedIndex = 0;

  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-inferrable-types
  isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne: boolean = false;
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-inferrable-types
  isNewValidity: boolean = false;

  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantCode?: string;
  isAddingNewValidity = false;
  activeEditingValidityId: number | null = null;
  building?: BuildingModel;
  buildingValidities: BuildingValidityEntityDto[] = [];
  orgUnitType: OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Building;
  currentUrl: string;
  roomValidtyWarnings: RoomValidityWarning[];

  measurementPointCards: PeakValueCardDetailsModel[] = [];

  @ViewChildren(MatTabGroup) tabGroups?: QueryList<MatTabGroup>;
  @ViewChild(MatTabGroup) tabGroup?: MatTabGroup;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private buildingsService: BuildingsService,
    private measurementPointService: MeasurementPointsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private emitService: EmitService,
    private translate: TranslateService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.rootPath = 'partner/buildings';

    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
    this.buildingValidities = [];
    this.buildingId = +route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!;
    this.currentUrl = this.router.url;
    this.roomValidtyWarnings = [];
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    super.ngOnInit();
    this.loadBuildingValidities();
    this.loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards();
    //this.loadRoomValidityWarnings();
  }

  private loadBuildingValidities() {
    if (this.buildingId) {
      this.isLoading = true;
      this.buildingsService.buildingsGetBuildingById(this.buildingId).subscribe({
        next: (building) => {
          this.building = building;
          this.buildingValidities = building.buildingValidities || [];
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: () => {
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  /*
  export interface MatDialogData {
  message?: string;
  confirmButtonText?: string;
  cancelButtonText?: string;
  isDelete?: boolean;
  showConfirmButton?: boolean;
  showCancelBtn?: boolean;
}
*/

  private loadRoomValidityWarnings() {
    // uj hozzáadásakor minden esetben jelenjen meg.
    if (this.activeEditingValidityId == null) {
      //this.ShowWarningDialog();
      return;
    }
    if (this.buildingId) {
      const activeValidityId = this.activeEditingValidityId;
      this.buildingsService.getRoomValidtyWarnings(activeValidityId).subscribe({
        next: (data) => {
          this.roomValidtyWarnings = data;
          if (this.roomValidtyWarnings.length === 0) return;
          this.ShowWarningDialog();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards() {
    if (this.buildingId) {
      this.measurementPointService.measurementPointsGetOrgunitPeakValueCards(this.buildingId).subscribe({
        next: (cardData) => {
          this.measurementPointCards = cardData;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  addNewValidity() {
    const lastValidity = this.buildingValidities[this.buildingValidities.length - 1];
    let validFromDate = new Date();

    if (lastValidity && lastValidity.validTo) {
      // Parse the validTo date string and add one day
      validFromDate = new Date(lastValidity.validTo);
      validFromDate.setDate(validFromDate.getDate() + 1);
    }

    const newValidity: any /*BuildingValidityEntityDto */ = {
      building: { id: this.buildingId },
      id: 0,
      name: lastValidity?.name ? lastValidity.name : '',
      validFrom: validFromDate,
      validTo: null,
      address: lastValidity?.address
        ? lastValidity.address
        : ({
            addressType: AddressType.NotDefined,
            address: '',
            city: '',
            country: '',
            postalCode: '',
            region: '',
          } as AddressEntityDto),
      businessIdentifier: lastValidity?.businessIdentifier ? lastValidity.businessIdentifier : '',
      eMail: lastValidity?.eMail ? lastValidity.eMail : '',
      telephone: lastValidity?.telephone ? lastValidity.telephone : '',
      contactPersonName: lastValidity?.contactPersonName ? lastValidity.contactPersonName : '',
      contactPerson: lastValidity?.contactPerson ? lastValidity.contactPerson : null,
      lat: lastValidity?.lat ? lastValidity.lat : null,
      lon: lastValidity?.lon ? lastValidity.lon : null,
      buildingProfile: lastValidity?.buildingProfile ? lastValidity.buildingProfile : null,
    };
    this.buildingValidities = [...this.buildingValidities, newValidity];
    this.isAddingNewValidity = true;
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 1; // Switch to validities tab
    this.validityTabSelectedIndex = this.buildingValidities.length - 1; // Select the newly added validity
    this.isNewValidity = true;
  }

  onBaseDataSaved() {}

  onBaseDataCancelled() {}

  onBaseDataEditStarted() {}

  onBaseDataDeleted() {
    // Navigate with state to preserve the current route for potential back navigation
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/buildings'], {
      state: {
        fromBuildingEdit: true,
        returnUrl: this.currentUrl,
      },
    });
  }

  onPodSaved() {}

  onValiditySaved() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.loadRoomValidityWarnings();
    this.loadBuildingValidities();
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
  }

  onValidityCancelled() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadBuildingValidities();
  }

  onValidityEditStarted(validityId: number) {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = validityId;
  }

  onTabGroup1Change(selectedIndex: number): void {
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
    if (selectedIndex == 1 && !this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne) {
      this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne = true;
      this.emitService.emit();
    }
  }

  onValidityDeleted(validityId: number) {
    this.buildingValidities = this.buildingValidities.filter((v) => v.id !== validityId);
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadBuildingValidities();
  }

  // Helper method to navigate to new building from this component with proper state
  navigateToNewBuilding() {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/buildings/new'], {
      queryParams: { sourceRoute: this.currentUrl.replace(/^\//, '') },
      state: { returnUrl: this.currentUrl },
    });
  }
  private ShowWarningDialog() {
    this.translate.get('WARNING.BUILDING_VALIDITY').subscribe((translatedText: string) => {
      this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, {
        width: '450px',
        data: { message: translatedText, cancelButtonText: 'Rendben', showCancelBtn: true, showConfirmButton: false },
      });
    });
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, Output, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { modifyBuildingRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/building/modifyBuildingRequestForm';
import { BuildingModel, BuildingsService, OrgunitType, TenantStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-details-edit-base-data',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-details-edit-base-data.component.html',
  styleUrl: './partner-building-details-edit-base-data.component.scss',
})
export class PartnerBuildingDetailsEditBaseDataComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() building?: BuildingModel;
  @Input() buildingId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  @Input() isNew = false;
  @Input() isEditDisabled = false;
  public identifier?: string;

  @Output() baseDataSaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() baseDataCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() baseDataEditStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() baseDataDeleted = new EventEmitter<number>();

  isLoading = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;

  private orgUnitTypeMapping = [
    OrgunitType.Institution,
    OrgunitType.Site,
    OrgunitType.Building,
    OrgunitType.BuildingPart,
    OrgunitType.Floor,
    OrgunitType.Room
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private buildingsService: BuildingsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(modifyBuildingRequestForm.get());

    this.form.disable();

    if (this.building && this.form) {
      this.form.patchValue(this.building);

      // Keep the original orgunitType value
      this.form.get('type')?.setValue(this.building.orgunitType);

      this.identifier = this.building.identifier;
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  delete() {
    this.form.disable();

    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.BUILDINGS.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.buildingsService.buildingsDelete(this.buildingId!).subscribe(() => {
          this.baseDataDeleted.emit();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // Helper method to convert OrgUnitType string to index
  private getOrgUnitTypeIndex(orgUnitType: OrgunitType): number {
    return this.orgUnitTypeMapping.findIndex((type) => type === orgUnitType);
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\partners\partners-buildings\partner-building-details\partner-building-details-edit\partner-building-details-edit-validity\partner-building-details-edit-validity.component.ts
====================================================================================================

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, Output, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createOrUpdateBuildingValidityRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/building/createOrUpdateBuildingValidityRequestForm';
import {
  BuildingValidityEntityDto,
  BuildingsService,
  DictService,
  SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef,
  TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef,
  TenantStatus,
  UsersService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import moment from 'moment';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-details-edit-validity',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-details-edit-validity.component.html',
  styleUrl: './partner-building-details-edit-validity.component.scss',
})
export class PartnerBuildingDetailsEditValidityComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() validity?: BuildingValidityEntityDto;
  @Input() buildingId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  @Input() isNew = false;
  @Input() isEditDisabled = false;

  @Output() validitySaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() validityCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() editStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() validityDeleted = new EventEmitter<number>();

  public pageMode?: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  validityId?: number;
  users?: Observable<SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  buildingProfiles?: Observable<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private buildingsService: BuildingsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private dictService: DictService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createOrUpdateBuildingValidityRequestForm.get());

    if (this.isNew) {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.CREATE;
      this.isEdit = true;
    } else {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
      this.isEdit = false;

      this.form.disable();
    }
    if (this.validity && this.form) {
      this.validityId = this.validity.id;
      this.form.patchValue(this.validity);

      // Check if a contactPerson is initially selected and disable fields accordingly
      if (this.validity.contactPerson?.id) {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
        this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
      }
    }

    // Get users for select input
    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();

    // Get building profiles from dictionary service
    this.buildingProfiles = this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('building_profile');

    this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();

    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
      }
    });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.get('address')?.enable();
    this.form.enable();
    this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
    this.editStarted.emit(this.validity!.id);
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    if (!this.buildingId) {
      this.cancel();
    } else {
      this.cancel();
      const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
      this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const formValue = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValue.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValue.validFrom = moment(formValue.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValue.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValue.validTo = moment(formValue.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    const saveObservable = this.isNew
      ? this.buildingsService.buildingsPostBuildingValidity(this.buildingId!, formValue)
      : this.buildingsService.buildingsPutBuildingValidity(this.buildingId!, this.validityId!, formValue);

    return new Observable((observer) => {
      saveObservable.subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.validitySaved.emit();
          observer.next(result);
          observer.complete();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          observer.error(error);
          observer.complete();
        },
      });
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.get('address')?.disable();
    this.form.disable();
    this.validityCancelled.emit();
  }

  deleteValidity() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.get('address')?.disable();
    this.form.disable();
    this.buildingsService.buildingsDeleteBuildingValidity(this.buildingId!, this.validityId!).subscribe(() => {
      this.validityDeleted.emit();
    });
  }

  getLatTooltip() {
    return 'Latitude : min/max -90,0000000 to 90,0000000';
  }
  getLongTooltip() {
    return 'Longitude : min/max -180,0000000 to 180,0000000';
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit, Input, Injector } from '@angular/core';
import { FormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { BuildingsService, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto, EnergyConsumptionDevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';

// Date option interface
export interface DateOption {
  displayName: string;
  date: Date;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-details-energy-consumption-device',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-details-energy-consumption-device.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-building-details-energy-consumption-device.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerBuildingDetailsEnergyConsumptionDeviceComponent implements OnInit {
  /**
   * OrgunitId
   */
  @Input() orgunitId?: number;

  devices: EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto[] = [];

  dateControl = new FormControl();
  availableDates: DateOption[] = [];
  selectedDate?: Date;
  selectedDateIsoString?: string;

  isLoading = false;
  protected dialog: MatDialog;

  /**
   * Converts a Date object to ISO string format (YYYY-MM-DD) without timezone adjustments
   * @param date The date to convert
   * @returns Object containing the ISO string and a new Date object
   */
  private convertToIsoDateString(date: Date): { isoString: string; dateObject: Date } {
    // Get date components
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = date.getMonth() + 1; // Month is 0-based
    const day = date.getDate();

    // Create ISO date string manually (YYYY-MM-DD format)
    // This avoids any timezone adjustments
    const isoString = `${year}-${month.toString().padStart(2, '0')}-${day.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;

    // Create a new Date object from the ISO string
    const dateObject = new Date(isoString);

    return { isoString, dateObject };
  }

  constructor(
    private buildingService: BuildingsService, 
    private energyConsumptionDevicesService: EnergyConsumptionDevicesService, 
    private datePipe: DatePipe, 
    private router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    private apiService: EnergyConsumptionDevicesService,
  ) { 
      this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);
    }

  ngOnInit() {
    this.loadAvailableDates();
  }

  loadAvailableDates() {
    this.energyConsumptionDevicesService.energyConsumptionDevicesGetEnergyConsumptionDevicesInspectionDates(this.orgunitId!).subscribe({
      next: (response) => {
        this.availableDates = response.map((date) => ({
          displayName: this.datePipe.transform(date, 'yyyy.MM.dd.') || '',
          date: new Date(date),
        }));
        if (this.availableDates.length > 0) {
          this.dateControl.setValue(this.availableDates[0]);

          // Handle initial date using the conversion function
          const tempDate = new Date(this.availableDates[0].date);
          const { isoString, dateObject } = this.convertToIsoDateString(tempDate);

          this.selectedDateIsoString = isoString;

          this.selectedDate = dateObject;

          // Load devices for the initial date
          this.loadDevices();
        }
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error loading available dates:', error);
      },
    });
  }

  onDateChange(event: any) {
    if (event && event.value) {
      // Parse the date but maintain it exactly as specified without timezone conversion
      const tempDate = new Date(event.value.date);

      // Use the conversion function
      const { isoString, dateObject } = this.convertToIsoDateString(tempDate);

      this.selectedDateIsoString = isoString;

      // Store as Date object for any UI/display purposes
      this.selectedDate = dateObject;

      this.loadDevices();
    }
  }

  loadDevices() {
    if (!this.orgunitId || !this.selectedDateIsoString) {
      return;
    }
    this.isLoading = true;

    // Create a new Date object from the ISO string for the API
    // When creating a date without time, it will be midnight in local timezone
    const apiDate = new Date(this.selectedDateIsoString);

    this.energyConsumptionDevicesService.energyConsumptionDevicesGetEnergyConsumptionDevices(this.orgunitId, apiDate).subscribe({
      next: (response) => {
        this.devices = response;
        this.isLoading = false;
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error loading available dates:', error);
        this.isLoading = false;
      },
    });
  }

  addNewEnergyConsumptionDevice() {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/energy-consumption-device/${this.orgunitId}/create`]);
  }
  editEnergyConsumptionDevice(id: number) {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/energy-consumption-device/${id}/edit`]);
  }
  deleteEnergyConsumptionDevice(id: number) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICE.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.apiService.energyConsumptionDevicesDeleteEnergyConsumptionDevice(id).subscribe(() => {});
        }
      },
    );
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createBuildingRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/building/createBuildingRequestForm';
import {
  BuildingsService,
  DictService,
  SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef,
  SiteEntityDtoEntityRef,
  SitesService,
  TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef,
  UsersService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import moment from 'moment';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-building-details-new',
  templateUrl: './partner-building-details-new.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-building-details-new.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerBuildingDetailsNewComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  sites?: Observable<SiteEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  users?: Observable<SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  institution: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.BACK, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  idOfElement;
  siteId?: number;
  sourceRoute?: string;
  returnUrl?: string;
  previousPath?: string;
  buildingProfiles?: Observable<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private buildingService: BuildingsService,
    private siteService: SitesService,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private location: Location,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.idOfElement = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.id;
    this.siteId = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.siteId;
    this.institution.disable();
    // Get sourceRoute from query params for use in navigation
    this.activatedRoute.queryParams.subscribe((params) => {
      if (params['sourceRoute']) {
        this.sourceRoute = params['sourceRoute'];
      }
    });

    // Check navigation state for return URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.returnUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }

    // Also consider the previous URL from browser history
    this.previousPath = this.location.path();
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createBuildingRequestForm.get());
    this.edit();
    this.getSites();
    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();
    this.buildingProfiles = this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('building_profile');
    this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        //this.contactmessage = null;
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
      }
    });

    this.form.get('site')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        this.siteService.sitesGetParentsEntityRefModelById(value.id).subscribe((result) => {
          this.institution.setValue(result.institution?.entityDisplayName);
        });
      } else {
        this.institution.setValue(null);
      }
    });

    // Add required validator to site control
    this.form.get('site')?.setValidators([Validators.required]);
    this.form.get('site')?.updateValueAndValidity();

    if (this.siteId) {
      this.siteService.sitesGetParentsEntityRefModelById(this.siteId).subscribe((site) => {
        this.institution.setValue(site.institution?.entityDisplayName);
        this.form.get('site')?.setValue(site.site);
      });
      this.form.get('site')?.disable();
    }
  }

  getSites() {
    this.sites = this.siteService.sitesGetSitesEntityRef();
  }

  save() {
    // Mark all fields as touched to trigger validation
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    // Check if form is valid
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this._snackBar.open(this.translateService.instant('SNACKBAR.FILL_REQUIRE_FIELDS'), '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Error}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });
      return null;
    }

    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }
    return this.buildingService.buildingsPost(formValues);
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.get('address')?.enable();
    this.form.enable();
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
    const msg = this.translateService.instant('SNACKBAR.MODIFICATION_SAVED');
    this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
      duration: 5000,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
      horizontalPosition: 'end',
      verticalPosition: 'top',
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
  }

  back() {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
  }

  private navigateWithFallbacks(): void {
    // First check if we have a direct returnUrl
    if (this.returnUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.returnUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Then check for sourceRoute from query parameters
    if (this.sourceRoute) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl('/' + this.sourceRoute);
      return;
    }

    // Check if we came from a building view page
    if (
      this.previousPath &&
      this.previousPath.includes('/partner/buildings/') &&
      (this.previousPath.includes('/view') || this.previousPath.includes('/edit'))
    ) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.previousPath);
      return;
    }

    // Default fallback - go to buildings list
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/buildings']);
  }

  getLatTooltip(): string {
    return 'Latitude coordinate (e.g. 47.497912)';
  }

  getLongTooltip(): string {
    return 'Longitude coordinate (e.g. 19.040235)';
  }
}

import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection, IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';

    <IColumnDefinition>{
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    },
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private buildingsService: BuildingsService,
    private location: Location,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    this.rootPath = 'partner/buildings';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    // Store current URL for navigation context
    this.currentUrl = this.location.path();

    // If we're embedded within a site view, save that as the source URL
    if (this.siteId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/sites/${this.siteId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a site edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/sites/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    }

    // Check navigation state for source URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.sourceUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/buildings/${element.id}/view`]);
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/buildings/${element.id}/edit`]);
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.BUILDINGS.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.buildingsService.buildingsDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => this.dataDataTable!.refreshEvent());
      }
    });
  }

  addNew() {
    if (this.siteId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/buildings/new/${this.siteId}`]);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/buildings/new`]);
    }
  }

  // Navigate back to the source URL if available
  goBack() {
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.sourceUrl);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['/partner/buildings']);
    }
  }

  getBuildings(params: IDataTableRequest) {
    let apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      params.sortDirection == DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    if (this.siteId) {
      return this.buildingsService.buildingsGetBuildings(
        this.sfc.addressFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        this.siteId,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else if (this.institutionId) {
      return this.buildingsService.buildingsGetBuildings(
        this.sfc.addressFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        this.institutionId,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else {
      return this.buildingsService.buildingsGetBuildings(
        this.sfc.addressFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    }
  }

  shouldShowAddButton(): boolean {
    // Show if all IDs are null or if siteId has a value
    return (!this.institutionId && !this.siteId) || !!this.siteId;
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }
}
