import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormComponentBase } from '../../../../core/base/form-component-base';
import { LoaderService } from '../../../../core/services/loader.service';
import { BreadcrumbService } from '../../../../core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { EnergyContractsService } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/energyContracts.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from '../../../../core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { UntypedFormArray, UntypedFormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { openConfirmDialog } from '../../../../core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { EnergyContractType } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/energyContractType';
import { powerPurchaseAgreementForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/energycontract/powerPurchaseAgreementForm';
import { SuppliersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/suppliers.service';
import { SupplierEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/supplierEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { networkConnectionContractForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/energycontract/networkConnectionContractForm';
import { networkUsageContractForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/energycontract/networkUsageContractForm';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { AccountingMethodType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/accountingMethodType';
import { powerCapacityForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/energycontract/powerCapacityForm';
import { AddressType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/addressType';
import { PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/powerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto';
import { timeOfUseTariffForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/energycontract/timeOfUseTariffForm';
import { networkUsageFeeForm } from '../../../../core/generated/forms/energycontract/networkUsageFeeForm';
import { TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/tenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ErrorHelper } from 'src/app/core/errors/error-helper';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { first, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef, InstitutionsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-contract-editor',
  templateUrl: './contract-editor.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./contract-editor.component.scss'],
})
export class ContractEditorComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  public AddressType: typeof AddressType = AddressType;
  public readonly contractId?: number;
  public readonly energyContractType: EnergyContractType;
  public readonly EnergyContractType = EnergyContractType;

  public suppliers?: SupplierEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  public institutions?: InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  institutionId?: number;
  public currencies?: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  public accountingMethodTypes: any[];
  public days = Array(28)
    .fill(0)
    .map((e, i) => {
      return { id: i + 1, entityDisplayName: (i + 1).toString() };
    });

  public get IsTimeOfUseTariff(): boolean {
    const val = this.form.get('accountingMethodType')?.value;
    return val == AccountingMethodType.TimeOfUseTariff;
  }

  /**
   * A szerkesztőfelületen megjelenő második tabfül szövege.
   * Hálózati csatlakozási szerződés esetén: 'CSATLAKOZÁSI PONT ADATOK' legyen,
   * egyéb esetben 'ENERGIADÍJAK'.
   */
  public secondTabDisplayName: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private energyContractService: EnergyContractsService,
    private institutionService: InstitutionsService,
    private suppliersService: SuppliersService,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
    this.rootPath = '/records/contracts';
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [
      new BreadcrumbItem('Nyilvántartás', ''),
      new BreadcrumbItem('Szerződések', this.rootPath),
    ];
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    if (this.router.getCurrentNavigation()?.extras.state === undefined) {
      this.ngOnDestroy();
      this.router.navigate(['records', 'contracts']);
    }
    this.institutionId = this.router.getCurrentNavigation()?.extras.state?.institutionId;

    this.energyContractType = this.router.getCurrentNavigation()?.extras.state?.energyContractType;

    this.accountingMethodTypes = [
      { label: 'Idősoros (távmért)', value: AccountingMethodType.TimeSeries },
      { label: 'Profilos (átalány)', value: AccountingMethodType.Profiled },
      { label: 'Vezérelt (díjsávok)', value: AccountingMethodType.TimeOfUseTariff },
      { label: 'Árfolyam alapú (HUPX)', value: AccountingMethodType.ExchangeRateBased },
    ];

    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT || this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      this.contractId = parseInt(this._route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!);
    }

    // Alapértelmezett tabfül név
    this.secondTabDisplayName = this.translateService.instant('RECORDS.CONTRACT_EDITOR.ENERGY_PRICES');

    switch (this.energyContractType) {
      case EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement:
        this.form = this.formBuilder.group(powerPurchaseAgreementForm.get());
        this.form.addControl('timeOfUseTariffs', new UntypedFormArray([]));
        this.secondTabDisplayName = this.translateService.instant('RECORDS.CONTRACT_EDITOR.ENERGY_PRICES');
        break;
      case EnergyContractType.NetworkConnectionContract:
        this.form = this.formBuilder.group(networkConnectionContractForm.get());
        this.form.addControl('availableCapacity', this.formBuilder.group(powerCapacityForm.get()));
        this.form.addControl('feedInCapacity', this.formBuilder.group(powerCapacityForm.get()));
        // Második tabfül név
        this.secondTabDisplayName = this.translateService.instant('RECORDS.CONTRACT_EDITOR.CONNECTION_POINT_DATA');
        break;
      case EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract:
        this.form = this.formBuilder.group(networkUsageContractForm.get());
        this.form.addControl('networkUsageFee', this.formBuilder.group(networkUsageFeeForm.get()));
        this.secondTabDisplayName = this.translateService.instant('RECORDS.CONTRACT_EDITOR.DISTRIBUTION_FEES');
        break;
    }

    this.fc.monthlyAccountingStart.addValidators([Validators.min(1), Validators.max(28)]);

    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      this.form.disable();
    }
    if (this.contractId) this.form.get('id')?.setValue(this.contractId ?? 0);

    this.form.get('energyContractType')?.setValue(this.energyContractType);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.suppliersService.suppliersGetSuppliersEntityRef().subscribe((items) => {
      this.suppliers = items;
    });
    this.institutionService.institutionsGetInstitutionEntityRef().subscribe((items) => {
      this.institutions = items;
    });
    this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('currency').subscribe((items) => {
      this.currencies = items;
    });
    if (this.contractId) {
      this.energyContractService.energyContractsGetEnergyContract(this.contractId).subscribe((energyContract) => {
        if (energyContract.energyContractType == EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement) {
          this.setTimeOfUseTariffControlValue(energyContract as PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto);
        }
        energyContract.monthlyAccountingStart = this.days.find(
          (x) => x.id == energyContract.monthlyAccountingStart,
        )!.id;
        this.form.setValue(energyContract);

        if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
          this.form.disable();
        }
      });
    }

    if (this.institutionId) {
      this.institutionService.institutionsGetInstitutionEntityRefById(this.institutionId).subscribe((institution) => {
        //this.institution.setValue(institution?.entityDisplayName);
        this.form.get('institution')?.setValue(institution);
      });
      this.form.get('institution')?.disable();
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  delete() {
    const name = this.form.get('name')?.value;
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${name}' szerződést?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.energyContractService.energyContractsDeleteEnergyContract(this.contractId!).subscribe(() => {
            this.router.navigate(['records', 'contracts']);
          });
        }
      },
    );
  }

  edit() {
    this.router.navigate(['../edit', this.contractId], {
      relativeTo: this.route,
      state: {
        energyContractType: this.energyContractType,
      },
    });
  }

  save(): Observable<object> | null {
    const energyContract = this.form.value;
    energyContract['monthlyAccountingStart'] = this.fc.monthlyAccountingStart.value.id;
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
      return this.energyContractService.energyContractsPostEnergyContract(energyContract);
    }
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT) {
      return this.energyContractService.energyContractsPutEnergyContract(this.contractId!, energyContract);
    }

    return null;
  }

  onSubmit(customRootPath: string | boolean = null as any) {
    if (this.form.valid) {
      this.showLoader();
      this.isSavePending = true;
      this.save()!
        .pipe(first())
        .subscribe(
          (data: any) => {
            this.saved = true;
            this.onSaved(customRootPath, data);
          },
          (error) => {
            ErrorHelper.serverErrorHandler(error, this.form, (errors: any) => {
              this.openSnackBar(
                'A mentés nem hajtható végre, az űrlap hibás adatokat tartalmaz.',
                SnackBarColor.Warning,
              );
              if (errors)
                for (const error in errors) {
                  if (error === 'streetSuffix') {
                    errors['locationOfNetworkConnectionPoint.streetSuffix'] = errors[error];
                    delete errors[error];
                  }
                }
              this.onServerError(errors);
            });
          },
        )
        .add(() => {
          this.hideLoader();
          this.isSavePending = false;
        });
    } else {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
    }
  }

  secondTabDisabled(): boolean {
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      return false;
    }
    const firstPageControls = [
      'name',
      'supplier',
      'contractIssueDate',
      'contractExpiryDate',
      'institution',
      'monthlyAccountingStart',
    ];
    return firstPageControls.some((formControlName) => !this.form.get(formControlName)?.valid);
  }

  selectedIndex = 0;

  goToSecondTab() {
    this.selectedIndex = this.selectedIndex = 1;
  }

  goToFirstTab() {
    this.selectedIndex = this.selectedIndex = 0;
  }

  private setTimeOfUseTariffControlValue(energyContract: PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto) {
    const timeOfUseTariffFormControl = this.form.get('timeOfUseTariffs') as UntypedFormArray;

    if (energyContract.timeOfUseTariffs) {
      energyContract.timeOfUseTariffs.forEach(() => {
        timeOfUseTariffFormControl.push(this.formBuilder.group(timeOfUseTariffForm.get()));
      });
    }
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { FormComponentBase } from '../../../../core/base/form-component-base';
import { BreadcrumbService } from '../../../../core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from '../../../../core/services/loader.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from '../../../../core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from '../../../../core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from '../../../../core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { IDataTableResponse } from '../../../../core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { SortDirection as EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection } from '../../../../core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/sortDirection';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { openNewEnergyContractDialog } from '../new-contract-dialog/new-contract-dialog.component';
import { filter } from 'rxjs';
import { EnergyContractType } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/energyContractType';
import { openConfirmDialog } from '../../../../core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { EnergyContractsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/energyContracts.service';
import { EnergyContractListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/energyContractListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult';
import { EnergyContractTypeDisplayName } from '../../../../core/generated/forms/energycontract/energyContractType';
import { EnergyContractStatusTypeDisplayName } from '../../../../core/generated/forms/energycontract/energyContractStatusType';
import { EnergyContractListItemDto } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/energyContractListItemDto';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-contracts',
  templateUrl: './contracts.component.html',
})
export class ContractsComponent extends FormComponentBase {
  @Input() institutionId?: number;

  filterForm: UntypedFormGroup;
  energyContractTypes = EnergyContractTypeDisplayName.filter((x) => x.id !== EnergyContractType.NotDefined);
  energyContractStatuses = EnergyContractStatusTypeDisplayName;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private energyContractsService: EnergyContractsService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.rootPath = '/partner';
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Nyilvántartás', '')];
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    const filterFormFields = {
      contractName: [null],
      contractType: [null],
      contractSupplier: [null],
      contractStatus: [null],
      contractIssueDate: [null],
      contractExpiryDate: [null],
    };
    this.filterForm = this.formBuilder.group(filterFormFields);
  }

  @ViewChild('contractDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'institution',
      displayName: 'RECORDS.CONTRACTS.INSTITUTION',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'name',
      displayName: 'RECORDS.CONTRACTS.NAME',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'supplier',
      displayName: 'RECORDS.CONTRACTS.SUPPLIER',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'contractIssueDate',
      displayName: 'RECORDS.CONTRACTS.ISSUE_DATE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'contractExpiryDate',
      displayName: 'RECORDS.CONTRACTS.EXPIRY_DATE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'energyContractType',
      displayName: 'RECORDS.CONTRACTS.TYPE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'status',
      displayName: 'RECORDS.CONTRACTS.STATUS',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems?: EnergyContractListItemDto[] = [];

  override ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
    this.getItems();
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.filterForm.controls;
  }

  getItems() {
    console.log(this.institutionId);
    this.isLoading = true;
    const startPage = this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex ?? this.pageIndex;
    const pageSize = this.dataDataTable?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize;
    const sortColumn = this.dataDataTable?.getSort() ?? this.sortActive;
    const sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.getSortDirection() ?? EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
        ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
        : ApiSortDirection.Descending;
    const from = this.filterForm?.get('contractIssueDate')?.value;
    const until = this.filterForm?.get('contractExpiryDate')?.value;
    const contractName = this.filterForm?.get('contractName')?.value;
    const contractType = this.filterForm?.get('contractType')?.value?.map((x: any) => x.id);
    const contractSupplier = this.filterForm?.get('contractSupplier')?.value;
    const contractStatus = this.filterForm?.get('contractStatus')?.value?.id;
    this.energyContractsService
      .energyContractsGetEnergyContractsDatatable(
        contractName,
        contractType,
        contractSupplier,
        this.institutionId?.toString() ?? undefined,
        contractStatus,
        from,
        until,
        startPage,
        pageSize,
        sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
        false,
      )
      .subscribe((data: EnergyContractListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
        this.allItems = data.items;
        this.data.items = this.allItems!;
        this.data.recordsTotal = data.recordsTotal!;
        this.dataDataTable.refresh();
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  openDialog() {
    openNewEnergyContractDialog(this.dialog)
      .pipe(filter((val) => !!val))
      .subscribe((energyContractType: EnergyContractType) => {
        this.router.navigate(['partner', 'contracts', 'create'], {
          state: {
            institutionId: this.institutionId,
            energyContractType: energyContractType,
          },
        });
      });
  }

  showRow(element: EnergyContractListItemDto) {
    this.router.navigate(['partner', 'contracts', element.id], {
      state: {
        energyContractType: element.energyContractType,
      },
    });
  }

  editRow(element: EnergyContractListItemDto) {
    this.router.navigate(['partner', 'contracts', 'edit', element.id], {
      state: {
        energyContractType: element.energyContractType,
      },
    });
  }

  deleteRow(element: EnergyContractListItemDto) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.name}' szerződést?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.energyContractsService.energyContractsDeleteEnergyContract(element.id!).subscribe(() => this.getItems());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.filterForm.get('contractIssueDate')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('contractExpiryDate')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('contractName')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('contractType')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('contractSupplier')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('contractStatus')?.setValue(null);
  }
}

import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { EnergyContractType } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/energyContractType';
import { EnergyContractTypeDisplayName } from '../../../../core/generated/forms/energycontract/energyContractType';
import { MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-new-contract-dialog',
  templateUrl: './new-contract-dialog.component.html',
})
export class NewContractDialogComponent {
  form: UntypedFormGroup;
  energyContractTypes = EnergyContractTypeDisplayName.filter((x) => x.id !== EnergyContractType.NotDefined);

  get selectedEnergyContractType(): EnergyContractType {
    return this.form.get('energyContractType')?.value?.id;
  }

  constructor(private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder, private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<NewContractDialogComponent>) {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      energyContractType: [null],
    });
  }

  save() {
    this.dialogRef.close(this.selectedEnergyContractType);
  }

  close() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }
}

export function openNewEnergyContractDialog(dialog: MatDialog) {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(NewContractDialogComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { CommonDetailsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/commonDetails.service';
import { SitesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sites.service';
import { CommonCardDetailsModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/commonCardDetailsModel';
import { DeviceStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/deviceStatus';
import { SiteModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteModel';
import { IEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/models/core/entity-ref';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from '../../../core/services/loader.service';
import { InstitutionsService, PartnersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PartnerCurrentCardModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/partnerCurrentCardModel';

@Component({
  selector: 'partners-current-edit-root',
  templateUrl: './partners-current-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partners-current-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnersCurrentEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  contactPersons?: IEntityRef[];
  cards: CommonCardDetailsModel[] = [];
  sites?: SiteModel[];
  id?: string;

  constructor(
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private partnersService: PartnersService,
    private commonDetailsService: CommonDetailsService,
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private institutionsService: InstitutionsService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    if (route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')) {
      this.id = route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!;
    } else {
      this.partnersService.partnersGetCurrentPartner().subscribe({
        next: (model) => {
          this.id = String(model.id);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error(error);
        },
      });
    }
    this.rootPath = 'partner';
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Initialize the cards array
    this.cards = [];

    // Load cards using partnersGetCurrentCards
    this.institutionsService.institutionsGetCurrentPartnerCards().subscribe({
      next: (cardData) => {
        this.transformCardData(cardData);
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error(error);
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Transform PartnerCurrentCardModel data into CommonCardDetailsModel format
   */
  transformCardData(cardData: PartnerCurrentCardModel): void {
    this.cards = [];

    if (cardData.institutionCount && cardData.institutionCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'Institution',
        count: cardData.institutionCount,
        displayName: 'Intézmények',
        description: `${cardData.institutionCount} intézmény(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }

    if (cardData.siteCount && cardData.siteCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'Site',
        count: cardData.siteCount,
        displayName: 'Telephelyek',
        description: `${cardData.siteCount} telephely(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }

    if (cardData.measurementPointCount && cardData.measurementPointCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'MeasurementPoint',
        count: cardData.measurementPointCount,
        displayName: 'Mérési helyek',
        description: `${cardData.measurementPointCount} mérési hely(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }

    if (cardData.deviceCount && cardData.deviceCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'Device',
        count: cardData.deviceCount,
        displayName: 'Eszközök',
        description: `${cardData.deviceCount} eszköz(ök)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }
  }

  commonCardClikedHander(card: CommonCardDetailsModel) {
    switch (card.type) {
      case 'Device':
        this.router.navigate(['devices/iot']);
        break;
      case 'Site':
        this.router.navigate(['partner/sites']);
        break;
      case 'Institution':
        this.router.navigate(['partner/institutions']);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, ViewChild, OnInit, OnDestroy, AfterViewInit, TemplateRef } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, NavigationEnd } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { EntityRef, IEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/models/core/entity-ref';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from '../../../../core/services/loader.service';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { InvoiceListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/invoiceListItemDto';
import { SortDirection as EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection } from '../../../../core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/model/sortDirection';
import { InvoicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/invoices.service';
import { InvoiceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/invoiceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult';
import { environment } from 'src/environments/environment';
import { AuthenticateService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/authenticate.service';
import { SecOperationMatrixModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secOperationMatrixModel';
import { NavbarService } from 'src/app/layout/navbar/navbar-service';
import { Subscription, filter, map } from 'rxjs';
import { PartnersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/partners.service';
import { JobResultStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

@Component({
  selector: 'partners-base-data',
  templateUrl: './partners-base-data.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partners-base-data.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnersBaseDataComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy, AfterViewInit {
  @Input() partnerId?: number;

  filterForm?: UntypedFormGroup;

  public secOperationMatrix?: SecOperationMatrixModel;

  public isDevEnviroment = true;

  templateDownloadPath = '/partner/download-import-template';

  // Column definitions for data-import component
  dataImportColumns = [
    { 
      key: 'id', 
      label: 'PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.JOB_ID',
      format: 'text'
    },
    { 
      key: 'fileName', 
      label: 'PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.FILE_NAME',
      format: 'text'
    },
    { 
      key: 'initiationDate', 
      label: 'PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.UPLOAD_DATE',
      format: 'date',
      dateFormat: 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'
    },
    { 
      key: 'status', 
      label: 'PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.STATUS',
      format: 'custom',
      template: 'status-template'
    }
  ];

  // Action definitions for data-import component
  dataImportActions = [
    {
      key: 'viewErrors',
      icon: 'error',
      tooltip: 'PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.VIEW_ERRORS',
      showCondition: (job: any) => job.status === JobResultStatus.Failed
    },
    {
      key: 'finalize',
      icon: 'check_circle',
      tooltip: 'PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.FINALIZE_JOB',
      showCondition: (job: any) => job.status === JobResultStatus.Validated
    },
    {
      key: 'delete',
      icon: 'delete',
      tooltip: 'PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.DELETE_JOB',
      color: 'warn',
      showCondition: (job: any) => job.status === JobResultStatus.Failed || job.status === JobResultStatus.Validated
    }
  ];

  // Functions for data-import component
  getOrgunitImportJobs = () => {
    return this.partnersService.partnersGetOrgunitImportJobs();
  }

  uploadOrgunitImport = (file: File) => {
    return this.partnersService.partnersPostOrgunitImportForm(file);
  }

  deleteOrgunitImport = (jobId: number | string) => {
    return this.partnersService.partnersDeleteOrgunitImport(jobId as number);
  }

  finalizeOrgunitImport = (jobId: number | string) => {
    return this.partnersService.partnersFinalizeOrgunitImport(jobId as number);
  }

  viewOrgunitImportErrors = (jobId: number | string) => {
    // This function isn't directly available in the API service, but would return errors from the job
    // Either use the job's error list or implement a specific call if needed
    return this.partnersService.partnersGetOrgunitImportJobs().pipe(
      map(response => {
        const job = response.items?.find(item => item.id === jobId);
        return job?.errorList || [];
      })
    );
  }

  get select(): EntityRef[] {
    return this._selectedValues;
  }

  @ViewChild('invoicesDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable!: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    // <IColumnDefinition>{
    //   columnName: 'select',
    //   displayName: '',
    //   columnType: ColumnType.Select,
    //   filterable: false,
    //   sortable: false
    // },
    {
      columnName: 'invoiceIdentifier',
      displayName: 'Név',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'energyContract',
      displayName: 'Szerződés',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'invoicePeriodStart',
      displayName: 'Időszak',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'totalAmount',
      displayName: 'Összeg',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems?: InvoiceListItemDto[] = [];
  private _selectedValues: EntityRef[] = [];

  contactPersons?: IEntityRef[];
  isAddressEnabled = false;

  // Add a Subscription collection
  private subs = new Subscription();

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private invoicesService: InvoicesService,
    private authenticateService: AuthenticateService,
    private navbarService: NavbarService,
    private partnersService: PartnersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = 'partner';
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    console.log('PartnersBaseDataComponent: ngOnInit called');

    // Listen for router navigation end events and set up the button after navigation completes
    this.subs.add(
      this.router.events.pipe(filter((event) => event instanceof NavigationEnd)).subscribe(() => {
        // Set up navbar button after navigation is complete
        console.log('Navigation complete, setting up navbar button');
        this.setupNavbarButton();
      }),
    );

    this.filterForm = this.formBuilder.group({
      invoiceIdentifier: [null],
      invoicePeriodStart: [null],
      invoicePeriodEnd: [null],
    });

    this.authenticateService.authenticateGetSecOperationMatrix().subscribe((secOperationMatrix) => {
      this.secOperationMatrix = secOperationMatrix;
      this.secOperationMatrix.secOperationList?.forEach(function () {});
    });

    if (!this.partnerId && this.hasRightBySecOpCode('InvoiceRead')) this.getItems();

    this.isDevEnviroment = environment.production;
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    console.log('PartnersBaseDataComponent: ngOnDestroy called');
    // Make sure to unsubscribe when component is destroyed
    if (this.subs) {
      this.subs.unsubscribe();
    }
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    console.log('PartnersBaseDataComponent: ngAfterViewInit called');
  }

  /**
   * HasRight megvalósítás string bemenetre.
   * @param reqSecOp A secOp kódja, stringként átadva.
   */
  hasRightBySecOpCode(reqSecOp: string): boolean {
    const availableSecops = this.secOperationMatrix?.secOperationList?.map((secOp) => secOp.secOperation);
    return availableSecops?.includes(reqSecOp) || false;
  }

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;
    const sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.getSortDirection() ?? EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
        ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
        : ApiSortDirection.Descending;
    const from = this.filterForm?.get('invoicePeriodStart')?.value;
    const until = this.filterForm?.get('invoicePeriodEnd')?.value;
    const invoiceIdentifier = this.filterForm?.get('invoiceIdentifier')?.value;
    this.invoicesService
      .invoicesGetAll(
        invoiceIdentifier,
        from,
        until,
        this.pageIndex,
        this.pageSize,
        this.sortActive,
        apiSortDirection,
        false,
      )
      .subscribe((data: InvoiceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
        this.allItems = data.items;
        this.data.items = this.allItems!;
        this.data.recordsTotal = data.recordsTotal!;
        this.dataDataTable.refresh();
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  rowsAreRendered() {
    this.dataDataTable.setActionRowVisibility();
  }

  back() {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner']);
  }

  private setupNavbarButton() {
    console.log('Setting up navbar button from setupNavbarButton');
    // Use a short delay to ensure this happens after the navbar component has finished its own event processing
    setTimeout(() => {
      console.log('Executing delayed navbar button setup');
      this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonVisibility(true);
      this.navbarService.setNavbarButtonText('GLOBAL.TOOLTIP.DOWNLOAD_EXCEL');
      this.navbarService.setNavbarIcon('download');
      this.navbarService.setNavbarSecOp(''); // No permission check for testing

      // Ensure we're not creating multiple subscriptions
      this.subs.add(
        this.navbarService.navbarButton$.subscribe(() => {
          console.log('Navbar button clicked - triggering download');
          this.download();
        }),
      );
    }, 100);
  }

  private download() {
    this.router.navigate([this.templateDownloadPath]);
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit, ElementRef } from '@angular/core';
import { FormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { PartnersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/partners.service';
import { OrgunitImportJobResultListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/orgunitImportJobResultListItemDto';
import { JobResultStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/jobResultStatus';
import { ExcelImportErrorModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/excelImportErrorModel';

// Custom components
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { ImportErrorsDialogComponent } from './import-errors-dialog/import-errors-dialog.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partners-data-import',
  templateUrl: './partners-data-import.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partners-data-import.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnersDataImportComponent implements OnInit {
  // File upload
  fileControl = new FormControl(null);
  selectedFile: File | null = null;
  templateDownloadPath = '/partner/download-import-template';

  // Job errors map for storing errors by job ID
  jobErrorsMap = new Map<string, ExcelImportErrorModel[]>();

  // Job data
  importJobs: OrgunitImportJobResultListItemDto[] = [];
  displayedColumns: string[] = ['id', 'fileName', 'initiationDate', /*'secUser',*/ 'status', 'actions'];

  // Progress tracking
  isUploading = false;
  progressRef: any = null;

  constructor(
    private dialog: MatDialog,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
    private loaderService: LoaderService,
    private elRef: ElementRef,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
    private partnersService: PartnersService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Load import jobs from the API
    this.refreshJobsList();
  }

  /**
   * Handle files loaded event from file upload control
   */
  filesLoaded(files: FileList | File[]): void {
    if (files && files.length > 0) {
      const file = files[0];
      const fileExtension = file.name.split('.').pop()!.toLowerCase();

      // Check if file is an xlsx file
      if (fileExtension !== 'xlsx') {
        // Invalid file format
        this.selectedFile = null;
        this.fileControl.reset();

        // Set validation error on the form control instead of showing a snackbar
        this.fileControl.setErrors({
          invalidFileFormat: true,
        });
        return;
      }

      // Valid file
      this.selectedFile = file;
      this.fileControl.setErrors(null);
    } else {
      // File was cleared
      this.selectedFile = null;
      this.fileControl.setErrors(null);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Trigger file upload process
   */
  uploadFile(): void {
    if (!this.selectedFile) {
      return;
    }

    // Double-check that the file is xlsx format before upload
    const fileExtension = this.selectedFile.name.split('.').pop()!.toLowerCase();
    if (fileExtension !== 'xlsx') {
      this.snackBar.open(
        this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.INVALID_FILE_FORMAT'),
        this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
        { duration: 5000, panelClass: ['error-snackbar'] },
      );
      this.selectedFile = null;
      this.fileControl.reset();
      return;
    }

    // Upload file to the server
    this.partnersService.partnersPostOrgunitImportForm(this.selectedFile).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        // Show success notification
        this.snackBar.open(
          this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.UPLOAD_COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY'),
          this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
          { duration: 3000 },
        );

        // Reset the file input
        this.selectedFile = null;
        this.fileControl.reset();

        // Refresh the jobs list to show the new job
        this.refreshJobsList();
      },
      error: (error) => {
        let errorMessage = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.UPLOAD_FAILED');

        // Check if there's a specific error message from the API
        if (error?.error?.message) {
          errorMessage = error.error.message;
        }

        // Show error notification
        this.snackBar.open(errorMessage, this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'), {
          duration: 5000,
          panelClass: ['error-snackbar'],
        });
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Load the list of import jobs
   */
  refreshJobsList(): void {
    // Show loading indicator
    this.isUploading = true;
    this.progressRef = this.loaderService.showProgress(this.elRef);

    // Fetch jobs from the API
    this.partnersService
      .partnersGetOrgunitImportJobs()
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => {
          this.isUploading = false;
          this.loaderService.detach(this.progressRef);
        }),
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (response) => {
          if (response && response.items) {
            this.importJobs = response.items;
          } else {
            this.importJobs = [];
          }
        },
        error: () => {
          this.importJobs = [];
          this.snackBar.open(
            this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.LOAD_JOBS_FAILED'),
            this.translateService.instant('GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CLOSE'),
            { duration: 5000, panelClass: ['error-snackbar'] },
          );
        },
      });
  }

  /**
   * View errors for a job
   */
  viewErrors(job: OrgunitImportJobResultListItemDto): void {
    if (job.status !== JobResultStatus.Failed) {
      return;
    }

    // Get errors from the API response
    const errors = job.errorList || [];

    this.dialog.open(ImportErrorsDialogComponent, {
      width: '1200px',
      data: {
        jobId: job.id,
        fileName: job.fileName,
        errors,
      },
    });
  }

  // saveJobData method removed as it was unused

  /**
   * Delete a job
   */
  deleteJob(job: OrgunitImportJobResultListItemDto): void {
    this.partnersService.partnersDeleteOrgunitImport(job.id!).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.snackBar.open(
          this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.DELETE_JOB_SUCCESS'),
          this.translateService.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'),
          { duration: 3000 },
        );
        this.refreshJobsList();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.snackBar.open(
          this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.DELETE_JOB_ERROR'),
          this.translateService.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'),
          { duration: 3000 },
        );
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Finalize a validated job
   */
  finalizeJob(job: OrgunitImportJobResultListItemDto): void {
    this.partnersService.partnersFinalizeOrgunitImport(job.id!).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.snackBar.open(
          this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.FINALIZE_JOB_SUCCESS'),
          this.translateService.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'),
          { duration: 3000 },
        );
        this.refreshJobsList();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.snackBar.open(
          this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.CURRENT_EDIT.DATA_IMPORT.FINALIZE_JOB_ERROR'),
          this.translateService.instant('COMMON.CLOSE'),
          { duration: 3000 },
        );
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Handle row click in the jobs table
   * Shows the appropriate dialog based on job status
   */
  onRowClick(job: OrgunitImportJobResultListItemDto): void {
    if (job.status === JobResultStatus.Failed) {
      // For error status, show the errors dialog
      this.viewErrors(job);
    }
  }

  trackByFn(index: number, item: OrgunitImportJobResultListItemDto): number {
    return item.id!;
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRouteSnapshot, Resolve, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, tap, map } from 'rxjs';
import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders } from '@angular/common/http';
import { PartnersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

@Injectable()
export class PartnerImportTemplateDownloadResolver implements Resolve<any> {
  constructor(
    private partnersService: PartnersService,
    private router: Router,
    private http: HttpClient,
  ) {}

  resolve(route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot): Observable<any> {
    // Get the base path and authentication from the partners service
    const basePath = this.partnersService['basePath'];
    const apiUrl = `${basePath}/api/partners/import-template/download`;

    // Get authentication token if available
    let headers = new HttpHeaders();
    if (this.partnersService['configuration'].accessToken) {
      const accessToken =
        typeof this.partnersService['configuration'].accessToken === 'function'
          ? this.partnersService['configuration'].accessToken()
          : this.partnersService['configuration'].accessToken;
      headers = headers.set('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + accessToken);
    }

    return this.http
      .get(apiUrl, {
        responseType: 'blob',
        observe: 'response',
        headers: headers,
        withCredentials: this.partnersService['configuration'].withCredentials,
      })
      .pipe(
        tap((response) => {
          const blob = response.body;
          if (!blob) return;

          const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          link.href = url;

          // Get filename from content-disposition or use default
          const contentDisposition = response.headers.get('content-disposition');
          let filename = 'partner-import-template.xlsx';
          if (contentDisposition) {
            const filenameRegex = /filename[^;=\n]*=((['"]).*?\2|[^;\n]*)/;
            const matches = filenameRegex.exec(contentDisposition);
            if (matches != null && matches[1]) {
              filename = matches[1].replace(/['"]/g, '');
            }
          }

          link.download = filename;
          link.click();
          window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }),
        map(() => this.router.navigate(['partner/current'])), // stay on current route
      );
  }
}

import { Component, Injector, Input, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import {
  PartnerValidityEntityDto,
  TenantStatus,
  AddressEntityDto,
  AddressType,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PartnersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/partners.service';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { MatTabGroup } from '@angular/material/tabs';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partners-edit',
  templateUrl: './partners-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partners-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnersEditComponent implements OnInit {
  @Input() partnerId?: number;
  @Input() tenantPartnerId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  isAddingNewValidity = false;
  activeEditingValidityId: number | null = null;

  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  password?: string;
  tenantCode?: string;
  partnerValidities?: PartnerValidityEntityDto[];
  tabSelectedIndex = 0;

  @ViewChild(MatTabGroup) tabGroup?: MatTabGroup;

  constructor(
    private router: Router,
    private injector: Injector,
    private breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private loaderService: LoaderService,
    private partnersService: PartnersService,
  ) {
    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    console.log(this.partnerId, this.tenantPartnerId);
    if (!this.partnerId && !this.tenantPartnerId) {
      this.partnersService.partnersGetCurrentPartner().subscribe((model: any) => {
        this.partnerValidities = model.partnerValidities;
        this.tenantCode = model.tenantCode;
      });
    } else if (this.partnerId)
      this.partnersService.partnersGet(this.partnerId).subscribe((model: any) => {
        this.partnerValidities = model.partnerValidities;
        this.tenantCode = model.tenantCode;
      });
    else if (this.tenantPartnerId)
      this.partnersService.partnersGet(this.tenantPartnerId).subscribe((model: any) => {
        this.partnerValidities = model.partnerValidities;
        this.tenantCode = model.tenantCode;
      });

    if (this.partnerValidities && this.partnerValidities.length > 0) {
      this.tabSelectedIndex = this.partnerValidities.length - 1;
    } else {
      this.tabSelectedIndex = 0; // vagy -1, ha nincs elem
    }
  }

  addNewValidity() {
    // Create an empty validity object
    const lastValidity = this.partnerValidities![this.partnerValidities!.length - 1];
    let validFromDate = new Date();

    if (lastValidity && lastValidity.validTo) {
      // Parse the validTo date string and add one day
      validFromDate = new Date(lastValidity.validTo);
      validFromDate.setDate(validFromDate.getDate() + 1);
    }

    const emptyValidity = {
      id: 0,
      name: lastValidity?.name ? lastValidity.name : '',
      validFrom: validFromDate,
      validTo: null,
      description: lastValidity?.description ? lastValidity.description : '',
      headquarters: lastValidity?.headquarters
        ? lastValidity.headquarters
        : ({
            addressType: AddressType.NotDefined,
            address: '',
            city: '',
            country: '',
            postalCode: '',
            region: '',
          } as AddressEntityDto),
      eMail: lastValidity?.eMail ? lastValidity.eMail : '',
      website: lastValidity?.website ? lastValidity.website : '',
      telephone: lastValidity?.telephone ? lastValidity.telephone : '',
      taxIdentificationNumber: lastValidity?.taxIdentificationNumber ? lastValidity.taxIdentificationNumber : '',
      companyRegistrationNumber: lastValidity?.companyRegistrationNumber ? lastValidity.companyRegistrationNumber : '',
      contactPersonName: lastValidity?.contactPersonName ? lastValidity.contactPersonName : '',
      contactPerson: lastValidity?.contactPerson ? lastValidity.contactPerson : null,
      maintainer: lastValidity?.maintainer ? lastValidity.maintainer : null,
    };

    this.partnerValidities!.push(emptyValidity as any);
    this.isAddingNewValidity = true;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = 0; // Set to 0 to match the new validity's ID
    // Set the tab to the last one (the newly added validity)
    this.tabSelectedIndex = this.partnerValidities!.length - 1;
  }

  onValiditySaved() {
    this.refreshValidities();
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
  }
  onValidityDeleted() {
    this.refreshValidities();
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
  }

  onValidityCancelled() {
    if (this.isAddingNewValidity) {
      // Remove the last validity if it was newly added and cancelled
      this.partnerValidities!.pop();
      this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
      // Set the tab to the previous one
      this.tabSelectedIndex = Math.max(0, this.partnerValidities!.length - 1);
    }
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
  }

  onValidityEditStarted(validityId: number) {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = validityId;
  }

  trackValidityById(index: number, validity: any): any {
    return validity.id;
  }

  refreshValidities() {
    if (!this.partnerId && !this.tenantPartnerId) {
      this.partnersService.partnersGetCurrentPartner().subscribe((model: any) => {
        this.partnerValidities = model.partnerValidities;
      });
    } else if (this.partnerId) {
      this.partnersService.partnersGet(this.partnerId).subscribe((model: any) => {
        this.partnerValidities = model.partnerValidities;
      });
    } else if (this.tenantPartnerId) {
      this.partnersService.partnersGetTenantPartner(this.tenantPartnerId).subscribe((model: any) => {
        this.partnerValidities = model.partnerValidities;
      });
    }
  }

  back() {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner']);
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\partners\partners-current-edit\partners-edit\partners-edit-validity\partners-edit-validity.component.ts

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, Output, EventEmitter } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createOrUpdatePartnerValidityRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/partners/createOrUpdatePartnerValidityRequestForm';
import { MaintainerEntityDtoEntityRef, MaintainersService, PartnersService, PartnerValidityEntityDto, TenantStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partners-edit-validity',
  templateUrl: './partners-edit-validity.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partners-edit-validity.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnersEditValidityComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() partnerId?: number;
  @Input() tenantPartnerId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  @Input() validity?: PartnerValidityEntityDto;
  @Input() isNew?: boolean;
  @Input() isEditDisabled?: boolean;
  @Output() validitySaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() validityCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() editStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() validityDeleted = new EventEmitter<void>();

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  password?: string;
  tenantCode?: string;
  validityId?: number;
  maintainers: MaintainerEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private partnersService: PartnersService,
    private maintainersService: MaintainersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createOrUpdatePartnerValidityRequestForm.get());
    if (this.isNew) {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.CREATE;
      this.isEdit = true;
    } else {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
      this.isEdit = false;

      this.form.disable();
    }
    if (this.validity && this.form) {
      this.validityId = this.validity.id;
      this.form.patchValue(this.validity);
    }
    this.loadMaintainers();
  }

  loadMaintainers() {
    this.maintainersService.maintainersGetMaintainersEntityRef().subscribe((result) => {
      this.maintainers = result;
    });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.get('headquarters')?.enable();
    this.form.enable();
    this.editStarted.emit(this.validity!.id);
  }
  public onSaved(): void {
    if (!this.partnerId && !this.tenantPartnerId) {
      // Tenant-os felhasználóval történő szerkesztés esetén nincs navigálás, és snackbar üzenet.
      // Igény esetén ezt megváltoztathatjuk.
      this.cancel();
    } else {
      //this.router.navigate(['/partner']);
      this.cancel();
      const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
      this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    const saveObservable = this.isNew
      ? this.partnersService.partnersCreateValidity(this.partnerId!, formValues)
      : this.partnersService.partnersModifyValidity(this.validityId!, formValues);

    return new Observable((observer) => {
      saveObservable.subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.validitySaved.emit();
          observer.next(result);
          observer.complete();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          observer.error(error);
          observer.complete();
        },
      });
    });
  }
  cancel() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.get('headquarters')?.disable();
    this.form.disable();
    this.validityCancelled.emit();
  }
  deleteValidity() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.get('headquarters')?.disable();
    this.form.disable();
    this.partnersService.partnersDeletePartnerValidity(this.partnerId!, this.validityId!).subscribe(() => {
      this.validityDeleted.emit();
    });
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createPartnerRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/partners/createPartnerRequestForm';
import { MaintainerEntityDtoEntityRef, MaintainersService, PartnersService, TenantStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';
import { SecUserModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secUserModel';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partners-new',
  templateUrl: './partners-new.component.html',
  styleUrl: './partners-new.component.scss',
})
export class PartnersNewComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() partnerId?: number;
  @Input() tenantPartnerId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantCode?: string;
  maintainers: MaintainerEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
  isCheckingEmail = false;
  emailCheckPerformed = false;
  userFoundFromEmail = false;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private partnersService: PartnersService,
    private maintainersService: MaintainersService,
    private userService: UsersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createPartnerRequestForm.get());
    this.edit();
    this.loadMaintainers();
  }

  loadMaintainers(): void {
    this.maintainersService.maintainersGetMaintainersEntityRef().subscribe(result => {
      this.maintainers = result;
    });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.get('headquarters')?.enable();
    this.form.enable();
  }
  public onSaved(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner']);
    const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
    this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
      duration: 5000,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
      horizontalPosition: 'end',
      verticalPosition: 'top',
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner']);
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    return this.partnersService.partnersPost(formValues);
  }

  back() {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner']);
  }

  getNameTooltip() {
    return (
      'A név kizárólag a magyar ABC betűiből álló elnevezést tartalmazhat, maximum 64 karakter hosszan. \n' +
      'Speciális és numerikus karakterek nem szerepelhetnek benne.'
    );
  }

  getEmailTooltip() {
    return 'Email formátum pl.: john.smith@example.com';
  }

  checkEmail(): void {
    const email = this.fc.administratorEmail.value;
    if (!email || this.fc.administratorEmail.invalid) {
      this.fc.administratorEmail.markAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    this.isCheckingEmail = true;
    this.emailCheckPerformed = false;
    this.userFoundFromEmail = false;

    this.userService.usersGetUserByEmail(email).subscribe({
      next: (response: SecUserModel) => {
        this.isCheckingEmail = false;
        this.emailCheckPerformed = true;
        
        if (response && response.id) {
          // User found, populate administrator fields
          this.userFoundFromEmail = true;
          this.fc.administratorLastName.setValue(response.lastName || '');
          this.fc.administratorFirstName.setValue(response.firstName || '');
          this.fc.administratorPhone.setValue(response.phone || '');
          
          // Disable administrator fields since they come from existing user
          this.fc.administratorLastName.disable();
          this.fc.administratorFirstName.disable();
          this.fc.administratorPhone.disable();
          this.fc.administratorEmail.disable();
        } else {
          // No user found, enable fields for manual entry
          this.enableAdministratorFields();
        }
      },
      error: (error) => {
        this.isCheckingEmail = false;
        this.emailCheckPerformed = true;
        
        if (error.status === 404) {
          // User not found, enable fields for manual entry
          this.enableAdministratorFields();
        } else {
          // Other error, show error message
          console.error('Error checking email:', error);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  private enableAdministratorFields(): void {
    this.userFoundFromEmail = false;
    this.fc.administratorLastName.enable();
    this.fc.administratorFirstName.enable();
    this.fc.administratorPhone.enable();
    // Keep email enabled so user can modify if needed
    this.fc.administratorEmail.enable();
  }

  resetEmailCheck(): void {
    this.emailCheckPerformed = false;
    this.userFoundFromEmail = false;
    this.enableAdministratorFields();
    // Clear the administrator fields
    this.fc.administratorLastName.setValue('');
    this.fc.administratorFirstName.setValue('');
    this.fc.administratorPhone.setValue('');
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, ViewChildren, QueryList, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatTabGroup } from '@angular/material/tabs';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import {
  FloorModel,
  FloorsService,
  FloorValidityEntityDto,
  MeasurementPointsService,
  PeakValueCardDetailsModel,
  TenantStatus,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import { EmitService } from 'src/app/core/services/emit.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-floor-details-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-floor-details-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-floor-details-edit.component.scss'],
  providers: [EmitService],
})
export class PartnerFloorDetailsEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() floorId: number;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroup2SelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroup3SelectedIndex = 0;
  validityTabSelectedIndex = 0;
  isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne: boolean = false;
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantCode?: string;
  isAddingNewValidity = false;
  activeEditingValidityId: number | null = null;
  floor?: FloorModel;
  floorValidities: FloorValidityEntityDto[] = [];

  // Navigation properties
  sourceUrl?: string;
  returnUrl?: string;
  previousPath?: string;
  currentUrl?: string;

  measurementPointCards: PeakValueCardDetailsModel[] = [];

  @ViewChildren(MatTabGroup) tabGroups?: QueryList<MatTabGroup>;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private floorsService: FloorsService,
    private measurementPointService: MeasurementPointsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private location: Location,
    private emitService: EmitService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.rootPath = 'partner/floors';

    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
    this.floorValidities = [];
    this.floorId = +route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!;

    // Store current URL for later use
    this.currentUrl = this.location.path();

    // Get sourceRoute from query params for use in navigation
    this.route.queryParams.subscribe((params) => {
      if (params['sourceRoute']) {
        this.sourceUrl = params['sourceRoute'];
      }
    });

    // Check navigation state for return URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.returnUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }

    // Also consider the previous URL from browser history
    this.previousPath = this.router.url;
    if (this.previousPath && this.previousPath.includes('/partner/buildingparts/')) {
      this.sourceUrl = this.previousPath;
    }
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    super.ngOnInit();
    this.loadFloorValidities();
    this.loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards();
  }

  private loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards() {
    if (this.floorId) {
      this.measurementPointService.measurementPointsGetOrgunitPeakValueCards(this.floorId).subscribe({
        next: (cardData) => {
          this.measurementPointCards = cardData;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private loadFloorValidities() {
    if (this.floorId) {
      this.isLoading = true;
      this.floorsService.floorsGetFloorById(this.floorId).subscribe({
        next: (floor) => {
          this.floor = floor;
          this.floorValidities = floor.floorValidities || [];
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: () => {
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  addNewValidity() {
    const lastValidity = this.floorValidities[this.floorValidities.length - 1];
    let validFromDate = new Date();

    if (lastValidity && lastValidity.validTo) {
      // Parse the validTo date string and add one day
      validFromDate = new Date(lastValidity.validTo);
      validFromDate.setDate(validFromDate.getDate() + 1);
    }

    const newValidity: any /*FloorValidityEntityDto */ = {
      floor: { id: this.floorId },
      id: 0,
      name: lastValidity?.name ? lastValidity.name : '',
      validFrom: validFromDate,
      validTo: null,
      businessIdentifier: lastValidity?.businessIdentifier ? lastValidity.businessIdentifier : '',
      eMail: lastValidity?.eMail ? lastValidity.eMail : '',
      telephone: lastValidity?.telephone ? lastValidity.telephone : '',
      contactPersonName: lastValidity?.contactPersonName ? lastValidity.contactPersonName : '',
      contactPerson: lastValidity?.contactPerson ? lastValidity.contactPerson : null,
      lat: lastValidity?.lat ? lastValidity.lat : null,
      lon: lastValidity?.lon ? lastValidity.lon : null,
    };

    this.floorValidities = [...this.floorValidities, newValidity];
    this.isAddingNewValidity = true;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = 0;
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 1; // Switch to validities tab
    this.validityTabSelectedIndex = this.floorValidities.length - 1; // Switch to the new validity tab
  }

  editValidity(validityId: number) {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = validityId;
  }

  onBaseDataSaved() {
    // Reset the first tab group to the base data tab
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 0;
  }

  onBaseDataCancelled() {
    // Reset the first tab group to the base data tab
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 0;
  }

  onBaseDataEditStarted() {
    // Implementation as needed
  }

  onBaseDataDeleted() {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
  }

  onValiditySaved() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadFloorValidities();
  }

  onValidityCancelled() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;

    // If this was a new validity and we're cancelling, we might want to remove it
    if (this.isAddingNewValidity) {
      this.floorValidities.pop(); // Remove the last validity (the one we were adding)
      this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    }
  }

  onValidityEditStarted(validityId: number) {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = validityId;
  }

  onValidityDeleted() {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadFloorValidities();
  }

  onTabGroup1Change(index: number) {
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = index;
    if(index === 1 && !this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne) {
      this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne = true;
      this.emitService.emit();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Navigate with priority fallbacks
   * 1. Use stored returnUrl from navigation state
   * 2. Use sourceUrl from query parameters
   * 3. Check if coming from a building part view/edit page
   * 4. Default to floors list
   */
  private navigateWithFallbacks(): void {
    // First check if we have a direct returnUrl
    if (this.returnUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.returnUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Then check for sourceUrl from query parameters
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.sourceUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Check if we came from a building part view page
    if (
      this.previousPath &&
      this.previousPath.includes('/partner/buildingparts/') &&
      (this.previousPath.includes('/view') || this.previousPath.includes('/edit'))
    ) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.previousPath);
      return;
    }

    // Default fallback - go to floors list
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/floors']);
  }
}

import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { modifyFloorRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/floor/modifyFloorRequestForm';
import { FloorModel, FloorsService, TenantStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-floor-details-edit-base-data',
  templateUrl: './partner-floor-details-edit-base-data.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-floor-details-edit-base-data.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerFloorDetailsEditBaseDataComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() floor?: FloorModel;
  @Input() floorId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  public identifier?: string;

  @Output() baseDataSaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() baseDataCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() baseDataEditStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() baseDataDeleted = new EventEmitter<number>();

  isLoading = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private floorsService: FloorsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(modifyFloorRequestForm.get());
    this.form.disable();
    if (this.floor && this.form) {
      this.form.patchValue(this.floor);
      this.identifier = this.floor.identifier;
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  delete() {
    this.form.disable();

    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.FLOORS.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.floorsService.floorsDelete(this.floorId!).subscribe(() => {
          this.baseDataDeleted.emit(this.floor!.id);
        });
      }
    });
  }
}
