    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private floorsService: FloorsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private userService: UsersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createOrUpdateFloorValidityRequestForm.get());
    if (this.isNew) {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.CREATE;
      this.isEdit = true;
    } else {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
      this.isEdit = false;

      this.form.disable();
    }
    if (this.validity && this.form) {
      this.validityId = this.validity.id;
      this.form.patchValue(this.validity);

      // Check if a contactPerson is initially selected and disable fields accordingly
      if (this.validity.contactPerson?.id) {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
        this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
      }
    }

    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();

    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        //this.contactmessage = null;
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
          // Disable eMail and telephone fields when contactPerson is selected
          this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
          this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
        // Enable eMail and telephone fields when no contactPerson is selected
        this.form.get('eMail')?.enable();
        this.form.get('telephone')?.enable();
      }
    });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.enable();
    this.editStarted.emit(this.validity!.id);
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    if (!this.floorId) {
      this.cancel();
    } else {
      this.cancel();
      const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
      this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    const saveObservable = this.isNew
      ? this.floorsService.floorsPostFloorValidity(this.floorId!, formValues)
      : this.floorsService.floorsPutFloorValidity(this.floorId!, this.validityId!, formValues);

    return new Observable((observer) => {
      saveObservable.subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.validitySaved.emit();
          observer.next(result);
          observer.complete();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          observer.error(error);
        },
      });
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
    this.validityCancelled.emit();
  }

  deleteValidity() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
    this.floorsService.floorsDeleteFloorValidity(this.floorId!, this.validityId!).subscribe(() => {
      this.validityDeleted.emit(this.validityId);
    });
  }

  getLatTooltip() {
    return 'Latitude : min/max -90,0000000 to 90,0000000';
  }
  getLongTooltip() {
    return 'Longitude : min/max -180,0000000 to 180,0000000';
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createFloorRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/floor/createFloorRequestForm';
import {
  SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef,
  UsersService,
  FloorsService,
  BuildingPartEntityDtoEntityRef,
  BuildingPartsService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-floor-details-new',
  templateUrl: './partner-floor-details-new.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-floor-details-new.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerFloorDetailsNewComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  buildingParts?: Observable<BuildingPartEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  users?: Observable<SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  email: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  phone: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  institution: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  site: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  building: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.BACK, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  idOfElement;
  buildingPartId?: number;

  // Navigation properties
  sourceUrl?: string;
  returnUrl?: string;
  previousPath?: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private floorService: FloorsService,
    private buildingPartService: BuildingPartsService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private location: Location,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.idOfElement = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.id;
    this.buildingPartId = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.buildingPartId;

    // Get sourceRoute from query params for use in navigation
    this.activatedRoute.queryParams.subscribe((params) => {
      if (params['sourceRoute']) {
        this.sourceUrl = params['sourceRoute'];
      }
    });

    // Check navigation state for return URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.returnUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }

    // Also consider the previous URL from browser history
    this.previousPath = this.location.path();

    this.institution.disable();
    this.site.disable();
    this.building.disable();
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createFloorRequestForm.get());
    this.edit();
    this.getBuildingParts();
    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();

    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
      this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
      if (value?.id) {
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
      }
    });

    this.form.get('buildingPart')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        this.buildingPartService.buildingPartsGetParentsEntityRefModelById(value.id).subscribe((result) => {
          this.institution.setValue(result.institution?.entityDisplayName);
          this.site.setValue(result.site?.entityDisplayName);
          this.building.setValue(result.building?.entityDisplayName);
        });
      } else {
        this.institution.setValue(null);
        this.site.setValue(null);
        this.building.setValue(null);
      }
    });

    if (this.buildingPartId) {
      this.buildingPartService
        .buildingPartsGetParentsEntityRefModelById(this.buildingPartId)
        .subscribe((buildingPart) => {
          this.institution.setValue(buildingPart.institution?.entityDisplayName);
          this.site.setValue(buildingPart.site?.entityDisplayName);
          this.building.setValue(buildingPart.building?.entityDisplayName);
          this.form.get('buildingPart')?.setValue(buildingPart.buildingPart);
        });
      this.form.get('buildingPart')?.disable();
    }
  }

  getBuildingParts() {
    this.buildingParts = this.buildingPartService.buildingPartsGetBuildingPartEntityRef();
  }

  save() {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    return this.floorService.floorsPost(formValues);
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.enable();
    this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
  }

  /**
   * Handle successful save operation
   */
  public onSaved(): void {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
    const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
    this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
      duration: 5000,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
      horizontalPosition: 'end',
      verticalPosition: 'top',
    });
  }

  /**
   * Handle cancel action
   */
  cancel() {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
  }

  /**
   * Handle back action
   */
  back() {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
  }

  /**
   * Navigate with priority fallbacks
   * 1. Use stored returnUrl from navigation state
   * 2. Use sourceUrl from query parameters
   * 3. Check if coming from a building part view/edit page
   * 4. Default to floors list
   */
  private navigateWithFallbacks(): void {
    // First check if we have a direct returnUrl
    if (this.returnUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.returnUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Then check for sourceUrl from query parameters
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl('/' + this.sourceUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Check if we came from a building part view page
    if (
      this.previousPath &&
      this.previousPath.includes('/partner/buildingparts/') &&
      (this.previousPath.includes('/view') || this.previousPath.includes('/edit'))
    ) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.previousPath);
      return;
    }

    // If a building part ID was specified, try to navigate back to it
    if (this.buildingPartId) {
      this.router.navigate(['/partner/buildingparts/' + this.buildingPartId + '/view']);
      return;
    }

    // Default fallback - go to floors list
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/floors']);
  }

  getLatTooltip(): string {
    return 'Latitude coordinate (e.g. 47.497912)';
  }

  getLongTooltip(): string {
    return 'Longitude coordinate (e.g. 19.040235)';
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable.component';
import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection, IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { FloorListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult, FloorsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-floor-list',
  templateUrl: './partner-floor-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-floor-list.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerFloorListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true })
  protected dataDataTable: MatDatatableComponent | undefined;
  @Input() institutionId: number | undefined;
  @Input() siteId: number | undefined;
  @Input() buildingId: number | undefined;
  @Input() buildingPartId: number | undefined;

  protected dialog: MatDialog;

  // Navigation properties
  sourceUrl: string | undefined;
  currentUrl: string | undefined;

  //todo add searchForminit
  searchForm = this.fb.group({
    nameFilter: [null],
    institutionFilter: [null],
    siteFilter: [null],
    buildingFilter: [null],
    buildingPartFilter: [null],
    addressFilter: [null],
    active: [{ id: true, name: 'Aktív' }],
  });

  activeOptions = [
    { id: true, name: 'Aktív' },
    { id: false, name: 'Inaktív' },
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private floorService: FloorsService,
    private location: Location,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    this.rootPath = 'partner/floors';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    // Store current URL for navigation context
    this.currentUrl = this.location.path();

    // If we're embedded within a building part view, save that as the source URL
    if (this.buildingPartId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/building-parts/${this.buildingPartId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a building part edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/building-parts/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    } else if (this.buildingId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/buildings/${this.buildingId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a building edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/buildings/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/sites/${this.siteId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a site edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/sites/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    }

    // Check navigation state for source URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      this.sourceUrl = (navigation.extras.state as any).sourceUrl || this.sourceUrl;
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/floors/${element.id}/view`]);
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/floors/${element.id}/edit`]);
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.FLOORS.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe((result) => {
      if (result) {
        this.floorService.floorsDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => {
          this.dataDataTable!.refreshEvent();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // Server-side data request method for modern datatable
  getFloors(params: IDataTableRequest): Observable<FloorListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult> {
    const apiSortDirection =
      params.sortDirection === DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    if (this.buildingPartId) {
      return this.floorService.floorsGetFloors(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.buildingPartId,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else if (this.buildingId) {
      return this.floorService.floorsGetFloors(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.buildingId,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      return this.floorService.floorsGetFloors(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        this.siteId,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else if (this.institutionId) {
      return this.floorService.floorsGetFloors(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        this.institutionId,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else {
      return this.floorService.floorsGetFloors(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    }
  }

  addNew() {
    if (this.buildingPartId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/floors/new/${this.buildingPartId}`], );
    } else if (this.buildingId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/floors/new/${this.buildingId}`]);
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/floors/new/${this.siteId}`]);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['partner/floors/new']);
    }
  }

  // Navigate back to the source URL if available
  goBack() {
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.sourceUrl);
    } else {
      this.location.back();
    }
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }

  // Method to check if the add button should be shown
  shouldShowAddButton(): boolean {
    // Show if all IDs are null or if buildingPartId has a value
    return (!this.institutionId && !this.siteId && !this.buildingId && !this.buildingPartId) || !!this.buildingPartId;
  }
}

import {
  Component,
  ElementRef,
  Injector,
  Input,
  OnInit,
  ViewChild,
} from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import {
  TenantStatus,
  AddressEntityDto,
  AddressType,
  InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { InstitutionValidityEntityDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/institutionValidityEntityDto';
import { InstitutionsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { CommonCardDetailsModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/commonCardDetailsModel';
import { DeviceStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/deviceStatus';
import { InstitutionCardModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/institutionCardModel';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { MatTabGroup } from '@angular/material/tabs';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { modifyInstitutionRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/institution/modifyInstitutionRequestForm';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-institutions-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-institutions-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-institutions-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerInstitutionsEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() institutionId: number;
  public identifier?: string;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  // TODO: intézmény alapadatok form előkészítés, most nem használjuk
  form: UntypedFormGroup;
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  institutionValidities: InstitutionValidityEntityDto[];
  tabSelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroupSelectedIndex = 0;
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantCode?: string;
  isAddingNewValidity = false;
  activeEditingValidityId: number | null = null;
  selectedIndex = 0;
  cards: CommonCardDetailsModel[] = [];

  @ViewChild(MatTabGroup) tabGroup?: MatTabGroup;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private institutionsService: InstitutionsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = 'partner/institutions';
    // this.previousBreadcrumbs = [
    //   new BreadcrumbItem('SIDEBAR.PARTNER_SUB_ROUTES.INSTITUTIONS', this.rootPath)
    // ];
    // this.setBreadcrumbs();

    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
    this.institutionValidities = [];
    this.institutionId = +route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!;

    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(modifyInstitutionRequestForm.get());
    this.form.disable();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();
    this.loadInstitutionValidities();
    this.loadInstitutionCards();
  }

  private loadInstitutionValidities() {
    if (this.institutionId) {
      this.institutionsService.institutionsGetById(this.institutionId).subscribe({
        next: (model) => {
          // Set the institution validities from the model
          this.institutionValidities = model.institutionValidities || [];
          // Set the identifier from the model
          this.identifier = model.identifier;
          // Set breadcrumb with institution name
          this.setBreadcrumbs(model.name);
          this.form.patchValue(model);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error(error);
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private loadInstitutionCards() {
    if (this.institutionId) {
      this.institutionsService.institutionsGetInstitutionCards(this.institutionId).subscribe({
        next: (cardData) => {
          this.transformCardData(cardData);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error(error);
        },
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Transform InstitutionCardModel data into CommonCardDetailsModel format
   */
  transformCardData(cardData: InstitutionCardModel): void {
    this.cards = [];

    if (cardData.siteCount && cardData.siteCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'Site',
        count: cardData.siteCount,
        displayName: 'Telephelyek',
        description: `${cardData.siteCount} telephely(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }

    if (cardData.measurementPointCount && cardData.measurementPointCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'MeasurementPoint',
        count: cardData.measurementPointCount,
        displayName: 'Mérési helyek',
        description: `${cardData.measurementPointCount} mérési hely(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }

    if (cardData.deviceCount && cardData.deviceCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'Device',
        count: cardData.deviceCount,
        displayName: 'Eszközök',
        description: `${cardData.deviceCount} eszköz(ök)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }

    if (cardData.energyContractCount && cardData.energyContractCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'Contract',
        count: cardData.energyContractCount,
        displayName: 'Szerződések',
        description: `${cardData.energyContractCount} szerződés(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }
  }

  commonCardClikedHander(card: CommonCardDetailsModel) {
    switch (card.type) {
      case 'Contract':
        this.router.navigate(['partner/contracts']);
        break;
      case 'Device':
        this.router.navigate(['devices/iot']);
        break;
      case 'Site':
        this.router.navigate(['partner/sites']);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  setBreadcrumbs(institutionName?: string) {
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();

    this.breadcrumbService.push(new BreadcrumbItem('SIDEBAR.PARTNER_SUB_ROUTES.INSTITUTIONS', this.rootPath!));

    if (institutionName) {
      this.breadcrumbService.push(new BreadcrumbItem(institutionName, ''));
    }
  }

  addNewValidity() {
    // Create an empty validity object
    const lastValidity = this.institutionValidities[this.institutionValidities.length - 1];
    let validFromDate = new Date();

    if (lastValidity && lastValidity.validTo) {
      // Parse the validTo date string and add one day
      validFromDate = new Date(lastValidity.validTo);
      validFromDate.setDate(validFromDate.getDate() + 1);
    }

    const emptyValidity: any /*InstitutionValidityEntityDto */ = {
      id: 0,
      name: lastValidity?.name ? lastValidity.name : '',
      validFrom: validFromDate,
      validTo: null,
      description: lastValidity?.description ? lastValidity.description : '',
      headquarters: lastValidity?.headquarters
        ? lastValidity.headquarters
        : ({
            addressType: AddressType.NotDefined,
            address: '',
            city: '',
            country: '',
            postalCode: '',
            region: '',
          } as AddressEntityDto),
      website: lastValidity?.website ? lastValidity.website : '',
      businessIdentifier: lastValidity?.businessIdentifier ? lastValidity.businessIdentifier : '',
      instituteIdentificationType: lastValidity?.instituteIdentificationType ? lastValidity.instituteIdentificationType : '',
      instituteIdentification: lastValidity?.instituteIdentification ? lastValidity.instituteIdentification : '',
      eMail: lastValidity?.eMail ? lastValidity.eMail : '',
      telephone: lastValidity?.telephone ? lastValidity.telephone : '',
      taxIdentificationNumber: lastValidity?.taxIdentificationNumber ? lastValidity.taxIdentificationNumber : '',
      companyRegistrationNumber: lastValidity?.companyRegistrationNumber ? lastValidity.companyRegistrationNumber : '',
      contactPersonName: lastValidity?.contactPersonName ? lastValidity.contactPersonName : '',
      contactPerson: lastValidity?.contactPerson ? lastValidity.contactPerson : null,
      institution: { id: this.institutionId } as InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef,
    };

    this.institutionValidities = [...this.institutionValidities, emptyValidity];
    this.isAddingNewValidity = true;
    this.tabSelectedIndex = this.institutionValidities.length - 1;
  }

  onValiditySaved() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadInstitutionValidities();
  }

  onValidityDeleted(validityId: number) {
    this.institutionValidities = this.institutionValidities.filter((v) => v.id !== validityId);
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadInstitutionValidities();
  }

  onValidityCancelled() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadInstitutionValidities();
  }

  onValidityEditStarted(validityId: number) {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = validityId;
  }

  trackValidityById(index: number, validity: any): any {
    return validity.id;
  }

  cancel() {
    // Navigate back
    this.router.navigate([this.rootPath]);
  }

  back() {
    this.router.navigate([this.rootPath]);
  }

  secondTabDisabled(): boolean {
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      return false;
    }
    // Add any validation logic here if needed
    return false;
  }

  goToSecondTab() {
    this.selectedIndex = 1;
  }

  goToFirstTab() {
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, Output, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createOrUpdateInstitutionValidityRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/institution/createOrUpdateInstitutionValidityRequestForm';
import { InstitutionsService, TenantStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { InstitutionValidityEntityDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/institutionValidityEntityDto';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partners-institutions-validity',
  templateUrl: './partners-institutions-validity.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partners-institutions-validity.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnersInstitutionsValidityComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() institutionId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  @Input() validity?: InstitutionValidityEntityDto;
  @Input() isNew?: boolean;
  @Input() isEditDisabled?: boolean;
  @Output() validitySaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() validityCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() editStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() validityDeleted = new EventEmitter<void>();

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantCode?: string;
  validityId?: number;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private institutionsService: InstitutionsService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createOrUpdateInstitutionValidityRequestForm.get());
    if (this.isNew) {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.CREATE;
      this.isEdit = true;
    } else {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
      this.isEdit = false;
      this.form.disable();
    }

    if (this.validity && this.form) {
      this.validityId = this.validity.id;
      this.form.patchValue(this.validity);
    }

    // Initialize fields with empty strings to prevent null values
    // if (this.form.get('taxIdentificationNumber').value === null) {
    //   this.form.get('taxIdentificationNumber').setValue('');
    // }

    // if (this.form.get('companyRegistrationNumber').value === null) {
    //   this.form.get('companyRegistrationNumber').setValue('');
    // }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;

    // // Store current values before enabling the form
    // const taxIdValue = this.form.get('taxIdentificationNumber').value;
    // const companyRegValue = this.form.get('companyRegistrationNumber').value;

    // Enable form controls
    this.form.get('headquarters')?.enable();
    this.form.enable();

    // Force update the formatted ID fields with their current values
    // // This ensures they retain their values when switching to edit mode
    // setTimeout(() => {
    //   if (taxIdValue) {
    //     this.form.get('taxIdentificationNumber').setValue(taxIdValue, { emitEvent: true });
    //   }

    //   if (companyRegValue) {
    //     this.form.get('companyRegistrationNumber').setValue(companyRegValue, { emitEvent: true });
    //   }
    // });

    this.editStarted.emit(this.validity!.id);
  }

  public onSaved(customRootPath: string): void {
    if (!this.institutionId) {
      this.cancel();
    } else {
      this.cancel();
      const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
      this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> | null {
    // Mark all fields as touched to trigger validation
    Object.keys(this.form.controls).forEach((key) => {
      const control = this.form.get(key);

      if (control) {
        control.markAsTouched();
        control.markAsDirty();
        control.updateValueAndValidity();
      }
    });

    // Only proceed if the form is valid
    if (!this.form.valid) {
      // If we get here, form is invalid - show error message
      this._snackBar.open('Kérjük, töltse ki az összes kötelező mezőt', '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Error}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });

      return null;
    }

    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };
    console.log(formValues);

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    const saveObservable = this.isNew
      ? this.institutionsService.institutionsCreateValidity(this.institutionId!, formValues)
      : this.institutionsService.institutionsModifyValidity(this.institutionId!, this.validityId!, formValues);

    return new Observable((observer) => {
      saveObservable.subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.validitySaved.emit();
          observer.next(result);
          observer.complete();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          observer.error(error);
          observer.complete();
        },
      });
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.get('headquarters')?.disable();
    this.form.disable();
    this.validityCancelled.emit();
  }

  deleteValidity() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.get('headquarters')?.disable();
    this.form.disable();
    this.institutionsService.institutionsDeleteValidity(this.institutionId!, this.validityId!).subscribe(() => {
      this.validityDeleted.emit();
    });
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { CommonCardDetailsModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/commonCardDetailsModel';
import { SiteEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { SiteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/tenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection, IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import {
  InstitutionListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult,
  InstitutionsService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { MatDatatableComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partners-institutions-list',
  templateUrl: './partners-institutions-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partners-institutions-list.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnersInstitutionsListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true })
  protected dataDataTable: MatDatatableComponent | undefined;
  @Input() isOnPartnerDetail: boolean = false;
  needRefresh: boolean = false;

  private subs = new Subscription();

  //todo add searchForminit
  searchForm = this.fb.group({
    headquartersFilter: [null],
    nameFilter: [null],
    active: [{ id: true, name: 'Aktív' }],
  });

  activeOptions = [
    { id: true, name: 'Aktív' },
    { id: false, name: 'Inaktív' },
  ];

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'name',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.INSTITUTIONS.LIST.NAME_FULL',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'headquarters',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.INSTITUTIONS.LIST.HEADQUARTERS',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'isDeleted',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.INSTITUTIONS.LIST.STATUS',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

  institutions: InstitutionListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult | undefined;
  sites: Observable<SiteEntityDtoEntityRef[]> | undefined;
  siteLocations: Observable<SiteLocationEntityDtoEntityRef[]> | undefined;
  deviceTypes: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] | undefined;

  cards: CommonCardDetailsModel[] = [];

  item: number | undefined;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private institutionsService: InstitutionsService,
    private dictService: DictService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    //this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    this.rootPath = 'partner/institutions';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  addNew() {
    this.router.navigate([`./new`], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  showRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`./${element.id}/view`], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`./${element.id}/edit`], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.INSTITUTIONS.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.institutionsService.institutionsDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => this.dataDataTable!.refreshEvent());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  getDeviceTypes() {
    this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('iot_device_category').subscribe((res) => (this.deviceTypes = res));
  }

  getInstitutions(params: IDataTableRequest) {
    let apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      params.sortDirection == DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    return this.institutionsService.institutionsGetInstitutions(
      this.sfc.headquartersFilter?.value,
      this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
      this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
      params.pageIndex,
      params.pageSize,
      params.sortColumn,
      apiSortDirection,
      false,
    );
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }
}

<div class="form-main-container">

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, Subject } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createInstitutionRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/institution/createInstitutionRequestForm';
import { InstitutionsService, TenantStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partners-institutions-new',
  templateUrl: './partners-institutions-new.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partners-institutions-new.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnersInstitutionsNewComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() partnerId?: number;
  @Input() tenantPartnerId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;

  validationSub = new Subject();

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private institutionsService: InstitutionsService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];

    this.rootPath = 'partner/institutions';
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('SIDEBAR.PARTNER_SUB_ROUTES.INSTITUTIONS', this.rootPath)];
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createInstitutionRequestForm.get());
    this.edit();

    // Initialize fields with empty strings to prevent null values
    if (this.form.get('taxIdentificationNumber')?.value === null) {
      this.form.get('taxIdentificationNumber')?.setValue('');
    }

    if (this.form.get('companyRegistrationNumber')?.value === null) {
      this.form.get('companyRegistrationNumber')?.setValue('');
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.get('headquarters')?.enable();
    this.form.enable();
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/institutions']);
    const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
    this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
      duration: 5000,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
      horizontalPosition: 'end',
      verticalPosition: 'top',
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/institutions']);
  }

  protected override save(): Observable<object> {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    return this.institutionsService.institutionsPost(formValues);
  }
  override onSubmit(customRootPath?: string | boolean): void {
    this.validationSub.next(true);
    super.onSubmit(customRootPath);
  }

  back() {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/institutions']);
  }
}

import { Component, Inject, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormArray } from '@angular/forms';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { IoTDevicesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/ioTDevices.service';
import { LoaderService, ProgressRef } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-orgunit-device-connection-result',
  templateUrl: './partner-orgunit-device-connection-result.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-orgunit-device-connection-result.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerOrgUnitDeviceConnectionResultDialogComponent implements OnInit {
  isConnectionSuccessfull?: boolean;
  configsForm: UntypedFormArray;

  @ViewChild('deviceConnectionResultContent') elRef: any;
  progressRef: ProgressRef = null as any;

  constructor(
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<PartnerOrgUnitDeviceConnectionResultDialogComponent>,
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) deviceConnectionResultDialogData: DeviceConnectionResultDialogData,
    private ioTDevicesService: IoTDevicesService,
    private loaderService: LoaderService,
  ) {
    this.isConnectionSuccessfull = deviceConnectionResultDialogData.isConnectionSuccessfull;
    this.configsForm = deviceConnectionResultDialogData.configsForm;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  cancel() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  reTest() {
    this.progressRef = this.loaderService.showProgress(this.elRef) as any;
    this.ioTDevicesService.ioTDevicesHealthcheck('smappee', this.configsForm.value).subscribe(
      (result) => {
        this.isConnectionSuccessfull = result.success;
      },
      (err: any) => {},
      () => {
        this.loaderService.detach(this.progressRef);
      },
    );
  }
}

export interface DeviceConnectionResultDialogData {
  isConnectionSuccessfull: boolean;
  configsForm: UntypedFormArray;
}

export function openDeviceConnectionResultDialog(
  dialog: MatDialog,
  isConnectionSuccessfull: boolean,
  configsForm: UntypedFormArray,
) {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';
  config.data = {
    configsForm,
    isConnectionSuccessfull,
  } as DeviceConnectionResultDialogData;

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(PartnerOrgUnitDeviceConnectionResultDialogComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<PartnerOrgUnitDeviceCreateComponent>,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private ioTDeviceTypesService: IoTDeviceTypesService,
    deviceConfigsService: DeviceConfigsService,
    private devicesService: DevicesService,
    private ioTDevicesService: IoTDevicesService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createDeviceRequestForm.get());
    this.form.addControl('configValues', new UntypedFormArray([]));
    this.deviceCategoryForm.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      this.getIoTDeviceType(value as EntityRef);
    });
    this.getDeviceCategories();
    this.ioTDeviceTypeForm.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      deviceConfigsService.deviceConfigsGetDeviceDeviceConfigListById(value.id).subscribe((configs) => {
        this.configInputFields.length = 0;
        this.configsForm.clear();
        for (const config of configs) {
          this.configsForm.push(
            new UntypedFormGroup({
              code: new UntypedFormControl(config.code),
              value: new UntypedFormControl(''),
            }),
          );
          this.configInputFields.push({
            code: config.code,
            label: config.name,
          } as ConfigDefinition);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form.get('siteLocation')?.setValue({
      id: this.siteLocationId,
    });
  }

  public connectionTest() {
    this.ioTDevicesService.ioTDevicesHealthcheck('smappee', this.configsForm.value).subscribe((result) => {
      openDeviceConnectionResultDialog(this.dialog, result.success!, this.configsForm);
    });
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    this.form.get('siteLocation')?.setValue({
      id: this.siteLocationId,
    });
    console.log(this.form.getRawValue());
    return this.devicesService.devicesPost(this.form.getRawValue());
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.dialogRef.close();
    this.connectionTest();
  }

  parentFormGroupValueHandler() {
    const configValues = this.form.get('configValues') as UntypedFormArray;
    configValues.clear();

    this.configInputFields.forEach(() => {
      configValues.push(this.formBuilder.group(configValueModelForm.get()));
    });

    for (const formGroup of (this.parentFormGroup.get('parentFormArray') as UntypedFormArray).controls) {
      this.form.patchValue(formGroup.value);
    }
    this.onSubmit(false);
  }

  private getDeviceCategories() {
    this.deviceCategories = this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('iot_device_category');
  }

  private getIoTDeviceType(v: EntityRef) {
    this.ioTDeviceTypes = this.ioTDeviceTypesService.ioTDeviceTypesGetDevicesRefByDeviceCategoryId(v.id!);
  }

  cancel() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  add() {}
}

export function openNewDeviceDialog(dialog: MatDialog, siteLocationId: number) {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(PartnerOrgUnitDeviceCreateComponent, config);
  const instance = dialogRef.componentInstance;
  instance.siteLocationId = siteLocationId;
  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'installationDate',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.EDM_DEVICES.LIST.INSTALLATION_DATE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'removalDate',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.EDM_DEVICES.LIST.REMOVAL_DATE',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'measurementDescriptors',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.EDM_DEVICES.LIST.MEASUREMENT_DESCRIPTORS',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];

    router: Router,

    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private deviceService: DevicesService,

    this.rootPath = 'devices';

    console.log(element);
    this.router.navigate(['devices/iot/' + element.identifier + '/view']);
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate(['devices/iot/' + element.identifier + '/edit']);
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.name}' IOT eszközt?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.deviceService.devicesDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => this.getDevices());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  refreshChange(element: boolean) {
    if (element) this.needRefresh = false;
  }

  addNew() {
    this.router.navigate(['devices/iot/new']);
  }

  getDeviceTypes() {
    this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('iot_device_category').subscribe((res) => (this.deviceTypes = res));
  }

  getDevices(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;

    this.measurementPointsService
      .measurementPointsGetDevicesByOrgunitBaseId(this.orgUnitId!, this.activeOnlyFilter!.value!)
      .subscribe({
        next: (data) => {
          const tableData: IDataTableResponse = {
            items: data,
            recordsTotal: data.length,
          };
          this.devices = tableData;
          this.dataDataTable.refresh();
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: () => {
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import {
  BuildingsService,
  BuildingPartsService,
  FloorsService,
  RoomsService,
  OrgunitType,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { LiveAnnouncer } from '@angular/cdk/a11y';
import { COMMA, ENTER } from '@angular/cdk/keycodes';
import { inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { MatChipEditedEvent, MatChipInputEvent } from '@angular/material/chips';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-orgunit-pod-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-orgunit-pod-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-orgunit-pod-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerOrgUnitPodEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() orgUnitId?: number;
  @Input() orgUnitType?: OrgunitType;
  @Input() isEditDisabled = false;
  @Input() isNew = false;

  @Output() podSaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() podCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() podEditStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() podDeleted = new EventEmitter<number>();

  public pageMode?: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  form: UntypedFormGroup;
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  errorMessage?: string;

  readonly addOnBlur = true;
  readonly separatorKeysCodes = [ENTER, COMMA] as const;
  readonly pods = signal<string[]>([]);
  readonly announcer = inject(LiveAnnouncer);

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private buildingsService: BuildingsService,
    private buildingPartsService: BuildingPartsService,
    private floorsService: FloorsService,
    private roomsService: RoomsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      pods: [[]],
    });
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
    this.getPods();
  }

  getPods(): void {
    let obs: Observable<string[]> | null = null;

    if (this.orgUnitType === OrgunitType.Building) {
      obs = this.buildingsService.buildingsGetPodIdentifiers(this.orgUnitId!);
    } else if (this.orgUnitType === OrgunitType.BuildingPart) {
      obs = this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsGetPodIdentifiers(this.orgUnitId!);
    } else if (this.orgUnitType === OrgunitType.Floor) {
      obs = this.floorsService.floorsGetPodIdentifiers(this.orgUnitId!);
    } else if (this.orgUnitType === OrgunitType.Room) {
      obs = this.roomsService.roomsGetPodIdentifiers(this.orgUnitId!);
    }

    obs?.subscribe({
      next: (result) => {
        this.pods.update(() => result);
        if (this.form) {
          this.form.patchValue({ pods: result });
        }
      },
      error: (error) => console.error(error),
    });
  }

  addPod(event: MatChipInputEvent): void {
    const value = (event.value || '').trim();

    if (value) {
      const currentPods = this.pods();
      this.pods.update((pods) => [...pods, value]);
      this.form.patchValue({ pods: [...currentPods, value] });
    }

    event.chipInput!.clear();
  }

  removePod(pod: string): void {
    this.pods.update((pods) => {
      const index = pods.indexOf(pod);
      if (index < 0) {
        return pods;
      }

      const newPods = [...pods];
      newPods.splice(index, 1);
      this.form.patchValue({ pods: newPods });
      this.announcer.announce(`Removed ${pod}`);
      return newPods;
    });
  }

  editPod(pod: string, event: MatChipEditedEvent) {
    const value = event.value.trim();

    if (!value) {
      this.removePod(pod);
      return;
    }

    const index = this.pods().indexOf(pod);
    if (index >= 0) {
      const newPods = [...this.pods()];
      newPods[index] = value;
      this.pods.update(() => newPods);
      this.form.patchValue({ pods: newPods });
    }
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.pageMode = PageMode.EDIT;
    this.form.enable();
    this.podEditStarted.emit(this.orgUnitId);
    this.errorMessage = undefined;
  }

  delete() {
    this.podDeleted.emit(this.orgUnitId);
  }

  override onSaved() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
    this.form.disable();
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    this.errorMessage = undefined;

    if (this.form.invalid) {
      return new Observable((observer) => {
        observer.error('Form is invalid');
        observer.complete();
      });
    }

    let saveObservable: Observable<string[]> | null = null;

    if (this.orgUnitType === OrgunitType.Building) {
      saveObservable = this.buildingsService.buildingsPutPodIdentifiers(this.orgUnitId!, {
        podIdentifiers: this.pods(),
      });
    } else if (this.orgUnitType === OrgunitType.BuildingPart) {
      saveObservable = this.buildingPartsService.buildingPartsPutPodIdentifiers(this.orgUnitId!, {
        podIdentifiers: this.pods(),
      });
    } else if (this.orgUnitType === OrgunitType.Floor) {
      saveObservable = this.floorsService.floorsPutPodIdentifiers(this.orgUnitId!, { podIdentifiers: this.pods() });
    } else if (this.orgUnitType === OrgunitType.Room) {
      saveObservable = this.roomsService.roomsPutPodIdentifiers(this.orgUnitId!, { podIdentifiers: this.pods() });
    }

    return new Observable((observer) => {
      saveObservable?.subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.podSaved.emit();
          //this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
          this.form.disable();
          observer.next(result);
          observer.complete();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          observer.error(error);
          observer.complete();
          this.getPods();

          if (error && error.error && error.error.errors) {
            const errorKeys = Object.keys(error.error.errors);
            if (errorKeys && errorKeys.length > 0) {
              const firstErrorKey = errorKeys[0];
              if (firstErrorKey) {
                const errorValue = error.error.errors[firstErrorKey];
                if (Array.isArray(errorValue) && errorValue.length > 0 && typeof errorValue[0] === 'string') {
                  this.errorMessage = errorValue[0];
                  this.form.controls.pods.setErrors({
                    Hiba: errorValue[0],
                  });
                } else if (typeof errorValue === 'string') {
                  this.errorMessage = errorValue;
                  this.form.controls.pods.setErrors({
                    Hiba: errorValue,
                  });
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
      });
    });
  }

  trackByPodAndIndex(index: number, pod: string): string {
    return `${index}-${pod}`;
  }

  cancel() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
    this.form.disable();
    this.podCancelled.emit();
    this.errorMessage = undefined;
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, ViewChildren, QueryList, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatTabGroup } from '@angular/material/tabs';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import {
  MeasurementPointsService,
  PeakValueCardDetailsModel,
  RoomModel,
  RoomsService,
  RoomValidityEntityDto,
  TenantStatus,
  //generikusság miatt generátla így a tipus nevet
  RoomValidityEntityDtoRoomValidityWithBuildingValidityInfoWarningContextEntityWarningModelBase as RoomValidityWarning,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { EmitService } from 'src/app/core/services/emit.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-room-details-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-room-details-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-room-details-edit.component.scss'],
  providers: [EmitService],
})
export class PartnerRoomDetailsEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() roomId: number;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroup2SelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroup3SelectedIndex = 0;
  validityTabSelectedIndex = 0;

  isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne: boolean = false;
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantCode?: string;
  isAddingNewValidity = false;
  activeEditingValidityId: number | null = null;
  room?: RoomModel;
  roomValidities: RoomValidityEntityDto[] = [];

  measurementPointCards: PeakValueCardDetailsModel[] = [];

  RoomValidityWarnings: RoomValidityWarning[] = [];

  @ViewChildren(MatTabGroup) tabGroups?: QueryList<MatTabGroup>;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private roomsService: RoomsService,
    private measurementPointService: MeasurementPointsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private emitService: EmitService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.rootPath = 'partner/rooms';

    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
    this.roomValidities = [];
    this.roomId = Number(route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    super.ngOnInit();
    this.loadRoomValidities();
    this.loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards();
    this.loadRoomValidityWarnings();
  }

  private loadRoomValidities() {
    if (this.roomId) {
      this.isLoading = true;
      this.roomsService.roomsGetRoomById(this.roomId).subscribe({
        next: (room) => {
          this.room = room;
          this.roomValidities = room.roomValidities || [];
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: () => {
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });
    }
  }
  private loadRoomValidityWarnings() {
    if (this.roomId) {
      this.roomsService.roomsGetRoomValidityWarnings(this.roomId).subscribe({
        next: (warnings) => {
          this.RoomValidityWarnings = warnings;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private hasWarningForValidity(validityId: number): boolean {
    return this.RoomValidityWarnings.some((warning) => warning.warnedEntity.id === validityId);
  }
  private hasIntervalMismatch(validityId: number): boolean {
    return this.RoomValidityWarnings.some(
      (warning) =>
        warning.warnedEntity.id === validityId &&
        warning.warningContext.buildingAndRoomValidityIntervalMismatch === true,
    );
  }
  private hasProfileMismatch(validityId: number): boolean {
    return this.RoomValidityWarnings.some(
      (warning) =>
        warning.warnedEntity.id === validityId && warning.warningContext.buildingAndRoomProfileMismatch === true,
    );
  }
  private loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards() {
    if (this.roomId) {
      this.measurementPointService.measurementPointsGetOrgunitPeakValueCards(this.roomId).subscribe({
        next: (cardData) => {
          this.measurementPointCards = cardData;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  addNewValidity() {
    const lastValidity = this.roomValidities[this.roomValidities.length - 1];
    let validFromDate = new Date();

    if (lastValidity && lastValidity.validTo) {
      // Parse the validTo date string and add one day
      validFromDate = new Date(lastValidity.validTo);
      validFromDate.setDate(validFromDate.getDate() + 1);
    }

    const newValidity: any /*RoomValidityEntityDto */ = {
      room: { id: this.roomId },
      id: 0,
      name: lastValidity?.name ? lastValidity.name : '',
      validFrom: validFromDate,
      validTo: null,
      businessIdentifier: lastValidity?.businessIdentifier ? lastValidity.businessIdentifier : '',
      eMail: lastValidity?.eMail ? lastValidity.eMail : '',
      telephone: lastValidity?.telephone ? lastValidity.telephone : '',
      contactPersonName: lastValidity?.contactPersonName ? lastValidity.contactPersonName : '',
      contactPerson: lastValidity?.contactPerson ? lastValidity.contactPerson : null,
      lat: lastValidity?.lat ? lastValidity.lat : null,
      lon: lastValidity?.lon ? lastValidity.lon : null,
      roomProfile: lastValidity?.roomProfile ? lastValidity.roomProfile : null,
    };
    this.roomValidities = [...this.roomValidities, newValidity];
    this.isAddingNewValidity = true;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = 0;
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 1; // Switch to validities tab
    this.validityTabSelectedIndex = this.roomValidities.length - 1; // Switch to the new validity tab
  }

  editValidity(validityId: number) {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = validityId;
  }

  onBaseDataSaved() {
    // Reset the first tab group to the base data tab
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 0;
  }

  onBaseDataCancelled() {
    // Reset the first tab group to the base data tab
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 0;
  }

  onBaseDataEditStarted(roomId: number) {}

  onBaseDataDeleted(roomId: number) {
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/rooms']);
  }

  onValiditySaved() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadRoomValidities();
    this.loadRoomValidityWarnings();
  }

  onValidityCancelled() {
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadRoomValidities();
  }

  onValidityEditStarted(validityId: number) {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = validityId;
  }

  onValidityDeleted(validityId: number) {
    this.roomValidities = this.roomValidities.filter((v) => v.id !== validityId);
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
    this.loadRoomValidities();
  }

  onTabGroup1Change(index: number) {
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = index;
    if (index === 1 && !this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne) {
      this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne = true;
      this.emitService.emit();
    }
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, Output, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { modifyRoomRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/room/modifyRoomRequestForm';
import { RoomModel, RoomsService, TenantStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-room-details-edit-base-data',
  templateUrl: './partner-room-details-edit-base-data.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-room-details-edit-base-data.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerRoomDetailsEditBaseDataComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() room?: RoomModel;
  @Input() roomId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  @Input() isNew = false;
  @Input() isEditDisabled = false;
  public identifier?: string;

  @Output() baseDataSaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() baseDataCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() baseDataEditStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() baseDataDeleted = new EventEmitter<number>();

  public pageMode?: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private roomsService: RoomsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(modifyRoomRequestForm.get());

    this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
    if (this.room && this.form) {
      this.form.patchValue(this.room);
      //this.form.get('type').setValue(this.room.orgunitType);
      this.identifier = this.room.identifier;
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.enable();
    this.baseDataEditStarted.emit(this.room!.id);
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    if (!this.roomId) {
      this.cancel();
    } else {
      this.cancel();
      const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
      this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const saveObservable = this.roomsService.roomsPut(this.roomId!, this.form.getRawValue());

    return new Observable((observer) => {
      saveObservable.subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.baseDataSaved.emit();
          observer.next(result);
          observer.complete();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          observer.error(error);
        },
      });
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
    this.baseDataCancelled.emit();
  }

  delete() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();

    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.ROOMS.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.roomsService.roomsDelete(this.roomId!).subscribe(() => {
          this.baseDataDeleted.emit();
        });
      }
    });
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\partners\partners-rooms\partner-room-details\partner-room-details-edit\partner-room-details-edit-validity\partner-room-details-edit-validity.component.ts
