import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, Output, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createOrUpdateRoomValidityRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/room/createOrUpdateRoomValidityRequestForm';
import {
  RoomValidityEntityDto,
  RoomsService,
  SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef,
  TenantStatus,
  UsersService,
  RoomProfilesService,
  RoomProfileEntityDtoEntityRef,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-room-details-edit-validity',
  templateUrl: './partner-room-details-edit-validity.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-room-details-edit-validity.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerRoomDetailsEditValidityComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() validity?: RoomValidityEntityDto;
  @Input() roomId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  @Input() isNew = false;
  @Input() isEditDisabled = false;

  @Input() hasProfileMismatch = false;
  @Input() hasIntervalMismatch = false;

  @Output() validitySaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() validityCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() editStarted = new EventEmitter<number>();
  @Output() validityDeleted = new EventEmitter<number>();

  public pageMode?: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  validityId?: number;
  users?: Observable<SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  roomProfiles?: Observable<RoomProfileEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private roomsService: RoomsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private roomProfilesService: RoomProfilesService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createOrUpdateRoomValidityRequestForm.get());
    if (this.isNew) {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.CREATE;
      this.isEdit = true;
    } else {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
      this.isEdit = false;

      this.form.disable();
    }
    if (this.validity && this.form) {
      this.validityId = this.validity.id;
      this.form.patchValue(this.validity);

      // Set the roomProfile if it exists in the validity data
      if (this.validity.roomProfile) {
        this.form.get('roomProfile')?.setValue(this.validity.roomProfile);
      }

      // Check if a contactPerson is initially selected and disable fields accordingly
      if (this.validity.contactPerson?.id) {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
        this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
      }
    }

    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();

    // Load room profiles
    const date = new Date(this.validity!.validFrom); 
    this.roomProfiles = this.roomsService.roomsGetRoomProfilesByRoomValidtyInterval(
      this.roomId!,
      date,
    );

    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        //this.contactmessage = null;
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
          // Disable eMail and telephone fields when contactPerson is selected
          this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
          this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
        // Enable eMail and telephone fields when no contactPerson is selected
        this.form.get('eMail')?.enable();
        this.form.get('telephone')?.enable();
      }
    });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.enable();
    this.fc.validFrom.valueChanges.subscribe((newDate: Date) => {
      this.roomProfiles = this.roomsService.roomsGetRoomProfilesByRoomValidtyInterval(this.roomId!, newDate);
    });
    this.editStarted.emit(this.validity!.id);
  }

  public onSaved(customRootPath: string): void {
    if (!this.roomId) {
      this.cancel();
    } else {
      this.cancel();
      const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
      this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    const saveObservable = this.isNew
      ? this.roomsService.roomsPostRoomValidity(this.roomId!, formValues)
      : this.roomsService.roomsPutRoomValidity(this.roomId!, this.validityId!, formValues);

    return new Observable((observer) => {
      saveObservable.subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.validitySaved.emit();
          observer.next(result);
          observer.complete();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          observer.error(error);
        },
      });
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
    this.validityCancelled.emit();
  }

  deleteValidity() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
    this.roomsService.roomsDeleteRoomValidity(this.roomId!, this.validityId!).subscribe(() => {
      this.validityDeleted.emit(this.validityId);
    });
  }

  getLatTooltip() {
    return 'Latitude : min/max -90,0000000 to 90,0000000';
  }
  getLongTooltip() {
    return 'Longitude : min/max -180,0000000 to 180,0000000';
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\partners\partners-rooms\partner-room-details\partner-room-details-edit\partner-room-details-energy-consumption-device\partner-room-details-energy-consumption-device.component.ts
====================================================================================================

import { Component, OnInit, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { FormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import {
  RoomsService,
  RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto,
  RoomEnergeticDataEntityDtoEntityRef,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { MatDialog, MatDialogConfig } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { ConfirmDialogComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { CreateOptionsDialogComponent, CreateOption } from './create-options-dialog/create-options-dialog.component';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

// Date option interface
export interface DateOption {
  displayName: string;
  date: string;
  entityRef: RoomEnergeticDataEntityDtoEntityRef;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-room-details-energy-consumption-device',
  templateUrl: './partner-room-details-energy-consumption-device.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-room-details-energy-consumption-device.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerRoomDetailsEnergyConsumptionDeviceComponent implements OnInit {
  @Input() roomId!: number;

  energeticData?: RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto;

  dateControl = new FormControl();
  availableDates: DateOption[] = [];
  selectedDate?: string;
  selectedInspectionId?: number;

  isLoading = false;

  constructor(
    private roomsService: RoomsService,
    private datePipe: DatePipe,
    private router: Router,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
    private dialog: MatDialog,
    private translateService: TranslateService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.loadAvailableDates();
  }

  loadAvailableDates() {
    this.roomsService.buildingsGetRoomEnergeticDataInspectionDates(this.roomId).subscribe({
      next: (response) => {
        this.availableDates = response.map((entityRef) => {
          // Since entityRef might not have a date string directly,
          // we use the entityDisplayName or a default display
          const displayName = entityRef.entityDisplayName || this.datePipe.transform(new Date(), 'yyyy.MM.dd.');

          return {
            displayName: displayName,
            date: displayName, // Using displayName as the date string
            entityRef: entityRef,
          } as DateOption;
        });

        if (this.availableDates.length > 0) {
          this.dateControl.setValue(this.availableDates[0]);
          this.selectedDate = this.availableDates[0].date;
          this.selectedInspectionId = this.availableDates[0].entityRef.id;
          this.loadEnergeticData();
        }
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error loading available dates:', error);
      },
    });
  }

  onDateChange(event: any) {
    if (event && event.value) {
      this.selectedDate = event.value.date;
      this.selectedInspectionId = event.value.entityRef.id;
      this.loadEnergeticData();
    }
  }

  loadEnergeticData() {
    if (!this.roomId || !this.selectedInspectionId) {
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;

    this.roomsService.buildingsGetRoomEnergeticData(this.selectedInspectionId).subscribe({
      next: (response) => {
        this.energeticData = response;
        this.isLoading = false;
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error loading room energetic data:', error);
        this.isLoading = false;
      },
    });
  }

  createEnergyConsumption() {
    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(CreateOptionsDialogComponent, {
      width: '600px',
      data: { copyOptionEnabled: !!this.selectedInspectionId }
    });

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe(result => {
      if (result === CreateOption.BLANK) {
        // Navigate to create new blank form
        this.router.navigate([`/partner/rooms/${this.roomId}/details/energy-consumption/new`]);
      } else if (result === CreateOption.COPY_EXISTING && this.selectedInspectionId) {
        // Navigate to create with copy param
        this.router.navigate([`/partner/rooms/${this.roomId}/details/energy-consumption/new`], {
          queryParams: { copyFrom: this.selectedInspectionId }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  editEnergyConsumption() {
    if (this.selectedInspectionId) {
      this.router.navigate([`/partner/rooms/${this.roomId}/details/energy-consumption/${this.selectedInspectionId}/edit`]);
    }
  }

  deleteEnergyConsumption() {
    if (!this.selectedInspectionId) {
      return;
    }
    const confirmTitle = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.CONFIRM_DELETE');
    const confirmMessage = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.CONFIRM_DELETE');
    const confirmYes = this.translateService.instant('COMMON.YES');
    const confirmNo = this.translateService.instant('COMMON.NO');
    
    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, {
      width: '400px',
      data: { title: confirmTitle, message: confirmMessage, yes: confirmYes, no: confirmNo }
    });
    
    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe(result => {
      if (result) {
        this.isLoading = true;
        // Ensure selectedInspectionId is a number before calling the API
        const inspectionId = this.selectedInspectionId as number;
        this.roomsService.roomsDeleteRoomEnergeticData(inspectionId)
          .pipe(finalize(() => this.isLoading = false))
          .subscribe({
            next: () => {
              const message = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.DATA_DELETED');
              this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
                duration: 3000,
                panelClass: ['success-snackbar']
              });
              
              // Reload available dates after deletion
              this.loadAvailableDates();
            },
            error: (error) => {
              const message = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.DATA_DELETE_FAILED');
              this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
                duration: 3000,
                panelClass: ['error-snackbar']
              });
              console.error('Error deleting energy consumption data', error);
            }
          });
      }
    });
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import {
  RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto,
  RoomEntityDtoEntityRef,
  RoomsService,
  CreateRoomEnergeticDataRequest,
  EditRoomEnergeticDataRequest,
  TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef,
  DictService,
  DictType
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';
import { Observable, forkJoin } from 'rxjs';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-room-details-energy-consumption-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-room-details-energy-consumption-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-room-details-energy-consumption-edit.component.scss']
})
export class PartnerRoomDetailsEnergyConsumptionEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() roomId!: number;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  isLoading = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  
  energeticDataForm!: UntypedFormGroup;
  energeticDataId?: number;
  isCreateMode = true;
  
  // Dictionary options
  windowFrameOptions: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
  openingsConditionOptions: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
  openingsShadingOptions: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
  lightingTypeOptions: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
  lightingControllabilityOptions: TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private roomsService: RoomsService,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.pageMode = this.route.snapshot.data['pageMode'] as PageMode || PageMode.VIEW;
    this.isCreateMode = this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE;
    
    // Get roomId and energeticDataId from route params
    const routeRoomId = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('roomId'));
    if (routeRoomId) {
      this.roomId = routeRoomId;
    }
    
    const energeticDataIdParam = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (energeticDataIdParam) {
      this.energeticDataId = Number(energeticDataIdParam);
      this.isCreateMode = false;
    }
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    // Load dictionary data first
    this.loadDictionaryData();
    
    this.initForm();
    
    // Check if we're in edit mode
    if (!this.isCreateMode && this.energeticDataId) {
      this.loadEnergeticData();
    } else {
      // Check if we should copy from existing record
      const copyFromId = this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('copyFrom');
      if (copyFromId) {
        // Load data from the copyFromId but keep isCreateMode true
        this.loadEnergeticDataForCopy(+copyFromId);
      }
    }
  }

  private initForm() {
    this.energeticDataForm = this.formBuilder.group({
      // Room reference will be set during save
      roomUsefulFloorArea: [null],
      roomCeilingHeight: [null],
      roomBoundaryAndOpeningStructuresSurfaceArea: [null],
      allWindowArea: [null],
      windowFrameAndDoorMaterial: [null],
      openingsCondition: [null],
      openingsGlassThickness: [null],
      openingsShading: [null],
      isItPossibleToUpgradeOpenings: [null],
      lightingType: [null],
      lightnigIntensity: [null],
      lightingControllability: [null],
      lightingPowerConsumption: [null],
      heatEmittersType: [null],
      heatEmittersRegulation: [null],
      heatEmitterPerformance: [null],
      numberOfHeatEmitters: [null],
      existingMetersSensorsActuators: [null],
      meterInstallationConditions: [null],
      dataConnectionConditions: [null],
      ensuringPowerSupply: [null],
      requiredForBasicSetup: [null],
      requiredForMediumSetup: [null],
      requiredForFullSetup: [null],
      inspectionDate: [null, Validators.required],
      id: [null]
    });
  }

  private loadEnergeticData() {
    if (!this.energeticDataId) return;
    
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.roomsService.buildingsGetRoomEnergeticData(this.energeticDataId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.isLoading = false))
      .subscribe({
        next: (data) => {
          if (data) {
            this.patchFormWithData(data);
          }
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.ERROR_LOADING_DATA');
          this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
            panelClass: ['error-snackbar']
          });
          console.error('Error loading energy consumption data', error);
        }
      });
  }

  private patchFormWithData(data: Partial<RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto>) {
    // We need to handle potential null/undefined values and format dates
    const formData = {
      ...data,
      inspectionDate: data.inspectionDate ? new Date(data.inspectionDate) : null
    };
    
    this.energeticDataForm.patchValue(formData);
  }
  
  private loadEnergeticDataForCopy(copyFromId: number) {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.roomsService.buildingsGetRoomEnergeticData(copyFromId)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.isLoading = false))
      .subscribe({
        next: (data) => {
          if (data) {
            // Clear the ID from the data as we're creating a new record
            const copyData = {
              ...data,
              id: undefined
            };
            this.patchFormWithData(copyData);
            const message = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.DATA_COPIED');
            this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
              duration: 5000,
              panelClass: ['info-snackbar']
            });
          }
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.ERROR_LOADING_DATA');
          this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
            panelClass: ['error-snackbar']
          });
          console.error('Error loading data to copy', error);
        }
      });
  }

  onCancel() {
    this.navigateBack();
  }

  onSubmit() {
    if (this.energeticDataForm.invalid) {
      this.markFormGroupTouched(this.energeticDataForm);
      return;
    }

    const formValue = this.energeticDataForm.value;
    
    this.isLoading = true;
    
    if (this.isCreateMode) {
      this.createEnergeticData(formValue);
    } else {
      this.updateEnergeticData(formValue);
    }
  }

  private createEnergeticData(formValue: any) {
    // Format the inspectionDate to yyyy-MM-dd format if present
    if (formValue.inspectionDate) {
      const date = new Date(formValue.inspectionDate);
      formValue.inspectionDate = date.getFullYear() + '-' + 
        ('0' + (date.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + '-' + 
        ('0' + date.getDate()).slice(-2);
    }
    
    const createRequest: CreateRoomEnergeticDataRequest = {
      ...formValue
    };
    
    this.roomsService.roomsCreateRoomEnergeticData(this.roomId, createRequest)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.isLoading = false))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          const message = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.DATA_CREATED');
          this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
            panelClass: ['success-snackbar']
          });
          this.navigateBack();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.DATA_CREATE_FAILED');
          this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
            panelClass: ['error-snackbar']
          });
          console.error('Failed to create energy consumption data', error);
        }
      });
  }

  private updateEnergeticData(formValue: any) {
    if (!this.energeticDataId) return;
    
    // Format the inspectionDate to yyyy-MM-dd format if present
    if (formValue.inspectionDate) {
      const date = new Date(formValue.inspectionDate);
      formValue.inspectionDate = date.getFullYear() + '-' + 
        ('0' + (date.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + '-' + 
        ('0' + date.getDate()).slice(-2);
    }
    
    const updateRequest: EditRoomEnergeticDataRequest = {
      ...formValue
    };
    
    this.roomsService.roomsEditRoomEnergeticData(this.energeticDataId, updateRequest)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.isLoading = false))
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          const message = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.DATA_UPDATED');
          this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
            panelClass: ['success-snackbar']
          });
          this.navigateBack();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const message = this.translateService.instant('PARTNERS.ROOMS.DETAILS.ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_DEVICES.DATA_UPDATE_FAILED');
          this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
            duration: 3000,
            panelClass: ['error-snackbar']
          });
          console.error('Failed to update energy consumption data', error);
        }
      });
  }
  
  private navigateBack() {
    // Navigate back to the room details page
    this.router.navigate([`/partner/rooms/${this.roomId}/edit`]);
  }
  
  // Helper to mark all form controls as touched to trigger validation
  private markFormGroupTouched(formGroup: UntypedFormGroup) {
    Object.values(formGroup.controls).forEach(control => {
      control.markAsTouched();
      
      if (control instanceof UntypedFormGroup) {
        this.markFormGroupTouched(control);
      }
    });
  }
  
  private loadDictionaryData() {
    const windowFrameMaterialsReq = this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType.WindowMaterial);
    const openingsConditionReq = this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType.OpenningsCondition);
    const openingsShadingReq = this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType.OpenningsShading);
    const lightingTypeReq = this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType.LightingType);
    const lightingControllabilityReq = this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType.LightingControllability);
    
    forkJoin([
      windowFrameMaterialsReq,
      openingsConditionReq,
      openingsShadingReq,
      lightingTypeReq,
      lightingControllabilityReq
    ])
    .subscribe({
      next: ([windowFrames, openingsConditions, openingsShadings, lightingTypes, lightingControllabilities]) => {
        this.windowFrameOptions = windowFrames || [];
        this.openingsConditionOptions = openingsConditions || [];
        this.openingsShadingOptions = openingsShadings || [];
        this.lightingTypeOptions = lightingTypes || [];
        this.lightingControllabilityOptions = lightingControllabilities || [];
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error loading dictionary data', error);
      }
    });
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, NgZone, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createRoomRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/room/createRoomRequestForm';
import {
  SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef,
  UsersService,
  RoomsService,
  FloorEntityDtoEntityRef,
  FloorsService,
  RoomProfilesService,
  RoomProfileEntityDtoEntityRef,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import { ErrorHelper } from '../../../../../core/errors/error-helper';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-room-details-new',
  templateUrl: './partner-room-details-new.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-room-details-new.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerRoomDetailsNewComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  floors?: Observable<FloorEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  users?: Observable<SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  roomProfiles?: Observable<RoomProfileEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  institution: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  site: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  building: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  buildingPart: UntypedFormControl = new UntypedFormControl('');
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.BACK, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  idOfElement;
  floorId?: number;
  partnerId?: number; // Added missing property for partnerId
  private ngZone: NgZone; // Add the missing ngZone property

  // Navigation properties
  sourceUrl?: string;
  returnUrl?: string;
  previousPath?: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private roomService: RoomsService,
    private floorService: FloorsService,
    private roomProfilesService: RoomProfilesService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private location: Location,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.idOfElement = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.id;
    this.floorId = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.floorId;
    this.ngZone = injector.get(NgZone); // Initialize ngZone from the injector

    // Get sourceRoute from query params for use in navigation
    this.activatedRoute.queryParams.subscribe((params) => {
      if (params['sourceRoute']) {
        this.sourceUrl = params['sourceRoute'];
      }
    });

    // Check navigation state for return URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.returnUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }

    // Also consider the previous URL from browser history
    this.previousPath = this.location.path();

    this.institution.disable();
    this.site.disable();
    this.building.disable();
    this.buildingPart.disable();
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createRoomRequestForm.get());
    this.edit();
    this.getFloors();
    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();
    this.roomProfiles = this.roomProfilesService.roomProfilesGetRoomProfiles();

    // Get partnerId from query params
    this.partnerId = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.queryParams.partnerId;

    this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
      }
    });

    this.form.get('floor')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        this.floorService.floorGetFloorParentsEntityRefModelById(value.id).subscribe((result) => {
          this.institution.setValue(result.institution?.entityDisplayName);
          this.site.setValue(result.site?.entityDisplayName);
          this.building.setValue(result.building?.entityDisplayName);
          this.buildingPart.setValue(result.buildingPart?.entityDisplayName);
        });
      } else {
        this.institution.setValue(null);
        this.site.setValue(null);
        this.building.setValue(null);
        this.buildingPart.setValue(null);
      }
    });

    if (this.floorId) {
      this.floorService.floorGetFloorParentsEntityRefModelById(this.floorId).subscribe((floor) => {
        this.institution.setValue(floor.institution?.entityDisplayName);
        this.site.setValue(floor.site?.entityDisplayName);
        this.building.setValue(floor.building?.entityDisplayName);
        this.buildingPart.setValue(floor.buildingPart?.entityDisplayName);
        this.form.get('floor')?.setValue(floor.floor);
      });
      this.form.get('buildingPart')?.disable();
    }
  }

  getFloors() {
    this.floors = this.floorService.floorsGetFloorEntityRef();
  }

  onSubmit(goToList = true): void {
    if (this.form.valid) {
      this.isLoading = true;
      let url = '/partners/rooms?partnerId=' + this.partnerId;
      const institutionId = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.queryParams.institutionId;
      if (institutionId) {
        url = `/partners/rooms?partnerId=${this.partnerId}&institutionId=${institutionId}`;
      }

      this.saveRoom(goToList, url);
    }
  }

  save() {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    return this.roomService.roomsPost(formValues);
  }

  // New method for actual room saving logic
  private saveRoom(goToList: boolean, url: string): void {
    this.save().subscribe({
      next: (result: any) => {
        this.onSaved();
        if (goToList) {
          this.ngZone.run(() => {
            this.router.navigateByUrl(url);
          });
        }
      },
      error: (error) => {
        this.isLoading = false;
        ErrorHelper.serverErrorHandler(error, this.form, (errors: any) => {
          this.openSnackBar(
            'A mentés nem hajtható végre, az űrlap hibás adatokat tartalmaz.',
            SnackBarColor.Warning,
          );
          this.onServerError(errors);
        });
      },
    });
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.enable();
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
    const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
    this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
      duration: 5000,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
      horizontalPosition: 'end',
      verticalPosition: 'top',
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
  }

  back() {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
  }

  /**
   * Navigate with priority fallbacks
   * 1. Use stored returnUrl from navigation state
   * 2. Use sourceUrl from query parameters
   * 3. Check if coming from a floor view/edit page
   * 4. If a floor ID was specified, try to navigate back to it
   * 5. Default to rooms list
   */
  private navigateWithFallbacks(): void {
    // First check if we have a direct returnUrl
    if (this.returnUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.returnUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Then check for sourceUrl from query parameters
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl('/' + this.sourceUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Check if we came from a floor view page
    if (
      this.previousPath &&
      this.previousPath.includes('/partner/floors/') &&
      (this.previousPath.includes('/view') || this.previousPath.includes('/edit'))
    ) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.previousPath);
      return;
    }

    // If a floor ID was specified, try to navigate back to it
    if (this.floorId) {
      this.router.navigate(['/partner/floors/' + this.floorId + '/view']);
      return;
    }

    // Default fallback - go to rooms list
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/rooms']);
  }

  getLatTooltip(): string {
    return 'Latitude coordinate (e.g. 47.497912)';
  }

  getLongTooltip(): string {
    return 'Longitude coordinate (e.g. 19.040235)';
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';

import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection, IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';

export class PartnerRoomListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true })

    } as IColumnDefinition,

      sortable: true,

  constructor(
    router: Router,

    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,

  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.dialog = injector.get(MatDialog);

    this.rootPath = 'partner/rooms';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    // Store current URL for navigation context
    this.currentUrl = this.location.path();

    // If we're embedded within a floor view, save that as the source URL
    if (this.floorId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/floors/${this.floorId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a floor edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/floors/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    } else if (this.buildingPartId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/building-parts/${this.buildingPartId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a building part edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/building-parts/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    } else if (this.buildingId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/buildings/${this.buildingId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a building edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/buildings/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/sites/${this.siteId}/view`;

      // Check if we're on a site edit page
      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/sites/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    }

    // Check navigation state for source URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      this.sourceUrl = (navigation.extras.state as any).sourceUrl || this.sourceUrl;
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}

  }
  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/rooms/${element.id}/edit`]);
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.ROOMS.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe((result) => {
      if (result) {
        this.roomService.roomsDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => {
          this.dataDataTable!.refreshEvent();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // Server-side data request method for modern datatable
  getRooms(params: IDataTableRequest): Observable<RoomListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult> {
    const apiSortDirection =
      params.sortDirection === DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    if (this.floorId) {
      return this.roomService.roomsGetRooms(

        this.sfc.floorFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,

        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        this.floorId,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else if (this.buildingPartId) {
      return this.roomService.roomsGetRooms(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.floorFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        this.buildingPartId,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else if (this.buildingId) {
      return this.roomService.roomsGetRooms(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.floorFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.buildingId,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      return this.roomService.roomsGetRooms(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.floorFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.siteId,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else if (this.institutionId) {
      return this.roomService.roomsGetRooms(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.floorFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.institutionId,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else {
      return this.roomService.roomsGetRooms(
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.floorFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingPartFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.buildingFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.siteFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    }
  }

  addNew() {
    if (this.floorId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/rooms/new/${this.floorId}`]);
    } else if (this.buildingPartId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/rooms/new/${this.buildingPartId}`]);
    } else if (this.buildingId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/rooms/new/${this.buildingId}`]);
    } else if (this.siteId) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/rooms/new/${this.siteId}`]);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['partner/rooms/new']);
    }
  }

  // Navigate back to the source URL if available
  goBack() {
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.sourceUrl);
    } else {
      this.location.back();
    }
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }

  // Method to check if the add button should be shown
  shouldShowAddButton(): boolean {
    // Show if all IDs are null or if floorId has a value
    return (
      (!this.institutionId && !this.siteId && !this.buildingId && !this.buildingPartId && !this.floorId) ||
      !!this.floorId
    );
  }

  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';
  showDataTable = false;
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems?: SiteLocationListItemDto[] = [];

  ngOnInit() {
    this.getDeviceTypes();
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;
    const startPage = this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex ?? this.pageIndex;
    const pageSize = this.dataDataTable?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize;
    const sortColumn = this.dataDataTable?.getSort() ?? this.sortActive;
    const sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.getSortDirection() ?? EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
        ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
        : ApiSortDirection.Descending;
    const siteLocationName = this.filterForm?.get('siteLocationName')?.value;
    const siteLocationIsAggregationPoint = this.filterForm?.get('siteLocationIsAggregationPoint')?.value;
    const siteLocationType = this.filterForm?.get('siteLocationType')?.value?.id;

    this.siteLocationsService
      .siteLocationsGet(
        this.guid,
        siteLocationName,
        undefined,
        siteLocationIsAggregationPoint,
        siteLocationType,
        undefined,
        startPage,
        pageSize,
        sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
        false,
      )
      .subscribe((data: SiteLocationListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
        this.allItems = data.items;
        this.data.items = this.allItems!;
        this.data.recordsTotal = data.recordsTotal!;
        this.dataDataTable.refresh();
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  private getDeviceTypes() {
    this.deviceTypes = this.dictService.dictsGetDictItemsEntityRef('site_location_type');
  }

  showRow(element: SiteLocationListItemDto) {
    this.router.navigate(['devices/measure-sites/' + element.id + '/view']);
  }

  editRow(element: SiteLocationListItemDto) {
    this.router.navigate(['devices/measure-sites/' + element.id + '/edit']);
  }

  deleteRow(element: SiteLocationListItemDto) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.name}' mérési helyet?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.siteLocationsService.siteLocationsDelete(element.id!).subscribe(() => this.getItems());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  addNew() {
    openNewMesureSiteDialog(this.dialog, this.guid).subscribe(() => {
      this.getItems();
    });
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.filterForm.get('siteLocationName')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('siteLocationType')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('siteLocationIsAggregationPoint')?.setValue(null);
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, ViewChild, OnInit, TemplateRef } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatTabGroup } from '@angular/material/tabs';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import {
  AddressEntityDto,
  AddressType,
  MeasurementPointsService,
  PeakValueCardDetailsModel,
  SitesService,
  SiteValidityEntityDto,
  TenantStatus,
  JobResultStatus,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { SiteModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { CommonCardDetailsModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/commonCardDetailsModel';
import { DeviceStatus } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/deviceStatus';
import { SiteCardModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteCardModel';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { EmitService } from 'src/app/core/services/emit.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-site-details-edit',
  templateUrl: './partner-site-details-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-site-details-edit.component.scss'],
  providers: [EmitService]
})
export class PartnerSiteDetailsEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() siteId: number;

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  form: UntypedFormGroup;
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne: boolean = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  tabGroup1SelectedIndex = 0;
  validityTabSelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroup2SelectedIndex = 0;
  tabGroupSelectedIndex = 0;
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantCode?: string;
  isAddingNewValidity = false;
  activeEditingValidityId: number | null = null;
  siteValidities: SiteValidityEntityDto[] = [];
  institutionName?: string;
  identifier?: string;
  cards: CommonCardDetailsModel[] = [];
  measurementPointCards: PeakValueCardDetailsModel[] = [];
  site?: SiteModel;
  @ViewChild(MatTabGroup) tabGroup?: MatTabGroup;
  templateDownloadPath: string = '';

  // Data import configuration
  //translationPrefix: string = 'PARTNERS.SITES.DETAILS.CONSUMPTION_IMPORT';
  acceptedFileExtensions: string[] = ['xlsx'];

  // Column definitions for data-import component
  dataImportColumns = [
    { 
      key: 'id', 
      label: 'DATA_IMPORT.JOB_ID',
      format: 'text'
    },
    { 
      key: 'fileName', 
      label: 'DATA_IMPORT.FILE_NAME',
      format: 'text'
    },
    { 
      key: 'initiationDate', 
      label: 'DATA_IMPORT.UPLOAD_DATE',
      format: 'date',
      dateFormat: 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'
    },
    { 
      key: 'status', 
      label: 'DATA_IMPORT.STATUS',
      format: 'custom',
      template: 'status-template'
    }
  ];

  // Action definitions for data-import component
  dataImportActions = [
    {
      key: 'viewErrors',
      icon: 'error',
      tooltip: 'DATA_IMPORT.VIEW_ERRORS',
      showCondition: (job: any) => job.status === JobResultStatus.Failed
    },
    {
      key: 'finalize',
      icon: 'check_circle',
      tooltip: 'DATA_IMPORT.FINALIZE_JOB',
      showCondition: (job: any) => job.status === JobResultStatus.Validated
    },
    {
      key: 'delete',
      icon: 'delete',
      tooltip: 'DATA_IMPORT.DELETE_JOB',
      color: 'warn',
      showCondition: (job: any) => job.status === JobResultStatus.Failed || job.status === JobResultStatus.Validated
    }
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private measurementPointService: MeasurementPointsService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private emitService: EmitService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = 'partner/sites';
    // this.previousBreadcrumbs = [
    //   new BreadcrumbItem('SIDEBAR.PARTNER_SUB_ROUTES.INSTITUTIONS', this.rootPath)
    // ];
    // this.setBreadcrumbs();

    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];

    this.siteId = Number(route.snapshot.paramMap?.get('id'));
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      isMeasurementPoint: [{ value: false, disabled: false }, []],
      isAggregationPoint: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
    });
    this.form.disable();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.siteId) {
      // Set the template download path with the siteId
      this.templateDownloadPath = `/partner/sites/${this.siteId}/download-template`;
      
      this.sitesService.sitesGetById(this.siteId).subscribe({
        next: (model) => {
          // Set the site validities from the model
          this.institutionName = model.institution.entityDisplayName;
          this.siteValidities = model.siteValidities || [];
          this.identifier = model.identifier;

          this.form.patchValue({
            isMeasurementPoint: model.isMeasurementPoint,
            isAggregationPoint: model.isAggregationPoint,
          });
          this.site = model;
          // Set breadcrumb with site name or identifier if name not available
          this.setBreadcrumbs(model.identifier);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error(error);
        },
      });

      // Load site cards
      this.loadSiteCards();

      // Load measurement point peak value cards
      this.loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards();
    }
  }

  private loadSiteCards() {
    if (this.siteId) {
      this.sitesService.sitesGetSiteCards(this.siteId).subscribe({
        next: (cardData) => {
          this.transformCardData(cardData);
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private loadMeasurementPointPeakValueCards() {
    if (this.siteId) {
      this.measurementPointService.measurementPointsGetOrgunitPeakValueCards(this.siteId).subscribe({
        next: (cardData) => {
          this.measurementPointCards = cardData;
        },
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Transform SiteCardModel data into CommonCardDetailsModel format
   */
  transformCardData(cardData: SiteCardModel): void {
    this.cards = [];

    if (cardData.buildingCount && cardData.buildingCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'Building',
        count: cardData.buildingCount,
        displayName: 'Épületek',
        description: `${cardData.buildingCount} épület(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }

    if (cardData.buildingPartCount && cardData.buildingPartCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'BuildingPart',
        count: cardData.buildingPartCount,
        displayName: 'Épületrészek',
        description: `${cardData.buildingPartCount} épületrész(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }

    if (cardData.floorCount && cardData.floorCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'Floor',
        count: cardData.floorCount,
        displayName: 'Szintek',
        description: `${cardData.floorCount} szint(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }

    if (cardData.roomCount && cardData.roomCount > 0) {
      this.cards.push({
        type: 'Room',
        count: cardData.roomCount,
        displayName: 'Helyiségek',
        description: `${cardData.roomCount} helyiség(ek)`,
        status: DeviceStatus.Online,
      } as CommonCardDetailsModel);
    }
  }

  commonCardClikedHander(card: CommonCardDetailsModel) {
    switch (card.type) {
      case 'Building':
        this.router.navigate(['partner/buildings']); // Navigate to Buildings tab
        break;
      case 'BuildingPart':
        this.router.navigate(['partner/buildingparts']); // Navigate to Building Parts tab
        break;
      case 'Floor':
        this.router.navigate(['partner/floors']); // Navigate to Floors tab
        break;
      case 'Room':
        this.router.navigate(['partner/rooms']); // Navigate to Rooms tab
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  setBreadcrumbs(siteName?: string) {
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('SIDEBAR.PARTNER_SUB_ROUTES.SITES', this.rootPath!)];

    if (siteName) {
      this.previousBreadcrumbs.push(new BreadcrumbItem(siteName, ''));
    }

    super.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  addNewValidity() {
    // Create an empty validity object
    const lastValidity = this.siteValidities[this.siteValidities.length - 1];
    let validFromDate = new Date();

    if (lastValidity && lastValidity.validTo) {
      // Parse the validTo date string and add one day
      validFromDate = new Date(lastValidity.validTo);
      validFromDate.setDate(validFromDate.getDate() + 1);
    }

    const emptyValidity: any = {
      id: 0,
      name: lastValidity?.name ? lastValidity.name : '',
      validFrom: validFromDate,
      validTo: null,
      address: lastValidity?.address
        ? lastValidity.address
        : ({
            addressType: AddressType.NotDefined,
            address: '',
            city: '',
            country: '',
            postalCode: '',
            region: '',
          } as AddressEntityDto),
      businessIdentifier: lastValidity?.businessIdentifier ? lastValidity.businessIdentifier : '',
      telephone: lastValidity?.telephone ? lastValidity.telephone : '',
      eMail: lastValidity?.eMail ? lastValidity.eMail : '',
      contactPersonName: lastValidity?.contactPersonName ? lastValidity.contactPersonName : '',
      contactPerson: lastValidity?.contactPerson ? lastValidity.contactPerson : null,
      lat: lastValidity?.lat ? lastValidity.lat : null,
      lon: lastValidity?.lon ? lastValidity.lon : null,
      site: { id: this.siteId },
    };

    this.siteValidities.push(emptyValidity);
    this.isAddingNewValidity = true;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = 0; // Set to 0 to match the new validity's ID
    // Set the tab to the last one (the newly added validity)
    this.validityTabSelectedIndex = this.siteValidities.length - 1;
  }

  onValiditySaved() {
    this.refreshValidities();
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
  }
  onValidityDeleted() {
    this.refreshValidities();
    this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
  }

  onValidityCancelled() {
    if (this.isAddingNewValidity) {
      // Remove the last validity if it was newly added and cancelled
      this.siteValidities.pop();
      this.isAddingNewValidity = false;
      // Set the tab to the previous one
      this.validityTabSelectedIndex = Math.max(0, this.siteValidities.length - 1);
    }
    this.activeEditingValidityId = null;
  }

  onValidityEditStarted(validityId: number) {
    this.activeEditingValidityId = validityId;
  }

  trackValidityById(index: number, validity: any): any {
    return validity.id;
  }

  refreshValidities() {
    this.sitesService.sitesGetById(this.siteId).subscribe({
      next: (model) => {
        this.siteValidities = model.siteValidities || [];
      },
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    // Navigate back
    this.router.navigate([this.rootPath]);
  }

  back() {
    this.router.navigate([this.rootPath]);
  }

  onTabGroup1Change(index: number) {
    this.tabGroup1SelectedIndex = index;
    if (index == 1 && !this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne) {
      this.isTabSelectIndexHasBeenOne = true;
      this.emitService.emit();
    }
  }

  // Energetic import job functions
  getEnergeticImportJobs = () => {
    return this.sitesService.sitesGetEnergeticImportJobs(this.siteId);
  }

  uploadEnergeticImport = (file: File) => {
    return this.sitesService.sitesPostEnergeticExcelForm(this.siteId, file);
  }

  finalizeEnergeticImport = (jobId: number) => {
    return this.sitesService.sitesFinalizeEnergeticImport(jobId);
  }

  deleteEnergeticImport = (jobId: number) => {
    return this.sitesService.sitesDeleteEnergeticImport(jobId);
  }

  viewEnergeticImportErrors = (job: any) => {
    // Handle viewing import errors
    if (job && job.failedItems) {
      // Implement error display logic based on your application's requirements
      console.log('Import errors:', job.failedItems);
    }
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRouteSnapshot, Resolve, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, tap, map } from 'rxjs';
import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders } from '@angular/common/http';
import { SitesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

@Injectable()
export class SiteImportTemplateDownloadResolver implements Resolve<any> {
  constructor(
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private router: Router,
    private http: HttpClient,
  ) {}

  resolve(route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot): Observable<any> {
    // Get the site id from the route parameters
    const siteId = route.paramMap.get('id');
    
    if (!siteId) {
      console.error('Site ID not provided in route parameters');
      return new Observable(observer => {
        observer.next(false);
        observer.complete();
      });
    }
    
    // Get the base path and authentication from the sites service
    const basePath = this.sitesService['basePath'];
    const apiUrl = `${basePath}/api/sites/energetic-template/download/${siteId}`;

    // Get authentication token if available
    let headers = new HttpHeaders();
    if (this.sitesService['configuration'].accessToken) {
      const accessToken =
        typeof this.sitesService['configuration'].accessToken === 'function'
          ? this.sitesService['configuration'].accessToken()
          : this.sitesService['configuration'].accessToken;
      headers = headers.set('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + accessToken);
    }

    return this.http
      .get(apiUrl, {
        responseType: 'blob',
        observe: 'response',
        headers: headers,
        withCredentials: this.sitesService['configuration'].withCredentials,
      })
      .pipe(
        tap((response) => {
          const blob = response.body;
          if (!blob) return;

          const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          link.href = url;

          // Get filename from content-disposition or use default
          const contentDisposition = response.headers.get('content-disposition');
          let filename = 'site-import-template.xlsx';
          if (contentDisposition) {
            const filenameRegex = /filename[^;=\n]*=((['"]).*?\2|[^;\n]*)/;
            const matches = filenameRegex.exec(contentDisposition);
            if (matches != null && matches[1]) {
              filename = matches[1].replace(/['"]/g, '');
            }
          }

          link.download = filename;
          link.click();
          window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }),
        map(() => this.router.navigate([`partner/sites/${siteId}/view`])), // Stay on the current route
      );
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, Injector, Input, Output, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import moment from 'moment';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createOrUpdateSiteValidityRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/site/createOrUpdateSiteValidityRequestForm';
import {
  SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef,
  SitesService,
  SiteValidityEntityDto,
  TenantStatus,
  UsersService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-site-details-edit-validity',
  templateUrl: './partner-site-details-edit-validity.component.html',
  styleUrl: './partner-site-details-edit-validity.component.scss',
})
export class PartnerSiteDetailsEditValidityComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() siteId?: number;
  @Input() tenantStatus?: TenantStatus;
  @Input() validity?: SiteValidityEntityDto;
  @Input() isNew?: boolean;
  @Input() isEditDisabled?: boolean;
  @Output() validitySaved = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() validityCancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() editStarted = new EventEmitter<number | undefined>();
  @Output() validityDeleted = new EventEmitter<void>();

  public pageMode: PageMode;
  public PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;

  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
  TenantStatus = TenantStatus;
  tenantCode?: string;
  validityId?: number;
  users?: Observable<SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private userService: UsersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createOrUpdateSiteValidityRequestForm.get());
    if (this.isNew) {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.CREATE;
      this.isEdit = true;
    } else {
      this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
      this.isEdit = false;

      this.form.disable();
    }
    if (this.validity && this.form) {
      this.validityId = this.validity.id;
      this.form.patchValue(this.validity);

      // Check if a contactPerson is initially selected and disable fields accordingly
      if (this.validity.contactPerson?.id) {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
        this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
      }
    }

    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();

    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
      }
    });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.get('address')?.enable();
    this.form.enable();
    this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
    this.editStarted.emit(this.validity?.id);
  }

  public onSaved(customRootPath: string): void {
    if (!this.siteId) {
      this.cancel();
    } else {
      this.cancel();
      const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
      this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    const saveObservable = this.isNew
      ? this.sitesService.sitesCreateValidity(this.siteId!, formValues)
      : this.sitesService.sitesModifyValidity(this.siteId!, this.validityId!, formValues);

    return new Observable((observer) => {
      saveObservable.subscribe({
        next: (result) => {
          this.validitySaved.emit();
          observer.next(result);
          observer.complete();
        },
        error: (error) => {
          observer.error(error);
          observer.complete();
        },
      });
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.get('address')?.disable();
    this.form.disable();
    this.validityCancelled.emit();
  }

  deleteValidity() {
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.get('address')?.disable();
    this.form.disable();
    this.sitesService.sitesDeleteSiteValidity(this.siteId!, this.validityId!).subscribe(() => {
      this.validityDeleted.emit();
    });
  }

  getLatTooltip() {
    return 'Latitude : min/max -90,0000000 to 90,0000000';
  }
  getLongTooltip() {
    return 'Longitude : min/max -180,0000000 to 180,0000000';
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { createSiteRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/locations/requests/site/createSiteRequestForm';
import {
  InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef,
  InstitutionsService,
  SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef,
  SitesService,
  UsersService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';
import moment from 'moment';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-partner-site-details-new',
  templateUrl: './partner-site-details-new.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./partner-site-details-new.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerSiteDetailsNewComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  institutions?: Observable<InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  users?: Observable<SecUserEntityDtoEntityRef[]>;
  isLoading = false;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.BACK, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  idOfElement;
  institutionId?: number;

  // Navigation properties
  sourceUrl?: string;
  returnUrl?: string;
  previousPath?: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private siteService: SitesService,
    private institutionService: InstitutionsService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private location: Location,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.idOfElement = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.id;
    this.institutionId = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.params.institutionId;

    // Get sourceRoute from query params for use in navigation
    this.activatedRoute.queryParams.subscribe((params) => {
      if (params['sourceRoute']) {
        this.sourceUrl = params['sourceRoute'];
      }
    });

    // Check navigation state for return URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.returnUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }

    // Also consider the previous URL from browser history
    this.previousPath = this.location.path();
  }
  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createSiteRequestForm.get());
    this.edit();
    this.getInstitutions();
    this.users = this.userService.usersGetAllEntityRef();
    this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    this.form.get('telephone')?.disable();
    this.form.get('contactPerson')?.valueChanges.subscribe((value) => {
      if (value?.id) {
        //this.contactmessage = null;
        this.userService.usersGetUser(value.id).subscribe((user) => {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(user.eMail);
          this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(user.phone);
        });
      } else {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(null);
        this.form.get('telephone')?.setValue(null);
      }
    });

    if (this.institutionId) {
      this.institutionService.institutionsGetInstitutionEntityRefById(this.institutionId).subscribe((institution) => {
        this.form.get('institution')?.setValue(institution);
      });
      this.form.get('institution')?.disable();
    }
  }

  save() {
    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };

    // Format dates correctly using moment.js to keep local time format
    if (formValues.validFrom) {
      // Create date with start of day time and format as string
      formValues.validFrom = moment(formValues.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00');
    }

    if (formValues.validTo) {
      // Create date with end of day time and format as string
      formValues.validTo = moment(formValues.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
    }

    return this.siteService.sitesPost(formValues);
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.get('address')?.enable();
    this.form.enable();
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
    const msg = 'A módosítások mentése sikeres.';
    this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
      duration: 5000,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
      horizontalPosition: 'end',
      verticalPosition: 'top',
    });
  }

  cancel() {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
  }

  delete() {
    // const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, {});
    // dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
    //   if (confirmed) {
    //     this.siteService.sitesDelete(this.form.getRawValue().id).subscribe(() => this.router.navigate(['partner/sites']));
    //   }
    // });
  }

  back() {
    this.navigateWithFallbacks();
  }

  /**
   * Navigate with priority fallbacks
   * 1. Use stored returnUrl from navigation state
   * 2. Use sourceUrl from query parameters
   * 3. Check if coming from an institution view/edit page
   * 4. If an institution ID was specified, try to navigate back to it
   * 5. Default to sites list
   */
  private navigateWithFallbacks(): void {
    // First check if we have a direct returnUrl
    if (this.returnUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.returnUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Then check for sourceUrl from query parameters
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl('/' + this.sourceUrl);
      return;
    }

    // Check if we came from an institution view/edit page
    if (
      this.previousPath &&
      this.previousPath.includes('/partner/institutions/') &&
      (this.previousPath.includes('/view') || this.previousPath.includes('/edit'))
    ) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.previousPath);
      return;
    }

    // If an institution ID was specified, try to navigate back to it
    if (this.institutionId) {
      this.router.navigate(['/partner/institutions/' + this.institutionId + '/view']);
      return;
    }

    // Default fallback - go to sites list
    this.router.navigate(['/partner/sites']);
  }

  getInstitutions() {
    this.institutions = this.institutionService.institutionsGetInstitutionEntityRef();
  }
  getLatTooltip() {
    return 'Latitude : min/max -90,0000000 to 90,0000000';
  }
  getLongTooltip() {
    return 'Longitude : min/max -180,0000000 to 180,0000000';
  }
}
