import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, OnInit, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable.component';
import { SiteListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { SitesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sites.service';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection, IDataTableRequest } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { Location } from '@angular/common';

@Component({
  selector: 'partner-sites-list',
  templateUrl: './partner-sites-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['partner-sites-list.component.scss'],
})
export class PartnerSitesListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true })
  protected dataDataTable: MatDatatableComponent | undefined;
  @Input() institutionId: number | undefined;

  needRefresh: boolean = false;

  // Navigation properties
  sourceUrl?: string;
  currentUrl?: string;

  searchForm = this.fb.group({
    nameFilter: [null],
    addressFilter: [null],
    institutionFilter: [null],
    active: [{ id: true, name: 'Aktív' }],
  });

  sites: SiteListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult | undefined;

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    {
      columnName: 'name',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.SITES.LIST.NAME_FULL',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'address',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.SITES.LIST.ADDRESS',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'institutionName',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.SITES.LIST.INSTITUTION',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'isDeleted',
      displayName: 'PARTNERS.SITES.LIST.STATUS',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
    {
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition,
  ];
  item?: number;
  private subs = new Subscription();

  activeOptions = [
    { id: true, name: 'Aktív' },
    { id: false, name: 'Inaktív' },
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private location: Location,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = 'partner/sites';
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
    this.stepForward();

    this.currentUrl = this.location.path();

    if (this.institutionId) {
      this.sourceUrl = `/partner/institutions/${this.institutionId}/view`;

      if (this.currentUrl.includes('/partner/institutions/') && this.currentUrl.includes('/edit')) {
        this.sourceUrl = this.currentUrl;
      }
    }

    // Check navigation state for source URL
    const navigation = this.router.getCurrentNavigation();
    if (navigation?.extras?.state) {
      const state = navigation.extras.state as { returnUrl: string };
      if (state.returnUrl) {
        this.sourceUrl = state.returnUrl;
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {}
  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.dialog.closeAll();
    this.subs.unsubscribe();
  }

  showRow(element: any) {

    this.router.navigate([`partner/sites/${element.id}/view`]);
  }

  editRow(element: any) {
    this.router.navigate([`partner/sites/${element.id}/edit`]);
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'PARTNERS.SITES.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.sitesService.sitesDelete(element.id).subscribe(() => this.dataDataTable!.refreshEvent());
      }
    });
  }

  addNew() {
    if (this.institutionId) {
      // Pass the source URL in state when navigating to new with institutionId
      this.router.navigate([this.rootPath + '/new/' + this.institutionId], {
        state: {
          returnUrl: this.sourceUrl || `/partner/institutions/${this.institutionId}/view`,
        },
      });
    } else {
      // Pass the current URL as return URL when navigating to new
      this.router.navigate([`partner/sites/new`]);
    }
  }

  // Navigate back to the source URL if available
  goBack() {
    if (this.sourceUrl) {
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.sourceUrl);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['/partner/sites']);
    }
  }

  getSites(params: IDataTableRequest) {
    let apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      params.sortDirection == DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    if (this.institutionId) {
      return this.sitesService.sitesGetSites(
        this.sfc.addressFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        this.institutionId,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    } else {
      return this.sitesService.sitesGetSites(
        this.sfc.addressFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.nameFilter?.value,
        this.sfc.institutionFilter?.value,
        undefined,
        this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
        params.pageIndex,
        params.pageSize,
        params.sortColumn,
        apiSortDirection,
      );
    }
  }

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { ConfirmDialogComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { ErrorHelper } from 'src/app/core/errors/error-helper';
import {
  AuthModel,
  AuthenticateService,
  TokenModel,
  TwoFactorLoginModel,
  UsersService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import AccessTokenModel from 'src/app/core/services/security/access-token-model';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';
import { TokenType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/tokenType';
import { takeUntil } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { PasswordStrengthService } from 'src/app/core/helper/password-strength.service';
import { Subject } from 'rxjs';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-password-change',
  templateUrl: './password-change.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./password-change.component.scss'],
})
export class PasswordChangeComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  private destroy$ = new Subject<void>();

  token: string;
  authenticationForm!: UntypedFormGroup;
  formFields: any;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  showSites = false;
  isVisibilityIcon = true;
  hide = true;
  hidepw = true;
  twoFactorCheck = false;

  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  isEdit = true;

  // Password strength variables
  passwordStrength = 0;
  passwordFeedback = '';

  // Password visibility
  hidePassword = true;
  hideConfirmPassword = true;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private authenticateService: AuthenticateService,
    public passwordStrengthService: PasswordStrengthService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    const route = router.url.split('?');
    if (route) this.authService.setChangePW(route[1]);
    this.token = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('token')!;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group([]);
    this.form.addControl('token', new UntypedFormControl(null));
    this.form.addControl('email', new UntypedFormControl({ value: '', disabled: true }));
    this.form.addControl(
      'newPassword',
      new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: false }, [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(8)]),
    );
    this.form.addControl(
      'newPasswordAgain',
      new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: false }, Validators.required),
    );

    // Add listener for password changes to calculate strength
    this.form
      .get('newPassword')
      ?.valueChanges.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe((password) => {
        if (password) {
          const result = this.passwordStrengthService.calculatePasswordStrength(password);
          this.passwordStrength = result.strength;
          this.passwordFeedback = result.feedback;

          // Update form validation state based on password strength
          const passwordControl = this.form.get('newPassword');
          if (passwordControl && this.passwordStrength < 40) {
            passwordControl.setErrors({ ...passwordControl.errors, weakPassword: true });
          }
        } else {
          this.passwordStrength = 0;
          this.passwordFeedback = '';
        }
      });

    // Add password validation for matching passwords
    this.form.setValidators(() => {
      const password = this.form.get('newPassword')?.value;
      const confirmPassword = this.form.get('newPasswordAgain')?.value;

      if (password && confirmPassword && password !== confirmPassword) {
        return { passwordMismatch: true };
      }
      return null;
    });

    this.form.updateValueAndValidity();

    // Only attempt to validate the token if we actually have one
    if (this.token) {
      console.log('Validating token:', this.token);

      this.userService.usersGetUserByToken(this.token, TokenType.ForgottenPassword).subscribe({
        next: (response: TokenModel) => {
          if (response == null) {
            console.log('Token validation failed - null response');
            this.openSnackBar(
              'Az üzenethez tartozó validációs token lejárt. Kérjük, lépjen kapcsolatba az alkalmazás rendszergazdájával!',
              SnackBarColor.Error,
            );
            // Don't navigate away immediately - let user see the error
            setTimeout(() => {
              this.authService.removeChangePW();
              this.router.navigate(['login']);
            }, 3000);
          } else {
            console.log('Token validation successful');
            // Continue with password reset flow
            this.form.get('email')?.setValue(response.email);
          }
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error('Token validation error:', error);
          this.openSnackBar('A jelszóváltoztatási kérés során hiba történt', SnackBarColor.Error);
          // Don't navigate away immediately - let user see the error
          setTimeout(() => {
            this.authService.removeChangePW();
            this.router.navigate(['login']);
          }, 3000);
        },
      });
    } else {
      console.log('Missing token or tenant parameters');
      this.openSnackBar('Hiányoznak a szükséges paraméterek a jelszóváltoztatáshoz', SnackBarColor.Error);
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.router.navigate(['login']);
      }, 2000);
    }
    this.form.get('token')?.setValue(this.token);

    const authenticationFormFields = {
      authenticationcode: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, [Validators.required]],
    };
    this.authenticationForm = this.formBuilder.group(authenticationFormFields);
  }

  submitCode() {
    if (this.authenticationForm?.valid) {
      const model = this.authenticationForm?.value;
      const userHash = this.authService.getAuthuser();
      const loginModel = {
        authenticationcode: model.authenticationcode,
        userhash: userHash,
      } as TwoFactorLoginModel;
      this.authenticateService.userAuthenticateTwofactorLogin(loginModel).subscribe({
        next: (tokenModel: AccessTokenModel) => {
          this.authService.setAuthToken(tokenModel);

          this.authService.removeAuthuser();
          this.router.navigate(['']);
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.log(error);
        },
      });
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  get afc() {
    return this.authenticationForm.controls;
  }

  public cancel(): void {
    this.authService.removeChangePW();
    this.authService.removeAuthuser();
    this.router.navigate(['login']);
  }

  changeType() {
    this.hide = !this.hide;
  }

  changepwType() {
    this.hidepw = !this.hidepw;
  }

  onSubmit() {
    if (this.form?.valid) {
      // const model: any = this.form?.value;
      const elem = this.form.getRawValue();
      this.userService.usersRenewtoken(elem).subscribe({
        next: (tokenModel: AuthModel) => {
          const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, {
            data: {
              message: 'Sikeresen módosította jelszavát!',
              cancelButtonText: 'Rendben',
              showConfirmButton: false,
            },
          });

          dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
            if (!confirmed) {
              const model = new AccessTokenModel();
              model.token = tokenModel.token!;
              model.expiration = tokenModel.expiration!.toString();
              this.authService.setAuthToken(model);
              this.authService.removeChangePW();
              this.router.navigate(['']);
            }
          });
        },
        error: (error) => {
          if (error.error.TwoFactorChecker) {
            const userGuid = error.error.TwoFactorChecker[0];
            this.authService.setAuthUser(userGuid);
            this.twoFactorCheck = true;
          }

          ErrorHelper.serverErrorHandler(error, this.form, (errors: any) => {
            this.openSnackBar('A mentés nem hajtható végre, az űrlap hibás adatokat tartalmaz.', SnackBarColor.Warning);
            this.onServerError(errors);
            this.authService.removeChangePW();
          });
        },
      });
    }
  }

  // Tooltip removed to match registration component styling

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }
}

                fxFlex="50"

            </div>
          </div>

          <label class="invoice-form-label">{{ 'RECORDS.INVOICE_EDITOR.DISTRIBUTOR_FEE_LABEL' | translate }}</label>
          <div style="overflow: hidden">
            <div fxLayout="row wrap" fxLayoutGap="16px grid" fxLayoutGap.lt-sm="10px grid">

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormComponentBase } from '../../../core/base/form-component-base';
import { LoaderService } from '../../../core/services/loader.service';
import { BreadcrumbService } from '../../../core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from '../../../core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { EnergyContractModel } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/energyContractModel';
import { PageMode } from '../../../core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { EnergyContractType } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/energyContractType';
import { EnergyContractEntityDtoEntityRef } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/energyContractEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { forkJoin, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { InvoicesService } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/invoices.service';
import { EnergyContractsService } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/energyContracts.service';
import { InvoiceModel } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/invoiceModel';
import { PartnersService } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/partners.service';
import { PartnerModel } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/partnerModel';
import { openConfirmDialog } from '../../../core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { createInvoiceRequestForm } from '../../../core/generated/forms/energycontract/createInvoiceRequestForm';
import { invoiceEnergyFeeForm } from '../../../core/generated/forms/energycontract/invoiceEnergyFeeForm';
import { invoiceDistributorFeeForm } from '../../../core/generated/forms/energycontract/invoiceDistributorFeeForm';
import { SuppliersService } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/suppliers.service';
import { networkUsageFeeForm } from '../../../core/generated/forms/energycontract/networkUsageFeeForm';
import { SupplierModel } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/supplierModel';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-invoice-editor',
  templateUrl: './invoice-editor.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./invoice-editor.component.scss'],
})
export class InvoiceEditorComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  pageMode: PageMode;
  PageMode: typeof PageMode = PageMode;
  pageType?: InvoicePageType;
  InvoicePageType: typeof InvoicePageType = InvoicePageType;
  invoicePartner?: InvoicePartyDetails;
  invoiceSupplier?: InvoicePartyDetails;
  energyContracts?: EnergyContractModel[];
  private readonly invoiceId?: number;
  private readonly energyContractRefs?: EnergyContractEntityDtoEntityRef[];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private invoiceService: InvoicesService,
    private energyContractService: EnergyContractsService,
    private partnerService: PartnersService,
    private supplierService: SuppliersService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.pageMode = route.snapshot.data.pageMode;
    this.rootPath = '/records/invoices';
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Nyilvántartás', ''), new BreadcrumbItem('Számlák', this.rootPath)];
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE && this.router.getCurrentNavigation()?.extras.state === undefined) {
      this.router.navigate(['records', 'invoices']);
    }

    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
      this.energyContractRefs = this.router.getCurrentNavigation()?.extras?.state?.energyContracts;
    } else if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT || this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      this.invoiceId = parseInt(this._route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!);
    }
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();

    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
      const energyContractPromises = this.energyContractRefs?.map((e) =>
        this.energyContractService.energyContractsGetEnergyContract(e.id!),
      );
      // noinspection TypeScriptValidateJSTypes
      forkJoin(...energyContractPromises!).subscribe((result: EnergyContractModel[]) => {
        this.energyContracts = result;
        this.setPageType(result);
        this.initializeForm();

        let energyContractForSupplier = result.find(
          (x) => x.energyContractType === EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement,
        );
        if (!energyContractForSupplier) {
          energyContractForSupplier = result[0];
        }
        this.supplierService
          .suppliersGet(energyContractForSupplier.supplier.id!)
          .subscribe((supplier: SupplierModel) => {
            this.invoiceSupplier = {
              name: supplier.name,
              address: supplier.headquarters.fullAddress,
              taxIdentificationNumber: supplier.taxIdentificationNumber,
            } as InvoicePartyDetails;
          });
      });
      //TODO: Temp
      this.partnerService.partnersGetCurrentPartner().subscribe((partner: PartnerModel) => {
        this.invoicePartner = {
          name: partner.partnerValidities![0].name,
          address: partner.partnerValidities![0].headquarters!.fullAddress,
          taxIdentificationNumber: partner.partnerValidities![0].taxIdentificationNumber,
        } as InvoicePartyDetails;
      });
    } else if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT || this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      this.invoiceService.invoicesGet(this.invoiceId!).subscribe((invoice: InvoiceModel) => {
        this.energyContracts = invoice.energyContracts;
        this.setPageType(invoice.energyContracts);

        this.invoicePartner = {
          name: invoice.customer!.name,
          address: invoice.customer!.fullAddress,
          taxIdentificationNumber: invoice.customer!.taxIdentificationNumber,
        } as InvoicePartyDetails;

        this.invoiceSupplier = {
          name: invoice.issuer!.name,
          address: invoice.issuer!.fullAddress,
          taxIdentificationNumber: invoice.issuer!.taxIdentificationNumber,
        } as InvoicePartyDetails;

        this.initializeForm();
        this.form.patchValue(invoice);
      });
    }
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  private setPageType(energyContracts?: EnergyContractModel[]) {
    if (!energyContracts) {
      this.router.navigate(['records', 'invoices']);
      return;
    }

    if (
      energyContracts.some((c) => c.energyContractType === EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement) &&
      energyContracts.some((c) => c.energyContractType === EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract)
    ) {
      this.pageType = InvoicePageType.Combined;
    } else if (energyContracts.some((c) => c.energyContractType === EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement)) {
      this.pageType = InvoicePageType.PowerPurchaseAgreement;
    } else if (energyContracts.some((c) => c.energyContractType === EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract)) {
      this.pageType = InvoicePageType.NetworkUsageContract;
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['records', 'invoices']);
    }
  }

  protected save(): Observable<any> | null {
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
      return this.invoiceService.invoicesPost(this.form.value);
    } else if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT) {
      return this.invoiceService.invoicesPut(this.invoiceId!, this.form.value);
    }

    return null;
  }

  private initializeForm() {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createInvoiceRequestForm.get());
    let control;
    switch (this.pageType) {
      case InvoicePageType.PowerPurchaseAgreement:
        this.form.addControl('invoiceEnergyFee', this.formBuilder.group(invoiceEnergyFeeForm.get()));
        break;
      case InvoicePageType.NetworkUsageContract:
        this.form.addControl('invoiceDistributorFee', this.formBuilder.group(invoiceDistributorFeeForm.get()));
        control = this.form.get('invoiceDistributorFee') as UntypedFormGroup;
        control.addControl('distributorFee', this.formBuilder.group(networkUsageFeeForm.get()));
        break;
      case InvoicePageType.Combined:
        this.form.addControl('invoiceEnergyFee', this.formBuilder.group(invoiceEnergyFeeForm.get()));
        this.form.addControl('invoiceDistributorFee', this.formBuilder.group(invoiceDistributorFeeForm.get()));
        control = this.form.get('invoiceDistributorFee') as UntypedFormGroup;
        control.addControl('distributorFee', this.formBuilder.group(networkUsageFeeForm.get()));
        break;
    }
    this.form.addControl('energyContracts', this.formBuilder.control(this.energyContractRefs));
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      this.form.disable();
    }
  }

  delete() {
    const name = this.form.get('invoiceIdentifier')?.value;
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${name}' számlát?`).subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.invoiceService.invoicesDelete(this.invoiceId!).subscribe(() => {
          this.router.navigate(['records', 'invoices']);
        });
      }
    });
  }

  edit() {
    this.router.navigate(['records', 'invoices', 'edit', this.invoiceId]);
  }
}

enum InvoicePageType {
  PowerPurchaseAgreement,
  NetworkUsageContract,
  Combined,
}

interface InvoicePartyDetails {
  name: string;
  address: string;
  taxIdentificationNumber: string;
}

@Component({

export class InvoicesComponent extends FormComponentBase {
  filterForm: UntypedFormGroup;

  get select(): EntityRef[] {

  }

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private invoicesService: InvoicesService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.rootPath = '/records';
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Nyilvántartás', '')];
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    const filterFormFields = {
      invoiceIdentifier: [null],
      invoicePeriodStart: [null],
      invoicePeriodEnd: [null],
    };
    this.filterForm = this.formBuilder.group(filterFormFields);

    this.getItems();
  }

  @ViewChild('invoicesDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable?: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    // <IColumnDefinition>{
    //   columnName: 'select',
    //   displayName: '',
    //   columnType: ColumnType.Select,
    //   filterable: false,
    //   sortable: false
    // },
    ({
      columnName: 'invoiceIdentifier',
      displayName: 'Név',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'energyContract',
      displayName: 'Szerződés',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'invoicePeriodStart',
      displayName: 'Időszak',
      columnType: ColumnType.Date,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'totalAmount',
      displayName: 'Összeg',
      columnType: ColumnType.Number,
      sortable: true,
      parameters: {
        postFix: 'Ft',
      } as INumberTypeParam,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = '';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems?: InvoiceListItemDto[] = [];
  private _selectedValues: EntityRef[] = [];

  override ngOnInit() {
    super.ngOnInit();
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.filterForm.controls;
  }

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;
    const startPage = this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex ?? this.pageIndex;
    const pageSize = this.dataDataTable?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize;
    const sortColumn = this.dataDataTable?.getSort() ?? this.sortActive;
    const sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.getSortDirection() ?? EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == EnergiaMenedzsmentSortDirection.Ascending
        ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending
        : ApiSortDirection.Descending;
    const from = this.filterForm?.get('invoicePeriodStart')?.value;
    const until = this.filterForm?.get('invoicePeriodEnd')?.value;
    const invoiceIdentifier = this.filterForm?.get('invoiceIdentifier')?.value;
    this.invoicesService
      .invoicesGetAll(invoiceIdentifier, from, until, startPage, pageSize, sortColumn, apiSortDirection, false)
      .subscribe((data: InvoiceListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
        this.allItems = data.items;
        this.data.items = this.allItems!;
        this.data.recordsTotal = data.recordsTotal!;
        this.dataDataTable?.refresh();
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  openDialog() {
    openNewInvoiceDialog(this.dialog)
      .pipe(filter((val) => !!val))
      .subscribe((energyContracts: EnergyContractEntityDtoEntityRef[]) => {
        this.router.navigate(['records', 'invoices', 'create'], { state: { energyContracts } });
      });
  }

  showRow(element: InvoiceListItemDto) {
    this.router.navigate(['records', 'invoices', element.id]);
  }

  editRow(element: InvoiceListItemDto) {
    this.router.navigate(['records', 'invoices', 'edit', element.id]);
  }

  deleteRow(element: InvoiceListItemDto) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${element.invoiceIdentifier}' számlát?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.invoicesService.invoicesDelete(element.id!).subscribe(() => this.getItems());
        }
      },
    );
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.filterForm.get('invoicePeriodStart')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('invoicePeriodEnd')?.setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('invoiceIdentifier')?.setValue(null);
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { EnergyContractsService } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/energyContracts.service';
import { EnergyContractEntityDtoEntityRef } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/energyContractEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { InvoicesService } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/invoices.service';
import { CanCreateInvoiceRequest } from '../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/canCreateInvoiceRequest';
import { NgxSpinnerService } from 'ngx-spinner';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { ErrorHelper } from '../../../core/errors/error-helper';
import { MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-new-invoice-modal',
  templateUrl: './new-invoice-dialog.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./new-invoice-dialog.component.scss'],
})
export class NewInvoiceDialogComponent implements OnInit {
  contracts: EnergyContractEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
  form: UntypedFormGroup;

  get selectedContracts(): EnergyContractEntityDtoEntityRef[] {
    return this.form.get('energyContracts')?.value;
  }

  set selectedContracts(value: EnergyContractEntityDtoEntityRef[]) {
    this.form.patchValue({
      energyContracts: value,
    });
  }

  constructor(
    private energyContractService: EnergyContractsService,
    private invoiceService: InvoicesService,
    private spinner: NgxSpinnerService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<NewInvoiceDialogComponent>,
  ) {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      energyContracts: [null],
    });
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    this.energyContractService
      .energyContractsGetEnergyContractsEntityRef()
      .subscribe((contracts: EnergyContractEntityDtoEntityRef[]) => {
        this.contracts = contracts;
      });
  }

  save() {
    this.spinner.show();

    this.invoiceService
      .invoicesCanCreateInvoice(({ energyContracts: this.selectedContracts } as CanCreateInvoiceRequest))
      .subscribe(
        () => {
          this.spinner.hide();
          this.dialogRef.close(this.selectedContracts);
        },
        (error) => {
          ErrorHelper.serverErrorHandler(error, this.form, () => null);
          this.spinner.hide();
        },
      );
  }

  close() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  // Multiselect with maximum 2 selections
  mySelections: EnergyContractEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
  changed() {
    if (this.selectedContracts.length < 3) {
      this.mySelections = this.selectedContracts;
    } else {
      this.selectedContracts = this.mySelections;
    }
  }
}

export function openNewInvoiceDialog(dialog: MatDialog) {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'app-dialog-container';

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(NewInvoiceDialogComponent, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

import { Component, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { AbstractControl, UntypedFormArray, UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { filter } from 'rxjs';
import { openItemDialog } from '../time-of-use-tariff-dialog/time-of-use-tariff-dialog.component';
import { openConfirmDialog } from '../../../../core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto } from '../timeOfUseTariffEntityDto';
import { TimeOfUseTariffType } from '../../../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/timeOfUseTariffType';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Component({
  selector: 'time-of-use-tariff',
  templateUrl: './time-of-use-tariff.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./time-of-use-tariff.component.scss'],
})
export class TimeOfUseTariff {
  @Input() control!: AbstractControl;

  get tariffs(): UntypedFormArray {
    return this.control as UntypedFormArray;
  }

  public TimeOfUseTariffType: typeof TimeOfUseTariffType = TimeOfUseTariffType;

  constructor(
    private fb: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private dialog: MatDialog,
  ) {}

  openEditDialog(rate: TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto, index: number) {
    openItemDialog(this.dialog, rate)
      .pipe(filter((val) => !!val))
      .subscribe((val) => {
        console.log('edited item value:', val);
        this.editRate(val, index);
      });
  }

  openDialog() {
    openItemDialog(this.dialog)
      .pipe(filter((val) => !!val))
      .subscribe((val) => {
        console.log('new item value:', val);
        this.addRate(val);
      });
  }

  private addRate(rate: TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto) {
    const tariff = this.fb.group({
      id: [rate.id ?? 0],
      name: [rate.name],
      periodStartDateTime: [rate.periodStartDateTime],
      periodEndDateTime: [rate.periodEndDateTime],
      timeOfUseStartTime: [rate.timeOfUseStartTime],
      timeOfUseEndTime: [rate.timeOfUseEndTime],
      purchasePrice: [rate.purchasePrice],
      timeOfUseTariffType: [rate.timeOfUseTariffType],
      days: [rate.days],
    });
    this.tariffs.push(tariff);
  }

  private editRate(rate: TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto, index: number) {
    const tariff = {
      id: rate.id,
      name: rate.name,
      periodStartDateTime: rate.periodStartDateTime,
      periodEndDateTime: rate.periodEndDateTime,
      timeOfUseStartTime: rate.timeOfUseStartTime,
      timeOfUseEndTime: rate.timeOfUseEndTime,
      purchasePrice: rate.purchasePrice,
      timeOfUseTariffType: rate.timeOfUseTariffType,
      days: rate.days,
    };
    this.tariffs.at(index).patchValue(tariff);
  }

  deleteRate(rate: TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto, index: number) {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, `Biztosan törölni kívánja a '${rate.name}' díjsávot?`).subscribe(
      (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          if (confirmed) {
            this.tariffs.removeAt(index);
          }
        }
      },
    );
  }

  getTariff(i: number): TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto {
    return this.tariffs.controls[i].value;
  }

  getTime(timeStr?: string): Date {
    let hours = '',
      minutes = '',
      seconds = '';

    if (timeStr) {
      [hours, minutes, seconds] = timeStr.split(':');
    }

    return new Date(2022, 1, 1, +(hours ?? 0), +(minutes ?? 0), +(seconds ?? 0));
  }
}

import { Component, Inject } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto } from '../timeOfUseTariffEntityDto';
import { TimeOfUseTariffType } from '../timeOfUseTariffType';
import { TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect } from '../timeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect';
import { timeOfUseTariffForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/energycontract/timeOfUseTariffForm';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogConfig, MatDialogRef } from '@angular/material/dialog';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-form-example-dialog',
  templateUrl: './time-of-use-tariff-dialog.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./time-of-use-tariff-dialog.component.scss'],
})
export class TimeOfUseTariffDialog {
  tariffTypeOptions = [
    { label: 'Folyamatos', value: TimeOfUseTariffType.Continuous },
    { label: 'Időszakos', value: TimeOfUseTariffType.Periodic },
  ];

  dayOptions = Object.entries(TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect)
    .filter(([key, value]) => typeof value === 'number')
    .map(([key, value]) => ({
      key: value as number,
      label: key,
    }));

  get daysValues() {
    return formValueToBit(TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect, this.form.value.selectedDays);
  }

  TimeOfUseTariffType: typeof TimeOfUseTariffType = TimeOfUseTariffType;

  public form: UntypedFormGroup = null as any;

  constructor(
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    @Inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA) private data: TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto,
    private dialogRef: MatDialogRef<TimeOfUseTariffDialog>,
  ) {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(timeOfUseTariffForm.get());
    this.form.patchValue(data);
    // initialize selectedDays form array with false values
    this.form.addControl(
      'selectedDays',
      this.formBuilder.array(this.dayOptions.map(() => this.formBuilder.control(false))),
    );

    // set selectedDays control based on received value
    if (!isNaN(+data.days)) {
      this.setFormDays(data.days);
    } else if (typeof data.days === 'string') {
      this.setFormDaysFromString(data.days);
    }
  }

  setFormDays(days: number) {
    if (this.daysValues === days) {
      days = 0;
    }
    this.form.patchValue({
      selectedDays: bitToFormValue(TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect, days),
    });
  }

  setFormDaysFromString(days: TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect) {
    const daysStr = days.toString();
    this.form.get('selectedDays')?.setValue(this.dayOptions.map((day) => daysStr.includes(day.label)));
  }

  isSelected(number: number) {
    return this.daysValues === number;
  }

  close() {
    this.dialogRef.close();
  }

  save() {
    this.form.patchValue({
      days: this.daysValues,
    });
    this.dialogRef.close(this.form.value);
  }
}

export function openItemDialog(dialog: MatDialog, rate?: TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto) {
  const config = new MatDialogConfig();

  config.disableClose = true;
  config.autoFocus = true;
  config.panelClass = 'rate-modal-container';
  config.backdropClass = 'backdrop-modal-panel';

  config.data =
    rate ??
    {
      timeOfUseTariffType: TimeOfUseTariffType.Continuous,
    } as TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto;

  const dialogRef = dialog.open(TimeOfUseTariffDialog, config);

  return dialogRef.afterClosed();
}

function formValueToBit(enumeration: object, selection: boolean[]) {
  const bits = enumToBitValues(enumeration);
  return selection.reduce((total, selected, i) => total + (selected ? bits[i] : 0), 0);
}

function bitToFormValue(enumeration: object, bit: number) {
  const bits = enumToBitValues(enumeration);
  return bits.map((b) => (bit & b) === b);
}

function enumToBitValues(enumeration: object) {
  return Object.keys(enumeration).map(Number).filter(Boolean);
}

import { Component, OnDestroy, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { takeUntil } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { MatSnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';
import { UsersService } from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';
import {
  TokenModel,
  TokenType,
  ModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentUserRequest,
} from '../../core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/models';
import { PasswordStrengthService } from '../../core/helper/password-strength.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-registration',
  templateUrl: './registration.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./registration.component.scss'],
})
export class RegistrationComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  registrationForm?: UntypedFormGroup;
  hidePassword = true;
  hideConfirmPassword = true;
  isLoading = false;
  emailFromInvite = '';
  passwordStrength = 0;
  passwordFeedback = '';
  token!: string;
  userData?: TokenModel;

  private destroy$ = new Subject<void>();

  constructor(
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private router: Router,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private snackBar: MatSnackBar,
    private userService: UsersService,
    public passwordStrengthService: PasswordStrengthService,
  ) {
    this.token = this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('token')!;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Get email from query params if available
    this.route.queryParams.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe((params) => {
      if (params['email']) {
        this.emailFromInvite = params['email'];
      }
    });

    this.createForm();

    // If token is available, get user data by token
    if (this.token) {
      this.isLoading = true;
      this.userService
        .usersGetUserByToken(this.token, TokenType.NewUserRegistration)
        .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
        .subscribe({
          next: (response: TokenModel) => {
            console.log(response);

            if (!response) {
              // Handle null response (invalid token)
              this.isLoading = false;
              this.showErrorMessage('Érvénytelen regisztrációs kód.');

              // Navigate back to login screen with error message
              this.router.navigate(['/login'], {
                state: { errorMessage: 'Érvénytelen regisztrációs kód.' },
              });
              return;
            }

            this.userData = response;
            this.populateForm(response);
            this.isLoading = false;
          },
          error: (error) => {
            this.isLoading = false;

            // Check if token is invalid
            if (error.status === 401 || error.error?.tokenMissing || error.error?.message?.includes('token')) {
              this.showErrorMessage('Érvénytelen regisztrációs kód.');
              // Navigate back to login screen with error message
              this.router.navigate(['/login'], {
                state: { errorMessage: 'Érvénytelen regisztrációs kód.' },
              });
            } else {
              this.showErrorMessage(error.error?.message || 'Nem sikerült lekérni az adatokat. Próbálja újra.');
            }
          },
        });
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  createForm(): void {
    this.registrationForm = this.formBuilder.group(
      {
        email: [{ value: this.emailFromInvite, disabled: !!this.token }, [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
        firstName: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(64)]],
        lastName: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(64)]],
        phone: ['', [Validators.pattern(/^\+?[\d\s-()]{6,20}$/)]],
        password: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(8)]],
        confirmPassword: ['', [Validators.required]],
      },
      { validators: this.passwordMatchValidator },
    );

    // Monitor password changes to update password strength
    this.registrationForm
      .get('password')
      ?.valueChanges.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe((password) => {
        if (password) {
          const result = this.passwordStrengthService.calculatePasswordStrength(password);
          this.passwordStrength = result.strength;
          this.passwordFeedback = result.feedback;

          // Update form validation state based on password strength
          const passwordControl = this.registrationForm!.get('password');
          if (passwordControl && this.passwordStrength < 40) {
            passwordControl.setErrors({ ...passwordControl.errors, weakPassword: true });
          }
        } else {
          this.passwordStrength = 0;
          this.passwordFeedback = '';
        }
      });
  }

  // Populate form with user data from token
  populateForm(userData: TokenModel): void {
    if (userData) {
      // Format phone number with +36 prefix if needed
      const phoneNumber = userData.phone || '';

      this.registrationForm!.patchValue({
        email: userData.email,
        firstName: userData.firstName,
        lastName: userData.lastName,
        phone: phoneNumber,
      });

      // Disable email field since it's pre-filled from token
      this.registrationForm!.get('email')?.disable();
    }
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.registrationForm!.invalid) {
      return;
    }

    this.isLoading = true;

    if (this.token) {
      // If we have a token, use PutCurrentUser
      const updateData: ModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentUserRequest = {
        firstName: this.registrationForm!.get('firstName')?.value,
        lastName: this.registrationForm!.get('lastName')?.value,
        phone: this.registrationForm!.get('phone')?.value,
        newPassword: this.registrationForm!.get('password')?.value,
        newPasswordAgain: this.registrationForm!.get('confirmPassword')?.value,
        token: this.token,
      };

      this.userService
        .usersPutNewlyRegisteredCurrentUser(updateData)
        .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
        .subscribe({
          next: (response) => {
            this.isLoading = false;

            if (!response) {
              // Handle null response (invalid token)
              this.showErrorMessage('Invalid token');

              // Navigate back to login screen with error message
              this.router.navigate(['/login'], {
                state: { errorMessage: 'Invalid token' },
              });
              return;
            }

            this.showSuccessMessage('Sikeres regisztráció!');

            // Navigate to home page with success message
            setTimeout(() => {
              this.router.navigate(['/login'], {
                state: { successMessage: 'Sikeres regisztráció!' },
              });
            }, 1000);
          },
          error: (error) => {
            this.isLoading = false;

            // Check for token-related errors
            if (error.status === 401 || error.error?.tokenMissing || error.error?.message?.includes('token')) {
              this.showErrorMessage('Invalid token');
              // Navigate back to login screen with error message
              this.router.navigate(['/login'], {
                state: { errorMessage: 'Invalid token' },
              });
            } else {
              this.showErrorMessage(error.error?.message || 'Nem sikerült regisztrálni. Próbálja újra.');
            }
          },
        });
    }
  }

  // Clear the value of a form field
  clearField(fieldName: string): void {
    if (fieldName === 'email' && this.emailFromInvite) {
      // Don't allow clearing email if it came from invitation
      return;
    }
    const control = this.registrationForm!.get(fieldName);
    if (control) {
      control.setValue('');
      control.markAsTouched();
    }
  }

  // Show success message
  showSuccessMessage(message: string): void {
    this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
      duration: 3000,
      panelClass: ['success-snackbar'],
    });
  }

  // Show error message
  showErrorMessage(message: string): void {
    this.snackBar.open(message, 'Close', {
      duration: 3000,
      panelClass: ['error-snackbar'],
    });
  }

  // Custom validator to check if passwords match
  passwordMatchValidator(form: UntypedFormGroup) {
    const password = form.get('password')?.value;
    const confirmPassword = form.get('confirmPassword')?.value;

    if (password === confirmPassword) {
      form.get('confirmPassword')?.setErrors(null);
      return null;
    } else {
      form.get('confirmPassword')?.setErrors({ passwordMismatch: true });
      return { passwordMismatch: true };
    }
  }
}

📄 FILE: Source\ClientApp\Framework\src\app\pages\roles\role-edit\role-edit.component.ts

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormArray, FormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, finalize, firstValueFrom, of } from 'rxjs';
import { SecOperationEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secOperationEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService, ProgressRef } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { MatDialog } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { RolesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/roles.service';
import { createRoleRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/security/createRoleRequestForm';
import { modifyRoleRequestForm } from 'src/app/core/generated/forms/security/modifyRoleRequestForm';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { SecOperationsByCategoryListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-role-edit',
  templateUrl: './role-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./role-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class RoleEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  id?: number;
  operations: SecOperationsByCategoryListItemDto[] = [];
  selectedOperationCodes = new Set<string>();
  allOperationsSelected = false;
  renderKey = 0; // Used to force re-rendering of toggle switches
  pageMode?: PageMode;
  PageMode = PageMode;

  // Loader variables
  protected _isLoading = false;
  protected _progressRef?: ProgressRef;

  // Required by app-action-buttons component
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    protected override loaderService: LoaderService,
    protected override dialog: MatDialog,
    public _route: ActivatedRoute,
    private formBuilder: FormBuilder,
    private rolesService: RolesService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.numberOfBreadcrumbGoBacks = 2;
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();

    // Determine the page mode based on the route
    this.determinePageMode();

    // Initialize form based on mode
    this.initializeForm();

    // Start loading data
    this.loadPageData();
  }

  private determinePageMode(): void {
    const mode = this._route.snapshot.data.pageMode;

    if (this._route.snapshot.paramMap.has('id')) {
      this.id = parseInt(this._route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')!);

      if (mode === PageMode.EDIT) {
        this.pageMode = PageMode.EDIT;
        // In edit mode, show all action buttons
        this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.DELETE];
      } else {
        this.pageMode = PageMode.VIEW;
        // Default to view mode if has ID but mode not specified
        this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL];
      }
    } else {
      // If no ID, then we're in create mode
      this.pageMode = PageMode.CREATE;
      // In create mode, don't show the delete button
      this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
    }
  }

  private initializeForm() {
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
      // Initialize form for create mode
      this.form = this.formBuilder.group(createRoleRequestForm.get());
    } else {
      // Initialize form for edit or view mode
      this.form = this.formBuilder.group(modifyRoleRequestForm.get());

      // If in view mode, disable the form
      if (this.isViewMode) {
        this.form.disable();
      }
    }

    // Add operations form array
    this.form.addControl('secOperations', this.formBuilder.array([]));

    // Explicitly disable secOperations control in view mode
    if (this.isViewMode) {
      const secOperationsControl = this.form.get('secOperations');
      if (secOperationsControl) {
        secOperationsControl.disable();
      }
    }
  }

  private async loadPageData() {
    try {
      // Show loader
      this._isLoading = true;
      this._progressRef = this.loaderService.showProgress(this.elRef) || undefined;

      // First load all operations
      await this.loadOperations();

      // Then load role details if in edit or view mode
      if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT || this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
        await this.loadRole();
      }

      // Finally hide loader
      this._isLoading = false;
      this.loaderService.detach(this._progressRef!);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading page data:', error);
      // Make sure to hide loader even on error
      this._isLoading = false;
      if (this._progressRef) {
        this.loaderService.detach(this._progressRef);
      }
    }
  }

  private async loadRole(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.id) {
      try {
        // Load the role data (operations should already be loaded by loadPageData)
        const role = await firstValueFrom(this.rolesService.rolesGetRole(this.id));
        console.log('Loaded role data:', role);

        // Populate the form with the role data
        this.form.patchValue({
          id: role.id,
          name: role.roleName,
        });

        // Look for operations in the role data
        // Since we don't know exactly how operations are stored in the role object,
        // let's check for common property names that might contain operations
        const possibleOperationProps = [
          'operations',
          'secOperations',
          'permissions',
          'roleOperations',
          'securityOperations',
        ];

        let roleOperations = null;

        // Try to find operations in the role object
        if (role && typeof role === 'object') {
          for (const propName of possibleOperationProps) {
            const value = (role as any)[propName];
            if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0) {
              roleOperations = value;
              console.log(`Found role operations in property '${propName}':`, roleOperations);
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        // If we found operations, set them in the form
        if (roleOperations && roleOperations.length > 0) {
          const operationsArray = this.form.get('secOperations') as FormArray;

          // Clear existing operations first
          operationsArray.clear();
          this.selectedOperationCodes.clear();

          console.log('Available operations categories:', this.operations);

          // Add each operation to the form array
          roleOperations.forEach((op) => {
            // Different operation structures might store the ID in different properties
            const opId = op.id || op.operationId || op.secOperationId;
            console.log('Processing role operation:', op, 'extracted ID:', opId);

            if (opId !== undefined && opId !== null) {
              // Verify that this operation ID exists in our loaded categories
              const operationExists = this.operations.some(category => 
                category.operations?.some(operation => operation.id === opId)
              );

              if (operationExists) {
                operationsArray.push(this.formBuilder.control(opId));
                this.selectedOperationCodes.add(opId.toString());
                console.log(`Added operation ${opId} to selected operations`);
              } else {
                console.warn(`Operation with ID ${opId} not found in available operations`);
              }
            }
          });

          console.log('Final selected operation codes:', Array.from(this.selectedOperationCodes));
          console.log('Form operations array length:', operationsArray.length);

          // Update the all operations selected flag
          this.updateAllOperationsSelectedFlag();
        } else {
          console.log('No operations found in role data');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading role:', error);
        throw error;
      }
    }
  }

  private async loadOperations(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const operations = await firstValueFrom(this.rolesService.rolesGetOperations());
      this.operations = operations || [];
      this.updateAllOperationsSelectedFlag();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading operations:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  toggleOperation(operation: SecOperationEntityDtoEntityRef, isChecked: boolean): void {
    // Prevent changes in view mode
    if (this.isViewMode) {
      return;
    }

    const operationsArray = this.form.get('secOperations') as FormArray;
    const opId = operation.id;

    if (opId === undefined || opId === null) {
      return;
    }

    const opIdStr = opId.toString();

    if (isChecked) {
      // Add the operation id to the array if it's not already there
      if (!this.hasOperation(opIdStr)) {
        operationsArray.push(this.formBuilder.control(opId));
        this.selectedOperationCodes.add(opIdStr);
      }
    } else {
      // Remove the operation id from the array
      const index = this.getOperationIndex(opIdStr);
      if (index !== -1) {
        operationsArray.removeAt(index);
        this.selectedOperationCodes.delete(opIdStr);
      }
    }

    // Update allOperationsSelected flag
    this.updateAllOperationsSelectedFlag();
  }

  toggleAllOperations(): void {
    const operationsArray = this.form.get('secOperations') as FormArray;

    if (this.allOperationsSelected) {
      // Deselect all operations
      operationsArray.clear();
      this.selectedOperationCodes.clear();
    } else {
      // Select all operations from all categories
      operationsArray.clear();
      this.selectedOperationCodes.clear();

      this.operations.forEach((category) => {
        if (category.operations) {
          category.operations.forEach((operation) => {
            if (operation.id !== undefined && operation.id !== null) {
              operationsArray.push(this.formBuilder.control(operation.id));
              this.selectedOperationCodes.add(operation.id.toString());
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // Update the flag
    this.updateAllOperationsSelectedFlag();

    // Force re-render
    this.renderKey++;

    // Mark form as dirty
    this.form.markAsDirty();
  }

  updateAllOperationsSelectedFlag(): void {
    const operationsArray = this.form.get('secOperations') as FormArray;
    const totalOperationsCount = this.operations.reduce((count, category) => {
      return count + (category.operations?.length || 0);
    }, 0);
    this.allOperationsSelected = operationsArray.length === totalOperationsCount;
  }

  hasOperation(operationCode: string): boolean {
    return this.selectedOperationCodes.has(operationCode);
  }

  getOperationIndex(operationCode: string): number {
    const operationsArray = this.form.get('secOperations') as FormArray;
    return operationsArray.controls.findIndex((control) => control.value.toString() === operationCode);
  }

  // Category-level toggle methods
  toggleCategoryOperations(category: SecOperationsByCategoryListItemDto): void {
    if (!category.operations) return;

    const allCategoryOperationsSelected = this.areCategoryOperationsSelected(category);
    const operationsArray = this.form.get('secOperations') as FormArray;

    if (allCategoryOperationsSelected) {
      // Deselect all operations in this category
      category.operations.forEach((operation) => {
        const operationCode = operation.id ? operation.id.toString() : '';
        if (this.selectedOperationCodes.has(operationCode)) {
          this.selectedOperationCodes.delete(operationCode);
          const index = this.getOperationIndex(operationCode);
          if (index !== -1) {
            operationsArray.removeAt(index);
          }
        }
      });
    } else {
      // Select all operations in this category
      category.operations.forEach((operation) => {
        const operationCode = operation.id ? operation.id.toString() : '';
        if (!this.selectedOperationCodes.has(operationCode)) {
          this.selectedOperationCodes.add(operationCode);
          operationsArray.push(this.formBuilder.control(operation.id));
        }
      });
    }

    // Update the "all operations selected" flag
    this.updateAllOperationsSelectedFlag();

    // Force re-render
    this.renderKey++;

    // Mark form as dirty
    this.form.markAsDirty();
  }

  areCategoryOperationsSelected(category: SecOperationsByCategoryListItemDto): boolean {
    if (!category.operations || category.operations.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }

    return category.operations.every((operation) => {
      const operationCode = operation.id ? operation.id.toString() : '';
      return this.selectedOperationCodes.has(operationCode);
    });
  }

  getCategoryToggleState(category: SecOperationsByCategoryListItemDto): boolean {
    return this.areCategoryOperationsSelected(category);
  }

  save(): Observable<object> {
    if (this.form.valid) {
      // Show loader
      this._isLoading = true;
      this._progressRef = this.loaderService.showProgress(this.elRef) || undefined;

      // Get the form value
      const formValue = this.form.value;

      // Convert operation IDs to SecOperationEntityDtoEntityRef objects with display names
      const operationRefs: SecOperationEntityDtoEntityRef[] = [];
      if (formValue.secOperations && formValue.secOperations.length > 0) {
        formValue.secOperations.forEach((opId: any) => {
          // Find the operation in our operations array (now organized by categories)
          let operation: SecOperationEntityDtoEntityRef | undefined;
          
          for (const category of this.operations) {
            if (category.operations) {
              operation = category.operations.find((op) => op.id === opId);
              if (operation) break;
            }
          }

          operationRefs.push({
            id: opId,
            entityDisplayName: operation ? operation.entityDisplayName : '',
          });
        });
      }

      // Explicitly create request objects with the correct structure
      if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT) {
        // Update existing role
        const modifyRequest = {
          id: formValue.id,
          name: formValue.name,
          secOperations: operationRefs,
        };
        this.rolesService
          .rolesPut(modifyRequest)
          .pipe(
            finalize(() => {
              this._isLoading = false;
              this.loaderService.detach(this._progressRef!);
            }),
          )
          .subscribe({
            next: () => {
              this.router.navigate(['roles']);
            },
            error: (error) => {
              console.error('Error updating role:', error);
            },
          });
      } else if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
        // Create new role
        const createRequest = {
          name: formValue.name,
          secOperations: operationRefs,
        };
        this.rolesService
          .rolesPost(createRequest)
          .pipe(
            finalize(() => {
              this._isLoading = false;
              this.loaderService.detach(this._progressRef!);
            }),
          )
          .subscribe({
            next: () => {
              this.router.navigate(['roles']);
            },
            error: (error) => {
              console.error('Error creating role:', error);
            },
          });
      }
    }

    return of(this.form.value);
  }

  cancel() {
    this.router.navigate(['roles']);
  }

  delete() {
    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'ROLES.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe({
      next: (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this._isLoading = true;
          this._progressRef = this.loaderService.showProgress(this.elRef) || undefined;

          this.rolesService
            .rolesDelete(this.id!)
            .pipe(
              finalize(() => {
                this._isLoading = false;
                this.loaderService.detach(this._progressRef!);
              }),
            )
            .subscribe({
              next: () => {
                this.router.navigate(['roles']);
              },
              error: (error) => {
                console.error('Error deleting role:', error);
              },
            });
        }
      },
    });
  }

  // Helper methods for component template
  get isEditMode(): boolean {
    return this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT;
  }

  get isViewMode(): boolean {
    return this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW;
  }

  get isCreateMode(): boolean {
    return this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE;
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { SortDirection as MatSortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';
import { openConfirmDialog } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { RolesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/roles.service';
import { SecRoleListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secRoleListItemDto';
import { SortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-role-list',
  templateUrl: './role-list.component.html',
})
export class RoleListComponent extends FormComponentBase {
  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private formBuilder: FormBuilder,
    private rolesService: RolesService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = '/roles';

    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  override ngOnInit() {
    super.ngOnInit();

    this.getItems();
  }

  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable?: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    ({
      columnName: 'roleCode',
      displayName: 'Kód',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'roleName',
      displayName: 'Név',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: MatSortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = 'roleCode';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems?: SecRoleListItemDto[] = [];

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;

    // Convert Angular Material's sort direction to API's sort direction
    const apiSortDirection: SortDirection =
      this.sortDirection === 'asc'
        ? SortDirection.Ascending
        : this.sortDirection === 'desc'
          ? SortDirection.Descending
          : SortDirection.Ascending;

    this.rolesService
      .rolesGetRolesDataTable(
        '', // name
        this.pageIndex, // startPage
        this.pageSize, // pageSize
        this.sortActive, // sortColumn
        apiSortDirection, // sortDirection
        true, // isDeleted
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (response) => {
          this.allItems = response.items;
          this.data.items = response.items || [];
          this.data.recordsTotal = response.recordsTotal || 0;
          this.dataDataTable?.refresh();
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: (error) => {
          console.error('Error fetching roles:', error);
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
      });
  }

  editRow(element: SecRoleListItemDto) {
    // Don't allow editing system roles
    if (element.isSystem) {
      return;
    }
    this.router.navigate(['/roles/edit', element.id]);
  }

  addNew() {
    this.router.navigate([this.rootPath + '/add']);
  }

  showRow(element: SecRoleListItemDto) {
    // Don't allow showing system roles
    this.router.navigate([this.rootPath + '/view', element.id]);
  }

  deleteRow(element: any) {
    // Don't allow deleting system roles
    if (element.isSystem) {
      return;
    }

    openConfirmDialog(this.dialog, 'ROLES.LIST.ACTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM').subscribe({
      next: (confirmed: boolean) => {
        if (confirmed) {
          this.rolesService.rolesDelete(element.id).subscribe({
            next: () => {
              this.getItems(); // Refresh the list after deletion
            },
            error: (error) => {
              console.error('Error deleting role:', error);
            },
          });
        }
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error opening confirm dialog:', error);
      },
    });
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRouteSnapshot, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';
import { SecUserModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secUserModel';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class SecUserResolver {
  constructor(
    private userService: UsersService,
    private router: Router,
  ) {}

  resolve(route: ActivatedRouteSnapshot): Observable<SecUserModel> {
    if (route.paramMap.get('tenantcode')) {
      return this.userService
        .usersAdministrationGetUser(+route.paramMap.get('id')!, route.paramMap.get('tenantcode')!)
        .pipe(
          catchError((err) => {
            this.router.navigateByUrl('/partner');
            return err;
          }),
        ) as Observable<SecUserModel>;
    } else {
      return this.userService.usersGetUser(+route.paramMap.get('id')!).pipe(
        catchError((err) => {
          this.router.navigateByUrl('/sec-user');
          return err;
        }),
      ) as Observable<SecUserModel>;
    }
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { SecUserSharedService } from '../shared/sec-user-shared.service';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';
import { catchError, finalize } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { SecUserModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secUserModel';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sec-user-email',
  templateUrl: './sec-user-email.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./sec-user-email.component.scss'],
})
export class SecUserEmailComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  tenantCode = '';
  partnerId?: string;

  isEditedUserTenantUser = false;
  isCurrentUserTenantUser = false;
  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private secUserSharedService: SecUserSharedService,
    private userService: UsersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
  }

  get isTenant(): boolean {
    return !!this.tenantCode;
  }
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.createForm();
    this.tenantCode = this._route.snapshot.params.tenantCode;
    this.partnerId = this._route.snapshot.params.partnerId;
    console.log(this.tenantCode, this.partnerId);
  }

  createForm(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      email: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
    });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  save(): Observable<object> {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return of({});
    }

    // Store the email in the shared service
    const email = this.fc.email.value;
    this.secUserSharedService.setEmail(email);

    // Show loading indicator
    this.showLoader();

    // Call the API to check if user with this email exists
    this.userService
      .usersGetUserByEmail(email)
      .pipe(
        catchError((error) => {
          console.log('Error response status:', error.status);

          // If user not found (404), navigate to create form with just email
          if (error.status === 404) {
            console.log('User not found, navigating to create form');
            // Make sure we only have the email stored and not an incomplete user model
            this.secUserSharedService.clearUserModel();

            // Small delay to ensure the navigation doesn't happen too quickly
            setTimeout(() => {
              if (this.isTenant) {
                this.router.navigate([`sec-user/administrationcreate/${this.tenantCode}/partner/${this.partnerId}`]);
              } else {
                this.router.navigate(['sec-user', 'create']);
              }
            }, 100);
          } else {
            // Handle other errors
            console.error('Error checking user email:', error);
          }
          return of(null);
        }),
        finalize(() => {
          this.hideLoader();
        }),
      )
      .subscribe((response: SecUserModel | null) => {
        if (response) {
          // Check if the model is properly filled
          if (response.id) {
            // User found, store the full user model in the shared service
            console.log('User found, storing model and navigating to edit form', response);
            this.secUserSharedService.setUserModel(response);

            // Small delay to ensure the model is stored before navigation
            setTimeout(() => {
              // Navigate to edit page since we found an existing user
              if (this.isTenant) {
                this.router.navigate([
                  'sec-user',
                  response.id,
                  'administrationedit',
                  this.tenantCode,
                  'partner',
                  this.partnerId,
                ]);
              } else {
                this.router.navigate(['sec-user', response.id, 'edit']);
              }
            }, 100);
          } else {
            // Empty model returned (user not found but no 404 error)
            console.log('Empty user model returned, navigating to create form');
            // Make sure we only have the email stored and not an incomplete user model
            this.secUserSharedService.clearUserModel();

            setTimeout(() => {
              if (this.isTenant) {
                this.router.navigate([`sec-user/administrationcreate/${this.tenantCode}/partner/${this.partnerId}`]);
              } else {
                this.router.navigate(['sec-user', 'create']);
              }
            }, 100);
          }
        }
      });

    return of({});
  }

  cancel(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['sec-user']);
  }

  getEmailTooltip(): string {
    return 'Email formátum pl.: john.smith@example.com';
  }
}
