import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormArray, UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs/internal/Observable';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { RolesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/roles.service';
import { SitesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sites.service';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';
import { SecRoleEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secRoleEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { SecUserModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secUserModel';
import { SiteEntityDtoEntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/siteEntityDtoEntityRef';
import { PageMode } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/PageMode';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { LoaderService } from '../../../core/services/loader.service';
import {
  BuildingEntityDtoEntityRef,
  BuildingsService,
  InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef,
  InstitutionsService,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import moment from 'moment';
import { SecUserSharedService } from '../shared/sec-user-shared.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'sec-user-form-root',
  templateUrl: './sec-user-form.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./sec-user-form.component.scss'],
})
export class SecUserFormComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  user: SecUserModel;
  roles?: SecRoleEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  institutions?: InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  sites?: SiteEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  buildings?: BuildingEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  formFields: any;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  pageMode: PageMode;
  PageMode = PageMode;
  hide = true;
  hidepw = true;
  isVisibilityIcon = true;
  hasAdminRole = false;
  roleEditStates: boolean[] = []; // Track per-line edit states

  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.SAVE, ActionButtonType.BACK];
  isEdit = true;
  idOfElement;

  schemaCode = '';
  isEditedUserTenantUser = false;
  isCurrentUserTenantUser = false;
  partnerId: string;
  customRootPath?: string;
  emailFromParams?: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private rolesService: RolesService,
    private institutionsService: InstitutionsService,
    private buildingsService: BuildingsService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    private secUserSharedService: SecUserSharedService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.user = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.user;

    // Get the page mode from the route data
    this.pageMode = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.pageMode;
    this.schemaCode = this._route.snapshot.params.tenantcode; // Globális admin adott séma felhasználóját nézi-e?
    this.isEditedUserTenantUser = !!this.schemaCode; // megtekintett, szerkesztett vagy létrehozandó felhasználó tenant sémába tartozik-e
    this.partnerId = this._route.snapshot.params.partner;
    this.rootPath = 'sec-user';
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Felhasználók', this.rootPath)];
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    // Set isEdit based on pageMode
    this.isEdit = this.pageMode !== PageMode.VIEW;

    // Set the idOfElement correctly for action buttons
    if (this.user && this.user.id) {
      this.idOfElement = this.user.id;
    }
  }

  // Is the current user a tenant user or the edited user is a tenant user (edited or created by global user)
  get isTenant(): boolean {
    return this.isEditedUserTenantUser || this.isCurrentUserTenantUser;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // First get page mode from route data to ensure it's set early
    const routePageMode = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
    if (routePageMode) {
      this.pageMode = routePageMode;
      console.log('Page mode set from route data:', this.pageMode);
    }

    // Subscribe to the shared service to get the email and user model
    this.secUserSharedService.currentEmail$.subscribe((email) => {
      if (email) {
        this.emailFromParams = email;
        console.log('Received email from service:', email);

        // If form already exists, update it
        if (this.form && this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
          this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(email);
          this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
        }
      }
    });

    // Subscribe to get the full user model if available
    this.secUserSharedService.currentUserModel$.subscribe((userModel) => {
      if (userModel && this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
        console.log('Received user model from service:', userModel);
        // Store the user model to use it in createForm
        this.user = userModel;
      }
    });

    this.userService.usersGetCurrentUser().subscribe((data: any) => {
      this.isCurrentUserTenantUser = data.tenantCode !== null && data.tenantCode !== '';
      if (this.isTenant) {
        this.getInstitutions();
      }
      this.createForm();

      // After form creation, ensure form is disabled if in VIEW mode
      if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW && this.form) {
        console.log('Explicitly disabling form after creation because we are in VIEW mode');
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.disableFormInViewMode();
        }, 0);
      }
    });

    if (this.schemaCode) {
      this.rootPath = `partner/${this.partnerId}/edit`;
    }

    this.getRoles();
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    const model = this.form.getRawValue();

    if (model.phone && model.phone['value']) {
      model.phone = model.phone['value'];
    }
    // Filter out incomplete role org units before saving
    if (model.roleOrgUnits && model.roleOrgUnits.length > 0) {
      // First filter out any empty/invalid roles
      model.roleOrgUnits = model.roleOrgUnits.filter((role: any) => {
        // Keep only role entries that have at least a role selected
        return role.role != null;
      });

      // Format dates for the valid roles
      model.roleOrgUnits.forEach((role: any) => {
        const updatedRole = role;
        // Use moment objects with DateFormatInterceptor to handle formatting
        if (role.validFrom) {
          // Create date with start of day time (let interceptor handle formatting)
          updatedRole.validFrom = moment(role.validFrom).startOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00.000');
        }

        if (role.validTo) {
          // Create date with end of day time (let interceptor handle formatting)
          updatedRole.validTo = moment(role.validTo).endOf('day').format('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999');
        }
        role = updatedRole;
      });
    }

    model.siteIds = model.sites?.map((site: any) => site.id);
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
      if (this.schemaCode) {
        return this.userService.usersAdministrationPost(this.schemaCode, model);
      } else {
        return this.userService.usersPost(model);
      }
    } else {
      model.id = this.user.id;
      if (this.schemaCode) {
        model.tenantCode = this.schemaCode;
        return this.userService.usersAdministrationPut(this.user.id!, this.schemaCode, model);
      } else {
        return this.userService.usersPut(this.user.id!, model);
      }
    }
  }

  toEdit() {
    if (this.schemaCode) {
      this.router.navigate([
        `sec-user/${this.user.id}/administrationedit/${this.schemaCode}/partner/${this.partnerId}`,
      ]);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['sec-user', this.user.id, 'edit']);
    }
  }

  public cancel(): void {
    if (this.schemaCode) {
      if (this.user?.id) {
        this.router.navigate([
          `sec-user/${this.user.id}/administrationview/${this.schemaCode}/partner/${this.partnerId}`,
        ]);
      } else {
        this.router.navigate([`partner/${this.partnerId}/edit`]);
      }
    } else {
      if (this.user?.id) {
        this.router.navigate(['sec-user', this.user.id, 'view']);
      } else {
        this.router.navigate(['sec-user']);
      }
    }
  }

  public goBack(): void {
    if (this.schemaCode) {
      this.router.navigate([`partner/${this.partnerId}/edit`]);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['sec-user']);
    }
  }

  toPasswordChange() {
    this.router.navigate(['sec-user', this.user.id, 'edit']);
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  changeType() {
    this.hide = !this.hide;
  }

  changepwType() {
    this.hidepw = !this.hidepw;
  }

  createSecUserRequestFormFields = {
    lastName: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
    firstName: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
    userName: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
    eMail: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
    phone: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
  };

  modifySecUserRequestFormFields = {
    lastName: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
    firstName: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
    eMail: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
    phone: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
    status: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, []],
  };

  detailsSecUserRequestFormFields = {
    lastName: [{ value: null, disabled: true }, []],
    firstName: [{ value: null, disabled: true }, []],
    eMail: [{ value: null, disabled: true }, []],
    phone: [{ value: null, disabled: true }, []],
    status: [{ value: null, disabled: true }, []],
  };

  private createForm() {
    try {
      // First get page mode from route data
      const routePageMode = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data['pageMode'];
      if (routePageMode) {
        this.pageMode = routePageMode;
      } else if (!this.pageMode) {
        // Default to CREATE if pageMode is not set
        this.pageMode = PageMode.CREATE;
      }

      // Initialize formFields with a safe approach
      try {
        switch (this.pageMode) {
          case PageMode.CREATE:
            this.formFields = { ...this.createSecUserRequestFormFields };
            break;
          case PageMode.EDIT:
            this.formFields = { ...this.modifySecUserRequestFormFields };
            break;
          case PageMode.VIEW:
            this.formFields = { ...this.detailsSecUserRequestFormFields };
            break;
          default:
            console.warn('Unknown pageMode, defaulting to CREATE form fields');
            this.formFields = { ...this.createSecUserRequestFormFields };
            break;
        }

        // Special handling for email when it comes from the email input component
        if (this.emailFromParams && this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE && this.formFields && this.formFields.eMail) {
          this.formFields.eMail.initialValue = this.emailFromParams;
          this.formFields.eMail.disabled = true;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error initializing form fields:', error);
        // Continue execution, we'll handle this by creating a default form
      }

      if (!this.form) {
        if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
          if (this.user) {
            // We have a user model, create the form with that data
            this.createFormFromUserModel();
          } else {
            // No user model, create a new form
            this.createNewUserForm();
          }
        } else {
          // EDIT or VIEW mode
          this.createEditViewForm();
        }
      }

      // Set up action buttons regardless of form creation method
      this.setupActionButtons();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Fatal error in createForm:', error);
      // Last resort - create minimal working form
      this.createMinimalForm();
    }
  }

  // Create a form from an existing user model
  private createFormFromUserModel() {
    try {
      console.log('Creating form from user model:', this.user);

      // Create the form
      this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
        lastName: [
          this.user.lastName,
          [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(64), Validators.pattern(/^[a-zA-ZáéíóöőúüűÁÉÍÓÖŐÚÜŰ\s.,-]+$/)],
        ],
        firstName: [
          this.user.firstName,
          [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(64), Validators.pattern(/^[a-zA-ZáéíóöőúüűÁÉÍÓÖŐÚÜŰ\s.,-]+$/)],
        ],
        eMail: [{ value: this.user.eMail || '', disabled: true }, [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
        phone: [{ value: this.user.phone || '' }, [Validators.required]],
        isActive: [!this.user.isDeleted], // Use isDeleted instead of isActive
        status: [{ value: this.user.isDeleted ? 'Inaktív' : 'Aktív', disabled: true }], // Calculate status from isDeleted
        tenantCode: [this.user.tenantCode || ''],
        roleOrgUnits: this.formBuilder.array([]),
      });

      // Add roles if available
      if (this.user.roles && this.user.roles.length > 0) {
        this.user.roles.forEach((role) => {
          this.addExistingRoleOrgUnit(role);
        });
      }

      // Clear the stored user model
      this.secUserSharedService.clearUserModel();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating form from user model:', error);
      this.createNewUserForm();
    }
  }

  // Create a new user form
  private createNewUserForm() {
    try {
      let formCreated = false;

      // First try to use formFields if available
      if (this.formFields && typeof this.formFields.getFormWithValidators === 'function') {
        try {
          this.form = this.formBuilder.group(this.formFields.getFormWithValidators());
          formCreated = true;
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn('Error creating form from formFields:', error);
        }
      }

      // If that failed, create the form manually
      if (!formCreated) {
        this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
          lastName: [
            '',
            [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(64), Validators.pattern(/^[a-zA-ZáéíóöőúüűÁÉÍÓÖŐÚÜŰ\s.,-]+$/)],
          ],
          firstName: [
            '',
            [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(64), Validators.pattern(/^[a-zA-ZáéíóöőúüűÁÉÍÓÖŐÚÜŰ\s.,-]+$/)],
          ],
          eMail: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
          phone: ['', [Validators.required]],
          isActive: [true],
          tenantCode: [''],
          roleOrgUnits: this.formBuilder.array([]),
        });
      }

      // Set email from params if available
      if (this.emailFromParams && this.form.get('eMail')) {
        this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(this.emailFromParams);
        this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating new user form:', error);
      this.createMinimalForm();
    }
  }

  // Last resort method to create minimal working form
  private createMinimalForm() {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      lastName: ['', Validators.required],
      firstName: ['', Validators.required],
      eMail: [this.emailFromParams || '', Validators.required],
      phone: ['', [Validators.required]],
      isActive: [true],
      tenantCode: [''],
      roleOrgUnits: this.formBuilder.array([]),
    });

    if (this.emailFromParams && this.form.get('eMail')) {
      this.form.get('eMail')?.setValue(this.emailFromParams);
      this.form.get('eMail')?.disable();
    }
  }

  // Create form for EDIT or VIEW mode
  private createEditViewForm() {
    try {
      // Get user from route data
      this.user = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data['user'];

      if (this.user) {
        // Set tenant code
        this.schemaCode = this.user.tenantCode ?? '';
        this.isEditedUserTenantUser = !!this.user.tenantCode;

        // Create the form
        if (this.formFields && typeof this.formFields.getFormWithValidators === 'function') {
          try {
            this.form = this.formBuilder.group(this.formFields.getFormWithValidators());
            this.form.patchValue(this.user);

            // Disable all form controls when in VIEW mode
            if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
              // Disable the entire form
              this.form.disable();
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.warn('Error creating form for EDIT/VIEW mode:', error);
            this.createFormFromUserModel();
            return;
          }
        } else {
          console.warn('formFields not properly initialized for EDIT/VIEW mode');
          this.createFormFromUserModel();
          return;
        }

        // Handle roles
        if (this.user.roles && this.user.roles.length > 0) {
          this.handleRoleOrgUnits();

          // Disable role org units form array in VIEW mode - now handled by disabling entire form
          if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW && this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray) {
            this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray.disable();
          }
        }
      } else {
        console.warn('No user data available for EDIT/VIEW mode');
        this.createNewUserForm();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating EDIT/VIEW form:', error);
      this.createMinimalForm();
    }
  }

  // Helper method to add existing role org units when populating from shared user model
  private addExistingRoleOrgUnit(role: any) {
    const roleGroup = new UntypedFormGroup({
      id: new UntypedFormControl(role.id),
      role: new UntypedFormControl(role.role, [Validators.required]),
    });

    if (this.isTenant) {
      roleGroup.addControl('validFrom', new UntypedFormControl(role.validFrom, [Validators.required]));
      roleGroup.addControl('validTo', new UntypedFormControl(role.validTo));
      roleGroup.addControl('institution', new UntypedFormControl(role.institution, [Validators.required]));
      roleGroup.addControl('site', new UntypedFormControl({ value: role.site, disabled: !role.institution }));
      roleGroup.addControl('building', new UntypedFormControl({ value: role.building, disabled: !role.site }));

      // Setup value change subscriptions for cascading dropdowns
      this.setupRoleDropdownSubscriptions(roleGroup);

      // If we have an institution, make sure sites data is loaded
      if (role.institution && this.isTenant) {
        this.getSites(role.institution);
      }

      // If we have a site, make sure buildings data is loaded
      if (role.site && this.isTenant) {
        this.getBuildings(role.site);
      }
    }

    this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray.push(roleGroup);
    this.roleEditStates.push(false); // Start in non-edit mode for existing roles
  }

  // Setup value change subscriptions for cascading dropdowns with better error handling
  private setupRoleDropdownSubscriptions(roleGroup: UntypedFormGroup) {
    try {
      // Only set up subscriptions if the form controls exist
      if (!roleGroup.get('institution') || !roleGroup.get('site') || !roleGroup.get('building')) {
        console.warn('Required role form controls not found, skipping subscriptions');
        return;
      }

      // Subscribe to institution changes
      roleGroup.get('institution')?.valueChanges.subscribe((institution) => {
        try {
          if (institution) {
            roleGroup.get('site')?.enable();
            this.getSites(institution);
          } else {
            roleGroup.get('site')?.disable();
            roleGroup.get('site')?.setValue(null);
            roleGroup.get('building')?.disable();
            roleGroup.get('building')?.setValue(null);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error in institution valueChanges:', error);
        }
      });

      // Subscribe to site changes
      roleGroup.get('site')?.valueChanges.subscribe((site) => {
        try {
          if (site) {
            roleGroup.get('building')?.enable();
            this.getBuildings(site);
          } else {
            roleGroup.get('building')?.disable();
            roleGroup.get('building')?.setValue(null);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error in site valueChanges:', error);
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error setting up role dropdown subscriptions:', error);
    }
  }

  // Determine which action buttons to show based on page mode
  private determineActionButtons() {
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.BACK, ActionButtonType.EDIT];
      this.isEdit = false;
    } else if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT) {
      this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.DELETE, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
      this.isEdit = true;
    } else if (this.pageMode === PageMode.CREATE) {
      this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
      this.isEdit = true;
    }

    // Set the cancel button label based on mode
    this.cancelLabel = this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW ? 'GLOBAL.BUTTONS.BACK' : 'GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CANCEL';
  }

  private getRoles() {
    if (this.schemaCode) {
      this.rolesService
        .rolesGetAdministrationEFRoles(this.schemaCode)
        .subscribe((roles: SecRoleEntityDtoEntityRef[]) => {
          this.roles = roles;
        });
    } else {
      this.rolesService.rolesGetEFRoles().subscribe((roles: SecRoleEntityDtoEntityRef[]) => {
        this.roles = roles;
      });
    }
  }

  private getInstitutions(): void {
    if (this.schemaCode)
      this.institutionsService
        .institutionsGetInstitutionAdministrationEntityRef(this.schemaCode)
        .subscribe((institutions) => {
          this.institutions = institutions;
        });
    else
      this.institutionsService.institutionsGetInstitutionEntityRef().subscribe((institutions) => {
        this.institutions = institutions;
      });
  }

  private getSites(selectedInstitution: InstitutionEntityDtoEntityRef): void {
    if (this.schemaCode)
      this.sitesService
        .sitesGetSiteAdministrationEntityRef(selectedInstitution.id, this.schemaCode)
        .subscribe((sites) => {
          this.sites = sites;
        });
    else
      this.sitesService.sitesGetSitesEntityRef(selectedInstitution.id).subscribe((sites) => {
        this.sites = sites;
      });
  }

  private getBuildings(selectedSite: SiteEntityDtoEntityRef): void {
    if (this.schemaCode)
      this.buildingsService
        .buildingsGetBuildingAdministrationEntityRef(selectedSite.id, this.schemaCode)
        .subscribe((buildings) => {
          this.buildings = buildings;
        });
    else
      this.buildingsService.buildingsGetBuildingEntityRef(selectedSite.id).subscribe((buildings) => {
        this.buildings = buildings;
      });
  }

  toggleRolesEdit(index: number) {
    this.roleEditStates[index] = !this.roleEditStates[index];

    // Loop through all role groups and enable/disable controls
    this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray.controls.forEach((group, i) => {
      if (i === index) {
        if (this.roleEditStates[index]) {
          // Enable controls when edit is enabled
          group.get('role')?.enable();

          if (this.isTenant) {
            group.get('institution')?.enable();
            group.get('validFrom')?.enable();
            group.get('validTo')?.enable();
          }

          // Only enable site if institution is selected
          if (group.get('institution')?.value) {
            group.get('site')?.enable();
          }

          // Only enable building if site is selected
          if (group.get('site')?.value) {
            group.get('building')?.enable();
          }
        } else {
          // Disable all controls when edit is disabled
          group.get('role')?.disable();
          group.get('institution')?.disable();
          group.get('site')?.disable();
          group.get('building')?.disable();
          group.get('validFrom')?.disable();
          group.get('validTo')?.disable();
        }
      }
    });
  }

  getNameTooltip() {
    return (
      'A név kizárólag a magyar ABC betűiből álló elnevezést tartalmazhat, maximum 64 karakter hosszan. \n' +
      'Speciális és numerikus karakterek nem szerepelhetnek benne.'
    );
  }

  getEmailTooltip() {
    return 'Email formátum pl.: john.smith@example.com';
  }

  // Get roleOrgUnits form array
  get roleOrgUnitsFormArray(): FormArray {
    return this.form.get('roleOrgUnits') as FormArray;
  }

  // Add a new role org unit entry
  addRoleOrgUnit() {
    // Don't add role if in VIEW mode
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      return;
    }

    const roleGroup = new UntypedFormGroup({
      role: new UntypedFormControl(null),
    });

    if (this.isTenant) {
      roleGroup.addControl('id', new UntypedFormControl(null));
      roleGroup.addControl('validFrom', new UntypedFormControl(null));
      roleGroup.addControl('validTo', new UntypedFormControl(null));
      roleGroup.addControl('institution', new UntypedFormControl(null));
      roleGroup.addControl('site', new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }));
      roleGroup.addControl('building', new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: true }));
    }

    if (this.isTenant) {
      // Subscribe to institution changes to enable/disable site dropdown
      roleGroup.get('institution')?.valueChanges.subscribe((institution) => {
        if (institution) {
          roleGroup.get('site')?.enable();
          this.getSites(institution);
        } else {
          roleGroup.get('site')?.disable();
          roleGroup.get('site')?.setValue(null);
          roleGroup.get('building')?.disable();
          roleGroup.get('building')?.setValue(null);
        }
      });

      // Subscribe to site changes to enable/disable building dropdown
      roleGroup.get('site')?.valueChanges.subscribe((site) => {
        if (site) {
          roleGroup.get('building')?.enable();
          this.getBuildings(site);
        } else {
          roleGroup.get('building')?.disable();
          roleGroup.get('building')?.setValue(null);
        }
      });
    }

    this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray.push(roleGroup);
    this.roleEditStates.push(true); // Initialize edit state for new row
  }

  // Remove a role org unit entry
  removeRoleOrgUnit(index: number) {
    // Don't remove role if in VIEW mode
    if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
      return;
    }

    this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray.removeAt(index);
    this.roleEditStates.splice(index, 1); // Remove edit state for removed row
  }

  // Set up action buttons based on page mode
  private setupActionButtons() {
    try {
      console.log('setupActionButtons - PageMode:', this.pageMode, 'PageMode.VIEW:', PageMode.VIEW);

      if (this.pageMode === PageMode.VIEW) {
        this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.BACK, ActionButtonType.EDIT];
        this.isEdit = false;
        this.cancelLabel = 'GLOBAL.BUTTONS.BACK';

        // Force disable all form controls in VIEW mode
        if (this.form) {
          console.log('VIEW mode detected - disabling entire form');

          // First disable the main form
          Object.keys(this.form.controls).forEach((controlName) => {
            if (controlName !== 'roleOrgUnits') {
              this.form.get(controlName)?.disable();
            }
          });

          // Then disable all role org units if they exist
          const roleOrgUnits = this.form.get('roleOrgUnits') as FormArray;
          if (roleOrgUnits) {
            console.log('Found roleOrgUnits FormArray, disabling all controls');
            for (let i = 0; i < roleOrgUnits.length; i++) {
              const group = roleOrgUnits.at(i) as UntypedFormGroup;
              Object.keys(group.controls).forEach((key) => {
                console.log(`Disabling role control: ${key}`);
                group.get(key)?.disable();
              });
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (this.pageMode === PageMode.EDIT) {
        this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.DELETE, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
        this.isEdit = true;
        this.cancelLabel = 'GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CANCEL';
      } else {
        this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
        this.isEdit = true;
        this.cancelLabel = 'GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CANCEL';
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error setting up action buttons:', error);
      // Default to CREATE mode buttons
      this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
      this.isEdit = true;
      this.cancelLabel = 'GLOBAL.BUTTONS.CANCEL';
    }
  }

  // Helper method to get the full name from the user model
  private getUserFullName(user: SecUserModel): string {
    let fullName = '';
    if (user.firstName) {
      fullName += user.firstName;
    }
    if (user.lastName) {
      if (fullName) {
        fullName += ' ';
      }
      fullName += user.lastName;
    }
    return fullName;
  }

  // Helper method to handle role org units when user data is loaded
  private handleRoleOrgUnits() {
    if (!this.user || !this.user.roles) return;

    this.user.roles.forEach((role) => {
      const roleGroup = new UntypedFormGroup({
        id: new UntypedFormControl(role.id),
        role: new UntypedFormControl(role.role, [Validators.required]),
      });

      if (this.isTenant) {
        roleGroup.addControl('validFrom', new UntypedFormControl(role.validFrom, [Validators.required]));
        roleGroup.addControl('validTo', new UntypedFormControl(role.validTo));
        roleGroup.addControl('institution', new UntypedFormControl(role.institution, [Validators.required]));
        roleGroup.addControl('site', new UntypedFormControl({ value: role.site, disabled: !role.institution }));
        roleGroup.addControl('building', new UntypedFormControl({ value: role.building, disabled: !role.site }));

        // If we have an institution, make sure sites data is loaded
        if (role.institution && this.isTenant) {
          this.getSites(role.institution);
        }

        // If we have a site, make sure buildings data is loaded
        if (role.site && this.isTenant) {
          this.getBuildings(role.site);
        }

        // Setup value change subscriptions for cascading dropdowns
        this.setupRoleDropdownSubscriptions(roleGroup);
      }

      this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray.push(roleGroup);
      this.roleEditStates.push(false);
    });
  }

  // Disable all form controls when in VIEW mode
  private disableFormInViewMode() {
    if (!this.form) return;

    console.log('Disabling all form controls for VIEW mode');

    // First disable all main form controls
    Object.keys(this.form.controls).forEach((controlName) => {
      if (controlName !== 'roleOrgUnits') {
        console.log(`Disabling control: ${controlName}`);
        this.form.get(controlName)?.disable();
      }
    });

    // Then disable all role form controls if they exist
    if (this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray) {
      console.log(`Disabling ${this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray.length} role groups`);
      for (let i = 0; i < this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray.length; i++) {
        const roleGroup = this.roleOrgUnitsFormArray.at(i) as UntypedFormGroup;
        Object.keys(roleGroup.controls).forEach((controlName) => {
          console.log(`Disabling role control: ${controlName} in group ${i}`);
          roleGroup.get(controlName)?.disable();
        });
      }
    }
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, Input, ViewChild, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { ConfirmDialogComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/dialog/confirm-dialog/confirm-dialog.component';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from '../../../core/services/loader.service';
import {
  PartnersService,
  SecUserListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult,
} from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { SortDirection as DTSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-request';
import { SortDirection as ApiSortDirection } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sortDirection';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'sec-user-list-root',
  templateUrl: './sec-user-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./sec-user-list.component.scss'],
})
export class SecUserListComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  @Input() partnerId: number | null | undefined;

  searchForm = this.formBuilder.group({
    emailFilter: [null],
    firstNameFilter: [null],
    lastNameFilter: [null],
    active: [null],
    isLocked: [null],
  });

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private partnerService: PartnersService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = 'sec-user';
    this.stepForward();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  private searchField = ''; // A keresési mező értékének letárolására.
  private tenantCode = '';

  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable?: MatDatatableOldComponent;

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    ({
      columnName: 'email',
      displayName: 'E-mail cím (felhasználó név)',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'lastName',
      displayName: 'Vezetéknév',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'firstName',
      displayName: 'Keresztnév',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'phone',
      displayName: 'Telefonszám',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'isDeleted',
      displayName: 'Állapot',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'isLocked',
      displayName: 'Zárolva',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
  ];
  isLoading = false;

  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = 'lastName';

  users?: SecUserListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult;

  get sfc() {
    return this.searchForm.controls;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (this.partnerId) {
      this.partnerService.partnersGet(this.partnerId).subscribe((result) => {
        this.tenantCode = result.tenantCode;
        this.getItems();
      });
    } else {
      this.getItems();
    }
  }

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;

    const startPage = this.dataDataTable?.pageIndex ?? this.pageIndex;
    const pageSize = this.dataDataTable?.pageSize ?? this.pageSize;
    const sortColumn = this.dataDataTable?.getSort() ?? this.sortActive;
    const sortDirection = this.dataDataTable?.getSortDirection() ?? ApiSortDirection.Ascending;
    const apiSortDirection: ApiSortDirection =
      sortDirection == DTSortDirection.Ascending ? ApiSortDirection.Ascending : ApiSortDirection.Descending;

    if (this.tenantCode) {
      this.userService
        .usersAdministrationGetUsers(
          this.tenantCode,
          this.sfc.emailFilter?.value,
          this.sfc.firstNameFilter?.value,
          this.sfc.lastNameFilter?.value,
          this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
          this.sfc.isLocked?.value?.id,
          startPage,
          pageSize,
          sortColumn,
          apiSortDirection,
        )
        .subscribe((data: SecUserListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
          this.users = data;
          this.dataDataTable?.refresh();
          this.isLoading = false;
        });
    } else {
      this.userService
        .usersGetUsers(
          this.tenantCode,
          this.sfc.emailFilter?.value,
          this.sfc.firstNameFilter?.value,
          this.sfc.lastNameFilter?.value,
          this.sfc.active?.value?.id,
          this.sfc.isLocked?.value?.id,
          startPage,
          pageSize,
          sortColumn,
          apiSortDirection,
        )
        .subscribe((data: SecUserListItemDtoEntityListItemQueryResult) => {
          this.users = data;
          this.dataDataTable?.refresh();
          this.isLoading = false;
        });
    }
  }

  search(searchText: string) {
    this.searchField = searchText; // Searchfield mező beállítása a keresés mező értékével. Így egy change esemény futásakor is megőrizzük a keresés szűrést.
    this.getItems();
  }

  createRow() {
    if (this.tenantCode) {
      this.router.navigate([`sec-user/email/${this.tenantCode}/partner/${this.partnerId}`]);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['sec-user', 'email']);
    }
  }
  seeRow(element: any) {
    const id = element?.id;
    if (this.tenantCode) {
      this.router.navigate([`sec-user/${id}/administrationview/${this.tenantCode}/partner/${this.partnerId}`]);
    } else {
      this.router.navigate(['sec-user', id, 'view']);
    }
  }
  editRow(element: any) {
    const id = element?.id;
    if (this.tenantCode)
      this.router.navigate([`sec-user/${id}/administrationedit/${this.tenantCode}/partner/${this.partnerId}`]);
    else this.router.navigate(['sec-user', id, 'edit']);
  }
  passwordChangeRow(element: any) {
    const id = element?.id;
    if (this.tenantCode)
      this.router.navigate([
        `sec-user/${id}/administrationpassword-change/${this.tenantCode}/partner/${this.partnerId}`,
      ]);
    else this.router.navigate(['sec-user', id, 'password-change']);
  }

  lockRow(element: any) {
    const config = {
      disableClose: true,
      autoFocus: true,
      panelClass: 'app-dialog-container',
      data: {
        message: 'SEC_USER.LOCK_CONFIRM_MESSAGE',
        confirmButtonText: 'GLOBAL.CONFIRM_DIALOG.YES',
        cancelButtonText: 'GLOBAL.CONFIRM_DIALOG.NO',
        isLock: true,
      },
    };

    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, config);
    const id = element?.id;

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.userService.usersLock(id).subscribe(() => {
          this.getItems();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  unlockRow(element: any) {
    const config = {
      disableClose: true,
      autoFocus: true,
      panelClass: 'app-dialog-container',
      data: {
        message: 'SEC_USER.UNLOCK_CONFIRM_MESSAGE',
        confirmButtonText: 'GLOBAL.CONFIRM_DIALOG.YES',
        cancelButtonText: 'GLOBAL.CONFIRM_DIALOG.NO',
        isLock: false,
      },
    };

    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, config);
    const id = element?.id;

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.userService.usersUnlock(id).subscribe(() => {
          this.getItems();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  sendNotificationRow(element: any) {
    const config = {
      disableClose: true,
      autoFocus: true,
      panelClass: 'app-dialog-container',
      data: {
        message: 'SEC_USER.SEND_NOTIFICATION_CONFIRM_MESSAGE',
        confirmButtonText: 'GLOBAL.CONFIRM_DIALOG.YES',
        cancelButtonText: 'GLOBAL.CONFIRM_DIALOG.NO',
        isLock: false,
      },
    };

    const dialogRef = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, config);
    const id = element?.id;

    dialogRef.afterClosed().subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (confirmed) {
        this.userService.usersNotificationResend(id).subscribe(() => {
          const notificationDialog = this.dialog.open(ConfirmDialogComponent, {
            data: {
              message: 'A felhasználó e-mail címére elküldtük újra az értesítést.',
              cancelButtonText: 'Rendben',
              showConfirmButton: false,
            },
          });

          notificationDialog.afterClosed().subscribe((confirmed: boolean) => {
            if (!confirmed) {
              this.getItems();
            }
          });
        });
      }
    });
  }

  rowsAreRendered() {
    this.dataDataTable?.setActionRowVisibility();
  }

  isHidden(element: any) {
    if (element.isSystem) return true;
    else return false;
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.sfc.emailFilter.setValue(null);
    this.sfc.firstNameFilter.setValue(null);
    this.sfc.lastNameFilter.setValue(null);
    this.sfc.active.setValue(null);
  }

  activeOptions = [
    { id: true, name: 'Aktív' },
    { id: false, name: 'Inaktív' },
  ];

  yesNoOptions = [
    { id: true, name: 'Igen' },
    { id: false, name: 'Nem' },
  ];
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnDestroy, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormControl, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { SecUserModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secUserModel';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';
import { RolesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/roles.service';
import { SitesService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sites.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { Observable, Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { takeUntil } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { PasswordStrengthService } from 'src/app/core/helper/password-strength.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sec-user-password-change',
  templateUrl: './sec-user-password-change.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./sec-user-password-change.component.scss'],
})
export class SecUserPasswordChangeComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnDestroy, OnInit {
  user: SecUserModel;
  //roles: SecRoleEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  //sites: SiteEntityDtoEntityRef[];
  formFields: any;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  showSites = false;
  isVisibilityIcon = true;
  hide = true;
  hidepw = true;

  // Password strength tracking
  passwordStrength = 0;
  passwordFeedback = '';
  private destroy$ = new Subject<void>();

  actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
  isEdit = true;
  idOfElement;
  currentUserId = 0;
  schemaCode = '';
  partnerId: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private sitesService: SitesService,
    private rolesService: RolesService,
    private activatedRoute: ActivatedRoute,
    public passwordStrengthService: PasswordStrengthService,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);
    this.user = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.user;
    this.idOfElement = this.activatedRoute.snapshot.data.user?.id;
    this.schemaCode = this._route.snapshot.params.tenantcode;
    this.partnerId = this._route.snapshot.params.partner;
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Felhasználók', this.rootPath!)];
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(
      {
        id: new UntypedFormControl(null),
        newPassword: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: false }, [
          Validators.required,
          Validators.minLength(8),
        ]),
        newPasswordAgain: new UntypedFormControl({ value: null, disabled: false }, Validators.required),
      },
      { validators: this.passwordMatchValidator },
    );

    this.form.get('id')?.setValue(this.idOfElement);

    this.userService.usersGetCurrentUser().subscribe((data: any) => {
      this.form.patchValue(data);
      this.currentUserId = data.id;
    });

    // Monitor password changes to update password strength
    this.form
      .get('newPassword')
      ?.valueChanges.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe((password) => {
        if (password) {
          const result = this.passwordStrengthService.calculatePasswordStrength(password);
          this.passwordStrength = result.strength;
          this.passwordFeedback = result.feedback;

          // Update form validation state based on password strength
          const passwordControl = this.form.get('newPassword');
          if (passwordControl && this.passwordStrength < 40) {
            passwordControl.setErrors({ ...passwordControl.errors, weakPassword: true });
          }
        } else {
          this.passwordStrength = 0;
          this.passwordFeedback = '';
        }
      });
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  protected save(): Observable<SecUserModel> {
    const elem = this.form.getRawValue();
    elem.tenant = this.user.tenantCode;
    if (this.user.id == this.form.get('id')?.value && this.currentUserId == this.user.id) {
      return this.userService.usersPostOwnPassword(elem);
    }
    return this.userService.usersPostPassword(this.user.id!, elem);
  }

  public cancel(): void {
    console.log(this.schemaCode);
    console.log(this.partnerId);
    console.log(this.user?.id);
    if (this.schemaCode) {
      console.log('valami');
      this.router.navigate([`partner/${this.partnerId}/edit`]);
    } else {
      if (this.user.id == this.form.get('id')?.value && this.currentUserId == this.user.id) {
        this.router.navigate(['user']);
      } else {
        this.router.navigate(['sec-user']);
      }
    }
  }

  changeType() {
    this.hide = !this.hide;
  }

  changepwType() {
    this.hidepw = !this.hidepw;
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  // Custom validator to check if passwords match
  passwordMatchValidator(form: UntypedFormGroup) {
    const password = form.get('newPassword')?.value;
    const confirmPassword = form.get('newPasswordAgain')?.value;

    if (password === confirmPassword) {
      form.get('newPasswordAgain')?.setErrors(null);
      return null;
    } else {
      form.get('newPasswordAgain')?.setErrors({ passwordMismatch: true });
      return { passwordMismatch: true };
    }
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { BehaviorSubject } from 'rxjs';
import { SecUserModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/secUserModel';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class SecUserSharedService {
  // BehaviorSubject to store and share the email value
  private emailSource = new BehaviorSubject<string | null>(null);

  // BehaviorSubject to store and share the user model
  private userModelSource = new BehaviorSubject<SecUserModel | null>(null);

  // Observables that components can subscribe to
  currentEmail$ = this.emailSource.asObservable();
  currentUserModel$ = this.userModelSource.asObservable();

  // Method to update the email value
  setEmail(email: string) {
    this.emailSource.next(email);
  }

  // Method to clear the email value
  clearEmail() {
    this.emailSource.next(null);
  }

  // Method to update the user model
  setUserModel(user: SecUserModel) {
    this.userModelSource.next(user);
  }

  // Method to clear the user model
  clearUserModel() {
    this.userModelSource.next(null);
  }

  // Method to clear all stored data
  clearAll() {
    this.clearEmail();
    this.clearUserModel();
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder, FormGroup } from '@angular/forms';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';

import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { SysConfigViewModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sysConfigViewModel';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { SysConfigsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sysConfigs.service';
import { SysConfigsService as DataReceiverSysConfigsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/sysConfigs.service';
import { SysConfigsService as MonitoringSysConfigsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/sysConfigs.service';
import { SysConfigsService as ReportingSysConfigsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiReporting/api/sysConfigs.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'sys-config',
  templateUrl: './sys-config.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./sys-config.component.scss'],
})
export class SysConfigComponent extends FormComponentBase {
  filterForm: FormGroup;
  tenantName: string;
  private sysConfigBaseUrl: string;
  private sysConfigsService:
    | SysConfigsService
    | DataReceiverSysConfigsService
    | MonitoringSysConfigsService
    | ReportingSysConfigsService;
  public sysConfigType: SysConfigPageType;
  public sysConfigSelector: string;

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private formBuilder: FormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.sysConfigSelector = route.snapshot.data['sysConfigSelector'];
    this.sysConfigType = route.snapshot.data['sysConfigType'];
    this.sysConfigBaseUrl = route.snapshot.data['sysConfigBaseUrl'];

    switch (this.sysConfigType) {
      case SysConfigPageType.Framework:
        this.sysConfigsService = injector.get(SysConfigsService);
        break;
      case SysConfigPageType.DataReceiver:
        this.sysConfigsService = injector.get(DataReceiverSysConfigsService);
        break;
      case SysConfigPageType.Monitoring:
        this.sysConfigsService = injector.get(MonitoringSysConfigsService);
        break;
      case SysConfigPageType.Reporting:
        this.sysConfigsService = injector.get(ReportingSysConfigsService);
        break;
    }

    this.rootPath = '/sys-config';
    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Rendszer konfig', '')];
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
    const filterFormFields = {
      configName: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []] as any,
      configDisplayName: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []] as any,
    };
    this.filterForm = this.formBuilder.group(filterFormFields);
  }

  override ngOnInit() {
    super.ngOnInit();

    this.getItems();
    this.authService.OnChanged().subscribe((res) => {
      this.tenantName = res.tenantName;
    });
  }

  @ViewChild('dataDataTable', { static: true }) protected dataDataTable: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    ({
      columnName: 'configName',
      displayName: 'Név',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'configDisplayName',
      displayName: 'Megjelenési név',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'configValue',
      displayName: 'Érték',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Custom,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
  ];
  isLoading = false;
  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = 'configName';
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  allItems: SysConfigViewModel[] = [];

  getItems() {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.sysConfigsService.sysConfigGetSysConfigs().subscribe((data: SysConfigViewModel[]) => {
      this.allItems = data;
      this.data.items = this.allItems;
      this.data.recordsTotal = this.allItems.length;
      this.dataDataTable.refresh();
      this.isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  dbFilter() {
    const configNameFilter = this.filterForm.get('configName')?.value;
    const configDisplayNameFilter = this.filterForm.get('configDisplayName')?.value;
    this.data.items = this.allItems;
    if (configNameFilter)
      this.data.items = this.data.items.filter((d) => d.configName && d.configName.includes(configNameFilter));
    if (configDisplayNameFilter)
      this.data.items = this.data.items.filter(
        (d) => d.configDisplayName && d.configDisplayName.includes(configDisplayNameFilter),
      );
    this.data.recordsTotal = this.data.items.length;

    this.dataDataTable.refresh();
  }

  editRow(element: SysConfigViewModel) {
    this.router.navigate(['/sys-config', this.sysConfigBaseUrl, 'edit', element.id]);
  }

  resetFilter() {
    this.filterForm.get('configName').setValue(null);
    this.filterForm.get('configDisplayName').setValue(null);
  }
}

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { FormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { SysConfigPageType } from 'src/app/core/models/enums/SysConfigPageType';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { DictItemModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/dictItemModel';
import { SysConfigValueType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sysConfigValueType';
import { SysConfigViewModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/sysConfigViewModel';
import { LoaderService } from 'src/app/core/services/loader.service';
import { SysConfigsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/sysConfigs.service';
import { SysConfigsService as DataReceiverSysConfigsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/sysConfigs.service';
import { SysConfigsService as MonitoringSysConfigsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/sysConfigs.service';
import { SysConfigsService as ReportingSysConfigsService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiReporting/api/sysConfigs.service';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as DataReceiverDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as MonitoringDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring/api/dict.service';
import { DictService as ReportingDictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApiReporting/api/dict.service';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'sys-config-edit',
  templateUrl: './sys-config-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./sys-config-edit.component.scss'],
})
export class SysConfigEditComponent extends FormComponentBase implements OnInit {
  private readonly id: number;
  item: SysConfigViewModel;
  dictItems: DictItemModel[];
  SysConfigValueType: typeof SysConfigValueType = SysConfigValueType;
  private sysConfigsService:
    | SysConfigsService
    | DataReceiverSysConfigsService
    | MonitoringSysConfigsService
    | ReportingSysConfigsService;
  private dictService: DictService | DataReceiverDictService | MonitoringDictService | ReportingDictService;
  public sysConfigType: SysConfigPageType;

  trueFalseOptions = [
    { label: 'True', value: true },
    { label: 'False', value: false },
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    route: ActivatedRoute,
    translate: TranslateService,
    private formBuilder: FormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.previousBreadcrumbs = [new BreadcrumbItem('Rendszer konfig', '')];

    const dictBaseUrl = route.snapshot.data['dictBaseUrl'];
    this.rootPath = '/dict/' + dictBaseUrl;
    this.sysConfigType = route.snapshot.data['sysConfigType'];

    switch (this.sysConfigType) {
      case SysConfigPageType.Framework:
        this.sysConfigsService = injector.get(SysConfigsService);
        this.dictService = injector.get(DictService);
        break;
      case SysConfigPageType.DataReceiver:
        this.sysConfigsService = injector.get(DataReceiverSysConfigsService);
        this.dictService = injector.get(DataReceiverDictService);
        break;
      case SysConfigPageType.Monitoring:
        this.sysConfigsService = injector.get(MonitoringSysConfigsService);
        this.dictService = injector.get(MonitoringDictService);
        break;
      case SysConfigPageType.Reporting:
        this.sysConfigsService = injector.get(ReportingSysConfigsService);
        this.dictService = injector.get(ReportingDictService);
        break;
    }

    const breadcrumbTitle = translate.instant(
      'SIDEBAR.SYS_CONFIG_SUB_ROUTES.' + route.snapshot.data['sysConfigSelector'],
    );
    this.previousBreadcrumbs.push(new BreadcrumbItem(breadcrumbTitle, this.rootPath));

    this.numberOfBreadcrumbGoBacks = 2;
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    this.setBreadcrumbs();

    this.id = parseInt(this._route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id'));
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    super.ngOnInit();

    this.form = this.formBuilder.group({
      id: [''],
      configName: [''],
      configDisplayName: [''],
      configValue: [''],
    });

    this.sysConfigsService.sysConfigGetSysConfigById(this.id).subscribe((model: SysConfigViewModel) => {
      this.item = model;
      this.form.patchValue({
        id: model.id,
        configName: model.configName,
        configDisplayName: model.configDisplayName,
        configValue: model.configValue,
      });

      if (model.valueType === SysConfigValueType.Bool) {
        this.form.get('configValue').setValue(model.configValue.toLowerCase() === 'true');
      }

      if (model.valueType === SysConfigValueType.Dictionary) {
        this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsForDict(model.dictCode).subscribe((dictItems: DictItemModel[]) => {
          this.dictItems = dictItems;
          const toSelect = dictItems.find((x) => x.value === model.configValue);
          this.form.get('configValue').setValue(toSelect);
        });
      }
    });

    this.form.get('configDisplayName').disable();
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> {
    if (this.item.valueType === SysConfigValueType.Dictionary) {
      const configValueFormControl = this.form.get('configValue');
      configValueFormControl.setValue(configValueFormControl.value?.value);
    }
    return this.sysConfigsService.sysConfigEdit(this.id, this.form.value);
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { NgxSpinnerService } from 'ngx-spinner';
import { SelectListItemDto } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/selectListItemDto';
import { AuthService } from 'src/app/core/services/security/auth.service';
import AccessTokenModel from 'src/app/core/services/security/access-token-model';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tenant-selection',
  templateUrl: './tenant-selection.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./tenant-selection.component.scss'],
})
export class TenantSelectionComponent implements OnInit {
  tenants: SelectListItemDto[] = [];
  selectedTenantCode?: string;
  loading = true;
  error: string | null = null;
  hasTenants = false;
  returnUrl = '';
  isSwitchingTenant = false;

  constructor(
    private authService: AuthService,
    private router: Router,
    private spinner: NgxSpinnerService,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Check if user is authenticated
    const token = this.authService.getAuthToken();
    const isAuthenticated = Object.keys(token).length !== 0;

    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      // If not authenticated, redirect to login
      this.router.navigate(['/login']);
      return;
    }

    // Get the return URL if available
    this.returnUrl = localStorage.getItem('returnUrl') || '';
    this.isSwitchingTenant = !!this.returnUrl;

    // Check if tenant is already selected
    const currentTenant = this.authService.getCurrentTenant();

    // IMPORTANT: Preselect the current tenant if it exists, but NEVER auto-navigate
    // Force the user to explicitly select a tenant in all cases
    if (currentTenant) {
      this.selectedTenantCode = currentTenant;
    }

    // Load available tenants
    this.spinner.show();
    this.loadTenants();
  }

  private loadTenants(): void {
    this.authService.getTenants().subscribe({
      next: (tenants: SelectListItemDto[]) => {
        this.tenants = tenants;
        this.loading = false;
        this.spinner.hide();
        console.log(tenants);
        if (tenants.length === 0) {
          this.error = 'No tenants available for this user';
          // Log out the user if no tenants are available
          this.authService.setAuthToken({} as AccessTokenModel);
        } else if (tenants.length > 0) {
          this.hasTenants = true;
        }
      },
      error: () => {
        this.loading = false;
        this.error = 'Error loading tenants. Please try again.';
        this.spinner.hide();
        console.log('ererrrr');
        // Log out the user if there was an error fetching tenants
        this.authService.setAuthToken({} as AccessTokenModel);
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Select a tenant
   * @param tenant The tenant to select
   */
  selectTenant(): void {
    this.spinner.show();

    // Get the name of the selected tenant from the list
    const selectedTenant = this.tenants.find((t) => t.code === this.selectedTenantCode);
    const tenantName = selectedTenant ? selectedTenant.name : 'No Tenant';

    // All tenants (including null) should go through the same flow
    this.authService.loginToSelectedTenant(this.selectedTenantCode!).subscribe({
      next: (response) => {
        // Update the auth token with the response
        this.authService.setAuthToken(response);

        // Set the tenant with its name AFTER setting the auth token
        this.authService.setCurrentTenant(this.selectedTenantCode!, tenantName!);

        // Clear any return URL to ensure we go to home
        localStorage.removeItem('returnUrl');

        this.spinner.hide();

        // Navigate using Angular router instead of forcing page reload
        this.router.navigate(['/']);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.spinner.hide();
        this.error = 'Error loading tenants. Please try again.';

        // Log out the user if there was an error
        this.authService.setAuthToken({} as AccessTokenModel);
        this.cancel();
      },
    });
  }

  cancel(): void {
    // If there's a return URL, go back to it, otherwise log out
    if (this.returnUrl) {
      localStorage.removeItem('returnUrl');
      this.router.navigateByUrl(this.returnUrl);
    } else {
      // Log out the user if they cancel tenant selection
      this.authService.setAuthToken({} as AccessTokenModel);
      this.router.navigate(['/login']);
    }
  }
}

import { AfterContentChecked, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, ElementRef, Injector, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder, UntypedFormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { SortDirection } from '@angular/material/sort';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { TitleOption } from 'echarts/types/dist/shared';
import { Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { ColumnType, IColumnDefinition } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/definitions/column-definition';
import { MatDatatableOldComponent } from 'src/app/core/components/datatable/mat-datatable/mat-datatable-old.component';
import { EntityRef } from 'src/app/core/generated/core/entity-ref';
import { DictService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/dict.service';
import { AddressType } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/model/models';
import { IDataTableResponse } from 'src/app/core/models/datatable/datatable-response';

@Component({
  selector: 'test-form-root',
  templateUrl: './test-form.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./test-form.component.scss'],
})
export class TestFormComponent extends FormComponentBase implements AfterContentChecked {
  hide = true;
  public AddressType: typeof AddressType = AddressType;

  optionsRadio = [
    { label: 'one', value: 1 },
    { label: 'two', value: 2 },
    { label: 'three', value: 3 },
  ];
  optionsSelect = [
    { label: 'one', id: 1 },
    { label: 'two', id: 2 },
    { label: 'three', id: 3 },
  ];

  parentFormGroup = this.formBuilder.group({
    parentFormArray: this.formBuilder.array([
      this.formBuilder.group({
        checkboxInput: [false],
        numberInput: [1, [Validators.required]],
      }),
      this.formBuilder.group({
        textareaInput: [],
      }),
      this.formBuilder.group({
        datepicker: [Validators.required],
      }),
    ]),
  });

  stepLabels = ['STEPPER.STEP_LABELS.FIRST', 'STEPPER.STEP_LABELS.SECOND', 'STEPPER.STEP_LABELS.THIRD'];

  formArray = this.formBuilder.array([]);
  formFormArray = this.formBuilder.group({
    tariffs: this.formArray,
  });
  inputsForm = this.formBuilder.group({
    radioInput: [],
    radioInputRow: [null],
    checkboxInput: [false],
    checkboxInput2: [false],
    switchInput: [],
    selectInput: [[{ label: 'three', id: 3 }]],
    filterSelect: [{ id: 1, entityDisplayName: 'Egy' }],
    autocomplete: [],
    textInput: [],
    numberInput: [],
    textareaInput: [],
    textInputEmail: [],
    textInputPhone: [],
    address: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, [Validators.required]],
    address2: [{ value: null, disabled: false }, [Validators.required]],
    datepicker: [null],
    amount: [5000],
  });

  columns: IColumnDefinition[] = [
    ({
      columnName: 'select',
      displayName: '',
      columnType: ColumnType.Select,
      filterable: false,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'Name',
      displayName: 'Név',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'Value1',
      displayName: 'Érték 1',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'Value2',
      displayName: 'Érték 2',
      columnType: ColumnType.Number,
      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'State',
      displayName: 'Állapot',

      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'Date',

      sortable: true,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
    ({
      columnName: 'Actions',
      displayName: 'GLOBAL.LIST.OPERATIONS',
      columnType: ColumnType.Text,
      sortable: false,
    } as IColumnDefinition),
  ];

  private _selectedValues: EntityRef[] = [];

  pageIndex = 0;
  pageSize = 10;
  sortDirection: SortDirection = 'asc';
  sortActive = 'Name';
  isFilterContainerOpen = false;
  data: IDataTableResponse = {
    items: [],
    recordsTotal: 0,
  };
  @ViewChild('testStaticDatatable', { static: true }) protected testStaticDatatable?: MatDatatableOldComponent;
  @ViewChild('testStaticDatatable') table?: MatTable<any>;

  get select(): EntityRef[] {
    return this._selectedValues;
  }

  testDatatableFilterForm?: UntypedFormGroup;
  allItems: any[] = [];

  mergeOption: any;
  loading = false;
  options: any;

  getDicts?: (string: string, paramId?: string) => Observable<any>;

  testFilterSelectOptions: any[] = [
    { id: 1, entityDisplayName: 'Egy' },
    { id: 2, entityDisplayName: 'Ketto' },
    { id: 3, entityDisplayName: 'harom' },
    { id: 4, entityDisplayName: 'Harminc harom' },
    { id: 5, entityDisplayName: 'Öt' },
    { id: 6, entityDisplayName: 'Hat' },
  ];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private dictService: DictService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
    private cdref: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = 'test-form';
    this.setBreadcrumbs();
    this.getItems();
  }

  ngAfterContentChecked() {
    this.cdref.detectChanges();
  }

  override ngOnInit(): void {
    this.getDicts = (search) => {
      return of(this.testFilterSelectOptions.filter((data) => data.entityDisplayName.toLowerCase().startsWith(search)));
      // return this.testFilterSelectOptions;
      //let searchText = this.fc.filterSelect.value;
      // return this.dictService.dictsGetAllDictItemsForDict(search);
    };

    const filterFormFields = {
      megnevezes: [{ value: '', disabled: false }, []] as any,
    };
    this.testDatatableFilterForm = this.formBuilder.group(filterFormFields);

    this.setOptions({
      //EChartsOption
      title: {
        text: 'Almérő neve',
      } as TitleOption,
      tooltip: {
        trigger: 'axis',
      },
      legend: {
        data: new Array<any>(),
        bottom: 0,
      },
      xAxis: {
        type: 'category',
        data: new Array<any>(),
      },
      yAxis: {
        type: 'value',
        axisLabel: {
          formatter: (val: any) => `${new DecimalPipe('hu-HU').transform(val ?? '', '0.0-2')}`,
        },
      },
      series: new Array<any>(),
      dataZoom: [
        {
          id: 'dataZoomX',
          type: 'slider',
          xAxisIndex: [0],
          filterMode: 'filter',
          height: 10,
        },
        {
          id: 'dataZoomY',
          type: 'slider',
          yAxisIndex: [0],
          filterMode: 'empty',
        },
      ],

import { Component, ElementRef, Injector } from '@angular/core';
import { UntypedFormBuilder } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { FormComponentBase } from 'src/app/core/base/form-component-base';
import { UsersService } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi/api/users.service';
import { BreadcrumbService } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.service';
import { LoaderService } from '../../core/services/loader.service';
import { ActionButtonType } from 'src/app/core/components/action-buttons/action-buttons.component';
import { SnackBarColor } from 'src/app/core/base/page-component-base';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto, SecUserModel } from 'src/app/core/generated/swaggerGeneratedApi';
import { BreadcrumbItem } from 'src/app/core/services/breadcrumb/IBreadcrumbItem';

@Component({
  selector: 'user-root',
  templateUrl: './user.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./user.component.css'],
})
export class UserComponent extends FormComponentBase {
  user?: SecUserModel;
  roles?: SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto[] | null = null;
  userId? = 0;
  tenantCode?: string | null = null;
  isEdit = false;
  actionButtons: ActionButtonType[] = [];

  constructor(
    router: Router,
    injector: Injector,
    breadcrumbService: BreadcrumbService,
    elRef: ElementRef,
    loaderService: LoaderService,
    private translateService: TranslateService,
    private userService: UsersService,
    private formBuilder: UntypedFormBuilder,
  ) {
    super(router, injector, breadcrumbService, elRef, loaderService);

    this.rootPath = 'user';
    this.breadcrumbService.clear();
    const breadcrumbName = this.translateService.instant('BREADCRUMB.PROFILE');
    this.breadcrumbService.push(new BreadcrumbItem(breadcrumbName, this.router.url));
  }

  override ngOnInit(): void {
    const userFormFields = {
      userName: [{ value: '', disabled: false }],
      lastName: [{ value: '', disabled: false }],
      firstName: [{ value: '', disabled: false }],
      eMail: [{ value: '', disabled: false }],
      phone: [{ value: '', disabled: false }],
    };

    this.form = this.formBuilder.group(userFormFields);
    this.form.disable();

    this.getCurrentUserData();
  }

  get fc() {
    return this.form.controls;
  }

  edit() {
    this.isEdit = true;
    this.form.enable();
  }

  cancel() {
    this.getCurrentUserData();
    this.isEdit = false;
    this.form.disable();
  }

  public onSaved(): void {
    this.cancel();
    const msg = this.translateService.instant('SNACKBAR.MODIFICATION_SAVED');
    this._snackBar.open(msg, '', {
      duration: 5000,
      panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Success}`],
      horizontalPosition: 'end',
      verticalPosition: 'top',
    });
  }

  protected save(): Observable<object> | null {
    this.form.markAllAsTouched();

    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this._snackBar.open(this.translateService.instant('SNACKBAR.FILL_REQUIRE_FIELDS'), '', {
        duration: 5000,
        panelClass: [`snackbar-color-${SnackBarColor.Error}`],
        horizontalPosition: 'end',
        verticalPosition: 'top',
      });

      return null;
    }

    const formValues = { ...this.form.getRawValue() };
    return this.userService.usersPutCurrentUser(formValues);
  }

  private getCurrentUserData(): void {
    this.userService.usersGetCurrentUser().subscribe((data: SecUserModel) => {
      this.form.patchValue(data);
      this.roles = data.roles;
      this.userId = data.id;
      this.tenantCode = data.tenantCode;

      if (!data.isSystem) {
        // only allow profile editing for non-system users
        this.actionButtons = [ActionButtonType.EDIT, ActionButtonType.CANCEL, ActionButtonType.SAVE];
      }
    });
  }

  redirectToPasswordChangePage() {
    this.cancel();
    this.router.navigate([`/sec-user/${this.userId}/password-change`]);
  }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;

namespace Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic;

/// <summary>
/// HandlerBase
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TDto">The type of the dto.</typeparam>
public abstract class HandlerBase<T, TDto>
      where T : class
      where TDto : IEntityDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="HandlerBase{T, TDto}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    protected HandlerBase(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper)
    {
        DbContext = dbContext;
        Mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the database context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The database context.
    /// </value>
    protected IDbContext DbContext { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the mapper.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The mapper.
    /// </value>
    protected IMapper Mapper { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual TDto CreateDto(T obj)
    {
        return CreateDto<TDto>(obj);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual TEntityDto CreateDto<TEntityDto>(T obj)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        return Mapper.Map<TEntityDto>(obj);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual T ApplyDto(TDto obj, T destination)
    {
        return ApplyDto<TDto>(obj, destination);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual T ApplyDto<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto source, T destination)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        var result = Mapper.Map(source, destination);

        return result;
    }



}
