using System.Collections;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Reflection;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Types;
using FluentValidation;
using NHibernate;

namespace Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;

/// <summary>
/// CommandHandlerBase ősosztály, amelyből az egyes entitások commandhandlerjeit származtatjuk.
/// </summary>
public abstract class CommandHandlerBase<T, TDto> : HandlerBase<T, TDto>, ICommandHandler
    where T : class, new()
    where TDto : IEntityDto, new()
{
    private readonly Lazy<IAccessLogger> _accessLogger;
    private readonly Lazy<IValidator<TDto>> _validator;

    protected readonly ICommandService _commandService;

    /// <summary>Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CommandHandlerBase{T, TDto}" /> class.</summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    protected CommandHandlerBase(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<TDto>> validator, ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _accessLogger = accessLogger;
        _validator = validator;
        _commandService = commandService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tranzakció módja
    /// </summary>
    public virtual CommandHandlerTransactionMode TransactionMode => CommandHandlerTransactionMode.Auto;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the access logger.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The access logger.
    /// </value>
    protected IAccessLogger AccessLogger => _accessLogger.Value;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this instance is access log enabled.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is access log enabled; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    protected virtual bool IsAccessLogEnabled => true;

    #region Interface entry point

    /// <summary>
    /// ExecuteEntityCommand
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">Paraméterként átadott command</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">command</exception>
    public ICommandResult ExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command == null ? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command)) : DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Overridable entry points

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    public virtual ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command is UpdateEntityCommand updateEntityCommand
            ? (ICommandResult)ExecuteUpdateEntityCommand<TDto>(updateEntityCommand)
            : throw new NotSupportedException($"Command not supported: {command.GetType().Name}");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A commandban referált entitás közvetlenül az adatbázisból.
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual T? GetEntity(UpdateEntityCommand command)
    {
        var obj = command.Update?.Entity;
        return obj != null ? DbContext.Session.Get<T>(obj.Id) : null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az ApplyDto előtt megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual void BeforeApplyDto(TDto entity, T domainEntity) { }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual void OnEntityCreating(TDto entity, T domainEntity)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus. Amennyiben a domainEntity implementálja az ITrackedEntity interfészt,
    /// akkor a létrehozással beállításra kerülnek a Created/Modified, CreatorUser/ModifierUser/DeletionUser mezőértékek.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">IEntityDto-t megvalósító osztály típus</typeparam>
    /// <param name="entityDto">DTO</param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity">Entitás</param>
    protected virtual void OnEntityCreating<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto entityDto, T domainEntity)
    {
        if (domainEntity is ITrackedEntity trackedEntity)
            SetUpTrackedEntity(trackedEntity, true);
        this.SetGlobalIdentifier(domainEntity);
        if (entityDto is TDto dto) OnEntityCreating(dto, domainEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Amennyiben az entitás implementálja az IGlobalIdentifier interfészt,
    /// úgy ha még nem rendelkezik egyedi azonosítóval (tipikusan Guid), és engedélyezve van az automatikus
    /// egyedi azonosító generálás, úgy a metódusban megtörténik az egyedi azonosító kiosztása, és beállítása
    /// az entitásnak.
    /// </summary>
    protected void SetGlobalIdentifier(T entity)
    {
        if (entity is IGlobalIdentifier globalIdentifier)
        {
            var autoGenAttr = entity.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(globalIdentifier.Identifier))
                ?.GetCustomAttribute<AutoGenerateAttribute>();
            if (autoGenAttr == null || autoGenAttr.Enabled)
                globalIdentifier.Identifier = Guid.NewGuid();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    protected virtual TDto OnEntityCreated(TDto createdEntity, TDto source)
    {
        return createdEntity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozását _követően_ megfutó metódus. Ekkor az entitás már "adatbázisszinten létezik"*.
    /// Gyakran szükséges a frissen létrejött entitást, mint referenciát menteni egy, az entitással "egyszerre" létrejövő
    /// másik típusú entitás adott mezőjébe menteni. Ezt csak akkor tudjuk megtenni, ha létezik az adatbázisban rá "referencia"*.
    /// (* = Természetesen az NHibernate szemszögéből.)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A létrehozott, DB-ből vissza-lekérdezett entitás DTO-ja.</param>
    /// <param name="source">Forrás, "adatbázisba mentés előtti" entitás DTO</param>
    protected virtual IEntityDto OnEntityCreated<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto createdEntity, TEntityDto source)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        return createdEntity is TDto dto && source is TDto sourceDto ? OnEntityCreated(dto, sourceDto) : (IEntityDto)createdEntity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítási CRUD műveletekkor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual void OnEntityUpdating(TDto entity, T domainEntity)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítási CRUD műveletekkor megfutó metódus. Amennyiben a domainEntity implementálja az ITrackedEntity interfészt,
    /// akkor a létrehozással beállításra kerülnek a Modified, ModifierUser/DeletionUser mezőértékek.
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual void OnEntityUpdating<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto entityDto, T domainEntity)
    {
        if (domainEntity is ILogicalDeleteEntity logicalDeleteableEntity && logicalDeleteableEntity.IsDeleted)
        {
            //Logikailag törölt elem nem módosítható!
            Mapper.Map(domainEntity, entityDto);
        }

        if (domainEntity is ITrackedEntity trackedEntity)
            SetUpTrackedEntity(trackedEntity, false);
        if (entityDto is TDto dto) OnEntityUpdating(dto, domainEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected virtual void OnEntityUpdated(TDto originalEntity, TDto updatedEntity)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítását _követően_ megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected virtual void OnEntityUpdated<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto originalEntity, TEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        if (updatedEntity is TDto dto && originalEntity is TDto sourceDto) OnEntityUpdated(sourceDto, dto);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás törlésekor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual string? OnEntityDeleting(T domainEntity, Func<T, string?> deleteAction)
    {
        return deleteAction(domainEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>
    /// <param name="originalEntity"></param>
    protected virtual void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(T originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Backend validáció alaplogika
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity">A forrás DTO, amelyen vizsgálatra kerül majd a validáció.</param>
    protected virtual void OnValidate<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto entity)
    {
        if (entity is TDto dto)
            _validator
                .Value
                .Validate(
                    dto,
                    options => options
                        .IncludeRuleSets("default", "BackEnd")
                        .ThrowOnFailures()
                );
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás logikai törlésekor megfutó, felüldefiniálható logika.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity"></param>
    /// <param name="logComment"></param>
    protected virtual void LogicalDeleteAction(T? entity, out string? logComment) { logComment = null; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Típusfüggő custom formatter
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual string? AccessLogValueFormatter(object? objValue)
    {
        return objValue switch
        {
            null => "[NULL]",
            //KodtarElemEntity dictItem => $"{dictItem.Szoveg} => ({dictItem.Kodtar.Kod}:{dictItem.Kod})",
            bool value => value ? "Igaz" : "Hamis",
            byte[] bytes => $"{bytes.Length / 1024}KB méretű csatolmány.",
            UserRef ur => $"{ur.LoginName} ({ur.GlobalId})",
            IList enumerableValue => $"Array({enumerableValue.Count})",
            _ => Convert.ToString(objValue)
        };
    }

    #endregion

    #region Private section

    /// <summary>
    /// Itt lehet a spéci logolásokat feltuningolni
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbobj"></param>
    protected virtual void PrepareLog(T? dbobj)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Létrehozási/Módosítási/Törlési belső logika
    /// </summary>
    protected UpdateEntityCommandResult ExecuteUpdateEntityCommand<TEntityDto>(
        UpdateEntityCommand<TEntityDto> command)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        return ExecuteUpdateEntityCommand<TEntityDto>(command as UpdateEntityCommand);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Létrehozási/Módosítási/Törlési belső logika
    /// </summary>
    protected UpdateEntityCommandResult ExecuteUpdateEntityCommand<TEntityDto>(UpdateEntityCommand command)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        var update = command.Update ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"{nameof(command.Update)} is null!");
        var obj = (command.Update?.Entity) ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"{nameof(command.Update.Entity)} is null!");
        T? dbObj;

        bool isNew = obj is { Id: 0 } || update.Action == EntityUpdateAction.New;
        bool isModification = update.Action == EntityUpdateAction.Update;
        bool isDelete = update.Action == EntityUpdateAction.Delete;

        var originalEntity = default(TEntityDto);

        var logContext = default(AccessLogContext<T>);

        if (isNew)
        {
            dbObj = CreateNew();
            PrepareLog(dbObj); // a logolás inicializálásához egy trigger
        }
        else
        {
            dbObj = GetEntity(command);

            if (dbObj == null)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"{nameof(dbObj)} is null!");

            PrepareLog(dbObj); // a logolás inicializálásához egy trigger

            if (IsAccessLogEnabled && isModification)
            {
                logContext = AccessLogger.BeginLogOperation(Mapper, LogOperationEnum.Modify, dbObj,
                    AccessLogValueFormatter);
            }

            originalEntity = CreateDto<TEntityDto>(dbObj);

            if (isDelete)
            {
                OnEntityDeleting(dbObj, Delete);
            }
        }

        if (!isDelete)
        {
            dbObj = typeof(TEntityDto) == typeof(TDto)
                ? ApplyDto((TDto)obj, dbObj)
                : ApplyDto((TEntityDto)obj, dbObj);
        }

        if (isNew)
        {
            OnValidate(obj);
            OnEntityCreating((TEntityDto)obj, dbObj);

            DbContext.Session.Save(dbObj);
        }
        else if (!isDelete)
        {
            OnValidate(obj);
            OnEntityUpdating((TEntityDto)obj, dbObj);
        }

        var result = CreateDto<TEntityDto>(dbObj);

        if (isNew)
        {
            result = (TEntityDto)OnEntityCreated(result, obj);

            if (IsAccessLogEnabled)
            {
                AccessLogger.LogOperation(Mapper, LogOperationEnum.Create, dbObj, AccessLogValueFormatter);
            }
        }
        else if (isModification)
        {
            OnEntityUpdated(obj, result);

            if (IsAccessLogEnabled)
            {
                logContext?.Finish(dbObj);
            }
        }
        else if (isDelete)
        {
            OnEntityDeleted(dbObj, originalEntity);

            if (IsAccessLogEnabled)
            {
                AccessLogger.LogOperation(Mapper, LogOperationEnum.Delete, dbObj, AccessLogValueFormatter);
            }
        }

        var isLogicalDeletedEntity = (result as ILogicalDeleteEntity)?.IsDeleted ?? false;
        return new UpdateEntityCommandResult()
        {
            UpdateResult = !isDelete || isLogicalDeletedEntity ? new EntityUpdate(result) : null
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Default új entitáspéldány létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual T CreateNew()
    {
        var dbObj = new T();

        return dbObj;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Törlési logika. Amennyiben a forrás entitás implementálja az ILogicalDeleteEntity interfészt,
    /// akkor kombinált törlés történik, egyébként fizikailag töröljük az adatbázisból.
    /// </summary>
    protected string? Delete(T entity)
    {
        var deleteMode = DeletionMode.Physical;
        if (entity is ILogicalDeleteEntity)
            deleteMode = DeletionMode.Combined;

        var attrib = typeof(T).GetCustomAttribute<DeletionModeAttribute>();
        if (attrib != null)
            deleteMode = attrib.DeletionMode;

        return deleteMode != DeletionMode.Physical && entity is not ILogicalDeleteEntity
            ? throw new InvalidOperationException($"{entity.GetType().Name} is not ILogicalDeleteEntity")
            : Delete(entity, deleteMode);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Törlési logika, ahol a törlési mód megadható. 
    /// Amennyiben a forrás entitás implementálja az ILogicalDeleteEntity interfészt, és nem kerül fizikai törlésre
    /// az entitás, akkor beállításra kerülnek a kapcsolódó metaadatok, pl. IsDeleted, DeletionUser, Deleted.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity">Törlésre kerülő entitás</param>
    /// <param name="deleteMode">Törlés módja. Fizikai, logikai, kombinált</param>
    protected string? Delete(T entity, DeletionMode deleteMode)
    {
        string? logComment = null;

        DeleteItem(entity, ((IEntity)entity).Id, deleteMode, item => Common.Shared.Extensions.ProductivityExtensions.When<ILogicalDeleteEntity>(item, x =>
        {
            x.IsDeleted = true;
            if (x is ITrackedEntity trackedEntity)
            {
                trackedEntity.DeletionUser = AccessLogger.UserRef as UserRef;
            }

            x.Deleted = DateTimeContext.Now;

            LogicalDeleteAction(x as T, out logComment);
        }));

        return logComment;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Törlési logika, a törléstípus függvényében.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TItem"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="item">Törlésre kerülő entitás</param>
    /// <param name="itemId">Entitás id-ja</param>
    /// <param name="deleteMode">Törlés módja</param>
    /// <param name="logicalDeleteAction">Logikai törlés esetén futó paraméterben átadott metódus.</param>
    protected void DeleteItem<TItem>(TItem item, int itemId, DeletionMode deleteMode,
        Action<TItem> logicalDeleteAction)
        where TItem : class
    {
        switch (deleteMode)
        {
            case DeletionMode.Physical:
                DbContext.Session.Delete(item);
                break;
            case DeletionMode.Logical:
                logicalDeleteAction(item);
                break;
            case DeletionMode.Combined:
                try
                {
                    TryDelete<TItem>(itemId);

                    DbContext.Session.Delete(item); // az eredeti tranzakcióban törlünk
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    if (ex.IsForeignConstraintException() && logicalDeleteAction != null)
                    {
                        logicalDeleteAction(item);
                        DbContext.Session.Update(item);
                    }
                    else throw;
                }

                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EntityRef-es referenciák betöltése, tipikusan ApplyDto futásnál az egyes leszármazott commandhandlerekben.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="THost"></typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TRef"></typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TRefDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="expression"></param>
    /// <param name="host"></param>
    /// <param name="entityRef"></param>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    protected void LoadRef<THost, TRef, TRefDto>(Expression<Func<THost, TRef>> expression, THost host,
        EntityRef<TRefDto>? entityRef)
        where THost : class
        where TRef : class?
        where TRefDto : IEntityDto
    {
        if (expression is LambdaExpression lambda && lambda.Body is MemberExpression memberExpr)
        {
            var prop = (PropertyInfo)memberExpr.Member;

            if (entityRef == null)
            {
                prop.SetValue(host, null);
                return;
            }

            var refEntity = (TRef)DbContext.Session.Load(prop.PropertyType, entityRef.Id);

            if (typeof(IDictItemEntity).IsAssignableFrom(prop.PropertyType))
            {
                var attrib = prop.GetCustomAttribute<DictCodeAttribute>();
                if (attrib != null && refEntity is IDictItemEntity dictItem && dictItem.ParentDict.Code != attrib.DictCode)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"Kodtar scope assertion. Kod: {attrib.DictCode} Id: {entityRef.Id}");
            }

            prop.SetValue(host, refEntity);
        }
    }

    //TODO: Ezt a LoadRef-et refaktorálni kéne: Itt csak egy Id alapján akarjuk lekérni a referált entitást. Miért kötjük meg a kezünket az EntityRef-fel?
    protected void LoadRef<THost, TRef>(Expression<Func<THost, TRef>> expression, THost host,
       IEntityDto entityRef)
       where THost : class
       where TRef : class?
    {
        if (expression is LambdaExpression lambda && lambda.Body is MemberExpression memberExpr)
        {
            var prop = (PropertyInfo)memberExpr.Member;

            if (entityRef == null)
            {
                prop.SetValue(host, null);
                return;
            }

            var refEntity = (TRef)DbContext.Session.Load(prop.PropertyType, entityRef.Id);

            if (typeof(IDictItemEntity).IsAssignableFrom(prop.PropertyType))
            {
                var attrib = prop.GetCustomAttribute<DictCodeAttribute>();
                if (attrib != null && refEntity is IDictItemEntity dictItem && dictItem.ParentDict.Code != attrib.DictCode)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"Kodtar scope assertion. Kod: {attrib.DictCode} Id: {entityRef.Id}");
            }

            prop.SetValue(host, refEntity);
        }
    }


    // Használaton kívül
    public void LoadDictItem<THost, TDictItemEntity>(Expression<Func<THost, TDictItemEntity>> expression,
        THost host, string itemCode)
        where THost : class
        where TDictItemEntity : class, IDictItemEntity
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemCode))
            return;

        if (expression is LambdaExpression lambda && lambda.Body is MemberExpression memberExpr)
        {
            var prop = (PropertyInfo)memberExpr.Member;
            IDictEntity? dictalias = null;

            var attrib = prop.GetCustomAttribute<DictCodeAttribute>();
            if (attrib == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(attrib)} is null");
            }

            var refEntity = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<TDictItemEntity>()
                .JoinAlias(x => x.ParentDict, () => dictalias)
                .Where(x => x.Code == itemCode && dictalias!.Code == attrib.DictCode)
                .List()
                .FirstOrDefault();

            prop.SetValue(host, refEntity);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Törlés megpróbálása. Amennyiben sikertelen (ennek oka lehet az, hogy egyes referenciák az adatbázisban
    /// "fogják" a törlését az adott rekordnak), úgy kivételt fogunk kapni. Minden esetben rollbackelünk, mert
    /// itt csak a törlés elvégezhetőségének vizsgálata történik.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TItem">Az entitás típusa</typeparam>
    /// <param name="itemId">Az entitás id-ja</param>
    protected void TryDelete<TItem>(int itemId)
        where TItem : class
    {
#pragma warning disable IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
        using (var delSession = SessionFactoryContainer.ByDb(DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext, false).OpenSession())
#pragma warning restore IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
        {
#pragma warning disable IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
            using (var tran = delSession.BeginTransaction())
#pragma warning restore IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
            {
                var delItem = delSession.Get<TItem>(itemId);
                // Nem tudunk tranzakcióban törölni, mert abortálja a tranzakciót
                delSession.Delete(delItem);
                delSession.Flush();

                tran.Rollback(); // itt csak teszteltünk, nem végezzük el a műveletet...
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adatbázis művelet(ek) elvégezhetőségének tesztelése. Csak tesztelés történik, 
    /// így minden esetben rollback-eljük a tranzakcióban végrehajtott parancsokat.
    /// Ha kivétel történik a tranzakció végrehajtása során, és nem ForeignConstraintException típusú, 
    /// akkor kivételt dobunk, ForeignConstraintException kivétel esetén logikai hamis értékkel térünk vissza,
    /// sikeres futás esetén logikai igaz értékkel.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">Paraméterként átadott műveletek, amelyek lefutását vizsgáljuk.</param>
    protected bool TryDbAction(Action<ISession> action)
    {
        try
        {
#pragma warning disable IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
            using (var trySession =
                   SessionFactoryContainer.ByDb(DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext, false).OpenSession())
#pragma warning restore IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
            {
#pragma warning disable IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
                using (var tran = trySession.BeginTransaction())
#pragma warning restore IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
                {
                    action(trySession);
                    trySession.Flush();
                    tran.Rollback(); // itt csak teszteltünk, nem végezzük el a műveletet...
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            if (ex.IsForeignConstraintException())
            {
                return false;
            }
            else throw;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás ITrackedEntity mezőinek beállítása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity">Forrás entitás</param>
    /// <param name="isNew">Újonnan létrehozott entitásról van szó, vagy már korábban létezőről?</param>
    protected void SetUpTrackedEntity(ITrackedEntity entity, bool isNew)
    {
        var now = DateTimeContext.Now;
        if (isNew)
        {
            entity.Created = now;
            entity.CreatorUser = AccessLogger.UserRef as UserRef;
        }

        entity.Modified = now;
        entity.ModifierUser = AccessLogger.UserRef as UserRef;
    }

    #endregion

    /// <summary>
    /// Listás változásának kezelése (elemek kerülhetnek ki-be) az entitás-adatbázis 
    /// </summary>
    protected ICollection<TDest>? MergeList<TSrc, TDest>(ICollection<TSrc>? srcList, ICollection<TDest>? destList,
        Func<TSrc, TDest, bool> isEqualFunc, Func<TSrc, object> getId)
        where TDest : class
    {
        return ListHelper.MergeList(srcList, destList, isEqualFunc,
            (src) => DbContext.Session.Load<TDest>(getId(src)));
    }

    protected void SyncChildren<TChildEntityDto, TChildEntity>(IList<TChildEntityDto> source,
                                                               IList<TChildEntity> target,
                                                               Func<TChildEntityDto, TChildEntity, bool> idSelector,
                                                               Func<TChildEntityDto, TChildEntity> createAction,
                                                               Action<TChildEntityDto, TChildEntity> beforeUpdateAction = null) where TChildEntity : IEntity
                                                                                                                                where TChildEntityDto : IEntityDto, new()
    {
        ListHelper.SyncChildren(_commandService,
                                source, 
                                target, 
                                idSelector, 
                                createAction,
                                beforeUpdateAction);
    }

    protected void SendSyncMessage(ApiClientServiceBase clientService, string route, string syncObjectName, DateTime dateOfModification, TenantScopeType tenantCode = TenantScopeType.TenantCode)
    {
        var request = new
        {
            EntityName = syncObjectName,
            LastModifiedDate = dateOfModification,
            TenantCode = tenantCode == TenantScopeType.TenantCode ? DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName : null
        };
        DbContext.AddSyncRequestAction($"{clientService.GetType().Name}_{syncObjectName}", () => clientService.Post(route, request, DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName).RunSync());
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Enums;

namespace Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;

/// <summary>
/// AccessLogContext
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
public class AccessLogContext<T>
    where T : class
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IAccessLogger _logger;
    /// <summary>
    /// The operation
    /// </summary>
    private readonly LogOperationEnum _operation;
    /// <summary>
    /// The log object
    /// </summary>
    private readonly LogObject _logObject;
    /// <summary>
    /// The custom formatter
    /// </summary>
    private readonly Func<object?, string?>? _customFormatter;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the changes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The changes.
    /// </value>
    public LogObjectChange[] Changes { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AccessLogContext{T}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    /// <param name="operation">The operation.</param>
    /// <param name="logObject">The log object.</param>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="customFormatter">The custom formatter.</param>
    internal AccessLogContext(IAccessLogger logger, LogOperationEnum operation, LogObject logObject, object obj, Func<object?, string?>? customFormatter)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _operation = operation;
        _logObject = logObject;
        _customFormatter = customFormatter;
        Changes = LoggingHelper.GetObjectChanges(obj, _customFormatter)
            .Select(x => new LogObjectChange() { FieldName = x.Key, OldValue = x.Value != null ? x.Value.ToString() : string.Empty }).ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Finishes the specified final object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="finalObj">The final object.</param>
    /// <param name="comment">The comment.</param>
    /// <param name="commentToEnd">if set to <c>true</c> [comment to end].</param>
    /// <param name="ifHasChanges">if set to <c>true</c> [if has changes].</param>
    public void Finish(T finalObj, string? comment = null, bool commentToEnd = false, bool ifHasChanges = false)
    {
        var values = LoggingHelper.GetObjectChanges(finalObj, _customFormatter);
        var delList = new List<LogObjectChange>();
        foreach (var change in Changes)
        {
            if (change.FieldName != null && values.ContainsKey(change.FieldName))
            {
                var val = values[change.FieldName];
                val = val == null ? string.Empty : (object?)val.ToString();

                if (val != null)
                {
                    if (!val.Equals(change.OldValue))
                        change.NewValue = val.ToString()!;
                    else
                        delList.Add(change);
                }   
            }
        }

        Changes = Changes.Where(x => !delList.Contains(x)).ToArray();

        if (!ifHasChanges || Changes.Any())
            _logger.LogOperation(_operation, _logObject, Changes, comment, commentToEnd);
    }

}

using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Enums;

namespace Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;

/// <summary>
/// LogObject
/// </summary>
public class LogObject
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The type.
    /// </value>
    public string? Type { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The identifier.
    /// </value>
    public int Id { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the name.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name.
    /// </value>
    public string? Name { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// 
/// </summary>
public class LogObjectChange
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the name of the field.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the field.
    /// </value>
    public string? FieldName { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the old value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The old value.
    /// </value>
    public object? OldValue { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates new value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The new value.
    /// </value>
    public object? NewValue { get; set; }
}

/// 
/// </summary>

{

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the user reference.
    /// </summary>

    /// </value>

    /// <summary>
    /// Logs the operation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="operation">The operation.</param>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="changes">The changes.</param>
    /// <param name="comment">The comment.</param>
    /// <param name="commentToEnd">if set to <c>true</c> [comment to end].</param>
    void LogOperation(LogOperationEnum operation, LogObject obj, LogObjectChange[]? changes = null, string? comment = null, bool commentToEnd = false);
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Shared.Enums;

namespace Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;

/// <summary>
/// LoggingExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class LoggingExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Begins the log operation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="operation">The operation.</param>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="customFormatter">The custom formatter.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static AccessLogContext<T> BeginLogOperation<T>(this IAccessLogger logger, IMapper mapper, LogOperationEnum operation, T obj, Func<object?, string?>? customFormatter = null)
        where T : class
    {
        return new AccessLogContext<T>(logger, operation, mapper.Map<T, LogObject>(obj), obj, customFormatter);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Logs the operation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="operation">The operation.</param>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="customFormatter">The custom formatter.</param>
    /// <param name="comment">The comment.</param>
    public static void LogOperation<T>(this IAccessLogger logger, IMapper mapper, LogOperationEnum operation, T obj, Func<object?, string?>? customFormatter = null, string? comment = null)
        where T : class
    {
        var changes = LoggingHelper.GetObjectChanges(obj, customFormatter)
            .Select(x => new LogObjectChange() { FieldName = x.Key, NewValue = x.Value != null ? x.Value.ToString() : string.Empty }).ToArray();
        logger.LogOperation(operation, mapper.Map<T, LogObject>(obj), changes, comment);
    }

}

using System.ComponentModel;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;

namespace Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;

public static class LoggingHelper
{
    public static Dictionary<string, object?> GetObjectChanges(object obj, Func<object?, object?>? customFormatter = null)
    {
        var values = obj.GetType().GetObjectValues(obj, customFormatter);
        return values;
    }

    public static string GetLogObjectName(Type type, int id)
    {
        var name = type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DisplayNameAttribute), true).FirstOrDefault() is DisplayNameAttribute dnAttribute ? dnAttribute.DisplayName : type.Name;
        return GetLogObjectName(name, id);
    }

    public static string GetLogObjectName<TObj>(TObj obj)
    {
        string result;


        result = GetLogObjectName(typeof(TObj).Name, obj is EntityBase entity ? entity.Id : 0);

        return result;
    }

    public static string GetLogObjectName(string name, int id)
    {
        string result = name;

        if (id > 0)
            result += string.Format(" [{0}]", id);

        return result;
    }

    public static List<LogObjectChange> MergeLogObjects(List<LogObjectChange> oldObjectChanges,
        List<LogObjectChange> newObjectChanges)
    {
        var result = new List<LogObjectChange>(oldObjectChanges);
        var delList = new List<LogObjectChange>();

        List<LogObjectChange> mergedObjects;
        foreach (var oldChange in result)
        {
            var newChange = newObjectChanges.SingleOrDefault(x => x.FieldName == oldChange.FieldName);
            if (newChange != null)
            {
                // 0 - Ha string típusú a value
                var newValueStr = newChange.NewValue as string;
                if (newValueStr != null)
                {
                    if (oldChange.OldValue is string)
                    {
                        // akkor megnézzük megyegyezik-e a régi értékkel
                        if (!newValueStr.Equals(oldChange.OldValue.ToString()))
                        {
                            // Ha nem egyezik meg, akkor 
                            oldChange.NewValue = newChange.NewValue;
                        }
                        else
                            delList.Add(oldChange);

                        continue;
                    }

                    // Ha nem létezi, azaz új értéket veszünk fel.
                    if (oldChange.OldValue == null)
                    {
                        oldChange.NewValue = newChange.NewValue;
                    }
                }

                // 1 - Ha üres string a NewValue és oldValue is List<LogObjectChange>
                if (newValueStr != null && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newValueStr) && oldChange.OldValue is List<LogObjectChange>)
                {
                    // Ekkor törölve lett az adat
                    oldChange.NewValue = null;
                }

                // 2 - Ha List<LogObjectChange> a value
                if (newChange.NewValue is List<LogObjectChange> list)
                {
                    // Ha nincs old, akkor új az adat...
                    if (oldChange.OldValue == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldChange.OldValue.ToString()))
                    {
                        var newChanges = list;
                        oldChange.NewValue = MergeLogObjects(newChanges, new List<LogObjectChange>());
                    }
                    // Ha van, akkor módosítás van.
                    else if (oldChange.OldValue is List<LogObjectChange> oldChanges)
                    {
                        var newChanges = list;
                        mergedObjects = MergeLogObjects(oldChanges, newChanges);
                        if (!mergedObjects.Any())
                        {
                            delList.Add(oldChange);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            for (int i = oldChanges.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                            {
                                var oldLogObjectChange = oldChanges[i];

                                if (int.TryParse(oldLogObjectChange.FieldName, out int oldId)
                                    && newChanges.Exists(x => x.FieldName == oldId.ToString()))
                                    oldChanges.RemoveAt(i);
                            }

                            oldChange.NewValue = mergedObjects;

                            if (oldChanges.Count == 0)
                                oldChange.OldValue = null;
                        }

                    }
                    else
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Old and New value type not equals!");

                    continue;
                }

                // 3 - Ha NewValue null és oldValue is null
                if (newChange.NewValue == null && oldChange.OldValue == null)
                {
                    delList.Add(oldChange);
                }
            }
        }

        result = result.Where(x => !delList.Contains(x)).ToList();

        var newObjects = newObjectChanges.Where(x => oldObjectChanges.TrueForAll(y => y.FieldName != x.FieldName)).ToList();
        if (newObjects.Any())
        {
            mergedObjects = MergeLogObjects(newObjects, new List<LogObjectChange>());
            if (mergedObjects.Any())
            {
                result.AddRange(mergedObjects);
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    public static List<LogObjectChange> ToLogObjectChanges(this Dictionary<string, object> dictionary, bool oldObj)
    {
        var result = new List<LogObjectChange>();

        foreach (var x in dictionary)
        {
            var logObj = new LogObjectChange { FieldName = x.Key };

            if (x.Value is string)
            {
                if (oldObj)
                    logObj.OldValue = x.Value != null ? x.Value.ToString() : string.Empty;
                else
                    logObj.NewValue = x.Value != null ? x.Value.ToString() : string.Empty;
            }
            else
            {
                if (x.Value is Dictionary<string, object> value)
                {
                    if (oldObj)
                        logObj.OldValue = value.ToLogObjectChanges(true);
                    else
                        logObj.NewValue = value.ToLogObjectChanges(false);
                }
            }

            result.Add(logObj);
        }

        return result;
    }

}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Types;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.Transform;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using NHibernate.Impl;
using NHibernate.Loader.Criteria;
using NHibernate.Persister.Entity;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;

/// <summary>
/// QueryHandlerBase
/// </summary>
namespace Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;

public abstract class QueryHandlerBase<T, TDto> : HandlerBase<T, TDto>, IQueryHandler
 where T : class
 where TDto : IEntityDto
{
    // ReSharper disable once StaticMemberInGenericType
    public static readonly Expression<Func<ILogicalDeleteEntity, bool>> NotDeletedExpression = x => !x.IsDeleted;

    protected QueryHandlerBase(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {

    }

    #region Interface entry points

    /// <summary>Entitás lekérdezése</summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>result</returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public virtual IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    /// <summary>Egy entitás lekérdezése</summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>entitások</returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">query</exception>
    public IEntityQuerySingleResult? QuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query == null ? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(query)) : DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>Entitások lekérdezése</summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>entitások</returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">query</exception>
    public virtual IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(query));

        var result = DoQueryEntities(query) ?? DoQueryEntities<TDto>(query);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// További alap entitások lekérdezése kijelölt adatbázisból
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">Dto</typeparam>
    /// <param name="dbContext">Adatbázis</param>
    /// <param name="query">Lekérdezés</param>
    /// <param name="result">Korábbi eredmény</param>
    /// <returns>Kiegészített eredmény</returns>
    protected virtual IEntityQueryItemsResult<TResult> QueryEntities<TResult>(IDbContext dbContext, IEntityQuery query, IEntityQueryItemsResult<TResult> result)
        where TResult : IEntityDto
    {
        var currentDbContext = this.DbContext;
        this.DbContext = dbContext;
        if (DoQueryEntities(query) is IEntityQueryItemsResult<TResult> coreResult)
        {
            var defaultList = new List<TResult>();
            defaultList.AddRange(result.Items);
            foreach (var item in coreResult.Items)
            {
                if (!result.Items.OfType<ISame>().Any(x => x.Same(item)))
                    defaultList.Add(item);
            }
            result = new EntityQueryItemsResult<TResult>()
            {
                Items = defaultList.ToArray()
            };
        }
        this.DbContext = currentDbContext;
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>Entitások lekérdezése</summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>darabszám</returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">query</exception>
    public long QueryEntityCount(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query == null ? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(query)) : DoQueryEntityCount(query);
    }
    #endregion

    #region Overridable entry points
    /// <summary>Does the query single entity.</summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotSupportedException"></exception>
    protected virtual IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            EntityByIdQuery<TDto> idQuery => HandleEntityByIdQuery(idQuery),
            EntityByGlobalIdQuery<TDto> globalIdQuery => HandleEntityByGlobalIdQuery(globalIdQuery),
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException(query.GetType().Name)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>Does the query entities.</summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected virtual IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SelectListItemQuery<TDto> selectQuery)
            return HandleSelectListItemQuery(selectQuery);
        else if (query is SelectEntityRefQuery<TDto> entityRefQuery)
            return HandleSelectEntityRefQuery(entityRefQuery);
        return DoQueryEntities<TDto>(query);
    }

    protected IEntityQueryItemsResult<TResult> DoQueryEntities<TResult>(IEntityQuery<TResult> query)
        where TResult : IEntityDto
    {
        return (IEntityQueryItemsResult<TResult>)DoQueryEntities<TResult>((IEntityQuery)query);
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni, lsd OrgUnitQueryHandler
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual IQueryOver<T, T> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<T>();
    }

    /// <summary>Does the query entities.</summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected virtual IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities<TResult>(IEntityQuery query)
        where TResult : IEntityDto
    {
        IEntityQueryItemsResult<TResult>? result = null;

        //FROM
        var queryOver = GetQueryOver();

        bool isBaseDtoResult = typeof(TDto) == typeof(TResult);

        Func<object[], TResult>? select = null;

        if (!isBaseDtoResult)
        {
            select = SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(queryOver, query);
        }

        //JOIN
        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        //WHERE
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        result = query is IPagedEntityQuery
            ? new EntityListItemQueryResult<TResult> { RecordsTotal = SetUpRowCount(queryOver, query) }
            : new EntityQueryItemsResult<TResult>();

        //PAGING
        if (!(query is IAllEntitiesQuery))
            ProductivityExtensions.When<IPagedEntityQuery>(query, q => SetQueryPaging(queryOver, q));

        //ORDER BY
        ProductivityExtensions.When<IPagedEntityQuery>(query, q => SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, q));

        TResult[]? items = default;

        if (!isBaseDtoResult)
        {
            //Run the queryOver
            var createDtoAttribute = Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(typeof(TResult), typeof(QueryEntitiesCreateDtoAttribute)) as QueryEntitiesCreateDtoAttribute;
            if (select != null)
                // custom select
                items = queryOver.List<object[]>().Select(select).ToArray();
            else if (createDtoAttribute?.AutoCreateDto == false)
                // require automapper definition
                items = queryOver.List<T>().Select(CreateDto<TResult>).OfType<TResult>().ToArray();
            else
                // Auto create 'dto' (AliasToBean)
                items = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<TResult>()).List<TResult>().ToArray();
        }
        else
            items = queryOver.List<T>().Select(CreateDto).OfType<TResult>().ToArray();

        result.Items = items;

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the generated SQL.</summary>
    /// <param name="criteria">The criteria.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    public String GetGeneratedSql(ICriteria criteria)
    {
        var criteriaImpl = (CriteriaImpl)criteria;
        var sessionImpl = (SessionImpl)criteriaImpl.Session;
        var factory = (SessionFactoryImpl)sessionImpl.SessionFactory;
        var implementors = factory.GetImplementors(criteriaImpl.EntityOrClassName);
        var loader = new CriteriaLoader((IOuterJoinLoadable)factory.GetEntityPersister(implementors[0]), factory, criteriaImpl, implementors[0], sessionImpl.EnabledFilters);

        return loader.SqlString.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the generated SQL.</summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    public String GetGeneratedSql(IQueryOver queryOver)
    {
        return GetGeneratedSql(queryOver.UnderlyingCriteria);
    }

    /// <summary>Sets up row count.</summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    public virtual int SetUpRowCount(IQueryOver<T, T> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return queryOver.RowCount();
    }

    /// <summary>Does the query entity count.</summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected virtual long DoQueryEntityCount(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        //FROM
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<T>();

        //JOIN
        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        //WHERE
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        //Run the queryOver
        var result = queryOver.RowCount();

        return result;
    }
    #endregion

    #region Multiple entity query override points

    /// <summary>Setups the query select.</summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    protected virtual Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<T, T> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
        where TResult : IEntityDto
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <exception cref="NotImplementedException"></exception>
    protected virtual void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<T, T> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <exception cref="NotImplementedException"></exception>
    protected virtual void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<T, T> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query sort.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <exception cref="NotImplementedException"></exception>
    protected virtual void SetUpQuerySort(IQueryOver<T, T> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query sort.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <exception cref="NotImplementedException"></exception>
    protected virtual void SetUpQuerySort(IQueryOver<T, T> queryOver, IPagedEntityQuery query, IDictionary<string, IProjection>? sortableColumns = null)
    {
        if (query.SortingInfo != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.SortingInfo.SortColumn))
        {
            if (sortableColumns != null && sortableColumns.TryGetValue(query.SortingInfo.SortColumn, out var sortableColumn))
            {
                if (query.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending)
                    queryOver.OrderBy(sortableColumn).Asc();
                else
                    queryOver.OrderBy(sortableColumn).Desc();
            }
            else
            {
                queryOver.UnderlyingCriteria.AddOrder(
                    new Order(
                        query.SortingInfo.SortColumn,
                        query.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending));
            }
        }
    }

    #endregion

    #region Private section
    /// <summary>Handles the entity by identifier query.</summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult HandleEntityByIdQuery(EntityByIdQuery<TDto> query)
    {
        var res = QueryById(query.Id);
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult { Entity = CreateDto(res) as IEntityDto };
    }
    
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult HandleEntityByGlobalIdQuery(EntityByGlobalIdQuery<TDto> query, CancellationToken cancellationToken=default)
    {
        var res = QueryByGlobalIdentifier(query.GlobalId);
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult { Entity = CreateDto(res) };
    }

    /// <summary>Handles the entity by identifier query.</summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    public IEntityQuerySingleResult HandleEntityByIdQuery<TResult>(EntityByIdQuery<TDto, TResult> query)
        where TResult : IEntityDto
    {
        var res = QueryById(query.Id);
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult { Entity = CreateDto<TResult>(res) };
    }

    /// <summary>Handles the select list item query.</summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult HandleSelectListItemQuery(SelectListItemQuery<TDto> query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<T>();

        // Ne kapjuk vissza a logikailag törölt elemeket
        if (typeof(ILogicalDeleteEntity).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T)))
            queryOver.Where(Restrictions.Where(NotDeletedExpression));

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query);

        return new EntityQueryItemsResult<SelectListItemDto>()
        {
            Items = queryOver.List<T>().Select(x => Mapper.Map<SelectListItemDto>(x)).OrderBy(x => x.Name).ToArray()
        };
    }

    /// <summary>Handles the select entity reference query.</summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult HandleSelectEntityRefQuery(SelectEntityRefQuery<TDto> query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<T>();

        // Ne kapjuk vissza a logikailag törölt elemeket
        if (typeof(ILogicalDeleteEntity).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T)))
            queryOver.Where(Restrictions.Where(NotDeletedExpression));

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query);

        return new EntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<TDto>>()
        {
            Items = queryOver.List<T>().Select(x => Mapper.Map<EntityRef<TDto>>(x)).ToArray()
        };
    }

    /// <summary>Queries the by identifier.</summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected T QueryById(int id)
    {
        var result = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<T>()
            .Where(x => ((IEntity)x).Id == id)
            .List()
            .SingleEx("Entity not found.", "Ambigous entity.", "Type: {0} Id: {1}", typeof(T).Name, id);

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>Queries an entity by its global identifier.</summary>
    /// <param name="identifier">The globally unique identifier of the entity.</param>
    /// <returns>The entity that matches the given global identifier.</returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Thrown when no entity is found or if multiple entities are found with the same identifier.</exception>
    protected T QueryByGlobalIdentifier(Guid identifier)
    {
        var result = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<T>()
            .Where(x => ((IGlobalIdentifier)x).Identifier == identifier)
            .List()
            .SingleEx("Entity not found.", "Ambigous entity.", "Type: {0} Id: {1}", typeof(T).Name, identifier);

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the query paging.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected void SetQueryPaging(IQueryOver<T> queryOver, IPagedEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query.PagingInfo != null)
        {
            var pageSize = query.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10;
            var firstItem = query.PagingInfo.StartPage * pageSize;
            queryOver.Skip(firstItem);
            queryOver.Take(pageSize);
        }
    }

    #endregion

}

using System.ComponentModel;

using System.Data;
using System.Data.Common;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using NHibernate.Driver;
using Npgsql;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

/// <summary>
/// CustomNpgsqlDriver
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="NHibernate.Driver.NpgsqlDriver" />
public class CustomNpgsqlDriver : NpgsqlDriver
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 
    /// </summary>
    /// <seealso cref="System.Data.Common.DbCommand" />
    public class MyCommand : DbCommand
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The command
        /// </summary>
        private readonly DbCommand _cmd;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MyCommand"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        public MyCommand()
        {
            _cmd = new NpgsqlCommand();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, attempts to cancel the execution of a <see cref="T:System.Data.Common.DbCommand" />.
        /// </summary>
        public override void Cancel()
        {
            _cmd.Cancel();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, executes the query and returns the first column of the first row in the result set returned by the query. All other columns and rows are ignored.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>
        /// The first column of the first row in the result set.
        /// </returns>
        public override object? ExecuteScalar()
        {
            return _cmd.ExecuteScalar();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, creates a prepared (or compiled) version of the command on the data source.
        /// </summary>
        public override void Prepare()
        {
            _cmd.Prepare();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, creates a new instance of a <see cref="T:System.Data.Common.DbParameter" /> object.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>
        /// A <see cref="T:System.Data.Common.DbParameter" /> object.
        /// </returns>
        protected override DbParameter CreateDbParameter()
        {
            return _cmd.CreateParameter();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, executes the command text against the connection.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="behavior">An instance of <see cref="T:System.Data.CommandBehavior" />.</param>
        /// <returns>
        /// A task representing the operation.
        /// </returns>
        protected override DbDataReader ExecuteDbDataReader(CommandBehavior behavior)
        {
            return _cmd.ExecuteReader();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, executes a SQL statement against a connection object.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>
        /// The number of rows affected.
        /// </returns>
        public override int ExecuteNonQuery()
        {
            if (Config.TryGetBoolValue("ShowSql") ?? false)
            {
                var logMsg = new Lazy<string>(FormatLogMsg);
                Log.LogDebug($"{_cmd.Connection?.Database}: {logMsg.Value}");
            }
            var result = _cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, gets or sets the <see cref="T:System.Data.Common.DbConnection" /> used by this <see cref="T:System.Data.Common.DbCommand" />.
        /// </summary>
        protected override DbConnection? DbConnection { get { return _cmd.Connection; } set { _cmd.Connection = value; } }
        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, gets the collection of <see cref="T:System.Data.Common.DbParameter" /> objects.
        /// </summary>
        protected override DbParameterCollection DbParameterCollection { get { return _cmd.Parameters; } }
        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, gets or sets the <see cref="P:System.Data.Common.DbCommand.DbTransaction" /> within which this <see cref="T:System.Data.Common.DbCommand" /> object executes.
        /// </summary>
        protected override DbTransaction? DbTransaction { get { return _cmd.Transaction; } set { _cmd.Transaction = value; } }
        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, gets or sets a value indicating whether the command object should be visible in a customized interface control.
        /// </summary>
        public override bool DesignTimeVisible { get { return _cmd.DesignTimeVisible; } set { _cmd.DesignTimeVisible = value; } }
        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, gets or sets the text command to run against the data source.
        /// </summary>
        public override string CommandText { get { return _cmd.CommandText; } set { _cmd.CommandText = value; } }
        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, gets or sets the wait time (in seconds) before terminating the attempt to execute a command and generating an error.
        /// </summary>
        public override int CommandTimeout { get { return _cmd.CommandTimeout; } set { _cmd.CommandTimeout = value; } }
        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, gets or sets how the <see cref="P:System.Data.Common.DbCommand.CommandText" /> property is interpreted.
        /// </summary>
        public override CommandType CommandType { get { return _cmd.CommandType; } set { _cmd.CommandType = value; } }
        /// <summary>
        /// When overridden in a derived class, gets or sets how command results are applied to the <see cref="T:System.Data.DataRow" /> when used by the Update method of a <see cref="T:System.Data.Common.DbDataAdapter" />.
        /// </summary>
        public override UpdateRowSource UpdatedRowSource { get { return _cmd.UpdatedRowSource; } set { _cmd.UpdatedRowSource = value; } }

        /// <summary>
        /// Formats the log MSG.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private string FormatLogMsg()
        {
            var parameters = string.Join(", ", _cmd.Parameters.OfType<NpgsqlParameter>()
                                    .Select(x => $"{x.ParameterName}: {x.Value}")
                                    .ToArray());
            var logMsg = $"{_cmd.CommandText} Parameters: {parameters}";
            return logMsg;
        }

    }



    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override DbCommand CreateCommand()
    {
        return new MyCommand();
    }


}

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

/// <summary>
/// DatabaseNodeContext
/// </summary>
public class DatabaseNodeContext
{

    /// <summary>
    /// The default schema name
    /// </summary>
    public const string DefaultSchemaName = "public";

    /// <summary>
    /// The database code energia menedzsment
    /// </summary>
    public const string DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment = "EnergiaMenedzsment";
    /// <summary>
    /// The database code datareceiver
    /// </summary>
    public const string DB_CODE_DATARECEIVER = "DATARECEIVER";
    /// <summary>
    /// The database code energia menedzsment core
    /// </summary>
    public const string DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE = "EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE";
    /// <summary>
    /// The database code monitoring
    /// </summary>
    public const string DB_CODE_Monitoring = "EnergiaMenedzsment_MONITORING";

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the database code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The database code.
    /// </value>
    public string DbCode { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the configuration key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The configuration key.
    /// </value>
    public string ConfigKey { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the schema.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the schema.
    /// </value>
    public string? SchemaName { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DatabaseNodeContext"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbCode">The database code.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    public DatabaseNodeContext(string dbCode, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        this.SchemaName = DefaultSchemaName;
        this.DbCode = dbCode;
        switch (DbCode)
        {
            case DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment:
                this.ConfigKey = "Db";
                break;
            case DB_CODE_DATARECEIVER:
                this.ConfigKey = "DataReceiverDb";
                break;
            case DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE:
                this.ConfigKey = "CoreDb";
                break;
            case DB_CODE_Monitoring:
                this.ConfigKey = "MonitoringDb";
                break;
            default:
                throw new InvalidOperationException();
        }

        SchemaName = tenantCode;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a hash code for this instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>
    /// A hash code for this instance, suitable for use in hashing algorithms and data structures like a hash table. 
    /// </returns>
    public override int GetHashCode()
    {
        return DbCode.GetHashCode();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether the specified object is equal to the current object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="obj">The object to compare with the current object.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <see langword="true" /> if the specified object  is equal to the current object; otherwise, <see langword="false" />.
    /// </returns>
    public override bool Equals(object? obj)
    {
        return obj is DatabaseNodeContext other && other.DbCode.Equals(DbCode) &&
               ((other.SchemaName != null && other.SchemaName.Equals(SchemaName)) || (other.SchemaName == null && this.SchemaName == null));
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\DbContextBase.cs

using Common.BackEnd.Threading;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using NHibernate;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

/// <summary>
/// IDbContext
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="System.IDisposable" />
public interface IDbContext : IDisposable
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the database node context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The database node context.
    /// </value>
    DatabaseNodeContext DatabaseNodeContext { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the session.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The session.
    /// </value>
    ISession Session { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is read only.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is read only; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    bool IsReadOnly { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Begins the transaction.
    /// </summary>
    void BeginTransaction();
    /// <summary>
    /// Commits this instance.
    /// </summary>
    void Commit();

    /// <summary>
    /// Rollbacks this instance.
    /// </summary>
    void RollBack();

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the dispose action.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    void AddDisposeAction(Action action);

    void AddSyncRequestAction(string key, Action action);
}

/// <summary>
/// 
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.IDbContext" />
public abstract class DbContextBase : IDbContext
{

    /// <summary>
    /// 
    /// </summary>
    /// <seealso cref="System.IDisposable" />
    public class DbContextSession : IDisposable
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The sess key
        /// </summary>
        public const string SESS_KEY = "DbContext.Current";

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DbContextSession"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
        public DbContextSession(IDbContext context)
        {
            CallContext.SetData(SESS_KEY, context);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Performs application-defined tasks associated with freeing, releasing, or resetting unmanaged resources.
        /// </summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            Dispose(true);
            GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Releases unmanaged and - optionally - managed resources.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="disposing"><c>true</c> to release both managed and unmanaged resources; <c>false</c> to release only unmanaged resources.</param>
        protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
        {
            CallContext.ClearData(SESS_KEY);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The session
    /// </summary>
    private ISession? _session;
    /// <summary>
    /// The transaction
    /// </summary>
    private ITransaction? _transaction;
    /// <summary>
    /// The dispose actions
    /// </summary>
    private readonly List<Action> _disposeActions;

    /// <summary>
    /// Keyed dispose action
    /// </summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Action> _syncRequestActions;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DbContextBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="databaseNodeContext">The database node context.</param>
    protected DbContextBase(DatabaseNodeContext databaseNodeContext)
    {
        DatabaseNodeContext = databaseNodeContext;
        _disposeActions = new List<Action>();
        _syncRequestActions = new Dictionary<string, Action>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the current.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The current.
    /// </value>
    public static IDbContext? Current => (IDbContext?)CallContext.GetData(DbContextSession.SESS_KEY);

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is read only.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is read only; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool IsReadOnly { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the database node context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The database node context.
    /// </value>
    public DatabaseNodeContext DatabaseNodeContext { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the session.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The session.
    /// </value>
    public ISession Session
    {
        get
        {
            if (_session == null)
            {
                _session = OpenSession();
                _session.FlushMode = IsReadOnly ? FlushMode.Manual : FlushMode.Commit;
                
                if (!IsReadOnly && IsAutoTransactionAllowed)
                    _transaction = _session.BeginTransaction();
                if (IsReadOnly)
                    _session.DefaultReadOnly = true;
            }

            return _session;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this instance is automatic transaction allowed.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is automatic transaction allowed; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    protected virtual bool IsAutoTransactionAllowed
    {
        get { return true; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Opens the session.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual ISession OpenSession()
    {
        return SessionFactoryContainer.ByDb(
                DatabaseNodeContext,
                IsReadOnly)
            .WithOptions()
            .AutoJoinTransaction(false)
            .OpenSession();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Begins the transaction.
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Already in transcation</exception>
    public virtual void BeginTransaction()
    {
        if (TransactionContext.Current == null && _transaction != null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Already in transcation");

        _session?.Dispose();
        _session = OpenSession();

        _transaction = _session.BeginTransaction();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the dispose action.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    public void AddDisposeAction(Action action)
    {
        _disposeActions.Add(action);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the dispose action.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    public void AddSyncRequestAction(string key, Action action)
    {
        _ = _syncRequestActions.TryAdd(key,action);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Commits this instance.
    /// </summary>
    public virtual void Commit()
    {
        if (_transaction != null)
        {
            if (!_transaction.WasRolledBack)
                _transaction.Commit();
            _transaction = null;

            Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rollbacks this instance.
    /// </summary>
    public virtual void RollBack()
    {
        if (_transaction != null)
        {
            Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Performs application-defined tasks associated with freeing, releasing, or resetting unmanaged resources.
    /// </summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        Dispose(true);
        GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Releases unmanaged and - optionally - managed resources.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="disposing"><c>true</c> to release both managed and unmanaged resources; <c>false</c> to release only unmanaged resources.</param>
    protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
    {
        if (_session != null)
        {
            bool isOk = true;
            try
            {
                if (_transaction != null && _transaction.IsActive && !_transaction.WasCommitted)
                {
                    _transaction.Rollback();
                    isOk = false;
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                _session.Dispose();
            }

            _transaction = null;
            _session = null;

            if (isOk && _disposeActions.Any())
                ProcessDisposeActions();

            if (isOk && _syncRequestActions.Any())
                ProcessSyncedActions();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the dispose actions.
    /// </summary>
    private void ProcessDisposeActions()
    {
        var disposeActions = _disposeActions.ToList();
        _disposeActions.Clear();

        BackgroundTaskExecutor.ExecuteBackgroundTask(() =>
        {
            foreach (var disposeAction in disposeActions)
            {
                try
                {
                    disposeAction();
                }
                catch (Exception exception)
                {
                    Log.LogInfo(string.Format(
                        "DisposeAction error: {0}  (ManagedThreadId: {1})", exception, Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId));
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the dispose actions.
    /// </summary>
    private void ProcessSyncedActions()
    {
        var disposeActions = _syncRequestActions.Values.ToList();
        _syncRequestActions.Clear();

        BackgroundTaskExecutor.ExecuteBackgroundTask(() =>
        {
            foreach (var disposeAction in disposeActions)
            {
                try
                {
                    disposeAction();
                }
                catch (Exception exception)
                {
                    Log.LogInfo(string.Format(
                        "DisposeAction error: {0}  (ManagedThreadId: {1})", exception, Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId));
                }
            }
        });
    }
}
