using System.Data;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Dialect;
using NHibernate.Dialect.Function;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

/// <summary>
/// FrameworkPostgreSQLDialect
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="NHibernate.Dialect.PostgreSQLDialect" />
public class FrameworkPostgreSQLDialect: PostgreSQLDialect
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="FrameworkPostgreSQLDialect"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public FrameworkPostgreSQLDialect()
    {
        // Guid primary key miatt szükséges
        RegisterColumnType(DbType.Guid, "uuid");

        RegisterFunction("string_agg", new StandardSQLFunction("String_agg", NHibernateUtil.String));
        RegisterFunction("age", new StandardSQLFunction("age"));
        RegisterFunction("string_to_array", new StandardSQLFunction("string_to_array"));
        RegisterFunction("unnest", new StandardSQLFunction("unnest"));
        RegisterFunction("array_remove", new StandardSQLFunction("array_remove"));
        RegisterFunction("CONCAT_WS", new StandardSQLFunction("CONCAT_WS"));
        RegisterFunction("extract_epoch", new SQLFunctionTemplate(NHibernateUtil.Double, "extract(epoch from ?1)"));
    }
}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using NHibernate;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

/// <summary>
/// SessionFactoryContainer
/// </summary>
public static class SessionFactoryContainer
{
    // Default factories
    /// <summary>
    /// The factories
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<DatabaseNodeContext, ISessionFactory> _factories = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// The custom driver factories
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<DatabaseNodeContext, ISessionFactory> _customDriverFactories = new();

    // ReadOnly factories
    /// <summary>
    /// The read only factories
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<DatabaseNodeContext, ISessionFactory> _readOnlyFactories = new();
    /// <summary>
    /// The read only custom driver factories
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<DatabaseNodeContext, ISessionFactory> _readOnlyCustomDriverFactories = new();

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the <see cref="SessionFactoryContainer"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    static SessionFactoryContainer()
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Bies the database.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="databaseContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="readOnly">if set to <c>true</c> [read only].</param>
    /// <param name="withCustomDriver">if set to <c>true</c> [with custom driver].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static ISessionFactory ByDb(DatabaseNodeContext databaseContext, bool readOnly, bool withCustomDriver = false)
    {
        bool showSql = Config.TryGetBoolValue($"{databaseContext.ConfigKey}:ShowSql", true) ?? false;
        ISessionFactory result;

        var connectionString = Config.TryGetStringValue($"{databaseContext.ConfigKey}:{GetConnectionStringKey(readOnly)}", true);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
            connectionString = Config.GetStringValue($"{databaseContext.ConfigKey}:{GetConnectionStringKey(false)}", true);
        ISessionFactory SessionFactory(DatabaseNodeContext x) => SessionFactoryCreator.Create(connectionString, databaseContext.SchemaName, showSql, withCustomDriver);
        if (readOnly)
        {
            result = withCustomDriver
                ? _readOnlyCustomDriverFactories.GetOrAdd(databaseContext, SessionFactory)
                : _readOnlyFactories.GetOrAdd(databaseContext, SessionFactory);
        }
        else
        {
            result = withCustomDriver
                ? _customDriverFactories.GetOrAdd(databaseContext, SessionFactory)
                : _factories.GetOrAdd(databaseContext, SessionFactory);
        }
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the connection string key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="readOnly">if set to <c>true</c> [read only].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string GetConnectionStringKey(bool readOnly)
    {
        return readOnly ? "ReadOnlyConnectionString" : "ConnectionString";
    }
}

using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using FluentNHibernate.Cfg;
using FluentNHibernate.Cfg.Db;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Cfg;
using NHibernate.SqlCommand;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

/// <summary>
/// SessionFactoryCreator
/// </summary>
public class SessionFactoryCreator
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the specified connection string.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connectionString">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="schemaName">Name of the schema.</param>
    /// <param name="showSql">if set to <c>true</c> [show SQL].</param>
    /// <param name="withCustomDriver">if set to <c>true</c> [with custom driver].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static ISessionFactory Create(string connectionString, string? schemaName, bool showSql = true, bool withCustomDriver = false)
    {
        var assemblies = AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblies(AssemblyType.BackEnd);
        var factory = BuildConfiguration(connectionString, schemaName, assemblies, showSql, withCustomDriver)
            .BuildSessionFactory();
        return factory;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Builds the configuration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connectionString">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="schemaName">Name of the schema.</param>
    /// <param name="assemblies">The assemblies.</param>
    /// <param name="showSql">if set to <c>true</c> [show SQL].</param>
    /// <param name="withCustomDriver">if set to <c>true</c> [with custom driver].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static Configuration BuildConfiguration(string connectionString, string? schemaName, Assembly[] assemblies, bool showSql, bool withCustomDriver = false)
    {
        var config = Fluently.Configure();

        if (showSql)
            config.ExposeConfiguration(cfg => cfg.SetInterceptor(new SqlStatementInterceptor()));

        var dbConfiguration = PostgreSQLConfiguration.Standard.ConnectionString(connectionString)
            .Dialect<FrameworkPostgreSQLDialect>()
            .AdoNetBatchSize(1000)
#if DEBUG
            .ShowSql()
#endif
            .DefaultSchema(schemaName);

        if (withCustomDriver)
            dbConfiguration = dbConfiguration.Driver<CustomNpgsqlDriver>();

        config = config.Database(dbConfiguration);

        var configuration = SetMappingsAndOtherStuffs(config, assemblies);

        return configuration;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the mappings and other stuffs.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="config">The configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="assemblies">The assemblies.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static Configuration SetMappingsAndOtherStuffs(FluentConfiguration config, Assembly[] assemblies)
    {
        config = CoreFluentMapper.MapFromAssemblies(config, assemblies);

        var configuration = config.BuildConfiguration();

        return configuration;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 
    /// </summary>
    /// <seealso cref="NHibernate.EmptyInterceptor" />
    private sealed class SqlStatementInterceptor : EmptyInterceptor
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Called when [prepare statement].
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="sql">The SQL.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public override SqlString OnPrepareStatement(SqlString sql)
        {
            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("{0:yyyy.MM.dd hh:mm:ss.fff}:{1}", DateTime.UtcNow, sql);
            return sql;
        }
    }

}

using Common.BackEnd.Threading;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

/// <summary>
/// TransactionContext
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="System.IDisposable" />
public sealed class TransactionContext : IDisposable
{

    /// <summary>
    /// The has parent
    /// </summary>
    private readonly bool _hasParent;

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the specified database context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="begin">if set to <c>true</c> [begin].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TransactionContext Create(IDbContext dbContext, bool begin = true)
    {
        var hasParent = Current != null;

        var ctx = new TransactionContext(hasParent, dbContext);

        if (!hasParent)
            CallContext.SetData("_TransactionContext", ctx);

        if (begin)
            ctx.Begin();

        return ctx;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TransactionContext"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="hasParent">if set to <c>true</c> [has parent].</param>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    private TransactionContext(bool hasParent, IDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _hasParent = hasParent;
        DbContext = dbContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the current.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The current.
    /// </value>
    public static TransactionContext? Current => CallContext.GetData("_TransactionContext") as TransactionContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether [already in transaction].
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [already in transaction]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool AlreadyInTransaction { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the database context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The database context.
    /// </value>
    public IDbContext? DbContext { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Begins this instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Begin was already.</exception>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException"></exception>
    public void Begin()
    {
        if (AlreadyInTransaction)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Begin was already.");

        AlreadyInTransaction = true;

        if (DbContext == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException($"{nameof(DbContext)} is null!");

        if (!_hasParent)
        {
            DbContext.BeginTransaction();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Commits this instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Call commit without begin.</exception>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException"></exception>
    public void Commit()
    {
        if (!_hasParent)
        {
            if (!AlreadyInTransaction)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Call commit without begin.");

            AlreadyInTransaction = false;

            if (DbContext == null)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException($"{nameof(DbContext)} is null!");

            DbContext.Commit();
        }
    }

    public void RollBack()
    {
        if (!_hasParent)
        {
            if (!AlreadyInTransaction)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Call commit without begin.");

            AlreadyInTransaction = false;

            if (DbContext == null)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException($"{nameof(DbContext)} is null!");

            DbContext.RollBack();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Performs application-defined tasks associated with freeing, releasing, or resetting unmanaged resources.
    /// </summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (!_hasParent)
        {
            CallContext.ClearData("_TransactionContext");
            DbContext?.Dispose();
            DbContext = null;
        }
    }
}

using NHibernate.Exceptions;
using Npgsql;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// ExceptionExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class ExceptionExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether [is foreign constraint exception].
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ex">The ex.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [is foreign constraint exception] [the specified ex]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    public static bool IsForeignConstraintException(this Exception ex)
    {
        if (ex is GenericADOException 
            && ex.InnerException is PostgresException 
            && ex.InnerException is PostgresException sqlEx)
            return sqlEx.SqlState == "23503" || sqlEx.SqlState == "23502"; //  23502

        return false;
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.Criterion.Lambda;
using NHibernate.Proxy;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// NHibernateExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class NHibernateExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Uns the proxy.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="helper">The helper.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T UnProxy<T>(this T obj, Action<T>? helper = null)
    {
        var result = obj;
        if (obj is INHibernateProxy proxy)
            result = (T)proxy.HibernateLazyInitializer.GetImplementation();

        helper?.Invoke(result);

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Uns the proxy list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="helper">The helper.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static List<T>? UnProxyList<T>(this IList<T> obj, Action<T>? helper = null)
    {
        if (obj == null)
            return null;

        var result = new List<T>(obj.Select(x => x.UnProxy(helper)));
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Uns the proxy list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="helper">The helper.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static List<T>? UnProxyList<T>(this ICollection<T> obj, Action<T>? helper = null)
    {
        if (obj == null)
            return null;

        var result = new List<T>(obj.Select(x => x.UnProxy(helper)));
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the type of the real.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="type">The type.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Type GetRealType(this Type type)
    {
        // Serialize proxies as the base type
        if (typeof(INHibernateProxy).IsAssignableFrom(type) && type.BaseType != null)
        {
            type = type.BaseType!;
        }

        return type;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the long query timeout.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="timeout">The timeout.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static ICriteria SetLongQueryTimeout(this IQueryOver queryOver, int? timeout = null)
    {
        return queryOver.UnderlyingCriteria.SetTimeout(timeout ?? GetTimeoutConfigValue());
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the long query timeout.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="timeout">The timeout.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IQuery SetLongQueryTimeout(this IQuery query, int? timeout = null)
    {
        return query.SetTimeout(timeout ?? GetTimeoutConfigValue());
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the timeout configuration value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static int GetTimeoutConfigValue()
    {
        return Config.TryGetIntValue("LongQueryTimeout") ?? 150;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adott string szövegrészlet megtalálható-e egy adott Enum valamelyik elemének DisplayName attribútumában %LIKE%-osan?
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="lrb">The LRB.</param>
    /// <param name="searchText">The search text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static AbstractCriterion IsInsensitiveLikeEnum<T>(this LambdaRestrictionBuilder lrb, string searchText)
        where T : Enum
    {
        return lrb.IsIn(EnumHelper.GetEnumDisplayNameLike<T>(searchText));
    }
}

using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.AutomappingSteps;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using FluentNHibernate;
using FluentNHibernate.Automapping.Steps;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping;

/// <summary>
/// CoreAutomappingConfiguration
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.AutomappingConfiguration" />
public class CoreAutomappingConfiguration : AutomappingConfiguration
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Shoulds the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="type">The type.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override bool ShouldMap(Type type)
    {
        return base.ShouldMap(type) || type.GetAttribute<SkipMappingAttribute>() == null && type.IsSubclassOf(typeof(TrackedEntityBase));
    }

    public override bool ShouldMap(Member member)
    {
        return base.ShouldMap(member) && member.MemberInfo.GetAttribute<SkipMappingAttribute>() == null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the mapping steps.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="conventionFinder">The convention finder.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override IEnumerable<IAutomappingStep> GetMappingSteps(FluentNHibernate.Automapping.AutoMapper mapper, IConventionFinder conventionFinder)
    {
        return base.GetMappingSteps(mapper, conventionFinder).Select(GetDecoratedStep);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the decorated step.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="step">The step.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    IAutomappingStep GetDecoratedStep(IAutomappingStep step)
    {
        if (step is HasManyStep)
        {
            return new ManyToManyAutomappingStep(this, step);
        }

        return step;
    }

}

using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Conventions;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using FluentNHibernate.Automapping;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Helpers;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping;

/// <summary>
/// FluentMapper
/// </summary>
public static class FluentMapper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <param name="assemblies">The assemblies.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static AutoPersistenceModel SetUp(AutoPersistenceModel model, params Assembly[] assemblies)
    {
        var result = model.UseOverridesFromAssemblyOf<EntityBase>()
            .IgnoreBase<EntityBase>()
            .IgnoreBase<SubEntityBase>()
            //.IgnoreBase<EntityBase>() duplicate
            .Conventions.Add<JsonConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<FormulaConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<TenantIndependentConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<TableNameConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<PropertyConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<PrimaryKeySequenceConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<HasManyConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<HasManyToManyConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<ReferenceConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<JoinedSubClassConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<BoolConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<DateOnlyConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<UniqueConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<NotNullConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<EnumConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<ReadonlyConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<TextConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<StringLengthConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add<IndexConvention>()
            .Conventions.Add(DefaultCascade.SaveUpdate())
            .OverrideAll(DropPropertiesWithoutSetter);

        foreach (var assembly in AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblies(AssemblyType.BackEnd))
            result.UseOverridesFromAssembly(assembly);

        foreach (var assembly in assemblies)
            result = result.UseOverridesFromAssembly(assembly);

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Eldobja azokat a property-ket, amiknek nincs settere.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ignorer">The ignorer.</param>
    private static void DropPropertiesWithoutSetter(IPropertyIgnorer ignorer)
    {
        ignorer.IgnoreProperties(m => !m.CanWrite || m.MemberInfo.GetAttribute<SkipMappingAttribute>() != null);
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\AutomappingSteps\ManyToManyAutomappingStep.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using FluentNHibernate;
using FluentNHibernate.Automapping;
using FluentNHibernate.Automapping.Steps;
using FluentNHibernate.Mapping;
using FluentNHibernate.MappingModel;
using FluentNHibernate.MappingModel.ClassBased;
using FluentNHibernate.MappingModel.Collections;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.AutomappingSteps;

/// <summary>
/// ManyToManyAutomappingStep
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentNHibernate.Automapping.Steps.IAutomappingStep" />
public class ManyToManyAutomappingStep: IAutomappingStep
{

    /// <summary>
    /// The configuration
    /// </summary>
    readonly IAutomappingConfiguration Configuration;
    /// <summary>
    /// The default many to many step
    /// </summary>
    readonly IAutomappingStep DefaultManyToManyStep;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ManyToManyAutomappingStep"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configuration">The configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="defaultManyToManyStep">The default many to many step.</param>
    public ManyToManyAutomappingStep(IAutomappingConfiguration configuration, IAutomappingStep defaultManyToManyStep)
    {
        Configuration = configuration;
        DefaultManyToManyStep = defaultManyToManyStep;
    }

    #region Implementation of IAutomappingStep

    /// <summary>
    /// Shoulds the map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="member">The member.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool ShouldMap(Member member)
    {
        if (DefaultManyToManyStep.ShouldMap(member))
        {
            return true;
        }

        return member.MemberInfo.IsDefined(typeof(ManyToManyAttribute), true);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps the specified class map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="classMap">The class map.</param>
    /// <param name="member">The member.</param>
    public void Map(ClassMappingBase classMap, Member member)
    {
        if (DefaultManyToManyStep.ShouldMap(member) && !member.MemberInfo.IsDefined(typeof(ManyToManyAttribute), true))
        {
            DefaultManyToManyStep.Map(classMap, member);
            return;
        }

        var Collection = CreateManyToMany(classMap, member);
        classMap.AddCollection(Collection);
    }

    #endregion

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the many to many.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="classMap">The class map.</param>
    /// <param name="member">The member.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    CollectionMapping CreateManyToMany(ClassMappingBase classMap, Member member)
    {
        var ParentType = classMap.Type;
        var ChildType = member.PropertyType.GetGenericArguments()[0];

        var Collection = CollectionMapping.For(CollectionTypeResolver.Resolve(member));
        Collection.ContainingEntityType = ParentType;
        Collection.Set(x => x.Name, Layer.Defaults, member.Name);
        Collection.Set(x => x.Relationship, Layer.Defaults, CreateManyToMany(member, ParentType, ChildType));
        Collection.Set(x => x.ChildType, Layer.Defaults, ChildType);
        Collection.Member = member;

        SetDefaultAccess(member, Collection);
        SetKey(member, classMap, Collection);
        return Collection;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the default access.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="member">The member.</param>
    /// <param name="mapping">The mapping.</param>
    void SetDefaultAccess(Member member, CollectionMapping mapping)
    {
        var ResolvedAccess = MemberAccessResolver.Resolve(member);

        if (ResolvedAccess != Access.Property && ResolvedAccess != Access.Unset)
        {
            mapping.Set(x => x.Access, Layer.Defaults, ResolvedAccess.ToString());
        }

        if (member.IsProperty && !member.CanWrite)
        {
            mapping.Set(x => x.Access, Layer.Defaults, Configuration.GetAccessStrategyForReadOnlyProperty(member).ToString());
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the many to many.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="member">The member.</param>
    /// <param name="parentType">Type of the parent.</param>
    /// <param name="childType">Type of the child.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    static ICollectionRelationshipMapping CreateManyToMany(Member member, Type parentType, Type childType)
    {
        var ColumnMapping = new ColumnMapping();
        ColumnMapping.Set(x => x.Name, Layer.Defaults, childType.Name + "_id");

        var Mapping = new ManyToManyMapping { ContainingEntityType = parentType };
        Mapping.Set(x => x.Class, Layer.Defaults, new TypeReference(childType));
        Mapping.Set(x => x.ParentType, Layer.Defaults, parentType);
        Mapping.Set(x => x.ChildType, Layer.Defaults, childType);
        Mapping.AddColumn(Layer.Defaults, ColumnMapping);

        return Mapping;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="property">The property.</param>
    /// <param name="classMap">The class map.</param>
    /// <param name="mapping">The mapping.</param>
    static void SetKey(Member property, ClassMappingBase classMap, CollectionMapping mapping)
    {
        var ColumnName = property.DeclaringType.Name + "_id";
        var ColumnMapping = new ColumnMapping();
        ColumnMapping.Set(x => x.Name, Layer.Defaults, ColumnName);

        var Key = new KeyMapping { ContainingEntityType = classMap.Type };
        Key.AddColumn(Layer.Defaults, ColumnMapping);

        mapping.Set(x => x.Key, Layer.Defaults, Key);
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\Conventions\EnumConvention.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Types;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.AcceptanceCriteria;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Inspections;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Instances;
using NHibernate.Util;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Conventions;

/// <summary>
/// EnumConvention
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentNHibernate.Conventions.IUserTypeConvention" />
public class EnumConvention : IUserTypeConvention
{
    #region IPropertyConvention Members

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the specified instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="instance">The instance.</param>
    public void Apply(IPropertyInstance instance)
    {
        var propertyType = instance.Property.PropertyType;
        var underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(propertyType) ?? propertyType;
        bool isNullable = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(propertyType) != null;

        if (instance.Property.MemberInfo.GetCustomAttribute<StringBasedEnumAttribute>() != null)
        {
            if (isNullable)
            {
                // Use NullableEnumStringType for nullable enum properties
                var type = typeof(NullableEnumStringType<>).MakeGenericType(underlyingType);
                instance.CustomType(type);
            }
            else
            {
                // Use EnumStringType for non-nullable enum properties
                var type = typeof(EnumStringType<>).MakeGenericType(underlyingType);
                instance.CustomType(type);
            }
        }
        else 
        {
            instance.CustomType(underlyingType);
        }
    }

    #endregion IPropertyConvention Members

    #region IPropertyConventionAcceptance Members

    /// <summary>
    /// Accepts the specified criteria.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="criteria">The criteria.</param>
    public void Accept(IAcceptanceCriteria<IPropertyInspector> criteria)
    {
        criteria.Expect(x => x.Property.PropertyType.IsEnum || x.Property.PropertyType.IsNullableEnum());
    }

    #endregion IPropertyConventionAcceptance Members
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\Conventions\HasManyConvention.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Helpers;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Instances;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Conventions;

/// <summary>
/// HasManyConvention
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentNHibernate.Conventions.IHasManyConvention" />
public class HasManyConvention : IHasManyConvention
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies the specified instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="instance">The instance.</param>
    public void Apply(IOneToManyCollectionInstance instance)
    {
        var attr = instance.Member.GetCustomAttributes(false);
        if (attr.Any(a => a.GetType() == typeof(InverseAttribute)))
        {
            instance.Inverse();
        }

        var tableName = instance.EntityType.GetCustomAttribute<TableNameAttribute>()?.TableName ?? instance.EntityType.Name;

        var customForeignKeyAttribute = attr.SingleOrDefault(a => a.GetType() == typeof(CustomForeignKeyAttribute)) as CustomForeignKeyAttribute;

        var foreignKeyColumnName = string.Empty;
        var foreignKeyConstraintName = string.Empty;

        if (customForeignKeyAttribute != null)
        {
            foreignKeyColumnName = customForeignKeyAttribute.ForeignKeyColumnName;
            foreignKeyConstraintName = customForeignKeyAttribute.ForeignKeyConstraintName;
        }
        else
        {
            foreignKeyColumnName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}_id", NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(tableName));
            foreignKeyConstraintName = string.Format(
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "fk_{0}_{1}",
                NameHelper.ConvertName(instance.Member.Name),
                NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(tableName)
            );
        }

        instance.Key.Column(foreignKeyColumnName);
        instance.Key.ForeignKey(foreignKeyConstraintName);
    }
}


====================================================================================================
📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\Conventions\HasManyToManyConvention.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Helpers;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Instances;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Conventions;

/// <summary>
/// HasManyToManyConvention
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentNHibernate.Conventions.IHasManyToManyConvention" />
public class HasManyToManyConvention : IHasManyToManyConvention
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the specified instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="instance">The instance.</param>
    public void Apply(IManyToManyCollectionInstance instance)
    {
        var attr = instance.Member.GetCustomAttributes(false);
        if (attr.Any(a => a.GetType() == typeof(InverseAttribute)))
        {
            instance.Inverse();
        }

        var manyToManyAttribute = instance.Member.GetCustomAttribute<ManyToManyAttribute>();

        var memberName = NameHelper.ConvertName(instance.Member.Name);
        var entityName = NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(instance.EntityType.Name);
        var childTypeName = NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(instance.ChildType.Name);

        var tableName = manyToManyAttribute?.TableName ?? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}_{1}", entityName, memberName);
        instance.Table(tableName);

        var columnName = manyToManyAttribute?.KeyColumnName ?? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}_id", entityName);
        instance.Key.Column(columnName);

        var otherColumnName = manyToManyAttribute?.RelatedColumnName ?? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}_id", childTypeName);
        instance.Relationship.Column(otherColumnName);

        // length (max: 64) *********************
        var keyName = manyToManyAttribute?.ForeignKeyName ?? NameHelper.ConvertToSqlName("fk_", tableName, columnName);
        instance.Key.ForeignKey(keyName);


        // length (max: 64) *********************
        var otherKeyName = manyToManyAttribute?.RelatedForeignKeyName ?? NameHelper.ConvertToSqlName("fk_", tableName, otherColumnName);
        instance.Relationship.ForeignKey(otherKeyName);

        // Check if both entities are tenant-independent
        var parentHasTenantIndependent = instance.EntityType.GetCustomAttribute<TenantIndependentAttribute>() != null;
        var childHasTenantIndependent = instance.ChildType.GetCustomAttribute<TenantIndependentAttribute>() != null;
        
        // If both entities are tenant-independent, set schema for join table
        if (parentHasTenantIndependent && childHasTenantIndependent)
        {
            instance.Schema(DatabaseNodeContext.DefaultSchemaName);
        }
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\Conventions\IndexConvention.cs
====================================================================================================

using AutoMapper.Configuration.Annotations;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Helpers;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Instances;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Conventions;

/// <summary>
/// IndexConvention
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentNHibernate.Conventions.AttributePropertyConvention&lt;Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes.IndexAttribute&gt;" />
public class IndexConvention : AttributePropertyConvention<IndexAttribute>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Apply changes to a property with an attribute matching T.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="attribute">Instance of attribute found on property.</param>
    /// <param name="instance">Property with attribute</param>
    protected override void Apply(IndexAttribute attribute, IPropertyInstance instance)
    {
        IEnumerable<string> indexNames = attribute.IndexName ?? Array.Empty<string>();
        
        // Csak akkor adjuk hozzá a saját nevéből generált indexet, ha nem volt index névlista megadva vagy ha volt,
        // akkor az IndexOnSelf property-t igazra állították
        if (attribute.IndexName is null or { Length: 0 } || attribute.IndexOnSelf)
            indexNames = indexNames.Append(instance.Name);

        var indices = indexNames.Select(x => $"ix_{NameHelper.ConvertName(x)}");
        instance.Index(string.Join(",", indices));
    }
}

====================================================================================================

using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Helpers;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Instances;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Conventions;

/// <summary>
/// JoinedSubClassConvention
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentNHibernate.Conventions.IJoinedSubclassConvention" />
public class JoinedSubClassConvention : IJoinedSubclassConvention
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the specified instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="instance">The instance.</param>
    public void Apply(IJoinedSubclassInstance instance)
    {
        var attr = instance.EntityType.GetCustomAttribute<SubClassAttribute>();
        string baseTypeName = string.Empty;
        if (attr != null)
            baseTypeName = attr.BaseType.Name;
        else 
            if (instance.Type.BaseType != null) 
                baseTypeName = instance.Type.BaseType.Name;

        var attrName = instance.EntityType.GetCustomAttribute<TableNameAttribute>()?.TableName;
        var tableName = attrName ?? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(instance.EntityType.Name));
        instance.Table(tableName);
        if (instance.Type.BaseType != null)
            instance.Key.Column(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}_id", NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(baseTypeName)));

        instance.Key.ForeignKey(NameHelper.ConvertToSqlName(
            "fk_",
            NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(instance.EntityType.Name), 
            NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(baseTypeName)));
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\Conventions\PrimaryKeySequenceConvention.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Data;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Helpers;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Spreadsheet;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Instances;
using NHibernate.Dialect;
using NHibernate.Engine;
using NHibernate.Id;
using NHibernate.Type;
using NHibernate.Util;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Conventions;

/// <summary>
/// PrimaryKeySequenceConvention
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentNHibernate.Conventions.IIdConvention" />
public class PrimaryKeySequenceConvention : IIdConvention
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the specified instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="instance">The instance.</param>
    public void Apply(IIdentityInstance instance)
    {
        var tableName = instance.EntityType.GetCustomAttribute<TableNameAttribute>()?.TableName ?? instance.EntityType.Name;

        var entityName = NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(tableName);
        var columnName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}_id", entityName);
        instance.Column(columnName);

        var generationAttribute = instance.EntityType.GetCustomAttribute<PrimaryKeyGenerationAttribute>();

        if (generationAttribute == null)
        {
            instance.GeneratedBy.Sequence(GetSequenceName(entityName, columnName));
        }
        else if(generationAttribute.Strategy == IdGenerationStrategy.Assigned)
        {
            instance.GeneratedBy.Assigned();
        }
        else if (generationAttribute.Strategy == IdGenerationStrategy.Hybrid)
        {
            instance.GeneratedBy.Custom<HybridSequenceGenerator>(param =>
            {
                param.AddParam("sequence", GetSequenceName(entityName, columnName));
            });
        }
        instance.Not.Nullable();
    }

    private string GetSequenceName(string entityName, string columnName) 
    {
        // BUG: Seq length (max: 64) *********************
        // /general/EnergiaMenedzsment/-/issues/33#note_29561
        var seqName = $"{entityName}_{columnName}_seq";
        if (seqName.Length > 64)
        {
            if (entityName.Length + 1 > 30)
                entityName = entityName.Substring(0, 29);
            if (columnName.Length + 1 > 30)
                columnName = columnName.Substring(0, 29);
        }
        // ------------------------------------------------

        return $"{entityName}_{columnName}_seq";
    }
}

using System.Globalization;

/// PropertyConvention
/// </summary>

public class PropertyConvention : IPropertyConvention
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the specified instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="instance">The instance.</param>
    public void Apply(IPropertyInstance instance)
    {
        var attr = instance.Property.MemberInfo.GetCustomAttributes(
            typeof(PropertyNameAttribute), true
        ).FirstOrDefault();

        if (attr is PropertyNameAttribute propertyNameAttr)
            instance.Column(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", propertyNameAttr.PropertyName));
        else
            instance.Column(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", NameHelper.ConvertName(instance.Property.Name)));
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\Conventions\ReferenceConvention.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Helpers;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Instances;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Conventions;

/// <summary>
/// ReferenceConvention
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentNHibernate.Conventions.IReferenceConvention" />
public class ReferenceConvention : IReferenceConvention
{

    /// <summary>
    /// The counter
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, int> Counter = new Dictionary<string, int>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the specified instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="instance">The instance.</param>
    public void Apply(IManyToOneInstance instance)
    {
        var tableName = instance.EntityType.GetCustomAttribute<TableNameAttribute>()?.TableName ?? instance.EntityType.Name;

        var entityName = NameHelper.ConvertEntityName(tableName);

        var propertyNameAttribute = instance.Property.MemberInfo.GetCustomAttributes(
            typeof(PropertyNameAttribute), true
        ).FirstOrDefault();

        string columnName;
        if (propertyNameAttribute is PropertyNameAttribute propertyNameAttr)
            columnName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", propertyNameAttr.PropertyName);
        else
            columnName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", NameHelper.ConvertName(instance.Name));

        var indexName = $"{entityName}_{columnName}";
        var index = string.Empty;
        if (instance.EntityType.GetCustomAttribute<ComponentTypeAttribute>() != null)
        {
            // Ugyanazt az indexet generálta, mert ezeknél az instance egy ComponentType
            if (!Counter.ContainsKey(indexName)) Counter.Add(indexName, 1);
            else Counter[indexName]++;
            index = Counter[indexName].ToString();
        }
        //-- ez dupla constarint nevet generál a TermeszetesSzemelyEntity esetében: 
        // var keyName = string.Format("fk_{0}_{1}", columnName, entityName);
        //-- működő verzió, kérdés van- jobb: 
        // var keyName = string.Format("fk_{0}", Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Replace("-","_"));

        var attr = instance.Property.MemberInfo.GetCustomAttributes(false);
        if (attr.Any(a => a.GetType() == typeof(RequiredAttribute)))
            instance.Not.Nullable();

        //-- ideiglenesen kiszedjük: 
        // instance.ForeignKey(keyName);
        var columnSqlName = $"{columnName}_id";
        instance.Column(columnSqlName);
        var indexSqlName = NameHelper.ConvertToSqlName($"ix{index}_", entityName, columnSqlName);
        instance.Index(indexSqlName);
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\Conventions\TenantIndependentConvention.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions;
using FluentNHibernate.Conventions.Instances;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Conventions;

/// <summary>
/// TenantIndependentConvention
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentNHibernate.Conventions.IClassConvention" />
public class TenantIndependentConvention : IClassConvention
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the specified instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="instance">The instance.</param>
    public void Apply(IClassInstance instance)
    {
        var attrName = instance.EntityType.GetCustomAttribute<TenantIndependentAttribute>();
        if (attrName != null)
            instance.Schema(DatabaseNodeContext.DefaultSchemaName);
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\Helpers\NameHelper.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;

namespace Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping.Helpers;

public static class NameHelper
{
    private const int _regexTimeout = 200;

    // Cache the compiled regex patterns for better performance
    private static readonly Regex _upperCaseGroupPattern = new("[A-Z]+", RegexOptions.Compiled, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(_regexTimeout));
    private static readonly Regex _upperCasePattern = new("[A-Z]", RegexOptions.Compiled, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(_regexTimeout));
    private static readonly Regex _multipleUnderscoresPattern = new("_+", RegexOptions.Compiled, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(_regexTimeout));

    /// <summary>
    /// Helper method to create DB specific naming.
    /// It changes the accentuated letters and changes the uppercase letters to lowercase and inserts a '_' charecter 
    /// before the changed character => converts the CamelCase to under_score.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="name"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string ConvertName(string name)
    {
        // Egymas mellett levo nagybetuket nem CamelCase-esiti
        name = _upperCaseGroupPattern.Replace(name, x => x.Value[0].ToString().ToUpper() + x.Value[1..].ToLower());

        Match m;
        while ((m = _upperCasePattern.Match(name)).Success)
        {
            var substr = name.Substring(m.Index, m.Length);
            name = name.Remove(m.Index, m.Length);
            name = name.Insert(m.Index, (m.Index > 0 ? "_" : "") + substr.ToLower());
        }

        name = _multipleUnderscoresPattern.Replace(name, "_");
        name = name.ToLower();
        return name;
    }

    public static string ConvertName(Type type, string propertyName)
    {
        var propertyInfo = type.GetProperty(propertyName);

        var attribute = propertyInfo?.GetCustomAttribute<PropertyNameAttribute>();
        if (attribute != null)
        {
            return attribute.PropertyName;
        }
        else
        {
            return ConvertName(propertyName);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Converts the name of the entity.</summary>
    /// <param name="name">The name.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    public static string ConvertEntityName(string name)
    {
        return ConvertName(name.Replace("Entity", ""));
    }

    /// <summary>Converts the name of to SQL.</summary>
    /// <param name="prefix">The prefix.</param>
    /// <param name="tableName">Name of the table.</param>
    /// <param name="columnName">Name of the column.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    public static string ConvertToSqlName(string prefix, string tableName, string columnName)
    {
        const int maxLength = 64;
        // length (max: 64) *********************
        string keyName;
        var originalKeyName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{1}_{2}", prefix, tableName, columnName);
        var p = (int)Math.Ceiling((prefix.Length + 1) / 2.0);
        if (originalKeyName.Length >= maxLength)
        {
            var ml1 = maxLength / 2 - p;
            if (tableName.Length >= ml1)
                tableName = tableName[..(ml1 - 1)];
            if (columnName.Length + 1 >= ml1)
                columnName = columnName[..(ml1 - 1)];
            keyName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{1}_{2}", prefix, tableName, columnName);
            Console.Out.Write("DBGenerator ");
            var consoleColor = Console.ForegroundColor;
            Console.ForegroundColor = ConsoleColor.Yellow;
            Console.Out.Write("WARNING");
            Console.ForegroundColor = consoleColor;
            Console.Out.WriteLine($" - '{originalKeyName}' (Max length: {maxLength}) => '{keyName}'");
        }
        else keyName = originalKeyName;
        // ------------------------------------------------
        return keyName;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\DataAccess\Mapping\IdGenerators\HybridSequenceGenerator.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using NHibernate.Dialect;
using NHibernate.Engine;
using NHibernate.Id;
using NHibernate.Type;
using System.Data;

/// <summary>
/// Megadott Id-t használja beszúráskor, ha nincs megadva, akkor a szekvenciát próbálja meghasználni
/// </summary>
public class HybridSequenceGenerator : IIdentifierGenerator, IConfigurable
{
    private string _sequenceName;

    public void Configure(IType type, IDictionary<string, string> parms, Dialect dialect)
    {
        if (!parms.TryGetValue("sequence", out _sequenceName))
            throw new ArgumentException("Missing 'sequence' parameter for HybridSequenceGenerator");
    }

    public object Generate(ISessionImplementor session, object obj)
    {
        var idProperty = obj.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(IEntity.Id));
        if (idProperty == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Entity must have a public Id property.");

        var currentValue = Convert.ToInt32(idProperty.GetValue(obj));

        // If the ID is already set, use it
        if (currentValue != default)
            return currentValue;

        // Otherwise, get next value from sequence
        using var command = session.Connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = $"SELECT nextval('{_sequenceName}')";
        command.CommandType = CommandType.Text;

        var result = command.ExecuteScalar();
        return Convert.ToInt32(result);
    }

    public async Task<object> GenerateAsync(ISessionImplementor session, object obj, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var idProperty = obj.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(IEntity.Id));
        if (idProperty == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Entity must have a public Id property.");

        var currentValue = Convert.ToInt32(idProperty.GetValue(obj));

        // If the ID is already set, use it
        if (currentValue != default)
            return currentValue;

        // Otherwise, get the next value from the sequence asynchronously
        await using var command = session.Connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = $"SELECT nextval('{_sequenceName}')";
        command.CommandType = CommandType.Text;

        var result = await command.ExecuteScalarAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return Convert.ToInt32(result);
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\Domain\Attributes\IndexAttribute.cs
====================================================================================================

namespace Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;

/// <summary>
/// Egyszerű vagy összetett adatbázis indexek megadására alkalmas attribútum.
/// </summary>
/// <remarks>
/// Összetett indexek létrehozásához minden mezőre rá kell tenni ezt az attribútumot aminek szerepelnie kell az összetett indexben
/// és az IndexName mezőjében meg kell adni egy közös string-et.
/// <para>
/// Ez a közös string lesz az összetett index neve az adatbázisban.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Meg lehet adni több nevet, ha több indexben is szerepelnie kell.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Ha nincs megadva semmilyen IndexName érték, akkor egy olyan index jön létre, amiben egyedül ez az egy mező fog
/// szerepelni.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// Ha meg van adva IndexName érték és ezen felül kell egy olyan index amiben egyedül ennek az egy mezőnek kell szerepelnie,
/// akkor az <see cref="IndexOnSelf"/> mezőt igazra kell állítani!
/// </para>
/// </remarks>
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property)]
public class IndexAttribute : Attribute
{
    /// Az összetett indexek kulcsainak a listája, amibe a mezőt bele kell tenni.
    public string[]? IndexName { get; }
    
    /// Ha összetett index kulcsok lettek definiálva erre a mezőre, akkor az IndexOnSelf-fel
    /// lehet beállítani, hogy a mezőhöz kell egy önálló index is.
    public bool IndexOnSelf { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IndexAttribute" /> class.</summary>
    /// <param name="indexName">Name of the index.</param>
    public IndexAttribute(params string[]? indexName)
    {
        this.IndexName = indexName;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.BackEnd\Domain\DomainModel\EntityBase.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;

namespace Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;

/// <summary>
///  EntityBase
/// </summary>
public abstract class EntityBase : DomainModelBase, IEntity
{
    /// <summary>Gets or sets the identifier.</summary>
    /// <value>The identifier.</value>
    [SkipLog]
    [Required]
    public virtual int Id { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether the specified <see cref="object"/> is equal to this instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="obj">The <see cref="object"/> to compare with this instance.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if the specified <see cref="object"/> is equal to this instance; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    public override bool Equals(object? obj)
    {
        return obj is EntityBase eObj && eObj.Id == Id;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a hash code for this instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>
    /// A hash code for this instance, suitable for use in hashing algorithms and data structures like a hash table. 
    /// </returns>
    public override int GetHashCode()
    {
        return Id.GetHashCode();
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;

namespace Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel.Validity;

// közös ValidityBase ősosztály, ami később másra is alkalmazható lesz (ha szintén TrackedEntityBase-re épül),
// nem csak partner és orgunit szervezeti egységekre.
//TODO:  az OrgunitValidityBase-t viszont a framework modulban kell definiálni, mert onnan éri el az OrgUnitBase-t

public abstract class ValidityEntityBase : TrackedEntityBase, IValidityEntity
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség kezdete
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Description("Érvényesség kezdete")]
    public virtual DateTime ValidFrom { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség kezdete
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Description("Érvényesség Vége")]
    public virtual DateTime ValidTo { get; set; }

    [SkipMapping]
    public abstract int ParentId { get; protected set; }
}

using System.Data.Common;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Engine;
using NHibernate.SqlTypes;
using NHibernate.UserTypes;

namespace Common.BackEnd.Domain.Types;
public class DateOnlyType : IUserType
{
    public SqlType[] SqlTypes => new[] { SqlTypeFactory.Date };

    public Type ReturnedType => typeof(DateOnly);

    public bool IsMutable => false;

    public object NullSafeGet(DbDataReader rs, string[] names, ISessionImplementor session, object owner)
    {
        var obj = NHibernateUtil.Date.NullSafeGet(rs, names[0], session, owner);
        return obj == null ? null : DateOnly.FromDateTime((DateTime)obj);
    }

    public void NullSafeSet(DbCommand cmd, object value, int index, ISessionImplementor session)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            NHibernateUtil.Date.NullSafeSet(cmd, null, index, session);
        }
        else
        {
            var dateOnlyValue = ((DateOnly)value).ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue);
            NHibernateUtil.Date.NullSafeSet(cmd, dateOnlyValue, index, session);
        }
    }

    public object DeepCopy(object value) => value;
    public object Replace(object original, object target, object owner) => original;
    public object Assemble(object cached, object owner) => cached;
    public object Disassemble(object value) => value;
    public int GetHashCode(object x) => x?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
    public bool Equals(object x, object y) => object.Equals(x, y);
}

using System.Data;
using System.Data.Common;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Engine;
using NHibernate.SqlTypes;
using NHibernate.UserTypes;

namespace Common.BackEnd.Domain.Types;
public class EnumStringType<T> : IUserType where T : struct, Enum
{
    public SqlType[] SqlTypes => new[] { new SqlType(DbType.String) };

    public Type ReturnedType => typeof(T);

    public bool IsMutable => false;

    public object Assemble(object cached, object owner) => cached;

    public object DeepCopy(object value) => value;

    public object Disassemble(object value) => value;

    public new bool Equals(object x, object y)
    {
        return object.Equals(x, y);
    }

    public int GetHashCode(object x)
    {
        return x is Enum enumX ? enumX.GetHashCode() : 0;
    }

    public object NullSafeGet(DbDataReader rs, string[] names, ISessionImplementor session, object owner)
    {
        var value = NHibernateUtil.String.NullSafeGet(rs, names[0], session, owner) as string;
        return value == null ? default(T) : Enum.Parse(typeof(T), value);
    }

    public void NullSafeSet(DbCommand cmd, object value, int index, ISessionImplementor session)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            NHibernateUtil.String.NullSafeSet(cmd, null, index, session);
        }
        else
        {
            NHibernateUtil.String.NullSafeSet(cmd, value.ToString(), index, session);
        }
    }

    public object Replace(object original, object target, object owner) => target;
}

/// <summary>
/// Type handler for nullable enum properties with StringBasedEnum attribute.
/// Ensures that null database values properly map to null enum values.
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T">The enum type</typeparam>
public class NullableEnumStringType<T> : IUserType where T : struct, Enum
{
    public SqlType[] SqlTypes => new[] { new SqlType(DbType.String) };

    public Type ReturnedType => typeof(T?);

    public bool IsMutable => false;

    public object Assemble(object cached, object owner) => cached;

    public object DeepCopy(object value) => value;

    public object Disassemble(object value) => value;

    public new bool Equals(object x, object y)
    {
        return object.Equals(x, y);
    }

    public int GetHashCode(object x)
    {
        return x != null ? x.GetHashCode() : 0;
    }

    public object NullSafeGet(DbDataReader rs, string[] names, ISessionImplementor session, object owner)
    {
        var value = NHibernateUtil.String.NullSafeGet(rs, names[0], session, owner) as string;
        
        // When database value is null, return null for the nullable enum
        if (value == null)
        {
            return null;
        }
        
        return Enum.Parse(typeof(T), value);
    }

    public void NullSafeSet(DbCommand cmd, object value, int index, ISessionImplementor session)
    {
        if (value == null)
        {
            NHibernateUtil.String.NullSafeSet(cmd, null, index, session);
        }
        else
        {
            NHibernateUtil.String.NullSafeSet(cmd, value.ToString(), index, session);
        }
    }

    public object Replace(object original, object target, object owner) => target;
}

using System.Collections;
using System.Data;
using System.Data.Common;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using NHibernate.Engine;
using NHibernate.SqlTypes;
using NHibernate.Type;
using NHibernate.UserTypes;
using Npgsql;
using NpgsqlTypes;

namespace Common.BackEnd.Domain.Types;

/// <summary>
/// JsonType
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TSerializable">The type of the serializable.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="NHibernate.UserTypes.IUserType" />
[Serializable]
    public class JsonType<TSerializable> : IUserType where TSerializable : class
    {

    /// <summary>
    /// Serializes the specified object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.Runtime.Serialization.SerializationException">Could not serialize a serializable property:</exception>
    private static string Serialize(object obj)
        {
            try
            {
                return JsonConvert.SerializeObject(obj);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                throw new SerializationException("Could not serialize a serializable property: ", e);
            }
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Deserializes the specified database value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbValue">The database value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.Runtime.Serialization.SerializationException">Could not deserialize a serializable property:</exception>
    private object? Deserialize(string dbValue)
        {
            try
            {
                return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(dbValue, typeof(TSerializable));
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                throw new SerializationException("Could not deserialize a serializable property: ", e);
            }
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Compare two instances of the class mapped by this type for persistent "equality"
    /// ie. equality of persistent state
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="x"></param>
    /// <param name="y"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public new bool Equals(object? x, object? y)
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(x, y))
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (x == null || y == null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (x is IDictionary xx && y is IDictionary yy)
            {
                return EqualDictionary(xx, yy);
            }

            return x!.Equals(y);
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Equals the dictionary.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="a">a.</param>
    /// <param name="b">The b.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static bool EqualDictionary(IDictionary a, IDictionary b)
        {
            if (a.Count != b.Count) return false;

            foreach (var key in a.Keys)
            {
                if (!b.Contains(key)) return false;

                var va = a[key];
                var vb = b[key];

                if (va is null && vb is null) return true;

                if (va is not null && !va.Equals(vb)) return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a hash code for this instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="x">The x.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// A hash code for this instance, suitable for use in hashing algorithms and data structures like a hash table. 
    /// </returns>
    public int GetHashCode(object x)
        {
            return x.GetHashCode();
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieve an instance of the mapped class from an ADO resultset.
    /// Implementors should handle possibility of null values.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="rs">a DbDataReader</param>
    /// <param name="names">column names</param>
    /// <param name="session">The session for which the operation is done. Allows access to
    /// <c>Factory.Dialect</c> and <c>Factory.ConnectionProvider.Driver</c> for adjusting to
    /// database or data provider capabilities.</param>
    /// <param name="owner">the containing entity</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// The value.
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">One column name expected but received {names.Length}</exception>
    public object? NullSafeGet(DbDataReader rs, string[] names, ISessionImplementor session, object owner)
        {
            if (names.Length != 1)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"One column name expected but received {names.Length}");

            if (rs[names[0]] is string value && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                return Deserialize(value);

            return null;
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Write an instance of the mapped class to a prepared statement.
    /// Implementors should handle possibility of null values.
    /// A multi-column type should be written to parameters starting from index.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">a DbCommand</param>
    /// <param name="value">the object to write</param>
    /// <param name="index">command parameter index</param>
    /// <param name="session">The session for which the operation is done. Allows access to
    /// <c>Factory.Dialect</c> and <c>Factory.ConnectionProvider.Driver</c> for adjusting to
    /// database or data provider capabilities.</param>
    public void NullSafeSet(DbCommand cmd, object? value, int index, ISessionImplementor session)
        {
            var parameter = cmd.Parameters[index];

            if (parameter is NpgsqlParameter)
                parameter.DbType = SqlTypes[0].DbType;

            if (value == null)
                parameter.Value = DBNull.Value;
            else
                parameter.Value = value;
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Return a deep copy of the persistent state, stopping at entities and at collections.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">Generally a collection element or entity field value mapped as this user type.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// A copy.
    /// </returns>
    public object? DeepCopy(object value)
        {
            return Deserialize(Serialize(value));
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// During merge, replace the existing (<paramref name="target" />) value in the entity
    /// we are merging to with a new (<paramref name="original" />) value from the detached
    /// entity we are merging. For immutable objects, or null values, it is safe to simply
    /// return the first parameter. For mutable objects, it is safe to return a copy of the
    /// first parameter. For objects with component values, it might make sense to
    /// recursively replace component values.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="original">the value from the detached entity being merged</param>
    /// <param name="target">the value in the managed entity</param>
    /// <param name="owner">the managed entity</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// the value to be merged
    /// </returns>
    public object Replace(object original, object target, object owner)
        {
            return original;
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Reconstruct an object from the cacheable representation. At the very least this
    /// method should perform a deep copy if the type is mutable. See
    /// <see cref="M:NHibernate.UserTypes.IUserType.Disassemble(System.Object)" />. (Optional operation if the second level cache is not used.)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cached">The cacheable representation.</param>
    /// <param name="owner">The owner of the cached object.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// A reconstructed object from the cachable representation.
    /// </returns>
    public object? Assemble(object? cached, object owner)
        {
            return (cached == null) ? null : Deserialize((string) cached);
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Transform the object into its cacheable representation. At the very least this
    /// method should perform a deep copy if the type is mutable. That may not be enough
    /// for some implementations, however; for example, associations must be cached as
    /// identifier values. (Optional operation if the second level cache is not used.)
    /// Second level cache implementations may have additional requirements, like the
    /// cacheable representation being binary serializable.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The object to be cached.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// A cacheable representation of the object.
    /// </returns>
    public object? Disassemble(object? value)
        {
            return (value == null) ? null : Serialize(value);
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// The SQL types for the columns mapped by this type.
    /// </summary>
    public SqlType[] SqlTypes => new SqlType[] {new NpgsqlExtendedSqlType(DbType.Object, NpgsqlDbType.Jsonb)};

    /// <summary>
    /// The type returned by <c>NullSafeGet()</c>
    /// </summary>
    public Type ReturnedType => typeof(TSerializable);
    /// <summary>
    /// Are objects of this type mutable?
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsMutable => true;
    }

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using Common.Shared.Types;

namespace Common.BackEnd.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// SecurityManager
/// </summary>
public static class SecurityManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the access.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotSupportedException">Query not supported: {query.GetType().Name}</exception>
    public static void CheckAccess(SecurityContext securityContext, IQuery query)
    {
        // 0.) egyáltalán kell-e műveletet ellenőrizni?
        if (!ShouldCheck(query) || securityContext.CurrentUser.IsSystem)
        {
            return;
        }

        var attrib = GetAttribute(query);
        if (attrib != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(attrib.SecOperationCode))
        {
            securityContext.CheckRight(attrib.SecOperationCode);
            return;
        }

        if (query is IEntityQuery entityQuery && attrib != null)
        {
            securityContext.CheckRight(entityQuery.EntityTypeName, attrib.SecurityOperation);
            return;
        }

        // 1.) EntityQuery-nél tudjuk mi a teendő: nem foglalkozunk az esetlegesen rápakolt SecurityOperation-nal !!
        if (query is IEntityQuery entityQuery2)
        {
            securityContext.CheckRight(entityQuery2.EntityTypeName, SecurityOperation.Read);
            return;
        }

        // 2.) minden más esetben ez hibás aktiválás
        throw new NotSupportedException($"Query not supported: {query.GetType().Name}");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the access.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">EntityTypeName</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotSupportedException">Command not supported: {command.GetType().Name}</exception>
    public static void CheckAccess(this IComponentContext context, IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var securityContext = context.Resolve<SecurityContext>();

        // 0.) egyáltalán kell-e műveletet ellenőrizni?
        if (!ShouldCheck(command) || securityContext.CurrentUser.IsSystem)
        {
            return;
        }

        // 1.) megnézzük, hogy van-e rajta konkrét SecOperation előírva: ha van, akkor azt ellenőrizzük
        var attrib = GetAttribute(command);
        if (attrib != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(attrib.SecOperationCode))
        {
            securityContext.CheckRight(attrib.SecOperationCode);
            return;
        }

        if (command.EntityTypeName == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException(nameof(command.EntityTypeName));

        // 2.) ha UpdateEntityCommand, akkor megnézzük a konkrét műveletet:
        if (command is UpdateEntityCommand updateEntityCommand)
        {
            securityContext.CheckRight(command.EntityTypeName, GetOperation(updateEntityCommand));
            return;
        }

        if (command is EntityCommandBase && attrib != null)
        {
            securityContext.CheckRight(command.EntityTypeName, attrib.SecurityOperation);
            return;
        }

        // 3.) minden más esetben ez hibás aktiválás
        throw new NotSupportedException($"Command not supported: {command.GetType().Name}");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// UpdateEntityCommand-ból kivarázsolja a műveleti kódot
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="updateEntityCommand">A command referencia</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// a EntityUpdateAction-nek megfelelő SecurityOperation
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Update</exception>
    private static SecurityOperation GetOperation(UpdateEntityCommand updateEntityCommand)
    {
        return updateEntityCommand?.Update == null
            ? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException(nameof(updateEntityCommand.Update))
            : updateEntityCommand.Update.Action switch
            {
                EntityUpdateAction.Update => SecurityOperation.Modify,
                EntityUpdateAction.New => SecurityOperation.Create,
                _ => SecurityOperation.Delete,
            };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Eldönti az adott objektum példányról, hogy van-e rajta [RequiredSecOperation(NoCheck=true)] bejegyzés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">A viszgálandó referencia</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// True: ha nincs ilyen bejegyzés, vagy van, de NoChekc=false van megadva
    /// </returns>
    private static bool ShouldCheck(object source)
    {
        // FONTOS: ha először a Config-ot olvassuk fel, justLocalConfig nélkül, akkor végtelen ciklusba esik,
        //         mert a config-ot is QueryServiceServer-en keresztül olvassa fel
        //         ezért is kell, hogy a Cache esetében attributum szinten ki legyen kapcsolva az ellenörzés

        // a művelet kívülről kikapcsolható
        // de csak az appconfig-ban keressük lsd előbb
        bool? noCheck = Config.TryGetBoolValue("SecOperationNoCheck", true);
        if (noCheck.HasValue && noCheck.Value)
        {
            return false;
        }

        // megnézzük van-e Attributum bejegyzése?
        var attrib = GetAttribute(source);
        // ha meg van adva az attributum, akkor onnan kell venni az értéket
        return attrib == null || !attrib.NoCheck;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kibányássza a szükséges attributum objektumot
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// A RequiredSecOperationAttribute példány, vagy null ha nincs
    /// </returns>
    public static RequiredSecOperationAttribute? GetAttribute(object source)
    {
        var type = source.GetType();
        if (Attribute.IsDefined(type, typeof(RequiredSecOperationAttribute)))
        {
            // meg van adva, akkor azzal kell dolgozni
            return Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(type, typeof(RequiredSecOperationAttribute)) as RequiredSecOperationAttribute;
        }
        return null;
    }

    //TODO: Töröljük, ha a jogosultság kezelés tesztelve lett rendesen
    //public static SecUser GetCurrentUser()
    //{
    //    var secContext = AutofacScope.Global.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
    //    return secContext.CurrentUser;
    //}
}
