namespace Common.BackEnd.Threading;

/// <summary>
/// IBackgroundTaskExecutorInstance
/// </summary>
public interface IBackgroundTaskExecutorInstance
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    void ExecuteBackgroundTask(Action action);
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task and wait.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    void ExecuteBackgroundTaskAndWait(Action action);
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    Task<T> ExecuteBackgroundTaskAsync<T>(Func<T> action)
        where T : class;
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <param name="state">The state.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    Task<T> ExecuteBackgroundTaskAsync<T>(Func<object?, T> action, object state)
        where T : class;
}

/// <summary>
/// TaskBasedBackgroundTaskExecutorInstance
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.Threading.IBackgroundTaskExecutorInstance" />
public class TaskBasedBackgroundTaskExecutorInstance : IBackgroundTaskExecutorInstance
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    public virtual void ExecuteBackgroundTask(Action action)
    {
        var task = new Task(action);
        StartTask(task);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task and wait.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    public virtual void ExecuteBackgroundTaskAndWait(Action action)
    {
        var task = new Task(action);
        StartTask(task);
        task.Wait();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual Task<T> ExecuteBackgroundTaskAsync<T>(Func<T> action) where T : class
    {
        var task = new Task<T>(action);
        StartTask(task);
        return task;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <param name="state">The state.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual Task<T> ExecuteBackgroundTaskAsync<T>(Func<object?, T> action, object state) where T : class
    {
        var task = new Task<T>(action, state);
        StartTask(task);
        return task;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts the task.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="task">The task.</param>
    protected virtual void StartTask(Task task)
    {
        task.Start();
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// BackgroundTaskExecutor
/// </summary>
public static class BackgroundTaskExecutor
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the <see cref="BackgroundTaskExecutor"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    static BackgroundTaskExecutor()
    {
        Instance = new TaskBasedBackgroundTaskExecutorInstance();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The instance.
    /// </value>
    internal static IBackgroundTaskExecutorInstance Instance { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    public static void ExecuteBackgroundTask(Action action)
    {
        Instance.ExecuteBackgroundTask(action);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task and wait.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    public static void ExecuteBackgroundTaskAndWait(Action action)
    {
        Instance.ExecuteBackgroundTaskAndWait(action);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Task<T> ExecuteBackgroundTaskAsync<T>(Func<T> action)
        where T : class
    {
        return Instance.ExecuteBackgroundTaskAsync(action);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the background task asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <param name="state">The state.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Task<T> ExecuteBackgroundTaskAsync<T>(Func<object?, T> action, object state)
        where T : class
    {
        return Instance.ExecuteBackgroundTaskAsync(action, state);
    }
}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;

namespace Common.BackEnd.Threading;

/// <summary>
/// Provides a way to set contextual data that flows with the call and 
/// async context of a test or invocation.
/// </summary>
public static class CallContext
{
    static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, AsyncLocal<object>> State = new();

    /// <summary>
    /// Stores a given object and associates it with the specified name.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="name">The name with which to associate the new item in the call context.</param>
    /// <param name="data">The object to store in the call context.</param>
    public static void SetData(string name, object data) =>
        State.GetOrAdd(name, _ => new AsyncLocal<object>()).Value = data;

    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves an object with the specified name from the <see cref="CallContext"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="name">The name of the item in the call context.</param>
    /// <returns>The object in the call context associated with the specified name, or <see langword="null"/> if not found.</returns>
    public static object? GetData(string name) =>
        State.TryGetValue(name, out AsyncLocal<object>? data) ? data.Value : null;

    /// <summary>Clears the data.</summary>
    /// <param name="name">The name.</param>
    public static void ClearData(string name) => State.TryRemove(name, out _);
}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;

namespace Common.Logic.Caching;

/// <summary>
///  ICache
/// </summary>
public interface ICache
{
    /// <summary>Invalidates the specified tenant code.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    void Invalidate(string tenantCode);
}

/// <summary>
/// Cache class
/// </summary>
public abstract class Cache<TKey, TValue> : ICache where TKey : notnull
{
    #region Private variables

    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue>> _cache = new();

    #endregion

    #region Constructors

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="Cache{TKey, TValue}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cacheName">Name of the cache.</param>
    /// <param name="keepPeriod">The keep period.</param>
    protected Cache(string cacheName, TimeSpan? keepPeriod = null)
    {
        CacheName = cacheName;
        KeepPeriod = keepPeriod;
        FillUpDates = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, DateTime?>();
    }

    #endregion

    #region Public properties

    /// <summary>
    /// Cache name
    /// </summary>
    public string CacheName { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cache create date
    /// </summary>
    public ConcurrentDictionary<string, DateTime?> FillUpDates { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cache keep period
    /// </summary>
    public TimeSpan? KeepPeriod { get; private set; }

    #endregion

    #region Public methods

    /// <summary>Sets the keep period.</summary>
    /// <param name="keepPeriod">The keep period.</param>
    public void SetKeepPeriod(TimeSpan? keepPeriod = null)
    {
        KeepPeriod = keepPeriod;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the specified key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool Add(string tenantCode, TKey key, TValue value)
    {
        bool success;

        CheckAccess(tenantCode);

        if (!_cache.ContainsKey(tenantCode))
            _cache.TryAdd(tenantCode, new ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue>());

        success = !_cache[tenantCode].ContainsKey(key) && _cache[tenantCode].TryAdd(key, value);

        return success;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the specified value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool Add(string tenantCode, TValue value)
    {
        return Add(tenantCode, GetValueKey(tenantCode, value), value);
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the tenant cache.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue>? GetTenantCache(string? tenantCode)
    {

        tenantCode ??= "TenantIndependentCache";

        if (!_cache.ContainsKey(tenantCode))
            _cache.TryAdd(tenantCode, new ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue>());
        _cache.TryGetValue(tenantCode, out ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue>? tenantCache);
        return tenantCache ?? new ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the specified key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode"></param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public TValue? Get(string? tenantCode, TKey key)
    {
        TValue? value;

        CheckAccess(tenantCode);

        var tenantCache = GetTenantCache(tenantCode) 
            ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException(nameof(TValue) + "cache");
        value = this.GetValue(tenantCache, key);

        return value;
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the value.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCache">The tenant cache.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected virtual TValue? GetValue(ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue> tenantCache, TKey key)
    {
        TValue? value;
        if (tenantCache.ContainsKey(key))
            tenantCache.TryGetValue(key, out value);
        else
            value = default;
        return value;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Removes the specified key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool Remove(string tenantCode, TKey key)
    {
        CheckAccess(tenantCode);
        var tenantCache = GetTenantCache(tenantCode);
        return tenantCache != null && tenantCache.TryRemove(key, out var value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Removes the specified value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool Remove(string tenantCode, TValue value)
    {
        return Remove(tenantCode, GetValueKey(tenantCode, value));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Invalidates this instance.
    /// </summary>
    public void Invalidate(string? tenantCode)
    {
        if (!FillUpDates.ContainsKey(TenantCacheKey(tenantCode)))
            FillUpDates.TryAdd(TenantCacheKey(tenantCode), null);
        else
            FillUpDates[TenantCacheKey(tenantCode)] = null;
        CheckAccess(tenantCode);
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the content.</summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   TValue
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">TValue</exception>
    public ICollection<TValue> GetContent(IComponentContext? context = null)
    {
        var tenantCode = GetTenantCode(context);
        CheckAccess(tenantCode);
        var tenantCache = GetTenantCache(tenantCode);

        // TODO: Ez így megfelelő lekezelése a nem talált cache-nek?
        return tenantCache == null
            ? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException(nameof(TValue) + " cache")
            : GetTenantCache(tenantCode)!.Values;
    }

    /// <summary>Clears the specified tenant code.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">TValue</exception>
    public void Clear(string? tenantCode)
    {
        var tenantCache = GetTenantCache(tenantCode) 
            ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException(nameof(TValue) + " cache");
        tenantCache!.Clear();
    }

    #endregion

    #region Protected methods

    /// <summary>Gets the value key.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///  TKey
    /// </returns>
    protected abstract TKey GetValueKey(string? tenantCode, TValue value);

    /// <summary>Fills up.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    protected abstract void FillUp(string? tenantCode = null);

    /// <summary>Adds the range.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="values">The values.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">TValue</exception>
    protected void AddRange(string? tenantCode, TValue[] values)
    {
        var tenantCache = GetTenantCache(tenantCode) 
            ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException(nameof(TValue) + " cache");

        foreach (var value in values)
        {
            tenantCache!.TryAdd(GetValueKey(tenantCode, value), value);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the tenant code.</summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///  string
    /// </returns>
    protected string? GetTenantCode(IComponentContext? context)
    {
        if (context == null) return null;
        var securityContext = context.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        return securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
    }

    #endregion

    #region Private variables

    /// <summary>Checks the access.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    private void CheckAccess(string? tenantCode)
    {
        if (!FillUpDates.ContainsKey(TenantCacheKey(tenantCode)))
            FillUpDates.TryAdd(TenantCacheKey(tenantCode), null);

        var fillUpDate = FillUpDates[TenantCacheKey(tenantCode)];
        if (fillUpDate == null || KeepPeriod != null && fillUpDate.Value + KeepPeriod < DateTime.UtcNow)
        {
            FillUp(tenantCode);
            fillUpDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
        }
        FillUpDates[TenantCacheKey(tenantCode)] = fillUpDate;
    }

    /// <summary>Tenants the cache key.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///  string
    /// </returns>
    protected string TenantCacheKey(string? tenantCode)
    {
        return tenantCode ?? "TenantIndependentCache";
    }

    #endregion
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;

namespace Common.Logic.Caching;

/// <summary>
/// CoreEntityCache
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TCacheEntity">The type of the cache entity.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Caching.CoreEntityCache&lt;TCacheEntity, TCacheEntity&gt;" />
public class CoreEntityCache<TCacheEntity> : CoreEntityCache<TCacheEntity, TCacheEntity>
    where TCacheEntity : IEntityDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CoreEntityCache{TCacheEntity}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public CoreEntityCache()
    {
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CoreEntityCache{TCacheEntity}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="keepPeriod">The keep period.</param>
    protected CoreEntityCache(TimeSpan? keepPeriod)
        : base(keepPeriod)
    {
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// CoreEntityCache
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TCacheEntity">The type of the cache entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TQueryEntity">The type of the query entity.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Caching.CoreEntityCache&lt;TCacheEntity, TCacheEntity&gt;" />
public abstract class CoreEntityCache<TCacheEntity, TQueryEntity> : CoreEntityCache<TCacheEntity, TQueryEntity, IQueryService>
    where TCacheEntity : IEntityDto
    where TQueryEntity : IEntityDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CoreEntityCache{TCacheEntity, TQueryEntity}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    protected CoreEntityCache()
    {
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CoreEntityCache{TCacheEntity, TQueryEntity}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="keepPeriod">The keep period.</param>
    protected CoreEntityCache(TimeSpan? keepPeriod)
        : base(keepPeriod)
    {
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// CoreEntityCache
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TCacheEntity">The type of the cache entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TQueryEntity">The type of the query entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TQueryService">The type of the query service.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Caching.CoreEntityCache&lt;TCacheEntity, TCacheEntity&gt;" />
public abstract class CoreEntityCache<TCacheEntity, TQueryEntity, TQueryService> : EntityCache<TCacheEntity>
    where TCacheEntity : IEntityDto
    where TQueryEntity : IEntityDto
    where TQueryService : IQueryService
{

    #region Constructors

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CoreEntityCache{TCacheEntity, TQueryEntity, TQueryService}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="keepPeriod">The keep period.</param>
    protected CoreEntityCache(TimeSpan? keepPeriod = null)
        : base(keepPeriod)
    {
    }

    #endregion

    #region Public methods

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets all entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IList<TCacheEntity> GetAllEntities(string? tenantCode)
    {
        Log.LogDebug("Load entities from db to Cache. EntityName: " + typeof(TCacheEntity).Name);

        IList<TCacheEntity>? result = null;

        using (var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
        {
            scope.SetAnonymousContext(tenantCode);

            var svc = scope.Resolve<TQueryService>();

            if (typeof(TCacheEntity) != typeof(TQueryEntity))
            {
                var res = svc.QueryEntities<TQueryEntity, TCacheEntity>(GetQuery());
                result = res.Items.ToList();
            }
            else
                result = svc.QueryEntities<TCacheEntity>(GetQuery()).Items.ToList();

        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual IEntityQuery<TCacheEntity> GetQuery()
    {
        return new CacheEntityQuery<TQueryEntity, TCacheEntity>();
    }

    #endregion
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.Logic\Caching\EntityCache.cs

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;

namespace Common.Logic.Caching;

/// <summary>
///  EntityCache
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
public abstract class EntityCache<TEntity> : Cache<int, TEntity>
    where TEntity : IEntityDto
{

    /// <summary>The default keep period</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultKeepPeriod = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.TryGetIntValue("DefaultCacheKeepPeriodSeconds") ?? 60);

    #region Private variables

    /// <summary>The synchronize root</summary>
    private readonly object _syncRoot = new();

    #endregion

    #region Constructors

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EntityCache{T}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="keepPeriod">The keep period.</param>
    protected EntityCache(TimeSpan? keepPeriod = null)
        : base(typeof(TEntity).Name, keepPeriod)
    {
    }

    #endregion

    #region Protected methods

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected abstract IList<TEntity> GetAllEntities(string? tenantCode);

    /// <summary>Gets the value key.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns>TKey</returns>
    protected override int GetValueKey(string? tenantCode, TEntity value)
    {
        return ((IEntity)value).Id;
    }

    /// <summary>Fills up.</summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    protected override void FillUp(string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        lock (_syncRoot)
        {
            if (!FillUpDates.ContainsKey(TenantCacheKey(tenantCode)))
                FillUpDates.TryAdd(TenantCacheKey(tenantCode), null);
            var fillUpDate = FillUpDates[TenantCacheKey(tenantCode)];
            if (fillUpDate == null || (DateTime.UtcNow - fillUpDate.Value).TotalSeconds > 1)
            {
                var entities = GetAllEntities(tenantCode);
                Clear(tenantCode);
                AddRange(tenantCode, entities.ToArray());
            }
        }
    }
    
    #endregion

}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;

namespace Common.Logic.Caching;

/// <summary>
/// Rendszer konfig cache
/// </summary>
public class SysConfigCache : CoreEntityCache<SysConfig>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Konstruktor
    /// </summary>
    public SysConfigCache() : base(DefaultKeepPeriod)
    {

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rendszer konfig-ból lekérés kód alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context"></param>
    /// <param name="kod"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public string? GetByKod(IComponentContext context, string kod)
    {
        var work = GetContent(context).SingleOrDefault(x => x.ConfigName == kod);
        return work?.ConfigValue;
    }

}

/// <summary>
/// ConfigExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class ConfigExtensions
{

    /// <summary>
    /// The tenant independent configuration
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly TenantConfig TenantIndependentConfig = new();

    /// <summary>
    /// Configurations the specified context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TenantConfig Config(this IComponentContext context)
    {
        var tenantCode = context.GetTenantCode();
        return tenantCode != null ? context.Resolve<TenantConfig>() : TenantIndependentConfig;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string? GetTenantCode(this IComponentContext? context)
    {
        if (context == null) return null;
        var securityContext = context.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        return securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Common configuration abstraction layer
/// </summary>
public static class Config
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The place holder application path
    /// </summary>
    public const string PlaceHolderAppPath = "%APP_PATH%";

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the test provider.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The test provider.
    /// </value>
    public static IConfigProvider? TestProvider { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Config provider
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The local provider.
    /// </value>
    public static IConfigProvider? LocalProvider { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Config provider
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The provider.
    /// </value>
    public static IConfigProvider? Provider { get; set; }


    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the string value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">Name of the config.</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">if set to <c>true</c> just local configuration</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// the value of the config
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentConfigurationException">Konfigurációs beállítás nem található: {0}</exception>
    public static string GetStringValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false, IComponentContext? context = null)
    {
        var val = GetConfigValue(configName, justLocalConfig, context);
        return val ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentConfigurationException("Konfigurációs beállítás nem található: {0}", configName);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Try to get the string value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">Name of the config.</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">Just from local config</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// value
    /// </returns>
    public static string? TryGetStringValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false, IComponentContext? context = null)
    {
        string? val = GetConfigValue(configName, justLocalConfig, context);
        return val;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a bool config value
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config setting name</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">Just from local config</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// value
    /// </returns>
    public static bool GetBoolValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false, IComponentContext? context = null)
    {
        string val = GetStringValue(configName, justLocalConfig, context);
        var result = ConfigHelperFunctions.Convert2Bool(val);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Optional get bool value
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config setting name</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">Just from local config</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// value
    /// </returns>
    public static bool? TryGetBoolValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false)
    {
        var val = TryGetStringValue(configName, justLocalConfig);
        if (val == null)
            return null;

        bool result = ConfigHelperFunctions.Convert2Bool(val);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets an int config value
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config setting name</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">Just from local config</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// value
    /// </returns>
    public static int GetIntValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false, IComponentContext? context = null)
    {
        string val = GetStringValue(configName, justLocalConfig, context);
        int result = ConfigHelperFunctions.Convert2Int(val);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Try to get an int config value
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config setting name</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">Just from local config</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// value
    /// </returns>
    public static int? TryGetIntValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false)
    {
        var val = TryGetStringValue(configName, justLocalConfig);
        if (val == null)
            return null;

        int result = ConfigHelperFunctions.Convert2Int(val);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Try to get an long config value
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config setting name</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">Just from local config</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// value
    /// </returns>
    public static long? TryGetLongValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false)
    {
        var val = TryGetStringValue(configName, justLocalConfig);
        if (val == null)
            return null;

        long result = ConfigHelperFunctions.Convert2Long(val);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a datetime config value
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config setting name</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">Just from local config</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// value
    /// </returns>
    public static DateTime GetDateTimeValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false, IComponentContext? context = null)
    {
        string val = GetStringValue(configName, justLocalConfig, context);
        if (!DateTime.TryParseExact(val, "yyyy.MM.dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
            ConfigHelperFunctions.RaiseTypeMismatchException(configName);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get a TimeSpan config value
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config setting name</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">Just from local config</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// value
    /// </returns>
    public static TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false, IComponentContext? context = null)
    {
        string val = GetStringValue(configName, justLocalConfig, context);

        return ConfigHelperFunctions.Convert2TimeSpan(val);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Try to get a TimeSpan config value
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config setting name</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">Just from local config</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// value
    /// </returns>
    public static TimeSpan? TryGetTimeSpanValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false, IComponentContext? context = null)
    {
        var val = TryGetStringValue(configName, justLocalConfig);
        if (val == null)
            return null;

        return ConfigHelperFunctions.Convert2TimeSpan(val);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets if is in the config and has value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">Name of the config.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// true if is in config and has value
    /// </returns>
    public static bool IsInConfigAndHasValue(string configName)
    {
        var val = GetConfigValue(configName);
        return val != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(val);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the enum value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="configName">Name of the configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T GetEnumValue<T>(string configName)
    {
        string value = GetStringValue(configName);
        return (T)Enum.Parse(typeof(T), value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tries the get enum value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="configName">Name of the configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="defaultValue">The default value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T TryGetEnumValue<T>(string configName, T defaultValue)
    {
        var value = TryGetStringValue(configName);
        return value == null ? defaultValue : (T)Enum.Parse(typeof(T), value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the configuration section.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="sectionName">Name of the section.</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">if set to <c>true</c> [just local configuration].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentConfigurationException">Konfigurációs szekció nem található: {0}</exception>
    public static T GetConfigSection<T>(string sectionName, bool justLocalConfig = false)
        where T : class
    {
        var result = TryGetConfigSection<T>(sectionName, justLocalConfig);

        return result ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentConfigurationException("Konfigurációs szekció nem található: {0}", sectionName);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tries the get configuration section.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="sectionName">Name of the section.</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">if set to <c>true</c> [just local configuration].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T? TryGetConfigSection<T>(string sectionName, bool justLocalConfig = false)
        where T : class
    {
        T? result = null;

        if (TestProvider != null)
            result = TestProvider.GetConfigSection<T>(sectionName);

        if (LocalProvider != null && result == null)
            result = LocalProvider.GetConfigSection<T>(sectionName);
        
        if (Provider != null && result == null && !justLocalConfig)
            result = Provider.GetConfigSection<T>(sectionName);

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generic config property access with defaultValue support
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="config">The config.</param>
    /// <param name="defaultValue">The default value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    public static T GetConfig<T>(Expression<Func<T>> config, T defaultValue)
    {
        T result = default!;
        if (config.Body is MemberExpression memberExpression)
        {
            var prop = memberExpression.Member as PropertyInfo;
            if (prop != null)
            {
                var val = prop.GetValue(null);
                if (val == null)
                {
                    result = defaultValue;
                    prop.SetValue(null, result);
                }
                else if (val is T t)
                    result = t;
            }
            else
                throw new InvalidOperationException();
        }
        else
            throw new InvalidOperationException();
        return result!;
    }

    #region Implementation
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the configuration value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">Name of the configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="justLocalConfig">if set to <c>true</c> [just local configuration].</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">LocalProvider</exception>
    private static string? GetConfigValue(string configName, bool justLocalConfig = false, IComponentContext? context = null)
    {
        if (LocalProvider == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException(nameof(LocalProvider));

        string? val = null;

        if (TestProvider != null)
            val = TestProvider.GetConfigValue(configName);

        if (val == null && LocalProvider != null)
            val = LocalProvider.GetConfigValue(configName);

        if (val == null && Provider != null && !justLocalConfig)
            val = Provider.GetConfigValue(configName, context);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val) && val.IndexOf(PlaceHolderAppPath, StringComparison.Ordinal) != -1)
        {
            val = val.Replace(PlaceHolderAppPath, AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory.Trim('\\'));
        }

        return val;
    }
    #endregion
}

/// <summary>
/// ConfigHelperFunctions
/// </summary>
public static class ConfigHelperFunctions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Convert2s the int.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="val">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static int Convert2Int(string val)
    {
        if (!int.TryParse(val, out int result))
            RaiseTypeMismatchException(val);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Convert2s the long.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="val">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static long Convert2Long(string val)
    {
        if (!long.TryParse(val, out long result))
            RaiseTypeMismatchException(val);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Convert2s the bool.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="val">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool Convert2Bool(string val)
    {
        if (!bool.TryParse(val, out bool result))
            RaiseTypeMismatchException(val);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Convert2s the time span.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="val">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TimeSpan Convert2TimeSpan(string val)
    {
        if (!TimeSpan.TryParse(val, out var result))
            RaiseTypeMismatchException(val);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Raises the type mismatch exception.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="val">The value.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentConfigurationException">Konfigurációs beállítás típusa nem megfelelő: {0}</exception>
    public static void RaiseTypeMismatchException(string val)
    {
        throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentConfigurationException("Konfigurációs beállítás típusa nem megfelelő: {0}", val);
    }
}

namespace Common.Logic.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// DbConfigProvider
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Configuration.IConfigProvider" />
public class DbConfigProvider : IConfigProvider
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The system configuration cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SysConfigCache _sysConfigCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DbConfigProvider"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="lifetimeScope">The lifetime scope.</param>
    public DbConfigProvider(ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope)
    {
        _sysConfigCache = lifetimeScope.Resolve<SysConfigCache>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get configuration value by name
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config value</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// config name
    /// </returns>
    public string? GetConfigValue(string configName)
    {
        string? result = _sysConfigCache.GetContent()
            .SingleOrDefault(x => x.ConfigName!.Equals(configName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
            ?.ConfigValue;
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get configuration value by name
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config value</param>
    /// <param name="context"></param>
    /// <returns>
    /// config name
    /// </returns>
    public string? GetConfigValue(string configName, IComponentContext? context)
    {
        var result = _sysConfigCache
            .GetContent(context)
            .SingleOrDefault(x => x.ConfigName!.Equals(configName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
            ?.ConfigValue;
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get configuration section object
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">section type</typeparam>
    /// <param name="sectionName">section name</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// section object
    /// </returns>
    public T GetConfigSection<T>(string sectionName)
    {
        return default;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

namespace Common.Logic.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// DotNetCoreConfigProvider
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Configuration.IConfigProvider" />
public class DotNetCoreConfigProvider : IConfigProvider
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The configuration
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DotNetCoreConfigProvider"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configuration">The configuration.</param>
    public DotNetCoreConfigProvider(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _configuration = configuration;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get configuration value by name
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config value</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// config name
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">.NET Core configuration not accessible</exception>
    public string GetConfigValue(string configName)
    {
        if (configName.Contains("."))
            configName = configName.Replace(".", ":");

        if (_configuration is null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(".NET Core configuration not accessible");
        return _configuration[configName];
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get configuration value by name
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configName">config value</param>
    /// <param name="context"></param>
    /// <returns>
    /// config name
    /// </returns>
    public string? GetConfigValue(string configName, IComponentContext? context)
    {
        return GetConfigValue(configName);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get configuration section object
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">section type</typeparam>
    /// <param name="sectionName">section name</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// section object
    /// </returns>
    public T GetConfigSection<T>(string sectionName)
    {
        return _configuration.GetSection(sectionName).Get<T>();
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;

namespace Common.Logic.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// SysConfig
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces.IEntityDto" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces.ISame" />
public class SysConfig : IEntityDto, ISame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The identifier.
    /// </value>
    public int Id { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the name of the configuration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the configuration.
    /// </value>
    public string? ConfigName { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the configuration value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The configuration value.
    /// </value>
    public string? ConfigValue { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sames the specified object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool Same(object? obj)
    {
        return obj is SysConfig sysConfig && sysConfig.ConfigName == this.ConfigName;
    }
}

using System.Runtime.Loader;
using Autofac;
using Autofac.Core;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// AutofacExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class AutofacExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the named parameter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="parameters">The parameters.</param>
    /// <param name="parameterName">Name of the parameter.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T? GetNamedParameter<T>(this IEnumerable<Autofac.Core.Parameter> parameters, string parameterName)
    {
        var param = parameters.Cast<NamedParameter>()
            .Where(x => x.Name == parameterName)
            .SingleEx("Parameter not found", "Ambiguous parameter", "Parameter name: {0}", parameterName);
        return (T?)param.Value;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tries the get named parameter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="parameters">The parameters.</param>
    /// <param name="parameterName">Name of the parameter.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T? TryGetNamedParameter<T>(this IEnumerable<Autofac.Core.Parameter> parameters, string parameterName)
    {
        var param = parameters.Cast<NamedParameter>()
            .Where(x => x.Name == parameterName)
            .SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous parameter: {0}", parameterName);
        if (param == null)
            return default;
        return (T?)param.Value;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether the specified parameter name has parameter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="parameters">The parameters.</param>
    /// <param name="parameterName">Name of the parameter.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if the specified parameter name has parameter; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    public static bool HasParameter(this IEnumerable<Autofac.Core.Parameter> parameters, string parameterName)
    {
        var result = parameters.Cast<NamedParameter>().Count(x => x.Name == parameterName) == 1;
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Registers as implemented interfaces.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder.</param>
    public static void RegisterAsImplementedInterfaces<T>(this ContainerBuilder builder) where T : notnull
    {
        var assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()
            .Where(x => x.FullName != null && (x.FullName.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment."))).ToArray();

        builder.RegisterAssemblyTypes(assemblies)
            .Where(t => typeof(T).IsAssignableFrom(t))
            .As<T>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Loads the and register assemblies.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder.</param>
    /// <param name="selector">The selector.</param>
    public static void LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(this ContainerBuilder builder, Func<string, bool> selector)
    {
        var files = Directory.GetFiles(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "*.dll");
        var assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();

        foreach (var file in files)
        {
            var fileName = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file);
            if (selector(fileName))
            {
                var assembly = assemblies.FirstOrDefault(x => x.GetName().Name != null && x.GetName().Name!.Equals(fileName));
                if (assembly == null)
                {
                    var assemblyPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, fileName + ".dll");
                    assembly = AssemblyLoadContext.Default.LoadFromAssemblyPath(assemblyPath);
                }

                builder.RegisterAssemblyModules(assembly);

            }
        }

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the mapper configuration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static MapperConfiguration GetMapperConfiguration()
    {
        var profileTypes = AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblies(AssemblyType.Application).SelectMany(x => x.GetTypes())
            .Where(p => typeof(Profile).IsAssignableFrom(p) && p.IsPublic && !p.IsAbstract)
            .Distinct();

        var autoMapperProfiles = profileTypes
            .Select(p => (Profile?)Activator.CreateInstance(p)).ToList();

        var mapperConfig = new MapperConfiguration(cfg =>
        {
            foreach (var profile in autoMapperProfiles)
            {
                cfg.AddProfile(profile);
            }
        });

        return mapperConfig;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Registers the maps.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder.</param>
    public static void RegisterMaps(this ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        var mapperConfig = GetMapperConfiguration();

        builder.Register(ctx => mapperConfig.CreateMapper()).As<IMapper>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }


}

using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Types;

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// CommandExtensionss
/// </summary>
public static class CommandExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TEntityDto? CreateEntity<TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, TEntityDto entity, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        return UpdateEntity(commandService, entity, EntityUpdateAction.New, dbContextKey);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the entity asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <param name="updateAction">The update action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Task<TEntityDto?> CreateEntityAsync<TEntity, TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, TEntityDto entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, EntityUpdateAction updateAction = EntityUpdateAction.Update, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntity : IEntityDto
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        return UpdateEntityAsync<TEntity, TEntityDto>(commandService, entity, cancellationToken, EntityUpdateAction.New, dbContextKey);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the entity asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <param name="updateAction">The update action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Task<TEntityDto?> CreateEntityAsync<TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, TEntityDto entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, EntityUpdateAction updateAction = EntityUpdateAction.Update, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        return UpdateEntityAsync(commandService, entity, cancellationToken, EntityUpdateAction.New, dbContextKey);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <param name="updateAction">The update action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TEntityDto? UpdateEntity<TEntity, TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, TEntityDto entity, EntityUpdateAction updateAction = EntityUpdateAction.Update, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntity : IEntityDto
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        var command = new UpdateEntityCommand<TEntityDto> { Update = new EntityUpdate<TEntity, TEntityDto>(entity, updateAction) };
        var result = (UpdateEntityCommandResult)commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command, dbContextKey: dbContextKey).RunSync();
        if (result.UpdateResult == null) return default;
        return (TEntityDto)result.UpdateResult.Entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <param name="updateAction">The update action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TEntityDto? UpdateEntity<TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, TEntityDto entity, EntityUpdateAction updateAction = EntityUpdateAction.Update, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        var command = new UpdateEntityCommand { Update = new EntityUpdate(entity, updateAction) };
        var result = (UpdateEntityCommandResult)commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command, dbContextKey: dbContextKey).RunSync();
        if (result.UpdateResult == null) return default;
        return (TEntityDto)result.UpdateResult.Entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the entity asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <param name="updateAction">The update action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task<TEntityDto?> UpdateEntityAsync<TEntity, TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, TEntityDto entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, EntityUpdateAction updateAction = EntityUpdateAction.Update, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntity : IEntityDto
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        var command = new UpdateEntityCommand<TEntityDto> { Update = new EntityUpdate<TEntity, TEntityDto>(entity, updateAction) };
        var commandResult = await commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command, cancellationToken, dbContextKey);
        var result = (UpdateEntityCommandResult)commandResult;
        return (TEntityDto?)result.UpdateResult?.Entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the entity asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <param name="updateAction">The update action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task<TEntityDto?> UpdateEntityAsync<TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, TEntityDto entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, EntityUpdateAction updateAction = EntityUpdateAction.Update, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        var command = new UpdateEntityCommand { Update = new EntityUpdate(entity, updateAction) };
        var commandResult = await commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command, cancellationToken, dbContextKey);
        var result = (UpdateEntityCommandResult)commandResult;
        return (TEntityDto?)result.UpdateResult?.Entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes the entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entityId">The entity identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TEntityDto? DeleteEntity<TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, int entityId, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto, new()
    {
        return UpdateEntity(commandService, new TEntityDto { Id = entityId }, EntityUpdateAction.Delete, dbContextKey);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes the entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entityId">The entity identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TEntityDto? DeleteEntity<TEntity, TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, int entityId, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto, new()
        where TEntity : IEntityDto
    {
        return UpdateEntity<TEntity, TEntityDto>(commandService, new TEntityDto { Id = entityId }, EntityUpdateAction.Delete, dbContextKey);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes the entity asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="entityId">The entity identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <param name="updateAction">The update action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Task<TEntityDto> DeleteEntityAsync<TEntityDto>(this ICommandService commandService, int entityId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, EntityUpdateAction updateAction = EntityUpdateAction.Update, string? dbContextKey = default)
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto, new()
    {
        return UpdateEntityAsync(commandService, new TEntityDto { Id = entityId }, cancellationToken, EntityUpdateAction.Delete, dbContextKey);
    }
}

using System.Globalization;

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// DateTimeExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class DateTimeExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 
    /// </summary>
    public enum RoundingType
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The round
        /// </summary>
        Round = 0,
        /// <summary>
        /// The floor
        /// </summary>
        Floor = 1,
        /// <summary>
        /// The ceil
        /// </summary>
        Ceil = 2
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to year start.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime TruncateToYearStart(this DateTime dt)
    {
        return new DateTime(dt.Year, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to month start.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime TruncateToMonthStart(this DateTime dt)
    {
        return new DateTime(dt.Year, dt.Month, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to week start.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <param name="weekStartDay">The week start day. (Monday, etc.)</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime TruncateToWeekStart(this DateTime dt, DayOfWeek weekStartDay = DayOfWeek.Monday)
    {
        var daysToSubtract = (int)dt.DayOfWeek - (int)weekStartDay;
        if (daysToSubtract < 0) daysToSubtract += 7;
        return dt.AddDays(-daysToSubtract).TruncateToDayStart();
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to day start.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime TruncateToDayStart(this DateTime dt)
    {
        return new DateTime(dt.Year, dt.Month, dt.Day, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to hour start.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime TruncateToHourStart(this DateTime dt)
    {
        return new DateTime(dt.Year, dt.Month, dt.Day, dt.Hour, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to minute start.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime TruncateToMinuteStart(this DateTime dt)
    {
        return new DateTime(dt.Year, dt.Month, dt.Day, dt.Hour, dt.Minute, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to second start.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime TruncateToSecondStart(this DateTime dt)
    {
        return new DateTime(dt.Year, dt.Month, dt.Day, dt.Hour, dt.Minute, dt.Second, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to day end.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime TruncateToDayEnd(this DateTime dt)
    {
        return dt.TruncateToDayStart().AddDays(1).AddTicks(-1);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to day end.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime? TruncateToDayEnd(this DateTime? dt)
    {
        return dt?.TruncateToDayEnd();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Truncates to day start.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime? TruncateToDayStart(this DateTime? dt)
    {
        return dt?.TruncateToDayStart();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az adott dátumértékhez legközelebbi interval értékre kerekítve adja vissza.
    /// Pl. ha az interval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5), akkor a megadott dátum értéket
    /// a legközelebbi kerek 5 perc dátumra kerekítve adja vissza.
    /// Round kerekítés esetén kerekít, Floor esetén lefelé kerekítve, Ceil esetén felfelé kerekítve
    /// Round esetén pl.: 16:31 -&gt; 16:30, 16:33 -&gt; 16:35, stb.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <param name="interval">A kerekítés pontossága, pl.: TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)</param>
    /// <param name="rounding">The rounding.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime RoundToClosestInterval(this DateTime dt, TimeSpan interval, RoundingType rounding = RoundingType.Round)
    {
        switch (rounding)
        {
            case RoundingType.Floor:
                return new DateTime((long)Math.Floor(dt.Ticks / (double)interval.Ticks) * interval.Ticks, dt.Kind);
            case RoundingType.Ceil:
                return new DateTime((long)Math.Ceiling(dt.Ticks / (double)interval.Ticks) * interval.Ticks, dt.Kind);
            case RoundingType.Round:
            default:
                return new DateTime((long)Math.Round(dt.Ticks / (double)interval.Ticks) * interval.Ticks, dt.Kind);
        }

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Unixes the timestamp total milliseconds.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static long? UnixTimestampTotalMilliseconds(this DateTime dt) => (dt as DateTime?).UnixTimestampTotalMilliseconds();
    /// <summary>
    /// Unixes the timestamp total milliseconds.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static long? UnixTimestampTotalMilliseconds(this DateTime? dt)
    {
        var epoch = DateTime.UnixEpoch;
        var timestamp = dt != null ?
                            (long?)(dt.Value.ToUniversalTime() - epoch).TotalMilliseconds :
                            default;
        return timestamp;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Dates the time from unix time stamp milliseconds.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="timestamp">The timestamp.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime DateTimeFromUnixTimeStampMilliseconds(this long timestamp) => (timestamp as long?).DateTimeFromUnixTimeStampMilliseconds();
    /// <summary>
    /// Dates the time from unix time stamp milliseconds.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="timestamp">The timestamp.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime DateTimeFromUnixTimeStampMilliseconds(this long? timestamp)
    {
        var epoch = DateTime.UnixEpoch;
        var dateTime = epoch.AddMilliseconds(timestamp ?? 0).ToLocalTime();
        return dateTime;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Unixes the timestamp total seconds.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static long? UnixTimestampTotalSeconds(this DateTime dt) => (dt as DateTime?).UnixTimestampTotalSeconds();
    /// <summary>
    /// Unixes the timestamp total seconds.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt">The dt.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static long? UnixTimestampTotalSeconds(this DateTime? dt)
    {
        var epoch = DateTime.UnixEpoch;
        var timestamp = dt != null ?
                            (long?)(dt.Value.ToUniversalTime() - epoch).TotalSeconds :
                            default;
        return timestamp;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Két dátum közül a korábbi dátumot adja vissza.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="date1">The date1.</param>
    /// <param name="date2">The date2.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime Earlier(this DateTime date1, DateTime date2)
    {
        return (date1 < date2) ? date1 : date2;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Két dátum közül a korábbi dátumot adja vissza.
    /// Null érték korábbinak számít egy nem-null értékhez képest.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="date1">The date1.</param>
    /// <param name="date2">The date2.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime? Earlier(this DateTime? date1, DateTime? date2)
    {
        if (!date1.HasValue && !date2.HasValue)
            return null;

        DateTime _date1 = date1 ?? DateTime.MinValue;
        DateTime _date2 = date2 ?? DateTime.MinValue;

        return (_date1 < _date2) ? date1 : date2;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Két dátum közül a későbbi dátumot adja vissza.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="date1">The date1.</param>
    /// <param name="date2">The date2.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime Later(this DateTime date1, DateTime date2)
    {
        return (date1 < date2) ? date2 : date1;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Két dátum közül a későbbi dátumot adja vissza.
    /// Null érték későbbinek számít egy nem-null értékez képest.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="date1">The date1.</param>
    /// <param name="date2">The date2.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime? Later(this DateTime? date1, DateTime? date2)
    {
        if (!date1.HasValue && !date2.HasValue)
            return null;

        DateTime _date1 = date1 ?? DateTime.MaxValue;
        DateTime _date2 = date2 ?? DateTime.MaxValue;

        return (_date1 < _date2) ? date2 : date1;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Dátum sztring alakja pl. 2000.01.01
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dateTime">The date time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string? DateStr(this DateTime? dateTime)
    {
        return !dateTime.HasValue ? string.Empty : dateTime.Value.ToString("yyyy.MM.dd");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Magyar helyi idő =&gt; UTC dátum. Sajnos a téli nyári időszámítás gondot okozhat, ezért megfelelő
    /// elővigyázatossággal alkalmazzuk! Árfolyam excel esetén csak napok vannak ott használható, de
    /// a HUPX excel esetén problematikus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="sourceDateTime">The source date time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime GetUtcFromHungarianLocalTime(this DateTime sourceDateTime)
    {
        TimeZoneInfo hungarianTimeZone = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Europe/Budapest");
        DateTime utcTime = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeToUtc(sourceDateTime, hungarianTimeZone);
        return utcTime;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// UTC dátum a magyar helyi időből.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="sourceDateTime">The source date time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime GetHungarianLocalTimeFromUtc(this DateTime sourceDateTime)
    {
        TimeZoneInfo hungarianTimeZone = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Europe/Budapest");
        DateTime localTime = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(sourceDateTime.ToUniversalTime(), hungarianTimeZone);
        return localTime;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy UTC dátumból magyar helyi időt képez, majd e helyi idő nap vége dátumot UTC-re visszaalakítva visszaadja
    /// </summary>
    public static DateTime GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay(this DateTime utcDateTime)
    {
        TimeZoneInfo hungarianTimeZone = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Europe/Budapest");

        // Convert UTC to local time
        DateTime localDateTime = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcDateTime, hungarianTimeZone);

        // Calculate the end of the day in the local time zone
        DateTime endOfDay = new DateTime(localDateTime.Year, localDateTime.Month, localDateTime.Day, 23, 59, 59, DateTimeKind.Unspecified);
        DateTime endOfDayLocal = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeToUtc(endOfDay, hungarianTimeZone);
        return endOfDayLocal;
    }

    public static DateOnly ToDateOnly(this DateTime dateTime) => DateOnly.FromDateTime(dateTime);
    public static DateOnly? ToDateOnly(this DateTime? dateTime) => dateTime.HasValue ? DateOnly.FromDateTime(dateTime.Value) : null;


    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the previous lower boundary of the given interval. If the moment is at the interval boundary, it returns the same moment.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dt"></param>
    /// <param name="interval"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime GetPreviousBoundary(this DateTime dt, TimeSpan interval)
    {
        long ticks = dt.Ticks - (dt.Ticks % interval.Ticks);
        return new DateTime(ticks, dt.Kind);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the next upper boundary of the given interval. Includes the start moment of the next interval.
    /// </summary>
    public static DateTime GetNextBoundary(this DateTime dt, TimeSpan interval)
    {
        return dt.GetPreviousBoundary(interval).Add(interval);
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Reflection;

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// EnumExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class EnumExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the display name.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="e">The e.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string? GetDisplayName(this Enum e)
    {
        var attr = GetDisplayAttribute(e);
        return attr != null ? attr.Name : e.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the display name of the flags.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="enumValue">The enum value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException"></exception>
    public static string? GetFlagsDisplayName(this Enum enumValue)
    {
        var enumType = enumValue.GetType();
        var names = Enum.GetValues(enumType).Cast<Enum>().Where(enumValue.HasFlag).Select(flag => flag.GetDisplayName()).ToList();

        if (names.Count <= 0) throw new ArgumentException();
        return names.Count == 1 ? names.First() : string.Join(", ", names);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the description.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="e">The e.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string? GetDescription(this Enum e)
    {
        var attr = GetDisplayAttribute(e);
        return attr != null ? attr.Description : e.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the display attribute.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Type {type} is not an enum</exception>
    private static DisplayAttribute? GetDisplayAttribute(object value)
    {
        var type = value.GetType();
        if (!type.IsEnum)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException($"Type {type} is not an enum");
        }

        return type.GetField(value.ToString() ?? string.Empty)?.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Extension method to return an enum value of type T for the given string.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T ToEnum<T>(this string value)
    {
        return (T)Enum.Parse(typeof(T), value, true);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// https://www.ryadel.com/en/asyncutil-c-helper-class-async-method-sync-result-wait/
/// </summary>
public static class AsyncUtil
{
    private static readonly TaskFactory _taskFactory = new
        TaskFactory(CancellationToken.None,
            TaskCreationOptions.None,
            TaskContinuationOptions.None,
            TaskScheduler.Default);

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes an async Task method which has a void return value synchronously
    /// USAGE: AsyncUtil.RunSync(() => AsyncMethod());
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="task">Task method to execute</param>
    public static void RunSync(Func<Task> task)
        => _taskFactory
            .StartNew(task)
            .Unwrap()
            .GetAwaiter()
            .GetResult();

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes an async Task<T> method which has a T return type synchronously
    /// USAGE: T result = AsyncUtil.RunSync(() => AsyncMethod<T>());
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">Return Type</typeparam>
    /// <param name="task">Task<T> method to execute</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TResult RunSync<TResult>(Func<Task<TResult>> task)
        => _taskFactory
            .StartNew(task)
            .Unwrap()
            .GetAwaiter()
            .GetResult();
}

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// ListExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class ListExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Singles the or default ex.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="items">The items.</param>
    /// <param name="errorText">The error text.</param>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">items</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    public static T? SingleOrDefaultEx<T>(this IEnumerable<T> items, string errorText, params object[] args)
    {
        if (items == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(items));

        var res = items.ToList();
        if (res.Count == 0)
            return default;
        if (res.Count == 1)
            return res[0];

        if (args != null)
            errorText = string.Format(errorText, args);

        throw new InvalidOperationException(errorText);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Singles the ex.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="items">The items.</param>
    /// <param name="zeroText">The zero text.</param>
    /// <param name="ambigousText">The ambigous text.</param>
    /// <param name="endingText">The ending text.</param>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    public static T SingleEx<T>(this IEnumerable<T> items, string zeroText, string ambigousText, string endingText,
        params object[] args)
    {
        var result = items.SingleOrDefaultEx(string.Concat(ambigousText, " ", endingText), args);
        if (result == null || result.Equals(default(T)))
        {
            var text = string.Concat(zeroText, " ", endingText);
            if (args != null)
                text = string.Format(text, args);
            throw new InvalidOperationException(text);
        }
        return result;
    }
    public static bool TrySearchFor<T>(this IEnumerable<T> list, Func<T, bool> predicate, out T result)
    {
        return !Equals(result = list.FirstOrDefault(predicate), default(T));
    }
}

    /// <param name="getFunc">The get function.</param>

    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TVal Return<T, TVal>(this T? value, Func<T, TVal> getFunc, TVal defaultValue)
        where T : class
    {
        var result = defaultValue;
        if (value != default(T))
            result = getFunc(value);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whens the specified action.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [Obsolete("Use pattern matching instead")]
    public static bool When<T>(this object value, Action<T> action)
        where T : class
    {
        if (value is T obj)
        {
            action(obj);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whens the result.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>

    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>

    public static TResult? WhenResult<T, TResult>(this object value, Func<T, TResult> action)
        where T : class
    {
        TResult? result = default;

        if (value is T obj)
            result = action(obj);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whens the result.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>

    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <param name="result">The result.</param>

    [Obsolete("Use pattern matching instead")]
    public static bool WhenResult<T, TResult>(this object value, Func<T, TResult> action, out IEntity? result)
        where T : class
        where TResult : IEntity
    {
        result = null;

        if (value is T obj)
        {
            result = action(obj);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// <returns></returns>
    [Obsolete("Use pattern matching instead")]

        where T : class
        where TResult : class

{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the by identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TEntity GetById<TEntity>(this IQueryService queryService, int id)
        where TEntity : IEntityDto
    {
        var query = new EntityByIdQuery<TEntity>() { Id = id };
        var result = queryService.QuerySingleEntity(query).RunSync();
        return (TEntity)((EntityQuerySingleResult)result).Entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the by identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Entity {0} with {1} id not found</exception>
    public static TEntityDto GetById<TEntity, TEntityDto>(this IQueryService queryService, int id)
        where TEntity : IEntityDto
        where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        var query = new EntityByIdQuery<TEntity, TEntityDto>() { Id = id };
        var result = queryService.QuerySingleEntity(query).RunSync() ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Entity {0} with {1} id not found", typeof(TEntity).EntityTypeName(), id);
        return (TEntityDto)((EntityQuerySingleResult)result).Entity;
    }
