    public static async Task<TEntity> GetByIdAsync<TEntity>(this IQueryService queryService, int id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        where TEntity : IEntityDto
    {
        var query = new EntityByIdQuery<TEntity>() { Id = id };
        var result = (await queryService.QuerySingleEntity(query, cancellationToken)) ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Entity {0} with {1} id not found", typeof(TEntity).EntityTypeName(), id);
        return (TEntity)((EntityQuerySingleResult)result).Entity;
    }

using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// ReflectionExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class ReflectionExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The property information cache
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Type, PropertyInfo[]> _propertyInfoCache = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, PropertyInfo[]>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the attribute.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="member">The member.</param>
    /// <param name="inherit">if set to <c>true</c> [inherit].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T? GetAttribute<T>(this MemberInfo member, bool inherit = false)
        where T : Attribute
    {
        return member.GetCustomAttributes(inherit).OfType<T>().SingleOrDefault();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the required attribute.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="member">The member.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    public static T GetRequiredAttribute<T>(this MemberInfo member)
        where T : Attribute
    {
        var attrib = member.GetCustomAttribute<T>();
        if (attrib == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{typeof(T).Name} not found: {member.Name}");
        return attrib;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the object values.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="type">The type.</param>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="valueFormatter">The value formatter.</param>
    /// <param name="emptyValueFormatter">The empty value formatter.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">type</exception>
    public static Dictionary<string, object?> GetObjectValues(this Type type, object obj,
        Func<object?, object?>? valueFormatter = null,
        Func<object?, object?>? emptyValueFormatter = null)
    {
        if (type == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException("type");

        var result = new Dictionary<string, object?>();
        if (obj == null)
            return result;

        PropertyInfo[] propertyInfoColl = _propertyInfoCache.GetOrAdd(type, t =>
        {
            return t.GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Instance |
                    BindingFlags.Public);
        });
        foreach (var propertyInfo in propertyInfoColl)
        {
            if (propertyInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(SkipPropertyAttribute), true).Any())
                continue;

            object? value = propertyInfo.GetValue(obj);
            object? formattedValue = null;

            if (emptyValueFormatter == null)
                emptyValueFormatter = EmptyValueDefaultFormatter;

            formattedValue = emptyValueFormatter(value);

            if (formattedValue == null && valueFormatter != null)
                formattedValue = valueFormatter(value);

            var propDesc = propertyInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DescriptionAttribute), false).Cast<DescriptionAttribute>().SingleOrDefault();
            var propName = propDesc != null ? propDesc.Description : propertyInfo.Name;

            result.Add(propName, formattedValue);
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Emptys the value default formatter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static object? EmptyValueDefaultFormatter(object? value)
    {
        const string formattedEmptyValue = "(üres)";

        if (value == null)
        {
            return formattedEmptyValue;
        }

        if (value is ICollection collection && collection.Count == 0)
        {
            return formattedEmptyValue;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Builds the getter expression.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="prop">The property.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Expression<Func<T, object>> BuildGetterExpression<T>(this PropertyInfo prop)
    {
        var param = Expression.Parameter(typeof(T), "x");
        Expression expression = Expression.PropertyOrField(param, prop.Name);

        if (prop.PropertyType.IsValueType)
            expression = Expression.Convert(expression, typeof(object));

        return Expression.Lambda<Func<T, object>>(expression, param);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Fors the nested property.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="columnName">Name of the column.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Expression<Func<T, object>> ForNestedProperty<T>(string columnName)
    {
        ParameterExpression param = Expression.Parameter(typeof(T), "x");

        Expression property = columnName.Split('.')
                                        .Aggregate<string, Expression>
                                        (param, (c, m) => Expression.Property(c, m));

        Expression<Func<T, object>> lambda = Expression.Lambda<Func<T, object>>(
            Expression.Convert(property, typeof(object)), param);
        return lambda;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Security;

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// SharedSecurityExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class SharedSecurityExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers the security context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder.</param>
    public static void RegisterSecurityContext(this ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.Register((c, p) =>
        {
            var securityContext = p.TryGetNamedParameter<SecurityContext>("securityContext");
            if (securityContext != null)
                return securityContext;

            return null;
        }).InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the system context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public static void SetSystemContext(this ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var securityContext = SecurityContext.Create(
            scope,
            SecUser.System, 
            sessionId: null, 
            clientIp: null);
        SetSecurityContext(scope, securityContext);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the anonymous context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">The session identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="clientIp">The client ip.</param>
    public static void SetAnonymousContext(this ILifetimeScope scope, string? tenantCode, string? sessionId = null, string? clientIp = null)
    {
        var securityContext = SecurityContext.Create(
            scope,
            SecUser.AnonymousSecUser(tenantCode),
            sessionId: sessionId, 
            clientIp: clientIp);
        SetSecurityContext(scope, securityContext);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the tenant admin user context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">The session identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="clientIp">The client ip.</param>
    public static void SetTenantAdminUserContext(this ILifetimeScope scope, string? tenantCode, string? sessionId = null, string? clientIp = null)
    {
        var securityContext = SecurityContext.Create(
            scope,
            SecUser.TenantAdminUser(tenantCode),
            sessionId: sessionId,
            clientIp: clientIp);
        SetSecurityContext(scope, securityContext);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the security context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public static void SetSecurityContext(this ILifetimeScope scope, SecurityContext securityContext)
    {
        scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>(new NamedParameter("securityContext", securityContext));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Overrides the security.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="securable">The securable.</param>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <param name="checkAcces">if set to <c>true</c> [check acces].</param>
    public static void OverrideSecurity<T>(this T securable, Action<T> action, bool checkAcces)
    {
        bool origCheckAccess = false;
        if (securable != null)
        {
            securable.When<ISecurable>(s =>
            {
                origCheckAccess = s.IsCheckAccessEnabled;
                s.IsCheckAccessEnabled = checkAcces;
            });

            action(securable);
            securable.When<ISecurable>(s => s.IsCheckAccessEnabled = origCheckAccess);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether the specified entity type name has right.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="entityTypeName">Name of the entity type.</param>
    /// <param name="op">The op.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if the specified entity type name has right; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    public static bool HasRight(this SecurityContext securityContext, string entityTypeName, SecurityOperation op)
    {
        return securityContext.HasRight(Shared.Extensions.SharedSecurityExtensions.CalcOperation(entityTypeName, op));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether the specified op has right.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="op">The op.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if the specified op has right; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    public static bool HasRight<T>(this SecurityContext securityContext, SecurityOperation op)
    {
        return securityContext.HasRight(Shared.Extensions.SharedSecurityExtensions.CalcOperation<T>(op));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the right.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="entityTypeName">Name of the entity type.</param>
    /// <param name="op">The op.</param>
    public static void CheckRight(this SecurityContext securityContext, string entityTypeName, SecurityOperation op)
    {
        securityContext.CheckRight(Shared.Extensions.SharedSecurityExtensions.CalcOperation(entityTypeName, op));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the right.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="op">The op.</param>
    public static void CheckRight<T>(this SecurityContext securityContext, SecurityOperation op)
    {
        securityContext.CheckRight(Shared.Extensions.SharedSecurityExtensions.CalcOperation<T>(op));
    }

}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions;

public static class StringManipulationExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A string minden karakterét kisbetűsre cseréli.
    /// Eltávolítja az ékezeteket és a speciális karaktereket.
    /// A space-eket alulvonásra cseréli.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="text">A módosítandó string</param>
    public static string RemoveAccentsAndChangeSpaceToUnderscore(this string text)
    {
        text = text.ToLower();
        text = Regex.Replace(text, @"[^0-9a-zA-Zá-ű\s]", "", RegexOptions.None, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(2000));
        StringBuilder sbReturn = new();
        var arrayText = text.Normalize(NormalizationForm.FormD).ToCharArray();
        foreach (char letter in arrayText)
        {
            if (CharUnicodeInfo.GetUnicodeCategory(letter) == UnicodeCategory.SpaceSeparator)
                sbReturn.Append('_');
            else if (CharUnicodeInfo.GetUnicodeCategory(letter) != UnicodeCategory.NonSpacingMark)
                sbReturn.Append(letter);
        }
        return sbReturn.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Lecseréljük a magyar ékezetes karaktereket angol betűkre. 
    /// Kisbetűk/nagybetűk maradnak, a speciális karakterek, - beleértve a space-eket - maradnak.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="text">A módosítandó string</param>
    public static string ToEnglishAlphabets(this string text)
    {
        StringBuilder sbReturn = new();
        var arrayText = text.ToCharArray();

        Dictionary<char, char> hungarianToEnglishCharactersDict = new()
        {
            // Árvíztűrő tükörfúrógép
            { 'Á', 'A' },
            { 'á', 'a' },
            { 'É', 'E' },
            { 'é', 'e' },
            { 'Í', 'I' },
            { 'í', 'i' },
            { 'Ó', 'O' },
            { 'ó', 'o' },
            { 'Ö', 'O' },
            { 'ö', 'o' },
            { 'Ő', 'O' },
            { 'ő', 'o' },
            { 'Ú', 'U' },
            { 'ú', 'u' },
            { 'Ü', 'U' },
            { 'ü', 'u' },
            { 'Ű', 'U' },
            { 'ű', 'u' }
        };

        foreach (char letter in arrayText)
        {
            char englishLetter = hungarianToEnglishCharactersDict.ContainsKey(letter) ? hungarianToEnglishCharactersDict.GetValueOrDefault(letter) : letter;
            sbReturn.Append(englishLetter);
        }
        return sbReturn.ToString();
    }
}

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// TypeExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class TypeExtensions
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether [is numeric type].
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="type">The type.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [is numeric type] [the specified type]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    public static bool IsNumericType(this Type type)
    {
        if (type.IsEnum) return false;
        switch (Type.GetTypeCode(type))
        {
            case TypeCode.Byte:
            case TypeCode.SByte:
            case TypeCode.UInt16:
            case TypeCode.UInt32:
            case TypeCode.UInt64:
            case TypeCode.Int16:
            case TypeCode.Int32:
            case TypeCode.Int64:
            case TypeCode.Decimal:
            case TypeCode.Double:
            case TypeCode.Single:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether [is logical type].
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="type">The type.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [is logical type] [the specified type]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    public static bool IsLogicalType(this Type type)
    {
        switch (Type.GetTypeCode(type))
        {
            case TypeCode.Boolean:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

}

namespace Common.Logic.Extensions.Validity;

public interface IDateOnlyClosedValidityRange
{
    DateOnly ValidFrom { get; }
    DateOnly ValidTo { get; }
}
public interface IDateOnlyOpenValidityRange
{
    DateOnly ValidFrom { get; }
    DateOnly? ValidTo { get; }
}

public static class ValidityExtensions
{
    #region
    public static bool OverlapsWith(this IDateOnlyClosedValidityRange thisValidity, IDateOnlyClosedValidityRange otherValidity)
    {
        // If this ends before other starts => no overlap
        if (thisValidity.ValidTo < otherValidity.ValidFrom)
            return false;
        // If other ends before this starts => no overlap
        if (otherValidity.ValidTo < thisValidity.ValidFrom)
            return false;
        // All other cases mean overlap
        return true;
    }

    public static bool OverlapsWith(this IDateOnlyOpenValidityRange thisValidity, IDateOnlyOpenValidityRange otherValidity)
    {
        // If this ends before other starts => no overlap
        if (thisValidity.ValidTo.HasValue && thisValidity.ValidTo.Value < otherValidity.ValidFrom)
            return false;
        // If other ends before this starts => no overlap
        if (otherValidity.ValidTo.HasValue && otherValidity.ValidTo.Value < thisValidity.ValidFrom)
            return false;
        // Otherwise, overlap
        return true;
    }
    #endregion

    #region HasGaps
    /// <summary>
    /// Checks if there are gaps in the sorted list of closed-ended validities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="sortedValidities">A list of validities, where there are no overlaps, and the list is already sorted by ValidFrom</param>
    public static bool HasGaps(this IReadOnlyList<IDateOnlyClosedValidityRange> sortedValidities)
    {
        //quick return if we're certain without looping
        if (sortedValidities == null || sortedValidities.Count < 2)
            return false;

        return sortedValidities
            .Zip(sortedValidities.Skip(1), (current, next) => new { current, next }) // pairs each item with its next one.
            .Any(pair => pair.next.ValidFrom > pair.current.ValidTo.AddDays(1));     // checks for a gap (i.e. if next.ValidFrom > current.ValidTo + 1).
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks if there are gaps in the sorted list of open-ended validities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="sortedValidities">A list of validities, where there are no overlaps, and the list is already sorted by ValidFrom</param>
    public static bool HasGaps(this IReadOnlyList<IDateOnlyOpenValidityRange> sortedValidities)
    {
        //quick return if we're certain without looping
        if (sortedValidities == null || sortedValidities.Count < 2 || sortedValidities[0].ValidTo.HasValue == false)
            return false;

        return sortedValidities
            .Zip(sortedValidities.Skip(1), (current, next) => new { current, next })    // pairs each item with its next one.
            .TakeWhile(pair => pair.current.ValidTo.HasValue)                           // stops evaluating if an open-ended range (ValidTo == null) is found
            .Any(pair => pair.next.ValidFrom > pair.current.ValidTo!.Value.AddDays(1)); // checks for a gap (i.e. if next.ValidFrom > current.ValidTo + 1).

        /* for (int i = 0; i < sortedValidities.Count - 1; i++)
         {
             var current = sortedValidities[i];
             var next = sortedValidities[i + 1];

             // If current is open-ended, we can't continue checking
             if (!current.ValidTo.HasValue)
                 return false;

             //check for expected next start
             if (next.ValidFrom > current.ValidTo.Value.AddDays(1))
             {
                 // There is a gap between current.ValidTo and next.ValidFrom
                 return true;
             }
         }

         return false;*/
    }
    #endregion

}

using System.Reflection;

namespace Common.Logic.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// AssemblyType
/// </summary>
[Flags]
public enum AssemblyType
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The shared
    /// </summary>
    Shared = 1,
    /// <summary>
    /// The back end
    /// </summary>
    BackEnd = 2,
    /// <summary>
    /// The front end
    /// </summary>
    FrontEnd = 4,
    /// <summary>
    /// The application
    /// </summary>
    Application = 7,
    /// <summary>
    /// The device type
    /// </summary>
    DeviceType = 8
}

/// <summary>
/// 
/// </summary>
public static class AssemblyHelper
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the assemblies.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="assemblyType">Type of the assembly.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Assembly[] GetAssemblies(AssemblyType assemblyType)
    {
        var result = new List<Assembly>();
        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.Shared))
            result.AddRange(GetAssemblies(".Shared"));
        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.BackEnd))
            result.AddRange(GetAssemblies(".BackEnd"));
        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.FrontEnd))
            result.AddRange(GetAssemblies(".FrontEnd"));
        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.FrontEnd))
            result.AddRange(GetAssemblies(".WebAPI"));
        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.DeviceType))
            result.AddRange(GetAssemblies(".DeviceType"));
        return result.ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the type of the assembly.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="assembly">The assembly.</param>
    /// <param name="assemblyType">Type of the assembly.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool CheckAssemblyType(string assembly, AssemblyType assemblyType)
    {
        var result = assembly.StartsWith($"EnergiaMenedzsment.");

        var isOk = true;

        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.Shared))
            isOk = assembly.Contains(".Shared");
        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.BackEnd))
            isOk = isOk || assembly.Contains(".BackEnd");
        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.FrontEnd))
            isOk = isOk || assembly.Contains(".FrontEnd");
        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.FrontEnd))
            isOk = isOk || assembly.Contains(".WebAPI");
        if (assemblyType.HasFlag(AssemblyType.DeviceType))
            isOk = isOk || assembly.Contains(".DeviceType");

        return result && isOk;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the assemblies.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="searchText">The search text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static Assembly[] GetAssemblies(string searchText)
    {
        var result = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()
            .Where(x => 
                x.FullName != null &&
                x.FullName!.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.") && 
                x.FullName!.Contains(searchText)).ToArray();
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the assembly informational version.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="type">The type.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(Type? type = null)
    {
        var assembly = type?.Assembly ?? Assembly.GetEntryAssembly();
        var versionAttribute = assembly?.GetCustomAttribute<AssemblyInformationalVersionAttribute>();
        var version = versionAttribute?.InformationalVersion ?? "0.0.0.0";
        return version;
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Extensions;

namespace Common.Logic.Helpers;

public static class DateKeyedDictionaryHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Ensures that the specified dictionary of time blocks contains entries for every period between the given range.
    /// For each missing period, adds an empty list for that time slot.
    /// The range is rounded to 15-minute boundaries before filling gaps.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The type of the list elements in each block.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="blocks">The dictionary of blocks, keyed by DateTime, to fill gaps in. Passed by reference.</param>
    /// <param name="blockSize">The time interval for each block (e.g., 15 minutes).</param>
    /// <param name="rangeStart">The start of the range (inclusive).</param>
    /// <param name="rangeEnd">The end of the range (exclusive).</param>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException">Thrown if the range is zero or negative length.</exception>
    public static void FillGaps<T>(ref Dictionary<DateTime, List<T>> blocks, TimeSpan blockSize, DateTime rangeStart, DateTime rangeEnd)
    {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThanOrEqual(rangeEnd, rangeStart);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThanOrEqual(blockSize, TimeSpan.Zero);

        //to be sure, reapply the rounding to 15min whole blocks
        rangeStart = rangeStart.GetPreviousBoundary(blockSize);
        rangeEnd = rangeEnd.GetNextBoundary(blockSize).AddTicks(-1);

        for (var time = rangeStart; time < rangeEnd; time += blockSize)
        {
            if (!blocks.ContainsKey(time))
            {
                blocks.Add(time, []); //itt hozzáadjuk a hiányzó üres blokkot
            }
        }
    }
}

namespace Common.Logic.Helpers;

/// <summary>
///  EnumHelper
/// </summary>
public static class EnumHelper
{
    /// <summary>Determines whether [is nullable enum].</summary>
    /// <param name="t">The t.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [is nullable enum] [the specified t]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    public static bool IsNullableEnum(this Type t)
    {
        var u = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(t);
        return u != null && u.IsEnum;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the attribute of enum.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="enumVal">The enum value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T? GetAttributeOfEnum<T>(this Enum enumVal)
        where T : Attribute
    {
        var type = enumVal.GetType();
        var memInfo = type.GetMember(enumVal.ToString());
        var attributes = memInfo.FirstOrDefault()?.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(T), false);
        return attributes is { Length: > 0 } ? (T)attributes[0] : null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// FIGYELEM! Ha nem találja meg név szerint a keresett enumértéket, akkor is visszatér valamivel, de ez hibás is lehet!
    /// Egy enum értékkel térünk vissza, amennyiben a "neve" alapján megtaláljuk. 
    /// Ha nem, akkor az első elemmel térünk vissza amivel csak lehet az enumból.
    /// Ha üres lenne az enum (nincsenek értékei) akkor 0 értékkel.
    /// </summary>
    public static T GetEnumByName<T>(string name)
        where T : Enum
    {
        var elements = Enum.GetValues((typeof(T)));
        bool firstElement = true;
        int firstElementIntValue = 0; 
        foreach (var k in (T[])elements)
        {
            if (firstElement)
            {
                firstElementIntValue = (int)((object)k);
                firstElement = false;
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && name.ToLower() == k.ToString().ToLower())
            {
                return k;
            }
        }

        return elements.Length > 0
            ? (T)Enum.Parse(typeof(T), firstElementIntValue.ToString())
            : throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException($"Empty Enum of type: '{typeof(T)}'");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy enum elemeinek a DisplayName attribútumában %LIKE%-osan keresve visszaadjuk
    /// azokat az enum elemeket, amelyek illeszkednek a search paraméterre.
    /// </summary>
    public static T[] GetEnumDisplayNameLike<T>(string search)
        where T : Enum
    {
        var matchingEnums = Enum.GetValues((typeof(T)))
            .Cast<T>()
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.GetDisplayName()) && x.GetDisplayName()!.ToLower().Contains(search.ToLower()));
        
        return matchingEnums.ToArray();
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;

namespace Common.Logic.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// ListHelper
/// </summary>
public static class ListHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Merges the list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSrc">The type of the source.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TDest">The type of the dest.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="srcList">The source list.</param>
    /// <param name="destList">The dest list.</param>
    /// <param name="isEqualFunc">The is equal function.</param>
    /// <param name="newFunc">The new function.</param>
    /// <param name="specialDeleteFunc">The special delete function.</param>
    /// <param name="withDelete">if set to <c>true</c> [with delete].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static ICollection<TDest>? MergeList<TSrc, TDest>(ICollection<TSrc>? srcList, ICollection<TDest>? destList,
        Func<TSrc, TDest, bool> isEqualFunc, Func<TSrc, TDest> newFunc, Func<TSrc, bool>? specialDeleteFunc = null, bool withDelete = true)
        where TDest : class
    {
        return MergeList(srcList, destList, isEqualFunc, newFunc, out ICollection<TDest>? _, specialDeleteFunc, withDelete);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Merges the list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSrc">The type of the source.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TDest">The type of the dest.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="srcList">The source list.</param>
    /// <param name="destList">The dest list.</param>
    /// <param name="isEqualFunc">The is equal function.</param>
    /// <param name="newFunc">The new function.</param>
    /// <param name="deletedElements">The deleted elements.</param>
    /// <param name="specialDeleteFunc">The special delete function.</param>
    /// <param name="withDelete">if set to <c>true</c> [with delete].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static ICollection<TDest>? MergeList<TSrc, TDest>(
        ICollection<TSrc>? srcList, 
        ICollection<TDest>? destList,
        Func<TSrc, TDest, bool> isEqualFunc,
        Func<TSrc, TDest> newFunc, 
        out ICollection<TDest> deletedElements, 
        Func<TSrc, bool>? specialDeleteFunc = null, 
        bool withDelete = true)
        where TDest : class
    {
        ICollection<TDest>? result = destList;
        deletedElements = new List<TDest>();

        if (srcList != null)
        {
            result ??= new List<TDest>();

            if (withDelete)
            {
                var delList = result.ToList();
                foreach (var srcElement in srcList)
                {
                    var selElement = result.SingleOrDefault(x => isEqualFunc(srcElement, x));
                    if (selElement != null)
                        delList.RemoveAll(x => isEqualFunc(srcElement, x));
                    else
                        result.Add(newFunc(srcElement));
                }
                delList.ForEach(x => result.Remove(x));
                deletedElements = delList;
            }
            else
            {
                foreach (var srcElement in srcList)
                {
                    var destItem = result.SingleOrDefault(x => isEqualFunc(srcElement, x));
                    if (specialDeleteFunc != null && specialDeleteFunc(srcElement) && destItem != null)
                    {
                        result.Remove(destItem);
                    }
                    else if (destItem == null)
                    {
                        result.Add(newFunc(srcElement));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Equalses the list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSrc">The type of the source.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TDest">The type of the dest.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="srcList">The source list.</param>
    /// <param name="destList">The dest list.</param>
    /// <param name="isEqualFunc">The is equal function.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool EqualsList<TSrc, TDest>(ICollection<TSrc>? srcList, ICollection<TDest>? destList, Func<TSrc, TDest, bool> isEqualFunc)
       where TDest : class
    {
        ICollection<TDest>? result = destList;
        if (srcList != null)
        {
            result ??= new List<TDest>();

            var delList = result.ToList();

            foreach (var srcElement in srcList)
            {
                var selElement = result.SingleOrDefault(x => isEqualFunc(srcElement, x));
                if (selElement != null)
                    delList.RemoveAll(x => isEqualFunc(srcElement, x));
                else
                    return false;
            }
            if (delList.Any())
                return false;
        }
        else
        {
            return result != null && !result.Any();
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static void SyncChildren<TChildEntityDto, TChildEntity>(ICommandService commandService,
                                                                      IList<TChildEntityDto> source,
                                                                      IList<TChildEntity> target,
                                                                      Func<TChildEntityDto, TChildEntity, bool> idSelector,
                                                                      Func<TChildEntityDto, TChildEntity> createFuntion,
                                                                      Action<TChildEntityDto, TChildEntity> beforeUpdateAction = null,
                                                                      bool withDelete = true) where TChildEntity : IEntity
                                                                                                                         where TChildEntityDto : IEntityDto, new()
    {
        //Csak akkor kezelünk gyerek lista módosítást, ha az új listánk nem null
        if (source != null)
        {
            if (withDelete) 
            {
                // Törölt elemek kezelése
                var toDelete = target.Where(existing => !source.Any(x => idSelector(x, existing))).ToList();
                foreach (var item in toDelete)
                {
                    target.Remove(item);
                    commandService.DeleteEntity<TChildEntityDto>(item.Id);
                }
            }

            foreach (var sourceItem in source)
            {
                //Meglévő elemek frissítése
                if (target.TrySearchFor(x => idSelector(sourceItem, x), out TChildEntity result))
                {
                    beforeUpdateAction?.Invoke(sourceItem, result);  
                    commandService.UpdateEntity(sourceItem);
                }
                //Új elemek hozzáadása
                else
                {
                    target.Add(createFuntion(sourceItem));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cryptography.KeyDerivation;

namespace Common.Logic.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// PasswordHelper
/// </summary>
public static class PasswordHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Hashes the password.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="password">The password.</param>
    /// <param name="salt">The salt.</param>
    /// <param name="needsOnlyHash">if set to <c>true</c> [needs only hash].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string HashPassword(string? password, byte[]? salt = null, bool needsOnlyHash = false)
    {
        if (salt == null || salt.Length != 16)
        {
            // generate a 128-bit salt using a secure PRNG
            salt = new byte[128 / 8];
            using var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.Create();
            rng.GetBytes(salt);
        }

        string hashed = Convert.ToBase64String(KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2(
            password: password,
            salt: salt,
            prf: KeyDerivationPrf.HMACSHA256,
            iterationCount: 10000,
            numBytesRequested: 256 / 8));

        if (needsOnlyHash) return hashed;
        // password will be concatenated with salt using ':'
        return $"{hashed}:{Convert.ToBase64String(salt)}";
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies the password.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="hashedPasswordWithSalt">The hashed password with salt.</param>
    /// <param name="passwordToCheck">The password to check.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool VerifyPassword(string hashedPasswordWithSalt, string? passwordToCheck)
    {
        // retrieve both salt and password from 'hashedPasswordWithSalt'
        var passwordAndHash = hashedPasswordWithSalt.Split(':');
        if (passwordAndHash.Length != 2)
            return false;
        var salt = Convert.FromBase64String(passwordAndHash[1]);
        // hash the given password
        var hashOfpasswordToCheck = HashPassword(passwordToCheck, salt, true);
        // compare both hashes
        if (String.CompareOrdinal(passwordAndHash[0], hashOfpasswordToCheck) == 0)
            return true;
        return false;
    }

}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;

namespace Common.Logic.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// ReflectionHelper
/// </summary>
public static class ReflectionHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the member.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="expression">The expression.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">The expression cannot be null.</exception>
    public static string GetMemberName<T>(
        Expression<Func<T, object?>> expression)
    {
        return expression == null
            ? throw new ArgumentException(
                "The expression cannot be null.")
            : GetMemberName(expression.Body);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the member.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="expression">The expression.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// The expression cannot be null.
    /// or
    /// Invalid expression
    /// </exception>
    private static string GetMemberName(
        Expression expression)
    {
        if (expression == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException(
                "The expression cannot be null.");
        }
        // Reference type property or field

        if (expression is MemberExpression memberExpression)
        {
            return memberExpression.Member.Name;
        }
        // Reference type method

        if (expression is MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression)
        {
            return methodCallExpression.Method.Name;
        }
        // Property, field of method returning value type

        return expression is UnaryExpression unaryExpression
            ? GetMemberName(unaryExpression)
            : throw new ArgumentException("Invalid expression");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the member.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="unaryExpression">The unary expression.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string GetMemberName(
        UnaryExpression unaryExpression)
    {
        return unaryExpression.Operand is MethodCallExpression methodExpression
            ? methodExpression.Method.Name
            : ((MemberExpression)unaryExpression.Operand)
            .Member.Name;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the inherited classes.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="t">The t.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Can't get Assembly from type: '{t.Name}'</exception>
    public static Type[] GetInheritedClasses(this Type t)
    {
        //if you want the abstract classes drop the !TheType.IsAbstract but it is probably to instance so its a good idea to keep it.
        var assembly = Assembly.GetAssembly(t);

        return assembly == null
            ? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Can't get Assembly from type: '{t.Name}'")
            : assembly.GetTypes().Where(theType => theType.IsClass && !theType.IsAbstract && theType.IsSubclassOf(t))
            .ToArray();
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the attribute.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="member">The member.</param>
    /// <param name="isRequired">if set to <c>true</c> [is required].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException"></exception>
    public static T? GetAttribute<T>(this MemberInfo member, bool isRequired)
        where T : Attribute
    {
        var attribute = member.GetCustomAttributes<T>(inherit: false).SingleOrDefault();

        return attribute == null && isRequired
            ? throw new ArgumentException(
                string.Format(
                    CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                    "The {0} attribute must be defined on member {1}",
                    typeof(T).Name,
                    member.Name))
            : attribute;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the display name of the property.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="propertyExpression">The property expression.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">No property reference expression was found. - propertyExpression</exception>
    public static string GetPropertyDisplayName<T>(Expression<Func<T, object>> propertyExpression)
    {
        var memberInfo = GetPropertyInformation(propertyExpression.Body) ?? throw new ArgumentException(
                "No property reference expression was found.",
                nameof(propertyExpression));

        var attr = memberInfo.GetAttribute<DisplayAttribute>(isRequired: false);
        return attr?.Name == null ? memberInfo.Name : attr.Name;
    }

    public static MemberInfo? GetPropertyInformation(Expression propertyExpression)
    {
        Debug.Assert(propertyExpression != null, "propertyExpression != null");
        MemberExpression? memberExpr = propertyExpression as MemberExpression;
        if (memberExpr == null && propertyExpression is UnaryExpression { NodeType: ExpressionType.Convert } unaryExpr)
        {
            memberExpr = unaryExpr.Operand as MemberExpression;
        }

        return memberExpr is { Member.MemberType: MemberTypes.Property } ? memberExpr.Member : null;
    }


    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, string> _propertyDisplayNames = new(); // Thread-safe cache

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the display name of the property with a cache.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="propertyName">The property name.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string GetPropertyDisplayNameCached<T>(string propertyName)
    {
        var typeFullName = typeof(T).FullName;
        var cacheKey = $"{typeFullName}:{propertyName}";

        if (_propertyDisplayNames.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out var displayName))
        {
            return displayName;
        }

        var property = typeof(T).GetProperty(propertyName);
        if (property is null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException($"Property '{propertyName}' not found on {typeFullName}.");
        }

        var displayAttribute = property.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>();
        var result = displayAttribute?.Name ?? propertyName;
        _propertyDisplayNames[cacheKey] = result;
        return result;
    }
}

using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Shared;

namespace Common.Logic.Infrastructure;

public class HttpClientApiAuthorizationDelegatingHandler
    : DelegatingHandler
{
    private readonly ILogger<HttpClientApiAuthorizationDelegatingHandler> _logger;
    private readonly HttpClient _authHttpClient;
    
    //Empty string means null teanant Code
    private Dictionary<string, string> _token;

    public HttpClientApiAuthorizationDelegatingHandler(IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory, ILogger<HttpClientApiAuthorizationDelegatingHandler> logger)
    {
        _token = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        _authHttpClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient(Constants.ModuleAuthClientNames.FrameworkAuthClient); //ez itt csúnya, de egyelőre megfelel, mert a framework által adott token érvényes a többi apinál is
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var token = await GetToken(request);

        request.Headers.Accept.Clear();
        request.Headers.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));
        if (token != null)
        {
            request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        }

        return await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
    }

    private async Task GetAndStoreToken(string tenantCode)
    {
        //Empty string means null teanant Code
        string actualTenantCode = string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode) ? null : tenantCode;
        var tokenModel = await _authHttpClient.GetToken("/api/apiauthenticate/auth", Config.GetStringValue("EnergiaMenedzsment.ApiKey"), tenantCode: actualTenantCode);
        _token.TryAdd(tenantCode, tokenModel.Token);
    }

    private async Task<string> GetToken(HttpRequestMessage request)
    {
        string? tenantCode = string.Empty;

        if (request.Headers.TryGetValues("TenantCode", out var tenantCodeValues))
        {
            tenantCode = tenantCodeValues.First();
        }

        try
        {
            if (!_token.ContainsKey(tenantCode))
            {
                await GetAndStoreToken(tenantCode);
            }

            var jwt = new JwtSecurityToken(_token[tenantCode]);

            var expireClaim = jwt.Claims.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Type == "exp");

            if (expireClaim != null)
            {
                var referenceTime = DateTime.Now.AddSeconds(-60).ToUniversalTime();
                var expire = new DateTime(1970, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddSeconds(int.Parse(expireClaim.Value));

                if (expire < referenceTime)
                {
                    await GetAndStoreToken(tenantCode);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            if (!_token.ContainsKey(tenantCode))
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.ToString());
            }
        }

        return _token[tenantCode];
    }
}

using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;

namespace Common.Logic.Infrastructure;

public class HttpClientUserAuthorizationDelegatingHandler
    : DelegatingHandler
{
    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;

    public HttpClientUserAuthorizationDelegatingHandler(IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccesor)
    {
        _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccesor;
    }

    protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        request.Headers.Accept.Clear();
        request.Headers.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));

        var authorizationHeader = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.Request.Headers["Authorization"];

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(authorizationHeader))
        {
            request.Headers.Add("Authorization", new List<string>() { authorizationHeader });
        }

        return await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);

    }
}

namespace Common.Logic.Logging;

/// <summary>
/// Defines values for the categories used by <see cref="ILogger"/>.
/// </summary>
public enum Category
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Debug category.
    /// </summary>
    Debug,

    /// <summary>
    /// Exception category.
    /// </summary>
    Exception,

    /// <summary>
    /// Informational category.
    /// </summary>
    Info,

    /// <summary>
    /// Warning category.
    /// </summary>
    Warn,
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Error category.
    /// </summary>
    Error,
}

/// <summary>
/// Interface for a logger.
/// </summary>
public interface ILogger : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Log with category.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="category">current log category</param>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    void Log(Category category, string message, params object?[]? additionalData);
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Log debug messages.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    void LogDebug(string message, params object?[]? additionalData);
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Log informational messages.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    void LogInfo(string message, params object?[]? additionalData);
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Log warning messages.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    void LogWarn(string message, params object?[]? additionalData);
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Log error messages.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    void LogError(string message, params object?[]? additionalData);

    /// <summary>
    /// Log exception
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="exception">current exception</param>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    void LogError(Exception exception, string message, params object?[]? additionalData);

    /// <summary>
    /// Log security message
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">The message.</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    void LogSecurity(string message, params object?[]? additionalData);

    /// <summary>
    /// Log traffic message
    /// </summary>

using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Serilog;
using System.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;

namespace Common.Logic.Logging;

/// <summary>
/// SerilogLogger
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Logging.SerilogLogger" />

public class SerilogLogger<T> : SerilogLogger, ILogger<T>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SerilogLogger{T}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SerilogLogger() : this(Serilog.Log.ForContext<T>())
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SerilogLogger{T}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    protected SerilogLogger(Serilog.ILogger logger) : base(logger)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Performs application-defined tasks associated with freeing, releasing, or resetting unmanaged resources.
    /// </summary>
    public override void Dispose()
    {
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// 
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Logging.SerilogLogger" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Logging.ILogger&lt;T&gt;" />
public class SerilogLogger : ILogger
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    private readonly Serilog.ILogger _logger;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SerilogLogger"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    protected SerilogLogger(Serilog.ILogger logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the bootstrap.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static SerilogLogger CreateBootstrap()
    {
        var logger = new Serilog.LoggerConfiguration()
            .MinimumLevel.Override("Microsoft", Serilog.Events.LogEventLevel.Information)
            .Enrich.FromLogContext()
            .WriteTo.Console()
            .CreateBootstrapLogger();

        Serilog.Log.Logger = logger;

        Serilog.Debugging.SelfLog.Enable(msg => Debug.WriteLine(msg));

        return new SerilogLogger(logger);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the with configuration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configuration">The configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static SerilogLogger CreateWithConfiguration(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
            .ReadFrom.Configuration(configuration)
            .CreateLogger();
        
        Serilog.Log.Logger = logger;

        Serilog.Debugging.SelfLog.Enable(msg => Debug.WriteLine(msg));

        return new SerilogLogger(logger);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Log with category.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="category">current log category</param>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Use LogException or LogError instead</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException">category - null</exception>
    public void Log(Category category, string message, params object?[]? additionalData)
    {
        switch (category)
        {
            case Category.Debug:
                LogDebug(message, additionalData);
                break;
            case Category.Info:
                LogInfo(message, additionalData);
                break;
            case Category.Warn:
                LogWarn(message, additionalData);
                break;
            case Category.Error:
                LogError(message, additionalData);
                break;
            case Category.Exception:
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Use LogException or LogError instead");
            default:
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(category), category, null);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Log debug messages.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    public void LogDebug(string message, params object?[]? additionalData)
    {
        _logger.Debug(message, additionalData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Log informational messages.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    public void LogInfo(string message, params object?[]? additionalData)
    {
        _logger.Information(message, additionalData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Log warning messages.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    public void LogWarn(string message, params object?[]? additionalData)
    {
        _logger.Warning(message, additionalData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Log error messages.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    public void LogError(string message, params object?[]? additionalData)
    {
        _logger.Error(message, additionalData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Log exception
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="exception">current exception</param>
    /// <param name="message">current log message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    public void LogError(Exception exception, string message, params object?[]? additionalData)
    {
        _logger.Error(exception, message, additionalData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Log security message
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="message">The message.</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    public void LogSecurity(string message, params object?[]? additionalData)
    {
        _logger.ForContext("Security", "Security").Information(message, additionalData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Log traffic message
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="trafficLogItem">Trafficlog item</param>
    /// <param name="targetName">Name of the target.</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public void LogTraffic(object trafficLogItem, string? targetName, params object?[]? additionalData)
    {
        // this.Log(Category.Debug, "TrafficLog", targetName + " " + trafficLogItem);
        throw new NotImplementedException(); // ha lesz ehhez use-case, akkor majd ki kell találni, hogy hogyan loggoljon
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Log message to custom log
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="logName">logName</param>
    /// <param name="message">message</param>
    /// <param name="additionalData">additional data</param>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public void LogCustom(string logName, string message, params object?[]? additionalData)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException(); // ha lesz ehhez use-case, akkor majd ki kell találni, hogy hogyan loggoljon

using Common.Logic.Caching;
using Common.Shared.Security;

namespace Common.Logic.Security;

/// <summary>
/// SecurityCache
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Caching.CoreEntityCache&lt;Common.Shared.Security.SecurityEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SecurityCache : CoreEntityCache<SecurityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The sec operations
    /// </summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<string, SecurityEntityDto> _secOperations;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecurityCache"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SecurityCache()
    {
        FillUp();

        _secOperations = GetContent()
            .ToDictionary(x => x.SecOperationCode, x => x);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the sec operation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="operationCode">The operation code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public SecurityEntityDto? GetSecOperation(string operationCode)
    {
        if (_secOperations.ContainsKey(operationCode))
            return _secOperations[operationCode];
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the sec operations by role.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="roleCode">The role code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public SecurityEntityDto[] GetSecOperationsByRole(string roleCode)
    {
        return GetContent().Where(x => x.RoleCodes.Any(y => y.Equals(roleCode))).Select(x => x).ToArray();
    }
}

using System.Text;
using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Caching;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace Common.Logic.Security;

/// <summary>
/// SecurityContext
/// </summary>
public class SecurityContext
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecurityContext"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="currentUser">The current user.</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">The session identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="clientIp">The client ip.</param>
    private SecurityContext(
        IComponentContext context,
        SecUser currentUser,
        string? sessionId,
        string? clientIp) =>
        (Context, CurrentUser, SessionId, ClientIp) = (context, currentUser, sessionId, clientIp);

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the specified context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="secUser">The sec user.</param>
    /// <param name="sessionId">The session identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="clientIp">The client ip.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static SecurityContext Create(
        IComponentContext context,
        SecUser secUser,
        string? sessionId,
        string? clientIp)
    {
        return new SecurityContext(context, secUser, sessionId, clientIp);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the specified context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="authorizationToken">The authorization token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static SecurityContext? Create(IComponentContext context, string authorizationToken)
    {
        var authToken = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(authorizationToken));
        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SecurityContext>(authToken);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The context.
    /// </value>
    public IComponentContext Context { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The tenant security cache
    /// </summary>
    private TenantSecurityCache? _tenantSecurityCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant security cache.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant security cache.
    /// </value>
    public TenantSecurityCache TenantSecurityCache => _tenantSecurityCache ??= Context.Resolve<TenantSecurityCache>();

    /// <summary>
    /// The security cache
    /// </summary>
    private SecurityCache? _securityCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the security cache.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The security cache.
    /// </value>
    public SecurityCache SecurityCache => _securityCache ??= AutofacScope.Global.Resolve<SecurityCache>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the current user.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The current user.
    /// </value>
    public SecUser CurrentUser { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the session identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The session identifier.
    /// </value>
    public string? SessionId { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the client ip.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The client ip.
    /// </value>
    public string? ClientIp { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether the specified sec operation has right.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="secOperation">The sec operation.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if the specified sec operation has right; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">secOperation</exception>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException"></exception>
    public bool HasRight(string secOperation)
    {
        if (secOperation == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(secOperation));

        var securityEntityDto = this.CurrentUser.TenantCode != null
            ? TenantSecurityCache.GetSecOperation(Context, secOperation)
            : SecurityCache.GetSecOperation(secOperation);

        if (securityEntityDto == null)
        {
            Log.LogWarning($"SECURITY ERROR: {secOperation} is not defined");
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException(string.Format("Önnek nincs jogosultsága a művelet elvégzéséhez. Felhasználó: {0} Művelet: {1}", CurrentUser.DisplayName, secOperation));
        }

        var result = securityEntityDto
            .Return(x => x.RoleCodes.Any(r => CurrentUser.Roles.Contains(r)), false);

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the right.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="secOperation">The sec operation.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException"></exception>
    public void CheckRight(string secOperation)
    {
        if (!HasRight(secOperation))
        {
            var securityEntityDto = this.CurrentUser.TenantCode != null
                ? TenantSecurityCache.GetSecOperation(Context, secOperation)
                : SecurityCache.GetSecOperation(secOperation);
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException(string.Format(
                "Önnek nincs jogosultsága a művelet elvégzéséhez. Felhasználó: {0} Művelet: {1} ({2})",
                CurrentUser.DisplayName,
                securityEntityDto?.Return(x => x.SecOperationName, "Ismeretlen"),
                secOperation));
        }
    }

}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Caching;

namespace Common.Logic.Security;

    /// </summary>

    /// <param name="operationCode">The operation code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>

    public SecurityEntityDto[] GetSecOperationsByRole(ILifetimeScope scope, string roleCode)
    {
        return GetContent(scope).Where(x => x.RoleCodes.Any(y => y.Equals(roleCode))).Select(x => x).ToArray();
    }

}

using Common.Extensions.HttpClientExtensions;

namespace Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;

public abstract class ApiClientServiceBase
{
    protected abstract HttpClient _httpClient { get; set; }

    public async Task<TResponse?> Get<TResponse>(string uri, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _httpClient.GetAsync<TResponse>(uri, tenantCode: tenantCode, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task Post<TRequest>(string uri, TRequest? request, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await _httpClient.PostAsync(uri, request, tenantCode: tenantCode, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<TResponse?> Post<TResponse>(string uri, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _httpClient.PostAsync<TResponse>(uri, tenantCode: tenantCode, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<TResponse?> Post<TRequest, TResponse>(string uri, TRequest? request, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        where TRequest : class
    {
        return await _httpClient.PostAsync<TRequest, TResponse>(uri, request, tenantCode: tenantCode, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<TResponse?> Put<TResponse>(string uri, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _httpClient.PutAsync<TResponse>(uri, tenantCode: tenantCode, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<TResponse?> Put<TRequest, TResponse>(string uri, TRequest? request, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        where TRequest : class
    {
        return await _httpClient.PutAsync<TRequest, TResponse>(uri, request, tenantCode: tenantCode, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<TResponse?> Delete<TResponse>(string uri, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _httpClient.DeleteAsync<TResponse?>(uri, tenantCode: tenantCode, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task Delete(string uri, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await _httpClient.DeleteAsync(uri, tenantCode: tenantCode, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.Logic\Validators\BaseDtoValidator.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.Internal;
using FluentValidation.Validators;

namespace Common.Logic.Validators;

/// <summary>
/// BaseDtoValidator
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="FluentValidation.AbstractValidator&lt;T&gt;" />
public class BaseDtoValidator<T> : AbstractValidator<T>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the type of the model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The type of the model.
    /// </value>
    protected Type ModelType { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BaseDtoValidator{T}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public BaseDtoValidator()
    {
        ModelType = typeof(T);
        var properties = ModelType.GetProperties();
        ProcessProperties(properties);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the properties.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="properties">The properties.</param>
    private void ProcessProperties(PropertyInfo[] properties/*, string baseColumnName = null, int maxLevel = 5*/)
    {
        foreach (var property in properties)
        {
            var isReadonly = property.GetAttribute<ReadOnlyAttribute>();
            if (isReadonly == null || !isReadonly.IsReadOnly)
            {
                var required = property.GetAttribute<RequiredAttribute>();
                if (required != null)
                {
                    var rule = CreateRule<object>(property).NotEmpty();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(required.ErrorMessage))
                        rule.WithMessage(required.ErrorMessage);
                }
                var stringLength = property.GetAttribute<StringLengthAttribute>();
                if (stringLength != null)
                {
                    CreateRule<string>(property).MaximumLength(stringLength.MaximumLength);
                    CreateRule<string>(property).MinimumLength(stringLength.MinimumLength);
                }

                var minLength = property.GetAttribute<MinLengthAttribute>();
                if (minLength != null)
                {
                    CreateRule<string>(property).MinimumLength(minLength.Length);
                }

                var intCount = property.GetAttribute<IntegerAttribute>();
                if (intCount != null)
                {
                    CreateRule<int>(property).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(intCount.Minimum);
                    CreateRule<int>(property).LessThan(intCount.Maximum);
                }

                var longCount = property.GetAttribute<LongAttribute>();
                if (longCount != null)
                {
                    CreateRule<long>(property).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(longCount.Minimum);
                    CreateRule<long>(property).LessThan(longCount.Minimum);
                }

                var decimalCount = property.GetAttribute<DecimalAttribute>();
                if (decimalCount != null)
                {
                    CreateRule<decimal>(property).ScalePrecision(decimalCount.Precision, decimalCount.Scale);
                }

                var floatCount = property.GetAttribute<DecimalAttribute>();
                if (floatCount != null)
                {
                    CreateRule<decimal>(property).ScalePrecision(floatCount.Precision, floatCount.Scale);
                }

                var taxNumber = property.GetAttribute<TaxIdentificationNumberAttribute>();
                if (taxNumber != null)
                {
                    CreateRule<string>(property).Must(IsTaxIdentificationNumber).WithMessage("Érvénytelen adószám!");
                }

                var companyRegistrationNumber = property.GetAttribute<CompanyRegistrationNumberAttribute>();
                if (companyRegistrationNumber != null)
                {
                    CreateRule<string>(property)
                       .Must(value => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) || IsCompanyRegistrationNumber(value))
                       .WithMessage("Érvénytelen cégjegyzékszám!");
                }

                var distinctList = property.GetAttribute<DistinctListAttribute>();
                if (distinctList != null)
                {
                    if (typeof(System.Collections.IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(property.PropertyType))
                    {
                        CreateRule<object>(property)
                            .Must(collection => 
                            {
                                if (collection == null)
                                    return true;
                                    
                                if (collection is System.Collections.IEnumerable enumerable)
                                {
                                    var items = new List<object>();
                                    foreach (var item in enumerable)
                                    {
                                        items.Add(item);
                                    }
                                    
                                    return items.Count == items.Distinct().Count();
                                }
                                
                                return true;
                            })
                            .WithMessage(distinctList.ErrorMessage ?? $"A(z) {property.Name} listaelemeknek egyedinek kell lenniük!");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException($"The DistinctList attribute can only be applied to properties that implement System.Collections.IEnumerable. Property '{property.Name}' of type '{property.PropertyType.Name}' does not implement System.Collections.IEnumerable.");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the rule.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="PT">The type of the t.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="property">The property.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected IRuleBuilder<T, PT> CreateRule<PT>(PropertyInfo property)
    {
        var expression = property.BuildGetterExpression<T>();
        var rule = PropertyRule.Create(expression);
        AddRule(rule);
        var ruleBuilder = new RuleBuilder<T, PT>(rule, this);
        return ruleBuilder;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the rule builder options.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TT">The type of the t.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="targetExpression">The target expression.</param>
    /// <param name="expression">The expression.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">
    /// Missing Property by name of: '{targetPropertyName}'
    /// or
    /// Missing DisplayName attribute for: '{targetPropertyName}'
    /// </exception>
    protected IRuleBuilderOptions<T, DateTime?> CreateRuleBuilderOptions<TT>(
        Expression<Func<TT, object>> targetExpression,
        Expression<Func<TT, object>> expression,
        Func<Func<object, object>, MemberInfo, string, IPropertyValidator> validator)
    {
        var targetPropertyName = ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName(targetExpression);
        var targetPropertyInfo = ModelType.GetProperty(targetPropertyName);

        if (targetPropertyInfo == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Missing Property by name of: '{targetPropertyName}'");

        var ruleBuilder = this.CreateRule<DateTime?>(targetPropertyInfo);
        var member = expression.GetMember();
        var func = AccessorCache<TT>.GetCachedAccessor(member, expression);
        var name = ModelType.Attributes.GetDisplayName();
        if (name == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Missing DisplayName attribute for: '{targetPropertyName}'");

        return ruleBuilder.SetValidator(validator(func.CoerceToNonGeneric(), member, name));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Regexes the valid.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="input">The input.</param>
    /// <param name="pattern">The pattern.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected bool RegexValid(string input, string pattern)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pattern))
            return false;

        try
        {
            var isMatch = Regex.IsMatch(input, pattern, RegexOptions.None, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000));
            return isMatch;
        }
        catch (System.ArgumentException)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy stringről dönti el, hogy szám-e
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="azon">The azon.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// True: ha számról van szó (üres stringet is elfogad)
    /// </returns>
    protected bool IsNumber(string azon)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(azon))
            return false;

        //Töröljük a szám elejéről a nullákat
        var newAzon = azon.TrimStart('0');

        //tizedes vessző/pont esetén visszatesszük az első nullát
        if (newAzon != azon && newAzon.Length > 1 && (newAzon[0] == ',' || newAzon[0] == '.'))
            newAzon = '0' + newAzon;

        //https://stackoverflow.com/a/11725077
        var fractionWithForwardSlashRegex = new Regex(@"\d+(\.\d+)?/\d+(\.\d+)?", RegexOptions.None, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(2000));
        //https://stackoverflow.com/a/39446526
        var fractionAndNonFractionNumberWithoutForwSlashRegex = new Regex(@"^(-?[1-9]+\d*([,]\d+)?)$|^(-?0[,]\d*[1-9]+)$|^0$|^0.0$", RegexOptions.None, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(2000));

        var isFractionWithForwardSlash = fractionWithForwardSlashRegex.IsMatch(newAzon);
        var isFractionAndNonFractionNumberWithoutForwSlash = fractionAndNonFractionNumberWithoutForwSlashRegex.IsMatch(newAzon);
        var isNumber = isFractionWithForwardSlash || isFractionAndNonFractionNumberWithoutForwSlash;

        return isNumber;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy stringről dönti el, hogy érvényes adószám-e
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="input">The string input to validate.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// True: if the input is a valid tax identification number
    /// </returns>
    protected bool IsTaxIdentificationNumber(string input)
    {
        return Regex.IsMatch(input, RegexConstants.TaxIdentificationNumber);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy stringről dönti el, hogy érvényes cégjegyzékszám-e
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="input">The string input to validate.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// True: if the input is a valid company registration number
    /// </returns>
    protected bool IsCompanyRegistrationNumber(string input)
    {
        return Regex.IsMatch(input, RegexConstants.CompanyRegistrationNumber);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A csak a BackEnd-en futtatandó RuleSet-ek neve szimbólikus hivatkozásként
    /// </summary>
    public const string BackendRuleSetName = "BackEnd";
}
