namespace Common.Logic.Validators;

/// <summary>
/// RegexConstants
/// </summary>
public static class RegexConstants
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The only alphanumeric 2 50
    /// </summary>
    public const string OnlyAlphanumeric_2_50 = @"^[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,50}$";
    /// <summary>
    /// The phone number regex
    /// </summary>
    public const string PhoneNumberRegex = @"^[0-9]*$";
    /// <summary>
    /// The hungarian bank account number
    /// </summary>
    public const string HungarianBankAccountNumber = @"^[0-9]{8}([ -]?[0-9]{8}){1,2}$";
    /// <summary>
    /// The email address
    /// </summary>
    public const string EmailAddress = @"^[\w-\.]+@([\w-]+\.)+[\w-]{2,4}$"; // Korábbi megvalósítás másik projectből: "^\w+([-+.null]\w+)*@(\w+([-.]\w+)*\.hu)$"
    /// <summary>
    /// The URL
    /// </summary>
    public const string URL = @"(^http[s]?:\/{2})|(^www)|(^\/{1,2})";

    /// <summary>
    /// Hungarian tax identification number format
    /// </summary>
    public const string TaxIdentificationNumber = @"^\d{11}$";

    /// <summary>
    /// Hungarian company registration number format
    /// </summary>
    public const string CompanyRegistrationNumber = @"^\d{10}$";
    /// <summary>
    /// POD identifier format
    /// </summary>
    public const string PodIdRegex = "^HU.{31}$";
}

using Autofac;

namespace Common.Logic.Wireup;

/// <summary>
/// AutofacScope
/// </summary>
public static class AutofacScope
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The test
    /// </summary>
    private static ILifetimeScope? _test;
    /// <summary>
    /// The global
    /// </summary>
    private static ILifetimeScope? _global;
    /// <summary>
    /// The request function
    /// </summary>
    private static Func<ILifetimeScope>? _requestFunc;

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the global.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="global">The global.</param>
    public static void SetGlobal(ILifetimeScope global)
    {
        _global = global;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the test.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="test">The test.</param>
    public static void SetTest(ILifetimeScope test)
    {
        _test = test;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the request function.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="requestFunc">The request function.</param>
    public static void SetRequestFunc(Func<ILifetimeScope> requestFunc)
    {
        _requestFunc = requestFunc;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the global.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The global.
    /// </value>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Global scope not set</exception>
    public static ILifetimeScope Global
    {
        get
        {
            return _global ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Global scope not set");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the test.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The test.
    /// </value>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Test scope not set</exception>
    public static ILifetimeScope Test
    {
        get
        {
            return _test ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Test scope not set");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the request.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The request.
    /// </value>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Request scope func not set</exception>
    public static ILifetimeScope Request
    {
        get
        {
            return _requestFunc == null ? throw new InvalidOperationException("Request scope func not set") : _requestFunc();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this instance is request set.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is request set; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public static bool IsRequestSet
    {
        get
        {
            return _requestFunc != null;
        }
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Extensions.Validity;

namespace Common.Logic.UnitTests.ValidationTests;

public class DateOnlyValidityGapTests
{
    private class ClosedEndValidityClass(DateOnly validFrom, DateOnly validTo) : IDateOnlyClosedValidityRange
    {
        public DateOnly ValidFrom { get; } = validFrom;
        public DateOnly ValidTo { get; } = validTo;
    }

    private class OpenEndValidityClass(DateOnly validFrom, DateOnly? validTo = null) : IDateOnlyOpenValidityRange
    {
        public DateOnly ValidFrom { get; } = validFrom;
        public DateOnly? ValidTo { get; } = validTo;
    }


    [Fact]
    public void CanCheckGaps_ClosedEnd()
    {
        //checks but should not find

        //Arrange
        List<ClosedEndValidityClass> range = [
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 01, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 01, 31)),
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 02, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 02, 28)),
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 03, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 03, 31)),
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 04, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 12, 31)),
            ];
        //Act
        var result = range.HasGaps();
        //Assert
        Assert.False(result);
    }


    [Fact]
    public void CanDetectGaps_ClosedEnd()
    {
        //should find

        //Arrange
        List<ClosedEndValidityClass> range = [
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 01, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 01, 31)),
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 02, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 02, 28)),
            //new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 03, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 03, 31)), this is the gap
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 04, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 12, 31)),
            ];
        //Act
        var result = range.HasGaps();
        //Assert
        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CanFindMultipleGaps_ClosedEnd()
    {
        //should find any

        //Arrange
        List<ClosedEndValidityClass> range = [
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 01, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 01, 31)),
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 02, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 02, 28)),
            //gap
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 04, 01), new DateOnly(2025, 08, 31)),
            //gap
            new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2026, 10, 01), new DateOnly(2026, 12, 31)),
            ];
        //Act
        var result = range.HasGaps();
        //Assert
        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CanCheckGaps_OpenEnd()

using Common.Logic.Extensions.Validity;

namespace Common.Logic.UnitTests.ValidationTests;

public class DateOnlyValidityRangeTests
{
    private class ClosedEndValidityClass(DateOnly validFrom, DateOnly validTo) : IDateOnlyClosedValidityRange
    {
        public DateOnly ValidFrom { get; } = validFrom;
        public DateOnly ValidTo { get; } = validTo;
    }

    private class OpenEndValidityClass(DateOnly validFrom, DateOnly? validTo = null) : IDateOnlyOpenValidityRange
    {
        public DateOnly ValidFrom { get; } = validFrom;
        public DateOnly? ValidTo { get; } = validTo;
    }


    [Fact]
    public void CanCheckConflictWithNew()
    {
        //Arrange
        List<OpenEndValidityClass> range = [
            new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2025, 01, 31)),
            new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 2, 1), new DateOnly(2025, 02, 28)),
            new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 3, 1), new DateOnly(2025, 03, 31)),
            new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 3, 1), null),
            ];

        var newItem = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 2, 15), new DateOnly(2025, 03, 15));

        //Act
        var result = range.Any(x => x.OverlapsWith(newItem));
        //Assert
        Assert.True(result);
    }


    [Fact]
    public void CanCheckConflictWithInfinite()
    {
        //Arrange
        List<OpenEndValidityClass> range = [
            new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2025, 01, 31)),
            new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 2, 1), new DateOnly(2025, 02, 28)),
            new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 3, 1), new DateOnly(2025, 03, 31)),
            new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 3, 1), null),
            ];

        var newItem = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 4, 10), new DateOnly(2025, 12, 31));

        //Act
        var conflicts = range.Where(x => x.OverlapsWith(newItem)).ToList();
        //Assert
        Assert.True(conflicts.Count > 0);
        Assert.True(conflicts.Count(x => x.ValidTo == null) > 0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CanCheckOverlapsWithEqualRanges()
    {
        //Arrange
        var closed_v1 = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2025, 01, 31));
        var closed_v2 = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2025, 01, 31));

        var open_v1 = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 1, 1), null);
        var open_v2 = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2025, 1, 1), null);
        //Act
        var closed_result = closed_v1.OverlapsWith(closed_v2);
        var open_result = open_v1.OverlapsWith(open_v2);
        //Assert
        Assert.True(closed_result);
        Assert.True(open_result);
    }


    // AI generated cases:


    [Fact]
    public void ClosedEndValidityClass_Should_Overlap_When_DateRanges_Intersect()
    {
        var first = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 3, 1));
        var second = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 2, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 4, 1));

        Assert.True(first.OverlapsWith(second));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ClosedEndValidityClass_Should_Not_Overlap_When_Ranges_Are_Adjacent()
    {
        var first = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 2, 1));
        var second = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 2, 2), new DateOnly(2024, 4, 1)); //same date considered overlapping

        Assert.False(first.OverlapsWith(second));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OpenEndValidityClass_Should_Overlap_When_OpenEnded_Overlaps_Closed()
    {
        var first = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), null); // open-ended
        var second = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 3, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 5, 1));

        Assert.True(first.OverlapsWith(second));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OpenEndValidityClass_Should_Not_Overlap_When_Ends_Before_Starts()
    {
        var first = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 2, 1));
        var second = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 2, 2), null); // open-ended, same date considered overlapping

        Assert.False(first.OverlapsWith(second));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ClosedEndValidityClass_Should_Overlap_When_One_Is_Inside_Other()
    {
        var first = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 5, 1));
        var second = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 2, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 3, 1));

        Assert.True(first.OverlapsWith(second));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OpenEndValidityClass_List_Should_Find_Overlap()
    {
        var existing = new List<OpenEndValidityClass>
        {
            new(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 2, 15)),
            new(new DateOnly(2024, 3, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 4, 1)),
            new(new DateOnly(2024, 5, 1), null) // open-ended
        };

        var newItem = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 3, 15), new DateOnly(2024, 4, 15));

        bool overlapsAny = existing.Any(e => e.OverlapsWith(newItem));

        Assert.True(overlapsAny);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ClosedEndValidityClass_List_Should_Not_Find_Overlap()
    {
        var existing = new List<ClosedEndValidityClass>
        {
            new(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 2, 1)),
            new(new DateOnly(2024, 2, 15), new DateOnly(2024, 3, 1)),
            new(new DateOnly(2024, 3, 10), new DateOnly(2024, 4, 1)),
        };

        var newItem = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 4, 2), new DateOnly(2024, 5, 1));  //same date considered overlapping

        bool overlapsAny = existing.Any(e => e.OverlapsWith(newItem));

        Assert.False(overlapsAny);
    }


    [Fact]
    public void ClosedEndValidityClass_Should_Overlap_When_ValidTo_Equals_Other_ValidFrom()
    {
        var a = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 2, 1));
        var b = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 2, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 3, 1));

        // Since 2024-02-01 is included in both, it overlaps
        Assert.True(a.OverlapsWith(b));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OpenEndValidityClass_Should_Overlap_When_ValidTo_Equals_Other_ValidFrom()
    {
        var a = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 5, 1));
        var b = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 5, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 6, 1));

        Assert.True(a.OverlapsWith(b));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ClosedEndValidityClass_Should_Not_Overlap_If_Other_Starts_After_ValidTo()
    {
        var a = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 5, 1));
        var b = new ClosedEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 5, 2), new DateOnly(2024, 6, 1));

        Assert.False(a.OverlapsWith(b));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OpenEndValidityClass_Should_Not_Overlap_If_Other_Starts_After_ValidTo()
    {
        var a = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 1, 1), new DateOnly(2024, 5, 1));
        var b = new OpenEndValidityClass(new DateOnly(2024, 5, 2), null);

    }

    [Fact]

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using PuppeteerSharp.Media;

namespace Common.Pdf.Models;

/// <summary>
/// PdfGeneratorSettings
/// </summary>
public class PdfGeneratorSettings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Scale of the webpage rendering. Defaults to <c>1</c>. Scale amount must be between 0.1 and 2.
    /// </summary>
    public decimal Scale { get; set; } = 1;

    /// <summary>
    /// Display header and footer. Defaults to <c>false</c>
    /// </summary>
    public bool DisplayHeaderFooter { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// HTML template for the print header. Should be valid HTML markup with following classes used to inject printing values into them:
    ///   <c>date</c> - formatted print date
    ///   <c>title</c> - document title
    ///   <c>url</c> - document location
    ///   <c>pageNumber</c> - current page number
    ///   <c>totalPages</c> - total pages in the document
    /// </summary>
    public string HeaderTemplate { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// HTML template for the print footer. Should be valid HTML markup with following classes used to inject printing values into them:
    ///   <c>date</c> - formatted print date
    ///   <c>title</c> - document title
    ///   <c>url</c> - document location
    ///   <c>pageNumber</c> - current page number
    ///   <c>totalPages</c> - total pages in the document
    /// </summary>
    public string FooterTemplate { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Print background graphics. Defaults to <c>false</c>
    /// </summary>
    public bool PrintBackground { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Paper orientation.. Defaults to <c>false</c>
    /// </summary>
    public bool Landscape { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Paper ranges to print, e.g., <c>1-5, 8, 11-13</c>. Defaults to the empty string, which means print all pages
    /// </summary>
    public string PageRanges { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Paper format. If set, takes priority over <see cref="Width"/> and <see cref="Height"/>
    /// </summary>
    public PaperFormat Format { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Paper margins, defaults to none
    /// </summary>
    public MarginOptions MarginOptions { get; set; } = new MarginOptions();

    /// <summary>
    /// Give any CSS <c>@page</c> size declared in the page priority over what is declared in <c>width</c> and <c>height</c> or <c>format</c> options.
    /// Defaults to <c>false</c>, which will scale the content to fit the paper size.
    /// </summary>
    public bool PreferCSSPageSize { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Hides default white background and allows generating pdfs with transparency.
    /// </summary>
    public bool OmitBackground { get; set; }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace Common.Shared.Caching;
/// <summary>
/// CachingConfigExtension
/// </summary>
public static class CachingConfigExtension
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures the caching.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The services.</param>
    /// <param name="redisSettings">The redis settings.</param>
    public static void ConfigureCaching(this IServiceCollection services, RedisSettings redisSettings)
    {
        if (redisSettings.RedisEnabled)
        {
            services.AddStackExchangeRedisCache(options =>
            {
                //TODO jelszó kezelés, ha secure lesz a redis
                options.Configuration = redisSettings.BaseUrl;
            });
        }
        else
        {
            services.AddDistributedMemoryCache();
        }
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.Shared\Caching\DistributedCacheExtensions.cs
====================================================================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Distributed;

namespace Common.Shared.Caching;
/// <summary>
/// DistributedCacheExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class DistributedCacheExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="cache">The cache.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Task SetAsync<T>(this IDistributedCache cache, string key, T value)
    {
        return SetAsync(cache, key, value, new DistributedCacheEntryOptions());
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="cache">The cache.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="options">The options.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Task SetAsync<T>(this IDistributedCache cache, string key, T value, DistributedCacheEntryOptions options)
    {
        var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, _serializerOptions));
        return cache.SetAsync(key, bytes, options);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Tries the get value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="cache">The cache.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool TryGetValue<T>(this IDistributedCache cache, string key, out T? value)
    {
        var val = cache.Get(key);
        value = default;
        if (val == null) return false;
        value = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(val, _serializerOptions);
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The serializer options
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions _serializerOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions
    {
        PropertyNamingPolicy = null,
        WriteIndented = true,
        AllowTrailingCommas = true,
        DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
    };
}

﻿using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;

namespace Common.Shared.Commands;

/// <summary>
/// Entity based command abstract class
/// </summary>
public abstract class EntityCommandBase : IEntityCommand
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Entity type 
    /// </summary>
    public virtual string? EntityTypeName { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Entity based command abstract class
/// </summary>
public abstract class EntityCommandBase<T> : EntityCommandBase
    where T : class
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Entity type 
    /// </summary>
    public override string EntityTypeName
    {
        get
        {
            return typeof(T).EntityTypeName();
        }
    }
}

namespace Common.Shared.Diagnostics;

/// DateTimeContext
/// </summary>
public static class DateTimeContext
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the <see cref="DateTimeContext"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    static DateTimeContext()
    {
        DateTimeFuncUtcNow = () => DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the date time function UTC now.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The date time function UTC now.
    /// </value>
    public static Func<DateTime> DateTimeFuncUtcNow { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the now.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The now.
    /// </value>
    public static DateTime Now => DateTimeFuncUtcNow();

}

[Serializable]
[DataContract]
public class EntityRef<T> : IPrimaryKey, IEntityDto
    where T : IEntityDto
{

    /// Gets or sets the identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The identifier.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    public int Id { get; set; }

    /// Gets or sets the display name of the entity.
    /// </summary>

    /// </value>

    /// <summary>
    /// Converts to string.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>
    /// A <see cref="System.String" /> that represents this instance.
    /// </returns>
    public override string ToString()
    {
        return $"Type: {typeof(T)} Key: {Id} DisplayName: {EntityDisplayName}";
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;

/// <summary>
/// DecimalAttribute
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.ValidationAttribute" />
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property)]
public class DecimalAttribute : ValidationAttribute
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the scale.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The scale.
    /// </value>
    public int Scale { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the precision.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The precision.
    /// </value>
    public int Precision { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DecimalAttribute"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scale">The scale.</param>
    /// <param name="precision">The precision.</param>
    public DecimalAttribute(int scale = 0, int precision = 0) 
    { 
        if (scale != 0)
            this.Scale = scale;
        else
            this.Scale = 19;

        if (precision != 0)
            this.Precision = precision;
        else
            this.Precision = 5;
    }
}


====================================================================================================
📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.Shared\Entities\Attributes\DictCodeAttribute.cs
====================================================================================================

namespace Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;

/// <summary>
/// DictCodeAttribute
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="System.Attribute" />
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property | AttributeTargets.Field)]
public class DictCodeAttribute : Attribute
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DictCodeAttribute"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictCode">The dictionary code.</param>
    public DictCodeAttribute(string dictCode)
    {
        DictCode = dictCode;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the dictionary code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The dictionary code.
    /// </value>
    public string DictCode { get; set; }

    public static string Get(object enm)
    {
        if (enm == null || enm.ToString() == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(enm));

        var memberInfos = enm?.GetType().GetMember(enm.ToString()!);
        if (memberInfos is not {Length: > 0}) return null;
        if (GetCustomAttribute(
                memberInfos[0], 
                typeof(DictCodeAttribute)) is DictCodeAttribute attr)
        {
            return attr.DictCode;
        }
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Extensions;

namespace Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;

/// <summary>
/// RequiredSecOperationAttribute
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="System.Attribute" />
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class | AttributeTargets.Method)]
public class RequiredSecOperationAttribute : Attribute
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the security operation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The security operation.
    /// </value>
    public SecurityOperation SecurityOperation { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the sec operation code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The sec operation code.
    /// </value>
    public string SecOperationCode { get; set; }
    public Type? SecOperationType { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether [no check].
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [no check]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool NoCheck { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RequiredSecOperationAttribute"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public RequiredSecOperationAttribute()
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RequiredSecOperationAttribute"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="securityOperation">The security operation.</param>
    public RequiredSecOperationAttribute(SecurityOperation securityOperation)
    {
        SecurityOperation = securityOperation;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RequiredSecOperationAttribute"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityType">Type of the entity.</param>
    /// <param name="securityOperation">The security operation.</param>
    public RequiredSecOperationAttribute(Type entityType, SecurityOperation securityOperation)
    {
        SecurityOperation = securityOperation;
        SecOperationCode = entityType.CalcOperation(securityOperation);
        SecOperationType = entityType;
    }
    public void SetOperationCodeRuntime(Type entityType)
    {
        SecOperationCode = entityType.CalcOperation(SecurityOperation);
        SecOperationType = entityType;
    }
}

using System.Runtime.Serialization;

namespace Common.Shared.Exceptions;

/// <summary>
/// EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException
/// </summary>
[Serializable]
public class EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException : Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Unique error identifier
    /// </summary>
    public string ErrorCode { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException" /> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="errorCode">Unique error identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="message">A message that describes the error.</param>
    public EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException(string errorCode, string message) : base($"{errorCode} => {message}")
    {
        ErrorCode = errorCode;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="errorCode">Unique error identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="innenException">The innen exception.</param>
    public EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException(string errorCode, System.Exception innerException) : base(errorCode, innerException)
    {
        ErrorCode = errorCode;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="errorCode">Unique error identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="message">A message that describes the error.</param>
    /// <param name="innenException">The innen exception.</param>
    public EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException(string errorCode, string message, System.Exception innerException) : base($"{errorCode} => {message}", innerException)
    {
        ErrorCode = errorCode;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="info">The info.</param>
    /// <param name="ctxt">The CTXT.</param>
    protected EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext ctxt)
        : base(info, ctxt)
    {
        ErrorCode = (info.GetValue("ErrorCode", typeof(string)) as string) ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Key: 'ErrorCode' does not found in {nameof(info)}.");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Get object data (JSON Info)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="info">The info.</param>
    /// <param name="ctxt">The CTXT.</param>
    public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
    {
        base.GetObjectData(info, context);
        info.AddValue("ErrorCode", ErrorCode);
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;

namespace Common.Shared.Extensions;

/// <summary>
///  EntityExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class EntityExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates entity type name of entity
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity">entity</param>
    /// <returns>EntityTypeName</returns>
    public static string EntityTypeName(this IEntity entity)
    {
        var result = EntityTypeName(entity.GetType());
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates entity type name of entity
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityType">entityType</param>
    /// <returns>EntityTypeName</returns>
    public static string EntityTypeName(this Type entityType)
    {       
        var result = entityType.Name.Replace("EntityDto", string.Empty);
        result = result.Replace("Public", string.Empty);
        result = result.Replace("Entity", string.Empty);
        result = result.Replace("Proxy", string.Empty);

        //ha van generikus paraméter, akkor leszedjük a paraméter számlálót
        result = result.Split('`')[0]; // Leválasztjuk a `1, `2 stb. postfixet
        result += ExtractGenericParameters(entityType); // <-- Itt hozzáfűzzük

        return result;
    }

    private static string ExtractGenericParameters(Type entityType)
    {
        if (!entityType.IsGenericType)
            return string.Empty;

        var genericArgs = entityType.GetGenericArguments();

        var genericPart = string.Join("_", genericArgs.Select(arg =>
        {
            // Rekurzív: ha a paraméter is generikus, akkor feldolgozzuk azt is
            return arg.IsGenericType
                ? arg.Name.Split('`')[0] + ExtractGenericParameters(arg)
                : arg.Name;
        }));

        return "_" + genericPart;
    }

}

    }

using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;

namespace Common.Shared.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// ProductivityExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class ProductivityExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the specified get function.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TVal">The type of the value.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="getFunc">The get function.</param>
    /// <param name="defaultValue">The default value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TVal Return<T, TVal>(this T value, Func<T, TVal> getFunc, TVal defaultValue)
        where T : class
    {
        var result = defaultValue;
        if (value != default(T))
            result = getFunc(value);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whens the specified action.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool When<T>(this object value, Action<T> action)
        where T : class
    {
        var obj = value as T;
        if (obj != null)
        {
            action(obj);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whens the result.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TResult WhenResult<T, TResult>(this object value, Func<T, TResult> action)
        where T : class
    {
        TResult result = default;

        var obj = value as T;
        if (obj != null)
            result = action(obj);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whens the result.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <param name="result">The result.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool WhenResult<T, TResult>(this object value, Func<T, TResult> action, out IEntity result)
        where T : class
        where TResult : IEntity
    {
        result = null;

        var obj = value as T;
        if (obj != null)
        {
            result = action(obj);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whens the result.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <param name="result">The result.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool WhenResult<T, TResult>(this object value, Func<T, TResult> action, out TResult result)
        where T : class
        where TResult : class
    {
        result = null;

        var obj = value as T;
        if (obj != null)
        {
            result = action(obj);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Whens the result.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <param name="result">The result.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool WhenResult<T>(this object value, Func<T, long> action, out long result)
        where T : class
    {
        result = default;

        var obj = value as T;

        if (obj != null)
        {
            result = action(obj);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns an empty IEnumerable if <paramref name="obj" /> is null
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IEnumerable<T> EmptyIfNull<T>(this IEnumerable<T> obj)
    {
        if (obj == null)
            return Enumerable.Empty<T>();
        return obj;
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Linq.Expressions;

namespace Common.Shared.Extensions;

public static class PropertyDisplayNameExtensions
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the display names of all public properties of the specified object.
    /// If a property has a <see cref="DisplayAttribute"/>, its <c>Name</c> value is used;
    /// otherwise, the property name is returned.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The type of the object whose property display names are retrieved.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="obj">The object instance to inspect.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// An <see cref="IEnumerable{string}"/> containing the display names of the object's public properties.
    /// </returns>
    public static IEnumerable<string> GetPropertyDisplayNames<T>(this T obj)
    {
        var properties = typeof(T).GetProperties()
            .Where(p => p.GetGetMethod() is not null && p.GetGetMethod()!.IsPublic);
        foreach (var property in properties)
        {
            var displayAttribute = property.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DisplayAttribute), false)
                .FirstOrDefault() as DisplayAttribute;
   
            yield return displayAttribute?.Name ?? property.Name;
        }
    }

    
    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the display name of a specific property of the specified object.
    /// The property is identified by a strongly-typed property selector expression (e.g., <c>x => x.Property</c>).
    /// If the property has a <see cref="DisplayAttribute"/>, its <c>Name</c> value is used;
    /// otherwise, the property name is returned.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">The type of the object whose property display name is retrieved.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="obj">The object instance to inspect.</param>
    /// <param name="selector">
    /// An expression selecting the property to retrieve the display name for (e.g., <c>x => x.Property</c>).
    /// </param>
    /// <returns>
    /// The display name of the specified property.
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">
    /// Thrown if the selector does not reference a property, or if the property does not exist on the type <typeparamref name="T"/>.
    /// </exception>
    public static string GetDisplayNameOfProperty<T>(this T obj, Expression<Func<T, object>> selector) where T : class
    {
        var member = (selector.Body as MemberExpression
            ?? (selector.Body is UnaryExpression unary ? unary.Operand as MemberExpression : null)) ?? throw new ArgumentException("Selector must be a property expression.");
        var property = typeof(T).GetProperty(member.Member.Name)
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Property '{member.Member.Name}' does not exist on type '{typeof(T).Name}'.");

        var displayAttribute = property.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DisplayAttribute), false)
            .FirstOrDefault() as DisplayAttribute;

        return displayAttribute?.Name ?? property.Name;
    }
}

using Common.Extensions.HttpClientExtensions;
using Common.Shared.Models.Authentication;

namespace Common.Shared.Helpers;
public static class ApiAuthentication
{
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, AuthModel> _tokenCache = [];

    public static async Task<AuthModel> GetToken(this HttpClient authClient, string authEndpoint, string apiKey, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        var resp = await authClient.PostAsync<APIAuthModel, AuthModel>(authEndpoint, new APIAuthModel()
        {
            APIKey = apiKey,
            TenantCode = tenantCode
        });

        if (resp is null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(resp.Token))
            throw new Exception("Authentication failed. Null response from API or no token received.");

        return resp;
    }

    public static async Task AuthenticateClient(this HttpClient client, string authEndpoint, string apiKey, string? tenantCode = null)
    { 
        await client.AuthenticateClient(null, authEndpoint, apiKey, tenantCode ?? string.Empty);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// itt az a lényeg, hogy meg lehet hívni simán arra a kliense, amit a végpontok hívására használunk, vagy meg lehet adni egy külön authClient-et,
    /// amivel az authentikációs végpontot hívjuk meg. (pl. az authClient másképp lehet felkonfigurálva, más resiliency, más szerver baseUrl-t hív, stb.)
    /// TODO: rendes xmldoc
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task AuthenticateClient(this HttpClient client, HttpClient? authClient, string authEndpoint, string apiKey, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(apiKey))
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiKey), "API key must not be null or empty.");
        }

        //check token expiration, and get a new, if expired
        if (_tokenCache.TryGetValue(apiKey, out var cachedToken)
            && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cachedToken.Token)
            && cachedToken.Expiration > DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(1)  //adding 1 extra minute, so token won't expire while the request is being processed
            )
        {
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", cachedToken.Token);
            return;
        }
        else
        {
            try
            {
                var authenticationClient = authClient ?? client; // Use the provided authClient or fall back to the main client

                var tokenModel = await GetToken(authenticationClient, authEndpoint, apiKey, tenantCode);

                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", tokenModel.Token);
                _tokenCache[apiKey] = tokenModel; // Cache the token for future use
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                throw new Exception($"Authentication failed: {ex.Message}", innerException: ex);
            }
        }
    }
}

namespace Common.Shared.Helpers;

public static class DateHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Generates an array of DateTime objects representing the interval-based series between the specified start and end dates.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="from">The starting DateTime of the series.</param>
    /// <param name="to">The ending DateTime of the series.</param>
    /// <param name="interval">The TimeSpan interval between each DateTime in the series.</param>
    /// <returns>An array of DateTime objects representing the interval-based series.</returns>
    public static DateTime[] GetDateTimes(DateTime from, DateTime to, TimeSpan interval)
    {
        var result = new List<DateTime>();
        var current = from;
        while (current <= to)
        {
            result.Add(current);
            current += interval;
        }
        return result.ToArray();
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Generates an array of DateOnly objects representing the interval-based series between the specified start and end dates.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="from">The starting DateOnly of the series.</param>
    /// <param name="to">The ending DateOnly of the series.</param>
    /// <param name="interval">The TimeSpan interval between each DateOnly in the series.</param>
    /// <returns>An array of DateOnly objects representing the interval-based series.</returns>
    public static DateOnly[] GetDateTimes(DateOnly from, DateOnly to, TimeSpan interval)
    {
        if (from > to || interval <= TimeSpan.Zero || interval < TimeSpan.FromDays(1))
            return [];

        var result = new List<DateOnly>();
        var current = from;
        while (current <= to)
        {
            result.Add(current);
            current = current.AddDays((int)interval.TotalDays);
        }
        return result.ToArray();
    }
}

using System.Reflection;

namespace Common.Shared.Helpers;

public static class InterfaceImplementationFinder
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Get all implementations of a given interface in the specified assembly.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TInterface"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="assembly"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IEnumerable<Type> GetImplementations<TInterface>(Assembly? assembly = null)
    {
        assembly ??= Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly(); // default to current assembly

        return assembly.GetTypes()
            .Where(type => typeof(TInterface).IsAssignableFrom(type)
                && type.IsClass
                && !type.IsAbstract);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Common.Shared.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// Secure random number generator helper
/// </summary>
public static class RandomHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the random double.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static double GetRandomDouble()
    {
        var denominator = RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32(2, int.MaxValue);
        double sDouble = (double)1 / denominator;
        return sDouble;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the secure double within range.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="lowerBound">The lower bound.</param>
    /// <param name="upperBound">The upper bound.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static double GetSecureDoubleWithinRange(double lowerBound, double upperBound)
    {
        var rDouble = GetRandomDouble();
        var rRangeDouble = (double)rDouble * (upperBound - lowerBound) + lowerBound;
        return rRangeDouble;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the random int.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="fromInclusive">From inclusive.</param>
    /// <param name="toInclusive">To inclusive.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static int GetRandomInt(int fromInclusive = 0, int toInclusive = int.MaxValue)
    {
        return RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32(fromInclusive, toInclusive + 1);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the random float.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static float GetRandomFloat()
    {
        double mantissa = (GetRandomDouble() * 2.0) - 1.0;
        // choose -149 instead of -126 to also generate subnormal floats (*)
        double exponent = Math.Pow(2.0, GetRandomInt(-126, 128));
        return (float)(mantissa * exponent);
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;

namespace Common.Shared.Queries;

/// <summary>
/// EntityQuery
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces.IEntityQuery" />
public class EntityQuery : IEntityQuery
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the entity type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the entity type.
    /// </value>
    public virtual string EntityTypeName { get; init; } = null!;
}

/// <summary>
/// 
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces.IEntityQuery" />
public class EntityQuery<TEntity, TResult> : EntityQuery, IEntityQuery<TResult>
    where TEntity : IEntityDto
    where TResult : IEntityDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the entity type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the entity type.
    /// </value>
    public override string EntityTypeName
    {
        get { return typeof(TEntity).EntityTypeName(); }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// 
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces.IEntityQuery" />
public class EntityQuery<TEntity> : EntityQuery<TEntity, TEntity>
    where TEntity : IEntityDto
{
}

using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Types;

namespace Common.Shared.Queries;

/// <summary>
/// ISortedEntityQuery
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces.IEntityQuery" />
public interface ISortedEntityQuery : IEntityQuery
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the sorting information.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The sorting information.
    /// </value>
    SortingInfo SortingInfo { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the search text.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The search text.
    /// </value>
    string SearchText { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is deleted.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is deleted; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    bool? IsDeleted { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// ISortedEntityQuery
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces.IEntityQuery" />
public interface ISortedEntityQuery<TEntity, TResult> : IEntityQuery<TResult>, IEntityQuery, ISortedEntityQuery
    where TEntity : IDto
    where TResult : IDto
{
}

/// <summary>
/// SortedEntityQuery
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Queries.EntityQuery&lt;TEntity, TResult&gt;" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Queries.ISortedEntityQuery&lt;TEntity, TResult&gt;" />
public class SortedEntityQuery<TEntity, TResult> : EntityQuery<TEntity, TResult>, ISortedEntityQuery<TEntity, TResult>
    where TEntity : IEntityDto
    where TResult : IEntityDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Sorbarendezéshez információ
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The sorting information.
    /// </value>
    public SortingInfo SortingInfo { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the search text.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The search text.
    /// </value>
    public string SearchText { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Logikai törölt?
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is deleted; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool? IsDeleted { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// EntityTypeName beállítása TResult alapján
    /// </summary>
    public SortedEntityQuery()
    {
        EntityTypeName = typeof(TEntity).EntityTypeName();
    }
}

namespace Common.Shared.Security;

/// <summary>
/// SecRoleType

[DataContract]
public enum SecRoleType
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Default
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Adminisztrátor")]
    Adminisztrator = 0,
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely menedzser
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Telephely menedzser")]
    SiteManager = 1,
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Műszaki karbantartó
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Műszaki karbantartó")]
    TechnicalOperator = 3,
    
    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Intézmény fenntartó")]
    Superintendent = 6,
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.Shared\Security\SecUser.cs

namespace Common.Shared.Security;

/// <summary>
/// SecUser
/// </summary>
public class SecUser
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The anonymous
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly SecUser Anonymous = new SecUser(Guid.Empty, "anonymous", null, "Anonymous", "anonymous@mail.hu", new string[0], new string[0], true);

    /// <summary>
    /// The system
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly SecUser System = new SecUser(Guid.Empty, "system", null, "System", "system@mail.hu", new string[0], new string[0], true);

    /// <summary>
    /// The tenant admin
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly SecUser TenantAdmin = new SecUser(Guid.Empty, "tenantadmin", null, "Tenant Admin", "teanantadmin@mail.hu", new [] { SecRoleType.Adminisztrator }, new string[0], true);

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecUser"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="globalId">The global identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="loginName">Name of the login.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="displayName">The display name.</param>
    /// <param name="email">The email.</param>
    /// <param name="roles">The roles.</param>
    /// <param name="orgUnits">The org units.</param>
    /// <param name="isSystem">if set to <c>true</c> [is system].</param>
    public SecUser(Guid globalId, string loginName, string? tenantCode, string displayName, string email, string[] roles, string[] orgUnits, bool isSystem)
    {
        GlobalId = globalId;
        LoginName = loginName;
        TenantCode = tenantCode;
        DisplayName = displayName;
        Email = email;
        Roles = roles;
        OrgUnits = orgUnits;
        IsSystem = isSystem;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecUser"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="globalId">The global identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="loginName">Name of the login.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="displayName">The display name.</param>
    /// <param name="email">The email.</param>
    /// <param name="roles">The roles.</param>
    /// <param name="orgUnits">The org units.</param>
    /// <param name="isSystem">if set to <c>true</c> [is system].</param>
    public SecUser(Guid globalId, string loginName, string? tenantCode, string displayName, string email, SecRoleType[] roles, string[] orgUnits, bool isSystem) :
        this(globalId, loginName, tenantCode, displayName, email,
            roles.Select(type => Enum.GetName(type) ?? string.Empty).ToArray(), orgUnits, isSystem)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Anonymouses the sec user.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static SecUser AnonymousSecUser(string? tenantCode)
    {
        return new SecUser(
            Anonymous.GlobalId,
            Anonymous.LoginName,
            tenantCode,
            Anonymous.DisplayName,
            Anonymous.Email,
            Anonymous.Roles,
            Anonymous.OrgUnits,
            Anonymous.IsSystem
        );
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenants the admin user.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static SecUser TenantAdminUser(string? tenantCode)
    {
        return new SecUser(
            TenantAdmin.GlobalId,
            TenantAdmin.LoginName,
            tenantCode,
            TenantAdmin.DisplayName,
            TenantAdmin.Email,
            TenantAdmin.Roles,
            TenantAdmin.OrgUnits,
            TenantAdmin.IsSystem
        );
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Clones the specified tenant code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public SecUser Clone(string? tenantCode)
    {
        return new SecUser(
            this.GlobalId,
            this.LoginName,
            tenantCode,
            this.DisplayName,
            this.Email,
            this.Roles,
            this.OrgUnits,
            this.IsSystem
        );
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the global identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The global identifier.
    /// </value>
    public Guid GlobalId { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant code.
    /// </value>
    public string? TenantCode { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the login.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the login.
    /// </value>
    public string LoginName { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the display name.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The display name.
    /// </value>
    public string DisplayName { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the email.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The email.
    /// </value>
    public string Email { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the roles.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The roles.
    /// </value>
    public string[] Roles { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the org units.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The org units.
    /// </value>
    public string[] OrgUnits { get; }

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

﻿using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Extensions;

namespace Common.Shared.Types;

/// <summary>
/// Argument class of entity updates
/// </summary>
public class EntityUpdate
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EntityUpdate"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public EntityUpdate()
    {

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EntityUpdate" /> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <param name="action">action</param>
    public EntityUpdate(IEntityDto entity, EntityUpdateAction action = EntityUpdateAction.Update)
    {
        Entity = entity;
        Action = action;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Related entity
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public IEntityDto Entity { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// True, if the update 
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public EntityUpdateAction Action { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the entity type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the entity type.
    /// </value>
    public virtual string EntityTypeName => Entity?.EntityTypeName();
}

/// <summary>
/// Argument class of entity updates
/// </summary>
public class EntityUpdate<TEntity, TEntityDto> : EntityUpdate
    where TEntity: IEntityDto
    where TEntityDto: IEntityDto
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EntityUpdate" /> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <param name="action">action</param>
    public EntityUpdate(TEntityDto entity, EntityUpdateAction action = EntityUpdateAction.Update): base(entity, action)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the entity type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the entity type.
    /// </value>
    public override string EntityTypeName
    {
        get
        {
            if (Entity != null)
                return typeof(TEntity).EntityTypeName();
            return null;
        }
    }

}

    [Fact]
    public static void CanImportExcelSheet()
    {
        // Arrange
        string filePath = @"./ExcelImport/Data/OsFeltoltes_testdata.xlsx";
        string sheetName = "Intézmény";

        // Act
        var data = Utils.Excel.ExcelImport.ImportFile<TestInstitutionImportModel>(
            filePath,
            sheetName,
            hasHeader: false, //because there's a merged extra header 
            skipRows: 2);     //real data starts at 3rd row

        // Assert
        data.Should().NotBeNull();
        data.Should().NotBeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public static void CanImportExcelSheetWithErrors()
    {
        // Arrange
        string filePath = @"./ExcelImport/Data/OsFeltoltes_testdata_witherrors.xlsx";
        string sheetName = "Intézmény";

        // Act
        //TODO: assertions for known errors in excel, validate that the error messages are correct with correct excel coordinates
        var xlsExc = Assert.Throws<ExcelImportException>(() =>
            {
                var data = Utils.Excel.ExcelImport.ImportFile<TestInstitutionImportModel>(
                    filePath,
                    sheetName,
                    hasHeader: false, //because there's a merged extra header 
                    skipRows: 2);     //real data starts at 3rd row
            });
        xlsExc.Should().NotBeNull();
        xlsExc.Errors.Should().Contain(x => x.ErrorMessage.Contains("null", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
        xlsExc.Errors.Should().Contain(x => x.ErrorMessage.Contains("datetime", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
    }

}

﻿using FluentAssertions;
using FluentAssertions.Primitives;

namespace Common.UnitTest.Extensions;

// Az értékek a BeCloseTo metódus precision bemeneti paraméter értékét adják majd.
public enum DateTimeAssertionType
{
    Default = 20,
    PostgreCompare = 10
}

public static class DateTimeAssertionsExtensions
{
    public static AndConstraint<DateTimeAssertions> BeCloseTo(this DateTimeAssertions dateTimeAssertion, DateTime nearbyTime, DateTimeAssertionType assertionType, string because = "", params object[] becauseArgs)
    {
        return dateTimeAssertion.BeCloseTo(nearbyTime, TimeSpan.FromTicks((int)assertionType), because, becauseArgs);
    }
}

﻿using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using FluentAssertions;
using FluentAssertions.Equivalency;

namespace Common.UnitTest.Extensions;

public static class EquivalencyAssertionOptionExtensions
{

    public static EquivalencyAssertionOptions<TExpectation> EntityDtoAssertion<TExpectation>(this EquivalencyAssertionOptions<TExpectation> options)
    {
        return options
            .Excluding(tep => typeof(TrackedEntityDtoBase).IsAssignableFrom(tep.DeclaringType) &&
                              (tep.Path.EndsWith(
                                   $".{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<ITrackedEntity>(x => x.Created)}") ||
                               tep.Path.Equals(
                                   $"{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<ITrackedEntity>(x => x.Created)}") ||
                               tep.Path.EndsWith(
                                   $".{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<ITrackedEntity>(x => x.CreatorUser)}") ||
                               tep.Path.Equals(
                                   $"{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<ITrackedEntity>(x => x.CreatorUser)}") ||
                               tep.Path.EndsWith(
                                   $".{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<ITrackedEntity>(x => x.Modified)}") ||
                               tep.Path.Equals(
                                   $"{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<ITrackedEntity>(x => x.Modified)}") ||
                               tep.Path.EndsWith(
                                   $".{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<ITrackedEntity>(x => x.ModifierUser)}") ||
                               tep.Path.Equals(
                                   $"{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<ITrackedEntity>(x => x.ModifierUser)}")))
            .Excluding(tep => tep.DeclaringType.IsGenericType &&
                              tep.DeclaringType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() ==
                              typeof(EntityRef<>) &&
                              (tep.Path.EndsWith(
                                   $".{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<EntityRef<EntityDtoBase>>(x => x.EntityDisplayName)}") ||
                               tep.Path.Equals(
                                   $"{ReflectionHelper.GetMemberName<EntityRef<EntityDtoBase>>(x => x.EntityDisplayName)}")
                              ));
    }


    public static EquivalencyAssertionOptions DateTimeAssertion(this EquivalencyAssertionOptions options)
    {
        return options
            .Using<DateTime?>(ctx =>
            {
                if (ctx.Expectation.HasValue)
                    ctx.Subject.Should()
                        .NotBeNull().And
                        .BeCloseTo(ctx.Expectation.Value, TimeSpan.FromTicks((int)DateTimeAssertionType.PostgreCompare));
                else ctx.Subject.Should().Be(ctx.Expectation);
            }).WhenTypeIs<DateTime?>()
            .Using<DateTime>(ctx =>
            {
                ctx.Subject.Should().BeCloseTo(ctx.Expectation, DateTimeAssertionType.PostgreCompare);
            }).WhenTypeIs<DateTime>();
    }


}

﻿using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using AutoMapper.Internal;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using FluentAssertions;

namespace Common.UnitTest.Helpers;

public static class TrackedEntityTestHelper
{

    public static void AutomapperTest(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
        var tempDate = DateTimeContext.Now;
        var tempUser = new UserRef()
        {
            GlobalId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            LoginName = "Teszt1"
        };

        var srcList = new List<object>();
        var destList = new List<object>();
        
        foreach (var map in mapper.ConfigurationProvider.Internal().GetAllTypeMaps())
        {
            if (typeof(ITrackedEntity).IsAssignableFrom(map.SourceType) && typeof(IEntityDto).IsAssignableFrom(map.SourceType) &&
                typeof(ITrackedEntity).IsAssignableFrom(map.DestinationType) && typeof(IDomainModelEntity).IsAssignableFrom(map.DestinationType))
            {
                var expectation = Activator.CreateInstance(map.DestinationType) as ITrackedEntity;
                expectation.Created = tempDate;
                expectation.CreatorUser = tempUser;
                expectation.Modified = tempDate;
                expectation.ModifierUser = tempUser;
                expectation.DeletionUser = tempUser;

                var source = Activator.CreateInstance(map.SourceType) as ITrackedEntity;
                var destination = Activator.CreateInstance(map.DestinationType) as ITrackedEntity;

                // Setup
                // Destination
                destination.Created = tempDate;
                destination.CreatorUser = tempUser;
                destination.Modified = tempDate;
                destination.ModifierUser = tempUser;
                destination.DeletionUser = tempUser;
                // Source
                source.CreatorUser = null;
                source.Created = null;
                source.DeletionUser = null;
                source.Modified = null;
                source.ModifierUser = null;

                srcList.Add((object) source);
                destList.Add((object) destination);

                mapper.Map(source, destination);

                destination.Should().BeEquivalentTo(expectation, "A '{0}' ITrackedEntity propertiket csak a HANDLER logika módosíthatja, az AutoMapper nem! (Lehetséges hiba ok: A vonatkozó entitás mappingjában Dto->Entity irányban nem maradt ki az \".IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties()\"?)", map.DestinationType);
            }
        }
    }

}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ModelBinding;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using System.Diagnostics;

namespace Common.WebAPI.ErrorHandler;

/// <summary>
/// EnergiaMenedzsmentProblemDetailsFactory
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Infrastructure.ProblemDetailsFactory" />
public class EnergiaMenedzsmentProblemDetailsFactory: ProblemDetailsFactory
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The options
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ApiBehaviorOptions options;
    /// <summary>
    /// The json options
    /// </summary>
    private readonly JsonOptions jsonOptions;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentProblemDetailsFactory"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="options">The options.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonOptions">The json options.</param>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">
    /// options
    /// or
    /// jsonOptions
    /// </exception>
    public EnergiaMenedzsmentProblemDetailsFactory(IOptions<ApiBehaviorOptions> options, IOptions<JsonOptions> jsonOptions)
    {
        this.options = options?.Value ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(options));
        this.jsonOptions = jsonOptions?.Value ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(jsonOptions));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails" /> instance that configures defaults based on values specified in <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ApiBehaviorOptions" />.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="httpContext">The <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext" />.</param>
    /// <param name="statusCode">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Status" />.</param>
    /// <param name="title">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Title" />.</param>
    /// <param name="type">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Type" />.</param>
    /// <param name="detail">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Detail" />.</param>
    /// <param name="instance">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Instance" />.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// The <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails" /> instance.
    /// </returns>
    public override ProblemDetails CreateProblemDetails(
        HttpContext httpContext,
        int? statusCode = null,
        string? title = null,
        string? type = null,
        string? detail = null,
        string? instance = null)
    {
        statusCode ??= 500;

        var problemDetails = new ProblemDetails
        {
            Status = statusCode,
            Title = title,
            Type = type,
            Detail = detail,
            Instance = instance,
        };

        ApplyProblemDetailsDefaults(httpContext, problemDetails, statusCode.Value);

        return problemDetails;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ValidationProblemDetails" /> instance that configures defaults based on values specified in <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ApiBehaviorOptions" />.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="httpContext">The <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext" />.</param>
    /// <param name="modelStateDictionary">The <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ModelBinding.ModelStateDictionary" />.</param>
    /// <param name="statusCode">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Status" />.</param>
    /// <param name="title">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Title" />.</param>
    /// <param name="type">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Type" />.</param>
    /// <param name="detail">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Detail" />.</param>
    /// <param name="instance">The value for <see cref="P:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ProblemDetails.Instance" />.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// The <see cref="T:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ValidationProblemDetails" /> instance.
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">modelStateDictionary</exception>
    public override ValidationProblemDetails CreateValidationProblemDetails(
        HttpContext httpContext,
        ModelStateDictionary modelStateDictionary,
        int? statusCode = null,
        string? title = null,
        string? type = null,
        string? detail = null,
        string? instance = null)
    {
        if (modelStateDictionary == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modelStateDictionary));
        }

        statusCode ??= 400;

        var errors = modelStateDictionary.Where(x => x.Value?.Errors.Count > 0).ToDictionary(
            kvp => string.Join('.', kvp.Key.Split('.').Select(k => jsonOptions?.JsonSerializerOptions?.PropertyNamingPolicy?.ConvertName(k) ?? k).ToArray()),
            kvp => kvp.Value?.Errors.Select(x => x.ErrorMessage).ToArray()
        );

        if (errors.Any() && errors.Count == 1 && errors.Keys.FirstOrDefault() == "confirmed")
            return new ValidationProblemDetails()
                {
                    Status = statusCode,
                    Type = type,
                    Detail = detail,
                    Instance = instance,
                    Title = "DoubleConfirmDialog"
                };

        foreach (var error in errors)
            for (int i = 0; i < error.Value?.Length; i++)
            {
                if (error.Value[i].Contains(" is not a valid"))
                    error.Value[i] = "Nem megfelelő adat!";
                if (error.Value[i].Contains("Error converting"))
                    error.Value[i] = "Nem megfelelő adat!";
            }

        var problemDetails = new ValidationProblemDetails(errors!)
        {
            Status = statusCode,
            Type = type,
            Detail = detail,
            Instance = instance,
            Title = "A mentés nem hajtható végre, az űrlap hibás adatokat tartalmaz."
        };

        if (title != null)
        {
            // For validation problem details, don't overwrite the default title with null.
            problemDetails.Title = title;
        }

        ApplyProblemDetailsDefaults(httpContext, problemDetails, statusCode.Value);

        return problemDetails;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the problem details defaults.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="httpContext">The HTTP context.</param>
    /// <param name="problemDetails">The problem details.</param>
    /// <param name="statusCode">The status code.</param>
    private void ApplyProblemDetailsDefaults(HttpContext httpContext, ProblemDetails problemDetails, int statusCode)
    {
        problemDetails.Status ??= statusCode;

        if (options.ClientErrorMapping.TryGetValue(statusCode, out var clientErrorData))
        {
            problemDetails.Title ??= clientErrorData.Title;
            problemDetails.Type ??= clientErrorData.Link;
        }

        var traceId = Activity.Current?.Id ?? httpContext?.TraceIdentifier;
        if (traceId != null)
        {
            problemDetails.Extensions["traceId"] = traceId;
        }
    }
}

using System.Reflection;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cors;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cors.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Controllers;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace Common.WebAPI.ErrorHandler;

/// <summary>
/// ExceptionMiddleware
/// </summary>
public class ExceptionMiddleware
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The next
    /// </summary>
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ICorsService _corsService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ExceptionMiddleware"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="next">The next.</param>
    public ExceptionMiddleware(RequestDelegate next,
        ICorsService corsService)
    {
        _next = next ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(next));
        _corsService = corsService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(corsService));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Invokes the asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="httpContext">The HTTP context.</param>
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext httpContext)
    {
        var corsOptions = httpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IOptionsSnapshot<CorsOptions>>();
        var corsPolicy = GetCorsPolicyForEndpoint(httpContext, corsOptions);

        try
        {
            await _next(httpContext);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            if (corsPolicy != null)
            {
                var corsResult = _corsService.EvaluatePolicy(httpContext, corsPolicy);
                _corsService.ApplyResult(corsResult, httpContext.Response);
            }

            var exception = ex;
            if (!(ex is EnergiaMenedzsmentException) && ex is not FluentValidation.ValidationException)
                exception = new EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException(Generate(), "Hiba történt a művelet során.", ex);
            if (ex is EnergiaMenedzsmentTokenException)
                exception = new EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException("InvalidToken", "Hiba történt a művelet során.", ex);

            if (ex is EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException)
                Log.LogSecurity("S_" + nameof(EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException), ex.Message);
            else if (ex is FluentValidation.ValidationException)
                Log.LogDebug(ex.Message);
            else
                Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, exception,"Exception middleware error");

            throw exception;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generates this instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string Generate()
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyMMddHHmmssfff");
        var machineId = Config.TryGetIntValue("MachineId") ?? 1;

        return $"Ki{machineId}{now}";
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets CORS policy for the current endpoint
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="httpContext">The HTTP context.</param>
    /// <returns>Relevant CORS policy if the endpoint or the controller has the EnableCors attribute, null otherwise.</returns>
    private CorsPolicy? GetCorsPolicyForEndpoint(HttpContext httpContext, IOptionsSnapshot<CorsOptions> corsOptions)
    {
        try
        {
            var endpoint = httpContext.GetEndpoint();
            if (endpoint == null) return null;

            var enableCorsAttribute = endpoint.Metadata.GetMetadata<EnableCorsAttribute>();
            if (enableCorsAttribute == null)
            {
                var controllerActionDescriptor = endpoint.Metadata.GetMetadata<ControllerActionDescriptor>();
                if (controllerActionDescriptor != null)
                {
                    enableCorsAttribute = controllerActionDescriptor.ControllerTypeInfo.GetCustomAttribute<EnableCorsAttribute>();
                }
            }

            if (enableCorsAttribute != null)
            {
                var policyName = enableCorsAttribute.PolicyName ?? "corsapp";

                if (corsOptions.Value.GetPolicy(policyName) is CorsPolicy corsPolicy)
                {
                    return corsPolicy;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogWarning($"Failed to detect CORS configuration in exception middleware: {ex.Message}");
        }

        return null;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.WebAPI\ErrorHandler\GlobalExceptionHandlerExtensions.cs
