using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using FluentValidation;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ModelBinding;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using System.Text;

namespace Common.WebAPI.ErrorHandler;

/// <summary>
/// GlobalExceptionHandlerExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class GlobalExceptionHandlerExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// This method will globally handle logging unhandled execeptions.<br />It will respond json response for ajax calls that send the json accept header<br />otherwise it will redirect to an error page
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="app">The application.</param>
    /// <param name="errorPagePath">The error page path.</param>
    /// <param name="respondWithJsonErrorDetails">if set to <c>true</c> [respond with json error details].</param>
    public static void UseGlobalExceptionHandler(this IApplicationBuilder app
                                                , string errorPagePath
                                                , bool respondWithJsonErrorDetails = false)
    {
        app.UseExceptionHandler(appBuilder => appBuilder.Run(async context =>
            {
                var exception = context.Features.Get<IExceptionHandlerFeature>()?.Error;
                if (exception == null) return;

                var requestServiceProvider = context.RequestServices;
                var problemDetailsFactory = requestServiceProvider?.GetRequiredService<ProblemDetailsFactory>();

                //============================================================
                //Log Exception
                //============================================================

                ProblemDetails problemDetails;
                if (problemDetailsFactory != null)
                {
                    if (exception is EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException securityException)
                    {
                        var modelState = new ModelStateDictionary();
                        problemDetails = problemDetailsFactory.CreateValidationProblemDetails(context, modelState, StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, securityException.Message, "Security");
                    }
                    else if (exception is ValidationException validationException)
                    {
                        var modelState = new ModelStateDictionary();
                        foreach (var error in validationException.Errors)
                        {
                            modelState.AddModelError(error.PropertyName, error.ErrorMessage);
                        }
                        problemDetails = problemDetailsFactory.CreateValidationProblemDetails(
                            context,
                            modelState,
                            StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest,
                            validationException.Message,
                            BaseDtoValidator<object>.BackendRuleSetName);
                    }
                    else
                        problemDetails = problemDetailsFactory.CreateProblemDetails(context, StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError);
                }
                else
                {
                    problemDetails = new ProblemDetails()
                    {
                        Status = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError
                    };
                }

                problemDetails.Status ??= StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;

                context.Response.StatusCode = problemDetails.Status.Value;

                if (exception is EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException energiamenedzsmentBusinessLogicException)
                {
                    problemDetails.Title = energiamenedzsmentBusinessLogicException.Message;
                }
                else if (exception is EnergiaMenedzsmentUnhandledException energiamenedzsmentUnhandledException)
                {
                    problemDetails.Title = exception.Message;
                    problemDetails.Instance = energiamenedzsmentUnhandledException.ErrorCode;
                }
                else if (exception is not ValidationException && exception is not EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException)
                {
                    problemDetails.Title = "Hiba történt a művelet során. Kérjük, jelezze az adminisztrátornak (részletek a napló állományban).";
                }

                if (respondWithJsonErrorDetails)
                {
                    problemDetails.Detail = exception.ToString();
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(problemDetails.Instance))
                        problemDetails.Instance = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
                }

                var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(problemDetails);

                if (exception is not FluentValidation.ValidationException && exception is not EnergiaMenedzsmentException)
                    Log.LogError("D_" + exception.GetType().Name, exception, json);

                //============================================================
                //Return response
                //============================================================
                var matchText = "JSON";

                bool requiresJsonResponse = context.Request
                                                    .GetTypedHeaders()
                                                    .Accept
                                                    .Any(t => t.Suffix.Value?.ToUpper() == matchText
                                                              || t.SubTypeWithoutSuffix.Value?.ToUpper() == matchText);

                if (requiresJsonResponse)
                {
                    context.Response.ContentType = "application/problem+json; charset=utf-8";
                    await context.Response
                                    .WriteAsync(json, Encoding.UTF8);
                }
                else
                {
                    context.Response.Redirect(errorPagePath);

                    await Task.CompletedTask;
                }
            }));
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Swagger;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.SwaggerUI;

namespace Common.WebAPI.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// ApplicationBuilderExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class ApplicationBuilderExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Uses the customized swagger.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="app">The application.</param>
    /// <param name="configuration">The configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IApplicationBuilder  UseCustomizedSwagger(this IApplicationBuilder app, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        if (!(Config.TryGetBoolValue("Swagger:Enable", true) ?? false))
        {
            return app;
        }
        
        string basePath = configuration["Swagger:BasePath"] ?? string.Empty;

        app.UseSwagger(c => ConfigureSwagger(c, basePath));

        // Enable middleware to serve swagger-ui (HTML, JS, CSS, etc.), 
        // specifying the Swagger JSON endpoint.
        app.UseSwaggerUI(c => ConfigureSwaggerUI(c, basePath));

        return app;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Configures the swagger.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="options">The options.</param>
    /// <param name="basePath">The base path.</param>
    private static void ConfigureSwagger(SwaggerOptions options, string basePath)
    {
        //options.PreSerializeFilters.Add((swaggerDoc, httpRequest) =>
        //{
        //    swaggerDoc.BasePath = $"{basePath}";
        //    swagger
        //});
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Configures the swagger UI.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="options">The options.</param>
    /// <param name="basePath">The base path.</param>
    private static void ConfigureSwaggerUI(SwaggerUIOptions options, string basePath)
    {
        // Get the version from config but ensure it's properly formatted for Swagger
        string configVersion = Config.TryGetStringValue("ApiVersion") ?? "1";
        // Remove 'v' prefix if it exists in the config
        if (configVersion.StartsWith("v", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            configVersion = configVersion.Substring(1);
        }
        var ver = $"v{configVersion}";
        options.SwaggerEndpoint($"{basePath}/swagger/{ver}/swagger.json", "EnergiaMenedzsment API");
    }
}

using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.DataTable;

namespace Common.WebAPI.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// DataTableRequestExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class DataTableRequestExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts to url.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="baseUrl">The base URL.</param>
    /// <param name="path">The path.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string ToUrl<T>(this DataTableRequest<T> request, string baseUrl, string path)
        where T : EntityListItemDtoBase
    {
        return $"{baseUrl}/{path}" +
               $"?StartPage={request.StartPage}" +
               $"&PageSize={request.PageSize}" +
               $"&SortColumn={request.SortColumn}" +
               $"&SortDirection={request.SortDirection}" +
               $"&IsDeleted={request.IsDeleted}" +
               $"&IsDeleted={request.IsDeleted}";
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Serilog.Context;

namespace Common.WebAPI.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// SerilogMiddleware
/// </summary>
public class SerilogMiddleware
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The next
    /// </summary>
    private readonly RequestDelegate next;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SerilogMiddleware"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="next">The next.</param>
    public SerilogMiddleware(RequestDelegate next)
    {
        this.next = next;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Invokes the specified context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task Invoke(HttpContext context)
    {
        LogContext.PushProperty("UserName", context.User.Identity?.Name);
        LogContext.PushProperty("SessionId", context.Session.Id);

        return next(context);
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Common\Common.WebAPI\Extensions\ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.WebAPI.Filters;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.OpenApi.Models;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.SwaggerGen;

namespace Common.WebAPI.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// ServiceCollectionExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class ServiceCollectionExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the customized swagger.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The services.</param>
    /// <param name="namespacePrefix">The namespace prefix.</param>
    /// <param name="action">The action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddCustomizedSwagger(this IServiceCollection services, string namespacePrefix, Action<SwaggerGenOptions>? action = null)
    {
        if (!(Config.TryGetBoolValue("Swagger:Enable", true) ?? false))
        {
            return services;
        }

        var ver = $"v{Config.TryGetStringValue("ApiVersion") ?? "1"}";

        services.AddControllers(o =>
        {
            o.Conventions.Add(new ActionHidingConvention());
        });

        services.AddSwaggerGenNewtonsoftSupport();
        services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
        {
            c.SwaggerDoc(ver, new OpenApiInfo()
            {
                Title = "EnergiaMenedzsment API",
                Version = ver
            });
            if (action != null) action(c);
            //c.DescribeAllEnumsAsStrings();
            c.IncludeAllXmlComments(namespacePrefix);
            c.OperationFilter<OperationNamingFilter>();

            // Include 'SecurityScheme' to use JWT Authentication
            var jwtSecurityScheme = new OpenApiSecurityScheme
            {
                Scheme = "bearer",
                BearerFormat = "JWT",
                Name = "JWT Authentication",
                In = ParameterLocation.Header,
                Type = SecuritySchemeType.Http,
                Description = "Put **_ONLY_** your JWT Bearer token on textbox below!",

                Reference = new OpenApiReference
                {
                    Id = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme,
                    Type = ReferenceType.SecurityScheme
                }
            };
            c.AddSecurityDefinition(jwtSecurityScheme.Reference.Id, jwtSecurityScheme);
            c.AddSecurityRequirement(new OpenApiSecurityRequirement
            {
                { jwtSecurityScheme, Array.Empty<string>() }
            });
            
            c.EnableAnnotations(enableAnnotationsForInheritance: true, enableAnnotationsForPolymorphism: true);
        });

        services.AddCors(p => p.AddPolicy("corsapp", builder =>
        {
            //builder.WithOrigins("*")
            builder.WithOrigins(Config.GetStringValue("AccessControlAllowOrigin",true).Split(',')).SetIsOriginAllowedToAllowWildcardSubdomains()
            .AllowAnyMethod()
            .AllowAnyHeader();
        }));



        return services;
    }

}

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.SwaggerGen;

namespace Common.WebAPI.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// SwaggerXmlCommentsExtension
/// </summary>
public static class SwaggerXmlCommentsExtension
{

    /// <summary>
    /// XML komment fájlok hozzáadása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="options"></param>
    public static void IncludeAllXmlComments(this SwaggerGenOptions options, string namespacePrefix)
    {
        var xmlfiles = Directory.GetFiles(AppContext.BaseDirectory, $"{namespacePrefix}.*.xml");
        foreach (var item in xmlfiles)
        {
            options.IncludeXmlComments(item);
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ApplicationModels;

namespace Common.WebAPI.Filters;

/// <summary>
/// ActionHidingConvention
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ApplicationModels.IActionModelConvention" />
public class ActionHidingConvention : IActionModelConvention
{
    public void Apply(ActionModel action)
    {
        // Replace with any logic you want
        if (action.Attributes.Any(x => x is SwaggerOptionsAttribute {IsVisible: false}))
        {
            action.ApiExplorer.IsVisible = false;
        }
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Microsoft.OpenApi.Models;

namespace Common.WebAPI.Filters;

/// <summary>
/// SwaggerDocumentFilter
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.SwaggerGen.IDocumentFilter" />
public class SwaggerDocumentFilter : IDocumentFilter
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the specified swagger document.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="swaggerDoc">The swagger document.</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    public void Apply(OpenApiDocument swaggerDoc, DocumentFilterContext context)
    {
        var urls = Config.TryGetConfigSection<string[]>("Swagger:Urls", true);
        swaggerDoc.Servers = urls?.Select(url => new OpenApiServer
        {

        }).ToList();
    }

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Controllers;
using Microsoft.OpenApi.Models;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.SwaggerGen;

namespace Common.WebAPI.Filters;

/// <summary>
/// OperationNamingFilter
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.SwaggerGen.IOperationFilter" />
public class OperationNamingFilter : IOperationFilter
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the specified operation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="operation">The operation.</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    public void Apply(OpenApiOperation operation, OperationFilterContext context)
    {
        if (context.ApiDescription.ActionDescriptor is ControllerActionDescriptor actionDescriptor)
        {
            operation.OperationId = $"{actionDescriptor.ControllerName}.{actionDescriptor.RouteValues["action"]}";
        }
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Types;

namespace Common.WebAPI.Models.DataTable;


/// <summary>
/// IDataTableRequest
/// </summary>
public interface IDataTableRequest
{
}

/// <summary>
/// DataTableRequest
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.WebAPI.Models.RequestBase" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.WebAPI.Models.DataTable.IDataTableRequest" />
public class DataTableRequest<T> : RequestBase, IDataTableRequest
{

    /// <summary>
    /// The sort column
    /// </summary>
    private string _sortColumn;

    /// <summary>
    /// Kezdő lap száma
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The start page.
    /// </value>
    public int StartPage { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Lap mérete
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The size of the page.
    /// </value>
    public int? PageSize { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the sort column.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The sort column.
    /// </value>
    public string SortColumn
    {
        get
        {
            var column = _sortColumn;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(column)) return column;
            var properties = typeof(T).GetProperties();
            column = properties.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Name.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == column.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture))?.Name;
            return column;
        }
        set => _sortColumn = value;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the sort direction.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The sort direction.
    /// </value>
    public SortDirection SortDirection { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is deleted.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is deleted; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool? IsDeleted { get; set; }
}

using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Unicode;
using System.Web;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
//using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;


namespace Common.Extensions.HttpClientExtensions;

/// <summary>
/// HttpClientExtensions - independent extension library
/// </summary>
public static class HttpClientExtensions
{

    public static string GetQueryString(object obj)
    {
        /*var properties = from p in obj.GetType().GetProperties()
                         where p.GetValue(obj, null) != null
                         select p.Name + "=" + HttpUtility.UrlEncode(p.GetValue(obj, null).ToString());*/

        //preferred (safer):
        var properties = obj.GetType().GetProperties()
            .Where(p => p.GetValue(obj) != null)
            .Select(p => $"{Uri.EscapeDataString(p.Name)}={Uri.EscapeDataString(p.GetValue(obj)?.ToString() ?? "")}");

        return string.Join("&", properties.ToArray());
    }

    private static void EnsureSuccess(HttpResponseMessage response, string content)
    {
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError)
            {
                Exception remoteException = null;
                try
                {
                    var errorModel = ErrorHandling.ApiErrorModel.CreateFromJson(content);
                    remoteException = errorModel.ToException();
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                    // response.content-et berakom innner exception-be, hogy valami látszódjon a hibából
                    var contentEx = new Exception(content);
                    remoteException = new ApplicationException("Internal server error.", contentEx);
                }
                throw remoteException;
            }
            else if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.NotFound)
            {

                if (content != null)
                {
                    throw new ApplicationException("Not found.", new Exception(content));
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new ApplicationException("Not found.");
                }
            }
            else if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
            {
                if (content != null)
                {
                    throw new ApplicationException("Forbidden.", new Exception(content));
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new ApplicationException("Forbidden.");
                }
            }
            else if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
            {
                if (content != null)
                {
                    throw new ApplicationException("Unauthorized.", new Exception(content));
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new ApplicationException("Unauthorized.");
                }

            }
            else
            {
                if (content != null)
                {
                    throw new ApplicationException("Unknown error.", new Exception(content));
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new ApplicationException("Unknown error.");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static async Task<TResponse?> GetAsync<TResponse>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, object? queryObj = null, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (queryObj != null)
            requestUri = $"{requestUri}?{GetQueryString(queryObj)}";

        var requestMessage = GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, requestUri, tenantCode: tenantCode);

        var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(requestMessage, cancellationToken);
        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        //response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
        EnsureSuccess(response, content);

        if (typeof(TResponse) == typeof(string))
        {
            return (TResponse)(object)content;
        }
        else
        {
            return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TResponse>(content);
        }
    }

    public static async Task<Stream> GetStreamAsync(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, object queryObj, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (queryObj != null)
            requestUri = $"{requestUri}?{GetQueryString(queryObj)}";

        var response = await httpClient.GetStreamAsync(requestUri, cancellationToken);
        return response;
    }

    /*

    {
        if (queryString != null)
            requestUri = $"{requestUri}?{GetQueryString(queryString)}";

        if (range != null)
        {
            httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Range = range;
        }

        response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

        var result = new PartialStreamModel();
        result.ResponseContentRange = response.Content.Headers.ContentRange?.ToString();
        HttpContent c = response.Content;

        if (c == null)
            result.Stream = Stream.Null;
        else
        {
            result.Stream = await c.ReadAsStreamAsync();
        }

        return result;
    }

    public static async Task PostWithQueryStringAsync(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, object queryObj, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (queryObj != null)
            requestUri = $"{requestUri}?{GetQueryString(queryObj)}";

        var content = new StringContent("");

        var response = await httpClient.PostAsync(requestUri, content, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);
    }

    public static async Task<TResponse> PostWithQueryStringAsync<TResponse>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, object queryObj, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (queryObj != null)
            requestUri = $"{requestUri}?{GetQueryString(queryObj)}";

        var content = new StringContent("");

        var response = await httpClient.PostAsync(requestUri, content, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);

        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TResponse>(responseContent);
    }

    public static async Task<TResponse> PostWithQueryStringAsync<TResponse>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, MultipartFormDataContent content, object queryObj, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (queryObj != null)
            requestUri = $"{requestUri}?{GetQueryString(queryObj)}";

        var response = await httpClient.PostAsync(requestUri, content, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);

        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TResponse>(responseContent);
    }

    public static async Task<TResponse> PostWithQueryStringAsync<TRequest, TResponse>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, object queryObj, TRequest model, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (queryObj != null)
            requestUri = $"{requestUri}?{GetQueryString(queryObj)}";

        var content = new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(model), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

        var response = await httpClient.PostAsync(requestUri, content, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);

        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TResponse>(responseContent);
    }

    public static async Task PostAsync<TRequest>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, TRequest model, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var requestMessage = GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, requestUri, model, tenantCode);
        var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(requestMessage, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);
        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);
    }

    public static async Task<TResponse?> PostAsync<TResponse>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var requestMessage = GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, requestUri, tenantCode);
        var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(requestMessage, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);

        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TResponse?>(responseContent);
    }

    public static async Task<TResponse?> PostAsync<TRequest, TResponse>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, TRequest? model, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var requestMessage = GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, requestUri, model, tenantCode);
        var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(requestMessage, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);

        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TResponse?>(responseContent);
    }

    public static async Task PutAsync<TRequest>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, TRequest model, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var requestMessage = GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Put, requestUri, model, tenantCode);
        var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(requestMessage, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);
    }

    public static async Task<TResponse?> PutAsync<TRequest, TResponse>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, TRequest? model, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var requestMessage = GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Put, requestUri, model, tenantCode);

    public static async Task<TResponse?> PutAsync<TResponse>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var requestMessage = GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Put, requestUri, tenantCode);
        var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(requestMessage, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);

        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TResponse?>(responseContent);
    }

    public static async Task<TResponse> DeleteAsync<TResponse>(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, object queryObj = null, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (queryObj != null)
            requestUri = $"{requestUri}?{GetQueryString(queryObj)}";

        var requestMessage = GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Delete, requestUri, tenantCode);
        var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(requestMessage, cancellationToken);
        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, content);

        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TResponse>(content);
    }

    public static async Task DeleteAsync(this HttpClient httpClient, string requestUri, object queryObj = null, string? tenantCode = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (queryObj != null)
            requestUri = $"{requestUri}?{GetQueryString(queryObj)}";

        var requestMessage = GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Delete, requestUri, tenantCode);
        var response = await httpClient.SendAsync(requestMessage, cancellationToken);
        var responseContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

        EnsureSuccess(response, responseContent);
    }

    private static HttpRequestMessage GetRequestMessage(HttpMethod method, string requestUri, object? bodyContent = null, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        var requestMessage = new HttpRequestMessage(method, requestUri);
        if (tenantCode != null)
        {
            requestMessage.Headers.Add("TenantCode", tenantCode);
        }

        var content = bodyContent == null ? null : new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(bodyContent), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
        requestMessage.Content = content;

        return requestMessage;
    }
}

using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace Common.Extensions.HttpClientExtensions.ErrorHandling;
public class ApiErrorModel
{

    public string? TypeName { get; set; }
    public string? Data { get; set; }
    public ApiErrorModel() { }
    public ApiErrorModel(Exception exception)
    {
        if (exception == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Paramter 'exception' cannot be null.");
        var ex = ExtractAggregatedException(exception);
        TypeName = ex.GetType().AssemblyQualifiedName;
        Data = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(ex);
    }

    public Exception ExtractAggregatedException(Exception ex)
    {
        if (ex is AggregateException && ex.InnerException != null)
            return ex.InnerException;
        else
            return ex;
    }
    public static ApiErrorModel CreateFromJson(string json)
    {
        var result = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ApiErrorModel>(json);
        return result;
    }
    public Exception ToException()
    {
        var type = ResolveType(this.TypeName);
        var ex = (Exception?)JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(this.Data, type);
        return ex;
    }

    public string ToJson()
    {
        return JsonConvert.SerializeObject(this);
    }
    private static System.Reflection.Assembly AssemblyResolver(System.Reflection.AssemblyName assemblyName)
    {
        assemblyName.Version = null;
        return System.Reflection.Assembly.Load(assemblyName);
    }
    private static Type ResolveType(string typeName)
    {
        Type result = null;
        try
        {
            result = Type.GetType(typeName, AssemblyResolver, null);
        }
        catch { }
        if (result == null)
        {
            result = typeof(Exception);
        }
        return result;
    }
}

using ClosedXML.Excel;
using System.Data;

namespace Common.Utils.Excel;

public static class ExcelHelper
{
    public static DataTable GetDataTableFromExcel(Stream stream, string sheetName, bool hasHeader = true, int skipRows = 0, Func<IXLCell, bool>? cellFilter = null)
    {
        using (var workbook = new XLWorkbook(stream))
        {
            var ws = workbook.Worksheet(sheetName);
            return GetWorksheetDataTable(ws, hasHeader, workbook, skipRows, cellFilter);
        }
    }

    public static DataTable GetDataTableFromExcel(Stream stream, bool hasHeader = true, int sheetIndex = 1, int skipRows = 0)
    {
        using (var workbook = new XLWorkbook(stream))
        {
            var ws = workbook.Worksheet(sheetIndex);
            return GetWorksheetDataTable(ws, hasHeader, workbook, skipRows);
        }
    }

    private static DataTable GetWorksheetDataTable(IXLWorksheet ws, bool hasHeader, XLWorkbook workbook, int skipRows = 0, Func<IXLCell, bool>? cellFilter = null)
    {
        DataTable tbl = new();
        tbl.TableName = ws.Name;

        var rowQuery = cellFilter == null
          ? ws.RowsUsed()
          : ws.RowsUsed(row => row.Cells().Any(cellFilter));

        var firstRowUsed = rowQuery.FirstOrDefault();
        var lastRowUsed = rowQuery.LastOrDefault();

        if (hasHeader)
        {
            foreach (var firstRowCell in firstRowUsed.CellsUsed(cellFilter))
            {
                tbl.Columns.Add(firstRowCell.Value.ToString());
            }
        }
        else
        {
            firstRowUsed = ws.Row(firstRowUsed.RowNumber() + skipRows);
            foreach (var firstRowCell in firstRowUsed.CellsUsed(cellFilter))
            {
                tbl.Columns.Add(string.Format("Column {0}", firstRowCell.Address.ColumnNumber));
            }
        }


        var startRow = firstRowUsed.RowNumber();
        if (hasHeader)
            startRow += 1 + skipRows;

        var endRow = lastRowUsed.RowNumber();
        for (int rowNum = startRow; rowNum <= endRow; rowNum++)
        {
            var wsRow = ws.Row(rowNum);
            DataRow row = tbl.Rows.Add();
            foreach (var cell in wsRow.CellsUsed(cellFilter))
            {
                /*
                    cell.CachedValue ->     gets the value of the cell WITHOUT evaluating the formula 
                    cell.Value       ->     gets the value of the cell WITH evaluating the formula (can be very slow)
                */
                if (tbl.Columns.Count >= cell.Address.ColumnNumber)
                {
                    row[cell.Address.ColumnNumber - 1] = cell.CachedValue.ToString();
                }
            }
        }

        return tbl;
    }
}

using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using ClosedXML.Excel;

namespace Common.Utils.Excel;

public static class ExcelImport
{
    public static readonly ReadOnlyCollection<string> ColumnNames = InitializeColumnNames().AsReadOnly();

    private static HashSet<string> trueBoolValues = ["igen", "igaz", "yes", "true"];
    private static HashSet<string> falseBoolValues = ["nem", "hamis", "no", "false"];


    #region Byte array input

    public static IList<T> ImportBytes<T>(byte[] bytes, string sheetName, bool hasHeader = true, int skipRows = 0,Func<IXLCell, bool>? cellFilter = null) where T : new()
    {
        if (bytes is null || bytes.Length < 1)
            throw new ArgumentNullException("Input cannot be empty!", nameof(bytes));

        try
        {
            using var stream = new MemoryStream(bytes);
            return ImportFromStream<T>(stream, sheetName, hasHeader, skipRows, cellFilter);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            throw;
        }
    }
    public static IList<T> ImporBytes<T>(byte[] bytes, bool hasHeader = true, int sheetIndex = 1, int skipRows = 0) where T : new()
    {
        if (bytes is null || bytes.Length < 1)
            throw new ArgumentNullException("Input cannot be empty!", nameof(bytes));

        try
        {
            using var stream = new MemoryStream(bytes);
            return ImportFromStream<T>(stream, hasHeader, sheetIndex, skipRows);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            throw;
        }
    }

    #endregion

    #region File input

    public static IList<T> ImportFile<T>(string filePath, string sheetName, bool hasHeader = true, int skipRows = 0) where T : new()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filePath))
            throw new NullReferenceException("The file path cannot be null or empty!");
        try
        {
            using var stream = File.OpenRead(filePath);
            return ImportFromStream<T>(stream, sheetName, hasHeader, skipRows);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            throw;
        }
    }

    public static IList<T> ImportFile<T>(string filePath, bool hasHeader = true, int sheetIndex = 1, int skipRows = 0) where T : new()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filePath))
            throw new NullReferenceException("The file path cannot be null or empty!");
        try
        {
            using var stream = File.OpenRead(filePath);
            return ImportFromStream<T>(stream, hasHeader, sheetIndex, skipRows);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            throw;
        }
    }

    #endregion

    #region Stream input

    public static IList<T> ImportFromStream<T>(Stream stream, bool hasHeader = true, int sheetIndex = 1, int skipRows = 0) where T : new()
    {
        if (stream == null)
            throw new NullReferenceException("The stream cannot be null!");

        try
        {
            using var dataTable = ExcelHelper.GetDataTableFromExcel(stream, hasHeader, sheetIndex, skipRows);
            var map = GetExcelHeadersMap<T>(dataTable);
            uint rowsSkipped = (uint)(skipRows + (hasHeader ? 1 : 0));
            return GetExcelRowValues<T>(dataTable, map, rowsSkipped);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            throw;
        }
    }

    public static IList<T> ImportFromStream<T>(Stream stream, string sheetName, bool hasHeader = true, int skipRows = 0, Func<IXLCell, bool>? cellFilter = null) where T : new()
    {
        if (stream == null)
            throw new NullReferenceException("The stream cannot be null!");

        try
        {
            using var dataTable = ExcelHelper.GetDataTableFromExcel(stream, sheetName, hasHeader, skipRows,cellFilter);
            var map = GetExcelHeadersMap<T>(dataTable);
            uint rowsSkipped = (uint)(skipRows + (hasHeader ? 1 : 0));
            return GetExcelRowValues<T>(dataTable, map, rowsSkipped);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            throw;
        }
    }

    #endregion

    #region private methods

    private static List<string> InitializeColumnNames()
    {
        var columnNames = new List<string>();
        for (char c = 'A'; c <= 'Z'; c++)
        {
            columnNames.Add(c.ToString());
        }
        for (char c1 = 'A'; c1 <= 'Z'; c1++)
        {
            for (char c2 = 'A'; c2 <= 'Z'; c2++)
            {
                columnNames.Add($"{c1}{c2}");
            }
        }

        for (char c1 = 'A'; c1 <= 'Z'; c1++)
        {
            for (char c2 = 'A'; c2 <= 'Z'; c2++)
            {
                for (char c3 = 'A'; c3 <= 'Z'; c3++)
                {
                    //3 letter can go up to XFD
                    if (columnNames.Count == 16384)
                        return columnNames;

                    columnNames.Add($"{c1}{c2}{c3}");
                }
            }
        }

        /*
         Total number of rows and columns on a worksheet
         1,048,576 rows by 16,384 columns
         */

        return columnNames;
    }


    private static IList<T> GetExcelRowValues<T>(DataTable dataTable, Dictionary<string, int> map, uint rowsSkipped = 0) where T : new()
    {
        var result = new List<T>();
        var errors = new List<ExcelImportError>();
        for (int rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < dataTable.Rows.Count; rowIndex++)
        {
            var newClass = new T();
            foreach (var keyValuePair in map)
            {
                //TODO: excel import always handles empty cells as string.Emtpy, so we'll never have null in the datatable column.
                //      but we could write an attribute property that can treat emty cell as null or give other default value
                var valueStr = dataTable.Rows[rowIndex][keyValuePair.Value].ToString();

                try
                {
                    var propertyInfo = newClass.GetType().GetProperty(keyValuePair.Key);
                    var value = dataTable.Rows[rowIndex][keyValuePair.Value];

                    //support nullable types
                    if (propertyInfo.PropertyType.IsGenericType && propertyInfo.PropertyType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
                    {
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()))
                        {
                            propertyInfo.SetValue(newClass, null);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(propertyInfo.PropertyType);
                            var convertedValue = Convert.ChangeType(value, underlyingType);
                            propertyInfo.SetValue(newClass, convertedValue);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (propertyInfo.PropertyType == typeof(bool))
                        {
                            //support multiple bollean formats, incl. hungarian
                            string vStr = value?.ToString()?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "";
                            bool parsedBool;
                            if (trueBoolValues.Contains(vStr))
                            {
                                parsedBool = true;
                            }
                            else if (falseBoolValues.Contains(vStr))
                            {
                                parsedBool = false;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                //try with default conversion
                                parsedBool = (bool)Convert.ChangeType(value, propertyInfo.PropertyType);
                            }
                            propertyInfo.SetValue(newClass, parsedBool);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var convertedValue = Convert.ChangeType(value, propertyInfo.PropertyType);
                            propertyInfo.SetValue(newClass, convertedValue);
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    if (valueStr?.Length > 100) //trim if too long
                    {
                        valueStr = string.Concat(valueStr.AsSpan(0, 100), "[...]");  //CA1845: Use span-based 'string.Concat'
                    }
                    errors.Add(new ExcelImportError
                    {
                        SheetTitle = dataTable.TableName,
                        Column = keyValuePair.Value,
                        ColumnId = ColumnNames[keyValuePair.Value],
                        Row = rowIndex + (int)rowsSkipped,
                        ErrorMessage = ex.Message,
                        TargetPropertyName = keyValuePair.Key,
                        OriginalException = ex,
                        OriginalValueAsString = valueStr is not null ? string.Format("'{0}'", valueStr) : "<null>",
                    });
                    continue;
                }
            }
            result.Add(newClass);
        }

        if (errors.Any())
            throw new ExcelImportException(errors);

        return result;
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, int> GetExcelHeadersMap<T>(DataTable dataTable/*, bool hasHeader*/) where T : new()
    {
        var map = new Dictionary<string, int>();
        foreach (var prop in new T().GetType().GetProperties())
        {
            var atr = prop.GetCustomAttribute<ExcelImportAttribute>();

            if (atr == null)
                continue;

            /*if (!hasHeader && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(atr.Header))
                throw new ExcelImportException("Mapping error! Header property has value when there are no headers.");*/

            map.Add(prop.Name, atr.ColumnIndex);
            //continue;

            /*if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(atr.Header))
            {
                map.Add(prop.Name, atr.ColumnIndex);
                continue;
            }

            for (int columnIndex = 0; columnIndex < dataTable.Columns.Count; columnIndex++)
            {
                if (atr.Header == dataTable.Columns[columnIndex].ToString())
                {
                    map.Add(prop.Name, columnIndex);
                    break;
                }
            }*/
        }
        return map;
    }

    #endregion
}

namespace Common.Utils.Excel;

[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property, AllowMultiple = false)]
public class ExcelImportAttribute : Attribute
{

    private int _columnIndex;

    /// <summary>
    /// Zero-based index of the column in the Excel sheet.
    /// </summary>
    public virtual int ColumnIndex
    {
        get => _columnIndex;
        init => _columnIndex = value;
    }

    private string? _columnId;

    /// <summary>
    /// Column identifier in the Excel sheet.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>Valid values: A, B, C, ... XFD</value>
    public virtual string? ColumnId
    {
        get => _columnId;
        init
        {
            _columnId = value;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_columnId))
            {
                var ix = ExcelImport.ColumnNames.IndexOf(_columnId);
                if (ix > -1)
                    _columnIndex = ix;
                else
                    throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid column id: {_columnId}");

            }
        }
    }

}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Serilog;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Application;

/// <summary>
/// DBLoaderApp
/// </summary>
public class DBLoaderApp
{

    /// <summary>
    /// The configuration
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IConfigurationRoot _config;
    /// <summary>
    /// The application
    /// </summary>
    private static DBLoaderApp? _app;

    /// <summary>
    /// Prevents a default instance of the <see cref="DBLoaderApp"/> class from being created.
    /// </summary>
    private DBLoaderApp()
    {
        _config = new ConfigurationBuilder()
           .SetBasePath(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory)
           .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
           .AddJsonFile("appsettings.Development.json", true)
           .AddEnvironmentVariables()
           //.AddEnvironmentVariables("Energiamenedzsment_")
           .Build();

        Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration().ReadFrom.Configuration(_config).CreateLogger();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts the specified arguments.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool Start(string[] args)
    {
        _app ??= new DBLoaderApp();
        var ok = _app.Execute(args);

        if(!ok) ErrorHelper.ExitCode = 1;

        return ok;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the specified arguments.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual bool Execute(string[] args)
    {
        string mode, db = "", file = "";

        try
        {
            Log.ForContext<DBLoaderApp>().Debug($"Execute: args = {string.Join(',', args)}");

            if (args.Length < 3)
                Log.Information("Usage: DBLoader.exe [script|textfile|binaryfile] [DB] [folderPath]");
            else
            {
                mode = args[0];
                db = args[1];
                file = args[2];

                var info = new ConnectionInfo
                {
                    Database = db,
                    Username = TryGetParameter("username", args),
                    Password = TryGetParameter("password", args),
                    HostName = TryGetParameter("host", args),
                    Port = TryGetParameter("port", args)

                };

                if (mode == "script")
                {
                    var loader = new ScriptLoader(_config, info, file);
                    loader.StartProcess(args);
                }
                else if (mode == "textfile")
                {
                    var loader = new TextFileLoader(_config, info, file);
                    loader.StartProcess(args);
                }
                else if (mode == "binaryfile")
                {
                    var loader = new BinaryFileLoader(_config, info, file);
                    loader.StartProcess(args);
                }

            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.ForContext<DBLoaderApp>().Error($"Execute file:'{file}' on db:'{db}' ERROR: {ex}");
            return false;
        }

        Log.ForContext<DBLoaderApp>().Information($"Execute file:'{file}' on db:'{db}' Ready.");
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tries the get parameter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    static string? TryGetParameter(string key, IEnumerable<string> args)
    {
        string? result = null;
        foreach (var arg in args)
        {
            if (arg.StartsWith(key))
            {
                var param = arg.Split('=');
                result = param[1];
                break;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

}


====================================================================================================

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Models;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Npgsql;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic;
using CommandLine;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FluentMigration;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Serilog;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Application;

/// <summary>
/// FluentMigrationApp
/// </summary>
public class FluentMigrationApp
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The application
    /// </summary>
    private static FluentMigrationApp? _app;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the current directory.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The current directory.
    /// </value>
    public string CurrentDirectory { get; set; } = Path.GetDirectoryName(Assembly.GetEntryAssembly()!.Location)!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Prevents a default instance of the <see cref="FluentMigrationApp"/> class from being created.
    /// </summary>
    private FluentMigrationApp()
    {
        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .SetBasePath(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory)
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.Development.json", true)
            .AddEnvironmentVariables()
            //.AddEnvironmentVariables("Energiamenedzsment_")
            .Build();
        Config.LocalProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);

        Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration().ReadFrom.Configuration(configuration).CreateLogger();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts the specified arguments.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    public static void Start(string[] args)
    {
        _app ??= new FluentMigrationApp();
        _app.Execute(args);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the specified arguments.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    protected virtual void Execute(string[] args)
    {
        try
        {
            Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"Current directory: {CurrentDirectory}");

            var hasOptions = false;
            Parser.Default.ParseArguments<FluentMigrationOptions>(args)
             .WithParsed(o =>
             {
                 if (o.RerunFailedMigrations)
                 {
                     hasOptions = true;
                     var connStr = GetConnStrToDbType(o.DbType);
                     var conn = new NpgsqlConnection(connStr);
                     var tenantManager = new TenantManager();
                     var tenants = tenantManager.GetTenants();
                     foreach (var tenant in tenants)
                     {
                         RerunFailedMigrations(o.DbType, GetDbName(o.DbType), conn.UserName ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("UserName is required"), tenant.Code);
                     }
                 }
             });

            Log.Information($"Database initialization...");

            var dbFolderPath = !hasOptions && args.Length >= 1
                ? args[0]
                : Config.TryGetStringValue("DatabaseScriptFolder", true) ?? "../../../../../";
            var insertTests = !hasOptions && args.Length > 1 && bool.TryParse(args[1], out bool tests)
                ? tests
                : Config.TryGetBoolValue("InsertTestData", true) ?? false;
            
            var insertDevSchema = Config.TryGetBoolValue("InsertDevSchema", true) ?? true;

            dbFolderPath = Path.Combine(CurrentDirectory, dbFolderPath);

            Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"DB folder base path: {dbFolderPath}");

            var coreDbAlreadyExisted = CreateDbIfNotExists(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Core, dbFolderPath, insertDevSchema);
            var dataReceiverDbAlreadyExisted = CreateDbIfNotExists(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver, dbFolderPath, insertDevSchema);
            var frameworkDbAlreadyExisted = CreateDbIfNotExists(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment, dbFolderPath, insertDevSchema);
            var monitoringDbAlreadyExisted = CreateDbIfNotExists(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring, dbFolderPath, insertDevSchema);

            if (insertTests)
            {
                InsertTests(dbFolderPath, insertDevSchema: insertDevSchema, frameworkDbAlreadyExisted: frameworkDbAlreadyExisted, dataReceiverDbAlreadyExisted: dataReceiverDbAlreadyExisted);
            }

            RunDBMigrations(insertDevSchema: insertDevSchema);

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            ErrorHelper.ExitCode = 1;
            Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Error($"Execute - ERROR: {ex}");
        }

        Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Information($"Execute - Ready");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Runs the database migrations.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantDtoCode">The tenant dto code.</param>
    /// <param name="path">The path.</param>
    /// <param name="corePath">The core path.</param>
    /// <param name="publicPath">The public path.</param>
    /// <param name="insertDevSchema">if set to <c>true</c> [insert dev schema].</param>
    private void RunDBMigrations(string? tenantDtoCode = null, string? path = null, string? corePath = null, string? publicPath = null, bool insertDevSchema = false)
    {
        try
        {
            Log.Information("Migrációk futtatása");

            Log.Information("Core adatbázis migrációi");
            Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Core, "Core", null, corePath);

            Log.Information("Modul adatbázisok public sémáinak migrációi");
            UpdatePublic("DbData:DataReceiver:DbName", EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver, publicPath);
            UpdatePublic("DbData:EnergiaMenedzsment:DbName", EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment, publicPath);
            UpdatePublic("DbData:Monitoring:DbName", EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring, publicPath);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantDtoCode))
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
                    path = Config.GetStringValue("MigrationFolders:Energiamenedzsment");
                Log.Information("EnergiaMenedzsment adatbázis migrációi");
                Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment, "EnergiaMenedzsment", tenantDtoCode, path, "EnergiaMenedzsment");

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
                    path = Config.GetStringValue("MigrationFolders:DataReceiver");
                Log.Information("DataReceiver adatbázis migrációi");
                Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver, "EnergiaMenedzsment_DATARECEIVER", tenantDtoCode, path, "EnergiaMenedzsment");

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
                    path = Config.GetStringValue("MigrationFolders:Monitoring");
                Log.Information("Monitoring adatbázis migrációi");
                Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring, "EnergiaMenedzsment_MONITORING", tenantDtoCode, path, "EnergiaMenedzsment");

                //TODO: Csekkolni, hogy tenant létrehozáskor ezt kell-e futtatni
                Log.Information("Tenant adatbázisok migrációi");
                Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.All, "EnergiaMenedzsment", tenantDtoCode, Config.GetStringValue("MigrationFolders:Tenant"));
            }
            else if (insertDevSchema)
            {
                Log.Information("DataReceiver adatbázis migrációi");
                Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver);

                Log.Information("EnergiaMenedzsment adatbázis migrációi");
                Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment);

                Log.Information("Monitoring adatbázis migrációi");
                Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring);

                Log.Information("Tenant adatbázisok migrációi");
                Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.All);
            }
        }
        catch(Exception ex)
        {
            ErrorHelper.ExitCode = 1;
            Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Error($"Execute - ERROR: {ex}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the database if not exists.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbType">Type of the database.</param>
    /// <param name="currentDirectory">The current directory.</param>
    /// <param name="insertDevSchema">if set to <c>true</c> [insert dev schema].</param>
    private bool CreateDbIfNotExists(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType dbType, string currentDirectory, bool insertDevSchema = true)
    {
        var connStr = Config.GetStringValue("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection");
        Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"ConnectionStrings: {connStr}");
        var dbAlreadyExisted = true;

        switch (dbType)
        {
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Core:
                Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"Create Db: {EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Core}");
                connStr = connStr.Replace("[DB]", Config.GetStringValue("DbData:Core:DbName"));
                CheckIfDbExistsElseRunFn(connStr, () => { dbAlreadyExisted = false; CreateCoreDbIfNotExists(currentDirectory); });
                break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment:
                Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"Create Db: {EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment}");
                connStr = connStr.Replace("[DB]", Config.GetStringValue("DbData:EnergiaMenedzsment:DbName"));
                CheckIfDbExistsElseRunFn(connStr, () => { dbAlreadyExisted = false; CreateEnergiaMenedzsmentDbIfNotExists(currentDirectory, insertDevSchema: insertDevSchema); });
                break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver:
                Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"Create Db: {EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver}");
                connStr = connStr.Replace("[DB]", Config.GetStringValue("DbData:DataReceiver:DbName"));
                CheckIfDbExistsElseRunFn(connStr, () => { dbAlreadyExisted = false; CreateDataReceiverDbIfNotExists(currentDirectory, insertDevSchema: insertDevSchema); });
                break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring:
                Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"Create Db: {EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring}");
                connStr = connStr.Replace("[DB]", Config.GetStringValue("DbData:Monitoring:DbName"));
                CheckIfDbExistsElseRunFn(connStr, () => { dbAlreadyExisted = false; CreateMonitoringDbIfNotExists(currentDirectory, insertDevSchema: insertDevSchema); });
                break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Test:
                Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"Create Db: {EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Test}");
                InsertTests(currentDirectory, insertDevSchema: insertDevSchema);
                break;
            default: break;
        }

        return dbAlreadyExisted;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks if database exists else run function.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connStr">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="createDbAction">The create database action.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static void CheckIfDbExistsElseRunFn(string connStr, Action createDbAction)
    {
        try
        {
            using NpgsqlConnection? conn = new(connStr);
            conn.Open();
        }
        catch
        {
            createDbAction.Invoke();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the core database if not exists.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="currentDirectory">The current directory.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static void CreateCoreDbIfNotExists(string currentDirectory)
    {
        DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "postgres",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"DB/CreateDB.sql"),
            "dbname=EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE;schema=public"
        });
        DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"DB/CreateUser.sql"),
            "dbname=EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE;username=energiamenedzsmentapp;schema=public"
        });
        DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"DB/EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE_DB.sql"),
            "docstore=/mnt/energiamenedzsment-container;schema=public"
        });

        var schneiderStagingDbInit = Config.TryGetBoolValue("SchneiderStagingDbInit", true) ?? false;
        if (schneiderStagingDbInit)
        {
            DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
            {
            "script",
            "postgres",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"DB/CreateSchneiderMigrationDB.sql"),
            "dbname=EnergiaMenedzsment_STAGING;username=energiamenedzsmentapp;schema=public"
        });
            DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
            {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment_STAGING",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"DB/CreateSchneiderMigrationTablesDB.sql"),
             "docstore=/mnt/energiamenedzsment-container;schema=public"
        });
        }
    }
