    /// <summary>
    /// Inserts the tests.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="currentDirectory">The current directory.</param>
    /// <param name="insertDevSchema">if set to <c>true</c> [insert dev schema].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private void InsertTests(string currentDirectory, bool insertDevSchema = true, bool frameworkDbAlreadyExisted = false, bool dataReceiverDbAlreadyExisted = false)
    {
        CreateDbIfNotExists(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment, currentDirectory, insertDevSchema);
        CreateDbIfNotExists(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver, currentDirectory, insertDevSchema);

        if (insertDevSchema)
        {
            if (!frameworkDbAlreadyExisted)
            {
                DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
                {
                    "script", "EnergiaMenedzsment",
                    Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/Framework/DB/EnergiaMenedzsment_Test_DB.sql"),
                    "dbname=EnergiaMenedzsment;schema=dev"
                });
            }

            if (!dataReceiverDbAlreadyExisted)
            {
                DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
                {
                    "script", "EnergiaMenedzsment_DATARECEIVER",
                    Path.Combine(currentDirectory,
                        @"Modules/DataReceiver/DB/EnergiaMenedzsment_DATARECEIVER_Test_DB.sql"),
                    "dbname=EnergiaMenedzsment_DATARECEIVER;schema=dev"
                });
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the schema database.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="currentDirectory">The current directory.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantDtoCode">The tenant dto code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static bool CreateSchemaDB(string currentDirectory, string tenantDtoCode)
    {
        var host = Config.TryGetStringValue("DatabaseHost", true) ?? "ERR";
        var port = Config.TryGetStringValue("DatabasePort", true) ?? "ERR";

        Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"Create tenant - CreateSchemaDB: currentdirectory={currentDirectory}, tenantDtoCode={tenantDtoCode}, host={host}, port={port}");

        // FRAMEWORK
        var result = DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/Framework/DB/CreateSchema.sql"),
            $"dbname=EnergiaMenedzsment;schema={tenantDtoCode}"
            ,$"host={host}"
            ,$"port={port}"
        });
        result = result && DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/Framework/DB/EnergiaMenedzsment_DB.sql"),
            $"docstore=/mnt/energiamenedzsment-datareceiver-container;schema={tenantDtoCode}"
            , host
            , port
        });
        result = result && DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/Framework/DB/ModifyUser.sql"),
            $"username=energiamenedzsmentapp;schema={tenantDtoCode}"
             , host
            , port
       });

        // DATARECEIVER
        result = result && DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment_DATARECEIVER",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/DataReceiver/DB/CreateSchema.sql"),
            $"dbname=EnergiaMenedzsment_DATARECEIVER;schema={tenantDtoCode}"
            , host
            , port
        });
        result = result && DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment_DATARECEIVER",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/DataReceiver/DB/EnergiaMenedzsment_DATARECEIVER_DB.sql"),
            $"docstore=/mnt/energiamenedzsment-datareceiver-container;schema={tenantDtoCode}"
            , host
            , port
        });
        result = result && DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment_DATARECEIVER",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/DataReceiver/DB/ModifyUser.sql"),
            $"username=energiamenedzsment_datareceiver_app;schema={tenantDtoCode}"
            , host
            , port
        });

        // MONITORING
        result = result && DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment_MONITORING",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/Monitoring/DB/CreateSchema.sql"),
            $"dbname=EnergiaMenedzsment_MONITORING;schema={tenantDtoCode}"
            , host
            , port
        });
        result = result && DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment_MONITORING",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/Monitoring/DB/EnergiaMenedzsment_MONITORING_DB.sql"),
            $"docstore=/mnt/energiamenedzsment-monitoring-container;schema={tenantDtoCode}"
            , host
            , port
        });
        result = result && DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
        {
            "script",
            "EnergiaMenedzsment_MONITORING",
            Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"Modules/Monitoring/DB/ModifyUser.sql"),
            $"username=energiamenedzsment_monitoring_app;schema={tenantDtoCode}"
            , host
            , port
        });

        var path = Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"DB/Tenant/Migrations");
        var corePath = Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"DB/Core/Migrations");
        var publicPath = Path.Combine(currentDirectory, @"DB/Public/Migrations");
        Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"Create tenant - RunDBMigrations: currentdirectory={path}, tenantDtoCode={tenantDtoCode}, host={host}, port={port}");
        var fMa = new FluentMigrationApp() { CurrentDirectory = path };
        fMa.RunDBMigrations(tenantDtoCode, path, corePath, publicPath);

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the specified database type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbType">Type of the database.</param>
    /// <param name="dbname">The dbname.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantDtoCode">The tenant dto code.</param>
    /// <param name="path">The path.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantDbname">The tenant dbname.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual void Update(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType dbType, string? dbname = null, string? tenantDtoCode = null, string? path = null, string? tenantDbname = null)
    {
        IList<TenantModel> tenants = new List<TenantModel>();
        var tenantManager = new TenantManager(tenantDbname);
        if (dbname != EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Core.ToString())
            tenants = tenantManager.GetTenants();
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantDtoCode))
            tenants = tenants.Where(x => x.Code == tenantDtoCode).ToList();

        switch (dbType)
        {
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Core:
                UpdateCore(path);
                break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment:               
                foreach (var tenant in tenants)
                    UpdateEnergiaMenedzsment(tenant.Code, dbType, dbname, path);
                break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver:
                foreach (var tenant in tenants)
                    UpdateDataReceiver(tenant.Code, dbType, dbname, path);
                break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring:
                foreach (var tenant in tenants)
                    UpdateMonitoring(tenant.Code, dbType, dbname, path);
                break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.All:
                foreach (var code in tenants.Select(x => x.Code))
                {
                    Log.Information(" > EnergiaMenedzsment");
                    UpdateEnergiaMenedzsment(code, EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.All, "", path);
                }
                break;
            default: break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the update.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connStr">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="migFolderPath">The mig folder path.</param>
    /// <param name="dbName">Name of the database.</param>
    /// <param name="username">The username.</param>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema.</param>
    /// <param name="dbType">Type of the database.</param>
    /// <param name="path">The path.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private void DoUpdate(
        string connStr,
        string migFolderPath,
        string dbName,
        string username,
        string schema,
        EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType dbType,
        string? path = null)
    {
        var migrationRows = GetMigrationRows(connStr, schema);

        migFolderPath = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) ? path : Path.Combine(CurrentDirectory, migFolderPath);

        Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"DoUpdate - extra path param: {path}");
        Log.ForContext<FluentMigrationApp>().Debug($"DoUpdate - combined migfolderPath: {migFolderPath}");

        List<FileChecksumModel> checksumModels = ChecksumHelper.GetFileChecksums(migFolderPath);
        FolderValidationHelper.ValidateFiles(migrationRows, checksumModels);

        FluentMigrationModel? lastDbRow = migrationRows.LastOrDefault();
        var versions = checksumModels
            .Select(c => c.FilenameModel.Version)
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        if (lastDbRow?.Version is not null && !versions.Contains(lastDbRow.Version))
            versions.Add(lastDbRow.Version);
        versions = VersionHelper.OrderVersions(versions);

        //Order checksumModels
        List<FileChecksumModel> orderedChecksumModels = new();
        foreach (var version in versions)
        {
            var modelsWithVersion = checksumModels.Where(x => x.FilenameModel.Version == version).ToList();
            orderedChecksumModels = orderedChecksumModels.Concat(modelsWithVersion).ToList();
        }

        //files which have a version that is higher than the last row in the db
        var lastVersion = GetLastVersion(lastDbRow, connStr, dbType, schema);
        var toBeMigrated = orderedChecksumModels;
        if (lastVersion != null)
            toBeMigrated = toBeMigrated.Where(m => new Version(m.FilenameModel.Version) > lastVersion).ToList();

        RunMigrationScripts(toBeMigrated, dbName, username, schema, connStr, dbType, false, 0);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Reruns the failed migrations.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbType">Type of the database.</param>
    /// <param name="dbName">Name of the database.</param>
    /// <param name="username">The username.</param>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private void RerunFailedMigrations(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType dbType, string dbName, string username, string schema)
    {
        var connStr = GetConnStrToDbType(dbType);
        var migrationRows = GetMigrationRows(connStr, schema);
        var allVersions = migrationRows.Select(c => c.Version).Distinct().ToList();
        allVersions = VersionHelper.OrderVersions(allVersions);
        var lastDbVersion = allVersions.LastOrDefault();
        var failedRows = migrationRows.Where(x => !x.InstalledAt.HasValue).ToList();
        var failedVersions = failedRows.Select(c => c.Version).Distinct().ToList();
        failedVersions = VersionHelper.OrderVersions(failedVersions);

        //Order rows
        List<FluentMigrationModel> ordered = new();
        foreach (var version in failedVersions)
        {
            var modelsWithVersion = failedRows.Where(x => x.Version == version).ToList();
            ordered = ordered.Concat(modelsWithVersion).ToList();
        }

        var migFolderPath = GetMigrationFolder(dbType);
        migFolderPath = Path.Combine(CurrentDirectory, migFolderPath ?? "");
        var folderChecksumModels = ChecksumHelper.GetFileChecksums(migFolderPath);
        foreach (var previouslyFailedRow in ordered)
        {
            var script = previouslyFailedRow.Script?.Split("__")[1];
            var checksumOfPhysicalFile =
                folderChecksumModels
                .Find(x => x.FilenameModel.Filename == script &&
                                     x.FilenameModel.Version == previouslyFailedRow.Version);
            if (previouslyFailedRow.Checksum != checksumOfPhysicalFile?.Checksum)
            {
                RunMigrationScripts(
                    new List<FileChecksumModel> { checksumOfPhysicalFile },
                    dbName, username, schema, connStr, dbType, true, previouslyFailedRow.FluentMigrationId, false);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the migration folder.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbType">Type of the database.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string? GetMigrationFolder(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType dbType)
    {
        var module = "";
        switch (dbType)
        {
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Core: module = "Core"; break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Public: module = "Public"; break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment: module = "EnergiaMenedzsment"; break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver: module = "DataReceiver"; break;
            case EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring: module = "Monitoring"; break;
        }

        var config = Config.GetStringValue($"MigrationFolders:{module}");
        return config;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the last version.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="lastDbRow">The last database row.</param>
    /// <param name="connStr">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="dbType">Type of the database.</param>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static Version? GetLastVersion(FluentMigrationModel? lastDbRow, string connStr, EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType dbType, string schema)
    {
        Version? version = null;

        var sysconfigMigVersion = GetSysconfigModel(connStr, dbType, schema);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sysconfigMigVersion.Version))
            version = new Version(sysconfigMigVersion.Version);
        else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastDbRow?.Version))
            version = new Version(lastDbRow.Version ?? "");

        return version;
    }

#pragma warning disable S107 // Methods should not have too many parameters
    /// <summary>
    /// Runs the migration scripts.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="orderedChecksumModels">The ordered checksum models.</param>
    /// <param name="dbName">Name of the database.</param>
    /// <param name="username">The username.</param>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema.</param>
    /// <param name="connectionString">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="energiaMenedzsmentDbType">Type of the energia menedzsment database.</param>
    /// <param name="isRerun">if set to <c>true</c> [is rerun].</param>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="allowVersionChange">if set to <c>true</c> [allow version change].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static void RunMigrationScripts(
        List<FileChecksumModel> orderedChecksumModels,
        string dbName,
        string username,
        string schema,
        string connectionString,
        EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType energiaMenedzsmentDbType,
        bool isRerun, int id, bool allowVersionChange = true)
#pragma warning restore S107 // Methods should not have too many parameters
    {
        foreach (var model in orderedChecksumModels)
        {
            //1. run script
            //2. insert new FluentMigrationEntity or update

            var fileType = GetFileType(model.FullFilePath);
            var result = DBLoaderApp.Start(new[]
            {
                fileType,
                dbName,
                model.FullFilePath ?? "",
                $"username={username};schema={schema}"
            });

            if (isRerun)
                UpdateFluentMigrationEntity(model, id, connStr: connectionString, schema);
            else
                InsertNewFluentMigrationEntity(model, fileType, connStr: connectionString, result, schema);
        }

        if (allowVersionChange && orderedChecksumModels.Any())
        {
            var lastVersion = orderedChecksumModels[orderedChecksumModels.Count - 1].FilenameModel?.Version;
            SaveCurrentDbVersion(lastVersion, connectionString, GetEnergiaMenedzsmentDbTypeConfigName(energiaMenedzsmentDbType), schema);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Inserts the new fluent migration entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <param name="type">The type.</param>
    /// <param name="connStr">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="scriptRunSuccessfull">if set to <c>true</c> [script run successfull].</param>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static void InsertNewFluentMigrationEntity(FileChecksumModel model, string type, string connStr, bool scriptRunSuccessfull, string schema)
    {
        var cmdStr = @$"INSERT INTO {schema}.fluent_migration (version, type, script, checksum";
        if (scriptRunSuccessfull)
            cmdStr += @", installed_at) VALUES (@p1, @p2, @p3, @p4, @p5)";
        else
            cmdStr += @") VALUES (@p1, @p2, @p3, @p4)";

        using NpgsqlConnection? conn = new(connStr);
        conn.Open();

        NpgsqlCommand command = scriptRunSuccessfull
            ? new NpgsqlCommand(cmdStr, conn)
            {
                Parameters =
                {
                    new("p1", model.FilenameModel?.Version),
                    new("p2", type),
                    new("p3", Path.GetFileName(model.FullFilePath)),
                    new("p4", model.Checksum),
                    new("p5", DateTime.UtcNow)
                }
            }
            : new NpgsqlCommand(cmdStr, conn)
            {
                Parameters =
                {
                    new("p1", model.FilenameModel?.Version),
                    new("p2", type),
                    new("p3", Path.GetFileName(model.FullFilePath)),
                    new("p4", model.Checksum)
                }
            };
        using var cmd = command;
        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
        conn.Close();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the fluent migration entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="connStr">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static void UpdateFluentMigrationEntity(FileChecksumModel model, int id, string connStr, string schema)
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="$Program"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        var cmdStr = @$"UPDATE {schema}.fluent_migration SET checksum=@p1, installed_at=@p2 
            WHERE {schema}.fluent_migration_id=@p3;";

        using NpgsqlConnection? conn = new(connStr);
        conn.Open();

        NpgsqlCommand command = new(cmdStr, conn)
        {
            Parameters =
            {
                new("p1", model.Checksum),
                new("p2", DateTime.UtcNow),
                new("p3", id)
            }
        };
        using var cmd = command;
        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
        conn.Close();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Saves the current database version.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="lastVersion">The last version.</param>
    /// <param name="connectionString">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="configName">Name of the configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static void SaveCurrentDbVersion(string? lastVersion, string connectionString, string configName, string schema)
    {
        var cmdStr =
           $"UPDATE {schema}.sys_config_value SET config_value=@p1 " +
            "WHERE sys_config_id = " +
            "( " +
                "SELECT sys_config_id " +
               $"from {schema}.sys_config " +
                "WHERE config_name=@p2" +
            ")";

        using NpgsqlConnection? conn = new(connectionString);
        conn.Open();
        using var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand(cmdStr, conn)
        {
            Parameters =
            {
                new("p1", lastVersion),
                new("p2", configName),
            }
        };

        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
        conn.Close();
    }

    /// Updates the public.

        DoUpdate(connStr, migFolderPath, dbName: dbName, username: conn.UserName ?? "", DatabaseNodeContext.DefaultSchemaName, dbType, path);

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the migration rows.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connStr">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static List<FluentMigrationModel> GetMigrationRows(string connStr, string schema)
    {
        var result = new List<FluentMigrationModel>();
        var queryString = $"SELECT fluent_migration_id, version, type, script, checksum, installed_at " +
            $"FROM {schema}.fluent_migration;";

        using NpgsqlConnection? conn = new(connStr);
        conn.Open();

        using var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand(queryString, conn);
        using var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader();
        while (reader.Read())
        {
            var entity = new FluentMigrationModel
            {
                FluentMigrationId = reader.GetInt32(0),
                Version = reader.GetString(1),
                Type = reader.GetString(2),
                Script = reader.GetString(3),
                Checksum = reader.GetString(4),
                InstalledAt = reader.GetFieldValue<DateTime?>(5)
            };
            result.Add(entity);
        }
        conn.Close();

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the sysconfig model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="connStr">The connection string.</param>
    /// <param name="energiaMenedzsmentDbType">Type of the energia menedzsment database.</param>
    /// <param name="schema">The schema.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static SysconfigModel GetSysconfigModel(string connStr, EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType energiaMenedzsmentDbType, string schema)
    {
        var result = new SysconfigModel();
        var configName = GetEnergiaMenedzsmentDbTypeConfigName(energiaMenedzsmentDbType);

        var queryString =
            "SELECT sc.sys_config_id, config_value " +
               $"FROM {schema}.sys_config sc " +
               $"INNER JOIN {schema}.sys_config_value scv on sc.sys_config_id = scv.sys_config_id " +
               $"WHERE config_name = '{configName}';";

        using NpgsqlConnection? conn = new(connStr);
        conn.Open();

        using var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand(queryString, conn);
        using var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader();
        while (reader.Read())
        {
            result.SysconfigValueId = reader.GetInt32(0);
            result.Version = reader.GetString(1);
        }
        conn.Close();

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the energia menedzsment database type configuration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="energiaMenedzsmentDbType">Type of the energia menedzsment database.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string GetEnergiaMenedzsmentDbTypeConfigName(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType energiaMenedzsmentDbType)
    {
        return energiaMenedzsmentDbType switch
        {
            EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Core => "MigrationDbVersion.Core",
            EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver => "MigrationDbVersion.DataReceiver",
            EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment => "MigrationDbVersion.Framework",
            EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring => "MigrationDbVersion.Monitoring",
            EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.All => "MigrationDbVersion.Tenant",
            _ => string.Empty
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the type of the file.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="fullFilePath">The full file path.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string GetFileType(string? fullFilePath)
    {
        var extension = Path.GetExtension(fullFilePath ?? "").Replace(".", string.Empty);
        return extension switch
        {
            "sql" => "script",
            "txt" => "textfile",
            _ => string.Empty,
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the type of the connection string to database.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbType">Type of the database.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string GetConnStrToDbType(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType dbType)
    {
        var dbName = GetDbName(dbType);
        var defaultConnStr = Config.GetStringValue("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection");
        var connStr = defaultConnStr.Replace("[DB]", dbName);
        return connStr;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the database.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbType">Type of the database.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string GetDbName(EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType dbType)
    {
        string modulName = dbType switch
        {
            EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Core => "Core",
            EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.DataReceiver => "DataReceiver",
            EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.Monitoring => "Monitoring",
            EnergiaMenedzsmentDbType.EnergiaMenedzsment => "EnergiaMenedzsment",
            _ => throw new Exception("Egyéb modul nem megengedett!")
        };

        var dbName = Config.GetStringValue($"DbData:{modulName}:DbName");
        return dbName;
    }
}

using ByteDev.Crypto;
using ByteDev.Crypto.Hashing;
using ByteDev.Crypto.Hashing.Algorithms;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// ChecksumHelper
/// </summary>
public static class ChecksumHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The service
    /// </summary>
    static readonly FileChecksumService service = new(new Md5Algorithm(), EncodingType.Hex);

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the checksum.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="filePath">The file path.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string CalculateChecksum(string filePath)
    {
        string hexChecksum = service.Calculate(filePath);
        return hexChecksum;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the file checksums.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="folderPath">The folder path.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.IO.DirectoryNotFoundException"></exception>
    public static List<FileChecksumModel> GetFileChecksums(string? folderPath)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(folderPath))
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(folderPath);

        var result = new List<FileChecksumModel>();
        string[] fileEntries = Directory.GetFiles(folderPath);

        foreach (var filenameWithPath in fileEntries)
        {
            var checksum = CalculateChecksum(filenameWithPath);
            var filename = Path.GetFileName(filenameWithPath);
            if (filename.ToUpper() == "README.MD") continue;

            var model = new FileChecksumModel
            {
                Checksum = checksum,
                FilenameModel = FilenameHelper.GetFilenameModel(filename),
                FullFilePath = filenameWithPath
            };
            result.Add(model);
        }

        return result;
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// FilenameHelper
/// </summary>
public static class FilenameHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Generates the filename.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="version">The version.</param>
    /// <param name="name">The name.</param>
    /// <param name="extension">The extension.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string GenerateFilename(string version, string name, string extension) => $"V{version}__{name}.{extension}";

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the filename model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="fullFilename">The full filename.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Logic.Logging.Category.Exception">
    /// Hiba: Nem 'Vx.y.z' verzióval kezdődik a fájlnév: "+ fullFilename
    /// or
    /// Fájl formátum hibás! (Helyes formátum: Vx.y.z__filename.extension). Hibás fájl: " + fullFilename
    /// </exception>
    public static FilenameModel GetFilenameModel(string fullFilename)
    {
        if (!fullFilename.StartsWith('V'))
            throw new Exception("Hiba: Nem 'Vx.y.z' verzióval kezdődik a fájlnév: "+ fullFilename);

        var splitted = fullFilename.Split("__");
        if (splitted.Length != 2)
            throw new Exception("Fájl formátum hibás! (Helyes formátum: Vx.y.z__filename.extension). Hibás fájl: " + fullFilename);

        var version = splitted[0].Replace("V", string.Empty);
        ValidateVersion(version);

        var filename = splitted[1];

        var model = new FilenameModel
        {
            Version = version,
            Filename = filename
        };

        return model;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Validates the version.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="version">The version.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Logic.Logging.Category.Exception">
    /// Hibás verzió! A helyes verzió formátuma: x.y.z - hibás verzió: " + version
    /// or
    /// A verzió major része nem szám! Hibás verzió: " + version
    /// or
    /// A verzió minor része nem szám! Hibás verzió: " + version
    /// or
    /// A verzió patch része nem szám! Hibás verzió: " + version
    /// </exception>
    private static void ValidateVersion(string version)
    {
        var splitted = version.Split('.');
        if (splitted.Length != 3)
            throw new Exception("Hibás verzió! A helyes verzió formátuma: x.y.z - hibás verzió: " + version);

        var majorSuccess = int.TryParse(splitted[0], out var _);
        if (!majorSuccess)
            throw new Exception("A verzió major része nem szám! Hibás verzió: " + version);

        var minorSuccess = int.TryParse(splitted[1], out var _);
        if (!minorSuccess)
            throw new Exception("A verzió minor része nem szám! Hibás verzió: " + version);

        var patchSuccess = int.TryParse(splitted[2], out var _);
        if (!patchSuccess)
            throw new Exception("A verzió patch része nem szám! Hibás verzió: " + version);
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// FolderValidationHelper
/// </summary>
public static class FolderValidationHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Validates the files.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="migrationModels">The migration models.</param>
    /// <param name="fileChecksumModels">The file checksum models.</param>
    public static void ValidateFiles(
        List<FluentMigrationModel> migrationModels,
        List<FileChecksumModel> fileChecksumModels)
    {
        var errors = new List<string?>();

        foreach (var fileChecksumModel in fileChecksumModels)
        {
            var migrationModel = migrationModels
                .FirstOrDefault(mm =>
                    mm.Script ==
                    $"V{fileChecksumModel?.FilenameModel?.Version}__{fileChecksumModel?.FilenameModel?.Filename}");
            
            if (migrationModel is null)
                continue;

            if (fileChecksumModel.Checksum != migrationModel.Checksum)
                errors.Add($"{migrationModel.Script}({fileChecksumModel.Checksum} != {migrationModel.Checksum})");
        }

        //Checksum hiba a már korábban feldolgozott migrációs fájl tartalmának megváltozása estén lép fel
        //if (errors.Any())
        //    throw new Exception(
        //        "Checksum hib(a/ák) a migrációs mappában! Hibás fájlok: " + string.Join(',', errors));
    }
}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// VersionHelper
/// </summary>
public static class VersionHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Orders the versions.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="versions">The versions.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static List<string> OrderVersions(List<string> versions)
    {
        var versionClasses = versions.Select(v => new Version(v)).ToList();
        versionClasses.Sort();
        return versionClasses.Select(vc => vc.ToString()).ToList();
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Npgsql;
using NpgsqlTypes;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic;

/// <summary>
/// BinaryFileLoader
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic.LogicBase" />
public class BinaryFileLoader : LogicBase
{
    #region Private variables

    /// <summary>
    /// The source path
    /// </summary>
    private readonly string _sourcePath;

    #endregion

    #region Constructors

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BinaryFileLoader"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configuration">The configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="info">The information.</param>
    /// <param name="sourcePath">The source path.</param>
    public BinaryFileLoader(IConfiguration configuration, ConnectionInfo info, string sourcePath)
        : base(configuration, info)
    {
        _sourcePath = sourcePath;
    }
    #endregion

    #region Public methods
    /// <summary>
    /// Starts the process.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    public override void StartProcess(string[]? args = null)
    {
        using (var conn = CreateConnection())
        {
            ProcessDirectory(conn);
        }
    }
    #endregion

    #region Private methods

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the directory.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="conn">The connection.</param>
    private void ProcessDirectory(NpgsqlConnection conn)
    {
        string[] dirs = Directory.GetDirectories(_sourcePath);
        foreach (var dir in dirs)
        {
            string[] dirParams = Path.GetFileName(dir).Split(new[] { "__" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);

            if (dirParams.Length < 2)
                continue;

            var tableName = dirParams[0].ToLower();
            var columnName = dirParams[1].ToLower();

            Console.WriteLine("Processing {0}", tableName);

            string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(dir);
            foreach (var file in files)
            {
                string fileName = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file);
                string[] fileParams = fileName.Split(new[] { '_' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                int entityId = Convert.ToInt32(fileParams[0]);
                string sqlText = CreateSqlText(tableName, columnName, entityId);

                var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand(sqlText, conn);
                var param = new NpgsqlParameter("@data", NpgsqlDbType.Bytea);
                var fileBytes = File.ReadAllBytes(file);
                param.Value = fileBytes;

                cmd.Parameters.Add(param);
                cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the SQL text.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tableName">Name of the table.</param>
    /// <param name="columnName">Name of the column.</param>
    /// <param name="entityId">The entity identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string CreateSqlText(string tableName, string columnName, int entityId)
    {
        var sqlText = string.Format("UPDATE {0} SET {1} = @data WHERE {0}_id = {2}",
                tableName, columnName, entityId);
        return sqlText;
    }
    #endregion
}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic;

{

    /// Gets or sets the database.

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    public string? Password { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the username.
    /// </summary>

    /// </value>

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    /// <value>

    /// </value>
    public string? HostName { get; set; }

    /// </summary>
    /// <value>

using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Npgsql;
using Serilog;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic;

/// <summary>
/// LogicBase
/// </summary>
public abstract class LogicBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The connection information
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ConnectionInfo _connectionInfo;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the configuration.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The configuration.
    /// </value>
    public IConfiguration Configuration { get; init; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="LogicBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configuration">The configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="info">The information.</param>
    protected LogicBase(IConfiguration configuration, ConnectionInfo info)
    {
        _connectionInfo = info;
        Configuration = configuration;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the connection information.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The connection information.
    /// </value>
    protected ConnectionInfo ConnectionInfo { get { return _connectionInfo; } }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the connection.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public NpgsqlConnection CreateConnection()
    {
        string connStr = _connectionInfo.HostName == null 
            ? Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection") ?? "ERR"
            : Configuration.GetConnectionString("TemplateConnection") ?? "ERR";

        connStr = connStr.Replace("[DB]", _connectionInfo.Database);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_connectionInfo.HostName))
            connStr = connStr.Replace("[host]", _connectionInfo.HostName ?? "ERR");

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_connectionInfo.Port))
            connStr = connStr.Replace("[port]", _connectionInfo.Port ?? "5432");

        var conn = new NpgsqlConnection();

        conn.Notice += Conn_Notice;

        Log.ForContext<LogicBase>().Debug($"LogicBase-CreateConnection: connStr built: {connStr}");

        conn.ConnectionString = connStr;
        conn.Open();
        return conn;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Handles the Notice event of the Conn control.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="sender">The source of the event.</param>
    /// <param name="e">The <see cref="NpgsqlNoticeEventArgs"/> instance containing the event data.</param>
    private void Conn_Notice(object sender, NpgsqlNoticeEventArgs e)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(e.Notice.MessageText);
        Log.ForContext<LogicBase>().Debug(e.Notice.MessageText);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts the process.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    public abstract void StartProcess(string[]? args = null);



}

using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Helpers;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Npgsql;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic;

/// <summary>
/// ScriptLoader
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic.LogicBase" />
public class ScriptLoader : LogicBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The script path
    /// </summary>
    private readonly string _scriptPath;



    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ScriptLoader"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configuration">The configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="info">The information.</param>
    /// <param name="scriptPath">The script path.</param>
    public ScriptLoader(IConfiguration configuration, ConnectionInfo info, string scriptPath) : base(configuration, info)
    {
        _scriptPath = scriptPath;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts the process.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    public override void StartProcess(string[]? args = null)
    {
        var arg = (args != null && args.Length > 3) ? args[3] : null;

        Serilog.Log.ForContext<ScriptLoader>().Debug($"Processing {_scriptPath}");

        // Szokásos módon, kapott schemara legyen megfuttatva a script.
        var replaceData = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(arg))
        {
            var @params = arg.Split(';');
            foreach (var x in @params)
            {
                var data = x.Split('=');
                if (data.Length == 2)
                {
                    replaceData.Add(string.Concat("{", data[0], "}"), data[1]);
                }
            }
        }
        if (!replaceData.ContainsKey("{host}"))
            replaceData.Add("{host}", ConnectionInfo.HostName);
        if (!replaceData.ContainsKey("{port}"))
            replaceData.Add("{port}", ConnectionInfo.Port);
        if (!replaceData.ContainsKey("{username}"))
            replaceData.Add("{username}", ConnectionInfo.Username);

        bool isMultiStatement = arg != null && arg.Equals("multistatement", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);

        Serilog.Log.ForContext<ScriptLoader>().Debug($"StartProcess: Connectioninfo = {ConnectionInfo}");
        using var conn = CreateConnection();

        string currentPath = Directory.GetCurrentDirectory();
        var script = File.ReadAllText(_scriptPath);

        foreach (var x in replaceData)
            script = script.Replace(x.Key, x.Value);

        if (isMultiStatement)
        {
            var statements = script.Split(';');
            int i = 0;
            foreach (var statement in statements)
            {
                ExecuteScript(statement, conn);

                i++;
                if (i % 1000 == 0)
                    Console.WriteLine(i);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            ExecuteScript(script, conn);
        }
        conn.Close();

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the script.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="script">The script.</param>
    /// <param name="conn">The connection.</param>
    private static void ExecuteScript(string script, NpgsqlConnection conn)
    {
        var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand
        {
            Connection = conn,
            CommandText = script,
            CommandTimeout = 600
        };

        try
        {
            cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            ErrorHelper.ExitCode = 1;
            Serilog.Log.ForContext<ScriptLoader>().Debug($"ExecuteScript: {script}{Environment.NewLine}{ex}");
            throw;
        }
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Models;
using Npgsql;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic;

/// <summary>
/// TenantManager
/// </summary>
public class TenantManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the connection string.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The connection string.
    /// </value>
    public string ConnectionStr { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TenantManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbname">The dbname.</param>
    public TenantManager(string? dbname = null)
    {
        var dbName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbname) ? Config.GetStringValue($"DbData:EnergiaMenedzsment:DbName") : dbname;
        var defaultConnStr = Config.GetStringValue("ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection");
        ConnectionStr = defaultConnStr.Replace("[DB]", dbName);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the non-deleted and successfully created tenants.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IList<TenantModel> GetTenants()
    {
        var tenantList = new List<TenantModel>();

        using (NpgsqlConnection? conn = new(ConnectionStr))
        {
            conn.Open();
            var queryString = "SELECT code, name FROM public.tenant WHERE is_deleted = false ORDER BY tenant_id;";

            using var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand(queryString, conn);
            using var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader();
            while (reader.Read())
            {
                var entity = new TenantModel
                {
                    Code = reader.GetString(0),
                    Name = reader.GetString(1)
                };
                tenantList.Add(entity);
            }
        }

        return tenantList;
    }

}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Npgsql;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic;

/// <summary>
/// TextFileLoader
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Logic.LogicBase" />
public class TextFileLoader : LogicBase
{
    #region Private variables

    /// <summary>
    /// The source path
    /// </summary>
    private readonly string _sourcePath;

    #endregion

    #region Constructors

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TextFileLoader"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="configuration">The configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="info">The information.</param>
    /// <param name="sourcePath">The source path.</param>
    public TextFileLoader(IConfiguration configuration, ConnectionInfo info, string sourcePath)
        : base(configuration, info)
    {
        _sourcePath = sourcePath;
    }

    #endregion

    #region Public methods

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts the process.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    public override void StartProcess(string[]? args = null)
    {
        using (var conn = CreateConnection())
        {
            if (args.Length == 3)
            {
                ProcessDirectory(conn);
            }
            else
            {
                ProcessFile(conn, args);
            }
        }
    }

    #endregion

    #region Private methods

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the file.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="conn">The connection.</param>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    private void ProcessFile(NpgsqlConnection conn, string[] args)
    {
        var tableName = args[3];
        var columnName = args[4];
        var entityId = Convert.ToInt32(args[5]);

        Console.WriteLine(tableName);
        Console.WriteLine(columnName);
        Console.WriteLine(entityId);
        Console.WriteLine(_sourcePath);
        Console.WriteLine(Path.GetDirectoryName(_sourcePath));

        var text = File.ReadAllText(_sourcePath);

        // http://www.postgresql.org/docs/8.3/interactive/sql-syntax-lexical.html#SQL-SYNTAX-STRINGS
        text = text.Replace("'", "''");

        string sqlText = CreateSqlText(tableName, columnName, entityId, text);

        var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand(sqlText, conn);
        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the directory.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="conn">The connection.</param>
    private void ProcessDirectory(NpgsqlConnection conn)
    {
        string[] dirs = Directory.GetDirectories(_sourcePath);
        foreach (var dir in dirs)
        {
            string[] dirParams = Path.GetFileName(dir).Split(new[] { "__" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);

            if (dirParams.Length < 2)
                continue;

            var tableName = dirParams[0].ToLower();
            var columnName = dirParams[1].ToLower();

            Console.WriteLine("Processing {0}", tableName);

            string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(dir);
            foreach (var file in files)
            {
                string fileName = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file);

                string[] fileParams = fileName.Split(new[] { '_' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);

                int entityId = Convert.ToInt32(fileParams[0]);

                var text = File.ReadAllText(file).Replace("'", "''");

                string sqlText = CreateSqlText(tableName, columnName, entityId, text);

                var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand(sqlText, conn);
                cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the SQL text.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tableName">Name of the table.</param>
    /// <param name="columnName">Name of the column.</param>
    /// <param name="entityId">The entity identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="text">The text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string CreateSqlText(string tableName, string columnName, int entityId, string text)
    {
        var sqlText = string.Format("UPDATE {0} SET {1} = '{2}' WHERE {0}_id = {3}",
                tableName, columnName, text, entityId);

        return sqlText;
    }

    #endregion
}

using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>
/// BackgroundServiceBase
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.BackgroundService" />
public abstract class BackgroundServiceBase : BackgroundService
{
    /// <summary>
    /// This method is called when the <see cref="T:Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.IHostedService" /> starts. The implementation should return a task that represents
    /// the lifetime of the long running operation(s) being performed.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="stoppingToken">Triggered when <see cref="M:Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.IHostedService.StopAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)" /> is called.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// A <see cref="T:System.Threading.Tasks.Task" /> that represents the long running operations.
    /// </returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// See <see href="https://docs.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/extensions/workers">Worker Services in .NET</see> for implementation guidelines.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        Log.LogInfo($"Start service: {GetType().Name}");

        OnStart();

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Triggered when the application host is performing a graceful shutdown.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Indicates that the shutdown process should no longer be graceful.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        Log.LogInfo($"Stop service: {GetType().Name}");

        OnStop();

        return base.StopAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Service start implementation
    /// </summary>
    protected abstract void OnStart();

    /// <summary>
    /// Service stop implementation
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual void OnStop()
    {
    }
}

using System.Collections.Specialized;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Quartz;
using Quartz.Impl;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>
/// QuartzServiceBase
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.BackgroundServiceBase" />
public abstract class QuartzServiceBase : BackgroundServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The scheduler
    /// </summary>
    private static IScheduler? _scheduler;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the database connection string key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The database connection string key.
    /// </value>
    private string DbConnectionStringKey { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="QuartzServiceBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbConnectionStringKey">The database connection string key.</param>
    protected QuartzServiceBase(string dbConnectionStringKey)
    {
        DbConnectionStringKey = dbConnectionStringKey;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Service stop implementation
    /// </summary>
    protected override void OnStop()
    {
        if (_scheduler == null)
            return;

        _scheduler.Shutdown(true);
        _scheduler = null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the scheduler.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected IScheduler GetScheduler()
    {
        return _scheduler ?? StartScheduler();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts the scheduler.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IScheduler StartScheduler()
    {
        if (_scheduler != null)
            return _scheduler;

        var properties = new NameValueCollection
        {
            ["quartz.jobStore.dataSource"] = "default",
            ["quartz.dataSource.default.provider"] = "Npgsql",
            ["quartz.dataSource.default.connectionString"] = Config.GetStringValue(DbConnectionStringKey, true),

            // appSettings
            ["quartz.scheduler.instanceName"] = Config.GetStringValue("Quartz.Scheduler.InstanceName", true),
            ["quartz.scheduler.instanceId"] = Config.GetStringValue("Quartz.Scheduler.InstanceId", true),
            ["quartz.threadPool.type"] = "Quartz.Simpl.SimpleThreadPool, Quartz",
            ["quartz.jobStore.misfireThreshold"] = Config.GetStringValue("Quartz.JobStore.MisfireThreshold", true),
            ["quartz.jobStore.clustered"] = "true",
            ["quartz.jobStore.performSchemaValidation"] = "false",
            ["quartz.jobStore.type"] = "Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.JobStoreTX, Quartz",
            ["quartz.jobStore.useProperties"] = "false",
            ["quartz.jobStore.driverDelegateType"] = "Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.StdAdoDelegate, Quartz",
            ["quartz.jobStore.tablePrefix"] = "qrtz_",
            ["quartz.serializer.type"] = "json"
        };

        var factory = new StdSchedulerFactory(properties);
        _scheduler = factory.GetScheduler().RunSync();

        return _scheduler;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\BackgroundServices\SyncRunJobManager.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Scheduler;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;
using Quartz;
using Quartz.Impl.Matchers;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>
/// SyncRunJobManager
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TRunEntity">The type of the run entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TRunJob">The type of the run job.</typeparam>
public class SyncRunJobManager<TRunEntity, TRunJob>
    where TRunEntity : TrackedEntityBase, IEntityWithRecurrence
    where TRunJob : IScheduledJob
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the run identifier key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The run identifier key.
    /// </value>
    public string RunIdKey { get; init; } = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the run filter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The run filter.
    /// </value>
    public Func<IQueryable<TRunEntity>, IQueryable<TRunEntity>> RunFilter { get; init; } = source => source;

    /// <summary>
    /// The synchronize object name
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly string SyncObjectName = typeof(TRunEntity).EntityTypeName();

    /// <summary>
    /// The key prefix
    /// </summary>
    private readonly string _keyPrefix = $"{SyncObjectName}Job";

    /// <summary>
    /// Runs the key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityId">The entity identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private string RunKey(int entityId) => $"{_keyPrefix}_{entityId}";

    /// <summary>
    /// The group prefix
    /// </summary>
    private readonly string _groupPrefix = $"{SyncObjectName}Group";

    /// <summary>
    /// Groups the specified tenant code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private string Group(string tenantCode) => $"{_groupPrefix}_{tenantCode}";

    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    private ILogger<SyncRunJobManager<TRunEntity, TRunJob>>? _logger;

    /// <summary>
    /// Schedules the jobs.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="scheduler">The scheduler.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">TenantCode is required to run this job</exception>
    public void ScheduleJobs(ILifetimeScope scope, IScheduler scheduler)
    {
        _logger = scope.Resolve<ILogger<SyncRunJobManager<TRunEntity, TRunJob>>>();
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var dbSession = dbContext.Session;

        var syncInfo = dbSession.Query<SyncObjectEntity>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.EntityName == SyncObjectName);

        if (!JobCanRun(syncInfo) || !JobNeedsToRun(syncInfo))
        {
            _logger.LogDebug("Job can't run or doesn't need to run");
            return;
        }

        var securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        if (securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode is null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("TenantCode is required to run this job");

        // lekérem a tenant Runokat, ami nem törölt
        var query = dbSession.Query<TRunEntity>().NotDeleted().RecurrenceEndYetToCome();
        var runsInDb = RunFilter(query);

        var groupMatcher = GroupMatcher<JobKey>.GroupEquals(Group(securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode));
        // lekérem a már regisztrált jobokat
        var existingJobs = scheduler.GetJobKeys(groupMatcher).RunSync()
            .Where(jobKey => jobKey.Name.StartsWith(_keyPrefix)).ToList();

        foreach (var runEntity in runsInDb)
        {
            if (runEntity.StartAt == DateTime.MinValue) runEntity.StartAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            // regisztrálom a job-t ha még nem regisztrált
            CreateScheduledJobIfNotExists(runEntity, securityContext, scheduler);
        }

        // a regisztrált jobokból kitörlöm, ami a db-ben is már törölt
        var deletedRuns = dbSession.Query<TRunEntity>().Where(x => x.IsDeleted).Select(x => x.Id).ToList();
        var jobsToBeDeleted = existingJobs.Where(jobKey =>
        {
            var jobDetail = scheduler.GetJobDetail(jobKey).RunSync();
            if (jobDetail != null)
            {
                var jobId = (long)jobDetail.JobDataMap[RunIdKey];
                return deletedRuns.Contains((int)jobId);
            }
            return false;
        }).ToList();

        _logger.LogDebug("Deleting jobs that have deleted runs (job keys: {@JobsToBeDeleted})", jobsToBeDeleted);
        scheduler.DeleteJobs(jobsToBeDeleted).RunSync();

        syncInfo.LastSyncDate = DateTime.UtcNow;

        dbSession.SaveOrUpdate(syncInfo);
        dbContext.Commit();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jobs the can run.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="syncInfo">The synchronize information.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static bool JobCanRun([NotNullWhen(true)] SyncObjectEntity? syncInfo)
    {
        return syncInfo is { LastModifiedDate: { } };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jobs the needs to run.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="syncInfo">The synchronize information.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static bool JobNeedsToRun(SyncObjectEntity syncInfo)
    {
        return syncInfo.LastSyncDate is null || syncInfo.LastSyncDate < syncInfo.LastModifiedDate;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the scheduled job if not exists.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jobToBeScheduled">The job to be scheduled.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="scheduler">The scheduler.</param>
    private void CreateScheduledJobIfNotExists(TRunEntity jobToBeScheduled, SecurityContext securityContext, IScheduler scheduler)
    {
        try
        {
            var jobKey = new JobKey(RunKey(jobToBeScheduled.Id), Group(securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode!));
            var triggerKey = new TriggerKey(RunKey(jobToBeScheduled.Id), Group(securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode!));

            IJobDetail job = null!;

            if (!scheduler.CheckExists(jobKey).RunSync())
            {
                _logger?.LogDebug("Creating {JobKey} job (reason: didn't exist yet)", jobKey);

                IDictionary<string, object> defaultJobData = new Dictionary<string, object>
                {
                    {RunIdKey,  jobToBeScheduled.Id},
                    {JobBase.JobSecurityContextKey, JobBase.GetJobSecurityContext(securityContext)},
                };

                var jobBuilder = JobBuilder.Create(typeof(TRunJob))
                    .WithIdentity(jobKey)
                    .UsingJobData(new JobDataMap(defaultJobData))
                    .RequestRecovery(false);

                job = jobBuilder.Build();
            }
            else
            {
                _logger?.LogDebug("Found {JobKey} job", jobKey);
                job = scheduler.GetJobDetail(jobKey).RunSync()!;
            }

            if (jobToBeScheduled.RecurrenceType == RecurrenceType.Once)//egyszeri végrehajtás
            {
                if (!scheduler.CheckExists(triggerKey).RunSync())
                {
                    var schedule = SimpleScheduleBuilder.Create().WithRepeatCount(0);

                    var trigger = TriggerBuilder.Create()
                        .WithIdentity(triggerKey)
                        .StartAt(jobToBeScheduled.StartAt)
                        .WithSchedule(schedule)
                        .Build();

                    //Ha a JOB-hoz már tartozik trigger és a trigger hibát tartalmaz, akkor újraütemezzük
                    var triggers = scheduler.GetTriggersOfJob(jobKey).RunSync();
                    if (!triggers.Any() || triggers.First().Key.Group != JobFailureListenerConstants.TriggerGroup)
                    {
                        _logger?.LogDebug("Scheduling {JobKey} with new {TriggerKey} trigger for a Run Once job", jobKey, triggerKey);
                        scheduler.ScheduleJob(job, trigger).RunSync();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _logger?.LogDebug("Rescheduling {JobKey} with new {TriggerKey} trigger for a Run Once job (last trigger was in the failed trigger group)", jobKey, triggerKey);
                        scheduler.RescheduleJob(triggerKey, trigger).RunSync();
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var trigger = (ISimpleTrigger)scheduler.GetTrigger(triggerKey).RunSync()!;
                    if (trigger.StartTimeUtc == jobToBeScheduled.StartAt)
                    {
                        _logger?.LogDebug("No rescheduling done for {JobKey} with {TriggerKey} trigger because its starting time doesn't need to change", jobKey, triggerKey);
                        return;
                    }

                    trigger = (ISimpleTrigger)trigger.GetTriggerBuilder()
                        .StartAt(jobToBeScheduled.StartAt)
                        .WithSchedule(SimpleScheduleBuilder.Create().WithRepeatCount(0))
                        .Build();

                    _logger?.LogDebug("Rescheduling {JobKey} using existing but rebuilt {TriggerKey} trigger for a Run Once job", jobKey, triggerKey);
                    scheduler.RescheduleJob(triggerKey, trigger).RunSync();
                }
            }
            else //többszöri végrehajtás
            {
                if (!scheduler.CheckExists(triggerKey).RunSync())
                {
                    var cronExpression = new CronGenerator(jobToBeScheduled, 2).CronString;
                    var trigger = TriggerBuilder.Create()
                        .WithIdentity(triggerKey)
                        .StartAt(jobToBeScheduled.StartAt)
                        .WithCronSchedule(cronExpression)
                        .EndAt(jobToBeScheduled.EndAt)
                        .Build();
                    _logger?.LogDebug($"New trigger created: key={triggerKey}, cron='{cronExpression}', start='{jobToBeScheduled.StartAt}', end='{jobToBeScheduled.EndAt}'");

                    //Ha a JOB-hoz már tartozik trigger és a trigger hibát tartalmaz, akkor újraütemezzük
                    var triggers = scheduler.GetTriggersOfJob(jobKey).RunSync();
                    if (!triggers.Any() || triggers.First().Key.Group != JobFailureListenerConstants.TriggerGroup)
                    {
                        _logger?.LogDebug("Scheduling {JobKey} with new {TriggerKey} trigger for a cron job", jobKey, triggerKey);
                        scheduler.ScheduleJob(job, trigger).RunSync();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _logger?.LogDebug("Rescheduling {JobKey} with new {TriggerKey} trigger for a cron job (last trigger was in the failed trigger group)", jobKey, triggerKey);
                        scheduler.RescheduleJob(triggerKey, trigger).RunSync();
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var cronExpression = new CronGenerator(jobToBeScheduled).CronString;
                    var trigger = (ICronTrigger)scheduler.GetTrigger(triggerKey).RunSync()!;
                    if (trigger.CronExpressionString == cronExpression)
                    {
                        _logger?.LogDebug("No rescheduling done for {JobKey} with {TriggerKey} trigger because its cron expression doesn't need to change", jobKey, triggerKey);
                        return;
                    }

                    trigger = (ICronTrigger)trigger.GetTriggerBuilder()
                        .StartAt(jobToBeScheduled.StartAt)
                        .WithCronSchedule(cronExpression)
                        .EndAt(jobToBeScheduled.EndAt)
                        .Build();
                    _logger?.LogDebug($"Existing trigger rebuilt: key={triggerKey}, cron='{cronExpression}', start='{jobToBeScheduled.StartAt}', end='{jobToBeScheduled.EndAt}'");

                    _logger?.LogDebug("Rescheduling {JobKey} using existing but rebuilt {TriggerKey} trigger for a cron job", jobKey, triggerKey);
                    scheduler.RescheduleJob(triggerKey, trigger).RunSync();
                }
            }

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger?.LogError(ex, $"SyncRunJobManager_CreateScheduledJobIfNotExists: Error occured at Job id = {jobToBeScheduled.Id} ");
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// 
/// </summary>
internal static class QueryHelpers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Nots the deleted.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSource">The type of the source.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IQueryable<TSource> NotDeleted<TSource>(this IQueryable<TSource> source)
        where TSource : ILogicalDeleteEntity
    {
        return source.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Recurrences the end yet to come.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSource">The type of the source.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IQueryable<TSource> RecurrenceEndYetToCome<TSource>(this IQueryable<TSource> source)
        where TSource : IEntityWithRecurrence
    {
        return source.Where(x => x.EndAt == null || x.EndAt > DateTime.UtcNow);
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Tenant;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>
/// TimerServiceBase
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.QuartzServiceBase" />
/// <seealso cref="Quartz.IJob" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public abstract class TimerServiceBase : QuartzServiceBase, IJob
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the job.
    /// </value>
    protected virtual string JobName => GetType().Name;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the cron expression.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The cron expression.
    /// </value>
    protected virtual string CronExpression => Config.TryGetStringValue($"{JobName}.CronExpression") ?? "0 0/5 * * * ?";

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the scheduler group.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the scheduler group.
    /// </value>
    protected abstract string SchedulerGroupName { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant running mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected virtual TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode { get; } = TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TimerServiceBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbConnectionStringKey">The database connection string key.</param>
    protected TimerServiceBase(string dbConnectionStringKey) : base(dbConnectionStringKey)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected abstract void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope);

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jobBuilder">The job builder.</param>
    protected virtual void SetUpJob(JobBuilder jobBuilder) { }

    /// <summary>
    /// Service start implementation
    /// </summary>
    protected override void OnStart()
    {
        if (CronExpression is null)
            return;

        var scheduler = GetScheduler();

        var jobKey = new JobKey(JobName, SchedulerGroupName);
        var triggerKey = new TriggerKey(JobName, SchedulerGroupName);

        IJobDetail? job = null;
        if (!scheduler.CheckExists(jobKey).RunSync())
        {
            var jobBuilder = JobBuilder.Create(GetType())
                .WithIdentity(jobKey)
                .RequestRecovery(false);
            SetUpJob(jobBuilder);
            job = jobBuilder.Build();
        }

        if (!scheduler.CheckExists(triggerKey).RunSync())
        {
            var trigger = TriggerBuilder.Create()
                .WithIdentity(triggerKey)
                .WithCronSchedule(CronExpression)
                .StartNow()
                .Build();

            // TODO A job itt lehet null! Fel kell olvasni a jobDetail-t, hogy ne okozzon hibát ez a sor?
            scheduler.ScheduleJob(job, trigger).RunSync();
        }
        else
        {
            var trigger = (ICronTrigger?)scheduler.GetTrigger(triggerKey).RunSync();
            if (trigger is not null && trigger.CronExpressionString != CronExpression)
            {
                trigger = (ICronTrigger)trigger.GetTriggerBuilder()
                    .WithCronSchedule(CronExpression)
                    .StartNow()
                    .Build();
                scheduler.RescheduleJob(triggerKey, trigger).RunSync();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Called by the <see cref="T:Quartz.IScheduler" /> when a <see cref="T:Quartz.ITrigger" />
    /// fires that is associated with the <see cref="T:Quartz.IJob" />.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The execution context.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <remarks>
    /// The implementation may wish to set a  result object on the
    /// JobExecutionContext before this method exits.  The result itself
    /// is meaningless to Quartz, but may be informative to
    /// <see cref="T:Quartz.IJobListener" />s or
    /// <see cref="T:Quartz.ITriggerListener" />s that are watching the job's
    /// execution.
    /// </remarks>
    public Task Execute(IJobExecutionContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"Executing {JobName} job");


            switch (TenantRunningMode)
            {
                case TenantRunningMode.Both:
                    {
                        TenantDependentExecute();
                        TenantInDependentExecute();
                        break;
                    }
                case TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent:
                    {
                        TenantDependentExecute();
                        break;
                    }
                case TenantRunningMode.TenantIndependent:
                    {
                        TenantInDependentExecute();
                        break;
                    }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, "TimerServiceBase error");
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenants the dependent execute.
    /// </summary>
    private void TenantDependentExecute()
    {
        using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        scope.SetAnonymousContext(null);
        var qs = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        var tenantList = qs.QueryEntities<TenantEntityDto>();
        foreach (var tenant in tenantList.Items)
        {
            if (tenant.Status != TenantStatus.Created) continue;
            using var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
            tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(tenant.Code);
            var enabled = tenantScope.Config().TryGetBoolValue($"{JobName}.Enabled") ?? true;
            if (enabled)
            {
                Log.LogInfo($"Tenant: {tenant.Name} - {tenant.Code} [{this.GetType().Name}] background job is running...");
                // TODO: Background job context-et létre kell hozni és jogosítani
                Elapsed(tenantScope);
                Log.LogInfo($"Tenant: {tenant.Name} - {tenant.Code} [{this.GetType().Name}] background job is finished.");
            }
        }
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Tenants the in dependent execute.
    /// </summary>
    private void TenantInDependentExecute()
    {
        using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        scope.SetAnonymousContext(null);
        var enabled = scope.Config().TryGetBoolValue($"{JobName}.Enabled") ?? true;
        if (enabled)
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"Tenant independent: [{this.GetType().Name}] background job is running...");
            // TODO: Background job context-et létre kell hozni és jogosítani
            Elapsed(scope);
            Log.LogInfo($"Tenant independent: [{this.GetType().Name}] background job is finished.");
        }
    }
}
