using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Models.Job;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// JobBase
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Quartz.IJob" />
[PersistJobDataAfterExecution]
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public abstract class JobBase : IJob
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The job security context key
    /// </summary>
    public const string JobSecurityContextKey = "JobSecurityContext";

    /// <summary>
    /// Called by the <see cref="T:Quartz.IScheduler" /> when a <see cref="T:Quartz.ITrigger" />
    /// fires that is associated with the <see cref="T:Quartz.IJob" />.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The execution context.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// The implementation may wish to set a  result object on the
    /// JobExecutionContext before this method exits.  The result itself
    /// is meaningless to Quartz, but may be informative to
    /// <see cref="T:Quartz.IJobListener" />s or
    /// <see cref="T:Quartz.ITriggerListener" />s that are watching the job's
    /// execution.
    /// </remarks>
    public async Task Execute(IJobExecutionContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"{context.JobDetail.Key.Name} - {DateTimeContext.Now} -> START");

            var jobData = context.JobDetail.JobDataMap;

            using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();

            JobSecurityContext? jobSecurityContext = (JobSecurityContext?)jobData[JobSecurityContextKey];
            if (jobSecurityContext != null)
            {
                SetSecurityContext(scope, jobSecurityContext);
                Log.LogInfo($"SecurityContext: {jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.LoginName}@{jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode}");
            }
            await ExecuteJob(context, scope);

            Log.LogInfo($"{context.JobDetail.Key.Name} - Done.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, $"{context.JobDetail.Key.Name} - {DateTimeContext.Now} -> ERROR!");
            Log.LogInfo($"{context.JobDetail.Key.Name} - {DateTimeContext.Now} -> ERROR!");
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"{context.JobDetail.Key.Name} - {DateTimeContext.Now} -> END");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected abstract Task ExecuteJob(IJobExecutionContext context, ILifetimeScope scope);

    /// <summary>
    /// A SecurityContext beállítása a Scope-on.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="jobSecurityContext">The job security context.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">
    /// Scope cannot be null!
    /// or
    /// JobSecurityContext cannot be null!
    /// or
    /// JobSecurityContext.CurrentUser cannot be null!
    /// </exception>
    protected static void SetSecurityContext(ILifetimeScope? scope, JobSecurityContext? jobSecurityContext)
    {
        if (scope == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Scope cannot be null!");

        if (jobSecurityContext == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("JobSecurityContext cannot be null!");

        if (jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("JobSecurityContext.CurrentUser cannot be null!");

        SecUser secUser = new(
            jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId,
            jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.LoginName,
            jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode,
            jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.DisplayName,
            jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.Email,
            jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.Roles,
            jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.OrgUnits,
            jobSecurityContext.CurrentUser.IsSystem
        );

        SecurityContext securityContext = SecurityContext.Create(scope,
            secUser,
            jobSecurityContext.SessionId,
            jobSecurityContext.ClientIp
        );

        scope.SetSecurityContext(securityContext);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the job security context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static JobSecurityContext GetJobSecurityContext(SecurityContext securityContext)
    {
        JobSecurityContext jobSecurityContext = null;
        if (securityContext?.CurrentUser != null)
        {
            // SecUser becsomagolása
            var jobSecUser = new JobSecUser
            {
                DisplayName = securityContext.CurrentUser.DisplayName,
                Email = securityContext.CurrentUser.Email,
                IsSystem = securityContext.CurrentUser.IsSystem,
                GlobalId = securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId,
                LoginName = securityContext.CurrentUser.LoginName,
                OrgUnits = securityContext.CurrentUser.OrgUnits,
                Roles = securityContext.CurrentUser.Roles,
                TenantCode = securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode
            };

            // SecContext becsomagolása
            jobSecurityContext = new JobSecurityContext
            {
                CurrentUser = jobSecUser,
                ClientIp = securityContext.ClientIp,
                SessionId = securityContext.SessionId
            };
        }

        return jobSecurityContext;
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// JobFailureListener
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Quartz.IJobListener" />
public class JobFailureListener : IJobListener
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Get the name of the <see cref="T:Quartz.IJobListener" />.
    /// </summary>
    public string Name => "FailJobListener";

    /// <summary>
    /// Called by the <see cref="T:Quartz.IScheduler" /> when a <see cref="T:Quartz.IJobDetail" />
    /// is about to be executed (an associated <see cref="T:Quartz.ITrigger" />
    /// has occurred).
    /// <para>
    /// This method will not be invoked if the execution of the Job was vetoed
    /// by a <see cref="T:Quartz.ITriggerListener" />.
    /// </para>
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context"></param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <seealso cref="M:Quartz.IJobListener.JobExecutionVetoed(Quartz.IJobExecutionContext,System.Threading.CancellationToken)" />
    public Task JobToBeExecuted(IJobExecutionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (!context.JobDetail.JobDataMap.Contains(JobFailureListenerConstants.RetryCount))
        {
            context.JobDetail.JobDataMap.Put(JobFailureListenerConstants.RetryCount, 0);
        }

        var numberTries = context.JobDetail.JobDataMap.GetIntValue(JobFailureListenerConstants.RetryCount);
        context.JobDetail.JobDataMap.Put(JobFailureListenerConstants.RetryCount, ++numberTries);

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Called by the <see cref="T:Quartz.IScheduler" /> when a <see cref="T:Quartz.IJobDetail" />
    /// was about to be executed (an associated <see cref="T:Quartz.ITrigger" />
    /// has occurred), but a <see cref="T:Quartz.ITriggerListener" /> vetoed it's
    /// execution.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context"></param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <seealso cref="M:Quartz.IJobListener.JobToBeExecuted(Quartz.IJobExecutionContext,System.Threading.CancellationToken)" />
    public Task JobExecutionVetoed(IJobExecutionContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Called by the <see cref="T:Quartz.IScheduler" /> after a <see cref="T:Quartz.IJobDetail" />
    /// has been executed, and be for the associated <see cref="T:Quartz.Spi.IOperableTrigger" />'s
    /// <see cref="M:Quartz.Spi.IOperableTrigger.Triggered(Quartz.ICalendar)" /> method has been called.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context"></param>
    /// <param name="jobException"></param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
    public async Task JobWasExecuted(IJobExecutionContext context, JobExecutionException? jobException, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (jobException == null)
        {
            return;
        }

        var numTries = context.JobDetail.JobDataMap.GetIntValue(JobFailureListenerConstants.RetryCount);

        if (numTries > JobFailureListenerConstants.MaxRetries)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + jobException.GetType().Name, jobException, $"Job with ID and type: {context.JobDetail.Key}, {context.JobDetail.JobType} has run {JobFailureListenerConstants.MaxRetries} times and has failed each time.");

            return;
        }

        var trigger = TriggerBuilder
            .Create()
            .WithIdentity(Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), JobFailureListenerConstants.TriggerGroup)
            .StartAt(DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(JobFailureListenerConstants.WaitInterval * numTries))
            .Build();

        Log.LogWarning($"Job with ID and type: {context.JobDetail.Key}, {context.JobDetail.JobType} has thrown the exception: {jobException}. Running again in {JobFailureListenerConstants.WaitInterval * numTries} seconds.");

        await context.Scheduler.RescheduleJob(context.Trigger.Key, trigger, cancellationToken);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Common;

/// <summary>
/// FavouriteCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Common.FavouriteEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Common.FavouriteEntityDto&gt;" />
public class FavouriteCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<FavouriteEntity, FavouriteEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="FavouriteCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public FavouriteCommandHandler(
       IDbContext dbContext,
       IMapper mapper,
       Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
       Lazy<IValidator<FavouriteEntityDto>> validator,
       ICommandService commandService,
       SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override FavouriteEntity ApplyDto(FavouriteEntityDto source, FavouriteEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        SecUserEntity currentUser = 
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.GlobalId == _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId)
            .List()[0];
        destination.User = currentUser;

        return entity;
    }

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;

using FluentValidation;
namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Emissions;

/// <summary>
/// Co2eFactorCommandHandler
/// </summary>
public class Co2eFactorCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<Co2eFactorEntity, Co2eFactorEntityDto>
{
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private const string CORE_DBCONTEXT_KEY = DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="Co2eFactorCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    public Co2eFactorCommandHandler(
        IMapper mapper,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<Co2eFactorEntityDto>> validator
        ) : base(lifetimeScope.ResolveKeyed<IDbContext>(CORE_DBCONTEXT_KEY), mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _commandService = commandService;
        _queryService = queryService;
    }


    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateCo2eFactorCommand createCommand => DoCreateCo2eFactorCommand(createCommand),
            ModifyCo2eFactorCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyCo2eFactorCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteCo2eFactorCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteCo2eFactorCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    private CreateCo2eFactorCommandResult DoCreateCo2eFactorCommand(CreateCo2eFactorCommand createCommand)
    {

        // az idősorban az előző bejegyzés záró dátumát is módosítani
        var previousEntry = (_queryService.QueryEntities(new Co2eFactorEntityQuery { Category = createCommand.Category, IsDeleted=false })?.Result as EntityQueryItemsResult<Co2eFactorEntityDto>)?.Items            
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.ValidFrom)
            .FirstOrDefault();


        //If there's a previous entry, set its end date to one day before the new entry's start date
        if (previousEntry != null)
        {
            previousEntry.ValidTo = createCommand.ValidFrom.AddDays(-1);
            _commandService.UpdateEntity(previousEntry,dbContextKey: CORE_DBCONTEXT_KEY);
        }


        Co2eFactorEntityDto entityDto = Mapper.Map<Co2eFactorEntityDto>(createCommand);


        var createdDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto, CORE_DBCONTEXT_KEY) ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Couldn't create CO2e factor!"); ;
        return new CreateCo2eFactorCommandResult { Co2eFactorEntityDto = createdDto };
    }

    private ModifyCo2eFactorCommandResult DoModifyCo2eFactorCommand(ModifyCo2eFactorCommand modifyCommand)
    {
        var existing = _queryService.GetById<Co2eFactorEntityDto>(modifyCommand.Co2eFactorId)
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Co2eFactorEntity Id. There is no Co2eFactorEntity with Id: '{modifyCommand.Co2eFactorId}'");

        Mapper.Map(modifyCommand, existing);
        var modifiedDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(existing, dbContextKey: CORE_DBCONTEXT_KEY)
            ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Couldn't modify CO2e factor!");
        return new ModifyCo2eFactorCommandResult { Co2eFactorEntityDto = modifiedDto };
    }

    private DeleteCo2eFactorCommandResult DoDeleteCo2eFactorCommand(DeleteCo2eFactorCommand deleteCommand)
    {
        var co2efactor = _queryService.GetById<Co2eFactorEntityDto>(deleteCommand.Co2eFactorId);

        if (co2efactor is null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Co2eFactorEntity Id. There is no Co2eFactorEntity with Id: '{deleteCommand.Co2eFactorId}'");

        var entityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<Co2eFactorEntityDto>(deleteCommand.Co2eFactorId, CORE_DBCONTEXT_KEY);

 
        //ha az idősorban a legutolsó tényezőt törlik, akkor az előtte lévőnek a ValidTo-ját null-ra kell átállíani.
        var previousFactor = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<Co2eFactorEntity>()
                                    .Where(x => x.Category == co2efactor.Category)
                                    .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted)
                                    .Where(x => x.ValidFrom < co2efactor.ValidFrom)
                                    .OrderBy(x => x.ValidFrom).Desc
                                    .Take(1)
                                    .SingleOrDefault();

        Co2eFactorEntityDto previousEntry = Mapper.Map<Co2eFactorEntityDto>(previousFactor);

        if (previousEntry != null)
        {
            previousEntry.ValidTo = null;
            _commandService.UpdateEntity(previousEntry);
        }

        return new DeleteCo2eFactorCommandResult { IsSuccess = entityDto == null || entityDto.IsDeleted };
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override Co2eFactorEntity ApplyDto(Co2eFactorEntityDto source, Co2eFactorEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        return entity;
    }

}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// AddressCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TAddressEntity">The type of the address entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TAddressEntityDto">The type of the address entity dto.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;TAddressEntity, TAddressEntityDto&gt;" />
public class AddressCommandHandler<TAddressEntity, TAddressEntityDto> : CommandHandlerBase<TAddressEntity, TAddressEntityDto>
    where TAddressEntity : AddressEntity, new()
    where TAddressEntityDto : AddressEntityDto, new()
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly SettlementCache _settlementCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AddressCommandHandler{TAddressEntity, TAddressEntityDto}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public AddressCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<TAddressEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService, SettlementCache settlementCache) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _settlementCache = settlementCache;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Address is {AddressType.NotDefined.GetDisplayName()}</exception>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is PhysicalDeleteAddressCommand physicalDeleteAddressCommand)
        {
            var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<TAddressEntity>(physicalDeleteAddressCommand.Id);
            this.Delete(entity,
                DeletionMode.Physical);
            var entityDto = CreateDto<TAddressEntityDto>(entity);

            return new UpdateEntityCommandResult
            {
                UpdateResult = new EntityUpdate
                {
                    Action = EntityUpdateAction.Delete,
                    Entity = entityDto
                }
            };
        }

        if (command is UpdateEntityCommand updateEntityCommand && updateEntityCommand.Update!.Action == EntityUpdateAction.Update)
        {
            var entity = (TAddressEntityDto)updateEntityCommand.Update.Entity;
            var dbObject = _queryService.GetById<AddressEntityDto>(entity.Id);

            if (dbObject.AddressType != entity.AddressType)
            {
                _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(dbObject.Id);

                var entityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entity);

                return new UpdateEntityCommandResult
                {
                    UpdateResult = new EntityUpdate { Action = EntityUpdateAction.New, Entity = entityDto }
                };
            }

            var updatedEntityDto = (UpdateEntityCommandResult)base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);

            return new UpdateEntityCommandResult
            {
                UpdateResult = new EntityUpdate { Action = EntityUpdateAction.Update, Entity = updatedEntityDto.UpdateResult?.Entity }
            };
        }

        if (command is UpdateEntityCommand deleteEntityCommand && deleteEntityCommand.Update!.Action == EntityUpdateAction.Delete)
        {
            var entity = (TAddressEntityDto)deleteEntityCommand.Update.Entity;

            if (typeof(TAddressEntityDto) != typeof(AddressEntityDto))
            {
                return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
            }

            var dbObject = _queryService.GetById<AddressEntityDto>(entity.Id);

            AddressEntityDto? returnVal = dbObject.AddressType switch
            {
                AddressType.DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddress => _commandService.DeleteEntity<DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto>(entity.Id),
                AddressType.DomesticNonPOBoxAddress => _commandService.DeleteEntity<DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto>(entity.Id),
                AddressType.ForeignAddress => _commandService.DeleteEntity<ForeignAddressEntityDto>(entity.Id),
                AddressType.DomesticPOBoxAddress => _commandService.DeleteEntity<DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto>(entity.Id),
                AddressType.DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddress => _commandService.DeleteEntity<DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto>(entity.Id),
                AddressType.DomesticLotNumberAddress => _commandService.DeleteEntity<DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto>(entity.Id),
                AddressType.IncompleteAddress => _commandService.DeleteEntity<IncompleteAddressEntityDto>(entity.Id),
                AddressType.NotDefined => throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Address is {AddressType.NotDefined.GetDisplayName()}"),
                _ => throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Unknown address type!")
            };

            return new UpdateEntityCommandResult
            {
                UpdateResult = new EntityUpdate { Action = EntityUpdateAction.Delete, Entity = returnVal }
            };
        }


        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override TAddressEntity ApplyDto(TAddressEntityDto obj, TAddressEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(obj, destination);

        if (destination is DomesticLotNumberAddressEntity bhszAddressEntity &&
            obj is DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto bhszAddressEntityDto)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.District, bhszAddressEntity, bhszAddressEntityDto.District!);
            LoadRef(x => x.Settlement, bhszAddressEntity, bhszAddressEntityDto.Settlement!);
        }
        if (destination is DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntity bnpAddressEntity &&
            obj is DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto bnpAddressEntityDto)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.District, bnpAddressEntity, bnpAddressEntityDto.District!);
            LoadRef(x => x.StreetSuffix, bnpAddressEntity, bnpAddressEntityDto.StreetSuffix!);
            LoadRef(x => x.Settlement, bnpAddressEntity, bnpAddressEntityDto.Settlement!);
        }
        if (destination is DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntity extendedLotAddressEntity &&
            obj is DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto extendedLotAddressEntityDto)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.Settlement, extendedLotAddressEntity, extendedLotAddressEntityDto.Settlement!);
            LoadRef(x => x.ZipCode, extendedLotAddressEntity, extendedLotAddressEntityDto.ZipCode!);
            LoadRef(x => x.StreetSuffix, extendedLotAddressEntity, extendedLotAddressEntityDto.StreetSuffix!);

            var settlementDto = _settlementCache.GetById(extendedLotAddressEntityDto.Settlement.Id);
            extendedLotAddressEntity.County = DbContext.Session.Load<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity>(settlementDto.County.Id);
            extendedLotAddressEntity.CountyDistrict = DbContext.Session.Load<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity>(settlementDto.CountyDistrict.Id);
        }
        if (destination is DomesticPOBoxAddressEntity bpAddressEntity &&
            obj is DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto bpAddressEntityDto)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.Settlement, bpAddressEntity, bpAddressEntityDto.Settlement!);
        }
        if (destination is DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntity bpszheAddressEntity &&
            obj is DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto bpszheAddressEntityDto)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.Settlement, bpszheAddressEntity, bpszheAddressEntityDto.Settlement!);
        }

        entity.FullAddress = obj.ConcatenatedName();
        obj.FullAddress = entity.FullAddress;

        return entity;
    }
}

using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Reflection;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.OrgUnitSecurity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// CommandHandlerBase ősosztály, amelyből az egyes entitások commandhandlerjeit származtatjuk.
/// </summary>
public abstract class OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<TEntity, TDto> : CommandHandlerBase<TEntity, TDto>
    where TEntity : class, IEntity, new()
    where TDto : IEntityDto, new()
{
    private readonly Lazy<IAccessLogger> _accessLogger;
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    protected readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;


    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    protected OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<TDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        SecurityContext securityContext
        ) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _accessLogger = accessLogger;
        _queryService = queryService;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tranzakció módja
    /// </summary>
    public virtual CommandHandlerTransactionMode TransactionMode => CommandHandlerTransactionMode.Auto;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the access logger.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The access logger.
    /// </value>
    protected IAccessLogger AccessLogger => _accessLogger.Value;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this instance is access log enabled.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is access log enabled; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    protected virtual bool IsAccessLogEnabled => true;

    #region Interface entry point

    /// <summary>
    /// ExecuteEntityCommand
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">Paraméterként átadott command</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException">command</exception>
    public new ICommandResult ExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        //TODO...
        return base.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);
        //return command == null ? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command)) : DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Overridable entry points

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command is UpdateEntityCommand updateEntityCommand
            ? (ICommandResult)ExecuteUpdateEntityCommand<TDto>(updateEntityCommand)
            : throw new NotSupportedException($"Command not supported: {command.GetType().Name}");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A commandban referált entitás közvetlenül az adatbázisból.
    /// </summary>
    protected override TEntity? GetEntity(UpdateEntityCommand command)
    {
        return base.GetEntity(command);
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    protected override void OnEntityCreating(TDto entity, TEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entity, domainEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus. Amennyiben a domainEntity implementálja az ITrackedEntity interfészt,
    /// akkor a létrehozással beállításra kerülnek a Created/Modified, CreatorUser/ModifierUser/DeletionUser mezőértékek.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">IEntityDto-t megvalósító osztály típus</typeparam>
    /// <param name="entityDto">DTO</param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity">Entitás</param>
    protected override void OnEntityCreating<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto entityDto, TEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítási CRUD műveletekkor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(TDto entity, TEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entity, domainEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítási CRUD műveletekkor megfutó metódus. Amennyiben a domainEntity implementálja az ITrackedEntity interfészt,
    /// akkor a létrehozással beállításra kerülnek a Modified, ModifierUser/DeletionUser mezőértékek.
    /// </summary>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdating<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto entityDto, TEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);
    }




    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás törlésekor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    protected override string? OnEntityDeleting(TEntity domainEntity, Func<TEntity, string?> deleteAction)
    {
        return base.OnEntityDeleting(domainEntity, deleteAction);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Private section


    #endregion


    public async Task CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(IEntityCommand command, int? entityId)
    {
        var secAttr = command.GetType().GetCustomAttribute<RequiredSecOperationAttribute>();
        if (secAttr is null)
        {
            //TODO: az a baj, hogy ide az általános entitycommandok végrehajtásakor is be fog futni. annál pedig nem lesz attribútum
            //throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException("Nincs megadva biztonsági attribútum a parancshoz.");
            return; //egyelőre ezt az esetet hagyjuk figyelmen kívül
        }

        // Rendszerszintű áthívásoknál nincs jogosultság kezelés
        if (_securityContext.CurrentUser.IsSystem)
        {
            return;
        }

        var u = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        var userQuery = new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
        {
            GlobalId = u.GlobalId,
            TenantCode = u.TenantCode,
            IsDeleted = false
        };

        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(userQuery))?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto user)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User doesn't exist with global id: '{userQuery.GlobalId}'");

        var op = secAttr.SecurityOperation; //módosítottam az attr konstruktorán, hogy a SecurityOperation is ki legyen töltve, mert nem volt. elméletileg ez nem okoz máshol gondot.
        if (op == SecurityOperation.Read && !secAttr.SecOperationCode.EndsWith(op.ToString()))
        {
            //TODO: váratlan működés: a SecurityOperation Read, de a SecOperationCode valami másra végződik.
            // ilyenkor vagy rosszul állították be az attribútumot a commandon, vagy mi lehet még?
#if DEBUG
            if (Debugger.IsAttached)
            {
                Debugger.Break(); //ha véletlenül fejlesztés közben előállna ez az eset (azért nem breakpoint, mert az nem megy fel a gitbe)
            }
#endif
        }


        //ha az operation egy create, akkor az entityId az entitás szülőjének az id-ja.
        //az adott usernek a szülőben (vagy annak szüleiben) kell rendelkeznie az entitás típusához tartozó create jogosultsággal.
        //update/delete operationöknél az adott entitásra, vagy annak szüleiben kell rendelkeznie a joggal
        string? parentEntityName = null;
        if (op == SecurityOperation.Create)
        {
            parentEntityName = OrgUnitHelpers.GetOrgUnitParentType(command.EntityTypeName);
        }

        var ouType = OrgUnitHelpers.GetOrgunitType(op == SecurityOperation.Create ? parentEntityName : command.EntityTypeName);
        if (entityId == null)
        { //null entityId csak akkor megengedett, ha InstitutionCreate műveletről van szó (ouType==null)
            if (!(op == SecurityOperation.Create && ouType == null))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid SecurityOperation or OrgunitType. Only Institution creation is allowed with null entityId.");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new OrgUnitParentHierarchyQuery { EntityId = entityId.Value, OrgunitType = ouType.Value })) is not OrgUnitParentHierarchyQueryResult parentHierarchy)
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Failed to query parent hierarchy.");
            }

            var activeRoles = user.Roles.Select(r => r.Id).ToList(); //TODO: IsActive filtering -> needs IsActive flag in entity and in db -> because it's entityref, we don't have that property here. instead I filtered out the inactive roles in the mapping
            var queryParams = new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQuery
            {
                UserId = user.Id,
                TargetOrgUnitId = entityId,
                TargetOrgUnitType = ouType,
                RoleIds = [.. activeRoles],
                ParentOrgUnits = parentHierarchy.Parents,
            };

            if ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(queryParams)) is not SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult queryResults)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Failed to query security role-orgunit assignment.");

            //megvizsgáljuk, hogy a kigyűjtött role-ok közül valamelyikben szerepel-e az az opcode, ami a commandra vonatkozik
            var allOpCodes = new HashSet<string>(queryResults.Items.SelectMany(x => x.SecOpCodes));
            if (!allOpCodes.Contains(secAttr.SecOperationCode))
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User '{user.EMail}' has no permission to execute '{secAttr.SecOperationCode}' operation on entity '{command.EntityTypeName}' with id '{entityId}'");
            }

            //ha ide eljutottunk, akkor a usernek van jogosultsága a művelethez
        }

    }






    protected abstract int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command);


}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Locations.RoomProfile;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// RoomProfileCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations.RoomProfileEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations.RoomProfileEntityDto&gt;" />
public class RoomProfileCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<RoomProfileEntity, RoomProfileEntityDto>
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RoomProfileCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    public RoomProfileCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<RoomProfileEntityDto>> validator
        ) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }


    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateRoomProfileCommand createCommand => DoCreateRoomProfileCommand(createCommand),
            ModifyRoomProfileCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyRoomProfileCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteRoomProfileCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteRoomProfileCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    private CreateRoomProfileCommandResult DoCreateRoomProfileCommand(CreateRoomProfileCommand createCommand)
    {
        RoomProfileEntityDto entityDto = Mapper.Map<RoomProfileEntityDto>(createCommand);
        var createdDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto) ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Helyiségtípus '{createCommand.Name}' létrehozás nem sikerült!"); ;
        return new CreateRoomProfileCommandResult { RoomProfileEntityDto = createdDto };
    }

    private ModifyRoomProfileCommandResult DoModifyRoomProfileCommand(ModifyRoomProfileCommand modifyCommand)
    {
        if (_queryService.GetById<RoomProfileEntityDto>(modifyCommand.RoomProfileId) is null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid RoomProfileEntity Id. There is no RoomProfileEntity with Id: '{modifyCommand.RoomProfileId}'");

        RoomProfileEntityDto entityDto = Mapper.Map<RoomProfileEntityDto>(modifyCommand);
        var createdDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto)
            ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Helyiségtípus '{modifyCommand.Name}' létrehozás nem sikerült!"); ;
        return new ModifyRoomProfileCommandResult { RoomProfileEntityDto = createdDto };
    }

    private DeleteRoomProfileCommandResult DoDeleteRoomProfileCommand(DeleteRoomProfileCommand deleteCommand)
    {
        if (_queryService.GetById<RoomProfileEntityDto>(deleteCommand.RoomProfileId) is null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid RoomProfileEntity Id. There is no RoomProfileEntity with Id: '{deleteCommand.RoomProfileId}'");

        var entityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<RoomProfileEntityDto>(deleteCommand.RoomProfileId);
        return new DeleteRoomProfileCommandResult { IsSuccess = entityDto == null || entityDto.IsDeleted };
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override RoomProfileEntity ApplyDto(RoomProfileEntityDto source, RoomProfileEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        destination.BuildingProfiles ??= [];
        MergeList(source.BuildingProfiles,
             entity.BuildingProfiles,
             (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id,
             entityRef => entityRef.Id);

        return entity;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\BusinessLogic\CommandHandler\Security\SecAuthCommandHandler.cs
====================================================================================================

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.OneTimeToken;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Security;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using NHibernate;
using OtpNet;
using SkiaSharp.QrCode;
using SkiaSharp;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Security;

/// <summary>
/// SecAuthCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.ICommandHandler" />
public class SecAuthCommandHandler : ICommandHandler
{

    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// The mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    private IDbContext _dbContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Tranzakció módja
    /// </summary>
    public CommandHandlerTransactionMode TransactionMode => CommandHandlerTransactionMode.Auto;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecAuthCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public SecAuthCommandHandler(
        IMapper mapper,
        IQueryService queryService,
        IDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _mapper = mapper;
        _queryService = queryService;
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// ExecuteEntityCommand
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">Paraméterként átadott command</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public ICommandResult ExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is IsPasswordValidCommand isPasswordValidCommand)
            return DoIsPasswordValidCommand(isPasswordValidCommand);
        if (command is TwoFactorValidCommand twoFactorValidCommand)
            return DoTwoFactorValidCommand(twoFactorValidCommand);
        if (command is TwoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommand twoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommand)
            return DoTwoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommand(twoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommand);
        if (command is TwoFactorRegistrationConfirmationCommand twoFactorRegistrationConfirmationCommand)
            return DoTwoFactorRegistrationConfirmationCommand(twoFactorRegistrationConfirmationCommand);

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the two factor valid command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoTwoFactorValidCommand(TwoFactorValidCommand command)
    {
        var secUser = _dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                                       .Where(x => x.EMail == command.Email && !x.IsDeleted && !x.IsLocked)
                                       .TransformUsing(NHibernate.Transform.Transformers.DistinctRootEntity)
                                       .SingleOrDefault() ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User doesn't exist with email: '{command.Email}'");

        string base32Secret = secUser.TwoFactorSharedSecret;
        var secret = Base32Encoding.ToBytes(base32Secret);

        var totp = new Totp(secret);
        var verifyResult = totp.VerifyTotp(command.TwoFactorCode, out long timeWindowUsedFirst, VerificationWindow.RfcSpecifiedNetworkDelay);

        if (!verifyResult)
        {
            return new TwoFactorValidCommandResult();
        }

        if (secUser.TwoFactorStatus != TwoFactorStatus.Verified)
        {
            secUser.TwoFactorStatus = TwoFactorStatus.Verified;
            _dbContext.Session.Save(secUser);
        }

        return new TwoFactorValidCommandResult()
        {
            User = _mapper.Map<SecUserEntityDto>(secUser)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the two factor QR code generate command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoTwoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommand(TwoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommand command)
    {
        var userEntity = _dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                                       .Where(x => x.GlobalId == command.GlobalUserId && !x.IsDeleted && !x.IsLocked)
                                       .TransformUsing(NHibernate.Transform.Transformers.DistinctRootEntity)
                                       .SingleOrDefault() ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User doesn't exist with global id: '{command.GlobalUserId}'");

        if (userEntity.TwoFactorStatus == TwoFactorStatus.Verified)
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User with global id: '{command.GlobalUserId}' already has two-factor authentication enabled.");
        } else if (userEntity.TwoFactorStatus == TwoFactorStatus.NeedToVerify) //QR code already generated, no need to generate a new one
        {
            return new TwoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommandResult()
            {
                QrCodeBase64 = Convert.ToBase64String(userEntity.QRCode)
            };
        }

        GenerateTwoFactor(userEntity);

        //OTP opcionális paraméterek
        var twoFactorOptions = new OtpNetTotpSettings();
        var options = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(twoFactorOptions);

        //Kulcs generálás
        var secret = KeyGeneration.GenerateRandomKey(20);
        userEntity.TwoFactorSharedSecret = Base32Encoding.ToString(secret);
        string base32Secret = userEntity.TwoFactorSharedSecret;
        var secretKey = Base32Encoding.ToBytes(base32Secret);

        //UriString a vonalkódhoz
        var issuer = "Energiamenedzsment";
        var uriString = new OtpUri(OtpType.Totp, secretKey, userEntity.EMail, issuer, algorithm: twoFactorOptions.HashMode, digits: twoFactorOptions.Size, period: twoFactorOptions.Step).ToString();
        userEntity.TwoFactorOptions = options;
        userEntity.TwoFactorStatus = TwoFactorStatus.NeedToVerify;

        // Generate QrCode
        using var generator = new QRCodeGenerator();
        var qr = generator.CreateQrCode(uriString, ECCLevel.L);

        // Render to canvas
        var info = new SKImageInfo(512, 512);
        using var surface = SKSurface.Create(info);
        var canvas = surface.Canvas;
        canvas.Render(qr, info.Width, info.Height);

        using var image = surface.Snapshot();
        using var data = image.Encode(SKEncodedImageFormat.Png, 100);
        var stream = data.AsStream();

        byte[] byteArray;
        using (var memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
        {
            stream.CopyTo(memoryStream);
            byteArray = memoryStream.ToArray();
        }

        userEntity.QRCode = byteArray;
        var base64String = Convert.ToBase64String(byteArray);

        _dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(userEntity);

        return new TwoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommandResult()
        {
            QrCodeBase64 = base64String
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the two factor QR code generate command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoTwoFactorRegistrationConfirmationCommand(TwoFactorRegistrationConfirmationCommand command)
    {
        var userEntity = _dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                                       .Where(x => x.GlobalId == command.GlobalUserId && !x.IsDeleted && !x.IsLocked)
                                       .TransformUsing(NHibernate.Transform.Transformers.DistinctRootEntity)
                                       .SingleOrDefault() ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User doesn't exist with global id: '{command.GlobalUserId}'");

        if (userEntity.TwoFactorStatus != TwoFactorStatus.NeedToVerify)
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User with global id: '{command.GlobalUserId}' either already has two-factor authentication enabled or has not started the registration process.");
        }

        string base32Secret = userEntity.TwoFactorSharedSecret;
        var secret = Base32Encoding.ToBytes(base32Secret);

        var totp = new Totp(secret);
        var verifyResult = totp.VerifyTotp(command.TwoFactorCode, out long timeWindowUsedFirst, VerificationWindow.RfcSpecifiedNetworkDelay);

        if (verifyResult)
        {
            userEntity.TwoFactorStatus = TwoFactorStatus.Verified;
            _dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(userEntity);
        }

        return new TwoFactorRegistrationConfirmationCommandResult()
        {
            Result = verifyResult
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the is password valid command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoIsPasswordValidCommand(IsPasswordValidCommand command)
    {
        var expirationTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue("PasswordPolicy.ExpirationTimeSpan", true) ?? TimeSpan.FromDays(90);

        var secUserEntity = _dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                                       .Where(x => x.EMail == command.Email && !x.IsDeleted && !x.IsLocked)
                                       .Fetch(SelectMode.Fetch, x => x.Tenants)
                                       .TransformUsing(NHibernate.Transform.Transformers.DistinctRootEntity)
                                       .SingleOrDefault();

        if (secUserEntity == null)
        {
            return new IsPasswordValidCommandResult()
            {
                IsValid = false
            };
        }

        SecUserEntity secUser = null!;
        var lastToken =
           _dbContext.Session.QueryOver<OneTimeTokenEntity>()
           .JoinAlias(x => x.User, () => secUser)
           .Where(x =>
               secUser.Id == secUserEntity.Id &&
               (x.TokenType == TokenType.PasswordReset || x.TokenType == TokenType.ForgottenPassword) &&
               x.Ervenyesseg > DateTimeContext.Now)
           .SingleOrDefault();

        if (secUserEntity.PasswordLastModify.Add(expirationTimeSpan) > DateTimeContext.Now)
        {
            if (lastToken != null)
            {
                lastToken.Ervenyesseg = DateTimeContext.Now.AddSeconds(-1);
                _dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(lastToken);
                _dbContext.Commit();
            }
            return new IsPasswordValidCommandResult()
            {
                IsValid = true,
                User = _mapper.Map<SecUserEntityDto>(secUserEntity)
            };

        }

        //Ha nincs még token
        if (lastToken == null)
        {
            var expirationTime = DateTimeContext.Now.Add(expirationTimeSpan);

            var newTokenString = Convert.ToBase64String(Guid.NewGuid().ToByteArray()).Replace("/", "_").Replace("+", "-");
            var newToken = new OneTimeTokenEntity()
            {
                User = secUserEntity,
                Ervenyesseg = expirationTime,
                Token = newTokenString,
                TokenType = TokenType.PasswordReset,
                Created = DateTimeContext.Now,
            };
            _dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(newToken);
            _dbContext.Commit();

            return new IsPasswordValidCommandResult()
            {
                IsValid = false,
                Token = newToken.Token,
                User = _mapper.Map<SecUserEntityDto>(secUserEntity),
            };
        }
        else
            return new IsPasswordValidCommandResult()
            {
                IsValid = false,
                Token = lastToken.Token,
                User = _mapper.Map<SecUserEntityDto>(secUserEntity),
            };

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kétfaktoros kulcs generálása a felhasználó részére
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dto">The dto.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private SecUserEntity GenerateTwoFactor(SecUserEntity dto)
    {
        //OTP opcionális paraméterek
        var twoFactorOptions = new OtpNetTotpSettings();
        var options = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(twoFactorOptions);

        //Kulcs generálás
        var secret = KeyGeneration.GenerateRandomKey(twoFactorOptions.HashMode);
        dto.TwoFactorSharedSecret = Base32Encoding.ToString(secret);
        string base32Secret = dto.TwoFactorSharedSecret;
        var secretKey = Base32Encoding.ToBytes(base32Secret);

        //UriString a vonalkódhoz
        var issuer = "Energiamenedzsment";
        var uriString = new OtpUri(OtpType.Totp, secretKey, dto.EMail, issuer, algorithm: twoFactorOptions.HashMode, digits: twoFactorOptions.Size, period: twoFactorOptions.Step).ToString();
        dto.TwoFactorOptions = options;
        dto.TwoFactorStatus = TwoFactorStatus.NeedToVerify;

        // Generate QrCode
        using var generator = new QRCodeGenerator();
        var qr = generator.CreateQrCode(uriString, ECCLevel.L);

        // Render to canvas
        var info = new SKImageInfo(512, 512);
        using var surface = SKSurface.Create(info);
        var canvas = surface.Canvas;
        canvas.Render(qr, info.Width, info.Height);

        using var image = surface.Snapshot();
        using var data = image.Encode(SKEncodedImageFormat.Png, 100);
        var stream = data.AsStream();

        byte[] byteArray;
        using (var memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
        {
            stream.CopyTo(memoryStream);
            byteArray = memoryStream.ToArray();
        }

        dto.QRCode = byteArray;

        return dto;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Security;

/// <summary>
/// SecRoleCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security.SecRoleEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security.SecRoleEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SecRoleCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<SecRoleEntity, SecRoleEntityDto>
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecRoleCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    public SecRoleCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<SecRoleEntityDto>> validator
        ) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        _queryService = queryService;
        _securityContext = _scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(SecRoleEntityDto originalEntity, SecRoleEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        this.SendSyncMessage(updatedEntity.Modified!.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sends the synchronize message.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dateOfModification">The date of modification.</param>
    private void SendSyncMessage(DateTime dateOfModification)
    {
        DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() => SyncHelper.SendSyncMessage(
            typeof(SecRoleEntityDto).EntityTypeName(),
            dateOfModification,
            _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>
    /// <param name="originalEntityDto"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(SecRoleEntity originalDomainEntity,
        TEntityDto originalEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntityDto);
        this.SendSyncMessage(originalDomainEntity.Deleted!.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is CreateSecRoleCommand createSecRoleCommand)
            return DoCreateSecRoleCommand(createSecRoleCommand);

        if (command is ModifySecRoleCommand modifySecRoleCommand)
            return DoModifySecRoleCommand(modifySecRoleCommand);

        if (command is DeleteSecRoleCommand deleteSecRoleCommand)
            return DoExecuteDeleteSecRoleCommand(deleteSecRoleCommand);

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkör létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Szerepkör '{command.Name}' létrehozás nem sikerült!</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoCreateSecRoleCommand(CreateSecRoleCommand command)
    {
        SecRoleEntityDto newRoleDto = new()
        {
            RoleName = command.Name,
            SecOperations = command.SecOperations,
            IsDeleted = false,
            RoleCode = command.Name,
            //SecRoleType = ,
        };


        var savedDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(newRoleDto) ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Szerepkör '{command.Name}' létrehozás nem sikerült!");

        return new CreateSecRoleCommandResult { SecRoleEntityDto = savedDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkör módosítása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Id - Missing argument:</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid SecRole Id. There is no SecRole with Id: '{command.Id}'
    /// or
    /// SecRole with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be edited
    /// </exception>
    private ICommandResult DoModifySecRoleCommand(ModifySecRoleCommand command)
    {
        if (command.Id == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument:");

        var secRoleEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<SecRoleEntityDto>(command.Id);
        if (secRoleEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SecRole Id. There is no SecRole with Id: '{command.Id}'");

        if (secRoleEntityDto.IsSystem)
            throw new ArgumentException($"SecRole with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be edited");

        secRoleEntityDto.SecOperations = command.SecOperations;
        secRoleEntityDto.RoleName = command.Name;

        var modifiedDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(secRoleEntityDto);
        return new ModifySecRoleCommandResult { SecRoleEntityDto = modifiedDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkör törlése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Id - Missing argument:</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid SecRole Identifier. There is no SecRole with Id: '{command.Id}'</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoExecuteDeleteSecRoleCommand(DeleteSecRoleCommand command)
    {
        if (command.RoleId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.RoleId), "Missing argument:");

        var entity = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecRoleEntity>().Where(x => x.Id == command.RoleId).SingleOrDefault();
        if (entity == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SecRole Identifier. There is no SecRole with Id: '{command.RoleId}'");

        var modifiedDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<SecRoleEntityDto>(entity.Id);

        return new DeleteSecRoleCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = true
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override SecRoleEntity ApplyDto(SecRoleEntityDto source, SecRoleEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        destination.SecOperations ??= new List<SecOperationEntity>();
        MergeList(source.SecOperations,
            entity.SecOperations,
            (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id,
            entityRef => entityRef.Id);

        return entity;
    }
}

    /// <summary>

    public class SecUserCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<SecUserEntity, SecUserEntityDto>
    {

        /// <summary>

        /// <summary>

        /// <summary>

        /// <summary>
        /// The scope
        /// </summary>

        /// <summary>

        /// </summary>

        private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _monitoringClientService;

        /// <summary>

        /// </summary>

        /// <param name="roleCache">The role cache.</param>
        public SecUserCommandHandler(
            IDbContext dbContext,
            IMapper mapper,
            Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
            Lazy<IValidator<SecUserEntityDto>> validator,
            IQueryService queryService,
            ICommandService commandService,
            ILifetimeScope scope,
            RoleCache roleCache,
            MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClient,
            DataReceiverApiClientService dataReceiverApiClient) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
        {
