            _queryService = queryService;
            _scope = scope;
            _roleCache = roleCache;
            _securityContext = _scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
            _dataReceiverClientService = dataReceiverApiClient;
            _monitoringClientService = monitoringApiClient;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="entity"></param>
        /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
        protected override void OnEntityCreating(SecUserEntityDto entity, SecUserEntity domainEntity)
        {
            //Ha adminisztrátor, akkor mindenképp kétfaktoros autentikációt várunk
            if (entity.Roles != null && entity.Roles.Any() && Array.Exists(entity.Roles, x => x.EntityDisplayName == SecRoleType.Adminisztrator.GetDisplayName()))
                entity.TwoFactorAuthentication = true;

            base.OnEntityCreating(entity, domainEntity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
        /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        protected override SecUserEntityDto OnEntityCreated(SecUserEntityDto createdEntity, SecUserEntityDto source)
        {
            var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
            SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.UserTenant, entityDto.Created!.Value, TenantScopeType.Public);
            SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.UserTenant, entityDto.Created!.Value, TenantScopeType.Public);

            return entityDto;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
        /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
        protected override void OnEntityUpdated(SecUserEntityDto originalEntity, SecUserEntityDto updatedEntity)
        {
            base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
            SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.UserTenant, updatedEntity.Modified!.Value, TenantScopeType.Public);
            SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.UserTenant, updatedEntity.Modified!.Value, TenantScopeType.Public);
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.
        /// </summary>
        /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
        /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>
        /// <param name="originalEntityDto"></param>
        protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(SecUserEntity originalDomainEntity,
            TEntityDto originalEntityDto)
        {
            base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntityDto);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
        /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
        /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
        {
            if (command is CreateAdminSecUserCommand createAdminCommand)
                return DoCreateAdminSecUserCommand(createAdminCommand);

            if (command is CreateSecUserCommand createSecUserCommand)
                return DoCreateSecUserCommand(createSecUserCommand);

            if (command is ModifySecUserCommand modifyCommand)
                return DoModifySecUserCommand(modifyCommand);

            if (command is ModifyTenantSecUserAdministrationCommand modifyTenantSecUserAdministrationCommand)
                return DoModifyTenantSecUserAdministrationCommand(modifyTenantSecUserAdministrationCommand);

            if (command is ModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentSecUserCommand modifyNewlyRegisteredSecUserCommand)
                return DoModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentSecUserCommand(modifyNewlyRegisteredSecUserCommand);

            if (command is ModifyCurrentSecUserCommand modifyCurrentCommand)
                return DoModifyCurrentSecUserCommand(modifyCurrentCommand);

            if (command is DeleteSecUserCommand deleteSecUserCommand)
                return DoExecuteDeleteSecUserCommand(deleteSecUserCommand);

            if (command is ModifySecUserPasswordCommand modifySecUserPasswordCommand)
                return DoModifySecUserPasswordCommand(modifySecUserPasswordCommand);

            if (command is ModifyOwnUserPasswordCommand modifyOwnUserPasswordCommand)
                return DoModifyOwnUserPasswordCommand(modifyOwnUserPasswordCommand);

            if (command is ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommand modifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommand)
                return DoModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommand(modifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommand);

            if (command is ForgottenPasswordCommand forgottenPasswordCommand)
                return DoForgottenPasswordCommand(forgottenPasswordCommand).Result;

            if (command is ExpiringPasswordCommand expiringPasswordCommand)
                return DoExpiringPasswordCommand(expiringPasswordCommand).Result;

            //if(command is UpdateEntityCommand updateEntityCommand && updateEntityCommand.Update.Action != EntityUpdateAction.Delete && 
            //    (updateEntityCommand.Update.Entity as SecUserEntityDto).Tenant == null)
            //    return DoCreateTenantIndependentSecUserCommand(updateEntityCommand);

            if (command is CreateSecUserTokenCommand createSecUserTokenCommand)
                return DoNewUserNewTokenCommand(createSecUserTokenCommand).Result;

            if (command is LockSecUserCommand lockCommand)
                return DoLockSecUserCommand(lockCommand);

            if (command is UnlockSecUserCommand unlockCommand)
                return DoUnlockSecUserCommand(unlockCommand);

            if (command is ResendNotificationSecUserCommand resendNotificationCommand)
                return DoResendNotificationSecUserCommand(resendNotificationCommand).Result;

            return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Does the expiring password command.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="expiringPasswordCommand">The expiring password command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private async Task<ICommandResult> DoExpiringPasswordCommand(ExpiringPasswordCommand expiringPasswordCommand)
        {
            _template = "PasswordExpiredTemplate";
            return await ForgottenPasswordCreateNewToken(expiringPasswordCommand.Email);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Does the forgotten password command.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="forgottenPasswordCommand">The forgotten password command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private async Task<ICommandResult> DoForgottenPasswordCommand(ForgottenPasswordCommand forgottenPasswordCommand)
        {
            _template = "ForgottenPasswordTemplate";

            if (!new EmailAddressAttribute().IsValid(forgottenPasswordCommand.Email))
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Érvénytelen email formátum.");

            return await ForgottenPasswordCreateNewToken(forgottenPasswordCommand.Email);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Admin user létrehozás
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">
        /// TenantCode is required!
        /// or
        /// Cannot find valid Tenant with TenantCode: '{command.TenantCode}'
        /// </exception>
        /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Felhasználó ({command.UserName}) létrehozás nem sikerült!</exception>
        private ICommandResult DoCreateAdminSecUserCommand(CreateAdminSecUserCommand command)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.TenantCode))
                throw new ArgumentNullException($"TenantCode is required!");

            // Ezen a ponton már léteznie kell a tenantnak, és nem lehet törölt.
            var tenantDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TenantEntityQuery
            {
                TenantCode = command.TenantCode,
                OnlyValidResults = true
            }).Result?.Entity as TenantEntityDto;

            if (tenantDto == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException($"Cannot find valid Tenant with TenantCode: '{command.TenantCode}'");

            var secUserDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecUserSingleEntityQuery() { Email = command.EMail , IsDeleted = false}).RunSync()?.Entity as SecUserEntityDto;

            var expirationTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue("PasswordPolicy.ExpirationTimeSpan", true) ?? TimeSpan.FromDays(90);
            var adminRole = _roleCache.GetRoleByCode(_scope, "Adminisztrator");
            SecUserEntityDto newDto = new()
            {
                Id = secUserDto?.Id ?? 0,
                DateOfBirth = command.DateOfBirth,
                IsSystem = false,
                EMail = command.EMail,
                GlobalId = secUserDto?.GlobalId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
                FirstName = command.FirstName,
                LastName = command.LastName,
                Phone = command.Phone,
                Tenants = new List<TenantEntityDto>(secUserDto?.Tenants ?? Enumerable.Empty<TenantEntityDto>()) { tenantDto },
                Roles = secUserDto?.Roles ?? new[]
                {
                    Mapper.Map<EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>>(adminRole)
                },
                PasswordLastModify = DateTime.UtcNow.Add(-expirationTimeSpan).AddDays(-1)
            };

            // SecUser létrehozás
            newDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity<SecUserEntityDto>(newDto) ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Felhasználó ({AnonymizeEmail(command.EMail)}) létrehozás nem sikerült!");
            return new CreateSecUserCommandResult { SecUserEntityDto = newDto };
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Felhasználó létrehozása
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Cannot find valid Tenant with TenantCode: '{tenantCode}'</exception>
        /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Felhasználó ({command.UserName}) létrehozás nem sikerült!</exception>
        private ICommandResult DoCreateSecUserCommand(CreateSecUserCommand command)
        {
            string tenantCode = command.TenantCode ?? _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;

            TenantEntityDto tenantDto = null!;

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            {
                // Ezen a ponton már léteznie kell a tenantnak, és nem lehet törölt.
                tenantDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TenantEntityQuery
                {
                    TenantCode = tenantCode,
                    OnlyValidResults = true
                }).Result?.Entity as TenantEntityDto;

                if (tenantDto == null)
                    throw new ArgumentNullException($"Cannot find valid Tenant with TenantCode: '{tenantCode}'");
            }

            var secUser = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.EMail == command.EMail!.Trim().ToLower())
                .SingleOrDefault();

            if (secUser != null)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"A felhasználó a megadott email címmel ({AnonymizeEmail(command.EMail)}) már létezik, létrehozás sikertelen!");

            SecUserEntityDto newUserDto = new()
            {
                IsSystem = command.IsSystem,
                EMail = command.EMail!.Trim().ToLower(),
                GlobalId = Guid.NewGuid(),
                FirstName = command.FirstName!.Trim(),
                LastName = command.LastName!.Trim(),
                Phone = command.Phone?.Trim(),
                DateOfBirth = command.DateOfBirth,
                Roles = command.Roles,
                Tenants = new List<TenantEntityDto>() { tenantDto },
                PasswordLastModify = DateTime.UtcNow
            };


            var savedDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(newUserDto) ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Felhasználó ({AnonymizeEmail(command.EMail)}) létrehozás nem sikerült!");

            // set to inactive status at creation
            var inactiveUserDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<SecUserEntityDto>(savedDto.Id);

            return new CreateSecUserCommandResult { SecUserEntityDto = inactiveUserDto };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Felhasználó törlése
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Id - Missing argument:</exception>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid SecUser Identifier. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'</exception>
        private ICommandResult DoExecuteDeleteSecUserCommand(DeleteSecUserCommand command)
        {
            if (command.Id == 0)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument:");

            var entity = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>().Where(x => x.Id == command.Id).SingleOrDefault();
            if (entity == null)
                throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SecUser Identifier. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'");

            var modifiedDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<SecUserEntityDto>(entity.Id);

            return new DeleteSecUserCommandResult
            {
                IsSuccess = true
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Felhasználó módosítása
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Id - Missing argument:</exception>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// Invlid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'
        /// or
        /// SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be edited
        /// </exception>
        private ICommandResult DoModifySecUserCommand(ModifySecUserCommand command)
        {
            if (command.Id == 0)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument:");

            SecUserEntityDto? secUserEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<SecUserEntityDto>(command.Id);
            if (secUserEntityDto == null)
                throw new ArgumentException($"Invlid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'");

            if (secUserEntityDto.IsSystem)
                throw new ArgumentException($"SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be edited");

            string tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;

            TenantEntityDto tenantDto = null!;

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            {
                // Ezen a ponton már léteznie kell a tenantnak, és nem lehet törölt.
                tenantDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TenantEntityQuery
                {
                    TenantCode = tenantCode,
                    OnlyValidResults = true
                }).Result?.Entity as TenantEntityDto;

                if (tenantDto == null)
                    throw new ArgumentNullException($"Cannot find valid Tenant with TenantCode: '{tenantCode}'");
            }


            secUserEntityDto.Roles = command.Roles;

            // Ha null egy átadott mező értéke, akkor maradjon a korábbi érték
            secUserEntityDto.FirstName = command.FirstName ?? secUserEntityDto.FirstName;
            secUserEntityDto.LastName = command.LastName ?? secUserEntityDto.LastName;
            secUserEntityDto.EMail = command.EMail ?? secUserEntityDto.EMail;
            secUserEntityDto.Phone = command.Telephone ?? secUserEntityDto.Phone;
            secUserEntityDto.Tenants = new List<TenantEntityDto>() { tenantDto };

            var modifiedDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(secUserEntityDto);
            return new ModifySecUserCommandResult { SecUserEntityDto = modifiedDto };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Tenanthoz tartozó felhasználó módosítása
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Id - Missing argument:</exception>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'
        /// or
        /// SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be edited
        /// </exception>
        private ICommandResult DoModifyTenantSecUserAdministrationCommand(ModifyTenantSecUserAdministrationCommand command)
        {
            if (command.Id == 0)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument:");

            SecUserEntityDto? secUserEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<SecUserEntityDto>(command.Id)
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'");

            if (secUserEntityDto.IsSystem)
                throw new ArgumentException($"SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be edited");

            secUserEntityDto.Roles = command.Roles;

            // Ha null egy átadott mező értéke, akkor maradjon a korábbi érték
            secUserEntityDto.FirstName = command.FirstName ?? secUserEntityDto.FirstName;
            secUserEntityDto.LastName = command.LastName ?? secUserEntityDto.LastName;
            secUserEntityDto.EMail = command.EMail ?? secUserEntityDto.EMail;
            secUserEntityDto.Phone = command.Telephone ?? secUserEntityDto.Phone;
            

            var modifiedDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(secUserEntityDto);
            return new ModifySecUserCommandResult { SecUserEntityDto = modifiedDto };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Aktuális felhasználó módosítása (nem új regisztráció esetén)
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">GlobalId - GlobalId is required!</exception>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// There is no SecUser with GlobalId: '{globalId}'
        /// or
        /// SecUser with GlobalId: '{globalId}' is system, so it can not be edited
        /// </exception>
        private ICommandResult DoModifyCurrentSecUserCommand(ModifyCurrentSecUserCommand command)
        {
            var secUserEntity = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                            .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted && !x.IsLocked && x.GlobalId == _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId)
                            .SingleOrDefault() ?? throw new ArgumentException($"No user with global id '{_securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId}' found.");

            if (secUserEntity.IsSystem)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException($"SecUser with GlobalId: '{secUserEntity.GlobalId}' is system, so it can not be edited");
            }

            // Ha null egy átadott mező értéke, akkor maradjon a korábbi érték
            secUserEntity.FirstName = command.FirstName ?? secUserEntity.FirstName;
            secUserEntity.LastName = command.LastName ?? secUserEntity.LastName;
            secUserEntity.Phone = command.Telephone ?? secUserEntity.Phone;

            DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(secUserEntity);

            var secUserEntityDto = CreateDto(secUserEntity);

            return new ModifySecUserCommandResult { SecUserEntityDto = secUserEntityDto };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Aktuális felhasználó módosítása (új regisztráció esetén)
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">GlobalId - GlobalId is required!</exception>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// There is no SecUser with GlobalId: '{globalId}'
        /// or
        /// SecUser with GlobalId: '{globalId}' is system, so it can not be edited
        /// </exception>
        private ICommandResult DoModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentSecUserCommand(ModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentSecUserCommand command)
        {
            // Jelszó összehasonlítás
            if (command.NewPassword != command.NewPasswordAgain)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("Passwords do not match");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.Token))
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Token));
            }

            PasswordValidation(command.NewPassword, command.NewPasswordAgain, 0, false);

            SecUserEntity user = null!;
            var oneTimeToken = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<OneTimeTokenEntity>()
                .JoinAlias(x => x.User, () => user)
                    .Where(x => x.Token == command.Token)
                    .SingleOrDefault()
                    ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException("oneTimeToken is null!");

            //Lejártjuk a OneTimeToken-t
            if (oneTimeToken != null)
            {
                oneTimeToken.Ervenyesseg = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(-1);
                DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(oneTimeToken);
            }

            var secUserEntity = oneTimeToken.User;
            secUserEntity.Password = PasswordHelper.HashPassword(command.NewPassword);

            secUserEntity.SecUserPasswordHistories.Add(new SecUserPasswordHistory()
            {
                Password = secUserEntity.Password,
                PasswordChangeDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                User = secUserEntity
            });

            secUserEntity.PasswordLastModify = DateTime.UtcNow;
            secUserEntity.WarningMail = false;

            // activate user
            secUserEntity.IsDeleted = false;
            secUserEntity.Deleted = null;
            secUserEntity.DeletionUser = null;

            DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(secUserEntity);

            if (secUserEntity.IsSystem)
                throw new ArgumentException($"SecUser with GlobalId: '{secUserEntity.GlobalId}' is system, so it can not be edited");

            // Ha null egy átadott mező értéke, akkor maradjon a korábbi érték
            secUserEntity.FirstName = command.FirstName ?? secUserEntity.FirstName;
            secUserEntity.LastName = command.LastName ?? secUserEntity.LastName;
            secUserEntity.Phone = command.Telephone ?? secUserEntity.Phone;

            DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(secUserEntity);

            var secUserEntityDto = CreateDto(secUserEntity);

            return new ModifySecUserCommandResult { SecUserEntityDto = secUserEntityDto };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Saját jelszó cseréje
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// Passwords do not match
        /// or
        /// Invalid SecUser GlobalId. There is no SecUser with GlobalId: '{globalId}'
        /// </exception>
        private ICommandResult DoModifyOwnUserPasswordCommand(ModifyOwnUserPasswordCommand command)
        {
            // Jelszó összehasonlítás
            if (command.NewPassword != command.NewPasswordAgain)
                throw new ArgumentException("Passwords do not match");

            var globalId = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId;


            var secUserEntity = DbContext.Session.Query<SecUserEntity>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.GlobalId == globalId)
                                ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SecUser GlobalId. There is no SecUser with GlobalId: '{globalId}'");

            var id = secUserEntity.Id;

            PasswordValidation(command.NewPassword, command.NewPasswordAgain, id);

            secUserEntity.Password = PasswordHelper.HashPassword(command.NewPassword);

            secUserEntity.SecUserPasswordHistories.Add(new SecUserPasswordHistory()
            {
                Password = secUserEntity.Password,
                PasswordChangeDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                User = secUserEntity
            });
            secUserEntity.PasswordLastModify = DateTime.UtcNow;

            DbContext.Session.Save(secUserEntity);

            var result = _queryService.GetById<SecUserEntityDto>(id);

            Log.LogSecurity("S_ModifyPassword", "");
            return new ModifySecUserPasswordCommandResult { SecUserEntityDto = result };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Jelszó módosítás
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// Passwords do not match
        /// or
        /// Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'
        /// </exception>
        private ICommandResult DoModifySecUserPasswordCommand(ModifySecUserPasswordCommand command)
        {
            // Jelszó összehasonlítás
            if (command.NewPassword != command.NewPasswordAgain)
                throw new ArgumentException("Passwords do not match");

            var secUserEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<SecUserEntity>(command.Id);
            if (secUserEntity == null)
                throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'");

            PasswordValidation(command.NewPassword, command.NewPasswordAgain, command.Id);

            secUserEntity.Password = PasswordHelper.HashPassword(command.NewPassword);

            secUserEntity.SecUserPasswordHistories.Add(new SecUserPasswordHistory()
            {
                Password = secUserEntity.Password,
                PasswordChangeDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                User = secUserEntity
            });
            secUserEntity.PasswordLastModify = DateTime.UtcNow;

            DbContext.Session.Save(secUserEntity);

            var result = _queryService.GetById<SecUserEntityDto>(command.Id);

            Log.LogSecurity("S_ModifyPassword", "");
            return new ModifySecUserPasswordCommandResult { SecUserEntityDto = result };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Jelszó módosítás és token megújítás
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// Passwords do not match
        /// or
        /// Token is not null
        /// </exception>
        private ICommandResult DoModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommand(ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommand command)
        {
            // Jelszó összehasonlítás
            if (command.NewPassword != command.NewPasswordAgain)
                throw new ArgumentException("Passwords do not match");

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.Token))
                throw new ArgumentException("Token is not null");

            PasswordValidation(command.NewPassword, command.NewPasswordAgain, 0, false);

            SecUserEntity user = null!;
            var oneTimeToken = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<OneTimeTokenEntity>()
                .JoinAlias(x => x.User, () => user)
                    .Where(x => x.Token == command.Token)
                    .SingleOrDefault()
                    ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException("oneTimeToken is null!");

            //Lejártjuk a OneTimeToken-t
            if (oneTimeToken != null)
            {
                oneTimeToken.Ervenyesseg = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(-1);
                DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(oneTimeToken);
            }

            var secUserEntity = oneTimeToken.User;
            secUserEntity.Password = PasswordHelper.HashPassword(command.NewPassword);

            secUserEntity.SecUserPasswordHistories.Add(new SecUserPasswordHistory()
            {
                Password = secUserEntity.Password,
                PasswordChangeDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                User = secUserEntity
            });

            secUserEntity.PasswordLastModify = DateTime.UtcNow;
            secUserEntity.WarningMail = false;
            DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(secUserEntity);

            var expirationTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue("PasswordPolicy.ExpirationTimeSpan", true) ?? TimeSpan.FromDays(90);
            var expirationTime = DateTime.UtcNow.Add(expirationTimeSpan);

            DbContext.Commit();
            Log.LogSecurity("S_RenewToken", "");

            return new PasswordCommandResult()
            {
                SecurityContext = _securityContext,
                SecUserId = secUserEntity.Id,
                SendEmail = true,
                TenantCode = command.TenantCode,
                Token = oneTimeToken.Token,
                Template = "PasswordChangeTemplate",
                Expiration = expirationTime
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Felhasználó létrehozása, ellenőrzése
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private async Task<ICommandResult> DoNewUserNewTokenCommand(CreateSecUserTokenCommand command)
        {
            using (var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                scope.SetAnonymousContext(null);
                var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
                return await NewUserCreateNewToken(command.Email, dbContext);
            }
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Elfelejtette jelszó kezelése, token beállítás
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
        /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
        /// <param name="userName">Name of the user.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private async Task<PasswordCommandResult> ForgottenPasswordCreateNewToken(string email)
        {
            var expirationTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue("PasswordPolicy.ExpirationTimeSpan", true) ?? TimeSpan.FromDays(90);

            var secUser = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                            .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted && x.EMail == email)
                            .SingleOrDefault();

            if (secUser == null)
                return new PasswordCommandResult();

            SecUserEntity _secUser = null!;
            var currentToken =
                DbContext.Session.QueryOver<OneTimeTokenEntity>()
                .JoinAlias(x => x.User, () => _secUser)
                .Where(x => _secUser.Id == secUser.Id && x.Ervenyesseg > DateTime.UtcNow)
                .OrderBy(x => x.Created)
                .Desc
                .Take(1)
                .SingleOrDefault();

            if (currentToken != null)
            {
                currentToken.Ervenyesseg = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(-1);
                DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(currentToken);
            }

            var newTokenString = Convert.ToBase64String(Guid.NewGuid().ToByteArray()).Replace("/", "_").Replace("+", "-");
            var expirationTime = DateTime.UtcNow.Add(expirationTimeSpan);
            var newToken = new OneTimeTokenEntity()
            {
                User = secUser,
                Ervenyesseg = expirationTime,
                Token = newTokenString,
                TokenType = TokenType.ForgottenPassword,
                Created = DateTime.UtcNow,
            };
            DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(newToken);

            secUser.WarningMail = true;
            DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(secUser);
            DbContext.Commit();
            Log.LogSecurity("S_ForgottenPassword", "");

            await CreateNotification(DbContext, "ForgottenPasswordTemplate", secUser, newTokenString);

            return new PasswordCommandResult()
            {
                SecurityContext = _securityContext,
                SecUserId = secUser.Id,
                SendEmail = true,
                Token = newToken.Token,
                Template = _template
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Új felhasználó regisztráció kezelése, token beállítás
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
        /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
        /// <param name="userName">Name of the user.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private async Task<PasswordCommandResult> NewUserCreateNewToken(string email, IDbContext dbContext)
        {
            var expirationTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue("PasswordPolicy.ExpirationTimeSpan", true) ?? TimeSpan.FromDays(90);

            var secUser = await dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                            .Where(x => x.EMail == email)
                            .SingleOrDefaultAsync();

            if (secUser == null)
                return new PasswordCommandResult();

            SecUserEntity _secUser = null!;
            var currentToken = await
                dbContext.Session.QueryOver<OneTimeTokenEntity>()
                .JoinAlias(x => x.User, () => _secUser)
                .Where(x => _secUser.Id == secUser.Id && x.Ervenyesseg > DateTime.UtcNow)
                .OrderBy(x => x.Created)
                .Desc
                .Take(1)
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync();

            if (currentToken != null)
            {
                currentToken.Ervenyesseg = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(-1);
                await dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdateAsync(currentToken);
            }

            var newTokenString = Convert.ToBase64String(Guid.NewGuid().ToByteArray()).Replace("/", "_").Replace("+", "-");
            var expirationTime = DateTime.UtcNow.Add(expirationTimeSpan);
            var newToken = new OneTimeTokenEntity()
            {
                User = secUser,
                Ervenyesseg = expirationTime,
                Token = newTokenString,
                TokenType = TokenType.NewUserRegistration,
                Created = DateTime.UtcNow,
            };
            await dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdateAsync(newToken);

            secUser.WarningMail = true;
            await dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdateAsync(secUser);
            dbContext.Commit();
            Log.LogSecurity("S_NewUserCreateNewToken", "");

            await CreateNotification(DbContext, "NewUserTemplate", secUser, newTokenString);

            return new PasswordCommandResult()
            {
                SecurityContext = _securityContext,
                SecUserId = secUser.Id,
                SendEmail = true,
                Token = newToken.Token,
                Template = _template
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Applys the dto.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
        /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">GlobalId - GlobalId is required!</exception>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">There is no SecUser with GlobalId: '{globalId}'</exception>
        /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Az aktuális felhasználó nem jogoult felhazsnálói fiók zárolására!</exception>
        protected override SecUserEntity ApplyDto(SecUserEntityDto source, SecUserEntity destination)
        {
            var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
            destination.Roles ??= new List<SecRoleEntity>();

            // TODO: Ha közintézményi szerepköröket mentünk úgy, hogy már van központi szerepköre a felhasználónak,
            // akkor a központi szerepköröket törli a mergelist.
            // Itt vizsgálni kell az aktuális tenant-ot és azt, hogy csak azokat a Role-okat dobjuk ki, amik a tenanthoz tartoztak.
            MergeList(source.Roles,
                entity.Roles,
                (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id,
                entityRef => entityRef.Id);

            destination.Tenants ??= new List<TenantEntity>();
            if (source.Tenants != null && source.Tenants.Count > 0 && source.Tenants[0] != null)
                MergeList(source.Tenants,
                    entity.Tenants,
                    (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id,
                    entityRef => entityRef.Id);


            if (destination.IsLocked != source.IsLocked)
            {
                var globalId = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId;
                if (globalId == Guid.Empty)
                    throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(_securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId), "GlobalId is required!");

                var userEntity = DbContext.Session.Query<SecUserEntity>().SingleOrDefault(u => u.GlobalId == globalId);
                if (userEntity == null)
                    throw new ArgumentException($"There is no SecUser with GlobalId: '{globalId}'");

                if (userEntity.Roles == null || !userEntity.Roles.Any() || !userEntity.Roles.Any(x => x.SecRoleType == SecRoleType.Adminisztrator))
                    throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Az aktuális felhasználó nem jogoult felhazsnálói fiók zárolására!");

                if (source.IsLocked)
                {
                    destination.IsLocked = true;
                    destination.LockerUser = userEntity;
                    destination.Locked = DateTime.UtcNow;
                }
                else
                {
                    destination.IsLocked = false;
                    destination.LockerUser = null;
                    destination.Locked = null;

                }

            }


            return entity;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Jelszó ellenőrzés
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
        /// <param name="newPasswordAgain">The new password again.</param>
        /// <param name="userId">The user identifier.</param>
        /// <param name="checkUser">if set to <c>true</c> [check user].</param>
        /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">
        /// Új jelszó nem került megadásra!
        /// or
        /// Az új jelszó nincs 12 karakter!
        /// or
        /// A jelszó nem tartalmazhat egymást követő karaktereket!
        /// or
        /// A megadott jelszó megegyezik egy korábban regisztrált jelszóval!
        /// or
        /// Az ismételten megadott jelszó nem egyezik meg az eredetivel!
        /// </exception>
        private void PasswordValidation(string newPassword, string newPasswordAgain, int userId = 0, bool checkUser = true)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(newPassword))
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Új jelszó nem került megadásra!");

            if (newPassword.Length < 12)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Az új jelszó nincs 12 karakter!");

            if (!SequentialChar(newPassword))
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("A jelszó nem tartalmazhat egymást követő karaktereket!");

            if (userId != 0 && checkUser && PassworIsUsed(newPassword, userId))
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("A megadott jelszó megegyezik egy korábban regisztrált jelszóval!");

            if (!PwIsEqual(newPassword, newPasswordAgain))
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Az ismételten megadott jelszó nem egyezik meg az eredetivel!");

        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Sequentials the character.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private bool SequentialChar(string newPassword)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < newPassword.Length - 2; i++)
                if (+newPassword[+i + 1] == +newPassword[i] + 1 &&
                    +newPassword[+i + 2] == +newPassword[i] + 2) return false;

            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Passwors the is used.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
        /// <param name="userId">The user identifier.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private bool PassworIsUsed(string newPassword, int userId)
        {
            var passwords = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserPasswordHistory>()
             .Select(x => x.Password)
             .Where(x => x.User.Id == userId)
             .OrderBy(x => x.PasswordChangeDate)
             .Desc
             .Take(5)
             .List<string>();

            return passwords == null || !passwords.Any() ? false : passwords.Any(x => PasswordHelper.VerifyPassword(x, newPassword));
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Pws the is equal.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
        /// <param name="newPasswordAgain">The new password again.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private bool PwIsEqual(string newPassword, string newPasswordAgain)
        {
            return newPassword == newPasswordAgain;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Notification létrehozása új felhasználó létrehozását követően
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
        /// <param name="templateName">Name of the template.</param>
        /// <param name="targetUser">The target user.</param>
        /// <param name="token">The one-time token string</param>
        private async Task CreateNotification(IDbContext dbContext, string templateName, SecUserEntity targetUser, string token = null)
        {
            var template = await dbContext.Session.QueryOver<TemplateEntity>()
               .Where(x => x.Name == templateName)
               .SingleOrDefaultAsync();

            var notification = new NotificationEntity()
            {
                NotificationSource = NotificationSource.TaskManager,
                NotificationType = NotificationType.Email,
                Title = templateName,
                HtmlTemplate = template,
                TargetUsers = new List<SecUserEntity>() { targetUser },
                ExpirationDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1),
                SendDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                IsRead = false,
                NotificationState = NotificationState.Pending,
                Description = token
            };

            await dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdateAsync(notification);
        }
        
        private string AnonymizeEmail(string email)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email) || !email.Contains('@'))
                return null;

            var emailSplitted = email.Split('@');
            var anonimEmail = emailSplitted.Length > 0 ? $"{emailSplitted[0].Substring(0, 3)}@{emailSplitted[1].Substring(0, 3)}***" : "";
            return anonimEmail;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Felhasználó zárolása
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Id - Missing argument:</exception>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'
        /// or
        /// SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be locked
        /// </exception>
        private ICommandResult DoLockSecUserCommand(LockSecUserCommand command)
        {
            if (command.Id == 0)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument:");

            var secUserEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<SecUserEntity>(command.Id);
            if (secUserEntity == null)
                throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'");

            if (secUserEntity.IsSystem)
                throw new ArgumentException($"SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be locked");

            secUserEntity.IsLocked = true;
            
            // Get current user who is performing the lock
            var currentUser = DbContext.Session.Query<SecUserEntity>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.GlobalId == _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId);
            if (currentUser == null)
                throw new ArgumentException("Current user not found");
                
            // Set locking user and timestamp
            secUserEntity.LockerUser = currentUser;
            secUserEntity.Locked = DateTime.UtcNow;
            
            DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(secUserEntity);

            // Log security event
            Log.LogSecurity("S_LockUser", $"User locked: {AnonymizeEmail(secUserEntity.EMail)}");
            
            return new LockSecUserCommandResult 
            { 
                SecUserEntityDto = CreateDto<SecUserEntityDto>(secUserEntity),
                IsSuccess = true
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Felhasználó zárolásának feloldása
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Id - Missing argument:</exception>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'
        /// or
        /// SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be unlocked
        /// </exception>
        private ICommandResult DoUnlockSecUserCommand(UnlockSecUserCommand command)
        {
            if (command.Id == 0)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument:");

            var secUserEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<SecUserEntity>(command.Id);
            if (secUserEntity == null)
                throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'");

            if (secUserEntity.IsSystem)
                throw new ArgumentException($"SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be unlocked");

            secUserEntity.IsLocked = false;
            
            // Clear locking information
            secUserEntity.LockerUser = null;
            secUserEntity.Locked = null;
            
            DbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(secUserEntity);

            // Log security event
            Log.LogSecurity("S_UnlockUser", $"User unlocked: {AnonymizeEmail(secUserEntity.EMail)}");
            
            return new UnlockSecUserCommandResult 
            { 
                SecUserEntityDto = CreateDto<SecUserEntityDto>(secUserEntity),
                IsSuccess = true
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Felhasználó értesítés újraküldése
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Id - Missing argument:</exception>
        /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
        /// Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'
        /// or
        /// SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be unlocked
        /// </exception>
        private async Task<ICommandResult> DoResendNotificationSecUserCommand(ResendNotificationSecUserCommand command)
        {
            if (command.Id == 0)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument:");

            var secUserEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<SecUserEntity>(command.Id);
            if (secUserEntity == null)
                throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SecUser Id. There is no SecUser with Id: '{command.Id}'");

            var currentToken =
                DbContext.Session.QueryOver<OneTimeTokenEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.User.Id == secUserEntity.Id 
                    && (x.TokenType == TokenType.ForgottenPassword || x.TokenType == TokenType.NewUserRegistration))
                .OrderBy(x => x.Created)
                .Desc
                .Take(1)
                .SingleOrDefault();

            if (currentToken is not null)
            {
                if (currentToken.TokenType == TokenType.ForgottenPassword)
                {
                    await ForgottenPasswordCreateNewToken(secUserEntity.EMail);
                }
                else if (currentToken.TokenType == TokenType.NewUserRegistration)
                {
                    await NewUserCreateNewToken(secUserEntity.EMail, DbContext);
                }
            }

            // Log security event
            Log.LogSecurity("S_NotificationResend", $"User notification resend: {AnonymizeEmail(secUserEntity.EMail)}");

            return new ResendNotificationSecUserCommandResult
            {
                SecUserEntityDto = CreateDto<SecUserEntityDto>(secUserEntity),
                IsSuccess = true
            };
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Security;

/// <summary>
/// Tenant kezelés tartozó CommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security.TenantEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security.TenantEntityDto&gt;" />
public class TenantCommandHandler<TEntity> : CommandHandlerBase<TEntity, TenantEntityDto> where TEntity : class, new ()
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TenantCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public TenantCommandHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger, Lazy<IValidator<TenantEntityDto>> validator, IQueryService queryService, ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is CreateTenantCommand createTenantCommand)
            return DoCreateTenantCommand(createTenantCommand);

        if (command is SyncTenantCommand syncTenantCommand)
            return DoSyncTenantCommand(syncTenantCommand);

        if (command is DeleteTenantCommand deleteTenantCommand)
            return DoDeleteTenantCommand(deleteTenantCommand);

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant létrehozás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">
    /// TenantName is required!
    /// or
    /// TenantCode is required!
    /// or
    /// Tenant with this code '{command.TenantCode}' has already existed.
    /// or
    /// Could not create tenant with code '{command.TenantCode}'!
    /// </exception>
    private ICommandResult DoCreateTenantCommand(CreateTenantCommand command)
    {
        CheckCommandData(command.TenantCode, command.TenantName);

        //TODO: use Mapper
        TenantEntityDto newDto = new TenantEntityDto
        {
            Name = command.TenantName,
            Code = command.TenantCode,
            TenantIdentifier = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Maintainer = new EntityRef<MaintainerEntityDto>() { Id = command.MaintainerId }
        };

        newDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(newDto) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Could not create tenant with code '{command.TenantCode}'!");

        return new CreateTenantCommandResult { TenantEntityDto = newDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoSyncTenantCommand(SyncTenantCommand command)
    {
        CheckCommandData (command.TenantCode, command.TenantName);

        //TODO: use Mapper
        TenantEntityDto newDto = new TenantEntityDto
        {
            Id = command.Id,
            Name = command.TenantName,
            Code = command.TenantCode,
            TenantIdentifier = command.Identifier,
            Status = command.Status,
        };

        newDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(newDto) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Could not create tenant with code '{command.TenantCode}'!");

        return new CreateTenantCommandResult { TenantEntityDto = newDto };
    }

    private void CheckCommandData(string tenantCode, string tenantName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("TenantName is required!");

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantName))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"TenantCode is required!");

        // Egy tenantkódot csak egyszer lehet kiadni, egy törölt tenant kódja is foglalt, nem adható ki újra,
        // így a ezen query során minden rekordot szeretnénk visszakapni érvényességtől függetlenül.
        TenantEntityDto? tenantDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TenantEntityQuery { TenantCode = tenantCode, OnlyValidResults = false }).RunSync()?.Entity as TenantEntityDto;

        // Ezen a ponton parancs paraméterében átadott kóddal a Tenantnak nem szabad korábbról léteznie, most akarjuk létrehozni.
        if (tenantDto != null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Tenant with this code '{tenantCode}' has already existed.");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant törlés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoDeleteTenantCommand(DeleteTenantCommand command)
    {
        TenantEntityDto? tenantDto = _queryService
            .QuerySingleEntity(new TenantEntityQuery { TenantCode = command.TenantCode, OnlyValidResults = false })
            .RunSync()?.Entity as TenantEntityDto;

        if (tenantDto is null)
            return new DeleteTenantCommandResult();

        _commandService.DeleteEntity<TenantEntityDto>(tenantDto.Id);
        
        return new DeleteTenantCommandResult();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityCreating(TenantEntityDto entity, TEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entity, domainEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override TEntity ApplyDto(TenantEntityDto source, TEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        if (destination is TenantEntity tenantEntity)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.Maintainer, tenantEntity, source.Maintainer);

        }

        return entity;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Sync;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Sync;

/// <summary>
/// SyncObjectCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync.SyncObjectEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Sync.SyncObjectEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SyncObjectCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<SyncObjectEntity, SyncObjectEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this instance is access log enabled.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// <c>true</c> if this instance is access log enabled; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    protected override bool IsAccessLogEnabled { get; } = false;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SyncObjectCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    public SyncObjectCommandHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, null, commandService)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command is SyncCommand syncCommand ? DoSyncCommand(syncCommand) : base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the synchronize command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="syncCommand">The synchronize command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoSyncCommand(SyncCommand syncCommand)
    {
        try
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(syncCommand.TenantCode))
                using (var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
                {
                    tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(syncCommand.TenantCode);
                    var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
                    var syncObjectEntity = tenantDbContext.Session.Query<SyncObjectEntity>()
                    .SingleOrDefault(x => x.EntityName == syncCommand.EntityName);

                    if (syncObjectEntity is not null)
                    {
                        syncObjectEntity.LastModifiedDate = syncCommand.LastModifiedDate;
                        tenantDbContext.Session.Update(syncObjectEntity);
                        tenantDbContext.Commit();
                        tenantDbContext.Dispose();
                    }
                }
            else
            {
                using (var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
                {
                    scope.SetAnonymousContext(null);
                    var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
                    var syncObjectEntity = dbContext.Session.Query<SyncObjectEntity>()
                    .SingleOrDefault(x => x.EntityName == syncCommand.EntityName);

                    if (syncObjectEntity is not null)
                    {
                        syncObjectEntity.LastModifiedDate = syncCommand.LastModifiedDate;
                        dbContext.Session.Update(syncObjectEntity);
                        dbContext.Commit();
                        dbContext.Dispose();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        { 
            return null;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// AbstractDictCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TDictEntity">The type of the dictionary entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TDictItemEntity">The type of the dictionary item entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TDictEntityDto">The type of the dictionary entity dto.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TDictItemEntityDto">The type of the dictionary item entity dto.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;TDictEntity, TDictEntityDto&gt;" />
public abstract class AbstractDictCommandHandler<TDictEntity, TDictItemEntity, TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto> : CommandHandlerBase<TDictEntity, TDictEntityDto>
    where TDictItemEntity : AbstractDictItemEntity<TDictEntity>
    where TDictItemEntityDto : AbstractDictItemEntityDto<TDictEntityDto>
    where TDictEntity : AbstractDictEntity<TDictItemEntity>, new()
    where TDictEntityDto : AbstractDictEntityDto<TDictItemEntityDto>, new()
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AbstractDictCommandHandler{TDictEntity, TDictItemEntity, TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    protected AbstractDictCommandHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<TDictEntityDto>> validator, IQueryService queryService, ICommandService commandService)
        : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify abstract dictionary command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TModifyDictCommandResult">The type of the modify dictionary command result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid {typeof(TDictEntity).Name} Code. There is no {typeof(TDictEntity).Name} with Code: '{command.Code}'
    /// or
    /// </exception>
    protected virtual ICommandResult DoModifyAbstractDictCommand<TModifyDictCommandResult>(ModifyAbstractDictCommand<TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto> command) 
        where TModifyDictCommandResult : ModifyAbstractDictCommandResult<TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto>, new()
    {
        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new DictEntityQuery {Code = command.Code}).Result?.Entity is not TDictEntityDto dictEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid {typeof(TDictEntity).Name} Code. There is no {typeof(TDictEntity).Name} with Code: '{command.Code}'");
        
        if (dictEntity.IsSystem)
            throw new ArgumentException($"{typeof(TDictEntity).Name} with Code: '{command.Code}' is system, so it can not be edited");

        dictEntity.Name = command.Name ?? dictEntity.Name;

        var dictEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dictEntity);
        return new TModifyDictCommandResult {DictEntityDto = dictEntityDto};
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.Abstract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.System;

/// <summary>
/// AbstractDictItemCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TDictEntity">The type of the dictionary entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TDictItemEntity">The type of the dictionary item entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TDictEntityDto">The type of the dictionary entity dto.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TDictItemEntityDto">The type of the dictionary item entity dto.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;TDictItemEntity, TDictItemEntityDto&gt;" />
public abstract class AbstractDictItemCommandHandler<TDictEntity, TDictItemEntity, TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto> : CommandHandlerBase<TDictItemEntity, TDictItemEntityDto>
    where TDictItemEntity : AbstractDictItemEntity<TDictEntity>, new()
    where TDictItemEntityDto : AbstractDictItemEntityDto<TDictEntityDto>, new()
    where TDictEntity : AbstractDictEntity<TDictItemEntity>
    where TDictEntityDto : AbstractDictEntityDto<TDictItemEntityDto>
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AbstractDictItemCommandHandler{TDictEntity, TDictItemEntity, TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    protected AbstractDictItemCommandHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<TDictItemEntityDto>> validator, ICommandService commandService)
        : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify abstract dictionary item command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TModifyDictItemCommandResult">The type of the modify dictionary item command result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">Id - Missing argument</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid {typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} Id. There is no {typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} with Id: '{command.Id}'
    /// or
    /// </exception>
    protected virtual ICommandResult DoModifyAbstractDictItemCommand<TModifyDictItemCommandResult>(ModifyAbstractDictItemCommand<TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto> command)
        where TModifyDictItemCommandResult : ModifyAbstractDictItemCommandResult<TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto>, new()
    {
        if (command.Id == 0)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument");

        var dictItemEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<TDictItemEntity>(command.Id) 
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid {typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} Id. There is no {typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} with Id: '{command.Id}'");
        
        if (dictItemEntity.Dict.IsSystem)
            throw new ArgumentException($"{typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be edited");

        var dictItemEntityDto = Mapper.Map<TDictItemEntityDto>(dictItemEntity);
        dictItemEntityDto.Value = command.Value ?? null;
        dictItemEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dictItemEntityDto);
        return new TModifyDictItemCommandResult { DictItemEntityDto = dictItemEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the create abstract dictionary item command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TCreateDictItemCommandResult">The type of the create dictionary item command result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">ParentDictId - Missing argument</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid {typeof(TDictEntity).Name} Id. There is no {typeof(TDictEntity).Name} with Id: '{command.ParentDictId}'
    /// or
    /// </exception>
    protected virtual ICommandResult DoCreateAbstractDictItemCommand<TCreateDictItemCommandResult>(CreateAbstractDictItemCommand<TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto> command)
        where TCreateDictItemCommandResult : CreateAbstractDictItemCommandResult<TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto>, new()
    {
        if (command.ParentDictId == 0)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException(nameof(command.ParentDictId), "Missing argument");

        var dictEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<TDictEntity>(command.ParentDictId) 
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid {typeof(TDictEntity).Name} Id. There is no {typeof(TDictEntity).Name} with Id: '{command.ParentDictId}'");
        
        if (dictEntity.IsSystem)
            throw new ArgumentException($"{typeof(TDictEntity).Name} with Id: '{command.ParentDictId}' is system, so it can not be edited");

        var entityDto = new TDictItemEntityDto
        {
            Id = 0,
            Dict = new EntityRef<TDictEntityDto>()
            {
                Id = dictEntity.Id
            },
            Code = command.Code,
            Value = command.Value
        };

        var dictItemEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);
        return new TCreateDictItemCommandResult { DictItemEntityDto = dictItemEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the delete abstract dictionary item command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TDeleteDictItemCommandResult">The type of the delete dictionary item command result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">Id - Missing argument</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid {typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} Id. There is no {typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} with Id: '{command.Id}'
    /// or
    /// </exception>
    protected virtual ICommandResult DoDeleteAbstractDictItemCommand<TDeleteDictItemCommandResult>(DeleteAbstractDictItemCommand<TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto> command)
        where TDeleteDictItemCommandResult : DeleteAbstractDictItemCommandResult<TDictEntityDto, TDictItemEntityDto>, new()
    {
        if (command.Id == 0)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument");

        var dictItemEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<TDictItemEntity>(command.Id) 
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid {typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} Id. There is no {typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} with Id: '{command.Id}'");
        
        if (dictItemEntity.Dict.IsSystem)
            throw new ArgumentException($"{typeof(TDictItemEntity).Name} with Id: '{command.Id}' is system, so it can not be edited");

        var dictItemEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<DictItemEntityDto>(dictItemEntity.Id);
        return new TDeleteDictItemCommandResult { IsSuccess = dictItemEntityDto == null || dictItemEntity.IsDeleted };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="obj">The object.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override TDictItemEntity ApplyDto(TDictItemEntityDto obj, TDictItemEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(obj, destination);
        LoadRef(x => x.Dict, entity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<TDictEntityDto>>(obj.Dict));

        return entity;
    }
}

{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DictItemCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public DictItemCommandHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<DictItemEntityDto>> validator, ICommandService commandService)
        : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is ModifyDictItemCommand modifyDictItemCommand)
            return base.DoModifyAbstractDictItemCommand<ModifyDictItemCommandResult>(modifyDictItemCommand) as ModifyDictItemCommandResult;
        
        if (command is CreateDictItemCommand createDictItemCommand)
            return base.DoCreateAbstractDictItemCommand<CreateDictItemCommandResult>(createDictItemCommand) as CreateDictItemCommandResult;
        
        if (command is DeleteDictItemCommand deleteDictItemCommand)
            return base.DoDeleteAbstractDictItemCommand<DeleteDictItemCommandResult>(deleteDictItemCommand) as DeleteDictItemCommandResult;

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }
}
