using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using Common.Logic.Services;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.System;

/// <summary>
/// Rendszer változók Command Handler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.SysConfigEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System.SysConfigEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SysConfigCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<SysConfigEntity, SysConfigEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The configuration value
    /// </summary>
    private string? _configValue;
    /// <summary>
    /// The security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SysConfigCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public SysConfigCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper, 
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger, 
        Lazy<IValidator<SysConfigEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítási CRUD műveletekkor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException">Tenant független sysconfig módosítás nem engedélyezett!</exception>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Dict kód csak akkor változhat ha az érték típusa szótár!</exception>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(SysConfigEntityDto entity, SysConfigEntity domainEntity)
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var currentValue = domainEntity.Values.Where(x =>
                x.ValidFrom <= now && (x.ValidUntil == null || x.ValidUntil > now))
            .SingleEx("SysConfig value not found", "Ambigous SysConfig value", "SysConfig: {0}", entity.ConfigName);

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode))
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException("Tenant független sysconfig módosítás nem engedélyezett!");

        if (currentValue.SysConfig.ValueType != Shared.Enums.SysConfigValueType.Dictionary &&
            currentValue.SysConfig.DictCode != entity.DictCode)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Dict kód csak akkor változhat ha az érték típusa szótár!");

        // ha nincs változás, akkor nem szabad lementeni, mert dupla érték fog megjelenni a currentValue felolvasásakor
        // de a currentValue.ValidUntil-t sem szabad bántani ilyenkor, mert akkor meg nem fog találni semmit....
        if (currentValue.ConfigValue != entity.ConfigValue)
        {
            currentValue.ValidUntil = now.AddTicks(-1);

            var newValue = new SysConfigValue
            {
                SysConfig = domainEntity,
                ValidFrom = now,
                ConfigValue = entity.ConfigValue
            };

            DbContext.Session.Save(newValue);
        }

        _configValue = entity.ConfigValue;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(SysConfigEntityDto originalEntity, SysConfigEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        updatedEntity.ConfigValue = _configValue;
    }
}

using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Log;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;

/// <summary>
/// DefaultAccessLogger
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging.IAccessLogger" />
public class DefaultAccessLogger : IAccessLogger
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// The database context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDbContext _dbContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// The update item format
    /// </summary>
    private const string UpdateItemFormat = "{0}:{1}->{2}";
    /// <summary>
    /// The show item format
    /// </summary>
    private const string ShowItemFormat = "{0}: {2}";
    /// <summary>
    /// The list separator
    /// </summary>
    private const string ListSeparator = "\n";

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the user reference.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The user reference.
    /// </value>
    public IUserRef UserRef =>
        new UserRef()
        {
            GlobalId = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId,
            LoginName = _securityContext.CurrentUser.LoginName
        };

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DefaultAccessLogger"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    public DefaultAccessLogger(SecurityContext securityContext, IDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _securityContext = securityContext;
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public void LogOperation(LogOperationEnum operation, LogObject obj, LogObjectChange[]? changes = null, string? comment = null,
        bool commentToEnd = false)
    {
        // kell-e egyáltalán business log erről az entitásról?
        var relatedObjectType = _dbContext.Session.Query<DictItemEntity>().Where(x => x.Code == obj.Type && x.Dict.Code == "adminlog_objecttype").FirstOrDefault();
        if (relatedObjectType == null)
        {
            // ezt nem tudjuk kezelni, pedig kellene. Ezért az exception
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{obj.Type} is not registered for logging in dict_item table");
        }

        // kell: összerakjuk a standard adatokat a leíróhoz
        var dbObj = new AdminLogEntity()
        {
            ClientIp = _securityContext.ClientIp,
            Date = DateTimeContext.Now,
            Operation = operation,
            SessionId = _securityContext.SessionId,
            RelatedObjectType = relatedObjectType,
            RelatedObject = new ArchiveRef()
            {
                Name = obj.Name,
                Identifier = obj.Id.ToString(),
            },
            Content = "",
            EventId = obj.Name is nameof(SecUser) or nameof(SecRoleEntity)
                ? "S_" + operation + "_" + obj.Name
                : "B_" + operation + "_" + obj.Name
        };

        // ideiglenesen amíg nincs kitöltve a securityContext
        if (_securityContext.CurrentUser != null)
        {
            dbObj.User = new ArchiveRef()
            {
                Identifier = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId.ToString(),
                Name = _securityContext.CurrentUser.Email,
            };
        }

        // a művelet tipusa alapján összerakjuk a Content tartalmát
        if (changes != null && changes.Length > 0)
        {
            var formatter = operation == LogOperationEnum.Modify ? UpdateItemFormat : ShowItemFormat;
            foreach (var item in changes)
            {
                if (dbObj.Content.Length > 0)
                {
                    dbObj.Content += ListSeparator;
                }
                dbObj.Content += string.Format(formatter, item.FieldName, item.OldValue, item.NewValue);
            }
        }

        // ha még van saját kommentje is:
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(comment))
        {
            dbObj.Content = commentToEnd ? dbObj.Content + ListSeparator + comment : comment + ListSeparator + dbObj.Content;
        }

        // nincs adminisztrálandó változás, akkor nem kell menteni semmit
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dbObj.Content))
            return;

        if (obj.Name is nameof(SecUser))
        {
            Log.LogSecurity(dbObj.EventId, dbObj.Content);
        }
        else
        {
            Log.LogInfo(dbObj.EventId, dbObj.Content);
        }
        
        // és ennyi:
        _dbContext.Session.Save(dbObj);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.TenantIndependent;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings;

/// <summary>
/// DictMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class DictMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DictMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public DictMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<DictEntityDto, DictEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Items, z => z.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IsSystem, z => z.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DictEntity, DictEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<DictEntity, EntityRef<DictEntityDto>>()
           .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<DictItemEntity, DictItemEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<DictEntity, LogObject>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Name))
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                d.Type = s?.GetType().EntityTypeName();
            });

        CreateMap<DictItemEntityDto, DictItemEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Dict, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentDict, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DictItemEntity, LogObject>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Value))
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                d.Type = s?.GetType().EntityTypeName();
            });

        CreateMap<EntityRef<DictItemEntityDto>, DictItemEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Code, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Dict, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Value, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentDict, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.Id))
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DictItemEntity, EntityRef<DictItemEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Value);

        CreateMap<DictItemEntityDto, EntityRef<DictItemEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Value);
        
        CreateMap<DictEntityDto, EntityRef<DictEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// FavouriteMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class FavouriteMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="FavouriteMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public FavouriteMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<FavouriteEntity, FavouriteEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.User, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<FavouriteEntityDto, FavouriteEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.User, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<FavouriteEntity, EntityRef<FavouriteEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Identifier.ToString());

        CreateMap<FavouriteEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings;

/// <summary>
/// SecOperationMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class SecOperationMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecOperationMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SecOperationMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<SecOperationEntity, SecOperationEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<SecOperationEntity, EntityRef<SecOperationEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.OperationName);

        CreateMap<SecOperationEntity, EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.OperationName);

        CreateMap<SecRoleEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<SecOperationEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<SecOperationEntityDto, EntityRef<SecOperationEntityDto>>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.EntityDisplayName, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.OperationName));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings;

/// <summary>
/// SecRoleMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class SecRoleMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecRoleMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SecRoleMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<SecRoleEntity, SecRoleEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<SecRoleEntityDto, SecRoleEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.IsSystem, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.RoleName, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.RoleName))
            .ForMember(x => x.RoleCode, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.RoleCode))
            .ForMember(x => x.SecOperations, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<SecRoleEntity, SelectListItemDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Code, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.RoleCode))
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.RoleName));

        CreateMap<SecRoleEntityDto, SelectListItemDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Code, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.RoleCode))
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.RoleName));

        CreateMap<SecRoleEntity, EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.EntityDisplayName, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.RoleName));

        CreateMap<SecRoleEntityDto, EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.EntityDisplayName, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.RoleName));

    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\BusinessLogic\Mappings\SecUserMappings.cs

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings;

/// <summary>
/// SecUserMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class SecUserMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecUserMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SecUserMappings()
    {

        CreateMap<SecAuthEntity, SecAuthEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Roles, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.RoleCodes, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((secAuthEntity, secAuthEntityDto) =>
            {
                secAuthEntityDto.Roles = secAuthEntity.Roles
                    .Where(roleEntity => roleEntity.IsActive) //TODO: jó, hogy csak az aktív role-okat adjuk vissza?
                    .Select(roleEntity => new EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>
                    {
                        Id = roleEntity.Id,
                        EntityDisplayName = roleEntity.RoleName
                    }).ToArray();
                secAuthEntityDto.RoleCodes = secAuthEntity.Roles
                    .Where(roleEntity => roleEntity.IsActive) //TODO: jó, hogy csak az aktív role-okat adjuk vissza?
                    .Select(roleEntity => roleEntity.RoleCode).ToArray();
            });

        CreateMap<SecUserEntityDto, SecUserEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Tenants, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Roles, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Password, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IsLocked, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.LockerUser, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Locked, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.SecUserPasswordHistories, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.WarningMail, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<SecUserEntity, SecUserEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgUnits, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Roles, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.NewPassword, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.NewPasswordAgain, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.TwoFactorAuthentication, y => y.MapFrom(m =>
                        m.TwoFactorStatus != Shared.Enums.Security.TwoFactorStatus.Off ? 
                        true : 
                        false))
            .IncludeBase<SecAuthEntity, SecAuthEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<SecUserEntity, EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.EMail!);

        CreateMap<SecUserEntityDto, EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.EMail!);

        CreateMap<SecAPIEntity, SecAPIEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<SecAuthEntity, SecAuthEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<SecUserEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<SecUserSyncModel, SecUserSyncedEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Roles, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Roles.Select(x => new SecRoleEntityDto { Id = x })))
            .ForMember(x => x.Tenants, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Tenants.Select(x => new EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security.TenantEntityDto { Id = x })));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Views;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings;

/// <summary>
/// SysConfigMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class SysConfigMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SysConfigMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SysConfigMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<SysConfigView, SysConfig>();
        CreateMap<SysConfigView, SysConfigEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<SysConfigEntity, SysConfigEntityDto>()
            .ReverseMap();

        CreateMap<SysConfigEntity, LogObject>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ConfigDisplayName))
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                d.Type = s?.GetType().EntityTypeName();
            });
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.TenantIndependent;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings;

/// <summary>
/// TenantIndependentDictMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class TenantIndependentDictMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TenantIndependentDictMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public TenantIndependentDictMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<TenantIndependentDictEntityDto, TenantIndependentDictEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Items, z => z.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IsSystem, z => z.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<TenantIndependentDictEntity, TenantIndependentDictEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<TenantIndependentDictEntity, EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictEntityDto>>()
           .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity, TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<TenantIndependentDictEntity, LogObject>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Name))
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                d.Type = s?.GetType().EntityTypeName();
            });

        CreateMap<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto, TenantIndependentDictItemEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Dict, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentDict, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity, LogObject>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Value))
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                d.Type = s?.GetType().EntityTypeName();
            });

        CreateMap<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>, TenantIndependentDictItemEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Code, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Dict, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Value, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentDict, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, m => m.MapFrom(y => y.Id))
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity, EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Value);

        CreateMap<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto, EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Value);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings;

/// <summary>
/// TenantMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class TenantMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TenantMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public TenantMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<TenantEntity, TenantEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Maintainer, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Maintainer = c.Mapper.Map(src.Maintainer.UnProxy(), dest.Maintainer);
            });

        CreateMap<TenantEntityDto, TenantEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Status, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Maintainer, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<TenantEntityDto, EntityRef<TenantEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<TenantEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<TenantEntityDto, TenantSyncedEntity>().ReverseMap();

        CreateMap<TenantSyncedEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Country;

/// <summary>
/// CountryMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class CountryMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CountryMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public CountryMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> ...
        CreateMap<CountryEntity, CountryEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.IsHungary, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                d.IsHungary = s?.ISO3 == "HU";
            });

        CreateMap<CountryEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<CountryEntity, EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        // EntityDto -> ...
        CreateMap<CountryEntityDto, CountryEntity>()
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<CountryEntityDto, EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// AddressMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class AddressMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AddressMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public AddressMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<AddressEntity, AddressEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<AddressEntityDto, EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.AddressType.ToString());

        CreateMap<AddressEntityDto, AddressEntity>()
            ////.ForMember(x => x.Country, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.FullAddress, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        #region DomesticExtendedLotNumber Address Mappings
        CreateMap<DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntity, DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntity, AddressEntityDto>()
            ////.ForMember(x => x.Country, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.County, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.CountyDistrict, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ZipCode, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Settlement, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.StreetSuffix, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                //dest.Country = c.Mapper.Map(src.Country.UnProxy(), dest.Country ?? new EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>());
                dest.County = c.Mapper.Map(src.County.UnProxy(), dest.County ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
                dest.Settlement = c.Mapper.Map(src.Settlement.UnProxy(), dest.Settlement ?? new EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>());
                dest.ZipCode = c.Mapper.Map(src.ZipCode.UnProxy(), dest.ZipCode ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
                dest.StreetSuffix = c.Mapper.Map(src.StreetSuffix.UnProxy(), dest.StreetSuffix ?? new EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>());
            });
        CreateMap<DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto, DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntityDto, AddressEntity>()
            ////.ForMember(x => x.Country, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.County, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.CountyDistrict, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ZipCode, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Settlement, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.StreetSuffix, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto, EntityRef<DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.AddressType.ToString());
        #endregion


        #region DomesticLotNumber Address Mappings
        CreateMap<DomesticLotNumberAddressEntity, DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntity, AddressEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto, DomesticLotNumberAddressEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntityDto, AddressEntity>()
            ////.ForMember(x => x.Country, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.District, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Settlement, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto, EntityRef<DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.AddressType.ToString());
        #endregion

        #region DomesticNonPOBox Address Mappings
        CreateMap<DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntity, DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntity, AddressEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.ZipCode, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                var id = TenantIndependentDictCache.Current.GetItem(DictType.ZipCode, s.ZipCode!)?.Id ?? 0;

                if (id == 0)
                    d.ZipCode = null;
                else
                    d.ZipCode = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>
                    {
                        Id = id,
                        EntityDisplayName = s.ZipCode
                    };
            });
        CreateMap<DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto, DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntityDto, AddressEntity>()
            ////.ForMember(x => x.Country, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Settlement, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.District, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.StreetSuffix, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ZipCode, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ZipCode != null ? z.ZipCode.EntityDisplayName : null))
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto, EntityRef<DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.AddressType.ToString());
        #endregion

        #region DomesticPOBox Address Mappings
        CreateMap<DomesticPOBoxAddressEntity, DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntity, AddressEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.ZipCode, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                var id = TenantIndependentDictCache.Current.GetItem(DictType.ZipCode, s.ZipCode!)?.Id ?? 0;

                if (id == 0)
                    d.ZipCode = null;
                else
                    d.ZipCode = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>
                    {
                        Id = id,
                        EntityDisplayName = s.ZipCode
                    };
            });

        CreateMap<DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto, DomesticPOBoxAddressEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntityDto, AddressEntity>()
            //.ForMember(x => x.Country, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Settlement, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ZipCode, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ZipCode != null ? z.ZipCode.EntityDisplayName : null))
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto, EntityRef<DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.AddressType.ToString());
        #endregion

        #region DomesticPostOfficeNotification Address Mappings
        CreateMap<DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntity, DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntity, AddressEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.ZipCode, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                var id = TenantIndependentDictCache.Current.GetItem(DictType.ZipCode, s.ZipCode!)?.Id ?? 0;

                if (id == 0)
                    d.ZipCode = null;
                else
                    d.ZipCode = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>
                    {
                        Id = id,
                        EntityDisplayName = s.ZipCode
                    };
            });

        CreateMap<DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto, DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntityDto, AddressEntity>()
            //.ForMember(x => x.Country, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Settlement, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ZipCode, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ZipCode != null ? z.ZipCode.EntityDisplayName : null))
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto, EntityRef<DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.AddressType.ToString());
        #endregion

        #region Foreign Address Mappings
        CreateMap<ForeignAddressEntity, ForeignAddressEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntity, AddressEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<ForeignAddressEntityDto, ForeignAddressEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntityDto, AddressEntity>()
            //.ForMember(x => x.Country, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<ForeignAddressEntityDto, EntityRef<ForeignAddressEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.AddressType.ToString());
        #endregion

        #region Incomplete Address Mappings
        CreateMap<IncompleteAddressEntity, IncompleteAddressEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntity, AddressEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<IncompleteAddressEntityDto, IncompleteAddressEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<AddressEntityDto, AddressEntity>()
            //.ForMember(x => x.Country, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<IncompleteAddressEntityDto, EntityRef<IncompleteAddressEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.AddressType.ToString());
        #endregion

        #region LogObject Mappings
        CreateMap<AddressEntity, LogObject>().MappingLogObject();
        CreateMap<DomesticLotNumberAddressEntity, LogObject>().MappingLogObject();
        CreateMap<DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntity, LogObject>().MappingLogObject();
        CreateMap<DomesticPOBoxAddressEntity, LogObject>().MappingLogObject();
        CreateMap<DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntity, LogObject>().MappingLogObject();
        CreateMap<ForeignAddressEntity, LogObject>().MappingLogObject();
        CreateMap<IncompleteAddressEntity, LogObject>().MappingLogObject();
        #endregion
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

/// <summary>
/// StreetSuffixMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class StreetSuffixMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="StreetSuffixMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public StreetSuffixMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<StreetSuffixEntity, StreetSuffixEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<StreetSuffixEntityDto, StreetSuffixEntity>()
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<StreetSuffixEntity, EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name!);

        CreateMap<StreetSuffixEntityDto, EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name!);

        CreateMap<EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>, StreetSuffixEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IsFloorAndDoorSpecified, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IsHouseNumberRequired, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Code, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IsStreetNameRequired, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<StreetSuffixEntity, LogObject>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Code))
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                d.Type = s?.GetType().EntityTypeName();
            });
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Users;

/// <summary>
/// SecUserSyncedMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class SecUserSyncedMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecUserSyncedMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SecUserSyncedMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> EntityDto
        CreateMap<SecUserSyncedEntity, SecUserSyncedEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Tenants, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Roles, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                if (src.Tenants != null)
                    dest.Tenants = src.Tenants.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<TenantEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.Roles != null)
                    dest.Roles = src.Roles.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<SecRoleEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
            });


                // EntityDto -> Entity
        CreateMap<SecUserSyncedEntityDto, SecUserSyncedEntity>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Tenants, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Roles, y => y.Ignore());

        //LogObject
        CreateMap<SecUserSyncedEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\BusinessLogic\QueryHandlers\Emissions\Co2eFactorQueryHandler.cs
====================================================================================================

using Autofac;
using Autofac.Core.Lifetime;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.ListItems.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Emissions;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Transform;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Co2eFactorQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations.Co2eFactorEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations.Co2eFactorEntityDto&gt;" />
public class Co2eFactorQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<Co2eFactorEntity, Co2eFactorEntityDto>
{

    private const string CORE_DBCONTEXT_KEY = DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE;


    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="Co2eFactorQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// 

    public Co2eFactorQueryHandler(IMapper mapper, ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope) 
        : base(lifetimeScope.ResolveKeyed<IDbContext>(CORE_DBCONTEXT_KEY), mapper)
    {
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            Co2eFactorPagedEntityQuery pagedQuery => DoCo2eFactorPagedEntityQuery(pagedQuery),
            Co2eFactorGetByCategoryEntityQuery categoryQuery => DoCo2eFactorGetByCategoryEntityQuery(categoryQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<Co2eFactorEntity, Co2eFactorEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        //... if needed
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            Co2eFactorPagedEntityQuery pagedQuery => DoCo2eFactorPagedEntityQuery(pagedQuery),
            _ => base.DoQueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    private EntityListItemQueryResult<Co2eFactorListItemDto> DoCo2eFactorPagedEntityQuery(Co2eFactorPagedEntityQuery query)
    {

        // Get the query over, applying filters and joins
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<Co2eFactorEntity>();
        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        //SetupQuerySelect nem kell itt

        var totalCount = queryOver.RowCount();

        SetQueryPaging(queryOver, query);
        SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query);

        var entities = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity).List();

        var latestByCategory = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<Co2eFactorEntity>()
            .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted)
            .List()
            .GroupBy(e => e.Category)
            .ToDictionary(
                g => g.Key,
                g => g.OrderByDescending(e => e.ValidFrom).First().Id
            );

        var items = entities.Select(entity =>
        {
            var dto = Mapper.Map<Co2eFactorListItemDto>(entity);
            // Set IsLastActiveByCategory to true if this is the latest valid from date for its category
            dto.IsLastActiveByCategory = latestByCategory.TryGetValue(entity.Category, out var Id) &&
                                        entity.Id == Id;
            return dto;
        }).ToArray();

        var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<Co2eFactorListItemDto>
        {
            Items = items,
            RecordsTotal = totalCount
        };

        return result;
    }

    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoCo2eFactorGetByCategoryEntityQuery(Co2eFactorGetByCategoryEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<Co2eFactorEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false && x.Category == query.Category)
            .OrderBy(x => x.ValidFrom).Asc;
        var entities = queryOver.List();

        var result = new EntityQueryItemsResult<Co2eFactorEntityDto>
        {
            Items = [.. entities.Select(Mapper.Map<Co2eFactorEntityDto>)]
        };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<Co2eFactorEntity, Co2eFactorEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        switch (query)
        {
            case Co2eFactorPagedEntityQuery pagedQuery:
                if (pagedQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == pagedQuery.IsDeleted.Value);
                if (pagedQuery.IsActive.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == pagedQuery.IsActive.Value);//TODO érdemes lehet kiszedni ezt a fordított bekötést
                if (pagedQuery.Category.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Category == pagedQuery.Category.Value);
                if (pagedQuery.ValidFrom.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.ValidFrom >= pagedQuery.ValidFrom.Value);
                if (pagedQuery.ValidTo.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x =>
                    x.ValidTo <= pagedQuery.ValidTo.Value
                    || (!x.ValidTo.HasValue && x.ValidFrom <= pagedQuery.ValidFrom) //null végű validitást is adjon vissza, ha a kezdete nem nagyobb mint a lekérdezett kezdete
                    );

                break;

            case Co2eFactorEntityQuery entityQuery:
                if (entityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityQuery.IsDeleted.Value);
         
                if (entityQuery.Category.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Category == entityQuery.Category.Value);
                break;

            case ChangedCo2eFactorsQuery changedCo2eFactorsQuery:
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Modified != null 
                                                && x.Modified >= changedCo2eFactorsQuery.FromDate 
                                                && !x.IsDeleted);

                if (changedCo2eFactorsQuery.Category.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Category == changedCo2eFactorsQuery.Category.Value);

                break;
            default:
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<Co2eFactorEntity, Co2eFactorEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            Co2eFactorSingleEntityQuery entityQuery => DoCo2eFactorEntityQuery(entityQuery),
            //...
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the Co2eFactor entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityQuery">The entity query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private EntityQuerySingleResult? DoCo2eFactorEntityQuery(Co2eFactorSingleEntityQuery entityQuery)
    {
        Co2eFactorEntity? entity = null;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<Co2eFactorEntity>();

        // A nem törölt elemek között keresünk.
        queryOver.Where(o => !o.IsDeleted);

        //két eset lehet: vagy id-re keresünk, vagy kategóriára ÉS érvényességi idpőszakra.
        if (entityQuery.Id != default)
        {
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == entityQuery.Id);
        }
        else
        {
            if (!entityQuery.Category.HasValue)
                throw new ArgumentException("Category must be specified if Id is not provided.");
            if (!entityQuery.ValidFrom.HasValue)
                throw new ArgumentException("ValidFrom must be specified if Id is not provided.");

            queryOver.Where(x => x.Category == entityQuery.Category);
            queryOver.Where(x => x.ValidFrom >= entityQuery.ValidFrom);
            queryOver.Where(x => x.ValidTo == null || x.ValidTo <= entityQuery.ValidTo);
        }

        entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous Co2eFactor");
        if (entity is null)
            return null;

        var resultDto = CreateDto(entity);
/*
        //betöltjük az összes többit is, ami a kategórián belül van és nem törölt. kell majd a validációkhoz.
        var otherValidites = DbContext.Session.Query<Co2eFactorEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Category == entityQuery.Category && x.IsDeleted == false && x.Id != entity.Id)
            .ToList();
        resultDto.OtherValidites = otherValidites.Select(x => Mapper.Map<Co2eFactorEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
*/

        return new EntityQuerySingleResult { Entity = resultDto };
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\BusinessLogic\QueryHandlers\Locations\CountryQueryHandler.cs

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Locations;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// CountryQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations.CountryEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations.CountryEntityDto&gt;" />
public class CountryQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<CountryEntity, CountryEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CountryQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public CountryQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<CountryEntity, CountryEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<CountryEntity, CountryEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        // Query függvényében bekötni a megye alapján történő szűrést.

        queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
        if (query is SelectEntityRefQuery<CountryEntityDto> countriesEntityRefQuery && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(countriesEntityRefQuery.Search))
            queryOver.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Name).IsInsensitiveLike(countriesEntityRefQuery.Search, MatchMode.Anywhere);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query is CountryEntityQuery entityQuery ? DoCountrySingleEntityQuery(entityQuery) : base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the country single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityQuery">The entity query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoCountrySingleEntityQuery(CountryEntityQuery entityQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<CountryEntity>();
        // A nem törölt elemek között keresünk.
        queryOver.Where(o => !o.IsDeleted);

        // Business Logic keresési igények:
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.Name))
            queryOver.Where(o => o.Name == entityQuery.Name);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.ISO3))
            queryOver.Where(o => o.ISO3 == entityQuery.ISO3);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous Country");
        
        return entity != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
    }
}

    public async Task<List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>> GetOrgUnitQueryPermissions(IEntityQuery query, int? entityId, RequiredSecOperationAttribute secAttr)
    {
        var op = secAttr.SecurityOperation;
        if (op == SecurityOperation.Read && !secAttr.SecOperationCode.EndsWith(op.ToString()))
        {
            //TODO: váratlan működés: a SecurityOperation Read, de a SecOperationCode valami másra végződik.
            // ilyenkor vagy rosszul állították be az attribútumot a query-n, vagy mi lehet még?
#if DEBUG
            if (Debugger.IsAttached)
            {
                Debugger.Break(); //ha véletlenül fejlesztés közben előállna ez az eset (azért nem breakpoint, mert az nem megy fel a gitbe)
            }
#endif
        }

        var u = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        var userQuery = new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
        {
            GlobalId = u.GlobalId,
            TenantCode = u.TenantCode,
            IsDeleted = false
        };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(userQuery))?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto user)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User doesn't exist with global id: '{userQuery.GlobalId}'");



        //ha az operation egy create, akkor az entityId az entitás szülőjének az id-ja.
        //az adott usernek a szülőben (vagy annak szüleiben) kell rendelkeznie az entitás típusához tartozó create jogosultsággal.
        //update/delete operationöknél az adott entitásra, vagy annak szüleiben kell rendelkeznie a joggal
        //más kérdés, hogy query handler-ben vagyunk, tehát read operation-önökkel kellene csak találkozni itt?
        string? parentEntityName = null;
        if (op == SecurityOperation.Create)
        {
            parentEntityName = OrgUnitHelpers.GetOrgUnitParentType(query.EntityTypeName);
        }

        var ouType = OrgUnitHelpers.GetOrgunitType(op == SecurityOperation.Create ? parentEntityName : query.EntityTypeName);
        IEnumerable<string> userAvailableOpCodes = [];
        if (entityId.HasValue && ouType.HasValue)
        {
            //konkrét orgunit általi lekérdezés
            return await QueryUserPermissionByConcreteOrgUnit(entityId.Value, user, ouType.Value);
        }
        else
        {
            //tenant szintű listázó lekérdezés -> entityId-t nem kell figyelembe venni, és az ouType is kvázi lényegtelen, mert az öröklődés miatt minden kell
            return await QueryAllUserPermissionByOrgUnitType(user, ouType);
            //a további szűrést az adott query handler fogja megvalósítani, a query eredményéből kiszűrve azokat az elemeket, amire nincs engedélye a usernek.
        }
    }

    public async Task CheckForMultipleOrgUnitQueryPermissions(IEntityQuery query, IEnumerable<int> entityIds)
    {
        RequiredSecOperationAttribute? secAttr = query.GetType().GetCustomAttribute<RequiredSecOperationAttribute>();
        if (secAttr is null)
        {
            return;
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode))
        {
            return;
        }

        var u = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        var userQuery = new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
        {
            GlobalId = u.GlobalId,
            TenantCode = u.TenantCode,
            IsDeleted = false
        };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(userQuery))?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto user)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User doesn't exist with global id: '{userQuery.GlobalId}'");

        // kivesszük a generikus paraméterből ha nincs setelve az attributumban a SecOpCode
        // ez egy workaround
        Type type = query.GetType();
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(secAttr.SecOperationCode) && type.IsGenericType)
        {
            Type[] typeArguments = type.GetGenericArguments();
            Type genericArg = typeArguments[0];
            /*
                runtime be kell állítani, mert a generikusság miatt csak futásidőben derül ki, hogy mely entitásra kell a permission check
                itt csak secAttrnek annyit adunk meg, hogy SiteEntityDto, FloorEntityDto... és társai. Utana a SecOpCodet elkészíti a szokásos módon.                
             */
            secAttr.SetOperationCodeRuntime(genericArg);

        }

        var otype = OrgUnitHelpers.GetOrgunitType(query.EntityTypeName);

        var assignments = await QueryAllUserPermissionByOrgUnitType(user, otype);
        string userName = _securityContext.CurrentUser.LoginName;


        var userAvailableOpCodes = new HashSet<string>(assignments.SelectMany(x => x.SecOpCodes));
        if (!userAvailableOpCodes.Contains(secAttr.SecOperationCode))
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User '{userName}' has no permission to execute '{secAttr.SecOperationCode}' operation on entity '{query.EntityTypeName}'");
        }


        /*
         * Itt késöbb majd lehet tesztelni az assignments re minden OrgunitTypera minden jogosultságot
         * egyenlőre Adminnal megy 
            
            foreach (var a in assignments)
            {
                hierarchiaban lehivni a gyerek osztalyokat 
                teszteles az entityIdk-ra
            }
        */




    }
    public async Task CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(IEntityQuery query, int? entityId)
    {
#if DEBUG
        Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
#endif
        RequiredSecOperationAttribute? secAttr = query.GetType().GetCustomAttribute<RequiredSecOperationAttribute>();
        if (secAttr is null)
        {
            //TODO: az a baj, hogy ide az általános entityqueryk végrehajtásakor is be fog futni. annál pedig nem lesz attribútum
            //throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException("Nincs megadva biztonsági attribútum a parancshoz.");
            return; //egyelőre ezt az esetet hagyjuk figyelmen kívül
            //entitytypename-ből lehetne részben következtetni, és itt csak read operation-ök vannak.
        }

        //globál user esetén a user összes jogosultsága öröklődik lefelé, ezért nem kell egyedi orgunitokra vizsgálni, ezért itt kilépünk
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode))
        {
            return;
        }

        // Rendszerszintű áthívásoknál nincs jogosultság kezelés
        if (_securityContext.CurrentUser.IsSystem)
        {
            return;
        }

        string userName = _securityContext.CurrentUser.LoginName;

        var permissionList = await GetOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId, secAttr);
        var userAvailableOpCodes = new HashSet<string>(permissionList.SelectMany(x => x.SecOpCodes));

        //megvizsgáljuk, hogy a kigyűjtött role-ok közül valamelyikben szerepel-e az az opcode, ami a query-re vonatkozik
        if (!userAvailableOpCodes.Contains(secAttr.SecOperationCode))
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentSecurityException($"User '{userName}' has no permission to execute '{secAttr.SecOperationCode}' operation on entity '{query.EntityTypeName}' with id '{entityId}'");
        }

#if DEBUG
        sw.Stop();
        var el = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds; //kiraktam változóba, mert valami anomália folytán mintha nem állna le a stopper, hiába hívtam a stopot.
        Debug.WriteLine($"{el} ms.");
#endif
        //ha ide eljutottunk, akkor a usernek van jogosultsága a művelethez
        Debug.WriteLine($"{userName} can perform {query}");
    }

    private async Task<List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>> QueryAllUserPermissionByOrgUnitType(SecUserEntityDto user, OrgunitType? ouType)
    {
        var activeRoles = user.Roles.Select(r => r.Id).ToList();

        var queryParams = new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentListQuery
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            TargetOrgUnitType = ouType,
            RoleIds = [.. activeRoles],
        };


        if ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(queryParams)) is not SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult queryResults)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Failed to query security role-orgunit assignment.");

#if DEBUG
        //---------------
        var tenantLevelRoles = queryResults.Items.Where(x => x.OrgunitType is null).ToList();
        //adott típushoz tartozó role-ok
        var rolesByOrgUnitType = queryResults.Items
            .Where(x => x.OrgunitType.HasValue) //nem nullok, tehát nem tenanthoz rendelt jogok
            .GroupBy(x => x.OrgunitType!.Value).ToDictionary(x => x.Key, x => x.ToList());
        if (rolesByOrgUnitType.Count > 0)
        {

        }

        /*TODO: de itt még nem tudjuk, hogy az adott típusú orgunitok közül melyikhez van joga emberünknek.
            ha tenant szintű joga van, akkor tiszta sor, mert mindenhez
            viszont mi van az örökölt jogokkal?
            pl. nincs tenant szintű joga, de mondjuk van site szinten joga. és a query épületeket akar listázni.
            ebben az esetben csak azokat az épületeket kell listázni, amelyek a site-hoz tartoznak.
        megoldás: az adott query handler az adott típusú listázás végrehajtása után kiszűri az eredményekből azokat az elemeket, amire nincs a felhasználónak joga.
        */
        //---------------
#endif
        return queryResults.Items.ToList();

    }

    // az adott orgunithoz tartozó jogosultságok lekérdezése, a felülről örökölt jogosultságokkal együtt.
    private async Task<List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>> QueryUserPermissionByConcreteOrgUnit(int entityId, SecUserEntityDto user, OrgunitType ouType)
    {
        if ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new OrgUnitParentHierarchyQuery { EntityId = entityId, OrgunitType = ouType })) is not OrgUnitParentHierarchyQueryResult parentHierarchy)
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Failed to query parent hierarchy.");
        }

        var activeRoles = user.Roles.Select(r => r.Id).ToList(); //TODO: IsActive filtering -> needs IsActive flag in entity and in db -> because it's entityref, we don't have that property here. instead I filtered out the inactive roles in the mapping
        var queryParams = new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQuery
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            TargetOrgUnitId = entityId,
            TargetOrgUnitType = ouType,
            RoleIds = [.. activeRoles],
            ParentOrgUnits = parentHierarchy.Parents,
        };

        if ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(queryParams)) is not SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult queryResults)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Failed to query security role-orgunit assignment.");

        return queryResults.Items.ToList();
        //var opCodes = new HashSet<string>(queryResults.Items.SelectMany(x => x.SecOpCodes));
        //return opCodes;

    }

    protected abstract int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query);
    // azért virtual, hogy ne akadjon ki a fordito amig nincs implementálva mindenhol
    protected virtual IEnumerable<int>? GetEntityIdsForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query) { return null; }

}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// RoomProfileQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations.RoomProfileEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations.RoomProfileEntityDto&gt;" />
public class RoomProfileQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<RoomProfileEntity, RoomProfileEntityDto>
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RoomProfileQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public RoomProfileQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            RoomProfilesByBuildingProfileQuery profilesQuery => DoRoomProfilesByBuildingProfileQuery(profilesQuery),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)

        };
    }

    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            //RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery itemQuery => DoQueryEntities(itemQuery),
            RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery pagedQuery => RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery(pagedQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<RoomProfileEntity, RoomProfileEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        //... if needed
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery pagedQuery => RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery(pagedQuery),
            _ => base.DoQueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    // egyedi lekérdezés kellett, mert az ősosztály nem tudta feloldani azt, hogy a BuildingProfiles is ki legyen töltve
    private EntityListItemQueryResult<RoomProfileListItemDto> RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery(RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery query)
    //private IEntityQueryItemsResult RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery(RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery query) -->  CA1859: Use concrete types when possible for improved performance
    {
        // Get the query over, applying filters and joins
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomProfileEntity>();
        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        //SetupQuerySelect nem kell itt

        var totalCount = queryOver.RowCount();

        SetQueryPaging(queryOver, query);
        SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query);

        var entities = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity).List();
        var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<RoomProfileListItemDto>
        {
            Items = entities.Select(Mapper.Map<RoomProfileListItemDto>).ToArray(),
            RecordsTotal = totalCount
        };

        return result;
    }
    private RoomProfilesByBuildingProfileQueryResult DoRoomProfilesByBuildingProfileQuery(RoomProfilesByBuildingProfileQuery profilesQuery)
    {
        TenantIndependentDictItemEntity? buildingProfileAlias = null;

        var items = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomProfileEntity>()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingProfiles, () => buildingProfileAlias)
            .Where(() => buildingProfileAlias!.Id == profilesQuery.BuildingProfileId)
            .List();

        var dtos = items.Select(x =>  Mapper.Map<EntityRef<RoomProfileEntityDto>>(x) );

        return new RoomProfilesByBuildingProfileQueryResult { RoomProfiles = dtos };
    }
   
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<RoomProfileEntity, RoomProfileEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        switch (query)
        {
            case SelectEntityRefQuery<RoomProfileEntityDto> roomprofilesEntityRefQuery:
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(roomprofilesEntityRefQuery.Search))
                    queryOver.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Name).IsInsensitiveLike(roomprofilesEntityRefQuery.Search, MatchMode.Anywhere);
                break;

            case RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery roomprofilesPagedQuery:
                if (roomprofilesPagedQuery.IsActive.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == roomprofilesPagedQuery.IsActive.Value);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(roomprofilesPagedQuery.Name))
                    queryOver.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Name).IsInsensitiveLike(roomprofilesPagedQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere);
                break;

            default:
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
                break;
        }


    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<RoomProfileEntity, RoomProfileEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        // Fetch the BuildingProfiles collection using the non-deprecated API
        if (query is RoomProfilePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            queryOver.Fetch(SelectMode.Fetch, x => x.BuildingProfiles);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            RoomProfileEntityQuery entityQuery => DoRoomProfileEntityQuery(entityQuery),
            //...
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the RoomProfile entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityQuery">The entity query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private EntityQuerySingleResult? DoRoomProfileEntityQuery(RoomProfileEntityQuery entityQuery)
    {
        RoomProfileEntity? entity = null;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomProfileEntity>();

        // A nem törölt elemek között keresünk.
        queryOver.Where(o => !o.IsDeleted);

        if (entityQuery.Id != default)
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == entityQuery.Id);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.Name))
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Name == entityQuery.Name);

        entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous RoomProfile");

        return entity is null ? null : new EntityQuerySingleResult { Entity = CreateDto(entity) };
    }
}

        // Query függvényében bekötni a megye alapján történő szűrést.

        queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
        if (query is SelectEntityRefQuery<SettlementEntityDto> settlementsEntityRefQuery && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(settlementsEntityRefQuery.Search))
            queryOver.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Name).IsInsensitiveLike(settlementsEntityRefQuery.Search, MatchMode.Anywhere);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<SettlementEntity, SettlementEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.County, () => _countyAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query is SettlementEntityQuery entityQuery ? DoSettlementEntityQuery(entityQuery) : base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the settlement entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityQuery">The entity query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSettlementEntityQuery(SettlementEntityQuery entityQuery)
    {
        SettlementEntity? entity = null;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.Code))
            entity = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SettlementEntity>().Where(x => x.Code == entityQuery.Code).SingleOrDefault();

        return entity != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the cache entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoCacheEntityQuery()
    {

        SettlementZipCodeEntityDto alias = null!;
        TenantIndependentDictItemEntity iranyitoszamAlias = null!;
        var result = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SettlementEntity>()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.ZipCodes, () => iranyitoszamAlias)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Settlement)
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SettlementId)
                .Select(x => iranyitoszamAlias.Code).WithAlias(() => alias.ZipCode)
                .Select(x => iranyitoszamAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.ZipCodeId)
            ).TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<SettlementZipCodeEntityDto>()).List<SettlementZipCodeEntityDto>().ToArray();
        var index = 1;
        foreach (var telepulesIranyitoszamEntityDto in result)
        {
            telepulesIranyitoszamEntityDto.Id = index++;
        }
        return new EntityQueryItemsResult<SettlementZipCodeEntityDto>()
        {
            Items = result
        };
    }
}

    /// </summary>

    {
        StreetSuffixEntity? entity = entityQuery.GetDeletedItems
            ? DbContext.Session.QueryOver<StreetSuffixEntity>().Where(x =>
               x.Code == entityQuery.Code || x.Name == entityQuery.Name).SingleOrDefault()
            : DbContext.Session.QueryOver<StreetSuffixEntity>().Where(x =>
                (x.Code == entityQuery.Code || x.Name == entityQuery.Name) && !x.IsDeleted).SingleOrDefault();
        
        return entity != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
