using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Tenant;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Security;

/// <summary>
/// Felhasználó authentikáció lekérdezése
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security.SecAuthEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security.SecAuthEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SecAuthQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<SecAuthEntity, SecAuthEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the core database context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The core database context.
    /// </value>
    private IDbContext CoreDbContext { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecAuthQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public SecAuthQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, ILifetimeScope scope) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        CoreDbContext = scope.ResolveKeyed<IDbContext>(DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {

        if (query is SecAPIEntityQuery secAPIEntityQuery)
        {
            using var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope();

            tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(secAPIEntityQuery.TenantCode);
            var secUserResult =
                GetSecAPI(DbContext, secAPIEntityQuery)
                ?? GetSecAPI(CoreDbContext, secAPIEntityQuery);
            return secUserResult;
        }
        if (query is SecAuthEntityQuery secUserEntityQuery)
        {
            return GetSecUser(secUserEntityQuery);
        }

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the sec API.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="secAPIEntityQuery">The sec API entity query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Not implemented!</exception>
    private EntityQuerySingleResult? GetSecAPI(IDbContext dbContext, SecAPIEntityQuery secAPIEntityQuery)
    {
        var secAPIQuery = dbContext
            .Session
            .QueryOver<SecAPIEntity>();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secAPIEntityQuery.APIKey))
            secAPIQuery.Where(x => x.APIKey == secAPIEntityQuery.APIKey);
        else if (secAPIEntityQuery.GlobalId != null)
            secAPIQuery.Where(x => x.GlobalId == secAPIEntityQuery.GlobalId);
        else
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Not implemented!");

        var validSecAPIEntity = secAPIQuery.SingleOrDefault();
        return validSecAPIEntity != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto<SecAPIEntityDto>(validSecAPIEntity)
            }
            : null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the sec user.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="secUserEntityQuery">The sec user entity query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Not implemented!</exception>
    private EntityQuerySingleResult? GetSecUser(SecAuthEntityQuery secUserEntityQuery)
    {
        var secUserQuery = DbContext
            .Session
            .QueryOver<SecUserEntity>();

        secUserQuery.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);


        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secUserEntityQuery.Email))
        {
            secUserQuery.Where(x => x.EMail == secUserEntityQuery.Email);
        }
        else if (secUserEntityQuery.GlobalId != null)
        {
            secUserQuery.Where(x => x.GlobalId == secUserEntityQuery.GlobalId);
        }
        else
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Not implemented!");
        }

        SecUserEntity? validSecUserEntity = null;
        if (secUserEntityQuery.GlobalId != null && secUserEntityQuery.GlobalId.Value != Guid.Empty)
            validSecUserEntity = secUserQuery.SingleOrDefault();
        else
            foreach (var secUserEntity in secUserQuery.List())
            {
                if (!PasswordHelper.VerifyPassword(secUserEntity.Password, secUserEntityQuery.Password))
                    continue;
                
                validSecUserEntity = secUserEntity;
                break;
            }

        return validSecUserEntity != null && !validSecUserEntity.IsLocked
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto<SecUserEntityDto>(validSecUserEntity)
            }
            : null;
    }
}

    /// <br />
    /// </returns>

    {
        return query is IEntityQuery<SecOperationListItemDto> itemQuery ? DoQueryEntities(itemQuery) : base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<SecOperationEntity, SecOperationEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(SecOperationListItemDto))
        {
            SecOperationListItemDto alias = null;
            queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(x => x.OperationCode).WithAlias(() => alias.OperationCode)
                    .Select(x => x.OperationName).WithAlias(() => alias.OperationName)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SecOperationEntity, SecOperationEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SecOperationPagedEntityQuery secOperationPagedQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(secOperationPagedQuery.OperationName))
                queryOver
                    .And(Restrictions
                        .On<SecOperationEntity>(x => x.OperationName)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(secOperationPagedQuery.OperationName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(secOperationPagedQuery.OperationCode))
                queryOver
                    .And(Restrictions
                    .On<SecOperationEntity>(x => x.OperationCode)
                    .IsInsensitiveLike(secOperationPagedQuery.OperationCode, MatchMode.Anywhere));
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }
}

using NHibernate.Criterion;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Security;

/// <summary>
/// Felhasználó szerepkörök lekérdezése
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security.SecRoleEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security.SecRoleEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SecRoleQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<SecRoleEntity, SecRoleEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The sec operation entity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecOperationEntity _secOperationEntityAlias = null;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecRoleQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public SecRoleQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IEntityQuery<SecRoleListItemDto> itemQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(itemQuery);

        if (query is IEntityQuery<SecurityEntityDto>)
        {
            var items = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecRoleEntity>()
                .JoinAlias(x => x.SecOperations, () => _secOperationEntityAlias)
                .SelectList(list =>
                    list.Select(x => x.RoleCode)
                        .Select(() => _secOperationEntityAlias.Id)
                        .Select(() => _secOperationEntityAlias.OperationCode)
                        .Select(() => _secOperationEntityAlias.OperationName)
                    )
                .List<object[]>()
                .Select(x => new { RoleCode = (string)x[0], OperationId = (int)x[1], OperationCode = (string)x[2], OperationName = (string)x[3] })

                .GroupBy(x => x.OperationId)
                .Select(x => new SecurityEntityDto { Id = x.Key, SecOperationCode = x.First().OperationCode, SecOperationName = x.First().OperationName, RoleCodes = x.Select(y => y.RoleCode).ToArray() })
                .ToArray();

            return new EntityQueryItemsResult<SecurityEntityDto> { Items = items };
        }

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<SecRoleEntity, SecRoleEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(SecRoleListItemDto))
        {
            SecRoleListItemDto alias = null;
            queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(x => x.RoleName).WithAlias(() => alias.RoleName)
                    .Select(x => x.RoleCode).WithAlias(() => alias.RoleCode)
                    .Select(x => x.IsSystem).WithAlias(() => alias.IsSystem)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<SecRoleEntity, SecRoleEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IEntityQuery<SecurityEntityDto>)
        {
            queryOver = queryOver.Left.JoinAlias(x => x.SecOperations, () => _secOperationEntityAlias);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SecRoleEntity, SecRoleEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is IPagedEntityQuery secRolePagedQuery)
        {
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
        }

        if (query is RoleBySecRoleTypeEntityQuery roleBySecRoleTypeEntityQuery)
        {
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.SecRoleType == roleBySecRoleTypeEntityQuery.SecRoleType);
        }

        
    }
}

    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="lifetimeScope">The lifetime scope.</param>
    public SecUserQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _lifetimeScope = lifetimeScope;
        _securityContext = lifetimeScope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SecUserSingleEntityQuery singleEntityQuery)
            return DoSecUserSingleEntityQuery(singleEntityQuery);
        if (query is SecUserByTokenEntityQuery secUserByTokenEntityQuery)
            return DoSecUserByTokenEntityQuery(secUserByTokenEntityQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant kód, username és töröltségi állapot függvényében keres egy SecUser-t.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSecUserSingleEntityQuery(SecUserSingleEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>();
        
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.TenantCode))
        {
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Tenants, () => _tenantEntityAlias).
                Where(x => _tenantEntityAlias.Code == query.TenantCode);
        }

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        if (query.GlobalId != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.GlobalId == query.GlobalId);

        if (query.IsDeleted.HasValue)
            queryOver = query.IsDeleted.Value
                ? queryOver.Where(o => o.IsDeleted)
                : queryOver.Where(o => !o.IsDeleted);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Email))
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.EMail == query.Email);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous SecUserEntity");

        var result = entity != null
             ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
             {
                 Entity = CreateDto(entity)
             }
             : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Token és Tenant kód alapján visszaadja a tokenhez tartozó User-t
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSecUserByTokenEntityQuery(SecUserByTokenEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Token))
            return null;

        var token = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<OneTimeTokenEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Token == query.Token && x.TokenType == query.TokenType)
            .SingleOrDefault();

        if (token == null || (query.TokenType != null && token.TokenType == Shared.Enums.TokenType.Valid))
            return null;

        return token.User != null && token.Ervenyesseg >= DateTime.UtcNow
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(token.User)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">TenantCode is required!</exception>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SecUserEntityQuery entityQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(entityQuery);

        if (query is SecUserTenantsQuery tenantsQuery)
            return DoSecUserTenantsQuery(tenantsQuery);

        if (query is TenantSecUserEntityQuery tenantSecUserEntityQuery)
        {
            return _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode == null
                ? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException($"TenantCode is required!")
                : (IEntityQueryItemsResult)DoQueryEntities(new SecUserEntityQuery
                {
                    Id = tenantSecUserEntityQuery.Id,
                    EMail = tenantSecUserEntityQuery.EMail,
                    IsDeleted = tenantSecUserEntityQuery.IsDeleted,
                    TenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode,
                    From = tenantSecUserEntityQuery.From
                });
        }

        if (query is IEntityQuery<SecUserListItemDto> itemQuery)
        {
            return DoQueryEntities(itemQuery);
        }

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoSecUserTenantsQuery(SecUserTenantsQuery tenantsQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                                         .Where(x => x.GlobalId == tenantsQuery.SecUserGlobalId)
                                         .Fetch(SelectMode.Fetch, x => x.Tenants)
                                         .TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous SecUserEntity");

        if (entity == null) 
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"A {tenantsQuery.SecUserGlobalId} globális azonosítójú felhasználó nem található!");
        }

        NHibernateUtil.Initialize(entity.Roles);

        var items = entity.Tenants.Select(x => new SelectListItemDto() 
        {
            Id = x.Id,
            Identifier = x.TenantIdentifier,
            Code = x.Code,
            Name = $"{x.Name} - Közintézményi adatok",
        }).ToList();

        if (entity.Roles.Any(x => x.SecRoleType == SecRoleType.Adminisztrator)) 
        {
            items.Add(new SelectListItemDto() { Code = null, Name = "Központi adatok" });
        }

        return new EntityQueryItemsResult<SelectListItemDto> { Items = items.ToArray() };
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<SecUserEntity, SecUserEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(SecUserListItemDto))
        {
            SecUserListItemDto alias = default!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.GlobalId).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                .Select(x => x.EMail).WithAlias(() => alias.Email)
                .Select(x => x.FirstName).WithAlias(() => alias.FirstName)
                .Select(x => x.LastName).WithAlias(() => alias.LastName)
                .Select(x => x.Phone).WithAlias(() => alias.Phone)
                .Select(x => x.IsDeleted).WithAlias(() => alias.IsDeleted)
                .Select(x => x.IsLocked).WithAlias(() => alias.IsLocked)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SecUserEntity, SecUserEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is SecUserEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            // Töröltségre szűrés
            if (entityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver = entityQuery.IsDeleted.Value
                    ? queryOver.Where(o => o.IsDeleted)
                    : queryOver.Where(o => !o.IsDeleted);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.TenantCode))
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(t => _tenantEntityAlias.Code == entityQuery.TenantCode);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.EMail))
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(t => t.EMail == entityQuery.EMail);

            if (entityQuery.Id != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == entityQuery.Id);

            // Sync használja! (ha módosulna a logika, akkor ezt át kell vezetni külön query-be)
            if (entityQuery.From != null)
                queryOver = entityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue
                    ? queryOver.OnlyFrom(entityQuery.From)
                    : queryOver.Where(t => t.Created > entityQuery.From ||
                    (t.Created != null && t.Modified != null && t.Modified > entityQuery.From) ||
                    (t.Created != null && t.Deleted != null && t.Deleted > entityQuery.From));
        }

        if (query is SecUserEntityRefQuery secUserEntityRefQuery && secUserEntityRefQuery.RoleType is not null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => _roleAlias.SecRoleType == secUserEntityRefQuery.RoleType);
        }

        if (query is SecUserPagedEntityQuery secUserPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secUserPagedEntityQuery.Email))
            {
                queryOver.Where(Restrictions.On<SecUserEntity>(x => x.EMail).IsInsensitiveLike(secUserPagedEntityQuery.Email, MatchMode.Anywhere));
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secUserPagedEntityQuery.FirstName))
            {
                queryOver.Where(Restrictions.On<SecUserEntity>(x => x.FirstName).IsInsensitiveLike(secUserPagedEntityQuery.FirstName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secUserPagedEntityQuery.LastName))
            {
                queryOver.Where(Restrictions.On<SecUserEntity>(x => x.LastName).IsInsensitiveLike(secUserPagedEntityQuery.LastName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
            }

            if (secUserPagedEntityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == secUserPagedEntityQuery.IsDeleted.Value);
            }

            if (secUserPagedEntityQuery.IsLocked.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsLocked == secUserPagedEntityQuery.IsLocked.Value);
            }

            var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
            if (tenantCode != null)
            {
                queryOver.Where(() => _tenantEntityAlias.Code == tenantCode);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<SecUserEntity, SecUserEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is SecUserEntityQuery entityQuery && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.TenantCode))
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Tenants, () => _tenantEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

        if (query is SecUserEntityRefQuery secUserEntityRefQuery && secUserEntityRefQuery.RoleType is not null)
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Roles, () => _roleAlias);

        if (query is SecUserPagedEntityQuery pagedQuery && pagedQuery?.Tenant is not null)
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Tenants, () => _tenantEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.SqlCommand;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Security;

/// <summary>
/// Tenantokhoz kapcsolódó lekérdezések
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security.TenantEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security.TenantEntityDto&gt;" />
public class TenantQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<TenantEntity, TenantEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Maintainer alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly MaintainerEntity _maintainerAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TenantQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public TenantQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query is TenantEntityQuery tenantEntityQuery ? DoTenantEntityQuery(tenantEntityQuery) : base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the tenant entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoTenantEntityQuery(TenantEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query.PartnerId.HasValue)
        {
            var partnerQueryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerEntity>();
            partnerQueryOver.Where(p => !p.IsDeleted);
            partnerQueryOver.Where(p => p.Id == query.PartnerId.Value);
            var partner = partnerQueryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous PartnerEntityQuery");
            if (partner != null)
                query.TenantCode = partner.TenantCode;
        }

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<TenantEntity>();

        // Van olyan eset, amikor minden rekordot szeretnénk visszakapni
        // Itt azt az esetet kezeljük le, amikor csak az érvényes (nem-törölt)
        // rekordokra szeretnénk szűrni.
        if (query.OnlyValidResults)
            queryOver.Where(Restrictions.Where(NotDeletedExpression));

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.TenantCode))
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Code == query.TenantCode);

        if (query.TenantIdentifier != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.TenantIdentifier == query.TenantIdentifier);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous TenantEntityQuery");

        return entity != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<TenantEntity, TenantEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        //queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Maintainer, () => _maintainerAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<TenantEntity, TenantEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is TenantEntityQuery tenantQuery) 
        {
            if (tenantQuery.From.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(t => (t.Modified != null && t.Modified >= tenantQuery.From) || t.Created >= tenantQuery.From);
            }
            if (tenantQuery.MaintainterId.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(t => t.Maintainer.Id == tenantQuery.MaintainterId);
            }
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.Abstract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.System;
using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.System;

/// <summary>
/// AbstractDictItemQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TDictEntity">The type of the dictionary entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;TEntity, TEntityDto&gt;" />
public abstract class AbstractDictItemQueryHandler<TDictEntity, TEntity, TEntityDto> : QueryHandlerBase<TEntity, TEntityDto>
    where TDictEntity: IDictEntity
    where TEntity: AbstractDictItemEntity<TDictEntity>
    where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The dictionary alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TDictEntity _dictAlias = default!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AbstractDictItemQueryHandler{TDictEntity, TEntity, TEntityDto}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public AbstractDictItemQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is DictItemEntityQuery entityQuery)
            return DoQueryDictItemEntity(entityQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is DictItemEntityQuery entityQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(entityQuery);
        
        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<TEntity, TEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        if (query is DictItemEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            if (entityQuery.Id != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == entityQuery.Id);
        
            if (entityQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityQuery.IsDeleted);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.Code))
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Code == entityQuery.Code);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.Value))
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Value == entityQuery.Value);

            if (entityQuery.DictId != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => _dictAlias.Id == entityQuery.DictId);
            else
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.DictCode))
                    queryOver.Where(x => _dictAlias.Code == entityQuery.DictCode);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<TEntity, TEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        if (query is DictItemEntityQuery entityQuery && (entityQuery.DictId != null || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityQuery.DictCode)))
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Dict, () => _dictAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query dictionary item entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQueryDictItemEntity(DictItemEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<TEntity>();
        
        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous DictItemQuery");

        return entity != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.Abstract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.System;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.System;

/// <summary>
/// AbstractDictQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TDictItemEntity">The type of the dictionary item entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TEntity">The type of the entity.</typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TEntityDto">The type of the entity dto.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;TEntity, TEntityDto&gt;" />
public class AbstractDictQueryHandler<TDictItemEntity, TEntity, TEntityDto> : QueryHandlerBase<TEntity, TEntityDto>
    where TDictItemEntity : IDictItemEntity
    where TEntity : AbstractDictEntity<TDictItemEntity>
    where TEntityDto : IEntityDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AbstractDictQueryHandler{TDictItemEntity, TEntity, TEntityDto}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public AbstractDictQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is DictEntityQuery entitiesQuery)
            return DoDictEntitiesQuery(entitiesQuery);

        return base.QueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the dictionary entities query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entitiesQuery">The entities query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoDictEntitiesQuery(DictEntityQuery entitiesQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<TEntity>();
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entitiesQuery.Code))
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Code == entitiesQuery.Code);
        }

        if (entitiesQuery.Id != null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == entitiesQuery.Id);
        }

        if (entitiesQuery.IsSystemFilter != null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsSystem == entitiesQuery.IsSystemFilter.Value);
        }

        var entities = queryOver.List();

        EntityListItemQueryResult<TEntityDto> result = new() { Items = entities.Select(CreateDto).ToArray() };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is DictEntityQuery dictEntityQuery)
            return DoDictEntityQuery(dictEntityQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the dictionary entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoDictEntityQuery(DictEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<TEntity>();
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Code))
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Code == query.Code);

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        if (query.IsSystemFilter != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsSystem == query.IsSystemFilter.Value);

        var entity = queryOver.SingleOrDefault();

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult() { Entity = CreateDto(entity) };
        return null;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\BusinessLogic\QueryHandlers\System\SysConfigQueryHandler.cs

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Views;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.ListItems.Sysconfig;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.System;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using SecurityContext = Common.Logic.Security.SecurityContext;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.System;

/// <summary>
/// SysConfigQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Views.SysConfigView, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System.SysConfigEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SysConfigQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<SysConfigView, SysConfigEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the core database context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The core database context.
    /// </value>
    private IDbContext CoreDbContext { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// The security context
    /// </summary>
    private SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether the specified operation has right.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="operation">The operation.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if the specified operation has right; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    private bool HasRight(SecurityOperation operation)
    {
        var hasRight = _securityContext.HasRight<SysConfigEntityDto>(operation);
        return hasRight;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SysConfigQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public SysConfigQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, ILifetimeScope scope, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        CoreDbContext = scope.ResolveKeyed<IDbContext>(DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE);
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SysConfigSingleEntityQuery sysConfigSingleEntityQuery)
            return DoSysConfigSingleEntityQuery(sysConfigSingleEntityQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the system configuration single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSysConfigSingleEntityQuery(SysConfigSingleEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SysConfigView>();

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.ConfigName))
            queryOver.Where(x => x.ConfigName == query.ConfigName);

        // Ha szűrűnk arra, hogy ne jelenjen meg bizalmas sysconfig az arra nem jogosultaknak
        // (jelenleg azoknak, akiknek nincs Szerkesztési joga a SysConfig-okra), akkor vizsgáljuk meg,
        // hogy rendelkezik-e az aktuális felhasználó a joggal. Ha nem, akkor csak a "publikus" sysconfigokat
        // adjuk vissza.
        if (query.IsClientConfigOnlyFilter && HasRight(SecurityOperation.Modify) == false) 
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsClientConfig == true);

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous SysConfig");

        return entity != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var result = base.QueryEntities(query);

        if (result is IEntityQueryItemsResult<SysConfig> sysConfigResult)
            result = QueryEntities(CoreDbContext, query, sysConfigResult);

        if (query is SysConfigEntitiesQuery entitiesQuery)
            return DoSysConfigEntitiesQuery(entitiesQuery);

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the system configuration entities query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoSysConfigEntitiesQuery(SysConfigEntitiesQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SysConfigView>();

        // Ha szűrűnk arra, hogy ne jelenjen meg bizalmas sysconfig az arra nem jogosultaknak
        // (jelenleg azoknak, akiknek nincs Szerkesztési joga a SysConfig-okra), akkor vizsgáljuk meg,
        // hogy rendelkezik-e az aktuális felhasználó a joggal. Ha nem, akkor csak a "publikus" sysconfigokat
        // adjuk vissza.
        if (query.IsClientConfigOnlyFilter && HasRight(SecurityOperation.Modify) == false)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsClientConfig == true);

        var entities = queryOver.List();
        EntityListItemQueryResult<SysConfigEntityDto> result = new() { Items = entities.Select(CreateDto).ToArray() };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IEntityQuery<SysConfigListItemDto> itemQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(itemQuery);

        if (query is IEntityQuery<SysConfig> itemQuery2)
            return DoQueryEntities(itemQuery2);

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<SysConfigView, SysConfigView> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {

        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(SysConfigListItemDto))
        {
            SysConfigListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(x => x.ConfigName).WithAlias(() => alias.ConfigName)
                        .Select(x => x.ConfigDisplayName).WithAlias(() => alias.ConfigDisplayName)
                        .Select(x => x.ConfigValue).WithAlias(() => alias.ConfigValue)
            );
        }
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(SysConfig))
        {
            SysConfigListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(x => x.ConfigName).WithAlias(() => alias.ConfigName)
                    .Select(x => x.ConfigValue).WithAlias(() => alias.ConfigValue)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SysConfigView, SysConfigView> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IPagedEntityQuery pagedQuery && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(pagedQuery.SearchText))
            queryOver
               .And(Restrictions.Or(
                        Restrictions
                            .On<SysConfigView>(x => x.ConfigDisplayName)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere),
                        Restrictions
                            .On<SysConfigView>(x => x.ConfigName)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere)
                   ));

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.TenantIndependent;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.System;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.System;

/// <summary>
/// TenantIndependentDictItemQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.System.AbstractDictItemQueryHandler&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.TenantIndependent.TenantIndependentDictEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.TenantIndependent.TenantIndependentDictItemEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System.TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto&gt;" />
public class TenantIndependentDictItemQueryHandler : AbstractDictItemQueryHandler
    <TenantIndependentDictEntity, 
    TenantIndependentDictItemEntity, 
    TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The dictionary alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictEntity _dictAlias = default;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TenantIndependentDictItemQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public TenantIndependentDictItemQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity, TenantIndependentDictItemEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is SelectDictItemEntityRefQuery dictItemEntityRefQuery)
        {
            queryOver =
                    queryOver
                    .Where(x => _dictAlias.Code == dictItemEntityRefQuery.DictCode);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dictItemEntityRefQuery.Search))
                queryOver
                    .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Value)
                    .IsInsensitiveLike(dictItemEntityRefQuery.Search, MatchMode.Anywhere);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity, TenantIndependentDictItemEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if(query is SelectDictItemEntityRefQuery)
        {
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Dict, () => _dictAlias);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity, TenantIndependentDictItemEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return null;
    }
}

﻿using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Országok
/// </summary>
[TenantIndependent]
public class CountryEntity : TrackedEntityBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// ISO3-as kódja az adott országnak
    /// </summary>
    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "iso3")]

    /// </summary>

    /// The external e-mail addresses.
    /// </value>
    public virtual string? ExternalEmailAddresses { get; set; }

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The expiration date.
    /// </value>
    public virtual DateTime ExpirationDate { get; set; }

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The state of the notification.
    /// </value>
    public virtual NotificationState NotificationState { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Küldés ideje
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The send date.
    /// </value>
    public virtual DateTime? SendDate { get; set; }


    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the retries.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The retries.
    /// </value>
    public virtual int Retries { get; set; } = 0;

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// The phone.
    /// </value>
    [ShortStringLength]
    [Description("Telefon")]
    public virtual string? Phone { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Születési idő
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The date of birth.
    /// </value>
    [Description("Születési idő")]
    public virtual DateTime? DateOfBirth { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rendszerszintű-e?
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is system; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    [Description("Rendszerszintű-e?")]
    public virtual bool IsSystem { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jelszó változási napló
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The sec user password histories.
    /// </value>
    [Inverse]
    [Description("Jelszó változási napló")]
    public virtual IList<SecUserPasswordHistory> SecUserPasswordHistories { get; set; } = new List<SecUserPasswordHistory>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Zárolt-e a felhasználó?
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is locked; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    [Description("Zárolt-e a felhasználó?")]
    public virtual bool IsLocked { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Zárolást végző felhasználó
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The locker user.
    /// </value>
    [Description("Zárolást végző felhasználó")]
    public virtual SecUserEntity? LockerUser { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Zárolás időpontja
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The locked.
    /// </value>
    [Description("Zárolás időpontja")]
    public virtual DateTime? Locked { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jelszó utolsó módosítási időpontja
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The password last modify.
    /// </value>
    [Description("Jelszó utolsó módosítási időpontja")]
    [Required]
    public virtual DateTime PasswordLastModify { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// A figyelmeztető üzenet vagy lejárt jelszó mailküldés esetén használatos flag
    /// Küldés alatt 'true', ha kiment az üzenet, akkor visszaállítjuk 'falsra', hogy a köv. alkalommal is tudjuk használni
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [warning mail]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    [Description("Figyelmeztető üzenet")]
    [Required]
    public virtual bool WarningMail { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kétfaktoros authentikáció státusza
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The two factor status.
    /// </value>
    [Description("Kétfaktoros authentikáció státusza")]
    [Required]
    public virtual TwoFactorStatus TwoFactorStatus { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the two factor shared secret.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The two factor shared secret.
    /// </value>
    [MediumStringLength]
    public virtual string TwoFactorSharedSecret { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the two factor options.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The two factor options.
    /// </value>
    [Text]
    public virtual string TwoFactorOptions { get; set;}

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the qr code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The qr code.
    /// </value>
    public virtual byte[]? QRCode { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant
    /// </summary>
    [ManyToMany]
    [Description("Tenants")]
    public virtual IList<TenantEntity> Tenants { get; set; }
}

where T : IDictEntity

    /// Kódtárelem kód

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The configuration value.
    /// </value>
    [SkipMapping]
    // az éppen editált érték ide, hogy legyen mit logolni
    public virtual string ConfigValue { get; set; }

    /// vagy csak Admin szerepkörű felhasználónak van rá jogosultsága.

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// ArrayExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class ArrayExtensions
{
    // array elem lekérdezése, negatív indexelés lehetőségével
    /// <summary>
    /// Ats the specified index.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="array">The array.</param>
    /// <param name="index">The index.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T At<T>(this T[] array, int index)
    {
        return index >= 0 ? array[index] : array[array.Length + index];
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\Extensions\AutoMapperExtensions.cs

using System.Linq.Expressions;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// AutomapperExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class AutomapperExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Ignores all unmapped.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSource">The type of the source.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TDest">The type of the dest.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="expression">The expression.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IMappingExpression<TSource, TDest> IgnoreAllUnmapped<TSource, TDest>(this IMappingExpression<TSource, TDest> expression)
    {
        expression.ForAllMembers(opt => opt.Ignore());
        return expression;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ignores the tracked entity properties.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSource">The type of the source.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TDestination">The type of the destination.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="mappingConfig">The mapping configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IMappingExpression<TSource, TDestination> IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties<TSource, TDestination>(this IMappingExpression<TSource, TDestination> mappingConfig) where TDestination : ILogicalDeleteEntity, ITrackedEntity
    {
        var result = mappingConfig
            .ForMember(x => x.IsDeleted, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => ((ILogicalDeleteEntity)x).Deleted, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.DeletionUser, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Created, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.CreatorUser, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Modified, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ModifierUser, y => y.Ignore());

        return mappingConfig;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mappings the log object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSource">The type of the source.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="mappingConfig">The mapping configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IMappingExpression<TSource, LogObject> MappingLogObject<TSource>(this IMappingExpression<TSource, LogObject> mappingConfig)
    where TSource : IEntity
    {
        return mappingConfig
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.EntityTypeName()))
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                d.Type = s?.GetType().EntityTypeName();
            });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates to entity reference map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSourceEntity">The type of the source entity.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TDestinationEntityDto">The type of the destination entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="mappingConfig">The mapping configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="displayNameSourceMember">The display name source member.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IMappingExpression<TSourceEntity, EntityRef<TDestinationEntityDto>> CreateToEntityRefMap<TSourceEntity, TDestinationEntityDto>(this IMappingExpression<TSourceEntity, EntityRef<TDestinationEntityDto>> mappingConfig, Expression<Func<TSourceEntity, string?>> displayNameSourceMember)
        where TSourceEntity : IEntity
        where TDestinationEntityDto : IEntityDto
    {
        return mappingConfig
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(f => f.EntityDisplayName, y => y.MapFrom(displayNameSourceMember));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates to unique identifier entity reference map.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSourceEntity">The type of the source entity.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TDestinationEntityDto">The type of the destination entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="mappingConfig">The mapping configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="displayNameSourceMember">The display name source member.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IMappingExpression<TSourceEntity, GuidEntityRef<TDestinationEntityDto>> CreateToGuidEntityRefMap<TSourceEntity, TDestinationEntityDto>(this IMappingExpression<TSourceEntity, GuidEntityRef<TDestinationEntityDto>> mappingConfig, Expression<Func<TSourceEntity, string?>> displayNameSourceMember)
        where TSourceEntity : IEntity, IGlobalIdentifier
        where TDestinationEntityDto : IEntityDto, IGlobalIdentifier
    {
        return mappingConfig
            .ForMember(x => x.Identifier, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Identifier))
            .ForMember(f => f.EntityDisplayName, y => y.MapFrom(displayNameSourceMember));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// TEntityDto -&gt; TEntity irányban ignoráljuk az Identifiert
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TSourceEntity">The type of the source entity.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TDestinationEntityDto">The type of the destination entity dto.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="mappingConfig">The mapping configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IMappingExpression<TSourceEntity, TDestinationEntityDto> IgnoreIdentifier<TSourceEntity, TDestinationEntityDto>(this IMappingExpression<TSourceEntity, TDestinationEntityDto> mappingConfig)
        where TSourceEntity : IEntityDto, IGlobalIdentifier
        where TDestinationEntityDto : IEntity, IGlobalIdentifier
    {
        return mappingConfig.ForMember(x => x.Identifier, y => y.Ignore());
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\Extensions\HttpClientExtensions.cs

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.DataReceiver;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.Framework;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.Monitoring;
using DRAPIAuthModel = EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.DataReceiver.APIAuthModel;
using FWAPIAuthModel = EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.Framework.APIAuthModel;
using MAPIAuthModel = EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.Monitoring.APIAuthModel;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// HttpClientExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class HttpClientExtensions
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the client.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static HttpClient CreateClient()
    {
        return new HttpClient
        {
            Timeout = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue("HttpClientTimeout", true) ?? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60)
        };
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the authentication token.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="client">The client.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    public static void SetAuthToken(this HttpClient client, string token)
    {
        if (client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization"))
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("Authorization");
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " + token);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the API client.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="client">The client.</param>
    /// <param name="options">The options.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static T GetApiClient<T>(this HttpClient client, Action<T> options)
    {
        var apiClient = (T)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(T), client)!;
        options(apiClient);
        return apiClient;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Authenticates the specified API.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="client">The client.</param>
    /// <param name="api">The API.</param>
    /// <param name="apiKey">The API key.</param>
    public static async Task Authenticate(this HttpClient client, FrameworkApi api, string? apiKey = null, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        apiKey ??= Config.GetStringValue("EnergiaMenedzsment.ApiKey");
        var authModel = await api.APIAuthenticate_AuthAsync(new FWAPIAuthModel()
        {
            ApiKey = apiKey,
            TenantCode = tenantCode
        });
        client.SetAuthToken(authModel.Token);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Authenticates the specified API.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="client">The client.</param>
    /// <param name="api">The API.</param>
    /// <param name="apiKey">The API key.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    public static async Task Authenticate(this HttpClient client, DataReceiverApi api, string? apiKey = null, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        apiKey ??= Config.GetStringValue("EnergiaMenedzsment.ApiKey");
        var authModel = await api.APIAuthenticate_AuthAsync(new DRAPIAuthModel()
        {
            TenantCode = tenantCode ?? "",
            ApiKey = apiKey
        });
        client.SetAuthToken(authModel.Token);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Authenticates the specified API.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="client">The client.</param>
    /// <param name="api">The API.</param>
    /// <param name="apiKey">The API key.</param>
    public static async Task Authenticate(this HttpClient client, MonitoringApi api, string? apiKey = null)
    {
        apiKey ??= Config.GetStringValue("EnergiaMenedzsment.ApiKey");
        var authModel = await api.APIAuthenticate_AuthAsync(new MAPIAuthModel()
        {
            ApiKey = apiKey
        });
        client.SetAuthToken(authModel.Token);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks whether the client has been authenticated.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="client">The client.</param>
    public static bool IsAuthenticated(this HttpClient client)
    {
        return client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Contains("Authorization");
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\Extensions\QueryOverExtensions.cs

using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using System.Linq.Expressions;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// QueryOverExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class QueryOverExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Called when [date time valid].
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="targetDate">The target date.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IQueryOver<T, T> OnlyDateTimeValid<T>(this IQueryOver<T, T> queryOver, DateTime? targetDate = null)
    {
        // Néha nem az aktuális dátumhoz képest nézünk érvényességet, ekkor megadható az adott nap. Az érvényességet csak nap szintjén kezeljük (TruncateToDayStart)
        var now = targetDate.HasValue ? targetDate.Value : DateTimeContext.Now;

        if (typeof(ILogicalDeleteEntity).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T)))
            queryOver.Where(Restrictions.Where(DateTimeValidityExtensions.NotDeletedExpression));
        if (typeof(IDateTimeInterval).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T)))
            queryOver.Where(Restrictions.Where(DateTimeValidityExtensions.DateTimeValidityExpression(now)));

        return queryOver;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Called when [date time valid].
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="validFromExpression">The valid from expression.</param>
    /// <param name="validToExpression">The valid to expression.</param>
    /// <param name="targetDateTime">The target date time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IQueryOver<T, T> OnlyDateTimeValid<T>(this IQueryOver<T, T> queryOver,
        Expression<Func<T, object>> validFromExpression, Expression<Func<T, object>> validToExpression, DateTime? targetDateTime = null)
    {
        if (typeof(ILogicalDeleteEntity).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T)))
            queryOver.Where(Restrictions.Where(DateTimeValidityExtensions.NotDeletedExpression));

        queryOver.And(OnlyDateTimeValidCriterion(validFromExpression, validToExpression, targetDateTime));

        return queryOver;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Called when [date time valid criterion].
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="validFromExpression">The valid from expression.</param>
    /// <param name="validToExpression">The valid to expression.</param>
    /// <param name="targetDateTime">The target date time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static ICriterion OnlyDateTimeValidCriterion<T>(Expression<Func<T, object>> validFromExpression,
        Expression<Func<T, object>> validToExpression, DateTime? targetDateTime = null)
    {
        targetDateTime ??= DateTimeContext.Now;
        var or = Restrictions.Disjunction();
        or.Add(Restrictions.And(Restrictions.Le(Projections.Property(validFromExpression), targetDateTime), Restrictions.Gt(Projections.Property(validToExpression), targetDateTime)));
        or.Add(Restrictions.And(Restrictions.Le(Projections.Property(validFromExpression), targetDateTime), Restrictions.IsNull(Projections.Property(validToExpression))));
        or.Add(Restrictions.And(Restrictions.IsNull(Projections.Property(validFromExpression)), Restrictions.Gt(Projections.Property(validToExpression), targetDateTime)));
        or.Add(Restrictions.And(Restrictions.IsNull(Projections.Property(validFromExpression)), Restrictions.IsNull(Projections.Property(validToExpression))));
        return or;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Called when [from].
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="from">From.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IQueryOver<T, T> OnlyFrom<T>(this IQueryOver<T, T> queryOver, DateTime? from = null)
    where T: ITrackedEntity
    {
        if (from.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Created > from || (t.Created != null && t.Modified != null && t.Modified > from));
        if (typeof(ILogicalDeleteEntity).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T)))
            queryOver.Where(Restrictions.Where(DateTimeValidityExtensions.NotDeletedExpression));

        return queryOver;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\Helpers\OrgUnitHelpers.cs

using Common.Shared.Enums;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Helpers;

public static class OrgUnitHelpers
{
    public const string ValidityPostfix = "Validity";

    public static class OrgUnitTypeNames
    {
        public const string Partner = "Partner";
        public const string Institution = "Institution";
        public const string Site = "Site";
        public const string Building = "Building";
        public const string BuildingPart = "BuildingPart";
        public const string Floor = "Floor";
        public const string Room = "Room";
    }

    public static string[] AllOrgUnitTypeNames => [
        OrgUnitTypeNames.Partner,
        OrgUnitTypeNames.Institution,
        OrgUnitTypeNames.Site,
        OrgUnitTypeNames.Building,
        OrgUnitTypeNames.BuildingPart,
        OrgUnitTypeNames.Floor,
        OrgUnitTypeNames.Room
        ];

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás típusa alapján visszaadja az entitás szülőjének típusát. Csak OrgunitDtoBase-ből származó típusokra értelmezhető ebben a kontextusban. (+Partner, ami speciális egy kissé)
    /// </summary>
    public static string? GetOrgUnitParentType(string entityTypeName)
    {
        return entityTypeName switch
        {
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Partner => null, //spec eset: partner műveletek esetén nincs értelme a szülőnek, ezért null
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Institution => OrgUnitTypeNames.Partner,
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Site => OrgUnitTypeNames.Institution,
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Building => OrgUnitTypeNames.Site,
            //bár épülettől lefelé egyelőre nincs relevancia, mert a jogosultság ellenőrzés csak épület mélységig lesz megadható,
            //annál lejjebb nem, de azért beteszem ide a többi szintet is
            OrgUnitTypeNames.BuildingPart => OrgUnitTypeNames.Building,
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Floor => OrgUnitTypeNames.BuildingPart,
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Room => OrgUnitTypeNames.Floor,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"'{entityTypeName}' is not supported."),
        };
    }

    public static OrgunitType? GetOrgunitType(string entityTypeName)
    {
        entityTypeName = TransformValidityEntityTypeName(entityTypeName);

        return entityTypeName switch
        {
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Partner => null, //Ha Partner-re vonatkozik a művelet, akkor null érték jelenti azt, hogy bármely típusú, Partner alatti szervezeti egysége érvényes
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Institution => OrgunitType.Institution,
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Site => OrgunitType.Site,
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Building => OrgunitType.Building,
            //bár épülettől lefelé egyelőre nincs relevancia, mert a jogosultság ellenőrzés csak épület mélységig lesz megadható,
            //annál lejjebb nem, de azért beteszem ide a többi szintet is
            OrgUnitTypeNames.BuildingPart => OrgunitType.BuildingPart,
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Floor => OrgunitType.Floor,
            OrgUnitTypeNames.Room => OrgunitType.Room,
            _ => throw new ArgumentException($"'{entityTypeName}' is not a valid OrgunitType")
        };
    }

    private static string TransformValidityEntityTypeName(string entityTypeName)
    {
        if (AllOrgUnitTypeNames.Any(x => entityTypeName == $"{x}{ValidityPostfix}"))
        {
            return entityTypeName.Substring(0, entityTypeName.Length - ValidityPostfix.Length); //remove only from the end
        }

        return entityTypeName;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd\Helpers\SyncHelper.cs

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.DataReceiver;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.Monitoring;
using DRSyncRequest = EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.DataReceiver.SyncRequest;
using MSyncRequest = EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.Monitoring.SyncRequest;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Helpers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// SyncHelper
    /// </summary>
    public static class SyncHelper
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The data receiver base URL
        /// </summary>
        private static readonly string DataReceiverBaseUrl = Config.GetStringValue("DataReceiverApiHost");
        /// <summary>
        /// The monitoring base URL
        /// </summary>
        private static readonly string MonitoringBaseUrl = Config.GetStringValue("MonitoringApiHost");

        /// <summary>
        /// Sends the synchronize message.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="entityName">Name of the entity.</param>
        /// <param name="dateOfModification">The date of modification.</param>
        /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
        public static void SendSyncMessage(string entityName, DateTime dateOfModification, string? tenantCode = null)
        {
            var client = HttpClientExtensions.CreateClient();

            var dataReceiverApi = client.GetApiClient<DataReceiverApi>(x => { x.BaseUrl = DataReceiverBaseUrl; });
            client.Authenticate(dataReceiverApi).RunSync();
            dataReceiverApi.Sync_PostAsync(new DRSyncRequest
            {
                EntityName = entityName,
                LastModifiedDate = dateOfModification,
                TenantCode = tenantCode,
            }).RunSync();

            var monitoringApi = client.GetApiClient<MonitoringApi>(x => { x.BaseUrl = MonitoringBaseUrl; });
            client.Authenticate(monitoringApi).RunSync();
            monitoringApi.Sync_PostAsync(new MSyncRequest
            {
                EntityName = entityName,
                LastModifiedDate = dateOfModification,
                TenantCode = tenantCode,
            }).RunSync();

            Log.LogInfo($"[{nameof(SyncHelper)}] - {nameof(SendSyncMessage)} called! Tenant:{tenantCode}, Entiy:{entityName}, modDate:{dateOfModification}");
        }
    }
}

﻿namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Messaging;

/// <summary>
/// Üzenetkezelő interface
/// </summary>
public interface IMessagingContext : IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Üzenet érkezett (esemény kezelése).
    /// </summary>
    public event EventHandler<MessageEventArgs> Received;

    public string ConfigName { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// A messaging be van-e kapcsolva
    /// </summary>
    public bool Enabled { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Feliratkozás indítása üzenet fogadására.
    /// Előfeltétel, hogy a received EventHandler-en keresztül iratkozzunk fel az üzenetek kezelésére.
    /// </summary>
    public void BasicConsume(string queueName);

    /// <summary>
    /// A soron várakozó hibás üzenetet adja vissza (pl. Újraküldési céllal)
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>üzenet</returns>
    public bool RetryFailedMessage(string queueName);

    /// <summary>
    /// 
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queueName">Queue neve</param>
    /// <param name="body">Üzenet</param>
    /// <param name="type">Üzenet típusa</param>
    public string SendMessage(string queueName, byte[] body, string type);

    /// <summary>
    /// Üzenet küldése
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">Tipizált üzenet</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queueName"></param>
    /// <param name="message">üzenet</param>
    /// <returns>messageId</returns>
    public string SendMessage<T>(string queueName, T message);

    /// <summary>
    /// Üzenet olvasása
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T">Üzenet típusa</typeparam>
    /// <param name="args">üzenet</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public T ReadMessage<T>(byte[] message);

    /// <summary>
    /// Üzenet kiolvasásas a sorból
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queueName"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public object GetMessage(string queueName);

    /// <summary>
    /// Queue megnyitása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queueName">queue neve</param>
    public void CreateQueue(string queueName);

    public bool IsInTransaction { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Üzenet tranzakció indítása
    /// </summary>
    public void CreateTransaction();

    /// <summary>
    /// Üzenet tranzakció visszavonása
    /// </summary>
    public void Rollback();

    /// <summary>
    /// Üzenet tranzakció véglegesítése
    /// </summary>
    public void Commit();

}
