using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Emissions;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Services.Co2eCalculation;

public class Co2eCalculatorService : ICo2eCalculatorService
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    private readonly ILogger<Co2eCalculatorService> _logger;

    public Co2eCalculatorService(IQueryService queryService, IMapper mapper, ILogger<Co2eCalculatorService> logger)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public decimal? CalculateCo2e(decimal? measurementValue, decimal? co2eFactor, bool isConsumption = true)
    {
        // Production: Co2e * (-1)
        int factor = isConsumption ? 1 : -1;

        // US: #212
        if (measurementValue.HasValue && co2eFactor.HasValue)
        {
            return Math.Round(measurementValue.Value * co2eFactor.Value / 1000, 9) * factor;
        }
        else
        {
            return default;
        }
    }

    public decimal? CalculateCo2e(decimal? measurementValue, DateTime measurementDate, Co2eFactorCategory category, IReadOnlyList<Co2eFactorEntityDto> co2FactorSeries)
    {
        var co2eFactor = GetCo2eFactorForMeasurementDate(co2FactorSeries, measurementDate, category);
        return CalculateCo2e(measurementValue, co2eFactor, isConsumption: category == Co2eFactorCategory.Consumption);
    }


    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Co2eFactorEntityDto>> GetCo2eConsumptionFactorSeries()
    {
        var query = new Co2eFactorEntityQuery { IsDeleted = false, };

        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(query);

        return result.Items;
    }


    public async Task<decimal?> GetCo2eFactorForMeasurementDate(DateTime measurementDate, Co2eFactorCategory category)
    {
        var factorSeries = await GetCo2eConsumptionFactorSeries();
        return factorSeries.FindByDate(DateOnly.FromDateTime(measurementDate), category)?.Factor;
    }

    public decimal? GetCo2eFactorForMeasurementDate(IReadOnlyList<Co2eFactorEntityDto> co2FactorSeries, DateTime measurementDate, Co2eFactorCategory category)
    {
        return co2FactorSeries.FindByDate(DateOnly.FromDateTime(measurementDate), category)?.Factor;
    }

}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Resolutions;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Services.Normalization;
public abstract class DataNormalizationService<TModel, TResult, TGroupKey> : INormalizationService<TModel, TResult> where TModel : IAggregationValue
{
    protected Dictionary<AggregationMethod, Func<IGrouping<TGroupKey, TModel>, double?>> _aggregationDictionary
        = new Dictionary<AggregationMethod, Func<IGrouping<TGroupKey, TModel>, double?>>
        {
            [AggregationMethod.Sum] = g => g.Sum(e => e.Value),
            [AggregationMethod.Average] = g => g.Where(m => m.Value.HasValue).Select(m => m.Value.Value).DefaultIfEmpty().Average(),
            [AggregationMethod.TakeFirst] = g => g.First().Value,
            [AggregationMethod.TakeLast] = g => g.Last().Value,
        };

    protected Dictionary<AggregationMethod, Func<IEnumerable<TModel>, double?>> _aggregateEnumerableDictionary
       = new Dictionary<AggregationMethod, Func<IEnumerable<TModel>, double?>>
       {
           [AggregationMethod.Sum] = g => g.Sum(e => e.Value),
           [AggregationMethod.Average] = g => g.Where(m => m.Value.HasValue).Select(m => m.Value.Value).DefaultIfEmpty().Average(),
           [AggregationMethod.TakeFirst] = g => g.First().Value,
           [AggregationMethod.TakeLast] = g => g.Last().Value,
       };


    public abstract IEnumerable<TResult> Normalize(IEnumerable<TModel> data, IResolutionHandler resolution, AggregationMethod method);
    public virtual TResult NormalizeSingle(IEnumerable<TModel> data, DateTime timestamp, AggregationMethod method)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Autofac.Features.AttributeFilters;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Wireup;

/// <summary>
/// AutofacBackEndModule
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Autofac.Module" />
public class AutofacBackEndModule : Module
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Override to add registrations to the container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder through which components can be
    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        //Handlers
        builder.RegisterType<SecAuthQueryHandler>()
            .Named<IQueryHandler>("SecAuth")
            .WithAttributeFiltering()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        // Security
        builder.RegisterType<SecRoleQueryHandler>().Named<IQueryHandler>("Security").InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        // SecRole
        builder.RegisterType<SecRoleQueryHandler>().Named<IQueryHandler>("SecRole").InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<BaseDtoValidator<SecRoleEntityDto>>().As<IValidator<SecRoleEntityDto>>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        // SecOperation
        builder.RegisterType<SecOperationQueryHandler>().Named<IQueryHandler>("SecOperation").InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        // SecUser
        builder.RegisterType<BaseDtoValidator<SecUserEntityDto>>().As<IValidator<SecUserEntityDto>>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        builder.RegisterType<TenantConfig>().AsSelf().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

    }
}

using Common.EDM_Models.MasterData;
using Energiamenedzsment.Common.EdmInterface.LocalMock.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

namespace Energiamenedzsment.Common.EdmInterface.LocalMock.Services;


public class MasterdataMockService
{
    private readonly MockConfig _mockConfig;

    public MasterdataMockService(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _mockConfig = configuration.GetValue<MockConfig>("MockConfig") ?? new MockConfig();
    }

    public async Task<MasterDataResponse> GetMockData(IEnumerable<string> podNos)
    {
        var resultCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxResultCount);
        var channelCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxChannelCount);
        var result = new MasterDataResponse
        {
            UnknownPods = podNos.Where(x => x.Contains("unk", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)).ToList()
        };

        var knownPodNames = podNos.Except(result.UnknownPods).ToList();
        foreach (var podName in knownPodNames)
        {
            var pod = new EdmDeviceModel(podName);

            for (int i = 0; i < resultCount; i++)
            {
                var device = new EdmDeviceDetails
                {
                    DeviceType = GetRandomDeviceType(),
                    SerialNumber = GetRandomSN(),
                    InstallationDate = GetRandomDateOnly()!.Value,
                    RemovalDate = GetRandomDateOnly(_mockConfig.DeviceRemovalDateNullable), //if true, then about 50% of the dates will be null                    
                    DataChannels = []
                };
                for (int j = 0; j < channelCount; j++)
                {
                    //randomizing channel data:
                    int channelId = Random.Shared.Next(1, 99);
                    var obiscode = Random.Shared.GetItems(OBISCodeDict.Keys.ToArray(), 1).First(); //get a random item from dict
                    var obisCodeValue = OBISCodeDict[obiscode];
                    device.DataChannels.Add(new EdmDataChannel
                    {
                        ObisCode = $"mock_{obiscode}",
                        DataChannelId = channelId,
                        DataChannel = $"mock_{obisCodeValue}",
                        IntegrationPeriod = "10",
                        Unit = GetRandomUnit()
                    });
                }
                pod.Devices.Add(device);
            }

            result.KnownPods.Add(pod);
        }

        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return result;
    }

    private string GetRandomDeviceType()
    {
        return Random.Shared.GetItems(_mockConfig.PossibleDeviceTypes, 1).FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private string GetRandomUnit()
    {
        return Random.Shared.GetItems(_mockConfig.PossibleUnits, 1).FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
    }


    private string GetRandomSN()
    {
        return Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
    }

    private static DateOnly? GetRandomDateOnly(bool nullable = false)
    {
        if (nullable)
        {
            if (Random.Shared.Next(0, 100) > 50)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        var rndDate = DateTime.Today.AddDays(Random.Shared.Next(-365, 365));
        return new DateOnly(rndDate.Year, rndDate.Month, rndDate.Day);
    }

    // found a possible specification of OBIS codes: https://onemeter.com/docs/device/obis/#summary-codes
    //we can use a nice 
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> OBISCodeDict = new()
    {
    { "1.8.0", "A+" },
    { "1.8.1", "A+ (T1)" },
    { "1.8.2", "A+ (T2)" },
    { "1.8.3", "A+ (T3)" },
    { "1.8.4", "A+ (T4)" },
    { "2.8.0", "A-" },
    { "2.8.1", "A- (T1)" },
    { "2.8.2", "A- (T2)" },
    { "2.8.3", "A- (T3)" },
    { "2.8.4", "A- (T4)" },
    { "15.8.0/F.8.0", "|A|" },
    { "15.8.1/F.8.1", "|A| (T1)" },
    { "15.8.2/F.8.2", "|A| (T2)" },
    { "15.8.3/F.8.3", "|A| (T3)" },
    { "15.8.4/F.8.4", "|A| (T4)" },
    { "21.8.0", "A+ (L1)" },
    { "41.8.0", "A+ (L2)" },
    { "61.8.0", "A+ (L3)" },
    { "22.8.0", "A- (L1)" },
    { "42.8.0", "A- (L2)" },
    { "62.8.0", "A- (L3)" },
    { "35.8.0", "|A| (L1)" },
    { "55.8.0", "|A| (L2)" },
    { "75.8.0", "|A| (L3)" }
    };

}

using Energiamenedzsment.Common.EdmInterface.LocalMock.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Common.EDM_Models.Measurement;
using Common.EDM_Models.MeteorologyData;

namespace Energiamenedzsment.Common.EdmInterface.LocalMock.Services;


public class MeasurementsMockService
{

    private readonly MockConfig _mockConfig;

    private readonly Dictionary<Guid, (DateTime Start, DateTime End)> _guidDatePairs = [];

    private readonly Dictionary<Guid, (int DataChannelId, DateTime Start, DateTime End)> _guidChannelDatePairs = [];

    public MeasurementsMockService(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _mockConfig = configuration.GetValue<MockConfig>("MockConfig") ?? new MockConfig();
    }

    public async Task<Guid> GetMockDataRequestId(int dataChannelId, DateTime from, DateTime to)
    {
        to = to.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);
        var generatedGuid = Guid.NewGuid();
        _guidChannelDatePairs.Add(generatedGuid, (dataChannelId, from, to));
        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return generatedGuid;
    }

    //OLD: public async Task<List<MeasurementResponseModel>> GetMockDataById(Guid guid)
    public async Task<List<MeasurementResponseModel>> GetMockData(Guid guid)
    {
        if (!_guidChannelDatePairs.TryGetValue(guid, out (int DataChannelId, DateTime Start, DateTime End) data))
        {
            return null!;
        }

        List<MeasurementResponseModel> result = [];
        if (data.DataChannelId == 0)
            return result;

        var resultCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxResultCount);
        for (int i = 0; i < resultCount; i++)
        {
            var item = new MeasurementResponseModel
            {
                DataChannelId = data.DataChannelId, //fixed
                Measurements = [],
            };

            var measurementCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxMeasurementCount);
            for (int j = 0; j < measurementCount; j++)
            {
                item.Measurements.Add(
                    new MeasurementDataModel
                    {
                        MeasurementDate = GetRandomDateTime(data.Start, data.End),
                        State = GetRandomState(),
                        Value = Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 99.9d //TODO: range of randomized value
                    });
            }
            item.Measurements = item.Measurements.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToList(); //nicer, than random order
            result.Add(item);
        }

        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return result;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> GetMeteorologyDataRequestId(DateTime from, DateTime to)
    {
        to = to.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);
        var generatedGuid = Guid.NewGuid();
        _guidDatePairs.Add(generatedGuid, (from, to));
        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return generatedGuid;
    }

    public async Task<MeteoResponseModel> GetMeteorologyDataById(Guid guid)
    {
        if (!_guidDatePairs.TryGetValue(guid, out (DateTime Start, DateTime End) interval))
        {
            return null!;
        }

        var result = new MeteoResponseModel
        {
            Data = [],
        };

        var resultCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxResultCount);
        for (int i = 0; i < resultCount; i++)
        {
            var meteoReading = new MeteoReading
            {
                Timestamp = GetRandomDateTime(interval.Start, interval.End),
                MeteoParams = []
            };

            var measurementCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxMeasurementCount);
            for (int j = 0; j < measurementCount; j++)
            {
                meteoReading.MeteoParams.Add(
                    new MeteorologyDataModel
                    {
                        Temperature = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 80d - 20, 1), // Range: -20 to 60°C
                        Humidity = Random.Shared.Next(0, 101), // Range: 0% to 100%
                        AmountOfPrecipitation = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 50, 1), // Range: 0 to 50 mm
                        SolarRadiation = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 1200, 1), // Range: 0 to 1200 W/m²
                        AtmosphericPressure = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 50 + 950, 1), // Range: 950 to 1000 hPa
                        WindSpeed = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 40, 1), // Range: 0 to 40 m/s
                        WindDirection = Random.Shared.Next(0, 360), // Range: 0 to 359 degrees
                        EarthTemperature = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 50d - 10, 1) // Range: -10 to 40°C
                    });
            }
            result.Data.Add(meteoReading);
        }

        result.Data = result.Data.OrderBy(x => x.Timestamp).ToList(); //nicer, than random order

        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return result;
    }

    private string GetRandomState()
    {
        return Random.Shared.GetItems(_mockConfig.PossibleStates, 1).FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private static DateTime GetRandomDateTime(DateTime start, DateTime end)
    {
        long range = (end - start).Ticks;
        return new DateTime(start.Ticks + (long)(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * range));
    }
}

using Common.EDM_Models.MasterData;
using Common.EDM_Models.Measurement;
using Common.EDM_Models.MeteorologyData;
using Common.Extensions.HttpClientExtensions;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Energiamenedzsment.Common.EdmInterface.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Polly;

namespace Energiamenedzsment.Common.EdmInterface.Services;


public class EdmInterfaceService : IEdmInterfaceService
{
    private record UuidResponse(Guid Uuid);
    private record MeasurementRequest(int dataChannelId, DateOnly? start, DateOnly? end, bool forceRefresh = false);
    private record MeteoRequest(Guid institutionId, string lat, string lng, DateOnly start, DateOnly end, bool forceRefresh = false);


    private readonly HttpClient _EdmClient;
    private readonly ILogger<EdmInterfaceService> _logger;

    public EdmInterfaceService(IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory, ILogger<EdmInterfaceService> logger)
    {
        _EdmClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("EDM-API");
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<List<EDMMasterDataFlatModel>> GetMasterData(string[] podIdentifiers, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (podIdentifiers.Any(x => x.Contains(',')))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Vessző ',' karakter a POD azonosítóban nem megengedett!");
        }

        var masterdataQry = new
        {
            podNos = string.Join(',', podIdentifiers)
        };
        try
        {
            List<EDMMasterDataFlatModel> result = [];

            var response = await _EdmClient.GetAsync<MasterDataResponse>("master-data", masterdataQry, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            if (response is null)
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Empty response");
            }

            //TODO: a speciben nem volt teljesen egyértelmű, hogy csak 1 device lehet-e, vagy több is, ezért többre csináltam, mivel a json szerint egy tömbről van szó, de minden példában csak 1 eleme volt.
            //viszont a visszaadandó listát úgy tűnik, hogy flattenelni kell. ezt majd lehet, hogy tisztázni kell.
            foreach (var pod in response.KnownPods)
            {
                result.AddRange(pod.Devices.Select(dev => new EDMMasterDataFlatModel
                {
                    PodID = pod.Pod,
                    DeviceType = dev.DeviceType,
                    SerialNumber = dev.SerialNumber,
                    InstallationDate = dev.InstallationDate.ToDateTime(default), //time empty
                    RemovalDate = dev.RemovalDate?.ToDateTime(default), //TODO: to decide if we're sure that it can't be null
                }));
            }
            if (response.UnknownPods.Any())
            {
                //TODO:... 
            }

            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!");
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!", ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the device details for a specific POD identifier from EDM.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="podIdentifier"></param>
    /// <returns><see cref="EdmDeviceModel"/></returns>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException"></exception>
    public async Task<EdmDeviceModel> GetEDMDevices(string podIdentifier, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (podIdentifier.Contains(','))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Vessző ',' karakter a POD azonosítóban nem megengedett!");
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(podIdentifier))
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(podIdentifier));
        }

        var masterdataQry = new
        {
            podNos = podIdentifier
        };
        try
        {
            var response = await _EdmClient.GetAsync<MasterDataResponse>("master-data", masterdataQry, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            if (response is null)
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Empty response");
            }
            if (response.UnknownPods.Contains(podIdentifier))
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Unknown POD");
            }
            var result = response.KnownPods?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Pod.Equals(podIdentifier, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase));
            return result is null ? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Unknown POD") : result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!");
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!", ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the device details for a specific POD identifier from EDM.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="podIdentifier"></param>
    /// <returns><see cref="EdmDeviceModel"/></returns>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException"></exception>
    public async Task<IList<EdmDeviceModel>> GetEDMDevices(string[] podIdentifiers, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (podIdentifiers.Any(x => x.Contains(',')))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Vessző ',' karakter a POD azonosítóban nem megengedett!");
        }

        var masterdataQry = new
        {
            podNos = string.Join(',', podIdentifiers)
        };
        try
        {
            List<EDMMasterDataFlatModel> result = [];

            var response = await _EdmClient.GetAsync<MasterDataResponse>("master-data", masterdataQry, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            if (response is null)
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Empty response");
            }

            //TODO: a speciben nem volt teljesen egyértelmű, hogy csak 1 device lehet-e, vagy több is, ezért többre csináltam, mivel a json szerint egy tömbről van szó, de minden példában csak 1 eleme volt.
            //viszont a visszaadandó listát úgy tűnik, hogy flattenelni kell. ezt majd lehet, hogy tisztázni kell.
            return response.KnownPods;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!");
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!", ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the device details for a specific POD identifier from EDM.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="podIdentifier"></param>
    /// <returns><see cref="EdmDeviceModel"/></returns>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException"></exception>
    public async Task<List<int>> GetEDMDevicesChannelIds(string podIdentifier, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (podIdentifier.Contains(','))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Vessző ',' karakter a POD azonosítóban nem megengedett!");
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(podIdentifier))
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(podIdentifier));
        }

        var masterdataQry = new
        {
            podNos = podIdentifier
        };
        try
        {
            var response = await _EdmClient.GetAsync<MasterDataResponse>("master-data", masterdataQry, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            if (response is null)
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Empty response");
            }
            if (response.UnknownPods.Contains(podIdentifier))
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Unknown POD");
            }
            var edmDeviceModel = response.KnownPods?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Pod.Equals(podIdentifier, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
                    ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Unknown POD");

            var result = edmDeviceModel.Devices.SelectMany(x => x.DataChannels.Select(x => x.DataChannelId)).ToList();

            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!");
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!", ex);
        }
    }

    public async Task<Guid> RequestMeasurements(int dataChannelId, DateOnly? from, DateOnly? to, bool forceRefresh = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var measurementsRequest = new MeasurementRequest(dataChannelId, from, to, forceRefresh);

        try
        {
            // POST {{HOST}}/measurements?dataChannelId={{dataChannelId}}&from={{from}}&to={{to}}&forceRefresh={{forceRefresh}}
            // FYI! mivel már POST, ezért azt is meg keleltt oldani, hogy a paramétereket ne body-ban küldje, hanem URL-ben
            //UuidResponse? resp = await _EdmClient.PostAsQueryAsync<MeasurementRequest, UuidResponse>("measurements", measurementsRequest);

            UuidResponse? resp = await _EdmClient.PostWithQueryStringAsync<UuidResponse>(requestUri: "measurements", queryObj: measurementsRequest, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            return resp?.Uuid ?? Guid.Empty; //TODO: null válasz kezelése?
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!");
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!", ex);
        }
    }

    public async Task<List<MeasurementResponseModel>> GetMeasurementResults(Guid requestId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var query = new
            {
                guid = requestId
            };

            // Polly retry policy: retry if result is null, up to 10 min total, 1 sec delay, single try max 90 sec
            var timeoutPerTry = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(90);
            var totalTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10);  // don't retry infinitely, because the UI will never get a response from the server. the UI or user should decide to retry if totalTimout is reached
            var delay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);

            var policy = Policy<List<MeasurementResponseModel>>
                .HandleResult(result => result == null)
                .WaitAndRetryAsync(
                    retryCount: int.MaxValue, // will be limited by totalTimeout
                    sleepDurationProvider: _ => delay,
                    onRetry: (result, timespan, retryCount, context) =>
                    {
                        _logger.LogWarning(new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Measurement data not available yet"), $"Retry {retryCount}: EDM measurement data not available, waiting {timespan.TotalSeconds} sec before next try.");
                    }
                );

            // use the token from the caller, but combine with a total timeout
            // if the caller cancels, we should cancel the whole operation
            // if the total timeout is reached, we should throw an exception
            // if the per try timeout is reached, we should retry

            // Create a linked cancellation token source to combine the total timeout with the caller's cancellation token
            using var cts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken, new CancellationTokenSource(totalTimeout).Token);
            var start = DateTime.UtcNow;
            List<MeasurementResponseModel>? result = null;

            await policy.ExecuteAsync(async ct =>
            {
                using var perTryCts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
                perTryCts.CancelAfter(timeoutPerTry);
                // GET {{HOST}}/measurements?guid={{guid}}
                result = await _EdmClient.GetAsync<List<MeasurementResponseModel>>("/measurements", query, cancellationToken: perTryCts.Token);
                return result;
            }, cts.Token);

            if (result == null)
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("A mérési adatok még nem állnak rendelkezésre");
            }
            return result;
        }
        catch (TaskCanceledException tcex) when (tcex.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("A mérési adatok még nem állnak rendelkezésre", tcex);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!");
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!", ex);
        }
    }

    public async Task<Guid> RequestMeasurementsTable(int dataChannelId, DateOnly? from, DateOnly? to, bool forceRefresh = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await RequestMeasurements(dataChannelId, from, to, forceRefresh, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<List<MeasurementResponseModel>> GetMeasurementTableResults(Guid requestId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await GetMeasurementResults(requestId, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<Guid> RequestMeteorologyData(Guid institutionId, string lat, string lng, DateOnly start, DateOnly end, bool forceRefresh = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var meteoRequest = new MeteoRequest(institutionId, lat, lng, start, end, forceRefresh);
        try
        {
            // POST {{HOST}}/meteo-data?from={{from}}&to={{to}}&forceRefresh={{forceRefresh}}
            // FYI! mivel már POST, ezért azt is meg keleltt oldani, hogy a paramétereket ne body-ban küldje, hanem URL-ben
            //UuidResponse? resp = await _EdmClient.PostAsQueryAsync<MeteoRequest, UuidResponse>("/meteo-data", meteoRequest);
            UuidResponse? resp = await _EdmClient.PostWithQueryStringAsync<UuidResponse>(requestUri: "meteo-data", queryObj: meteoRequest, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            return resp?.Uuid ?? Guid.Empty; //TODO: null választ hogyan kezeljük?
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!");
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!", ex);
        }
    }

    public async Task<EdmDeviceModel> GetEDMDevices(string podIdentifier, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (podIdentifier.Contains(','))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Vessző ',' karakter a POD azonosítóban nem megengedett!");
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(podIdentifier))
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(podIdentifier));

        try
        {
            var response = await masterdataMockService.GetMockData([podIdentifier]);
            if (response is null)

                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Unknown POD");
            }
            var result = response.KnownPods?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Pod.Equals(podIdentifier, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase));
            return result is null ? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Unknown POD") : result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)

            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!", ex);

    {
        if (podIdentifier.Contains(','))

            }
            var edmDeviceModel = response.KnownPods?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Pod.Equals(podIdentifier, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))

            return result;

            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EDM interfész kommunikáció sikertelen!", ex);

        if (to.DayNumber - from.DayNumber > 365)
        {
            throw new Exception("A kezdő dátum és a záró dátum közti különbség nem lehet több mint egy év!");
        }

        try
        {
            // GET {{HOST}}/meteo-data?from={{from}}&to={{to}}&forceRefresh={{forceRefresh}}
            return await measurementsMockService.GetMeteorologyDataRequestId(from.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue), to.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue));

using Common.Shared.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Chart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Chart.StringChartTable;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Export;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel;

public static class ExcelExporthelpers
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Converts a collection of chart table items into a sequence of measurement export rows.  
    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>Each <see cref="MeasurementExportRow"/> contains a timestamp from the source item's <see
    /// cref="IChartTableItem{TValueItem}.DateTime"/> property and an array of dynamic values extracted from the source
    /// item's <see cref="IChartTableItem{TValueItem}.Values"/> collection.</remarks>
    /// <typeparam name="TSource">The type of the source items, which must implement <see cref="IChartTableItem{TValueItem}"/>.</typeparam>
    /// <typeparam name="TValueItem">The type of the value items, which must implement <see cref="IDecimalValueItem"/>.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="items">The collection of source items to convert. If <paramref name="items"/> is <see langword="null"/>, the method
    /// returns an empty sequence.</param>
    /// <returns>An <see cref="IEnumerable{T}"/> of <see cref="MeasurementExportRow"/> objects, each representing a row of
    /// measurement data derived from the source items.</returns>
    public static IEnumerable<MeasurementExportRow> ConvertToMeasurementTableRowsWithDynamicGeneric<TSource, TValueItem>(IEnumerable<TSource> items)
        where TSource : IChartTableItem<TValueItem>
        where TValueItem : IDecimalValueItem
    {
        if (items == null)
            yield break;

        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            yield return new MeasurementExportRow
            {
                Timestamp = item.DateTime,
                ColumnData = item.Values?.Select(v => (dynamic)v.Value).ToArray() ?? [],
            };
        }
    }

    public static IEnumerable<MeasurementExportTimeOnlyRow> ConvertStringChartTableToMeasurementTableRowsWithDynamic(IEnumerable<StringChartTableItemModel> items)
    {
        if (items == null)
            yield break;

        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            yield return new MeasurementExportTimeOnlyRow
            {
                Time = TimeOnly.FromDateTime(item.DateTime),
                ColumnData = item.Values?.Select(v => (dynamic)v.Value).ToArray() ?? [],
            };
        }
    }



    public static async Task<byte[]> CreateExcelExportFileAsync(IEnumerable<ChartTableItemModel> items, IExportDataModel header)
    {
        var names = items
            .SelectMany(item => item.Values)
            .Select(value => value.MeasurementPointName)
            .Distinct()
            .ToArray();

        MeasurementExportRow[] excelData = ExcelExporthelpers.ConvertToMeasurementTableRowsWithDynamicGeneric<ChartTableItemModel, ChartTableItemValueModel>(items).ToArray();
        var excelBytes = await ExcelManager.Export(excelData, names, exportDataModel: header);

        return excelBytes;
    }

    public static async Task<byte[]> CreateExcelExportFileFromStringChartTableAsync(IEnumerable<StringChartTableItemModel> items, IExportDataModel header)
    {
        var names = items
            .SelectMany(item => item.Values)
            .Select(value => value.ColumnName)
            .Distinct()
            .ToArray();

        MeasurementExportTimeOnlyRow[] excelData = ExcelExporthelpers.ConvertStringChartTableToMeasurementTableRowsWithDynamic(items).ToArray();
        var excelBytes = await ExcelManager.Export(excelData, names, exportDataModel: header);

        return excelBytes;
    }

}

/// <summary>
/// ExcelManager
/// </summary>
public static class ExcelManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Exports the specified source.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonbColumnNames">The jsonb column names.</param>
    /// <param name="exportDataModel">The export data model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task<byte[]> Export(IDto[]? source, string[]? jsonbColumnNames = null, IExportDataModel? exportDataModel = null)
    {
        if (source == null) return Array.Empty<byte>();

        var workbook = await GetWorkBook(source, jsonbColumnNames, exportDataModel);

        await using var ms = new MemoryStream();
        workbook.SaveAs(ms);
        return ms.ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Exports the multi sheet.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonbColumnNames">The jsonb column names.</param>
    /// <param name="exportDataModel">The export data model.</param>
    /// <param name="staticSource">The static source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task<byte[]> ExportMultiSheet(Dictionary<string, IDto[]> source, string[]? jsonbColumnNames = null, IExportDataModel? exportDataModel = null, Dictionary<string, ExportReportingStaticModel[]>? staticSource = null)
    {
        var workbook = await GetMultiSheetWorkBook(source, jsonbColumnNames, exportDataModel, staticSource);

        await using var ms = new MemoryStream();
        workbook.SaveAs(ms);
        return ms.ToArray();
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Exports as stream.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="columns">The columns.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task<MemoryStream> ExportAsStream(IDto[] source, ICollection<string> columns = null)
    {
        var itemType = source.GetType().GetElementType();

        var col = 0;
        var workbook = new XLWorkbook();
        if (itemType != null)
        {
            var worksheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(itemType.Name);

            var properties = itemType.GetProperties().Where(p =>
        (p.IsDefined(typeof(DisplayNameAttribute), false) ||
         p.IsDefined(typeof(DisplayAttribute), false)) &&
        !p.IsDefined(typeof(IgnoreExportAttribute), false))
    .Select(p => new
    {
        PropertyName = p.Name,
        DisplayName = p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayNameAttribute>()?.DisplayName ??
                      p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? p.Name
    }).ToList();

            var propertiesToExport = properties.ToList();

            if (columns != null)
            {
                propertiesToExport.Clear();
                foreach (var column in columns)
                {
                    propertiesToExport.Add(properties.First(i => i.PropertyName == column));
                }
            }

            col++;
            worksheet.Cell(1, col).Value = "Sorszám";

            foreach (var prop in propertiesToExport)
            {
                col++;
                worksheet.Cell(1, col).Value = prop.DisplayName;
            }

            for (int i = 1; i <= source.Length; i++)
            {
                col = 0;
                var item = source[i - 1];

                col++;
                worksheet.Cell(i + 1, col).Value = i;

                foreach (var column in propertiesToExport)
                {
                    var prop = itemType.GetProperties().First(i => i.Name == column.PropertyName);

                    col++;

                    var value = prop.GetValue(item);

                    if (prop.PropertyType.IsEnum)
                    {
                        worksheet.Cell(i + 1, col).Value = prop.PropertyType
                            .GetField(value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty)?.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()
                            ?.Name ?? value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        worksheet.Cell(i + 1, col).Value = value is DateTime date ? (XLCellValue)date.ToShortDateString() : (XLCellValue)(value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        var ms = new MemoryStream();
        workbook.SaveAs(ms);
        ms.Position = 0;
        return ms;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the CSV data.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonbColumnNames">The jsonb column names.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task<StringBuilder> GetCsvData(IDto[] source, string[]? jsonbColumnNames = null)

        return await GetCSVProps(source, jsonbColumnNames);

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task<StringBuilder> GetCsvData(ExportReportingStaticModel[] staticSource)
    {
        return await GetCsvList(staticSource);
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the PDF data.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonbColumnNames">The jsonb column names.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task<List<List<string>>> GetPDFData(IDto[] source, string[]? jsonbColumnNames = null)
    {
        return await GetPDFProps(source, jsonbColumnNames);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the multi sheet work book.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonbColumnNames">The jsonb column names.</param>
    /// <param name="exportDataModel">The export data model.</param>
    /// <param name="staticSource">The static source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static async Task<XLWorkbook> GetMultiSheetWorkBook(Dictionary<string, IDto[]> source, string[]? jsonbColumnNames = null,
            IExportDataModel? exportDataModel = null, Dictionary<string, ExportReportingStaticModel[]>? staticSource = null)
    {
        var workbook = new XLWorkbook();

        foreach (KeyValuePair<string, IDto[]> valuePair in source)
        {
            await CreateWorkSheet(workbook, valuePair.Value, jsonbColumnNames, exportDataModel, valuePair.Key);
        }

        if (staticSource == null)
        {
            return workbook;
        }

        foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ExportReportingStaticModel[]> valuePair in staticSource)
        {
            CreateWorkSheet(workbook, valuePair.Value, valuePair.Key);
        }

        return workbook;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the work book.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonbColumnNames">The jsonb column names.</param>
    /// <param name="exportDataModel">The export data model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static async Task<XLWorkbook> GetWorkBook(IDto[] source, string[]? jsonbColumnNames = null, IExportDataModel? exportDataModel = null)
    {
        var workbook = new XLWorkbook();

        await CreateWorkSheet(workbook, source, jsonbColumnNames, exportDataModel);

        return workbook;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Function Name - CreateWorkSheet.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="workbook">The workbook.</param>
    /// <param name="staticSource">The static source.</param>
    /// <param name="workSheetName">Name of the work sheet.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// void.
    /// </returns>
    private static void CreateWorkSheet(XLWorkbook workbook, ExportReportingStaticModel[] staticSource, string? workSheetName = null)
    {
        workSheetName = SanitizeSheetName(workSheetName ?? "");

        var worksheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(workSheetName);

        var properties = new List<PropertyHeader>();

        foreach (var element in staticSource)
        {
            var headerName = $"{element.Property} ({element.Unit})";
            properties.Add(new PropertyHeader { DisplayName = headerName });
        }

        var col = 1;
        var row = 1;
        foreach (var element in staticSource)
        {
            worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = $"{element.Property} ({element.Unit})";
            col++;
        }

        row++;
        col = 1;

        foreach (var element in staticSource)
        {
            worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = Math.Round(element.Value, 3);
            col++;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Function Name - CreateWorkSheet.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="workbook">The workbook.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonbColumnNames">The jsonb column names.</param>
    /// <param name="exportDataModel">The export data model.</param>
    /// <param name="workSheetName">Name of the work sheet.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// System.Threading.Tasks.Task.
    /// </returns>
    private static async Task CreateWorkSheet(XLWorkbook workbook, IDto[] source, string[]? jsonbColumnNames = null, IExportDataModel? exportDataModel = null, string? workSheetName = null)
    {
        var itemType = source.GetType().GetElementType();
        if (itemType != null)
        {
            workSheetName ??= itemType.Name.Replace("ListItemDto", "");

            workSheetName = SanitizeSheetName(workSheetName);

            var worksheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(workSheetName);

            var allProperties = itemType.GetProperties();
            int dynamicColumnNameIndex = 0;
            var properties = new List<PropertyHeader>();

            foreach (var p in allProperties.Where(p =>
                         (p.IsDefined(typeof(DisplayNameAttribute), false) ||
                          p.IsDefined(typeof(DisplayAttribute), false)) &&
                         !p.IsDefined(typeof(IgnoreExportAttribute), false)))
            {
                if (p.PropertyType != typeof(dynamic[]))
                {
                    properties.Add(new PropertyHeader
                    {
                        PropertyName = p.Name,
                        DisplayName = p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayNameAttribute>()?.DisplayName ??
                                      p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? p.Name
                    });
                }
                else
                {
                    if (jsonbColumnNames != null)
                    {
                        foreach (string columnName in jsonbColumnNames)
                        {
                            properties.Add(new PropertyHeader { PropertyName = p.Name, DisplayName = columnName });
                            dynamicColumnNameIndex++;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        var dynamicPropertyCount = (p.GetValue(source[0]) as dynamic[])!.Length;
                        for (int dpc = 1; dpc <= dynamicPropertyCount; dpc++)
                        {
                            properties.Add(new PropertyHeader
                            {
                                PropertyName = p.Name,
                                DisplayName =
                                    (p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayNameAttribute>()?.DisplayName ??
                                     p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? p.Name) + dpc.ToString()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            var col = 1;
            var row = 1;

            if (exportDataModel is not null)
            {
                row = ExportBasicDataHelper.InsertBasicData(worksheet, row, col, exportDataModel);
                row += 1;
            }

            worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = "Sorszám";
            worksheet.Cell(row, col).Style.Font.Bold = true;

            foreach (var prop in properties)
            {
                col++;
                worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = prop.DisplayName;
                worksheet.Cell(row, col).Style.Font.Bold = true;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < source.Length; i++)
            {
                col = 1;
                row += 1;
                var item = source[i];

                worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = i + 1;

                foreach (var prop in itemType.GetProperties()
                             .Where(x => properties.Select(j => j.PropertyName).Contains(x.Name)))
                {
                    col++;

                    var value = prop.GetValue(item);

                    if (prop.PropertyType.IsEnum)
                    {
                        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = prop.PropertyType
                            .GetField(value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty)?.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()
                            ?.Name ?? value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
                    }
                    else if (prop.PropertyType == typeof(dynamic[]))
                    {
                        int j = 0;
                        if (value != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var val in (value as dynamic[])!)
                            {
                                worksheet.Cell(row, col + j).Value = val;
                                j++;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = value is not double ? (XLCellValue)(value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty) : (XLCellValue)Math.Round((double)value, 3);
                    }
                }
            }

            worksheet.Columns().AdjustToContents();
            worksheet.Rows().AdjustToContents();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the PDF props.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="jsonbColumnNames">The jsonb column names.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static async Task<List<List<string>>> GetPDFProps(IDto[] source, string[]? jsonbColumnNames = null)
    {
        var itemType = source.GetType().GetElementType();

        var workbook = new XLWorkbook();
        if (itemType != null)
        {
            var workSheetName = itemType.Name.Replace("ListItemDto", "");
            workbook.Worksheets.Add(workSheetName[..Math.Min(31, workSheetName.Length)]);

            var allProperties = itemType.GetProperties();
            int dynamicColumnNameIndex = 0;
            var properties = new List<PropertyHeader>();

            foreach (var p in allProperties.Where(p =>
                         (p.IsDefined(typeof(DisplayNameAttribute), false) ||
                          p.IsDefined(typeof(DisplayAttribute), false)) &&
                         !p.IsDefined(typeof(IgnoreExportAttribute), false)))
            {
                if (p.PropertyType != typeof(dynamic[]))
                {
                    properties.Add(new PropertyHeader
                    {
                        PropertyName = p.Name,
                        DisplayName = p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayNameAttribute>()?.DisplayName ??
                                      p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? p.Name
                    });
                }
                else
                {
                    if (jsonbColumnNames != null)
                    {
                        foreach (string columnName in jsonbColumnNames)
                        {
                            properties.Add(new PropertyHeader { PropertyName = p.Name, DisplayName = columnName });
                            dynamicColumnNameIndex++;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        var dynamicPropertyCount = (p.GetValue(source[0]) as dynamic[])!.Length;
                        for (int dpc = 1; dpc <= dynamicPropertyCount; dpc++)
                        {
                            properties.Add(new PropertyHeader
                            {
                                PropertyName = p.Name,
                                DisplayName =
                                    (p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayNameAttribute>()?.DisplayName ??
                                     p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? p.Name) + dpc.ToString()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return await GetPdfList(properties, source, itemType);
        }

        return new List<List<string>>();
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the PDF list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="properties">The properties.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="itemType">Type of the item.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static async Task<List<List<string>>> GetPdfList(List<PropertyHeader> properties,
            IDto[] source, Type itemType)
    {
        var col = 0;
        var result = new List<List<string>>();
        var header = new List<string>();

        foreach (var prop in properties)
            header.Add(prop.DisplayName ?? "");
        result.Add(header);


        for (int i = 1; i <= source.Length; i++)
        {
            var sor = new List<string>();
            col = 0;
            var item = source[i - 1];

            foreach (var prop in itemType.GetProperties()
                         .Where(x => properties.Select(j => j.PropertyName).Contains(x.Name)))
            {
                col++;

                var value = prop.GetValue(item);
                if (value is null)
                {
                    sor.Add(string.Empty);
                    continue;
                }

                if (prop.PropertyType.IsEnum)
                {
                    var elem = prop.PropertyType.GetField(value.ToString() ?? string.Empty)
                        ?.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? value;

                    sor.Add(elem.ToString() ?? string.Empty);
                }
                else if (prop.PropertyType == typeof(dynamic[]))
                {
                    foreach (var val in (value as dynamic[])!)
                    {
                        if (val != null)
                            sor.Add(val.ToString());
                        else
                            sor.Add(string.Empty);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (value is double d)
                        sor.Add($"{d:f3}");
                    else
                        sor.Add(value.ToString() ?? string.Empty);
                }
            }

            result.Add(sor);
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <param name="jsonbColumnNames">The jsonb column names.</param>

    private static async Task<StringBuilder> GetCSVProps(IDto[] source, string[]? jsonbColumnNames = null)
    {
        var itemType = source.GetType().GetElementType();

        if (itemType != null)
        {
            var allProperties = itemType.GetProperties();
            int dynamicColumnNameIndex = 0;
            var properties = new List<PropertyHeader>();

            foreach (var p in allProperties.Where(p =>
                         (p.IsDefined(typeof(DisplayNameAttribute), false) ||

            {
                if (p.PropertyType != typeof(dynamic[]))
                {
                    properties.Add(new PropertyHeader
                    {
                        PropertyName = p.Name,
                        DisplayName = p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayNameAttribute>()?.DisplayName ??
                                      p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? p.Name
                    });
                }
                else
                {
                    if (jsonbColumnNames != null)
                    {
                        foreach (string columnName in jsonbColumnNames)
                        {
                            properties.Add(new PropertyHeader { PropertyName = p.Name, DisplayName = columnName });
                            dynamicColumnNameIndex++;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {

                }
            }

            return await GetCsvList(properties, source, itemType);
        }

        return new StringBuilder();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the CSV list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="staticSource">The static source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static async Task<StringBuilder> GetCsvList(ExportReportingStaticModel[] staticSource)
    {
        StringBuilder sb = new();

        var counter = 0;

        foreach (var element in staticSource)
        {
            if (counter == 0)
                sb.Append($"{element.Property} ({element.Unit})");
            else
                sb.Append($",{element.Property} ({element.Unit})");
            counter++;
        }

        sb.Append("\r\n");

        counter = 0;
        foreach (var element in staticSource)
        {
            var value = $"{Math.Round(element.Value, 3)}".Replace(',', '.');
            if (counter == 0)
                sb.Append(value);
            else
                sb.Append($",{value}");
            counter++;
        }

        return sb;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the CSV list.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="properties">The properties.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="itemType">Type of the item.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static async Task<StringBuilder> GetCsvList(List<PropertyHeader> properties,
            IDto[] source, Type itemType)
    {
        StringBuilder sb = new();

        var counter = 0;

        foreach (var prop in properties.Select(x => x.DisplayName))
        {
            if (counter == 0)
                sb.Append(prop);
            else
                sb.Append("," + prop);
            counter++;
        }

        sb.Append("\r\n");

        for (int i = 1; i <= source.Length; i++)
        {
            counter = 0;
            var item = source[i - 1];

            foreach (var prop in itemType.GetProperties()
                         .Where(x => properties.Select(j => j.PropertyName).Contains(x.Name)))
            {
                var value = prop.GetValue(item);

                if (prop.PropertyType.IsEnum)
                {
                    var elem = prop.PropertyType.GetField(value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty)
                        ?.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? value;
                    if (elem != null)
                        if (counter == 0)
                            sb.Append(elem.ToString());
                        else
                            sb.Append("," + elem.ToString());
                    else
                        sb.Append(string.Empty);
                }
                else if (prop.PropertyType == typeof(dynamic[]))
                {
                    if (value != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var val in (value as dynamic[])!)
                        {
                            if (val != null)
                                if (counter == 0)
                                    sb.Append(val.ToString());
                                else
                                    sb.Append("," + val.ToString());
                            else
                                sb.Append(string.Empty);
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (value != null)
                        if (counter == 0)
                            sb.Append(value.ToString());
                        else
                            sb.Append("," + value.ToString());
                    else
                        sb.Append(string.Empty);
                }

                counter++;
            }

            sb.Append("\r\n");
        }

        return sb;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// A kapott sheet nevet ékezetteleníti.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="name">The name.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// Az ékezettelenített sheet nevet adja vissza.
    /// </returns>
    public static string SanitizeSheetName(string name)
    {
        var invalidChars = new[] { ':', '\\', '/', '?', '*', '[', ']' };

        foreach (var c in invalidChars)
        {
            name = name.Replace(c.ToString(), string.Empty);
        }

        name = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(name, @"\s+", " ", RegexOptions.None, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)).Trim();

        if (name.Length > 31)
        {
            name = name[..31];
        }

        return name;
    }

    public static byte[] GetFileByteArray(Assembly assembly, string resourceName) 
    {
        using (var stream = assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(resourceName))
        {
            if (stream == null)
                return null!;

            using (var memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
            {
                stream.CopyTo(memoryStream);
                return memoryStream.ToArray();
            }
        }
    }

    public static async Task<byte[]> GetAggregatedDataReportExcel(IEnumerable<DevicesAggregatedDataBaseTableExportRow> baseTableExcelItems, List<DevicesAggregatedDataSummaryTableExportRow> summaryTableExcelItems, DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader excelInfo)
    {
        var workbook = new XLWorkbook();

        await CreateWorkSheet(workbook, baseTableExcelItems.ToArray(), null, excelInfo, "Alaptábla");

         CreateAggregatedDataReportSummarySheet(workbook, summaryTableExcelItems, excelInfo);        

        await using var ms = new MemoryStream();

        workbook.SaveAs(ms);

        return ms.ToArray();
    }

    private static void CreateAggregatedDataReportSummarySheet(XLWorkbook workbook, List<DevicesAggregatedDataSummaryTableExportRow> summaryTableExcelItems, DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader excelInfo)
    {
        var summaryWorksheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add("Összesítő táblák");

        int currentRow = 1;

        foreach (var summaryItem in summaryTableExcelItems)
        {
            summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 1).Value = summaryItem.TopologyPath;
            summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 1).Style.Font.Bold = true;
            //summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 1).Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
            //summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 1).Style.Fill.BackgroundColor = XLColor.LightGray;
            summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, 1, currentRow, 17).Merge();


            // Üres sor a topológia és táblázat között
            currentRow += 1;

            // Ha van elem az Items listában, létrehozzuk a táblázatot
            if (summaryItem.Items != null && summaryItem.Items.Any())
            {
                // Eszköz adatok fejléc
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 1).Value = "Eszköz adatok";
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 1).Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
                summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, 1, currentRow, 4).Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
                summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, 1, currentRow, 4).Merge();

                // Mai adatok fejléce
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 5).Value = "Mai nap";
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 5).Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
                summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, 5, currentRow, 8).Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
                summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, 5, currentRow, 8).Merge();

                // Ha van tegnapi adat
                int columnOffset = 9;
                if (excelInfo.AggregationYesterday)
                {
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset).Value = "Előző nap";
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset).Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
                    summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, columnOffset, currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
                    summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, columnOffset, currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Merge();
                    columnOffset += 4;
                }

                // Ha van utolsó 7 napi adat
                if (excelInfo.AggregationLast7Days)
                {
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset).Value = "Előző hét";
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset).Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
                    summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, columnOffset, currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
                    summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, columnOffset, currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Merge();
                }

                currentRow++;
                // Eszköz adatok alfejléc
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 1).Value = "Eszköz kategória";
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 2).Value = "Eszköz típus";
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 3).Value = "Napi aggregáció";
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 4).Value = "Mért jellemző";
                summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, 1, currentRow, 4).Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;

                // Mai adatok alfejléc
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 5).Value = "Utolsó mért érték";
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 6).Value = "Aggregált érték";
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 7).Value = "Minimum érték";
                summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 8).Value = "Maximum érték";
                summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, 5, currentRow, 8).Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;

                // Tegnapi adatok alfejléc
                columnOffset = 9;
                if (excelInfo.AggregationYesterday)
                {
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset).Value = "Aggregált érték";
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 1).Value = "Minimum érték";
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 2).Value = "Maximum érték";
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Value = "Átlag érték";
                    summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, columnOffset, currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
                    columnOffset += 4;
                }

                // Utolsó 7 nap adatok alfejléc
                if (excelInfo.AggregationLast7Days)
                {
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset).Value = "Aggregált érték";
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 1).Value = "Min. érték";
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 2).Value = "Max. érték";
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Value = "Átlag érték";
                    summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow, columnOffset, currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
                }

                // Fejléc formázása
                var headerRange = summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow - 1, 1, currentRow, summaryWorksheet.LastColumnUsed().ColumnNumber());
                headerRange.Style.Font.Bold = true;
                //headerRange.Style.Fill.BackgroundColor = XLColor.LightGray;
                headerRange.Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
                headerRange.Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;

                currentRow++;

                // Adatsorok
                foreach (var item in summaryItem.Items)
                {
                    //Eszköz adatok
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 1).Value = item.DeviceCategoryName ?? string.Empty;
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 2).Value = item.DeviceTypeName ?? string.Empty;
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 3).Value = item.AggregationMethod ?? string.Empty;
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 4).Value = item.MeasuredProperty ?? string.Empty;

                    // Mai adatok
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 5).Value = item.LastMeasuredValue ?? string.Empty;
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 6).Value = item.TodaysAggregatedValue ?? string.Empty;
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 7).Value = item.TodaysMinValue ?? string.Empty;
                    summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, 8).Value = item.TodaysMaxValue ?? string.Empty;

                    // Tegnapi adatok
                    columnOffset = 9;
                    if (excelInfo.AggregationYesterday)
                    {
                        summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset).Value = item.YesterdaysAggregatedValue ?? string.Empty;
                        summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 1).Value = item.YesterdaysMinValue ?? string.Empty;
                        summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 2).Value = item.YesterdaysMaxValue ?? string.Empty;
                        summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Value = item.YesterdaysAverageValue ?? string.Empty;
                        columnOffset += 4;
                    }

                    // Utolsó 7 nap adatok
                    if (excelInfo.AggregationLast7Days)
                    {
                        summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset).Value = item.Last7DaysAggregatedValue ?? string.Empty;
                        summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 1).Value = item.Last7DaysMinValue ?? string.Empty;
                        summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 2).Value = item.Last7DaysMaxValue ?? string.Empty;
                        summaryWorksheet.Cell(currentRow, columnOffset + 3).Value = item.Last7DaysAverageValue ?? string.Empty;
                    }

                    currentRow++;
                }

                // Táblázat szegélyek
                //var dataRange = summaryWorksheet.Range(currentRow - summaryItem.Items.Count, 1, currentRow - 1, summaryWorksheet.LastColumnUsed().ColumnNumber());
                //dataRange.Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
                //dataRange.Style.Border.InsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;

                // Oszlopok automatikus méretezése
                summaryWorksheet.Columns().AdjustToContents();
            }

            // Üres sorok a táblázatok között
            currentRow += 3;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ClosedXML.Excel;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel;
public class ExcelProcessor : IDisposable
{
    private readonly XLWorkbook _xlWorkbook;

    private const string UNEXPECTED_EX_MESSAGE = "Ismeretlen hiba lépett fel!";

    public ExcelProcessor(byte[] data)
    {
        if (data == null || data.Length == 0)
            throw new ArgumentException("A forrás fálj nem található!");

        using (var stream = new MemoryStream(data)) 
        {
            _xlWorkbook = new XLWorkbook(stream);
        }
    }

    public int GetLastUsedRowNumber(string sheet) 
    {
        return _xlWorkbook.Worksheet(sheet).LastRowUsed()?.RowNumber() ?? 0;
    }

    public bool TryGetCellAsString(string sheet, int row, string column, out string value, out string errorMessage)
    {
        return TryGetCellValue<string>(sheet, row, column, "A cella nem konvertálható karakter láncra!", out value, out errorMessage);
    }

    public bool TryGetCellAsDateTime(string sheet, int row, string column, out DateTime value, out string errorMessage)
    {
        return TryGetCellValue<DateTime>(sheet, row, column, "A cella nem konvertálható dátumra!", out value, out errorMessage);
    }

    public bool TryGetCellAsDouble(string sheet, int row, string column, out double value, out string errorMessage)
    {
        return TryGetCellValue<double>(sheet, row, column, "A cella nem konvertálható valós számra!", out value, out errorMessage);
    }

    public bool TryGetCellAsInteger(string sheet, int row, string column, out int value,out string errorMessage)
    {
        return TryGetCellValue<int>(sheet, row, column, "A cella nem konvertálható egész számra!", out value, out errorMessage);
    }

    public bool TryGetCellAsBoolean(string sheet, int row, string column, out bool value, out string errorMessage)
    {
        return TryGetCellValue<bool>(sheet, row, column, "A cella nem konvertálható logikai értékre!", out value, out errorMessage);
    }

    private bool TryGetCellValue<T>(string sheet, int row, string column, string notConvertable, out T value, out string errorMessage)
    {
        errorMessage = string.Empty;
        value = default!;
        try
        {
            if (_xlWorkbook.Worksheet(sheet).Cell(row, column).TryGetValue(out value))
            {
                return true;
            }

            errorMessage = notConvertable;
            return false;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            errorMessage = UNEXPECTED_EX_MESSAGE;
            return false;
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _xlWorkbook?.Dispose();
    }
}
