using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using ClosedXML.Excel;
using ClosedXML.Parser;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Export;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel;

/// <summary>
/// ExportBasicDataHelper
/// </summary>
public static class ExportBasicDataHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Inserts the basic data.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="worksheet">The worksheet.</param>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="col">The col.</param>
    /// <param name="exportDataModel">The export data model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static int InsertBasicData(IXLWorksheet worksheet, int row, int col, IExportDataModel exportDataModel)
    {
        return exportDataModel switch
        {
            ExportBasicDataModel m => InsertBasicDataModel(worksheet, row, col, m),
            ExportMonitoringHeaderModel m => InsertMonitoringBasicDataModel(worksheet, row, col, m),
            MeasurementExcelExportHeader m => InsertMeasurementExcelExportHeader(worksheet, row, col, m),
            DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader m => InsertDevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader(worksheet, row, col, m),
            AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader m => InsertAggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader(worksheet, row, col, m),
            _ => throw new NotImplementedException(),
        };
    }

    private static int InsertDevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader(IXLWorksheet worksheet, int row, int col, DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader m)
    {
        col += 1;

        MergeColumnCells(worksheet, row, col, 5, ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader>(x => x.InstitutionHierarchy!));
        col += 6;
        MergeColumnCells(worksheet, row, col, 2, ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader>(x => x.Device!));
        col += 3;
        MergeColumnCells(worksheet, row, col, 3, ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader>(x => x.MeasurementPoint!));
        col += 4;
        MergeColumnCells(worksheet, row, col, 3, ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader>(x => x.TodaysData!));
        col += 4;
        //if (m.AggregationYesterday)
        //{
            MergeColumnCells(worksheet, row, col, 3, ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader>(x => x.LastDaysData!));
            col += 4;
        //}

        //if (m.AggregationLast7Days)
        //{
            MergeColumnCells(worksheet, row, col, 3, ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader>(x => x.Last7DaysData!));
            col += 4;
        //}

        ////extra formatting
        //var headerRange = worksheet.Range(2, 1, 2, col);
        //headerRange.Style.Font.Bold = true;
        //headerRange.Style.Fill.BackgroundColor = XLColor.LightGray;


        return row;
    }

    private static void MergeColumnCells(IXLWorksheet worksheet, int row, int col, int range, string value)
    {
        var mergedRange = worksheet.Range(row, col, row, col + range);
        mergedRange.Merge();
        mergedRange.Cell(1, 1).Value = value;
        mergedRange.Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
        mergedRange.Style.Alignment.Vertical = XLAlignmentVerticalValues.Center;
        //mergedRange.Style.Fill.BackgroundColor = XLColor.LightGray;
        mergedRange.Style.Font.Bold = true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Inserts the monitoring basic data model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="worksheet">The worksheet.</param>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="col">The col.</param>
    /// <param name="exportMonitoringBasicDataModel">The export monitoring basic data model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static int InsertMonitoringBasicDataModel(IXLWorksheet worksheet, int row, int col, ExportMonitoringHeaderModel exportMonitoringBasicDataModel)
    {
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<ExportMonitoringHeaderModel>(x => x.MeasuredPropertyName!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = exportMonitoringBasicDataModel.MeasuredPropertyName;
        row += 1;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<ExportMonitoringHeaderModel>(x => x.MeasurementUnit!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = exportMonitoringBasicDataModel.MeasurementUnit;
        row += 1;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<ExportMonitoringHeaderModel>(x => x.From!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = exportMonitoringBasicDataModel.From?.ToLocalTime().ToString("yyyy.MM.dd. HH:mm");
        row += 1;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<ExportMonitoringHeaderModel>(x => x.To!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = exportMonitoringBasicDataModel.To?.ToLocalTime().ToString("yyyy.MM.dd. HH:mm");
        row += 1;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<ExportMonitoringHeaderModel>(x => x.Aggregation!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = exportMonitoringBasicDataModel.Aggregation;
        row += 1;
        return row;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Inserts the basic data model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="worksheet">The worksheet.</param>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="col">The col.</param>
    /// <param name="exportBasicDataModel">The export basic data model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static int InsertBasicDataModel(IXLWorksheet worksheet, int row, int col, ExportBasicDataModel exportBasicDataModel)
    {
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<ExportBasicDataModel>(x => x.Name!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = exportBasicDataModel.Name;
        row += 1;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<ExportBasicDataModel>(x => x.Description!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = exportBasicDataModel.Description;
        row += 1;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<ExportBasicDataModel>(x => x.CreatedDate!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = exportBasicDataModel.CreatedDate;
        row += 1;
        return row;
    }

    private static int InsertMeasurementExcelExportHeader(IXLWorksheet worksheet, int row, int col, MeasurementExcelExportHeader measurementExcelExportHeader)
    {
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<MeasurementExcelExportHeader>(x => x.MeasuredPropertyName!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = measurementExcelExportHeader.MeasuredPropertyName;
        row += 1;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<MeasurementExcelExportHeader>(x => x.MeasurementUnit!);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = measurementExcelExportHeader.MeasurementUnit;
        row += 1;

        if (measurementExcelExportHeader.MeasurementPoints?.Any() ?? false)
        {
            worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<MeasurementExcelExportHeader>(x => x.MeasurementPoints!);
            worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = string.Join(", ", measurementExcelExportHeader.MeasurementPoints);
            row += 1;
        }

        return row;
    }

    private static int InsertAggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader(IXLWorksheet worksheet, int row, int col, AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader aggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader)
    {
        //specifik�ci� szerinti elrendez�sben �rjuk ki a fejl�c adatokat

        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader>(x => x.InstitutionName);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Style.Font.Bold = true;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = aggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader.InstitutionName;
        row += 2; //egy sor kimarad

        //ezeket a property-ket egym�s mell� kellene �rni, nem egym�s al�
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 0).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader>(x => x.FromDateStr);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 0).Style.Font.Bold = true;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = aggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader.FromDateStr;
        //egy oszlop kimarad
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 3).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader>(x => x.ToDateStr);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 3).Style.Font.Bold = true;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 4).Value = aggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader.ToDateStr;
        //egy oszlop kimarad
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 6).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader>(x => x.AggregationLevelStr);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 6).Style.Font.Bold = true;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 7).Value = aggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader.AggregationLevelStr;
        row += 1;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Value = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyDisplayName<AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader>(x => x.MeasurementUnit);
        worksheet.Cell(row, col).Style.Font.Bold = true;
        worksheet.Cell(row, col + 1).Value = aggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader.MeasurementUnit;
        row += 2; //egy sor kimarad

        //MeasurementPoints -> fejl�cen bel�li al-t�bl�zat besz�r�sa
        row = InsertSimpleData<MeasurementPointExcelHeaderData>(worksheet, row, col, aggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader.MeasurementPoints);

        row += 1;
        return row;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Writes a simple table in the excel sheet, with all the string (!!!) properties of T as headers.
    /// </summary>
    private static int InsertSimpleData<T>(IXLWorksheet worksheet, int row, int col, IEnumerable<T> data) where T : ISimpleExcelData
    {
        //draw a table header with all public properties of T
        var properties = typeof(T).GetProperties().Where(p => p.CanRead && p.PropertyType == typeof(string));
        int c = col;
        foreach (var prop in properties)
        {
            var da = prop.GetAttribute<DisplayAttribute>(false);
            worksheet.Cell(row, c).Style.Font.Bold = true;
            worksheet.Cell(row, c++).Value = da?.Name ?? prop.Name;
        }
        row++;

        //then draw the data cells
        foreach (T item in data)
        {
            int colIndex = col;
            foreach (var prop in properties)
            {
                worksheet.Cell(row, colIndex++).Value = (string)prop.GetValue(item);
            }
            row++;
        }

        return row;
    }

}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ClosedXML.Excel;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Spreadsheet;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Abstractions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor;
/// <summary>
/// Base osztály, amely biztosítja a sablon Excel fájl betöltését és mentését.
/// </summary>
public class ExcelTemplatePreprocessorBase
{
    private ExcelHandler? _excelHandler;
    protected ExcelHandler LoadFileFromWork(IExcelTemplateWork work, Assembly assembly)
    {
        var type = work.GetType();

        var attribute = type
            .GetCustomAttributes(typeof(ExcelFile), inherit: true)
            .FirstOrDefault() as ExcelFile;

        if (attribute == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing [ExcelFile] attribute on template class.");

        string path = attribute.EmbeddedResourcePath;
        _excelHandler = new ExcelHandler(path,assembly);
        return _excelHandler;
    }
    protected byte[] GetFile()
    {
        using var stream = new MemoryStream();
        _excelHandler!.Save(stream);
        return stream.ToArray();
    }
   
}

using System.Reflection;
using ClosedXML.Excel;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Abstractions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Instructions;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Executer;
/// <summary>
/// Egy sablonalapú Excel fájl feldolgozását végző osztály.
/// Az adott <see cref="IExcelTemplateWork"/> implementáció alapján tölti ki a sablont.
/// Csak az instrukciókat kezeli.
/// </summary>
public class ExcelTemplateWorkExecuter : ExcelTemplatePreprocessorBase, IExcelTemplateWorkExecuter
{
    public byte[] Execute(IExcelTemplateWork work,Assembly assembly)
    {
        // Betölti a sablonfájlt a megadott work alapján.
        using (var handler = LoadFileFromWork(work,assembly))
        {
            var instructions = work.Instructions;

            foreach (var instruction in instructions)
            {
                instruction.ExecuteInstruction(handler);
            }
            /*
    #if DEBUG
            //Desktopra irja a fájlt.
            var desktopPath = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.Desktop);
            var filePath = Path.Combine(desktopPath, "energetic_debug_output.xlsx");

            File.WriteAllBytes(filePath, GetFile());
    #endif
             */

            // Visszaadja a végleges fájlt memóriában.
            return GetFile();
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ClosedXML.Excel;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;
/// <summary>
/// Excel fájl kezelését végzi a ClosedXML könyvtár segítségével.
/// </summary>
public class ExcelHandler : IDisposable
{
    public XLWorkbook XLSX { get; set; }
    public ExcelHandler(string embeddedPath, Assembly assembly)
    {
        var binFile = ExcelManager.GetFileByteArray(assembly, embeddedPath);
        var stream = new MemoryStream(binFile);
        stream.Position = 0;
        XLSX = new XLWorkbook(stream);
    }
    public List<IXLCell> FindProcessableCells(Regex processableRegex, string sheetName)
    {
        var processableCells = new List<IXLCell>();
        var worksheet = GetSheet(sheetName)!.Sheet;

        foreach (var cell in worksheet.CellsUsed())
        {
            if (cell.DataType == XLDataType.Text && processableRegex.IsMatch(cell.GetString()))
            {
                processableCells.Add(cell);
            }
        }

        return processableCells;
    }

    public ExcelHandlerSheet GetSheet(string sheetName)
    {
        if (XLSX.Worksheets.TryGetWorksheet(sheetName, out var sheet))
        {
            return new ExcelHandlerSheet(sheet);
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid sheet name.");
    }

    public ExcelHandlerSheet AddSheet(string sheetName, IXLWorksheet copyFrom = null)
    {
        if (copyFrom != null)
        {
            return new ExcelHandlerSheet(copyFrom.CopyTo(XLSX, sheetName));
        }

        return new ExcelHandlerSheet(XLSX.Worksheets.Add(sheetName));
    }
    public void FillColumnFromCellDown(IXLCell cell, IEnumerable<XLCellValue>? values, ExcelStyleSetter? style = null)
    {
        if (values is null) { return; }
        int startRow = cell.Address.RowNumber;
        int column = cell.Address.ColumnNumber;

        int offset = 0;

        foreach (var value in values)
        {
            var targetCell = cell.Worksheet.Cell(startRow + offset, column);
            if (style is not null)
            {
                style.ApplyToCell(targetCell);
            }
            targetCell.Value = value;
            offset++;
        }
    }
    public List<ExcelHandlerSheet> Sheets { get { return XLSX.Worksheets.Select(item => new ExcelHandlerSheet(item)).ToList(); } }


    public void Save(Stream stream)
    {
        XLSX.SaveAs(stream);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (XLSX != null)
        {
            XLSX.Dispose();
            XLSX = null;
        }
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel\ExcelPreprocessor\Handler\ExcelHandlerHelper.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Reflection;
using ClosedXML.Excel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Attributes;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;

public static class ExcelHandlerHelper
{
    private static Dictionary<string, int> Cache = new Dictionary<string, int>();

    public static int Column(string name)
    {
        int result;
        if (Cache.TryGetValue(name, out result)) return result;

        var number = 0;
        var pow = 1;
        for (var i = name.Length - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            number += (name[i] - 'A' + 1) * pow;
            pow *= 26;
        }

        Cache.Add(name, number);
        return number;
    }

    public static string Column(int index)
    {
        var dividend = index;
        var result = string.Empty;

        while (dividend > 0)
        {
            var modulo = (dividend - 1) % 26;
            result = Convert.ToChar(65 + modulo).ToString() + result;
            dividend = (dividend - modulo) / 26;
        }

        return result;
    }
    public static Dictionary<string, PropertyInfo> GetExcelColumnMappings(Type type)
    {
        return type.GetProperties()
            .Select(p => new
            {
                Property = p,
                Attribute = p.GetCustomAttribute<ExcelColumn>()
            })
            .Where(x => x.Attribute != null)
            .ToDictionary(x => x.Attribute!.Placeholder, x => x.Property);
    }
    public static XLCellValue ConvertToXLCellValue(object? value)
    {
        if (value == null)
            return XLCellValue.FromObject(null);

        return XLCellValue.FromObject(value);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ClosedXML.Excel;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Spreadsheet;
using Color = System.Drawing.Color;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;
public class ExcelHandlerSheet
{
    public IXLWorksheet Sheet { get; set; }

    public ExcelHandlerSheet(IXLWorksheet sheet)
    {
        Sheet = sheet ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sheet));
    }

    public string Name { get { return Sheet.Name; } }
    public bool IsProtected => Sheet.IsProtected;
    public void Protect(string? password)
    {
        if (password is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        Sheet.Protect(password);
    }
    public void Unprotect(string? password)
    {
        if (password is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        Sheet.Unprotect(password); 
    }
    public IXLRange GetCellsFromColumnName(string columnName)
    {
        // Find the column number that matches the column name (case-insensitive)
        int columnIndex = -1;
        foreach (var cell in Sheet.Row(1).CellsUsed())
        {
            if (cell.GetString().Trim().Equals(columnName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                columnIndex = cell.Address.ColumnNumber;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (columnIndex == -1)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Column '{columnName}' not found in sheet '{Sheet.Name}'.");

        // Get all used rows in the sheet (excluding header)
        var usedRows = Sheet.RowsUsed().Skip(1).ToList();

        if (!usedRows.Any())
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"No data rows found in column '{columnName}'.");

        // Define range from first to last cell in that column
        var firstCell = usedRows.First().Cell(columnIndex);
        var lastCell = usedRows.Last().Cell(columnIndex);

        return Sheet.Range(firstCell.Address, lastCell.Address);
    }
    public IEnumerable<IXLCell> FindProcessableCells()
    {
        var processableCells = new List<IXLCell>();
        Regex processableCellRegex = new Regex(@"\{[^}]+\}");

        foreach (var cell in Sheet.CellsUsed())
        {
            if (cell.DataType == XLDataType.Text && processableCellRegex.IsMatch(cell.GetString()))
            {
                processableCells.Add(cell);
            }
        }

        return processableCells;
    }
    public IEnumerable<IXLCell> GetCellsByPositions(IEnumerable<ExcelPosition> positions)
    {
        foreach (var position in positions)
        {
            yield return GetCell(position.RowExcelIndex, position.ColumnExcelIndex);
        }
    }
    public object this[int rowIndex, string columnName]
    {
        get { return this[rowIndex, ExcelHandlerHelper.Column(columnName)]; }
        set { this[rowIndex, ExcelHandlerHelper.Column(columnName)] = value; }
    }

    public object this[int rowIndex, int columnIndex]
    {
        get { return GetCell(rowIndex, columnIndex).GetValue<object>(); }
        set { GetCell(rowIndex, columnIndex).Value = value is XLCellValue valueAsXLCellValue ? valueAsXLCellValue : XLCellValue.FromObject(value); }
    }

    public void CopyRange(IXLCell fromFirstCell, IXLCell fromLastCell, int toRowIndex, int toColumnIndex)
    {
        var range = Sheet.Range(fromFirstCell, fromLastCell);
        Sheet.Cell(toRowIndex, toColumnIndex).CopyFrom(range);
    }

    public void CopyRangeWithShift(IXLCell fromFirstCell, IXLCell fromLastCell, int toRowIndex, int toColumnIndex)
    {
        var range = Sheet.Range(fromFirstCell, fromLastCell);
        var columnCount = fromLastCell.Address.ColumnNumber - fromFirstCell.Address.ColumnNumber + 1;
        InsertColumn(toColumnIndex, columnCount);
        Sheet.Cell(toRowIndex, toColumnIndex).CopyFrom(range);
    }

    public void CopyColumnsWithShift(int fromFirstColumnIndex, int fromLastColumnIndex, int toFirstColumnIndex)
    {
        var columnCount = fromLastColumnIndex - fromFirstColumnIndex + 1;
        var range = Sheet.Range(1, fromFirstColumnIndex, Sheet.LastCell()?.Address.RowNumber ?? 1, fromLastColumnIndex);
        InsertColumn(toFirstColumnIndex, columnCount);
        Sheet.Cell(1, toFirstColumnIndex).CopyFrom(range);
    }

    public void CopyRowsWithShift(int fromFirstRowIndex, int fromLastRowIndex, int toFirstRowIndex)
    {
        var rowCount = fromLastRowIndex - fromFirstRowIndex + 1;
        var range = Sheet.Range(fromFirstRowIndex, 1, fromLastRowIndex, Sheet.LastCell()?.Address.ColumnNumber ?? 1);
        InsertRow(toFirstRowIndex, rowCount);
        Sheet.Cell(toFirstRowIndex, 1).CopyFrom(range);
    }

    public void InsertColumn(int columnIndex, int columnCount = 1)
    {
        Sheet.Column(columnIndex).InsertColumnsBefore(columnCount);
    }

    public void InsertColumn(string columnName, int columnCount = 1)
    {
        InsertColumn(ExcelHandlerHelper.Column(columnName), columnCount);
    }

    public void InsertRow(int rowIndex, int rowCount = 1)
    {
        Sheet.Row(rowIndex).InsertRowsAbove(rowCount);
    }

    public void SetActiveCell(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
    {
        var cell = GetCell(rowIndex, columnIndex);
        cell.SetActive();
    }

    public IXLTable GetTable(string tableName)
    {
        var result = Sheet.Tables.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Name == tableName);
        return result;
    }

    public IXLPivotTable GetPivotTable(string pivotName)
    {
        return Sheet.PivotTables.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Name == pivotName);
    }
    public IXLPivotTable CreatePivotTable(string pivotTableName, IXLCell targetCell, IXLRange range)
    {
        return Sheet.PivotTables.Add(pivotTableName, targetCell, range);
    }

    public IXLPivotTable CreatePivotTable(string pivotTableName, IXLCell targetCell, IXLTable table)
    {
        return Sheet.PivotTables.Add(pivotTableName, targetCell, table);
    }

    public void AdjustToContents()
    {
        Sheet.Columns().AdjustToContents();
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {

    }

====================================================================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;
public struct ExcelPosition
{
    public int RowExcelIndex { get { return _row + 1; }}
    public int RowIndex { get { return _row; }}

    private readonly int _row;
    public int ColumnExcelIndex { get { return _column + 1; }}
    public int ColumnIndex { get { return _row; }}

    private readonly int _column;
    public ExcelPosition(int row, int column) 
    {
        _row = row;
        _column = column;
    }
    public ExcelPosition(string address)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(address))
            throw new ArgumentException("Address cannot be null or empty.", nameof(address));

        int col = 0;
        int i = 0;

        while (i < address.Length && char.IsLetter(address[i]))
        {
            col *= 26;
            col += char.ToUpper(address[i]) - 'A' + 1;
            i++;
        }

        string rowPart = address[i..]; 
        if (!int.TryParse(rowPart, out int row))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Excel address format: {address}");

        _row = row - 1;
        _column = col - 1;
    }

    public static ExcelPosition FromIndex(int row, int column)
    { 
        return new ExcelPosition(row, column);
    }
    public static ExcelPosition FromExcelIndex(int row, int column)
    {
        return new ExcelPosition(row-1, column-1);
    }
    public static ExcelPosition FromAddress(string address)
    {
        return new ExcelPosition(address);
    }
    public override string ToString()
    {
        return $"<{_row},{_column}>";
    }


}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ClosedXML.Excel;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;
public class ExcelStyleSetter
{
    public bool? Bold { get; set; }
    public XLColor? FontColor { get; set; }
    public XLColor? BackgroundColor { get; set; }
    public XLAlignmentHorizontalValues? HorizontalAlignment { get; set; }
    public XLAlignmentVerticalValues? VerticalAlignment { get; set; }
    public XLBorderStyleValues? BorderStyle { get; set; }
    public XLColor? BorderColor { get; set; }
    public bool? Locked { get; set; }

    public void ApplyToCell(IXLCell cell)
    {
        var style = cell.Style;

        if (Bold.HasValue)
            style.Font.Bold = Bold.Value;

        if (FontColor != null)
            style.Font.FontColor = FontColor;

        if (BackgroundColor != null)
            style.Fill.BackgroundColor = BackgroundColor;

        if (HorizontalAlignment.HasValue)
            style.Alignment.Horizontal = HorizontalAlignment.Value;

        if (VerticalAlignment.HasValue)
            style.Alignment.Vertical = VerticalAlignment.Value;

        if (BorderStyle.HasValue)
        {
            style.Border.TopBorder = BorderStyle.Value;
            style.Border.BottomBorder = BorderStyle.Value;
            style.Border.LeftBorder = BorderStyle.Value;
            style.Border.RightBorder = BorderStyle.Value;
        }

        if (BorderColor != null)
        {
            style.Border.TopBorderColor = BorderColor;
            style.Border.BottomBorderColor = BorderColor;
            style.Border.LeftBorderColor = BorderColor;
            style.Border.RightBorderColor = BorderColor;
        }

        //csak akkor mukodik ha utana protectelunk
        if (Locked.HasValue)
        { 
            style.Protection.SetLocked(Locked.Value);
        }
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel\ExcelPreprocessor\Handler\IXLPivotTableExtensions.cs
====================================================================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ClosedXML.Excel;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;
public static class IXLPivotTableExtensions
{
    public static bool IsContainsColumnLabel(this IXLPivotTable table, string labelName)
    {
        return table.ColumnLabels.FirstOrDefault(x => x.CustomName == labelName) != null;
    }

    public static bool IsContainsRowLabel(this IXLPivotTable table, string labelName)
    {
        return table.RowLabels.FirstOrDefault(x => x.CustomName == labelName) != null;
    }

    public static bool IsContainsValue(this IXLPivotTable table, string valueName)
    {
        return table.Values.FirstOrDefault(x => x.CustomName == valueName) != null;
    }

    public static void AddColumnLabel(this IXLPivotTable table, string labelName)
    {
        if (!table.IsContainsColumnLabel(labelName))
            table.ColumnLabels.Add(labelName);
    }

    public static void AddRowLabel(this IXLPivotTable table, string labelName)
    {
        if (!table.IsContainsRowLabel(labelName))
            table.RowLabels.Add(labelName);
    }

    public static void AddValue(this IXLPivotTable table, string valueName)
    {
        if (!table.IsContainsValue(valueName))
            table.Values.Add(valueName);
    }
}

====================================================================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ClosedXML.Excel;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Office.CustomUI;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Abstractions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Instructions;
public class CreateDropdownInstruction : IExcelTemplateInstruction
{
    public required string SheetName { get; set; }
    public string? PasswordProtection { get; set; }
    public required string DropdownCellPlaceholder { get; set; }


    public required string SourceSheetName { get; set; }
    public string? SourcePasswordProtection { get; set; }
    public required string SourceColumnName { get; set; }

    public required bool FillDownIndefinitely { get; set; }

    public void ExecuteInstruction(ExcelHandler handler)
    {
        var sheet = handler.GetSheet(SheetName);
        sheet.Unprotect(PasswordProtection);

        var sourceSheet = handler.GetSheet(SourceSheetName);
        sourceSheet.Unprotect(SourcePasswordProtection);

        IXLRange sourceRange = sourceSheet.GetCellsFromColumnName(SourceColumnName);

        if (sourceRange.IsEmpty())
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"The source range for column '{SourceColumnName}' in sheet '{SourceSheetName}' is empty.");

        var cells = sheet.FindProcessableCells();
        IXLCell? dropdownCell = cells.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Value.ToString() == DropdownCellPlaceholder);
        if (dropdownCell == null)
            throw new InvalidDataException($"Cannot find placeholder: {DropdownCellPlaceholder}");

        var workbook = dropdownCell.Worksheet.Workbook;
        string rangeName = $"Dropdown_{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        workbook.NamedRanges.Add(rangeName, sourceRange);

        if (FillDownIndefinitely)
        {
            int startRow = dropdownCell.Address.RowNumber;
            int column = dropdownCell.Address.ColumnNumber;
            var rangeToFill = dropdownCell.Worksheet.Range(
                dropdownCell.Worksheet.Cell(startRow, column),
                dropdownCell.Worksheet.LastCellUsed().WorksheetRow().LastCell().Worksheet.Cell(1048576, column) // Excel max row
            );

            var validation = rangeToFill.CreateDataValidation();
            validation.IgnoreBlanks = true;
            validation.InCellDropdown = true;
            validation.AllowedValues = XLAllowedValues.List;
            validation.List($"={rangeName}");
        }
        else
        {
            var validation = dropdownCell.CreateDataValidation();
            validation.IgnoreBlanks = true;
            validation.InCellDropdown = true;
            validation.AllowedValues = XLAllowedValues.List;
            validation.List($"={rangeName}");


        }
        // Set first value as default
        var firstValue = sourceRange.FirstCell().GetFormattedString();
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstValue))
        {
            dropdownCell.Value = "";
        }

        sheet.Unprotect(PasswordProtection);
        sourceSheet.Unprotect(SourcePasswordProtection);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using ClosedXML.Excel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Abstractions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Instructions;
public class FillTableInstruction : IExcelTemplateInstruction
{
    public required string SheetName { get; set; }
    public string? PasswordProtection { get; set; }
    public required IEnumerable<IExcelTemplateTable> Table { get; set; }
    public ExcelStyleSetter? CellStyle { get; set; }

    public void ExecuteInstruction(ExcelHandler handler)
    {
        var sheet = handler.GetSheet(SheetName);
        var cells = sheet.FindProcessableCells();

        sheet.Protect(PasswordProtection);

        var columnMappings = ExcelHandlerHelper.GetExcelColumnMappings(Table.First().GetType());

        foreach (var cell in cells)
        {
            string placeholder = cell.GetString();

            if (!columnMappings.TryGetValue(placeholder, out var propertyInfo))
                continue;

            var values = Table
                .Select(item => ExcelHandlerHelper.ConvertToXLCellValue(propertyInfo.GetValue(item)))
                .ToList();

            handler.FillColumnFromCellDown(cell, values,CellStyle);
        }

        sheet.Unprotect(PasswordProtection);

    }
}

using System;

using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

using ClosedXML;
using ClosedXML.Excel;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Handler;
namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Instructions;
public class InsertColumnToPositionInstruction : IExcelTemplateInstruction
{
    public required string SheetName { get; set; }
    public string? PasswordProtection { get; set; }
    public required Dictionary<ExcelPosition, IEnumerable<XLCellValue>> Insertations { get; set; }

    public void ExecuteInstruction(ExcelHandler handler)

        sheet.Unprotect(PasswordProtection);

            handler.FillColumnFromCellDown(cell, values);
        }

        sheet.Protect(PasswordProtection);
    }

using System;

        }

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\Energiamenedzsment.Common.ModuleApiServices\Monitoring\MonitoringApiService.cs

using Common.Extensions.HttpClientExtensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Energiamenedzsment.Common.ModuleApiServices.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;

namespace Energiamenedzsment.Common.ModuleApiServices.Monitoring;



/// <summary>
/// Modulok közötti áthíváshoz használható service, ami a Monitoring Web API végpontjait hívja meg.
/// </summary>
/// <param name="httpClientFactory"></param>
public class MonitoringApiService(
    IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory,
    IHttpContextAccessor ctx,
    ILogger<MonitoringApiService> logger) : IMonitoringApiService
{
    string authEndpoint; 
    private string? apiKey;

    //JWT-ből kiszedjük a tenantcode-ot, ezzel fogunk a Monitoring API-hoz hitelesíteni, ha kell
    string? tenantCode = ctx?.HttpContext?.User.Claims.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == "tenantcode")?.Value ?? null; 


    private readonly HttpClient _monitoringApiClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient(Constants.ModuleNames.MonitoringWebApi);
    private readonly HttpClient _monitoringAuthClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient(Constants.ModuleAuthClientNames.MonitoringAuthClient);

    //TODO: majd ezt is DI-ból kaphatná meg!
    public void Configure(string authEndpoint, string apiKey)
    {
        this.authEndpoint = authEndpoint;
        this.apiKey = apiKey;
    }

    public async Task<IList<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel>> GetActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels(IEnumerable<Guid> channelIdentifiers)
    {
        await _monitoringApiClient.AuthnticateClient(_monitoringAuthClient, authEndpoint, apiKey, tenantCode);
        string endpoint = $"api/consumption/ActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels";

        var result = await _monitoringApiClient.PostAsync<List<Guid>, IList<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel>>(endpoint, channelIdentifiers.ToList());
        if (result == null)
        {
            logger.LogError("{endpoint}: null result from API call.", nameof(GetActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels));
            return [];
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    public async Task<IList<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel>> GetActualMonthlyMainMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels(IEnumerable<int> channelIdentifiers)
    {
        await _monitoringApiClient.AuthnticateClient(_monitoringAuthClient, authEndpoint, apiKey, tenantCode);
        string endpoint = $"api/consumption/ActualMonthlyMainMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels";

        var result = await _monitoringApiClient.PostAsync<List<int>, IList<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel>>(endpoint, channelIdentifiers.ToList());
        if (result == null)
        {
            logger.LogError("{endpoint}: null result from API call.", nameof(GetActualMonthlyMainMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels));
            return [];
        }
        return result;
    }


}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Helpers;

public class LayoutParameters
{
    public List<string> OutsideDivAttributes { get; set; } = [];
    public List<string> RowDivAttributes { get; set; } = [];
    public List<string> ColDivAttributes { get; set; } = [];
    public string LabelTag {get; set; } = "mat-label";
    public List<string> LabelAttributes { get; set; } = [];
    public string ValueTag {get; set; } = "span";
    public List<string> ValueAttributes { get; set; } = [];

    public int MaxColsInRow { get; set; } = 12; // Assuming a 12-column grid system like Bootstrap
    public int ColSizeDefault { get; set; } = 6; // Default column size for each item if not specified, and only a single column is in the row
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Interfaces;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Helpers;

public record HeaderRowItem(string Label, string Value, string? Group = null, int? GrpOrder = null/*, int ColSpan = 1*/); //TODO: ColSpan kezelése egyéb attribútummal

public static class PdfFlexibleHeaderHelper
{
    public static List<List<HeaderRowItem>> GenerateFlexibleHeader<THeaderModel>(THeaderModel model) where THeaderModel : IPdfHeaderModel
    {
        var modelType = typeof(THeaderModel);
        List<PropertyInfo> propsWithDisplayAttr = modelType
            .GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)
            .Where(p => p.CanRead && p.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>() != null)
            .ToList();

        List<HeaderRowItem> allItems = [];
        foreach (var prop in propsWithDisplayAttr)
        {
            var displayAttr = prop.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>();
            var label = displayAttr?.Name ?? prop.Name;
            var value = prop.GetValue(model)?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
            var displayGroup = displayAttr?.GetGroupName();
            int? order = displayAttr?.GetOrder();
            //TODO: a colspanra valami egyedi attribútum lesz szükséges

            allItems.Add(new HeaderRowItem(label, value, displayGroup, order/*, colspan: 1*/));
        }

        //TODO: when the item has groupname, then the tems should be grouped together (appear in same row),
        //otherwise, every item comes in a new row. but we must keep the original order of properties.
        //if grouped, then order by GrpOrder inside of group, if specified

        // Map property name to its index in the class definition for stable ordering
        var propOrderMap = propsWithDisplayAttr
            .Select((p, idx) => new { p.Name, idx })
            .ToDictionary(x => x.Name, x => x.idx);

        // Prepare a buffer for each group and for ungrouped items, with their class index
        var groupBuffers = new Dictionary<string, List<(HeaderRowItem item, int classIndex, int? grpOrder)>>();
        var ungroupedItems = new List<(HeaderRowItem item, int classIndex)>();

        for (int i = 0; i < allItems.Count; i++)
        {
            var item = allItems[i];
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Group))
            {
                if (!groupBuffers.ContainsKey(item.Group!))
                    groupBuffers[item.Group!] = [];
                groupBuffers[item.Group!].Add((item, i, item.GrpOrder));
            }
            else
            {
                ungroupedItems.Add((item, i));
            }
        }

        // Build the final rows in the order of property definition
        var headerItems = new List<List<HeaderRowItem>>();
        var handledGroups = new HashSet<string>();

        foreach (var prop in propsWithDisplayAttr)
        {
            var item = allItems.First(x => x.Label == (prop.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? prop.Name));
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Group))
            {
                if (!handledGroups.Contains(item.Group!))
                {
                    // Add the whole group row, ordered by GrpOrder then class index
                    var groupRow = groupBuffers[item.Group!]
                        .OrderBy(x => x.grpOrder ?? int.MaxValue)
                        .ThenBy(x => x.classIndex)
                        .Select(x => x.item)
                        .ToList();
                    headerItems.Add(groupRow);
                    handledGroups.Add(item.Group!);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Add ungrouped item as a single row
                headerItems.Add([item]);
            }
        }

        return headerItems;
    }


    public static string RenderFlexibleHeader(List<List<HeaderRowItem>> modelData, LayoutParameters layoutParameters)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(layoutParameters, nameof(layoutParameters));
        if (layoutParameters.MaxColsInRow < 1)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(layoutParameters.MaxColsInRow), "MaxColsInRow must be at least 1.");
        }
        layoutParameters.ColDivAttributes ??= []; //safe init
        string? columnClassAttribute = layoutParameters.ColDivAttributes.FirstOrDefault(x => x.StartsWith("class=", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
        List<string> classes = columnClassAttribute?.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).ToList() ?? [];
        string? colSizeClassGiven = classes.FirstOrDefault(x => Regex.IsMatch(x, @"col-(\d+)")); //meg volt adva class-ban? -> lehet alapértelmezettként használni, de felül is kell bírálni majd

        /* var sampleHtml = """
<div fxLayout="row" fxFlexFill fxLayout.lt-sm="column" fxLayoutGap="16px">
	<div class="row">
		<div class="col-6">
			<mat-label class="control-label">Intézmény</mat-label>
			<span>Teszt Intézmény</span>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div class="row">
		<div class="col-4">
			<mat-label class="control-label">Adatsor kezdete</mat-label>
			<span>2025-07-29 00:00:00</span>
		</div>
		<div class="col-4">
			<mat-label class="control-label">Adatsor vége</mat-label>
			<span>2025-07-29 16:55:00</span>
		</div>
		<div class="col-4">
			<mat-label class="control-label">Gyakoriság</mat-label>
			<span>5 perc</span>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div class="row">
		<div class="col-6">
			<mat-label class="control-label">Mértékegység</mat-label>
			<span>TestUnit</span>
		</div>
	</div>
</div>
         """;*/


        StringBuilder sb = new();

        // Build outside div with attributes
        sb.Append("<div");
        if (layoutParameters.OutsideDivAttributes != null && layoutParameters.OutsideDivAttributes.Count > 0)
        {
            foreach (var attr in layoutParameters.OutsideDivAttributes)
            {
                sb.Append(' ').Append(attr);
            }
        }
        sb.AppendLine(">");

        // Each row
        foreach (var row in modelData)
        {
            sb.Append("<div");
            if (layoutParameters.RowDivAttributes != null && layoutParameters.RowDivAttributes.Count > 0)
            {
                foreach (var attr in layoutParameters.RowDivAttributes)
                {
                    sb.Append(' ').Append(attr);
                }
            }
            sb.Append('>');

            // Each column in row
            int colCount = row.Count;

            // Calculate the appropriate column size for this row
            int calculatedColSize = CalculateColumnSize(colCount, layoutParameters.MaxColsInRow, layoutParameters.ColSizeDefault);
            string newColClass = $"col-{calculatedColSize}";

            // Create a copy of ColDivAttributes for this row with updated column class
            List<string> rowColAttributes = new List<string>(layoutParameters.ColDivAttributes ?? []);
            UpdateColumnClassInAttributes(rowColAttributes, newColClass);

            foreach (var item in row)
            {
                sb.Append("<div");
                if (rowColAttributes.Count > 0)
                {
                    foreach (var attr in rowColAttributes)
                    {
                        sb.Append(' ').Append(attr);
                    }
                }
                sb.Append('>');

                // Label
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(layoutParameters.LabelTag))
                {
                    sb.Append('<').Append(layoutParameters.LabelTag);
                    if (layoutParameters.LabelAttributes != null && layoutParameters.LabelAttributes.Count > 0)
                    {
                        foreach (var attr in layoutParameters.LabelAttributes)
                        {
                            sb.Append(' ').Append(attr);
                        }
                    }
                    sb.Append('>');
                    sb.Append(item.Label);
                    sb.Append("</").Append(layoutParameters.LabelTag).Append('>');
                }

                // Value
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(layoutParameters.ValueTag))
                {
                    sb.Append('<').Append(layoutParameters.ValueTag);
                    if (layoutParameters.ValueAttributes != null && layoutParameters.ValueAttributes.Count > 0)
                    {
                        foreach (var attr in layoutParameters.ValueAttributes)
                        {
                            sb.Append(' ').Append(attr);
                        }
                    }
                    sb.Append('>');
                    sb.Append(item.Value);
                    sb.Append("</").Append(layoutParameters.ValueTag).Append('>');
                }

                sb.Append("</div>"); // end col
            }

            sb.AppendLine("</div>"); // end row
        }

        sb.AppendLine("</div>"); // end outside

        return sb.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the appropriate Bootstrap column size based on the number of columns in a row
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="colCount">Number of columns in the current row</param>
    /// <param name="maxCols">Maximum columns in the grid system (default: 12)</param>
    /// <param name="defaultSize">Default column size for single columns</param>
    /// <returns>Calculated column size</returns>
    private static int CalculateColumnSize(int colCount, int maxCols, int defaultSize)
    {
        if (colCount <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(colCount), "Column count must be greater than 0.");

        if (maxCols <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maxCols), "Max columns must be greater than 0.");

        // For single column, use the default size
        if (colCount == 1)
            return defaultSize;

        // Calculate equal distribution
        int calculatedSize = maxCols / colCount;

        // Ensure we don't go below 1
        return Math.Max(1, calculatedSize);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Extracts the existing column size from a Bootstrap class string
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="classAttribute">The class attribute string (e.g., "class=\"row col-6 custom-class\"")</param>
    /// <returns>The existing column size number, or null if not found</returns>
    private static int? ExtractColumnSizeFromClass(string classAttribute)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(classAttribute))
            return null;

        var match = Regex.Match(classAttribute, @"col-(\d+)", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
        if (match.Success && int.TryParse(match.Groups[1].Value, out int size))
        {
            return size;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the column class in the ColDivAttributes list
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="attributes">The list of div attributes</param>
    /// <param name="newColClass">The new column class (e.g., "col-4")</param>
    private static void UpdateColumnClassInAttributes(List<string> attributes, string newColClass)
    {
        if (attributes == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(newColClass))
            return;

        // Find the class attribute
        int classAttrIndex = -1;
        string? classAttribute = null;

        for (int i = 0; i < attributes.Count; i++)
        {
            if (attributes[i].StartsWith("class=", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
            {
                classAttrIndex = i;
                classAttribute = attributes[i];
                break;
            }
        }

        if (classAttribute != null)
        {
            // Extract the class value from the attribute (handle both quoted and unquoted)
            var classMatch = Regex.Match(classAttribute, @"class\s*=\s*[""']?([^""']*)[""']?", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
            if (classMatch.Success)
            {
                string classValue = classMatch.Groups[1].Value;
                List<string> classes = classValue.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).ToList();

                // Remove existing col-X classes
                classes.RemoveAll(c => Regex.IsMatch(c, @"col-\d+", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase));

                // Add the new column class
                classes.Add(newColClass);

                // Rebuild the class attribute
                string newClassValue = string.Join(" ", classes);
                string newClassAttribute = $"class=\"{newClassValue}\"";
                attributes[classAttrIndex] = newClassAttribute;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // No class attribute exists, create a new one
            attributes.Add($"class=\"{newColClass}\"");
        }
    }
}

using Common.Pdf.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Services;

/// <summary>
/// PdfGenerator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Interfaces.IPdfGenerator" />
public class PdfGenerator : IPdfGenerator
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the content of the HTML.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The content of the HTML.
    /// </value>
    private string? HtmlContent { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The template service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ITemplateService _templateService;

    /// <summary>
    /// The model
    /// </summary>
    private readonly PdfTableModel _model = new()
    {
        Header = [],
        Data = [],
        BasicData = new PdfBasicDataModel(),
        MonitoringHeader = new PdfMonitoringHeaderModel(),
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PdfGenerator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="templateService">The template service.</param>
    public PdfGenerator(ITemplateService templateService)
    {
        _templateService = templateService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the header.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="header">The header.</param>
    public void SetHeader(IList<string> header)
    {
        _model.Header = header;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the row.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    public void AddRow(IList<string> row)
    {
        _model.Data.Add(row);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the basic data.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="basicdata"></param>
    public void SetBasicData(PdfBasicDataModel basicdata)
    {
        _model.BasicData = basicdata;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the monitoring basic data.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="monitoringHeaderData"></param>
    public void SetMonitoringHeader(PdfMonitoringHeaderModel monitoringHeaderData)
    {
        _model.MonitoringHeader = monitoringHeaderData;
    }

    //public void SetFlexiblePdfHeader(IPdfHeaderModel pdfHeaderData)
    //{
    //    _model.FlexiblePdfHeader = pdfHeaderData;
    //}
    public void SetFlexiblePdfHeaderHtmlStr(string htmlString)
    {
        _model.FlexiblePdfHeaderHtmlStr = htmlString;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the multi-row header and an optional caption for the model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="multiRowHeaderCells">A list of lists containing the header rows to be set. Each inner list represents a row of header values.</param>
    /// <param name="caption">An optional caption for the multi-row header. Can be <see langword="null"/> if no caption is desired.</param>
    public void SetMultiRowHeaderTable(List<List<string>> multiRowHeaderCells, string? caption = null)
    {
        _model.MultiRowHeaderTable = multiRowHeaderCells;
        _model.MultiRowHeaderTableCaption = caption;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the content.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="html">The HTML.</param>
    public void SetContent(string html)
    {
        HtmlContent = html;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the chart image.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="chartImage">The chart image.</param>
    public void SetChartImage(string chartImage)
    {
        _model.Chart = chartImage;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generates the asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="settings">The settings.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<Stream?> GenerateAsync(PdfGeneratorSettings? settings = null)
    {
        string html = string.Empty;
        settings ??= new PdfGeneratorSettings
        {
            Format = PaperFormat.A4,
            Landscape = true,
            PrintBackground = true,
            MarginOptions = {
                Top = "2cm",
                Bottom = "2cm",
                Left = "1cm",
                Right = "1cm"
            }
        };

        settings.Format ??= PaperFormat.A4;

        if (CheckModel(_model.BasicData))
            html = HtmlContent ?? await _templateService.RenderAsync("PdfTableModel", _model);
        else if (CheckModel(_model.MonitoringHeader))
            html = HtmlContent ?? await _templateService.RenderAsync("PdfMonitoringTableModel", _model);
        if (_model.MultiRowHeaderTable?.Count > 0)
        {
            html = HtmlContent ?? await _templateService.RenderAsync("PdfMultiTableModel", _model);
            //TODO: egyelőre csak a fejléc többsoros táblázatát kezeljük, a nagy táblázat még nem bontódik fel több kisebb táblázatra (pl. mérési pontonként)
#if DEBUG
            //if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(html) && System.Diagnostics.Debugger.IsAttached)
            //{
            //    //save to file for debug
            //    string tmpFilePath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"pdfhtml_tmp_{Guid.NewGuid():D}.html");
            //    File.WriteAllText(tmpFilePath, html);
            //}
#endif
        }

        var pdfGeneratorApi = ApiHelper.PuppeteerApi();

        var pdfFile = await pdfGeneratorApi.PdfGenerator_GenerateAsync(new Modules.Puppeteer.PdfGeneratorModel()
        {
            Html = html,
            Settings = new Modules.Puppeteer.PdfGeneratorSettings()
            {
                Scale = (double)settings.Scale,
                DisplayHeaderFooter = settings.DisplayHeaderFooter,
                HeaderTemplate = settings.HeaderTemplate,
                FooterTemplate = settings.FooterTemplate,
                PrintBackground = settings.PrintBackground,
                Landscape = settings.Landscape,
                PageRanges = settings.PageRanges,
                Format = new Modules.Puppeteer.PaperFormat()
                {
                    Height = (double)settings.Format.Height,
                    Width = (double)settings.Format.Width,
                },
                MarginOptions = new Modules.Puppeteer.MarginOptions()
                {
                    Bottom = settings.MarginOptions?.Bottom,
                    Left = settings.MarginOptions?.Left,
                    Top = settings.MarginOptions?.Top,
                    Right = settings.MarginOptions?.Right,
                },
                PreferCSSPageSize = settings.PreferCSSPageSize,
                OmitBackground = settings.OmitBackground,
            }
        });

        return new MemoryStream(pdfFile);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private bool CheckModel(object model)
    {
        return model.GetType().GetProperties()
      .Where(pi => pi.PropertyType == typeof(string))
      .Select(pi => (string)pi.GetValue(model))
      .Any(value => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value));
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Views;
using RazorLight;
using PdfTableModel = EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Models.PdfTableModel;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Services;

/// <summary>
/// RazorViewsTemplateService
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Interfaces.ITemplateService" />
public class RazorViewsTemplateService : ITemplateService
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the engine.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The engine.
    /// </value>
    private RazorLightEngine Engine { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The template key
    /// </summary>
    private const string TemplateKey = nameof(PdfTableModel);

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RazorViewsTemplateService"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public RazorViewsTemplateService()
    {
        Engine = new RazorLightEngineBuilder()
            .EnableDebugMode()
            .UseEmbeddedResourcesProject(typeof(ViewsResourceReference))
            .UseMemoryCachingProvider()
            .Build();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Renders the asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TViewModel">The type of the view model.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="filename">The filename.</param>
    /// <param name="viewModel">The view model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<string> RenderAsync<TViewModel>(string filename, TViewModel viewModel)
    {
        var cacheResult = Engine.Handler.Cache.RetrieveTemplate(TemplateKey);
        if (!cacheResult.Success)
            return await Engine.CompileRenderAsync(filename, viewModel);

        var templatePage = cacheResult.Template.TemplatePageFactory();
        return await Engine.RenderTemplateAsync(templatePage, viewModel);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Compiles the render string asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="content">The content.</param>
    /// <param name="param">The parameter.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<string> CompileRenderStringAsync(string key, string content, string param)
    {
        return await Engine.CompileRenderStringAsync(key, content, new { Param = param });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Compiles the render string asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="content">The content.</param>
    /// <param name="param">The parameter.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<string> CompileRenderStringAsync(string key, string content, object parameters)
    {
        //dynamic expando = new ExpandoObject();
        //var dict = (IDictionary<string, object>)expando;
        //foreach (var prop in parameters.GetType().GetProperties())
        //{
        //    dict.Add(prop.Name, prop.GetValue(parameters));
        //}

        return await Engine.CompileRenderStringAsync(key, content, parameters);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generikus megoldás
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<string> CompileRenderStringAsync<TModel>(string templateStr, TModel model)
    {
        string key = model.GetType().FullName;
        return await Engine.CompileRenderStringAsync(key, templateStr, model);
    }
}

using Autofac;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Services;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Wireup;

// Ez automatikusan regisztrálásra kerül abban a projektben, ahol a PDF-gen be van hivatkozva.
// A RazorViewsTemplateService megfelelő működéséhez, a futtató projekt .csproj fájlában be kell állítani az alábbit:
// <PropertyGroup>
//     <PreserveCompilationContext>true</PreserveCompilationContext>
// </PropertyGroup>
public class AutofacPdfGenerator : Module
{
    /// <summary>Override to add registrations to the container.</summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder through which components can be
    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.</remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        // Puppeteer
        builder.RegisterType<RazorViewsTemplateService>().As<ITemplateService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<PdfGenerator>().As<IPdfGenerator>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<ReportResultPdfGenerator>().As<IReportResultPdfGenerator>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Serilog;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Log = Common.Logic.Logging.Log;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Controllers;
using Common.WebAPI.ErrorHandler;
using Common.WebAPI.Extensions;
using Common.WebAPI.Filters;
using Autofac.Core;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Services;

var allowSpecificOrigins = "_allowSpecificOrigins";

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Host.UseSerilog((context, configuration) => configuration.ReadFrom.Configuration(context.Configuration));

ConfigureConfiguration(builder.Configuration);

// Add services to the container.

builder.Services.AddControllers();
// Learn more about configuring Swagger/OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/swashbuckle
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.Configure<RouteOptions>(options => options.LowercaseUrls = true);
builder.Services.AddCustomizedSwagger(nameof(EnergiaMenedzsment), c =>
{
    c.DocumentFilter<SwaggerDocumentFilter>();
});

builder.Services.AddHealthChecks();


builder.Services.AddSingleton<IPuppeteerService, PuppeteerService>();

builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy(name: allowSpecificOrigins,
        corsBuilder =>
        {
            corsBuilder.WithOrigins(builder.Configuration["AccessControlAllowOrigin"].Split(',')).SetIsOriginAllowedToAllowWildcardSubdomains()
                   .AllowAnyHeader()
                   .AllowAnyMethod();
        });
});

var app = builder.Build();

app.Lifetime.ApplicationStopping.Register(OnShutdown);

app.UseCustomizedSwagger(builder.Configuration);

app.MapHealthChecks("/api/healthcheck");

app.UseMiddleware<ExceptionMiddleware>();

app.UseRouting();

app.UseCors(allowSpecificOrigins);

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.MapControllers();

Log.LogInfo($"EnergiaMenedzsment Puppeteer WebAPI - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(PdfGeneratorController))} started");
app.Run();

void ConfigureConfiguration(ConfigurationManager configuration)
{
    var cultureInfo = new CultureInfo("hu-HU");

    CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = cultureInfo;
    CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = cultureInfo;

    Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
    Config.LocalProvider ??= new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);
};

void OnShutdown()
{
    Log.LogInfo($"EnergiaMenedzsment Puppeteer WebAPI - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(PdfGeneratorController))} stopped");
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using PuppeteerSharp;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// DiagramGeneratorController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class DiagramGeneratorController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILogger<PdfGeneratorController> _logger;
    /// <summary>
    /// The puppeteer service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IPuppeteerService _puppeteerService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DiagramGeneratorController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    /// <param name="puppeteerService">The puppeteer service.</param>
    public DiagramGeneratorController(ILogger<PdfGeneratorController> logger,
        IPuppeteerService puppeteerService)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _puppeteerService = puppeteerService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generates the specified model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("generate", Name = "DiagramGenerator_Generate")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "DiagramGenerator_Generate")]
    public async Task<byte[]> Generate([FromBody] DiagramModel model)
    {
        try
        {
            var browser = await _puppeteerService.GetBrowserAsync();

            await using var page = await browser.NewPageAsync();
            await page.SetContentAsync(model.Html, new NavigationOptions() { WaitUntil = new WaitUntilNavigation[] { WaitUntilNavigation.DOMContentLoaded } });

            var chart = await page.QuerySelectorAsync("#chart");

            var diagramImage = await chart.ScreenshotStreamAsync(new ScreenshotOptions
            {
                Type = ScreenshotType.Png
            });

            using (MemoryStream ms = new MemoryStream())
            {
                await diagramImage.CopyToAsync(ms);
                return ms.ToArray();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "DiagramGenerator Error");
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            _puppeteerService.ReleaseSemaphore();
        }
    }
}

====================================================================================================

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Pdf.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cors;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ModelBinding;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using PuppeteerSharp;
using PuppeteerSharp.Media;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// PdfGeneratorController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class PdfGeneratorController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILogger<PdfGeneratorController> _logger;
    /// <summary>
    /// The puppeteer service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IPuppeteerService _puppeteerService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PdfGeneratorController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    /// <param name="puppeteerService">The puppeteer service.</param>
    public PdfGeneratorController(ILogger<PdfGeneratorController> logger,
        IPuppeteerService puppeteerService)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _puppeteerService = puppeteerService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generates the specified model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost("generate", Name = "PdfGenerator_Generate")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "PdfGenerator_Generate")]
    public async Task<byte[]> Generate([FromBody] PdfGeneratorModel model)
    {
        var settings = model.Settings ?? new PdfGeneratorSettings
        {
            Format = PaperFormat.A4,
            Landscape = true,
            PrintBackground = true,
            MarginOptions = {
                Top = "2cm",
                Bottom = "2cm",
                Left = "1cm",
                Right = "1cm"
            }
        };

        try
        {
            var browser = await _puppeteerService.GetBrowserAsync();

            await using var page = await browser.NewPageAsync();
            await page.EmulateMediaTypeAsync(MediaType.Screen);
            await page.SetContentAsync(model.Html);

            var pdfContent = await page.PdfStreamAsync(new PdfOptions
            {
                Scale = settings.Scale,
                DisplayHeaderFooter = settings.DisplayHeaderFooter,
                HeaderTemplate = settings.HeaderTemplate,
                FooterTemplate = settings.FooterTemplate,
                PrintBackground = settings.PrintBackground,
                Landscape = settings.Landscape,
                PageRanges = settings.PageRanges,
                Format = settings.Format,
                MarginOptions = settings.MarginOptions,
                PreferCSSPageSize = settings.PreferCSSPageSize,
                OmitBackground = settings.OmitBackground,
            });

            using (MemoryStream ms = new MemoryStream())
            {
                await pdfContent.CopyToAsync(ms);
                return ms.ToArray();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "PdfGenerator Error");
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            _puppeteerService.ReleaseSemaphore();
        }
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI\Services\PuppeteerService.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using PuppeteerSharp;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Services;

/// <summary>
/// PuppeteerService
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI.Services.IPuppeteerService" />
/// <seealso cref="System.IDisposable" />
public class PuppeteerService : IPuppeteerService, IDisposable
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The semaphore
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(Config.GetIntValue("SemaphoreInitialCount"), Config.GetIntValue("SemaphoreInitialCount"));
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the browser.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The browser.
    /// </value>
    private IBrowser Browser { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PuppeteerService"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public PuppeteerService()
    {
        Browser = PuppeteerSharp.Puppeteer.LaunchAsync(
                   new LaunchOptions
                   {
                       Headless = true,
                       ExecutablePath = Config.GetStringValue("ChromeBinPath", true),
                       Args = new string[] { "--no-sandbox", "--disable-setuid-sandbox" }
                   }
               ).Result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the browser asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<IBrowser> GetBrowserAsync()
    {
        await _semaphore.WaitAsync();
        return Browser;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Releases the semaphore.
    /// </summary>
    public void ReleaseSemaphore()
    {
        _semaphore.Release();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Performs application-defined tasks associated with freeing, releasing, or resetting unmanaged resources.
    /// </summary>
    public void Dispose()
    {
        Browser.Dispose();
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// 
/// </summary>
public interface IPuppeteerService
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the browser asynchronous.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    Task<IBrowser> GetBrowserAsync();
    /// <summary>
    /// Releases the semaphore.
    /// </summary>
    void ReleaseSemaphore();
}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Attributes;

/// <summary>
/// EntityCodeAttribute
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="System.Attribute" />
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property | AttributeTargets.Field)]
public class EntityCodeAttribute : Attribute
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EntityCodeAttribute"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code">The code.</param>
    public EntityCodeAttribute(string code)
    {
        Code = code;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The code.
    /// </value>
    public string? Code { get; set; }

    public static string? Get(object enm)
    {
        if (enm == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(enm.ToString()))
            return null;

        var memberInfos = enm?.GetType().GetMember(enm.ToString()!);
        if (memberInfos is not { Length: > 0 })
            return null;
        
        if (GetCustomAttribute(
                memberInfos[0],
                typeof(EntityCodeAttribute)) is EntityCodeAttribute attr)
        {
            return attr.Code;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;

/// <summary>
/// Kódtár Cache
/// </summary>
public class TenantDictCache : DictCache<DictEntityDto, DictItemEntityDto>
{
    public TenantDictCache() : base()
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jelenlegi kódtár cache
    /// </summary>
    public static TenantDictCache? Current => AutofacScope.Global.Resolve<DictCache<DictEntityDto, DictItemEntityDto>>() as TenantDictCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// Kódtár lekérése a kód alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictCode">A kódtár Code mező értéke.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public DictEntityDto? GetDictByCode(ILifetimeScope scope, string dictCode)
    {
        return GetContent(scope).SingleOrDefault(x => x.Code == dictCode);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy kódtár elemeinek lekérése listatípus alapján, értékük szerint növekvő sorrendbe rendezve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictType">A kódtárentitás típusa.</param>
    /// <param name="onlyNonDeleted">Amennyiben az érték igaz, csak a nem törölt kódtárelemekkel térünk vissza. 
    /// Amennyiben minden, az adott típushoz tartozó kódtárelemmel vissza szeretnénk térni, adjunk át hamis értéket.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IEnumerable<DictItemEntityDto>? GetItems(ILifetimeScope scope, DictType dictType, bool onlyNonDeleted = true)
    {
        if (onlyNonDeleted)
            return GetDictByCode(scope, DictCodeAttribute.Get(dictType))?.Items?.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).OrderBy(x => x.Value).OfType<DictItemEntityDto>();
        else
            return GetDictByCode(scope, DictCodeAttribute.Get(dictType))?.Items?.OrderBy(x => x.Value).OfType<DictItemEntityDto>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy konkrét kódtárelem lekérdezése a listatípus, és az elem kódja alapján. Ha nem találtunk a feltételeknek
    /// megfelelő kódtárelemet, akkor null visszatérési értékkel térünk vissza.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictType">A kódtárentitás típusa</param>
    /// <param name="dictItemCode">A kódtárelem Code mező értéke.</param>
    /// <param name="onlyNonDeleted">Amennyiben az érték igaz, csak a nem törölt kódtárelemekkel térünk vissza. 
    /// Amennyiben minden, az adott típushoz tartozó kódtárelemmel vissza szeretnénk térni, adjunk át hamis értéket.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public DictItemEntityDto? GetItem(ILifetimeScope scope, DictType dictType, string dictItemCode, bool onlyNonDeleted = true)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dictItemCode))
            return null;

        if (onlyNonDeleted)
            return GetDictByCode(scope, DictCodeAttribute.Get(dictType))?.Items?.FirstOrDefault(x => !x.IsDeleted && x.Code == dictItemCode);
        else
            return GetDictByCode(scope, DictCodeAttribute.Get(dictType))?.Items?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == dictItemCode);
    }
}
