using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Caching;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using System.Globalization;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Ország cache
/// </summary>
public class CountryCache : CoreEntityCache<CountryEntityDto>
{
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Konstruktor
    /// </summary>
    public CountryCache(IMapper mapper) : base(DefaultKeepPeriod)
    {
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jelenlegi kódtár cache
    /// </summary>
    public static CountryCache Current => AutofacScope.Global.Resolve<CountryCache>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Ország lekérése iso3 kód alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="iso3"></param>
    public CountryEntityDto? GetByCode(string iso3)
    {
        return GetContent().SingleOrDefault(x => x.ISO3 == iso3);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ország lekérése ID alapján
    /// </summary>
    public CountryEntityDto? GetById(int id)
    {
        return GetContent().SingleOrDefault(x => x.Id == id);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ország EntityRef elemek lekérése
    /// </summary>
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>> GetCountryEntityRefItems()
    {
        return GetContent().OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Országok lekérése select list-hez
    /// </summary>
    public IEnumerable<SelectListItemDto> GetCountrySelectListItems()
    {
        return GetContent().OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(_mapper.Map<SelectListItemDto>);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Országok EntityRef-es lekérése úgy, hogy Magyarország mindig az első az elemek között!
    /// </summary>
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>> GetCountryEntityRefItemsHungaryIsFirst(string search = "")
    {
        if (search == null) search = string.Empty;
        return GetContent().Where(x => x!.Name!.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture).StartsWith(search.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)))
            .OrderBy(x => x.ISO3 != "HU").ThenBy(x => x.Name).Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>);

        // Miért az (x.ISO3 != "HU") kiértékelés?  
        // "The expression evaluates to false for the item we want first and true for all other items. 
        //  Ordering by a boolean has the false value (our item) first then the true value (all others) after."
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Külföldi ország EntityRef elemek lekérése
    /// </summary>
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>> GetForeignCountryEntityRefItems(string search = "")
    {
        if (search == null) search = string.Empty;
        return GetContent().Where(x => x.ISO3 != "HU" && x.Name!.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture).StartsWith(search.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)))
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az adott ország Magyarország-e?
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsMagyarorszag(int? orszagId)
    {
        if (orszagId == null || orszagId.Value <= 0)
            return false;

        var orszagEntityDto = GetById(orszagId.Value);
        if (orszagEntityDto == null)
            return false;

        return orszagEntityDto.IsHungary;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Caching;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;
using System.Globalization;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Település cache
/// </summary>
public class SettlementCache : CoreEntityCache<SettlementEntityDto>
{
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Konstruktor
    /// </summary>
    public SettlementCache(IMapper mapper) : base(DefaultKeepPeriod)
    {
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Település lekérése kód alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code"></param>
    public SettlementEntityDto? GetByCode(string code)
    {
        return GetContent().SingleOrDefault(x => x.Code == code);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Település lekérése ID alapján
    /// </summary>
    public SettlementEntityDto? GetById(int id)
    {
        return GetContent().SingleOrDefault(x => x.Id == id);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Település EntityRef elemek lekérése search filter alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="search"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>> GetSettlementEntityRefItems(string search = "", bool limited = true)
    {
        if (search == null) search = string.Empty;
        if (limited)
            return GetContent()
            .Where(x => x.Name
                            .ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                            .Contains(search.ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                  ).OrderBy(x => x.Name).SelectListItemLimit().Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>>);
        else
            return GetContent()
            .Where(x => x.Name
                            .ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                            .Contains(search.ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                  ).OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>>);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Település EntityRef elemek lekérése megye ID alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="megyeId"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>> GetSettlementEntityRefItemsByCounty(int? megyeId)
    {
        if (megyeId.HasValue && megyeId.Value != 0)
            return GetContent().Where(x => x.County.Id == megyeId).OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>>);
        else
            return GetContent().OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>>);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Települések lekérése megye ID alapján select list-hez
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="megyeId"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IEnumerable<SelectListItemDto> GetSettlementEntitiesByCounty(int? megyeId)
    {
        if (megyeId.HasValue && megyeId.Value != 0)
            return GetContent().Where(x => x.County.Id == megyeId).OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(x => _mapper.Map<SelectListItemDto>(x));
        else
            return GetContent().OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(x => _mapper.Map<SelectListItemDto>(x));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Összes Település lekérése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IEnumerable<SettlementEntityDto> GetAllSettlementEntityDto()
    {
        return GetContent().OrderBy(x => x.Name);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Település lekérése név alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="nev"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public SettlementEntityDto GetByName(string nev)
    {
        return GetContent().Where(x => x.Name.Equals(nev, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
            .SingleEx($"{nev} nevű település nem található.",
                $"{nev} nem eredményezett egyértelmű találatot.",
                "", null);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Település EntityRef elemek lekérése search filter és település id-k alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="search"></param>
    /// <param name="telepulesIds"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>> GetSettlementRefsBySearchAndIds(string search = "", int[] telepulesIds = null)
    {
        if (search == null) search = string.Empty;

        if (telepulesIds == null || !telepulesIds.Any())
            return GetContent()
            .Where(x => x.Name
                            .ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                            .Contains(search.ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)))
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name).SelectListItemLimit().Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>>);
        else
            return GetContent()
                .Where(x => x.Name
                            .ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                            .Contains(search.ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)) && telepulesIds.Contains(x.Id))
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name).SelectListItemLimit().Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>>);
    }

}

using Common.Logic.Caching;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Locations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Település irányítószáma
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Caching.CoreEntityCache&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations.SettlementZipCodeEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SettlementZipCodeCache: CoreEntityCache<SettlementZipCodeEntityDto>
{

    /// <summary>
    /// A település irányítószámának kinyerés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="zipCodeSearch">The zip code search.</param>
    /// <param name="settlement">The settlement.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<DictItemEntityDto>> GetZipCodeItemsBySettlement(string zipCodeSearch = "", string settlement = null)
    {
        var result = this.GetContent() as IEnumerable<SettlementZipCodeEntityDto>;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(settlement))
            result = result.Where(x => x.Settlement == settlement);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(zipCodeSearch))
            result = result.Where(x => x.ZipCode.StartsWith(zipCodeSearch));
        return result.DistinctBy(x => x.ZipCode).OrderBy(x => x.ZipCode).Select(x => new EntityRef<DictItemEntityDto>()
        {
            EntityDisplayName = x.ZipCode,
            Id = x.ZipCodeId
        }).Distinct();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the settlement items by zip code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="settlementSearch">The settlement search.</param>
    /// <param name="zipCode">The zip code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>> GetSettlementItemsByZipCode(string settlementSearch = "", string? zipCode = null)
    {
        var result = this.GetContent() as IEnumerable<SettlementZipCodeEntityDto>;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(zipCode))
            result = result.Where(x => x.ZipCode == zipCode);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(settlementSearch))
            result = result.Where(x => x.Settlement.ToLower().Contains(settlementSearch.ToLower()));
        return result.DistinctBy(x => x.Settlement).OrderBy(x => x.Settlement).Select(x => new EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>()
        {
            EntityDisplayName = x.Settlement,
            Id = x.SettlementId
        });
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IEntityQuery<SettlementZipCodeEntityDto> GetQuery()
    {
        return new SettlementZipCodeCacheEntityQuery();
    }
}

    /// <summary>

    /// <summary>
    /// Közterület jelleg lekérése ID alapján
    /// </summary>
    public StreetSuffixEntityDto? GetById(int id)
    {
        return GetContent().SingleOrDefault(x => x.Id == id);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Közterület jelleg EntityRef elemek lekérése
    /// </summary>
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>> GetStreetSuffixEntityRefItems()
    {
        return GetContent().OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>>);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Közterület jellegok lekérése select list-hez
    /// </summary>
    public IEnumerable<SelectListItemDto> GetStreetSuffixSelectListItems()
    {
        return GetContent().OrderBy(x => x.Name).Select(_mapper.Map<SelectListItemDto>);
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared\Caching\Security\RoleCache.cs
====================================================================================================

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Caching;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Security;

/// <summary>
/// SecRole cache
/// </summary>
public class RoleCache : CoreEntityCache<SecRoleEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Konstruktor
    /// </summary>
    public RoleCache() : base(DefaultKeepPeriod)
    {

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkör lekérdezés kód alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public SecRoleEntityDto? GetRoleByCode(IComponentContext context, string code)
    {
        var secRoleEntity = GetContent(context).SingleOrDefault(x => x.RoleCode == code);
        return secRoleEntity;
    }

    public SecRoleEntityDto? GetRoleByType(IComponentContext context, SecRoleType secRoleType)
    {
        return GetContent(context).FirstOrDefault(x => x!.SecRoleType == secRoleType);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkör kód vagy a szerepkör típusa alapján visszaad egy szerepkört
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context"></param>
    /// <param name="code"></param>
    /// <param name="secRoleType"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public SecRoleEntityDto? GetRoleByCodeOrType(IComponentContext context, string? code, SecRoleType? secRoleType)
    {
        List<SecRoleEntityDto> secRoles = new List<SecRoleEntityDto>();
        secRoles = GetContent(context).ToList();

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
            secRoles = secRoles
                .Where(x => x.RoleCode == code).ToList();

        if (secRoleType != null)
            secRoles = secRoles
                .Where(x => x.SecRoleType == secRoleType.Value).ToList();
        
        if(!secRoles.Any())
            return null;

        return secRoles.SingleOrDefault();
    }

}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.Shared.Entities;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Consumption;

/// <summary>
/// Az almérők fogyasztási méréseit feldolgozott formában, napra aggregálva tartalmazó DTO
/// </summary>
[DataContract]
public class NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntityDto : EntityDtoBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A mérés időpontja, vagy a mérés végdátuma (azaz az összesítés időpontja) UTC-ben
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Mérés időpontja")]
    public DateTime MeasuredAtUtc { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// channel identifier.
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Csatorna azonosítója")]
    public Guid ChannelIdentifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az IoT eszköz által szolgáltatott adat parse-olt értéke.
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Mért érték")]
    public decimal? Value { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// CO2e (kibocsátási egyenérték) kg/kWh
    /// </summary>

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.Logic.Extensions.Validity;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Enums;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Emissions;

/// <summary>
/// CO2 kibocsátás átalakítási tényező DTO
/// </summary>
[DataContract]
public class Co2eFactorEntityDto : TrackedEntityDtoBase, IDateOnlyOpenValidityRange
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Kategória: fogyasztás, termelés (stb)
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Kategória")]
    public Co2eFactorCategory Category { get; set; } // termelés vagy fogyasztás (a jövőben lehet még más is, ezért enum)



    [Required]
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Tényező")]
    public decimal Factor { get; set; } = 0.00m; // g/kWh


    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség kezdete
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Érvényesség kezdete")]
    public DateOnly ValidFrom { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség kezdete
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Érvényesség Vége")]
    public DateOnly? ValidTo { get; set; }

}

public static class Co2eFactorEntityDtoExtensions
{
    public static Co2eFactorEntityDto? FindByDate(this IEnumerable<Co2eFactorEntityDto> list, DateOnly date, Co2eFactorCategory category)
    {
        return list.FirstOrDefault(x =>
            x.Category == category
            && x.ValidFrom <= date
            && (x.ValidTo == null || x.ValidTo >= date)
            );
    }
}

    /// </summary>
    ///

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [DataMember]
    [Description("Jogosultság érvényesség kezdete UTC")]
    public DateTime ValidFrom { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jogosultság érvényesség vége UTC
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Description("Jogosultság érvényesség vége UTC")]
    public DateTime? ValidTo { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Aktív-e a jogosultság a jelenlegi időpontban
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Description("Aktív-e a jogosultság a jelenlegi időpontban")]
    public bool IsActive =>
        ValidFrom.TruncateToDayStart() <= DateTime.UtcNow &&
        (ValidTo.TruncateToDayEnd() == null || ValidTo.TruncateToDayEnd() > DateTime.UtcNow);
}

    /// <summary>

    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Kétfaktoros authentikáció ")]
    public bool TwoFactorAuthentication { get; set; }

{
    /// <summary>
    /// Kódtár kód

    /// </value>

    /// </summary>

    /// The name.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    [MediumStringLength]
    [Display(Name = "Kódtár név")]
    public string Name { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kódtárelemek
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The items.
    /// </value>
    [Display(Name = "Kódtárelemek")]
    public IList<T> Items { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rendszerszintű-e?
    /// </summary>

    /// </value>

}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared\Extensions\AddressExtensions.cs
====================================================================================================

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;
using System.Text;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// AddressExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class AddressExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 
    /// </summary>
    private const string Magyarorszag = "Magyarország";
    /// <summary>
    /// Az attributumokból összerakja a szöveges címet
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="address">The address.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string ConcatenatedName(this AddressEntityDto address)
    {
        if (address != null)
            switch (address.AddressType)
            {
                case AddressType.NotDefined:
                    break;
                case AddressType.DomesticNonPOBoxAddress:
                    return (address as DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto).ConcatenatedName1();
                case AddressType.DomesticPOBoxAddress:
                    return (address as DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto).ConcatenatedName2();
                case AddressType.ForeignAddress:
                    return (address as ForeignAddressEntityDto).ConcatenatedName3();
                case AddressType.DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddress:
                    return (address as DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto).ConcatenatedName4();
                case AddressType.DomesticLotNumberAddress:
                    return (address as DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto).ConcatenatedName5();
                case AddressType.IncompleteAddress:
                    return (address as IncompleteAddressEntityDto).ConcatenatedName6();
                case AddressType.DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddress:
                    return (address as DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto).ConcatenatedName7();
                default:
                    break;
            }
        return string.Empty;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the settlement.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="address">The address.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string GetSettlement(this AddressEntityDto address)
    {
        if (address != null)
            return address.AddressType switch
            {
                AddressType.DomesticNonPOBoxAddress when address is DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto cim => CacheHelper.GetSettlement(cim.Settlement!)!.Name,
                AddressType.DomesticPOBoxAddress when address is DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto cim => CacheHelper.GetSettlement(cim.Settlement!)!.Name,
                AddressType.ForeignAddress when address is ForeignAddressEntityDto cim => cim!.ForeignSettlementName!,
                AddressType.DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddress when address is DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto cim => CacheHelper.GetSettlement(cim.Settlement!)!.Name!,
                AddressType.DomesticLotNumberAddress when address is DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto cim => CacheHelper.GetSettlement(cim.Settlement!)!.Name!,
                AddressType.DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddress when address is DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto cim => CacheHelper.GetSettlement(cim.Settlement!)!.Name!,
                _ => string.Empty
            };

        return string.Empty;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Címadatok összefűzése 
    /// </summary>
    public static string ConcatenatedName1(this DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto cim)
    {
        if (cim == null) return string.Empty;
        var bld = new StringBuilder();
        var vesszo = "";
        if (cim.ZipCode != null)
        {
            bld.Append(cim.ZipCode?.EntityDisplayName);
        }
        if (cim.Settlement != null)
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(CacheHelper.GetSettlement(cim.Settlement).Name);
            vesszo = ", ";
        }
        if (cim.District != null)
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(CacheHelper.GetDistrict(cim.District).Value);
        }
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.StreetName))
        {
            bld.Append(vesszo);
            bld.Append(cim.StreetName);
        }
        if (cim.StreetSuffix != null)
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(CacheHelper.GetStreetSuffix(cim.StreetSuffix).Name);
        }
        if (cim.HouseNumber != null)
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(cim.HouseNumber);
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.Building))
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(cim.Building);
            bld.Append(" ép.");
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.Stairway))
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(cim.Stairway);
            bld.Append(" lph.");
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.Floor))
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(cim.Floor);
            bld.Append(".em");
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.Door))
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(cim.Door);
            bld.Append(" a.");
        }

        return bld.ToString().TrimStart();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Címadatok összefűzése 
    /// </summary>
    private static string ConcatenatedName2(this DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto cim)
    {
        if (cim == null) return string.Empty;
        var bld = new StringBuilder();
        if (cim.ZipCode != null)
        {
            bld.Append(cim.ZipCode?.EntityDisplayName);

            bld.Append(" ");

        }
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.POBox))
        {
            bld.Append(", pf. ");
            bld.Append(cim.POBox);
        }

        return bld.ToString().TrimStart();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Címadatok összefűzése 
    /// </summary>
    private static string ConcatenatedName3(this ForeignAddressEntityDto cim)
    {
        if (cim == null) return string.Empty;
        var bld = new StringBuilder();


        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.ForeignZipCode))
        {
            bld.Append(cim.ForeignZipCode);
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.Province))
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(cim.Province);
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.ForeignSettlementName))
        {
            bld.Append(" ");
            bld.Append(cim.ForeignSettlementName);
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cim.ForeignAddress))
        {
            bld.Append(", ");
            bld.Append(cim.ForeignAddress);
        }

        return bld.ToString().TrimStart();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Címadatok összefűzése 
    /// </summary>

        }

    }

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ha a szöveg nem null hozzáfűz egy prefixet
    /// </summary>
    public static string AddPrefix(this string s, string prefix)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s))
        {
            return s;
        }

        return $"{prefix}{s}";
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ha a szöveg nem null hozzáfűz egy postfixet
    /// </summary>
    public static string AddPostfix(this string s, string postfix)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s))
        {
            return s;
        }

        return $"{s}{postfix}";
    }
}

using System.Reflection;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Attributes;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// CodeEntityExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class CodeEntityExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the entity code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">
    /// '{value}' field is not in '{enumType.Name}' enum
    /// or
    /// The '{value}' field in '{enumType.Name}' enum needs an {nameof(EntityCodeAttribute)} attribute
    /// </exception>
    public static string GetEntityCode(this Enum value)
    {
        var enumType = value.GetType();
        FieldInfo fieldInfo = enumType.GetField(value.ToString()) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"'{value}' field is not in '{enumType.Name}' enum");
        
        EntityCodeAttribute? attribute = fieldInfo.GetCustomAttribute<EntityCodeAttribute>();
        return attribute?.Code ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"The '{value}' field in '{enumType.Name}' enum needs an {nameof(EntityCodeAttribute)} attribute");
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using System.Linq.Expressions;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// DateTimeConvertExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class DateTimeConvertExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Ha beérkező dátum órája 00 órára esik vagy 23 óra 59 percre, akkor leveszi belőle az aktuális UTC és LocalTime közti különbséget
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static DateTime? SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate(this DateTime? source)
    {
        if (source.HasValue)
        {
            return source.Value.SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate();
        }

        return source;
    }

    public static DateTime SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate(this DateTime source)
    {
        if (source == DateTime.MinValue || source == DateTime.MaxValue)
            return source;

        if (source.Hour == 00 || (source.Hour == 23 && source.Minute == 59))
        {
            var diff = (source.ToLocalTime() - source).Hours;
            var adjusted = source + TimeSpan.FromHours(-diff);
            if (adjusted < DateTime.MinValue || adjusted > DateTime.MaxValue)
                return source;
            return adjusted;
        }

        return source;
    }
}


====================================================================================================
📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared\Extensions\DateTimeValidityExtensions.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using System.Linq.Expressions;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;

public static class DateTimeValidityExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Törölt elemek globális kezeléséhez
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly Expression<Func<ILogicalDeleteEntity, bool>> NotDeletedExpression = x => !x.IsDeleted;

    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség globális kezeléséhez
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="targetDate"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Expression<Func<IDateTimeInterval, bool>> DateTimeValidityExpression(DateTime? targetDate)
    {
        return x => x.From <= targetDate && x.To > targetDate ||
              x.From <= targetDate && x.To == null ||
              x.From == null && x.To > targetDate ||
              x.To == null && x.From == null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség globális kezeléséhez. Olyan adattípuson végrehajtott query-hez, amely rendelkezik egy időbélyeggel.
    /// A paraméterként átadott időintervallumba eső adatokat szűrjük le. Az intervallum lehet nyitott mindkét oldalán.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dateTimeValidity">Paraméterként egy olyan objektumot kap, amely rendelkezik egy időintervallum kezdeti- és végdátumával.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Expression<Func<IMeasurementDate, bool>> DateTimeValidityExpression(IDateTimeInterval dateTimeValidity)
    {
        return x => dateTimeValidity.From <= x.MeasurementDate && dateTimeValidity.To > x.MeasurementDate ||
              dateTimeValidity.From <= x.MeasurementDate && dateTimeValidity.To == null ||
              dateTimeValidity.From == null && dateTimeValidity.To > x.MeasurementDate ||
              dateTimeValidity.To == null && dateTimeValidity.From == null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Olyan entitások kereséséhez, amelyek a paraméterben átadott érvényesség kezdete, és vége idősávban érvényesek valamikor.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="validityFrom"></param>
    /// <param name="validityTo"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Expression<Func<IDateTimeInterval, bool>> DateTimeValidityIntervalExpression(DateTime? validityFrom, DateTime? validityTo)
    {
        // Az első vizsgálat olyan entitásokra szűr, ahol aktuálisan érvényes a paraméterben átadott ervenyessegKezdete idején.
        // A második vizsgálat olyan entitásokra szűr, ahol aktuálisan érvényes a paraméterben átadott ervenyessegVege idején.
        // A harmadik vizsgálat olyan entitásokra szűr, ahol aktuálisan érvényes valamikor az ervenyessegKezdete és ervenyessegVege között, és le is van zárva az érvényesség.
        DateTime validityFromNotNull = validityFrom == null ? DateTime.MinValue : validityFrom.Value;
        DateTime validityToNotNull = validityTo == null ? DateTime.MaxValue : validityTo.Value;

        return x =>
        x.From <= validityFromNotNull && x.To > validityFromNotNull ||
              x.From <= validityFromNotNull && x.To == null ||
              x.From == null && x.To > validityFromNotNull ||
              x.To == null && x.From == null ||
          x.From <= validityToNotNull && x.To > validityToNotNull ||
              x.From <= validityToNotNull && x.To == null ||
              x.From == null && x.To > validityToNotNull ||
              x.To == null && x.From == null ||
          x.From >= validityFromNotNull && x.To <= validityToNotNull;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Azt vizsgáljuk, hogy az adott érvényességi időintervallumnak (melynek van kezdete, és létezhet vége) van-e metszete a 
    /// paraméterként átadott érvényességi időintervallummal (melynek szintén van kezdete, és létezhet vége).
    /// A visszatérési érték igaz, ha van közös metszet.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool HasDateTimeValidityIntervalIntersectionWith(this IDateTimeInterval source, IDateTimeInterval expectation)
    {
        // Kiküszöböljük a nullable vizsgálatot, hogy áttekinthető legyen a dolog
        var sourceDateTimeValidityFrom = source.From ?? DateTime.MinValue;
        var sourceDateTimeValidityTo = source.To ?? DateTime.MaxValue;
        var expectationDateTimeValidityFrom = expectation.From ?? DateTime.MinValue;
        var expectationDateTimeValidityTo = expectation.To ?? DateTime.MaxValue;

        if (sourceDateTimeValidityTo < expectationDateTimeValidityFrom)
        {
            // Ilyenkor nincs átfedés
            return false;
        }
        if (expectationDateTimeValidityTo <= sourceDateTimeValidityFrom)
        {
            // Ilyenkor sincs átfedés
            return false;
        }
        // Minden más esetben átfedés van
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az adott Érvényességi időintervallumon belül van-e a paraméterben átadott nap? Ha nincs megadva, akkor a rendszer szerinti aznapi napot nézi. 
    /// </summary>
    public static bool IsDateTimeValid(this IDateTimeInterval source, DateTime? expectation = null)
    {
        DateTime day = expectation == null ? DateTime.Today : expectation.Value.Date;
        var sourceDateTimeValidityFrom = source.From ?? DateTime.MinValue;
        sourceDateTimeValidityFrom = sourceDateTimeValidityFrom.TruncateToDayStart();
        var sourceDateTimeValidityTo = source.To ?? DateTime.MaxValue;
        sourceDateTimeValidityTo = sourceDateTimeValidityTo.TruncateToDayStart();
        var expectationDateTimeValidityFrom = day;
        var expectationDateTimeValidityTo = day;

        if (sourceDateTimeValidityTo < expectationDateTimeValidityFrom)
        {
            // Ilyenkor nincs átfedés
            return false;
        }
        if (expectationDateTimeValidityTo < sourceDateTimeValidityFrom)
        {
            // Ilyenkor sincs átfedés
            return false;
        }
        // Minden más esetben átfedés van
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A metódus azt vizsgálja, hogy a forrás érvényességi intervalluma benne van-e az elvárt idővallumban. (Nincs-e kilógó szakasz)
    /// </summary>
    public static bool IsDateTimeValidWithin(this IDateTimeInterval source, IDateTimeInterval expectation)
    {
        return IsDateTimeValidWithin(source, expectation.From, expectation.To);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A metódus azt vizsgálja, hogy a forrás érvényességi intervalluma benne van-e az elvárt idővallumban. (Nincs-e kilógó szakasz)
    /// </summary>
    public static bool IsDateTimeValidWithin(this IDateTimeInterval source, DateTime? expectationFrom, DateTime? expectationTo)
    {
        if (!source.From.HasValue || !expectationFrom.HasValue)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Két érvényességi idő intervallum metszetének vizsgálata során az egyik, vagy mindkét intervallum Érvényesség kezdete üres volt!");

        bool sourceDateTimeValidityToExists = source.To.HasValue;
        bool expectationDateTimeValidityToExists = expectationTo.HasValue;
        bool result = true;

        if (source.From < expectationFrom)
            return false;

        if (sourceDateTimeValidityToExists && expectationDateTimeValidityToExists)
        {
            if (source.To > expectationTo)
                result = false;
        }
        else if (sourceDateTimeValidityToExists && !expectationDateTimeValidityToExists)
        {
            result = true;
        }
        else if (!sourceDateTimeValidityToExists && expectationDateTimeValidityToExists)
        {
            result = false;
        }
        else
        {
            result = true;
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A listában felsorolt elemek közül a dátum szerinti érvényeseket kapjuk meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="targetDate">Amennyiben itt nem adunk meg értéket, akkor az aktuális dátumot veszi alapul.</param>
    /// <param name="historicalDataList">historicalDataList</param>
    public static T GetDateTimeValidValue<T>(this IList<T> historicalDataList, DateTime? targetDate = null)
        where T : IDateTimeInterval, ILogicalDeleteEntity
    {
        // Alapértelmezés szerint ha nincs megadva dátum, akkor a jelenlegi dátummal nézzük, hogy érvényes-e.
        if (targetDate == null)
            targetDate = DateTimeContext.Now;
        T result = default;
        if (historicalDataList != null)
            result = historicalDataList
                .OfType<ILogicalDeleteEntity>().Where(NotDeletedExpression.Compile().Invoke)
                .OfType<IDateTimeInterval>().Where(DateTimeValidityExpression(targetDate).Compile())
                .OfType<T>().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambigous entity. Type: {0}", typeof(T).Name);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A listában felsorolt elemek közül a dátum szerinti érvényeseket kapjuk meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="targetDate">Amennyiben itt nem adunk meg értéket, akkor az aktuális dátumot veszi alapul.</param>
    /// <param name="sourceList">sourceList</param>
    public static IList<T> GetDateTimeValidValues<T>(this IList<T> sourceList, DateTime? targetDate = null)
        where T : IDateTimeInterval
    {
        // Alapértelmezés szerint ha nincs megadva dátum, akkor a jelenlegi dátummal nézzük, hogy érvényes-e.
        if (targetDate == null)
            targetDate = DateTimeContext.Now;
        IList<T> result = default;
        if (sourceList != null)
        {
            result = sourceList.OfType<IDateTimeInterval>().Where(DateTimeValidityExpression(targetDate).Compile()).OfType<T>().ToList();
            if (typeof(ILogicalDeleteEntity).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T)))
            {
                result = result.OfType<ILogicalDeleteEntity>().Where(NotDeletedExpression.Compile()).OfType<T>().ToList();
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A listában felsorolt elemek közül a kezdő és végdátum szerinti érvényes elemeket adja vissza.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="sourceList"></param>
    /// <param name="startDate">Amennyiben itt nem adunk meg értéket, akkor az aktuális dátumot veszi alapul.</param>
    /// <param name="endDate">Amennyiben itt nem adunk meg értéket, akkor a maximális dátumot veszi alapul.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IList<T> GetDateTimeValidInIntervalValues<T>(this IList<T> sourceList, DateTime? startDate = null, DateTime? endDate = null)
        where T : IDateTimeInterval
    {
        // Alapértelmezés szerint ha nincs megadva dátum, akkor a jelenlegi dátummal nézzük, hogy érvényes-e.
        if (startDate == null)
            startDate = DateTimeContext.Now;
        // Alapértelmezés szerint ha nincs megadva dátum, akkor a maximális dátummal nézzük, hogy érvényes-e.
        if (endDate == null)
            endDate = DateTime.MaxValue;

        IList<T> result = default;
        if (sourceList != null)
        {
            result = sourceList.OfType<IDateTimeInterval>().Where(DateTimeValidityIntervalExpression(startDate, endDate).Compile()).OfType<T>().ToList();
            if (typeof(ILogicalDeleteEntity).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(T)))
            {
                result = result.OfType<ILogicalDeleteEntity>().Where(NotDeletedExpression.Compile()).OfType<T>().ToList();
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the last value.</summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="historicalDataList">The historical data list.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    public static T GetLastValue<T>(this IList<T> historicalDataList)
        where T : IDateTimeInterval, ILogicalDeleteEntity, IEntity
    {
        T result = default;
        if (historicalDataList != null)
        {
            result = historicalDataList.OrderByDescending(x => x.From).ThenByDescending(x => x.Id).Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).FirstOrDefault() ??
                     historicalDataList.Where(x => x.From == null && !x.IsDeleted).SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambigous entity. Type: {0}", typeof(T).Name);
        }

        return result;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared\Extensions\IEntityWithRecurrenceExtensions.cs

using Dates.Recurring;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Scheduler;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// EntityWithRecurrenceExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class EntityWithRecurrenceExtensions
{
    // Null-t ad vissza, ha többet nem fut
    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the next run.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityWithRecurrence">The entity with recurrence.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException"></exception>
    public static DateTime? CalculateNextRun(this IEntityWithRecurrence entityWithRecurrence)
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        switch (entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceType)
        {
            case RecurrenceType.Once:
                return now < entityWithRecurrence.StartAt ? entityWithRecurrence.StartAt : null;
            case RecurrenceType.Day:
                {
                    // RecurrenceTime
                    var recurrenceTime = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceTime ??
                                         throw new InvalidOperationException( $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceTime)} is required");

                    var daily = Recurs
                        .Starting(entityWithRecurrence.StartAt)
                        .Every(1)
                        .Days()
                        .Ending(entityWithRecurrence.EndAt ?? DateTime.MaxValue)
                        .Build();

                    return GetWithTime(daily.Next(now), recurrenceTime);
                }
            case RecurrenceType.Week:
                {
                    // RecurrenceDay, RecurrenceTime
                    var recurrenceTime = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceTime ??
                                         throw new InvalidOperationException( $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceTime)} is required");

                    var recurrenceDay = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay ??
                                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                            $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay)} is required");
                    
                    var weekly = Recurs
                        .Starting(entityWithRecurrence.StartAt)
                        .Every(1)
                        .Weeks()
                        .FirstDayOfWeek(DayOfWeek.Monday)
                        .OnDay(entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay == 7
                            ? DayOfWeek.Sunday
                            : (DayOfWeek)recurrenceDay)
                        .Ending(entityWithRecurrence.EndAt ?? DateTime.MaxValue)
                        .Build();

                    return GetWithTime(weekly.Next(now), recurrenceTime);
                }
            case RecurrenceType.Month:
                {
                    // RecurrenceWeek, RecurrenceDay, RecurrenceTime
                    var recurrenceTime = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceTime ??
                                         throw new InvalidOperationException( $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceTime)} is required");

                    var recurrenceWeek = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceWeek ??
                                         throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                             $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceWeek)} is required");
                    var recurrenceDay = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay ??
                                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                            $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay)} is required");

                    if (entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceWeek != null && entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceWeek != 0)
                    {
                        var monthlyOnWeek = Recurs
                            .Starting(entityWithRecurrence.StartAt)
                            .Every(1)
                            .Months()
                            .OnOrdinalWeek((Ordinal)recurrenceWeek)
                            .OnDay(entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay == 7
                                ? DayOfWeek.Sunday
                                : (DayOfWeek)recurrenceDay)
                            .Ending(entityWithRecurrence.EndAt ?? DateTime.MaxValue)
                            .Build();

                        return GetWithTime(monthlyOnWeek.Next(now), recurrenceTime);
                    }

                    // RecurrenceDay, RecurrenceTime
                    var monthlyWithoutWeek = Recurs
                        .Starting(entityWithRecurrence.StartAt)
                        .Every(1)
                        .Months()
                        .OnDay((int)entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay!)
                        .Ending(entityWithRecurrence.EndAt ?? DateTime.MaxValue)
                        .Build();

                    return GetWithTime(monthlyWithoutWeek.Next(now), recurrenceTime);
                }
            case RecurrenceType.Year:
                {
                    // RecurrenceMonth, RecurrenceWeek, RecurrenceDay, RecurrenceTime
                    var recurrenceTime = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceTime ??
                                         throw new InvalidOperationException( $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceTime)} is required");

                    var recurrenceMonth = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceMonth ??
                                          throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                              $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceMonth)} is required");
                    var recurrenceWeek = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceWeek ??
                                         throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                             $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceWeek)} is required");
                    var recurrenceDay = entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay ??
                                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                            $"{nameof(IEntityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay)} is required");

                    if (entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceWeek != null && entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceWeek != 0)
                    {
                        var yearlyOnWeek = Recurs
                            .Starting(entityWithRecurrence.StartAt)
                            .Every(1)
                            .Years()
                            .OnMonth(new DateTime(2022, recurrenceMonth, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc))
                            .OnOrdinalWeek((Ordinal)recurrenceWeek)
                            .OnDay(entityWithRecurrence.RecurrenceDay == 7
                                ? DayOfWeek.Sunday
                                : (DayOfWeek)recurrenceDay)
                            .Ending(entityWithRecurrence.EndAt ?? DateTime.MaxValue)
                            .Build();

                        return GetWithTime(yearlyOnWeek.Next(now), recurrenceTime);
                    }

                    // RecurrenceMonth, RecurrenceDay, RecurrenceTime
                    var yearlyWithoutWeek = Recurs
                        .Starting(entityWithRecurrence.StartAt)
                        .Every(1)
                        .Years()
                        .OnMonth(new DateTime(2022, recurrenceMonth, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc))
                        .OnDay(recurrenceDay)
                        .Ending(entityWithRecurrence.EndAt ?? DateTime.MaxValue)
                        .Build();

                    return GetWithTime(yearlyWithoutWeek.Next(now), recurrenceTime);
                }
            default:
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the with time.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dateTime">The date time.</param>
    /// <param name="recurrenceTime">The recurrence time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static DateTime? GetWithTime(DateTime? dateTime, int recurrenceTime)
    {
        return dateTime?.ToLocalTime().Date.ToUniversalTime().AddMinutes(recurrenceTime);
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;

/// <summary>

    /// <summary>

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Locations;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Filters;

/// <summary>
/// AddressJsonConverter
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" />
public class AddressJsonConverter : JsonConverter
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether this instance can convert the specified object type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="objectType">Type of the object.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <c>true</c> if this instance can convert the specified object type; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    public override bool CanConvert(Type objectType)
    {
        return objectType == typeof(AddressEntityDto);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" /> can read JSON.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" /> can read JSON; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public override bool CanRead => true;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" /> can write JSON.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" /> can write JSON; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public override bool CanWrite => false;

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new reader for the specified jObject by copying the settings
    /// from an existing reader.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="reader">The reader whose settings should be copied.</param>
    /// <param name="jToken">The jToken to create a new reader for.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// The new disposable reader.
    /// </returns>
    public static JsonReader CopyReaderForObject(JsonReader reader, JToken jToken)
    {
        JsonReader jTokenReader = jToken.CreateReader();
        jTokenReader.Culture = reader.Culture;
        jTokenReader.DateFormatString = reader.DateFormatString;
        jTokenReader.DateParseHandling = reader.DateParseHandling;
        jTokenReader.DateTimeZoneHandling = reader.DateTimeZoneHandling;
        jTokenReader.FloatParseHandling = reader.FloatParseHandling;
        jTokenReader.MaxDepth = reader.MaxDepth;
        jTokenReader.SupportMultipleContent = reader.SupportMultipleContent;
        return jTokenReader;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the specified j object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jObject">The j object.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected AddressEntityDto Create(JObject jObject)
    {
        if (Enum.TryParse(jObject["addressType"]?.ToString() ?? jObject["AddressType"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty, out AddressType addressType)) 
        {
            switch (addressType)
            {
                case AddressType.DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddress:
                    return new DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto();
                case AddressType.DomesticLotNumberAddress:
                    return new DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto();
                case AddressType.DomesticNonPOBoxAddress:
                    return new DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto();
                case AddressType.DomesticPOBoxAddress:
                    return new DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto();
                case AddressType.DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddress:
                    return new DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto();
                case AddressType.IncompleteAddress:
                    return new IncompleteAddressEntityDto();
                case AddressType.ForeignAddress:
                    return new ForeignAddressEntityDto();
            }
        }
        return new DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Reads the JSON representation of the object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="reader">The <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonReader" /> to read from.</param>
    /// <param name="objectType">Type of the object.</param>
    /// <param name="existingValue">The existing value of object being read.</param>
    /// <param name="serializer">The calling serializer.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// The object value.
    /// </returns>
    public override object ReadJson(JsonReader reader, Type objectType, object existingValue, JsonSerializer serializer)
    {
        if (reader.TokenType == JsonToken.Null)
            return null;
        var jObject = JObject.Load(reader);
        var target = Create(jObject);
        using JsonReader jObjectReader = CopyReaderForObject(reader, jObject);
        serializer.Populate(jObjectReader, target);
        return target;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Writes the JSON representation of the object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="writer">The <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonWriter" /> to write to.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="serializer">The calling serializer.</param>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public override void WriteJson(JsonWriter writer, object value, JsonSerializer serializer)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System;
using System.Numerics;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;

public static class AggregationHelper
{

    public static TNumber? Aggregate<T, TNumber>(IEnumerable<T> series, Func<T, TNumber?> selector, AggregationMethod method)
        where TNumber : struct, INumber<TNumber>
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(series);
        var nonNullValues = series.Where(item => selector(item) != null).Select(selector);

        return method switch
        {
            //these can return null value!
            AggregationMethod.TakeFirst => series.Select(selector).FirstOrDefault(),
            AggregationMethod.TakeLast => series.Select(selector).LastOrDefault(),

            AggregationMethod.Sum => series.Aggregate(TNumber.Zero, (acc, item) => acc + (selector(item) ?? TNumber.Zero)),

            AggregationMethod.Average => Average(nonNullValues),

            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(method), method, null)
        };
    }

    private static TNumber Average<TNumber>(IEnumerable<TNumber?> numbers) where TNumber : struct, INumber<TNumber>
    {
        int count = 0;
        TNumber sum = TNumber.Zero;
        foreach (var item in numbers)
        {
            if (item.HasValue) //ignore nulls
            {
                checked { sum += item.Value; }
                count++;
            }
        }
        return sum / TNumber.CreateChecked(count);
    }

    public static TimeSpan ConvertToTimeSpan(AggregationLevel aggregationLevel)
    {
        return aggregationLevel switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
            AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15),
            AggregationLevel.OneHour => TimeSpan.FromHours(1),
            AggregationLevel.OneDay => TimeSpan.FromDays(1),
            AggregationLevel.OneWeek => TimeSpan.FromDays(7),
            AggregationLevel.OneMonth => TimeSpan.FromDays(30), //BUG: WTF!!!!! ezt nem lehet ilyen általánosan kezelni.
            AggregationLevel.OneYear => TimeSpan.FromDays(365), //BUG: szökőév!!!!
            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(aggregationLevel), aggregationLevel, null)
        };
    }

}

using Common.Extensions.HttpClientExtensions;
using Common.Shared.Models.Authentication;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;
public static class ApiAuthentication
{
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, AuthModel> _tokenCache = [];

    private static async Task<AuthModel> GetToken(HttpClient authClient, string authEndpoint, string apiKey, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        var resp = await authClient.PostAsync<APIAuthModel, AuthModel>(authEndpoint, new APIAuthModel()
        {
            APIKey = apiKey,
            TenantCode = tenantCode
        });

        if (resp is null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(resp.Token))
            throw new Exception("Authentication failed. Null response from API or no token received.");

        return resp;
    }

    public static async Task AuthnticateClient(this HttpClient client, string authEndpoint, string apiKey, string? tenantCode = null)
    { 
        await client.AuthnticateClient(null, authEndpoint, apiKey, tenantCode ?? string.Empty);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// itt az a lényeg, hogy meg lehet hívni simán arra a kliense, amit a végpontok hívására használunk, vagy meg lehet adni egy külön authClient-et,
    /// amivel az authentikációs végpontot hívjuk meg. (pl. az authClient másképp lehet felkonfigurálva, más resiliency, más szerver baseUrl-t hív, stb.)
    /// TODO: rendes xmldoc
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task AuthnticateClient(this HttpClient client, HttpClient? authClient, string authEndpoint, string apiKey, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(apiKey))
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiKey), "API key must not be null or empty.");
        }

        //check token expiration, and get a new, if expired
        if (_tokenCache.TryGetValue(apiKey, out var cachedToken)
            && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cachedToken.Token)
            && cachedToken.Expiration > DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(1)  //adding 1 extra minute, so token won't expire while the request is being processed
            )
        {
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", cachedToken.Token);
            return;
        }
        else
        {
            try
            {
                var authenticationClient = authClient ?? client; // Use the provided authClient or fall back to the main client

                var tokenModel = await GetToken(authenticationClient, authEndpoint, apiKey, tenantCode);

                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", tokenModel.Token);
                _tokenCache[apiKey] = tokenModel; // Cache the token for future use
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                throw new Exception($"Authentication failed: {ex.Message}", innerException: ex);
            }
        }
    }

}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Scheduler;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// Cron kifejezés létrehozása <see cref="IEntityWithRecurrence"/> interfész használatával
/// Ellenőrzésképp ezt az oldalt használva készült <a href="https://www.freeformatter.com/cron-expression-generator-quartz.html">freeformatter.com</a>
/// </summary>
public class CronGenerator
{
    /// <summary>Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CronGenerator" /> class.</summary>
    /// <param name="entity">The entity.</param>
    /// <param name="additionalMinutes">The additional minutes.</param>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotSupportedException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException"></exception>
    public CronGenerator(IEntityWithRecurrence entity, int additionalMinutes = 0)
    {
        if (entity.RecurrenceType == RecurrenceType.Once)
        {
            throw new NotSupportedException();
        }
        var recTime = entity.RecurrenceTime + additionalMinutes;
        Hours = (recTime / 60).ToString()!;
        Minutes = (recTime % 60).ToString()!;
        var dayOfWeek = (int?)(entity.RecurrenceDay == 7
            ? System.DayOfWeek.Sunday
            : (DayOfWeek?)entity.RecurrenceDay);

        switch (entity.RecurrenceType)
        {
            case RecurrenceType.Day:
                return;
            case RecurrenceType.Week:
                DayOfMonth = "?";
                DayOfWeek = dayOfWeek!.Value.ToString();
                return;
            case RecurrenceType.Month:
                if (entity.RecurrenceWeek != null && entity.RecurrenceWeek != 0)
                {
                    DayOfMonth = "?";
                    DayOfWeek = $"{dayOfWeek}#{entity.RecurrenceDay}";
                    return;
                }

                DayOfMonth = entity.RecurrenceDay.ToString()!;
                DayOfWeek = "?";
                return;
            case RecurrenceType.Year:
                if (entity.RecurrenceWeek != null && entity.RecurrenceWeek != 0)
                {
                    DayOfMonth = "?";
                    DayOfWeek = $"{dayOfWeek}#{entity.RecurrenceDay}";
                    Month = entity.RecurrenceMonth.ToString()!;
                    return;
                }

                DayOfMonth = entity.RecurrenceDay.ToString()!;
                DayOfWeek = "?";
                Month = entity.RecurrenceMonth.ToString()!;
                return;
            case RecurrenceType.Once:
            default:
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the cron string.</summary>
    /// <value>The cron string.</value>
    public string CronString => $"{Seconds} {Minutes} {Hours} {DayOfMonth} {Month} {DayOfWeek} {Year}";

    /// <summary>Gets the seconds.</summary>
    /// <value>The seconds.</value>
    public string Seconds { get; } = "0";

    /// <summary>Gets the minutes.</summary>
    /// <value>The minutes.</value>
    public string Minutes { get; } = "0";

    /// <summary>Gets the hours.</summary>
    /// <value>The hours.</value>
    public string Hours { get; } = "*";

    /// <summary>Gets the day of month.</summary>
    /// <value>The day of month.</value>
    public string DayOfMonth { get; } = "?";

    /// <summary>Gets the month.</summary>
    /// <value>The month.</value>
    public string Month { get; } = "*";

    /// <summary>Gets the day of week.</summary>
    /// <value>The day of week.</value>
    public string DayOfWeek { get; } = "*";

    /// <summary>Gets the year.</summary>
    /// <value>The year.</value>
    public string Year { get; } = "*";
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// CryptHelper
/// </summary>
public static class CryptHelper
{
    // This constant is used to determine the keysize of the encryption algorithm in bits.
    // We divide this by 8 within the code below to get the equivalent number of bytes.
    /// <summary>
    /// The keysize
    /// </summary>
    private const int Keysize = 128;

    /// <summary>
    /// The private key
    /// </summary>
    private const string PrivateKey = "MIGrAgEAAiEAh1RHd1siFtCL17Zl2aRqlbFTEgx9KzxsNvMrSjtPUuUCAwEAAQIg\r\ncIhLuVul+DTI5MK+5QGMwt/2deP2fTUjvKhESU/QBsECEQDRTT+1WKRP+n+DZFOO\r\nWBO1AhEApYXrK1/N1/adWfK6PxggcQIRAJ0iM7xAKkvpMqZAQgLR2SkCEFO/cWBt\r\nxdGaVrz3AeMAixECEQCkFH+9qxJkc5RqRU+dVxDv";


    // This constant determines the number of iterations for the password bytes generation function.
    /// <summary>
    /// The derivation iterations
    /// </summary>
    private const int DerivationIterations = 1000;

    /// <summary>
    /// Encrypts the specified plain text.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="plainText">The plain text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string Encrypt(string plainText)
    {
        // Salt and IV is randomly generated each time, but is preprended to encrypted cipher text
        // so that the same Salt and IV values can be used when decrypting.  
        var saltStringBytes = Generate256BitsOfRandomEntropy();
        var ivStringBytes = Generate256BitsOfRandomEntropy();
        var plainTextBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(plainText);

        using var password = new Rfc2898DeriveBytes(PrivateKey, saltStringBytes, DerivationIterations);
        var keyBytes = password.GetBytes(Keysize / 8);
        using var symmetricKey = Aes.Create();
        symmetricKey.BlockSize = 128;
        symmetricKey.Mode = CipherMode.CBC;
        symmetricKey.Padding = PaddingMode.PKCS7;
        using var encryptor = symmetricKey.CreateEncryptor(keyBytes, ivStringBytes);
        using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
        using var cryptoStream = new CryptoStream(memoryStream, encryptor, CryptoStreamMode.Write);
        cryptoStream.Write(plainTextBytes, 0, plainTextBytes.Length);
        cryptoStream.FlushFinalBlock();
        // Create the final bytes as a concatenation of the random salt bytes, the random iv bytes and the cipher bytes.
        var cipherTextBytes = saltStringBytes;
        cipherTextBytes = cipherTextBytes.Concat(ivStringBytes).ToArray();
        cipherTextBytes = cipherTextBytes.Concat(memoryStream.ToArray()).ToArray();
        memoryStream.Close();
        cryptoStream.Close();
        return Convert.ToBase64String(cipherTextBytes);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Decrypts the specified cipher text.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cipherText">The cipher text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string Decrypt(string cipherText)
    {
        // Get the complete stream of bytes that represent:
        // [32 bytes of Salt] + [32 bytes of IV] + [n bytes of CipherText]
        var cipherTextBytesWithSaltAndIv = Convert.FromBase64String(cipherText);
        // Get the saltbytes by extracting the first 32 bytes from the supplied cipherText bytes.
        var saltStringBytes = cipherTextBytesWithSaltAndIv.Take(Keysize / 8).ToArray();
        // Get the IV bytes by extracting the next 32 bytes from the supplied cipherText bytes.
        var ivStringBytes = cipherTextBytesWithSaltAndIv.Skip(Keysize / 8).Take(Keysize / 8).ToArray();
        // Get the actual cipher text bytes by removing the first 64 bytes from the cipherText string.
        var cipherTextBytes = cipherTextBytesWithSaltAndIv.Skip(Keysize / 8 * 2).Take(cipherTextBytesWithSaltAndIv.Length - Keysize / 8 * 2).ToArray();

        using var password = new Rfc2898DeriveBytes(PrivateKey, saltStringBytes, DerivationIterations);
        var keyBytes = password.GetBytes(Keysize / 8);
        using var symmetricKey = Aes.Create();
        symmetricKey.BlockSize = 128;
        symmetricKey.Mode = CipherMode.CBC;
        symmetricKey.Padding = PaddingMode.PKCS7;
        using var decryptor = symmetricKey.CreateDecryptor(keyBytes, ivStringBytes);
        using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream(cipherTextBytes);
        using var cryptoStream = new CryptoStream(memoryStream, decryptor, CryptoStreamMode.Read);
        using var streamReader = new StreamReader(cryptoStream, Encoding.UTF8);
        return streamReader.ReadToEnd();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generate256s the bits of random entropy.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static byte[] Generate256BitsOfRandomEntropy()
    {
        var randomBytes = new byte[16]; // 32 Bytes will give us 256 bits.
        using (var rngCsp = RandomNumberGenerator.Create())
        {
            // Fill the array with cryptographically secure random bytes.
            rngCsp.GetBytes(randomBytes);
        }
        return randomBytes;
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;

public static class ErrorCodeHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Loggolja a biztonsági naplóba a megadott hiba kódot (ha kell) és visszaad egy string-et ami megjelenhet a felhasználónak
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="exception"></param>
    /// <returns>A felhasználó által is látható hibaüzenet</returns>
    public static string LogErrorCode(EnergiaMenedzsmentCodeException exception)
    {
        return LogErrorCode("S_EnergiaMenedzsmentCodeException", exception.ErrorCode, exception.Message);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Loggolja a biztonsági naplóba a megadott hiba kódot (ha kell) és visszaad egy string-et ami megjelenhet a felhasználónak
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="eventId"></param>
    /// <param name="errorCode"></param>
    /// <param name="message"></param>
    /// <returns>A felhasználó által is látható hibaüzenet</returns>
    public static string LogErrorCode(string eventId, EnergiaMenedzsmentErrorCode errorCode, string message)
    {
        if (message is null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(message));

        var desc = ErrorCodeDescription(errorCode);
        var secMessage = desc != message ? string.Join(" ", desc, message) : message;

        var secAttr = errorCode.GetAttributeOfEnum<LogSecurityAttribute>();
        if (secAttr != null)
        {
            Log.LogSecurity(eventId, secMessage);
        }

        return string.Join(' ', errorCode.ToString(), desc);
    }

    /// <summary>Errors the code description.</summary>
    /// <param name="errorCode">The error code.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <br />
    /// </returns>
    public static string ErrorCodeDescription(EnergiaMenedzsmentErrorCode errorCode)
    {
        var descAttr = errorCode.GetAttributeOfEnum<ErrorCodeDescriptionAttribute>();
        if (descAttr == null)
            return null;

        var p = new List<string>();
        return string.Format(descAttr.Description, p.ToArray());
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared\Helpers\SecurityHelper.cs

using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Security;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// SecurityHelper
/// </summary>
public static class SecurityHelper
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Token létrehozás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="secUser">The sec user.</param>
    /// <param name="expiration">The expiration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string CreateToken(SecUser secUser, DateTime? expiration = null)
    {
        var authClaims = new List<Claim>
        {
            new (ClaimTypes.Name, secUser.LoginName ?? "API-" + secUser.GlobalId.ToString()),
            new (ClaimTypes.Email, secUser.Email ?? "info@energiamenedzsment-dev-application.com"),
            new (ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, secUser.GlobalId.ToString()),
        };
        if (secUser.TenantCode != null)
            authClaims.Add(new Claim(CustomClaimTypes.TenantCode, secUser.TenantCode));

        foreach (var userRole in secUser.Roles)
            authClaims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, userRole));

        expiration ??= DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(Config.GetIntValue("JWT.TokenValidityInMinutes"));

        var authSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Config.GetStringValue("JWT.Secret")));

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            issuer: Config.GetStringValue("JWT.ValidIssuer"),
            audience: Config.GetStringValue("JWT.ValidAudience"),
            expires: expiration,
            claims: authClaims,
            signingCredentials: new SigningCredentials(authSigningKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256)
        );
        return (new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the access token.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static string GetAccessToken(this SecurityContext securityContext)
    {
        return CreateToken(securityContext.CurrentUser);
    }

}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;

public enum StoredFunctionNames
{
    [Display(Name = "refresh_combined_normalized_consumption_hourly_view")]
    CombinedHourlyNormalizedConsumption,

    [Display(Name = "refresh_combined_normalized_consumption_daily_view")]
    CombinedDailyNormalizedConsumption,
}

public static class StoredFunctionHelper
{
    public static void RunStoredFunction(IDbContext dbContext, StoredFunctionNames name, string tenant = null) 
    {
        var attribute = name.GetAttributeOfEnum<DisplayAttribute>();
        tenant ??= "public";
        dbContext.Session.CreateSQLQuery($"SELECT {tenant}.{attribute!.Name}()")
                         .ExecuteUpdate();
    } 
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared\Managers\EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient.cs
