📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI\Controllers\AuthenticateControllerBase.cs
====================================================================================================

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.System;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// AuthenticateControllerBase
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[ApiController]
public abstract class AuthenticateControllerBase : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// The security cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantSecurityCache _securityCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// The role cache
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly RoleCache _roleCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AuthenticateControllerBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="roleCache">The role cache.</param>
    /// <param name="securityCache">The security cache.</param>
    protected AuthenticateControllerBase(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        RoleCache roleCache,
        TenantSecurityCache securityCache)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        _roleCache = roleCache;
        _securityCache = securityCache;
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Refreshes the token.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens.SecurityTokenException">Érvénytelen token</exception>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentTokenException">Munkaideje lejárt, ezért kiléptettük! A folytatáshoz jelentkezzen be újra! - InvalidToken</exception>
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [Route("{token}/refresh-token")]
    [HttpPost]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Authenticate_RefreshToken")]
    public async Task<ActionResult> RefreshToken(string token)
    {
        var tokenValidationParameters = Extensions.SharedSecurityExtensions.TokenValidationParameters;
        tokenValidationParameters.ValidateLifetime = false;
        SecurityToken securityToken;
        ClaimsPrincipal principal;
        try
        {
            var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
            principal = tokenHandler.ValidateToken(token, tokenValidationParameters, out securityToken);
            if (securityToken is not JwtSecurityToken jwtSecurityToken ||
                !jwtSecurityToken.Header.Alg.Equals(SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentTokenException("Érvénytelen token", "InvalidToken");
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentTokenException("Munkaideje lejárt, ezért kiléptettük! A folytatáshoz jelentkezzen be újra!", "InvalidToken");
        }

        var refreshTokenValidityInMinutes = Config.GetIntValue("JWT.RefreshTokenValidityInMinutes");
        if (securityToken.ValidTo.AddMinutes(refreshTokenValidityInMinutes) < DateTimeContext.Now)
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentTokenException("Munkaideje lejárt, ezért kiléptettük! A folytatáshoz jelentkezzen be újra!", "InvalidToken");
        }

        var userGlobalId = principal.Claims.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Type == ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        var tenantCode = principal.Claims.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Type == CustomClaimTypes.TenantCode)?.Value;

        if (userGlobalId == null)
        {
            return Unauthorized();
        }

        var user = await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecAuthEntityQuery()
        {
            GlobalId = Guid.Parse(userGlobalId),
        });
        
        if (user?.Entity is SecUserEntityDto secUser)
        {
            var authClaims = new List<Claim>
            {
                new (ClaimTypes.Email, secUser.EMail),
                new (ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, secUser.GlobalId.ToString()),
                new Claim(CustomClaimTypes.TenantCode, tenantCode)
            };

            foreach (var roleCode in secUser.RoleCodes)
            {
                authClaims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, roleCode));
            }

            var authSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Config.GetStringValue("JWT.Secret")));

            var jwtToken = new JwtSecurityToken(
                issuer: Config.GetStringValue("JWT.ValidIssuer"),
                audience: Config.GetStringValue("JWT.ValidAudience"),
                expires: DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(Config.GetIntValue("JWT.TokenValidityInMinutes")),
                claims: authClaims,
                signingCredentials: new SigningCredentials(authSigningKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256)
            );

            return Ok(new
            {
                token = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(jwtToken),
                expiration = jwtToken.ValidTo
            });
        }

        return Unauthorized();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the sec operation matrix.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("getsecoperationmatrix")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Authenticate_GetSecOperationMatrix")]
#pragma warning disable CS1998 // Async method lacks 'await' operators and will run synchronously
    public virtual async Task<ActionResult<SecOperationMatrixModel>> GetSecOperationMatrix()
#pragma warning restore CS1998 // Async method lacks 'await' operators and will run synchronously
    {
        var roles = _roleCache.GetContent(_scope);
        var vm = new SecOperationMatrixModel();
        foreach (var roleCode in roles.Select(x => x.RoleCode))
        {
            var operations = _securityCache.GetSecOperationsByRole(_scope, roleCode);
            foreach (var secOperationCode in operations.Select(x => x.SecOperationCode))
            {
                var secOpViewModel = vm.SecOperationList.FirstOrDefault(x => x.SecOperation == secOperationCode);
                var exists = secOpViewModel != null;
                secOpViewModel ??= new SecOperationModel
                {
                    SecOperation = secOperationCode
                };
                if (secOpViewModel.SecRoleList.TrueForAll(x => x != roleCode)) secOpViewModel.SecRoleList.Add(roleCode);
                if (!exists) vm.SecOperationList.Add(secOpViewModel);
            }
        }
        return Ok(vm);
    }

}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// SyncControllerBase
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[ApiController]
public abstract class SyncControllerBase : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SyncControllerBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    protected SyncControllerBase(ICommandService commandService)
    {
        _commandService = commandService;
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// The lifetime scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _lifetimeScope;

    // POST: api/IoTData/uploadJSONData
    /// <summary>
    /// Adat feltöltése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost]
    [Route("")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sync_Post")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Post(SyncRequest request)
    {
        await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new SyncCommand()
        {
            EntityName = request.EntityName,
            LastModifiedDate = request.LastModifiedDate,
            TenantCode = request.TenantCode != null ? request.TenantCode.ToString() : string.Empty
        });
        return Ok();
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SyncControllerBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="lifetimeScope">The lifetime scope.</param>
    protected SyncControllerBase(ICommandService commandService, ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope)
        {
            _commandService = commandService;
            _lifetimeScope = lifetimeScope;
        }

}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using Common.Shared.Models.Authentication;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ModelBinding;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// UserAuthenticateControllerBase
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers.AuthenticateControllerBase" />
[ApiController]
public abstract class UserAuthenticateControllerBase : AuthenticateControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;

    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="UserAuthenticateControllerBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="roleCache">The role cache.</param>
    /// <param name="securityCache">The security cache.</param>
    protected UserAuthenticateControllerBase(
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        RoleCache roleCache,
        TenantSecurityCache securityCache,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(queryService, scope, roleCache, securityCache)
    {
        _commandService = commandService;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Logins the specified model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [HttpPost]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [Route("login")]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "UserAuthenticate_Login")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginModel model)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Email))
            return Unauthorized();

        if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Password))
            return Unauthorized();

        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;

        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecAuthEntityQuery { Email = model.Email, Password = model.Password }))?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto entity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecUser" });

        var tokenCheck = (IsPasswordValidCommandResult)(await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new IsPasswordValidCommand()
        {
            Email = model.Email,
            Password = model.Password,
        }));

        //Nincs jogosultság a belépéshez
        if (!tokenCheck.IsValid && string.IsNullOrEmpty(tokenCheck.Token))
        {
            ErrorCodeHelper.LogErrorCode(new EnergiaMenedzsmentCodeException(EnergiaMenedzsmentErrorCode.K0101,
                ErrorCodeHelper.ErrorCodeDescription(EnergiaMenedzsmentErrorCode.K0101)));
            return Unauthorized();
        }

        var twoFactorEnabled = Config.TryGetBoolValue("TwoFactorAuthenticationEnabled") ?? true; //TODO tenant-specific implementation

        //Lejárt érvényességű token
        if (!tokenCheck.IsValid && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tokenCheck.Token))
        {
            var modelstate = new ModelStateDictionary();
            modelstate.AddModelError("RenewInvalidToken", tokenCheck.Token);
            Log.LogSecurity("S_TokenExpired", "Lejárt érvényességű token");
            return BadRequest(modelstate);
        }
        else if (twoFactorEnabled && tokenCheck.User.TwoFactorStatus == TwoFactorStatus.Verified) //ha NeedToVerify, ugyanúgy be kell léptetnünk az else ágban, mintha Off lenne, és be kell fejeznie a regisztrációt a QR kód beolvasásával
        {
            var modelstate = new ModelStateDictionary();
            modelstate.AddModelError("TwoFactorChecker", CryptHelper.Encrypt(tokenCheck.User.EMail));
            return BadRequest(modelstate);
        }
        else
        {
            //Érvényes token
            var expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(Config.GetIntValue("JWT.TokenValidityInMinutes"));

            return Ok(new AuthModel()
            {
                Token = SecurityHelper.CreateToken(
                    new SecUser(
                            tokenCheck.User.GlobalId,
                            tokenCheck.User.EMail,
                            null,
                            tokenCheck.User.EMail,
                            tokenCheck.User.EMail,
                            tokenCheck.User.RoleCodes,
                            tokenCheck.User.OrgUnits,
                            tokenCheck.User.IsSystem
                        ), expires
                    ),
                Expiration = expires,
                TwoFactorEnabled = twoFactorEnabled
            });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Visszaadja egy sec user-hez az összes hozzárendelt tenant-ot
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [Route("tenants")]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "UserAuthenticate_GetTenants")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SelectListItemDto[]>> GetTenants()
    {
        var globalId = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId;

        if ((await _queryService.QueryEntities(new SecUserTenantsQuery
        {
            SecUserGlobalId = globalId,
        })) is not EntityQueryItemsResult<SelectListItemDto> result)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecUser Tenants" });

        return Ok(result.Items);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A kiválasztott tenant-ba belépteti a felhasználót
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [Route("select-tenant")]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "UserAuthenticate_LoginToSelectedTenant")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> LoginToSelectedTenant([FromQuery] string tenantCode)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;

        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecAuthEntityQuery { GlobalId = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId }))?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto entity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecUser" });

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
        {
            if (!entity.Tenants.Any(x => x.Code == tenantCode))
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"A felhasználó nincs hozzárendelve a \"{tenantCode}\" nevű tenant-hoz!");
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (!entity.Roles.Any(x => x.EntityDisplayName == SecRoleType.Adminisztrator.GetDisplayName()))
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("A felhasználónak nincs jogosultsága a központi felülethez!");
            }
        }

        var expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(Config.GetIntValue("JWT.TokenValidityInMinutes"));

        return Ok(new AuthModel()
        {
            Token = SecurityHelper.CreateToken(
                    new SecUser(
                            entity.GlobalId,
                            entity.EMail,
                            tenantCode,
                            entity.EMail,
                            entity.EMail,
                            entity.RoleCodes,
                            entity.OrgUnits,
                            entity.IsSystem
                        ), expires
                    ),
            Expiration = expires
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Twofactors the login.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [HttpPost]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [Route("twofactor_login")]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "UserAuthenticate_Twofactor_Login")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> TwofactorLogin([FromBody] TwoFactorLoginModel model)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Authenticationcode) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(model.Userhash))
        {
            return Unauthorized();
        }

        var hash = CryptHelper.Decrypt(model.Userhash);

        var secUser = (await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new TwoFactorValidCommand()
        {
            TwoFactorCode = model.Authenticationcode,
            Email = hash
        })) as TwoFactorValidCommandResult;

        if (secUser?.User == null)
        {
            return Unauthorized();
        }


        var expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(Config.GetIntValue("JWT.TokenValidityInMinutes"));
        Log.LogSecurity("S_LoginSuccess", "Sikeres bejelentkezés");
        return Ok(new AuthModel()
        {
            Token = SecurityHelper.CreateToken(
                new SecUser(
                        secUser.User.GlobalId,
                        secUser.User.EMail,
                        tenantCode: null,
                        secUser.User.EMail,
                        secUser.User.EMail,
                        secUser.User.RoleCodes,
                        secUser.User.OrgUnits,
                        secUser.User.IsSystem
                    ), expires
                ),
            Expiration = expires
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Visszaadja egy sec user-hez a kétfaktoros authentikátor regisztrációjához szükséges QR-kódot, amennyiben még nincs neki beállítva
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [Route("twofactor_qrcode")]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "UserAuthenticate_GetTwoFactorQrCode")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TwoFactorQrCodeModel>> GetTwoFactorQrCode()
    {
        var qrCodeCommandResult = (await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new TwoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommand()
        {
            GlobalUserId = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId

        })) as TwoFactorQrCodeGenerateCommandResult;

        return Ok(new TwoFactorQrCodeModel
        {
            QrCodeBase64 = qrCodeCommandResult?.QrCodeBase64,
            UserHash = CryptHelper.Encrypt(_securityContext.CurrentUser.Email)
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Véglegesíti a kétfaktoros authentikátor regisztrációt a kód megadásával
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [Route("twofactor_register")]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "UserAuthenticate_TwoFactorConfirmation")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> TwoFactorConfirmation([FromBody] TwoFactorRegistrationConfirmationModel model)
    {
        var result = (await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new TwoFactorRegistrationConfirmationCommand()
        {
            GlobalUserId = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId,
            TwoFactorCode = model.AuthenticationCode

        })) as TwoFactorRegistrationConfirmationCommandResult;

        return (result?.Result ?? false) ? Ok() : BadRequest();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A bejelentkezett felhasználó adatainak lekérése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [Route("get-current-user-status")]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "UserAuthenticate_GetCurrentUserStatus")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserEntityStatusDto>> GetCurrentUserStatus()
    {
        var globalId = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId;

        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecAuthEntityQuery { GlobalId = globalId }))?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto secUserEntity)
        {
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecUser" });
        }

        var result = new SecUserEntityStatusDto
        {
            TwoFactorAuthenticationEnabled = Config.TryGetBoolValue("TwoFactorAuthenticationEnabled") ?? true, //TODO tenant-specific implementation
            TwoFactorAuthenticationConfiguredForUser = secUserEntity.TwoFactorStatus == TwoFactorStatus.Verified,
            IsLocked = secUserEntity.IsLocked
        };

        return Ok(result);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.System;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.System;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers.System;

/// <summary>
/// DictItemsControllerBase
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public abstract class DictItemsControllerBase: ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// The command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// The mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DictItemsControllerBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    protected DictItemsControllerBase(IQueryService queryService, ICommandService commandService, IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/dictitems/{dictItemId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Kódtárelem lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictItemId">Kódtárelem azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{dictItemId}", Name = "GetDictItem")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "DictItems_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DictItemModel>> Get(int dictItemId)
    {
        if (dictItemId == 0)
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "DictItem azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new DictItemEntityQuery {Id = dictItemId, IsDeleted = false}))?.Entity is not DictItemEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse {Type = "DictItem"});

        var result = _mapper.Map<DictItemModel>(queryResponse);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/dictitems/{dictItemId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Kódtárelem szerkesztése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictItemId">Kódtárelem azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{dictItemId}", Name = "PutDictItem")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "DictItems_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DictItemModel>> Put(int dictItemId, ModifyDictItemRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifyDictItemCommand
        {
            Id = dictItemId,
            Value = request.Value
        }) as ModifyDictItemCommandResult;

        if (response?.DictItemEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<DictItemModel>(response.DictItemEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/dictitems/{dictItemId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Kódtárelem törlése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictItemId">Kódtárelem azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{dictItemId:int}", Name = "DeleteDictItem")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "DictItems_Delete")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DeleteDictItemCommandResult>> Delete(int dictItemId)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteDictItemCommand
        {
            Id = dictItemId
        }) as DeleteDictItemCommandResult;

        if (response is not { IsSuccess: true })
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
    }
}

using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

/// <summary>
/// DictsControllerBase

[ApiController]
[Authorize]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/dicts")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public abstract class DictsControllerBase : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// The command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// The mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// The ti dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the is system filter.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The is system filter.
    /// </value>
    protected bool? IsSystemFilter { get; set; } = null;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DictsControllerBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    protected DictsControllerBase(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache)
    {
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/dicts
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes kódtár lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetDicts")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Dicts_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<DictModel>>> GetAll()
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new DictEntityQuery { IsSystemFilter = IsSystemFilter }))?.Items is DictEntityDto[] dictEntityDtos)
            || dictEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Dict" });

        var result = dictEntityDtos.Select(t => _mapper.Map<DictModel>(t));
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/dicts/{dictCode}/items
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes kódtárelem lekérdezése adott kódtárhoz
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictCode">The dictionary code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{dictCode}/items", Name = "GetDictItemsForDict")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Dicts_GetAllDictItemsForDict")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<DictItemModel>>> GetAllDictItemsForDict(string dictCode)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dictCode))
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Kódtár kód megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new DictItemEntityQuery { DictCode = dictCode, IsDeleted = false }))?.Items is DictItemEntityDto[] dictItemEntityDtos)
            || dictItemEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "DictItem" });

        var result = dictItemEntityDtos.Select(t => _mapper.Map<DictItemModel>(t));
        return Ok(result);
    }
    // GET: api/dicts/{dType}/dict-items
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes kódtárelem lekérdezése adott kódtárhoz
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictCode">The dictionary code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{dictType}/dict-items", Name = "GetDictItemsFromDictType")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Dicts_GetAllDictItemsFromDictType")]
    public ActionResult<IEnumerable<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>> GetAllDictItemsFromDictType(DictType dictType)
    {
        var items = _tiDictCache.GetItems(dictType);
        if (items is null)       
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse{ Error = "Kódtár tipús nem létezik!" });
        
        var itemRefs = items
            .Select(item => _mapper.Map<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>(item))
            .ToList();

        return itemRefs;
    }
    // GET: api/dicts/{dictCode}/items/{dictItemCode}
    /// <summary>
    /// Az kódtárelem lekérdezése kódtárelem kódja alapján adott kódtárból.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictCode">The dictionary code.</param>
    /// <param name="dictItemCode">The dictionary item code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{dictCode}/code/{dictItemCode}", Name = "GetDictItemByCodeForDict")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Dicts_GetDictItemByCodeForDict")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DictItemModel>> GetDictItemByCodeForDict(string dictCode, string dictItemCode)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dictCode))
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Kódtár kód megadása kötelező!",
            });

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dictItemCode))
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Kódtárelem kód megadása kötelező!",
            });

        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new DictItemEntityQuery { DictCode = dictCode, Code = dictItemCode, IsDeleted = false }))?.Entity is not DictItemEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "DictItem" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<DictItemModel>(queryResponse);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/dicts/{code}
    /// <summary>
    /// Kódtár lekérdezése kód azonosító alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code">Kódtár azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{code}", Name = "GetDict")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Dicts_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DictModel>> Get(string code)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Kódtár azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new DictEntityQuery { Code = code }))?.Entity is not DictEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Dict" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<DictModel>(queryResponse);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/dicts/{code}
    /// <summary>
    /// Kódtár szerkesztés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code">Kódtár azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{code}", Name = "PutDict")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Dicts_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DictModel>> Put(string code, ModifyDictRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifyDictCommand
        {
            Code = code,
            Name = request.Name
        }) as ModifyDictCommandResult;

        if (response?.DictEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<DictModel>(response.DictEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: /api/dicts/{dictId}/dictitems
    /// <summary>
    /// Kódtárelem létrehozása kódtárhoz
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictId">The dictionary identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("{dictId}/dictitems", Name = "PostDictItem")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Dicts_PostDictItem")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DictModel>> PostDictItem(int dictId, CreateDictItemRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreateDictItemCommand
        {
            Code = request.Code,
            Value = request.Value,
            ParentDictId = dictId
        }) as CreateDictItemCommandResult;

        if (response?.DictItemEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<DictItemModel>(response.DictItemEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/dicts/{dictCode}/items/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes szótár elem lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictCode">The dictionary code.</param>
    /// <param name="text">The text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{dictCode}/items/entity-ref", Name = "GetDictItemsEntityRef")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Dicts_GetDictItemsEntityRef")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>[]>> GetDictItemsEntityRef(string dictCode, string? text)
    {
        var dictItems = _tiDictCache.GetDictByCode(dictCode).Items;

        // Kerületek esetén rendezzük számérték szerinti növekvő sorrendbe
        if (dictCode == DictCodeAttribute.Get(DictType.District) && dictItems != null)
            dictItems = dictItems.OrderBy(x => int.Parse(x.Code)).ToList();

        var result = dictItems?.Select(x => _mapper.Map<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>(x));
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/dicts/{dictCode}/tenant-independent-items
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes TENANTFÜGGETLEN szótár elem lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dictCode">The dictionary code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{dictCode}/tenant-independent-items", Name = "GetTenantIndependentDictItemsByCode")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Dicts_GetTenantIndependentDictItemsByCode")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TenantIndependentDictItemModel[]>> GetTenantIndependentDictItemsByCode(string dictCode)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dictCode))
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Kódtár kód megadása kötelező!"
            });

        var result = _tiDictCache.GetItemsByCode(dictCode)?
            .Select(x => _mapper.Map<TenantIndependentDictItemModel>(x));
        return Ok(result);
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Security;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Security.Principal;
using System.Text;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// SharedSecurityExtensions
/// </summary>
public static class SharedSecurityExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the token validation parameters.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The token validation parameters.
    /// </value>
    public static TokenValidationParameters TokenValidationParameters => new TokenValidationParameters()
    {
        ValidateIssuer = true,
        ValidateAudience = true,
        ValidateLifetime = true,
        ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
        ClockSkew = TimeSpan.Zero, // treat the token as invalid as soon as it expires
        ValidAudience = Config.GetStringValue("JWT.ValidAudience"),
        ValidIssuer = Config.GetStringValue("JWT:ValidIssuer"),
        IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Config.GetStringValue("JWT:Secret")))
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// Registers the API security context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder.</param>
    public static void RegisterAPISecurityContext(this ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.Register((c, p) =>
        {
            var acc = c.Resolve<IHttpContextAccessor>();
            return acc.HttpContext?.User;
        }).As<IPrincipal>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        builder.Register((c, p) =>
        {
            var securityContext = p.TryGetNamedParameter<SecurityContext>("securityContext") ?? null;
            if (securityContext != null)
                return securityContext;

            var acc = c.Resolve<IHttpContextAccessor>();
            string? ip = acc.HttpContext?.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString();

            var tenantCode = acc.HttpContext?.User.Claims.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Type == CustomClaimTypes.TenantCode)?.Value.ToString();
            var userIdentifier = acc.HttpContext?.User.Claims.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Type == ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value.ToString();
            var email = acc.HttpContext?.User.Claims.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Type == ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value?.ToString();
            var isSystemString = acc.HttpContext?.User.Claims.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Type == CustomClaimTypes.IsSystem)?.Value?.ToString();
            Guid userGlobalId;

            if (userIdentifier != null)
            {
                Guid.TryParse((string?)userIdentifier, out userGlobalId);
                _ = bool.TryParse(isSystemString, out bool isSystem);

                if (acc.HttpContext != null)
                {

                    var roles = acc.HttpContext.User.Claims.Where(x => x.Type == ClaimTypes.Role).Select(x => x.Value.ToString()).ToArray();
                    securityContext = SecurityContext.Create(c.Resolve<IComponentContext>(),
                        new SecUser(
                            userGlobalId,
                            email,
                            tenantCode,
                            email,
                            email,
                            roles,
                            Array.Empty<string>(),
                            isSystem),
                        Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                        ip ?? "0.0.0.0");

                }

            }

            if (securityContext == null)
                securityContext = SecurityContext.Create(c.Resolve<IComponentContext>(),
                    SecUser.AnonymousSecUser(null /* Tenant independent */),
                    Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                    ip ?? "0.0.0.0");

            return securityContext;
        }).InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the energia menedzsment authentication.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The services.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static AuthenticationBuilder AddEnergiaMenedzsmentAuthentication(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        return services.AddAuthentication(options =>
            {
                options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
                options.DefaultChallengeScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
                options.DefaultScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
            })
            .AddJwtBearer(options =>
            {
                options.SaveToken = true;
                options.RequireHttpsMetadata = false;
                options.TokenValidationParameters = TokenValidationParameters;
            });
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Filters;

/// <summary>
/// Attribute to enforce tenant code requirements on controller actions.
/// <para>
/// Use this attribute to specify whether a tenant code must be present or absent for the current user
/// when executing an action. If <paramref name="IsRequired"/> is true, the action will only execute if
/// the current user's <c>TenantCode</c> is not null or empty. If <paramref name="MustBeEmpty"/> is true,
/// the action will only execute if the current user's <c>TenantCode</c> is null or empty.
/// </para>
/// <para>
/// <b>Note:</b> <paramref name="IsRequired"/> and <paramref name="MustBeEmpty"/> cannot both be true.
/// </para>
/// </summary>
public class TenantCodeRequiredAttribute : TypeFilterAttribute
{
    /// <param name="IsRequired">If <paramref name="IsRequired"/> is true, the action will only execute if
    /// the current user's <c>TenantCode</c> is not null or empty.</param>
    /// <param name="MustBeEmpty">If <paramref name="MustBeEmpty"/> is true,
    /// the action will only execute if the current user's <c>TenantCode</c> is null or empty.</param>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException"></exception>
    public TenantCodeRequiredAttribute(bool IsRequired = true, bool MustBeEmpty = false) : base(typeof(TenantCodeRequiredFilter))
    {
        if (IsRequired && MustBeEmpty)
            throw new ArgumentException($"{nameof(IsRequired)} and {nameof(MustBeEmpty)} cannot both be true.");

        Arguments = [IsRequired, MustBeEmpty];
    }
}

public class TenantCodeRequiredFilter : IActionFilter
{
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    private readonly bool _isRequired;
    private readonly bool _mustBeEmpty;

    public TenantCodeRequiredFilter(SecurityContext securityContext, bool isRequired, bool mustBeEmpty)
    {
        if (isRequired && mustBeEmpty)
            throw new ArgumentException($"{nameof(isRequired)} and {nameof(mustBeEmpty)} cannot both be true.");

        _securityContext = securityContext;
        _isRequired = isRequired;
        _mustBeEmpty = mustBeEmpty;
    }

    public void OnActionExecuting(ActionExecutingContext context)
    {
        if (_isRequired)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode))
            {
                context.Result = new BadRequestObjectResult($"{nameof(SecUser.TenantCode)} is IsRequired!");
            }
        }
        if (_mustBeEmpty)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode))
            {
                context.Result = new BadRequestObjectResult($"{nameof(SecUser.TenantCode)} is not allowed in this context!");
            }
        }
    }

    public void OnActionExecuted(ActionExecutedContext context)
    {
        // No-op
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.Validators;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.ConfirmRequest;

/// <summary>
/// ConfirmRequestValidator
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TRequest">The type of the request.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;TRequest&gt;" />
public abstract class ConfirmRequestValidator<TRequest> : BaseDtoValidator<TRequest> where TRequest : ConfirmRequest
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The database context
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly IDbContext DbContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ConfirmRequestValidator{TRequest}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected ConfirmRequestValidator(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        DbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        RuleFor(x => x).CustomAsync(MustBeConfirmed);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Musts the be confirmed.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="confirmRequest">The confirm request.</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected abstract Task MustBeConfirmed(TRequest confirmRequest, CustomContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}

using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Scheduler;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.EntityWithRecurrence;

/// <summary>
/// EntityWithRecurrenceCommandValidator
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TEntityWithRecurrenceCommand">The type of the entity with recurrence command.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;TEntityWithRecurrenceCommand&gt;" />
public class EntityWithRecurrenceCommandValidator<TEntityWithRecurrenceCommand>
    : BaseDtoValidator<TEntityWithRecurrenceCommand> where TEntityWithRecurrenceCommand : IEntityWithRecurrenceCommand
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EntityWithRecurrenceCommandValidator{TEntityWithRecurrenceCommand}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public EntityWithRecurrenceCommandValidator()
    {
        // Ha nem egyszer fut, akkor az idő kitöltése kötelező (24 óra percben megfeleltetve 0-1439)
        When(x => x.RecurrenceType != RecurrenceType.Once, () =>
        {
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceTime).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).LessThan(1440);
            RuleFor(x => x.StartAt).NotNull().GreaterThan(DateTime.UtcNow);
        });

        // Egyszer futásnál:
        // Ha most akarjuk futtatni akkor az idő és StartAt sincs kitöltve
        // Ha később akarjuk futtatni akkor az idő és a StartAt van kitöltve
        When(x => x.RecurrenceType == RecurrenceType.Once, () =>
        {
            When(x => x.StartAt is null, () => { RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceTime).Null(); });
            When(x => x.StartAt is not null, () =>
            {
                RuleFor(x => x.StartAt).NotNull().GreaterThan(DateTime.UtcNow);
                RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceTime).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).LessThan(1440);
            });
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceDay).Null();
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceWeek).Null();
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceMonth).Null();
            RuleFor(x => x.EndAt).Null();
        });

        // Napi ismétlődésnél az idő lehet kitöltve
        When(x => x.RecurrenceType == RecurrenceType.Day, () =>
        {
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceDay).Null();
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceWeek).Null();
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceMonth).Null();
        });

        // Heti ismétlődés: idő, nap (1-7)
        When(x => x.RecurrenceType == RecurrenceType.Week, () =>
        {
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceDay).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1).LessThanOrEqualTo(7);
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceWeek).Null();
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceMonth).Null();
        });

        // Havi ismétlődés: idő, nap, hét
        // Ha a hét (1-4) meg van adva akkor a nap (1-7)
        // Ha a hét nincs megadva akkor a nap (1-28)
        When(x => x.RecurrenceType == RecurrenceType.Month, () =>
        {
            When(x => x.RecurrenceWeek is null,
                () => { RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceDay).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1).LessThanOrEqualTo(28); });
            When(x => x.RecurrenceWeek is not null, () =>
            {
                RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceWeek).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1).LessThanOrEqualTo(4);
                RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceDay).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1).LessThanOrEqualTo(7);
            });
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceMonth).Null();
        });

        // Éves ismétlődés: idő, nap, hét, hónap (1-12)
        // Ha a hét (1-4) meg van adva akkor a nap (1-7)
        // Ha a hét nincs megadva akkor a nap (1-28)
        When(x => x.RecurrenceType == RecurrenceType.Year, () =>
        {
            // Jelenleg ez az első variáció van megvalósítva, azaz napot (mint sorszám), és hónapot választunk.
            When(x => x.RecurrenceWeek is null,
                () => { RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceDay).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1).LessThanOrEqualTo(28); });
            
            // Ez komponens szintjén nincs jelenleg
            When(x => x.RecurrenceWeek is not null, () =>
            {
                RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceWeek).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1).LessThanOrEqualTo(4);
                RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceDay).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1).LessThanOrEqualTo(7);
            });
            RuleFor(x => x.RecurrenceMonth).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1).LessThanOrEqualTo(12);
        });
    }
}

using System.Runtime.Serialization;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.Home;

/// <summary>
/// VersionModel
/// </summary>
[DataContract]
public class VersionModel
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Version
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System;
using NHibernate.Linq;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.System;

/// <summary>
/// CreateDictItemRequestValidator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.System.CreateDictItemRequest&gt;" />
public class CreateDictItemRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<CreateDictItemRequest>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The database context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDbContext _dbContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CreateDictItemRequestValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public CreateDictItemRequestValidator(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        
        RuleFor(x => x).CustomAsync(BeValidRequest);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Bes the valid request.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    private async Task BeValidRequest(CreateDictItemRequest request, CustomContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var isCodeUsedByAnyDictItem  = await _dbContext.Session.Query<DictItemEntity>()
            .AnyAsync(x => !x.IsDeleted && x.Code == request.Code && x.Dict.Id == request.DictId, cancellationToken);
        if (isCodeUsedByAnyDictItem)
            context.AddFailure(nameof(CreateDictItemRequest.Code), "A kódnak egyedinek kell lennie");
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

/// SysConfigViewModelMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />

{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SysConfigViewModelMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SysConfigViewModelMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<SysConfigViewModel, SysConfigEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.IsClientConfig, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ConfigName, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ConfigDisplayName, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Description, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ValueType, y => y.Ignore())

            .ForMember(x => x.ConfigValue, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ConfigValue));
        CreateMap<SysConfigEntityDto, SysConfigViewModel>();
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Common\EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI\Models\System\SysConfigViewModelValidator.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.System;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.System;

/// <summary>
/// SysConfigViewModelValidator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.System.SysConfigViewModel&gt;" />
public class SysConfigViewModelValidator : BaseDtoValidator<SysConfigViewModel>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SysConfigViewModelValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public SysConfigViewModelValidator(IQueryService queryService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;

        RuleFor(x => x.ConfigValue).NotNull().MustAsync(ConfigValueBeValid);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Configurations the value be valid.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <param name="configValue">The configuration value.</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">configValue</exception>
    private async Task<bool> ConfigValueBeValid(SysConfigViewModel model, string? configValue,
        PropertyValidatorContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(configValue)) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(configValue));

        var savedModel = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<SysConfigEntityDto>(model.Id, cancellationToken);

        switch (savedModel.ValueType)
        {
            case SysConfigValueType.String:
                return true;
            case SysConfigValueType.Bool:
                return bool.TryParse(configValue, out _);
            case SysConfigValueType.Int:
                return int.TryParse(configValue, out _);
            case SysConfigValueType.TimeSpan:
                return TimeSpan.TryParse(configValue, out _);
            case SysConfigValueType.Dictionary:
                return (await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new DictItemEntityQuery
                {
                    DictCode = savedModel.DictCode,
                    Value = configValue,
                    IsDeleted = false
                }, cancellationToken)).Items.Any();
            case SysConfigValueType.Regex:
                try
                {
                    Regex.Match("", configValue, RegexOptions.None, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000));
                    return true;
                }
                catch (ArgumentException)
                {
                    return false;
                }
            case SysConfigValueType.CronExpression:
                return RegexValid(configValue, @"((((\d+,)+\d+|(\d+(\/|-)\d+)|\d+|\*) ?){5,7})");
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Enums;

using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// Eszköz szinkronizációs job
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class DataNormalizationJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
    private IQueryService _queryService;
    private IResolutionHandler _resHandler;
    private INormalizationService<ConsumptionModel, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> _normalizationService;
    private ICo2eCalculatorService _co2eCalculatorService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant running mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    //HACK for testing
#if DEBUG
    protected override string CronExpression => "0 * * * * ?"; //every minute
#endif


    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        Log.LogInfo("DataNormalizationJob started");

        var securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        _queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        _resHandler = scope.Resolve<IResolutionHandler>();
        _normalizationService = scope.Resolve<INormalizationService<ConsumptionModel, NormalizedConsumptionEntity>>();
        _co2eCalculatorService = scope.Resolve<ICo2eCalculatorService>();

        var measuredEndpointCache = scope.Resolve<ChannelCache>();

        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var syncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                        .Where(x => x.EntityName == "DataNormalization").SingleOrDefault();

        if (syncInfo == null)
        {
            Log.LogError($"Syncronization object \"DataNormalization\" was not found! ");
            return;
        }

        var consumptionCo2eFactorQuery = new Co2eFactorEntityQuery { IsDeleted = false };

        var queryResult = _queryService.QueryEntities(consumptionCo2eFactorQuery).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        IEnumerable<Co2eFactorEntityDto> co2eConsumptionFactorSeries = null;
        if (queryResult is IEntityQueryItemsResult<Co2eFactorEntityDto> itemsResult) 
        {
            co2eConsumptionFactorSeries = itemsResult.Items;
        }

        var currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow;

        try
        {
            UnprocessedConsumptionIoTDataQueryResult? newConsumptions = _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new UnprocessedConsumptionIoTDataQuery
            {
                From = syncInfo.LastSyncDate ?? DateTime.MinValue,
            }).Result as UnprocessedConsumptionIoTDataQueryResult;

            var query = AssembleNeededIntervals(newConsumptions.UnprocessedConsumptions);

            var result = _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query).Result as IntervalSpecifiedUnprocessedConsumptionQueryResult;
            Log.LogDebug($"DataNormalizationJob: UnprocessedConsumptionData.Count = {result.UnprocessedConsumptionData.Count}");

            foreach (var item in result.UnprocessedConsumptionData)
            {
                var measuredEndpointFromCache = measuredEndpointCache.GetByIdentifier(scope, item.MeasuredEndPointIdentifier);
                if (item.AggregationMethod != AggregationMethod.Undefined)
                {
                    var normalizedData = _normalizationService.Normalize(item.ConsumptionModelList, _resHandler, item.AggregationMethod).ToList();
                    foreach (var entity in normalizedData)
                    {
                        /* TODO: szűrés csak a fogyasztás típusú tényezőkre, mert jelenleg csak ezeket kezeljük.
                         * de majd el kell tudni dönteni a MeasurementDescriptor alapján, hogy melyik kategória! */
                        var category = Co2eFactorCategory.Consumption; 
                        decimal? factor = co2eConsumptionFactorSeries.FindByDate(DateOnly.FromDateTime(entity.MeasuredAtUtc), category)?.Factor;
                        
                        //TODO: mi legyen, ha nincs a rendszerben az adott időpontra érvényes tényező?
                        //TODO: csak azt a mérést vegye figyelembe, aminek hatásos energiafogyasztás a típusa.
                        //Ennek az értéke még nem végleges, illetve lehet, hogy majd nem csak fixen 1 lehet, hanem egy előre definiált lista alapján.
                        //if (measuredEndpointFromCache!.MeasurementDescriptor == MeasurementDescriptorConstants.Active)
                        //{
                            entity.Co2eValue = _co2eCalculatorService.CalculateCo2e((decimal?)entity.Value, factor, true); 
                        //}
                        entity.ChannelIdentifier = item.MeasuredEndPointIdentifier;
                        
                        //TODO: Hatékonysági teszt szükséges nagy adathalmazra
                        dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(entity);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (result.UnprocessedConsumptionData.Count > 0) 
            {
                syncInfo.LastSyncDate = currentDate;
                dbContext.Session.Update(syncInfo);
            }
            dbContext.Commit();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("DataNormalizationJob", ex);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.LogInfo("DataNormalizationJob finished");
        }
    }

    private IntervalSpecifiedUnprocessedConsumptionQuery AssembleNeededIntervals(List<ConsumptionEntityDto> newConsumptions)
    {
        var idGrouppedList = newConsumptions.GroupBy(p => p.ChannelIdentifier)
                                            .Select(g => new
                                            {
                                                ChannelIdentifier = g.Key,
                                                Consumptions = g.OrderBy(p => p.MeasuredAtUtc).ToList()
                                            });

        var measuredEnpointIntervals = new List<MeasuredEnpointIntervalsModel>();
        foreach (var groupItem in idGrouppedList)
        {
            if (groupItem.Consumptions.Count != 0)
            {
                var endPointIntervalModel = new MeasuredEnpointIntervalsModel()
                {
                    ChannelIdentifier = groupItem.ChannelIdentifier,
                    Intervals = new List<DateTimeInterval>()
                };

                ConsumptionEntityDto lastItem = null;
                var firstDateTime = groupItem.Consumptions[0].MeasuredAtUtc;
                var startingTime = _resHandler.GetClosestDateTime(firstDateTime, RoundingDirection.Floor);
                var interval = new DateTimeInterval() { From = startingTime };

                for (int i = 0; i < groupItem.Consumptions.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (lastItem != null && lastItem.MeasuredAtUtc.AddMinutes(2 * _resHandler.Resolution) <= groupItem.Consumptions[i].MeasuredAtUtc)
                    {
                        interval.To = _resHandler.GetClosestDateTime(lastItem.MeasuredAtUtc, RoundingDirection.Ceiling);
                        endPointIntervalModel.Intervals.Add(interval);
                        interval = new DateTimeInterval() { From = _resHandler.GetClosestDateTime(groupItem.Consumptions[i].MeasuredAtUtc, RoundingDirection.Floor) };
                    }
                    if (i == groupItem.Consumptions.Count - 1)
                    {
                        interval.To = _resHandler.GetClosestDateTime(groupItem.Consumptions[i].MeasuredAtUtc, RoundingDirection.Ceiling);
                        endPointIntervalModel.Intervals.Add(interval);
                    }
                    lastItem = groupItem.Consumptions[i];
                }

                measuredEnpointIntervals.Add(endPointIntervalModel);
            }
        }

        return new IntervalSpecifiedUnprocessedConsumptionQuery() { Parameters = measuredEnpointIntervals };
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Models;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// IoT nyers adat feldolgozását végrehajtó job
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class DataProcessorJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the cron expression.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The cron expression.
    /// </value>
    protected override string CronExpression => "0 0/1 * * * ?"; // TODO hack, remove later

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant running mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    /// <summary>
    /// The data processing exceptions
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDictionary<string, (Exception Sample, Dictionary<int, List<int>> Ids)>
        _dataProcessingExceptions = new Dictionary<string, (Exception Sample, Dictionary<int, List<int>> Ids)>();

    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    private ILogger<DataProcessorJob>? _logger;

    /// <summary>
    /// Ősosztály feldolgozó logikájának felüldefiniálása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var tenant = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";
        try
        {
            var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
            _logger = scope.Resolve<ILogger<DataProcessorJob>>();
            _logger.LogInfo($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant})Starting Data processing");
            var dictCache = scope.Resolve<TenantDictCache>();
            var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
            var timeSeriesManagers = new Dictionary<string, ITimeSeriesManager?>();
            var unProcessedReadCount = Config.TryGetIntValue($"{JobName}.UnProcessedReadCount") ?? 6000;
            var unProcessedIntervalTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue($"{JobName}.UnProcessedIntervalTimeSpan") ?? TimeSpan.FromHours(12);

            // Vegyük a legkorább, nem feldolgozott IoT adatot, és ennek a dátumát vagyük, mint kezdődátumot.
            // Végdátumot az intervallumhoz a kezdődátum + konfigurációban TimeSpan értékkel állítsuk be, és erre fusson a lekérdezés.
            DateTime? from = GetEarliestDateTime(queryService);

            // Gyors kiszállás, ha nincs feldolgozatlan adat
            if (from is null)
                return;

            DateTime? to = from + unProcessedIntervalTimeSpan;

            var ioTDataQuery = new IoTDataQuery
            {
                From = from,
                To = to,
                Processed = false,
                UnProcessedReadCount = unProcessedReadCount,
                HasChannel = true
            };
            _logger.LogDebug($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}) - Querying with {ioTDataQuery}");

            var iotData = queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(ioTDataQuery).RunSync().Items;

            var batchCmd = new BatchMeasurementDataCreateCommand { Dtos = new List<MeasurementDataEntityDto>() };
            var dataSourceTypes = dictCache.GetItems(scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType)!.ToList();

            ClearExceptionLog();

            foreach (var ioTDataEntityDto in iotData)
            {
                try
                {
                    var code = dataSourceTypes.Single(i => i.Id == ioTDataEntityDto.IoTDataSourceType.Id).Code;

                    if (!timeSeriesManagers.TryGetValue(code, out var seriesManager))
                    {
                        scope.TryResolveNamed(code, out seriesManager);
                        if (seriesManager != null) timeSeriesManagers.Add(code, seriesManager);
                    }

                    if (seriesManager is null)
                    {
                        _logger.LogError($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}) - Time series manager for {code} source type code not found");
                        continue;
                    }

                    seriesManager.AddTelemetriesForDeviceToCommand(ioTDataEntityDto, batchCmd.Dtos);
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    AddExceptionLog(e, ioTDataEntityDto);
                }
            }

            LogExceptionLog(tenant);

            commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(batchCmd).RunSync();

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}");
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Legkorábbi, fel nem dolgozott nyers IoTData mérési időpontjának lekérdezése.
    /// (A nyers adathoz kapcsolódó IoT eszköznek rendelkeznie kell (legalább 1 érvényes) mérési végponttal,
    /// ennek hiányában nem elvégezhető a feldolgozás.)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static DateTime? GetEarliestDateTime(IQueryService queryService)
    {
        var queryResult = queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new GetIoTDataQuery()
        {
            IsProcessed = false, 
            Order = GetIoTDataQuery.Ordering.Earliest,
            HasChannels = true
        }).RunSync();

        var dto = queryResult?.Entity as IoTDataEntityDto;
        var measurementDate = dto?.MeasurementDate;
        return measurementDate != null ? DateTime.SpecifyKind(measurementDate.Value, DateTimeKind.Utc) : null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// ExceptionLog ürítése a job kapcsán.
    /// </summary>
    private void ClearExceptionLog() => _dataProcessingExceptions.Clear();

    /// <summary>
    /// Loggolás a jobhoz, hogy visszakövethető legyen egy hiba esetén, hogy mely nyers IoTData entitások feldolgozása során történt a hiba.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="exception">Kivétel</param>
    /// <param name="ioTDataEntityDto">Kapcsolódó IoT nyers adat DTO</param>
    private void AddExceptionLog(Exception exception, IoTDataEntityDto ioTDataEntityDto)
    {
        var key = exception.GetType().FullName ?? "(?)";

        if (!_dataProcessingExceptions.TryGetValue(key, out var ids))
        {
            ids = (exception, new Dictionary<int, List<int>>());
            _dataProcessingExceptions.Add(key, ids);
        }

        if (!ids.Ids.TryGetValue(ioTDataEntityDto.IoTDevice.Id, out var iotDataIds))
        {
            iotDataIds = new List<int>();
            ids.Ids.Add(ioTDataEntityDto.IoTDevice.Id, iotDataIds);
        }

        iotDataIds.Add(ioTDataEntityDto.Id);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A hibakezelés során összeállított adatok alapján a hibaloggolás végrehajtása.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    private void LogExceptionLog(string tenantCode)
    {
        foreach (var (exceptionName, ids) in _dataProcessingExceptions)
        {
            var idString = ids.Ids.Select(x => $"IoT Device {x.Key}: [{string.Join(",", x.Value)}]");

            _logger?.LogInfo( $"{JobName}(tenant: {tenantCode}) - IotDevice and IotData ids for {exceptionName} exception: {{ {string.Join(",", idString)} }}");
            _logger?.LogError(ids.Sample, $"{JobName}(tenant: {tenantCode}) - DataProcessorJob error");
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
