/// <summary>
/// A Consumption adatokon pótérték kezelést végző job.
/// Az elvárt mérési gyakoriság szerint hiányos adatok interpolálására szolgál.
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class IoTConsumptionInterpolatorJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
#if DEBUG
    protected override string CronExpression => "0 * * * * ?"; //TODO: hack, remove later, replace with real job configuration in db or appsettings
#endif

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant running mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    /// <summary>
    /// The data processing exceptions
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDictionary<string, (Exception Sample, Dictionary<int, List<int>> Ids)>
        _dataProcessingExceptions = new Dictionary<string, (Exception Sample, Dictionary<int, List<int>> Ids)>();

    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    private ILogger<IoTConsumptionInterpolatorJob>? _logger;

    /// <summary>
    /// Ősosztály feldolgozó logikájának felüldefiniálása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var tenant = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

        var acquired = ConsumptionCommandHandler.ConsumptionCommandLock.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
        if (!acquired)
        {
            throw new TimeoutException($"{nameof(IoTRawDataProcessorJob)}: Unable to aquire lock for {nameof(BatchConsumptionDataCreateCommand)}, try again later.");
        }

        try
        {
            var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
            _logger = scope.Resolve<ILogger<IoTConsumptionInterpolatorJob>>();
            _logger.LogInfo($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}) Starting Data processing");
            var factory = scope.Resolve<IDataProcessorFactory>();
            var dictCache = scope.Resolve<TenantDictCache>();
            var tenantIndependentDictCache = scope.Resolve<TenantIndependentDictCache>();
            var measuredEndpointCache = scope.Resolve<ChannelCache>();
            var deviceCache = scope.Resolve<IoTDeviceCache>();
            var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
            var unProcessedReadCount = Config.TryGetIntValue($"{JobName}.UnProcessedReadCount") ?? 5000;
            var unProcessedIntervalTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue($"{JobName}.UnProcessedIntervalTimeSpan") ?? TimeSpan.FromHours(12);

            // Vegyük a legkorább, nem feldolgozott consumption adatot, és ennek a dátumát vagyük, mint kezdődátumot.
            // Végdátumot az intervallumhoz a kezdődátum + konfigurációban TimeSpan értékkel állítsuk be, és erre fusson a lekérdezés.
            DateTime? from = GetEarliestDateTime(queryService, scope);

            // Gyors kiszállás, ha nincs feldolgozatlan adat
            if (from is null)
                return;

            //az idő paramétereket kerek 15 percre kell kiegészíteni (a from-ot lefelé, a to-t felfelé kerekítve)
            from = from.Value.GetPreviousBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
            DateTime to = from.Value + unProcessedIntervalTimeSpan; //a legkorábbihoz képest +12 óra (vagy amennyi konfig szerint)
            to = to.GetNextBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));

            //TODO: tesztelni!!!
            var consumptionQuery = new ConsumptionTimeWindowQuery
            {
                MeasurementStartUtc = from.Value,
                MeasurementEndUtc = to,
                BatchSize = unProcessedReadCount
            };
            _logger.LogDebug("{JobName} (tenant: {tenant}) - Querying with {consumptionQuery}", JobName, tenant, consumptionQuery);


            //var consumptionData = queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(consumptionQuery).RunSync().Items;
            if (queryService.ExecuteQuery(consumptionQuery).RunSync() is not UnprocessedConsumptionIoTDataQueryResult queryResult)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to run ConsumptionTimeWindowQuery");
            }
            var consumptionData = queryResult.UnprocessedConsumptions;

            var dataSourceTypes = dictCache.GetItems(scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType)!.ToList();

            ClearExceptionLog();

            var batchConsumptionUpdateCommand = new BatchConsumptionDataInsertOrUpdateAfterInterpolationCommand();

            var consumptionDataByEndpoint = consumptionData
                .GroupBy(x => x.Channel.Id)
                .ToDictionary(i => i.Key, i => i.ToList());

            foreach (var grp in consumptionDataByEndpoint)
            {
                try
                {
                    var actualMeasuredEndpoint = measuredEndpointCache.GetById(scope, grp.Key);
                    if (actualMeasuredEndpoint is null)
                    {
                        throw new Exception($"MeasuredEndpoint not found: {grp.Key}");
                    }

                    //TODO: az interpolátor fajtáját valahonnan kiolvasni. egyelőre csak egy van, azt használjuk általánosan: FifteenMinLinearInterpolator
                    var interpolator = factory.GetInterpolator(BusinessLogic.ConsumptionInterpolators.FifteenMinLinearInterpolator.DataSourceTypeCode);
                    var items = grp.Value ?? [];

                    var interpolatedList = interpolator.Interpolate(
                        items,
                        actualMeasuredEndpoint.TimeUnit,
                        from.Value,
                        to,
                        templateDto: items.FirstOrDefault()
                        //ha az egész endpointra nincs semmi adat ebben a batch-ben, akkor itt hibát fog dobni,
                        //ezért adjunk át valami template dto-t, úgyis csak navigációs property-ket használunk fel belőle.

                        ).ToList();
                    /*leválogatni:
                     - ahol csak státuszt frissítünk
                     - ahol az értéket és quality-t is frissíteni kell, de a Measured timestamp és a többi mező nem változott (a LastModified-t is frissíti a commandhandler)
                     - és amik teljesen új rekordok. 
                      (ezeknél ki kell tölteni még hiányzó mezőket (pl. MeasuredEndpoint, Device, MeasurementDescriptor) - ja nem, mert template-ből tölti az interpolátor belseje)
                    */
                    //ezeknek az IsHandled státuszát kell csak update-elni - elég id-ket gyűjteni hozzá
                    var unchangedListIds = interpolatedList.Where(x => x.DataQuality == DataQuality.Valid).Select(x => x.Id).ToHashSet();
                    //ezeknél a Value-t, a DataQuality-t és az  IsHandled státuszt kell update-elni
                    var interpolatedChangedItems = interpolatedList.Where(x => x.DataQuality != DataQuality.Valid && x.Id != 0).ToList();
                    //ezeket pedig insertálni kell
                    var interpolatedNewItems = interpolatedList.Where(x => x.DataQuality != DataQuality.Valid && x.Id == 0).ToList(); //new items get Id=0 because they were never persisted in the db yet, so I can filter them like this

                    //a három listára egy közös commandban mentjük a db-be (a CommandServiceServer intézi a tranzakciót)
                    batchConsumptionUpdateCommand.ProcessedUnchagedIds.UnionWith(unchangedListIds);
                    batchConsumptionUpdateCommand.ChangedDtos.AddRange(interpolatedChangedItems);
                    batchConsumptionUpdateCommand.NewDtos.AddRange(interpolatedNewItems);

#if DEBUG
                    //TODO: check for duplicates! - remove this block if issue resolved

                    //batchConsumptionUpdateCommand.ProcessedUnchagedIds --> ez HashSet, ebben nem lehet duplikáció

                    var zeroIds = batchConsumptionUpdateCommand.ChangedDtos.Where(x => x.Id == 0);
                    if (zeroIds.Any())
                    { //ezek létező entitásokból kapott dto-k nem szabadna 0 id-vel jönniük!
                        System.Diagnostics.Debugger.Break();
                    }

                    var changedDuplicatesGrp = batchConsumptionUpdateCommand.ChangedDtos
                        .GroupBy(x => new { deviceId = x.IoTDevice.Id, channelId = x.Channel.Id, x.MeasuredAtUtc })
                        .Where(g => g.Count() > 1);
                    var changedDuplicatesDict = changedDuplicatesGrp.ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.ToList());
                    if (changedDuplicatesDict.Count > 0)
                    {
                        System.Diagnostics.Debugger.Break();
                    }

                    var newDuplicatesGrp = batchConsumptionUpdateCommand.NewDtos
                        .GroupBy(x => new { deviceId = x.IoTDevice.Id, channelId = x.Channel.Id, x.MeasuredAtUtc })
                        .Where(g => g.Count() > 1);
                    var newDuplicatesDict = newDuplicatesGrp.ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.ToList());
                    if (newDuplicatesDict.Count > 0)
                    {
                        System.Diagnostics.Debugger.Break();
                    }
#endif
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    //ha valami csoportos hiba van, akkor az egész csoportot hibásnak jelöljük (pl. measuredEndpoint nem található)
                    //a hibásak státuszát is be kell állítani, hogy legközelebb már ne kerüljön feldolgozásra
                    grp.Value?.ForEach(x =>
                    {
                        batchConsumptionUpdateCommand.ProcessedUnchagedIds.Add(x.Id);
                        AddExceptionLog(e, x);
                    });
                }
            }
            LogExceptionLog(tenant);

            if (batchConsumptionUpdateCommand.HasAnyDtos) //ne futtasson commandot, ha nincs mit menteni
                commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(batchConsumptionUpdateCommand).RunSync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}");
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}");
        }
        finally
        {
            if (acquired)
                ConsumptionCommandHandler.ConsumptionCommandLock.Release();
        }
    }

    //TODO: ezt a QueryHandler-en keresztül kéne lekérni inkább?
    private DateTime? GetEarliestDateTime(IQueryService queryService, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var earliest = dbContext.Session.Query<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.IsHandled == false)
            .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc)   //MeasuredAtUtc szerinti legkorábbit keressük, ami még nincs feldolgozva. így azokra is sor kerül, amik utólag jöttek be.         
            .FirstOrDefault()
            ?.MeasuredAtUtc ?? null;

        return earliest is null ? null : DateTime.SpecifyKind(earliest.Value, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// ExceptionLog ürítése a job kapcsán.
    /// </summary>
    private void ClearExceptionLog() => _dataProcessingExceptions.Clear();

    /// <summary>
    /// Loggolás a jobhoz, hogy visszakövethető legyen egy hiba esetén, hogy mely nyers IoTData entitások feldolgozása során történt a hiba.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="exception">Kivétel</param>
    /// <param name="consumptionEntityDto">Kapcsolódó IoT nyers adat DTO</param>
    private void AddExceptionLog(Exception exception, ConsumptionEntityDto consumptionEntityDto)
    {
        var key = exception.GetType().FullName ?? "(?)";

        if (!_dataProcessingExceptions.TryGetValue(key, out var ids))
        {
            ids = (exception, new Dictionary<int, List<int>>());
            _dataProcessingExceptions.Add(key, ids);
        }

        if (!ids.Ids.TryGetValue(consumptionEntityDto.IoTDevice.Id, out var iotDataIds))
        {
            iotDataIds = new List<int>();
            ids.Ids.Add(consumptionEntityDto.IoTDevice.Id, iotDataIds);
        }

        iotDataIds.Add(consumptionEntityDto.Id);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A hibakezelés során összeállított adatok alapján a hibaloggolás végrehajtása.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    private void LogExceptionLog(string tenantCode)
    {
        foreach (var (exceptionName, ids) in _dataProcessingExceptions)
        {
            var idString = ids.Ids.Select(x => $"IoT Device {x.Key}: [{string.Join(",", x.Value)}]");

            _logger?.LogInfo($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenantCode}) - IotDevice and IotData ids for {exceptionName} exception: {{ {string.Join(",", idString)} }}");
            _logger?.LogError(ids.Sample, $"{JobName}(tenant: {tenantCode}) - {JobName} error");
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Managers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CsvImport;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// IoT adat import ellenőrző job
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class IoTDataImportCheckerJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        //1.Lekérni egy feltöltött import fájlt
        var fajl = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataImportEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Status == ImportState.Uploaded)
            .OrderBy(x => x.CreateDate).Asc.Take(1).SingleOrDefault();

        try
        {
            //2a-ha nincs ilyen, vége a futásnak
            if (fajl == null ) return;
            if (fajl.Data == null)
            {
                Log.LogError($"A feltöltött állomány üres (id:{fajl.Id}, fájlnév:{fajl.FileName})");
                fajl.Status = ImportState.Error;
                fajl.StatusDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
                dbContext.Session.Update(fajl);
                dbContext.Commit();
                return;
            }

            //2b-ha van, átállítani a státuszát ellenőrzés alatt
            fajl.Status = ImportState.Checking;
            fajl.StatusDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
            dbContext.Session.Update(fajl);
            dbContext.Commit();

            //3.Megnézni az endpoint típusát:
            var device = dbContext.Session.Get<IoTDeviceEntity>(fajl.IoTDevice.Id);
            MemoryStream? resultStream = null;
            MemoryStream inStream = new(fajl.Data);
            bool hasErrors = false;
            string deviceSerialNumber = device.SerialNumber?.ToString() ?? "";

            //3a. Smappee - a smappee adatstruktúrájához hasonlítani a csv fájlt
            if (device.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.Smappee.GetEntityCode())
                resultStream = new SmappeeImportManager(scope, fajl.Id).ValidateCsv(inStream, deviceSerialNumber, out hasErrors);
            //3b. SolarEdge - a SolarEdge adatstruktúrájához hasonlítani a csv fájlt
            else if (device.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.SolarEdge.GetEntityCode())
                resultStream = new SolarEdgeImportManager(scope, fajl.Id).ValidateCsv(inStream, deviceSerialNumber, out hasErrors);
            //3c. OtherConsumptionMeter - az egyéb adatstruktúrájához hasonlítani a csv fájlt, aszerint hogy fogyasztó/termelő az endpoint
            else if (device.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.OtherConsumptionMeter.GetEntityCode())
                resultStream = new OtherConsumptionMeterImportManager(scope, fajl.Id, fajl.Unit, fajl.TimeUnit).ValidateCsv(inStream, deviceSerialNumber, out hasErrors);
            //3d. OtherSolarPanel - az egyéb adatstruktúrájához hasonlítani a csv fájlt, aszerint hogy fogyasztó/termelő az endpoint
            else if (device.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.OtherSolarPanel.GetEntityCode())
                resultStream = new OtherSolarPanelImportManager(scope, fajl.Id, fajl.Unit, fajl.TimeUnit).ValidateCsv(inStream, deviceSerialNumber, out hasErrors);
            else return;

            //4. Nem megfelelő fájl esetén beírni a resultdatába a hibát és hibás státuszra tenni, majd vége a futásnak
            if (hasErrors)
            {
                fajl.Status = ImportState.Rejected;
                fajl.StatusDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
                fajl.Data = null;
                fajl.ResultData = resultStream.ToArray();
                dbContext.Session.Update(fajl);
                dbContext.Commit();
                return;
            }

            //5. Ha nem volt hiba, átállítani a státuszt megfelelőnek és vége, majd a másik job elkapja
            fajl.Status = ImportState.WaitingForImport;
            fajl.StatusDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
            dbContext.Session.Update(fajl);
            dbContext.Commit();
            return;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            fajl.Status = ImportState.Error;
            fajl.StatusDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
            dbContext.Session.Update(fajl);
            dbContext.Commit();
            Log.LogError($"{nameof(IoTDataImportCheckerJob)}_{nameof(Elapsed)} - Hiba az importállomány ellenőrzése során: {ex}");
            throw;
        }   
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Managers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CsvImport;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using NHibernate;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// IoT adat import job
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class IoTDataImporterJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();

        //1.Megfogni egy ellenőrzött, megfelelő import fájlt
        var fajl = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataImportEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Status == ImportState.WaitingForImport)
            .OrderBy(x => x.CreateDate).Asc.Take(1).SingleOrDefault();

        try
        {

            //2a-ha nincs ilyen, vége a futásnak
            if (fajl == null) return;
            if (fajl.Data == null)
            {
                Log.LogError($"A feltöltött állomány üres (id:{fajl.Id}, fájlnév:{fajl.FileName})");
                fajl.Status = ImportState.Error;
                fajl.StatusDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
                dbContext.Session.Update(fajl);
                dbContext.Commit();
                return;
            }

            //2b-ha van, átállítani a státuszát importálás alatt
            fajl.Status = ImportState.InProgress;
            fajl.StatusDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
            dbContext.Session.Update(fajl);
            dbContext.Commit();

            //3.Megnézni az endpoint típusát:
            var device = dbContext.Session.Get<IoTDeviceEntity>(fajl.IoTDevice.Id);
           
            MemoryStream inStream = new(fajl.Data);
            BatchUploadIoTJSONDataCommand? cmd = null;
            var deviceIdentifier = device.Identifier ?? Guid.Empty;
            string deviceSerialNumber = device.SerialNumber?.ToString() ?? "";

            //3a. Smappee - a smappee adatstruktúrája szerint soronként beolvasni a csv tartalmát és betenni a batch-be
            if (device.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.Smappee.GetEntityCode())
                cmd = new SmappeeImportManager(scope, fajl.Id).ImportFromCsv(inStream, deviceIdentifier, deviceSerialNumber).RunSync();
            //3b. SolarEdge - a SolarEdge adatstruktúrája szerint soronként beolvasni a csv tartalmát és betenni a batch-be
            else if (device.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.SolarEdge.GetEntityCode())
                cmd = new SolarEdgeImportManager(scope, fajl.Id).ImportFromCsv(inStream, deviceIdentifier, deviceSerialNumber).RunSync();
            //3c. OtherConsumptionMeter - az egyéb adatstruktúrája szerint soronként beolvasni a csv tartalmát és betenni a batch-be
            else if (device.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.OtherConsumptionMeter.GetEntityCode())
                cmd = new OtherConsumptionMeterImportManager(scope, fajl.Id, fajl.Unit, fajl.TimeUnit).ImportFromCsv(inStream, deviceIdentifier, deviceSerialNumber).RunSync();
            //3d. OtherSolarPanel - az egyéb adatstruktúrája szerint soronként beolvasni a csv tartalmát és betenni a batch-be
            else if (device.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.OtherSolarPanel.GetEntityCode())
                cmd = new OtherSolarPanelImportManager(scope, fajl.Id, fajl.Unit, fajl.TimeUnit).ImportFromCsv(inStream, deviceIdentifier, deviceSerialNumber).RunSync();
            else return;

            //4. A batch-et beszúrni a db-be, hiba esetén naplózni, tranzakciót rollback-elni
            if (cmd != null && cmd.Commands.Count > 0)
            {
                var tran = dbContext.Session.GetCurrentTransaction();
                commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(cmd).RunSync();
                Log.LogInfo($"Number of imported records: {cmd.Commands.Count}");
                Log.LogInfo($"[Device - {device.SerialNumber}] import done.");
                if (tran == null || !tran.IsActive) dbContext.BeginTransaction();
                fajl.Status = ImportState.Imported;
                fajl.StatusDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
                fajl.Data = null;
                fajl.ResultData = null;
                dbContext.Session.Update(fajl);
                dbContext.Commit();
                return;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            fajl.Status = ImportState.ImportError;
            fajl.StatusDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
            dbContext.Session.Update(fajl);
            dbContext.Commit();
            Log.LogError($"{nameof(IoTDataImportCheckerJob)}_{nameof(Elapsed)} - Hiba az importálás során: {ex}");
            throw;
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;

using Quartz;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// IoT nyers adat feldolgozását végrehajtó job
/// A mérési végpont típusa alapján eldönti, hogy milyen validációs és feldolgozási logikát alkalmazzon.
/// A DataReceiver consumptions táblájába tölti át a feldolgozott adatokat.
/// Elvégzi az adatok minőségi besorolását (tény, hiányzó, zavart)
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class IoTRawDataProcessorJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
#if DEBUG
    //protected override string CronExpression => "0 0/1 * * * ?"; //TODO: hack, remove later, replace with real job configuration in db or appsettings
#endif

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant running mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    /// <summary>
    /// The data processing exceptions
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDictionary<string, (Exception Sample, Dictionary<int, List<int>> Ids)>
        _dataProcessingExceptions = new Dictionary<string, (Exception Sample, Dictionary<int, List<int>> Ids)>();

    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    private ILogger<IoTRawDataProcessorJob>? _logger;

    /// <summary>
    /// Ősosztály feldolgozó logikájának felüldefiniálása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var tenant = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

        var acquired = ConsumptionCommandHandler.ConsumptionCommandLock.Wait(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
        if (!acquired)
        {
            throw new TimeoutException($"{nameof(IoTRawDataProcessorJob)}: Unable to aquire lock for {nameof(BatchConsumptionDataCreateCommand)}, try again later.");
        }

        try
        {
            var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
            _logger = scope.Resolve<ILogger<IoTRawDataProcessorJob>>();
            _logger.LogInfo($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}) Starting Data processing");
            var factory = scope.Resolve<IDataProcessorFactory>();
            var dictCache = scope.Resolve<TenantDictCache>();
            var tenantIndependentDictCache = scope.Resolve<TenantIndependentDictCache>();
            var channelsCache = scope.Resolve<ChannelCache>();
            var deviceCache = scope.Resolve<IoTDeviceCache>();
            var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
            var unProcessedReadCount = Config.TryGetIntValue($"{JobName}.UnProcessedReadCount") ?? 6000;
            var unProcessedIntervalTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue($"{JobName}.UnProcessedIntervalTimeSpan") ?? TimeSpan.FromHours(12);

            // Vegyük a legkorább, nem feldolgozott IoT adatot, és ennek a dátumát vagyük, mint kezdődátumot.
            // Végdátumot az intervallumhoz a kezdődátum + konfigurációban TimeSpan értékkel állítsuk be, és erre fusson a lekérdezés.
            DateTime? from = GetEarliestDateTime(queryService);

            // Gyors kiszállás, ha nincs feldolgozatlan adat
            if (from is null)
                return;

            DateTime? to = from + unProcessedIntervalTimeSpan;

            var ioTDataQuery = new IoTDataQuery
            {
                From = from,
                To = to,
                Processed = false,
                UnProcessedReadCount = unProcessedReadCount,
                HasChannel = true
            };
            _logger.LogDebug($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}) - Querying with {ioTDataQuery}");

            var iotData = queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(ioTDataQuery).RunSync().Items;

            var dataSourceTypes = dictCache.GetItems(scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType)!.ToList();

            ClearExceptionLog();

            var batchConsumptionDataCommand = new BatchConsumptionDataCreateCommand();
            var errorDataIds = new HashSet<int>();

            //az időjárás adat nem "fogyasztás", ezért szerintem annak a feldolgozását ki kéne hagyni, vagy nem Consumption-t csinálni belőle...
            //TODO: a későbbiekben az adatot szétválogatjuk fogyasztás/termelés/egyéb típus szerint -> akár pl. MeasurementDescriptor alapján és a típusnak megfelelő batch commandba küldjük
            //pl. ezt az egész nagy foreach-t szubemtódusokba kell tenni, és az csak az adott típusú eredménnye fog foglalkozni.

            foreach (var data in iotData)
            {
                try
                {
                    var dataTypeCode = dataSourceTypes.Single(i => i.Id == data.IoTDataSourceType.Id).Code;


                    //TODO: azokat az adatokat is be kell szúrni a consumption táblába, amiket nem lehetett feldolgozni, de minden kötelező adat megvan.
                    //így a parser/validator/converter csak akkor dobhat exception-t, ha nagyon nem tud mit kezdeni az adattal, vagy a configgal.


                    var parser = factory.GetParser(dataTypeCode);
                    var validator = factory.GetValidator(dataTypeCode);
                    var dtoConverter = factory.GetConsumptionDtoConverter(dataTypeCode);
                    DataQuality quality = DataQuality.Missing;

                    //==========================================================
                    var device = deviceCache.GetById(scope, data.IoTDevice.Id) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"IotDevice not found by id: {data.IoTDevice.Id}");
                    var deviceChannels = channelsCache.GetByDeviceId(scope, data.IoTDevice.Id);

                    //parse and validate
                    bool canParse = parser.TryParse(data.Data, out var parsedData);
                    if (!canParse)
                    {
                        quality = DataQuality.Invalid; //értelmezhetetlen adat = hibás (de van timestamp)
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        //the validator will read the necessary config from the deviceChannels (minvalue, maxvalue)
                        bool isValid = validator.Validate(parsedData, deviceChannels, out IEnumerable<string> validationErrors);
                        quality = isValid ? DataQuality.Valid : DataQuality.OutOfRange;
                        //TODO: egyébként mit kezdünk a validationErrors-ben lévő validációs hibákkal?
                    }

                    //mivel lehetnek összetett típusú adatok is egy device-on belül, abból egy dtoConverter segítségével állítunk elő egyszerű szám adatokat (akár többet is, ahány féle adat van).
                    //ez akkor is csinál dto-kat, ha érvénytelen volt az adat. (viszont ha az channel configok nem jók, akkor nem)
                    var dtos = dtoConverter.CreateConsumptionEntityDtos(
                        parsedData,
                        data.Id, //a nyers adat entity id-ja
                        quality, //ezt átadjuk, de a belső logika még felülbírálhatja
                        data.IoTDevice,
                        deviceChannels,
                        data.MeasurementDate);

                    batchConsumptionDataCommand.Dtos.AddRange(dtos);
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    AddExceptionLog(e, data);
                    errorDataIds.Add(data.Id); //ide már csak akkor jöhet, ha nagyon hibás a feldolgozás, nem tudunk egy ConsumptionEtityDto-t sem csinálni, mert nincsenek meg a kötelező adatok.
                                               //ebben az esetben a nyers adatot processed-re állítjuk, hogy a következő feldolgozás nem próblja újra.
                }
            }

            LogExceptionLog(tenant);

            if (batchConsumptionDataCommand.Dtos.Count > 0) //ne futtasson commandot, ha nincs mit menteni
                commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(batchConsumptionDataCommand).RunSync();

            if (errorDataIds.Count > 0)
            {
                //a sikertelenül feldolgozott nyers adatoknál (iot_data) is be kéne állítani a processed flag-et, mert különben csak gyűlik és gyűlik, amit a job következő futáskor megpróbál majd újra feldolgozni.
                commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new BatchIoTDataSetProcessedCommand { Ids = errorDataIds }).RunSync();
            }

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}");
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}");
        }
        finally
        {
            if (acquired)
                ConsumptionCommandHandler.ConsumptionCommandLock.Release();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Legkorábbi, fel nem dolgozott nyers IoTData mérési időpontjának lekérdezése.
    /// (A nyers adathoz kapcsolódó IoT eszköznek rendelkeznie kell (legalább 1 érvényes) mérési végponttal,
    /// ennek hiányában nem elvégezhető a feldolgozás.)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static DateTime? GetEarliestDateTime(IQueryService queryService)
    {
        var queryResult = queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new GetIoTDataQuery()
        {
            IsProcessed = false,
            Order = GetIoTDataQuery.Ordering.Earliest,
            HasChannels = true
        }).RunSync();

        var dto = queryResult?.Entity as IoTDataEntityDto;
        var measurementDate = dto?.MeasurementDate;
        return measurementDate != null ? DateTime.SpecifyKind(measurementDate.Value, DateTimeKind.Utc) : null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// ExceptionLog ürítése a job kapcsán.
    /// </summary>
    private void ClearExceptionLog() => _dataProcessingExceptions.Clear();

    /// <summary>
    /// Loggolás a jobhoz, hogy visszakövethető legyen egy hiba esetén, hogy mely nyers IoTData entitások feldolgozása során történt a hiba.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="exception">Kivétel</param>
    /// <param name="ioTDataEntityDto">Kapcsolódó IoT nyers adat DTO</param>
    private void AddExceptionLog(Exception exception, IoTDataEntityDto ioTDataEntityDto)
    {
        var key = exception.GetType().FullName ?? "(?)";

        if (!_dataProcessingExceptions.TryGetValue(key, out var ids))
        {
            ids = (exception, new Dictionary<int, List<int>>());
            _dataProcessingExceptions.Add(key, ids);
        }

        if (!ids.Ids.TryGetValue(ioTDataEntityDto.IoTDevice.Id, out var iotDataIds))
        {
            iotDataIds = new List<int>();
            ids.Ids.Add(ioTDataEntityDto.IoTDevice.Id, iotDataIds);
        }

        iotDataIds.Add(ioTDataEntityDto.Id);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A hibakezelés során összeállított adatok alapján a hibaloggolás végrehajtása.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    private void LogExceptionLog(string tenantCode)
    {
        foreach (var (exceptionName, ids) in _dataProcessingExceptions)
        {
            var idString = ids.Ids.Select(x => $"IoT Device {x.Key}: [{string.Join(",", x.Value)}]");

            _logger?.LogInfo($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenantCode}) - IotDevice and IotData ids for {exceptionName} exception: {{ {string.Join(",", idString)} }}");
            _logger?.LogError(ids.Sample, $"{JobName}(tenant: {tenantCode}) - {JobName} error");
        }
    }
}

                TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes//nem számít, nincs használva a property ennél a típusnál
            };
            batchCommand.Commands.Add(cmd);
        }
        if(batchCommand.Commands.Any())
            commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(batchCommand).RunSync();
    }

using System.Globalization;
using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Managers.OpenWeatherMap;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Enums.Smappee;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// OpenWeatherMapJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class OpenWeatherMapJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the name of the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the job.
    /// </value>
    protected override string JobName => "WeatherJob";

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        var openWeatherMapManager = scope.Resolve<IOpenWeatherMapManager>();

        IList<IoTDeviceEntityDto> devices = new List<IoTDeviceEntityDto>();
        var result = queryService.QueryEntities(new IoTDeviceQuery()
        {
            DeviceTypeCode = IoTDeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.GetEntityCode()
        }).RunSync() as EntityQueryItemsResult<IoTDeviceEntityDto>;
        devices = result?.Items ?? devices;

        foreach (var device in devices)
        {
            if (device.Identifier.HasValue)
            {
                var latStr = device.Configuration.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == IoTConfigProperty.Lat)?.Value;
                var lonStr = device.Configuration.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == IoTConfigProperty.Lon)?.Value;
                double lat;
                double lon;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(latStr) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lonStr) && 
                    double.TryParse(latStr, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out lat) && double.TryParse(lonStr, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out lon))
                {
                        var currentWeatherData = openWeatherMapManager.GetCurrentWeatherData(lat, lon, allowOneCall: false).RunSync();
                        var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(currentWeatherData);
                        commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand
                        {
                            DeviceIdentifier = device.Identifier.Value,
                            Data = json,
                            IoTDataSourceTypeCode = IoTDataSourceType.OpenWeatherAPIv2_5.GetEntityCode(),
                            MeasurementDate = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(currentWeatherData.Dt ?? 0).DateTime,
                            IsUnique = true,
                            TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes//nem számít, nincs használva a property ennél a típusnál
                        }).RunSync();
                }
                else
                {
                    Log.LogWarning("OpenWeatherMap lat&lon is not defined or is invalid.");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Managers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// SmappeeJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SmappeeJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
    //HACK for testing
    // protected override string CronExpression => "0/20 * * * * ?";

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        try
        {
            var enabled = Config.TryGetBoolValue("SmappeeJobEnabled", true) ?? true;
            if (!enabled) return;

            var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
            var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
            var smappeeManager = scope.Resolve<ISmappeeManager>();

            var result = queryService.QueryEntities(new IoTDeviceQuery()
            {
                DeviceTypeCode = IoTDeviceType.Smappee.GetEntityCode(),
                HasChannels = true // Csak a Channel rendelkező eszközöktől kérjünk fogyasztási adatokat
            })
                .RunSync() as IEntityQueryItemsResult<IoTDeviceEntityDto>;

            var devices = result!.Items;

            foreach (var device in devices)
            {
                if (device.Identifier.HasValue)
                {
                    Log.LogInfo($"Fetch [{device.DeviceName}:{device.Identifier}:{device.Id}] telemetry...");
                    var latestDateTimestamp = GetLatestDateTimestamp(queryService, device.Id);
                    var slStr = device.Configuration?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == IoTConfigProperty.ServiceLocationId)?.Value.ToString();
                    if (slStr == null) continue;
                    var serviceLocationId = int.Parse(slStr);
                    var electricityConsumption = smappeeManager.GetElectricityConsumption(serviceLocationId, null, latestDateTimestamp, null).RunSync();
                    var cmd = new BatchUploadIoTJSONDataCommand();
                    if (electricityConsumption.Consumptions != null)
                        foreach (var electricityConsumptionConsumption in electricityConsumption.Consumptions)
                        {
                            var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(electricityConsumptionConsumption);
                            cmd.Commands.Add(new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand
                            {
                                DeviceIdentifier = device.Identifier.Value,
                                Data = json,
                                IoTDataSourceTypeCode = IoTDataSourceType.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3.GetEntityCode(),
                                MeasurementDate = DateTimeOffset
                                    .FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(electricityConsumptionConsumption.Timestamp).UtcDateTime,
                                IsUnique = true,
                                SendSyncMessage = false,
                                TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes
                            });

                        }
                    commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(cmd).RunSync();
                    Log.LogInfo($"Number of telemetry: {electricityConsumption?.Consumptions?.Length ?? 0}");
                    Log.LogInfo($"[{device.DeviceName}:{device.Identifier}:{device.Id}] done.");
                }
            }

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
             Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}: {ex}");
           Log.LogError($"{JobName}: {ex}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the latest date timestamp.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceId">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static long? GetLatestDateTimestamp(IQueryService queryService, int deviceId)
    {
        var queryResult = queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new GetIoTDataQuery()
        {
            DeviceId = deviceId,
            IoTDataSourceType = IoTDataSourceType.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3,
            HasChannels = true
        }).RunSync();
        
        var dto = queryResult?.Entity as IoTDataEntityDto;
        var startDay = DateTime.Today.AddDays(-30);
        var measurementDate = dto?.MeasurementDate ?? new DateTime(startDay.Year, startDay.Month, startDay.Day, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc); ;
        long? timestamp = measurementDate.UnixTimestampTotalMilliseconds();
        return timestamp;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Managers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// SolarEdgeJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SolarEdgeJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        try
        {
            var enabled = Config.TryGetBoolValue("SolarEdgeJobEnabled", true) ?? true;
            if (!enabled) return;

            var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
            var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
            var manager = scope.Resolve<ISolarEdgeManager>();
            //var hours = Config.GetStringValue("SolarEdgeJob.ProcessingHours");
            var hours = scope.Config().TryGetIntValue("SolarEdgeJob.ProcessingHours");

            var result = queryService.QueryEntities(new IoTDeviceQuery()
            {
                DeviceTypeCode = IoTDeviceType.SolarEdge.GetEntityCode(),
                HasChannels = true // Csak a Channel rendelkező eszközöktől kérjünk fogyasztási adatokat
            })
                .RunSync() as IEntityQueryItemsResult<IoTDeviceEntityDto>;

            var devices = result!.Items;

            foreach (var device in devices)
            {
                if (device.Identifier.HasValue)
                {
                    var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    Log.LogInfo($"Fetch [{device.DeviceName}:{device.Identifier}:{device.Id}] solaredge data...");
                    var latestDate = GetLatestDate(queryService, device.Id, IoTDataSourceType.SolarEdgeAPI);
                    var startDay = DateTime.Today.AddDays(-30);
                    var from = latestDate ?? new DateTime(startDay.Year, startDay.Month, startDay.Day, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
                    var to = from.AddHours(hours ?? 24);
                    if (to > now) to = now;

                    //SitePower  //TODO SiteId paramétert betölteni a measured endpoint metadatákból
                    var power = manager.GetSitePower(1, from.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), to.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")).RunSync();
                    //SiteEnergy  //TODO SiteId paramétert betölteni a measured endpoint metadatákból
                    var energy = manager.GetSiteEnergy(1, from.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), to.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")).RunSync();

                    SolarEdgeProductionModel? production = TransformSolaredgeData(power, energy);

                    var cmd = new BatchUploadIoTJSONDataCommand();
                    if (production != null)
                    {
                        var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(production);
                        cmd.Commands.Add(new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand
                        {
                            DeviceIdentifier = device.Identifier.Value,
                            Data = json,
                            IoTDataSourceTypeCode = IoTDataSourceType.SolarEdgeAPI.GetEntityCode(),
                            MeasurementDate = production.Values.Max(x => x.Date),
                            IsUnique = true,
                            SendSyncMessage = false,
                            EntityTypeName = production.GetType().Name,
                            TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes
                        });
                    }

                    commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(cmd).RunSync();
                    Log.LogInfo($"Number of sitePower telemetry: {power?.Power?[0].Values.Length ?? 0}");
                    Log.LogInfo($"Number of siteEnergy telemetry: {energy?.Energy?[0].Values.Length ?? 0}");
                    Log.LogInfo($"[{device.DeviceName}:{device.Identifier}:{device.Id}] done.");
                }
            }

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}: {ex}");
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}: {ex}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Transforms the solaredge data.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="power">The power.</param>
    /// <param name="energy">The energy.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private SolarEdgeProductionModel? TransformSolaredgeData(PowerProductionCoreModel power, EnergyProductionCoreModel energy)
    {
        if (power == null || energy == null) return null;

        var production = new SolarEdgeProductionModel
        {
            TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes,// power.Power[0].TimeUnit,
            PowerUnit = power.Power[0].Unit,
            EnergyUnit = energy.Energy[0].Unit,
        };

        var values = new List<ProductionValueModel>();
        foreach (var pval in power.Power[0].Values)
        {
            values.Add(new ProductionValueModel
            {
                Date = pval.Date,
                Power = pval.Value,
                Energy = energy.Energy[0].Values.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Date == pval.Date)?.Value ?? null,
            });
        }
        production.Values = values.ToArray();

        return production;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the latest date.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceId">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static DateTime? GetLatestDate(IQueryService queryService, int deviceId, IoTDataSourceType source)
    {
        var queryResult = queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new GetIoTDataQuery()
        {
            DeviceId = deviceId,
            IoTDataSourceType = source,
            HasChannels = true
        }).RunSync();

        var dto = queryResult?.Entity as IoTDataEntityDto;
        var measurementDate = dto?.MeasurementDate;
        return measurementDate;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.MeasurementPointSync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Services.FrameworkApi;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// Eszköz szinkronizációs job
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.DataReceiverTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SyncDeviceJob : DataReceiverTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant running mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    //HACK for testing
    protected override string CronExpression => "0/20 * * * * ?";

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        Log.LogInfo("SyncDeviceJob started");

        var securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        var service = scope.Resolve<SyncDeviceService>();
        var mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
        var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        var frameworkApiClientService = scope.Resolve<FrameworkApiClientService>();

        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();


        try
        {
            using (dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction())
            {
                var timeStamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
                var syncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                                .Where(x => x.EntityName == SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync).List().FirstOrDefault();

                if (syncInfo != null && syncInfo.LastModifiedDate.HasValue &&
                    (!syncInfo.LastSyncDate.HasValue || syncInfo.LastSyncDate < syncInfo.LastModifiedDate))
                {
                    var measurementPoints = frameworkApiClientService.Post<SyncMeasurementPointsRequest, IList<MeasurementPointSyncModel>>
                        (FrameworkApi.MeasurementPoint.GetByOrgunitIds_FullRoute,
                         new SyncMeasurementPointsRequest(),
                         securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).RunSync()!;

                    var measurementPointEntityDtos = measurementPoints.Select(mapper.Map<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto>).ToList();

                    var localMeasurementPoints = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity>()
                                                                  .Where(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint == null)
                                                                  .List();

                    //Ez a metódus végzi a mérésipontok szinkronizálását
                    ListHelper.SyncChildren(commandService,
                                            measurementPointEntityDtos,
                                            localMeasurementPoints,
                                            (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                                            dto =>
                                            {
                                                var newDtoItem = commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                                                return dbContext.Session.Load<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                            },
                                            (dto, entity) =>
                                            {
                                                dto.Id = entity.Id;
                                            });

                    var measurementPointSettings = frameworkApiClientService.Get<IList<MeasurementPointSettingSyncModel>>
                       (FrameworkApi.MeasurementPoint.SyncMeasurementPointSetting_FullRoute,
                        securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).RunSync()!;

                    var allMeasurementPointIds = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity>().Select(x => x.Id).List<int>();

                    foreach (var settingModel in measurementPointSettings)
                    {
                        if (allMeasurementPointIds.Any(x => x == settingModel.MeasurementPointId))
                        {
                            var setting = new MeasurementPointSettingSyncedDataReceiverEntity()
                            {
                                MeasurementPoint = dbContext.Session.Load<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity>(settingModel.MeasurementPointId),
                                MeasuredProperty = dbContext.Session.Load<MeasuredPropertyEntity>(settingModel.MeasuredPropertyId),
                                Channel = settingModel.ChannelId.HasValue ? dbContext.Session.Load<ChannelEntity>(settingModel.ChannelId) : null,
                            };
                            dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(setting);
                        }
                    }

                    syncInfo.LastSyncDate = timeStamp;
                    dbContext.Session.Update(syncInfo);
                    dbContext.Commit();
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("Device sync", ex);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.LogInfo("SyncDeviceJob finished");
        }
    }
}

                {

                                            withDelete: false);

                    var syncUserRequest = new SyncSecUserRequest() { From = syncInfo.LastSyncDate ?? DateTime.MinValue };
                    var users = _frameworkApiClientService.Post<SyncSecUserRequest, IEnumerable<SecUserSyncModel>>($"{FrameworkApi.User.SyncUser_FullRoute}", syncUserRequest).RunSync();
                    var userEntityDtos = users.Select(mapper.Map<SecUserSyncedEntityDto>).ToList();
                    var localUsers = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserSyncedEntity>().List();

                    ListHelper.SyncChildren(commandService,
                                            userEntityDtos,
                                            localUsers,
                                            (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                                            dto =>
                                            {
                                                var newDtoItem = commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                                                return dbContext.Session.Load<SecUserSyncedEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                            },
                                            withDelete: false);

                    syncInfo.LastSyncDate = timeStamp;
                    dbContext.Session.Update(syncInfo);
                    dbContext.Commit();
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("SyncUserJob sync", ex);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.LogInfo("SyncUserJob finished");
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;

/// <summary>
/// Devizaárfolyam command handler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.ForeignCurrencyEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.ForeignCurrencyEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ForeignCurrencyCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<ForeignCurrencyEntity, ForeignCurrencyEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ForeignCurrencyCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public ForeignCurrencyCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<ForeignCurrencyEntityDto>> validator,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache,
        ICommandService commandService,
        ILifetimeScope scope) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
        _scope = scope;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// DoExecuteEntityCommand override saját command típus lekezelésére.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">Bejövő IEntityCommand ősosztály</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is SaveForeignCurrenciesCommand foreignCurrenciesCommand)
            return DoSaveForeignCurrenciesCommand(foreignCurrenciesCommand);

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Devizaárfolyam mentését vezérlő command handler logika, amely kitölti az adott naptári napokban könyvelt devizák
    /// aktuálisan érvényes árfolyamát.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">A command a bejövő paraméterekkel</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// A mentés eredménye
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">EUR currency is not found in code dictionary.</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoSaveForeignCurrenciesCommand(SaveForeignCurrenciesCommand cmd)
    {
        var foreignCurrencyTypeDto = _tiDictCache.GetItem(Common.Shared.Enums.DictType.Currency, "EUR") 
            ?? throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"EUR currency is not found in code dictionary.");
        
        var from = _scope.Config().GetDateTimeValue("ForeignCurrencyDate");
        var toSaveCurrencies = cmd.DatedCurrencies?.Where(x => x.Key >= from.Date).ToArray();

        Log.LogInfo("ToSaveCurrencies", toSaveCurrencies);

        var lastSavedCurrency =
            DbContext.Session
            .QueryOver<ForeignCurrencyEntity>()
            .OrderBy(x => x.Date)
            .Desc
            .Take(1)
            .List()
            .FirstOrDefault();


        Log.LogInfo("LastSavedCurrency ", lastSavedCurrency);

        if (lastSavedCurrency != null)
        {
            toSaveCurrencies = cmd.DatedCurrencies?.Where(x => x.Key > lastSavedCurrency.Date).ToArray();
        }

        try
        {
            if (toSaveCurrencies != null)
                foreach (var toSaveCurrency in toSaveCurrencies)
                {
                    var entity = new ForeignCurrencyEntity
                    {
                        Date = toSaveCurrency.Key,
                        Value = toSaveCurrency.Value,
                        ForeignCurrencyType = DbContext.Session.Load<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity>(foreignCurrencyTypeDto.Id)
                    };
                    DbContext.Session.Save(entity);
                }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogInfo("Fill missing days ", ex);
        }
        var cmdResult = new SaveForeignCurrenciesCommandResult();
        return cmdResult;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;

/// <summary>
/// HUPX energiaár command handler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityDto&gt;" />
public class HupxEnergyPriceDataCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity, HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// Foreign currency cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ForeignCurrencyCache _foreignCurrencyCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="HupxEnergyPriceDataCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="foreignCurrencyCache">The foreign currency cache.</param>
    public HupxEnergyPriceDataCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        Lazy<IValidator<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        ForeignCurrencyCache foreignCurrencyCache) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        _foreignCurrencyCache = foreignCurrencyCache;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// DoExecuteEntityCommand override saját command típus lekezelésére.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">Bejövő IEntityCommand ősosztály</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command is SaveHupxEnergyCommand saveHupxEnergyCommand
            ? DoSaveHupxEnergyCommand(saveHupxEnergyCommand)
            : base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// HUPX energiár mentését vezérlő command handler logika, amely órára pontosan meghatározza az aznapra érvényes devizaárfolyam alapján
    /// az energiaár értékét.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">Bejövő egyedi command</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoSaveHupxEnergyCommand(SaveHupxEnergyCommand cmd)
    {
        var from = _scope.Config().GetDateTimeValue("ForeignCurrencyDate");
        var energyModels = cmd.HupxTabsModel.PricesAtcFlowsExcelModels;

        var pricesOfEuros =
            _foreignCurrencyCache
            .GetContent(_scope)
            .ToArray();
        var savedEnergyDatum =
            DbContext.Session
            .QueryOver<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.DeliveryDateTime > from)
            .List();

        //Kitöltjük a hiányzó forint értékeket (ha vannak, és ha a hozzá tartozó forint érték szerepel az adatbázisban)
        foreach (var toUpdate in savedEnergyDatum.Where(x => !x.PriceOfForeignCurrencyInHuf.HasValue))
        {
            var priceOf1Euro = Array.Find(pricesOfEuros, e => e.Date.GetHungarianLocalTimeFromUtc().Date == toUpdate.DeliveryDateTime.GetHungarianLocalTimeFromUtc().Date);
            if (priceOf1Euro != null)
            {
                toUpdate.PriceOfForeignCurrencyInHuf = toUpdate.PriceEur * priceOf1Euro.Value;
                DbContext.Session.Update(toUpdate);
            }
        }

        //új sorok felvétele
        var lastSavedEnergyData = savedEnergyDatum.OrderByDescending(x => x.DeliveryDateTime).FirstOrDefault();
        
        // Megjegyzés: azokat az új értékeket keressük, amelyeknek a dátuma NAGYOBB, mint az eddigi legutolsó dátum.
        // Ezért az egyenlőség vizsgálatot lecseréltem a WHERE feltételben.
        var newDatum = lastSavedEnergyData != null ?
            energyModels.Where(x => x.DeliveryDateTime > lastSavedEnergyData.DeliveryDateTime) :
            energyModels;

        foreach (var newData in newDatum)
        {
            var priceOfCurrancyInHuf = Array.Find(pricesOfEuros, x => x.Date.GetHungarianLocalTimeFromUtc().Date == newData.DeliveryDateTime.GetHungarianLocalTimeFromUtc().Date);
            var entity = new HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity
            {
                PriceEur = newData.PriceEur,
                DeliveryDateTime = newData.DeliveryDateTime,
                PriceOfForeignCurrencyInHuf = priceOfCurrancyInHuf != null ? newData.PriceEur * priceOfCurrancyInHuf.Value : null
            };
            DbContext.Session.Save(entity);
        }

        var cmdResult = new SaveHupxEnergyCommandResult();
        return cmdResult;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;

using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// Mérési végpont command handler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT.ChannelEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.ChannelEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ChannelCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<ChannelEntity, ChannelEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ChannelCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public ChannelCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<ChannelEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is ChannelCreateCommand createCommand)
            return DoChannelCreateCommand(createCommand);

        if (command is ChannelDeleteCommand deleteCommand)
            return DoChannelDeleteCommand(deleteCommand);

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési végpont létrehozás command
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Device is null</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoChannelCreateCommand(ChannelCreateCommand command)
    {
        var device = 
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Identifier == command.DeviceIdentifier)
            .SingleOrDefault() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Device is null");

        var newDto = new ChannelEntityDto
        {
            Identifier = Guid.NewGuid(),
            IoTDevice = new EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto> 
            { 
                Id = device.Id 
            },
            Configuration = command.Configuration
        };

        newDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(newDto);
        return new ChannelCreateCommandResult { ChannelEntityDto = newDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési végpont törlés guid identifier alapján - command
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid IoT Measured Endpoint Identifier. There is no IoT Measured Endpoint with ChannelIdentifier: '{command.ChannelIdentifier}'</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoChannelDeleteCommand(ChannelDeleteCommand command)
    {
        var channel =
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Identifier == command.ChannelIdentifier)
            .SingleOrDefault();
        if (channel == null || channel.IsDeleted)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT Measured Endpoint Identifier. There is no IoT Measured Endpoint with MeasuredEndpointIdentifier: '{command.ChannelIdentifier}'");

        var deletedDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<ChannelEntityDto>(channel.Id);
        return new ChannelDeleteCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (deletedDto == null) || deletedDto.IsDeleted
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override ChannelEntity ApplyDto(ChannelEntityDto source, ChannelEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.IoTDevice, entity, source.IoTDevice);

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntityDto"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(ChannelEntityDto originalEntityDto, ChannelEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        var resultDto = EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override ChannelEntityDto OnEntityCreated(ChannelEntityDto createdEntity, ChannelEntityDto source)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityCreating(ChannelEntityDto entity, ChannelEntity domainEntity)
    {
        entity.Identifier = Guid.NewGuid();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ChannelEntityDto EntityPostEvent(ChannelEntityDto savedEntityDto, ChannelEntityDto source)
    {
        var savedEntity = DbContext.Session.Load<ChannelEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        // Config lista mentése
        savedEntity.Configuration ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Configuration,
                     savedEntity.Configuration,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Channel = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> { Id = savedEntity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<ChannelConfigValueEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     },
                     (dto, entity) =>
                     {
                         dto.Channel ??= new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> { Id = savedEntity.Id };
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(savedEntity, savedEntityDto);
        return savedEntityDto;
    }
}

using System.Windows.Input;
using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;

using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
