using System.Text;
using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CsvImport;

/// <summary>
/// CSV import menedzser
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CsvImport.IImportManager" />
public abstract class CsvImportManager : IImportManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The type.
    /// </value>
    public abstract IoTDeviceType Type { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// The import identifier
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly int _importId;
    /// <summary>
    /// The selected time unit
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly AggregationLevel _selectedTimeUnit;
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// The reference time
    /// </summary>
    protected DateTime? _referenceTime = null;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CsvImportManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="importId">The import identifier.</param>
    protected CsvImportManager(ILifetimeScope scope, int importId)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        _importId = importId;
        var dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        _selectedTimeUnit = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataImportEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Id == importId)
            .Select(x => x.TimeUnit).Take(1).SingleOrDefault<AggregationLevel>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CSV validáció
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="data">Forrás adat</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">IoT eszköz SerialNumber mezője</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">A mérési ponthoz kapcsolódó MeasurementId érték (lásd: ChannelConfigValue tábla Value mező)</param>
    /// <param name="hasErrors">Hiba történt-e?</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public MemoryStream ValidateCsv(MemoryStream data, string deviceSerialNumber, out bool hasErrors)
    {
        try
        {
            hasErrors = false;
            MemoryStream outStream = new();
            using TextWriter writer = new StreamWriter(outStream, Encoding.UTF8);
            bool isHeader = true;

            using TextReader reader = new StreamReader(data, true);

            var line = reader.ReadLine();
            var result = "";
            while (line != null)
            {
                if (isHeader)
                {
                    result = CheckHeader(line, ';', out bool headerOk);
                    if (!headerOk)
                    {
                        writer.WriteLine(result);
                        hasErrors = true;
                        break;
                    }

                }
                else
                {
                    hasErrors = !ValidateCsvRow(line, deviceSerialNumber, out result) || hasErrors;
                }

                writer.WriteLine(result);

                isHeader = false;
                line = reader.ReadLine();
            }
            writer.Flush();

            outStream.Seek(0, SeekOrigin.Begin);
            return outStream;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            throw;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CSV sor validáció ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">Egy beolvasott sor a forrásadatból</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">Eszköz SerialNumber mező értéke</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="result">The result.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual bool ValidateCsvRow(string row, string deviceSerialNumber, out string result)
    {
        try
        {
            char separator = ';';
            result = string.Empty;

            //1.Validálás
            string validationError = ValidateRow(row, deviceSerialNumber, separator, out DateTime created);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(validationError))
            {
                result = row;
                return true;
            }
            else
            {
                result = row + separator + validationError;
                return false;
            }

        }
        catch (Exception)
        {

            throw;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Imports from CSV.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="data">The data.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceIdentifier">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">The device serial number.</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<BatchUploadIoTJSONDataCommand> ImportFromCsv(MemoryStream data, Guid deviceIdentifier, string deviceSerialNumber, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        BatchUploadIoTJSONDataCommand cmd = new();
        bool isHeader = true;

        TextReader reader = new StreamReader(data, true);

        var line = await reader.ReadLineAsync();

        while (line != null)
        {
            if (isHeader)
            {
            }
            else
                cmd.Commands.Add(await ImportFromCsvRow(line, deviceIdentifier, deviceSerialNumber));

            isHeader = false;
            line = await reader.ReadLineAsync();
        }
        return cmd;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Imports from CSV row.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceIdentifier">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">The device serial number.</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual async Task<UploadIoTJSONDataCommand> ImportFromCsvRow(string row, Guid deviceIdentifier, string deviceSerialNumber, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        char separator = ';';

        UploadIoTJSONDataCommand entity = CreateRow(row, deviceIdentifier, deviceSerialNumber, separator);

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the header.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="line">The line.</param>
    /// <param name="separator">The separator.</param>
    /// <param name="headerOk">if set to <c>true</c> [header ok].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual string CheckHeader(string line, char separator, out bool headerOk)
    {
        headerOk = false;

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)) return "[HERR_01]Hiányzó fejléc";

        headerOk = true;
        return line;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Validates the row.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">The device serial number.</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="separator">The separator.</param>
    /// <param name="created">The created.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected virtual string ValidateRow(string row, string deviceSerialNumber, char separator, out DateTime created)
    {
        created = DateTime.UtcNow;
        string error = string.Empty;

        return string.IsNullOrEmpty(row) ? "[IERR_01]Hiányzó, vagy üres sor" : error;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the row.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceIdentifier">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">The device serial number.</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="separator">The separator.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">
    /// [IERR_01]Hiányzó, vagy üres sor
    /// or
    /// Az importálandó sor eszköz azonosítója nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez feltöltötte az állományt.
    /// or
    /// Az importálandó sor mérési végpont azonosítója nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez feltöltötte az állományt.
    /// </exception>
    protected virtual UploadIoTJSONDataCommand CreateRow(string row, Guid deviceIdentifier, string deviceSerialNumber, char separator)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(row)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("[IERR_01]Hiányzó, vagy üres sor");

        var fields = row.Split(separator);

        if (fields[0].ToLower() != deviceSerialNumber.ToLower()) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("Az importálandó sor eszköz azonosítója nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez feltöltötte az állományt.");   

        var entity = new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand
        {
            DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier,
            IoTDataSourceTypeCode = Type.GetTypeCode().ToString(),
            IoTDataTypeCode = Type.GetTypeCode().ToString(),
            IsUnique = true
        };

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether [is time unit correct] [the specified time string].
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="timeString">The time string.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [is time unit correct] [the specified time string]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    protected bool IsTimeUnitCorrect(string timeString)
    {
        bool ok = true;

        if (DateTime.TryParse(timeString, out DateTime measurementDate))
        {
            if (!_referenceTime.HasValue) _referenceTime = measurementDate;
            else
            {
                var span = measurementDate - _referenceTime.Value;
                switch (_selectedTimeUnit)
                {
                    case AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
                        if (span != TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)) ok = false;
                        break;
                    case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
                        if (span != TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15)) ok = false;
                        break;
                    case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                        if (span != TimeSpan.FromHours(1)) ok = false;
                        break;
                    case AggregationLevel.OneDay:
                        if (span != TimeSpan.FromDays(1)) ok = false;
                        break;
                }
                _referenceTime = measurementDate;
            }
        }

        return ok;
    }

}

    /// </summary>

    /// <param name="importId">The import identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="unit">The unit.</param>
    /// <param name="timeUnit">The time unit.</param>
    public OtherConsumptionMeterImportManager(ILifetimeScope scope, int importId, Unit unit, AggregationLevel timeUnit) : base(scope, importId)
    {
        _unit = unit;
        _timeUnit = timeUnit;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CSV sor validáció ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">Egy beolvasott sor a forrásadatból</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">Eszköz SerialNumber mező értéke</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="result">The result.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override bool ValidateCsvRow(string row, string deviceSerialNumber, out string result)
    {
        char separator = ';';
        result = string.Empty;

        //1.Validálás

        {
            result = row;
            return true;

    {
        char separator = ';';

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the header.

    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override string CheckHeader(string line, char separator, out bool headerOk)
    {
        headerOk = false;

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)) return "[HERR_01]Hiányzó fejléc";

        var fields = line.Split(separator);
        if (fields.Length != 5) return $"[HERR_02]Nem megfelelő számú mező a fejlécben, vagy nem megfelelő szeparátor karakter";

        headerOk = true;
        return line;

    /// Validates the row.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">The device serial number.</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="separator">The separator.</param>
    /// <param name="created">The created.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override string ValidateRow(string row, string deviceSerialNumber, char separator, out DateTime created)
    {
        created = DateTime.UtcNow;
        string error = string.Empty;

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(row)) return "[IERR_01]Hiányzó, vagy üres sor";

        var fields = row.Split(separator);
        if (fields.Length != 5) return $"[IERR_02]Nem megfelelő számú mező a sorban, vagy nem megfelelő szeparátor karakter";

        if (!IsTimeUnitCorrect(fields[2].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower())) return $"[IERR_03]Nem megfelelő a kiválasztott időegység ehhez a csv állományhoz!";

        var currentValue = fields[0].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#DeviceSerial(1): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (currentValue != deviceSerialNumber.ToLower()) error += "#deviceserial(1): Az eszköz azonosító nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez az állomány fel lett töltve";

        currentValue = fields[1].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#ChannelIdentifier(2): Hiányzó kötelező mező";      

        currentValue = fields[2].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#MeasurementDate(3): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (!DateTime.TryParse(currentValue, out DateTime measurementDate)) error += "#MeasurementDate(3): Nem értelmezhető Dátum mező";

        currentValue = fields[3].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length > 0 && !double.TryParse(currentValue, out double power)) error += "#Power(4): Nem értelmezhető érték, vagy nem megfelelő tizedes szeparátor (elvárt: ',')";

        currentValue = fields[4].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length > 0 && !double.TryParse(currentValue, out double energy)) error += "#Energy(5): Nem értelmezhető érték, vagy nem megfelelő tizedes szeparátor (elvárt: ',')";

        //currentValue = fields[1].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"');
        //if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#xxxxxxxx(2): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        //else if (currentValue.Length > 255) error += "#xxxxxxxx(2): A beolvasott érték több, mint 255 karakter";

        return error;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the row.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceIdentifier">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">The device serial number.</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="separator">The separator.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">
    /// [IERR_01]Hiányzó, vagy üres sor
    /// or
    /// #deviceserial(1): Az eszköz azonosító nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez az állomány fel lett töltve
    /// or
    /// #MeasurementDate(3): Nem értelmezhető Dátum mező
    /// or
    /// #Power(4): Nem értelmezhető érték
    /// or
    /// #Energy(5): Nem értelmezhető érték
    /// </exception>
    protected override UploadIoTJSONDataCommand CreateRow(string row, Guid deviceIdentifier, string deviceSerialNumber, char separator)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(row)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("[IERR_01]Hiányzó, vagy üres sor");

        var fields = row.Split(separator);

        var entity = new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand();
        OtherConsumerProducerModel other = new()
        {
            ImportId = _importId
        };

        var currentValue = fields[0].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue != deviceSerialNumber.ToLower()) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#deviceserial(1): Az eszköz azonosító nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez az állomány fel lett töltve");
        entity.DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier;
        other.DeviceSerial = deviceSerialNumber;

        currentValue = fields[1].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        other.EndpointIdentifier = currentValue;

        currentValue = fields[2].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!DateTime.TryParse(currentValue, out DateTime measurementDate)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#MeasurementDate(3): Nem értelmezhető Dátum mező");
        entity.MeasurementDate = measurementDate;
        other.MeasurementDate = measurementDate;

        currentValue = fields[3].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) other.Power = null;
        else if (double.TryParse(currentValue, out double power)) other.Power = power;
        else throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#Power(4): Nem értelmezhető érték");

        currentValue = fields[4].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) other.Energy = null;
        else if (double.TryParse(currentValue, out double energy)) other.Energy = energy;
        else throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#Energy(5): Nem értelmezhető érték");

        other.EndpointType = EndpointUnitType.Consumer;
        other.TimeUnit = _timeUnit;
        other.Unit = _unit;

        entity.SendSyncMessage = false;
        entity.IoTDataSourceTypeCode = IoTDataSourceType.OtherConsumptionMeterImport.GetEntityCode();
        var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(other);
        entity.Data = json;
        entity.EntityTypeName = other.GetType().Name;
        entity.IsUnique = true;
        entity.TimeUnit = _timeUnit;

        return entity;
    }
}

        entity.DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier;
        other.DeviceSerial = deviceSerialNumber;

        currentValue = fields[1].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        other.EndpointIdentifier = currentValue;

        currentValue = fields[2].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!DateTime.TryParse(currentValue, out DateTime measurementDate)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#MeasurementDate(3): Nem értelmezhető Dátum mező");
        entity.MeasurementDate = measurementDate;
        other.MeasurementDate = measurementDate;

        currentValue = fields[3].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) other.Power = null;
        else if (double.TryParse(currentValue, out double power)) other.Power = power;
        else throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#Power(4): Nem értelmezhető érték");

        currentValue = fields[4].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) other.Energy = null;
        else if (double.TryParse(currentValue, out double energy)) other.Energy = energy;
        else throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#Energy(5): Nem értelmezhető érték");

        other.EndpointType = EndpointUnitType.Producer;
        other.TimeUnit = _timeUnit;
        other.Unit = _unit;

        entity.SendSyncMessage = false;
        entity.IoTDataSourceTypeCode = IoTDataSourceType.OtherSolarPanelImport.GetEntityCode();
        var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(other);
        entity.Data = json;
        entity.EntityTypeName = other.GetType().Name;
        entity.IsUnique = true;
        entity.TimeUnit = _timeUnit;

        return entity;
    }
}

    {
        char separator = ';';
        result = string.Empty;

        //1.Validálás
        string validationError = ValidateRow(row, deviceSerialNumber, separator, out DateTime created);
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(validationError))
        {
            result = row;
            return true;
        }
        else
        {
            result = row + separator + validationError;
            return false;
        }
    }

    {
        char separator = ';';

        UploadIoTJSONDataCommand entity = CreateRow(row, deviceIdentifier, deviceSerialNumber, separator);

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the header.
    /// </summary>

    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override string CheckHeader(string line, char separator, out bool headerOk)
    {
        headerOk = false;

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(line)) return "[HERR_01]Hiányzó fejléc";

        var fields = line.Split(separator);
        if (fields.Length != 10) return $"[HERR_02]Nem megfelelő számú mező a fejlécben, vagy nem megfelelő szeparátor karakter";

        headerOk = true;
        return line;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Validates the row.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">The device serial number.</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="separator">The separator.</param>
    /// <param name="created">The created.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override string ValidateRow(string row, string deviceSerialNumber, char separator, out DateTime created)
    {
        created = DateTime.UtcNow;
        string error = string.Empty;

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(row)) return "[IERR_01]Hiányzó, vagy üres sor";

        var fields = row.Split(separator);
        if (fields.Length != 10) return $"[IERR_02]Nem megfelelő számú mező a sorban, vagy nem megfelelő szeparátor karakter";

        if (!IsTimeUnitCorrect(fields[2].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower())) return $"[IERR_03]Nem megfelelő a kiválasztott időegység ehhez a csv állományhoz!";

        var currentValue = fields[0].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#DeviceSerial(1): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (currentValue != deviceSerialNumber.ToLower()) error += "#deviceserial(1): Az eszköz sorozatszám nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez az állomány fel lett töltve";

        currentValue = fields[1].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#ChannelIdentifier(2): Hiányzó kötelező mező";      

        currentValue = fields[2].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#MeasurementDate(3): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (!DateTime.TryParse(currentValue, out DateTime measurementDate)) error += "#MeasurementDate(3): Nem értelmezhető Dátum mező";

        currentValue = fields[3].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#Active(4): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double active)) error += "#Active(4): Nem értelmezhető érték, vagy nem megfelelő tizedes szeparátor (elvárt: ',')";

        currentValue = fields[4].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#Current(5): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double current)) error += "#Current(5): Nem értelmezhető érték, vagy nem megfelelő tizedes szeparátor (elvárt: ',')";

        currentValue = fields[5].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#LineVoltage(6): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double lineVoltage)) error += "#LineVoltage(6): Nem értelmezhető érték, vagy nem megfelelő tizedes szeparátor (elvárt: ',')";

        currentValue = fields[6].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#PhaseVoltage(7): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double phaseVoltage)) error += "#PhaseVoltage(7): Nem értelmezhető érték, vagy nem megfelelő tizedes szeparátor (elvárt: ',')";

        currentValue = fields[7].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#Reactive(8): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double reactive)) error += "#Reactive(8): Nem értelmezhető érték, vagy nem megfelelő tizedes szeparátor (elvárt: ',')";

        currentValue = fields[8].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#Voltage(9): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double voltage)) error += "#Voltage(9): Nem értelmezhető érték, vagy nem megfelelő tizedes szeparátor (elvárt: ',')";

        currentValue = fields[9].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#RelativeConsumption(10): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        else if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double relativeConsumption)) error += "#RelativeConsumption(10): Nem értelmezhető érték, vagy nem megfelelő tizedes szeparátor (elvárt: ',')";

        //currentValue = fields[1].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"');
        //if (currentValue.Length == 0) error += "#xxxxxxxx(2): Hiányzó kötelező mező";
        //else if (currentValue.Length > 255) error += "#xxxxxxxx(2): A beolvasott érték több, mint 255 karakter";

        return error;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the row.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="row">The row.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceIdentifier">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">The device serial number.</param>
    /// <param name="endpointNumber">The endpoint number.</param>
    /// <param name="separator">The separator.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">
    /// [IERR_01]Hiányzó, vagy üres sor
    /// or
    /// #deviceserial(1): Az eszköz sorozatszáma nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez az állomány fel lett töltve
    /// or
    /// #endpointidentifier(2): A megadott mérési végpont azonosító nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez az állomány fel lett töltve
    /// or
    /// #MeasurementDate(3): Nem értelmezhető Dátum mező
    /// or
    /// #Active(4): Nem értelmezhető érték
    /// or
    /// #Current(5): Nem értelmezhető érték
    /// or
    /// #LineVoltage(6): Nem értelmezhető érték
    /// or
    /// #PhaseVoltage(7): Nem értelmezhető érték
    /// or
    /// #Reactive(8): Nem értelmezhető érték
    /// or
    /// #Voltage(9): Nem értelmezhető érték
    /// or
    /// #RelativeConsumption(10): Nem értelmezhető érték
    /// </exception>
    protected override UploadIoTJSONDataCommand CreateRow(string row, Guid deviceIdentifier, string deviceSerialNumber, char separator)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(row)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("[IERR_01]Hiányzó, vagy üres sor");

        var fields = row.Split(separator);

        var entity = new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand();
        ConsumptionImportModel consumption = new()
        {
            ImportId = _importId
        };

        var currentValue = fields[0].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (currentValue != deviceSerialNumber.ToLower()) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#deviceserial(1): Az eszköz sorozatszáma nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez az állomány fel lett töltve");
        entity.DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier;
        consumption.DeviceSerial = deviceSerialNumber;

        currentValue = fields[1].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        //if (currentValue != endpointNumber.ToLower()) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#endpointidentifier(2): A megadott mérési végpont azonosító nem egyezik azzal, amelyhez az állomány fel lett töltve");
        consumption.EndpointIdentifier = currentValue;

        currentValue = fields[2].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!DateTime.TryParse(currentValue, out DateTime measurementDate)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#MeasurementDate(3): Nem értelmezhető Dátum mező");
        entity.MeasurementDate = measurementDate;
        consumption.MeasurementDate = measurementDate;

        currentValue = fields[3].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double active)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#Active(4): Nem értelmezhető érték");
        consumption.Active = active;

        currentValue = fields[4].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double current)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#Current(5): Nem értelmezhető érték");
        consumption.Current = current;

        currentValue = fields[5].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double lineVoltage)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#LineVoltage(6): Nem értelmezhető érték");
        consumption.LineVoltage = lineVoltage;

        currentValue = fields[6].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double phaseVoltage)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#PhaseVoltage(7): Nem értelmezhető érték");
        consumption.PhaseVoltage = phaseVoltage;

        currentValue = fields[7].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double reactive)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#Reactive(8): Nem értelmezhető érték");
        consumption.Reactive = reactive;

        currentValue = fields[8].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double voltage)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#Voltage(9): Nem értelmezhető érték");
        consumption.Voltage = voltage;

        currentValue = fields[9].TrimStart('"').TrimEnd('"').Trim().ToLower();
        if (!double.TryParse(currentValue, out double relativeConsumption)) throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException("#RelativeConsumption(10): Nem értelmezhető érték");
        consumption.RelativeConsumption = relativeConsumption;

        entity.SendSyncMessage = false;
        entity.IoTDataSourceTypeCode = IoTDataSourceType.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import.GetEntityCode();
        var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(consumption);
        entity.Data = json;
        entity.EntityTypeName = consumption.GetType().Name;
        entity.IsUnique = true;
        entity.TimeUnit = AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes;

        return entity;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Serilog;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.ExcelImport.Currency;

/// <summary>
/// Deviza excel import
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.ExcelImport.Currency.ICurrencyExcelImport" />
public class CurrencyExcelImport : ICurrencyExcelImport
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Import excel
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IImportExcel _importExcel;
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CurrencyExcelImport"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="importExcel">The import excel.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public CurrencyExcelImport(
        IImportExcel importExcel,
        ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _importExcel = importExcel;
        _scope = scope;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Devizaárfolyam mentés (alapműködés szerint mentésre kerül, hogy 1 EUR hány HUF adott időpontban).
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="exactDate">Adott dátum specifikus árfolyam lekérdezéséhez</param>
    /// <param name="from">Árfolyamok lekérdezésénél kezdődátum</param>
    /// <param name="to">Árfolyamok lekérdezésénél végdátum</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// Dátum - árfolyam érték szótár
    /// </returns>
    public async Task<Dictionary<DateTime, float>> GetHufPriceOfEuro(DateTime? exactDate = null, DateTime? from = null, DateTime? to = null)
    {
        var result = new Dictionary<DateTime, float>();
        Log.Information("Get Currency table data");
        var table = await GetTable();

        Log.Information("Get First existing value Currency table data");
        DateTime dateKey = default;
        int distanceFromInputDate = default;

        if (exactDate.HasValue)
            GetFirstExistingValue(exactDate.Value, table, out dateKey, out distanceFromInputDate);

        if (from.HasValue)
            GetFirstExistingValue(from.Value, table, out dateKey, out distanceFromInputDate);

        Log.Information($"Currency table data: {table}");
        foreach (var row in table)
        {
            if (!DateTime.TryParse(row[0], out var key))
                continue;

            // Forrás magyar helyi idő szerinti dátumot utc-vé alakítjuk.
            key = key.GetUtcFromHungarianLocalTime();

            var couldParseFloat = float.TryParse(row[1], out var value);
            var canAdd = true;

            if (exactDate.HasValue)
            {
                canAdd = dateKey.Date == exactDate.Value.Date ? key == exactDate.Value.Date : key >= dateKey.Date && key <= exactDate.Value.Date;
            }

            if (from.HasValue)
                canAdd = key >= dateKey;
            if (to.HasValue)
                canAdd = key <= to.Value;

            if (canAdd)
                result.Add(key, couldParseFloat ? value : default);
        }

        FillMissingValues(result, distanceFromInputDate);

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Segéd metódus az árfolyamos excel releváns adatainak kinyeréséhez.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>Stringtömb a releváns adatokkal, amelyeket fel lehet dolgozni</returns>
    private async Task<string[][]> GetTable()
    {
        var url = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("CurrencyExcelImport.Url");
        var columns = GetColumns(_scope.Config().GetStringValue("CurrencyExcelImport.Columns"));
        var sheetname = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("CurrencyExcelImport.Sheetname");
        var numberOfHeaders = _scope.Config().GetIntValue("CurrencyExcelImport.NumberOfHeaders");

        using HttpClient? client = new();
        using var stream = await client.GetStreamAsync(url);
        using var ms = new MemoryStream();
        stream.CopyTo(ms);
        var table = _importExcel.ReadSheet(ms, columns, sheetname, numberOfHeaders);
        return table;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Segédmetódus numerikus oszlopnevek tömbbe feldolgozásához
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="columnsString">Vesszővel elválasztott numerikus oszlopnév string</param>
    private static int[] GetColumns(string columnsString)
    {
        var splitted = columnsString.Split(",");
        var columns = new List<int>();

        foreach (var columnString in splitted)
        {
            var column = int.Parse(columnString);
            columns.Add(column);
        }

        return columns.ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Segédmetódus a forrásexcelben kimaradó hétvégi árfolyamok feldolgozásához.
    /// </summary>
    private static void GetFirstExistingValue(DateTime sourceDate, string[][] table, out DateTime dateKey, out int distanceFromInputDate)
    {
        dateKey = sourceDate;
        distanceFromInputDate = default;

        foreach (var row in table)
        {
            if (!DateTime.TryParse(row[0], out var key) || key > sourceDate)
                continue;

            // Amennyiben az első, az excelben megtalálható nap [szombat] volt
            if (key.AddDays(2) == sourceDate)
            {
                dateKey = key;
                distanceFromInputDate = 2;
            }

            // Amennyiben az első, az excelben megtalálható nap [vasárnap] volt
            if (key.AddDays(1) == sourceDate)
            {
                dateKey = key;
                distanceFromInputDate = 1;
            }

            // Amennyiben hétköznapra esett a 'from' dátum értéke (ekkor rendelkezünk az aznapi árfolyammal)
            if (key == sourceDate)
            {
                dateKey = key;
                distanceFromInputDate = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A hiányzó napok értékét kitöltjük úgy, hogy a hiányzó napot megelőző létező nap értékét töltjök bele.
    /// Ehhez lehet, hogy "korábbról" kell indulnunk, mint ami a 'from' dátum lenne, ekkor az első 'distance'
    /// darab elemet eltávolítjuk az eredmények közül.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="data"></param>
    /// <param name="distance"></param>
    private static void FillMissingValues(Dictionary<DateTime, float> data, int distance)
    {
        // Get a sorted list of dates in the dictionary
        List<DateTime> sortedDates = new(data.Keys);
        sortedDates.Sort();

        // Iterate through the sorted dates
        for (int i = 1; i < sortedDates.Count; i++)
        {
            DateTime currentDate = sortedDates[i];
            DateTime previousDate = sortedDates[i - 1];

            // Check if there are missing dates
            if ((currentDate - previousDate).Days > 1)
            {
                // Fill in missing values with the previous day's value
                float previousValue = data[previousDate];
                for (DateTime missingDate = previousDate.AddDays(1); missingDate < currentDate; missingDate = missingDate.AddDays(1))
                {
                    data[missingDate] = previousValue;
                }
            }
        }

        sortedDates = new List<DateTime>(data.Keys);
        sortedDates.Sort();

        // Ha magyar idő szerint péntek az utolsó rögzített időpont, akkor hozzáadjuk a szombatot, és vasárnapot, rögtön a pénteki árfolyammal.
        DateTime lastDayUtc = sortedDates[^1];
        if (lastDayUtc.GetHungarianLocalTimeFromUtc().DayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Friday)
        {
            // Szombat hozzáadása a pénteki árfolyammal
            data.Add(lastDayUtc.AddDays(1), data[lastDayUtc]);
            sortedDates.Add(lastDayUtc.AddDays(1));

            // Vasárnap hozzáadása a pénteki árfolyammal
            data.Add(lastDayUtc.AddDays(2), data[lastDayUtc]);
            sortedDates.Add(lastDayUtc.AddDays(2));
        }

        RemoveFirstNElements(data, distance, sortedDates);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az első n-elem eltávolítása a szótárból.
    /// </summary>
    static void RemoveFirstNElements<TKey, TValue>(Dictionary<TKey, TValue> dictionary, int n, List<TKey> sortedKeys) where TKey:notnull
    {
        if (n >= dictionary.Count)
        {
            dictionary.Clear();
            return;
        }

        List<TKey> keysToRemove = sortedKeys.Take(n).ToList();
        foreach (var key in keysToRemove)
        {
            dictionary.Remove(key);
        }
    }
}

using System.Reflection;
using Autofac;
using Common.Shared.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Interfaces;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Factory;

public class DataProcessorFactory : IDataProcessorFactory
{
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Type> _parsers;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Type> _validators;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Type> _interpolators;
    //private readonly Dictionary<string, Type> _normalizers;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Type> _consumptionDtoConverters;


    public DataProcessorFactory(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var dataReceiverAssembly = typeof(DataProcessorFactory).Assembly;

        _scope = scope;

        _parsers = InterfaceImplementationFinder.GetImplementations<IParser>(dataReceiverAssembly)
            .ToDictionary(GetDataSourceTypeCodeFromAttribute, t => t);
        _validators = InterfaceImplementationFinder.GetImplementations<IValidator>(dataReceiverAssembly)
            .ToDictionary(GetDataSourceTypeCodeFromAttribute, t => t);
        _interpolators = InterfaceImplementationFinder.GetImplementations<IInterpolator>(dataReceiverAssembly)
            .ToDictionary(GetDataSourceTypeCodeFromAttribute, t => t);
        //_normalizers = InterfaceImplementationFinder.GetImplementations<INormalizer>(dataReceiverAssembly)
        //    .ToDictionary(GetDataSourceTypeCodeFromAttribute, t => t);
        _consumptionDtoConverters = InterfaceImplementationFinder.GetImplementations<IConsumptionDtoConverter>(dataReceiverAssembly)
            .ToDictionary(GetDataSourceTypeCodeFromAttribute, t => t);
    }


    private static string GetDataSourceTypeCodeFromAttribute(Type type)
    {
        var attribute = type.GetCustomAttribute<DataSourceTypeCodeAttribute>();
        if (attribute == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Type {type.FullName} implements IParser but does not have [DataSourceTypeCode] attribute.");

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(attribute.Code))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Type {type.FullName} has an invalid (null or empty) DataSourceTypeCode.");

        return attribute.Code;
    }


    public IParser GetParser(string dataSourceTypeCode)
    {
        if (!_parsers.TryGetValue(dataSourceTypeCode, out var parserType))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"No parser found for DataSourceTypeCode: {dataSourceTypeCode}");

        return (IParser)_scope.Resolve(parserType);
    }

    public IValidator GetValidator(string dataSourceTypeCode)
    {
        if (!_validators.TryGetValue(dataSourceTypeCode, out var validatorType))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"No validator found for DataSourceTypeCode: {dataSourceTypeCode}");

        return (IValidator)_scope.Resolve(validatorType);
    }

    public IInterpolator GetInterpolator(string dataSourceTypeCode)
    {
        if (!_interpolators.TryGetValue(dataSourceTypeCode, out var interpolatorType))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"No interpolator found for DataSourceTypeCode: {dataSourceTypeCode}");

        return (IInterpolator)_scope.Resolve(interpolatorType);
    }

    //public INormalizer GetNormalizer(string dataSourceTypeCode)
    //{
    //    if (!_normalizers.TryGetValue(dataSourceTypeCode, out var normalizerType))
    //        throw new InvalidOperationException($"No normalizer found for DataSourceTypeCode: {dataSourceTypeCode}");

    //    return (INormalizer)_scope.Resolve(normalizerType);
    //}

    public IConsumptionDtoConverter GetConsumptionDtoConverter(string dataSourceTypeCode)
    {
        if (!_consumptionDtoConverters.TryGetValue(dataSourceTypeCode, out var consumptionDtoConverterType))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"No consumption DTO converter found for DataSourceTypeCode: {dataSourceTypeCode}");

        return (IConsumptionDtoConverter)_scope.Resolve(consumptionDtoConverterType);
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Interfaces;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.IoTDataConsumptionDtoConverters;

[DataSourceTypeCode("OpenWeatherAPIv2.5")]
public class OpenWeatherAPIDtoConverter(ILifetimeScope scope) : IConsumptionDtoConverter
{
    public Type DataType => typeof(IoTDataParsers.OpenWeatherSampleData);

    //ez csak egy demonstrációs célú konverter, OpenWeatherSampleData típust vár, és egy sor ConsumptionEntityDto-t adunk belőle vissza.
    public IEnumerable<ConsumptionEntityDto> CreateConsumptionEntityDtos(
        object data,
        int dataSourceId, //a nyers adat entity id-ja
        DataQuality dataQuality,
        EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto> ioTDevice,
        IList<ChannelEntityDto> deviceMeasuredEndpoints,
        DateTime measuredAtUtc
        )
    {
        var utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;

        var tenantIndependentDictCache = scope.Resolve<TenantIndependentDictCache>();
        var measurementDescriptorsCached = tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.IoTMeasurementDescriptor)?.ToList() ?? [];

        if (deviceMeasuredEndpoints.Count < 1)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Missing MeasuredEndpoint(s)");
        }

        /*
         valós működésnél így kéne kinézzen a logika:
         - vesszük az eszköz MeasuredEndpoint-jait.
         - konkrét konverter típusban definiált logika alapján tudjuk, hogy melyik MeasurementDescriptor-hoz melyik property tartozik a DataType-ban.
         - a data objektum releváns property-jei alapján létrehozzuk a ConsumptionEntityDto-kat, és egy-egy yield return-ből visszaadjuk.
         */

        if (data is not IoTDataParsers.OpenWeatherSampleData weatherData)
        { //ha volt nem parsolható adat, akkor adjunk vissza üres bejegyzéseket, Invalid jelzővel -> hogy a pótérték kezelés majd fel tudja dolgozni
            foreach (var item in new IoTDataParsers.OpenWeatherSampleData().Results)
            {
                var measuredEndpointTemp = deviceMeasuredEndpoints.First(x => x.MeasurementDescriptor == item.Key); //szálljon el, ha nincs ilyen MeasuredEndpoint
                var md = measurementDescriptorsCached.First(x => x.Code == item.Key); //kell az id miatt, itt is szálljon el, ha nincs meg
                yield return new ConsumptionEntityDto
                {
                    IoTDevice = ioTDevice,
                    Channel = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> { Id = measuredEndpointTemp.Id },
                    MeasuredAtUtc = measuredAtUtc,
                    Value = null,
                    IoTDataEntityId = dataSourceId,
                    DataQuality = DataQuality.Invalid,
                    ModifiedAtUtc = utcNow,
                    MeasurementDescriptor = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = md.Id }, //kelleni fog a későbbiekben
                };
            }
        }
        else
        { //feldolgozzuk a "jó" adatokat
            foreach (var item in weatherData.Results)
            {
                var measuredEndpointTemp = deviceMeasuredEndpoints.First(x => x.MeasurementDescriptor == item.Key); //szálljon el, ha nincs ilyen MeasuredEndpoint
                var md = measurementDescriptorsCached.First(x => x.Code == item.Key); //kell az id miatt, itt is szálljon el, ha nincs meg
                yield return new ConsumptionEntityDto
                {
                    IoTDevice = ioTDevice,
                    Channel = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> { Id = measuredEndpointTemp.Id },
                    MeasuredAtUtc = measuredAtUtc,
                    Value = item.Value,
                    IoTDataEntityId = dataSourceId,
                    DataQuality = item.Value.HasValue ? dataQuality : DataQuality.Missing,
                    ModifiedAtUtc = utcNow,

                    MeasurementDescriptor = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = md.Id }, //kelleni fog a későbbiekben
                };
            }
        }

    }
}

[DataSourceTypeCode("SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3")]
public class SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3DtoConverter(ILifetimeScope scope) : IConsumptionDtoConverter
{
    public Type DataType => typeof(IoTDataParsers.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3SampleData);

    //ez csak egy demonstrációs célú konverter, SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3SampleData típust vár, és egy sor ConsumptionEntityDto-t adunk belőle vissza.
    public IEnumerable<ConsumptionEntityDto> CreateConsumptionEntityDtos(
        object data,
        int dataSourceId, //a nyers adat entity id-ja
        DataQuality dataQuality,
        EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto> ioTDevice,
        IList<ChannelEntityDto> deviceChannels,
        DateTime measuredAtUtc
        )
    {
        var utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;

        var tenantIndependentDictCache = scope.Resolve<TenantIndependentDictCache>();
        var measurementDescriptorsCached = tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.IoTMeasurementDescriptor)?.ToList() ?? [];

        if (deviceChannels.Count < 1)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Missing Channel(s)");
        }

        /*
         valós működésnél így kéne kinézzen a logika:
         - vesszük az eszköz MeasuredEndpoint-jait.
         - konkrét konverter típusban definiált logika alapján tudjuk, hogy melyik MeasurementDescriptor-hoz melyik property tartozik a DataType-ban.
         - a data objektum releváns property-jei alapján létrehozzuk a ConsumptionEntityDto-kat, és egy-egy yield return-ből visszaadjuk.
         */


        if (data is not IoTDataParsers.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3SampleData smappeeData)
        { //ha nem volt parsolható adat, akkor adjunk vissza üres bejegyzéseket, Invalid jelzővel -> hogy a pótérték kezelés majd fel tudja dolgozni
            foreach (var item in new IoTDataParsers.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3SampleData().Results)
            {
                var channelTemp = deviceChannels.First(x => x.MeasurementDescriptor == item.Key); //szálljon el, ha nincs ilyen Channel
                var md = measurementDescriptorsCached.First(x => x.Code == item.Key); //kell az id miatt, itt is szálljon el, ha nincs meg
                yield return new ConsumptionEntityDto
                {
                    IoTDevice = ioTDevice,
                    Channel = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> { Id = channelTemp.Id },
                    MeasuredAtUtc = measuredAtUtc,
                    Value = null,
                    IoTDataEntityId = dataSourceId,
                    DataQuality = DataQuality.Invalid,
                    ModifiedAtUtc = utcNow,
                    MeasurementDescriptor = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = md.Id }, //kelleni fog a későbbiekben
                };
            }
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var item in smappeeData.Results)
            {
                var channelTemp = deviceChannels.First(x => x.MeasurementDescriptor == item.Key); //szálljon el, ha nincs ilyen Channel
                var md = measurementDescriptorsCached.First(x => x.Code == item.Key); //kell az id miatt, itt is szálljon el, ha nincs meg
                yield return new ConsumptionEntityDto
                {
                    IoTDevice = ioTDevice,
                    Channel = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> { Id = channelTemp.Id },
                    MeasuredAtUtc = measuredAtUtc,
                    Value = item.Value,
                    IoTDataEntityId = dataSourceId,
                    DataQuality = item.Value.HasValue ? dataQuality : DataQuality.Missing,
                    ModifiedAtUtc = utcNow,

                    MeasurementDescriptor = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = md.Id }, //kelleni fog a későbbiekben
                };
            }

        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Interfaces;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.IoTDataConsumptionDtoConverters;

[DataSourceTypeCode("SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import")]
public class SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3ImportDtoConverter(ILifetimeScope scope) : IConsumptionDtoConverter
{
    public Type DataType => typeof(IoTDataParsers.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3ImportSampleData);

    //ez csak egy demonstrációs célú konverter, SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3ImportSampleData típust vár, és egy sor ConsumptionEntityDto-t adunk belőle vissza.
    public IEnumerable<ConsumptionEntityDto> CreateConsumptionEntityDtos(
        object data,
        int dataSourceId, //a nyers adat entity id-ja
        DataQuality dataQuality,
        EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto> ioTDevice,
        IList<ChannelEntityDto> deviceChannels,
        DateTime measuredAtUtc
        )
    {
        var utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;

        var tenantIndependentDictCache = scope.Resolve<TenantIndependentDictCache>();
        var measurementDescriptorsCached = tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.IoTMeasurementDescriptor)?.ToList() ?? [];

        if (deviceChannels.Count < 1)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Missing Channel(s)");
        }

        /*
         valós működésnél így kéne kinézzen a logika:
         - vesszük az eszköz Channel-jait.
         - konkrét konverter típusban definiált logika alapján tudjuk, hogy melyik MeasurementDescriptor-hoz melyik property tartozik a DataType-ban.
         - a data objektum releváns property-jei alapján létrehozzuk a ConsumptionEntityDto-kat, és egy-egy yield return-ből visszaadjuk.
         */


        if (data is not IoTDataParsers.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3ImportSampleData smappeeData)
        { //ha nem volt parsolható adat, akkor adjunk vissza üres bejegyzéseket, Invalid jelzővel -> hogy a pótérték kezelés majd fel tudja dolgozni
            foreach (var item in new IoTDataParsers.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3ImportSampleData().Results)
            {
                var channelTemp = deviceChannels.First(x => x.MeasurementDescriptor == item.Key); //szálljon el, ha nincs ilyen Channel
                var md = measurementDescriptorsCached.First(x => x.Code == item.Key); //kell az id miatt, itt is szálljon el, ha nincs meg
                yield return new ConsumptionEntityDto
                {
                    IoTDevice = ioTDevice,
                    Channel = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> { Id = channelTemp.Id },
                    MeasuredAtUtc = measuredAtUtc,
                    Value = null,
                    IoTDataEntityId = dataSourceId,
                    DataQuality = DataQuality.Invalid,
                    ModifiedAtUtc = utcNow,
                    MeasurementDescriptor = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = md.Id }, //kelleni fog a későbbiekben
                };
            }
        }
        else
        {
            foreach (var item in smappeeData.Results)
            {
                var channelTemp = deviceChannels.First(x => x.MeasurementDescriptor == item.Key); //szálljon el, ha nincs ilyen Channel
                var md = measurementDescriptorsCached.First(x => x.Code == item.Key); //kell az id miatt, itt is szálljon el, ha nincs meg
                yield return new ConsumptionEntityDto
                {
                    IoTDevice = ioTDevice,
                    Channel = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> { Id = channelTemp.Id },
                    MeasuredAtUtc = measuredAtUtc,
                    Value = item.Value,
                    IoTDataEntityId = dataSourceId,
                    DataQuality = item.Value.HasValue ? dataQuality : DataQuality.Missing,
                    ModifiedAtUtc = utcNow,

                    MeasurementDescriptor = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = md.Id }, //kelleni fog a későbbiekben
                };
            }

        }
    }
}

    public double?[] Active { get; set; } = []; // sum

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\DataReceiver\EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd\BusinessLogic\IoTDataValidators\OpenWeatherAPIValidator.cs

using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Interfaces;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.IoTDataParsers;

[DataSourceTypeCode("OpenWeatherAPIv2.5")]
public class OpenWeatherAPIValidator : IValidator
{
    public bool Validate<T>(T data, IEnumerable<ChannelEntityDto> deviceMeasuredEndpoints, out IEnumerable<string> errors) where T : notnull
    {
        var innerErrors = new List<string>();
        if (data is not OpenWeatherSampleData parsedValue)
        {
            innerErrors.Add($"Invalid value: {data}. Expected {nameof(OpenWeatherSampleData)}.");
            errors = innerErrors;
            return false;
        }
        if (parsedValue is null)
        {
            innerErrors.Add($"Null value for {nameof(OpenWeatherSampleData)} is not allowed.");
            errors = innerErrors;
            return false;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parsedValue.Name))
        {
            innerErrors.Add($"Must specify a name.");
        }

        #region MeasurementDescriptor endpoint config validations -> should be done elsewhere, but this is a sample
        //check if all required descriptors are defined
        var requiredDescriptorNames = parsedValue.Results.Keys.ToHashSet();
        var configuredDescriptorNames = deviceMeasuredEndpoints
            .Where(endpoint => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(endpoint.MeasurementDescriptor))
            .Select(endpoint => endpoint.MeasurementDescriptor!)
            .ToHashSet();
        if (!configuredDescriptorNames.SetEquals(requiredDescriptorNames))
        {
            innerErrors.Add($"Missing required measurement descriptors. Expected: {string.Join(", ", requiredDescriptorNames)}, Found: {string.Join(", ", configuredDescriptorNames)}");
        }
        #endregion


        #region Min-Max validations
        //TODO: amikor létrejönnek a konfigurációs értékek, biztosítani kell, hogy egy device MeasuredEndpoint-jai esetében a MeasurementDescriptorok egyediek legyenek, különben itt hibát fogunk kapni
        Dictionary<string, (double? min, double? max)> minMaxValuesByDescriptor = deviceMeasuredEndpoints
                .Where(endpoint => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(endpoint.MeasurementDescriptor))
                .ToDictionary(
                    endpoint => endpoint.MeasurementDescriptor!,
                    endpoint => (min: endpoint.MinValue, max: endpoint.MaxValue)
                );

        //fogjuk a talált propertyket és megvizsgáljuk, hogy a hozzá tartozó érték min-max közé esik-e.
        foreach (var result in parsedValue.Results)
        {
            string descriptor = result.Key;
            if (result.Value.HasValue)
            {
                if (result.Value.Value < minMaxValuesByDescriptor[descriptor].min)
                {
                    innerErrors.Add($"{descriptor} value {result.Value.Value} is below the minimum of {minMaxValuesByDescriptor[descriptor].min}");
                }
                if (result.Value.Value > minMaxValuesByDescriptor[descriptor].max)
                {
                    innerErrors.Add($"{descriptor} value {result.Value.Value} is above the maximum of {minMaxValuesByDescriptor[descriptor].max}");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                innerErrors.Add($"{descriptor} value is null"); //hiányzó adat
            }
        }
        #endregion

        errors = innerErrors;
        return innerErrors.Count == 0;
    }
}

                .ToDictionary(
                    channel => channel.MeasurementDescriptor!,
                    channel => (min: channel.MinValue, max: channel.MaxValue)
                );

        //fogjuk a talált propertyket és megvizsgáljuk, hogy a hozzá tartozó érték min-max közé esik-e.
        foreach (var result in parsedValue.Results)
        {
            string descriptor = result.Key;
            if (result.Value.HasValue)
            {
                if (result.Value.Value < minMaxValuesByDescriptor[descriptor].min)
                {
                    innerErrors.Add($"{descriptor} value {result.Value.Value} is below the minimum of {minMaxValuesByDescriptor[descriptor].min}");
                }
                if (result.Value.Value > minMaxValuesByDescriptor[descriptor].max)
                {
                    innerErrors.Add($"{descriptor} value {result.Value.Value} is above the maximum of {minMaxValuesByDescriptor[descriptor].max}");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                innerErrors.Add($"{descriptor} value is null"); //hiányzó adat
            }
        }
        #endregion

        errors = innerErrors;
        return innerErrors.Count == 0;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// IoT eszköz mapping
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class IoTDeviceMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDeviceMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public IoTDeviceMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<IoTDeviceConfigValueEntity, IoTDeviceConfigValueEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Value, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Value))
            .ForMember(x => x.Code, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Code));

        CreateMap<IoTDeviceEntity, IoTDeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channels, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Configuration, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.MeasurementPoint = c.Mapper.Map(src.MeasurementPoint.UnProxy(), dest.MeasurementPoint ?? new MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto());

                if (src.Channels != null)
                    dest.Channels = src.Channels.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<ChannelEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.Configuration != null)
                    dest.Configuration = src.Configuration.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<IoTDeviceConfigValueEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
            });


        CreateMap<IoTDeviceEntity, EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName)
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.SerialNumber);

        CreateMap<IoTDeviceEntityDto, EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName)
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.SerialNumber);

        CreateMap<IoTDeviceEntityDto, IoTDeviceEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channels, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Configuration, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<IoTDeviceEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<DeviceSyncModel, IoTDeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceTypeCode, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceTypeCode))
            //.ForMember(x => x.DeviceTypeName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceTypeName))
            //.ForMember(x => x., y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceCategory))
            .ForMember(x => x.Configuration, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ConfigValues));
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\DataReceiver\EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd\BusinessLogic\Mappings\MeasurementPoint\MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverMappings.cs
====================================================================================================

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.MeasurementPointSync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.MeasurementPoint;

public class MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity, MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ChildMeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Devices, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Labels, y => y.Ignore())
            .MaxDepth(2)
            .PreserveReferences()
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                if (src.ParentMeasurementPoint != null)
                {
                    dest.ParentMeasurementPoint = c.Mapper.Map(src.ParentMeasurementPoint.UnProxy(), dest.ParentMeasurementPoint ?? new EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto>());
                }
                if (src.ChildMeasurementPoints != null)
                    dest.ChildMeasurementPoints = src.ChildMeasurementPoints.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.MeasuredProperties != null)
                    dest.MeasuredProperties = src.MeasuredProperties.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.Devices != null)
                    dest.Devices = src.Devices.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<IoTDeviceEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.Labels != null)
                    dest.Labels = src.Labels.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

            });

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity, EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto, EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto, MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ChildMeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredProperties, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Devices, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Labels, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncModel, MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ParentMeasurementPointId.HasValue ? new MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntityDto() { Id = z.ParentMeasurementPointId.Value } : null))
            .ForMember(x => x.Labels, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.LabelIds.Select(x => new TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto() { Id = x })))
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredProperties, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.MeasuredProperties.Select(x => new MeasuredPropertyEntityDto() { Id = x })));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

/// <summary>
/// ForeignCurrencyQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.ForeignCurrencyEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.ForeignCurrencyEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ForeignCurrencyQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<ForeignCurrencyEntity, ForeignCurrencyEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ForeignCurrencyQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public ForeignCurrencyQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {}

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ForeignCurrenciesQuery foreignCurrenciesQuery)
            return DoForeignCurrenciesQuery(foreignCurrenciesQuery);

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the foreign currencies query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoForeignCurrenciesQuery(ForeignCurrenciesQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ForeignCurrencyEntity>();

        if (query.From.HasValue)
        {
            queryOver.Where(o => o.Date >= query.From);
        }

        var entities = queryOver.List();
        if (entities != null)
        {
            EntityListItemQueryResult<ForeignCurrencyEntityDto> result = new();
            List<ForeignCurrencyEntityDto> tempList = new();
            foreach (ForeignCurrencyEntity foreignCurrencyEntity in entities)
            {
                tempList.Add(CreateDto(foreignCurrencyEntity));
            }
            result.Items = tempList.ToArray();
            return result;
        }

        return null;
    }
}

/// <summary>

public class HupxEnergyPriceDataQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity, HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="HupxEnergyPriceDataQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public HupxEnergyPriceDataQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityQuery hupxEnergyPriceDataEntityQuery)
            return DoHupxEnergyPriceDataEntityQuery(hupxEnergyPriceDataEntityQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the hupx energy price data entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoHupxEnergyPriceDataEntityQuery(HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityQuery query)
    {
        var exactDateBeginOfDay = query.ExactDate.Date;
        var exactDateEndOfDay = exactDateBeginOfDay.AddHours(23).AddMinutes(59).AddSeconds(59);
        HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity entity =
            DbContext
            .Session
            .QueryOver<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.DeliveryDateTime >= exactDateBeginOfDay &&
                        x.DeliveryDateTime <= exactDateEndOfDay)
            .SingleOrDefault();

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities<TResult>(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is HupxEnergyPriceDataEntitesQuery hupxEnergyPriceDataEntitesQuery)
            return DoHupxEnergyPriceDataEntitesQuery(hupxEnergyPriceDataEntitesQuery);
        
        if (query is HupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery)
        {
            var result = base.DoQueryEntities<HupxEnergyPriceListItemDto>(query) as EntityListItemQueryResult<HupxEnergyPriceListItemDto>;
            return new HupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQueryResult { Items = result.Items, RecordsTotal = result.RecordsTotal };
        }

        return base.DoQueryEntities<TResult>(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity, HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(HupxEnergyPriceListItemDto))
        {

            HupxEnergyPriceListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(x => x.DeliveryDateTime).WithAlias(() => alias.Date)
                    .Select(x => Math.Round(x.PriceOfForeignCurrencyInHuf.Value, 2)).WithAlias(() => alias.PriceInHuf)
                    .Select(x => Math.Round(x.PriceEur, 2)).WithAlias(() => alias.PriceEur)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity, HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is HupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQuery hupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (hupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQuery.From.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.DeliveryDateTime >= hupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQuery.From.Value.ToUniversalTime());
            if (hupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQuery.To.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.DeliveryDateTime < hupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQuery.To.Value.ToUniversalTime());            
			}
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the hupx energy price data entites query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoHupxEnergyPriceDataEntitesQuery(HupxEnergyPriceDataEntitesQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver =
            DbContext
            .Session
            .QueryOver<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity>();

        if (query.FromDate.HasValue)
        {
            var fromDateBeginOfDay = query.FromDate.Value.Date;
            var fromDateEndOfDay = fromDateBeginOfDay.AddHours(23).AddMinutes(59).AddSeconds(59);
            queryOver =
                queryOver
                .Where(x => x.DeliveryDateTime >= fromDateBeginOfDay &&
                            x.DeliveryDateTime <= fromDateEndOfDay);
        }

        if (query.ToDate.HasValue)
        {
            var toDateBeginOfDay = query.ToDate.Value.Date;
            var toDateEndOfDay = toDateBeginOfDay.AddHours(23).AddMinutes(59).AddSeconds(59);
            queryOver =
                queryOver
                .Where(x => x.DeliveryDateTime >= toDateBeginOfDay &&
                            x.DeliveryDateTime <= toDateEndOfDay);
        }

        var result = queryOver.List() ?? Array.Empty<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntity>();
        var dtos =
            result
            .Select(_mapper.Map<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityDto>)
            .ToArray();

        return new EntityQueryItemsResult<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityDto> 
        {
            Items = dtos
        };
    }
}
