namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// ConsumptionQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="ConsumptionEntity.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.ConsumptionEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ConsumptionQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntityDto>
{
    private readonly MeasuredPropertyEntity? _measuredPropertyAlias = null;
    private readonly MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity? _measurementPointAlias = null;
    private readonly ChannelEntity? _channelAlias = null;
    //private readonly FrameworkApiClientService _frameworkApiClientService;
    private readonly FrameworkUserClientService _frameworkUserClientService;
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ConsumptionQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public ConsumptionQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        //FrameworkApiClientService frameworkApiClientService,
        FrameworkUserClientService frameworkUserClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext
        ) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        //_frameworkApiClientService = frameworkApiClientService;
        _frameworkUserClientService = frameworkUserClientService;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            UnprocessedConsumptionIoTDataQuery unprocessedConsumptionQuery => DoUnprocessedConsumptionQuery(unprocessedConsumptionQuery),
            IntervalSpecifiedUnprocessedConsumptionQuery consumptionQuery => DoIntervalSpecifiedUnprocessedConsumptionQuery(consumptionQuery),
            ConsumptionTimeWindowQuery consumptionTimeWindowQuery => DoConsumptionTimeWindowQuery(consumptionTimeWindowQuery),
            ConsumptionExtremesQuery consumptionExtremesQuery => DoConsumptionExtremesQuery(consumptionExtremesQuery).GetAwaiter().GetResult(),
            AggregationLevelQuery aggregationLevelQuery => DoAggregationLevelQuery(aggregationLevelQuery, CancellationToken.None).RunSync(),
            AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramQuery aggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramQuery => DoAggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramQuery(aggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramQuery).RunSync(),
            //AggregatedDataWithinDayPagedEntityQuery aggregatedDataWithinDayPagedEntityQuery => DoAggregatedDataWithinDayPagedEntityQuery(aggregatedDataWithinDayPagedEntityQuery).RunSync(),
            //ez az új:
            AggregatedDataWithinDayDataQuery aggregatedDataWithinDayDataQuery => DoAggregatedDataWithinDayQuery(aggregatedDataWithinDayDataQuery).RunSync(),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    private async Task<IQueryResult> DoConsumptionExtremesQuery(ConsumptionExtremesQuery query)
    {
        var result = new ConsumptionExtremesQueryResult();

        var minValues = await DbContext.Session.Query<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Where(c => c.Channel.Identifier != null && query.ChannelIdentifiers.Contains(c.Channel.Identifier.Value) && c.ModifiedAtUtc > query.SinceUtc)
            .Where(c =>
                DbContext.Session.Query<ConsumptionEntity>()
                    .Where(c2 => c2.Channel.Id == c.Channel.Id && c2.ModifiedAtUtc > query.SinceUtc)
                    .Min(c2 => c2.Value) == c.Value
            ).ToListAsync();

        var maxValues = await DbContext.Session.Query<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Where(c => c.Channel.Identifier != null && query.ChannelIdentifiers.Contains(c.Channel.Identifier.Value) && c.ModifiedAtUtc > query.SinceUtc)
            .Where(c =>
                DbContext.Session.Query<ConsumptionEntity>()
                    .Where(c2 => c2.Channel.Id == c.Channel.Id && c2.ModifiedAtUtc > query.SinceUtc)
                    .Max(c2 => c2.Value) == c.Value
            ).ToListAsync();

        // improved version of query POC:
#if TODOTODOTODOTODOTODOTODOTODO
        //TODO: also return the measuerement time of the extremes
        Dictionary<Guid, double> minValuesByChannel = (await DbContext.Session.Query<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Where(c => c.Channel.Identifier != null
                    && c.Value != null
                    && query.ChannelIdentifiers.Contains(c.Channel.Identifier.Value)
                    && c.MeasuredAtUtc > query.SinceUtc
                    )
            .GroupBy(c => c.Channel.Identifier!.Value)
            .Select(g => new { ChannelIdentifier = g.Key, MinValue = g.Min(c => c.Value) })
            .ToListAsync())
            .ToDictionary(x => x.ChannelIdentifier, x => x.MinValue!.Value);
        Dictionary<Guid, double> maxValuesByChannel = (await DbContext.Session.Query<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Where(c => c.Channel.Identifier != null
                    && c.Value != null
                    && query.ChannelIdentifiers.Contains(c.Channel.Identifier.Value)
                    && c.MeasuredAtUtc > query.SinceUtc
                    )
            .GroupBy(c => c.Channel.Identifier!.Value)
            .Select(g => new { ChannelIdentifier = g.Key, MaxValue = g.Max(c => c.Value) })
            .ToListAsync())
            .ToDictionary(x => x.ChannelIdentifier, x => x.MaxValue!.Value);
#endif
        //TODO: tesztelés után a groupby-os query-t használni a subquery helyett


        foreach (var channelId in query.ChannelIdentifiers)
        {
            var minValueRecord = minValues.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Channel.Identifier == channelId);
            var maxValueRecord = maxValues.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Channel.Identifier == channelId);

            if (minValueRecord?.Value != null && maxValueRecord?.Value != null)
            {
                result.Items.Add(new ConsumptionExtremesQueryResultItem(
                    channelId,
                    Convert.ToDecimal(minValueRecord.Value),
                    minValueRecord.MeasuredAtUtc,
                    Convert.ToDecimal(maxValueRecord.Value),
                    maxValueRecord.MeasuredAtUtc
                ));
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    private IQueryResult DoIntervalSpecifiedUnprocessedConsumptionQuery(IntervalSpecifiedUnprocessedConsumptionQuery consumptionQuery)
    {
        var result = new IntervalSpecifiedUnprocessedConsumptionQueryResult();
        foreach (var item in consumptionQuery.Parameters)
        {
            var unprocessedData = new UnprocessedConsumptionData();
            ChannelEntity alias = null!;
            var aggregationMethod = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelConfigValueEntity>()
                                                     .JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => alias)
                                                     .Where(x => alias.Identifier == item.ChannelIdentifier && x.Code == "AggregationMethod")
                                                     .Select(x => x.Value)
                                                     .List<string>()
                                                     .FirstOrDefault();

            unprocessedData.AggregationMethod = Enum.TryParse(aggregationMethod, out AggregationMethod method) ? method : AggregationMethod.Undefined;
            unprocessedData.MeasuredEndPointIdentifier = item.ChannelIdentifier;

            var disjunction = Restrictions.Disjunction();
            foreach (var interval in item.Intervals)
            {
                disjunction.Add(
                    Restrictions.Conjunction()
                        .Add(Restrictions.Ge(Projections.Property<ConsumptionEntity>(pr => pr.MeasuredAtUtc), interval.From))
                        .Add(Restrictions.Lt(Projections.Property<ConsumptionEntity>(pr => pr.MeasuredAtUtc), interval.To))
                );
            }

            ConsumptionModel dataAlias = null!;
            var consumptionData = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
                                                   .JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => alias)
                                                   .Where(x => alias.Identifier == item.ChannelIdentifier)
                                                   .And(disjunction)
                                                   .SelectList(list => list
                                                        .Select(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).WithAlias(() => dataAlias.MeasuredAtUtc)
                                                        .Select(x => x.DataQuality).WithAlias(() => dataAlias.DataQuality)
                                                        .Select(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => dataAlias.Value))
                                                   .TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ConsumptionModel>())
                                                   .List<ConsumptionModel>();

            unprocessedData.ConsumptionModelList.AddRange(consumptionData);
            result.UnprocessedConsumptionData.Add(unprocessedData);
        }
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            //TODO...
            //ConsumptionQuery consumptionQuery => DoQueryEntities(consumptionQuery),
            //ConsumptionPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery => DoPagedEntityQuery(pagedEntityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQueryEntities(query),
        };
    }

    private IQueryResult DoUnprocessedConsumptionQuery(UnprocessedConsumptionIoTDataQuery query)
    {
        var result = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
                                      .Fetch(SelectMode.Fetch, x => x.Channel)
                                      .Where(x => x.ModifiedAtUtc > query.From && x.IsHandled == true)
                                      .List();


        return new UnprocessedConsumptionIoTDataQueryResult()
        {
            UnprocessedConsumptions = result.Select(Mapper.Map<ConsumptionEntityDto>).ToList(),
        };
    }

    private IQueryResult DoConsumptionTimeWindowQuery(ConsumptionTimeWindowQuery query)
    {
        // Ensure consistent DateTime kind (UTC) before query
        var startUtc = query.MeasurementStartUtc;
        if (startUtc.Kind == DateTimeKind.Local)
        {
            startUtc = startUtc.ToUniversalTime();
        }
        else if (startUtc.Kind == DateTimeKind.Unspecified)
        {
            // Treat as local if that’s your convention.
            startUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(startUtc, DateTimeKind.Local).ToUniversalTime();
        }

        var endUtc = query.MeasurementEndUtc;
        if (endUtc.Kind == DateTimeKind.Local)
        {
            endUtc = endUtc.ToUniversalTime();
        }
        else if (endUtc.Kind == DateTimeKind.Unspecified)
        {
            endUtc = DateTime.SpecifyKind(endUtc, DateTimeKind.Local).ToUniversalTime();
        }

        var result = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
                                      .Where(x =>
                                            //x.ModifiedAtUtc > query.StartUtc
                                            x.MeasuredAtUtc >= startUtc
                                            //&& x.ModifiedAtUtc <= query.EndUtc
                                            && x.MeasuredAtUtc < endUtc
                                            //&& x.IsHandled == false ezeket is vissza kell adni, hogy az interpolátor megtalálja, a már feldolgozottat is, ne szúrjon be új időpontot
                                            )
                                      .List();


        //TODO: batch size-ban limitálni kéne a visszaadott sorok számát.
        //ezzel az a gond, hogy az fontosabb, hogy az idő paraméterek kerek 15 perces adatokat adjanak vissza!
        //talán az idő paramétereket lehetne úgy variálni, hogy azokból képezünk órás, vagy 3-6 órás kisebb szakaszokat, 
        //és csak azokat adjuk vissza egy körben. (kvázi nem darabra lenne limitálva, hanem 15 perces blokkok számára?)


        return new UnprocessedConsumptionIoTDataQueryResult()
        {
            UnprocessedConsumptions = result.Select(Mapper.Map<ConsumptionEntityDto>).ToList(),
        };
    }

    private async Task<AggregationLevelQueryResult> DoAggregationLevelQuery(AggregationLevelQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var setting = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingSyncedDataReceiverEntity>()
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias)
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasurementPoint, () => _measurementPointAlias)
            .Where(x => _measurementPointAlias!.Id == query.MeasurmentPointId &&
                        _measuredPropertyAlias!.Id == query.MeasuredPropertyId)
            .Take(1)
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (setting?.Channel?.Id == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Channel id not found.");

        var consumptionDates = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => _channelAlias)
            .Where(x => _channelAlias!.Id == setting.Channel.Id)
            .Select(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc)
            .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc
            .Take(5)
            .ListAsync<DateTime>(cancellationToken);

        if (consumptionDates.Count < 2)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Not enough data to calculate aggregation level.");

        AggregationLevel? aggregationLevel = null;
        for (int i = 0; i < consumptionDates.Count - 1; i++)
        {
            var oldAggregationLevel = aggregationLevel;
            var timeDiffMinutes = int.Abs((consumptionDates[i + 1] - consumptionDates[i]).Minutes);
            var newAggregationLevel = timeDiffMinutes switch
            {
                5 => AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes,
                15 => AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes,
                60 => AggregationLevel.OneHour,
                60 * 24 => AggregationLevel.OneDay,
                60 * 24 * 7 => AggregationLevel.OneWeek,
                >= 60 * 24 * 28 and <= 60 * 24 * 31 => AggregationLevel.OneMonth, // mert itt nem tudjuk, hogy 28, 30 vagy 31 nap a diff
                60 * 24 * 7 * 365 => AggregationLevel.OneYear,  // FYI: szökőév is lehet! :DDD
                _ => throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Unsupported aggregation level.")
            };

            if (i != 0 && oldAggregationLevel != newAggregationLevel)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Inconsistent aggregation level.");

            aggregationLevel = newAggregationLevel;
        }

        return new AggregationLevelQueryResult { AggregationLevel = aggregationLevel!.Value };
    }

    private async Task<IQueryResult> DoAggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramQuery(
        AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var measurementPointIds = query.OrgUnitSelections?.Where(x => x.MeasurementPointId.HasValue).Select(x => x.MeasurementPointId.Value).ToList() ?? new List<int>();

        if (query.OrgUnitSelections != null && query.OrgUnitSelections.Count > 0)
        {
            foreach (var orgUnitSelection in query.OrgUnitSelections.Where(x => x.OrgUnitId.HasValue && !x.MeasurementPointId.HasValue))
            {
                var fapi = ApiHelper.FrameworkApi(DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName);
                var points = await fapi.MeasurementPoints_GetMeasurementPointsByOrgunitAsync(orgUnitSelection.OrgUnitId.Value, false, cancellationToken);
                measurementPointIds.AddRange(points.Select(x => x.Id).ToList());
            }
        }

        measurementPointIds = measurementPointIds.Distinct().ToList();

        var settings = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingSyncedDataReceiverEntity>()
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias)
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasurementPoint, () => _measurementPointAlias)
            .Where(x => _measuredPropertyAlias!.Id == query.MeasuredPropertyId)
            .Where(Restrictions.In(Projections.Property(() => _measurementPointAlias!.Id), measurementPointIds))
            .ListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var stepSize = AggregationHelper.ConvertToTimeSpan(query.Aggregation);

        var allDates = DateHelper.GetDateTimes(DateTime.Today, DateTime.Today.AddDays(1), stepSize);

        var res = new ChartModelQueryResult
        {
            Title = "Aggregált adatok napon belül grafikon",
            XAxisValues = allDates
                .Select(x => x.ToString("t"))
                .ToList(),
            Unit = "kWh"
        };

        foreach (var measurementPointSetting in settings)
        {
            if (measurementPointSetting.MeasurementPoint.IsBilling)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Billing point is not supported.");

            if (measurementPointSetting.Channel?.Id == null)
            {
                //OLD: throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Channel id not found.");
                //ha nincs channel, akkor üres adatsort adjunk vissza
                res.Items.Add(new ChartItemModel()
                {
                    Name = measurementPointSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name,
                    ChartType = ChartType.Area,
                    Datas = [],
                });
                if (query.IsYesterdayNeeded)
                {
                    res.Items.Add(new ChartItemModel()
                    {
                        Name = $"{measurementPointSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name} - előző nap",
                        ChartType = ChartType.Line,
                        Datas = []
                    });
                }
                continue;
            }


            var currentDayData = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
                .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => _channelAlias)
                .Where(x => _channelAlias!.Id == measurementPointSetting.Channel.Id &&
                            x.MeasuredAtUtc >= DateTime.Today &&
                            x.MeasuredAtUtc < DateTime.Today.AddDays(1))
                .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc
                .Select(x => x.Value)
                .ListAsync<double?>(cancellationToken);

            res.Items.Add(new ChartItemModel()
            {
                Name = measurementPointSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name,
                ChartType = ChartType.Area,
                Datas = currentDayData.Select(x => (decimal?)Convert.ToDecimal(x)).ToList()
            });

            if (!query.IsYesterdayNeeded)
                continue;

            var yesterdayData = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
                .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => _channelAlias)
                .Where(x => _channelAlias!.Id == measurementPointSetting.Channel.Id &&
                            x.MeasuredAtUtc >= DateTime.Today.AddDays(-1) &&
                            x.MeasuredAtUtc < DateTime.Today)
                .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc
                .Select(x => x.Value)
                .ListAsync<double?>(cancellationToken);

            res.Items.Add(new ChartItemModel()
            {
                Name = $"{measurementPointSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name} - előző nap",
                ChartType = ChartType.Line,
                Datas = yesterdayData.Select(x => (decimal?)Convert.ToDecimal(x)).ToList()
            });
        }

        return res;
    }

    [Obsolete("Use DoAggregatedDataWithinDayQuery instead and apply pagination in memory, as different channels may have different time series data! Max item count per column is 288 anyways -> 5 min periods in a day", error: true)]
    private async Task<StringChartTableQueryResult> DoAggregatedDataWithinDayPagedEntityQuery(
        AggregatedDataWithinDayPagedEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var measurementPointGuid = Guid.Parse(query.MeasurementPointIdentifier);
        var measurementPointSetting = await DbContext.Session
            .QueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingSyncedDataReceiverEntity>()
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias)
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasurementPoint, () => _measurementPointAlias)
            .Where(x => _measuredPropertyAlias!.Id == query.MeasuredPropertyId &&
                        _measurementPointAlias!.Identifier == measurementPointGuid)
            .Take(1)
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        var stepSize = AggregationHelper.ConvertToTimeSpan(query.Aggregation);

        var allDates = DateHelper.GetDateTimes(DateTime.Today.ToUniversalTime(), DateTime.Today.ToUniversalTime().AddDays(1), stepSize);

        var table = new StringChartTableModel();
        if (measurementPointSetting.MeasurementPoint.IsBilling)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Billing point is not supported.");

        if (measurementPointSetting.Channel?.Id == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Channel id not found.");

        var currentDayData = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => _channelAlias)
            .Where(x => _channelAlias!.Id == measurementPointSetting.Channel.Id &&
                        x.MeasuredAtUtc >= DateTime.Today &&
                        x.MeasuredAtUtc < DateTime.Today.AddDays(1))
            .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc
            .Take(query.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10)
            .Skip(query.PagingInfo.StartPage * (query.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10))
            .ListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var yesterdayData = new List<ConsumptionEntity>();
        if (query.IsYesterdayNeeded)
        {
            yesterdayData = (await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
                    .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => _channelAlias)
                    .Where(x => _channelAlias!.Id == measurementPointSetting.Channel.Id &&
                                x.MeasuredAtUtc >= DateTime.Today.AddDays(-1) &&
                                x.MeasuredAtUtc < DateTime.Today)
                    .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc
                    .Take(query.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10)
                    .Skip(query.PagingInfo.StartPage * (query.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10))
                    .ListAsync(cancellationToken))
                .ToList();
        }

        var pagedDates = allDates
            .Skip(query.PagingInfo.StartPage * (query.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10))
            .Take(query.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10);
        foreach (var dateTime in pagedDates)
        {
            var consumption = currentDayData.FirstOrDefault(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == dateTime);
            var columnValues = new List<StringChartTableItemValueModel>()
            {
                new()
                {
                    ColumnName =
                        $"{dateTime:yyyy.MM.dd} \n {measurementPointSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name}",
                    Value = consumption?.Value != null
                        ? Decimal.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(consumption.Value), 3).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                        : "nincs adat"
                },
                new() {ColumnName = "Adat minőség", Value = consumption?.DataQuality.GetDisplayName() ?? "nincs adat"}
            };

            if (!query.IsYesterdayNeeded)
            {
                table.Items.Add(new StringChartTableItemModel { DateTime = dateTime, Values = columnValues });
                continue;
            }

            var yesterdayConsumption = yesterdayData.FirstOrDefault(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == dateTime.AddDays(-1));

            columnValues.Add(new StringChartTableItemValueModel
            {
                ColumnName =
                    $"{dateTime.AddDays(-1):yyyy.MM.dd} \n {measurementPointSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name}",
                Value = yesterdayConsumption?.Value != null
                    ? Decimal.Round(Convert.ToDecimal(yesterdayConsumption.Value), 3)
                        .ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    : "nincs adat"
            });
            columnValues.Add(new StringChartTableItemValueModel
            {
                ColumnName = "Adat minőség ",
                Value = yesterdayConsumption?.DataQuality.GetDisplayName() ?? "nincs adat"
            });

            table.Items.Add(new StringChartTableItemModel { DateTime = dateTime, Values = columnValues });
        }

        var currentDayDataCount = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => _channelAlias)
            .Where(x => _channelAlias!.Id == measurementPointSetting.Channel.Id &&
                        x.MeasuredAtUtc >= DateTime.Today &&
                        x.MeasuredAtUtc < DateTime.Today.AddDays(1))
            .RowCountAsync(cancellationToken);

        var yesterdayDataCount = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => _channelAlias)
            .Where(x => _channelAlias!.Id == measurementPointSetting.Channel.Id &&
                        x.MeasuredAtUtc >= DateTime.Today.AddDays(-1) &&
                        x.MeasuredAtUtc < DateTime.Today)
            .RowCountAsync(cancellationToken);
        table.RecordsTotal = currentDayDataCount + yesterdayDataCount;

        return new StringChartTableQueryResult
        {
            Table = table,
        };
    }


    private async Task<AggregatedDataWithinDayQueryResult> DoAggregatedDataWithinDayQuery(AggregatedDataWithinDayDataQuery query)
    {
        //HashSet to automatically filter out duplicates
        HashSet<int> measurementPointIds = query.OrgUnitSelections?
            .Where(x => x.MeasurementPointId.HasValue).Select(x => x.MeasurementPointId.Value)
            .ToHashSet() ?? [];
        if (query.OrgUnitSelections is not null && query.OrgUnitSelections.Count > 0)
        {
            //TODO: loopolt áthívás helett a szinkornizált datareceiver-es táblából kéne kiszedni az adatokat
            var fapi = ApiHelper.FrameworkApi(DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName);
            foreach (var orgUnitSelection in query.OrgUnitSelections.Where(x => x.OrgUnitId.HasValue && !x.MeasurementPointId.HasValue))
            {
                var points = await fapi.MeasurementPoints_GetMeasurementPointsByOrgunitAsync(orgUnitSelection.OrgUnitId!.Value, isBilling: false, cancellationToken: default);
                measurementPointIds.UnionWith(points.Select(x => x.Id));
            }
        }

        var settings = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingSyncedDataReceiverEntity>()
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias)
            .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasurementPoint, () => _measurementPointAlias)
            .Where(x => _measuredPropertyAlias!.Id == query.MeasuredPropertyId) // mért jellemzőre szűrés
            .Where(Restrictions.In(Projections.Property(() => _measurementPointAlias!.Id), measurementPointIds.ToList()))
            .ListAsync();

        //Dictionary<Guid, string> where key is measurement point identifier, value is Unit or "N/A"
        var measurementPointUnits = settings
            .Select(x => new
            {
                Identifier = x.MeasurementPoint.Identifier!.Value,
                Unit = x.Channel?.Configuration?.FirstOrDefault(cfg => cfg.Code == "Unit")?.Value ?? null //null if unit config missing
            })
            .ToDictionary(x => x.Identifier, x => x.Unit);
        //elméletileg az összes channel ugyanolyan mértékegységben kell, hogy mérjen, mert csak azokat kéne a UI-n engedni kiválasztani, illetve szűrtünk mért jellemzőre.
        var theUnit = measurementPointUnits.Values.FirstOrDefault(v => v != null) ?? "N/A";

        var todayUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.Date;
        DateTime from = query.IncludeYesterday ? todayUtc.AddDays(-1) : todayUtc;
        //TODO: a settingeket még tovább kéne szűrni, hogy csak a kiválasztott technológia szerintieket listázzuk?
        HashSet<int> channelsFilter = [.. settings
            .Where(x => x.Channel?.Id != null)
            .Select(x => x.Channel!.Id)];


        // Extract aggregation level from settings
        AggregationLevel aggregationLevelFilter = AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes; // Default fallback
        // Find the first setting that has a channel with TimeUnit configuration
        var timeUnitConfigValue = settings
            .Where(x => x.Channel?.Configuration != null)
            .SelectMany(x => x.Channel.Configuration)
            .FirstOrDefault(config => config.Code == "TimeUnit")?.Value;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(timeUnitConfigValue) && Enum.TryParse<AggregationLevel>(timeUnitConfigValue, out var parsedAggregationLevel))
        {
            aggregationLevelFilter = parsedAggregationLevel;
        }


        var queryParams = new
        {
            from = from,
            to = DateTime.UtcNow,
            channelIds = channelsFilter.ToArray(),
            isHandled = true, //megörtént a pótértékkezelés, tehát az adatsor folytonos
            dataQualities = new DataQuality[] { DataQuality.Valid, DataQuality.Interpolated, DataQuality.OutOfRange }, //ezek az elfogadott minőségek, a hiányost, hibást kiejtjük a lekérdezésből, mert úgyis csak null értéket jelenítene meg
        };

        //channel szerinti csoportokban a nyers adatok
        var rawData = await DbContext.Session.Query<ConsumptionEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc >= queryParams.from && x.MeasuredAtUtc < queryParams.to
                        && queryParams.channelIds.Contains(x.Channel.Id)
                        //TODO: && queryParams.isHandled == x.IsHandled    ---> ezt ideiglenesen kiszedtem, mert nem fut rá a mai adatokra a pótértékkezelés, ezért nem jelenik meg a táblázatban semmit. viszont a grafikonos qurey-ben meg nincs ilyen szűrő, ezért az ad vissza valami adatot
                        && queryParams.dataQualities.Contains(x.DataQuality))
            .Select(x => new
            {
                ChannelIdentifier = x.Channel.Identifier!.Value,
                x.MeasuredAtUtc,
                x.Value,
                x.DataQuality
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        //időszeletek előállítása. ha includeYesterday, akkor tegnapra is legyenek adatok, különben csak mára legyenek adatok
        List<DateTime> allTimeSlots = [];
        DateTime time = from; //ez vagy a tegnap 0:00, vagy a ma 0:0:00, viszont ez nem kell az adatsorba, az első sor már az inkrementált időt tartalmazza
        while (time < queryParams.to)
        {
            time = aggregationLevelFilter switch
            {
                AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => time.AddMinutes(5),
                AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => time.AddMinutes(15),
                AggregationLevel.OneHour => time.AddHours(1),
                AggregationLevel.OneDay => time.AddDays(1),
                AggregationLevel.OneWeek => time.AddDays(7),
                AggregationLevel.OneMonth => time.AddMonths(1),
                AggregationLevel.OneYear => time.AddYears(1),
                _ => throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Unsupported aggregation level.")
            };
            allTimeSlots.Add(time);
        }

        var rawDataGroupedDict = rawData.GroupBy(x => x.ChannelIdentifier);
        Dictionary<Guid, List<AggregatedDataWithinDayItem>> aggregatedData = [];
        foreach (var grp in rawDataGroupedDict)
        {
            //query.AggregationLevel szerint csoportosítani a nyers méréseket. ha egy csoporton belül több mérés van, akkor az első adatot vesszük. ha nincs adat, akkor null value és missing.
            foreach (var timeslot in allTimeSlots)
            {
                //mivel a slotok úgy lettek definiálva, hogy a megadott időpont előtti időszak adatait kell beletenni, ezért kivonjuk az AggregationLevel szerinti időt:
                DateTime slotStart = aggregationLevelFilter switch
                {
                    AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => timeslot.AddMinutes(-5),
                    AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => timeslot.AddMinutes(-15),
                    AggregationLevel.OneHour => timeslot.AddHours(-1),
                    AggregationLevel.OneDay => timeslot.AddDays(-1),
                    AggregationLevel.OneWeek => timeslot.AddDays(-7),
                    AggregationLevel.OneMonth => timeslot.AddMonths(-1),
                    AggregationLevel.OneYear => timeslot.AddYears(-1),
                    _ => throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Unsupported aggregation level.")
                };
                Guid id = grp.Key;
                var dataItem = grp.Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc > slotStart && x.MeasuredAtUtc <= timeslot)
                    .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc)
                    .FirstOrDefault();
                AggregatedDataWithinDayItem aggregatedItem = new AggregatedDataWithinDayItem(
                    timeslot,
                    dataItem?.Value != null ? Convert.ToDecimal(dataItem.Value) : null,
                    dataItem?.DataQuality ?? DataQuality.Missing
                );
                if (!aggregatedData.ContainsKey(id))
                {
                    aggregatedData[id] = [];
                }
                aggregatedData[id].Add(aggregatedItem);
            }
        }


        List<Guid> measurementPointGuids = settings.Select(x => x.MeasurementPoint.Identifier!.Value).ToList();
        //át kell hívni a FW-be és az összesről le kérni az orgunit hierarchiát, kell majd a headerbe

        //TODO: error handling
        MeasurementPointFWAPI.MeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsModel? hierarchyModel = await _frameworkUserClientService.Post<List<Guid>, MeasurementPointFWAPI.MeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsModel>(
            uri: FrameworkApiConst.MeasurementPoint.GetParentOrgUnitsByMeasurementPointIdentifiers_FullRoute,
            request: measurementPointGuids,
            tenantCode: _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode);
        if (hierarchyModel is null)
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Failed to retrieve measurement point-orgunit hierarchy.");
        }

        var instRef = hierarchyModel.ResultItems.Values.FirstOrDefault(x => x.InstitutionRef != null)?.InstitutionRef;
        if (instRef is null)
        {
            //TODO: nem jön át???
            //LOG ERROR:
        }
        string institutionNameCommon = instRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "[HIBA A LEKÉRDEZÉSKOR]";

        List<AggregatedDataWithinDayResultByMeasurementPointModel> resultItems = [];

        // FIXED: Process all measurement point settings, not just those with data
        // This ensures measurement points without data are still included in the result,
        // making the behavior consistent with DoAggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramQuery
        // Process settings with valid channels first
        foreach (var setting in settings)
        {
            if (setting.Channel?.Identifier == null)
                continue;

            Guid channelIdentifier = setting.Channel.Identifier.Value;

            //0:00 kezelése: a mai 0:00-s adat az előző x perc végét jelzi, tehát annak a tegnapi adatsor utolsó elemének kell lennie,
            //nem a mai első elemének. ami a megjelenítésben egyébként hülyén fog kinézni...
            //BA-val egyeztetve: az adatsor első eleme 0:05-tel rendben van, a utolsó sor (ha éjfélig tart az adatsor) pedig 0:00-val maradjon.

            // Get aggregated data for this channel, or create empty time slots if no data exists
            // Use TryGetValue to avoid double lookup and improve performance
            List<AggregatedDataWithinDayItem> channelData;
            if (aggregatedData.TryGetValue(channelIdentifier, out var existingData))
            {
                channelData = existingData;
            }
            else
            {
                // Create empty time slots for measurement points without data
                // This ensures all measurement points appear in the result, even without consumption data
                channelData = [.. allTimeSlots.Select(timeslot => new AggregatedDataWithinDayItem(
                    timeslot,
                    null, // No value available
                    DataQuality.Missing // Mark as missing data
                ))];
            }

            List<AggregatedDataWithinDayItem> todaysData = [.. channelData.Where(x => x.Time > todayUtc)];
            List<AggregatedDataWithinDayItem> yesterdaysData = [];
            if (query.IncludeYesterday)
            {
                yesterdaysData = [.. channelData.Where(x => x.Time <= todayUtc)];
            }

            string mpointName = setting.MeasurementPoint.Name ?? "";
            string mpropName = setting.MeasuredProperty.MeasuredPropertyName ?? "";
            Guid mpIdentifier = setting.MeasurementPoint.Identifier ?? Guid.Empty;
            var hierarchyRecord = hierarchyModel.ResultItems.FirstOrDefault(x => mpIdentifier == x.Key).Value;

            resultItems.Add(new AggregatedDataWithinDayResultByMeasurementPointModel
            {
                MeasurementPoint = new AggregatedDataWithinDayMeasurementPoint(
                    Identifier: mpIdentifier,
                    Name: mpointName,
                    MeasuredPropertyName: mpropName,
                    SiteName: hierarchyRecord?.SiteRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-",
                    BuildingName: hierarchyRecord?.BuildingRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-",
                    BuildingPartName: hierarchyRecord?.BuildingPartRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-",
                    FloorName: hierarchyRecord?.FloorRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-",
                    RoomName: hierarchyRecord?.RoomRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-  "
                ),
                AggregatedMeasurementsToday = todaysData,
                AggregatedMeasurementsYesterday = yesterdaysData
            });
        }

        // Now add entries for measurement points with missing channel
        foreach (var setting in settings)
        {
            if (setting.Channel?.Identifier != null)
                continue;

            string mpointName = setting.MeasurementPoint.Name ?? "";
            string mpropName = setting.MeasuredProperty.MeasuredPropertyName ?? "";
            Guid mpIdentifier = setting.MeasurementPoint.Identifier ?? Guid.Empty;
            var hierarchyRecord = hierarchyModel.ResultItems.FirstOrDefault(x => mpIdentifier == x.Key).Value;

            // Create empty time slots for today and yesterday
            List<AggregatedDataWithinDayItem> todaysData = [.. allTimeSlots.Where(x => x > todayUtc).Select(timeslot => new AggregatedDataWithinDayItem(
                timeslot,
                null,
                DataQuality.Missing
            ))];
            List<AggregatedDataWithinDayItem> yesterdaysData = [];
            if (query.IncludeYesterday)
            {
                yesterdaysData = [.. allTimeSlots.Where(x => x <= todayUtc).Select(timeslot => new AggregatedDataWithinDayItem(
                    timeslot,
                    null,
                    DataQuality.Missing
                ))];
            }

            resultItems.Add(new AggregatedDataWithinDayResultByMeasurementPointModel
            {
                MeasurementPoint = new AggregatedDataWithinDayMeasurementPoint(
                    Identifier: mpIdentifier,
                    Name: mpointName,
                    MeasuredPropertyName: mpropName,
                    SiteName: hierarchyRecord?.SiteRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-",
                    BuildingName: hierarchyRecord?.BuildingRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-",
                    BuildingPartName: hierarchyRecord?.BuildingPartRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-",
                    FloorName: hierarchyRecord?.FloorRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-",
                    RoomName: hierarchyRecord?.RoomRef?.EntityDisplayName ?? "-  "
                ),
                AggregatedMeasurementsToday = todaysData,
                AggregatedMeasurementsYesterday = yesterdaysData
            });
        }

        DateTime latestDataTime = resultItems
            .SelectMany(x => x.AggregatedMeasurementsToday)
            .Select(x => x.Time)
            .DefaultIfEmpty(DateTime.MinValue)
            .Max();

        //query végeredménye
        var result = new AggregatedDataWithinDayQueryResult
        {
            Items = resultItems,
            TodaysLastTime = latestDataTime,
            AggregationLevel = aggregationLevelFilter,
            InstitutionName = institutionNameCommon,
            Unit = theUnit
        };
        return result;
    }


}

/// <summary>
/// IoTDataImportQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT.IoTDataImportEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.IoTDataImportEntityDto&gt;" />
public class IoTDataImportQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<IoTDataImportEntity, IoTDataImportEntityDto>
{

    /// Device alias

            : base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the get io t data import query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoGetIoTDataImportQuery(GetIoTDataImportQuery query)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataImportEntity>().Where(x => x.Id == query.Id).Take(1).SingleOrDefault();

        return entity != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is GetIoTDataImportResultQuery getIoTDataImportResultQuery)
            return DoGetIoTDataImportResultQuery(getIoTDataImportResultQuery);

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the get io t data import result query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult? DoGetIoTDataImportResultQuery(GetIoTDataImportResultQuery query)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataImportEntity>().Where(x => x.Id == query.Id).Take(1).SingleOrDefault();

        return entity != null
            ? new GetIoTDataImportResultQueryResult()
            {
                FileName = entity.FileName,
                Data = entity.ResultData,
            }
            : (IQueryResult?)null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IoTDataImportPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery)
        {
            var result = (EntityListItemQueryResult<IoTDataImportListItemDto>)DoQueryEntities(pagedEntityQuery);
            return new IoTDataImportPagedEntityQueryResult { Items = result.Items, RecordsTotal = result.RecordsTotal };
        }

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<IoTDataImportEntity, IoTDataImportEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IoTDataImportPagedEntityQuery ioTDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.FileName))
                queryOver = queryOver
                    .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.FileName)
                    .IsInsensitiveLike(ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.FileName, MatchMode.Anywhere);

            if (ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.Status.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Status == ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.Status.Value);

            if (ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _ioTDeviceAlias.Identifier == ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.DeviceIdentifier.Value);

            if (ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _endpointAlias.Identifier == ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.ChannelIdentifier.Value);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(
        IQueryOver<IoTDataImportEntity, IoTDataImportEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(IoTDataImportListItemDto))
        {

            var selectExpressions = new List<Expression<Func<IoTDataImportEntity, object>>>
            {
                f => f.Id,
                f => f.IoTDevice.Id,
                f => f.CreateDate,
                f => f.FileName,
                f => f.Status,
                f => f.TimeUnit,
                f => f.Unit,
            };

            queryOver.Select(selectExpressions.ToArray());

            var devices = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>().Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).List();
            var endpoints = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>().Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).List();

            Func<object[], IoTDataImportListItemDto> result = o => new IoTDataImportListItemDto
            {
                Id = (int)o[0],
                IoTDeviceName = devices?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == (int)o[1])?.DeviceName ?? "",
                CreateDate = DateTime.SpecifyKind((DateTime)o[2], DateTimeKind.Utc),
                FileName = (string)o[3],
                Status = ((Shared.Enums.ImportState)o[4]).GetDisplayName() ?? "",
                TimeUnit = ((AggregationLevel)o[5]).GetDisplayName() ?? "",
                Unit = ((Unit)o[6]).GetDisplayName() ?? "",
            };

            return result as Func<object[], TResult>;
        }

        return null;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<IoTDataImportEntity, IoTDataImportEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDevice, () => _ioTDeviceAlias);
        //queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => _endpointAlias);
    }
}
