namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// IoTDataQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT.IoTDataEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.IoTDataEntityDto&gt;" />
public class IoTDataQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<IoTDataEntity, IoTDataEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDistributedCache _cache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// Dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantDictCache _tDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Device ids
    /// </summary>
    private int[]? _deviceIds = null;
    /// <summary>
    /// Device alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IoTDeviceEntity? _ioTDeviceAlias = null;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDataQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="cache">The cache.</param>
    /// <param name="tDictCache">The t dictionary cache.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    public IoTDataQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IDistributedCache cache,
        TenantDictCache tDictCache,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _cache = cache;
        _scope = scope;
        _tDictCache = tDictCache;
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query is GetIoTDataQuery getLatestIoTDataQuery ? DoGetIoTDataQuery(getLatestIoTDataQuery) : base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the get io t data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoGetIoTDataQuery(GetIoTDataQuery query)
    {
        DictItemEntity dataSourceAlias = null!;

        var lastQuery = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>();

        if (query.DeviceId is not null)
            lastQuery = lastQuery.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == query.DeviceId);

        if (query.IoTDataSourceType != null)
            lastQuery = lastQuery
                .JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDataSourceType, () => dataSourceAlias)
                .Where(x => dataSourceAlias.Code == query.IoTDataSourceType.GetEntityCode());

        if (query.HasChannels != null)
        {
            // Kikeressük, hogy mely eszközöknek van érvényes mérési végpontja.
            int[] devicesWithChannel = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>()
                .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted)
                .Select(x => x.IoTDevice.Id).List<int>()
                .Distinct().ToArray();

            // Csak azokat az IoTDatákat vesszük ki, amelyekek eszközének van mérési végpontja.
            lastQuery = lastQuery.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id.IsIn(devicesWithChannel));
        }

        if (query.IsProcessed != null)
        {
            lastQuery = lastQuery.Where(x => x.Processed == query.IsProcessed);
        }

        lastQuery = query.Order switch
        {
            GetIoTDataQuery.Ordering.Earliest => lastQuery.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc,
            GetIoTDataQuery.Ordering.Latest => lastQuery.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Desc,
            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException()
        };

        var last = lastQuery.Take(1).SingleOrDefault();

        return last != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(last)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IoTMeasuredDataQuery ioTMeasuredDataQuery)
            return DoIIoTMeasuredDataQuery(ioTMeasuredDataQuery);
        if (query is IoTMeasuredProductionDataQuery ioTMeasuredProductionDataQuery)
            return DoIIoTMeasuredProductionDataQuery(ioTMeasuredProductionDataQuery);
        if (query is CurrentIoTDataQuery currentIoTDataQuery)
            return DoCurrentIoTDataQuery(currentIoTDataQuery);
        if (query is FirstIoTDataDateQuery firstIoTDataDateQuery)
            return DoExecuteFirstIoTDataDateQuery(firstIoTDataDateQuery);
        if (query is IoTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery ioTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery)
            return DoIoTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery(ioTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery);
        if (query is IoTProductionDataForSyncQuery ioTProductionDataForSyncQuery)
            return DoIoTProductionDataForSyncQuery(ioTProductionDataForSyncQuery);
        if (query is IoTOtherDataForSyncQuery ioTOtherDataForSyncQuery)
            return DoIoTOtherDataForSyncQuery(ioTOtherDataForSyncQuery);
        if (query is ProcessIoTDataQuery processIoTDataQuery)
            return DoProcessIoTDataQuery(processIoTDataQuery);
        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the process io t data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3'
    /// or
    /// Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import'
    /// </exception>
    private IQueryResult DoProcessIoTDataQuery(ProcessIoTDataQuery query)
    {
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)} - {nameof(DoProcessIoTDataQuery)}: Getting unsynced Consumption IoTData...");

        using var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(query.TenantCode);

        using var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        tenantDbContext.BeginTransaction();

        var result = new ProcessIoTDataQueryResult();

        var queryOver = tenantDbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>().Where(x => !x.Synced);

        IoTDeviceEntityDto? device = null;
        string deviceIdentifier = string.Empty;
        string siteLocationIdentifier = string.Empty;
        string siteIdentifier = string.Empty;

        if (query.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
        {
            device = GetDeviceByIdentifier(query.DeviceIdentifier.Value, query.TenantCode);
            if (device != null)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == device.Id);

                if (device.Identifier != null)
                    deviceIdentifier = device.Identifier.Value.ToString();
            }
        }

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, "SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3")
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3'");

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, "SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import")
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import'");

        queryOver = queryOver
            .Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id
                || x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import.Id);

        var timeSeriesManagers = new Dictionary<string, ITimeSeriesManager>();
        List<double> active = new();
        List<double> reactive = new();
        List<double> voltages = new();
        List<double> lineVoltages = new();
        List<double> phaseVoltages = new();
        List<double> current = new();
        List<double> relativeConsumption = new();
        List<double?> calculatedFeeIn = new();
        List<double?> calculatedFeeOut = new();
        List<double?> purchasePrice = new();
        List<double?> powerInPrice = new();
        List<string> channelsIdentifiers = new();
        List<DateTime> measurementDates = new();
        List<AggregationLevel?> timeUnits = new();

        if (query.DeviceIdentifier != null)
            deviceIdentifier = query.DeviceIdentifier.Value.ToString();


        var ioTDataEntities = queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc().List();
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)} - {nameof(DoIoTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery)}: ioTDataEntities found: {ioTDataEntities.Count}");

        if (ioTDataEntities == null || !ioTDataEntities.Any()) return result;

        Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? contracts = null; // GetContracts(query.DeviceIdentifier, query.TenantCode);
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)} - {nameof(DoIoTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery)}: contracts count: {contracts?.Length ?? 0}");

        //Feldolgozzuk a mérési adatokat


        TimeSpan interval = new(0, 5, 0);
     
        var measurementDatesGrouppedByInterval = ioTDataEntities
            .Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id)
            .GroupBy(entity => entity.MeasurementDate.Ticks / interval.Ticks)
            .Select(g => new DateTime(g.Key * interval.Ticks, DateTimeKind.Utc));

            foreach (var measurementDate in measurementDatesGrouppedByInterval.OrderBy(x => x))
            {
                // Calculate the start and end of this 5-minute interval
                var intervalStart = measurementDate;
                var intervalEnd = measurementDate.Add(interval);

                // Find all entities within this time interval (inclusive start, exclusive end)
                var entities = ioTDataEntities
                    .Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id &&
                               x.MeasurementDate >= intervalStart &&
                               x.MeasurementDate < intervalEnd)
                    .ToList();

                //Dátum hozzáadása (X tengely)
                //result.MeasurementDate.Add(measurementDate); // átkerül

                //Értékek összegyűjtése
                foreach (var ioTDataEntity in entities)
                {
                    var code = ioTDataEntity.IoTDataSourceType.Code;

                    if (!timeSeriesManagers.TryGetValue(code, out var seriesManager))
                    {
                        _scope.TryResolveNamed(code, out seriesManager);
                        if (seriesManager != null)
                            timeSeriesManagers.Add(code, seriesManager);
                    }

                    if (seriesManager != null)
                    {
                        var channels = ioTDataEntity
                            .IoTDevice
                            .Channels
                            .ToList();

                        var ioTDevEntityDto = Mapper.Map<IoTDeviceEntityDto>(ioTDataEntity.IoTDevice);

                        if (ioTDevEntityDto != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var channelEntity in channels)
                            {
                                var channelEntityDto =
                                    Mapper.Map<ChannelEntityDto>(channelEntity);
                                seriesManager.GetTimeSeriesDataModel(
                                    ioTDataEntity.Data,
                                    ioTDevEntityDto.Configuration,
                                    channelEntityDto.Configuration);

                                var currentConsumption = seriesManager.GetConsumption() as ConsumptionModel;

                                if (currentConsumption?.Active != null)
                                    active.Add(currentConsumption.Active.Value / 1000); //Smappee esetén az adatok Wh-ban vannak, osztani kell 1000-el
                                if (currentConsumption?.Reactive != null)
                                    reactive.Add(currentConsumption.Reactive.Value / 1000);
                                if (currentConsumption?.Voltage != null)
                                    voltages.Add(currentConsumption.Voltage.Value);
                                if (currentConsumption?.LineVoltage != null)
                                    lineVoltages.Add(currentConsumption.LineVoltage.Value);
                                if (currentConsumption?.PhaseVoltage != null)
                                    phaseVoltages.Add(currentConsumption.PhaseVoltage.Value);
                                if (currentConsumption?.Current != null)
                                    current.Add(currentConsumption.Current.Value);
                                if (currentConsumption?.RelativeConsumption != null)
                                    relativeConsumption.Add(currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption.Value / 1000);
                                if (channelEntity.Identifier != null)
                                    channelsIdentifiers.Add(channelEntity.Identifier.Value.ToString());
                                measurementDates.Add(measurementDate);
                                timeUnits.Add(AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);//Smappeenél 5 perces adatok

                                if (ioTDevEntityDto.DeviceTypeCode == "smappee")
                                {
                                    if (currentConsumption == null || currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption == null
                                        || contracts == null || !contracts.Any()) calculatedFeeOut.Add(0);
                                    else calculatedFeeOut.Add((currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption / 1000) * contracts[0].PurchasePrice);

                                    calculatedFeeIn.Add(0);
                                    powerInPrice.Add(0);
                                    purchasePrice.Add(GetContractedPrice(contracts, EndpointUnitType.Consumer));
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (currentConsumption == null || currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption == null
                                       || contracts == null || !contracts.Any()) calculatedFeeIn.Add(0);
                                    else calculatedFeeIn.Add(currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption * contracts[0].PowerInPrice ?? 0);

                                    powerInPrice.Add(GetContractedPrice(contracts, EndpointUnitType.Producer));
                                    purchasePrice.Add(0);
                                    calculatedFeeOut.Add(null);
                                }
                            }
                        }

                    }
                    ioTDataEntity.Synced = true;
                    tenantDbContext.Session.Update(ioTDataEntity);
                }

                //Összegyűjtött értékek aggregálása (Y tengely)
                /*result.Active.Add(active.Sum(x => x));
                active.Clear();
                result.Reactive.Add(reactive.Sum(x => x));
                reactive.Clear();
                if (voltages.Any()) result.Voltages.Add(voltages.Average(x => x));
                else result.Voltages.Add(0);
                voltages.Clear();
                if (lineVoltages.Any()) result.LineVoltages.Add(lineVoltages.Average(x => x));
                else result.LineVoltages.Add(0);
                lineVoltages.Clear();
                if (phaseVoltages.Any()) result.PhaseVoltages.Add(phaseVoltages.Average(x => x));
                else result.PhaseVoltages.Add(0);
                phaseVoltages.Clear();
                result.Current.Add(current.Sum(x => x));
                current.Clear();
                result.RelativeConsumption.Add(relativeConsumption.Sum(x => x));
                relativeConsumption.Clear();
                result.CalculatedFeeIn.Add(calculatedFeeIn.Sum(x => x ?? 0));
                calculatedFeeIn.Clear();
                result.CalculatedFeeOut.Add(calculatedFeeOut.Sum(x => x ?? 0));
                calculatedFeeOut.Clear();
                result.PurchasePrice.Add(purchasePrice.Average(x => x));
                purchasePrice.Clear();
                result.PowerInPrice.Add(powerInPrice.Average(x => x));
                powerInPrice.Clear();*/

                // TODO: iot_datánként összegezni az egyes mérési végpontok eredményeit a fenti kikommentezett logika alapján.
                // jelenleg úgy kalkulálunk egy nincs több iot_data ugyanarra az 5 perces időintervallumra
                result.Active.AddRange(active);
                active.Clear();
                result.Reactive.AddRange(reactive);
                reactive.Clear();
                result.Voltages.AddRange(voltages);
                voltages.Clear();
                result.LineVoltages.AddRange(lineVoltages);
                lineVoltages.Clear();
                result.PhaseVoltages.AddRange(phaseVoltages);
                phaseVoltages.Clear();
                result.Current.AddRange(current);
                current.Clear();
                result.RelativeConsumption.AddRange(relativeConsumption);
                relativeConsumption.Clear();
                result.CalculatedFeeIn.AddRange(calculatedFeeIn);
                calculatedFeeIn.Clear();
                result.CalculatedFeeOut.AddRange(calculatedFeeOut);
                calculatedFeeOut.Clear();
                result.PurchasePrice.AddRange(purchasePrice);
                purchasePrice.Clear();
                result.PowerInPrice.AddRange(powerInPrice);
                powerInPrice.Clear();

                result.MeasurementDate.AddRange(measurementDates);
                measurementDates.Clear();
                result.TimeUnit.AddRange(timeUnits);
                timeUnits.Clear();

                // ChannelIdentifier?
                result.ChannelIdentifier.AddRange(channelsIdentifiers);
                channelsIdentifiers.Clear();
            }

        //feldolgozzuk az importokat
        foreach (var entity in ioTDataEntities.Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import.Id))
        {
            var prd = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ElectricityConsumptionImportModel>(entity.Data);
            var data = ProcessImportedConsumptionModel(prd, contracts, query.TenantCode);

            foreach (var item in data)
            {
                //Import esetén lekérdezzük a mérési pontot, amelyből kivesszük a mérési pont azonosítót (import esetén itt config value szerepel)
                if (entity.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import.Id)
                {
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prd!.EndpointIdentifier)) continue;

                    var mConfigValue = tenantDbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelConfigValueEntity>()
                            .Where(x => x.Value == prd!.EndpointIdentifier)
                            .SingleOrDefault();

                    if (mConfigValue == null || mConfigValue.Channel.Identifier == null)
                        continue;

                    result.ChannelIdentifier.Add(mConfigValue.Channel.Identifier.ToString()!);
                }
                else if (result.MeasurementDate.Contains(item.MeasurementDate)) continue;

                else
                    // ChannelIdentifier
                    result.ChannelIdentifier.Add(prd!.EndpointIdentifier);

                result.TimeUnit.Add(entity.TimeUnit);

                result.MeasurementDate.Add(item.MeasurementDate);
                result.Active.Add(item.Active);
                result.Reactive.Add(item.Reactive);
                result.Voltages.Add(item.Voltages);
                result.LineVoltages.Add(item.LineVoltages);
                result.PhaseVoltages.Add(item.PhaseVoltages);
                result.Current.Add(item.Current);
                result.RelativeConsumption.Add(item.RelativeConsumption);
                result.CalculatedFeeIn.Add(item.CalculatedFeeIn);
                result.CalculatedFeeOut.Add(item.CalculatedFeeOut);
                result.PurchasePrice.Add(item.PurchasePrice);
            }

            entity.Synced = true;
            tenantDbContext.Session.Update(entity);
        }

        tenantDbContext.Commit();

        result.SiteIdentifier = siteIdentifier;
        result.SiteLocationIdentifier = siteLocationIdentifier;
        result.DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier;

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the execute first io t data date query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: '{query.IoTDataSourceTypeCode}'</exception>
    private IQueryResult DoExecuteFirstIoTDataDateQuery(FirstIoTDataDateQuery query)
    {
        DateTime? resultDate = null;
        if (DbContext.Session.Query<IoTDataEntity>().Any())
        {
            var dictItem = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, query.IoTDataSourceTypeCode)
                ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: '{query.IoTDataSourceTypeCode}'");

            resultDate = DbContext.Session.Query<IoTDataEntity>().Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == dictItem.Id).Select(x => x.MeasurementDate).Min();

            resultDate = DateTime.SpecifyKind(resultDate.Value, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        }

        return new FirstIoTDataDateQueryResult { FirstConsumption = resultDate };
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Does the current io t data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoCurrentIoTDataQuery(CurrentIoTDataQuery query)
    {
        var device = GetDeviceByIdentifier(query.DeviceIdentifier);

        IoTDataEntity? result =
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == device.Id)
                .OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate)
                .Desc
                .Take(1)
                .SingleOrDefault();

        var response = new CurrentIoTDataQueryResult
        {
            Data = result?.Data
        };
        return response;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IoTDataQuery ioTDataQuery)
            return DoIoTDataQuery(ioTDataQuery);

        if (query is IoTDataForProcessingQuery processingQuery)
            return DoIoTDataForProcessingQuery(processingQuery);

        if (query is IoTDataPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery)
        {
            var result = (EntityListItemQueryResult<IoTDataListItemDto>)DoQueryEntities(pagedEntityQuery);
            return new IoTDataPagedEntityQueryResult { Items = result.Items, RecordsTotal = result.RecordsTotal };
        }

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the io t data for processing query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3'
    /// or
    /// Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import'
    /// </exception>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoIoTDataForProcessingQuery(IoTDataForProcessingQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>();
        queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.Synced);

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, "SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3")
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3'");

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, "SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import")
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import'");

        queryOver = queryOver
            .Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id
                || x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import.Id);

        queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc();

        var entities =
            query.UnProcessedReadCount.HasValue ?
                queryOver.Take(query.UnProcessedReadCount.Value).List() :
                queryOver.List();

        EntityListItemQueryResult<IoTDataEntityDto> result = new() { Items = entities.Select(CreateDto).ToArray() };
        return result;
    }

#pragma warning disable S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    /// <summary>
    /// Does the io t consumption data for synchronize query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3'
    /// or
    /// Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import'
    /// </exception>
    private IoTMeasuredDataQueryResult DoIoTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery(IoTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery query)
#pragma warning restore S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    {
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)} - {nameof(DoIoTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery)}: Getting unsynced Consumption IoTData...");

        DbContext.BeginTransaction();

        var result = new IoTMeasuredDataQueryResult();

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>().Where(x => !x.Synced);

        if (query.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
        {
            var device = GetDeviceByIdentifier(query.DeviceIdentifier.Value);
            if (device != null) queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == device.Id);
        }

        if (query.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
        {
            var channelEntity = DbContext.Session.Query<ChannelEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Identifier == query.ChannelIdentifier)
                .Select(x => x.IoTDevice).ToList();
            if (channelEntity.Any())
                queryOver
                    .Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == channelEntity[0].Id);
        }

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, "SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3")
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3'");

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, "SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import")
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3Import'");

        queryOver = queryOver
            .Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id
                || x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import.Id);

        var timeSeriesManagers = new Dictionary<string, ITimeSeriesManager>();
        List<double> active = new();
        List<double> reactive = new();
        List<double> voltages = new();
        List<double> lineVoltages = new();
        List<double> phaseVoltages = new();
        List<double> current = new();
        List<double> relativeConsumption = new();
        List<double?> calculatedFeeIn = new();
        List<double?> calculatedFeeOut = new();
        List<double?> purchasePrice = new();
        List<double?> powerInPrice = new();


        var ioTDataEntities = queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc().List();
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)} - {nameof(DoIoTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery)}: ioTDataEntities found: {ioTDataEntities.Count}");

        if (ioTDataEntities == null || !ioTDataEntities.Any()) return result;

        var contracts = GetContracts(query.DeviceIdentifier);
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)} - {nameof(DoIoTConsumptionDataForSyncQuery)}: contracts count: {contracts?.Length ?? 0}");

        //Feldolgozzuk a smappee mérési adatokat
        TimeSpan interval = new(0, 5, 0);
        var measurementDatesGrouppedByInterval = from entity in ioTDataEntities.Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id)
                                                 group entity.MeasurementDate by entity.MeasurementDate.Ticks / interval.Ticks
            into g
                                                 select new DateTime(g.Key * interval.Ticks, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        foreach (var measurementDate in measurementDatesGrouppedByInterval.OrderBy(x => x))
        {
            var entities = ioTDataEntities.Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id && x.MeasurementDate == measurementDate).ToList();

            //Dátum hozzáadása (X tengely)
            result.MeasurementDate.Add(measurementDate);

            result.TimeUnit.Add(AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);//Smappeenél 5 perces adatok

            //Értékek összegyűjtése
            foreach (var ioTDataEntity in entities)
            {
                var code = ioTDataEntity.IoTDataSourceType.Code;

                if (!timeSeriesManagers.TryGetValue(code, out var seriesManager))
                {
                    _scope.TryResolveNamed(code, out seriesManager);
                    if (seriesManager != null)
                        timeSeriesManagers.Add(code, seriesManager);
                }

                if (seriesManager != null)
                {
                    var channels = ioTDataEntity
                        .IoTDevice
                        .Channels
                        .ToList();

                    if (query.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
                        channels = channels
                            .Where(x => x.Identifier == query.ChannelIdentifier)
                            .ToList();

                    var ioTDevEntityDto = Mapper.Map<IoTDeviceEntityDto>(ioTDataEntity.IoTDevice);

                    if (ioTDevEntityDto != null)
                        foreach (var channelEntity in channels)
                        {
                            var channelEntityDto =
                                Mapper.Map<ChannelEntityDto>(channelEntity);
                            seriesManager.GetTimeSeriesDataModel(
                                ioTDataEntity.Data,
                                ioTDevEntityDto.Configuration,
                                channelEntityDto.Configuration);

                            var currentConsumption = seriesManager.GetConsumption() as ConsumptionModel;

                            if (currentConsumption?.Active != null)
                                active.Add(currentConsumption.Active.Value / 1000); //Smappeenél ez mindíg Wh, nekünk kWh kell
                            if (currentConsumption?.Reactive != null)
                                reactive.Add(currentConsumption.Reactive.Value / 1000); //Smappeenél ez mindíg Wh, nekünk kWh kell
                            if (currentConsumption?.Voltage != null)
                                voltages.Add(currentConsumption.Voltage.Value);
                            if (currentConsumption?.LineVoltage != null)
                                lineVoltages.Add(currentConsumption.LineVoltage.Value);
                            if (currentConsumption?.PhaseVoltage != null)
                                phaseVoltages.Add(currentConsumption.PhaseVoltage.Value);
                            if (currentConsumption?.Current != null)
                                current.Add(currentConsumption.Current.Value);
                            if (currentConsumption?.RelativeConsumption != null)
                                relativeConsumption.Add(currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption.Value / 1000); //Smappeenél ez mindíg Wh, nekünk kWh kell

                            if (ioTDevEntityDto.DeviceTypeCode == "smappee")
                            {
                                if (currentConsumption == null || currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption == null
                                    || contracts == null || !contracts.Any()) calculatedFeeOut.Add(0);
                                else calculatedFeeOut.Add(currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption * contracts[0].PurchasePrice);

                                calculatedFeeIn.Add(0);
                                powerInPrice.Add(0);
                                purchasePrice.Add(GetContractedPrice(contracts, EndpointUnitType.Consumer));
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (currentConsumption == null || currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption == null
                                   || contracts == null || !contracts.Any()) calculatedFeeIn.Add(0);
                                else calculatedFeeIn.Add(currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption * contracts[0].PowerInPrice??0.0);

                                powerInPrice.Add(GetContractedPrice(contracts, EndpointUnitType.Producer));
                                purchasePrice.Add(0);
                                calculatedFeeOut.Add(null);
                            }
                        }

                }
                ioTDataEntity.Synced = true;
                DbContext.Session.Update(ioTDataEntity);
            }

            //Összegyűjtött értékek aggregálása (Y tengely)
            result.Active.Add(active.Sum(x => x));
            active.Clear();
            result.Reactive.Add(reactive.Sum(x => x));
            reactive.Clear();
            if (voltages.Any()) result.Voltages.Add(voltages.Average(x => x));
            else result.Voltages.Add(0);
            voltages.Clear();
            if (lineVoltages.Any()) result.LineVoltages.Add(lineVoltages.Average(x => x));
            else result.LineVoltages.Add(0);
            lineVoltages.Clear();
            if (phaseVoltages.Any()) result.PhaseVoltages.Add(phaseVoltages.Average(x => x));
            else result.PhaseVoltages.Add(0);
            phaseVoltages.Clear();
            result.Current.Add(current.Sum(x => x));
            current.Clear();
            result.RelativeConsumption.Add(relativeConsumption.Sum(x => x));
            relativeConsumption.Clear();
            result.CalculatedFeeIn.Add(calculatedFeeIn.Sum(x => x ?? 0));
            calculatedFeeIn.Clear();
            result.CalculatedFeeOut.Add(calculatedFeeOut.Sum(x => x ?? 0));
            calculatedFeeOut.Clear();
            result.PurchasePrice.Add(purchasePrice.Average(x => x));
            purchasePrice.Clear();
            result.PowerInPrice.Add(powerInPrice.Average(x => x));
            powerInPrice.Clear();
        }

        //feldolgozzuk az importokat
        foreach (var entity in ioTDataEntities.Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import.Id))
        {
            var prd = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ElectricityConsumptionImportModel>(entity.Data);
            var data = ProcessImportedConsumptionModel(prd, contracts);

            foreach (var item in data)
            {
                if (result.MeasurementDate.Contains(item.MeasurementDate)) continue;

                result.MeasurementDate.Add(item.MeasurementDate);
                result.Active.Add(item.Active);
                result.Reactive.Add(item.Reactive);
                result.Voltages.Add(item.Voltages);
                result.LineVoltages.Add(item.LineVoltages);
                result.PhaseVoltages.Add(item.PhaseVoltages);
                result.Current.Add(item.Current);
                result.RelativeConsumption.Add(item.RelativeConsumption);
                result.CalculatedFeeIn.Add(item.CalculatedFeeIn);
                result.CalculatedFeeOut.Add(item.CalculatedFeeOut);
                result.PurchasePrice.Add(item.PurchasePrice);

                result.TimeUnit.Add(entity.TimeUnit);
            }

            entity.Synced = true;
            DbContext.Session.Update(entity);
        }

        DbContext.Commit();
        return result;
    }

#pragma warning disable S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    /// <summary>
    /// Does the io t production data for synchronize query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SolarEdgeAPI'
    /// or
    /// Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SolarEdgeAPIImport'
    /// </exception>
    private IoTProductionDataForSyncQueryResult DoIoTProductionDataForSyncQuery(IoTProductionDataForSyncQuery query)
#pragma warning restore S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    {

        using var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        
        tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(query.TenantCode);
        using var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var tenant = tenantDbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIoTProductionDataForSyncQuery)}: Getting unsynced Production IoTData...");

        tenantDbContext.BeginTransaction();

        var result = new IoTProductionDataForSyncQueryResult();

        var queryOver = tenantDbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>().Where(x => !x.Synced);

        var device = GetDeviceByIdentifier(query.DeviceIdentifier, query.TenantCode);
        if (device != null) queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == device.Id);

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, "SolarEdgeAPI")
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SolarEdgeAPI'");

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, "SolarEdgeAPIImport")
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SolarEdgeAPIImport'");

        queryOver = queryOver
            .Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id
                || x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import.Id);
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIoTProductionDataForSyncQuery)}: IoTDataSourceTypeId of SolarEdgeAPI {ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id}");

        var ioTDataEntities = queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc().List();
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIoTProductionDataForSyncQuery)}: ioTDataEntities found: {ioTDataEntities.Count}");

        if (ioTDataEntities == null || !ioTDataEntities.Any()) return result;

        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIoTProductionDataForSyncQuery)}: Using price value of 0 for calculations");

        _productionImports.Clear();
        foreach (var entity in ioTDataEntities)
        {
            if (entity.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity_import.Id)
            {
                var prd = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SolarEdgeProductionImportModel>(entity.Data);
                if (prd != null) result.Data.AddRange(ProcessImportedProductionModel(prd, null, tenantDbContext));
            }
            else if (entity.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id)
            {
                //SolarEdgeProductionImportModel
                var prd = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SolarEdgeProductionModel>(entity.Data);
                if (prd != null) foreach (var item in prd.Values)
                    {
                        result.Data.Add(new Shared.Models.IoTMeasuredProductionDataModel
                        {
                            Power = item.Power ?? 0,
                            PowerUnit = prd.PowerUnit,
                            Energy = item.Energy ?? 0,
                            EnergyUnit = prd.EnergyUnit,
                            MeasurementDate = item.Date,
                            CalculatedFeeIn = 0,
                            PowerInPrice = 0,
                            TimeUnit = entity.TimeUnit
                        });
                    }
            }

            entity.Synced = true;
            tenantDbContext.Session.Update(entity);
        }

        tenantDbContext.Commit();

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The production imports
    /// </summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<int, IoTDataImportEntityDto> _productionImports = new();

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the imported production model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <param name="contracts">The contracts.</param>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEnumerable<Shared.Models.IoTMeasuredProductionDataModel> ProcessImportedProductionModel(SolarEdgeProductionImportModel model, Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? contracts, IDbContext dbContext)
    {
        var import = _productionImports.ContainsKey(model.ImportId) ? _productionImports[model.ImportId] : null;
        if (import == null)
        {
            import = Mapper.Map<IoTDataImportEntityDto>(dbContext.Session.Get<IoTDataImportEntity>(model.ImportId));
            _productionImports.Add(model.ImportId, import);
        }

        var aggregatedMinutes = import.TimeUnit switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => 5,
            AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => 15,
            AggregationLevel.OneHour => 60,
            AggregationLevel.OneDay => 60 * 24,
            _ => 15,
        };

        var data = new List<Shared.Models.IoTMeasuredProductionDataModel>();
        DateTime start = model.MeasurementDate.AddMinutes(aggregatedMinutes - 15);
        DateTime current = start;
        var dataCount = aggregatedMinutes / 15;

        //átlagolt értékek
        var power = model.Power ?? 0;

        //szummázott értékek
        var energy = model.Energy > 0 ? model.Energy.Value / dataCount : 0;

        if (import.Unit == Unit.W)
        {
            power = power > 0 ? power / 1000 : 0;
            energy = energy > 0 ? energy / 1000 : 0;
        }

        while (current <= model.MeasurementDate)
        {
            data.Add(new Shared.Models.IoTMeasuredProductionDataModel
            {
                Power = power,
                PowerUnit = import.Unit == Unit.W ? "W" : "kW",
                Energy = energy,
                EnergyUnit = import.Unit == Unit.W ? "Wh" : "kWh",
                MeasurementDate = current,
                CalculatedFeeIn = 0,
                PowerInPrice = 0,
                TimeUnit = AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes
            });
            current = current.AddMinutes(15);
        }
        return data;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The consumption imports
    /// </summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<int, IoTDataImportEntityDto> _consumptionImports = new();
#pragma warning disable S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the imported consumption model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <param name="contracts">The contracts.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEnumerable<Shared.Models.IoTMeasuredConsumptionDataModel> ProcessImportedConsumptionModel(ElectricityConsumptionImportModel? model, Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? contracts, string? tenantCode = null)
#pragma warning restore S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    {
        var data = new List<Shared.Models.IoTMeasuredConsumptionDataModel>();

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(tenantCode);
                DbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
            }


                if (model == null) return data;

        var import = _consumptionImports.ContainsKey(model.ImportId) ? _consumptionImports[model.ImportId] : null;
        if (import == null)
        {
            import = Mapper.Map<IoTDataImportEntityDto>(DbContext.Session.Get<IoTDataImportEntity>(model.ImportId));
            _consumptionImports.Add(model.ImportId, import);
        }

        var aggregatedMinutes = import.TimeUnit switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => 5,
            AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => 15,
            AggregationLevel.OneHour => 60,
            AggregationLevel.OneDay => 60 * 24,
            _ => 15,
        };

        DateTime start = model.MeasurementDate.AddMinutes(aggregatedMinutes - 5);
        DateTime current = start;
        var dataCount = aggregatedMinutes / 5;

        //átlagolt értékek
        var voltage = model.Voltage ?? 0;
        var lineVoltage = model.LineVoltage ?? 0;
        var phaseVoltage = model.PhaseVoltage ?? 0;

        //szummázott értékek
        var active = model.Active > 0 ? model.Active.Value / dataCount : 0;
        var reactive = model.Reactive > 0 ? model.Reactive.Value / dataCount : 0;
        var curr = model.Current > 0 ? model.Current.Value / dataCount : 0;

        if (import.Unit == Unit.W)
        {
            active = active > 0 ? active / 1000 : 0;
            reactive = reactive > 0 ? reactive / 1000 : 0; 
        }

        while (current <= model.MeasurementDate)
        {
            data.Add(new Shared.Models.IoTMeasuredConsumptionDataModel
            {
                Voltages = voltage,
                LineVoltages = lineVoltage,
                PhaseVoltages = phaseVoltage,
                Active = active,
                Reactive = reactive,
                Current = curr,
                MeasurementDate = current,
                CalculatedFeeIn = 0,
                CalculatedFeeOut = CalculateFeeOut(active, contracts, import.Unit),
                RelativeConsumption = active * 0.08333,
                PurchasePrice = 0
            });
            current = current.AddMinutes(5);
        }
        return data;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the io t other data for synchronize query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: '{query.Source.GetEntityCode()}'</exception>
    private IoTOtherDataForSyncQueryResult DoIoTOtherDataForSyncQuery(IoTOtherDataForSyncQuery query)
    {
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)} - {nameof(DoIoTOtherDataForSyncQuery)}: Getting unsynced Other IoTData...");

        using var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(query.TenantCode);
        using var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var tenant = tenantDbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

        tenantDbContext.BeginTransaction();

        var result = new IoTOtherDataForSyncQueryResult();

        var queryOver = tenantDbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>().Where(x => !x.Synced);

        var device = GetDeviceByIdentifier(query.DeviceIdentifier, query.TenantCode);
        if (device != null) queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == device.Id);

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, query.Source.GetEntityCode())
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: '{query.Source.GetEntityCode()}'");

        queryOver = queryOver
            .Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id);
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIoTOtherDataForSyncQuery)}: IoTDataSourceTypeId of {query.Source.GetEntityCode()} {ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id}");

        var ioTDataEntities = queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc().Take(6000).List();
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIoTOtherDataForSyncQuery)}: ioTDataEntities found: {ioTDataEntities.Count}");

        if (!ioTDataEntities.Any()) return result;

        var contracts = GetContracts(query.DeviceIdentifier, query.TenantCode);
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIoTOtherDataForSyncQuery)}: contracts count: {contracts?.Length}");

        var endpointType = query.Source == Shared.Enums.IoTDataSourceType.OtherConsumptionMeterImport ? EndpointUnitType.Consumer : EndpointUnitType.Producer;

        foreach (var entity in ioTDataEntities)
        {

            var prd = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<OtherConsumerProducerModel>(entity.Data);
            if (prd == null) continue;

            var endpoint = GetEndpointByIdentifier(prd.EndpointIdentifier, query.TenantCode);

            result.Data.Add(new Shared.Models.IoTMeasuredOtherDataModel
            {
                Power = prd.Power ?? 0,
                Energy = prd.Energy ?? 0,
                Unit = prd.Unit,
                MeasurementDate = prd.MeasurementDate,
                EndpointType = endpointType,
                TimeUnit = prd.TimeUnit,
                ImportId = prd.ImportId,
                PowerPrice = 0,
                CalculatedFee = CalculateFee(contracts, prd),
                ChannelIdentifier = endpoint?.Identifier
            });

            entity.Synced = true;
            tenantDbContext.Session.Update(entity);
        }

        tenantDbContext.Commit();

        return result;
    }

#pragma warning disable S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    /// <summary>
    /// Does the i io t measured data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IoTMeasuredDataQueryResult DoIIoTMeasuredDataQuery(IoTMeasuredDataQuery query)
#pragma warning restore S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    {

        var result = new IoTMeasuredDataQueryResult();

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>();
        var tenant = DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";
   
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName??""}) - {nameof(DoIIoTMeasuredDataQuery)}: Getting Consumption IoTData {query.From}-{query.To}");

        if (query.From.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= query.From);

        if (query.To.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate < query.To);

        if (query.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
        {
            var device = GetDeviceByIdentifier(query.DeviceIdentifier.Value);
            if (device != null) queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == device.Id);
        }

        if (query.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
        {
            var channelEntity = DbContext.Session.Query<ChannelEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Identifier == query.ChannelIdentifier)
                .Select(x => x.IoTDevice).ToList();
            if (channelEntity.Any())
                queryOver
                    .Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == channelEntity[0].Id);
        }

        var aggregationMin = 5;
        if (query.Aggregation.HasValue)
        {
            switch (query.Aggregation.Value)
            {
                case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes: aggregationMin = 15; break;
                case AggregationLevel.OneHour: aggregationMin = 60; break;
            }
        }

        var timeSeriesManagers = new Dictionary<string, ITimeSeriesManager>();
        List<double> active = new();
        List<double> reactive = new();
        List<double> voltages = new();
        List<double> lineVoltages = new();
        List<double> phaseVoltages = new();
        List<double> current = new();
        List<double> relativeConsumption = new();
        List<double?> calculatedFeeIn = new();
        List<double?> calculatedFeeOut = new();
        List<double?> purchasePrice = new();
        List<double?> powerInPrice = new();

        var ioTDataEntities = queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc().List();
        TimeSpan interval = new(0, aggregationMin, 0);
        var measurementDatesGrouppedByInterval = from entity in ioTDataEntities
                                                 group entity.MeasurementDate by entity.MeasurementDate.Ticks / interval.Ticks
            into g
                                                 select new DateTime(g.Key * interval.Ticks, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIIoTMeasuredDataQuery)}: query contract of device: {query.DeviceIdentifier}");

        var contracts = Array.Empty<Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto>();
        if (measurementDatesGrouppedByInterval.Any() && query.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
            contracts = GetContracts(query.DeviceIdentifier.Value);

        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIIoTMeasuredDataQuery)}: contracts count: {contracts?.Length}");

        foreach (var measurementDate in measurementDatesGrouppedByInterval.OrderBy(x => x))
        {
            var entities = ioTDataEntities.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate == measurementDate).ToList();

            //Dátum hozzáadása (X tengely)
            result.MeasurementDate.Add(measurementDate);

            //Értékek összegyűjtése
            foreach (var ioTDataEntity in entities)
            {
                var code = ioTDataEntity.IoTDataSourceType.Code;

                if (!timeSeriesManagers.TryGetValue(code, out var seriesManager))
                {
                    _scope.TryResolveNamed(code, out seriesManager);
                    if (seriesManager != null)
                        timeSeriesManagers.Add(code, seriesManager);
                }

                if (seriesManager != null)
                {
                    var channels = ioTDataEntity
                        .IoTDevice
                        .Channels
                        .ToList();

                    if (query.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
                        channels = channels
                            .Where(x => x.Identifier == query.ChannelIdentifier)
                            .ToList();

                    var ioTDevEntityDto = Mapper.Map<IoTDeviceEntityDto>(ioTDataEntity.IoTDevice);

                    var correctionForSmappee = ioTDevEntityDto.DeviceTypeCode == "smappee" ? 1000.0 : 1.0; 

                    if (ioTDevEntityDto != null)
                        foreach (var channelEntity in channels)
                        {
                            var channelEntityDto =
                                Mapper.Map<ChannelEntityDto>(channelEntity);
                            seriesManager.GetTimeSeriesDataModel(
                                ioTDataEntity.Data,
                                ioTDevEntityDto.Configuration,
                                channelEntityDto.Configuration);

                            var currentConsumption = seriesManager.GetConsumption() as ConsumptionModel;

                            if (currentConsumption?.Active != null)
                                active.Add(currentConsumption.Active.Value / correctionForSmappee);
                            if (currentConsumption?.Reactive != null)
                                reactive.Add(currentConsumption.Reactive.Value / correctionForSmappee);
                            if (currentConsumption?.Voltage != null)
                                voltages.Add(currentConsumption.Voltage.Value);
                            if (currentConsumption?.LineVoltage != null)
                                lineVoltages.Add(currentConsumption.LineVoltage.Value);
                            if (currentConsumption?.PhaseVoltage != null)
                                phaseVoltages.Add(currentConsumption.PhaseVoltage.Value);
                            if (currentConsumption?.Current != null)
                                current.Add(currentConsumption.Current.Value);
                            if (currentConsumption?.RelativeConsumption != null)
                                relativeConsumption.Add(currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption.Value / correctionForSmappee);

                            Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto? validContract = null;
                            if (currentConsumption != null && contracts != null)
                                validContract = Array.Find(contracts, c => c.ContractIssueDate <= currentConsumption.MeasurementDate && c.ContractExpiryDate > currentConsumption.MeasurementDate);

                            if (ioTDevEntityDto.DeviceTypeCode == "smappee")
                            {
                                if (currentConsumption == null || currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption == null
                                    || validContract == null)
                                {
                                    purchasePrice.Add(0);
                                    calculatedFeeOut.Add(0);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    purchasePrice.Add(validContract.PurchasePrice);
                                    calculatedFeeOut.Add((currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption / correctionForSmappee) * validContract.PurchasePrice);
                                }

                                calculatedFeeIn.Add(0);
                                powerInPrice.Add(0);     // ?
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (currentConsumption == null || currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption == null
                                   || validContract == null)
                                {
                                    powerInPrice.Add(0);
                                    calculatedFeeIn.Add(0);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    powerInPrice.Add(validContract.PowerInPrice??0);
                                    calculatedFeeIn.Add((currentConsumption.RelativeConsumption / correctionForSmappee) * validContract.PowerInPrice??0);
                                }

                                calculatedFeeOut.Add(0);
                                purchasePrice.Add(0);    //?
                            }
                        }

                }
            }

            //Összegyűjtött értékek aggregálása (Y tengely)
            result.Active.Add(active.Sum(x => x));
            active.Clear();
            result.Reactive.Add(reactive.Sum(x => x));
            reactive.Clear();
            if (voltages.Any()) result.Voltages.Add(voltages.Average(x => x));
            else result.Voltages.Add(0);
            voltages.Clear();
            if (lineVoltages.Any()) result.LineVoltages.Add(lineVoltages.Average(x => x));
            else result.LineVoltages.Add(0);
            lineVoltages.Clear();
            if (phaseVoltages.Any()) result.PhaseVoltages.Add(phaseVoltages.Average(x => x));
            else result.PhaseVoltages.Add(0);
            phaseVoltages.Clear();
            result.Current.Add(current.Sum(x => x));
            current.Clear();
            result.RelativeConsumption.Add(relativeConsumption.Sum(x => x));
            relativeConsumption.Clear();
            result.CalculatedFeeIn.Add(calculatedFeeIn.Sum(x => x ?? 0));
            calculatedFeeIn.Clear();
            result.CalculatedFeeOut.Add(calculatedFeeOut.Sum(x => x ?? 0));
            calculatedFeeOut.Clear();
            if (purchasePrice.Any()) result.PurchasePrice.Add(purchasePrice.Average(x => x));
            else result.PurchasePrice.Add(0);
            if (powerInPrice.Any()) result.PowerInPrice.Add(powerInPrice.Average(x => x));
            else result.PowerInPrice.Add(0);
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the i io t measured production data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SolarEdgeAPI'</exception>
    private IoTMeasuredProductionDataQueryResult DoIIoTMeasuredProductionDataQuery(IoTMeasuredProductionDataQuery query)
    {
        var tenant = DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIIoTMeasuredProductionDataQuery)}: Getting Production IoTData {query.From}-{query.To}");

        var result = new IoTMeasuredProductionDataQueryResult();

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>();

        if (query.From.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate > query.From);

        if (query.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
        {
            var device = GetDeviceByIdentifier(query.DeviceIdentifier.Value);
            if (device != null) queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == device.Id);
        }

        var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, "SolarEdgeAPI")
            ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: 'SolarEdgeAPI'");

        queryOver = queryOver
            .Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id);
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIIoTMeasuredProductionDataQuery)}: IoTDataSourceTypeId of SolarEdgeAPI {ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id}");

        var entity = queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc().Take(1).SingleOrDefault();
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIIoTMeasuredProductionDataQuery)}: ioTData found: {(entity == null ? 0 : 1)}");

        if (entity == null) return result;

        Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? contracts = GetContracts(query.DeviceIdentifier);
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(IoTDataQueryHandler)}(tenant: {tenant}) - {nameof(DoIIoTMeasuredProductionDataQuery)}: contracts count: {contracts?.Length}");

        var prd = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SolarEdgeProductionModel>(entity.Data);

        if (prd == null) return result;

        foreach (var item in prd.Values)
        {
            result.Data.Add(new Shared.Models.IoTMeasuredProductionDataModel
            {
                Power = item.Power ?? 0,
                PowerUnit = prd.PowerUnit,
                Energy = item.Energy ?? 0,
                EnergyUnit = prd.EnergyUnit,
                MeasurementDate = item.Date,
                CalculatedFeeIn = CalculateFeeIn(item.Power ?? 0, contracts, prd.PowerUnit.ToLower() == "w" ? Unit.W : Unit.kW),
                PowerInPrice = GetContractedPrice(contracts, EndpointUnitType.Producer)
            });
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the fee.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="contracts">The contracts.</param>
    /// <param name="prd">The PRD.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static double CalculateFee(Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? contracts, OtherConsumerProducerModel prd)
    {
        var contractedPrice = GetContractedPrice(contracts, prd.EndpointType);

        var energy = prd.Unit == Unit.W ? (prd.Energy ?? 0) / 1000 : prd.Energy ?? 0;

        return energy * contractedPrice;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the contracted price.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="contracts">The contracts.</param>
    /// <param name="type">The type.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static double GetContractedPrice(Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? contracts, EndpointUnitType type)
    {
        if (contracts == null) return 0.0;

        var now = DateTimeOffset.Now;
        var contract = Array.Find(contracts, x => x.ContractIssueDate <= now && x.ContractExpiryDate > now);
        if (contract == null) return 0.0;

        if (type == EndpointUnitType.Producer)
        {
            return contract.PowerInPrice ?? 0.0;
        }
        else
        {
            return type == EndpointUnitType.Consumer ? contract.PurchasePrice : 0.0;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the fee in.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="power">The power.</param>
    /// <param name="contracts">The contracts.</param>
    /// <param name="unit">The unit.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static double CalculateFeeIn(double power, Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? contracts, Unit unit)
    {
        var contractedPrice = GetContractedPrice(contracts, EndpointUnitType.Producer);
        var correction = unit == Unit.W ? 1000 : 1;

        var fee = ((power * 0.25) / correction) * contractedPrice;

        return fee;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the fee out.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="active">The active.</param>
    /// <param name="contracts">The contracts.</param>
    /// <param name="unit">The unit.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static double CalculateFeeOut(double active, Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? contracts, Unit unit)
    {
        var contractedPrice = GetContractedPrice(contracts, EndpointUnitType.Consumer);
        var correction = unit == Unit.W ? 1000 : 1;

        var fee = ((active * 0.08333) / correction) * contractedPrice;

        return fee;
    }

    private Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? GetContracts(Guid? deviceIdentifier, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        if (deviceIdentifier == null) return null;
        var device = GetDeviceByIdentifier(deviceIdentifier.Value, tenantCode);

        var key = $"{nameof(Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto)}_{device?.DeviceName}";

        if (!_cache.TryGetValue(key, out Modules.Framework.PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]? contract) && device != null)
        {
            var frameworkApi = Common.BackEnd.Helpers.ApiHelper.FrameworkApi();

            //Ez az egész QueryHandler kuka, kikommenteltem ezt mert nics device.SiteIdentifier
            //contract = frameworkApi.EnergyContracts_GetContractsByInstitutionAsync(device.SiteIdentifier, tenantCode).GetAwaiter().GetResult().ToArray();
            //if (contract.Any()) _cache.SetAsync(key, contract);
        }

        return contract;
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<IoTDataEntity, IoTDataEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is IoTDataPagedEntityQuery ioTDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.From.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.From);

            if (ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.To.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate < ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.To);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.DeviceName))
                queryOver = queryOver
                    .WhereRestrictionOn(x => _ioTDeviceAlias!.DeviceName)
                    .IsInsensitiveLike(ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.DeviceName, MatchMode.Anywhere);

            if (ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.Processed.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Processed == ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.Processed.Value);

            if (ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.DataTypeId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataPagedEntityQuery.DataTypeId.Value);
        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(
        IQueryOver<IoTDataEntity, IoTDataEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(IoTDataListItemDto))
        {

            var selectExpressions = new List<Expression<Func<IoTDataEntity, object>>>
            {
                f => f.IoTDevice.Id,
                f => f.Id,
                f => f.MeasurementDate,
                f => f.CreateDate,
                f => f.Processed,
                f => f.IoTDataSourceType.Id,
                f => f.IoTDataType.Id
            };

            queryOver.Select(selectExpressions.ToArray());

            var devices = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>().List();

            Func<object[], IoTDataListItemDto> result = o => new IoTDataListItemDto
            {
                Id = (int)o[1],
                MeasurementDate = DateTime.SpecifyKind((DateTime)o[2], DateTimeKind.Utc),
                CreateDate = (DateTime)o[3],
                Processed = (bool)o[4],
                DeviceName = devices?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == (int)o[0])?.DeviceName,
                DeviceIdentifier = devices?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == (int)o[0])?.Identifier,
                IoTDataSourceType = _tDictCache
                    .GetDictByCode(_scope, "iot_data_source_type")
                    ?.Items
                    ?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == (int)o[5])?.Value,
                IoTDataType = _tiDictCache
                    .GetDictByCode("iot_data_type")
                    ?.Items
                    ?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == (int)o[6])?.Value
            };

            return result as Func<object[], TResult>;
        }

        return null;
    }


    protected override long DoQueryEntityCount(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query is IoTDataQuery ioTDataQuery ? DoIoTDataRowCountQuery(ioTDataQuery) : base.DoQueryEntityCount(query);
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<IoTDataEntity, IoTDataEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDevice, () => _ioTDeviceAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy eszközhöz tartozó mérési adatok adott idősávban. (Ha a kezdeti- és
    /// végidőpont null, akkor az összes, az eszközre vonatkozó IoTData rekord darabszáma.)
    /// </summary>
    private long DoIoTDataRowCountQuery(IoTDataQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>();

        SetIoTDataQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        return queryOver.RowCountInt64();
    }

    private IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoIoTDataQuery(IoTDataQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDataEntity>();
        SetIoTDataQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc();

        var entities =
            query.UnProcessedReadCount.HasValue ?
                queryOver.Take(query.UnProcessedReadCount.Value).List() :
                queryOver.List();

        EntityListItemQueryResult<IoTDataEntityDto> result = new() { Items = entities.Select(CreateDto).ToArray() };
        return result;
    }

    private void SetIoTDataQueryWhere(IQueryOver<IoTDataEntity, IoTDataEntity> queryOver, IoTDataQuery query)
    {
        // A megadott IoT eszközre vonatkozó adatok.
        if (query.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
        {
            var deviceQueryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Identifier == query.DeviceIdentifier);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.DeviceTypeCode))
                deviceQueryOver.Where(x => x.DeviceTypeCode == query.DeviceTypeCode);
            _deviceIds ??= deviceQueryOver
                .SelectList(x => x.Select(z => z.Id))
                .List<int>()
                .ToArray();
        }

        // A megadott deviceType kódú eszközökre vonatkozó adatok
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.DeviceTypeCode))
        {
            this._deviceIds ??= DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.DeviceTypeCode == query.DeviceTypeCode)
                .SelectList(x => x.Select(z => z.Id))
                .List<int>()
                .ToArray();
        }

        if (query.DeviceId.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == query.DeviceId);

        if (_deviceIds != null)
            queryOver.Where(d => d.IoTDevice.Id.IsIn(_deviceIds));

        if (query.Processed.HasValue)
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(d => d.Processed == query.Processed);

        // Az átadott mérés kezdete-, és végidőpontja közötti mérési adatok.
        queryOver.Where(Restrictions.Where(DateTimeValidityExtensions.DateTimeValidityExpression(query)));

        if (query.IoTDataSourceType.HasValue)
        {
            var ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity = _tDictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType, query.IoTDataSourceType.GetEntityCode()) ?? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DataSourceType Code. There is no IoT DataSourceType with IoTDataSourceTypeCode: '{query.IoTDataSourceType.GetEntityCode()}'");

            queryOver = queryOver
                .Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceType.Id == ioTDataSourceTypeCodeEntity.Id);
        }

        if (query.HasChannel.HasValue)
        {
            // Kikeressük, hogy mely eszközöknek van érvényes mérési végpontja.
            int[] devicesWithChannel = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>()
                .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted)
                .List()
                .Select(x => x.IoTDevice.Id)
                .Distinct().ToArray();

            // Csak azokat az IoTDatákat vesszük ki, amelyekek eszközének van mérési végpontja.
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id.IsIn(devicesWithChannel));
        }
    }

    private IoTDeviceEntityDto? GetDeviceByIdentifier(Guid? identifier, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        if (identifier == null) return null;

        string key = $"{nameof(IoTDeviceEntityDto)}_{identifier}";
        IoTDeviceEntity deviceEnt = null!;

        if (!_cache.TryGetValue(key, out IoTDeviceEntityDto? device))
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tenantCode))
                using (var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
                {
                    tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(tenantCode);
                    var _dbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

                    deviceEnt = _dbContext.Session
                    .QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.Identifier == identifier)
                        .SingleOrDefault();

                    if (deviceEnt is not null)
                    {
                        if (deviceEnt.Configuration.Any())
                            foreach (var entity in deviceEnt.Configuration)
                                entity.UnProxy();

                        if (deviceEnt.Channels.Any())
                            foreach (var entity in deviceEnt.Channels)
                                entity.UnProxy();
                    }
                }
            else
                deviceEnt = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>().Where(x => x.Identifier == identifier).SingleOrDefault();

            if (deviceEnt != null)
            {
                device = Mapper.Map<IoTDeviceEntityDto?>(deviceEnt);
                _cache.SetAsync(key, device).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            }
        }
        return device;
    }

    private ChannelEntityDto? GetEndpointByIdentifier(string identifier, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        if (identifier == null) return null;

        string key = $"{nameof(ChannelEntityDto)}_{identifier}";
        ChannelConfigValueEntity configEnt = null!;

        if (!_cache.TryGetValue(key, out ChannelEntityDto? endpoint))
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tenantCode))
                using (var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
                {
                    tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(tenantCode);
                    using var _dbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

                    configEnt = _dbContext.Session
                    .QueryOver<ChannelConfigValueEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.Value.IsInsensitiveLike(identifier))
                        .SingleOrDefault();

                    if (configEnt.Channel.Configuration.Any())
                        foreach (var entity in configEnt.Channel.Configuration)
                            entity.UnProxy();

                    if (configEnt.Channel.IoTDevice != null)
                        configEnt.Channel.IoTDevice.UnProxy();

                }
            else
                configEnt = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelConfigValueEntity>().Where(x => x.Value.IsInsensitiveLike(identifier)).SingleOrDefault();

            if (configEnt != null)
            {
                endpoint = Mapper.Map<ChannelEntityDto?>(configEnt.Channel);
                _cache.SetAsync(key, endpoint).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            }
        }
        return endpoint;
    }
}
