using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// IoTDeviceQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT.IoTDeviceEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.IoTDeviceEntityDto&gt;" />
public class IoTDeviceQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<IoTDeviceEntity, IoTDeviceEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDeviceQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public IoTDeviceQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity, IoTDeviceEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        if (query is IIoTDeviceQuery deviceQuery)
        {
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);

            if (deviceQuery.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == deviceQuery.DeviceIdentifier);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(deviceQuery.DeviceTypeCode))
                queryOver.Where(x => x.DeviceTypeCode == deviceQuery.DeviceTypeCode);

            if (deviceQuery.HasChannels != null)
            {
                // Kikeressük, hogy mely eszközöknek van érvényes mérési végpontja.
                int[] devicesWithChannel = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>()
                    .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted)
                    .List()
                    .Select(x => x.IoTDevice.Id)
                    .Distinct().ToArray();

                // Csak azokat az IoTDatákat vesszük ki, amelyekek eszközének van mérési végpontja.
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Id.IsIn(devicesWithChannel));
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query is IoTDeviceQuery<IoTDeviceEntityDto> ioTDeviceQuery
            ? DoIoTDeviceSingleEntityQuery(ioTDeviceQuery)
            : base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the io t device single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoIoTDeviceSingleEntityQuery<T>(IoTDeviceQuery<T> query)
    where T : IoTDeviceEntityDto
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>();
        queryOver.Where(d => !d.IsDeleted);

        if (query.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(d => d.Identifier == query.DeviceIdentifier);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous IoTDeviceQuery");

        return entity != null
            ? new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            }
            : (IEntityQuerySingleResult?)null;
    }
}

using System.Linq.Expressions;
using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.ListItems.MeasurementData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// MeasurementDataQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT.MeasurementDataEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.MeasurementDataEntityDto&gt;" />
public class MeasurementDataQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<MeasurementDataEntity, MeasurementDataEntityDto>
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeasurementDataQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public MeasurementDataQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is LastConsumptionForChannelQuery lastConsumptionForDeviceQuery)
            return DoLastConsumptionForChannelQuery(lastConsumptionForDeviceQuery);

        if (query is LastProductionForChannelQuery lastProductionForDeviceQuery)
            return DoLastProductionForChannelQuery(lastProductionForDeviceQuery);

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is MeasurementDataQuery measurementDataQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(measurementDataQuery);

        if (query is MeasurementDataPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery)
        {
            var result = (EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementDataListItemDto>)DoQueryEntities(pagedEntityQuery);
            return new MeasurementDataPagedEntityQueryResult
            {
                Items = result.Items,
                RecordsTotal = result.RecordsTotal
            };
        }

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }



    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<MeasurementDataEntity, MeasurementDataEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(MeasurementDataListItemDto))
        {
            MeasurementDataListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list
                    .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(x => x.MeasuredData).WithAlias(() => alias.Data)
                    .Select(x => x.TimeSeriesSchemmaCode).WithAlias(() => alias.CatalogCode)
                    .Select(x => x.MeasurementDate).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)
                    .Select(x => x.ChannelIdentifier).WithAlias(() => alias.ChannelIdentifier)
            );

            var selectExpressions = new List<Expression<Func<MeasurementDataEntity, object>>>
            {
                f => f.Channel.Id,
                f => f.Id,
                f => f.MeasuredData,
                f => f.TimeSeriesSchemmaCode,
                f => f.MeasurementDate,
                f => f.ChannelIdentifier
            };

            queryOver.Select(selectExpressions.ToArray());

            var channelEntities = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>().List();

            Func<object[], MeasurementDataListItemDto> result = o => new MeasurementDataListItemDto
            {
                Id = (int)o[1],
                Data = (object[])o[2],
                CatalogCode = (string?)o[3],
                MeasurementDate = DateTime.SpecifyKind((DateTime)o[4], DateTimeKind.Utc),
                ChannelIdentifier = (Guid?)o[5],
                DeviceIdentifier = channelEntities?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == (int)o[0])?.IoTDevice.Identifier,
                DeviceName = channelEntities?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == (int)o[0])?.IoTDevice.DeviceName
            };

            return result as Func<object[], TResult>;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<MeasurementDataEntity, MeasurementDataEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is MeasurementDataPagedEntityQuery measurementDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (measurementDataPagedEntityQuery.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.ChannelIdentifier == measurementDataPagedEntityQuery.ChannelIdentifier);

            if (measurementDataPagedEntityQuery.From.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= measurementDataPagedEntityQuery.From);

            if (measurementDataPagedEntityQuery.To.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate < measurementDataPagedEntityQuery.To);
        }

        if (query is IPagedEntityQuery pagedQuery && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(pagedQuery.SearchText))
        {
            ChannelEntity? channelAlias = null;
            IoTDeviceEntity? iotDeviceAlias = null;
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Channel, () => channelAlias);
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => channelAlias.IoTDevice, () => iotDeviceAlias);

            queryOver
               .And(Restrictions.Or(
                        Restrictions
                            .On<MeasurementDataEntity>(x => iotDeviceAlias.DeviceName)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere),
                        Restrictions
                            .On<MeasurementDataEntity>(x => x.TimeSeriesSchemmaCode)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere)
                   ));

            // TODO: Az alábbi kikommenzetett rész lenne a keresés minden oszlopra, azonban
            // nem lehetséges like-osan keresni egy guid típusú oszlopon, csak, ha előbb
            // stringgé alakítja az ember. Egyelőre fent a két string típusú oszlopra tudunk
            // csak keresni.

            /*queryOver
                   .And(Restrictions.Or(Restrictions.Or(Restrictions.Or(
                            Restrictions
                                .On<MeasurementDataEntity>(x => iotDeviceAlias.DeviceName)
                                .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere),
                            Restrictions
                                .On<MeasurementDataEntity>(x => iotDeviceAlias.Identifier)
                                .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere)
                       ), Restrictions
                                .On<MeasurementDataEntity>(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier)
                                .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere)
                       ), Restrictions
                                .On<MeasurementDataEntity>(x => x.TimeSeriesSchemmaCode)
                                .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere))
                   );*/
        }

        if (query is MeasurementDataQuery measurementDataQuery)
        {
            if (measurementDataQuery.From.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= measurementDataQuery.From);
            }
            if (measurementDataQuery.To.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate < measurementDataQuery.To);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the last consumption for measured endpoint query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="lastConsumptionForChannelQuery">The last consumption for measured endpoint query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoLastConsumptionForChannelQuery(LastConsumptionForChannelQuery lastConsumptionForChannelQuery)
    {
        var lastConsumption = 0d;
        var lastConsumptionQuery = DbContext.Session.Query<MeasurementDataEntity>();

        if (lastConsumptionForChannelQuery.ReferenceTimeBefore.HasValue)
            lastConsumptionQuery = lastConsumptionQuery.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= lastConsumptionForChannelQuery.ReferenceTimeBefore.Value);

        if (lastConsumptionForChannelQuery.ChannelId.HasValue)
            lastConsumptionQuery = lastConsumptionQuery
                .Where(x => x.Channel.Id == lastConsumptionForChannelQuery.ChannelId);
        else if (lastConsumptionForChannelQuery.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
            lastConsumptionQuery = lastConsumptionQuery
                .Where(x => x.Channel.Identifier == lastConsumptionForChannelQuery.ChannelIdentifier);
        else
            lastConsumptionQuery = null;

        if (lastConsumptionQuery != null)
            lastConsumption = lastConsumptionQuery
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.MeasurementDate)
                // TODO: MeasuredData[1] -> ezt a timeseriesManager osztálynak kellene visszaadnia
                .FirstOrDefault()?.MeasuredData[1] ?? 0d;

        return new LastConsumptionForDeviceQueryResult
        {
            LastConsumption = lastConsumption
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the last production for measured endpoint query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="lastProductionForChannelQuery">The last production for measured endpoint query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoLastProductionForChannelQuery(LastProductionForChannelQuery lastProductionForChannelQuery)
    {
        var lastProduction = 0d;
        var lastProductionQuery = DbContext.Session.Query<MeasurementDataEntity>();

        if (lastProductionForChannelQuery.ChannelId.HasValue)
            lastProductionQuery = lastProductionQuery
                .Where(x => x.Channel.Id == lastProductionForChannelQuery.ChannelId);
        else if (lastProductionForChannelQuery.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
            lastProductionQuery = lastProductionQuery
                .Where(x => x.Channel.Identifier == lastProductionForChannelQuery.ChannelIdentifier);
        else
            lastProductionQuery = null;

        if (lastProductionQuery != null)
            lastProduction = lastProductionQuery
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.MeasurementDate)
                // TODO: MeasuredData[1] -> ezt a timeseriesManager osztálynak kellene visszaadnia
                .FirstOrDefault()?.MeasuredData[1] ?? 0d;

        return new LastProductionForDeviceQueryResult
        {
            LastProduction = lastProduction
        };
    }
}

using System.Linq;
using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Types;
using FluentNHibernate.Utils;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Views;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;

using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.Transform;
using NHibernate.Type;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// Smappee IoT Adat feldolgozó
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Views.SmappeeIoTDataView, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.SmappeeIoTDataEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SmappeeIoTDataQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<SmappeeIoTDataView, SmappeeIoTDataEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantDictCache _dictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// Entity dto
    /// </summary>
    private readonly DictItemEntityDto? _typeEntityDto;
    /// <summary>
    /// Device ids
    /// </summary>
    private int[]? _deviceIds;
    /// <summary>
    /// Measurement from date
    /// </summary>
    private DateTime? _measurementFromDate;
    /// <summary>
    /// Measurement to date
    /// </summary>
    private DateTime? _measurementToDate;
    /// <summary>
    /// Projection
    /// </summary>
    IProjection? _projection = default;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SmappeeIoTDataQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="dictCache">The dictionary cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public SmappeeIoTDataQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, TenantDictCache dictCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope)
        : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        _dictCache = dictCache;
        _typeEntityDto = _dictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType,
            IoTDataSourceType.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3.GetEntityCode());
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SmappeeIoTDataQuery smappeeIoTDataQuery)
            return DoExecuteSmappeeIoTDataQuery(smappeeIoTDataQuery);
        
        if (query is ConsumptionDataQuery consumptionDataQuery)
            return DoExecuteConsumptionDataQuery(consumptionDataQuery);

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SmappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery)
        {
            this._deviceIds = pagedEntityQuery.DeviceIdentifiers?.Any() == true ? DbContext
                .Session
                .QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(pagedEntityQuery.DeviceIdentifiers))
                .Select(x => x.Id).List<int>().ToArray() : Array.Empty<int>();
            
            return _deviceIds.Any()
                ? (EntityListItemQueryResult<SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto>)DoQueryEntities(pagedEntityQuery)
                : (IEntityQueryItemsResult)new EntityListItemQueryResult<SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };
        }

        // Excel export rekordok lekérdezése
        if (query is SmappeeIoTDataExportEntityQuery exportQuery)
        {
            this._deviceIds = exportQuery.DeviceIdentifiers?.Any() == true ? DbContext
                .Session
                .QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(exportQuery.DeviceIdentifiers))
                .Select(x => x.Id).List<int>().ToArray() : Array.Empty<int>();

            return _deviceIds.Any()
                ? (EntityListItemQueryResult<SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto>)DoQueryEntities(exportQuery)
                : (IEntityQueryItemsResult)new EntityListItemQueryResult<SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };
        }

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Does the execute consumption data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="consumptionDataQuery">The consumption data query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoExecuteConsumptionDataQuery(ConsumptionDataQuery consumptionDataQuery)
    {
        var year = DateTime.UtcNow.Year;
        var month = DateTime.UtcNow.Month;
        var lastDay = DateTime.UtcNow.Day;
        var startDate = new DateTime(year, month, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var endDate = new DateTime(year, month, lastDay, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        var lastDate = startDate.AddMonths(-1);
        var lastStartDate = lastDate;
        var lastMonthLastDayday = DateTime.DaysInMonth(lastStartDate.Year, lastStartDate.Month);
        var lastEndDate = new DateTime(lastStartDate.Year, lastStartDate.Month, lastMonthLastDayday, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        var query = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SmappeeIoTDataView>();
        var queryLastMonth = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SmappeeIoTDataView>();

        if (consumptionDataQuery.DeviceIdentifiers == null || !consumptionDataQuery.DeviceIdentifiers.Any())
            return new ConsumptionDataQueryResult()
            {
                CO2 = 0,
                LastMonthConsumption = 0,
                RelativeConsumption = 0,
                ConsumptionDifference = 0
            };

        if (consumptionDataQuery.DeviceIdentifiers != null && consumptionDataQuery.DeviceIdentifiers.Any())
        {
            var deviceIds = DbContext
            .Session
            .QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(consumptionDataQuery.DeviceIdentifiers))
            .Select(x => x.Id).List<int>().ToArray();

            query = query
                .Where(x => x.IoTDeviceId.IsIn(deviceIds));
            queryLastMonth = queryLastMonth
                .Where(x => x.IoTDeviceId.IsIn(deviceIds));
        }


        ConsumptionDataQueryResult alias = null!;
        ConsumptionDataQueryResult alias2 = null!;


          queryLastMonth
            .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= lastStartDate && x.MeasurementDate <= lastEndDate && x.Active != null)
            .SelectList(list => list
            .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(y => y.Active / 1000 * (1.0 / 12.0))).WithAlias(() => alias2.LastMonthConsumption));


        if (consumptionDataQuery.CO2Multiplier != null)
            query
           .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= startDate && x.MeasurementDate <= endDate && x.Active != null)
           .SelectList(list => list
           .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(y => y.Active / 1000 * (1.0 / 12.0))).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
           .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(y => y.Active / 1000 * (1.0 / 12.0) * consumptionDataQuery.CO2Multiplier.Value)).WithAlias(()=> alias.CO2));
        else
                 query
                .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= startDate && x.MeasurementDate <= endDate && x.Active != null)
                .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(y => y.Active / 1000 * (1.0 / 12.0))).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(y => y.Active / 1000 * (1.0 / 12.0) * 0.35)).WithAlias(() => alias.CO2));


        var consumptionCO2Result = query.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ConsumptionDataQueryResult>()).SingleOrDefault<ConsumptionDataQueryResult>();
        var lastMonthConsumptionResult = queryLastMonth.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ConsumptionDataQueryResult>()).SingleOrDefault<ConsumptionDataQueryResult>();
        consumptionCO2Result.ConsumptionDifference = lastMonthConsumptionResult.LastMonthConsumption == 0 || consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption == 0 ? 0 : (consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption / lastMonthConsumptionResult.LastMonthConsumption) * 100;

        return consumptionCO2Result;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Does the execute smappee io t data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="smappeeIoTDataQuery">The smappee io t data query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoExecuteSmappeeIoTDataQuery(SmappeeIoTDataQuery smappeeIoTDataQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = GetQueryOver();

        var result = new IoTMeasuredDataQueryResult();

        var deviceIds = DbContext
            .Session
            .QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(smappeeIoTDataQuery.DeviceIdentifiers))
            .Select(x => x.Id).List<int>().ToArray();

        if (deviceIds.Any())
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDeviceId.IsIn(deviceIds));
        else
            return result;

        queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceTypeId == _typeEntityDto.Id);

        if (smappeeIoTDataQuery.From.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate > smappeeIoTDataQuery.From.Value);

        if (smappeeIoTDataQuery.To.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= smappeeIoTDataQuery.To.Value);

        DoAggregation(queryOver, smappeeIoTDataQuery);
        
        queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto>()).List<SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto>().Each(x =>
        {
            result.MeasurementDate.Add(x.MeasurementDate);
            result.Current.Add(x.Current ?? 0);
            result.Active.Add(x.Active ?? 0);
            result.Reactive.Add(x.Reactive ?? 0);
            result.Voltages.Add(x.Voltage ?? 0);
            result.LineVoltages.Add(x.Linevoltage ?? 0);
            result.PhaseVoltages.Add(x.Phasevoltage ?? 0);
            result.RelativeConsumption.Add(x.RelativeConsumption ?? 0);
        });

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up row count.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    public override int SetUpRowCount(IQueryOver<SmappeeIoTDataView, SmappeeIoTDataView> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SmappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            var sql = GetGeneratedSql(queryOver);
            sql = sql[sql.IndexOf(" FROM ")..];
            if (_measurementFromDate != null || _measurementToDate != null)
            {
                var sqlBody = sql[..sql.IndexOf(" GROUP ")];
                sqlBody = sqlBody.Replace("and this_.measurement_date > ?", string.Empty);
                sqlBody = sqlBody.Replace("and this_.measurement_date <= ?", string.Empty);
                var sqlGroup = sql[sql.IndexOf(" GROUP ")..];
                if (_measurementFromDate != null)
                    sqlBody += $" and this_.measurement_date > :from";
                if (_measurementToDate != null)
                    sqlBody += $" and this_.measurement_date <= :to";

                sqlGroup = sqlGroup.Replace("::int", "");
                sql = sqlBody + " " + sqlGroup;
            }

            ISQLQuery sqlQuery = smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.Aggregation switch
            {
                AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes or AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes or AggregationLevel.OneDay or AggregationLevel.OneHour => DbContext
                                        .Session
                                        .CreateSQLQuery($"SELECT COUNT(t1.*) FROM ({"SELECT min(this_.smappee_iot_data_view_id) as y0_ " + sql}) AS t1"),
                _ => DbContext
                                        .Session
                                        .CreateSQLQuery($"SELECT COUNT(t1.*) FROM ({"SELECT this_.measurement_date as y0_ " + sql}) AS t1"),
            };
            var index = 0;
            
            if (smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.DeviceIdentifiers != null && this._deviceIds != null)
                foreach (var deviceId in this._deviceIds)
                    sqlQuery.SetParameter(index++, deviceId, NHibernateUtil.Int32);

            sqlQuery.SetParameter(index, _typeEntityDto.Id, NHibernateUtil.Int32);

            if(_measurementToDate != null)
                sqlQuery.SetParameter("to", _measurementToDate.Value, NHibernateUtil.DateTime);
            if (_measurementFromDate != null)
                sqlQuery.SetParameter("from", _measurementFromDate.Value, NHibernateUtil.DateTime);

            var result = sqlQuery.UniqueResult<long>();
            return (int)result;
        }
        return base.SetUpRowCount(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<SmappeeIoTDataView, SmappeeIoTDataView> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto))
        {
            DoAggregation(queryOver, (IAggregation)query);
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SmappeeIoTDataView, SmappeeIoTDataView> queryOver,
        IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        if (query is SmappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.DeviceIdentifiers != null && smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.DeviceIdentifiers.Any() && this._deviceIds != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDeviceId.IsIn(this._deviceIds));

            var typeEntityDto = _dictCache.GetItem(_scope, DictType.IoTDataSourceType,
                IoTDataSourceType.SmappeeSmartMeterAPIv3.GetEntityCode());
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDataSourceTypeId == typeEntityDto.Id);

            if (smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.From.HasValue)
            {
                _measurementFromDate = smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.From.Value;
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate > smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.From.Value);
            }

            if (smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.To.HasValue)
            {
                _measurementToDate = smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.To.Value;
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.To.Value);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the aggregation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="smappeeIoTDataQuery">The smappee io t data query.</param>
    private void DoAggregation(IQueryOver<SmappeeIoTDataView, SmappeeIoTDataView> queryOver, IAggregation smappeeIoTDataQuery)
    {
        SmappeeIoTDataListItemDto alias = null!;
        
        switch (smappeeIoTDataQuery.Aggregation)
        {
            
            case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) + (date_part('minute', measurement_date)::int / 15 * interval '15 min') + interval '15 min' AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) + date_part('minute', measurement_date)::int / 15 * interval '15 min'",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)

                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Current / 3)).WithAlias(() => alias.Current)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Active / 1000 / 3)).WithAlias(() => alias.Active)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Reactive / 1000 / 3)).WithAlias(() => alias.Reactive)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Voltage / 3)).WithAlias(() => alias.Voltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Linevoltage / 3)).WithAlias(() => alias.Linevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Phasevoltage / 3)).WithAlias(() => alias.Phasevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => ((x.Active / 1000) * (1.0 / 4.0) / 3))).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneDay:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('day', measurement_date) AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('day', measurement_date)",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date").WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate))

                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Current / 288)).WithAlias(() => alias.Current)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Active / 1000 / 288)).WithAlias(() => alias.Active)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Reactive / 1000 / 288)).WithAlias(() => alias.Reactive)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Voltage / 288)).WithAlias(() => alias.Voltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Linevoltage / 288)).WithAlias(() => alias.Linevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Phasevoltage / 288)).WithAlias(() => alias.Phasevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => ((x.Active / 1000) * 24 / 288))).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date)",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)

                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Current / 12)).WithAlias(() => alias.Current)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Active / 1000 / 12)).WithAlias(() => alias.Active)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Reactive / 1000 / 12)).WithAlias(() => alias.Reactive)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Voltage / 12)).WithAlias(() => alias.Voltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Linevoltage / 12)).WithAlias(() => alias.Linevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Phasevoltage / 12)).WithAlias(() => alias.Phasevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => ((x.Active / 1000) * 1) / 12)).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
            default:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections.Group<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.MeasurementDate), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Current)).WithAlias(() => alias.Current)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Active / 1000)).WithAlias(() => alias.Active)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Reactive / 1000)).WithAlias(() => alias.Reactive)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Voltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Voltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Linevoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Linevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => x.Phasevoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Phasevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<SmappeeIoTDataView>(x => ((x.Active / 1000) * (1.0 / 12.0)))).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                );
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query sort.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="sortableColumns"></param>
    protected override void SetUpQuerySort(IQueryOver<SmappeeIoTDataView, SmappeeIoTDataView> queryOver, IPagedEntityQuery query, IDictionary<string, IProjection>? sortableColumns = null)
    {
        if (query is SmappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo?.SortColumn == null)
                smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo = new SortingInfo()
                {
                    SortColumn = nameof(SmappeeIoTDataView.MeasurementDate),
                    SortDirection = SortDirection.Descending
                };
            if (smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn == nameof(SmappeeIoTDataView.MeasurementDate))
            {
                var sort = queryOver.OrderBy(_projection);
                switch (smappeeIoTDataPagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection)
                {
                    case SortDirection.Ascending:
                        sort.Asc();
                        break;
                    case SortDirection.Descending:
                        sort.Desc();
                        break;
                }
            } else base.SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query, sortableColumns);
        } else if (query is SmappeeIoTDataExportEntityQuery exportQuery)
        {
            if (exportQuery.SortingInfo?.SortColumn == null)
                exportQuery.SortingInfo = new SortingInfo()
                {
                    SortColumn = nameof(SmappeeIoTDataView.MeasurementDate),
                    SortDirection = SortDirection.Descending
                };
            if (exportQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn == nameof(SmappeeIoTDataView.MeasurementDate))
            {
                var sort = queryOver.OrderBy(_projection);
                switch (exportQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection)
                {
                    case SortDirection.Ascending:
                        sort.Asc();
                        break;
                    case SortDirection.Descending:
                        sort.Desc();
                        break;
                }
            }
            else base.SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query, sortableColumns);
        }

        else
            base.SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query, sortableColumns);
    }

}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Caching;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Managers.OpenWeatherMap;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Models.ForecastData;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Caching;

/// <summary>
/// ForecastDataCache
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Caching.Cache&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Models.ForecastData.ForecastDataCacheKey, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Models.ForecastData.ForecastDataCacheModel&gt;" />
public class ForecastDataCache : Cache<ForecastDataCacheKey, ForecastDataCacheModel>
{
    #region SysConfigs
    /// <summary>
    /// Cache name
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly string FDcacheName = nameof(ForecastDataCache);
    /// <summary>
    /// The default keep period
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultKeepPeriod = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(Config.TryGetIntValue("ForecastDataCache.KeepPeriodMinutes") ?? 30);
    /// <summary>
    /// The coordinates decimal places
    /// </summary>
    public static readonly int CoordinatesDecimalPlaces = Config.TryGetIntValue("ForecastDataCache.CoordinatesDecimalPlaces") ?? 3;
    #endregion

    #region Private variables
    /// <summary>
    /// The open weather map manager
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IOpenWeatherMapManager _openWeatherMapManager;
    #endregion

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ForecastDataCache"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="openWeatherMapManager">The open weather map manager.</param>
    public ForecastDataCache(
        IOpenWeatherMapManager openWeatherMapManager) : base(FDcacheName, DefaultKeepPeriod)
    {
        _openWeatherMapManager = openWeatherMapManager;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ha megtalálható a cache-ben akkor azt adjuk vissza, ha nincsen akkor az api-ba kérdez be, azt lementi és visszaadja az eredményt.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">key</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">TenantCode is not defined</exception>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException"></exception>
    public ForecastDataCacheModel? GetData(
        IComponentContext context,
        ForecastDataCacheKey key)
    {
        if (key == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(key));

        var tenantCode = GetTenantCode(context) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("TenantCode is not defined");
        var result = Get(tenantCode, key);

        if(result == null)
        {
            var modelJson = _openWeatherMapManager.GetCurrentWeatherDataJson(context, key.Lat, key.Lon).RunSync();
            result = new ForecastDataCacheModel 
            {
                Key = key,
                ModelJson = modelJson
            };
            Add(tenantCode, key: key, value: result);
        }

        return result;
    }

    #region Overrides
    /// <summary>
    /// Fills up.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    protected override void FillUp(string? tenantCode = null) {}
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the value key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// TKey
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NullReferenceException">ForecastDataCacheKey</exception>
    protected override ForecastDataCacheKey GetValueKey(string? tenantCode, ForecastDataCacheModel value) => value.Key ?? throw new NullReferenceException(nameof(ForecastDataCacheKey));
    #endregion
}

using System.ComponentModel;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// Az almérők fogyasztási mérésit tartalmazza, feldolgozott formában
/// </summary>
public class NormalizedConsumptionEntity : DomainModelBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Utolsó módosítás dátuma
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Módosítás dátuma")]
    public virtual DateTime LastModified { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// A mérés időpontja, vagy a mérés végdátuma (azaz az összesítését időpontja) UTC-ben
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Mérés időpontja")]
    public virtual DateTime MeasuredAtUtc { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Measured endpoint identifier.
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Mérési végpont azonosítója")]
    public virtual Guid ChannelIdentifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az IoT eszköz által szolgáltatott adat parse-olt értéke.
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Mért érték")]
    public virtual double? Value { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az eszköz által küldött adat minősége
    /// </summary>
    [StringBasedEnum]
    [Description("Adatminőség")]
    public virtual DataQuality DataQuality { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az aggregáció bontása
    /// </summary>
    [StringBasedEnum]
    [Description("Az aggregáció bontása")]
    public virtual AggregationLevel AggregationLevel { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// CO2e (kibocsátási egyenérték) kg/kWh
    /// </summary>
    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "co2e_value")]
    [Description("CO2 egyenérték")]
    public virtual decimal? Co2eValue { get; set; } //CO2e érték (nem minden típusú adatra értelmezhető, ezért nullable)


    public override bool Equals(object obj)
    {
        return obj is NormalizedConsumptionEntity other &&
               ChannelIdentifier.Equals(other.ChannelIdentifier) &&
               MeasuredAtUtc.Equals(other.MeasuredAtUtc);
    }

    public override int GetHashCode()
    {
        return HashCode.Combine(ChannelIdentifier, MeasuredAtUtc);
    }
}

using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;

public class MeasurementPointSettingSyncedDataReceiverEntity : DomainModelBase
{
    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "measurement_point_synced_data_receiver")]
    public virtual MeasurementPointSyncedDataReceiverEntity MeasurementPoint { get; set; }

    public virtual MeasuredPropertyEntity MeasuredProperty { get; set; }

    public virtual ChannelEntity? Channel { get; set; }

    public override bool Equals(object obj)
    {
        if (ReferenceEquals(this, obj)) return true;
        if (obj is not MeasurementPointSettingSyncedDataReceiverEntity other) return false;

        return MeasurementPoint?.Id == other.MeasurementPoint?.Id
                && MeasuredProperty?.Id == other.MeasuredProperty?.Id;
    }

    public override int GetHashCode()
    {
        return HashCode.Combine(MeasurementPoint.Id, MeasuredProperty.Id);
    }
}

using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Npgsql;
using Quartz;
using Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore;
using Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.Common;
using Quartz.Impl.Triggers;
using Quartz.Simpl;
using Quartz.Spi;
using Quartz.Util;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// JobHelper
/// </summary>
public static class JobHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// JobStore
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly IJobStore JobStore;

    /// <summary>
    /// MyJobStore
    /// </summary>
    /// <seealso cref="Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.JobStoreCMT" />
    public class MyJobStore : JobStoreCMT
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MyJobStore"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        public MyJobStore()
        {
            ObjectSerializer = new BinaryObjectSerializer();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the non managed TX connection.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Context not available.</exception>
        [Obsolete]
        protected override ConnectionAndTransactionHolder GetNonManagedTXConnection()
        {
            var ctx = DbContextBase.Current ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Context not available.");
            var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand();
            ctx.Session.Transaction.Enlist(cmd);

            var result = new ConnectionAndTransactionHolder(ctx.Session.Connection, cmd.Transaction);
            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Cleanup the given database connection.  This means restoring
        /// any modified auto commit or transaction isolation connection
        /// attributes, and then closing the underlying connection.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="conn"></param>
        /// <remarks>
        /// This is separate from closeConnection() because the Spring
        /// integration relies on being able to overload closeConnection() and
        /// expects the same connection back that it originally returned
        /// from the datasource.
        /// </remarks>
        /// <seealso cref="M:Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.JobStoreSupport.CloseConnection(Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.ConnectionAndTransactionHolder)" />
        protected override void CleanupConnection(ConnectionAndTransactionHolder conn) { }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the <see cref="JobHelper"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    static JobHelper() => JobStore = InitializeJobStore();

    /// <summary>
    /// Posts the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="jobData">The job data.</param>
    public static void PostJob<T>(IDbContext dbContext, string key, IDictionary<string, object> jobData = null)
        where T : class
    {
        PostJob(typeof(T), dbContext, key, jobData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Posts the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jobType">Type of the job.</param>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="jobData">The job data.</param>
    /// <param name="setupTriggerAction">The setup trigger action.</param>
    public static void PostJob(Type jobType, IDbContext dbContext, string key,
        IDictionary<string, object>? jobData = null, Action<TriggerBuilder>? setupTriggerAction = null)
    {
        var jobKey = new JobKey(key, "EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver");
        var job = JobBuilder.Create(jobType)
            .WithIdentity(jobKey)
            .UsingJobData(jobData == null ? new JobDataMap() : new JobDataMap(jobData))
            .RequestRecovery(false)
            .Build();

        var triggerKey = new TriggerKey(key, "EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver");
        var triggerBuilder = TriggerBuilder.Create()
            .WithIdentity(triggerKey)
            .ForJob(jobKey);

        if (setupTriggerAction != null)
            setupTriggerAction(triggerBuilder);
        else
            triggerBuilder.StartNow();

        var trigger = triggerBuilder.Build();

        if (trigger is SimpleTriggerImpl simpletrigger)
            simpletrigger.SetNextFireTimeUtc(trigger.StartTimeUtc);

        if (trigger is CronTriggerImpl cronTrigger)
        {
            var exp = new CronExpression(cronTrigger.CronExpressionString);
            var nextValidTimeAfter = exp.GetNextValidTimeAfter(DateTime.UtcNow);
            if (nextValidTimeAfter != null)
            {
                var nextFireDate = nextValidTimeAfter.Value.UtcDateTime;
                cronTrigger.SetNextFireTimeUtc(nextFireDate);
            }
        }

        var dictionary = new Dictionary<IJobDetail, IReadOnlyCollection<ITrigger>>
        {
            {job, new HashSet<ITrigger> {trigger}}
        };

        using (new DbContext.DbContextSession(dbContext))
        {
            JobStore.StoreJobsAndTriggers(dictionary, true).RunSync();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the job store.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static IJobStore InitializeJobStore()
    {
        var connectionString = Config.GetStringValue("Db.ConnectionString", true);
        var dbProvider = new DbProvider("Npgsql", connectionString);
        DBConnectionManager.Instance.AddConnectionProvider("Main", dbProvider);

        var schedulerName = Config.GetStringValue("Quartz.Scheduler.InstanceName", true);
        var result = new MyJobStore
        {
            InstanceName = schedulerName,
            TablePrefix = "qrtz_",
            DataSource = "Main",
            Clustered = true,
            PerformSchemaValidation = false,
            DriverDelegateType = "Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.StdAdoDelegate, Quartz" // lsd: QuartzServiceBase.StartScheduler.  itt eredetileg ez volt: Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.SqlServerDelegate, Quartz    
        };
        result.Initialize(new SimpleTypeLoadHelper(), null).RunSync();
        return result;
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Configuration;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Models.ForecastData;

/// <summary>
/// ForecastDataCacheKey
/// </summary>
public class ForecastDataCacheKey
{

    /// <summary>
    /// The coordinates decimal places
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly int CoordinatesDecimalPlaces = Config.TryGetIntValue("ForecastDataCache.CoordinatesDecimalPlaces") ?? 3;
    /// <summary>
    /// Lat
    /// </summary>
    private readonly double _lat;
    /// <summary>
    /// Lon
    /// </summary>
    private readonly double _lon;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the lat.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The lat.
    /// </value>
    public double Lat
    {
        get => _lat;
        init => _lat = RoundCoordinate(value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the lon.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The lon.
    /// </value>
    public double Lon 
    {
        get => _lon;
        init => _lon = RoundCoordinate(value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether the specified object is equal to the current object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="obj">The object to compare with the current object.</param>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <see langword="true" /> if the specified object  is equal to the current object; otherwise, <see langword="false" />.
    /// </returns>
    public override bool Equals(object? obj)
    {
        return obj is ForecastDataCacheKey key &&
               _lat == RoundCoordinate(key.Lat) &&
               _lon == RoundCoordinate(key.Lon);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a hash code for this instance.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>
    /// A hash code for this instance, suitable for use in hashing algorithms and data structures like a hash table. 
    /// </returns>
    public override int GetHashCode()
    {
        return HashCode.Combine(_lat, _lon);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rounds the coordinate.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static double RoundCoordinate(double value)
    {
        var rounded = Math.Round(value, CoordinatesDecimalPlaces);
        return rounded;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.BackEnd.Managers;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Messaging;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Services;

/// <summary>
/// CommandServiceServer
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Services.ICommandService" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Security.ISecurable" />
public class CommandServiceServer : ICommandService, ISecurable
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CommandServiceServer"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public CommandServiceServer(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        IsCheckAccessEnabled = true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is check access enabled.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// <c>true</c> if this instance is check access enabled; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool IsCheckAccessEnabled { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public Task<ICommandResult> ExecuteCommand(ICommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the entity command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual Task<ICommandResult> ExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, string? dbContextKey = default)
    {
        ICommandResult result;
        var svc = ResolveService(command);

        if (svc.TransactionMode != CommandHandlerTransactionMode.No)
        {
            // Main database
            IDbContext dbContext;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbContextKey))
            {
                dbContext = _scope.ResolveKeyed<IDbContext>(dbContextKey);
            }
            else
            {
                dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
            }

            // Messaging
            _scope.TryResolve(out IMessagingContext? messagingContext);

            using var tran = TransactionContext.Create(dbContext, svc.TransactionMode == CommandHandlerTransactionMode.Auto);
            result = svc.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);

            tran.Commit();
            if ((messagingContext?.Enabled ?? false) && messagingContext.IsInTransaction)
                messagingContext.Commit();
        }
        else
        {
            result = svc.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);
        }

        return Task.FromResult(result);
    }

    public void TryDbAction(Action action)
    {
        var dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        using (var tran = TransactionContext.Create(dbContext, true))
        {
            action.Invoke();

            tran.RollBack();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves the service.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual ICommandHandler ResolveService(IEntityCommand command, string? key = null)
    {
        if (IsCheckAccessEnabled)
        {
            SecurityManager.CheckAccess(_scope, command);
        }

        if (key == null)
            return _scope.ResolveNamed<ICommandHandler>(command.EntityTypeName);
        if (_scope.IsRegisteredWithName<ICommandHandler>($"{key}.{command.EntityTypeName}"))
            return _scope.ResolveNamed<ICommandHandler>($"{key}.{command.EntityTypeName}");
        return null;
    }


}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.BackEnd.Managers;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Services;

/// <summary>
/// QueryServiceServer
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Services.IQueryService" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Security.ISecurable" />
public class QueryServiceServer : IQueryService, ISecurable
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is check access enabled.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// <c>true</c> if this instance is check access enabled; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool IsCheckAccessEnabled { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="QueryServiceServer"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public QueryServiceServer(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        IsCheckAccessEnabled = true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<IQueryResult> ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).ExecuteQuery(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<IEntityQuerySingleResult?> QuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).QuerySingleEntity(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<IEntityQueryItemsResult> QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).QueryEntities(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the entity count.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<long> QueryEntityCount(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).QueryEntityCount(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves the service.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual IQueryHandler ResolveService(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (IsCheckAccessEnabled)
        {
            var attrib = SecurityManager.GetAttribute(query);
            var securityContext = attrib == null || !attrib.NoCheck ? _scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>() : null;
            SecurityManager.CheckAccess(securityContext, query);
        }

        var svc = _scope.ResolveNamed<IQueryHandler>(query.EntityTypeName);
        var dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        dbContext.IsReadOnly = true;

        return svc;

    }

}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Services.Normalization;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Resolutions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Models;
namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Services.Normalization;
public class ConsumptionNormalizationService : DataNormalizationService<ConsumptionModel, NormalizedConsumptionEntity, DateTime>
{
    public override IEnumerable<NormalizedConsumptionEntity> Normalize(IEnumerable<ConsumptionModel> data, IResolutionHandler resolution, AggregationMethod method)
    {
        return data.GroupBy(entry => resolution.GetClosestDateTime(entry.MeasuredAtUtc, RoundingDirection.Ceiling))
                   .Select(groupList => new NormalizedConsumptionEntity
                   {
                       LastModified = DateTime.UtcNow,
                       AggregationLevel = resolution.AggregationLevel,
                       MeasuredAtUtc = groupList.Key,
                       Value = _aggregationDictionary[method](groupList),
                       DataQuality = SetDataQuality(groupList)
                   });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 15 perces adatsor alapján a DataQuality meghatározása a normalizált adatra
    /// </summary>
    private DataQuality SetDataQuality(IGrouping<DateTime, ConsumptionModel> list)
    {
        /* speci:
         Az eltárolt normalizált 15 perces adat a következő címkét kaphatja a nyers adatok minősége alapján 
            (a felsorolás egyben azt is jelenti, hogy a nyers alapadatokat hogyan veszi figyelembe a logika):
        - becsült: a normalizált érték számítása során becsléssel pótolni kellett legalább egy hiányzó adatot;
        - hibás: hiányzó nyers adat nem volt, de a normalizált érték számítása során pótolni kellett legalább egy hibás adatot;
        - zavart: hiányzó vagy hibás nyers adat nem volt, de a normalizált érték számítása során legalább egy, a mérő mérési tartományán kívül eső értéket kellett javítani.
        - tény/normál/mért: minden nyers adat rendelkezésre állt, a normalizált érték a mérő mérési tartományán belüli adatok alapján lett meghatározva van;
         */

        // Ha üres a lista, vagy minden adat Missing, akkor Missing
        if (!list.Any() || list.All(x => x.DataQuality == DataQuality.Missing))
            return DataQuality.Missing;

        // Ha van interpolált adat, akkor Interpolated
        if (list.Any(x => x.DataQuality == DataQuality.Interpolated))
            return DataQuality.Interpolated;

        // Ha van hibás adat, akkor Invalid
        if (list.Any(x => x.DataQuality == DataQuality.Invalid))
            return DataQuality.Invalid;

        // Ha van zavart adat, akkor OutOfRange
        if (list.Any(x => x.DataQuality == DataQuality.OutOfRange))
            return DataQuality.OutOfRange;

        // Egyébként Valid
        return DataQuality.Valid;
    }

}

    /// <summary>

    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        // Ha másik modul is használ JsonAttribute-t akkor közösbe kiszervezni

using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Autofac;
using Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Caching;
using static Common.Shared.Constants;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BackgroundWorker;

public static class BackgroundServiceInitializer
{
    public static async Task Initialize(string[] args)
    {

        Log.Logger.UseBootstrapSerilog();

        var host = CreateHost(args);
        AutofacScope.SetGlobal(host.Services.GetAutofacRoot());

        var configuration = AutofacScope.Global.Resolve<IConfiguration>();

        Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
        Log.LogInfo(
            $"EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver Background Service - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(BackgroundServiceInitializer))}");

        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Linux}");
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Windows}");

        Config.LocalProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);
        Config.Provider = new DbConfigProvider(AutofacScope.Global);

        await host.RunAsync();
    }

    public static void ConfigureContainer(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver"));
        builder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common"));
        builder.RegisterMaps();
    }

    public static IHost
        CreateHost(string[] args)
    {
        var hostBuilder = Host.CreateDefaultBuilder(args);

        hostBuilder.ConfigureServices(services => 
        {
            var builder = new ConfigurationBuilder()
             .SetBasePath(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory())
             .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
             .AddJsonFile("appsettings.Development.json", true);

            var configuration = builder.Build();

            var redisSection = configuration.GetSection(RedisSettings.Redis);
            services.Configure<RedisSettings>(redisSection);
            var redisSettings = new RedisSettings();
            redisSection.Bind(redisSettings);

            services.ConfigureCaching(redisSettings);

            //Keyed HTTP clients
            /*
            annak, hogy külön kliens van authentikációra, az a magyarázata, hogy fel lehetne konfigurálni őket különböző resiliency-vel, timeoutokkal, default header-ekkel, stb.
            de akár az is egy valós scenario lehet, hogy az authentikációt egy másik szerver biztosítja, pl. egy külső Identity Provider. ez csak lehetőség a jövőre nézve.
            */
            services.AddHttpClient(ModuleNames.FrameworkWebAPI, client =>
            {
                client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(ModuleHostConfigKeys.FrameworkApiHost));
                //client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("TODO..."));
            });
            services.AddHttpClient(ModuleAuthClientNames.FrameworkAuthClient, client =>
            {
                client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(ModuleHostConfigKeys.FrameworkApiHost));
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("text/plain"));
                //client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("TODO..."));
            });

            services.AddModuleApiClients();
        });

        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)) hostBuilder.UseSystemd();
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)) hostBuilder.UseWindowsService();
        hostBuilder.UseServiceProviderFactory(new AutofacServiceProviderFactory(ConfigureContainer));
        var host = hostBuilder.Build();
        return host;
    }
}

    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.RegisterSecurityContext();

        builder
            .RegisterType<DbContext>()
            .As<IDbContext>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        builder.RegisterType<QueryServiceServer>().As<IQueryService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<CommandServiceServer>().As<ICommandService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        builder.RegisterQuartzBackgroundService("DataReceiverDb.ConnectionString");

        //Jobs
        //OLD: builder.RegisterType<DataProcessorJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<IoTRawDataProcessorJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance(); //ez az új feldolgozó
        
        builder.RegisterType<SmappeeJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SolarEdgeJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<OpenWeatherMapJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<OpenWeatherMapHistoryBulkJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SyncUserJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SyncDeviceJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<IoTDataImportCheckerJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<IoTDataImporterJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<IoTConsumptionInterpolatorJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<DataNormalizationJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();

        builder.RegisterType<ConsumptionNormalizationService>().As<INormalizationService<ConsumptionModel, NormalizedConsumptionEntity>>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<Co2eCalculatorService>().As<ICo2eCalculatorService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        //Ha több Resolution is bevezetünk kell egy factory vagy névvel együtt kell regisztrálni
        builder.RegisterType<FifteenMinResolutionHandler>().As<IResolutionHandler>().SingleInstance();


        //Managers
        builder.RegisterType<EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient>().AsSelf().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SmappeeManager>().As<ISmappeeManager>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<SolarEdgeManager>().As<ISolarEdgeManager>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        //DataProcessorFactory
        builder.RegisterType<DataProcessorFactory>().As<IDataProcessorFactory>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        //all implementations for the data processor interfaces
        var assembly = typeof(DataProcessorFactory).Assembly; //EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic...
        builder.RegisterAssemblyTypes(assembly).AssignableTo<IParser>().As<IParser>()
            .AsSelf()  // 👈 Important: also register concrete type
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterAssemblyTypes(assembly).AssignableTo<IValidator>().As<IValidator>()
            .AsSelf()  // 👈 Important: also register concrete type
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterAssemblyTypes(assembly).AssignableTo<IInterpolator>().As<IInterpolator>()
            .AsSelf()  // 👈 Important: also register concrete type
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterAssemblyTypes(assembly).AssignableTo<INormalizer>().As<INormalizer>()
            .AsSelf()  // 👈 Important: also register concrete type
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterAssemblyTypes(assembly).AssignableTo<IConsumptionDtoConverter>().As<IConsumptionDtoConverter>()
            .AsSelf()  // 👈 Important: also register concrete type
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();


    }
}

using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Models.ForecastData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using Moq;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using System;
using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Enums.CurrentWeatherData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Managers.OpenWeatherMap;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Models.OpenWeatherApi.DailyForecastData;
using Xunit;
using Common.Shared.Helpers;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.UnitTest;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class CacheTest : DataReceiverTestBase
{
    public CacheTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture)
        : base(dataBaseFixture) { }

    [Fact]
    public void ForecastDataCacheTest()
    {
        this.Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var lat = RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(-90, 90) * RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble();
        var lon = RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(-180, 180) * RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble();
        var key = new ForecastDataCacheKey
        {
            Lat = lat,
            Lon = lon
        };
        var expectedModel = new DailyForecastDataModel
        {
            Message = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            Cnt = RandomHelper.GetRandomInt()
        };
        var expectedCacheModel = new ForecastDataCacheModel
        {
            Key = key,
            ModelJson = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(expectedModel)
        };
        var weatherManagerMoq = new Mock<IOpenWeatherMapManager>();
        weatherManagerMoq
            .Setup(x => x.GetCurrentWeatherDataJson(It.IsAny<IComponentContext>(), It.IsAny<double>(), It.IsAny<double>(), It.IsAny<bool>(), It.IsAny<TemperatureMeasurementType>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<bool>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(expectedCacheModel.ModelJson);
        var cache = new ForecastDataCache(weatherManagerMoq.Object);

        //Act #1
        var actualBeforeInCache = cache.GetData(Scope, key);

        //Act #2
        var actualAfterInCache = cache.GetData(Scope, key);

        //Assert #1
        Assert.Equal(expectedCacheModel.Key, actualBeforeInCache?.Key);
        Assert.Equal(expectedCacheModel.ModelJson, actualBeforeInCache?.ModelJson);

        //Assert #2
        Assert.Equal(expectedCacheModel.Key, actualAfterInCache?.Key);
        Assert.Equal(expectedCacheModel.ModelJson, actualAfterInCache?.ModelJson);
    }
}
