using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Helpers;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.UnitTest.BusinessLogic;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class ForeignCurrencyCommandHandlerTest : DataReceiverTestBase
{
    public ForeignCurrencyCommandHandlerTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture) : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {}

    [Fact]
    public async Task SaveForeignCurrenciesCommandTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var expectedCurrencies = GetRandomDatedCurrencies();
        var command = new SaveForeignCurrenciesCommand
        {
            DatedCurrencies = expectedCurrencies
        };

        await CommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);

        var actualCurrencies = QueryService
            .QueryEntities<ForeignCurrencyEntityDto>()
            .Items
            .Where(x => expectedCurrencies.ContainsKey(x.Date))
            .ToDictionary(x => x.Date, x => (float)x.Value);

        Assert.Equal(expectedCurrencies, actualCurrencies);
    }

    private Dictionary<DateTime, float> GetRandomDatedCurrencies()
    {
        var result = new Dictionary<DateTime, float>();

        for (int i = 0; i < RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(1, 50); i++)
        {
            result.Add(GetRandomDateTime(result), RandomHelper.GetRandomFloat());
        }

        return result;
    }

    private DateTime GetRandomDateTime(Dictionary<DateTime, float> result)
    {
        var lastYear = (QueryService.QueryEntities<ForeignCurrencyEntityDto>().Items.OrderByDescending(x => x.Date).FirstOrDefault()?.Date)?.Year;

        DateTime dt = new(lastYear != null ? lastYear.Value + 1 :  DateTime.UtcNow.Year+1, RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(1, 12), RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(1, 28),0,0,0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        return result.ContainsKey(dt) ? GetRandomDateTime(result) : dt;
    }
}

    public async Task CreateIoTDeviceTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var createCommand = new IoTDeviceCreateCommand()
        {
            DeviceName = "Teszt eszköz 01",
            DeviceTypeCode = IoTDeviceType.Smappee.GetEntityCode(),
            SerialNumber = "TS98765"
        };
        var result = await CommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(createCommand) as IoTDeviceCreateCommandResult;

        result
            .Should()

        result.IoTDeviceEntityDto
            .Should()

            .Should()
            .BeEquivalentTo(createCommand.DeviceName);

        result.IoTDeviceEntityDto.DeviceTypeCode
            .Should()
            .NotBeNull();

    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task IoTDeviceQueryTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        // Create devices for testing
        var newDevice = await CommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new IoTDeviceCreateCommand
        {
            DeviceName = "Teszt eszköz IoTDeviceQueryTest Smappee",
            DeviceTypeCode = IoTDeviceType.Smappee.GetEntityCode(),
            SerialNumber = "TS9876543"
        }) as IoTDeviceCreateCommandResult;
        await CommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new IoTDeviceCreateCommand
        {
            DeviceName = "Teszt eszköz IoTDeviceQueryTest OpenWeatherMap",
            DeviceTypeCode = IoTDeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.GetEntityCode(),
            SerialNumber = "TS987654"
        });
        
        // Test QueryAll
        var queryEntities = new IoTDeviceQuery();
        var queryEntitiesResult = (await QueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(queryEntities))?.Items;
        queryEntitiesResult.Should().NotBeNull();
        queryEntitiesResult.Should().HaveCountGreaterThanOrEqualTo(2);

        // Test by DeviceIdentifier
        var deviceIdentifier = newDevice!.IoTDeviceEntityDto!.Identifier;
        var queryByDeviceIdentifier = new IoTDeviceQuery {DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier};
        var queryByDeviceIdentifierResult = (await QueryService.QuerySingleEntity(queryByDeviceIdentifier))?.Entity as IoTDeviceEntityDto;
        queryByDeviceIdentifierResult.Should().NotBeNull();
        queryByDeviceIdentifierResult!.Identifier.Should().Be(deviceIdentifier);

        // Test by DeviceTypeCode
        var deviceTypeCode = IoTDeviceType.Smappee.GetEntityCode();
        var queryEntitiesByDeviceTypeCode = new IoTDeviceQuery {DeviceTypeCode = deviceTypeCode};
        var queryEntitiesByDeviceTypeCodeResult = (await QueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(queryEntitiesByDeviceTypeCode)).Items;
        queryEntitiesByDeviceTypeCodeResult.Should().NotBeNull();
        queryEntitiesByDeviceTypeCodeResult.Should().HaveCountGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1);
    }
}

using System;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.UnitTest.Infrastructure;

public class DataReceiverTestBase : DbTestsBase
{
    public DataReceiverTestBase(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture)
        : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
    }

    protected override void Initialize(Action<ContainerBuilder>? action = null)
    {
        base.Initialize(builder =>
        {
            builder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common")
            || x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver"));
            builder.RegisterMaps();
            builder.RegisterSecurityContext();

        });

        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .SetBasePath(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory)
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.Development.json", true)
            .Build();
        Config.TestProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);
        Config.Provider = new DbConfigProvider(AutofacScope.Test);
        Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
    }

}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;

/// <summary>
/// Ország cache
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Caching.CoreEntityCache&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.ChannelEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ChannelCache : CoreEntityCache<ChannelEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Konstruktor
    /// </summary>
    public ChannelCache() : base(DefaultKeepPeriod)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the by device identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceId">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IList<ChannelEntityDto> GetByDeviceId(IComponentContext context, int deviceId)
    {
        return this
            .GetContent(context)
            .Where(x => x.IoTDevice.Id == deviceId).ToList();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the by identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="channelIdentifier">The measured endpoint identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public ChannelEntityDto? GetByIdentifier(IComponentContext context, Guid channelIdentifier)
    {
        return this
            .GetContent(context)
            .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Identifier == channelIdentifier);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the by identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public ChannelEntityDto? GetById(IComponentContext context, int id)
    {
        return this
            .GetContent(context)
            .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == id);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;

/// <summary>
/// IoTDeviceCache cache
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Caching.CoreEntityCache&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.IoTDeviceEntityDto&gt;" />
public class IoTDeviceCache : CoreEntityCache<IoTDeviceEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Konstruktor
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public IoTDeviceCache(IMapper mapper) : base(DefaultKeepPeriod)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the by identifier.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IoTDeviceEntityDto? GetById(IComponentContext context, int id)
    {
        return this
            .GetContent(context)
            .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == id);
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Commands;

using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// BatchConsumptionDataInsertOrUpdateAfterInterpolationCommand
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Commands.EntityCommandBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.ConsumptionEntityDto&gt;" />
[RequiredSecOperation(typeof(ConsumptionEntityDto), SecurityOperation.Modify)]
public class BatchConsumptionDataInsertOrUpdateAfterInterpolationCommand : EntityCommandBase<ConsumptionEntityDto>
{
    public HashSet<int> ProcessedUnchagedIds { get; set; } = []; //itt csak id-ket tárolok le, mert nincs másra szükség a command futtatásához, csak IsHandled-t fogunk update-elni
    public List<ConsumptionEntityDto> ChangedDtos { get; set; } = []; //value-t, quality-t is update-elni kell, az IsHandled mellett.
    public List<ConsumptionEntityDto> NewDtos { get; set; } = []; //ezeket insertelni kell

    public bool HasAnyDtos => ProcessedUnchagedIds.Count > 0 || ChangedDtos.Count > 0 || NewDtos.Count > 0;
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\DataReceiver\EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared\Commands\IoT\UploadIoTDataCommandBase.cs

using Common.Shared.Commands;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// Adat feltöltés
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Commands.EntityCommandBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.IoTDataEntityDto&gt;" />
public abstract class UploadIoTDataCommandBase : EntityCommandBase<IoTDataEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT eszköz azonosító
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The device identifier.
    /// </value>
    public Guid DeviceIdentifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az adat
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The data.
    /// </value>
    public string Data { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Smappee, OpenWeatherApi, stb.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The io t data source type code.
    /// </value>
    public string IoTDataSourceTypeCode { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// JSON, XML, BINARY64
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The io t data type code.
    /// </value>
    public virtual string IoTDataTypeCode { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// A mérés időpontja
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The measurement date.
    /// </value>
    public DateTime MeasurementDate { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// A mérés időegysége
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The time unit.
    /// </value>
    public AggregationLevel TimeUnit { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ha a mérési időpontja már létezik, akkor nem tölti be az adatot.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance is unique; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool IsUnique { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether [send synchronize message].
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [send synchronize message]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool SendSyncMessage { get; set; }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\DataReceiver\EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared\Entities\IoT\ChannelEntityDto.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.Shared.Entities;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;

/// <summary>
///  Mérési végpont
/// </summary>
public class ChannelEntityDto: LogicalDeleteEntityDtoBase, IGlobalIdentifier
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési pont melyik eszközben található
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [DisplayName("IoT Eszköz")]
    public EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto> IoTDevice { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési pont egyedi publikus azonosítója
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [DisplayName("Mérési pont azonosító")]
    public Guid? Identifier { get; set; }

    [DisplayName("Konfiguráció")]
    public IList<ChannelConfigValueEntityDto> Configuration { get; set; }


    public string? Unit => Configuration?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == "Unit")?.Value ?? null;
    public double? MinValue => string.IsNullOrEmpty(Configuration?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == "MinValue")?.Value) ? null : double.TryParse(Configuration?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == "MinValue")?.Value, out var result) ? result : null;
    public double? MaxValue => string.IsNullOrEmpty(Configuration?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == "MaxValue")?.Value) ? null : double.TryParse(Configuration?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == "MaxValue")?.Value, out var result) ? result : null;
    public TimeUnit TimeUnit =>
        Enum.TryParse<TimeUnit>(Configuration?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == "TimeUnit")?.Value, out var result) 
        ? result 
        : TimeUnit.None; //nem akarok exception-t dobni itt, ha nincs konfigurálva, ezért van default értéke.

    public string? MeasurementDescriptor => Configuration?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == "MeasurementDescriptor")?.Value ?? null;

}

        public double Voltages { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Vonalfeszültség
        /// </summary>
        public double LineVoltages { get; set; }
        /// <summary>
        /// Fázisfeszültség
        /// </summary>
        public double PhaseVoltages { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Áramerősség
        /// </summary>
        public double Current { get; set; }
        /// <summary>
        /// Fogyasztás
        /// </summary>
        public double RelativeConsumption { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Szerződés és betáplált mennyiség alapján számított díj
        /// </summary>
        public double? CalculatedFeeIn { get; set; }
        /// <summary>
        /// Szerződés és fogyasztás alapján számított díj
        /// </summary>
        public double? CalculatedFeeOut { get; set; }
        /// <summary>
        /// Mérési időpontja
        /// </summary>
        public DateTime MeasurementDate { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// A fogyasztási díj tarifája az érvényes szerződés alapján (consumption)
        /// </summary>
        public double? PurchasePrice { get; set; }
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Enums;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// GetIoTDataQuery
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Queries.EntityQuery&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.IoTDataEntityDto&gt;" />
public class GetIoTDataQuery : EntityQuery<IoTDataEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz azonosító
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The device identifier.
    /// </value>
    public int? DeviceId { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adat forrás típus
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The type of the io t data source.
    /// </value>
    public IoTDataSourceType? IoTDataSourceType { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Feldolgozottságra való szűrés: NULL esetben nem szűrűnk,
    /// IGAZ esetben csak a feldolgozottak,
    /// HAMIS esetben csak a nem feldolgozottak.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The is processed.
    /// </value>
    public bool? IsProcessed { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rendezés
    /// </summary>
    public enum Ordering { Earliest, Latest }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rendezés
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The order.
    /// </value>
    public Ordering Order { get; set; } = Ordering.Latest;

    /// <summary>
    /// A kapcsolódó IoT eszköznek vannak-e mérési végpontjai?
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The has measured endpoints.
    /// </value>
    public bool? HasChannels { get; set; }
}

using Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// IoT eszköz query
/// </summary>
public interface IIoTDeviceQuery
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszközazonosító
    /// </summary>
    public Guid? DeviceIdentifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz típus
    /// </summary>
    public string DeviceTypeCode { get; set; }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Rendelkezik-e mérési végpontokkal?
    /// </summary>
    public bool? HasChannels { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// IoT eszköz query
/// </summary>
public class IoTDeviceQuery<T> : EntityQuery<T>, IIoTDeviceQuery
    where T : IoTDeviceEntityDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszközazonosító
    /// </summary>
    public Guid? DeviceIdentifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz típus
    /// </summary>
    public virtual string DeviceTypeCode { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rendelkezik-e mérési végpontokkal?
    /// </summary>
    public bool? HasChannels { get; set; }
}

public class IoTDeviceQuery : IoTDeviceQuery<IoTDeviceEntityDto>
{
}

using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT
{
    /// <summary>
    ///  Mérési adatok
    /// </summary>
    public class IoTMeasuredDataQueryResult : IQueryResult
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Aktív
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> Active { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Reaktív
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> Reactive { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Feszültség
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> Voltages { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Vonalfeszültség
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> LineVoltages { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Fázisfeszültség
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> PhaseVoltages { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Áramerősség
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> Current { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Fogyasztás
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> RelativeConsumption { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Szerződés és betáplált mennyiség alapján számított díj
        /// </summary>
        public List<double?> CalculatedFeeIn { get; set; } = new List<double?>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Szerződés és fogyasztás alapján számított díj
        /// </summary>
        public List<double?> CalculatedFeeOut { get; set; } = new List<double?>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Mérési időpontja
        /// </summary>
        public List<DateTime> MeasurementDate { get; set; } = new List<DateTime>();
 
        /// <summary>
        /// PowerPuchaseAgreement szerződésben rögzített a PurchasePrice.
        /// </summary>
        public List<double?> PurchasePrice { get; set; } = new List<double?>();

        /// <summary>
        /// ... szerződésben rögzített a PowerInPrice.
        /// </summary>
        public List<double?> PowerInPrice { get; set; } = new List<double?>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Időegysége
        /// </summary>
        public List<AggregationLevel?> TimeUnit { get; set; } = new List<AggregationLevel?>();
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT
{
    /// <summary>
    ///  Feldolgozott adatok
    /// </summary>
    public class ProcessIoTDataQueryResult : IQueryResult
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Feldolgozott fogyasztás eszköz identifier
        /// </summary>
        public string DeviceIdentifier { get; set; } = null!;

        /// <summary>
        /// Mérési hely identifier
        /// </summary>
        public string SiteLocationIdentifier { get; set; } = null!;
        
        /// <summary>
        /// Telephely identifier
        /// </summary>
        public string SiteIdentifier { get; set; } = null!;

        /// <summary>
        /// Feldolgozott fogyasztás mérési végpont azonosító (abből többféle lehet, mert egy eszköz több végpontjának eredményei szerepelhetnek a resultban.)
        /// </summary>
        public List<string> ChannelIdentifier { get; set; } = new List<string>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Aktív
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> Active { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Reaktív
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> Reactive { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Feszültség
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> Voltages { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Vonalfeszültség
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> LineVoltages { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Fázisfeszültség
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> PhaseVoltages { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Áramerősség
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> Current { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Fogyasztás
        /// </summary>
        public List<double> RelativeConsumption { get; set; } = new List<double>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Szerződés és betáplált mennyiség alapján számított díj
        /// </summary>
        public List<double?> CalculatedFeeIn { get; set; } = new List<double?>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Szerződés és fogyasztás alapján számított díj
        /// </summary>
        public List<double?> CalculatedFeeOut { get; set; } = new List<double?>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Mérési időpontja
        /// </summary>
        public List<DateTime> MeasurementDate { get; set; } = new List<DateTime>();
 
        /// <summary>
        /// PowerPuchaseAgreement szerződésben rögzített a PurchasePrice.
        /// </summary>
        public List<double?> PurchasePrice { get; set; } = new List<double?>();

        /// <summary>
        /// ... szerződésben rögzített a PowerInPrice.
        /// </summary>
        public List<double?> PowerInPrice { get; set; } = new List<double?>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Időegysége
        /// </summary>
        public List<AggregationLevel?> TimeUnit { get; set; } = new List<AggregationLevel?>();
    }
}

using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Autofac;
using Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.SmappeeApiSimulator.Controllers;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.SmappeeApiSimulator;

/// <summary>
/// Smappee szimulátor
/// </summary>
public class Program
{
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

        // Add services to the container.

        builder.Services.AddControllers();
        // Learn more about configuring Swagger/OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/swashbuckle
        builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
        builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();
        builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();

        builder.Host.UseServiceProviderFactory(new AutofacServiceProviderFactory(ConfigureContainer));

        var app = builder.Build();

        AutofacScope.SetGlobal(app.Services.GetAutofacRoot());
        var configuration = AutofacScope.Global.Resolve<IConfiguration>();
        Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
        Log.LogInfo( $"EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver SmappeeApiSimulator Service - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(SmappeeSimulatorController))}");
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Linux}");
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Windows}");
        Config.LocalProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);

        // Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
        if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
        {
            app.UseSwagger();
            app.UseSwaggerUI();
        }

        app.UseHttpsRedirection();

        app.UseAuthorization();

        app.MapControllers();

        app.Run();
    }

    public static void ConfigureContainer(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common"));
        builder.RegisterMaps();
    }
}

using System.Text;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Enums.Smappee;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Models.Smappee;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.SmappeeApiSimulator.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.SmappeeApiSimulator.Controllers;

/// <summary>
/// Smappee tesztadatokat előállító szimulátor controller-e
/// </summary>
[ApiController]
[Route("[controller]")]
public class SmappeeSimulatorController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMemoryCache _simulatedConsumptionsCache;

    public SmappeeSimulatorController(IMemoryCache simulatedConsumptionsCache)
    {
        _simulatedConsumptionsCache = simulatedConsumptionsCache;

    /// Fogyasztási adatok szimulációja, serviceLocationId, aggregáció típusa, és dátum kezdeti/vég tartomány értékének függvényében.
    /// A szimulátor alapértelmezett működése, hogy tesztfájlból olvassa ki a fogyasztási értékeket, de
    /// megvalósítható igény szerint saját megoldás is. Az előbbi előnye, hogy realisztikus adatokkal dolgozik, mert
    /// valós fogyasztó mérési értékei kerültek a forrásfájlba.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="serviceLocationId">Azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">Aggregáció szintje</param>
    /// <param name="from">A lekérdezés időtartományának kezdeti értéke</param>
    /// <param name="to">A lekérdezés időtartományának végértéke</param>
    /// <returns>ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel típusú visszatérési érték</returns>
    [HttpGet("dev/v3/servicelocation/{serviceLocationId}/consumption")]
    public IActionResult GetElectricityConsumption(
        int serviceLocationId,
        [FromQuery] Aggregation? aggregation,
        [FromQuery] long? from,
        [FromQuery] long? to)
    {
        // Szimulálás módja függjön egy config változótól.
        // Alapértelmezés szerint olvasson fájlból (ez megcserélhető később igény szerint)
        bool readFromFile = Config.TryGetBoolValue("IsReadConsumptionFromFile", true) ?? true;
        int frequencyMinutes = Config.TryGetIntValue("DataReceivingFrequencyMinutes", true) ?? 5;

        // Az adatok kinyerésének logikája a fenti változó értékétől függ:
        ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel? model = readFromFile ?
            ReadConsumptionModelFromFile(serviceLocationId, frequencyMinutes, from, to) :
            SimulatedConsumption(serviceLocationId);

        return Ok(model);
    }

    #region Helper methods

    /// <summary>
    /// Két dáum közötti nap sorszámokat adja vissza. Pl. január 3 és 5 között => [3,4,5]
    /// </summary>
    private static List<int> GetDayNumbersBetweenDates(DateTime fromDate, DateTime toDate)
    {
        List<int> dayNumbers = new();
        DateTime currentDate = fromDate.Date; // get the date component only
        while (currentDate <= toDate)
        {
            dayNumbers.Add(currentDate.Day);
            currentDate = currentDate.AddDays(1).Date;
        }

        return dayNumbers;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ha day értéke 5 => "05", ha 31 => "31"
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dayNumber"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string GetDayNumberString(int dayNumber)
    {
        return dayNumber.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0');
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Visszakapunk egy sorszámot, hogy egy adott óra/perc értékhez hanyadik Consumption bejegyzés
    /// tartozik az adott napi fájlból beolvasás esetén.
    /// Például 5 perces interval estén: 00:00 perc => 0. index, 00:05 => 1-es index .. 23:55 => 287. index (1 napban 288db 5 perces egység van)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dateTime">Forrás dátum amit először kerekítünk.</param>
    /// <param name="rounding">Kerekítés iránya. Alapértelmezett kerekítés, kerekítés fel, kerekítés le.</param>
    /// <param name="measurementIntervalInMinutes">Kerekítés lépésköze</param>
    private static int GetRecordIndex(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeExtensions.RoundingType rounding, out bool nextDay, int measurementIntervalInMinutes = 5)
    {
        nextDay = false;
        var dt = dateTime.RoundToClosestInterval(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(measurementIntervalInMinutes), rounding);
        int index = (int)Math.Floor((dt.Hour * 60 + dt.Minute) / (decimal)measurementIntervalInMinutes);

        int maxIndex = ((int)Math.Floor((24 * 60) / (decimal)measurementIntervalInMinutes) - 1);

        // Ilyen esetben pl 5 perces intervallum esetén 23:59-es dateTime érték esetén inkább a következő nap
        // 00:00-perctől lenne releváns kérni a szimulált adatot.
        if (index > maxIndex)
        {
            index = 0;
            nextDay = true;
        }

        return index;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Hozzáad egy adott serviceId-jú, adott napra vonatkozó mérési adatot a chache-hez, ha nincs benne.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="serviceLocationId"></param>
    /// <param name="dayOfMonth"></param>
    private void AddDayToCache(int serviceLocationId, int dayOfMonth)
    {
        Tuple<int, int> key = new(serviceLocationId, dayOfMonth);
        var cacheEntryOptions = new MemoryCacheEntryOptions().SetAbsoluteExpiration(TimeSpan.FromHours(1));
        ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel? elementInCache = _simulatedConsumptionsCache.Get<ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel>(key);
        if (elementInCache == null)
        {
            var filepath = $"App_Data/simulator_data/{serviceLocationId}/electricityconsumption-data-{GetDayNumberString(dayOfMonth)}.json";
            var json = System.IO.File.ReadAllText(filepath);
            // ide valami try-catch?
            var value = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel>(json);
            if (value != null)
            {
                _simulatedConsumptionsCache.Set(key, value!, cacheEntryOptions);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Lekérjük cache-ből az adott kulcsú napi mérési eredményeket.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="serviceLocationId">ServiceLocation id</param>
    /// <param name="dayOfMonth">A hónap adott napja. 1-31</param>
    private ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel? GetDayFromCache(int serviceLocationId, int dayOfMonth)
    {
        Tuple<int, int> key = new(serviceLocationId, dayOfMonth);
        ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel? value = _simulatedConsumptionsCache.Get<ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel>(key);
        if (value == null)
        {
            AddDayToCache(serviceLocationId, dayOfMonth);
            value = _simulatedConsumptionsCache.Get<ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel>(key);
        }
        return value;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ez a metódus akkor fusson, ha fájlból akarunk kiolvasni szimulált fogyasztási értékeket.
    /// </summary>
    private ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel? ReadConsumptionModelFromFile(int serviceLocationId, int dataReceivingFrequencyMinutes, long? from, long? to)
    {
        ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel result = new ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel
        {
            ServiceLocationId = serviceLocationId,
            Consumptions = Array.Empty<ElectricityConsumptionModel>()
        };

        if (!Directory.Exists($"App_Data/simulator_data/{serviceLocationId}/"))
        {
            var ex = new EnergiaMenedzsmentException(
                $"ServiceLocationId: '{serviceLocationId}' does not exists for simulation purposes.");
            Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, ex.Message);
            return result;
        }

        // A from érték az utolsó bementett iotData measurement date-je. Nekünk a következő 5 perces blokk kell,
        // növeljük meg 1 tick-kel a from értéket!
        from++;
        DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        DateTime fromDate = (from is null) ? now.AddMonths(-1) : DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(from.Value).UtcDateTime; //from.DateTimeFromUnixTimeStampMilliseconds();    // Ha nincs from érték (pl üres/friss a DB-nk), akkor az előző 1 hónaptól kérjük.
        DateTime toDate = (to == null) ? now : DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(to.Value).UtcDateTime;//to.DateTimeFromUnixTimeStampMilliseconds(); // Ha nincs megadott to érték, akkor az aktuális pillanatig vesszük a lekért adatokat.

        long frequencyInMillisec = (dataReceivingFrequencyMinutes * 60000);   // n*1perc, defaultból 5 perces

        // Jövőbeli értéket ne adjuk meg, mert ez még nem létezhet, de a szimulátor be tudná szimulálni.
        if (toDate > now)
            toDate = now;

        if (fromDate > toDate)
            return result;

        int fromIndex = GetRecordIndex(fromDate, DateTimeExtensions.RoundingType.Ceil, out bool fromNextDay, dataReceivingFrequencyMinutes); // Keződátumnál a forrásdátumtól kezdődően elérhető első következő értéket keressük.
        int toIndex = GetRecordIndex(toDate, DateTimeExtensions.RoundingType.Floor, out _, dataReceivingFrequencyMinutes);    // Végdátumnál a forrásdátumig bezárólagos utolsó rekord indexe kell.

        // Az első lekért szimulált rekord esetleg a következő nap első elemére átcsúszott-e? Ha igen, nem kell beolvasni feleslegesen egy napnyi adatot.
        if (fromNextDay)
            fromDate.AddDays(1);

        List<int> daysRequired = GetDayNumbersBetweenDates(fromDate, toDate);

        long firstElementTimeStamp =
            new DateTime(fromDate.Year, fromDate.Month, fromDate.Day, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).UnixTimestampTotalMilliseconds() ?? 0;

        firstElementTimeStamp += (fromIndex * frequencyInMillisec);

        var resultConsumptions = new List<ElectricityConsumptionModel>();
        long idx = 0;

        foreach (var dayOfMonth in daysRequired)
        {
            // Ha ez az első nap, akkor csak a fromIndex-edik elemtől kellenek adatok
            if (idx == 0)
            {
                // Ha egyben ez az utolsó nap is (csak 1 nap adatai kellettek)
                // akkor csak a toIndex-edik elemig bezárólag kellenek a fogyasztási adatok.
                if (idx == daysRequired.Count - 1)
                {
                    // Vizsgáljuk meg, hogy a fromIndex <= toIndex
                    // Ha igen, akkor tiszta sor, ha nem, akkor fromIndex-288
                    // majd 0-toIndex-ig kellenek adatok.
                    resultConsumptions.AddRange(
                        GetDayFromCache(serviceLocationId, dayOfMonth)?.Consumptions?
                            .Where((c, i) => i >= fromIndex && i <= toIndex) ?? Array.Empty<ElectricityConsumptionModel>());
                }
                // Csak az első nap, a jelenlegi, de nem egyben az utolsó
                else
                {
                    resultConsumptions.AddRange(
                        GetDayFromCache(serviceLocationId, dayOfMonth)?.Consumptions?
                            .Where((c, i) => i >= fromIndex) ?? Array.Empty<ElectricityConsumptionModel>());
                }
            }
            else if (idx == daysRequired.Count - 1)
            {
                resultConsumptions.AddRange(
                        GetDayFromCache(serviceLocationId, dayOfMonth)?.Consumptions?
                            .Where((c, i) => i <= toIndex) ?? Array.Empty<ElectricityConsumptionModel>());
            }
            // Köztes nap
            else
            {
                resultConsumptions.AddRange(GetDayFromCache(serviceLocationId, dayOfMonth)?.Consumptions ?? Array.Empty<ElectricityConsumptionModel>());
            }
            idx++;
        }

        // Időbélyegek beállítása. A szimulátorban nincs adatkiesés, minden 5 perces mérési eredményt
        // megkapunk, így mérési eredményenként egységesen 30 000 millisec-kel nő a méreési eredmény timestampje.
        if (resultConsumptions.Count > 0)
        {
            long addition = 0;

            resultConsumptions[0].Timestamp = firstElementTimeStamp;
            for (int i = 1; i < resultConsumptions.Count; i++)
            {
                addition += frequencyInMillisec;
                resultConsumptions[i].Timestamp = firstElementTimeStamp + addition;
            }
        }

        result.Consumptions = resultConsumptions.ToArray() ?? Array.Empty<ElectricityConsumptionModel>();
        return result;
    }

using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.SolarEdgeApiSimulator.Controllers;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.SolarEdgeApiSimulator;
public class Program
{
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

        // Add services to the container.

        builder.Services.AddControllers();
        // Learn more about configuring Swagger/OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/swashbuckle
        builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
        builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();
        builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();

        builder.Host.UseServiceProviderFactory(new AutofacServiceProviderFactory(ConfigureContainer));

        var app = builder.Build();

        AutofacScope.SetGlobal(app.Services.GetAutofacRoot());
        var configuration = AutofacScope.Global.Resolve<IConfiguration>();
        Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
        Log.LogInfo( $"EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver SolarEdgeApiSimulator Service - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(SolarEdgeSimulatorController))}");
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Linux}");
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Windows}");
        Config.LocalProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);

        // Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
        if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
        {
            app.UseSwagger();
            app.UseSwaggerUI();
        }

        app.UseHttpsRedirection();

        app.UseAuthorization();

        app.MapControllers();

        app.Run();
    }

    public static void ConfigureContainer(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common"));
        builder.RegisterMaps();
    }
}

using System.Text;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Shared.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.SolarEdgeApiSimulator.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("[controller]")]
public class SolarEdgeSimulatorController : ControllerBase
{
    public SolarEdgeSimulatorController()
    {
    }

    [HttpGet("dev/version/current")]
    public IActionResult GetApiVersion(
       [FromQuery] string api_key)
    {
        return string.IsNullOrEmpty(api_key) ? Unauthorized($"Missing or invalid API key!") : Ok("{\"version\":\"1.0.0\"}");
    }

    [HttpGet("dev/equipment/{siteId}/{serialNumber}/data")]
    public IActionResult GetInverterTechnicalData(
        int siteId,
        string serialNumber,
        [FromQuery] string api_key,
        [FromQuery] string startTime,
        [FromQuery] string endTime)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(api_key))
            return Unauthorized($"Missing or invalid API key!");

        int[] simulatedServiceLocationIds = new int[] { 79670, 79675, 79689, 79692, 79784, 79801, 79859 };
        if (simulatedServiceLocationIds.Contains(siteId))
        {
            var filepath = $"App_Data/simulator_data/1/meteringconfiguration.json";
            var json = System.IO.File.ReadAllText(filepath);
            return Content(json, "application/json", Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        var result = new InverterDataCoreModel();
        var model = new InverterDataModel();
        var telemetry = new List<InverterTelemetryModel>();
        var tpts = new List<ThreePhaseTelemetry>();
        tpts.Add(new ThreePhaseTelemetry
        {
            Date = DateTime.UtcNow,
            DcVoltage = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            GroundFaultResistance = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            InverterMode = "",
            L1Data = new TelemetryLevel
            {
                AcCurrent = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
                AcVoltage = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
                AcFrequency = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
                ActivePower = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
                ApparentPower = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
                CosPhi = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
                ReactivePower = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            },
            L2Data = new TelemetryLevel
            {
            },
            L3Data = new TelemetryLevel
            {
            },
            OperationMode = 1,
            PowerLimit = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            Temperature = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            TotalActivePower = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            TotalEnergy = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            VL1To2 = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            VL2To3 = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
            VL3To1 = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble(),
        });

        telemetry.Add(new InverterTelemetryModel { ThreePhaseTelemetries = tpts.ToArray() });

        model.Count = 1;
        model.Telemetries = telemetry.ToArray();

        result.Data = model;

        return Ok(result);
    }

    [HttpGet("dev/site/{siteId}/power")]
    public IActionResult GetSitePower(
        int siteId,
        [FromQuery] string api_key,
        [FromQuery] string startTime,
        [FromQuery] string endTime)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(api_key))
            return Unauthorized($"Missing or invalid API key!");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(startTime) || !DateTime.TryParse(startTime, out DateTime from))
            return BadRequest($"A proper startTime parameter is mandatory! (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(endTime) || !DateTime.TryParse(endTime, out DateTime to))
            return BadRequest($"A proper endTime parameter is mandatory! (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)");
        var period = to - from;
        if (period > from.AddMonths(1) - from)
            return Forbid($"Period of request is limited to one month!");

        // Szimulálás módja függjön egy config változótól.
        // Alapértelmezés szerint olvasson fájlból (ez megcserélhető később igény szerint)
        bool readFromFile = Config.TryGetBoolValue("IsReadProductionFromFile", true) ?? true;

        // Az adatok kinyerésének logikája a fenti változó értékétől függ:
        PowerProductionCoreModel? model = readFromFile ?
            ReadPowerProductionModelFromFile(from, to) :
            SimulatedPowerProduction(from, to);

        return Ok(model);
    }

    [HttpGet("dev/site/{siteId}/energy")]
    public IActionResult GetSiteEnergy(
       int siteId,
       [FromQuery] string api_key,
       [FromQuery] string startTime,
       [FromQuery] string endTime)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(api_key))
            return Unauthorized($"Missing or invalid API key!");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(startTime) || !DateTime.TryParse(startTime, out DateTime from))
            return BadRequest($"A proper startTime parameter is mandatory! (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(endTime) || !DateTime.TryParse(endTime, out DateTime to))
            return BadRequest($"A proper endTime parameter is mandatory! (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)");
        var period = to - from;
        if (period > from.AddMonths(1) - from)
            return Forbid($"Period of request is limited to one month!");

        // Szimulálás módja függjön egy config változótól.
        // Alapértelmezés szerint olvasson fájlból (ez megcserélhető később igény szerint)
        bool readFromFile = Config.TryGetBoolValue("IsReadProductionFromFile", true) ?? true;
        int frequencyMinutes = Config.TryGetIntValue("DataReceivingFrequencyMinutes", true) ?? 15;

        // Az adatok kinyerésének logikája a fenti változó értékétől függ:
        EnergyProductionCoreModel? model = readFromFile ?
            ReadEnergyProductionModelFromFile(from, to) :
            SimulatedEnergyProduction(from, to);

        return Ok(model);
    }

    #region Helper methods

    /// <summary>
    /// Lekérjük cache-ből az adott kulcsú napi mérési eredményeket.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="siteId">Site id</param>
    /// <param name="date">A hónap adott napja. 1-31</param>
    private PowerProductionCoreModel? GetDayPowerFromCache(DateTime date)
    {
        if (date >= new DateTime(2023, 04, 01, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc) && date <= new DateTime(2023, 06, 30, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc))
        {
            var dateString = date.ToString("yyyyMMdd");
            var filepath = $"App_Data/simulator_data/1/power/power_{dateString}.json";

            if (!System.IO.File.Exists(filepath)) return null;
            var json = System.IO.File.ReadAllText(filepath);
            // ide valami try-catch?
            if (json == null) return null;
            var value = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<PowerProductionCoreModel>(json);

            return value;
        }
        else
        {
            DateTime dateToLoad = date;
            var year = 2023;
            var month = date.Month;
            var day = date.Day;
            if (month == 1 || month == 4 || month == 7 || month == 10)//31,30,31,31
            {
                dateToLoad = new DateTime(year, 4, day == 31 ? 30 : day, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            }
            else if (month == 2 || month == 5 || month == 8 || month == 11)
            {
                dateToLoad = new DateTime(year, 5, day > 28 ? 28 : day, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            }
            else if (month == 3 || month == 6 || month == 9 || month == 12)
            {
                dateToLoad = new DateTime(year, 6, day == 31 ? 30 : day, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            }
            var dateString = dateToLoad.ToString("yyyyMMdd");

            var filepath = $"App_Data/simulator_data/1/power/power_{dateString}.json";

            if (!System.IO.File.Exists(filepath)) return null;
            var json = System.IO.File.ReadAllText(filepath);

            if (json == null) return null;
            var value = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<PowerProductionCoreModel>(json);

            if (value != null && value.Power?.Length > 0) foreach (var item in value.Power[0].Values)
                {
                    item.Date = new DateTime(date.Year, date.Month, date.Day, item.Date.Hour, item.Date.Minute, item.Date.Second, DateTimeKind.Utc);
                }

            return value;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ez a metódus akkor fusson, ha fájlból akarunk kiolvasni szimulált fogyasztási értékeket.
    /// </summary>
    private PowerProductionCoreModel? ReadPowerProductionModelFromFile(
        DateTime from,
        DateTime to)
    {
        PowerProductionCoreModel result = new()
        {
            Power = Array.Empty<PowerProductionModel>()
        };

        DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        if (to > now)
            to = now;

        if (from > to)
            return result;

        // A termelési adatok 15 percenként jönnek. Ha az utolsó feldolgozott adat 23:45-ös volt,
        // akkor már a következő napi adatokkal akarunk dolgozni (ezért toljuk el a current dátumot
        // a következő napra).
        DateTime current = from.Hour < 23 && from.Minute < 45 ? from : from.AddMinutes(15);

        var models = new List<PowerProductionModel>();
        var values = new List<PowerValueModel>();

        while (current <= to)
        {
            // A napfordulós dátum manipulációt (lásd fenti komment) az alábbi összehasonlításnál
            // is alkalmazni kell, hogy helyes logikai értékeket kapjunk.
            var isFirstDay = from.Hour < 23 && from.Minute < 45 ? current == from : current == from.AddMinutes(15);

            var isLastDay = current == to;

            var day = GetDayPowerFromCache(current);
            current = current.AddDays(1);
            if (day == null) continue;

            if (isFirstDay)
            {
                var valuesOfDay = day.Power[0].Values.ToList();
                valuesOfDay.RemoveAll(x => x.Date <= from);
                valuesOfDay.RemoveAll(x => x.Date > to);

                models.Add(day.Power[0]);
                values.AddRange(valuesOfDay);
            }
            else if (isLastDay)
            {
                var valuesOfDay = day.Power[0].Values.ToList();
                valuesOfDay.RemoveAll(x => x.Date <= from);
                valuesOfDay.RemoveAll(x => x.Date > to);

                values.AddRange(valuesOfDay);
            }
            else
            {
                var valuesOfDay = day.Power[0].Values.ToList();
                valuesOfDay.RemoveAll(x => x.Date <= from);
                valuesOfDay.RemoveAll(x => x.Date > to);

                values.AddRange(valuesOfDay);
            }
        }

        if (values.Count == 0) return null;

        result.Power = models.ToArray();
        result.Power[0].Values = values.ToArray();

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az eredeti backendes random mérési eredmény előállítás
    /// </summary>
    private static PowerProductionCoreModel? SimulatedPowerProduction(
        DateTime from,
        DateTime to)
    {
        var model = new PowerProductionCoreModel
        {
            Power = new PowerProductionModel[]
            {
                new PowerProductionModel
                {
                     TimeUnit = "QUARTER_OF_AN_HOUR"
                     , Unit = "W"
                     , Values = new PowerValueModel[]
                     {
                          new PowerValueModel
                          {
                              Date = new DateTime()
                              , Value = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble()
                          }
                     },
                }
            }
        };

        DateTime current;
        if (from.Minute > 45) current = new DateTime(from.Year, from.Month, from.Day, from.Hour, 45, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        else if (from.Minute > 30) current = new DateTime(from.Year, from.Month, from.Day, from.Hour, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        else if (from.Minute > 15) current = new DateTime(from.Year, from.Month, from.Day, from.Hour, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        else current = new DateTime(from.Year, from.Month, from.Day, from.Hour, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        var valueList = new List<PowerValueModel>();
        do
        {
            valueList.Add(new PowerValueModel
            {
                Date = current
                ,
                Value = RandomHelper.GetRandomDouble()
            });
            current = current.AddMinutes(15);
        } while (current < to);
        model.Power[0].Values = valueList.ToArray();

        return model;
    }

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.TimeSeries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// Termelési adatok manager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers.BaseTimeSeriesManager&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge.SolarEdgeProductionModel&gt;" />
public abstract class BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager<TTModel, TJsonsType> : BaseTimeSeriesManager<TTModel, TJsonsType>
    where TTModel : TimeSeriesBaseModel
    where TJsonsType : class
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The measured endpoint cache
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ChannelCache _channelCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// The device cache
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly IoTDeviceCache _deviceCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// The mapper
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILogger<BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager<TTModel, TJsonsType>> _logger;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the time series schema code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The time series schema code.
    /// </value>
    public override string TimeSeriesSchemaCode => "consumer_producer";

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="channelCache">The measured endpoint cache.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceCache">The device cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    protected BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager(ChannelCache channelCache,
        IoTDeviceCache deviceCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILogger<BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager<TTModel, TJsonsType>> logger)
    {
        _channelCache = channelCache;
        _deviceCache = deviceCache;
        _scope = scope;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the telemetries for device to command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="iotData">The iot data.</param>
    /// <param name="data">The data.</param>
    public override void AddTelemetriesForDeviceToCommand(IoTDataEntityDto iotData, IList<MeasurementDataEntityDto> data)
    {
        var deviceEntityDto = _deviceCache.GetById(_scope, iotData.IoTDevice.Id)!;
        
        if (deviceEntityDto.Channels.Count == 0)
            _logger.LogWarn("IoT device {IoTDeviceId} has zero measured endpoints (there must be at least one to process data)", iotData.IoTDevice.Id);

        foreach (var channel in deviceEntityDto.Channels)
        {            
            var channelRef = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto>() { Id = channel.Id };
            if (deviceEntityDto.Configuration == null)
            {
                _logger.LogDebug("Device configuration missing for {Channel} for {IoTDataId}", channel.Id, iotData.Id);
                continue;
            }

            var channelEntityDto = _channelCache.GetById(_scope, channel.Id);

            var telemetry = GetTimeSeriesDataModel(iotData.Data, deviceEntityDto.Configuration, channelEntityDto!.Configuration);

            if (!CanCreateTelemetry(channelEntityDto)) continue;

            int minutes = ConvertTimeResolution(ParsedModel);

            GetConsumptionForTelemetry(iotData, data, channelRef, channelEntityDto, telemetry);

            CreateMeasurementData(iotData, data, channelRef, channelEntityDto, telemetry, minutes);
        }
    }

    protected virtual void CreateMeasurementData(IoTDataEntityDto iotData, IList<MeasurementDataEntityDto> data, EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> channel, ChannelEntityDto? channelEntityDto, TimeSeriesModel? telemetry, int minutes)
    {
        foreach (var item in telemetry.Data)
        {
            var newMeasurementDataEntityDto = new MeasurementDataEntityDto
            {
                TimeResolutionInMinutes = minutes,
                MeasurementDate = item.Date!.Value,
                MeasuredData = item.Values,
                ChannelIdentifier = channelEntityDto.Identifier.Value,
                Channel = channel,
                IoTDataSource = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<IoTDataEntityDto>>(iotData),
                TimeResolution = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes,
                TimeSeriesSchemmaCode = telemetry.CatalogCode!
            };

            data.Add(newMeasurementDataEntityDto);
        }
    }

    protected virtual void GetConsumptionForTelemetry(IoTDataEntityDto iotData, IList<MeasurementDataEntityDto> data, EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> channel, ChannelEntityDto? measuredEndpointEntityDto, TimeSeriesModel? telemetry)
    {
        //nem teszünk semmit, ha kell felül lehet bírálni
    }

    protected abstract int ConvertTimeResolution(TJsonsType? parsedModel);

    protected virtual bool CanCreateTelemetry(ChannelEntityDto endpoint)
    {
        return true;
    }

}

using System.Text.Json;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.TimeSeries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Models;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using NJsonSchema;
using NJsonSchema.Generation;
using NJsonSchema.Validation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// BaseTimeSeriesManager
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="TJsonsType">The type of the jsons type.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers.ITimeSeriesManager" />
public abstract class BaseTimeSeriesManager<TTModel, TJsonsType> : ITimeSeriesManager//<TTModel>
    where TTModel : TimeSeriesBaseModel
    where TJsonsType : class
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the parsed model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The parsed model.
    /// </value>
    protected TJsonsType? ParsedModel { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The model.
    /// </value>
    protected TimeSeriesModel? Model { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the time series schema code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The time series schema code.
    /// </value>
    public virtual string? TimeSeriesSchemaCode => "";
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this instance can validate schema.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this instance can validate schema; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public virtual bool CanValidateSchema => true;
    /// <summary>
    /// Maps this instance.
    /// </summary>
    protected abstract void Map();

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the telemetries for device to command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="iotData">The iot data.</param>
    /// <param name="data">The data.</param>
    public abstract void AddTelemetriesForDeviceToCommand(IoTDataEntityDto iotData, IList<MeasurementDataEntityDto> data);

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the consumption.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public virtual TimeSeriesBaseModel? GetConsumption()
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the production.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public virtual TimeSeriesBaseModel? GetProduction()
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the other.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public virtual TimeSeriesBaseModel? GetOther()
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Json-ből TimeSeriesDataModel-t nyer ki.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jsonData"></param>
    /// <param name="args"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <throws name="BaseTimeSeriesManagerException"></throws>
    public virtual TimeSeriesModel? GetTimeSeriesDataModel(string jsonData, params object?[] args)
    {
        if (CanValidateSchema)
            ValidateJson(jsonData);

        ParsedModel = GetModel(jsonData);

        Model = new TimeSeriesModel
        {
            CatalogCode = TimeSeriesSchemaCode
        };

        Map();

        return Model;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual Type GetType(object?[] args)
    {
        return typeof(TJsonsType);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Validates the json.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="json">The json.</param>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.BaseTimeSeriesManagerException">
    /// Json validációs hiba. Validációs hibák = '{errors}'
    /// or
    /// Json validációs hiba. Msg = '{ex.Message}'
    /// </exception>
    public static void ValidateJson(string json)
    {
        var settings = new SystemTextJsonSchemaGeneratorSettings
        {
            SerializerOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions
            {
                PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
            }
        };

        var schema = JsonSchema.FromType(typeof(TJsonsType), settings);

        try
        {
            ICollection<ValidationError>? validationErrors = schema.Validate(json);

            if (validationErrors.Any())
            {
                var errors = string.Join(',', validationErrors.Select(x => x.ToString()));
                throw new BaseTimeSeriesManagerException($"Json validációs hiba. Validációs hibák = '{errors}'");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            throw new BaseTimeSeriesManagerException($"Json validációs hiba. Msg = '{ex.Message}'", ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="json">The json.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static TJsonsType? GetModel(string json)
    {
        return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TJsonsType>(json);
    }
}

using Autofac;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// Egyéb fogyasztás idősoros adatok manager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers.BaseTimeSeriesManager&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Devices.OtherConsumerProducerModel&gt;" />
public class OtherConsumptionMeterTimeSeriesManager : BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager<OtherImportModel, OtherConsumerProducerModel>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the time series schema code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The time series schema code.
    /// </value>
    public override string TimeSeriesSchemaCode => "consumer_producer";

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="OtherConsumptionMeterTimeSeriesManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="measuredEndpointCache">The measured endpoint cache.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceCache">The device cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    public OtherConsumptionMeterTimeSeriesManager(
        ChannelCache measuredEndpointCache,
        IoTDeviceCache deviceCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILogger<BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager<OtherImportModel, OtherConsumerProducerModel>> logger) : base(measuredEndpointCache, deviceCache, scope, mapper, logger)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps this instance.
    /// </summary>
    protected override void Map()
    {
        if (Model is null)
            return;

        if (ParsedModel is not OtherConsumerProducerModel cons)
            return;

        var code = TimeSeriesSchemaCode + "_" + cons.EndpointType.GetEntityCode();

        var data = new List<TimeSeriesDataModel>
        {
            CreateTimeSeriesModels(ParsedModel, code)
        };

        Model.Data = data.ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the time series models.
    /// LS20240103: Az egyéb típusú timeseries managereknél meg kell szüntetni a "beégetett" időbontásra alakítást
    /// és helyette azzal a bontással kell őket felvenni amivel az iotdata bejegyzés jön, konverzió nélkül
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <param name="code">The code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static TimeSeriesDataModel CreateTimeSeriesModels(object model, string code)
    {
        var prod = model as OtherConsumerProducerModel;
 
        var power = prod?.Power ?? 0;

        var energy = prod?.Energy > 0 ? prod.Energy : 0;

        if (prod?.Unit == Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.Unit.W)
        {
            power /= 1000;
            energy /= 1000;
        }

        return new TimeSeriesDataModel
        {
            Name = code,
            Date = prod?.MeasurementDate,
            Values = new object?[] { power, energy }
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the other.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override OtherImportModel? GetOther()
    {
        var prod = ParsedModel;
        if (prod == null) return null;
        var result = new OtherImportModel
        {
            EndpointIdentifier = prod.EndpointIdentifier,
            ImportId = prod.ImportId,
            Power = prod.Power,
            Energy = prod.Energy,
            MeasurementDate = prod.MeasurementDate,
        };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Json-ből TimeSeriesDataModel-t nyer ki.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jsonData"></param>
    /// <param name="args"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <throws name="BaseTimeSeriesManagerException"></throws>
    public override TimeSeriesModel? GetTimeSeriesDataModel(string jsonData, params object?[] args)
    {
        if (CanValidateSchema)
            ValidateJson(jsonData);

        ParsedModel = GetModel(jsonData);

        Model = new TimeSeriesModel
        {
            CatalogCode = TimeSeriesSchemaCode
        };

        Map();

        return Model;
    }

    protected override bool CanCreateTelemetry(ChannelEntityDto endpoint)
    {
        return ParsedModel.EndpointIdentifier.ToLower() == endpoint.Configuration.First(x => x.Code == "other_consumption_meter_MeasurementId").Value.ToLower();
    }

    protected override int ConvertTimeResolution(OtherConsumerProducerModel? parsedModel)
    {
        return ParsedModel.TimeUnit switch
        {
            Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => 5,
            Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => 15,
            Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneHour => 60,
            Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneDay => 60 * 24,
            _ => 5,
        };
    }
}

using Common.Shared.Entities;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// Import termelési adatok manager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers.BaseTimeSeriesManager&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge.SolarEdgeProductionImportModel&gt;" />
public class ProductionImportTimeSeriesManager : BaseProductionTimeSeriesManager<ProductionImportModel,SolarEdgeProductionImportModel>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Import
    /// </summary>
    private IoTDataImportEntityDto _import = null;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ProductionImportTimeSeriesManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="measuredEndpointCache">The measured endpoint cache.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceCache">The device cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    public ProductionImportTimeSeriesManager(IQueryService queryService,
        ChannelCache measuredEndpointCache,
        IoTDeviceCache deviceCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILogger<BaseProductionTimeSeriesManager<ProductionImportModel, SolarEdgeProductionImportModel>> logger) : base(measuredEndpointCache, deviceCache, scope, mapper, logger)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps this instance.
    /// </summary>
    protected override void Map()
    {
        if (Model is null)
            return;

        if (ParsedModel is not SolarEdgeProductionImportModel prod)
            return;

        if (prod is null)
            return;

        var data = new List<TimeSeriesDataModel>();
        switch (_import.TimeUnit)
        {
            case Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
                data.AddRange(CreateTimeSeriesModels(ParsedModel, TimeSeriesSchemaCode, 5));
                break;
            case Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
                data.AddRange(CreateTimeSeriesModels(ParsedModel, TimeSeriesSchemaCode, 15));
                break;
            case Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                data.AddRange(CreateTimeSeriesModels(ParsedModel, TimeSeriesSchemaCode, 60));
                break;
            case Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneDay:
                data.AddRange(CreateTimeSeriesModels(ParsedModel, TimeSeriesSchemaCode, 60 * 24));
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }

        Model.Data = data.ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the time series models.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="model">The model.</param>
    /// <param name="code">The code.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregatedMinutes">The aggregated minutes.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEnumerable<TimeSeriesDataModel> CreateTimeSeriesModels(object model, string code, int aggregatedMinutes)
    {
        var cons = model as SolarEdgeProductionImportModel;
        var data = new List<TimeSeriesDataModel>();
        DateTime start = cons.MeasurementDate.AddMinutes(-(aggregatedMinutes - ConvertTimeResolution(null)));
        DateTime current = start;
        var dataCount = aggregatedMinutes / ConvertTimeResolution(null);

        //átlagolt értékek
        var power = cons.Power ?? 0;

        //szummázott értékek
        var energy = cons.Energy > 0 ? cons.Energy / dataCount : 0;

        if (_import.Unit == Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.Unit.W)
        {
            power /=1000;
            energy /= 1000;
        }

        while (current <= cons.MeasurementDate)
        {
            data.Add(new TimeSeriesDataModel
            {
                Name = code,
                Date = current,
                Values = new object?[] { power, energy }
            });
            current = current.AddMinutes(ConvertTimeResolution(null));
        }
        return data;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the production.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ProductionImportModel? GetProduction()
    {
        var prod = ParsedModel;
        if (prod == null) return null;
        var result = new ProductionImportModel
        {
            Power = prod.Power,
            PowerUnit = _import.Unit.GetEntityCode(),
            Energy = prod.Energy,
            EnergyUnit = _import.Unit == Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.Unit.W ? "Wh": "kWh",
            MeasurementDate = prod.MeasurementDate,
        };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Json-ből TimeSeriesDataModel-t nyer ki.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jsonData"></param>
    /// <param name="args"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <throws name="BaseTimeSeriesManagerException"></throws>
    public override TimeSeriesModel? GetTimeSeriesDataModel(string jsonData, params object?[] args)
    {
        if (CanValidateSchema)
            ValidateJson(jsonData);

        ParsedModel = GetModel(jsonData);

        Model = new TimeSeriesModel
        {
            CatalogCode = TimeSeriesSchemaCode
        };

        _import = (IoTDataImportEntityDto)_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new GetIoTDataImportQuery { Id = ParsedModel.ImportId }).RunSync().Entity;

        Map();

        return Model;
    }

    protected override bool CanCreateTelemetry(ChannelEntityDto endpoint)
    {
        return ParsedModel.EndpointIdentifier.ToLower() == endpoint.Configuration.First(x => x.Code == "solaredge_MeasurementId").Value.ToLower();
    }

    protected override int ConvertTimeResolution(SolarEdgeProductionImportModel? parsedModel)
    {
        return _import.TimeUnit switch
        {
            Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => 5,
            Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => 15,
            Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneHour => 60,
            Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneDay => 60 * 24,
            _ => 15,
        };
    }

}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Models.OpenWeatherApi.OneCall;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.TimeSeries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// Termelési adatok manager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers.BaseTimeSeriesManager&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge.SolarEdgeProductionModel&gt;" />
public class ProductionTimeSeriesManager : BaseProductionTimeSeriesManager<ProductionModel, SolarEdgeProductionModel>
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ProductionTimeSeriesManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="measuredEndpointCache">The measured endpoint cache.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceCache">The device cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    public ProductionTimeSeriesManager(ChannelCache measuredEndpointCache,
        IoTDeviceCache deviceCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILogger<BaseProductionTimeSeriesManager<ProductionModel, SolarEdgeProductionModel>> logger) : base(measuredEndpointCache, deviceCache, scope, mapper, logger)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps this instance.
    /// </summary>
    protected override void Map()
    {
        if (Model is null)
            return;

        if (ParsedModel is not SolarEdgeProductionModel prod)
            return;

        var data = prod.Values.Select(x => new TimeSeriesDataModel()
        {
            Name = TimeSeriesSchemaCode,
            Date = x.Date,
            Values = new object?[] { x.Power ?? 0, x.Energy ?? 0 }
        });

        Model.Data = data.ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the production.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ProductionModel? GetProduction()
    {
        var prod = ParsedModel;
        if (prod == null) return null;
        var result = new ProductionModel
        {
            Power = prod.Values.Average(x => x.Power),
            PowerUnit = prod.PowerUnit,
            Energy = prod.Values.Sum(x => x.Energy),
            EnergyUnit = prod.EnergyUnit,
            MeasurementDate = prod.Values.Max(x => x.Date),
        };
        return result;
    }

    protected override int ConvertTimeResolution(SolarEdgeProductionModel? parsedModel)
    {
        return 15;
    }
}
