using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Models.Smappee;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.TimeSeries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// Smappee import manager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers.BaseTimeSeriesManager&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Models.Smappee.ElectricityConsumptionImportModel&gt;" />
public class SmappeeImportTimeSeriesManager : BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager<ConsumptionImportModel,ElectricityConsumptionImportModel>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// The import
    /// </summary>
    private IoTDataImportEntityDto _import = null;
    /// <summary>
    /// The time resolution
    /// </summary>
    private const int TimeResolution = 5;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SmappeeImportTimeSeriesManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="measuredEndpointCache">The measured endpoint cache.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceCache">The device cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    public SmappeeImportTimeSeriesManager(IQueryService queryService,
        ChannelCache measuredEndpointCache,
        IoTDeviceCache deviceCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILogger<BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager<ConsumptionImportModel, ElectricityConsumptionImportModel>> logger) : base(measuredEndpointCache, deviceCache, scope, mapper, logger)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps this instance.
    /// </summary>
    protected override void Map()
    {
        if (Model is null)
            return;

        if (ParsedModel== null)
            return;

        if (ParsedModel.Active is null)
            return;

        var data = new List<TimeSeriesDataModel>();
        switch (_import.TimeUnit)
        {
            case Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
                data.AddRange(CreateTimeSeriesModels(ParsedModel, TimeSeriesSchemaCode, 5));
                break;
            case Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
                data.AddRange(CreateTimeSeriesModels(ParsedModel, TimeSeriesSchemaCode, 15));
                break;
            case Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                data.AddRange(CreateTimeSeriesModels(ParsedModel, TimeSeriesSchemaCode, 60));
                break;
            case Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneDay:
                data.AddRange(CreateTimeSeriesModels(ParsedModel, TimeSeriesSchemaCode, 60 * 24));
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }

        Model.Data = data.ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the time series models.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cons">The cons.</param>
    /// <param name="code">The code.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregatedMinutes">The aggregated minutes.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEnumerable<TimeSeriesDataModel> CreateTimeSeriesModels(ElectricityConsumptionImportModel cons, string code, int aggregatedMinutes)
    {
        var data = new List<TimeSeriesDataModel>();
        DateTime start = cons.MeasurementDate.AddMinutes(-(aggregatedMinutes - TimeResolution));
        DateTime current = start;
        var dataCount = aggregatedMinutes / TimeResolution;

        //átlagolt értékek
        var voltage = cons.Voltage ?? 0;
        var lineVoltage = cons.LineVoltage ?? 0;
        var phaseVoltage = cons.PhaseVoltage ?? 0;

        //szummázott értékek
        var active = cons.Active > 0 ? cons.Active / dataCount : 0;
        var reactive = cons.Reactive > 0 ? cons.Reactive / dataCount : 0;
        var curr = cons.Current > 0 ? cons.Current / dataCount : 0;

        if (_import.Unit == Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.Unit.W)
        {
            active = active > 0 ? active / 1000 : 0;
            reactive = reactive > 0 ? reactive / 1000 : 0;
        }

        while (current <= cons.MeasurementDate)
        {
            data.Add(new TimeSeriesDataModel
            {
                Name = code,
                Date = current,
                Values = new object?[] { active, curr }
            });
            current = current.AddMinutes(TimeResolution);
        }
        return data;
    }

    protected override void CreateMeasurementData(IoTDataEntityDto iotData, IList<MeasurementDataEntityDto> data, EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> measuredEndpoint, ChannelEntityDto? measuredEndpointEntityDto, TimeSeriesModel? telemetry, int minutes)
    {
        var newMeasurementDataEntityDto = new MeasurementDataEntityDto
        {
            TimeResolutionInMinutes = minutes,
            MeasurementDate = iotData.MeasurementDate,
            MeasuredData = telemetry.Data[0].Values,
            ChannelIdentifier = measuredEndpointEntityDto.Identifier.Value,
            Channel = measuredEndpoint,
            IoTDataSource = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<IoTDataEntityDto>>(iotData),
            TimeResolution = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes,
            TimeSeriesSchemmaCode = telemetry.CatalogCode!
        };

        data.Add(newMeasurementDataEntityDto);
    }

    protected override void GetConsumptionForTelemetry(IoTDataEntityDto iotData, IList<MeasurementDataEntityDto> data, EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> measuredEndpoint, ChannelEntityDto? measuredEndpointEntityDto, TimeSeriesModel? telemetry)
    {
        double lastEnergy = data.LastOrDefault(x => x.ChannelIdentifier == measuredEndpointEntityDto!.Identifier)?.MeasuredData[1] ??
                            (_queryService.ExecuteQuery(new LastConsumptionForChannelQuery
                            {
                                ChannelId = measuredEndpoint.Id,
                                ReferenceTimeBefore = iotData.MeasurementDate
                            }).Result as LastConsumptionForDeviceQueryResult)?.LastConsumption ?? 0;
        telemetry!.Data![0].Values[1] = lastEnergy + CalculateEnergy((double)telemetry.Data![0].Values[0]!);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the consumption.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ConsumptionImportModel? GetConsumption()
    {
        var cons = ParsedModel;
        if (cons == null) return null;
        var result = new ConsumptionImportModel
        {
            EndpointIdentifier = cons.EndpointIdentifier,
            ImportId = cons.ImportId,
            Voltage = cons.Voltage,
            LineVoltage = cons.LineVoltage,
            PhaseVoltage = cons.PhaseVoltage,
            Active = cons.Active,
            Reactive = cons.Reactive,
            Current = cons.Current,
            MeasurementDate = cons.MeasurementDate,
        };
        if (result.Active.HasValue)
            result.RelativeConsumption = CalculateEnergy(result.Active.Value);
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Json-ből TimeSeriesDataModel-t nyer ki.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jsonData"></param>
    /// <param name="args"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <throws name="BaseTimeSeriesManagerException"></throws>
    public override TimeSeriesModel? GetTimeSeriesDataModel(string jsonData, params object?[] args)
    {
        if (CanValidateSchema)
            ValidateJson(jsonData);

        ParsedModel = GetModel(jsonData);

        Model = new TimeSeriesModel
        {
            CatalogCode = TimeSeriesSchemaCode
        };

        _import = (IoTDataImportEntityDto)_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new GetIoTDataImportQuery { Id = (ParsedModel).ImportId }).RunSync().Entity;

        Map();

        return Model;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the energy.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="energy">The energy.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static double CalculateEnergy(double energy)
    {
        return energy / (60.0 / TimeResolution);
    }

    protected override bool CanCreateTelemetry(ChannelEntityDto endpoint)
    {
        return ParsedModel.EndpointIdentifier.ToLower() == endpoint.Configuration.First(x => x.Code == "MeasurementId").Value.ToLower();
    }

    protected override int ConvertTimeResolution(ElectricityConsumptionImportModel? parsedModel)
    {
        return 5;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Caches;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Models.Smappee;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.TimeSeries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// Smappee manager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers.BaseTimeSeriesManager&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Models.Smappee.ElectricityConsumptionModel&gt;" />
public class SmappeeTimeSeriesManager : BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager<ConsumptionModel,ElectricityConsumptionModel>
    {
    /// <summary>
    /// Channels
    /// </summary>
    private IList<ChannelModel> _channels = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// The metering configuration cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly MeteringConfigurationCache _meteringConfigurationCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// The time resolution
    /// </summary>
    private const int TimeResolution = 5;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SmappeeTimeSeriesManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="measuredEndpointCache">The measured endpoint cache.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceCache">The device cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="meteringConfigurationCache">The metering configuration cache.</param>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    public SmappeeTimeSeriesManager(IQueryService queryService,
            ChannelCache measuredEndpointCache,
            IoTDeviceCache deviceCache,
            ILifetimeScope scope,
            IMapper mapper,
            MeteringConfigurationCache meteringConfigurationCache, 
            ILogger<BaseConsumptionTimeSeriesManager<ConsumptionModel, ElectricityConsumptionModel>> logger) : base(measuredEndpointCache, deviceCache, scope, mapper, logger)
    {
            _queryService = queryService;
            _meteringConfigurationCache = meteringConfigurationCache;
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps this instance.
    /// </summary>
    protected override void Map()
        {
            if (Model is null)
                return;

            if (ParsedModel is not ElectricityConsumptionModel cons)
                return;

            // TODO: Egyelőre kivettük, mert nincs használva a voltage
            /*double voltage = 0;
            if (cons.Voltages?.Any() ?? false)
                voltage = _channels.Average(_channel => cons.Voltages.Average());*/

            if (cons.Active is null)
                return;
            
            var values = new object?[]
            {
                _channels.Sum(ch => cons.Active[ch.ConsumptionIndex]),

                // _channels.Sum(_channel => cons.Reactive![_channel.ConsumptionIndex]),

                // _channels.Sum(_channel => cons.Current![_channel.ConsumptionIndex]),

                // voltage,

                // Ezt hozzáadjuk, de metóduson kivülről állítjuk
                _channels.Sum(_ => cons.Consumption),
            };


            Model.Data = new TimeSeriesDataModel[] { new()
            {
                Name = _channels.First().Name,
                Date = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(cons.Timestamp).DateTime,
                Values = values
            } };
        }

    protected override void CreateMeasurementData(IoTDataEntityDto iotData, IList<MeasurementDataEntityDto> data, EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> measuredEndpoint, ChannelEntityDto? measuredEndpointEntityDto, TimeSeriesModel? telemetry, int minutes)
    {
        var newMeasurementDataEntityDto = new MeasurementDataEntityDto
        {
            TimeResolutionInMinutes = minutes,
            MeasurementDate = iotData.MeasurementDate,
            MeasuredData = telemetry.Data[0].Values,
            ChannelIdentifier = measuredEndpointEntityDto.Identifier.Value,
            Channel = measuredEndpoint,
            IoTDataSource = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<IoTDataEntityDto>>(iotData),
            TimeResolution = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes,
            TimeSeriesSchemmaCode = telemetry.CatalogCode!
        };

        data.Add(newMeasurementDataEntityDto);
    }

    protected override void GetConsumptionForTelemetry(IoTDataEntityDto iotData, IList<MeasurementDataEntityDto> data, EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> measuredEndpoint, ChannelEntityDto? measuredEndpointEntityDto, TimeSeriesModel? telemetry)
    {
        double lastEnergy = data.LastOrDefault(x => x.ChannelIdentifier == measuredEndpointEntityDto!.Identifier)?.MeasuredData[1] ??
                            (_queryService.ExecuteQuery(new LastConsumptionForChannelQuery
                            {
                                ChannelId = measuredEndpoint.Id,
                            }).Result as LastConsumptionForDeviceQueryResult)?.LastConsumption ?? 0;
        telemetry!.Data![0].Values[1] = lastEnergy + CalculateEnergy((double)telemetry.Data![0].Values[0]!);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the consumption.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ConsumptionModel? GetConsumption()
        {
            var cons = ParsedModel as ElectricityConsumptionModel;
            if (cons == null) return null;
            var result = new ConsumptionModel
            {
                Voltage = cons.Voltages.Average(),
                LineVoltage = cons.LineVoltages?.Average(),
                PhaseVoltage = cons.PhaseVoltages.Average(),
                Active = _channels.Sum(channel => channel.ConsumptionIndex > cons.Active?.Length ? 0 : cons.Active![channel!.ConsumptionIndex]),
                Reactive = _channels.Sum(channel => channel.ConsumptionIndex > cons.Reactive?.Length ? 0 : cons.Reactive![channel.ConsumptionIndex]),
                Current = _channels.Sum(channel => channel.ConsumptionIndex > cons.Current?.Length ? 0 : cons.Current![channel.ConsumptionIndex]),
                MeasurementDate = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(cons.Timestamp).DateTime,
            };
            if (result.Active.HasValue)
                result.RelativeConsumption = CalculateEnergy(result.Active.Value);
            return result;
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Json-ből TimeSeriesDataModel-t nyer ki.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jsonData"></param>
    /// <param name="args"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Required parameters: {0}:[required]channelModel</exception>
    /// <throws name="BaseTimeSeriesManagerException"></throws>
    public override TimeSeriesModel? GetTimeSeriesDataModel(string jsonData, params object?[] args)
        {
            if (args.Length < 2)
                throw new ArgumentException("Required parameters: {0}:[required]channelModel");

            if (args.Length > 1)
            {

                var deviceConfig = (IList<IoTDeviceConfigValueEntityDto>?)args[0];
                if (int.TryParse(
                    deviceConfig?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == IoTConfigProperty.ServiceLocationId)?.Value
                        ?? string.Empty, out var serviceLocationId))
                {
                    var serviceLocationConfig = _meteringConfigurationCache.Get(null, serviceLocationId);
                    var measuredEndpointConfig = (IList<ChannelConfigValueEntityDto>?)args[1];
                    var measuredEndpointConfiguration = serviceLocationConfig
                        ?.Measurements
                        .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id.ToString() == measuredEndpointConfig?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == IoTConfigProperty.MeasurementId)?.Value);
                    if (measuredEndpointConfiguration != null)
                        _channels = measuredEndpointConfiguration.Channels;
                }
            }

            return base.GetTimeSeriesDataModel(jsonData, args);
        }

    /// <summary>
    /// Calculates the energy.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="energy">The energy.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static double CalculateEnergy(double energy)
        {
            return energy / (60.0 / TimeResolution);
        }

    protected override bool CanCreateTelemetry(ChannelEntityDto endpoint)
    {
        return true;
    }

    protected override int ConvertTimeResolution(ElectricityConsumptionModel? parsedModel)
    {
        return 5;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Models.OpenWeatherApi.CurrentWeatherData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Models.OpenWeatherApi.OneCall;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.TimeSeries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// WeatherTimeSeriesManager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.TimeSeries.Managers.BaseTimeSeriesManager&lt;System.Object&gt;" />
public class WeatherTimeSeriesManager : BaseTimeSeriesManager<TimeSeriesBaseModel,object>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Measured endpoint cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ChannelCache _measuredEndpointCache;
    /// <summary>
    ///Device cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IoTDeviceCache _deviceCache;
    /// <summary>
    ///Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// Logger
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILogger<WeatherTimeSeriesManager> _logger;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the time series schema code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The time series schema code.
    /// </value>
    public override string? TimeSeriesSchemaCode => "weather";

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="WeatherTimeSeriesManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="measuredEndpointCache">The measured endpoint cache.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceCache">The device cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="logger">The logger.</param>
    public WeatherTimeSeriesManager(ChannelCache measuredEndpointCache,
        IoTDeviceCache deviceCache, ILifetimeScope scope, IMapper mapper, ILogger<WeatherTimeSeriesManager> logger)
    {
        _measuredEndpointCache = measuredEndpointCache;
        _deviceCache = deviceCache;
        _scope = scope;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this instance can validate schema.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// <c>true</c> if this instance can validate schema; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public override bool CanValidateSchema => false;//mert base-t használok és a séma validáció nem tudja kezelni a poliformizmust

    /// <summary>
    /// The allow one call
    /// </summary>
    private bool _allowOneCall = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="args">The arguments.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override Type GetType(object?[] args)
    {
        _allowOneCall = args.Length == 0 || (args.Length > 0 && args[0] is bool boolValue && boolValue);
        var type = IsOneCall() ? typeof(OneCallCurrentWeatherDataModel) : typeof(CurrentWeatherDataModel);
        return type;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps this instance.
    /// </summary>
    protected override void Map()
    {
        if (Model == null)
            return;

        var dt = 
        (
            IsOneCall() ?
                (ParsedModel as OneCallCurrentWeatherDataModel)?.Current?.Dt :
                (ParsedModel as CurrentWeatherDataModel)?.Dt
        ) ?? 0;

        Model.Data = new TimeSeriesDataModel[] { new()
        {
            Name = TimeSeriesSchemaCode,
            Date = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(dt).DateTime,
            Values = GetTimeSeriesValueModel(ParsedModel)
        } };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds the telemetries for device to command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="iotData">The iot data.</param>
    /// <param name="data">The data.</param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">IoT Device {iotData.IoTDevice.Id} was not found</exception>
    public override void AddTelemetriesForDeviceToCommand(IoTDataEntityDto iotData, IList<MeasurementDataEntityDto> data)
    {
        var deviceEntityDto = _deviceCache.GetById(_scope, iotData.IoTDevice.Id) ??
                                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException(
                                    $"IoT Device {iotData.IoTDevice.Id} was not found");
        
        if (deviceEntityDto.Channels.Count == 0)
            _logger.LogWarn("IoT device {IoTDeviceId} has zero measured endpoints (there must be at least one to process data)", iotData.IoTDevice.Id);

        foreach (var measuredEndpoint in deviceEntityDto.Channels)
        {            
            var measuredEndpointEntityDto = _measuredEndpointCache.GetById(_scope, measuredEndpoint.Id);
            if (measuredEndpointEntityDto?.Identifier == null)
            {
                _logger.LogDebug("Identifier missing for {MeasuredEndpointId} for {IoTDataId}", measuredEndpoint.Id, iotData.Id);
                continue;
            }
            
            var telemetry = GetTimeSeriesDataModel(iotData.Data, new { allowOneCall = false });
            var newMeasurementDataEntityDto = new MeasurementDataEntityDto
            {
                TimeResolutionInMinutes = 5,
                MeasurementDate = iotData.MeasurementDate,
                MeasuredData = telemetry.Data[0].Values,
                ChannelIdentifier = measuredEndpointEntityDto.Identifier.Value,
                Channel = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto>>(measuredEndpointEntityDto),
                IoTDataSource = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<IoTDataEntityDto>>(iotData),
                TimeResolution = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes,
                TimeSeriesSchemmaCode = telemetry.CatalogCode
            };

            data.Add(newMeasurementDataEntityDto);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the time series value model.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="weatherDataModel">The weather data model.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private object?[] GetTimeSeriesValueModel(object? weatherDataModel)
    {
        object?[] values;
        if (IsOneCall())
        {
            var model = weatherDataModel as OneCallCurrentWeatherDataModel;
            values = new object?[]
            {
                //Temperature
                model?.Current?.Temp,

                //WindSpeed
                model?.Current?.WindSpeed,

                //Cloud
                model?.Current?.Clouds,

                //Humidity
                model?.Current?.Humidity,

                //RainWithin1Hour
                null,

                //RainWithin3Hour,
                null
            };
        }
        else
        {
            var model = weatherDataModel as CurrentWeatherDataModel;
            values = new object?[]
            {
                //Temperature
                model?.Main?.Temp,

                //WindSpeed
                model?.Wind?.Speed,

                //Cloud
                model?.Clouds?.All,

                //Humidity
                model?.Main?.Humidity,

                //RainWithin1Hour
                model?.Rain?.OneHour,

                //RainWithin3Hour
                model?.Rain?.ThreeHour
            };
        }

        return values;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether [is one call].
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>
    ///   <c>true</c> if [is one call]; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    private bool IsOneCall()
    {
        var category = Config.GetStringValue("hourly_forcast_category");
        return _allowOneCall && category == "OneCall";
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.WebAPI.ErrorHandler;
using Common.WebAPI.Extensions;
using Common.WebAPI.Filters;
using FluentValidation.AspNetCore;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Controllers;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Infrastructure;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Converters;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Globalization;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Shared.Caching;
using Serilog;
using Log = Common.Logic.Logging.Log;


var allowSpecificOrigins = "_allowSpecificOrigins";



/// <summary>
/// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="$Program"/> class.
/// </summary>
var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Host.UseSerilog((context, configuration) => configuration.ReadFrom.Configuration(context.Configuration));

ConfigureConfiguration(builder.Configuration);

//Autofac configuration
builder.Host.ConfigureContainer<ContainerBuilder>(containerBuilder =>
{
    containerBuilder.RegisterAPISecurityContext();
    containerBuilder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common") || x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver"));
    containerBuilder.RegisterMaps();
});
builder.Host.UseServiceProviderFactory(new AutofacServiceProviderFactory());

// Add services to the container.

builder.Services.AddSingleton<ProblemDetailsFactory, EnergiaMenedzsmentProblemDetailsFactory>();

builder.Services
    .AddControllers()
    .AddNewtonsoftJson(options => options
        .SerializerSettings
        .Converters
        .Add(new StringEnumConverter())
    )
    .AddFluentValidation(fv => ConfigureFluentValidation(fv));
// Learn more about configuring Swagger/OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/swashbuckle
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.Configure<RouteOptions>(options => options.LowercaseUrls = true);
builder.Services.AddCustomizedSwagger(nameof(EnergiaMenedzsment), c =>
{
    c.DocumentFilter<SwaggerDocumentFilter>();
});

builder.Services.AddHealthChecks();

builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies());

var redisSection = builder.Configuration.GetSection(RedisSettings.Redis);
builder.Services.Configure<RedisSettings>(redisSection);
var redisSettings = new RedisSettings();
redisSection.Bind(redisSettings);

builder.Services.ConfigureCaching(redisSettings);

// Adding Authentication  
builder.Services.AddEnergiaMenedzsmentAuthentication();

builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy(name: allowSpecificOrigins,
        corsBuilder =>
        {
            corsBuilder.WithOrigins(builder.Configuration["AccessControlAllowOrigin"].Split(',')).SetIsOriginAllowedToAllowWildcardSubdomains()
                   .AllowAnyHeader()
                   .AllowAnyMethod();
        });
});

builder.Services.AddModuleApiClients();


var app = builder.Build();

app.Lifetime.ApplicationStopping.Register(OnShutdown);
AutofacScope.SetGlobal(app.Services.GetAutofacRoot());
Config.Provider = new DbConfigProvider(AutofacScope.Global);

// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
app.UseCustomizedSwagger(builder.Configuration);

app.MapHealthChecks("/api/healthcheck");

app.UseMiddleware<ExceptionMiddleware>();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseRouting();

app.UseCors(allowSpecificOrigins); 

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();


Log.LogInfo($"EnergiaMenedzsment DataReceiver WebAPI - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(AuthenticateController))} started");
app.Run();


void ConfigureConfiguration(ConfigurationManager configuration)
{
    var cultureInfo = new CultureInfo("hu-HU");

    CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = cultureInfo;
    CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = cultureInfo;

    Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
    Config.LocalProvider ??= new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);

};

void ConfigureFluentValidation(FluentValidationMvcConfiguration fv)
{
    fv.RunDefaultMvcValidationAfterFluentValidationExecutes = false;
    fv.ValidatorOptions.LanguageManager.Culture = new CultureInfo("hu");
    fv.ImplicitlyValidateChildProperties = true;
    fv.ValidatorOptions.DisplayNameResolver = (_, member, _) => member?.GetAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? member?.Name;
}

void OnShutdown()
{
    Log.LogInfo($"EnergiaMenedzsment DataReceiver WebAPI - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(AuthenticateController))} stopped");
}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI;

/// <summary>
/// WeatherForecast
/// </summary>
public class WeatherForecast
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Dátum
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The date.
    /// </value>
    public DateTime Date { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// C hőmérséklet
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The temperature c.
    /// </value>
    public int TemperatureC { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// F hőmérséklet
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The temperature f.
    /// </value>
    public int TemperatureF => 32 + (int)(TemperatureC / 0.5556);

    /// <summary>
    /// Összegzés
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The summary.
    /// </value>
    public string? Summary { get; set; }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cors;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Controllers;

/// <summary>

/// <summary>
/// HupxEnergyPriceDataController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class HupxEnergyPriceDataController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="HupxEnergyPriceDataController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public HupxEnergyPriceDataController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/HupxEnergyPriceData/energyexchangeratebetween
    /// <summary>
    /// Energiadíj lekérdezés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="fromDate">From date.</param>
    /// <param name="toDate">To date.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("energyexchangeratebetween", Name = "EnergyExchangeRateBetween")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "HupxEnergyPriceData_GetEnergyExchangeRateBetween")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EnergyExchangeRateModel[]>> GetEnergyExchangeRateBetween(DateTime? fromDate, DateTime? toDate)
    {
        var response = ((await _queryService.QueryEntities(new HupxEnergyPriceDataEntitesQuery
        {
            FromDate = fromDate,
            ToDate = toDate
        })) as EntityQueryItemsResult<HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityDto>)
        ?.Items;

        var result = response?.Select(_mapper.Map<EnergyExchangeRateModel>)?.ToArray();
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // GET: api/HupxEnergyPriceData/energyexchangerateatexactDate
    /// <summary>
    /// Energiadíj lekérdezés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="exactDate">The exact date.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("energyexchangerateatexactDate", Name = "EnergyExchangeRateAtExactDate")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "HupxEnergyPriceData_GetEnergyExchangeRateAtExactDate")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<double?>> GetEnergyExchangeRateAtExactDate(DateTime exactDate)
    {
        var response = (await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityQuery
        {
            ExactDate = exactDate
        }))?.Entity as HupxEnergyPriceDataEntityDto;

        var result = response?.PriceOfForeignCurrencyInHuf;
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // GET: api/HupxEnergyPriceData
    /// <summary>
    /// HupxEnergyPrice adatok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetHupxEnergyPriceData")]
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "HupxEnergyPriceData_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<HupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQueryResult?>> Get([FromQuery] HupxEnergyPriceDataTableRequest request)
    {
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(new HupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQuery
        {
            PagingInfo = new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = request.PageSize,
                StartPage = request.StartPage
            },
            SortingInfo = new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = request.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = request.SortDirection
            },
            SearchText = request.SearchText ?? string.Empty,
            From = string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.FromDate) ? null : DateTime.Parse(request.FromDate),
            To = string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.ToDate) ? null : DateTime.Parse(request.ToDate)
        }) as HupxEnergyPriceDataPagedEntityQueryResult;

        return Ok(result);
    }
}

[ApiController]

[Route("api/[controller]")]

    /// The forecast data cache
    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>
    /// The time series manager
    /// </summary>
    private readonly WeatherTimeSeriesManager _timeSeriesManager;
    /// <summary>
    /// The security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// Context
    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="WeatherController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="forecastDataCache">The forecast data cache.</param>
    /// <param name="timeSeriesManager">The time series manager.</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public WeatherController(
        ForecastDataCache forecastDataCache,
        WeatherTimeSeriesManager timeSeriesManager, 
        IComponentContext context,
        SecurityContext securityContext)
    {
        _context = context;
        _forecastDataCache = forecastDataCache;
        _timeSeriesManager = timeSeriesManager;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    // GET: api/forecastdata/{lat}x{lon}
    /// <summary>
    /// OpenWeatherMap előrejelzés adatok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="lat">The lat.</param>
    /// <param name="lon">The lon.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("forecastdata/{lat}x{lon}", Name = "ForecastData")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "ForecastData_GetForecastData")]
    public ActionResult<CurrentWeatherDataBaseModel> GetForecastData(double lat, double lon)
    {
        var key = new ForecastDataCacheKey 
        {
            Lat = lat,
            Lon = lon
        };
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode ?? string.Empty;
        var cacheModel = _forecastDataCache.GetData(this._context, key);
        var model = _timeSeriesManager.GetTimeSeriesDataModel(cacheModel?.ModelJson ?? "{}");

        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, model);
    }
}

using System.Net;
using Autofac.Features.AttributeFilters;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.DataReceiverApi.Channels;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Commands.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Controllers.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// ChannelController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class ChannelController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ChannelController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public ChannelController(
        [KeyFilter("DataReceiver")] ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper)
    {
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // POST: api/channel/
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési pont létrehozás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "PostChannel")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Channel_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ChannelModel>> Post(CreateChannelRequest request)
    {
        var response = (ChannelCreateCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ChannelCreateCommand
        {
            DeviceIdentifier = request.DeviceIdentifier,
            Configuration = _mapper.Map<List<ChannelConfigValueEntityDto>>(request.Configuration)
        });

        if (response == null || response.ChannelEntityDto == null)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<ChannelModel>(response?.ChannelEntityDto);
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/channel/{deviceIdentifier}
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési pont törlése (logikai)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="channelIdentifier">The measured endpoint identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{channelIdentifier}", Name = "DeleteChannel")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Channel_Delete")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ChannelModel>> Delete(Guid channelIdentifier)
    {
        var response = (ChannelDeleteCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ChannelDeleteCommand
        {
            ChannelIdentifier = channelIdentifier
        });

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response);

        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, response);
    }
}

using System.Globalization;

public class ConsumptionController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    ///Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Lifetime scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _lifetimeScope;

    /// <summary>
    /// PDF generator
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IPdfGenerator _pdfGenerator;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ConsumptionController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public ConsumptionController(IQueryService queryService, ICommandService commandService, IMapper mapper, ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope, IPdfGenerator pdfGenerator)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _lifetimeScope = lifetimeScope;
        _pdfGenerator = pdfGenerator;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the consumption extreme values for the given channelids measured since the given point in time
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("consumption-extremes")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Consumption_GetConsumptionExtremes")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<MeasurementExtremes>>> GetConsumptionExtremes([FromBody] MeasurementExtremesRequest request)
    {

        using var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope();
        tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(request.TenantCode);
        var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

        var query = _mapper.Map<ConsumptionExtremesQuery>(request);
        var result = (await tenantQueryService.ExecuteQuery(query) as ConsumptionExtremesQueryResult);

        if (result == null)
        {
            return NotFound();
        }

        var mappedResult = result.Items
            .Select(_mapper.Map<MeasurementExtremes>)
            .ToList();

        return Ok(mappedResult);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets all the normalized data ready to be synced until the given timestamp
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("normalized-consumption-data")]
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Consumption_GetNormalizedConsumptionData")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto>>> GetNormalizedConsumptionData(DateTime until)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = (await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new NormalizedConsumptionQuery
            {
                Until = until
            })).Items;

            return result is null
                ? BadRequest()
                : Ok(result);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            throw;
        }

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes Normalized Consumption Data until the given timestamp
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="identifier">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("normalized-consumption-data")]
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Consumption_DeleteNormalizedConsumptionData")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteNormalizedConsumptionData(DateTime until)
    {
        var result = (await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteNormalizedConsumptionCommand
        {
            Until = until
        })) as DeleteNormalizedConsumptionCommandResult;

        return result is null
            ? BadRequest()
            : Ok();
    }

    #region Napi adatok
    // Get: api/consumption/getaggregationlevel
    /// <summary>
    /// A mérési pont alá tartozó almérők lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet(nameof(GetAggregationLevel), Name = nameof(GetAggregationLevel))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]

        if (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query) is not AggregationLevelQueryResult result)
            return NotFound();

        return Ok(result.AggregationLevel);
    }

    // POST: api/consumption/GetAggregatedDataWithinDay
    /// <summary>
    /// Napon belüli aggregált fogyasztás adatok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost(nameof(GetAggregatedDataWithinDayDiagram), Name = nameof(GetAggregatedDataWithinDayDiagram))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = nameof(GetAggregatedDataWithinDayDiagram))]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ChartModel?>> GetAggregatedDataWithinDayDiagram([FromBody] AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest request)
    {
        var mappedRequest = _mapper.Map<AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramQuery>(request);
        var result = (ChartModelQueryResult?)await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(mappedRequest);

        var chartModel = _mapper.Map<ChartModel>(result);

        return chartModel == null ? NotFound() : Ok(chartModel);
    }

    // GET: api/consumption/GetAggregatedDataWithinDayChartTableData
    /// <summary>
    /// Napon belüli aggregált fogyasztás táblázat adatok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost(nameof(GetAggregatedDataWithinDayChartTableData), Name = nameof(GetAggregatedDataWithinDayChartTableData))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = nameof(GetAggregatedDataWithinDayChartTableData))]
    public async Task<ActionResult<StringChartTableModel?>> GetAggregatedDataWithinDayChartTableData([FromBody] AggregatedDataWithinDayDataTableRequest request)
    {
        var techId = request.OrgUnitSelections.FirstOrDefault(x => x.MeasuredDataId.HasValue)?.MeasuredDataId!.Value;
        var qry = new AggregatedDataWithinDayDataQuery
        {
            OrgUnitSelections = request.OrgUnitSelections,
            MeasuredPropertyId = request.MeasuredPropertyId,
            IncludeYesterday = request.IsYesterdayNeeded,
            TechnologyId = techId,
        };

        var resultData = (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(qry) as AggregatedDataWithinDayQueryResult);
        if (resultData is null)
            return NotFound();

        List<AggregatedDataWithinDayResultByMeasurementPointModel>? resultItems = resultData.Items ?? [];

        int recordsTotal = request.IsYesterdayNeeded
            ? resultItems.FirstOrDefault()?.AggregatedMeasurementsYesterday.Count ?? 0
            : resultItems.FirstOrDefault()?.AggregatedMeasurementsToday.Count ?? 0;
        int pageSize = request.PageSize ?? 0;
        foreach (var endpointItem in resultItems)
        {
            endpointItem.AggregatedMeasurementsToday = endpointItem.AggregatedMeasurementsToday
                .Skip(request.PageIndex * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToList();
            endpointItem.AggregatedMeasurementsYesterday = endpointItem.AggregatedMeasurementsYesterday
                .Skip(request.PageIndex * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToList();
        }
        //a sorbarendezés mindig az idő szerint növekvően történik, az nem változtatható - a queryhandler már sorbarendezve adja vissza, nem kell újra rendezni.

        StringChartTableModel tblModel = ConvertAggregatedDataToStringChartTableModel(resultItems, request.IsYesterdayNeeded);
        tblModel.RecordsTotal = recordsTotal;

        return Ok(tblModel);
    }

    #region Task #517 - Napon belüli adatok XLS export
    // POST: api/consumption/AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExport
    /// <summary>
    /// Napon belüli aggregált fogyasztás táblázat adatok excel exportálása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost(nameof(AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExport), Name = nameof(AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExport))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = nameof(AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExport))]
    public async Task<ActionResult<StringChartTableModel?>> AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExport([FromBody] AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest request)
    {
        var techId = request.OrgUnitSelections.FirstOrDefault(x => x.MeasuredDataId.HasValue)?.MeasuredDataId!.Value;
        var query = new AggregatedDataWithinDayDataQuery
        {
            OrgUnitSelections = request.OrgUnitSelections,
            MeasuredPropertyId = request.MeasuredPropertyId,
            IncludeYesterday = request.IsYesterdayNeeded,
            TechnologyId = techId,
        };

        var resultData = (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query) as AggregatedDataWithinDayQueryResult);
        if (resultData is null)
            return NotFound();


        //ha meg vannak az adatok, akkor még transzformálnunk kell.
        List<AggregatedDataWithinDayResultByMeasurementPointModel>? resultItems = resultData.Items ?? [];

        //1: fejléc lista
        List<MeasurementPointExcelHeaderData> headerMeasurementPoints = resultItems
            .Select(item =>
            {
                var mp = item.MeasurementPoint;
                return new MeasurementPointExcelHeaderData(
                    Identifier: mp.Identifier.ToString("D"),
                    Name: mp.Name,
                    MeasuredPropertyName: mp.MeasuredPropertyName,
                    SiteName: mp.SiteName,
                    BuildingName: mp.BuildingName,
                    BuildingPartName: mp.BuildingPartName,
                    FloorName: mp.FloorName,
                    RoomName: mp.RoomName
                );
            })
            .ToList();

        //2: fő fejléc
        var reportHeader = new AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader
        {
            InstitutionName = resultData.InstitutionName,
            AggregationLevelStr = resultData.AggregationLevel.GetDisplayName() ?? "",
            FromDateStr = DateTime.Today.ToShortDateString(),
            ToDateStr = resultData.TodaysLastTime.ToShortDateString(),
            MeasurementUnit = resultData.Unit,
            MeasurementPoints = headerMeasurementPoints,
        };

        //3: adat táblázat
        StringChartTableModel tblModel = ConvertAggregatedDataToStringChartTableModel(resultItems, request.IsYesterdayNeeded);

        //és most már mehet az export
        byte[] excelBytes = await ExcelExporthelpers.CreateExcelExportFileFromStringChartTableAsync(tblModel.Items, reportHeader);

#if DEBUG
        /*if (SytemDebugger.IsAttached)
        {
            string tmpFilePath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"tmp_{Guid.NewGuid():D}.xlsx");
            SytemIoFile.WriteAllBytes(tmpFilePath, excelBytes);
        }*/
#endif

        return File(excelBytes,
                    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
                    "AggregatedDataWithinDay.xlsx");
    }


    //struktúrált adatok visszaalakítása a StringChartTableModel-ba
    private static StringChartTableModel ConvertAggregatedDataToStringChartTableModel(List<AggregatedDataWithinDayResultByMeasurementPointModel> resultData, bool includeYesterdayColumn)
    {
        var tblModel = new StringChartTableModel { Items = [] };

        // Gather all unique time slots from both today and yesterday
        List<TimeOnly> allTimes = [];
        if (includeYesterdayColumn) //ha a tegnapi adatokat is kérik, akkor a tegnapi teljes idősor kell (0:00-24:00), különben csak annyi, amennyi a mai napból eltelt
        {
            allTimes = resultData
                .SelectMany(mp => mp.AggregatedMeasurementsYesterday.Select(i => i.Time))
                .Distinct()
                .OrderBy(t => t)
                .Select(TimeOnly.FromDateTime)
                .ToList();
        }
        else
        {
            allTimes = resultData
                .SelectMany(mp => mp.AggregatedMeasurementsToday.Select(i => i.Time))
                .Distinct()
                .OrderBy(t => t)
                .Select(TimeOnly.FromDateTime)
                .ToList();
        }

        foreach (var t in allTimes)
        {
            var values = new List<StringChartTableItemValueModel>();

            foreach (var mp in resultData)
            {
                // Today's value for this time slot
                var measurementToday = mp.AggregatedMeasurementsToday.FirstOrDefault(i => TimeOnly.FromDateTime(i.Time) == t);
                decimal? todayValue = measurementToday?.Value;
                string todayQuality = measurementToday is null ? "" : measurementToday.DataQuality.GetDisplayName() ?? "";
                values.Add(new StringChartTableItemValueModel
                {
                    Id = default,
                    ColumnName = mp.MeasurementPoint.Name,
                    Value = todayValue.HasValue ? decimal.Round(todayValue.Value, 3).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "nincs adat"
                });
                values.Add(new StringChartTableItemValueModel
                {
                    Id = default,
                    ColumnName = $"Adatminőség ({mp.MeasurementPoint.Name})",
                    Value = todayQuality
                });

                // Yesterday's value for this time slot (if needed)
                if (includeYesterdayColumn)
                {
                    var measurementYesterday = mp.AggregatedMeasurementsYesterday?.FirstOrDefault(i => TimeOnly.FromDateTime(i.Time) == t);
                    decimal? yesterdayValue = measurementYesterday?.Value;
                    string yesterdayQuality = measurementYesterday is null ? "" : measurementYesterday.DataQuality.GetDisplayName() ?? "";
                    values.Add(new StringChartTableItemValueModel
                    {
                        Id = default,
                        ColumnName = mp.MeasurementPoint.Name + " - előző nap",
                        Value = yesterdayValue.HasValue ? decimal.Round(yesterdayValue.Value, 3).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : "nincs adat"
                    });
                    values.Add(new StringChartTableItemValueModel
                    {
                        Id = default,
                        ColumnName = $"Adatminőség - előző nap ({mp.MeasurementPoint.Name})",
                        Value = yesterdayQuality
                    });
                }
            }


            tblModel.Items.Add(new StringChartTableItemModel
            {
                DateTime = DateTime.Today.Add(t.ToTimeSpan()), //visszaalakítjuk DT-ra, mert a fejlécbe az kell (bár kiírás szeint meg csak az idő kéne ennél a riportnál...)
                Values = values
            });
        }

        tblModel.RecordsTotal = tblModel.Items.Count;
        return tblModel;
    }

    #region Task #518 - Napon belüli adatok PDF export
    // POST: api/consumption/AggregatedDataWithinDayPdfExport
    /// <summary>
    /// Napon belüli aggregált fogyasztás táblázat adatok excel exportálása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost(nameof(AggregatedDataWithinDayPdfExport), Name = nameof(AggregatedDataWithinDayPdfExport))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = nameof(AggregatedDataWithinDayPdfExport))]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AggregatedDataWithinDayPdfExport([FromForm] AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest request, IFormFile imageForPdf)
    {
        var techId = request.OrgUnitSelections.FirstOrDefault(x => x.MeasuredDataId.HasValue)?.MeasuredDataId!.Value;
        var query = new AggregatedDataWithinDayDataQuery
        {
            OrgUnitSelections = request.OrgUnitSelections,
            MeasuredPropertyId = request.MeasuredPropertyId,
            IncludeYesterday = request.IsYesterdayNeeded,
            TechnologyId = techId,
        };

        var resultData = (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query) as AggregatedDataWithinDayQueryResult);
        if (resultData is null)
            return NotFound();


        //ha meg vannak az adatok, akkor még transzformálnunk kell.
        List<AggregatedDataWithinDayResultByMeasurementPointModel>? resultItems = resultData.Items ?? [];

        //1: fejléc lista
        List<MeasurementPointExcelHeaderData> headerMeasurementPoints = resultItems
            .Select(item =>
            {
                var mp = item.MeasurementPoint;
                return new MeasurementPointExcelHeaderData(
                    Identifier: mp.Identifier.ToString("D"),
                    Name: mp.Name,
                    MeasuredPropertyName: mp.MeasuredPropertyName,
                    SiteName: mp.SiteName,
                    BuildingName: mp.BuildingName,
                    BuildingPartName: mp.BuildingPartName,
                    FloorName: mp.FloorName,
                    RoomName: mp.RoomName
                );
            })
            .ToList();

        //2: fő fejléc
        var reportHeader = new AggregatedDataWithinDayExcelExportHeader
        {
            InstitutionName = resultData.InstitutionName,
            AggregationLevelStr = resultData.AggregationLevel.GetDisplayName() ?? "",
            FromDateStr = DateTime.Today.ToShortDateString(),
            ToDateStr = resultData.TodaysLastTime.ToShortDateString(),
            MeasurementUnit = resultData.Unit,
            MeasurementPoints = headerMeasurementPoints,
        };

        //3: adat táblázat
        StringChartTableModel tblModel = ConvertAggregatedDataToStringChartTableModel(resultItems, request.IsYesterdayNeeded);

        var exportData = ExcelExporthelpers.ConvertStringChartTableToMeasurementTableRowsWithDynamic(tblModel.Items).ToArray();
        var pdfData = await ExcelManager.GetPDFData(exportData);

        var columnNames = tblModel.Items.FirstOrDefault()?.Values
            ?.Select(value => value.ColumnName)
            ?.Distinct()
            ?.ToArray() ?? Array.Empty<string>();

        //Set table header row
        if (pdfData != null && pdfData.Any())
        {
            var header = new List<string> { "Mérés időpontja" }.Concat(columnNames).ToList();
            _pdfGenerator.SetHeader(header);
            pdfData.Remove(pdfData.First());
        }

        //Set table data rows
        foreach (var row in pdfData!)
            _pdfGenerator.AddRow(row);

        var measuredProperty = resultItems.FirstOrDefault()?.MeasurementPoint?.MeasuredPropertyName ?? "N/A";

        //Set PDF header (blue rounded box on top of page)
        var flexiHeader = new Common.PDFGenerator.Models.PdfWithinDayHeaderModel
        {
            InstitutionName = reportHeader.InstitutionName,
            //TODO: dátum formátumot configból
            From = DateTime.Today.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), //mai nap eleje
            To = resultData.TodaysLastTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), //mai nap utolsó adatának ideje, nem a nap vége
            Aggregation = reportHeader.AggregationLevelStr,
            MeasurementUnit = reportHeader.MeasurementUnit
        };

        //_pdfGenerator.SetFlexiblePdfHeader(flexiHeader);
        var flexiHeaderData = PdfFlexibleHeaderHelper.GenerateFlexibleHeader(flexiHeader);
        var layoutParams = new LayoutParameters
        {
            OutsideDivAttributes = ["fxLayout=\"row\"", "fxFlexFill", "fxLayout.lt-sm=\"column\"", "fxLayoutGap=\"16px\""],
            RowDivAttributes = ["class=\"row\""],
            ColDivAttributes = ["class=\"col-6\""],

            LabelTag = "mat-label",
            LabelAttributes = ["class=\"control-label\""],
            ValueTag = "span",
            ValueAttributes = [],

            ColSizeDefault = 6, // Default column size for each item if not specified, and only a single column is in the row
            MaxColsInRow = 12,
        };
        string s = PdfFlexibleHeaderHelper.RenderFlexibleHeader(flexiHeaderData, layoutParams);
        _pdfGenerator.SetFlexiblePdfHeaderHtmlStr(s);

        _pdfGenerator.SetMultiRowHeaderTable(MeasurementPointExcelHeaderDataToStringList(headerMeasurementPoints), caption: "Kiválasztott mérési pontok");

        //Set chart image if provided
        if (imageForPdf != null && imageForPdf.Length > 0)
            using (var ms = new MemoryStream())
            {
                imageForPdf.CopyTo(ms);
                var fileBytes = ms.ToArray();
                var base64 = Convert.ToBase64String(fileBytes);
                _pdfGenerator.SetChartImage("data:image/png;base64," + base64);
            }

        var pdfContent = await _pdfGenerator.GenerateAsync();

        if (pdfContent is null)
            return BadRequest("PDF content generation failed."); // Indicate an error instead of NoContent

#if DEBUG
        //if (SytemDebugger.IsAttached)
        //{
        //    string tmpFilePath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"wtnday_tmp_{Guid.NewGuid():D}.PDF");
        //    using var fs = SytemIoFile.Create(tmpFilePath);
        //    await pdfContent.CopyToAsync(fs);
        //    await fs.FlushAsync();
        //}
#endif

        return File(pdfContent, "application/pdf", "converted.pdf");

    }

    //convert the header data to a flattened string list of list
    private static List<List<string>> MeasurementPointExcelHeaderDataToStringList(List<MeasurementPointExcelHeaderData> headerMeasurementPoints)
    {
        // Add the first row with the main headers
        var fod = headerMeasurementPoints.FirstOrDefault() ?? new MeasurementPointExcelHeaderData("", "", "", default, default, default, default, default); //empty record if nothing in the list
        List<List<string>> multiRowHeader =
        [
            [
                fod.GetDisplayNameOfProperty(x=>x.Identifier),
                fod.GetDisplayNameOfProperty(x=>x.Name),
                fod.GetDisplayNameOfProperty(x=>x.MeasuredPropertyName),
                fod.GetDisplayNameOfProperty(x=>x.SiteName),
                fod.GetDisplayNameOfProperty(x=>x.BuildingName),
                fod.GetDisplayNameOfProperty(x=>x.BuildingPartName),
                fod.GetDisplayNameOfProperty(x=>x.FloorName),
                fod.GetDisplayNameOfProperty(x=>x.RoomName)
            ]
        ];

        // Add each measurement point's data as a new row
        List<List<string>> dataRows = [.. headerMeasurementPoints.Select(
            mp => new List<string>
            {
                mp.Identifier,
                mp.Name,
                mp.MeasuredPropertyName,
                mp.SiteName ?? "-",
                mp.BuildingName ?? "-",
                mp.BuildingPartName ?? "-",
                mp.FloorName ?? "-",
                mp.RoomName ?? "-"
            }
        )];
        multiRowHeader.AddRange(dataRows);
        return multiRowHeader;
    }

    #endregion //end of PDF export



    #endregion
}

        /// </summary>

        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpPost("uploadJSONData", Name = "UploadJsonData")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
        [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTData_Post")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDataModel>> Post(UploadIoTJSONDataRequest request)
        {
            var response = (UploadIoTDataCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand
            {
                DeviceIdentifier = request.DeviceIdentifier,
                Data = request.Data,
                IoTDataSourceTypeCode = request.IoTDataSourceTypeCode,
                MeasurementDate = request.MeasurementDate,
                TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes//mindegy, nem használt kontroller metódus
            });

            if (response == null || response.IoTDataEntityDto == null)
                return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response);

            var result = _mapper.Map<IoTDataModel>(response?.IoTDataEntityDto);
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
        }

        // POST: api/IoTData/batchuploadJSONData
        /// <summary>
        /// Adatok feltöltése
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpPost("batchuploadJSONData", Name = "BatchUploadJsonData")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
        [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTData_PostBatch")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDataModel[]>> PostBatch(UploadIoTJSONDataRequest[] request)
        {
            var response = (BatchUploadIoTDataCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new BatchUploadIoTJSONDataCommand
            {
                Commands = request.Select(uploadIoTjsonDataRequest => new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand
                {
                    DeviceIdentifier = uploadIoTjsonDataRequest.DeviceIdentifier,
                    Data = uploadIoTjsonDataRequest.Data,
                    IoTDataSourceTypeCode = uploadIoTjsonDataRequest.IoTDataSourceTypeCode,
                    MeasurementDate = uploadIoTjsonDataRequest.MeasurementDate,
                    TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes //mindegy, nincs használva a metódus
                }).ToList()
            });

            if (response == null || response.IoTDataEntityDtos.Any(e => e == null))
                return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response);

            var result = response.IoTDataEntityDtos.Select(eDto => _mapper.Map<IoTDataModel>(eDto));
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
        }

using System.Net;
using AutoMapper;
using CommandLine;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;

using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Types;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.ListItems.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Models.IoT;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cors;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.StaticFiles;
using PuppeteerSharp;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Controllers.IoT
{
    /// <summary>
    /// IoTDataImportController
    /// </summary>
    /// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
    [Authorize]
    [ApiController]
    [Produces("application/json")]
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
    public class IoTDataImportController : ControllerBase
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Query service
        /// </summary>
        private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
        /// <summary>
        /// Command service
        /// </summary>
        private readonly ICommandService _commandService;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDataImportController"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
        /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
        public IoTDataImportController(IQueryService queryService, 
            ICommandService commandService)
        {
            _queryService = queryService;
            _commandService = commandService;
        }

        // POST: api/IoTDataImport/UploadImportData
        /// <summary>
        /// Import állomány feltöltése
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
        /// <param name="file">The file.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpPost("UploadImportData", Name = "UploadImportData"), DisableRequestSizeLimit]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
        [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDataImport_Post")]
        //public async Task<IActionResult> Post([FromForm(Name = "data")] string requestData, IFormFile file)
        public async Task<IActionResult> Post([FromForm]UploadIoTDataImportRequest request, IFormFile file)
        {
            try
            {
                if (request == null)
                    return BadRequest("Empty requestData parameter!");

                if (file == null)
                    return BadRequest("Empty file parameter!");

                var provider = new FileExtensionContentTypeProvider();

                if (!provider.TryGetContentType(file.FileName, out string contentType))
                    return BadRequest("Wrong filename!");

                using var stream = file.OpenReadStream();
                using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
                stream.CopyTo(memoryStream);

                var response = (UploadIoTDataImportCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new UploadIoTDataImportCommand
                {
                    DeviceIdentifier = request.DeviceIdentifier,
                    TimeUnit = request.TimeUnit,
                    Unit = request.Unit,
                    FileName = file.FileName,
                    Data = memoryStream.ToArray(),
                });

                if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
                    return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError, response);

                return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, response);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.LogError($"{nameof(IoTDataImportController)}-UploadImportData: {ex}");
                return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError, ex);
            }
        }

        // GET: api/IoTDataImport
        /// <summary>
        /// Import állományok lekérdezése
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpGet("", Name = "GetIoTDataImports")]
        [EnableCors("corsapp")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDataImport_GetList")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<IoTDataImportListItemDto>?>> Get([FromQuery] IoTDataImportDataTableRequest request)
        {
            IoTDataImportPagedEntityQuery query = new()
            {
                PagingInfo = new PagingInfo
                {
                    PageSize = request?.PageSize ?? 10,
                    StartPage = request?.StartPage ?? 0
                },
                SortingInfo = new SortingInfo
                {
                    SortColumn = request?.SortColumn ?? "FileName",
                    SortDirection = request?.SortDirection ?? SortDirection.Ascending
                },
                FileName = request?.FileName,
                Status = request?.State,
                DeviceIdentifier = request?.DeviceIdentifier,
                SearchText = request?.SearchText ?? string.Empty,
            };
            var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
            return result;
        }

        // GET: api/IoTDataImport/{id}
        /// <summary>
        /// Import állomány lekérdezése
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [EnableCors("corsapp")]
        [HttpGet("{id}", Name = "GetIoTDataImport")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDataImport_Get")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDataImportEntityDto>> GetIoTDataImport(int id)
        {
            var searchQuery = new GetIoTDataImportQuery { Id = id };

            if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(searchQuery))?.Entity is not IoTDataImportEntityDto queryResponse)
                return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "IoTDataImportEntity" });

            return Ok(queryResponse);
        }

        // GET: api/IoTDataImport/{id}/DownloadResult
        /// <summary>
        /// Import állomány lekérdezése
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [EnableCors("corsapp")]
        [HttpGet("{id}/DownloadResult", Name = "DownloadResult")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDataImport_DownloadResult")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DownloadResult(int id)
        {
            var searchQuery = new GetIoTDataImportResultQuery { Id = id };

            Response.Headers.Clear();
            if ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(searchQuery)) is not GetIoTDataImportResultQueryResult result || result.Data == null)
                return   NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "IoTDataImportEntity" });
            var content = new MemoryStream(result.Data);

            return File(content, "application/octet-stream", result.FileName);
        }

        // DELETE: api/IoTDataImport/{id}
        /// <summary>
        /// Import állomány törlése
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [EnableCors("corsapp")]
        [HttpDelete("{id}", Name = "DeleteIoTDataImport")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDataImport_Delete")]
        public async Task<ActionResult> DeleteIoTDataImport(int id)
        {
            await _commandService.DeleteEntityAsync<IoTDataImportEntityDto>(id);

            return Ok(new SuccessResponse());
        }
    }
}
