/// <summary>
/// IoTDevicesController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class IoTDevicesController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// The smappee manager
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ISmappeeManager _smappeeManager;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDevicesController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="smappeeManager">The smappee manager.</param>
    public IoTDevicesController(
        [KeyFilter("DataReceiver")] IQueryService queryService,
        [KeyFilter("DataReceiver")] ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper,
        ISmappeeManager smappeeManager)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _smappeeManager = smappeeManager;
    }

    // GET: api/iotdevices
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT Eszközök lekérdezése (GetAll)
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetIoTDevices")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDevices_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<IoTDeviceModel>>> GetAll()
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync<IoTDeviceEntityDto>())?.Items is IoTDeviceEntityDto[] iotDevices)
            || iotDevices == null
            || iotDevices.Length == 0)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "IoTDevice" });

        var result = iotDevices.Select(t => _mapper.Map<IoTDeviceModel>(t));
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // GET: api/iotdevices/{deviceIdentifier}
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT eszköz lekérdezése az eszközazonosítója alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="identifier">Az IoT eszköz eszközazonosítója</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{identifier}", Name = "GetIoTDevice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDevices_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDeviceModel>> Get(Guid identifier)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new IoTDeviceQuery
        {
            DeviceIdentifier = identifier
        }))?.Entity is IoTDeviceEntityDto IoTDeviceEntityDto)
            || IoTDeviceEntityDto == null
            || IoTDeviceEntityDto.Id == 0)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "IoTDevice" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<IoTDeviceModel>(IoTDeviceEntityDto);
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // POST: api/iotdevices/
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz létrehozás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "PostIoTDevice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDevices_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDeviceModel>> Post(CreateIoTDeviceRequest request)
    {
        var ioTDeviceEntityDto = _mapper.Map<IoTDeviceEntityDto>(request);

        ioTDeviceEntityDto = await _commandService.CreateEntityAsync(ioTDeviceEntityDto);

        if (ioTDeviceEntityDto == null)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);

        var result = _mapper.Map<IoTDeviceModel>(ioTDeviceEntityDto);
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // PUT: api/iotdevices/{deviceIdentifier}
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz szerkesztés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="identifier">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{identifier}", Name = "PutIoTDevice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDevices_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDeviceModel>> Put(Guid identifier, ModifyIoTDeviceRequest request)
    {
        var res = (await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new IoTDeviceQuery()
        {
            DeviceIdentifier = identifier
        }));
        if (res == null)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);

        var ioTDeviceEntityDto = res.Entity as IoTDeviceEntityDto;

        if (ioTDeviceEntityDto == null)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);

        ioTDeviceEntityDto = _mapper.Map(request, ioTDeviceEntityDto);

        ioTDeviceEntityDto = await _commandService.UpdateEntityAsync(ioTDeviceEntityDto);

        var result = _mapper.Map<IoTDeviceModel>(ioTDeviceEntityDto);
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);

    }

    // DELETE: api/iotdevices/{deviceIdentifier}
    /// <summary>
    /// Esdzköz törlése (logikai)
    /// </summary>

    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{identifier}", Name = "DeleteIoTDevice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDevices_Delete")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDeviceModel>> Delete(Guid identifier)
    {
        var response = (IoTDeviceDeleteCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new IoTDeviceDeleteCommand
        {
            DeviceIdentifier = identifier
        });

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response);

        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, response);
    }

    // POST: api/iotdevices/{ioTDeviceTypeCode}/healthcheck
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz tesztelése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ioTDeviceTypeCode">The io t device type code.</param>
    /// <param name="configValues">The configuration values.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost("{ioTDeviceTypeCode}/healthcheck", Name = "healthcheck")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDevices_Healthcheck")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ResponseBase>> Healthcheck(string ioTDeviceTypeCode, ConfigValueModel[] configValues)
    {
        var ok = false;
        try
        {
            if (ioTDeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.Smappee.GetEntityCode())
            {
                var serviceLocationIdConfigValue = configValues
                    .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == IoTConfigProperty.ServiceLocationId)?.Value;
                if (serviceLocationIdConfigValue != null &&
                    int.TryParse(serviceLocationIdConfigValue, out var serviceLocationId))
                {
                    await _smappeeManager.GetServicelocationInfo(serviceLocationId);
                    ok = true;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, "IoT device controller error");
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, new ErrorResponse());
        }

        return ok 
            ? StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, new SuccessResponse()) 
            : StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, new ErrorResponse());
    }

    // POST: api/iotdevices/{identifier}/telemetry
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT eszköz adatainak lekérdezése az eszközazonosítója alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="identifier">Az IoT eszköz eszközazonosítója</param>
    /// <param name="validity">The validity.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("{identifier}/telemetry", Name = "Telemetry")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDevices_Telemetry")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ChannelDataModel[]>> Telemetry(Guid identifier, [FromBody] DateTimeInterval validity)
    {
        var iotDevice = (await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new IoTDeviceQuery()
        {
            DeviceIdentifier = identifier
        })).Entity as IoTDeviceEntityDto;

        if (iotDevice == null)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.NotFound);

        var result = new List<ChannelDataModel>();

        var iotData = (await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new MeasurementDataQuery()
        {
            IoTDeviceIdentifier = identifier,
            From = validity.From,
            To = validity.To
        })).Items;

        foreach (var ioTDataEntityDto in iotData)
            result.Add(_mapper.Map<ChannelDataModel>(ioTDataEntityDto));

        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result.ToArray());
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// MeasurementDataController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class MeasurementDataController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    ///Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeasurementDataController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public MeasurementDataController(IQueryService queryService, ICommandService commandService, IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the specified measurement data data table request.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="measurementDataDataTableRequest">The measurement data data table request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet]
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "MeasurementData_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<MeasurementDataPagedEntityQueryResult?>> Get(
        [FromQuery] MeasurementDataDataTableRequest measurementDataDataTableRequest)
    {
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(new MeasurementDataPagedEntityQuery
        {
            ChannelIdentifier = measurementDataDataTableRequest.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier,
            From = measurementDataDataTableRequest.From,
            To = measurementDataDataTableRequest.To,
            PagingInfo = new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = measurementDataDataTableRequest.PageSize,
                StartPage = measurementDataDataTableRequest.StartPage
            },
            SortingInfo = new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = measurementDataDataTableRequest.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = measurementDataDataTableRequest.SortDirection
            },
            SearchText = measurementDataDataTableRequest.SearchText ?? string.Empty,
        }) as MeasurementDataPagedEntityQueryResult;

        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the last value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="identifier">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("measured-endpoints/{identifier}/last-value")]
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "MeasurementData_GetLastValue")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<double?>> GetLastValue(Guid? identifier)
    {
        var result = (_queryService.ExecuteQuery(new LastConsumptionForChannelQuery
        {
            ChannelIdentifier = identifier
        }).Result as LastConsumptionForDeviceQueryResult)!.LastConsumption ?? 0;

        return Ok(result);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Models.Users;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Controllers.Users;

/// <summary>
/// UsersController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class UsersController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="UsersController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public UsersController(ICommandService commandService, IMapper mapper)
    {
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // POST: api/users
    /// <summary>
    /// Új felhasználó létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "PostUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> Post(CreateUserRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreateSecUserCommand
        {
            LastName = request.LastName,
            FirstName = request.FirstName,
            EMail = request.EMail,
            Phone = request.Phone
        }) as CreateSecUserCommandResult;

        if (response?.SecUserEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(response.SecUserEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/users/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó adatok módosítása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id:int}", Name = "PutUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> Put(int id, ModifyUserRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifySecUserCommand
        {
            Id = id,
            FirstName = request.FirstName,
            LastName = request.LastName,
            Telephone = request.Phone,
        }) as ModifySecUserCommandResult;

        if (response?.SecUserEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(response.SecUserEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/users/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó törlése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{id:int}", Name = "DeleteUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_Delete")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DeleteSecUserCommandResult>> Delete(int id)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteSecUserCommand
        {
            Id = id
        }) as DeleteSecUserCommandResult;

        if (response is not { IsSuccess: true })
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
    }
    

}

{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDeviceMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public IoTDeviceMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<IoTDeviceEntityDto, IoTDeviceModel>();

        CreateMap<CreateIoTDeviceRequest, IoTDeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.DeviceName))
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceTypeCode, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.DeviceTypeCode))

            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<ModifyIoTDeviceRequest, IoTDeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.DeviceName))
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceTypeCode, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.DeviceTypeCode))
            .ForMember(x => x.Configuration, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Configuration))
            .ForMember(x => x.Channels, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Identifier, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.Ignore());

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.DataTable;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Chart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Models.IoT;

public class AggregatedDataWithinDayDataTableRequest
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Topológia elem illetve mérési pont lista
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public List<OrgUnitSelection> OrgUnitSelections { get; set; } = [];

using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Models.IoT;

public class AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest>
{
    public AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequestValidator()
    {
        When(x => x.OrgUnitSelections == null || x.OrgUnitSelections.Count == 0, () =>
            RuleFor(x => x.OrgUnitSelections)
                .NotEmpty()
                .WithMessage("Mérési pont vagy mérési hely kiválasztása kötelező"));
        
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\DataReceiver\EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI\Models\Mappings\ConsumptionMappings.cs

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Shared.Types;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Alerts;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Queries.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Models.IoT;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Mappings.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// ConsumptionMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class ConsumptionMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ConsumptionMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public ConsumptionMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<MeasurementExtremesRequest, ConsumptionExtremesQuery>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ChannelIdentifiers, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.DataPointIdentifiers.Distinct().ToList()));

        CreateMap<ConsumptionExtremesQueryResultItem, MeasurementExtremes>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.DataPointIdentifier, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.ChannelIdentifier));

        CreateMap<AggregationLevelRequest, AggregationLevelQuery>();
        CreateMap<AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest, AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramQuery>();
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Models.IoT;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Wireup;

/// <summary>
/// AutofacFrontEndModule
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Autofac.Module" />
public class AutofacFrontEndModule : Module
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Override to add registrations to the container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder through which components can be
    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.RegisterType<QueryServiceServer>().As<IQueryService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<CommandServiceServer>().As<ICommandService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder
            .RegisterType<DbContext>()
            .As<IDbContext>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        
        builder.RegisterType<BaseDtoValidator<AggregationLevelRequest>>().As<IValidator<AggregationLevelRequest>>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequestValidator>().As<IValidator<AggregatedDataWithinDayDiagramRequest>>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<BaseDtoValidator<AggregatedDataWithinDayDataTableRequest>>().As<IValidator<AggregatedDataWithinDayDataTableRequest>>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Linq;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Logic.Test;

public class DateTimeBoundaryTests
{
    /*rules:
    - next boundary: considering the timespan parameter, the next boundary is the next time that is a multiple of the timespan.
    - previous boundary: considering the timespan parameter, the previous boundary is the last time before dateTime, that is a multiple of the timespan.

    -example: (if interval is 15 minutes)
       12:01 -> next boundary: 12:15, previous boundary: 12:00
       12:59 -> next boundary: 13:00, previous boundary: 12:45
    - edge cases: (if interval is 15 minutes)
       12:00 -> next boundary: 12:15, previous boundary: 12:00 !!!
       
    */
    
    [Fact]
    public void DateTimeExtensions_NonBoundaryTime_GetNextBoundary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var dateTime = new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 01, 0);
        // Act
        var nextBoundary = dateTime.GetNextBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 15, 0), nextBoundary);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DateTimeExtensions_AlmostNextBoundary_GetNextBoundary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var dateTime = new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 59, 0);
        // Act
        var nextBoundary = dateTime.GetNextBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 13, 00, 0), nextBoundary);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DateTimeExtensions_ExactBoundaryTime_GetNextBoundary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var dateTime = new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 00, 0);
        // Act
        var nextBoundary = dateTime.GetNextBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 15, 0), nextBoundary);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DateTimeExtensions_NonBoundaryTime_GetPreviousBoundary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var dateTime = new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 01, 0);
        // Act
        var previousBoundary = dateTime.GetPreviousBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 00, 0), previousBoundary);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DateTimeExtensions_AlmostNextBoundary_GetPreviousBoundary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var dateTime = new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 59, 0);
        // Act
        var previousBoundary = dateTime.GetPreviousBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 45, 0), previousBoundary);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DateTimeExtensions_ExactBoundaryTime_GetPreviousBoundary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var dateTime = new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 00, 0);
        // Act
        var previousBoundary = dateTime.GetPreviousBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 00, 0), previousBoundary);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DateTimeExtensions_CanGetNextBoundary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var dateTime = new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 30, 0);
        // Act
        var nextBoundary = dateTime.GetNextBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 45, 0), nextBoundary);

    }

    [Fact]
    public void DateTimeExtensions_CanGetPreviousBoundary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var dateTime = new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 30, 0);
        // Act
        var previousBoundary = dateTime.GetPreviousBoundary(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
        //Assert    
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2025, 01, 01, 12, 30, 0), previousBoundary);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Linq;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.ConsumptionInterpolators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Logic.Test;

public class InterpolatorTests
{
    private readonly FifteenMinLinearInterpolator _interpolator;
    private readonly ConsumptionEntityDto _templateDto;

    public InterpolatorTests()
    {
        _interpolator = new FifteenMinLinearInterpolator();
        _templateDto = CreateTemplate();
    }

    private static ConsumptionEntityDto CreateTemplate()
    {
        return new ConsumptionEntityDto
        {
            IoTDevice = new EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto>(),
            Channel = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto>(),
            MeasuredAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Value = 0.0,
            DataQuality = DataQuality.Missing,
            MeasurementDescriptor = CreateTestMeasurementDescriptor()
        };
    }

    private static EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> CreateTestMeasurementDescriptor()
    {
        return new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>
        {
            Id = 1,
            EntityDisplayName = "Test Measurement Descriptor"
        };
    }

    private static ConsumptionEntityDto CreateConsumptionData(DateTime timestamp, double? value, DataQuality quality = DataQuality.Valid)
    {
        var template = CreateTemplate();
        template.MeasuredAtUtc = timestamp;
        template.Value = value;
        template.DataQuality = quality;
        return template;
    }

    #region Input Validation Tests

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_InvalidRange_ThrowsArgumentOutOfRangeException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 11, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc); // end before start
        var series = Enumerable.Empty<ConsumptionEntityDto>();

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() =>
            _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_EqualStartAndEnd_ThrowsArgumentOutOfRangeException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var timestamp = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var series = Enumerable.Empty<ConsumptionEntityDto>();

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() =>
            _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, timestamp, timestamp, _templateDto));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_InvalidTimeUnit_ThrowsArgumentException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var series = Enumerable.Empty<ConsumptionEntityDto>();

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() =>
            _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.None, start, end, _templateDto));
    }

    #endregion

    #region Time Unit Mapping Tests

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(TimeUnit.Seconds)]
    [InlineData(TimeUnit.Minutes)]
    [InlineData(TimeUnit.FiveMinutes)]
    [InlineData(TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes)]
    //[InlineData(TimeUnit.OneHour)] --> invalid, because it exceeds the 15 min block size
    //[InlineData(TimeUnit.OneDay)] --> invalid, because it exceeds the 15 min block size
    public void Interpolate_ValidTimeUnits_DoesNotThrow(TimeUnit timeUnit)
    {
        // Arrange
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1); //exclude 13:00, because it belongs to the next hour
        var series = Enumerable.Empty<ConsumptionEntityDto>();

        // Act & Assert
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, timeUnit, start, end, _templateDto);
        Assert.NotNull(result);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Boundary Rounding Tests

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_BoundariesRoundedTo15MinBlocks()
    {
        // Arrange - start at 12:07, end at 12:23 (should round to 12:00-12:30)
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 7, 30, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 23, 45, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert - should have entries for 12:00, 12:15 (12:30 is start of next period, outside range)
        Assert.Contains(result, x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
        Assert.Contains(result, x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));

        // Should NOT contain 12:30 as it's outside the normalized range
        Assert.DoesNotContain(result, x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));

        // Should have exactly 2 entries total
        Assert.Equal(2, result.Count);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Empty Data Tests

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_EmptySeriesOneHourRange_CreatesInterpolatedEntries()
    {
        // Arrange
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1); //exclude 13:00, because it belongs to the next hour
        var series = Enumerable.Empty<ConsumptionEntityDto>();

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert - should have entries for 12:00, 12:15, 12:30, 12:45 (13:00 is outside range)
        Assert.Equal(4, result.Count);
        Assert.All(result, r => Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Missing, r.DataQuality));
    }

    #endregion

    #region Linear Interpolation Tests

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_LinearInterpolationBetweenTwoPoints()
    {
        // Arrange - data at 12:00 (100) and 12:30 (200), expect 150 at 12:15
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0),
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1), 200.0)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FiveMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert
        var interpolatedPoint = result.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 5, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
        Assert.True(interpolatedPoint.Value > 100 && interpolatedPoint.Value < 200); //TODO: as end measurement time can't be exactly on boundary, the interpolated measurement will not be exaclty the middle point of the valid data - so I accept it somewhere between the two
        Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Interpolated, interpolatedPoint.DataQuality);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_LinearInterpolationWithMinutePeriod()
    {
        // Arrange - 15-minute block with minute resolution
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0),
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1), 114.999999)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.Minutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert - should have 15 entries (every minute from 12:00 to 12:15 exclusively!)
        Assert.Equal(15, result.Count);

        // rounding values to 4 digits: so we can verify the interpolated results
        foreach (var item in result.Where(x => x.DataQuality == DataQuality.Interpolated))
        {
            item.Value = Math.Round(item.Value!.Value, 4);
        }

        // Check interpolated value at 12:05 (should be 105.0)
        var interpolatedPoint = result.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 5, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
        Assert.Equal(105.0, interpolatedPoint.Value);
        Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Interpolated, interpolatedPoint.DataQuality);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_NoValidNeighborsForInterpolation_ReturnsNull()
    {
        // Arrange - only one data point, no neighbors for interpolation
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert
        var missingPoints = result.Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc != new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc)).ToList();
        Assert.All(missingPoints, point =>
        {
            Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Missing, point.DataQuality);
            Assert.Equal(0.0, point.Value);
        });
    }

    #endregion

    #region Data Quality Propagation Tests

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_ValidDataRemainValid()
    {
        // Arrange
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0, DataQuality.Valid),
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 200.0, DataQuality.Valid)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert
        var validEntries = result.Where(x => x.DataQuality == DataQuality.Valid).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, validEntries.Count);
        Assert.Equal(100.0, validEntries.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc)).Value);
        Assert.Equal(200.0, validEntries.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc)).Value);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_InvalidDataHandling()
    {
        // 5 perces gyakoriságot várunk el egy 15 perces periódusban, az egyik 5 perces mérés hibás -> interpolálni kell

        // Arrange - invalid data should be replaced by interpolation if possible
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0, DataQuality.Valid),
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 5, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), null, DataQuality.Invalid),
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 10, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 200.0, DataQuality.Valid)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FiveMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert
        var interpolatedPoint = result.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 5, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
        Assert.Equal(150.0, interpolatedPoint.Value);
        Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Interpolated, interpolatedPoint.DataQuality);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Ordering and Completeness Tests

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_ResultIsOrderedByTimestamp()
    {
        // Arrange - unordered input data
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 45, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 300.0),
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0),
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 200.0)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert
        var timestamps = result.Select(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(timestamps.OrderBy(x => x).ToList(), timestamps);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_CoversEntireExpectedRange()
    {
        // Arrange
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert - the interpolator creates entries based on 15-minute blocks and the period (15 minutes)
        // For a 1-hour range with 15-minute periods, we expect entries at each 15-minute boundary
        // Since we have one valid entry at 12:15, the interpolator should include:
        // 1. The original entry at 12:15
        // 2. Missing/interpolated entries at 12:00, 12:30, 12:45, 13:00
        Assert.True(result.Count >= 4, $"Expected at least 4 entries, but got {result.Count}");

        // Check that the result covers the expected time range
        var timestamps = result.Select(r => r.MeasuredAtUtc).OrderBy(t => t).ToList();
        Assert.True(timestamps.First() >= start, "First timestamp should be within or after start time");
        Assert.True(timestamps.Last() <= end, "Last timestamp should be within or before end time");

        // Verify that we have the original entry
        Assert.Contains(result, r => r.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc) && r.Value == 100.0);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Edge Cases

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_SameValueInterpolation()
    {
        // Arrange - same values at different times
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 14, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0),
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 14, 59, 999, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FiveMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert
        var interpolatedPoint = result.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 05, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
        Assert.Equal(100.0, interpolatedPoint.Value);
        Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Interpolated, interpolatedPoint.DataQuality);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_ZeroTimeDifferenceHandling()
    {
        // Arrange - test case where time difference is zero (edge case in InterpolateValue)
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var exactTime = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(exactTime, 100.0),
            CreateConsumptionData(exactTime, 200.0) // Same timestamp - should handle gracefully
        };

        // Act & Assert - should not throw
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();
        Assert.NotEmpty(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_LargeTimeGaps()
    {
        // Arrange - test interpolation across larger time gaps
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 15, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1); // 3 hours
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0),
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 14, 59, 59, 999, DateTimeKind.Utc), 400.0)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert - with 15-minute periods over 3 hours: 12 periods (12:00, 12:15, 12:30, 12:45, 13:00, 13:15, 13:30, 13:45, 14:00, 14:15, 14:30, 14:45)
        Assert.Equal(12, result.Count);

        // Check interpolated values at specific points
        var point1215 = result.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
        var point1330 = result.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 13, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));

        // Linear interpolation over 3 hours (180 minutes)
        //CHANGED: because interpolation happens only within 15 min slices, if there is no valid data in the slice, it will be missing
        Assert.Equal(0, point1215.Value); // 15 min: 100 + (400-100) * 15/180
        Assert.Equal(0, point1330.Value); // 90 min: 100 + (400-100) * 90/180
        Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Missing, point1215.DataQuality);
        Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Missing, point1330.DataQuality);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Interpolate_ExtrapolateAfterValidPoints()
    {
        //TODO: currently the implementation for extrapolation is missing, so this test will fail - will be solved later

        // Arrange - 15-minute block with 5-minute resolution
        // Valid data at 12:00 and 12:05, missing data at 12:10
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1);
        var series = new[]
        {
        CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0),
        CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 5, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 150.0)
        // No data at 12:10
    };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FiveMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(3, result.Count); // Should have entries at 12:00, 12:05, and 12:10

        // Verify original points preserved
        var point1200 = result.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
        var point1205 = result.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 5, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));
        Assert.Equal(100.0, point1200.Value);
        Assert.Equal(150.0, point1205.Value);
        Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Valid, point1200.DataQuality);
        Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Valid, point1205.DataQuality);

        // Check extrapolated point after the valid points
        var point1210 = result.First(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 10, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc));

        // Based on the trend from the two valid points, the extrapolated value should continue the same rate of change
        // From 100 to 150 is +50 over 5 minutes, so we expect +50 again for the next 5 minutes
        Assert.Equal(200.0, point1210.Value);
        Assert.Equal(DataQuality.Interpolated, point1210.DataQuality);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Debugging Issue

    [Fact]

    {
        // Arrange - Test with a very simple case
        var start = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var end = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 30, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).AddTicks(-1); // Just 30 minutes, exclude 12:30 
        var series = new[]
        {
            CreateConsumptionData(new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 12, 15, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc), 100.0)
        };

        // Act
        var result = _interpolator.Interpolate(series, TimeUnit.FifteenMinutes, start, end, _templateDto).ToList();

        // Debug output
        var grouped = result.GroupBy(r => r.MeasuredAtUtc).ToList();
        var duplicates = grouped.Where(g => g.Count() > 1).ToList();

        // Range 12:00-12:30 should have exactly 2 entries: 12:00, 12:15
        Assert.Equal(2, result.Count);

        Assert.True(duplicates.Count == 0,
            $"Found {duplicates.Count} duplicate timestamps: {string.Join(", ", duplicates.Select(d => d.Key.ToString("HH:mm:ss") + " (" + d.Count() + " times)"))}");
    }

using static EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.SimplifiedTest.InterpolatorTests.TestEnums;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.SimplifiedTest.InterpolatorTests;
internal static class DataGenerator
{

    // ez az alap teszt adat generáló metódus, randomizál egy kicsit a timestampeken és kb 20% invalid értéket is generál
    public static List<TestModel> GenerateTestData(
        DateTime startDate,
        DateTime endDate,
        TimeSpan measurmentInterval        
)
    {
        if (endDate - startDate <= TimeSpan.Zero)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("End date must be greater than start date.");
        }
        if ((endDate - startDate).TotalDays > 100)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Test data generation is limited to 100 days. (don't go crazy! :) )");
        }
        if(measurmentInterval <= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1))
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Measurement interval must be at least 1 second.");
        }
        if (measurmentInterval > TimeSpan.FromDays(1))
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Max 1 day of measurementInterval allowed.");
        }

        var testData = new List<TestModel>();

        DateTime cursor = startDate;
        int n = 1;
        while (cursor <= endDate)
        {
            double? value = n % 5 == 0 ? null : Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 1000; // every 5th value is invalid
            TestDataQuality q = value.HasValue ? TestDataQuality.Valid : TestDataQuality.Invalid;

            testData.Add(new TestModel
            {
                IoTDataEntityId = n,
                MeasuredAtUtc = cursor,
                Value = value,
                DataQuality = q,
                ModifiedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
                IsHandled = false
            });

            //adding variations to measurement timestamps
            var delta = Random.Shared.Next(-((int)measurmentInterval.TotalSeconds), ((int)measurmentInterval.TotalSeconds)) / 2;
            cursor += measurmentInterval + TimeSpan.FromSeconds(delta);
            n++;
        }

        return testData;
    }
}

using Xunit.Abstractions;

    {
        DateTime from = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-2);
        DateTime to = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(2);
        TimeSpan timeUnit = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);

        // Arrange
        var startingData = DataGenerator.GenerateTestData(
            from,
            to,
            timeUnit
        );

        // Act
        var interpolator = new TestLinearInterpolator();

        var result = interpolator.InterpolateList(
            startingData,
            TestTimeUnit.FiveMinutes,
            from,
            to,
            startingData.First() //az egyszerűség kedvéért ez a teszt szempontjából mindegy
        );

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.NotEmpty(result);


        //TODO: ellenőrizni, hogy a visszaadott lista tartalmazza-e az összes eredeti érvényes adatot
        var validOriginalData = startingData
            .Where(x => x.DataQuality == TestDataQuality.Valid)

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\DataReceiver\Test\EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.SimplifiedTest\InterpolatorTests\TestLinearInterpolator.cs
====================================================================================================


using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using static EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.SimplifiedTest.InterpolatorTests.TestEnums;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.SimplifiedTest.InterpolatorTests;
internal class TestLinearInterpolator
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan BlockSize = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15);

    /// <summary>
    /// Ez a teljes listára elkészíti az interpolációt, 15 perces blokkokra felosztva a belső logikában.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="series"></param>
    /// <param name="timeUnit"></param>
    /// <param name="expectedRangeStart"></param>
    /// <param name="expectedRangeEnd"></param>
    /// <param name="templateDto"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException"></exception>
    public IEnumerable<TestModel> InterpolateList(
        IEnumerable<TestModel> series,
        TestTimeUnit timeUnit,
        DateTime expectedRangeStart,
        DateTime expectedRangeEnd,
        TestModel templateDto)
    {
        if (expectedRangeEnd <= expectedRangeStart)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("The expected range cannot be negative or zero length.");
        }
        //to be sure, reapply the rounding to 15min whole blocks
        expectedRangeStart = expectedRangeStart.GetPreviousBoundary(BlockSize);
        expectedRangeEnd = expectedRangeEnd.GetNextBoundary(BlockSize);

        TimeSpan period = timeUnit switch
        {
            TestTimeUnit.Seconds => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1),
            TestTimeUnit.Minutes => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),
            TestTimeUnit.FiveMinutes => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
            TestTimeUnit.FifteenMinutes => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15),
            TestTimeUnit.OneHour => TimeSpan.FromHours(1),
            TestTimeUnit.OneDay => TimeSpan.FromDays(1),

            _ => throw new ArgumentException("TestTimeUnit is not set.") //ezt kivételesen dobhatja, rosszul lett hívva, vagy hibás device/endpoint config
        };

        /* TODO: itt jön a számítás...
            - a 15 perces szeleteken egyesével megyünk végig és hívjuk az interpolációt
            - egy 15 perces időszakban több adat is hiányozhat, a mérési gyakoriságtól függően.
            - ezért az interpolatornak listát kell majd visszaadnia, a kiegészített lista az eredeti, a módosított (null helyett becsült), és az új rekordokat is tartalmazza.
        */

        var blocks = series
            .GroupBy(x => new DateTime(x.MeasuredAtUtc.Ticks - (x.MeasuredAtUtc.Ticks % BlockSize.Ticks), DateTimeKind.Utc))
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).ToList());

        //ha az adatsor nem tartalmaz minden 15 perces szeletre értéket, akkor a groupolás során kimaradnak blokkok. ezeket pótoljuk utólag.
        DateKeyedDictionaryHelper.FillGaps(ref blocks, BlockSize, expectedRangeStart, expectedRangeEnd);
        
        List<TestModel> finalResult = [];
        foreach (var block in blocks)
        {
            var interpolated = InterpolateBlock(block.Value, block.Key, period, templateDto);
            finalResult.AddRange(interpolated);
        }

        return finalResult.OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc); //újra rendezzük, hogy a beszúrt elemek jó helyre kerüljenek
    }

    /* interpolációs logika megfogalmazása:
    A 15 perces blokkokat annyi kisebb szeletre bontjuk, ahány az elvárt mérési gyakoriság szerint szükséges.
    ezekben a kisebb szeletekben vizsgáljuk, hogy van-e legalább 1 érvényes mérés:
    - ha van, akkor a szelettel nincs további teendő.
    - ha nincs, akkor vizsgáljuk, hogy nem-valid értékkel van-e legalább egy konkrét időpont adatunk:
      - ha van, akkor arra a meglévő időpontra próbálunk a szomszédok alapján interpolálni (ha több is van, akkor mindegyikre)
      - ha egyáltalán nincs semmi használható, létrehozunk egyet az időszelet elején, az értékét pedig megpróbáljuk a szomszédok alapján interpolálni.
    */



    private double? InterpolateValueOld(List<TestModel> allData, DateTime targetTime)
    {
        var previous = allData
            .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc < targetTime && x.DataQuality == TestDataQuality.Valid)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        var next = allData
            .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc > targetTime && x.DataQuality == TestDataQuality.Valid)
            .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        if (previous == null || next == null)
            return null;

        double totalDuration = (next.MeasuredAtUtc - previous.MeasuredAtUtc).TotalSeconds;
        double targetOffset = (targetTime - previous.MeasuredAtUtc).TotalSeconds;

        if (totalDuration == 0)
            return previous.Value;

        return previous.Value + (next.Value - previous.Value) * (targetOffset / totalDuration);
    }

    private double? InterpolateValue(List<TestModel> allValidData, DateTime targetTime)
    {
        var previous = allValidData
            .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc < targetTime)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        var next = allValidData
            .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc > targetTime)
            .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        /*TODO: specifikáció szerint
         Az adatpótlás lineáris interpolációt alkalmaz, azaz a rendelkezésre álló két egymás melletti mérési adatra alapozva keresi meg a hiányzó értékeket. 
         A hiányzó adat lehet a két rendelkezésre álló mérési adat között, vagy a két mérési adat után is.
         Pótolt adatra nem lehet a számítást alapozni, csak tényadatokat lehet figyelembe venni a számításhoz. 
         Ha két tény mért adat nem áll rendelkezésre, akkor 0 értéket kell feltüntetni a pótlásban.
         */
        //TODO: interpoláció két egymást követő adat utánra
        if (previous == null || next == null)
            return null;

        double totalDuration = (next.MeasuredAtUtc - previous.MeasuredAtUtc).TotalSeconds;
        double targetOffset = (targetTime - previous.MeasuredAtUtc).TotalSeconds;

        if (totalDuration == 0)
            return previous.Value;

        return previous.Value + (next.Value - previous.Value) * (targetOffset / totalDuration);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy 15 perces blokkra elkészíti az interpolációt
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="blockData"></param>
    /// <param name="blockStartUtc"></param>
    /// <param name="period"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public List<TestModel> InterpolateBlock(
        List<TestModel> blockData,
        DateTime blockStartUtc,
        TimeSpan period, // a blokkon belüli kisebb szeletek mérete (TimeUnit config szerint)
        TestModel templateItem
        )
    {
        //ensure ordered
        //TODO: ezt át kell gondolni, hogy itt rendezünk-e, vagy kívül, mert 1x valahol muszáj megcsinálni, de duplán rendezni egy nagy listát időigényes lehet
        blockData = [.. blockData.OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc)];

        List<TestModel> result = [];

        var slices = blockData.GroupBy(x => new DateTime(x.MeasuredAtUtc.Ticks - (x.MeasuredAtUtc.Ticks % period.Ticks), DateTimeKind.Utc))
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).ToList());
        //TODO: a csoportosítás során nem minden időszeletre keletkezik group, ha nem volt érték, ezeket utólag bele kell tenni, üres listával.
        DateKeyedDictionaryHelper.FillGaps(ref slices, period, blockStartUtc, blockStartUtc.Add(BlockSize));

        var validOriginalEntries = blockData
            .Where(x => x.DataQuality == TestDataQuality.Valid)
            .ToList();

        foreach (var slice in slices)
        {
            // Ezek a teljesen jó szeletek, amikben van legalább 1 valid mérés (a szeleten belüli hibásakat is meghagyjuk)
            bool containsValid = slice.Value.Any(x => x.DataQuality == TestDataQuality.Valid);
            if (containsValid)
            {
                result.AddRange(slice.Value);
                continue;
            }

            // Ezek a szeletek, amiknél létezik timestamp, de nem jó az érték -> számítunk hozzá új értéket
            var invalidEntries = slice.Value
                .Where(x => x.DataQuality != TestDataQuality.Valid)
                .ToList();
            foreach (var entry in invalidEntries)
            {
                //interpolálás
                var interpValue = InterpolateValue(validOriginalEntries, entry.MeasuredAtUtc);
                entry.Value = interpValue ?? 0;
                entry.DataQuality = interpValue.HasValue ? TestDataQuality.Interpolated : TestDataQuality.Missing;
            }

            // Teljesen hiányoznak a mérések -> 0 értéket adunk egy új bejegyzésnek.
            if (slice.Value.Count == 0)
            {
                //keresünk egy szomszédos bejegyzést, amiről másoljuk az általános property-ket
                var anyNeighborEntry = blockData.LastOrDefault(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc < slice.Key);
                anyNeighborEntry ??= blockData.FirstOrDefault(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc > slice.Key);
                anyNeighborEntry ??= templateItem; //ha se előző, se következő, akkor a template-ből dolgozunk

                var missingEntry = new TestModel
                {
                    MeasuredAtUtc = slice.Key,
                    Value = InterpolateValue(validOriginalEntries, slice.Key),
                    DataQuality = TestDataQuality.Missing,

                    //TODO: azok a mezők, amik egy másik mérésből másolódnak
                    IoTDataEntityId = anyNeighborEntry.IoTDataEntityId,
                };
                slice.Value.Add(missingEntry); // add the new entry to the slice
                slice.Value.Sort((x, y) => x.MeasuredAtUtc.CompareTo(y.MeasuredAtUtc)); // re-sort the slice by MeasuredAtUtc
            }

            result.AddRange(slice.Value);
        }

        return result;
    }

}

using Antlr.Runtime.Misc;
using FluentAssertions;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Common.Shared.Models.Authentication;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Test;

/// <summary>
/// Tesztosztály ős
/// </summary>
public static class DataReceiverTestBaseExt
{
    private const string LoginUrl = "/api/authenticate/auth";

    /// <summary>
    /// Adminisztrátori jogkörrel való futtatás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="testFunction">Teszt metódus</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task RunTestAsAdmin(Func<HttpClient, Task> testFunction)
    {
        await RunTestAsUser(testFunction, "ZeBgOaUca");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tesztfelhasználói jogkörrel való futtatás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="testFunction">Teszt metódus</param>
    /// <param name="apiKey">ApiKey</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static async Task RunTestAsUser(Func<HttpClient, Task> testFunction, string apiKey)
    {
        var application = new WebApplicationFactory<Program>();
        HttpClient? client = null;
        try
        {
            client = await GetClient(application, apiKey);
            await testFunction(client);
        }
        finally
        {
            client?.Dispose();
            await application.DisposeAsync();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns with a HttpClient instance.
    /// </summary>
    private static async Task<HttpClient> GetClient(WebApplicationFactory<Program> application, string apiKey)
    {
        var client = application.CreateClient();
        // Login
        var loginAsAdminResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(LoginUrl, new APIAuthModel
        {
            APIKey = apiKey
        });

        loginAsAdminResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        var content = await loginAsAdminResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        var token = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<AuthModel>(content);
        token.Should().NotBeNull();
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " + token!.Token);
        return client;
    }
}

using System;

/// <summary>
/// IoTData WebApi unitteszt

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class DataTest : DataReceiverTestBase
{
    const string LOGIN_URL = "/api/authenticate/auth";
    const string DATA_URL = "/api/iotdata";
    const string API_KEY = "ZeBgOaUca";

    public DataTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture) 
        : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
        ConfigFixture.ConfigProviderMock
            .Setup(x => x.GetConfigValue("SmappeeJobCronExpression"))
            .Returns("0 0/5 * * * ?");
        ConfigFixture.ConfigProviderMock
            .Setup(x => x.GetConfigValue("WeatherJobCronExpression"))
            .Returns("0 0/5 * * * ?");

        var smappeHost = "https://localhost:7052/SmappeeSimulator";

        ConfigFixture.ConfigProviderMock
            .Setup(x => x.GetConfigValue("SmappeApi.Host"))
            .Returns(smappeHost);
        ConfigFixture.ConfigProviderMock
            .Setup(x => x.GetConfigValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.Path"))
            .Returns("dev/v3/oauth2/token");
        ConfigFixture.ConfigProviderMock
            .Setup(x => x.GetConfigValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.GrantTypePassword"))
            .Returns("test_grant_password");
        ConfigFixture.ConfigProviderMock
            .Setup(x => x.GetConfigValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.ClientId"))
            .Returns("test_token_client_id");
        ConfigFixture.ConfigProviderMock
            .Setup(x => x.GetConfigValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.ClientSecret"))
            .Returns("test_client_secret");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns with a HttpClient instance and an AuthToken string.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="application">WebApplicationFactory reference</param>
    private async Task<(HttpClient?, string?)> GetClientAndToken(WebApplicationFactory<Program> application)
    {
        var client = application.CreateClient();
        var response = await client.PostAsync(LOGIN_URL,
            new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new APIAuthModel()
            {
                APIKey = API_KEY
            }), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);

        var token = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<AuthModel>(content);
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " + token.Token);
        return (client, token.Token);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// POST (Upload) JSON Data Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task UploadIoTJSONDataAsync(HttpClient client, string token)
    {
        var response = await client.PostAsync(DATA_URL + "/" + "uploadjsondata",
        new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new UploadIoTJSONDataRequest()
        {
            DeviceIdentifier = new Guid("c41121ed-b6fb-c9a6-bc9b-574c82929e71"),
            IoTDataSourceTypeCode = "OpenWeatherAPIv2.5",
            Data = @"{""powerEnergyReading"": 25, ""thermalEnergyReading"": 98 }",
            MeasurementDate = DateTimeContext.Now
        }), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should()
            .NotBeNull()
            .And
            .NotBeEmpty();

        response.StatusCode.Should()
            .Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// POST (Upload) Batch JSON Data Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task BatchUploadIoTJSONDataAsync(HttpClient client, string token)
    {
        var response = await client.PostAsync(DATA_URL + "/" + "batchuploadjsondata",
        new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new[]
        {
            new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand
            {
                DeviceIdentifier = new Guid("c41121ed-b6fb-c9a6-bc9b-574c82929e71"),
                IoTDataSourceTypeCode = "OpenWeatherAPIv2.5",
                Data = @"{""powerEnergyReading"": 25, ""thermalEnergyReading"": 98 }",
                MeasurementDate = DateTimeContext.Now,
                TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneHour
            },
            new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand
            {
                DeviceIdentifier = new Guid("c41121ed-b6fb-c9a6-bc9b-574c82929e72"),
                IoTDataSourceTypeCode = "OpenWeatherAPIv2.5",
                Data = @"{""powerEnergyReading"": 25, ""thermalEnergyReading"": 98 }",
                MeasurementDate = DateTimeContext.Now,
                TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneHour
            },
            new UploadIoTJSONDataCommand
            {
                DeviceIdentifier = new Guid("f51121ed-b6fb-c9a6-bc9b-574c82929e73"),
                IoTDataSourceTypeCode = "OpenWeatherAPIv2.5",
                Data = @"{""powerEnergyReading"": 25, ""thermalEnergyReading"": 98 }",
                MeasurementDate = DateTimeContext.Now.AddMinutes(1),
                TimeUnit = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.OneHour
            }
        }), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should()
            .NotBeNull()
            .And
            .NotBeEmpty();

        response.StatusCode.Should()
            .Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// (Upload) JSON Data Test
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [Fact]
    public async Task UploadIoTJSONDataTest()
    {
        var application = new WebApplicationFactory<Program>();

        // Mock LocalProvider
        Config.LocalProvider = ConfigFixture.ConfigProviderMock.Object;

        HttpClient? client = null;
        try
        {
            (client, var token) = await GetClientAndToken(application);
            await UploadIoTJSONDataAsync(client, token);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (client != null)
                client.Dispose();
            application.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Batch upload test
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [Fact]
    public async Task BatchUploadIoTJSONDataTest()
    {
        var application = new WebApplicationFactory<Program>();
        
        Config.LocalProvider = ConfigFixture.ConfigProviderMock.Object;

        HttpClient? client = null;
        try
        {
            (client, var token) = await GetClientAndToken(application);
            await BatchUploadIoTJSONDataAsync(client, token);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (client != null)
                client.Dispose();
            application.Dispose();
        }
    }

}

            .Setup(x => x.GetConfigValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.ClientSecret"))
            .Returns("test_client_secret");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns with a HttpClient instance and an AuthToken string.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="application">WebApplicationFactory reference</param>
    private async Task<(HttpClient?, string?)> GetClientAndToken(WebApplicationFactory<Program> application)
    {
        var client = application.CreateClient();
        var response = await client.PostAsync(LOGIN_URL,
            new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new APIAuthModel()
            {
                APIKey = API_KEY
            }), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);

        var token = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<AuthModel>(content);
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " + token.Token);
        return (client, token.Token);
    }

    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        var kodtarak = await QueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync<DictEntityDto>();

        var dictDto = kodtarak.Items[0];

        dictDto = await QueryService.GetByIdAsync<DictEntityDto>(dictDto.Id);

        dictDto.Name = "unitTestAdat2";

        await CommandService.UpdateEntityAsync(dictDto);

        var testDict = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(new DictEntityDto
        {
            Name = "unitTestAdat",
            Code = "unitTestAdat" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
            IsSystem = false
        });

        Assert.NotNull(testDict);
  
        var dictItem = CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(new DictItemEntityDto
        {
            Dict = new EntityRef<DictEntityDto>
            {
                Id = testDict.Id
            },
            Value = "unitTestAdatItem",
            Code = "unitTestAdatItemCode" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString()
        })?.Result;

        Assert.NotNull(dictItem);

        await CommandService.DeleteEntityAsync<DictItemEntityDto>(dictItem.Id);

        await CommandService.DeleteEntityAsync<DictEntityDto>(testDict.Id);
    }

    {
        var uuid = Guid.NewGuid();

        name ??= $"{uuid}_name";

        var createResult = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(new DictEntityDto
        {
            Code = code,

            IsSystem = isSystem
        });

        createResult!.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);

        createResult.Name.Should().Be(name);
        createResult.IsSystem.Should().Be(isSystem);
        return createResult;
    }

    /// <param name="value">Kódtár elem értéke</param>
    private async Task<DictItemEntityDto> CreateNewDictItem(int dictId, string? code = null, string? value = null)
    {
        var uuid = Guid.NewGuid();
        code ??= $"{uuid}_code";
        value ??= $"{uuid}_value";

        var createResult = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(new DictItemEntityDto
        {
            Dict = new EntityRef<DictEntityDto> { Id = dictId },
            Code = code,
            Value = value
        });

        createResult.Should().NotBeNull();
        createResult!.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);
        createResult.Dict.Id.Should().Be(dictId);
        createResult.Code.Should().Be(code);
        createResult.Value.Should().Be(value);
        return createResult;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.Services;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI.Test.Wireup;

/// <summary>
/// AutoFac
/// </summary>
public class AutofacBackEndUnitTestsModule : Module
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Inicializálás, regisztráció
    /// </summary>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        //Database
        //EnergiaMenedzsment Database
        builder.RegisterType<DbContext>()
            .As<IDbContext>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        //Core Database
        builder.RegisterType<CoreDbContext>()
            .Keyed<IDbContext>(DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE)
            .Named<IDbContext>(DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE)
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        //Services
        builder.RegisterType<QueryServiceServer>().As<IQueryService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<CommandServiceServer>().As<ICommandService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }
}

    {

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Healthes the check.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="config">The configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool HealthCheck(IDictionary<string, string>? config = null)
    {
        double latValue;
        double lonValue;

        if (!config.TryGetValue(nameof(IGeoCoord.Lat), out var latString) || !double.TryParse(latString, out latValue))
        {
            // log
            return false;
        }

        if (!config.TryGetValue(nameof(IGeoCoord.Lon), out var lonString) || !double.TryParse(lonString, out lonValue))
        {
            // log
            return false;
        }

        return _openWeatherMapManager.GetCurrentWeatherData(latValue, lonValue) != null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Measureds the endpoint health check.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceConfig">The device configuration.</param>

    public bool MeasuredEndpointHealthCheck(IDictionary<string, string> deviceConfig, IDictionary<string, string> measuredEndpointConfig)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\DeviceTypes\EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap\Managers\OpenWeatherMap\OpenWeatherMapManager.cs
