using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Enums.CurrentWeatherData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Models.OpenWeatherApi.CurrentWeatherData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Models.OpenWeatherApi.DailyForecastData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Models.OpenWeatherApi.HourlyForecastData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Managers;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Managers.OpenWeatherMap;

/// <summary>
/// OpenWeatherMapManager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap.Managers.OpenWeatherMap.IOpenWeatherMapManager" />
public class OpenWeatherMapManager : IOpenWeatherMapManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The HTTP client
    /// </summary>
    private readonly EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient _httpClient;
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="OpenWeatherMapManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="httpClient">The HTTP client.</param>
    public OpenWeatherMapManager(ILifetimeScope scope, EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient httpClient)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        _scope = scope;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the current weather data json.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="lat">The lat.</param>
    /// <param name="lon">The lon.</param>
    /// <param name="responseInJson">if set to <c>true</c> [response in json].</param>
    /// <param name="temperatureMeasurementType">Type of the temperature measurement.</param>
    /// <param name="responseLang">The response language.</param>
    /// <param name="allowOneCall">if set to <c>true</c> [allow one call].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.CurrentWeatherDataException">Hiba történt a 'get current weather data' hívása során.</exception>
    public async Task<string> GetCurrentWeatherDataJson(
        IComponentContext context,
        double lat,
        double lon,
        bool responseInJson = true,
        TemperatureMeasurementType temperatureMeasurementType = TemperatureMeasurementType.Metric,
        string responseLang = "en", bool allowOneCall = true)
    {
        var category = Config.GetStringValue("hourly_forcast_category");
        var path =
            allowOneCall && category == "OneCall" ?
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.Onecall.Path") :
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.GetCurrentWeatherData.Path");
        var appId = context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.AppId");
        var host =
            category == "5Days3Hourly" ?
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.Host.Pro") :
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.Host");
        try
        {
            var qParams = new Dictionary<string, string>
            {
                { "appid", appId },
                { "lat", lat.ToString() },
                { "lon", lon.ToString() },
                { "lang", responseLang },
                { "units", GetTemperatureMeasurementType(temperatureMeasurementType) }
            };

            path = _httpClient.GetPathFromDictionary(path, qParams);
            var url = host + "/" + path;
            var result = await _httpClient.Get(url, false);
            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new CurrentWeatherDataException("Hiba történt a 'get current weather data' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the current weather data.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="lat">The lat.</param>
    /// <param name="lon">The lon.</param>
    /// <param name="responseInJson">if set to <c>true</c> [response in json].</param>
    /// <param name="temperatureMeasurementType">Type of the temperature measurement.</param>
    /// <param name="responseLang">The response language.</param>
    /// <param name="allowOneCall">if set to <c>true</c> [allow one call].</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<CurrentWeatherDataModel> GetCurrentWeatherData(
        double lat,
        double lon,
        bool responseInJson = true,
        TemperatureMeasurementType temperatureMeasurementType = TemperatureMeasurementType.Metric,
        string responseLang = "en", bool allowOneCall = true)
    {
        var result = await GetCurrentWeatherDataJson(_scope, lat, lon, responseInJson, temperatureMeasurementType, responseLang, allowOneCall:allowOneCall);
        var model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<CurrentWeatherDataModel>(result);
        return model;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the hourly forecastata.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="lat">The lat.</param>
    /// <param name="lon">The lon.</param>
    /// <param name="numberOfCities">The number of cities.</param>
    /// <param name="responseLang">The response language.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<HourlyForecastDataModel> GetHourlyForecastata(
        IComponentContext context,
        double lat,
        double lon,
        int? numberOfCities = null,
        string responseLang = "en")
    {
        var result = await GetHourlyForecastataJson(context, lat, lon, numberOfCities, responseLang);
        var model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<HourlyForecastDataModel>(result);
        return model;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the hourly forecastata json.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="lat">The lat.</param>
    /// <param name="lon">The lon.</param>
    /// <param name="numberOfCities">The number of cities.</param>
    /// <param name="responseLang">The response language.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.CurrentWeatherDataException">Hiba történt a 'get hourly forecast data' hívása során.</exception>
    public async Task<string> GetHourlyForecastataJson(
        IComponentContext context,
        double lat,
        double lon,
        int? numberOfCities = null,
        string responseLang = "en")
    {
        var path = context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.GetHourlyForecastata.Path");
        var appId = context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.AppId");
        var hostType = Config.GetStringValue("hourly_forcast_category");
        var host =
            hostType == "5Days3Hourly" ?
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.Host.Pro") :
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.Host");
        try
        {
            var qParams = new Dictionary<string, string>
            {
                { "appid", appId },
                { "lat", lat.ToString() },
                { "lon", lon.ToString() },
                { "lang", responseLang }
            };
            if (numberOfCities.HasValue)
                qParams.Add("cnt", numberOfCities.Value.ToString());

            path = _httpClient.GetPathFromDictionary(path, qParams);
            var url = host + "/" + path;
            var result = await _httpClient.Get(url, false);
            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new CurrentWeatherDataException("Hiba történt a 'get hourly forecast data' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the type of the temperature measurement.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="temperatureMeasurementType">Type of the temperature measurement.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static string GetTemperatureMeasurementType(TemperatureMeasurementType temperatureMeasurementType)
    {
        switch (temperatureMeasurementType)
        {
            case TemperatureMeasurementType.Imperial:
                return "imperial";
            case TemperatureMeasurementType.Metric:
                return "metric";
            case TemperatureMeasurementType.Standard:
                return "standard";
            default: return "";
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the daily forecastata.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="lat">The lat.</param>
    /// <param name="lon">The lon.</param>
    /// <param name="numberOfCities">The number of cities.</param>
    /// <param name="responseLang">The response language.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<DailyForecastDataModel> GetDailyForecastata(
        IComponentContext context,
        double lat,
        double lon,
        int? numberOfCities = null,
        string responseLang = "en")
    {
        var result = await GetDailyForecastDataJson(context, lat, lon, numberOfCities, responseLang);
        var model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<DailyForecastDataModel>(result);
        return model;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the daily forecast data json.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="lat">The lat.</param>
    /// <param name="lon">The lon.</param>
    /// <param name="numberOfCities">The number of cities.</param>
    /// <param name="responseLang">The response language.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.CurrentWeatherDataException">Hiba történt a 'get daily forecast data' hívása során.</exception>
    public async Task<string> GetDailyForecastDataJson(
        IComponentContext context,
        double lat,
        double lon,
        int? numberOfCities = null,
        string responseLang = "en")
    {
        var category = Config.GetStringValue("hourly_forcast_category");
        var path =
            category == "OneCall" ?
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.Onecall.Path") :
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.GetDailyForecastata.Path");
        var appId = context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.AppId");
        var host =
            category == "5Days3Hourly" ?
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.Host.Pro") :
            context.Config().GetStringValue("OpenWeatherMapManager.Host");
        try
        {
            var qParams = new Dictionary<string, string>
            {
                { "appid", appId },
                { "lat", lat.ToString() },
                { "lon", lon.ToString() },
                { "lang", responseLang }
            };
            if (numberOfCities.HasValue)
                qParams.Add("cnt", numberOfCities.Value.ToString());

            path = _httpClient.GetPathFromDictionary(path, qParams);
            var url = host + "/" + path;
            var result = await _httpClient.Get(url, false);
            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new CurrentWeatherDataException("Hiba történt a 'get daily forecast data' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// AutofacBackEndModule
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Autofac.Module" />
public class AutofacBackEndModule: Module
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Override to add registrations to the container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder through which components can be
    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.RegisterType<OpenWeatherMapManager>().As<IOpenWeatherMapManager>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<OpenWeatherMapCommandHandler>()
            .Named<IExternalCommandHandler>(OpenWeatherMapCommandHandler.KEY_IOT_DEVICE_TYPE_CODE)
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        
        Log.LogInfo("Plugin -> DeviceType.OpenWeatherMap");
    }
}

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Common.Logic.Caching;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Managers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Models.Smappee;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Caches;

/// <summary>
/// MeteringConfigurationCache
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Caching.Cache&lt;System.Int32, EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Models.Smappee.MeteringConfigurationModel&gt;" />
public class MeteringConfigurationCache : Cache<int, MeteringConfigurationModel>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The smappee manager
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ISmappeeManager _smappeeManager;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeteringConfigurationCache"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="smappeeManager">The smappee manager.</param>
    public MeteringConfigurationCache(ISmappeeManager smappeeManager) : base(nameof(MeteringConfigurationModel))
    {
        _smappeeManager = smappeeManager;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCache">The tenant cache.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override MeteringConfigurationModel? GetValue(ConcurrentDictionary<int, MeteringConfigurationModel> tenantCache, int key)
    {
        MeteringConfigurationModel? value;
        if (tenantCache.ContainsKey(key))
            tenantCache.TryGetValue(key, out value);
        else
        {
            value = _smappeeManager.GetMeteringConfiguration(key).RunSync();
            tenantCache[key] = value;
        }
            
        return value;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the value key.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// TKey
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    protected override int GetValueKey(string? tenantCode, MeteringConfigurationModel value)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Fills up.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    protected override void FillUp(string? tenantCode = null) { }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\DeviceTypes\EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee\Handlers\SmappeeCommandHandler.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.ExternalHandler.ExternalDevices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.ExternalHandler.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Managers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Models.Smappee;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Handlers;

/// <summary>
/// SmappeeCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.ExternalHandler.Interfaces.IExternalCommandHandler" />
public class SmappeeCommandHandler : IExternalCommandHandler
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The smappe manager
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ISmappeeManager _smappeManager;
    /// <summary>
    /// The servicelocations
    /// </summary>
    private ServiceLocationCoreModel? _servicelocations;
    /// <summary>
    /// The key iot device type code
    /// </summary>
    public const string KEY_IOT_DEVICE_TYPE_CODE = "smappee";
    /// <summary>
    /// The key service location identifier
    /// </summary>
    public const string KEY_SERVICE_LOCATION_ID = "ServiceLocationId";
    /// <summary>
    /// The key measurement identifier
    /// </summary>
    public const string KEY_MEASUREMENT_ID = "MeasurementId";

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the service locations.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The service locations.
    /// </value>
    private ServiceLocationCoreModel ServiceLocations => _servicelocations ??= _smappeManager.GetServicelocations().RunSync();

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SmappeeCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="manager">The manager.</param>
    public SmappeeCommandHandler(ISmappeeManager manager)
    {
        _smappeManager = manager;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the io t device type code.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The io t device type code.
    /// </value>
    public string IoTDeviceTypeCode => KEY_IOT_DEVICE_TYPE_CODE;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the devices.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IList<IExternalDevice> GetDevices()
    {
        var result = new List<IExternalDevice>();

        foreach (var servicelocation in ServiceLocations.ServiceLocations)
        {
            var serviceLocationConfig = _smappeManager.GetMeteringConfiguration(servicelocation.ServiceLocationId).RunSync();

            result.Add(new ExternalDevice()
            {
                SerialNumber = servicelocation.DeviceSerialNumber,
                ExternalIdentifier = servicelocation.ServiceLocationId.ToString(),
                DeviceName = servicelocation.Name,
                Lat = serviceLocationConfig.Lat,
                Lon = serviceLocationConfig.Lon,
                MACAddress = serviceLocationConfig.ServiceLocationUuid,
                Timezone = serviceLocationConfig.Timezone,
                Configuration = new Dictionary<string, string>()
                {
                    {KEY_SERVICE_LOCATION_ID, serviceLocationConfig.ServiceLocationId.ToString()}
                }
            });
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the device.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="config">The configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IExternalDevice GetDevice(IDictionary<string, string> config)
    {
        var deviceInfo = GetDeviceInfo(config);
        return new ExternalDevice()
        {
            ExternalIdentifier = deviceInfo.ServiceLocationId.ToString(),
            SerialNumber = ServiceLocations.ServiceLocations.First(x => x.ServiceLocationId == deviceInfo.ServiceLocationId).DeviceSerialNumber,
            DeviceName = deviceInfo.Name,
            Lat = deviceInfo.Lat,
            Lon = deviceInfo.Lon,
            MACAddress = deviceInfo.ServiceLocationUuid,
            Timezone = deviceInfo.Timezone,
            Configuration = new Dictionary<string, string>()
            {
                {KEY_SERVICE_LOCATION_ID, deviceInfo.ServiceLocationId.ToString()}
            }
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the mesured endpoints.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="config">The configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public IList<IExternalChannel> GetMesuredEndpoints(IDictionary<string, string> config)
    {
        var deviceInfo = GetDeviceInfo(config);
        var result = new List<IExternalChannel>();
        if (deviceInfo != null)
        {
            foreach (var measurement in deviceInfo.Measurements)
            {

                result.Add(new ExternalChannel()
                {
                    ExternalIdentifier = measurement.Id.ToString(),
                    Name = measurement.Name,
                    Description = measurement.Type,
                    Configuration = new Dictionary<string, string>()
                    {
                        {KEY_MEASUREMENT_ID, measurement.Id.ToString()}
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Healthes the check.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="config">The configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool HealthCheck(IDictionary<string, string>? config = null)
    {
        try
        {
            Log.LogInfo("Smappee HealthCheck in progress...");
            if (config == null)
            {
                _smappeManager.GetServicelocations().RunSync();
            }
            else
                return GetDeviceInfo(config) != null;
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + e.GetType().Name, e, "Smappee HealthCheck caught an Exception.");
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Measureds the endpoint health check.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceConfig">The device configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="measuredEndpointConfig">The measured endpoint configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool MeasuredEndpointHealthCheck(IDictionary<string, string> deviceConfig, IDictionary<string, string> measuredEndpointConfig)
    {
        try
        {
            var deviceInfo = GetDeviceInfo(deviceConfig);
            if (deviceInfo == null)
                return false;
            if (!measuredEndpointConfig.ContainsKey(KEY_MEASUREMENT_ID))
                return false;
            var measurementId = measuredEndpointConfig[KEY_MEASUREMENT_ID];
            return deviceInfo.Measurements.Any(x => x.Id.ToString() == measurementId);

        } catch (Exception)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the device information.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="config">The configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected MeteringConfigurationModel? GetDeviceInfo(IDictionary<string, string> config)
    {
        MeteringConfigurationModel? result = null;
        if (config.ContainsKey(KEY_SERVICE_LOCATION_ID))
        {
            var serviceLocationIdConfigValue = config[KEY_SERVICE_LOCATION_ID];
            if (int.TryParse(serviceLocationIdConfigValue, out var serviceLocationId))
                result = _smappeManager.GetMeteringConfiguration(serviceLocationId).RunSync();
        }
        else
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"Getting DeviceInfo from config - Config not contains value with key: '{KEY_SERVICE_LOCATION_ID}'");
        }

        if (result != null)
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"Getting DeviceInfo from config - Success!");
        }
        else
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"Getting DeviceInfo from config - Not found!");
        }

        return result;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;

/// <summary>
/// SmappeeManager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Managers.ISmappeeManager" />
public class SmappeeManager : ISmappeeManager
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets from configuration value.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// From configuration value.
    /// </value>
    private TimeSpan? FromConfigValue { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the host.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The host.
    /// </value>
    private string Host { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// The token
    /// </summary>
    private AccessTokenModel _token;
    /// <summary>
    /// The can call refresh token
    /// </summary>
    private bool _canCallRefreshToken = true;
    /// <summary>
    /// The username
    /// </summary>
    private string _username, _password;
    /// <summary>
    /// The HTTP client
    /// </summary>
    private readonly EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient _httpClient;
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SmappeeManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="httpClient">The HTTP client.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public SmappeeManager(EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient httpClient, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        _scope = scope;
        Host = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.Host");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the access token.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="username">The username.</param>
    /// <param name="password">The password.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.SmappeeException">Hiba történt a 'Get AccessToken' hívása során.</exception>
    public async Task<AccessTokenModel> GetAccessToken(
        string? username,
        string? password)
    {
        var path = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.Path");
        try
        {
            _username = username;
            _password = password;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(username))
                _username = username;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
                _password = password;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_username))
                _username = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.Username");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_password))
                _password = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.Password");

            var url = Host + "/" + path;
            var clientId = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.ClientId");
            var clientSecret = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.AccessToken.ClientSecret");

            var formData = new List<KeyValuePair<string, string>>
            {
                new("grant_type", "password"),
                new("username", _username),
                new("password", _password),
                new("client_id", clientId),
                new("client_secret", clientSecret),
            };

            var content = new FormUrlEncodedContent(formData);
            var response = await _httpClient.Post(url, "", httpContent: content);
            var token = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<AccessTokenModel>(response);

            _token = token;
            return token;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new SmappeeException("Hiba történt a 'Get AccessToken' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the servicelocations.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceSerialNumber">The device serial number.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.SmappeeException">
    /// Hiba történt az acces token lekérése során.
    /// or
    /// Hiba történt a 'Get Servicelocations' hívása során.
    /// </exception>
    public async Task<ServiceLocationCoreModel> GetServicelocations(
        int? deviceSerialNumber = null)
    {
        var path = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.GetServicelocations.Path");
        try
        {
            var qParams = new Dictionary<string, string>();
            if (deviceSerialNumber.HasValue)
            {
                qParams.Add(nameof(deviceSerialNumber), deviceSerialNumber.Value.ToString());
            }

            path = _httpClient.GetPathFromDictionary(path, qParams);
            var url = Host + "/" + path;
            var result = await _httpClient.Get(url, token: _token?.AccessToken??"");
            var model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ServiceLocationCoreModel>(result);
            _canCallRefreshToken = true;
            return model;
        }
        catch (UnauthorizedException exception)
        {
            if (_canCallRefreshToken)
            {
                _canCallRefreshToken = false;
                await RefreshToken();
                return await GetServicelocations(deviceSerialNumber);
            }
            else
                throw new SmappeeException("Hiba történt az acces token lekérése során.", exception);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new SmappeeException("Hiba történt a 'Get Servicelocations' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the electricity consumption.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="serviceLocationId">The service location identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">The aggregation.</param>
    /// <param name="from">From.</param>
    /// <param name="to">To.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.SmappeeException">
    /// Hiba történt az acces token lekérése során.
    /// or
    /// Hiba történt a 'GetElectricityConsumption' hívása során.
    /// </exception>
    public async Task<ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel> GetElectricityConsumption(
            int serviceLocationId,
            Aggregation? aggregation,
            long? from,
            long? to)
    {
        var basePath = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.GetElectricityConsumption.Path");
        basePath = basePath.Replace("%SERVICELOCATIONID%", serviceLocationId.ToString());
        var findFirstDate = from == null;
        try
        {
            aggregation ??= Aggregation.Level1;
            ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel? model;
            FromConfigValue ??= _scope.Config().TryGetTimeSpanValue("SmappeApi.GetElectricityConsumption.From") ?? new TimeSpan(88, 0, 0, 0);
            int toRange = 0;
            int consumptionLength = 0;
            var fromDateTime = DateTime.UtcNow.Subtract(FromConfigValue.Value);
            do
            {
                toRange++;
                long? requestTo;
                long? requestFrom;
                if (findFirstDate)
                {
                    requestFrom = fromDateTime.AddDays(toRange-1).UnixTimestampTotalMilliseconds();
                    requestTo = fromDateTime.AddDays(toRange).UnixTimestampTotalMilliseconds();
                }
                else
                {
                    requestFrom = from ?? fromDateTime.UnixTimestampTotalMilliseconds();
                    requestTo = to ?? from + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
                }

                var qParams = new Dictionary<string, string>();
                if (aggregation.HasValue)
                    qParams.Add(nameof(aggregation), ((int)aggregation.Value).ToString());
                if (requestFrom.HasValue)
                    qParams.Add(nameof(from), requestFrom.Value.ToString());
                if (requestTo.HasValue)
                    qParams.Add(nameof(to), requestTo.Value.ToString());

                var path = _httpClient.GetPathFromDictionary(basePath, qParams);
                var url = Host + "/" + path;
                var result = await _httpClient.Get(url, token: _token?.AccessToken ?? "");
                model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ElectricityConsumptionCoreModel>(result);

                consumptionLength = model?.Consumptions?.Length ?? 0;
            } while (findFirstDate && consumptionLength == 0 && toRange < FromConfigValue.Value.Days);

            _canCallRefreshToken = true;
            return model;
        }
        catch (UnauthorizedException exception)
        {
            if (_canCallRefreshToken)
            {
                _canCallRefreshToken = false;
                await RefreshToken();
                return await GetElectricityConsumption(serviceLocationId, aggregation, from, to);
            }
            else
                throw new SmappeeException("Hiba történt az acces token lekérése során.", exception);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new SmappeeException("Hiba történt a 'GetElectricityConsumption' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the events.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="serviceLocationId">The service location identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="applianceIds">The appliance ids.</param>
    /// <param name="maxNumber">The maximum number.</param>
    /// <param name="from">From.</param>
    /// <param name="to">To.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.SmappeeException">
    /// Hiba történt az acces token lekérése során.
    /// or
    /// Hiba történt a 'Get Events' hívása során.
    /// </exception>
    public async Task<EventModel[]> GetEvents(
        int serviceLocationId,
        int[] applianceIds,
        int? maxNumber,
        long? from,
        long? to)
    {
        var path = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.GetEvents.Path");
        path = path.Replace("%SERVICELOCATIONID%", serviceLocationId.ToString());
        try
        {
            var qParams = new Dictionary<string, string>();
            if (maxNumber.HasValue)
                qParams.Add(nameof(maxNumber), (maxNumber.Value).ToString());
            if (from.HasValue)
                qParams.Add(nameof(from), from.Value.ToString());
            if (to.HasValue)
                qParams.Add(nameof(to), to.Value.ToString());

            path = _httpClient.GetPathFromDictionary(path, qParams);
            if (applianceIds != null && applianceIds.Length > 0)
                path = _httpClient.AddArrayToPath(applianceIds, "applianceId", path);
            var url = Host + "/" + path;
            var result = await _httpClient.Get(url, token: _token?.AccessToken ?? "");
            var model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<EventModel[]>(result);
            _canCallRefreshToken = true;
            return model;
        }
        catch (UnauthorizedException exception)
        {
            if (_canCallRefreshToken)
            {
                _canCallRefreshToken = false;
                await RefreshToken();
                return await GetEvents(serviceLocationId, applianceIds, maxNumber, from, to);
            }
            else
                throw new SmappeeException("Hiba történt az acces token lekérése során.", exception);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new SmappeeException("Hiba történt a 'Get Events' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }

    public async Task SetChargingMode(

        int serialNumber,
        ChargingModePosition position)
    {
        var path = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SmappeApi.SetChargingMode.Path");
        path = path.Replace("$SERIALNUMBER$", serialNumber.ToString());
        path = path.Replace("$POSITION$", ((int)position).ToString());

        try
        {
            var url = Host + "/" + path;

            {
                _canCallRefreshToken = false;
                await RefreshToken();

        }
    }

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.ExternalHandler.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Handlers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Managers;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.Smappee.Wireup;

/// <summary>
/// AutofacBackEndModule
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Autofac.Module" />
public class AutofacBackEndModule: Module
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Override to add registrations to the container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder through which components can be
    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.RegisterType<SmappeeManager>().As<ISmappeeManager>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<SmappeeCommandHandler>()
            .Named<IExternalCommandHandler>(SmappeeCommandHandler.KEY_IOT_DEVICE_TYPE_CODE)
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        Log.LogInfo("Plugin -> DeviceType.Smappee");
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.ExternalHandler.ExternalDevices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.ExternalHandler.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Managers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Handlers;

/// <summary>
/// SolarEdgeCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.ExternalHandler.Interfaces.IExternalCommandHandler" />
public class SolarEdgeCommandHandler : IExternalCommandHandler
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The solar edge manager
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ISolarEdgeManager _solarEdgeManager;
    /// <summary>
    /// The key iot device type code
    /// </summary>
    public const string KEY_IOT_DEVICE_TYPE_CODE = "solaredge";
    /// <summary>
    /// The key site identifier
    /// </summary>
    public const string KEY_SITE_ID = "site_id";

    /// <summary>

    {
        try
        {
            Log.LogInfo("SolarEdge HealthCheck in progress...");

            var result = _solarEdgeManager.GetVersion();
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + e.GetType().Name, e, "SolarEdge HealthCheck caught an Exception.");
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Measureds the endpoint health check.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceConfig">The device configuration.</param>
    /// <param name="measuredEndpointConfig">The measured endpoint configuration.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public bool MeasuredEndpointHealthCheck(IDictionary<string, string> deviceConfig, IDictionary<string, string> measuredEndpointConfig)
    {
        return this.HealthCheck(deviceConfig);
    }

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Humanizer;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Models.SolarEdge;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Managers;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Managers;

/// <summary>
/// SolarEdgeManager
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.SolarEdge.Managers.ISolarEdgeManager" />
public class SolarEdgeManager : ISolarEdgeManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the host.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The host.
    /// </value>
    private string Host { get; }
    /// <summary>
    /// The HTTP client
    /// </summary>
    private readonly EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient _httpClient;
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SolarEdgeManager"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="httpClient">The HTTP client.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public SolarEdgeManager(EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient httpClient, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        _scope = scope;
        Host = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SolarEdgeApi.Host");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the version.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.SolarEdgeException">Hiba történt a 'GetVersion' hívása során.</exception>
    public async Task<string> GetVersion()
    {
        var basePath = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SolarEdgeApi.GetApiVersion.Path");
        var api_key = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SolarEdgeApi.APIKey");
        try
        {
            var qParams = new Dictionary<string, string>
            {
                { "api_key", api_key }
            };

            var path = _httpClient.GetPathFromDictionary(basePath, qParams);
            var url = Host + "/" + path;
            var result = await _httpClient.Get(url, addBearer: false);
            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new SolarEdgeException("Hiba történt a 'GetVersion' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the site power.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="siteId">The site identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="startTime">The start time.</param>
    /// <param name="endTime">The end time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.SolarEdgeException">
    /// Nincs jogosultsága a 'GetSitePower' hívásához.
    /// or
    /// Hiba történt a 'GetSitePower' hívása során.
    /// </exception>
    public async Task<PowerProductionCoreModel> GetSitePower(int siteId, string startTime, string endTime)
    {
        var basePath = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SolarEdgeApi.GetSitePower.Path");
        basePath = basePath.Replace("%SITEID%", siteId.ToString());

        var api_key = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SolarEdgeApi.APIKey");

        try
        {
            PowerProductionCoreModel? model;

            var qParams = new Dictionary<string, string>
            {
                { "api_key", api_key },
                { nameof(startTime), startTime },
                { nameof(endTime), endTime }
            };

            var path = _httpClient.GetPathFromDictionary(basePath, qParams);
            var url = Host + "/" + path;
            var result = await _httpClient.Get(url, addBearer: false);
            model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<PowerProductionCoreModel>(result);
            return model;
        }
        catch (UnauthorizedException exception)
        {
            throw new SolarEdgeException("Nincs jogosultsága a 'GetSitePower' hívásához.", exception);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new SolarEdgeException("Hiba történt a 'GetSitePower' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the site energy.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="siteId">The site identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="startTime">The start time.</param>
    /// <param name="endTime">The end time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.SolarEdgeException">
    /// Nincs jogosultsága a 'GetSiteEnergy' hívásához.
    /// or
    /// Hiba történt a 'GetSiteEnergy' hívása során.
    /// </exception>
    public async Task<EnergyProductionCoreModel> GetSiteEnergy(int siteId, string startTime, string endTime)
    {
        var basePath = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SolarEdgeApi.GetSiteEnergy.Path");
        basePath = basePath.Replace("%SITEID%", siteId.ToString());

        var api_key = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SolarEdgeApi.APIKey");

        try
        {

            {

            };

            var url = Host + "/" + path;
            var result = await _httpClient.Get(url, addBearer: false);
            model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<EnergyProductionCoreModel>(result);
            return model;
        }
        catch (UnauthorizedException exception)
        {
            throw new SolarEdgeException("Nincs jogosultsága a 'GetSiteEnergy' hívásához.", exception);
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            throw new SolarEdgeException("Hiba történt a 'GetSiteEnergy' hívása során.", exception);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the inverter technical data.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="siteId">The site identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="serialNumber">The serial number.</param>
    /// <param name="startTime">The start time.</param>
    /// <param name="endTime">The end time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Exceptions.SolarEdgeException">
    /// Nincs jogosultsága a 'GetInverterTechnicalData' hívásához.
    /// or
    /// Hiba történt a 'GetInverterTechnicalData' hívása során.
    /// </exception>
    public async Task<InverterDataCoreModel> GetInverterTechnicalData(int siteId, string serialNumber, string startTime, string endTime)
    {
        var basePath = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("SolarEdgeApi.GetInverterTechnicalData.Path");
        basePath = basePath.Replace("%SITEID%", siteId.ToString());
        basePath = basePath.Replace("%SERIALNUMBER%", serialNumber.ToString());

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Models.Job;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Helpers;
using Quartz;
using SkiaSharp;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// Értesítések lérehozása
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs.JobBase" />
public class CreateNotificationJob : JobBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Posts the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <param name="targetUserId">The target user identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="templateName">Name of the template.</param>
    public static void PostJob(
           SecurityContext securityContext,
           IDbContext dbContext,
           string token,
           List<int> targetUserId,
           string templateName
           )
    {
        JobSecurityContext? jobSecurityContext = GetJobSecurityContext(securityContext);
        var key = $"{nameof(CreateNotificationJob)}_{token}";
        var defaultJobData = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                //{JobSecurityContextKey, jobSecurityContext},
                {"token", token},
                {"targetUserId", targetUserId.FirstOrDefault()},
                {"templateName", templateName}
            };
        try
        {
            JobHelper.PostJob<CreateNotificationJob>(dbContext, key, defaultJobData);
        }
        catch ( Exception ex )
        {
            Log.LogError(ex.Message, "CreateNotificationJob running error.");
        }
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override async Task ExecuteJob(IJobExecutionContext context, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var jobData = context.JobDetail.JobDataMap;
        var token = jobData.GetString("token");
        var templateName = jobData.GetString("templateName");
        var targetUserId = jobData.GetInt("targetUserId");

        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        try
        {
            var template = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<TemplateEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Name == templateName)
            .SingleOrDefault();

            var targetUser = dbContext.Session.Get<SecUserEntity>(targetUserId);

            var notification = new NotificationEntity()
            {
                NotificationSource = NotificationSource.TaskManager,
                NotificationType = NotificationType.Email,
                Title = templateName,
                HtmlTemplate = template,
                TargetUsers = new List<SecUserEntity>() { targetUser },
                ExpirationDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1),
                SendDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                IsRead = false,
                NotificationState = NotificationState.Pending,
                Description = token
            };

            dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(notification);
            dbContext.Commit();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, "(Hiba 'NotificationEntity' létrehozásakor");
            throw;
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Models.Job;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Tenant;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.FluentMigration.Application;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using NHibernate.Linq;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant létrehozás
    /// </summary>
    /// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs.JobBase" />
    public class CreateTenantJob : JobBase
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Posts the job.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
        /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
        /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
        /// <param name="email">The email.</param>
        /// <param name="phone">The phone.</param>
        /// <param name="headquarters">The headquarters.</param>
        /// <param name="name">The name.</param>
        /// <param name="description">The description.</param>
        /// <param name="contactPersonName">Name of the contact person.</param>
        /// <param name="taxIdentificationNumber">The tax identification number.</param>
        /// <param name="companyRegistrationNumber">The company registration number.</param>
        /// <param name="partnerAdminUser">The partner admin user.</param>
        public static void PostJob(
            SecurityContext securityContext,
            PartnerValidityEntityDto partnerValidityEntityDto,
            IDbContext dbContext,
            string tenantCode,
            string partnerAdminUser)
        {
            JobSecurityContext? jobSecurityContext = GetJobSecurityContext(securityContext);

            var key = $"{nameof(CreateTenantJob)}_{tenantCode}";
            var defaultJobData = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                {"TenantCode", tenantCode},
                {"EMail", partnerValidityEntityDto.EMail},
                {"Website", partnerValidityEntityDto.Website},
                {"Phone", partnerValidityEntityDto.Telephone},
                {JobSecurityContextKey, jobSecurityContext},
                {"Headquarters", partnerValidityEntityDto.Headquarters},
                {"Name", partnerValidityEntityDto.Name},
                {"Description", partnerValidityEntityDto.Description},
                {"ContactPersonName", partnerValidityEntityDto.ContactPersonName},
                {"TaxIdentificationNumber", partnerValidityEntityDto.TaxIdentificationNumber},
                {"CompanyRegistrationNumber", partnerValidityEntityDto.CompanyRegistrationNumber},
                {"PartnerAdminUser", partnerAdminUser},
                {"ValidFrom", partnerValidityEntityDto.ValidFrom},
                {"ValidTo", partnerValidityEntityDto.ValidTo},
                {"InstituteIdentificationType", partnerValidityEntityDto.InstituteIdentificationType},
                {"InstituteIdentification", partnerValidityEntityDto.InstituteIdentification},
                {"Identifier", partnerValidityEntityDto.Identifier},
                {"MaintainerId", partnerValidityEntityDto.Maintainer.Id},
            };

            JobHelper.PostJob<CreateTenantJob>(dbContext, key, defaultJobData);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Executes the job.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
        /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
        protected override async Task ExecuteJob(IJobExecutionContext context, ILifetimeScope scope)
        {
            try
            {
                var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
                var monitoringApiClientService = scope.Resolve<MonitoringApiClientService>();
                var dataReceiverApiClientService = scope.Resolve<DataReceiverApiClientService>();

                var jobData = context.JobDetail.JobDataMap;

                var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
                var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
                var roleCache = scope.Resolve<RoleCache>();

                var tenantCode = jobData.GetString("TenantCode");
                var email = jobData.GetString("EMail");
                var website = jobData.GetString("Website");
                var phone = jobData.GetString("Phone");
                var headquarters = (AddressEntityDto)jobData["Headquarters"];
                var name = jobData.GetString("Name");
                var description = jobData.GetString("Description");
                var contactPersonName = jobData.GetString("ContactPersonName");
                var taxIdentificationNumber = jobData.GetString("TaxIdentificationNumber");
                var companyRegistrationNumber = jobData.GetString("CompanyRegistrationNumber");
                var partnerAdminUser = jobData.GetString("PartnerAdminUser");
                var validFrom = jobData.GetDateTime("ValidFrom");
                var validTo = jobData.GetDateTime("ValidTo");
                var instituteIdentificationType = jobData.GetString("InstituteIdentificationType");
                var instituteIdentification = jobData.GetString("InstituteIdentification");
                var identifier = Guid.Parse(jobData.GetString("Identifier"));
                var maintainerId = jobData.GetInt("MaintainerId");

                if (tenantCode == null) return;

                var tenantEntityDto = (await queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TenantEntityQuery()
                {
                    TenantCode = tenantCode,
                    OnlyValidResults = true
                })).Entity as TenantEntityDto;

                if (tenantEntityDto == null) return;

                dbContext.Session.Query<TenantEntity>()
                                 .Where(x => x.Id == tenantEntityDto.Id)
                                 .Update(x => new { Status = TenantStatus.Creating });

                Log.LogInfo($"Tenant létrehozás: '{tenantCode}' ...");

                var created = FluentMigrationApp.CreateSchemaDB(
                    Config.GetStringValue("DatabaseScriptFolder"),
                    tenantCode
                );

                if (created)
                {
                    await using var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
                    tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(tenantCode);
                    Log.LogInfo($"Adminisztrátor felhasználó létrehozás elindítva az alábbi Tenant-hoz: '{tenantCode}' ...");
                    var tenantCommandService = tenantScope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
                    var adminUser = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<PartnerAdminUserEntityDto>(partnerAdminUser);

                    dbContext.Session.Query<TenantEntity>()
                                     .Where(x => x.Id == tenantEntityDto.Id)
                                     .Update(x => new { Status = TenantStatus.Created });

                    SendSyncMessage(dbContext, monitoringApiClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.UserTenant, DateTime.UtcNow, TenantScopeType.Public);
                    SendSyncMessage(dbContext, dataReceiverApiClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.UserTenant, DateTime.UtcNow, TenantScopeType.Public);

                    await tenantCommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreatePartnerCommand
                    {
                        TenantCode = tenantCode,
                        Name = name,
                        Description = description,
                        Headquarters = headquarters,
                        EMail = email,
                        Website = website,
                        Telephone = phone,
                        ContactPersonName = contactPersonName,
                        PartnerAdminUser = null,
                        TaxIdentificationNumber = taxIdentificationNumber,
                        CompanyRegistrationNumber = companyRegistrationNumber,
                        ValidTo = validTo,
                        ValidFrom = validFrom,
                        InstituteIdentificationType = instituteIdentificationType,
                        InstituteIdentification = instituteIdentification,
                        Identifier = identifier,
                        Maintainer = new EntityRef<MaintainerEntityDto> { Id = maintainerId }
                    });

                    var isNewUser = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>().Where(x => x.EMail == adminUser.AdministratorEmail).SingleOrDefault() == null;

                    var result = await tenantCommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreateAdminSecUserCommand
                    {
                        TenantCode = tenantCode,
                        EMail = adminUser.AdministratorEmail,
                        Phone = adminUser.AdministratorPhone,
                        LastName = adminUser.AdministratorLastName,
                        FirstName = adminUser.AdministratorFirstName
                    }) as CreateSecUserCommandResult;

                    //TODO: A ContantPerson secUser nem létezik a public sémán sec-user táblán, felül kell vizsgálni, hogy kell-e contactPerson és ha igen hogyan legyen jelen a public schemán
                    //Alapértelmezett ContactPerson beállítása az admin felhasználóra.
                    //await commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new SetDefaultContactPersonCommand
                    //{
                    //    TenantCode = tenantCode,
                    //    SecUserId = result.SecUserEntityDto.Id,
                    //});
                    var userDto = result!.SecUserEntityDto!;
                    var role = roleCache.GetRoleByType(scope, SecRoleType.Adminisztrator)!;

                    await tenantCommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentCreateCommand
                    {
                        User = new EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto> { Id = userDto.Id },
                        Role = new EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto> { Id = role.Id },
                        ValidTo = validTo,
                        ValidFrom = validFrom,
                        Building = null,
                        Site = null,
                        Institution = null
                    });

                    // send new user notification
                    if (isNewUser) 
                    {
                        var passwordNotificationManager = new PasswordNotificationManager();
                        await passwordNotificationManager.NewUserRegistration(result.SecUserEntityDto.EMail, tenantScope);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    dbContext.Session.Query<TenantEntity>()
                                     .Where(x => x.Id == tenantEntityDto.Id)
                                     .Update(x => new { Status = TenantStatus.Error });
                }

            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, "CreateTenantJob error");
                throw;
            }
            finally 
            {
                try
                {
                    await context.Scheduler.DeleteJob(context.JobDetail.Key);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Log.LogError("Failed to delete job after execution", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        protected void SendSyncMessage(IDbContext dbContext, ApiClientServiceBase clientService, string route, string syncObjectName, DateTime dateOfModification, TenantScopeType tenantCode = TenantScopeType.TenantCode)
        {
            var request = new
            {
                EntityName = syncObjectName,
                LastModifiedDate = dateOfModification,
                TenantCode = tenantCode == TenantScopeType.TenantCode ? dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName : null
            };
            dbContext.AddSyncRequestAction(syncObjectName, () => clientService.Post(route, request, dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName).RunSync());
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.ExternalHandler.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// DeviceHealthCheckJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.FrameworkTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class DeviceHealthCheckJob : FrameworkTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the cron expression.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The cron expression.
    /// </value>
    protected override string CronExpression => Config.TryGetStringValue($"{JobName}.CronExpression") ?? "0 * * * * ?";
    /// <summary>
    /// The logger
    /// </summary>
    private ILogger<DeviceHealthCheckJob>? _logger;

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _logger = scope.Resolve<ILogger<DeviceHealthCheckJob>>();
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var tenant = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

        try
        {
            var devices = dbContext
        .Session
        .QueryOver<DeviceEntity>()
        .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).List();

            foreach (var device in devices)
            {
                _logger.LogInfo($"(tenant: {tenant}) - ExternalCommandHandler resolve for Device (id: {device.Id}, sn: {device.SerialNumber}), using IoTDeviceType code of: '{device.IoTDeviceType.Code}'");
                var edHandler = GetExternalCommandHandler(scope, device.IoTDeviceType.Code);
                if (edHandler != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        _logger.LogInfo($"(tenant: {tenant}) - {JobName} for device: (id: {device.Id}, sn: {device.SerialNumber})");
                        var online = edHandler.HealthCheck(DeviceCommandHandler.GetConfiguration(device));
                        device.Status = online ? DeviceStatus.Online : DeviceStatus.Offline;
                        dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(device);
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    {
                        _logger.LogError(e, $"(tenant: {tenant}) - HealthCheck for Device (id: {device.Id}, sn: {device.SerialNumber}), IoTDeviceTypeCode: {device.IoTDeviceType.Code} caught an Exception.");
                        device.Status = DeviceStatus.Error;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    device.Status = DeviceStatus.Unknown;
                }

                _logger.LogInfo($"(tenant: {tenant}) - Device (id: {device.Id}, sn: {device.SerialNumber}) HealthCheck status: {device.Status}");
            }
            dbContext.Commit();

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, $"(tenant: {tenant}) - Hiba 'Device Healthcheck' lekérdezéskor");
            throw;
        }   
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the external command handler.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="code">The code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IExternalCommandHandler? GetExternalCommandHandler(ILifetimeScope scope, string? code)
    {
        if (code != null &&
            scope.IsRegisteredWithName<IExternalCommandHandler>(code))
            return scope.ResolveNamed<IExternalCommandHandler>(code);

        _logger?.LogInfo($"Can't resolve ExternalCommandHandler.");
        return null;
    }
}

using System.Net.Mail;
using System.Net.Mime;
using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Notifications;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.Notifications;
using MimeKit;
