using SmtpClient = MailKit.Net.Smtp.SmtpClient;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// Email küldő job
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.FrameworkTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class EmailSenderJob : FrameworkTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the cron expression.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The cron expression.
    /// </value>
    protected override string CronExpression => Config.TryGetStringValue($"{JobName}.CronExpression") ?? "0 * * * * ?";

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant running mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.Both;



    /// <summary>
    /// Job trigger time elapsed, running the job
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        TemplateEntity templateEntityAlias = null!;

        SendEmail(
            title: "NewUserTemplate",
            subject: "KEP regisztráció",
            scope: scope,
            templateEntityAlias: templateEntityAlias,
            addressesFunc: ListFirstTargetAddress,
            templateParamFunc: GetHtmlTemplateNewUserParam,
            templateHtmlFunc: GetHtmlString);

        SendEmail(
            title: "ForgottenPasswordTemplate",
            subject: "Elfelejtett jelszó",
            scope: scope,
            templateEntityAlias: templateEntityAlias,
            addressesFunc: ListFirstTargetAddress,
            templateParamFunc: GetHtmlTemplatePasswordChangeParam,
            templateHtmlFunc: GetHtmlString);

        SendEmail(
            title: "PasswordChangeTemplate",
            subject: "Jelszó módosítás",
            scope: scope,
            templateEntityAlias: templateEntityAlias,
            addressesFunc: ListFirstTargetAddress,
            templateParamFunc: GetHtmlTemplatePasswordChangeParam,
            templateHtmlFunc: GetHtmlString);
        SendEmail(
            title: "ExpiringPasswordWarningTemplate",
            subject: "Értesítés nemsokára lejáró jelszóról",
            scope: scope,
            templateEntityAlias: templateEntityAlias,
            addressesFunc: ListAllTargetAddresses,
            templateParamFunc: GetHtmlTemplateExpiringPasswordParam,
            templateHtmlFunc: GetHtmlString);

        SendEmail(
            title: "PasswordExpiredTemplate",
            subject: "Értesítés lejárt jelszóról",
            scope: scope,
            templateEntityAlias: templateEntityAlias,
            addressesFunc: ListFirstTargetAddress,
            templateParamFunc: GetHtmlTemplatePasswordChangeParam,
            templateHtmlFunc: GetHtmlString);

        //Alerts (triggered from Monitoring module)
        //TODO: le lehetne kérni az összes alert template nevet és végig iterálni rajtuk, ha már sok lesz...
        SendAlertEmails(
            templateName: Constants.TemplateNames.ConsumptionAlertTemplate,
            subject: "Riasztás",
            scope: scope,
            templateEntityAlias: templateEntityAlias).RunSync();

        //SendAlertEmails(Constants.TemplateNames.NormalizedConsumptionAlertTemplate, "Riasztás", scope, templateEntityAlias: templateEntityAlias).RunSync();
    }

    private async Task SendAlertEmails(string templateName, string subject, ILifetimeScope scope, TemplateEntity templateEntityAlias)
    {
        // Create a new child scope with explicit SecurityContext
        using (var childScope = scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
        {
            childScope.SetAnonymousContext(null);
            var dbContext = childScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

            string tenantCode = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

            using var transaction = dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction();
            try
            {
                var notifications = ListNotificationsByType(dbContext, templateName, templateEntityAlias);
                foreach (var notification in notifications)
                {
                    SetNotificationPending(dbContext, notification);

                    //TODO: ha belsős felhasználó értesítése, akkor is kell email-t küldeni (SecUser-ből visszafejteni az email címet, és arra megy az értesítő)
                    string? recipient = notification.TargetUsers?.FirstOrDefault()?.EMail; //TODO: ez átalakítás alatt van, hogy már csak egy elemű mindig ez a lista, de még listaként van kezelve

                    recipient ??= notification.ExternalEmailAddresses; // ha nincs SecUser, akkor külső email címre küldjük
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(recipient))
                    {
                        Log.LogWarning($"(tenant: {tenantCode}) - No recipient email found for notification with ID {notification.Id} and title {notification.Title}");
                        continue;
                    }

                    try
                    {
                        string body = await GenerateHtmlBodyAsync(notification);
                        SendMail([recipient], subject, body);

                        notification.SendDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
                        notification.NotificationState = NotificationState.Sent;
                        dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(notification);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, $"(tenant: {tenantCode}) - Hiba az email küldés során!");
                        notification.NotificationState = NotificationState.Pending;
                        notification.Retries++;
                        dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(notification);
                        transaction.Commit();
                        throw;
                    }
                }
                transaction.Commit();

                if (templateEntityAlias != null)
                {
                    Log.LogInfo("(tenant: {tenantCode}) - Sent email for {TemplateName} template to {NumberOfRecipients} recipients", templateEntityAlias.Name, notifications.Count);

                }

            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, $"(tenant: {tenantCode}) - EmailSenderJob error");
            }
        }
    }

    private static async Task<string> GenerateHtmlBodyAsync(NotificationEntity notification)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(notification);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(notification.Payload, nameof(notification.Payload));

        Type payloadType = notification.AlertDataType switch
        {
            AlertDataType.Consumption => typeof(ConsumptionAlertNotificationPayload),
            //AlertDataType.NormalizedConsumption=> typeof(...), TODO: erre még nincs model osztály
            //... other payload types
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unsupported AlertDataType: {notification.AlertDataType}")
        };
        object? payloadObj = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(notification.Payload, payloadType)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to deserialize the payload.");

        var razorService = new RazorViewsTemplateService();
        string? body;
        switch (notification.AlertDataType)
        {
            case AlertDataType.Consumption:
                var consumptionPayload = payloadObj as ConsumptionAlertNotificationPayload
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Payload is not of type ConsumptionAlertNotificationPayload.");
                await ResolveAlertModelValues(consumptionPayload, notification);
                body = await razorService.CompileRenderStringAsync(notification.HtmlTemplate.HtmlContent, consumptionPayload);
                break;

            //case AlertDataType.NormalizedConsumption: ... TODO

            default:
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unsupported AlertDataType: {notification.AlertDataType}");
        }

        return body;
    }
    private static async Task ResolveAlertModelValues<TModel>(TModel model, NotificationEntity notification)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(model, nameof(model));

        switch (model)
        {
            case ConsumptionAlertNotificationPayload consumptionAlertModel:
                consumptionAlertModel.Addressee = ResolveAlertAddresseee(notification);
                //TODO: resolve other properties if needed...
                break;
            default:
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unsupported type: {model.GetType()}");
        }
    }

    private static string ResolveAlertAddresseee(NotificationEntity notification)
    {
        var user = notification.TargetUsers?.FirstOrDefault();
        if (user != null)
        {
            return $"{user.FirstName}"; //TODO megszólítás milyen formátumú?
        }
        return "Címzett"; //ha nincs rendszerbeli user, akkor visszaadunk egy alapértelmezett szöveget (pl. ha külsős email volt megadva, nem tudjuk a nevét)
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Sends the mail.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="addresses">The addresses.</param>
    /// <param name="subjectTxt">The subject text.</param>
    /// <param name="bodyTxt">The body text.</param>
    /// <param name="img">The img.</param>
    private static void SendMail(List<string> addresses, string subjectTxt, string bodyTxt, byte[]? img = null)
    {
        string smtpHost = Config.TryGetStringValue("SmtpHost", false) ?? string.Empty;
        int smtpPort = Config.TryGetIntValue("SmtpPort", false) ?? 25;
        string smtpCredentialsUserName = Config.TryGetStringValue("SmtpCredentialsUserName", false) ?? string.Empty;
        string smtpCredentialsPw = Config.TryGetStringValue("SmtpCredentialsPw", false) ?? string.Empty;
        string mailFrom = Config.TryGetStringValue("MailFrom", false) ?? string.Empty;
        bool useSsl = Config.TryGetBoolValue("UseSsl", false) ?? false;

        using var client = new SmtpClient();

        if (!useSsl)
        {
#pragma warning disable S4830 // Server certificates should be verified during SSL/TLS connections
            client.ServerCertificateValidationCallback = (s, c, h, e) => true;
#pragma warning restore S4830 // Server certificates should be verified during SSL/TLS connections
        }

        client.Connect(smtpHost, smtpPort, useSsl);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(smtpCredentialsUserName)) client.Authenticate(smtpCredentialsUserName, smtpCredentialsPw);

        foreach (var adress in addresses)
        {
            var mail = new MailMessage(mailFrom, adress)
            {
                IsBodyHtml = true,
                Subject = subjectTxt,
                Body = bodyTxt
            };

            if (img != null)
            {
                Attachment att = new(new MemoryStream(img), "qrcode.jpg");
                att.ContentDisposition.Inline = true;

                AlternateView avHtml = AlternateView.CreateAlternateViewFromString(bodyTxt, null, MediaTypeNames.Text.Html);

                MemoryStream ms = new(img);
                LinkedResource inline = new(ms, MediaTypeNames.Image.Jpeg)
                {
                    ContentId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString()
                };
                avHtml.LinkedResources.Add(inline);

                mail.AlternateViews.Add(avHtml);
                att.ContentDisposition.Inline = true;
                mail.Attachments.Add(att);
            }

            var mimeMessage = MimeMessage.CreateFromMailMessage(mail);

            client.Send(mimeMessage);
        }

        client.Disconnect(true);

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sends the email.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="title">The title.</param>
    /// <param name="subject">The subject.</param>
    private static void SendEmail(string title, string subject, ILifetimeScope scope, TemplateEntity templateEntityAlias,
        Func<NotificationEntity, List<string>>? addressesFunc = null,
        Func<NotificationEntity, ILifetimeScope, object>? templateParamFunc = null,
        Func<NotificationEntity, string, object, string>? templateHtmlFunc = null)
    {
        // Create a new child scope with explicit SecurityContext
        using (var childScope = scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
        {
            childScope.SetAnonymousContext(null);
            var dbContext = childScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

            string tenantCode = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

            using var transaction = dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction();
            try
            {
                var notifications = ListNotificationsByType(dbContext, title, templateEntityAlias);

                if (addressesFunc == null)
                {
                    addressesFunc = ListFirstTargetAddress;
                }

                if (templateParamFunc == null)
                {
                    templateParamFunc = GetHtmlTemplatePasswordChangeParam;
                }

                if (templateHtmlFunc == null)
                {
                    templateHtmlFunc = GetHtmlString;
                }

                foreach (var notification in notifications)
                {
                    SetNotificationPending(dbContext, notification);

                    var addresses = addressesFunc(notification);
                    var param = templateParamFunc(notification, scope);
                    var html = templateHtmlFunc(notification, title, param);


                    try
                    {
                        SendMail(addresses, subject, html, notification.Param);
                        notification.SendDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
                        notification.NotificationState = NotificationState.Sent;
                        dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(notification);

                        //Ha kimentek a figyelmeztető mailek
                        if (title == "ExpiringPasswordWarningTemplate")
                            SetWarningMail(notification.TargetUsers);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, $"(tenant: {tenantCode}) - Hiba az email küldés során!");
                        notification.NotificationState = NotificationState.Pending;
                        notification.Retries++;
                        dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(notification);
                        if (title == "ExpiringPasswordWarningTemplate")
                            SetWarningMail(notification.TargetUsers);
                        transaction.Commit();
                        throw;
                    }
                }
                transaction.Commit();

                if (templateEntityAlias != null)
                {
                    Log.LogInfo("(tenant: {tenantCode}) - Sent email for {TemplateName} template to {NumberOfRecipients} recipients", templateEntityAlias.Name, notifications.Count);

                }

            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, $"(tenant: {tenantCode}) - EmailSenderJob error");
            }
        }
    }

    private static List<string> ListFirstTargetAddress(NotificationEntity notification)
    {
        return new List<string>() { notification.TargetUsers.FirstOrDefault()?.EMail };
    }

    private static List<string> ListAllTargetAddresses(NotificationEntity notification)
    {
        return notification.TargetUsers.Select(x => x.EMail).ToList();
    }

    private static string GetHtmlString(NotificationEntity notification, string title, object param)
    {
        Task<string>? html;
        var razorVTS = new RazorViewsTemplateService();

        var htmlTask = razorVTS.CompileRenderStringAsync(title, notification.HtmlTemplate.HtmlContent, param);

        return htmlTask.Result;
    }

    private static object GetHtmlTemplateExpiringPasswordParam(NotificationEntity notification, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var daysCount = scope.Config().TryGetIntValue("ExpiringPasswordWarning.RemainingDays") ?? 30;

        return new
        {
            ExpireDays = daysCount.ToString()
        };
    }

    private static object GetHtmlTemplateNewUserParam(NotificationEntity notification, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var frameworkBaseUrl = Config.TryGetStringValue("FrameworkBaseUrl", false) ?? string.Empty;
        var urlWithToken = $"{ (frameworkBaseUrl.StartsWith("http") ? "" : "https://")}{frameworkBaseUrl}/registration/?token={notification.Description}";

        var targetUser = notification.TargetUsers.FirstOrDefault();
        var addresseeName = $"{targetUser?.LastName ?? string.Empty} {targetUser?.FirstName}";
        return new
        {
            Addressee = addresseeName,
            Url = urlWithToken,
            Email = targetUser.EMail,
            Phone = targetUser.Phone
        };
    }

    private static object GetHtmlTemplatePasswordChangeParam(NotificationEntity notification, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var frameworkBaseUrl = Config.TryGetStringValue("FrameworkBaseUrl", false) ?? string.Empty;
        var urlWithToken = $"{(frameworkBaseUrl.StartsWith("http") ? "" : "https://")}{frameworkBaseUrl}/password-change/?token={notification.Description}";

        var targetUser = notification.TargetUsers.FirstOrDefault();
        var addresseeName = $"{targetUser?.LastName ?? string.Empty} {targetUser?.FirstName}";

        return new
        {
            Addressee = addresseeName,
            Email = targetUser.EMail,
            Url = urlWithToken,
            Phone = targetUser.Phone
        };
    }


    private static IList<NotificationEntity> ListNotificationsByType(IDbContext dbContext, string title, TemplateEntity templateEntityAlias)
    {
        return dbContext
               .Session
               .QueryOver<NotificationEntity>()
               .JoinAlias(x => x.HtmlTemplate, () => templateEntityAlias)
               .Where(x =>
                   x.NotificationType == NotificationType.Email &&
                   x.NotificationState == NotificationState.Pending &&
                   x.Title == title &&
                   x.Retries < 5)
               .List();
    }

    private static void SetNotificationPending(IDbContext dbContext, NotificationEntity notification)
    {
        notification.NotificationState = NotificationState.InProgress;
        dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(notification);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the warning mail.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="targetUsers">The target users.</param>
    private static void SetWarningMail(IList<SecUserEntity> targetUsers)
    {
        targetUsers
            .ToList()
            .ForEach(x => x.WarningMail = false);
    }
}

using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Utils.Excel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.EnergyPerformance.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.EnergyPerformanceImport;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Room;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
public sealed class EnergeticDataImportValidationJob : ImportValidationJob<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>
{
   protected override async Task<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult?> FillValidationData(byte[] filebytes, EnergeticDataImportValidationResult original)
    {
        var now = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);

        var roomenergeticDataModels = ParseExcelData<RoomEnergeticDataImportModel>(filebytes);
        var entityDtos = roomenergeticDataModels
            .Where(x => x.RoomId != 0)
            .Select(x =>
            {
                var entityDto = _mapper.Map<RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto>(x);
                entityDto.InspectionDate = now;
                return entityDto;
            }).ToList();
        original.EnergeticData = entityDtos;

        var energyConsumptionDeviceModels = ParseExcelData<EnergyConsumptionDeviceImportModel>(filebytes);
        var deviceDtoTasks = energyConsumptionDeviceModels
            .Where(x => x.OrgunitId != "0")
            .Select(async (x, index) =>
            {
                var entityDto = _mapper.Map<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>(x);
                entityDto.InspectionDate = now;
                entityDto.OrgunitBase = await GetOrgunitId(x, index);
                return entityDto;
            });

        original.Devices = (await Task.WhenAll(deviceDtoTasks)).ToList();

        return original;
    }
    private async Task<EntityRef<OrgunitBaseEntityDto>> GetOrgunitId(EnergyConsumptionDeviceImportModel model,int index)
    {
        if (model.OrgunitIdAsGuid.HasValue)
        {
            var result =await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new OrgunitBaseIdQuery 
            {
                Identifier = Guid.Parse(model.OrgunitId)

            }) as OrgunitBaseIdQueryResult;
            return result.Id;
        }
        else 
        {
            var idProperty = model.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(EnergyConsumptionDeviceImportModel.OrgunitId));
            AddErrorMessage(idProperty, "A topológiai aznosító nem található az adatbázisban!", model.OrgunitId, index + 1);
            return null;
        }
    }

    protected override async Task ValidateData(EnergeticDataImportValidationResult data)
    {
        var energeticTasks = data.EnergeticData
            .Select(x => _commandService.UpdateEntityAsync(x))
            .Cast<Task>();

        var deviceTasks = data.Devices
            .Select(x => _commandService.UpdateEntityAsync(x))
            .Cast<Task>();

        await Task.WhenAll(energeticTasks.Concat(deviceTasks));
    } 
}

using Autofac;

/// <summary>
/// Lejár jelszó figyelés
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.FrameworkTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class ExpiredPasswordJob : FrameworkTimerServiceBase

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the cron expression.
    /// </summary>

    /// The cron expression.
    /// </value>
    protected override string CronExpression => Config.TryGetStringValue($"{JobName}.CronExpression") ?? "0 * * * * ?";

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant running mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantIndependent;

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var schema = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

        try
        {
            var expirationTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue("PasswordPolicy.ExpirationTimeSpan", true) ?? TimeSpan.FromDays(90);

            TenantEntity? tenant = null;
            var users = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
                 .JoinAlias(x => x.Tenants, () => tenant)
                     .Where(x => x.PasswordLastModify < DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-expirationTimeSpan.Days) && !x.WarningMail)
                     .List();

            if (users != null && users.Any())
            {
                foreach (var user in users)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var fPwManager = new PasswordNotificationManager();
                        fPwManager.ExpiringPassword(scope, user.EMail).RunSync();
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Log.LogError(ex.Message, "Password expiration email notification problem.");
                        throw;
                    }
                }

            }

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, $"(schema: {schema}) - ExpiredPasswordJob Hiba");
        }
    }
}

    private const string JOB_ID = "JobId";

    private IQueryService _queryService;
    private ICommandService _commandService;


    public static void PostJob(SecurityContext securityContext, IDbContext dbContext, string tenantCode, int Id)
    {
        JobSecurityContext? jobSecurityContext = GetJobSecurityContext(securityContext);

        var key = $"{nameof(ImportFinalizerJob<TValidation>)}_{tenantCode}";
        var defaultJobData = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                {TENANT_CODE, tenantCode},
                {JOB_ID, Id},
                {JobSecurityContextKey, jobSecurityContext},
            };

        JobHelper.PostJob<ImportFinalizerJob<TValidation>>(dbContext, key, defaultJobData);
    }

    protected override Task ExecuteJob(IJobExecutionContext context, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var jobData = context.JobDetail.JobDataMap;

        _queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        _commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();

        var tenantCode = jobData.GetString(TENANT_CODE);
        var jobId = jobData.GetInt(JOB_ID);

        if (_queryService.GetById<ImportJobResultEntityDto<TValidation>>(jobId) is ImportJobResultEntityDto<TValidation> jobResult)
        {
            try
            {
                _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new BatchImportCommand<TValidation>() { Data = jobResult.Data });
                SetJobState(jobResult, JobResultStatus.Finalized);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                SetJobState(jobResult, JobResultStatus.Failed);
            }
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

        jobResult.Status = status;
        _commandService.UpdateEntity(jobResult);
    }

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Import;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
public abstract class ImportJobBase : JobBase
{
    protected async Task SetJobState<T>(
                                    IQueryService queryService,
                                    ICommandService commandService,
                                    Guid jobId,
                                    JobResultStatus status,
                                    T? data = default,
                                    List<ExcelImportErrorModel>? errorlist = null) where T : IValidationData, new()
    {
        var jobResult = (await queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new ImportJobResultEntityQuery<T>()
        {
            JobId = jobId,
        }))?.Entity;

        if (jobResult is ImportJobResultEntityDto<T> jobResultDto)
        {
            jobResultDto.Status = status;
            jobResultDto.ErrorList = errorlist ?? [];
            jobResultDto.Data = data ?? jobResultDto.Data;

            commandService.UpdateEntity(jobResultDto);
        }
    }

    protected async Task<ImportJobResultEntityDto<T>> GetImportJobResult<T>(
                                    IQueryService queryService,
                                    Guid jobId) where T : IValidationData, new()
    {
        var jobResult = (await queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new ImportJobResultEntityQuery<T>()
        {
            JobId = jobId,
        }))?.Entity as ImportJobResultEntityDto<T>;

        return jobResult;
    }

    protected ExcelImportErrorModel SheetImportError(string sheet, Exception ex)
    {
        return new ExcelImportErrorModel
        {
            SheetTitle = sheet,
            Row = 0,
            Column = 0,
            ColumnId = "",
            ErrorMessage = $"{sheet} adatok importálása sikertelen. ({ex.Message})", //TODO: ex.Message magyarítás, vagy egyéb konverzió?
            OriginalValueAsString = "",
            TargetPropertyName = "",
        };
    }
}

using System.Reflection;
using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using ClosedXML.Excel;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Utils.Excel;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Bibliography;
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Spreadsheet;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Models.Job;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
public abstract class ImportValidationJob<TValidation> : ImportJobBase where TValidation : IValidationData,new()
{
    private const string TENANT_CODE = "TenantCode";
    private const string JOB_ID = "JobId";
    private const string ORGUNIT_IMPORT = "ImportData";
    private const string FILE_NAME = "FileName";

    private int _skipRow;
    private string _sheetTitle;


    protected IQueryService _queryService;
    protected ICommandService _commandService;
    protected IMapper _mapper;
    protected List<ExcelImportErrorModel> _errorlist = [];

    public static void PostJob<TImportValidationJob>(SecurityContext securityContext,
                             IDbContext dbContext,
                             string tenantCode,
                             Guid jobId,
                             string fileName,
                             byte[] fileBytes) where TImportValidationJob : ImportValidationJob<TValidation>, new()
    {
        
        JobSecurityContext? jobSecurityContext = GetJobSecurityContext(securityContext);
        var key = $"{nameof(ImportValidationJob<TValidation>)}_{tenantCode}";
        var defaultJobData = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                {TENANT_CODE, tenantCode},
                {JOB_ID, jobId},
                {ORGUNIT_IMPORT, fileBytes},
                {FILE_NAME, fileName},
                {JobSecurityContextKey, jobSecurityContext},
            };

        JobHelper.PostJob<TImportValidationJob>(dbContext, key, defaultJobData);
    }
    protected override async Task ExecuteJob(IJobExecutionContext context, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        _mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
        var jobData = context.JobDetail.JobDataMap;

        _queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        _commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();

        var tenantCode = jobData.GetString(TENANT_CODE);
        var jobId = Guid.Parse(jobData.GetString(JOB_ID)!);
        var fileBytes = (byte[])jobData[ORGUNIT_IMPORT];
        var fileName = jobData.GetString(FILE_NAME);

        var originalJobResult = await GetImportJobResult<TValidation>(_queryService, jobId);
        await SetJobState<TValidation>(_queryService, _commandService, jobId, JobResultStatus.Validating, originalJobResult.Data);

        try
        {
            var data = await FillValidationData(fileBytes, originalJobResult.Data);
            _commandService.TryDbAction(() =>
            {
                ValidateData(data);
            });

            await SetJobState<TValidation>(_queryService, _commandService, jobId, JobResultStatus.Validated, data, _errorlist);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {

            await SetJobState<TValidation>(_queryService, _commandService, jobId, JobResultStatus.Failed, errorlist: _errorlist);
        }
    }

    protected IList<TImportModel> ParseExcelData<TImportModel>(byte[] fileBytes) where TImportModel : IGenericImportModel, new()
    {
        var type = typeof(TImportModel);
        var sheetAttr = type.GetCustomAttribute<ExcelSheet>();
        var skipAttr = type.GetCustomAttribute<ExcelRowSkip>();

        if (sheetAttr is null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException($"{typeof(TImportModel).Name} must have {nameof(ExcelSheet)} attribute.");
        if (skipAttr is null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException($"{typeof(TImportModel).Name} must have {nameof(ExcelRowSkip)} attribute.");

        _skipRow = skipAttr.RowsToSkip;
        _sheetTitle = sheetAttr.SheetName;

        try
        {
            return ExcelImport.ImportBytes<TImportModel>(fileBytes, _sheetTitle, false, _skipRow, CellFilter).ToList();
        }
        catch (ExcelImportException importEx) 
        { 
            _errorlist.AddRange(BackendExcelImportHelper.ConvertImportErrors<TImportModel>(importEx.Errors));
            return new List<TImportModel>();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _errorlist.Add(SheetImportError(sheetAttr.SheetName, ex));
            return new List<TImportModel>();
        }
    }


    protected void AddErrorMessage(MemberInfo property, string errorMessage, string value, int row)
    {
        var excelImport = property?.GetCustomAttribute<ExcelImportAttribute>();
        var display = property?.GetCustomAttribute<System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.DisplayAttribute>();
        _errorlist.Add(new ExcelImportErrorModel()
        {
            SheetTitle = _sheetTitle,
            Row = row + _skipRow,
            Column = excelImport?.ColumnIndex ?? -1,
            ColumnId = excelImport?.ColumnId ?? "Nem ismert!",
            OriginalValueAsString = value,
            TargetPropertyName = display?.Name ?? "Nem ismert!",
            ErrorMessage = errorMessage,
        });
    }
    protected abstract Task ValidateData(TValidation data);
    protected abstract Task<TValidation?> FillValidationData(byte[] fileBytes, TValidation data);
    protected virtual bool CellFilter(IXLCell data) { return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(data.Value.ToString()); } 
}

    private const string ORGUNIT_IMPORT = "ImportData";
    private const string FILE_NAME = "FileName";

    private IQueryService _queryService;
    private ICommandService _commandService;
    private OrgunitDataValidationHandler _validationHandler;


    public static void PostJob(SecurityContext securityContext,
                               IDbContext dbContext,
                               string tenantCode,
                               Guid jobId,
                               string fileName,
                               byte[] fileBytes)
    {
        JobSecurityContext? jobSecurityContext = GetJobSecurityContext(securityContext);

        var key = $"{nameof(OrgunitImportDataProcessorJob)}_{tenantCode}";
        var defaultJobData = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                {TENANT_CODE, tenantCode},
                {JOB_ID, jobId},
                {ORGUNIT_IMPORT, fileBytes},
                {FILE_NAME, fileName},
                {JobSecurityContextKey, jobSecurityContext},
            };

        JobHelper.PostJob<OrgunitImportDataProcessorJob>(dbContext, key, defaultJobData);
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteJob(IJobExecutionContext context, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var jobData = context.JobDetail.JobDataMap;

        _queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        _commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();

        var tenantCode = jobData.GetString(TENANT_CODE);
        var jobId = Guid.Parse(jobData.GetString(JOB_ID)!);
        var fileBytes = (byte[])jobData[ORGUNIT_IMPORT];
        var fileName = jobData.GetString(FILE_NAME);

        await SetJobState(jobId, JobResultStatus.Validating);


        List<ExcelImportErrorModel> errorlist = [];
        try
        {
            OrgunitImportFormatValidationResult result = StartImportWithFormatValidation(fileBytes, errorlist);
            OrgunitImportDataValidationResult? data = null;
            if (errorlist.Count == 0)
            {
                _commandService.TryDbAction(() =>
                {
                    _validationHandler = scope.Resolve<OrgunitDataValidationHandler>();
                    data = _validationHandler.StartDataValidation(result, errorlist);
                });
            }

            if (errorlist.Count == 0)
            {
                await SetJobState(jobId, JobResultStatus.Validated, data, errorlist);
            }
            else
            {
                await SetJobState(jobId, JobResultStatus.Failed, errorlist: errorlist);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            //az eddig nem kezelt hibákat (pl. fájl olvashatatlan, stb) egy általános hibává alakítjuk, és a hibalistába tesszük
            var fileImportError = new ExcelImportErrorModel
            {
                SheetTitle = "",
                Row = 0,
                Column = 0,
                ColumnId = "",
                ErrorMessage = $"A fájl importálása sikertelen. ({ex.Message})", //TODO: ex.Message magyarítás, vagy egyéb konverzió?
#if DEBUG
                OriginalValueAsString = $"DEBUG stack trace:{Environment.NewLine}{ex.StackTrace}", //hibakereséshez DEBUG-ban visszaadhatjuk a stack trace-t
#else
                OriginalValueAsString = "",
#endif
                TargetPropertyName = "",
            };
            errorlist.Add(fileImportError);

            await SetJobState(jobId, JobResultStatus.Failed, errorlist: errorlist);
        }


    }


    internal static OrgunitImportFormatValidationResult StartImportWithFormatValidation(byte[] fileBytes, List<ExcelImportErrorModel> errors)
    {
        OrgunitImportFormatValidationResult result = new();

        //TODO: ha nem ExcelImportException történik, akkor valami egészen más probléma van, pl. hibás a fájl, nem létezik a kért sheet, stb.,
        //ami azt is jelenti, hogy nem tudunk egy kész modellt előállítani, amit érdemes lenne beírni az adatbázisba.
        //Ezért szerintem ebben az esetben az egész importálást meg kell szakítani, ezért az egyéb exception-t tovább dobom, a hívó kezelje majd le.

        //Institutions
        try
        {
            result.InstitutionImportModels = ExcelImport.ImportBytes<InstitutionImportModel>(fileBytes, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Institution, false, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetHeaderRow);
        }
        catch (ExcelImportException importEx) { errors.AddRange(BackendExcelImportHelper.ConvertImportErrors<InstitutionImportModel>(importEx.Errors)); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add(SheetImportError(OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Institution, ex));
        }

        //Sites
        try
        {
            result.SiteImportModels = ExcelImport.ImportBytes<SiteImportModel>(fileBytes, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Site, false, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetHeaderRow);
        }
        catch (ExcelImportException importEx) { errors.AddRange(BackendExcelImportHelper.ConvertImportErrors<SiteImportModel>(importEx.Errors)); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add(SheetImportError(OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Site, ex));
        }

        //Buildings
        try
        {
            result.BuildingImportModels = ExcelImport.ImportBytes<BuildingImportModel>(fileBytes, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Building, false, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetHeaderRow);
        }
        catch (ExcelImportException importEx) { errors.AddRange(BackendExcelImportHelper.ConvertImportErrors<BuildingImportModel>(importEx.Errors)); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add(SheetImportError(OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Building, ex));
        }

        //BuildingParts
        try
        {
            result.BuildingPartImportModels = ExcelImport.ImportBytes<BuildingPartImportModel>(fileBytes, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.BuildingPart, false, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetHeaderRow);
        }
        catch (ExcelImportException importEx) { errors.AddRange(BackendExcelImportHelper.ConvertImportErrors<BuildingPartImportModel>(importEx.Errors)); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add(SheetImportError(OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.BuildingPart, ex));
        }

        //Floors
        try
        {
            result.FloorImportModels = ExcelImport.ImportBytes<FloorImportModel>(fileBytes, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Floor, false, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetHeaderRow);
        }
        catch (ExcelImportException importEx) { errors.AddRange(BackendExcelImportHelper.ConvertImportErrors<FloorImportModel>(importEx.Errors)); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add(SheetImportError(OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Floor, ex));
        }

        //Rooms
        try
        {
            result.RoomImportModels = ExcelImport.ImportBytes<RoomImportModel>(fileBytes, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Room, false, OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetHeaderRow);
        }
        catch (ExcelImportException importEx) { errors.AddRange(BackendExcelImportHelper.ConvertImportErrors<RoomImportModel>(importEx.Errors)); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errors.Add(SheetImportError(OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Room, ex));
        }

        return result;
    }

    //ha már az adott sheet-et se tudjuk beolvasni, akkor egy általánosabb hibát adunk, de a UI-n szintén a táblázatos jobdetail hibalistában fog megjelenni.
    private static ExcelImportErrorModel SheetImportError(string sheet, Exception ex)
    {
        return new ExcelImportErrorModel
        {
            SheetTitle = sheet,
            Row = 0,
            Column = 0,
            ColumnId = "",
            ErrorMessage = $"{sheet} adatok importálása sikertelen. ({ex.Message})", //TODO: ex.Message magyarítás, vagy egyéb konverzió?
            OriginalValueAsString = "",
            TargetPropertyName = "",
        };
    }


    private async Task SetJobState(Guid jobId,
                                   JobResultStatus status,
                                   OrgunitImportDataValidationResult? data = null,
                                   List<ExcelImportErrorModel>? errorlist = null)
    {
        var jobResult = (await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new OrgunitImportJobResultEntityQuery()
        {
            JobId = jobId,
        }))?.Entity;

        if (jobResult is OrgunitImportJobResultEntityDto jobResultDto)
        {
            jobResultDto.Status = status;
            jobResultDto.ErrorList = errorlist ?? [];
            jobResultDto.Data = data ?? new();

            _commandService.UpdateEntity(jobResultDto);
        }

    }


}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Notifications;
using NHibernate.Util;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// Jelszó figyelmeztetés
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.FrameworkTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class PasswordWarningJob : FrameworkTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the cron expression.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The cron expression.
    /// </value>
    protected override string CronExpression => Config.TryGetStringValue($"{JobName}.CronExpression") ?? "0 6 * * * ?";

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the tenant running mode.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.Both;

    /// <summary>
    /// The template name
    /// </summary>
    private const string TemplateName = "ExpiringPasswordWarningTemplate";

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        string tenantCode = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

        try
        {
            var expirationTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue("PasswordPolicy.ExpirationTimeSpan", true) ?? TimeSpan.FromDays(90);
            var remainingDays = scope.Config().TryGetIntValue("ExpiringPasswordWarning.RemainingDays") ?? 15;
            var daysCount = expirationTimeSpan.Days - remainingDays;

            CheckExpiringPassword(dbContext, daysCount);

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("D_" + ex.GetType().Name, ex, $"(tenant: {tenantCode}) - PasswordWarningJob error");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Checks the expiring password.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="daysCount">The days count.</param>
    private static void CheckExpiringPassword(IDbContext dbContext, int daysCount)
    {
        using var transaction = dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction();
        TenantEntity? tenant = null;
        
        var users = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserEntity>()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Tenants, () => tenant)
            .List()
            .Where(x =>
                x.PasswordLastModify.Date == DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-daysCount).Date &&
                x.PasswordLastModify.Hour == DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-daysCount).Hour &&
                !x.WarningMail)
            .ToList();

        if (users != null && users.Any())
        {
            var template = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<TemplateEntity>()
                           .Where(x => x.Name == TemplateName)
                           .SingleOrDefault();

            foreach (var user in users)
                user.WarningMail = true;

            var notification = new NotificationEntity()
            {
                NotificationSource = NotificationSource.TaskManager,
                NotificationType = NotificationType.Email,
                Title = TemplateName,
                HtmlTemplate = template,
                TargetUsers = users,
                ExpirationDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1),
                SendDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                IsRead = false,
                NotificationState = NotificationState.Pending
            };

            dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(notification);
            transaction.Commit();
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// AbstractEndpointUnitCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TDto">The type of the dto.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;T, TDto&gt;" />
public class AbstractEndpointUnitCommandHandler<T, TDto> : CommandHandlerBase<T, TDto>
    where T : EndpointUnitEntity, new()
    where TDto : EndpointUnitEntityDto, new()
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AbstractEndpointUnitCommandHandler{T, TDto}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    public AbstractEndpointUnitCommandHandler(
        ICommandService commandService,
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<TDto>> validator) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override T ApplyDto(TDto source, T destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is CreateEndpointUnitCommand createEndpointUnitCommand)
            return DoCreateEndpointUnitCommand(createEndpointUnitCommand);

        if (command is ModifyEndpointUnitCommand modifyEndpointUnitCommand)
            return DoModifyEndpointUnitCommand(modifyEndpointUnitCommand);

        if (command is DeleteEndpointUnitCommand deleteEndpointUnitCommand)
            return DoDeleteEndpointUnitCommand(deleteEndpointUnitCommand);

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the create endpoint unit command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoCreateEndpointUnitCommand(CreateEndpointUnitCommand command)
    {
        var endpointUnit = Mapper.Map<EndpointUnitEntity>(command);
        endpointUnit.Channel = DbContext.Session.Load<ChannelEntity>(command.MeasuredEndpointId);
        this.SetGlobalIdentifier((T)endpointUnit);
        this.SetUpTrackedEntity((T)endpointUnit, true);
        int id = (int)DbContext.Session.Save(endpointUnit);

        var schema = DbContext.Session.Get<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntity>(command.Schema.Id);
        var metaDataValues = new List<EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntityDto>();
        
        foreach (var schemaModel in command.EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaModels)
        {
            var property = schema!.Properties?.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Code == schemaModel.Code);
            // Mi van, ha a sémában nem létezik ez a kódú property?

            metaDataValues.Add(new EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntityDto
            {
                Property = Mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto>>(property),
                Value = schemaModel.Value
            });
        };

        EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto metaData = new EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto
        {
            MetaDataSchema = command.Schema,
            EndpointUnit = new EntityRef<EndpointUnitEntityDto> { Id = id },
            MetaDataValues = metaDataValues
        };

        _commandService.CreateEntity(metaData);

        CreateEndpointUnitCommandResult result = new CreateEndpointUnitCommandResult { EndpointUnitEntityDto = _mapper.Map<EndpointUnitEntityDto>(DbContext.Session.Get<EndpointUnitEntity>(id)) };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify endpoint unit command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    private ICommandResult DoModifyEndpointUnitCommand(ModifyEndpointUnitCommand cmd)
    {
        var endpointUnit = DbContext.Session.Get<EndpointUnitEntity>(cmd.Id) 
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(EndpointUnitEntity)} nem található!");

        if(endpointUnit.IsDeleted)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(EndpointUnitEntity)} már törölve lett korábban!");

        endpointUnit.DeviceName = cmd?.DeviceName ?? string.Empty;
        this.SetUpTrackedEntity((T)endpointUnit, false);
        DbContext.Session.Update(endpointUnit);

        // MetaData Property érték módosítás
        if (endpointUnit.MetaData != null)
        {
            var sourceCodeValues = cmd.EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaModels;
            foreach (var metaDataValue in endpointUnit.MetaData!.MetaDataValues)
            {
                var modifiedValue = sourceCodeValues.FirstOrDefault(sc => sc.Code == metaDataValue.Property.Code)?.Value;
                if (metaDataValue.Value != modifiedValue)
                {
                    metaDataValue.Value = modifiedValue;
                    DbContext.Session.Update(metaDataValue);
                }
            }
        }

        var dto = _mapper.Map<EndpointUnitEntityDto>(endpointUnit);
        ModifyEndpointUnitCommandResult result = new() { EndpointUnitEntityDto = dto };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the delete endpoint unit command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">EndpointUnitId - Missing argument</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid EndpointUnitEntity Id. There is no EndpointUnitEntity with Id: '{cmd.EndpointUnitId}'</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    private ICommandResult DoDeleteEndpointUnitCommand(DeleteEndpointUnitCommand cmd)
    {
        if (cmd.EndpointUnitId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(cmd.EndpointUnitId), "Missing argument");

        var endpointUnit = DbContext.Session.Get<EndpointUnitEntity>(cmd.EndpointUnitId);
        if (endpointUnit == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid EndpointUnitEntity Id. There is no EndpointUnitEntity with Id: '{cmd.EndpointUnitId}'");
        if (endpointUnit.IsDeleted)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(EndpointUnitEntity)} már törölve lett korábban!");

        using (var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
        {
            var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
            var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();

            using (var transaction = dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction())
            {
                if (endpointUnit.MetaData.MetaDataValues != null && endpointUnit.MetaData.MetaDataValues.Any())
                    foreach (var val in endpointUnit.MetaData.MetaDataValues)
                        dbContext.Session.Delete(dbContext.Session.Load<EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntity>(val.Id));

                dbContext.Session.Delete(dbContext.Session.Load<EndpointUnitMetaDataEntity>(endpointUnit.MetaData.Id));
                dbContext.Session.Delete(dbContext.Session.Load<EndpointUnitEntity>(endpointUnit.Id));
                transaction.Commit();
            }
        }

        var result = new DeleteEndpointUnitCommandResult();
        return result;
    }
}

        ICommandService commandService,

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntityDto"></param>

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(ChannelEntityDto originalEntityDto, ChannelEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        var resultDto = EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>

    {

        var resultDto = EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, createdEntity.Created!.Value);
        SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, createdEntity.Created!.Value);
        return resultDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ChannelEntityDto EntityPostEvent(ChannelEntityDto savedEntityDto, ChannelEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<ChannelEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        // Config lista mentése
        entity.Configuration ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Configuration,
                     entity.Configuration,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Channel = new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<ChannelConfigValueEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);
        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// ModelTimeSeries rekord létrehozása MeasuredEntityDto létrejöttét követően.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdDto">A frissen létrejött channel, amely létrejöttét követően létrejön az új ModelTimeSeries rekord.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">
    /// Device of Channel with (guid: '{createdDto?.Identifier}') is not found!
    /// or
    /// IoTDeviceType of Device (with guid: '{parentDevice?.Identifier}') is not found!
    /// or
    /// IoTDeviceType with id: '{parentDeviceType.Id}' has no Code!
    /// or
    /// TimeSeriesSchema with code: '{parentDeviceType.Code}' is missing!
    /// </exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException">Unknown {typeof(IoTDeviceTypeEntity)} code: '{parentDeviceType.Code}'.</exception>
    /// <exception cref="NotImplementedException"></exception>
    private List<ModelTimeSeriesEntityDto> CreateModelTimeSeriesDto(ChannelEntityDto createdDto)
    {
        if (createdDto?.Device == null)
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Device of Channel with (guid: '{createdDto?.Identifier}') is not found!");
        }

        var parentDevice = _queryService.GetById<DeviceEntityDto>(createdDto.Device.Id);

        if (parentDevice?.IoTDeviceType == null)
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"IoTDeviceType of Device (with guid: '{parentDevice?.Identifier}') is not found!");
        }

        var parentDeviceType = _queryService.GetById<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>(parentDevice.IoTDeviceType.Id);

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parentDeviceType.Code))
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"IoTDeviceType with id: '{parentDeviceType.Id}' has no Code!");
        }

        var timeSeriesSchemas = new List<TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto>();

        switch (parentDeviceType.Code)
        {
            case Constants.IoTDeviceTypeCodes.SMAPPEE:
                var schema = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TimeSeriesSchemaQuery
                {
                    Code = Constants.TimeSeriesSchemaCodes.CONSUMER_PRODUCER
                })?.Result?.Entity as TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto;
                if (schema != null) timeSeriesSchemas.Add(schema);
                break;
            case Constants.IoTDeviceTypeCodes.OPEN_WEATHER_MAP:
                schema = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TimeSeriesSchemaQuery
                {
                    Code = Constants.TimeSeriesSchemaCodes.WEATHER
                })?.Result?.Entity as TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto;
                if (schema != null) timeSeriesSchemas.Add(schema);
                break;
            case Constants.IoTDeviceTypeCodes.OTHER_SOLAR_PANEL:
            case Constants.IoTDeviceTypeCodes.SOLAREDGE:
                schema = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TimeSeriesSchemaQuery
                {
                    Code = Constants.TimeSeriesSchemaCodes.PRODUCTION
                })?.Result?.Entity as TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto;
                
                if (schema != null)
                    timeSeriesSchemas.Add(schema);
                
                break;
            case Constants.IoTDeviceTypeCodes.OTHER_CONSUMPTION_METER:
                schema = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TimeSeriesSchemaQuery
                {
                    Code = Constants.TimeSeriesSchemaCodes.CONSUMER_PRODUCER
                })?.Result?.Entity as TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto;

                if (schema != null)
                    timeSeriesSchemas.Add(schema);

                break;
            default:
                throw new NotImplementedException($"Unknown {typeof(IoTDeviceTypeEntity)} code: '{parentDeviceType.Code}'.");
        }

        if (timeSeriesSchemas.Count == 0)
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"TimeSeriesSchema with code: '{parentDeviceType.Code}' is missing!");
        }

        var newModelTimeSeries = new List<ModelTimeSeriesEntityDto>();

        foreach ( var schema in timeSeriesSchemas)
        {
            newModelTimeSeries.Add(new ModelTimeSeriesEntityDto
            {
                Identifier = Guid.NewGuid(),
                Type = TimeSeriesType.RealData,
                TimeSeriesSchema = Mapper.Map<EntityRef<TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto>>(schema),
                DeviceType = Mapper.Map<EntityRef<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>>(parentDeviceType),
                Channel = Mapper.Map<EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto>>(createdDto),
                TimeSeriesDataParameters = "{}"
            });
        }

        return newModelTimeSeries;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the create measured endpoint command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid Device Identifier. There is no DeviceEntity with DeviceIdentifier: '{command.DeviceIdentifier}'</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoCreateChannelCommand(CreateChannelCommand command)
    {
        var device = DbContext.Session.Query<DeviceEntity>().SingleOrDefault(d => d.Identifier == command.DeviceIdentifier);
        if (device?.Identifier == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Device Identifier. There is no DeviceEntity with DeviceIdentifier: '{command.DeviceIdentifier}'");

        var entityDto = Mapper.Map<ChannelEntityDto>(command);
        entityDto.Device = Mapper.Map<EntityRef<DeviceEntityDto>>(device);

        var channelEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);

        return new CreateChannelCommandResult { ChannelEntityDto = channelEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozását _követően_ megfutó metódus. Ekkor az entitás már "adatbázisszinten létezik"*.
    /// Gyakran szükséges a frissen létrejött entitást, mint referenciát menteni egy, az entitással "egyszerre" létrejövő
    /// másik típusú entitás adott mezőjébe menteni. Ezt csak akkor tudjuk megtenni, ha létezik az adatbázisban rá "referencia"*.
    /// (* = Természetesen az NHibernate szemszögéből.)
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A létrehozott, DB-ből vissza-lekérdezett entitás DTO-ja.</param>
    /// <param name="source">Forrás, "adatbázisba mentés előtti" entitás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IEntityDto OnEntityCreated<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto createdEntity, TEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        return entityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify measured endpoint command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">Id - Missing argument</exception>
    //private ICommandResult DoModifyChannelCommand(ModifyChannelCommand command)

    //    if (command.Id == 0)

    //    var channel = CreateDto(channelEntity);

    //    channel.Name = command.Name ?? channel.Name;
    //    channel.Description = command.Description ?? channel.Description;
    //    channel.Configuration = command.Configuration ?? channel.Configuration;

    //    var channelDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(channel);
    //    return new ModifyChannelCommandResult { ChannelEntityDto = channelDto };
    //}

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the delete measured endpoint command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">Id - Missing argument</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoDeleteChannelCommand(DeleteChannelCommand command)
    {
        if (command.Id == 0)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument");

        QueryMeasurementEntity(command.Id, command.DeviceIdentifier);

        var channelEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<ChannelEntityDto>(command.Id);

        return new DeleteChannelCommandResult { IsSuccess = channelEntityDto == null || channelEntityDto.IsDeleted };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the measurement entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="deviceIdentifier">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid ChannelEntity Id. There is no ChannelEntity with Id: '{id}' and with Device Identifier: '{deviceIdentifier}'</exception>
    private ChannelEntity QueryMeasurementEntity(int id, Guid deviceIdentifier)
    {
        var channelEntity = DbContext.Session.Query<ChannelEntity>()
            .SingleOrDefault(e => e.Id == id && e.Device != null && e.Device.Identifier == deviceIdentifier && !e.Device.IsDeleted && !e.IsDeleted);
        
        return channelEntity is null
            ? throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid ChannelEntity Id. There is no ChannelEntity with Id: '{id}' and with Device Identifier: '{deviceIdentifier}'")
            : channelEntity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override ChannelEntity ApplyDto(ChannelEntityDto source, ChannelEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        // A mérési ponthoz tartozó eszköz
        LoadRef(x => x.Device, entity, source.Device!);

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sends the synchronize message.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dateOfModification">The date of modification.</param>
    private void SendSyncMessage(DateTime dateOfModification)
    {
        DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() =>
            // A Channel változása nem triggerel változást a hozzá
            // kapcsolódó eszközben, így nem fut meg a szinkronizáció.
            // Hívjunk szinkronizációt az eszközökre, ha létrejön, vagy változik
            // egy Channel.
            SyncHelper.SendSyncMessage(
                typeof(DeviceEntityDto).EntityTypeName(),
                dateOfModification, 
                DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName));
    }
}
