using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.SiteLocation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.SiteLocation;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// IoT eszköz entitások command handler-e
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.DeviceEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.DeviceEntityDto&gt;" />
public class DeviceCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<DeviceEntity, DeviceEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// The ti cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiCache;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _monitoringClientService;
    private readonly DataReceiverApiClientService _dataReceiverClientService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DeviceCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    public DeviceCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<DeviceEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        DataReceiverApiClientService dataReceiverClientService,
        IQueryService queryService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        _tiCache = tiDictCache;
        _queryService = queryService;
        _monitoringClientService = monitoringApiClientService;
        _dataReceiverClientService = dataReceiverClientService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandlerBase ősosztály ApplyDto metódus override-ja az eszközhöz kapcsolódó mentési logika elvégzéséhez.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">Missing argument: {nameof(source.IoTDeviceType)}</exception>
    protected override DeviceEntity ApplyDto(DeviceEntityDto source, DeviceEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        if (source.IoTDeviceType == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException($"Missing argument: {nameof(source.IoTDeviceType)}");

        // IoTDeviceType referencia "mappolása" mentéséhez.
        LoadRef(x => x.IoTDeviceType, entity, source.IoTDeviceType);

        LoadRef(x => x.MeasurementPoint, entity, source.MeasurementPoint);

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ősosztály metódusának override-ja.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            AddDeviceToSiteLocationCommand addDeviceToSiteLocationCommand => DoAddDeviceToSiteLocationCommand(addDeviceToSiteLocationCommand),
            RemoveDeviceFromSiteLocationCommand removeCommand => DoRemoveDeviceFromSiteLocationCommand(removeCommand),
            //DeviceAutoRegistrationCommand autoRegistrationCommand => DoDeviceAutoRegistrationCommand(autoRegistrationCommand),
            AddDeviceToOrgunitLocationCommand addCommand => DoAddDeviceToOrgunitCommand(addCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoAddDeviceToOrgunitCommand(AddDeviceToOrgunitLocationCommand addCommand)
    {
        DeviceEntityDto device = Mapper.Map<DeviceEntityDto>(addCommand);

        var query = new SiteLocationQuery() 
        {
            ParentIdentifier = addCommand.OrgunitIdentifier,
        };
        var siteLocation = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(query).Result?.Entity as SiteLocationEntityDto
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(SiteLocationEntity)} nem található!");

        var entity = _commandService.CreateEntity(device);

        return new AddDeviceToOrgunitLocationCommandResult
        {
            DeviceEntityDto = entity
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz hozzáadása adott Mérési hely alá.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    private ICommandResult DoAddDeviceToSiteLocationCommand(AddDeviceToSiteLocationCommand cmd)
    {
        var siteLocation = DbContext.Session.Get<SiteLocationEntity>(cmd.SiteLocationId) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(SiteLocationEntity)} nem található!");
        var device = DbContext.Session.Get<DeviceEntity>(cmd.DeviceId) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(DeviceEntity)} nem található!");
        DbContext.Session.Update(device);

        AddDeviceToSiteLocationCommandResult result = new();
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz eltávolítása adott mérési hely alól
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">
    /// Az eszköz nem lett hozzárendelve a fizikai mérési helyhez!
    /// </exception>
    private ICommandResult DoRemoveDeviceFromSiteLocationCommand(RemoveDeviceFromSiteLocationCommand cmd)
    {
        var siteLocation = DbContext.Session.Get<SiteLocationEntity>(cmd.SiteLocationId) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(SiteLocationEntity)} nem található!");
        var device = DbContext.Session.Get<DeviceEntity>(cmd.DeviceId) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(DeviceEntity)} nem található!");

        if (siteLocation.IoTDevices != null && siteLocation.IoTDevices.Any() && siteLocation.IoTDevices.Contains(device))
        {
            DbContext.Session.Update(device);

            RemoveDeviceFromSiteLocationCommandResult result = new();
            return result;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Az eszköz nem lett hozzárendelve a fizikai mérési helyhez!");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Konfigurációs értékek lekérdezése eszközhöz
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="domainEntity">IoT eszköz entitás, mint forrás</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static IDictionary<string, string> GetConfiguration(DeviceEntity domainEntity)
    {
        var config = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        if (domainEntity.ConfigValues != null)
            foreach (var domainEntityConfigValue in domainEntity.ConfigValues)
                config.Add(domainEntityConfigValue.Config.Code, domainEntityConfigValue.Value);


        Log.LogInfo($"Getting configuration for device: {domainEntity.DeviceName} (Id: {domainEntity.Id}). - {((config.Count > 0) ? "Configuration has value!" : "Configuration is missing or empty!")}");
        return config;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandlerBase ősosztály metódusának override-ja, új DeviceEntity létrejötte után
    /// hívódik meg közvetlenül, a adatbázisok közötti szinkronizáció végrehajtását indítja.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override DeviceEntityDto OnEntityCreated(DeviceEntityDto createdEntity, DeviceEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, createdEntity.Created!.Value);
        SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, createdEntity.Created!.Value);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityCreating(DeviceEntityDto entity, DeviceEntity domainEntity)
    {
        entity.Identifier = Guid.NewGuid();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandlerBase ősosztály metódusának override-ja, DeviceEntity módosulása után
    /// hívódik meg közvetlenül, konfigurációs értékek módosítását, és az adatbázisok közötti szinkronizációját végzi.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(DeviceEntityDto originalEntity, DeviceEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntity, originalEntity);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, updatedEntity.Modified!.Value);
        SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, updatedEntity.Modified!.Value);
    }

    private DeviceEntityDto EntityPostEvent(DeviceEntityDto savedEntityDto, DeviceEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<DeviceEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        // Konfigurációk mentése
        entity.ConfigValues ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.ConfigValues,
                     entity.ConfigValues,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Device = new EntityRef<DeviceEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<DeviceConfigValueEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        // Mérési csatornák mentése
        entity.Channels ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Channels,
                     entity.Channels,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Device = new EntityRef<DeviceEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<ChannelEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);
        return savedEntityDto;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// EndpointUnitMetaDataCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.EndpointUnitMetaDataEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto&gt;" />
public class EndpointUnitMetaDataCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<EndpointUnitMetaDataEntity, EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EndpointUnitMetaDataCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public EndpointUnitMetaDataCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override EndpointUnitMetaDataEntity ApplyDto(EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto source, EndpointUnitMetaDataEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        
        // EntityRef handle
        LoadRef(x => x.EndpointUnit!, entity, source.EndpointUnit!);
        LoadRef(x => x.MetaDataSchema!, entity, source.MetaDataSchema!);

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto OnEntityCreated(EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto createdEntity, EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto source)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto originalEntity, EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto EntityPostEvent(EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto savedEntityDto, EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<EndpointUnitMetaDataEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        if (source.MetaDataValues != null)
        {
            entity.MetaDataValues ??= new List<EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntity>();

            ICollection<EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntity> deletedElements;

            ListHelper.MergeList(source.MetaDataValues,
                entity.MetaDataValues, (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id, dto =>
                {
                    dto.EndpointUnitMetaData = new EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                    var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                    return DbContext.Session.Load<EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                }, out deletedElements);

            foreach (var measurementLocation in source.MetaDataValues.Where(x => x.Id != 0))
            {
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(measurementLocation);
            }

            foreach (var deletedElement in deletedElements)
            {
                _commandService.DeleteEntity<EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntityDto>(deletedElement.Id);
            }
        }

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }
}

// TODO: Erre nem lesz majd szükség, a séma mentésekor annak a command handlerje menti a propertyket
/// <summary>
/// EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto&gt;" />

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto&gt;" />
public class EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntity, EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto OnEntityCreated(EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto createdEntity, EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto source)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto originalEntity, EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntity ApplyDto(EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto source, EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto EntityPostEvent(EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto savedEntityDto, EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        if (source.Properties != null)
        {
            entity.Properties ??= new List<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntity>();

            ICollection<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntity> deletedElements;

            ListHelper.MergeList(source.Properties,
                entity.Properties, (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id, dto =>
                {
                    dto.EndpointUnitMetaDataSchema = new EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                    var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                    return DbContext.Session.Load<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                }, out deletedElements);

            foreach (var measurementLocation in source.Properties.Where(x => x.Id != 0))
            {
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(measurementLocation);
            }

            foreach (var deletedElement in deletedElements)
            {
                _commandService.DeleteEntity<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto>(deletedElement.Id);
            }
        }

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// IoTDeviceTypeCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.IoTDeviceTypeEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto&gt;" />
public class IoTDeviceTypeCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<IoTDeviceTypeEntity, IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// The ti dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// The mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDeviceTypeCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    public IoTDeviceTypeCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is IoTDeviceTypeCreateCommand createCommand)
            return DoIoTDeviceTypeCreateCommand(createCommand);

        if (command is IoTDeviceTypeModifyCommand modifyCommand)
            return DoIoTDeviceTypeModifyCommand(modifyCommand);

        if (command is IoTDeviceTypeDeleteCommand deleteCommand)
            return DoIoTDeviceTypeDeleteCommand(deleteCommand);

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the io t device type delete command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Missing argument: - DeviceTypeCode</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoIoTDeviceTypeDeleteCommand(IoTDeviceTypeDeleteCommand command)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.DeviceTypeCode))
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Missing argument:", nameof(command.DeviceTypeCode));

        IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto? iotDeviceType = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new IoTDeviceTypeQuery { Code = command.DeviceTypeCode }).Result?.Entity as IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto;
        if (iotDeviceType == null || iotDeviceType.IsDeleted)
            return null;    // Amennyiben nem találtuk meg a törlendő eszköztípus példányt. Amennyiben már (logikailag) törölve volt, akkor is ide esünk be.

        iotDeviceType = _commandService.DeleteEntity<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>(iotDeviceType.Id);
        return new IoTDeviceTypeDeleteCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (iotDeviceType == null) || iotDeviceType.IsDeleted
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the io t device type modify command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Missing argument: - DeviceTypeCode</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">
    /// Invalid IoT DeviceType Code. There is no IoT DeviceType with DeviceTypeCode: '{command.DeviceTypeCode}'
    /// or
    /// The IoTDeviceType with code: '{command.DeviceTypeCode}' has already generated IoTDeviceData, so modifying it's DeviceTypeCode is forbidden!
    /// </exception>
    private ICommandResult DoIoTDeviceTypeModifyCommand(IoTDeviceTypeModifyCommand command)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.DeviceTypeCode))
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Missing argument:", nameof(command.DeviceTypeCode));

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new IoTDeviceTypeQuery
        {
            Code = command.DeviceTypeCode
        }).Result?.Entity is not IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto iotDeviceType || iotDeviceType.IsDeleted)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid IoT DeviceType Code. There is no IoT DeviceType with DeviceTypeCode: '{command.DeviceTypeCode}'");

        //TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto? modifiedDeviceCategory = null;

        if (command.DeviceTypeCode != iotDeviceType.Code)
            throw new ArgumentException($"The IoTDeviceType with code: '{command.DeviceTypeCode}' has already generated IoTDeviceData, so modifying it's DeviceTypeCode is forbidden!");

        // Ha a DeviceTypeName változott...
        if (command.DeviceTypeName != iotDeviceType.DeviceTypeName)
            iotDeviceType.DeviceTypeName = command.DeviceTypeName;

        // Ha a DeviceCategory változott...
        //if (modifiedDeviceCategory != null)//TODO: Refaktor, mert ez mindig null, nincs lekérve
        //    iotDeviceType.DeviceCategory = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>(modifiedDeviceCategory);

        var modifiedDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(iotDeviceType);
        return new IoTDeviceTypeModifyCommandResult { IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto = modifiedDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the io t device type create command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">
    /// Missing argument: - DeviceTypeName
    /// or
    /// Missing argument: - DeviceTypeCode
    /// or
    /// Missing argument: - DeviceCategoryCode
    /// or
    /// Missing argument: - deviceCategory
    /// </exception>
    private ICommandResult DoIoTDeviceTypeCreateCommand(IoTDeviceTypeCreateCommand command)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.DeviceTypeName))
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Missing argument:", nameof(command.DeviceTypeName));

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.DeviceTypeCode))
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Missing argument:", nameof(command.DeviceTypeCode));

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.DeviceCategoryCode))
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Missing argument:", nameof(command.DeviceCategoryCode));

        // Device Category lekérdezés kódja alapján
        var deviceCategory = _tiDictCache.GetItem(DictType.IoTDeviceCategory, command.DeviceCategoryCode);
        if (deviceCategory == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Missing argument:", nameof(deviceCategory));

        IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto? newDto = new()
        {
            DeviceTypeName = command.DeviceTypeName,
            Code = command.DeviceTypeCode,
            DeviceCategory = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>(deviceCategory)
        };

        newDto = _commandService.CreateEntity<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>(newDto);
        return new IoTDeviceTypeCreateCommandResult { IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto = newDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IoTDeviceTypeEntity ApplyDto(IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto source, IoTDeviceTypeEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        LoadRef(x => x.DeviceCategory, destination, source.DeviceCategory);

        return entity;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Types;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.EnergyContract;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.EnergyContract;

/// <summary>
/// EnergyContractCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
/// <typeparam name="TDto">The type of the dto.</typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;T, TDto&gt;" />
public class EnergyContractCommandHandler<T, TDto> : CommandHandlerBase<T, TDto>
    where T : EnergyContractEntity, new()
    where TDto : EnergyContractEntityDto, new()
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergyContractCommandHandler{T, TDto}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public EnergyContractCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<TDto>> validator,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Energy Contract is {EnergyContractType.NotDefined.GetDisplayName()}</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException"></exception>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is UpdateEntityCommand updateEntityCommand && updateEntityCommand.Update!.Action == EntityUpdateAction.Update)
        {
            var entity = updateEntityCommand.Update.Entity as TDto;
            var dbObject = DbContext.Session.Load<EnergyContractEntity>(entity!.Id);

            if (dbObject.EnergyContractType != entity.EnergyContractType)
            {
                switch (dbObject.EnergyContractType)
                {
                    case EnergyContractType.NotDefined:
                        throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Energy Contract is {EnergyContractType.NotDefined.GetDisplayName()}");
                    case EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement:
                        _commandService.DeleteEntity<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto>(dbObject.Id);
                        break;
                    case EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract:
                        _commandService.DeleteEntity<NetworkUsageContractEntityDto>(dbObject.Id);
                        break;
                    case EnergyContractType.NetworkConnectionContract:
                        _commandService.DeleteEntity<NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto>(dbObject.Id);
                        break;
                    default:
                        throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
                }

                var entityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entity);

                return new UpdateEntityCommandResult
                {
                    UpdateResult = new EntityUpdate { Action = EntityUpdateAction.New, Entity = entityDto }
                };
            }

            var updatedEntityDto = base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command) as UpdateEntityCommandResult;

            return new UpdateEntityCommandResult
            {
                UpdateResult = new EntityUpdate { Action = EntityUpdateAction.Update, Entity = updatedEntityDto.UpdateResult.Entity }
            };
        }

        if (command is UpdateEntityCommand deleteEntityCommand && deleteEntityCommand.Update!.Action == EntityUpdateAction.Delete)
        {
            var entity = deleteEntityCommand.Update.Entity as TDto;

            if (typeof(TDto) != typeof(EnergyContractEntityDto))
            {
                return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
            }

            var dbObject = DbContext.Session.Load<EnergyContractEntity>(entity.Id);

            EnergyContractEntityDto? returnVal = dbObject.EnergyContractType switch
            {
                EnergyContractType.NetworkConnectionContract => _commandService.DeleteEntity<NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto>(dbObject.Id),
                EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract => _commandService.DeleteEntity<NetworkUsageContractEntityDto>(dbObject.Id),
                EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement => _commandService.DeleteEntity<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto>(dbObject.Id),
                EnergyContractType.NotDefined => throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Energy Contract is {EnergyContractType.NotDefined.GetDisplayName()}"),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException()
            };

            return new UpdateEntityCommandResult
            {
                UpdateResult = new EntityUpdate { Action = EntityUpdateAction.Delete, Entity = returnVal }
            };
        }

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override T ApplyDto(TDto source, T destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        
        LoadRef(x => x.Partner, entity, GetPartnerEntityRef());
        LoadRef(x => x.Institution, entity, source.Institution);
        LoadRef(x => x.Supplier, entity, source.Supplier);

        if (source.Currency != null)
            LoadRef(x => x.Currency, entity, source.Currency);

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the partner entity reference.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Missing argument: - PartnerId</exception>
    private EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto> GetPartnerEntityRef()
    {
        var partner = DbContext.Session.Query<PartnerEntity>()
            .SingleOrDefault(p => p.TenantCode == _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode);
        if (partner is null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException("Missing argument:", "PartnerId");
        return Mapper.Map<EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto>>(partner);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override TDto OnEntityCreated(TDto createdEntity, TDto source)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(TDto originalEntity, TDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>
    /// <param name="originalEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(T originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);

        if (originalDomainEntity is NetworkConnectionContractEntity networkEntity && originalEntity is NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto networkDto)
        {
            _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(networkEntity.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint.Id);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private TDto EntityPostEvent(TDto savedEntityDto, TDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<T>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        if (savedEntityDto is PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto &&
        entity is PowerPurchaseAgreementEntity powerPurchaseAgreementEntity && 
        source is PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto sourcePowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto)
        {
            if (sourcePowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto.TimeOfUseTariffs != null)
            {
                powerPurchaseAgreementEntity.TimeOfUseTariffs ??= new List<TimeOfUseTariffEntity>();

                ICollection<TimeOfUseTariffEntity> deletedElements;
                ListHelper.MergeList(sourcePowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto.TimeOfUseTariffs,
                    powerPurchaseAgreementEntity.TimeOfUseTariffs, (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id, dto =>
                    {
                        dto.EnergyContract = new EntityRef<EnergyContractEntityDto> { Id = powerPurchaseAgreementEntity.Id };
                        var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                        return DbContext.Session.Load<TimeOfUseTariffEntity>(newDtoItem.Id);
                    }, out deletedElements);

                foreach (var ppaDto in sourcePowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto.TimeOfUseTariffs.Where(x => x.Id != 0))
                {
                    ppaDto.EnergyContract = new EntityRef<EnergyContractEntityDto> { Id = powerPurchaseAgreementEntity.Id };
                    _commandService.UpdateEntity(ppaDto);
                }

                foreach (var deletedElement in deletedElements)
                {
                    _commandService.DeleteEntity<TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto>(deletedElement.Id);
                }
            }
        }
        
        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);
        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityCreating(TDto entityDto, T domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);
        
        if (domainEntity is NetworkConnectionContractEntity networkEntity && entityDto is NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto networkDto)
        {
            var addressEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(networkDto.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint);

            LoadRef(x => x.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint, networkEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(addressEntityDto));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítási CRUD műveletekkor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(TDto entityDto, T domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);

        if (domainEntity is NetworkConnectionContractEntity networkEntity && entityDto is NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto networkDto)
        {
            networkDto.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint.Id = networkEntity.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint.Id;
            var newAddress = _commandService.UpdateEntity(networkDto.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint);

            if (networkDto.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint.AddressType != networkEntity.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint.AddressType)
            {
                LoadRef(x => x.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint, networkEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(newAddress));
            }
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;

/// <summary>
/// InvoiceCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyContract.InvoiceEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract.InvoiceEntityDto&gt;" />
public class InvoiceCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<InvoiceEntity, InvoiceEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The ti dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// The security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InvoiceCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public InvoiceCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<InvoiceEntityDto>> validator,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        ILifetimeScope scope) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
        _scope = scope;
        _queryService = queryService;
        _securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is CreateInvoiceCommand createCommand)
            return DoCreateInvoiceCommand(createCommand);

        if (command is ModifyInvoiceCommand modifyCommand)
            return DoModifyInvoiceCommand(modifyCommand);

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify invoice command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoModifyInvoiceCommand(ModifyInvoiceCommand command)
    {
        var invoiceDto = _queryService.GetById<InvoiceEntityDto>(command.Id);
        
        // Modify
        invoiceDto.InvoiceIdentifier = command.InvoiceIdentifier;
        invoiceDto.TotalAmount = command.TotalAmount;
        invoiceDto.IssueDate = command.IssueDate;
        invoiceDto.PaymentDueDate = command.PaymentDueDate;
        invoiceDto.PaymentCompletedDate = command.PaymentCompletedDate;
        invoiceDto.AccountingPeriodStart = command.AccountingPeriodStart;
        invoiceDto.AccountingPeriodEnd = command.AccountingPeriodEnd;

        if (invoiceDto.InvoiceEnergyFee is not null) 
            invoiceDto.InvoiceEnergyFee = command.InvoiceEnergyFee;
        if (invoiceDto.InvoiceDistributorFee is not null) 
            invoiceDto.InvoiceDistributorFee = command.InvoiceDistributorFee;

        var dto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(invoiceDto);
        return new ModifyInvoiceCommandResult { InvoiceEntityDto = dto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the create invoice command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoCreateInvoiceCommand(CreateInvoiceCommand command)
    {
        var energyContractIds = command.EnergyContracts.Select(e => e.Id);
        var energyContracts = DbContext.Session.Query<EnergyContractEntity>().Where(e => energyContractIds.Contains(e.Id)).ToList();

        var energyContract = energyContracts.SingleOrDefault(c => c.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement) ?? energyContracts[0];
        
        var issuer = new InvoiceIssuerDto
        {
            TaxIdentificationNumber = energyContract.Supplier.TaxIdentificationNumber,
            Name = energyContract.Supplier.Name,
            FullAddress = energyContract.Supplier.Headquarters.FullAddress
        };
        
        var partnerValidity = GetCurrentPartnerValidity();
        var customer = new InvoiceCustomerDto
        {
            TaxIdentificationNumber = partnerValidity.TaxIdentificationNumber,
            Name = partnerValidity.Name,
            FullAddress = partnerValidity.Headquarters?.FullAddress
        };
        
        var newEntityDto = new InvoiceEntityDto
        {
            InvoiceIdentifier = command.InvoiceIdentifier,
            AccountingPeriodStart = command.AccountingPeriodStart,
            AccountingPeriodEnd = command.AccountingPeriodEnd,
            IssueDate = command.IssueDate,
            PaymentDueDate = command.PaymentDueDate,
            PaymentCompletedDate = command.PaymentCompletedDate,
            Issuer = issuer,
            Customer = customer,
            Supplier = Mapper.Map<EntityRef<SupplierEntityDto>>(energyContract.Supplier),
            EnergyContracts = command.EnergyContracts,
            TotalAmount = command.TotalAmount
        };

        if (energyContracts.Any(e => e.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement))
            newEntityDto.InvoiceEnergyFee = command.InvoiceEnergyFee;
        if (energyContracts.Any(e => e.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract))
            newEntityDto.InvoiceDistributorFee = command.InvoiceDistributorFee;

        newEntityDto.AccountingMethodType = ((IEnergyContractWithTimeOfUseTariffsEntity)energyContract.UnProxy()).AccountingMethodType;

        var createdDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(newEntityDto);
        return new CreateInvoiceCommandResult { InvoiceEntityDto = createdDto };
    }

    //TODO: implement this method
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the current valid partner data.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>The current valid partner data</returns>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">No valid partner data found for the current date</exception>
    private PartnerValidityEntity GetCurrentPartnerValidity()
    {
        //PartnerValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;

        //var partner = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerEntity>()
        //    .Where(p => p.TenantCode == _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).SingleOrDefault().CurrentValidity;
        //if (partner is null)
        //    throw new ArgumentNullException("Missing argument:", "PartnerId");
        return null;
    }

    // Számla törlése logikailag legyen törölve by default!

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">
    /// A tenanthoz nincs pénznem (currency) rendszerváltozó (SysConfigValue) mentve.
    /// or
    /// A tenantnál beállított pénznem kód alapján nem található pénznem kódszótár elem!
    /// </exception>
    protected override InvoiceEntity ApplyDto(InvoiceEntityDto source, InvoiceEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);  
        // Pénznem mentése (Tenant szintű konfigból vesszük ki a kódját,
        // és azt kérdezzük le a tenant-független kódtárból.
        // (A pénznemek már tenant-függetlenek, de a kód tenant-függő!)
        string currencyCode = _scope.Config().GetStringValue($"currency");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currencyCode)) 
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("A tenanthoz nincs pénznem (currency) rendszerváltozó (SysConfigValue) mentve.");
        
        var currencyDto = _tiDictCache.GetItem(DictType.Currency, currencyCode);
        if (currencyDto == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("A tenantnál beállított pénznem kód alapján nem található pénznem kódszótár elem!");

        //LoadRef(x => x.Currency!, entity, new EntityRef<DictItemEntityDto> { Id = currencyDto.Id });  // A tentant-függő SysConfig "currency" kódú sysvalue-vel töltjük
        LoadRef(x => x.Currency!, entity, new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = CacheHelper.GetPartnerDefaultCurrency(_scope).Id });
        LoadRef(x => x.Supplier!, entity, source.Supplier!);

        entity.EnergyContracts ??= new List<EnergyContractEntity>();
        MergeList(source.EnergyContracts, 
            entity.EnergyContracts, 
            (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id,
            entityRef => entityRef.Id);

        return entity;
    }
}

public class SupplierCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<SupplierEntity, SupplierEntityDto>

        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<SupplierEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)

        _queryService = queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.

    /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>

    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(SupplierEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)

        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);
        
        _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(originalDomainEntity.Headquarters.Id);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Can't save {nameof(entityDto.Headquarters)}</exception>
    protected override void OnEntityCreating(SupplierEntityDto entityDto, SupplierEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);
        
        var addressEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto.Headquarters);
        if (addressEntityDto is  null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Can't save {nameof(entityDto.Headquarters)}");
        
        LoadRef(x => x.Headquarters, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(addressEntityDto));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítási CRUD műveletekkor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(SupplierEntityDto entityDto, SupplierEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);
        
        entityDto.Headquarters.Id = domainEntity.Headquarters.Id;
        var newAddress = _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto.Headquarters);

        if (entityDto.Headquarters.AddressType != domainEntity.Headquarters.AddressType)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.Headquarters, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(newAddress));
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

    {
        UpdateEntities(uploadCommand.Data.EnergeticData);
        UpdateEntities(uploadCommand.Data.Devices);
        return null;
    }

    {
        ImportValidationJob<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>.PostJob<EnergeticDataImportValidationJob>(
                    _securityContext,
                    DbContext,
                    tenantCode,
                    jobId,
                    fileName,
                    fileBytes);
    }

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location.Building;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Building;
using FluentValidation;


namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.EnergyPerformance;

public class EnergyConsumptionDeviceCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;



    public EnergyConsumptionDeviceCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand createEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand => DoCreateEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand(createEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand),
            ModifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand modifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand => DoModifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand(modifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand),
            DeleteEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand deleteEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand => DoDeleteEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand(deleteEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand(DeleteEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand command)
    {
        if (command.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityQuery { Id = command.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId }).Result?.Entity is not EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto entityDto)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Energy Consumption Device Id. There is no Energy Consumption Device with Id: '{command.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId}'");

        _ = _commandService.DeleteEntity<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>(command.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId);
        return new DeleteEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommandResult { IsSuccess = true };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand(CreateEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand command)
    {
        var entityDto = Mapper.Map<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>(command);

        var EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);
        return new CreateEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommandResult { EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto = EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand(ModifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand modifyCommand)
    {
        if (modifyCommand.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modifyCommand.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityQuery { Id = modifyCommand.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId }).Result?.Entity is not EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto entityDto)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Energy Consumption Device Id. There is no Energy Consumption Device with Id: '{modifyCommand.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId}'");

        Mapper.Map(modifyCommand, entityDto);

        var energyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto);
        return new ModifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommandResult { EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto = energyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity ApplyDto(EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto source, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        LoadRef(x => x.OrgunitBase, entity, source.OrgunitBase);
        LoadRef(x => x.TypeOfEnergyCarrier, entity, source.TypeOfEnergyCarrier);
        LoadRef(x => x.EstablishedSubMetering, entity, source.EstablishedSubMetering);
        LoadRef(x => x.RemoteControl, entity, source.RemoteControl);
        LoadRef(x => x.Type, entity, source.Type);

        return entity;
    }
}

        return command switch
        {
            CreateRoomEnergeticDataCommand createRoomEnergeticDataCommand => DoCreateRoomEnergeticDataCommand(createRoomEnergeticDataCommand),
            ModifyRoomEnergeticDataCommand modifyRoomEnergeticDataCommand => DoModifyRoomEnergeticDataCommand(modifyRoomEnergeticDataCommand),

            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Room Energetic Data Id. There is no Room Energetic Data with Id: '{command.Id}'");

        Mapper.Map(command, entityDto); 

        var responseDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto);

        return new ModifyRoomEnergeticDataCommandResult { RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto = responseDto! };
    }

        //ha soft delete kellene

        return new DeleteRoomEnergeticDataCommandResult { IsSuccess = entityDto is null};

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Interfaces;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Import;
public abstract class ImportJobResultCommandHandlerBase<TValidation> : CommandHandlerBase<ImportJobResultEntity, ImportJobResultEntityDto<TValidation>> where TValidation : IValidationData
{

    protected readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    protected readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    public ImportJobResultCommandHandlerBase(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<ImportJobResultEntityDto<TValidation>>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        SecurityContext securityContext
        ) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            UploadImportCommand<TValidation> uploadCommand => DoUploadImportCommand(uploadCommand),
            DeleteImportJobCommand<TValidation> deleteCommand => DoDeleteImportJobCommand(deleteCommand),
            FinalizeImportCommand<TValidation> finalizeCommand => DoFinalizeImportCommand(finalizeCommand),
            BatchImportCommand<TValidation> batchCommand => DoBatchImportCommand(batchCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    protected abstract ICommandResult DoBatchImportCommand(BatchImportCommand<TValidation> batchCommand);

    protected abstract TValidation CreateData(UploadImportCommand<TValidation> uploadCommand);

    protected abstract void StartImportJob(string tenantCode, Guid jobId, string fileName, byte[] fileBytes);

    private ICommandResult DoFinalizeImportCommand(FinalizeImportCommand<TValidation> finalizeCommand)
    {
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        var jobEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<ImportJobResultEntityDto<TValidation>>(finalizeCommand.Id);
        if (jobEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid OrgunitImportJobResult Id. There is no OrgunitImportJobResult with Id: '{finalizeCommand.Id}'");

        jobEntityDto.Status = JobResultStatus.Finalizing;
        _commandService.UpdateEntity(jobEntityDto);

        ImportFinalizerJob<TValidation>.PostJob(_securityContext, DbContext, tenantCode, finalizeCommand.Id);

        return null;
    }

    private ICommandResult DoUploadImportCommand(UploadImportCommand<TValidation> uploadCommand) 
    {
        var user = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(user.TenantCode))
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Globális Adminisztrátorral a 'Topológia elemek importálása' parancs nem hajtható végre!");

        var userQuery = new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
        {
            GlobalId = user.GlobalId,
            TenantCode = user.TenantCode,
            IsDeleted = false
        };

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(userQuery).RunSync()?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto secUser)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Invalid user with global id: '{userQuery.GlobalId}'");

        var jobResult = new ImportJobResultEntityDto<TValidation>()
        {
            JobId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            FileName = uploadCommand.ImportFile.FileName,
            SecUser = new EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>() { Id = secUser.Id },
            InitiationDate = DateTime.Now,
            Status = JobResultStatus.New,
            Data = CreateData(uploadCommand)
        };

        _commandService.CreateEntity(jobResult);


        byte[] fileBytes;
        using (var memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
        {
            uploadCommand.ImportFile.CopyTo(memoryStream);
            fileBytes = memoryStream.ToArray();
        }

        StartImportJob(user.TenantCode, jobResult.JobId, uploadCommand.ImportFile.FileName, fileBytes);

        return new UploadImportCommandResult() { JobId = jobResult.JobId };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteImportJobCommand(DeleteImportJobCommand<TValidation> deleteCommand)
    {
        if (deleteCommand.JobId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(deleteCommand.JobId), "Missing argument");

        var jobEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<ImportJobResultEntityDto<TValidation>>(deleteCommand.JobId);
        if (jobEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid ImportJobResult Id. There is no ImportJobResult with Id: '{deleteCommand.JobId}'");

        jobEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<ImportJobResultEntityDto<TValidation>>(deleteCommand.JobId);
        return new DeleteImportJobCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (jobEntityDto == null)
        };
    }

    protected override ImportJobResultEntity ApplyDto(ImportJobResultEntityDto<TValidation> source, ImportJobResultEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.SecUser, entity, source.SecUser);

        return entity;
    }

    protected void UpdateEntities<T>(List<T> list) where T : IEntityDto
    {
        foreach (var item in list)
        {
            _commandService.UpdateEntity<T>(item);
        }
    }
}
