using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location.Building;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Building;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.SiteLocation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Building;
using FluentValidation;


namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Command handler for building-related commands
/// </summary>
public class BuildingCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<BuildingEntity, BuildingEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _clientService;

    public BuildingCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<BuildingEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            CreateBuildingCommand createBuildingCommand => DoCreateBuildingCommand(createBuildingCommand),
            ModifyBuildingCommand modifyBuildingCommand => DoModifyBuildingCommand(modifyBuildingCommand),
            DeleteBuildingCommand deleteBuildingCommand => DoDeleteBuildingCommand(deleteBuildingCommand),
            ModifyBuildingPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand => DoModifyPodsCommand(modifyPodsCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        //TODO! null-t csak akkor adhat vissza, ha Institution Create a command, mert annak szülője már a tenant -> ezt az institutioncommandhandlerben majd le kell kezelni!

        return command switch
        {
            CreateBuildingCommand createCommand => createCommand.Site.Id,
            ModifyBuildingCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.BuildingId,
            DeleteBuildingCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.BuildingId,
            ModifyBuildingPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand => modifyPodsCommand.Id,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyPodsCommand(ModifyBuildingPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand)
    {
        var joinedPods = string.Join(',', modifyPodsCommand.PodIdentifiers);

        var buildingEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<BuildingEntity>(modifyPodsCommand.Id);

        if (buildingEntity == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingEntity Id. There is no BuildingEntity with Id: '{modifyPodsCommand.Id}'");
        }

        buildingEntity.PodIdentifiers = joinedPods;

        DbContext.Session.Update(buildingEntity);
        return new ModifyPodsCommandResult { PodIdentifiers = buildingEntity.PodIdentifiers?.Split(',') ?? [] };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateBuildingCommand(CreateBuildingCommand createBuildingCommand)
    {
        var entityDto = new BuildingEntityDto()
        {
            BuildingParts = [],
            BuildingValidities = [Mapper.Map<BuildingValidityEntityDto>(createBuildingCommand)],
            Site = createBuildingCommand.Site
        };
        Mapper.Map(createBuildingCommand, entityDto);


        var buildingEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);
        return new CreateBuildingCommandResult { BuildingEntityDto = buildingEntityDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyBuildingCommand(ModifyBuildingCommand modifyBuildingCommand)
    {
        if (modifyBuildingCommand.BuildingId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modifyBuildingCommand.BuildingId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new BuildingEntityQuery { Id = modifyBuildingCommand.BuildingId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not BuildingEntityDto buildingEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingEntity Id. There is no BuildingEntity with Id: '{modifyBuildingCommand.BuildingId}'");

        Mapper.Map(modifyBuildingCommand, buildingEntity);

        var buildingEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(buildingEntity);
        return new ModifyBuildingCommandResult { BuildingEntityDto = buildingEntityDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteBuildingCommand(DeleteBuildingCommand deleteBuildingCommand)
    {
        //TODO: validators
        if (deleteBuildingCommand.BuildingId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(deleteBuildingCommand.BuildingId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new BuildingEntityQuery { Id = deleteBuildingCommand.BuildingId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not BuildingEntityDto buildingEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingEntity Id. There is no BuildingEntity with Id: '{deleteBuildingCommand.BuildingId}'");

        /// Törlés validáció: Amennyiben az épülethez tartozik legalább egy épületrész is, az épület nem törölhető. Ebben az esetben figyelmeztető üzenetet adjunk!
        if (buildingEntity.BuildingParts != null &&
            buildingEntity.BuildingParts.Any(x => !x.IsDeleted))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("Az épület nem törölhető! Szüntesse meg vagy csoportosítsa át másik épülethez a kapcsolódó épületrészeket!");
        }

        var buildingEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<BuildingEntityDto>(deleteBuildingCommand.BuildingId);
        return new DeleteBuildingCommandResult { IsSuccess = buildingEntityDto == null || buildingEntityDto.IsDeleted };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override BuildingEntityDto OnEntityCreated(BuildingEntityDto createdEntity, BuildingEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>
    /// <param name="originalEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(BuildingEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);

        //TODO: delete related things as needed
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(BuildingEntityDto originalEntityDto, BuildingEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private BuildingEntityDto EntityPostEvent(BuildingEntityDto savedEntityDto, BuildingEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<BuildingEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        entity.BuildingValidities ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.BuildingValidities,
                     entity.BuildingValidities, 
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id, 
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Building = new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<BuildingValidityEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        entity.BuildingParts ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.BuildingParts,
                     entity.BuildingParts,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Building = new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<BuildingPartEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);
        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override BuildingEntity ApplyDto(BuildingEntityDto source, BuildingEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        LoadRef(x => x.Site, entity, source.Site);

        return entity;
    }
}

    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="monitoringApiClientService">The monitoring API client service.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public BuildingPartCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<BuildingPartEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            BatchCreateBuildingPartCommand batchCreateCommand => DoBatchCreateBuildingPartCommand(batchCreateCommand),
            CreateBuildingPartCommand createCommand => DoCreateBuildingPartCommand(createCommand),
            BatchModifyBuildingPartCommand batchModifyCommand => DoBatchModifyBuildingPartCommand(batchModifyCommand),
            ModifyBuildingPartCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyBuildingPartCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteBuildingPartCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteBuildingPartCommand(deleteCommand),
            ModifyBuildingPartPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand => DoModifyPodsCommand(modifyPodsCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        //TODO! null-t csak akkor adhat vissza, ha Institution Create a command, mert annak szülője már a tenant -> ezt az institutioncommandhandlerben majd le kell kezelni!

        return command switch
        {
            CreateBuildingPartCommand createCommand => createCommand.Building.Id,
            ModifyBuildingPartCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.BuildingPartId,
            DeleteBuildingPartCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.BuildingPartId,
            ModifyBuildingPartPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand => modifyPodsCommand.Id,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyPodsCommand(ModifyBuildingPartPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand)
    {
        var joinedPods = string.Join(',', modifyPodsCommand.PodIdentifiers);


        var buildingPartEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<BuildingPartEntity>(modifyPodsCommand.Id);

        if (buildingPartEntity == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingPartEntity Id. There is no BuildingPartEntity with Id: '{modifyPodsCommand.Id}'");
        }

        buildingPartEntity.PodIdentifiers = joinedPods;

        DbContext.Session.Update(buildingPartEntity);
        return new ModifyPodsCommandResult { PodIdentifiers = buildingPartEntity.PodIdentifiers?.Split(',') ?? [] };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the batch create building part command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoBatchCreateBuildingPartCommand(BatchCreateBuildingPartCommand cmd)
    {
        var secUser = DbContext.Session.Get<SecUserEntity>(cmd.SecUserId);

        if (cmd.BuildingPartIds != null)
            foreach (var buildingPartId in cmd.BuildingPartIds)
            {
                var buildingPart = DbContext.Session.Get<BuildingPartEntity>(buildingPartId);

                //TODO: user beállítása a validity contactpersonra
                //if (buildingpart.... != null)
                //    throw new InvalidOperationException("SiteManager cannot be overriden!");
                //buildingpart.... = secUser;

                var buildingPartDto = Mapper.Map<BuildingPartEntityDto>(buildingPart);
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(buildingPartDto);
            }

        return new BatchCreateBuildingPartCommandResult();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the create building part command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoCreateBuildingPartCommand(CreateBuildingPartCommand command)
    {
        var newDto = new BuildingPartEntityDto()
        {
            Floors = [],
            BuildingPartValidities = [Mapper.Map<BuildingPartValidityEntityDto>(command)],
            Building = command.Building
        };
        var buildingPartEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(newDto);
        return new CreateBuildingPartCommandResult { BuildingPartEntityDto = buildingPartEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the batch modify building part command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoBatchModifyBuildingPartCommand(BatchModifyBuildingPartCommand cmd)
    {
        SecUserEntity secUserAlias = null;
        var secUser = DbContext.Session.Get<SecUserEntity>(cmd.SecUserId);

        var buildingPartsWithSecuser =
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingPartEntity>()
            //TODO: VALIDITY?
            //.JoinAlias(x => x.contactperson, () => secUserAlias)
            .Where(x => secUserAlias.Id == secUser.Id)
            .List();

        //Delete all previous connections
        foreach (var buildingPartWithSecuser in buildingPartsWithSecuser)
        {
            //TODO: validity...
            //buildingPartWithSecuser.contactperson = null;

            var buildingPartDto = Mapper.Map<BuildingPartEntityDto>(buildingPartWithSecuser);
            _commandService.UpdateEntity(buildingPartDto);
        }

        //Add new connections
        if (cmd.BuildingPartIds != null)
            foreach (var buildingPartId in cmd.BuildingPartIds)
            {
                var buildingPart = DbContext.Session.Get<BuildingPartEntity>(buildingPartId);

                var buildingPartDto = Mapper.Map<BuildingPartEntityDto>(buildingPart);
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(buildingPartDto);
            }

        return new BatchModifyBuildingPartCommandResult();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify building part command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoModifyBuildingPartCommand(ModifyBuildingPartCommand command)
    {
        if (command.BuildingPartId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.BuildingPartId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new BuildingPartEntityQuery { Id = command.BuildingPartId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not BuildingPartEntityDto buildingPartEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingPartEntity Id. There is no BuildingPartEntity with Id: '{command.BuildingPartId}'");

        //var updatedEntity = Mapper.Map<BuildingPartEntityDto>(command);
        Mapper.Map(command, buildingPartEntity);

        var buildingPartEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(buildingPartEntity);
        return new ModifyBuildingPartCommandResult { BuildingPartEntityDto = buildingPartEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the delete building part command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoDeleteBuildingPartCommand(DeleteBuildingPartCommand command)
    {
        if (command.BuildingPartId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.BuildingPartId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new BuildingPartEntityQuery { Id = command.BuildingPartId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not BuildingPartEntityDto buildingPartEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingPartEntity Id. There is no BuildingPartEntity with Id: '{command.BuildingPartId}'");

        /// Törlés validáció: Amennyiben az épületrészhez tartozik legalább egy telephely is, az épületrész nem törölhető. Ebben az esetben figyelmeztető üzenetet adjunk!
        if (buildingPartEntity.Floors != null &&
            buildingPartEntity.Floors
                .ToList()
                .Select(l => l.IsDeleted)
                .Contains(false))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("Az épületrész nem törölhető! Szüntesse meg vagy csoportosítsa át másik épületrészhez a kapcsolódó telephelyeket!");
        }


        var buildingPartEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<BuildingPartEntityDto>(command.BuildingPartId);
        return new DeleteBuildingPartCommandResult { IsSuccess = buildingPartEntityDto == null || buildingPartEntityDto.IsDeleted };
    }

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.

        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);

    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private BuildingPartEntityDto EntityPostEvent(BuildingPartEntityDto savedEntityDto, BuildingPartEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<BuildingPartEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        entity.BuildingPartValidities ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.BuildingPartValidities,
                     entity.BuildingPartValidities,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        entity.Floors ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Floors,
                     entity.Floors,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<FloorEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override BuildingPartEntity ApplyDto(BuildingPartEntityDto source, BuildingPartEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.Building, entity, source.Building);

        // if (source. != null)
        //     LoadRef(x => x.ContactPerson!, entity, source.ContactPerson!);

        return entity;
    }

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location.BuildingPart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.BuildingPart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// BuildingPartValidityCommandHandler
/// </summary>
public class BuildingPartValidityCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<BuildingPartValidityEntity, BuildingPartValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _clientService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BuildingPartValidityCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="monitoringApiClientService">The monitoring API client service.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public BuildingPartValidityCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<BuildingPartValidityEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            CreateBuildingPartValidityCommand createCommand => DoCreateBuildingPartValidityCommand(createCommand),
            ModifyBuildingPartValidityCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyBuildingPartValidityCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteBuildingPartValidityCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteBuildingPartValidityCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateBuildingPartValidityCommand createCommand => createCommand.BuildingPartId,
            ModifyBuildingPartValidityCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.BuildingPartId,
            DeleteBuildingPartValidityCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.BuildingPartId,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteBuildingPartValidityCommand(DeleteBuildingPartValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var buildingPartEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<BuildingPartEntityDto>(command.BuildingPartId);

        if (buildingPartEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingPart Id. There is no BuildingPart with Id: '{command.BuildingPartId}'");

        if (buildingPartEntityDto.BuildingPartValidities == null || !buildingPartEntityDto.BuildingPartValidities.Select(x => x.Id).Contains(command.ValidityId))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingPartValidity Id. There is no BuildingPartValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        //legalább egy érvényességnek léteznie kell az adott épületrészhez
        if ((buildingPartEntityDto.BuildingPartValidities?.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).Count() ?? 0) <= 1)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"At least one validity is required for the building part: {buildingPartEntityDto?.Name}");

        var buildingPartValidityEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<BuildingPartValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);

        return new DeleteBuildingPartValidityCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (buildingPartValidityEntityDto == null) || buildingPartValidityEntityDto.IsDeleted
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateBuildingPartValidityCommand(CreateBuildingPartValidityCommand command)
    {
        BuildingPartValidityEntityDto buildingValidity = Mapper.Map<BuildingPartValidityEntityDto>(command);
        buildingValidity.BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>() { Id = command.BuildingPartId };

        var entity = _commandService.CreateEntity(buildingValidity);
        return new CreateBuildingPartValidityCommandResult
        {
            BuildingPartValidityEntityDto = entity
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyBuildingPartValidityCommand(ModifyBuildingPartValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var buildingValidityEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<BuildingPartValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);
        if (buildingValidityEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingPartValidity Id. There is no BuildingPartValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        Mapper.Map(command, buildingValidityEntityDto);


        var updatedEntity = _commandService.UpdateEntity(buildingValidityEntityDto);
        return new ModifyBuildingPartValidityCommandResult { BuildingPartValidityEntityDto = updatedEntity };
    }

    protected override BuildingPartValidityEntityDto OnEntityCreated(BuildingPartValidityEntityDto createdEntity, BuildingPartValidityEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return entityDto;
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(BuildingPartValidityEntityDto originalEntityDto, BuildingPartValidityEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }

    private void SendSyncMessage(DateTime dateOfModification)
    {
        var request = new SyncRequest()
        {
            EntityName = SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization,
            LastModifiedDate = dateOfModification,
            TenantCode = DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName
        };
        DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() => _clientService.Post(SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, request, DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName).RunSync());
    }

    protected override void OnEntityCreating(BuildingPartValidityEntityDto entityDto, BuildingPartValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);

    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(BuildingPartValidityEntityDto entityDto, BuildingPartValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(BuildingPartValidityEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    protected override BuildingPartValidityEntity ApplyDto(BuildingPartValidityEntityDto source, BuildingPartValidityEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.BuildingPart!, entity, source.BuildingPart!);

        if (source.ContactPerson != null)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.ContactPerson, entity, source.ContactPerson);
        }

        return entity;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location.Building;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Building;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// BuildingValidityCommandHandler
/// </summary>
public class BuildingValidityCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<BuildingValidityEntity, BuildingValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _clientService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BuildingValidityCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public BuildingValidityCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<BuildingValidityEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            CreateBuildingValidityCommand createCommand => DoCreateBuildingValidityCommand(createCommand),
            ModifyBuildingValidityCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyBuildingValidityCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteBuildingValidityCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteBuildingValidityCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateBuildingValidityCommand createCommand => createCommand.BuildingId,
            ModifyBuildingValidityCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.BuildingId,
            DeleteBuildingValidityCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.BuildingId,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteBuildingValidityCommand(DeleteBuildingValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var buildingEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<BuildingEntityDto>(command.BuildingId);

        if (buildingEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Building Id. There is no Building with Id: '{command.BuildingId}'");

        if (buildingEntityDto.BuildingValidities == null || !buildingEntityDto.BuildingValidities.Select(x => x.Id).Contains(command.ValidityId))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingValidity Id. There is no BuildingValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        //legalább egy érvényességnek léteznie kell az adott épülethez
        if ((buildingEntityDto.BuildingValidities?.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).Count() ?? 0) <= 1)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"At least one validity is required for the building: {buildingEntityDto?.Name}");

        var buildingValidityEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<BuildingValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);

        return new DeleteBuildingValidityCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (buildingValidityEntityDto == null) || buildingValidityEntityDto.IsDeleted
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateBuildingValidityCommand(CreateBuildingValidityCommand command)
    {
        BuildingValidityEntityDto buildingValidity = Mapper.Map<BuildingValidityEntityDto>(command);
        buildingValidity.Building = new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>() { Id = command.BuildingId };

        var entity = _commandService.CreateEntity(buildingValidity);
        return new CreateBuildingValidityCommandResult
        {
            BuildingValidityEntityDto = entity
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyBuildingValidityCommand(ModifyBuildingValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var buildingValidityEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<BuildingValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);
        if (buildingValidityEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BuildingValidity Id. There is no BuildingValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        Mapper.Map(command, buildingValidityEntityDto);


        var updatedEntity = _commandService.UpdateEntity(buildingValidityEntityDto);
        return new ModifyBuildingValidityCommandResult { BuildingValidityEntityDto = updatedEntity };
    }

    protected override void OnEntityCreating(BuildingValidityEntityDto entityDto, BuildingValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);

        if (entityDto.Address != null)
        {
            var addressEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto.Address);
            if (addressEntityDto is null)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Can't save {nameof(entityDto.Address)}");

            LoadRef(x => x.Address, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(addressEntityDto));
        }
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(BuildingValidityEntityDto entityDto, BuildingValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);
        if (entityDto.Address != null)
        {
            if (domainEntity.Address != null)
                entityDto.Address.Id = domainEntity.Address.Id;

            var newAddress = (entityDto.Address.Id != 0
                ? _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto.Address)
                : _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto.Address));

            if (entityDto.Address.AddressType != domainEntity.Address?.AddressType)
            {
                LoadRef(x => x.Address, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(newAddress));
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (domainEntity.Address != null)
                _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(domainEntity.Address.Id);
            domainEntity.Address = null;
        }
    }

    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(BuildingValidityEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);
        //TODO: Delete logic for address
    }

    protected override BuildingValidityEntity ApplyDto(BuildingValidityEntityDto source, BuildingValidityEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.Building!, entity, source.Building!);
        LoadRef(x => x.BuildingProfile!, entity, source.BuildingProfile!);

        if (source.ContactPerson != null)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.ContactPerson, entity, source.ContactPerson);
        }

        return entity;
    }

    protected override BuildingValidityEntityDto OnEntityCreated(BuildingValidityEntityDto createdEntity, BuildingValidityEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return entityDto;
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(BuildingValidityEntityDto originalEntityDto, BuildingValidityEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location.Floor;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.BuildingPart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Floor;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.SiteLocation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Floor;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Command handler for floor-related commands
/// </summary>
public class FloorCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<FloorEntity, FloorEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _clientService;

    public FloorCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<FloorEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            CreateFloorCommand createFloorCommand => DoCreateFloorCommand(createFloorCommand),
            ModifyFloorCommand modifyFloorCommand => DoModifyFloorCommand(modifyFloorCommand),
            DeleteFloorCommand deleteFloorCommand => DoDeleteFloorCommand(deleteFloorCommand),
            ModifyFloorPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand => DoModifyPodsCommand(modifyPodsCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        //TODO! null-t csak akkor adhat vissza, ha Institution Create a command, mert annak szülője már a tenant -> ezt az institutioncommandhandlerben majd le kell kezelni!

        return command switch
        {
            CreateFloorCommand createCommand => createCommand.BuildingPart.Id,
            ModifyFloorCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.FloorId,
            DeleteFloorCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.FloorId,
            ModifyFloorPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand => modifyPodsCommand.Id,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyPodsCommand(ModifyFloorPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand)
    {
        var joinedPods = string.Join(',', modifyPodsCommand.PodIdentifiers);

        var floorEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<FloorEntity>(modifyPodsCommand.Id);

        if (floorEntity == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid FloorEntity Id. There is no FloorEntity with Id: '{modifyPodsCommand.Id}'");
        }

        floorEntity.PodIdentifiers = joinedPods;

        DbContext.Session.Update(floorEntity);
        return new ModifyPodsCommandResult { PodIdentifiers = floorEntity.PodIdentifiers?.Split(',') ?? [] };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateFloorCommand(CreateFloorCommand createFloorCommand)
    {
        var entityDto = new FloorEntityDto()
        {
            Rooms = [],
            FloorValidities = [Mapper.Map<FloorValidityEntityDto>(createFloorCommand)],
            BuildingPart = createFloorCommand.BuildingPart,
        };
        Mapper.Map(createFloorCommand, entityDto);


        var floorEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);
        return new CreateFloorCommandResult { FloorEntityDto = floorEntityDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyFloorCommand(ModifyFloorCommand modifyFloorCommand)
    {
        if (modifyFloorCommand.FloorId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modifyFloorCommand.FloorId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new FloorEntityQuery { Id = modifyFloorCommand.FloorId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not FloorEntityDto floorEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid FloorEntity Id. There is no FloorEntity with Id: '{modifyFloorCommand.FloorId}'");

        Mapper.Map(modifyFloorCommand, floorEntity);

        var floorEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(floorEntity);
        return new ModifyFloorCommandResult { FloorEntityDto = floorEntityDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteFloorCommand(DeleteFloorCommand deleteFloorCommand)
    {
        //TODO: validators
        if (deleteFloorCommand.FloorId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(deleteFloorCommand.FloorId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new FloorEntityQuery { Id = deleteFloorCommand.FloorId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not FloorEntityDto floorEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid FloorEntity Id. There is no FloorEntity with Id: '{deleteFloorCommand.FloorId}'");

        if (floorEntity.Rooms != null &&
            floorEntity.Rooms.Any(x => !x.IsDeleted))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("Az szint nem törölhető! Szüntesse meg szobákat!");
        }

        var floorEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<FloorEntityDto>(deleteFloorCommand.FloorId);
        return new DeleteFloorCommandResult { IsSuccess = floorEntityDto == null || floorEntityDto.IsDeleted };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override FloorEntityDto OnEntityCreated(FloorEntityDto createdEntity, FloorEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>
    /// <param name="originalEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(FloorEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(FloorEntityDto originalEntityDto, FloorEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private FloorEntityDto EntityPostEvent(FloorEntityDto savedEntityDto, FloorEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<FloorEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        entity.FloorValidities ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.FloorValidities,
                     entity.FloorValidities,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Floor = new EntityRef<FloorEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<FloorValidityEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        entity.Rooms ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Rooms,
                     entity.Rooms,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Floor = new EntityRef<FloorEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<RoomEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);
        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override FloorEntity ApplyDto(FloorEntityDto source, FloorEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        LoadRef(x => x.BuildingPart, entity, source.BuildingPart);

        return entity;
    }
}

        return new ModifyFloorValidityCommandResult { FloorValidityEntityDto = updatedEntity };
    }

    protected override void OnEntityCreating(FloorValidityEntityDto entityDto, FloorValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);

    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(FloorValidityEntityDto entityDto, FloorValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(FloorValidityEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    protected override FloorValidityEntity ApplyDto(FloorValidityEntityDto source, FloorValidityEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.Floor!, entity, source.Floor!);

        if (source.ContactPerson != null)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.ContactPerson, entity, source.ContactPerson);
        }

        return entity;
    }

    protected override FloorValidityEntityDto OnEntityCreated(FloorValidityEntityDto createdEntity, FloorValidityEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return entityDto;
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(FloorValidityEntityDto originalEntityDto, FloorValidityEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

/// <summary>
/// Institution command handler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="CommandHandlerBase{InstitutionEntity, InstitutionEntityDto}" />
public class InstitutionCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<InstitutionEntity, InstitutionEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _clientService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InstitutionCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public InstitutionCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<InstitutionEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            BatchCreateInstitutionCommand batchCreateCommand => DoBatchCreateInstitutionCommand(batchCreateCommand),
            CreateInstitutionCommand createCommand => DoCreateInstitutionCommand(createCommand),
            BatchModifyInstitutionCommand batchModifyCommand => DoBatchModifyInstitutionCommand(batchModifyCommand),
            ModifyInstitutionCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyInstitutionCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteInstitutionCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteInstitutionCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }


    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        //null-t csak akkor adhat vissza (és akkor kell), ha Institution Create a command, mert annak szülője már a tenant
        return command switch
        {
            CreateInstitutionCommand createCommand => null,
            ModifyInstitutionCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.InstitutionId,
            DeleteInstitutionCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.InstitutionId,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide

            //TODO: hoppá, ezzel mit kéne kezdeni??? tenant szintű jogosultság ellenőrzés szükséges. de van egyáltalán batch create és batch modify használatban?
            BatchCreateInstitutionCommand batchCreateCommand => throw new NotImplementedException(),
            BatchModifyInstitutionCommand batchModifyCommand => throw new NotImplementedException(),
            
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }



    /// <summary>
    /// Does the batch create institution command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoBatchCreateInstitutionCommand(BatchCreateInstitutionCommand cmd)
    {
        var secUser = DbContext.Session.Get<SecUserEntity>(cmd.SecUserId);

        if (cmd.InstitutionIds != null)
            foreach (var institutionId in cmd.InstitutionIds)
            {
                var institution = DbContext.Session.Get<InstitutionEntity>(institutionId);

                //TODO: user beállítása a validity contactpersonra
                //if (institution.... != null)
                //    throw new InvalidOperationException("SiteManager cannot be overriden!");
                //institution.... = secUser;

                var institutionDto = Mapper.Map<InstitutionEntityDto>(institution);
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(institutionDto);
            }


        return new BatchCreateInstitutionCommandResult();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the create institution command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoCreateInstitutionCommand(CreateInstitutionCommand command)
    {
        var newDto = new InstitutionEntityDto()
        {
            Sites = [],
            InstitutionValidities = [Mapper.Map<InstitutionValidityEntityDto>(command)],
        };

        var institutionEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(newDto);
        return new CreateInstitutionCommandResult { InstitutionEntityDto = institutionEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the batch modify institution command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoBatchModifyInstitutionCommand(BatchModifyInstitutionCommand cmd)
    {
        SecUserEntity secUserAlias = null;
        var secUser = DbContext.Session.Get<SecUserEntity>(cmd.SecUserId);

        var institutionsWithSecuser =
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InstitutionEntity>()
            //TODO: VALIDITY?
            //.JoinAlias(x => x.contactperson, () => secUserAlias)
            .Where(x => secUserAlias.Id == secUser.Id)
            .List();

        //Delete all previous connections
        foreach (var institutionWithSecuser in institutionsWithSecuser)
        {
            //TODO: validity...
            //institutionWithSecuser.contactperson = null;

            var institutionDto = Mapper.Map<InstitutionEntityDto>(institutionWithSecuser);
            _commandService.UpdateEntity(institutionDto);
        }

        //Add new connections
        if (cmd.InstitutionIds != null)
            foreach (var institutionId in cmd.InstitutionIds)
            {
                var institution = DbContext.Session.Get<InstitutionEntity>(institutionId);

                var institutionDto = Mapper.Map<InstitutionEntityDto>(institution);
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(institutionDto);
            }

        var result = new BatchModifyInstitutionCommandResult();
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify institution command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoModifyInstitutionCommand(ModifyInstitutionCommand command)
    {
        if (command.InstitutionId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.InstitutionId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new InstitutionEntityQuery { Id = command.InstitutionId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not InstitutionEntityDto institutionEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid InstitutionEntity Id. There is no InstitutionEntity with Id: '{command.InstitutionId}'");

        var updatedEntity = Mapper.Map<InstitutionEntityDto>(command);
        updatedEntity.Identifier = institutionEntity.Identifier;

        var institutionEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(updatedEntity);
        return new ModifyInstitutionCommandResult { InstitutionEntityDto = institutionEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the delete institution command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoDeleteInstitutionCommand(DeleteInstitutionCommand command)
    {
        if (command.InstitutionId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.InstitutionId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new InstitutionEntityQuery { Id = command.InstitutionId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not InstitutionEntityDto institutionEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid InstitutionEntity Id. There is no InstitutionEntity with Id: '{command.InstitutionId}'");

        /// Törlés validáció: Amennyiben az intézményhez tartozik legalább egy telephely is, az intézmény nem törölhető. Ebben az esetben figyelmeztető üzenetet adjunk!
        if (institutionEntity.Sites != null &&
            institutionEntity.Sites
                .ToList()
                .Select(l => l.IsDeleted)
                .Contains(false))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("Az intézmény nem törölhető! Szüntesse meg vagy csoportosítsa át másik intézményhez a kapcsolódó telephelyeket!");
        }

        var institutionEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<InstitutionEntityDto>(command.InstitutionId);
        return new DeleteInstitutionCommandResult { IsSuccess = institutionEntityDto == null || institutionEntityDto.IsDeleted };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>
    /// <param name="originalEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(InstitutionEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);

        foreach (var validity in originalDomainEntity.InstitutionValidities)
        {
            _commandService.DeleteEntity<InstitutionValidityEntityDto>(validity.Id);
        }

        //TODO: ha van kapcsolódó entitás, ami nem Validity-ben van, akkor azt is törölni kell
        // egyelőre nincs ilyen. de a userrole-ok majd lehet, hogy törlendők lesznek, ha bevezetésre kerülnek az orgunitba
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityCreating(InstitutionEntityDto entityDto, InstitutionEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);

        //}
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítási CRUD műveletekkor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(InstitutionEntityDto entityDto, InstitutionEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);
        AddressEntityDto? newAddress = null;

        //TODO: validity-be átkerültek ezek, itt elvileg nem kell semmit csinálni

                }

            if (newAddress != null && entityDto.Address?.AddressType != domainEntity.Address?.AddressType)

                    _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(domainEntity.Address.Id);

        */
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntityDto"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(InstitutionEntityDto originalEntityDto, InstitutionEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override InstitutionEntityDto OnEntityCreated(InstitutionEntityDto createdEntity, InstitutionEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private InstitutionEntityDto EntityPostEvent(InstitutionEntityDto savedEntityDto, InstitutionEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<InstitutionEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        entity.InstitutionValidities ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.InstitutionValidities,
                     entity.InstitutionValidities,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<InstitutionValidityEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        entity.Sites ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Sites,
                     entity.Sites,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<SiteEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override InstitutionEntity ApplyDto(InstitutionEntityDto source, InstitutionEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        // if (source. != null)
        //     LoadRef(x => x.ContactPerson!, entity, source.ContactPerson!);

        return entity;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location.Institution;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Institution;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Institution command handler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="CommandHandlerBase{InstitutionEntity, InstitutionEntityDto}" />
public class InstitutionValidityCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<InstitutionValidityEntity, InstitutionValidityEntityDto>
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _clientService;

    //TODO: partner alapján átnézni, mert ez a site-ból készült és az még nem annyira kiforrott!!!

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InstitutionValidityCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public InstitutionValidityCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<InstitutionValidityEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;    
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            CreateInstitutionValidityCommand createCommand => DoCreateInstitutionValidityCommand(createCommand),
            ModifyInstitutionValidityCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyInstitutionValidityCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteInstitutionValidityCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteInstitutionValidityCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateInstitutionValidityCommand createCommand => createCommand.InstitutionId,
            ModifyInstitutionValidityCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.InstitutionId,
            DeleteInstitutionValidityCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.InstitutionId,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteInstitutionValidityCommand(DeleteInstitutionValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var institutionEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<InstitutionEntityDto>(command.InstitutionId);
        if (institutionEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Institution Id. There is no Institution with Id: '{command.InstitutionId}'");

        if (institutionEntityDto.InstitutionValidities == null || !institutionEntityDto.InstitutionValidities.Select(x => x.Id).Contains(command.ValidityId))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid InstitutionValidity Id. There is no InstitutionValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        //legalább egy érvényességnek léteznie kell az adott intézményhez
        if ((institutionEntityDto.InstitutionValidities?.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).Count() ?? 0) <= 1)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"At least one validity is required for the institution: {institutionEntityDto?.Name}");

        var institutionValidityEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<InstitutionValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);


        return new DeleteInstitutionValidityCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (institutionValidityEntityDto == null) || institutionValidityEntityDto.IsDeleted
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateInstitutionValidityCommand(CreateInstitutionValidityCommand command)
    {
        var entityRef = new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto> { Id = command.InstitutionId };

        var institutionValidity = Mapper.Map<InstitutionValidityEntityDto>(command,
            x => x.AfterMap((src, dest) => dest.Institution = entityRef));

        var entity = _commandService.CreateEntity(institutionValidity);
        return new CreateInstitutionValidityCommandResult
        {
            InstitutionValidityEntityDto = entity
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyInstitutionValidityCommand(ModifyInstitutionValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var validityEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<InstitutionValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);
        if (validityEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid InstitutionValidity Id. There is no InstitutionValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        Mapper.Map(command, validityEntityDto);


        var updatedEntity = _commandService.UpdateEntity(validityEntityDto);
        return new ModifyInstitutionValidityCommandResult { InstitutionValidityEntityDto = updatedEntity };
    }

    protected override void OnEntityCreating(InstitutionValidityEntityDto entityDto, InstitutionValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);

        if (entityDto.Headquarters != null)
        {
            var addressEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto.Headquarters);
            if (addressEntityDto is null)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Can't save {nameof(entityDto.Headquarters)}");

            LoadRef(x => x.Headquarters, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(addressEntityDto));
        }
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(InstitutionValidityEntityDto entityDto, InstitutionValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);


        if (entityDto.Headquarters != null)
        {
            if (domainEntity.Headquarters != null)
                entityDto.Headquarters.Id = domainEntity.Headquarters.Id;

            var newAddress = (entityDto.Headquarters.Id != 0
                ? _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto.Headquarters)
                : _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto.Headquarters));

            if (entityDto.Headquarters.AddressType != domainEntity.Headquarters?.AddressType)
            {
                LoadRef(x => x.Headquarters, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(newAddress));
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (domainEntity.Headquarters != null)
                _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(domainEntity.Headquarters.Id);
            domainEntity.Headquarters = null;
        }
    }

    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(InstitutionValidityEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);

        //TODO: egy cím tartozhat-e egyszerre több entitáshoz? ha igen, akkor a törlés nem ilyen egyszerű
        if (originalDomainEntity.Headquarters != null)
        {
            _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(originalDomainEntity.Headquarters.Id);
        }
    }

    protected override InstitutionValidityEntity ApplyDto(InstitutionValidityEntityDto source, InstitutionValidityEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.Institution!, entity, source.Institution!);

        return entity;
    }

    protected override InstitutionValidityEntityDto OnEntityCreated(InstitutionValidityEntityDto createdEntity, InstitutionValidityEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return entityDto;
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(InstitutionValidityEntityDto originalEntityDto, InstitutionValidityEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
