using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Command handler for room-related commands
/// </summary>
public class RoomCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<RoomEntity, RoomEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _clientService;

    public RoomCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<RoomEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            CreateRoomCommand createRoomCommand => DoCreateRoomCommand(createRoomCommand),
            ModifyRoomCommand modifyRoomCommand => DoModifyRoomCommand(modifyRoomCommand),
            DeleteRoomCommand deleteRoomCommand => DoDeleteRoomCommand(deleteRoomCommand),
            ModifyRoomPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand => DoModifyPodsCommand(modifyPodsCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        //TODO! null-t csak akkor adhat vissza, ha Institution Create a command, mert annak szülője már a tenant -> ezt az institutioncommandhandlerben majd le kell kezelni!

        return command switch
        {
            CreateRoomCommand createCommand => createCommand.Floor.Id,
            ModifyRoomCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.RoomId,
            DeleteRoomCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.RoomId,
            ModifyRoomPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand => modifyPodsCommand.Id,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyPodsCommand(ModifyRoomPodsCommand modifyPodsCommand)
    {
        var joinedPods = string.Join(',', modifyPodsCommand.PodIdentifiers);

        var roomEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<RoomEntity>(modifyPodsCommand.Id);

        if (roomEntity == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid RoomEntity Id. There is no RoomEntity with Id: '{modifyPodsCommand.Id}'");
        }

        roomEntity.PodIdentifiers = joinedPods;

        DbContext.Session.Update(roomEntity);
        return new ModifyPodsCommandResult { PodIdentifiers = roomEntity.PodIdentifiers?.Split(',') ?? [] };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateRoomCommand(CreateRoomCommand createRoomCommand)
    {
        var entityDto = new RoomEntityDto()
        {
            RoomValidities = [Mapper.Map<RoomValidityEntityDto>(createRoomCommand)],
            Floor = createRoomCommand.Floor,
        };
        Mapper.Map(createRoomCommand, entityDto);


        var roomEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);
        return new CreateRoomCommandResult { RoomEntityDto = roomEntityDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyRoomCommand(ModifyRoomCommand modifyRoomCommand)
    {
        if (modifyRoomCommand.RoomId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modifyRoomCommand.RoomId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new RoomEntityQuery { Id = modifyRoomCommand.RoomId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not RoomEntityDto roomEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid RoomEntity Id. There is no RoomEntity with Id: '{modifyRoomCommand.RoomId}'");

        Mapper.Map(modifyRoomCommand, roomEntity);

        var roomEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(roomEntity);
        return new ModifyRoomCommandResult { RoomEntityDto = roomEntityDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteRoomCommand(DeleteRoomCommand deleteRoomCommand)
    {
        //TODO: validators
        if (deleteRoomCommand.RoomId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(deleteRoomCommand.RoomId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new RoomEntityQuery { Id = deleteRoomCommand.RoomId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not RoomEntityDto roomEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid RoomEntity Id. There is no RoomEntity with Id: '{deleteRoomCommand.RoomId}'");


        var roomEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<RoomEntityDto>(deleteRoomCommand.RoomId);
        return new DeleteRoomCommandResult { IsSuccess = roomEntityDto == null || roomEntityDto.IsDeleted };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override RoomEntityDto OnEntityCreated(RoomEntityDto createdEntity, RoomEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>
    /// <param name="originalEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(RoomEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(RoomEntityDto originalEntityDto, RoomEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private RoomEntityDto EntityPostEvent(RoomEntityDto savedEntityDto, RoomEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<RoomEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        if (source.RoomValidities != null)
        {
            entity.RoomValidities ??= new List<RoomValidityEntity>();

            ICollection<RoomValidityEntity> deletedElements;

            ListHelper.MergeList(source.RoomValidities,
                                 entity.RoomValidities,
                                 (src, dest) => src.Id == dest.Id,
                                 validityDto =>
                                 {
                                     validityDto.Room = new EntityRef<RoomEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                                     var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(validityDto);
                                     return DbContext.Session.Load<RoomValidityEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                 }, out deletedElements);

            foreach (var floorpart in source.RoomValidities.Where(x => x.Id != 0))
            {
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(floorpart);
            }

            foreach (var deletedElement in deletedElements)
            {
                _commandService.DeleteEntity<RoomValidityEntityDto>(deletedElement.Id);
            }
        }

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);
        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override RoomEntity ApplyDto(RoomEntityDto source, RoomEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        LoadRef(x => x.Floor, entity, source.Floor);

        return entity;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Room;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// RoomValidityCommandHandler
/// </summary>
public class RoomValidityCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<RoomValidityEntity, RoomValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _clientService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RoomValidityCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="monitoringApiClientService">The monitoring API client service.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public RoomValidityCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<RoomValidityEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            CreateRoomValidityCommand createCommand => DoCreateRoomValidityCommand(createCommand),
            ModifyRoomValidityCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyRoomValidityCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteRoomValidityCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteRoomValidityCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateRoomValidityCommand createCommand => createCommand.RoomId,
            ModifyRoomValidityCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.RoomId,
            DeleteRoomValidityCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.RoomId,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteRoomValidityCommand(DeleteRoomValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var roomEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<RoomEntityDto>(command.RoomId);
        if (roomEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid RoomId. There is no Room with Id: '{command.RoomId}'");

        if (roomEntityDto.RoomValidities == null || !roomEntityDto.RoomValidities.Select(x => x.Id).Contains(command.ValidityId))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid RoomValidity Id. There is no RoomValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        //legalább egy érvényességnek léteznie kell az adott helyiséghez
        if ((roomEntityDto.RoomValidities?.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).Count() ?? 0) <= 1)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"At least one validity is required for the room: {roomEntityDto?.Name}");

        var roomValidityEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<RoomValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);
        return new DeleteRoomValidityCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (roomEntityDto == null) || roomEntityDto.IsDeleted
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateRoomValidityCommand(CreateRoomValidityCommand command)
    {
        RoomValidityEntityDto roomValidity = Mapper.Map<RoomValidityEntityDto>(command);
        roomValidity.Room = new EntityRef<RoomEntityDto>() { Id = command.RoomId };

        var entity = _commandService.CreateEntity(roomValidity);
        return new CreateRoomValidityCommandResult
        {
            RoomValidityEntityDto = entity
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyRoomValidityCommand(ModifyRoomValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var roomValidityEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<RoomValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);
        if (roomValidityEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid RoomValidity Id. There is no RoomValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        Mapper.Map(command, roomValidityEntityDto);


        var updatedEntity = _commandService.UpdateEntity(roomValidityEntityDto);
        return new ModifyRoomValidityCommandResult { RoomValidityEntityDto = updatedEntity };
    }

    protected override RoomValidityEntityDto OnEntityCreated(RoomValidityEntityDto createdEntity, RoomValidityEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return entityDto;
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(RoomValidityEntityDto originalEntityDto, RoomValidityEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(RoomValidityEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    protected override RoomValidityEntity ApplyDto(RoomValidityEntityDto source, RoomValidityEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.Room!, entity, source.Room!);

        if (source.ContactPerson != null)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.ContactPerson, entity, source.ContactPerson);
        }
        if (source.RoomProfile != null)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.RoomProfile, entity, source.RoomProfile);
        }

        return entity;
    }
}

    /// Az entitás módosítási CRUD műveletekkor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(SiteEntityDto entityDto, SiteEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntityDto"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(SiteEntityDto originalEntityDto, SiteEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override SiteEntityDto OnEntityCreated(SiteEntityDto createdEntity, SiteEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the create site command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ICommandResult DoCreateSiteCommand(CreateSiteCommand command)
    {
        var entityDto = new SiteEntityDto()
        {
            Buildings = [],
            SiteValidities = [Mapper.Map<SiteValidityEntityDto>(command)],
            Institution = command.Institution
        };

        var siteEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);
        return new CreateSiteCommandResult { SiteEntityDto = siteEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the batch modify site command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cmd">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">SiteManager cannot be overriden!</exception>

        var result = new BatchModifySiteCommandResult();
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify site command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">SiteId - Missing argument</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid SiteEntity Id. There is no SiteEntity with Id: '{command.SiteId}'</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoModifySiteCommand(ModifySiteCommand command)
    {
        if (command.SiteId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.SiteId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SiteEntityQuery { Id = command.SiteId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not SiteEntityDto siteEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SiteEntity Id. There is no SiteEntity with Id: '{command.SiteId}'");

        var updatedEntity = Mapper.Map<SiteEntityDto>(command);
        updatedEntity.Identifier = siteEntity.Identifier;

        var siteEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(updatedEntity);
        return new ModifySiteCommandResult { SiteEntityDto = siteEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the delete site command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">SiteId - Missing argument</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid SiteEntity Id. There is no SiteEntity with Id: '{command.SiteId}'</exception>
    /// <exception cref="FluentValidation.ValidationException">A telephely nem törölhető! Szüntesse meg vagy csoportosítsa át másik telephelyhez a kapcsolódó épületeket!</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoDeleteSiteCommand(DeleteSiteCommand command)
    {
        if (command.SiteId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.SiteId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SiteEntityQuery { Id = command.SiteId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not SiteEntityDto siteEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SiteEntity Id. There is no SiteEntity with Id: '{command.SiteId}'");

        /// Törlés validáció: Amennyiben a telephelyhez tartozik legalább egy épület is, a telephely nem törölhető. Ebben az esetben figyelmeztető üzenetet adjunk!
        if (siteEntity.Buildings != null &&
            siteEntity.Buildings.Any(x => !x.IsDeleted))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("A telephely nem törölhető! Szüntesse meg vagy csoportosítsa át másik telephelyhez a kapcsolódó épületeket!");
        }

        var siteEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<SiteEntityDto>(command.SiteId);
        return new DeleteSiteCommandResult { IsSuccess = siteEntityDto == null || siteEntityDto.IsDeleted };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private SiteEntityDto EntityPostEvent(SiteEntityDto savedEntityDto, SiteEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<SiteEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        entity.SiteValidities ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.SiteValidities,
                     entity.SiteValidities,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<SiteValidityEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });


        entity.Buildings ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Buildings,
                     entity.Buildings,
                     (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<BuildingEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override SiteEntity ApplyDto(SiteEntityDto source, SiteEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        LoadRef(x => x.Institution, entity, source.Institution);

        return entity;
    }
}

        //LoadRef(x => x.ParentOrgUnit!, entity, source.ParentOrgunit!); ???

        // IoTDevices
        entity.IoTDevices ??= new List<DeviceEntity>();
        ListHelper.MergeList(source.IoTDevices,
            entity.IoTDevices, (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id, deviceRef =>
            {
                var device = DbContext.Session.Load<DeviceEntity>(deviceRef.Id);
                return device;
            }, out _);

        return entity;
    }

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Shared.Commands;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location.Site;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Site;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// SiteValidityCommandHandler
/// </summary>
public class SiteValidityCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<SiteValidityEntity, SiteValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _clientService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SiteValidityCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public SiteValidityCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<SiteValidityEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _clientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(command);
        CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return command switch
        {
            CreateSiteValidityCommand createCommand => DoCreateSiteValidityCommand(createCommand),
            ModifySiteValidityCommand modifyCommand => DoModifySiteValidityCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteSiteValidityCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteSiteValidityCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateSiteValidityCommand createCommand => createCommand.SiteId,
            ModifySiteValidityCommand modifyCommand => modifyCommand.SiteId,
            DeleteSiteValidityCommand deleteCommand => deleteCommand.SiteId,
            UpdateEntityCommand generatedUpdateCommand => generatedUpdateCommand.Update.Entity.Id, //spec eset: futás közben generált update command, amin nincs attribútum, de befut ide
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteSiteValidityCommand(DeleteSiteValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var siteEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<SiteEntityDto>(command.SiteId);
        if (siteEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Site Id. There is no Site with Id: '{command.SiteId}'");

        if (siteEntityDto.SiteValidities == null || !siteEntityDto.SiteValidities.Select(x => x.Id).Contains(command.ValidityId))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SiteValidity Id. There is no SiteValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        //legalább egy érvényességnek léteznie kell az adott telephelyhez
        if ((siteEntityDto.SiteValidities?.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).Count() ?? 0) <= 1)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"At least one validity is required for the site: {siteEntityDto?.Name}");

        var siteValidityEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<SiteValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);

        return new DeleteSiteValidityCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (siteValidityEntityDto == null) || siteValidityEntityDto.IsDeleted
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateSiteValidityCommand(CreateSiteValidityCommand command)
    {
        SiteValidityEntityDto siteValidity = Mapper.Map<SiteValidityEntityDto>(command);
        siteValidity.Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>() { Id = command.SiteId };

        var entity = _commandService.CreateEntity(siteValidity);
        return new CreateSiteValidityCommandResult
        {
            SiteValidityEntityDto = entity
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifySiteValidityCommand(ModifySiteValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var siteValidityEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<SiteValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);
        if (siteValidityEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid SiteValidity Id. There is no SiteValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        Mapper.Map(command, siteValidityEntityDto);


        var updatedEntity = _commandService.UpdateEntity(siteValidityEntityDto);
        return new ModifySiteValidityCommandResult { SiteValidityEntityDto = updatedEntity };
    }

    protected override void OnEntityCreating(SiteValidityEntityDto entityDto, SiteValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);

        if (entityDto.Address != null)
        {
            var addressEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto.Address);
            if (addressEntityDto is null)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Can't save {nameof(entityDto.Address)}");

            LoadRef(x => x.Address, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(addressEntityDto));
        }
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(SiteValidityEntityDto entityDto, SiteValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);
        if (entityDto.Address != null)
        {
            if (domainEntity.Address != null)
                entityDto.Address.Id = domainEntity.Address.Id;

            var newAddress = (entityDto.Address.Id != 0
                ? _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto.Address)
                : _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto.Address));

            if (entityDto.Address.AddressType != domainEntity.Address?.AddressType)
            {
                LoadRef(x => x.Address, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(newAddress));
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (domainEntity.Address != null)
                _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(domainEntity.Address.Id);
            domainEntity.Address = null;
        }
    }

    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(SiteValidityEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);
        //TODO: Delete logic for address
    }

    protected override SiteValidityEntity ApplyDto(SiteValidityEntityDto source, SiteValidityEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.Site!, entity, source.Site!);

        if (source.ContactPerson != null)
        {
            LoadRef(x => x.ContactPerson, entity, source.ContactPerson);
        }

        return entity;
    }

    protected override SiteValidityEntityDto OnEntityCreated(SiteValidityEntityDto createdEntity, SiteValidityEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, entityDto.Created!.Value);
        return entityDto;
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(SiteValidityEntityDto originalEntityDto, SiteValidityEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        SendSyncMessage(_clientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization, updatedEntityDto.Modified!.Value);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Command handler for measurementPoint-related commands

public class MeasurementPointCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<MeasurementPointEntity, MeasurementPointEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _monitoringClientService;
    private readonly DataReceiverApiClientService _dataReceiverlientService;

    /// <summary>
    /// TenantIndependentDictCache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tenantIndependentCache;

    public MeasurementPointCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<MeasurementPointEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        DataReceiverApiClientService dataReceiverlientService,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tenantIndependent) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _tenantIndependentCache = tenantIndependent;
        _monitoringClientService = monitoringApiClientService;
        _dataReceiverlientService = dataReceiverlientService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateMeasurementPointCommand createCommand => DoCreateMeasurementPointCommand(createCommand),
            ModifyMeasurementPointCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyMeasurementPointCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeleteMeasurementPointCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteMeasurementPointCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    private MeasurementPointCommandResult DoModifyMeasurementPointCommand(ModifyMeasurementPointCommand modifyCommand)
    {
        if (modifyCommand.MeasurementPointId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modifyCommand.MeasurementPointId), "Missing argument");

        var entityDto = _queryService.GetById<MeasurementPointEntityDto>(modifyCommand.MeasurementPointId);
        if (entityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid MeasurementPoint Id. There is no MeasurementPoint with Id: '{modifyCommand.MeasurementPointId}'");

        entityDto.MeasuredProperties.Clear();

        Mapper.Map(modifyCommand, entityDto);

        if (modifyCommand.IsBilling) entityDto.ParentMeasurementPoint = null;

        var labels = _tenantIndependentCache.GetItems(DictType.MeasuredDataLabel)?
            .Where(x => modifyCommand.MeasuredDataLabelIds.Contains(x.Id))
            .ToList() ?? [];
        entityDto.Labels = labels;

        foreach (var id in modifyCommand.MeasuredPropertyIds)
        {
            var propertyEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>(id);
            entityDto.MeasuredProperties.Add(propertyEntityDto);
        }

        var orgUnit = _queryService.GetById<OrgunitBaseEntityDto>(entityDto.OrgunitBase.Id);
        if (entityDto.IsBilling)
        {
            if (orgUnit is IMeasurementPointProperties properties && (!properties.IsAggregationPoint.HasValue || !properties.IsAggregationPoint.Value))
            {
                properties.IsAggregationPoint = true;
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(orgUnit);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (orgUnit is IMeasurementPointProperties properties && !properties.IsMeasurementPoint)
            {
                properties.IsMeasurementPoint = true;
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(orgUnit);
            }
        }

        var measurementPointEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto);
        return new MeasurementPointCommandResult { MeasurementPointEntityDto = measurementPointEntityDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateMeasurementPointCommand(CreateMeasurementPointCommand createCommand)
    {
        var entityDto = Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointEntityDto>(createCommand);
        var labels = _tenantIndependentCache.GetItems(DictType.MeasuredDataLabel)?.Where(x => createCommand.MeasuredDataLabelIds.Contains(x.Id))
                                                                                  .ToList() ?? [];
        entityDto.Labels = labels;
        entityDto.ParentMeasurementPoint = !createCommand.IsBilling && createCommand.MeasurementPoint?.Id > 0
            ? new EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto> { Id = createCommand.MeasurementPoint.Id }
            : null;

        var savedEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);

        var orgUnit = _queryService.GetById<OrgunitBaseEntityDto>(savedEntityDto.OrgunitBase.Id);
        if (savedEntityDto.IsBilling)
        {
            if (orgUnit is IMeasurementPointProperties properties && (!properties.IsAggregationPoint.HasValue || !properties.IsAggregationPoint.Value))
            {
                properties.IsAggregationPoint = true;
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(orgUnit);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (orgUnit is IMeasurementPointProperties properties && !properties.IsMeasurementPoint)
            {
                properties.IsMeasurementPoint = true;
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(orgUnit);
            }
        }

        foreach (var measuredPropertyId in createCommand.MeasuredPropertyIds)
        {
            var setting = new MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto
            {
                MeasurementPoint = new EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>() { Id = savedEntityDto.Id },
                MeasuredProperty = new EntityRef<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>() { Id = measuredPropertyId }
            };

            _ = _commandService.CreateEntity(setting);
        }

        return new MeasurementPointCommandResult()
        {
            MeasurementPointEntityDto = savedEntityDto,
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override MeasurementPointEntityDto OnEntityCreated(MeasurementPointEntityDto createdEntity, MeasurementPointEntityDto source)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverlientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, createdEntity.Created!.Value);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, createdEntity.Created!.Value);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(MeasurementPointEntityDto originalEntity, MeasurementPointEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverlientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, updatedEntity.Modified!.Value);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, updatedEntity.Modified!.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás törlését követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalDomainEntity"></param>
    /// <param name="originalEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(MeasurementPointEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);
        SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverlientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, DateTime.UtcNow);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, DateTime.UtcNow);
        //TODO: delete related things as needed
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Handles the delete measurement point command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The delete command.</param>
    /// <returns>The command result.</returns>
    private DeleteMeasurementPointCommandResult DoDeleteMeasurementPointCommand(DeleteMeasurementPointCommand command)
    {
        if (command.Id <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentException("Invalid MeasurementPoint Id", nameof(command.Id));

        // Get the measurement point to delete
        var measurementPoint = _queryService.GetById<MeasurementPointEntityDto>(command.Id);
        if (measurementPoint == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Measurement point with ID {command.Id} not found", nameof(command.Id));

        // Get the measurement point to delete
        if (measurementPoint.ChildMeasurementPoints?.Count > 0)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("A mérési pont nem törölhető, amennyiben a mérési pont hierarchiában felettes mérési pontként van beállítva!");

        // Perform the logical delete
        _commandService.DeleteEntity<MeasurementPointEntityDto>(command.Id);

        // Get the organization unit for potential updates
        var orgUnitId = measurementPoint.OrgunitBase?.Id;
        if (orgUnitId == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Measurement point is not associated with an organization unit");

        var orgUnit = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new OrgunitBaseEntityQuery { OrgunitId = orgUnitId.Value }).RunSync().Entity as OrgunitBaseEntityDto;

        if (orgUnit == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Associated organization unit with ID {orgUnitId} not found!");


        if (orgUnit is IMeasurementPointProperties orgunitWithProperties)
        {
            if (!orgUnit.MeasurementPoints.Any())
            {
                orgunitWithProperties.IsAggregationPoint = false;
                orgunitWithProperties.IsMeasurementPoint = false;
            }
            if (!orgUnit.MeasurementPoints.Any(x => x.IsBilling))
            {
                orgunitWithProperties.IsAggregationPoint = false;
            }
            _commandService.UpdateEntity(orgUnit);
        }

        return new DeleteMeasurementPointCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = true,
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private MeasurementPointEntityDto EntityPostEvent(MeasurementPointEntityDto savedEntityDto, MeasurementPointEntityDto source)
    {
        //Ez a metódus lehet, hogy nem fog kelleni és törölhető 
        return savedEntityDto;
    }
    protected override MeasurementPointEntity ApplyDto(MeasurementPointEntityDto source, MeasurementPointEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        LoadRef(x => x.OrgunitBase, entity, source.OrgunitBase);
        LoadRef(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, entity, source.ParentMeasurementPoint);

        MergeList(source.Labels, entity.Labels, (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id, entityRef => entityRef.Id);

        MergeList(source.MeasuredProperties, entity.MeasuredProperties, (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id, entityRef => entityRef.Id);

        return entity;
    }
}

public class MeasurementPointSettingCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<MeasurementPointSettingEntity, MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto>

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _monitoringClientService;

        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        DataReceiverApiClientService dataReceiverClientService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _monitoringClientService = monitoringApiClientService;
        _dataReceiverClientService = dataReceiverClientService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            MeasurementPointSettingCommand settingCommand => DoMeasurementPointSettingCommand(settingCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoMeasurementPointSettingCommand(MeasurementPointSettingCommand command)
    {
        var query = new MeasurementPointSettingEntityQuery() 
        {
            MeasurementPointId = command.MeasurementPointId,
            MeasuredPropertyId = command.MeasuredPropertyId
        };

        var result = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(query).RunSync();
        if (result?.Entity != null && result.Entity is MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto entityDto)
        {
            entityDto.Channel = command.ChannelId.HasValue ? new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto>() { Id = command.ChannelId.Value } : null;
            _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto);
        }
        else 
        {
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"MeasurementPointSetting is not found!");
        }
        return null;
    }

    protected override MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto OnEntityCreated(MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto createdEntity, MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, DateTime.UtcNow);
        SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, DateTime.UtcNow);
        return entity;
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto originalEntity, MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, DateTime.UtcNow);
        SendSyncMessage(_dataReceiverClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync, DateTime.UtcNow);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override MeasurementPointSettingEntity ApplyDto(MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto source, MeasurementPointSettingEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.Channel, entity, source.Channel);
        LoadRef(x => x.MeasurementPoint, entity, source.MeasurementPoint);
        LoadRef(x => x.MeasuredProperty, entity, source.MeasuredProperty);

        return entity;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// TimeSeriesSchemaCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.ModelCatalogue.TimeSeriesSchemaEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.IoT.TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto&gt;" />
public class TimeSeriesSchemaCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<TimeSeriesSchemaEntity, TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TimeSeriesSchemaCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public TimeSeriesSchemaCommandHandler(IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto OnEntityCreated(TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto createdEntity, TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto source)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto originalEntity, TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto EntityPostEvent(TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto savedEntityDto, TimeSeriesSchemaEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<TimeSeriesSchemaEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        if (source.Meta != null)
        {
            entity.Meta ??= new List<TimeSeriesMetaTypeEntity>();

            var timeSeriesEntityDto = savedEntityDto;
            var modelCatalogueEntityDto = savedEntityDto;
            ListHelper.MergeList(source.Meta,
                entity.Meta, (x, y) => x.Id > 0 && x.Id == y.Id, dto =>
                {
                    var metaTypeEntity = Mapper.Map<TimeSeriesMetaTypeEntity>(dto);
                    LoadRef(x => x.Unit, metaTypeEntity, new EntityRef<TimeSeriesMetaTypeEntityDto>
                    {
                        Id = modelCatalogueEntityDto.Id
                    });
                    return metaTypeEntity;
                }, out var deletedElements);

            foreach (var deletedElement in deletedElements)
                TryDelete<TimeSeriesMetaTypeEntity>(deletedElement.Id);
        }

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Notifications;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Notifications;
using Common.Logic.Services;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Notifications;

/// <summary>
/// NotificationCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Notifications.NotificationEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Notifications.NotificationEntityDto&gt;" />
public class NotificationCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<NotificationEntity, NotificationEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="NotificationCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">Database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">Mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger"Access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">Validator.</param>
    public NotificationCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        ICommandService commandService,
        Lazy<IValidator<NotificationEntityDto>> validator) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    { }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override NotificationEntity ApplyDto(NotificationEntityDto source, NotificationEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        MergeList(source.TargetUsers.ToList(),
            entity.TargetUsers,
            (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id,
            entityRef => entityRef.Id);

        return entity;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dto"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityCreating(NotificationEntityDto dto, NotificationEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(dto, domainEntity);
        //domainEntity.HtmlTemplate = ???? nincs a dto-n
        domainEntity.HtmlTemplate = dto.HtmlTemplateId > 0 ? DbContext.Session.Get<TemplateEntity>(dto.HtmlTemplateId) : null;
        dto.NotificationState = NotificationState.Pending;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        if (command is SetNotificationReadCommand readCommand)
            return DoSetNotificationReadCommand(readCommand);

        return base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the set notification read command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="readCommand">The read command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Notification Id={readCommand.Id} is invalid!</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoSetNotificationReadCommand(SetNotificationReadCommand readCommand)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Get<NotificationEntity>(readCommand.Id);
        if (entity == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Notification Id={readCommand.Id} is invalid!");

        entity.IsRead = true;

        DbContext.Session.Save(entity);
        return new SetNotificationReadCommandResult();
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.OrgunitImport;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.OrgunitImport;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.OrgunitImport;
using FluentValidation;


namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.OrgunitImport;

public class OrgunitImportJobResultCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<OrgunitImportJobResultEntity, OrgunitImportJobResultEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;



    public OrgunitImportJobResultCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<OrgunitImportJobResultEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            UploadOrgunitCommand uploadCommand => DoUploadOrgunitCommand(uploadCommand),
            DeleteOrgunitImportJobCommand deleteCommand => DoDeleteOrgunitImportJobCommand(deleteCommand),
            FinalizeOrgunitImportCommand finalizeCommand => DoFinalizeOrgunitImportJobCommand(finalizeCommand),
            BatchOrgunitImportCommand batchCommand => DoBatchOrgunitImportJobCommand(batchCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoBatchOrgunitImportJobCommand(BatchOrgunitImportCommand batchCommand)
    {
        UpdateEntities(batchCommand.EntityDtos.InstitutionEntityDtos);
        UpdateEntities(batchCommand.EntityDtos.SiteEntityDtos);
        UpdateEntities(batchCommand.EntityDtos.BuildingEntityDtos);
        UpdateEntities(batchCommand.EntityDtos.BuildingPartEntityDtos);
        UpdateEntities(batchCommand.EntityDtos.FloorEntityDtos);
        UpdateEntities(batchCommand.EntityDtos.RoomEntityDtos);

        return null;
    }

    private ICommandResult DoFinalizeOrgunitImportJobCommand(FinalizeOrgunitImportCommand finalizeCommand)
    {
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        var jobEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<OrgunitImportJobResultEntityDto>(finalizeCommand.Id);
        if (jobEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid OrgunitImportJobResult Id. There is no OrgunitImportJobResult with Id: '{finalizeCommand.Id}'");

        jobEntityDto.Status = JobResultStatus.Finalizing;
        _commandService.UpdateEntity(jobEntityDto);

        OrgunitImportFinalizerJob.PostJob(_securityContext, DbContext, tenantCode, finalizeCommand.Id);

        return null;
    }

    private ICommandResult DoUploadOrgunitCommand(UploadOrgunitCommand uploadCommand)
    {
        var user = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(user.TenantCode))
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Globális Adminisztrátorral a 'Topológia elemek importálása' parancs nem hajtható végre!");

        var userQuery = new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
        {
            GlobalId = user.GlobalId,
            TenantCode = user.TenantCode,
            IsDeleted = false
        };

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(userQuery).RunSync()?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto secUser)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Invalid user with global id: '{userQuery.GlobalId}'");

        var jobResult = new OrgunitImportJobResultEntityDto()
        {
            JobId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            FileName = uploadCommand.OrgunitImport.FileName,
            SecUser = new EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>() { Id = secUser.Id },
            InitiationDate = DateTime.Now,
            Status = JobResultStatus.New,
        };

        _commandService.CreateEntity(jobResult);

        byte[] fileBytes;
        using (var memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
        {
            uploadCommand.OrgunitImport.CopyTo(memoryStream);
            fileBytes = memoryStream.ToArray();
        }

        OrgunitImportDataProcessorJob.PostJob(
            _securityContext,
            DbContext,
            user.TenantCode,
            jobResult.JobId,
            uploadCommand.OrgunitImport.FileName,
            fileBytes);

        return new UploadOrgunitCommandResult() { JobId = jobResult.JobId };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeleteOrgunitImportJobCommand(DeleteOrgunitImportJobCommand deleteCommand)
    {
        if (deleteCommand.JobId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(deleteCommand.JobId), "Missing argument");

        var jobEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<OrgunitImportJobResultEntityDto>(deleteCommand.JobId);
        if (jobEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid OrgunitImportJobResult Id. There is no OrgunitImportJobResult with Id: '{deleteCommand.JobId}'");

        if (deleteCommand.AllowDeletingAnyStatus == false)
        {
            //user csak ezeket törölheti:
            var statusesAllowedToDeleteByUser = new HashSet<JobResultStatus>([JobResultStatus.Validated, JobResultStatus.Failed, JobResultStatus.Finalized]);
            if (!statusesAllowedToDeleteByUser.Contains(jobEntityDto.Status))
            {
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Deleting import job with status {jobEntityDto.Status} is not allowed!");
            }
        }

        jobEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<OrgunitImportJobResultEntityDto>(jobEntityDto.Id);
        return new DeleteOrgunitImportJobCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (jobEntityDto == null)
        };
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override OrgunitImportJobResultEntity ApplyDto(OrgunitImportJobResultEntityDto source, OrgunitImportJobResultEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.SecUser, entity, source.SecUser);

        return entity;
    }

    private void UpdateEntities<T>(List<T> list) where T : IEntityDto
    {
        foreach (var item in list)
        {
            _commandService.UpdateEntity<T>(item);
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Partner;
