using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Partner;

/// <summary>
/// PartnerCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner.PartnerEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners.PartnerEntityDto&gt;" />
public class PartnerCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<PartnerEntity, PartnerEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PartnerCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public PartnerCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<PartnerEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _securityContext = securityContext;
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(PartnerEntityDto originalEntity, PartnerEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntity, originalEntity);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private PartnerEntityDto EntityPostEvent(PartnerEntityDto savedEntityDto, PartnerEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<PartnerEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        ListHelper.MergeList(source.PartnerValidities,
                             entity.PartnerValidities,
                             (src, dest) => src.Id == dest.Id,
                             validityDto =>
                             {
                                 validityDto.Partner = new EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                                 var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(validityDto);
                                 return DbContext.Session.Load<PartnerValidityEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                             });

        if (source.PartnerStatistics != null)
        {
            entity.PartnerStatistics ??= new List<PartnerStatisticsEntity>();

            ICollection<PartnerStatisticsEntity> deletedElements;

            ListHelper.MergeList(source.PartnerStatistics,
                entity.PartnerStatistics, (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id, dto =>
                {
                    var newDtoItem = _commandService.UpdateEntity(dto);
                    return DbContext.Session.Load<PartnerStatisticsEntity>(newDtoItem.Id);
                }, out deletedElements);

            foreach (var measurementLocation in source.PartnerStatistics.Where(x => x.Id != 0))
                _commandService.UpdateEntity(measurementLocation);

            foreach (var deletedElement in deletedElements)
                _commandService.DeleteEntity<PartnerStatisticsEntityDto>(deletedElement.Id);
        }

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreatePartnerCommand createCommand => DoCreatePartnerCommand(createCommand),
            ModifyPartnerCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyPartnerCommand(modifyCommand),
            ModifyCurrentPartnerCommand modifyCurrentCommand => DoModifyCurrentPartnerCommand(modifyCurrentCommand),
            DeletePartnerCommand deleteCommand => DoDeletePartnerCommand(deleteCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify current partner command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Globális Adminisztrátorral a 'Saját partner módosítása' parancs nem hajtható végre!</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">There is no Partner with TenantCode of: '{tenantCode}'</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoModifyCurrentPartnerCommand(ModifyCurrentPartnerCommand command)
    {
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Globális Adminisztrátorral a 'Saját partner módosítása' parancs nem hajtható végre!");

        PartnerEntityDto? partnerEntityDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery { TenantCode = tenantCode }).Result?.Entity as PartnerEntityDto;
        if (partnerEntityDto == null || partnerEntityDto.IsDeleted)
            throw new ArgumentException($"There is no Partner with TenantCode of: '{tenantCode}'");


        var modifiedDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(partnerEntityDto);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode))
        {
            using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
            scope.SetSecurityContext(SecurityContext.Create(
                scope,
                _securityContext.CurrentUser.Clone(null),
                sessionId: _securityContext.SessionId,
                clientIp: _securityContext.ClientIp));
            var tiDbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
            var tenantIndependentPartnerEntity = tiDbContext.Session
                .QueryOver<PartnerEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.TenantCode == partnerEntityDto.TenantCode)
                .List().First();
            tiDbContext.Session.Update(tenantIndependentPartnerEntity);
            tiDbContext.Commit();
        }

        return new ModifyPartnerCommandResult { PartnerEntityDto = modifiedDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the delete partner command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">PartnerId - Missing argument:</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoDeletePartnerCommand(DeletePartnerCommand command)
    {
        if (command.PartnerId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.PartnerId), "Missing argument:");

        PartnerEntityDto? partnerEntityDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery { PartnerId = command.PartnerId }).Result?.Entity as PartnerEntityDto;

        // Amennyiben nem találtuk meg a törlendő partner példányt. Amennyiben már (logikailag) törölve volt, akkor is ide esünk be.
        if (partnerEntityDto == null || partnerEntityDto.IsDeleted)
            return new DeletePartnerCommandResult { IsSuccess = false };

        if (partnerEntityDto.TenantCode is { } tenantCode)
            _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteTenantCommand()
            {
                TenantCode = tenantCode,
            });

        partnerEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<PartnerEntityDto>(partnerEntityDto.Id);
        return new DeletePartnerCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (partnerEntityDto == null) || partnerEntityDto.IsDeleted
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the modify partner command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">Missing argument: - PartnerId</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentException">Invalid Partner Id. There is no Partner with Id: '{command.PartnerId}'</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoModifyPartnerCommand(ModifyPartnerCommand command)
    {
        if (command.PartnerId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException("Missing argument:", nameof(command.PartnerId));

        PartnerEntityDto? partnerEntityDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery { PartnerId = command.PartnerId }).Result?.Entity as PartnerEntityDto;
        if (partnerEntityDto == null || partnerEntityDto.IsDeleted)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Partner Id. There is no Partner with Id: '{command.PartnerId}'");


        var modifiedDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(partnerEntityDto);
        return new ModifyPartnerCommandResult { PartnerEntityDto = modifiedDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the create partner command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">
    /// PartnerName is required!
    /// or
    /// TenantCode is required!
    /// or
    /// Partner with this TenantCode '{command.TenantCode}' has already existed.
    /// </exception>
    private ICommandResult DoCreatePartnerCommand(CreatePartnerCommand command)
    {
        //TODO: fluent validation használata validator olszállyal
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.Name))
            throw new ArgumentNullException($"PartnerName is required!");

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.TenantCode))
            throw new ArgumentNullException($"TenantCode is required!");

        // Több partner ugyanazzal a tenantkóddal nem létezhet.
        PartnerEntityDto? partnerDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery { TenantCode = command.TenantCode }).Result?.Entity as PartnerEntityDto;
        if (partnerDto != null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException($"Partner with this TenantCode '{command.TenantCode}' has already existed.");

        //TODO: automapper
        PartnerValidityEntityDto partnerValidity = new PartnerValidityEntityDto()
        {
            Name = command.Name,
            Telephone = command.Telephone,
            Website = command.Website,
            EMail = command.EMail,
            CompanyRegistrationNumber = command.CompanyRegistrationNumber,
            TaxIdentificationNumber = command.TaxIdentificationNumber,
            ValidTo = command.ValidTo,
            ValidFrom = command.ValidFrom,
            ContactPersonName = command.ContactPersonName,
            Description = command.Description,
            Headquarters = command.Headquarters,
            ContactPerson = null,
            Partner = null,
            InstituteIdentification = command.InstituteIdentification,
            InstituteIdentificationType = command.InstituteIdentificationType,
            Identifier = command.Identifier ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
            Maintainer = command.Maintainer
        };

        PartnerEntityDto newDto = new PartnerEntityDto
        {
            TenantCode = command.TenantCode,
            PartnerAdminUser = command.PartnerAdminUser
        };

        newDto.PartnerValidities.Add(partnerValidity);


        newDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(newDto);

        return new CreatePartnerCommandResult { PartnerEntityDto = newDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override PartnerEntityDto OnEntityCreated(PartnerEntityDto createdEntity, PartnerEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);

        if (source.PartnerValidities == null || source.PartnerValidities.Count != 1)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Partner Validities need to contain exactly 1 element when creating a Partner");

        //Ha már létezett a tenant, akkor mentjük a Partnerhez.
        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TenantEntityQuery { TenantCode = source.TenantCode }).Result?.Entity is TenantEntityDto)
        {
            if (_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode == null)
                // Ha a tenant létezik, akkor figyelmeztetés, hogy már létezik.
                Log.LogWarning($"Az újonnan létrehozásra kerülő partnerhez: '{source.PartnerValidities[0].Name}' mellékelt tenant-kóddal: '{source.TenantCode}' már létezik Tenant.");
        }
        else
        {
            //Létrehozzuk a tenantot, ha még nem létezett
            _commandService
                .ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreateTenantCommand
                {
                    TenantCode = source.TenantCode,
                    TenantName = source.PartnerValidities[0].Name,
                    MaintainerId = source.PartnerValidities.FirstOrDefault().Maintainer.Id
                })
                .RunSync();

            //// Quartz job indítás
            CreateTenantJob.PostJob(
                _securityContext,
                source.PartnerValidities[0],
                DbContext,
                source.TenantCode,
                source.PartnerAdminUser);
        }

        return EntityPostEvent(entity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override PartnerEntity ApplyDto(PartnerEntityDto source, PartnerEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        return entity;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítását _követően_ megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated<TEntityDto>(TEntityDto originalEntity, TEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        if (updatedEntity is PartnerEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode))
            {
                var partnerEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<PartnerEntity>(updatedEntityDto.Id);
                DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() =>
                {
                    using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
                    scope.SetSecurityContext(SecurityContext.Create(
                        scope,
                        _securityContext.CurrentUser.Clone(updatedEntityDto.TenantCode),
                        sessionId: _securityContext.SessionId,
                        clientIp: _securityContext.ClientIp));
                    var tqs = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
                    var tenantPartnerEntityDto = tqs.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery()
                    {
                        TenantCode = updatedEntityDto.TenantCode
                    }).RunSync()?.Entity as PartnerEntityDto;
                    var tcs = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
                    int? tenantPartnerEntityDtoId = tenantPartnerEntityDto?.Id;
                    tenantPartnerEntityDto = Mapper.Map(updatedEntityDto, tenantPartnerEntityDto);

                    // A public sémában az összes partner szerepel, míg az egyes tenant sémákban
                    // csak a saját partnernek kellene szerepelnie. Ez utóbbi esetén itt 1-es idval
                    // kell szerepelnie a partnernek, míg a public sémában ez a szám bármi lehet,
                    // így hibás lenne a public sémában szereplő id-t belemappolni a séma-specifikus
                    // táblába mentésre kerülő DTO-ba.
                    if (tenantPartnerEntityDto != null && tenantPartnerEntityDtoId.HasValue)
                    {
                        tenantPartnerEntityDto.Id = tenantPartnerEntityDtoId!.Value;
                        tcs.UpdateEntity(tenantPartnerEntityDto);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;
using Common.Logic.Services;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Partner;

/// <summary>
/// PartnerStatisticsCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner.PartnerStatisticsEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners.PartnerStatisticsEntityDto&gt;" />
public class PartnerStatisticsCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<PartnerStatisticsEntity, PartnerStatisticsEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PartnerStatisticsCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">Dtabase context</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">Mapper</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">Access logger</param>
    /// <param name="validator">Validator</param>
    public PartnerStatisticsCommandHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger, ICommandService commandService,
        Lazy<IValidator<PartnerStatisticsEntityDto>> validator) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override PartnerStatisticsEntity ApplyDto(PartnerStatisticsEntityDto source, PartnerStatisticsEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        // A statisztikához tartozó partner
        LoadRef(x => x.Partner!, entity, source.Partner!);

        return entity;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Partners;
using FluentValidation;

public class PartnerValidityCommandHandler : OrgUnitCommandHandlerBase<PartnerValidityEntity, PartnerValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    public PartnerValidityCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<PartnerValidityEntityDto>> validator,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        SecurityContext securityContext)
        : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService, commandService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        //TODO: partner műveleteknél csak tenant szintű jogosultságok lehetnek érvényesek, ezért mindenre null-t adunk vissza
        int? entityId = null;
        //TODO: a probléma az, hogy az assignment-es táblában csak orgunit id-kat tárolunk, validy-ket nem.
        // a validity-vel kapcsolatos commandoknál viszont az id-k nem az orgunitra vonatkoznak (általában), hanem a validity-re.
        //TODO: ez nem jó itt CheckOrgUnitCommandPermissions(command, entityId)...
        //talán kéne egy másik metódus, ami visszakeresi a validity alapján a kapcsolódó orgunitot, és arra kezd el jogosultságokat ellenőrizni?

        return command switch
        {
            CreatePartnerValidityCommand createCommand => DoCreatePartnerValidityCommand(createCommand),
            ModifyPartnerValidityCommand modifyCommand => DoModifyPartnerValidityCommand(modifyCommand),
            DeletePartnerValidityCommand deleteCommand => DoDeletePartnerValidityCommand(deleteCommand),
            SetDefaultContactPersonCommand setdafaultCommand => DoSetDefaultContactPersonCommand(setdafaultCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"{command} is not supported here.");
    }

    private ICommandResult DoDeletePartnerValidityCommand(DeletePartnerValidityCommand command)
    {
        if (command.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var partnerEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<PartnerEntityDto>(command.PartnerId);
        if (partnerEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Partner Id. There is no Partner with Id: '{command.PartnerId}'");

        if (partnerEntityDto.PartnerValidities == null || !partnerEntityDto.PartnerValidities.Select(x => x.Id).Contains(command.ValidityId))
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid PartnerValidity Id. There is no PartnerValidity with Id: '{command.ValidityId}'");

        //legalább egy érvényességnek léteznie kell az intézményfenntartóhoz
        if ((partnerEntityDto.PartnerValidities?.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted).Count() ?? 0) <= 1)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"At least one validity is required for the partner: {partnerEntityDto?.TenantCode}");

        var partnerValidityEntityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<PartnerValidityEntityDto>(command.ValidityId);

        return new DeletePartnerValidityCommandResult
        {
            IsSuccess = (partnerValidityEntityDto == null) || partnerValidityEntityDto.IsDeleted
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the set default contact person command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">TenantCode</exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.NullReferenceException">partner</exception>
    private ICommandResult DoSetDefaultContactPersonCommand(SetDefaultContactPersonCommand command)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.TenantCode))
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.TenantCode));

        if (command.SecUserId == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.SecUserId));

        var partner = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery
        {
            TenantCode = command.TenantCode
        }).Result?.Entity as PartnerEntityDto;

        if (partner == null)
            throw new NullReferenceException(nameof(partner));

        //Pontosan egy Validitynek kéne létezni közvetlenül a Tenant készítése után
        if (partner?.PartnerValidities != null && partner.PartnerValidities.Count == 1)
        {
            var partnerValidity = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerValidityEntityQuery
            {
                PartnerId = partner.Id,
                Id = partner.PartnerValidities[0].Id,
            }).Result?.Entity as PartnerValidityEntityDto;

            var tenantAdmin = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
            {
                TenantCode = command.TenantCode,
                Id = command.SecUserId
            }).Result?.Entity as SecUserEntityDto;

            if (tenantAdmin == null)
                throw new NullReferenceException(nameof(tenantAdmin));

            partnerValidity.ContactPerson = Mapper.Map<EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>>(tenantAdmin);

            var modifiedDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(partnerValidity);

            return new ModifyPartnerValidityCommandResult { PartnerValidityEntityDto = modifiedDto };
        }

        return new ModifyPartnerValidityCommandResult { PartnerValidityEntityDto = null };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyPartnerValidityCommand(ModifyPartnerValidityCommand modifyCommand)
    {
        if (modifyCommand.ValidityId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modifyCommand.ValidityId), "Missing argument");

        var partnerValidityEntityDto = _queryService.GetById<PartnerValidityEntityDto>(modifyCommand.ValidityId);
        if (partnerValidityEntityDto == null)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid PartnerValidity Id. There is no PartnerValidity with Id: '{modifyCommand.ValidityId}'");

        Mapper.Map(modifyCommand, partnerValidityEntityDto);
        partnerValidityEntityDto.ValidFrom = modifyCommand.ValidFrom;
        partnerValidityEntityDto.ValidTo = modifyCommand.ValidTo;

        var updatedEntity = _commandService.UpdateEntity(partnerValidityEntityDto);
        return new ModifyPartnerValidityCommandResult { PartnerValidityEntityDto = updatedEntity };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreatePartnerValidityCommand(CreatePartnerValidityCommand command)
    {
        var partner = new EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto>();
        partner.Id = DbContext.Session.Load<PartnerEntity>(command.PartnerId).Id;

        PartnerValidityEntityDto partnerValidity = Mapper.Map<PartnerValidityEntityDto>(command);
        partnerValidity.Partner = partner;
        partnerValidity.Identifier = Guid.NewGuid();

        partnerValidity.Maintainer = new EntityRef<MaintainerEntityDto>() { Id = command.MaintainerId };

        var entity = _commandService.CreateEntity(partnerValidity);

        return new CreatePartnerValidityCommandResult
        {
            PartnerValidityEntityDto = entity
        };
    }

    protected override void OnEntityCreating(PartnerValidityEntityDto entityDto, PartnerValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);
        if (entityDto.Headquarters != null)
        {
            var addressEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto.Headquarters);
            if (addressEntityDto is null)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Can't save {nameof(entityDto.Headquarters)}");

            LoadRef(x => x.Headquarters, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(addressEntityDto));
        }
    }

    protected override PartnerValidityEntityDto OnEntityCreated(PartnerValidityEntityDto createdEntity, PartnerValidityEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);

        //Szinkronizáljuk a tenant vagy public sémát
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
        {
            DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() => CreatePartnerValidityOtherSchema(source, null, tenantCode));
        }
        else
        {
            var partnerEntity = DbContext.Session.Query<PartnerEntity>()
                                                 .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == source.Partner.Id);
            if (partnerEntity != null)
            {
                DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() => CreatePartnerValidityOtherSchema(source, partnerEntity.TenantCode, partnerEntity.TenantCode));
            }
        }

        return entity;
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdating(PartnerValidityEntityDto entityDto, PartnerValidityEntity domainEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdating(entityDto, domainEntity);

        if (entityDto.Headquarters != null)
        {
            if (domainEntity.Headquarters != null)
                entityDto.Headquarters.Id = domainEntity.Headquarters.Id;

            var newAddress = (entityDto.Headquarters.Id != 0
                ? _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto.Headquarters)
                : _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto.Headquarters));

            if (entityDto.Headquarters.AddressType != domainEntity.Headquarters?.AddressType)
            {
                LoadRef(x => x.Headquarters, domainEntity, Mapper.Map<EntityRef<AddressEntityDto>>(newAddress));
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (domainEntity.Headquarters != null)
                _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(domainEntity.Headquarters.Id);
            domainEntity.Headquarters = null;
        }
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(PartnerValidityEntityDto originalEntity, PartnerValidityEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        //Szinkronizáljuk a tenant vagy public sémát
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
        {
            DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() => UpdatePartnerValidityOtherSchema(originalEntity, null, tenantCode));
        }
        else
        {
            var partnerEntity = DbContext.Session.Query<PartnerEntity>()
                                                 .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == originalEntity.Partner.Id);
            if (partnerEntity != null)
            {
                DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() => UpdatePartnerValidityOtherSchema(originalEntity, partnerEntity.TenantCode, partnerEntity.TenantCode));
            }
        }
    }

    protected override void OnEntityDeleted<TEntityDto>(PartnerValidityEntity originalDomainEntity, TEntityDto originalEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityDeleted(originalDomainEntity, originalEntity);

        if (originalDomainEntity.Headquarters != null)
        {
            _commandService.DeleteEntity<AddressEntityDto>(originalDomainEntity.Headquarters.Id);
        }

        //Szinkronizáljuk a tenant vagy public sémát
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
        {
            DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() => DeletePartnerValidityOtherSchema(originalDomainEntity, null));
        }
        else
        {
            var partnerEntity = DbContext.Session.Query<PartnerEntity>()
                                                 .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == originalDomainEntity.Partner.Id);
            if (partnerEntity != null)
            {
                DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() => DeletePartnerValidityOtherSchema(originalDomainEntity, partnerEntity.TenantCode));
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás módosítását _követően_ megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TEntityDto"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>


    protected override PartnerValidityEntity ApplyDto(PartnerValidityEntityDto source, PartnerValidityEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        //TODO: ContactPerson-t beállítani, ha helyre lett rakva a kezelése
        //if (source.ContactPerson != null)
        //    LoadRef(x => x.ContactPerson!, entity, source.ContactPerson!);

        // Load partner reference
        LoadRef(x => x.Partner!, entity, source.Partner!);

        if (source.Maintainer != null)
            LoadRef(x => x.Maintainer!, entity, source.Maintainer!);

        return entity;
    }

    private void CreatePartnerValidityOtherSchema(PartnerValidityEntityDto source, string? newSecurityContextTenantCode, string? tenantCode)
    {
        using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        scope.SetSecurityContext(SecurityContext.Create(
                        scope,
                        _securityContext.CurrentUser.Clone(newSecurityContextTenantCode),
                        sessionId: _securityContext.SessionId,
                        clientIp: _securityContext.ClientIp));

        var tiDbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var validityEntity = tiDbContext.Session.Query<PartnerValidityEntity>()
                                                 .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Identifier == source.Identifier);

        if (validityEntity == null)
        {
            var partnerEntity = tiDbContext.Session
                                           .Query<PartnerEntity>()
                                           .FirstOrDefault(x => x.TenantCode == tenantCode);

            if (partnerEntity != null)
            {
                source.Partner = new EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto> { Id = partnerEntity.Id };

                var tcs = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
                tcs.CreateEntity(source);
            }
        }
    }

    private void UpdatePartnerValidityOtherSchema(PartnerValidityEntityDto source, string? newSecurityContextTenantCode, string? tenantCode)
    {
        using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        scope.SetSecurityContext(SecurityContext.Create(
                scope,
                _securityContext.CurrentUser.Clone(newSecurityContextTenantCode),
                sessionId: _securityContext.SessionId,
                clientIp: _securityContext.ClientIp));

        var tiDbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

        var validityEntityDto = queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerValidityEntityQuery() { Identifier = source.Identifier })
                                            .RunSync()?.Entity as PartnerValidityEntityDto;

        if (validityEntityDto != null && !source.Equals(validityEntityDto))
        {
            var partnerEntity = tiDbContext.Session
                                            .Query<PartnerEntity>()
                                            .FirstOrDefault(x => x.TenantCode == tenantCode);

            if (partnerEntity != null)
            {
                source.Partner = new EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto> { Id = partnerEntity.Id };
                source.Id = validityEntityDto.Id;
                var tcs = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
                tcs.UpdateEntity(source);
            }
        }
    }

    private void DeletePartnerValidityOtherSchema(PartnerValidityEntity source, string? newSecurityContextTenantCode)
    {
        using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        scope.SetSecurityContext(SecurityContext.Create(
                scope,
                _securityContext.CurrentUser.Clone(newSecurityContextTenantCode),
                sessionId: _securityContext.SessionId,
                clientIp: _securityContext.ClientIp));

        var tiDbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var validityEntity = tiDbContext.Session.Query<PartnerValidityEntity>()
                                                 .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Identifier == source.Identifier);

        if (validityEntity != null && !validityEntity.IsDeleted)
        {
            var tcs = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
            tcs.DeleteEntity<PartnerValidityEntityDto>(validityEntity.Id);
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.EnergyPerformance;
using FluentValidation;


namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Security;

public class MaintainerCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<MaintainerEntity, MaintainerEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    public MaintainerCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<MaintainerEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// CommandHandler DoExecuteEntityCommand hívása során megfutó metódus, amely azzal a céllal
    /// készült, hogy az egyes leszármazott CommandHandlerek override-olják szükség esetén a saját
    /// logikájukkal feltöltve.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">A command példány, amely rendelkezésre bocsájtja a belső feldolgozáshoz szükséges adatokat.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateMaintainerCommand createMaintainerCommand => DoCreateMaintainerCommand(createMaintainerCommand),
            ModifyMaintainerCommand modifyMaintainerCommand => DoModifyMaintainerCommand(modifyMaintainerCommand),
            DeleteMaintainerCommand deleteMaintainerCommand => DoDeleteMaintainerCommand(deleteMaintainerCommand),

            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateMaintainerCommand(CreateMaintainerCommand command)
    {
        var entityDto = Mapper.Map<MaintainerEntityDto>(command);

        var maintainerEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);
        return new CreateMaintainerCommandResult { MaintainerEntityDto = maintainerEntityDto };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoModifyMaintainerCommand(ModifyMaintainerCommand command)
    {
        if (command.Id == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new MaintainerQuery { Id = command.Id }).Result?.Entity is not MaintainerEntityDto entityDto)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Maintainer Id. There is no Maintainer with Id: '{command.Id}'");

        Mapper.Map(command, entityDto); 

        var responseDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto);

        return new ModifyMaintainerCommandResult { MaintainerEntityDto = responseDto! };
    }
    private ICommandResult DoDeleteMaintainerCommand(DeleteMaintainerCommand command)
    {
        if (command.Id == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(command.Id), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new MaintainerQuery { Id = command.Id }).Result?.Entity is not MaintainerEntityDto entityDto)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Maintainer Id. There is no Maintainer with Id: '{command.Id}'");

        var tenants = _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new TenantEntityQuery { MaintainterId = command.Id }).RunSync().Items;
        if (tenants.Length != 0) 
        {
            var tenantNames = tenants.Select(t => t.Name).ToList(); 
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException($"Az alábbi közintézményeknél meg kell szüntetni a kapcsolatot a {entityDto.Name} közintézményi fenntartóval, hogy tölölhetővé váljon a fenntartó: {string.Join(", ", tenantNames)}");
        }

        entityDto = _commandService.DeleteEntity<MaintainerEntityDto>(command.Id);

        return new DeleteMaintainerCommandResult { IsSuccess = entityDto is null};
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override MaintainerEntity ApplyDto(MaintainerEntityDto source, MaintainerEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        return entity;
    }
}

/// <summary>

public class SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity, SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>
{

    private readonly MonitoringApiClientService _monitoringClientService;


    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>

    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="lifetimeScope"></param>
    /// <param name="roleCache">The role cache.</param>
    public SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext, 
        IMapper mapper, 
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger, 
        Lazy<IValidator<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>> validator,
        MonitoringApiClientService monitoringApiClientService,
        IQueryService queryService, 
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _monitoringClientService = monitoringApiClientService;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentCreateCommand createBuildingCommand => DoCreateCommand(createBuildingCommand),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    private ICommandResult DoCreateCommand(SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentCreateCommand createCommand)
    {
        var entityDto = new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto()
        {
        };
        Mapper.Map(createCommand, entityDto);


        var orgUnitAssesmentEntityDto = _commandService.CreateEntity(entityDto);
        return new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentCreateCommandResult { SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto = orgUnitAssesmentEntityDto };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto OnEntityCreated(SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto createdEntity, SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto source)
    {
        var entityDto = base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.SecRoleOrgunitSync, createdEntity.Created!.Value);
        return entityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// az entitás adatbázisszintű módosítását követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="originalEntity">A módosításra került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntity">A frissen módosított entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto originalEntity, SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto updatedEntity)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntity, updatedEntity);
        SendSyncMessage(_monitoringClientService, SyncObjectConstants.BaseRoute, SyncObjectConstants.SecRoleOrgunitSync, updatedEntity.Modified!.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás törlésekor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    /// <param name="deleteAction"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override string? OnEntityDeleting(SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity domainEntity, Func<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity, string?> deleteAction)
    {
        return base.OnEntityDeleting(domainEntity, deleteAction);
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity ApplyDto(SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto source, SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        LoadRef(x => x.User, entity, source.User);
        LoadRef(x => x.Role, entity, source.Role);
        LoadRef(x => x.Institution, entity, source.Institution);
        LoadRef(x => x.Site, entity, source.Site);
        LoadRef(x => x.Building, entity, source.Building);

        return entity;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// DeviceMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class ChannelConfigValueMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ChannelConfigValueMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public ChannelConfigValueMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<ChannelConfigValueEntityDto, ChannelConfigValueEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Config, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channel, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<ChannelConfigValueEntity, ChannelConfigValueEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Config, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channel, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
        {
            dest.Config = c.Mapper.Map(src.Config.UnProxy(), dest.Config ?? new DeviceConfigEntityDto());
            dest.Channel = c.Mapper.Map(src.Channel.UnProxy(), dest.Channel ?? new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto>());
        });

        CreateMap<ChannelConfigValueEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<ChannelConfigValueEntity, ConfigValueSyncModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Code, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Config.Code));

        CreateMap<ChannelConfigValueEntityDto, ConfigValueSyncModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Code, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Config.Code));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.BackEnd.DeviceType.ExternalHandler.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.MeasurementPointSync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.SiteLocation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// DeviceMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class DeviceMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DeviceMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public DeviceMappings()
    {
        // Device
        CreateMap<IExternalDevice, DeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Identifier, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channels, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceType, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ConfigValues, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<IExternalDevice, DeviceEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Identifier, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channels, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceType, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Status, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ConfigValues, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DeviceEntity, DeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channels, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ConfigValues, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ConfigValues))
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.IoTDeviceType = c.Mapper.Map(src.IoTDeviceType.UnProxy(), dest.IoTDeviceType);
                dest.MeasurementPoint = c.Mapper.Map(src.MeasurementPoint.UnProxy(), dest.MeasurementPoint);
                if (src.Channels != null)
                    dest.Channels = src.Channels.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<ChannelEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
            }); ;

        // Device
        CreateMap<DeviceEntity, DeviceDto>()
            .ForMember(dto => dto.Name, entity => entity.MapFrom(e => e.DeviceName))
            .ForMember(dto => dto.DeviceCategory, entity => entity.MapFrom(e => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>
            {
                Id = e.IoTDeviceType.DeviceCategory.Id,
                EntityDisplayName = e.IoTDeviceType.DeviceCategory.Value
            }))
            .AfterMap((entity, dto, c) =>
            {
                dto.Channels =
                entity.Channels?.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false)?.Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<DeviceChannelDto>(x)).ToList();
            }); ;

        CreateMap<ChannelEntity, DeviceChannelDto>()
            .ForMember(dto => dto.EndpointDevicesStr, entity => entity.Ignore());

        CreateMap<DeviceEntity, EntityRef<DeviceEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        CreateMap<DeviceEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<DeviceEntityDto, DeviceEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Channels, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceType, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Status, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ConfigValues, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<DeviceEntityDto, EntityRef<DeviceEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        CreateMap<DeviceEntityDto, GuidEntityRef<DeviceEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToGuidEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        CreateMap<DeviceEntity, GuidEntityRef<DeviceEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToGuidEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName);


        CreateMap<DeviceEntity, SiteLocationDeviceDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Name, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.DeviceName))
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceType, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceType.DeviceTypeName));

        CreateMap<AddDeviceToOrgunitLocationCommand, DeviceEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<DeviceEntity, DeviceSyncModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceTypeCode, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceType.Code))
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceTypeName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceType.DeviceTypeName))
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceCategory, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceType.DeviceCategory.Value));

        CreateMap<DeviceEntityDto, DeviceSyncModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceTypeCode, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceType.Code))
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceTypeName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceType.DeviceTypeName))
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceCategory, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceType.DeviceCategory.EntityDisplayName));
    }
}

public class EndpointUnitMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EndpointUnitMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public EndpointUnitMappings()
    {
        // EndpointUnit: Device
        CreateMap<EndpointUnitEntity, EndpointUnitEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<EndpointUnitEntity, EntityRef<EndpointUnitEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        CreateMap<EndpointUnitEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<EndpointUnitEntityDto, EndpointUnitEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MetaData, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channel, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreIdentifier()
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<EndpointUnitEntityDto, EntityRef<EndpointUnitEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        CreateMap<CreateEndpointUnitCommand, EndpointUnitEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Identifier, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MetaData, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channel, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<ModifyEndpointUnitCommand, EndpointUnitEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Identifier, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MetaData, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Channel, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        // EnergyStorage : EndpointUnit
        CreateMap<EnergyStorageEntity, EnergyStorageEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<EndpointUnitEntity, EndpointUnitEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<EnergyStorageEntity, EntityRef<EnergyStorageEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        CreateMap<EnergyStorageEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<EnergyStorageEntityDto, EnergyStorageEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<EndpointUnitEntityDto, EndpointUnitEntity>()
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<EnergyStorageEntityDto, EntityRef<EnergyStorageEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        // Producer/Inverter : EndpointUnit
        CreateMap<ProducerOrInverterEntity, ProducerOrInverterEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<EndpointUnitEntity, EndpointUnitEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<ProducerOrInverterEntity, EntityRef<ProducerOrInverterEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        CreateMap<ProducerOrInverterEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<ProducerOrInverterEntityDto, ProducerOrInverterEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<EndpointUnitEntityDto, EndpointUnitEntity>()
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<ProducerOrInverterEntityDto, EntityRef<ProducerOrInverterEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        // Consumer : EndpointUnit
        CreateMap<ConsumerEntity, ConsumerEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<EndpointUnitEntity, EndpointUnitEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<ConsumerEntity, EntityRef<ConsumerEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

using AutoMapper;

using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// IoTDeviceTypeMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class IoTDeviceTypeMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDeviceTypeMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public IoTDeviceTypeMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<IoTDeviceTypeEntity, IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<IoTDeviceTypeEntity, EntityRef<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceTypeName);

        CreateMap<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto, EntityRef<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceTypeName);

        CreateMap<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto, IoTDeviceTypeEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceCategory, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<IoTDeviceTypeEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<EntityRef<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>, SimpleEntityRef>();

    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.EnergyContract;

/// <summary>
/// (Energia) Szerződés mapping
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class EnergyContractMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergyContractMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public EnergyContractMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<EnergyContractEntity, EnergyContractEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<EnergyContractEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<EnergyContractEntityDto, EnergyContractEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Institution, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Partner, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Supplier, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Currency, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<EnergyContractEntityDto, EntityRef<EnergyContractEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<EnergyContractEntity, EntityRef<EnergyContractEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        // Hálózati csatlakozási szerződés (NetworkConnectionContract)
        CreateMap<NetworkConnectionContractEntity, NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<EnergyContractEntity, EnergyContractEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d, c) =>
            {
                d.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint = c.Mapper.Map(s.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint.UnProxy(), d.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint);
            });

        CreateMap<NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto, NetworkConnectionContractEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<EnergyContractEntityDto, EnergyContractEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<NetworkConnectionContractEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto, EntityRef<NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<NetworkConnectionContractEntity, EntityRef<NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        // Hálózathasználati szerződés (NetworkUsageContract)
        CreateMap<NetworkUsageContractEntity, NetworkUsageContractEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<EnergyContractEntity, EnergyContractEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<NetworkUsageContractEntityDto, NetworkUsageContractEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<EnergyContractEntityDto, EnergyContractEntity>()
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<NetworkUsageContractEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<NetworkUsageContractEntityDto, EntityRef<NetworkUsageContractEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<NetworkUsageContractEntity, EntityRef<NetworkUsageContractEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        // Villamosenergia adásvételi szerződés (PowerPurchaseAgreement)
        CreateMap<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntity, PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto>()
            .IncludeBase<EnergyContractEntity, EnergyContractEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto, PowerPurchaseAgreementEntity>()
            .IncludeBase<EnergyContractEntityDto, EnergyContractEntity>()
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties()
            .ForMember(x => x.TimeOfUseTariffs, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto, EntityRef<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntity, EntityRef<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);
        
        CreateMap<PowerCapacityEntity, PowerCapacityEntityDto>().ReverseMap();
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.EnergyContract;

/// <summary>
/// SupplierMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class SupplierMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SupplierMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SupplierMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<SupplierEntity, SupplierEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Headquarters, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d, c) =>
            {
                d.Headquarters = c.Mapper.Map(s.Headquarters.UnProxy(), d.Headquarters);
            });
        CreateMap<SupplierEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<SupplierEntityDto, SupplierEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Headquarters, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.EnergyContracts, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<SupplierEntityDto, EntityRef<SupplierEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<SupplierEntity, EntityRef<SupplierEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.EnergyPerformance.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.EnergyPerformance;

/// <summary>
/// BuildingMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class EnergyConsumptionDeviceMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergyConsumptionDeviceMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public EnergyConsumptionDeviceMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> EntityDto
        CreateMap<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.TypeOfEnergyCarrier, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.EstablishedSubMetering, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.RemoteControl, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.OrgunitBase = c.Mapper.Map(src.OrgunitBase.UnProxy(), dest.OrgunitBase ?? new EntityRef<OrgunitBaseEntityDto>());
                dest.Type = c.Mapper.Map(src.Type.UnProxy(), dest.Type ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
                dest.TypeOfEnergyCarrier = c.Mapper.Map(src.TypeOfEnergyCarrier.UnProxy(), dest.TypeOfEnergyCarrier ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
                dest.EstablishedSubMetering = c.Mapper.Map(src.EstablishedSubMetering.UnProxy(), dest.EstablishedSubMetering ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
                dest.RemoteControl = c.Mapper.Map(src.RemoteControl.UnProxy(), dest.RemoteControl ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
            });

        CreateMap<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.TypeOfEnergyCarrier, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.EstablishedSubMetering, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.RemoteControl, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity, EntityRef<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>>()
           .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.InspectionDate.ToString());

        CreateMap<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto, EntityRef<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.InspectionDate.ToString());

        CreateMap<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<CreateEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<ModifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<EnergyConsumptionDeviceImportModel, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Type, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = z.TypeId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.TypeOfEnergyCarrier, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = z.TypeOfEnergyCarrierId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.EstablishedSubMetering, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = z.EstablishedSubMeteringId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.RemoteControl, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = z.RemoteControlId }));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.EnergyPerformance.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Room;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.EnergyPerformance;

public class RoomEnergeticDataMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RoomEnergeticDataMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public RoomEnergeticDataMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> EntityDto
        CreateMap<RoomEnergeticDataEntity, RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Room, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Room = c.Mapper.Map(src.Room.UnProxy(), dest.Room);
                dest.WindowFrameAndDoorMaterial = c.Mapper.Map(src.WindowFrameAndDoorMaterial.UnProxy(), dest.WindowFrameAndDoorMaterial ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
                dest.OpeningsCondition = c.Mapper.Map(src.OpeningsCondition.UnProxy(), dest.OpeningsCondition ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
                dest.OpeningsShading = c.Mapper.Map(src.OpeningsShading.UnProxy(), dest.OpeningsShading ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
                dest.LightingType = c.Mapper.Map(src.LightingType.UnProxy(), dest.LightingType ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
                dest.LightingControllability = c.Mapper.Map(src.LightingControllability.UnProxy(), dest.LightingControllability ?? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>());
            });

        CreateMap<RoomEnergeticDataEntity, EntityRef<RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.InspectionDate.ToString());

        CreateMap<RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto, EntityRef<RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.InspectionDate.ToString());

        CreateMap<RoomEnergeticDataEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto, RoomEnergeticDataEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Room, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.WindowFrameAndDoorMaterial, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.OpeningsCondition, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.OpeningsShading, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.LightingType, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.LightingControllability, y => y.Ignore());


        CreateMap<CreateRoomEnergeticDataCommand, RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<RoomEnergeticDataImportModel, RoomEnergeticDataEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Room, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<RoomEntityDto> { Id = z.RoomId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.WindowFrameAndDoorMaterial, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = z.WindowFrameAndDoorMateriallId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.OpeningsCondition, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = z.OpeningsConditionId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.OpeningsShading, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = z.OpeningsShadingId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.LightingType, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = z.LightingTypeId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.LightingControllability, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> { Id = z.LightControllabilityId }));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.EnergyPerformance.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.EnergyPerformanceImport;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems.Import;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Import;
public class ImportJobResultMappings : Profile
{
    public ImportJobResultMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> EntityDto
        CreateMap<ImportJobResultEntity, ImportJobResultEntityDto<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>>()
            .ForMember(x => x.SecUser, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Data, y => y.MapFrom(z => JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>(z.Data)))
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.SecUser = c.Mapper.Map(src.SecUser.UnProxy(), dest.SecUser);
            });

        // EntityDto -> Entity
        CreateMap<ImportJobResultEntityDto<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>, ImportJobResultEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.SecUser, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Data, y => y.MapFrom(z => JsonConvert.SerializeObject(z.Data)));

        CreateMap<ImportJobResultEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<ImportJobResultEntityDto<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>, ImportJobResultListItemDto<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>>();
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models;

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.SiteLocation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// SiteLocationMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class SiteLocationMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SiteLocationMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SiteLocationMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> ...
        CreateMap<SiteLocationEntity, SiteLocationEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Status, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Building, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.BuildingPart, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Floor, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Room, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d, c) =>
            {
                if (s.Building != null)
                    d.Building = c.Mapper.Map(s.Building.UnProxy(), d.Building);

                if (s.BuildingPart != null)
                    d.BuildingPart = c.Mapper.Map(s.BuildingPart.UnProxy(), d.BuildingPart);

                if (s.Floor != null)
                    d.Floor = c.Mapper.Map(s.Floor.UnProxy(), d.Floor);

                if (s.Room != null)
                    d.Room = c.Mapper.Map(s.Room.UnProxy(), d.Room);

                var deviceStatuses = s?.IoTDevices?.Select(d => d.Status);
                if (deviceStatuses!= null && deviceStatuses.Any())
                    d.Status = deviceStatuses!.Contains(DeviceStatus.Online) ? DeviceStatus.Online : DeviceStatus.Offline;
                else
                    d.Status = DeviceStatus.Unknown;
            });
        CreateMap<SiteLocationEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        // EntityDto -> ...
        CreateMap<SiteLocationEntityDto, SiteLocationEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Building, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.BuildingPart, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Floor, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Room, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDevices, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<SiteLocationEntity, EntityRef<SiteLocationEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => $"{x.GetParentOrgUnit().Name} mérési hely");

        CreateMap<SiteLocationEntityDto, EntityRef<SiteLocationEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => $"{x.GetParentName()} mérési hely");

        CreateMap<SiteLocationEntityDto, GuidEntityRef<SiteLocationEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToGuidEntityRefMap(x => $"{x.GetParentName()} mérési hely");
    }
}
