using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.EDM_Models.MasterData;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.MeasurementPointSync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// MeasurementPointMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class MeasurementPointMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeasurementPointMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public MeasurementPointMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> EntityDto
        CreateMap<MeasurementPointEntity, MeasurementPointEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ChildMeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Devices, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Labels, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.OrgunitBase = c.Mapper.Map(src.OrgunitBase.UnProxy(), dest.OrgunitBase ?? new EntityRef<OrgunitBaseEntityDto>());
                if (src.ParentMeasurementPoint != null) 
                {
                    dest.ParentMeasurementPoint = c.Mapper.Map(src.ParentMeasurementPoint.UnProxy(), dest.ParentMeasurementPoint ?? new EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>());
                }
                if (src.ChildMeasurementPoints != null)
                    dest.ChildMeasurementPoints = src.ChildMeasurementPoints.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.MeasuredProperties != null)
                    dest.MeasuredProperties = src.MeasuredProperties.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.Devices != null)
                    dest.Devices = src.Devices.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<DeviceEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.Labels != null)
                    dest.Labels = src.Labels.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

            });

        CreateMap<EDMMasterDataFlatModel, MeasurementPointEdmDeviceDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.MeasurementDescriptors, opt => opt.Ignore());

        CreateMap<DeviceEntityDto, MeasurementPointDeviceDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.UtilityType, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.MeasurementDescriptors, opt => opt.Ignore());

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        // EntityDto -> Entity
        CreateMap<MeasurementPointEntityDto, MeasurementPointEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ChildMeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredProperties, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Devices, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Labels, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointEntityDto, EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointEntity, EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<CreateMeasurementPointCommand, MeasurementPointEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<ModifyMeasurementPointCommand, MeasurementPointEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, ctx) =>
            {
                var measurementPoint = src.MeasurementPoint;
                dest.ParentMeasurementPoint = measurementPoint?.Id > 0
                    ? ctx.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>>(measurementPoint.Id.UnProxy())
                    : null;
            });
        CreateMap<int, EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>>()
           .ForMember(dest => dest.Id, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src));


        //Simple flattening átnevezésnél bekavarhat, így inkább kiírjuk a MapFrom-ot
        CreateMap<MeasurementPointEntityDto, MeasurementPointSyncModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBaseId, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.OrgunitBase.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPointId, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ParentMeasurementPoint.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.LabelIds, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Labels.Select(x => x.Id)))
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredProperties, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.MeasuredProperties.Select(x => x.Id)));
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;

/// <summary>
/// MeasurementPointSettingMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class MeasurementPointSettingMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeasurementPointSettingMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public MeasurementPointSettingMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> EntityDto
        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSettingEntity, MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Channel, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredProperty, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                if (src.Channel != null) 
                {
                    dest.Channel = c.Mapper.Map(src.Channel.UnProxy(), dest.Channel ?? new EntityRef<ChannelEntityDto>());
                }
                dest.MeasurementPoint = c.Mapper.Map(src.MeasurementPoint.UnProxy(), dest.MeasurementPoint ?? new EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>());
                dest.MeasuredProperty = c.Mapper.Map(src.MeasuredProperty.UnProxy(), dest.MeasuredProperty ?? new EntityRef<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>());
            });

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto, MeasurementPointSettingEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Channel, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredProperty, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSettingEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();
    }
}

public class SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity, LogObject>()
           .MappingLogObject();

        // Entity -> DTO
        CreateMap<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity, SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Role, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto> { Id = src.Role!.Id, EntityDisplayName = src.Role.RoleName }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.User, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto> { Id = src.User!.Id, EntityDisplayName = src.User.EMail }))

            .ForMember(d => d.Institution, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(d => d.Site, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(d => d.Building, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Institution = c.Mapper.Map(src.Institution.UnProxy(), dest.Institution);
                dest.Site = c.Mapper.Map(src.Site.UnProxy(), dest.Site);
                dest.Building = c.Mapper.Map(src.Building.UnProxy(), dest.Building);

                dest.SecOpCodes = src.Role?.SecOperations?.Select(x => x.OperationCode)?.ToList() ?? [];
            });

        // DTO -> Entity
        CreateMap<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto, SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity>()

            //.ForMember(dest => dest.Institution,  opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Institution != null ? new InstitutionEntity {  Id = src.Institution!.Id } : null ))
            //.ForMember(dest => dest.Site, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Site != null ? new SiteEntity { Id = src.Site!.Id } : null))
            //.ForMember(dest => dest.Building, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Building != null ? new BuildingEntity { Id = src.Building!.Id } : null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.User, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Role, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Institution, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Site, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Building, opt => opt.Ignore())

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Partner;
using NHibernate.Mapping;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.TenantIndependent.Partner;

/// <summary>
/// PartnerValidityMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class PartnerValidityMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PartnerValidityMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public PartnerValidityMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> DTO
        CreateMap<PartnerValidityEntity, PartnerValidityEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Partner, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ContactPerson, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Headquarters, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Maintainer, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Partner = c.Mapper.Map(src.Partner.UnProxy(), dest.Partner);
                if (src.ContactPerson != null)
                    dest.ContactPerson = c.Mapper.Map(src.ContactPerson.UnProxy(), dest.ContactPerson);

                if (src.Headquarters != null)
                    dest.Headquarters = c.Mapper.Map(src.Headquarters.UnProxy(), dest.Headquarters);

                if (src.Maintainer != null)
                    dest.Maintainer = c.Mapper.Map(src.Maintainer.UnProxy(), dest.Maintainer);
            });

        // DTO -> Entity
        CreateMap<PartnerValidityEntityDto, PartnerValidityEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Partner, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ContactPerson, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Headquarters, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Maintainer, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        // Entity -> LogObject
        CreateMap<PartnerValidityEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        // Entity -> EntityRef
        CreateMap<PartnerValidityEntity, EntityRef<PartnerValidityEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        // EntityDto -> EntityRef
        CreateMap<PartnerValidityEntityDto, EntityRef<PartnerValidityEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);


        // ModifyPartnerValidityCommand -> DTO
        CreateMap<ModifyPartnerValidityCommand, PartnerValidityEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Name, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.Name != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ContactPersonName, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.ContactPersonName != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Headquarters, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.Headquarters != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Telephone, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.Telephone != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Description, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.Description != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.EMail, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.EMail != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Website, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.Website != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.TaxIdentificationNumber, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.TaxIdentificationNumber != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.CompanyRegistrationNumber, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.CompanyRegistrationNumber != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.InstituteIdentification, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.InstituteIdentification != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.InstituteIdentificationType, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.InstituteIdentificationType != null))
            .ForAllMembers(opt => opt.Condition((src, dest, srcMember) => srcMember != null));

        // CreatePartnerValidityCommand -> DTO
        CreateMap<CreatePartnerValidityCommand, PartnerValidityEntityDto>();
            
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

/// <summary>
/// InstitutionValidityMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class InstitutionValidityMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InstitutionValidityMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public InstitutionValidityMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> DTO
        CreateMap<InstitutionValidityEntity, InstitutionValidityEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Institution, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Headquarters, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ContactPerson, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Institution = c.Mapper.Map(src.Institution.UnProxy(), dest.Institution);
                if (src.ContactPerson != null)
                    dest.ContactPerson = c.Mapper.Map(src.ContactPerson.UnProxy(), dest.ContactPerson);
                if (src.Headquarters != null)
                    dest.Headquarters = c.Mapper.Map(src.Headquarters.UnProxy(), dest.Headquarters);
            });


        CreateMap<InstitutionValidityEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        // EntityDto -> Entity
        CreateMap<InstitutionValidityEntityDto, InstitutionValidityEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Institution, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Headquarters, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ContactPerson, y => y.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        // ModifyPartnerValidityCommand -> DTO
        CreateMap<ModifyInstitutionValidityCommand, InstitutionValidityEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Name, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.Name != null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Headquarters, opt => opt.Condition(src => src.Headquarters != null))
            .ForAllMembers(opt => opt.Condition((src, dest, srcMember) => srcMember != null));

        // CreatePartnerValidityCommand -> DTO
        CreateMap<CreateInstitutionValidityCommand, InstitutionValidityEntityDto>()
            //.ForMember(x => x.Institution, y => y.Ignore())
            //.ForMember(x => x.Headquarters, y => y.Ignore())
            ;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.DeviceConfigValues;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.DeviceConfigValues;

/// <summary>
/// DeviceConfigValueQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.DeviceConfigValueEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.DeviceConfigValueEntityDto&gt;" />
public class DeviceConfigValueQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<DeviceConfigValueEntity, DeviceConfigValueEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DeviceConfigValueQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public DeviceConfigValueQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is DeviceConfigValueEntitiesQuery entitiesQuery)
            return DoDeviceConfigValueEntitiesQuery(entitiesQuery);

        return base.QueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the device configuration value entities query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoDeviceConfigValueEntitiesQuery(DeviceConfigValueEntitiesQuery query)
    {
        var qOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceConfigValueEntity>();
        DeviceConfigEntity configAlias = null;

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Code))
            qOver = 
                qOver
                .JoinAlias(x => x.Config, () => configAlias)
                .Where(x => configAlias.Code == query.Code);

        var items = qOver.List();
        var result = new EntityQueryItemsResult 
        {
            Items = items.Select(_mapper.Map<DeviceConfigValueEntityDto>).ToArray()
        };

        return result;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd\BusinessLogic\QueryHandlers\Devices\ChannelQueryHandler.cs

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices.Channels;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Room;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Tenant.Devices;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.SqlCommand;
using NHibernate.Transform;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// MeasuredEndpointQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.ChannelEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.ChannelEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ChannelQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<ChannelEntity, ChannelEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The device
    /// </summary>
    private DeviceEntity? _device = null;

    private MeasurementPointSettingEntity _settingAlias = null;

    private MeasurementPointEntity _measurementPointAlias = null;

    private MeasuredPropertyEntity _measuredPropertyAlias = null;

    private ChannelEntity _rootAlias = null;

    private ChannelConfigValueEntity _channelConfigValueAlias = null;

    private DeviceConfigEntity _deviceConfigAlias = null;

    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ChannelQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public ChannelQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, IQueryService queryService) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;   
    }

    protected override IQueryOver<ChannelEntity, ChannelEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ChannelSingleQuery singleQuery)
            return DoMeasuredEndpointSingleQuery(singleQuery);

        if (query is ChannelListItemDtoQuery listQuery)
            return DoChannelListItemDtoQuery(listQuery);

        if (query is HierarchyAndMeasuredPropertyQuery hiearchyQuery)
            return DoHiearchyQuery(hiearchyQuery);

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    private IQueryResult DoHiearchyQuery(HierarchyAndMeasuredPropertyQuery hiearchyQuery)
    {

        TempAliasClass alias = null!;
        var tempResult = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
                                         .JoinEntityAlias(() => _settingAlias, () => _rootAlias.Id == _settingAlias.Channel.Id, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                                         .JoinAlias(() => _settingAlias.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias)
                                         .JoinAlias(() => _settingAlias.MeasurementPoint, () => _measurementPointAlias)
                                         .Where(() => _rootAlias.Identifier == hiearchyQuery.ChannelIdentifier)
                                         .SelectList(list => list
                                            .Select(x => _rootAlias.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.ChannelIdentifier)
                                            .Select(x => _measuredPropertyAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasuredPropertyId)
                                            .Select(x => _measuredPropertyAlias.MeasuredPropertyName).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasuredProperty)
                                            .Select(x => _measurementPointAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementPointId)
                                            .Select(x => _measurementPointAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementPointName)
                                            .Select(x => _measurementPointAlias.OrgunitBase.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.OrgunitBaseId))
                                         .TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<TempAliasClass>())
                                         .SingleOrDefault<TempAliasClass>();

        var orgunitBase = DbContext.Session.Get<OrgunitBaseEntity>(tempResult.OrgunitBaseId);
        OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult? result = _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new OrgunitNameCascadeQuery() { OrgunitId = tempResult.OrgunitBaseId }).RunSync() as OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult;

        //TODO: use mapper
        return new HierarchyAndMeasuredPropertyQueryResult() 
        {
            ChannelOrgunitHierarchyCommonModel = new ChannelOrgunitHierarchyCommonModel 
            {
                OrgunitType = orgunitBase.OrgunitType,
                ChannelId = hiearchyQuery.ChannelIdentifier,
                InstitutionId = result?.Institution?.Id,
                InstitutionName = result?.Institution?.EntityDisplayName,
                SiteId = result?.Site?.Id,
                SiteName = result?.Site?.EntityDisplayName,
                BuildingId = result?.Building?.Id,
                BuildingName = result?.Building?.EntityDisplayName,
                BuildingPartId = result?.BuildingPart?.Id,
                BuildingPartName = result?.BuildingPart?.EntityDisplayName,
                FloorId = result?.Floor?.Id,
                FloorName = result?.Floor?.EntityDisplayName,
                RoomId = result?.Room?.Id,
                RoomName = result?.Room?.EntityDisplayName,
                MeasuredPropertyId = tempResult?.MeasuredPropertyId,
                MeasuredPropertyName = tempResult?.MeasuredProperty,
                MeasurementPointId = tempResult?.MeasurementPointId,
                MeasurementPointName = tempResult?.MeasurementPointName,
            }
        };
    }

    private IQueryResult DoChannelListItemDtoQuery(ChannelListItemDtoQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

        SetupQuerySelect<ChannelListItemDto>(queryOver, query);

        //JOIN
        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        //WHERE
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);


        //PAGING
        ProductivityExtensions.When<IPagedEntityQuery>(query, q => SetQueryPaging(queryOver, q));

        //ORDER BY
        ProductivityExtensions.When<IPagedEntityQuery>(query, q => SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, q));

        var items = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ChannelListItemDto>()).List<ChannelListItemDto>().ToArray();


        var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<ChannelListItemDto>();
        result.Items = items;
        result.RecordsTotal = items.Length;
        return result;
    }

    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            ChannelListItemDtoQuery itemQuery => DoQueryEntities(itemQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the measured endpoint single query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Eszköz azonosító nem egyezik a kérésben megadottal</exception>
    private IQueryResult DoMeasuredEndpointSingleQuery(ChannelSingleQuery query)
    {
        var endpoint = DbContext.Session.Get<ChannelEntity>(query.Id);
        if (endpoint.Device?.Identifier != query.DeviceIdentifier)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Eszköz azonosító nem egyezik a kérésben megadottal");
        
        var result = new ChannelSingleQueryResult
        {
            Id = endpoint.Id,
            Name = endpoint.Name,
            Description = endpoint.Description,
            Device = Mapper.Map<EntityRef<DeviceEntityDto>>(endpoint.Device),
            Configuration = Mapper.Map<IList<ConfigEntityDto>>(endpoint.Configuration),
            Identifier = endpoint.Identifier
        };

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<ChannelEntity, ChannelEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        if (query is ChannelListItemDtoQuery listDtoQuery)
        {
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Configuration, () => _channelConfigValueAlias);
            //TODO: A konfig kód értéknek enum típust kéne adni, hogy elkerüljük a beégetett stringet
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _channelConfigValueAlias.Config, () => _deviceConfigAlias);
            queryOver.WhereRestrictionOn(() => _deviceConfigAlias.Code).IsIn(new[] { "TimeUnit", "Unit", "MinValue", "MaxValue", "AggregationMethod", "MeasurementDescriptor" })
                     .And(() => _deviceConfigAlias.Type == DeviceConfigType.Channel);

            queryOver.JoinEntityAlias(() => _settingAlias, () => _rootAlias.Id == _settingAlias.Channel.Id, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _settingAlias.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
        }
        else 
        {
            query.When<ChannelQuery>(entityQuery =>
            {
                if (entityQuery.DeviceIdentifier != null || entityQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                    queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Device, () => _device);
            });

            query.When<ChannelRefsQuery>(entityQuery =>
            {
                if (entityQuery.DeviceId != null || entityQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                    queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Device, () => _device);
            });

            query.When<ChannelEntitiesQuery>(entityQuery =>
            {
                if (entityQuery.DeviceId != null || entityQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                    queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Device, () => _device);
            });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<ChannelEntity, ChannelEntity> queryOver,
        IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        if (query is ChannelListItemDtoQuery listItemDtoQuery)
        {
            if (listItemDtoQuery.DeviceId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Device.Id == listItemDtoQuery.DeviceId);
        }
        else if (query is ChannelQuery measuredEndpointQuery)
        {
            if (measuredEndpointQuery.DeviceIdentifier != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => _device.Identifier == measuredEndpointQuery.DeviceIdentifier);

            if (measuredEndpointQuery.Id != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == measuredEndpointQuery.Id);

            if (measuredEndpointQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == measuredEndpointQuery.IsDeleted);

            if (measuredEndpointQuery.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == measuredEndpointQuery.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier);
        }
        else if(query is ChannelRefsQuery refsQuery)
        {
            if (refsQuery.DeviceId != null && refsQuery.DeviceId > 0)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == refsQuery.DeviceId);

            if (refsQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == refsQuery.IsDeleted || _device.IsDeleted == refsQuery.IsDeleted);
        }
        else if(query is ChannelEntitiesQuery entitiesQuery)
        {
            if (entitiesQuery.DeviceId != null && entitiesQuery.DeviceId > 0)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == entitiesQuery.DeviceId);

            if (entitiesQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entitiesQuery.IsDeleted || _device.IsDeleted == entitiesQuery.IsDeleted);
        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<ChannelEntity, ChannelEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        //TODO: Bekötni a hiányzó értékeket
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(ChannelListItemDto))
        {
            //TODO: A konfig kód értéknek enum típust kéne adni, hogy elkerüljük a beégetett stringet
            ChannelListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                .SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.ChannelName)
                .SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.ObisCode).WithAlias(() => alias.ObisCode)
                .SelectGroup(() => _measuredPropertyAlias.MeasuredPropertyName).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasuredProperty)
                .SelectGroup(() => _measuredPropertyAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasuredPropertyId)
                .Select(Projections.SqlFunction("MAX", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                                Projections.Conditional(Restrictions.Eq(Projections.Property(() => _deviceConfigAlias.Code), "TimeUnit"),
                                                                        Projections.Property(() => _channelConfigValueAlias.Value),
                                                                        Projections.Constant(null, NHibernateUtil.String)))).WithAlias(() => alias.DateReceivingFrequency)
                .Select(Projections.SqlFunction("MAX", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                                Projections.Conditional(Restrictions.Eq(Projections.Property(() => _deviceConfigAlias.Code), "Unit"),
                                                                        Projections.Property(() => _channelConfigValueAlias.Value),
                                                                        Projections.Constant(null, NHibernateUtil.String)))).WithAlias(() => alias.Unit)
                .Select(Projections.SqlFunction("MAX", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                                Projections.Conditional(Restrictions.Eq(Projections.Property(() => _deviceConfigAlias.Code), "MinValue"),
                                                                        Projections.Property(() => _channelConfigValueAlias.Value),
                                                                        Projections.Constant(null, NHibernateUtil.String)))).WithAlias(() => alias.MinValue)
                .Select(Projections.SqlFunction("MAX", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                                Projections.Conditional(Restrictions.Eq(Projections.Property(() => _deviceConfigAlias.Code), "MaxValue"),
                                                                        Projections.Property(() => _channelConfigValueAlias.Value),
                                                                        Projections.Constant(null, NHibernateUtil.String)))).WithAlias(() => alias.MaxValue)
                .Select(Projections.SqlFunction("MAX", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                                Projections.Conditional(Restrictions.Eq(Projections.Property(() => _deviceConfigAlias.Code), "AggregationMethod"),
                                                                        Projections.Property(() => _channelConfigValueAlias.Value),
                                                                        Projections.Constant(null, NHibernateUtil.String)))).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationMethod)
                .Select(Projections.SqlFunction("MAX", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                                Projections.Conditional(Restrictions.Eq(Projections.Property(() => _deviceConfigAlias.Code), "MeasurementDescriptor"),
                                                                        Projections.Property(() => _channelConfigValueAlias.Value),
                                                                        Projections.Constant(null, NHibernateUtil.String)))).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDescriptor));

        }
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ChannelQuery measuredEndpointQuery)
            return DoMeasuredEndpointSingleEntityQuery(measuredEndpointQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ChannelEntitiesQuery measuredEndpointQuery)
            return DoMeasuredEndpointEntitiesQuery(measuredEndpointQuery);

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the measured endpoint entities query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entitiesQuery">The entities query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoMeasuredEndpointEntitiesQuery(ChannelEntitiesQuery entitiesQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>();

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, entitiesQuery);
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, entitiesQuery);

        var entities = queryOver.List();
        var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<ChannelEntityDto> { Items = entities.Select(CreateDto).ToArray() };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the measured endpoint single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoMeasuredEndpointSingleEntityQuery(ChannelQuery query)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.TenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(query.TenantCode);
                var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
                DbContext = tenantDbContext;
            }

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>();

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous MeasuredEndpointQuery");

        DbContext.Commit();

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }


    private class TempAliasClass 
    {
        public Guid ChannelIdentifier { get; set; }

        public string MeasuredProperty { get; set; }

        public string MeasurementPointName { get; set; }

        public int MeasuredPropertyId { get; set; }

        public int MeasurementPointId { get; set; }

        public int OrgunitBaseId { get; set; }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices;
using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// DeviceConfigQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.DeviceConfigEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.DeviceConfigEntityDto&gt;" />
public class DeviceConfigQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<DeviceConfigEntity, DeviceConfigEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// Device type entity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IoTDeviceTypeEntity _ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias = null;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DeviceConfigQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public DeviceConfigQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is DeviceConfigRefsQuery deviceConfigRefsQuery)
            return DoDeviceConfigRefsQuery(deviceConfigRefsQuery);

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the device configuration refs query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException"></exception>
    private IQueryResult DoDeviceConfigRefsQuery(DeviceConfigRefsQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceConfigEntity>()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDeviceType, () => _ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias);

        if (query.DeviceId.HasValue)
        {
            var deviceEntity = DbContext.Session.Get<DeviceEntity>(query.DeviceId);
            query.DeviceTypeId = deviceEntity?.IoTDeviceType?.Id;
            if (!query.DeviceTypeId.HasValue)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("");
        }

        if (query.DeviceTypeId != null && query.DeviceTypeId > 0)
            queryOver.Where(x => _ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias.Id == query.DeviceTypeId.Value);

        if (query.DeviceConfigType != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Type == query.DeviceConfigType.Value);

        var entityConfigCodeList = queryOver.List().Select(_mapper.Map<DeviceConfigCodeDto>).ToList();
        var result = new DeviceConfigRefsQueryResult { DeviceConfigCodeList = entityConfigCodeList };
        return result;
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<DeviceConfigEntity, DeviceConfigEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        if (query is DeviceConfigEntityQuery configQuery) 
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IoTDeviceType.Id == configQuery.IoTDeviceTypeId);

            queryOver.Where(x => x.Type == configQuery.ConfigType);
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Common;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.TenantIndependent;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.MeasurementPointSync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems.Device;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.MeasurementPoint;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.SqlCommand;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// DeviceQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.DeviceEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.DeviceEntityDto&gt;" />
public partial class DeviceQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<DeviceEntity, DeviceEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Dvice type entity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IoTDeviceTypeEntity _ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// The tenant independent dictionary item entity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictItemEntity _tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// The site location entity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteLocationEntity _siteLocationEntityAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// The site entity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteEntity _siteEntityAlias = null!;

    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DeviceQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public DeviceQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        IQueryService queryService) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            GetDevicesStatusQuery => DoGetDevicesStatusQuery(),
            SyncDeviceQuery syncDeviceQuery => DoSyncDeviceQuery(syncDeviceQuery),
            DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQuery deviceCategoriesQuery => DoDeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQuery(deviceCategoriesQuery),
            DeviceTypesByOrgUnitQuery deviceTypesQuery => DoDeviceTypesByOrgUnitQuery(deviceTypesQuery),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// This query retrieves device categories based on the organization unit, optionally (tough mandatory in controller) filtered by technology and measured property.
    /// It first retrieves measurement points for the specified organization unit, then collects device IDs from these measurement points.
    /// If a TechnologyId is specified, it filters the measurement points to only those that have the specified technology label.
    /// Finally, it queries the devices associated with those IDs, applying active filtering based on installation and removal dates,
    /// and retrieves distinct device categories from the resulting devices.
    /// </summary>
    private DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQueryResult DoDeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQuery(DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQuery query)
    {
        // Get measurement points for the org unit
        var measurementPointsQuery = new MeasurementPointsByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery { OrgUnitBaseId = query.OrgUnitId, IsBilling = false };
        var measurementPoints = _queryService.QueryEntities(measurementPointsQuery).RunSync() as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointEntityDto>;
        if (measurementPoints?.Items is null)
            return new DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQueryResult(); //not found

        // Get all device IDs from measurement points
        var deviceIds = measurementPoints.Items
            .SelectMany(mp => mp.Devices)
            .Select(d => d.Id)
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        // Filter by TechnologyId if specified
        // TechnologyId filtering is implemented by filtering measurement points with the specified technology label.
        if (query.TechnologyId.HasValue)
        {
            // Filter measurement points that have the specific technology label
            var measurementPointsWithTechnology = measurementPoints.Items
                .Where(mp => mp.Labels != null && mp.Labels.Any(label => label.Id == query.TechnologyId))
                .ToList();

            // Get device IDs from only these filtered measurement points
            deviceIds = measurementPointsWithTechnology
                .SelectMany(mp => mp.Devices)
                .Select(d => d.Id)
                .Distinct()
                .ToList();

            // If no devices found with this technology, return empty result
            if (!deviceIds.Any())
                return new DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQueryResult();
        }

        // Query devices with active filtering and additional criteria
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>()
            .Where(d => d.Id.IsIn(deviceIds));

        // Active device filtering based on installation/removal dates
        if (query.From != null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(d => d.RemovalDate == null || d.RemovalDate.Value.Date >= query.From);
        }

        if (query.To != null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(d => d.InstallationDate.Date <= query.To);
        }


        // Join with IoTDeviceType and DeviceCategory
        IoTDeviceTypeEntity iotDeviceTypeAlias = null!;
        TenantIndependentDictItemEntity deviceCategoryAlias = null!;

        queryOver
            .JoinAlias(d => d.IoTDeviceType, () => iotDeviceTypeAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => iotDeviceTypeAlias.DeviceCategory, () => deviceCategoryAlias);

        // Add filtering by MeasuredPropertyId through measurement point settings
        if (query.MeasuredPropertyId.HasValue)
        {
            MeasurementPointSettingEntity settingAlias = null!;
            ChannelEntity channelAlias = null!;
            MeasuredPropertyEntity measuredPropertyAlias = null!;

            queryOver
                .JoinAlias(d => d.Channels, () => channelAlias)
                .JoinEntityAlias(() => settingAlias, () => channelAlias.Id == settingAlias.Channel.Id)
                .JoinAlias(() => settingAlias.MeasuredProperty, () => measuredPropertyAlias)
                .Where(() => measuredPropertyAlias.Id == query.MeasuredPropertyId);
        }


        var deviceCategories = queryOver
            .Select(Projections.Distinct(Projections.ProjectionList()
                .Add(Projections.Property(() => deviceCategoryAlias.Id))
                .Add(Projections.Property(() => deviceCategoryAlias.Value))))
            .List<object[]>()
            .Select(item => (DeviceCategoryId: (int)item[0], DeviceCategoryName: (string)item[1]))
            .ToList();

        return new DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQueryResult
        {
            DeviceCategories = deviceCategories
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// This query retrieves device types based on the organization unit, filtered by device category.
    /// Similar to DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQuery, but returns device types instead of categories.
    /// It first retrieves measurement points for the specified organization unit, then collects device IDs from these measurement points.
    /// If filtering parameters are specified, it applies them accordingly.
    /// Finally, it queries the devices associated with those IDs, applying active filtering based on installation and removal dates,
    /// and retrieves distinct device types from the resulting devices filtered by the specified device category.
    /// </summary>
    private DeviceTypesByOrgUnitQueryResult DoDeviceTypesByOrgUnitQuery(DeviceTypesByOrgUnitQuery query)
    {
        // Get measurement points for the org unit
        var measurementPointsQuery = new MeasurementPointsByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery { OrgUnitBaseId = query.OrgUnitId, IsBilling = false };
        var measurementPoints = _queryService.QueryEntities(measurementPointsQuery).RunSync() as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointEntityDto>;
        if (measurementPoints?.Items is null)
            return new DeviceTypesByOrgUnitQueryResult(); //not found

        // Get all device IDs from measurement points
        var deviceIds = measurementPoints.Items
            .SelectMany(mp => mp.Devices)
            .Select(d => d.Id)
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        // Filter by TechnologyId if specified (same logic as DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQuery)
        if (query.TechnologyId.HasValue)
        {
            // Filter measurement points that have the specific technology label
            var measurementPointsWithTechnology = measurementPoints.Items
                .Where(mp => mp.Labels != null && mp.Labels.Any(label => label.Id == query.TechnologyId))
                .ToList();

            // Get device IDs from only these filtered measurement points
            deviceIds = measurementPointsWithTechnology
                .SelectMany(mp => mp.Devices)
                .Select(d => d.Id)
                .Distinct()
                .ToList();

            // If no devices found with this technology, return empty result
            if (!deviceIds.Any())
                return new DeviceTypesByOrgUnitQueryResult();
        }

        // Query devices with active filtering and additional criteria
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>()
            .Where(d => d.Id.IsIn(deviceIds));

        // Active device filtering based on installation/removal dates
        if (query.From != null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(d => d.RemovalDate == null || d.RemovalDate.Value.Date >= query.From);
        }

        if (query.To != null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(d => d.InstallationDate.Date <= query.To);
        }


        // Join with IoTDeviceType and DeviceCategory
        IoTDeviceTypeEntity iotDeviceTypeAlias = null!;
        TenantIndependentDictItemEntity deviceCategoryAlias = null!;

        queryOver
            .JoinAlias(d => d.IoTDeviceType, () => iotDeviceTypeAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => iotDeviceTypeAlias.DeviceCategory, () => deviceCategoryAlias);

        // Filter by DeviceCategoryId - this is the key difference from DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQuery
        if (query.DeviceCategoryId.HasValue)
        {
            queryOver.Where(() => deviceCategoryAlias.Id == query.DeviceCategoryId);
        }

        // Add filtering by MeasuredPropertyId through measurement point settings (same as DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQuery)
        if (query.MeasuredPropertyId.HasValue)
        {
            MeasurementPointSettingEntity settingAlias = null!;
            ChannelEntity channelAlias = null!;
            MeasuredPropertyEntity measuredPropertyAlias = null!;

            queryOver
                .JoinAlias(d => d.Channels, () => channelAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                .JoinEntityAlias(() => settingAlias, () => channelAlias.Id == settingAlias.Channel.Id, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                .JoinAlias(() => settingAlias.MeasuredProperty, () => measuredPropertyAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                .Where(() => measuredPropertyAlias.Id == query.MeasuredPropertyId);
        }

        // Select distinct IoTDeviceType information instead of DeviceCategory
        var deviceTypes = queryOver
            .Select(Projections.Distinct(Projections.ProjectionList()
                .Add(Projections.Property(() => iotDeviceTypeAlias.Id))
                .Add(Projections.Property(() => iotDeviceTypeAlias.DeviceTypeName))))
            .List<object[]>()
            .Select(item => (DeviceTypeId: (int)item[0], DeviceTypeName: (string)item[1]))
            .ToList();

        return new DeviceTypesByOrgUnitQueryResult
        {
            DeviceTypes = deviceTypes
        };
    }

    private IQueryResult DoSyncDeviceQuery(SyncDeviceQuery syncDeviceQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>()
                                         .Fetch(SelectMode.Fetch, x => x.ConfigValues);

        if (syncDeviceQuery.From.HasValue)
            queryOver.OnlyFrom(syncDeviceQuery.From);

        var result = queryOver.List();

        //TODO: Ki kéne kísérletezni, hogyan lehet betölteni már a query-vel egy ilyen struktúrát
        foreach (var device in result)
        {
            NHibernateUtil.Initialize(device.Channels);
            foreach (var channel in device.Channels)
            {
                NHibernateUtil.Initialize(channel.Configuration);
            }
        }

        return new SyncDeviceQueryResult()
        {
            Devices = result.Select(Mapper.Map<DeviceSyncModel>).ToList()
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the get devices status query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoGetDevicesStatusQuery()
    {
        var hasError = DbContext.Session.Query<DeviceEntity>().Any(e => e.Status == DeviceStatus.Error);
        if (hasError)
            return new GetDevicesStatusQueryResult { DeviceStatus = DeviceStatus.Error };

        var hasWarning = DbContext.Session.Query<DeviceEntity>().Any(e => e.Status == DeviceStatus.Warning);
        if (hasWarning)
            return new GetDevicesStatusQueryResult { DeviceStatus = DeviceStatus.Warning };

        return new GetDevicesStatusQueryResult { DeviceStatus = DeviceStatus.Online };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is DeviceMinEntitiesQuery deviceMinEntitiesQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(deviceMinEntitiesQuery);

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        // Itt a visszatérési érték DeviceDto != DeviceEntityDto
        if (query is SingleDeviceEntityQuery deviceEntityQuery)
            return DoSingleDeviceEntityQuery(deviceEntityQuery);

        if (query is SingleDeviceEntityDtoQuery deviceEntityDtoQuery)
            return DoSingleDeviceEntityDtoQuery(deviceEntityDtoQuery);


        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is DeviceEntitiesQuery_Old entitiesQuery)
            return DoDeviceEntitiesQuery_Old(entitiesQuery);
        if (query is DeviceEntitiesByIdListQuery deviceEntitiesByIdListQuery)
            return DoDeviceEntitiesByIdListQuery(deviceEntitiesByIdListQuery).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        if (query is DeviceEntitiesQuery deviceEntitiesQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(deviceEntitiesQuery);

        if (query is IEntityQuery<DeviceListItemDto_Old> itemQuery)
        {
            var items = DoQueryEntities(itemQuery);
            if (!items.Items.Any())
                return items;

            var identifiers = items.Items
                .Select(x => x.DeviceIdentifier)
                .ToList();

            var favourites =
                DbContext
                .Session
                .QueryOver<FavouriteEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(identifiers))
                .List();

            foreach (var item in items.Items)
                if (favourites.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Identifier == item.DeviceIdentifier) != null)
                    item.IsInFavourites = true;
            return items;

        }
        return base.QueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<DeviceEntity, DeviceEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is DevicePagedEntityQuery devicePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (devicePagedEntityQuery.Site.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => _siteEntityAlias.Id == devicePagedEntityQuery.Site.Value);

            if (devicePagedEntityQuery.SiteLocation.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => _siteLocationEntityAlias.Id == devicePagedEntityQuery.SiteLocation.Value);

            if (devicePagedEntityQuery.DeviceType.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => _tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias.Id == devicePagedEntityQuery.DeviceType.Value);

            if (devicePagedEntityQuery.Status.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Status == devicePagedEntityQuery.Status);
        }

        if (query is DeviceMinEntitiesQuery deviceMinEntitiesQuery)
        {
            if (deviceMinEntitiesQuery.SiteId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => _siteEntityAlias.Id == deviceMinEntitiesQuery.SiteId.Value);
        }

        if (query is DeviceEntitiesQuery deviceEntitiesQuery)
        {
            if (deviceEntitiesQuery.MeasurementPointId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementPoint.Id == deviceEntitiesQuery.MeasurementPointId);

            if (deviceEntitiesQuery.IsActive.HasValue)
                if (deviceEntitiesQuery.IsActive.Value)
                {
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.InstallationDate.Date <= DateTimeContext.Now.Date && (x.RemovalDate == null || x.RemovalDate >= DateTimeContext.Now.Date));
                }
                else
                {
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.RemovalDate != null && x.RemovalDate < DateTimeContext.Now.Date);
                }
        }

        if (query is SelectEntityRefQuery<DeviceEntityDto> deviceEntityRefQuery)
        {
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(deviceEntityRefQuery.Search))
                queryOver = queryOver.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.DeviceName).IsInsensitiveLike(deviceEntityRefQuery.Search, MatchMode.Anywhere);
        }

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<DeviceEntity, DeviceEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is DevicePagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery)
        {
            queryOver = queryOver
                .Left
                .JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDeviceType, () => _ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias)
                .Left
                .JoinAlias(x => _ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias.DeviceCategory, () => _tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias)
                ;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<DeviceEntity, DeviceEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(DeviceListItemDto))
        {
            DeviceListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(Projections.Constant("Fogyasztás mérő")).WithAlias(() => alias.DeviceType)
                    .Select(x => x.Manufacturer).WithAlias(() => alias.Manufacturer)
                    .Select(x => x.InstallationDate).WithAlias(() => alias.InstallationDate)
                    .Select(x => x.RemovalDate).WithAlias(() => alias.RemovalDate)
                    .Select(x => x.SerialNumber).WithAlias(() => alias.SerialNumber)
                    .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
            );
        }

        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(DeviceListItemDto_Old))
        {
            DeviceListItemDto_Old alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(x => x.DeviceName).WithAlias(() => alias.DeviceName)
                    .Select(x => _tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias.Value).WithAlias(() => alias.DeviceTypeCategoryName)
                    //.Select(x => _siteLocationEntityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteLocationName)
                    .Select(x => x.Status).WithAlias(() => alias.DeviceStatus)
                    .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.DeviceIdentifier)
            );
        }

        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(DeviceMinListDto))
        {
            DeviceMinListDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(x => x.DeviceName).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                    .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the device entities query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entitiesQuery">The entities query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoDeviceEntitiesQuery_Old(DeviceEntitiesQuery_Old entitiesQuery)
    {
        RoomEntity roomAlias = null!;
        SiteLocationEntity siteLocationAlias = null!;
        IoTDeviceTypeEntity ioTDeviceTypeAlias = null!;
        TenantIndependentDictItemEntity ioTDeviceCategoryAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>();

        if (entitiesQuery.SiteLocationId.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => siteLocationAlias.Id == entitiesQuery.SiteLocationId);

        if (entitiesQuery.SiteLocationIdentifier.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => siteLocationAlias.Identifier == entitiesQuery.SiteLocationIdentifier);

        if (entitiesQuery.RoomId.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => roomAlias.Id == entitiesQuery.RoomId);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entitiesQuery.IoTDeviceTypeCode))
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDeviceType, () => ioTDeviceTypeAlias)
                .Where(x => ioTDeviceTypeAlias!.Code == entitiesQuery.IoTDeviceTypeCode);

        // Ha nincs szűrés a DeviceType-ra, de a DeviceCategory-ra igen,
        // akkor JOIN-oljunk a Type-ra is (hogy tudjunk majd innen
        // tovább JOIN-olni Categoryra.
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(entitiesQuery.IoTDeviceTypeCode) &&
            entitiesQuery.IoTDeviceCategoryCode != null && entitiesQuery.IoTDeviceCategoryCode.Any())
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDeviceType, () => ioTDeviceTypeAlias);

        if (entitiesQuery.IoTDeviceCategoryCode != null && entitiesQuery.IoTDeviceCategoryCode.Any())
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => ioTDeviceTypeAlias.DeviceCategory, () => ioTDeviceCategoryAlias)
                .Where(x => ioTDeviceCategoryAlias!.Code.IsIn(entitiesQuery.IoTDeviceCategoryCode));


        var entities = queryOver.List();
        EntityListItemQueryResult<DeviceEntityDto> result = new() { Items = entities.Select(CreateDto).ToArray() };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the device entities by id list query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceEntitiesByIdListQuery">The entities by id list query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<IEntityQueryItemsResult> DoDeviceEntitiesByIdListQuery(DeviceEntitiesByIdListQuery deviceEntitiesByIdListQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>();

        queryOver.Where(x => x.Id.IsIn(deviceEntitiesByIdListQuery.DeviceIds));

        if (deviceEntitiesByIdListQuery.ActiveOnly)
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => x.InstallationDate.Date <= DateTimeContext.Now.Date && (x.RemovalDate == null || x.RemovalDate >= DateTimeContext.Now.Date));
        }

        queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.InstallationDate);

        var entities = await queryOver.ListAsync();
        EntityListItemQueryResult<DeviceEntityDto> result = new() { Items = entities.Select(CreateDto).ToArray() };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the single device entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceEntityQuery">The device entity query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSingleDeviceEntityQuery(SingleDeviceEntityQuery deviceEntityQuery)
    {
        SiteLocationEntity siteLocationAlias = null!;
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>();

        if (deviceEntityQuery.DeviceId.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == deviceEntityQuery.DeviceId);

        if (deviceEntityQuery.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == deviceEntityQuery.DeviceIdentifier);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous DeviceEntity");
        var dto = Mapper.Map<DeviceDto>(entity);

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = dto
            };

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the single device entity dto query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSingleDeviceEntityDtoQuery(SingleDeviceEntityDtoQuery query)
    {
        SiteLocationEntity siteLocationAlias = null!;
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>();

        if (query.DeviceIdentifier.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == query.DeviceIdentifier);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous DeviceEntity");
        var dto = Mapper.Map<DeviceEntityDto>(entity);

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = dto
            };

        return null;
    }

}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// EndpointUnitMetaDataQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.EndpointUnitMetaDataEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto&gt;" />
public class EndpointUnitMetaDataQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<EndpointUnitMetaDataEntity, EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The endpoint unit alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly EndpointUnitEntity? _endpointUnitAlias = null;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EndpointUnitMetaDataQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public EndpointUnitMetaDataQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    { }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EndpointUnitMetaDataQuery endpointUnitMetaDataQuery)
            return DoEndpointUnitMetaDataQuery(endpointUnitMetaDataQuery);

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the endpoint unit meta data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidCastException">
    /// Failed to parse EndpointUnitMetaDataValue of '{values[i]}' to Boolean. The id of the MetaDataValue is: '{endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult![i].Id}'
    /// or
    /// Failed to parse EndpointUnitMetaDataValue of '{values[i]}' to Integer. The id of the MetaDataValue is: '{endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult![i].Id}'
    /// or
    /// Failed to parse EndpointUnitMetaDataValue of '{values[i]}' to Double. The id of the MetaDataValue is: '{endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult![i].Id}'
    /// </exception>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException">Missing JSON object conversion implementation for MetadataType: '{type}'.</exception>
    private IQueryResult DoEndpointUnitMetaDataQuery(EndpointUnitMetaDataQuery query)
    {
        var result = new EndpointUnitMetaDataQueryResult { };

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EndpointUnitMetaDataEntity>();
        queryOver.JoinAlias(e => e.EndpointUnit, () => _endpointUnitAlias);
        if (query.EndpointUnitId != null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(e => _endpointUnitAlias.Id == query.EndpointUnitId);
        }

        if (query.EndpointUnitIdentifier != null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(e => _endpointUnitAlias.Identifier == query.EndpointUnitIdentifier);
        }

        var endpointUnitMetaData = queryOver.List().FirstOrDefault();
        var endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult = endpointUnitMetaData?.MetaDataValues;
        var keys = endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult?.Select(v => v.Property?.Code).ToArray();
        var types = endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult?.Select(v => v.Property?.ValueType).ToArray();
        var values = endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult?.Select(v => v.Value).ToArray();

        JsonObject jsonObj = new JsonObject();

        if (keys != null && types != null && values != null)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < keys.Count(); i++)
            {
                MetadataType type = (MetadataType)types![i]!;
                switch (type)
                {
                    case MetadataType.Bool:
                        bool successfullyParsedBool = bool.TryParse(values![i], out bool boolValue);
                        if (!successfullyParsedBool)
                        {
                            // Error handling?
                            throw new InvalidCastException($"Failed to parse EndpointUnitMetaDataValue of '{values[i]}' to Boolean. The id of the MetaDataValue is: '{endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult![i].Id}'");
                        }
                        jsonObj.Add(keys[i]!, boolValue);
                        break;
                    case MetadataType.Int:
                        bool successfullyParsedInt = int.TryParse(values![i], out int intValue);
                        if (!successfullyParsedInt)
                        {
                            // Error handling?
                            throw new InvalidCastException($"Failed to parse EndpointUnitMetaDataValue of '{values[i]}' to Integer. The id of the MetaDataValue is: '{endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult![i].Id}'");
                        }
                        jsonObj.Add(keys[i]!, intValue);
                        break;
                    case MetadataType.Double:
                        bool successfullyParsedDouble = double.TryParse(values![i], NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double doubleValue);
                        if (!successfullyParsedDouble)
                        {
                            // Error handling?
                            throw new InvalidCastException($"Failed to parse EndpointUnitMetaDataValue of '{values[i]}' to Double. The id of the MetaDataValue is: '{endpointUnitMetaDataValuesResult![i].Id}'");
                        }
                        jsonObj.Add(keys[i]!, doubleValue);
                        break;
                    case MetadataType.String:
                    case MetadataType.Dictionary:
                    case MetadataType.CronExpression:
                    case MetadataType.Regex:
                    case MetadataType.TimeSpan:
                        jsonObj.Add(keys[i]!, values[i]);
                        break;
                    case MetadataType.Json:
                        jsonObj.Add(keys[i]!, JsonNode.Parse(values[i]));
                        break;
                    default:
                        throw new NotImplementedException($"Missing JSON object conversion implementation for MetadataType: '{type}'.");
                }
            }
        }

        result.MetaDataJson = Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<object>(jsonObj.ToJsonString());
        return result;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
