using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems.Device;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// EndpointUnitQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.EndpointUnitEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.EndpointUnitEntityDto&gt;" />
public class EndpointUnitQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<EndpointUnitEntity, EndpointUnitEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EndpointUnitQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public EndpointUnitQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EndpointUnitSingleQuery endpointUnitSingleQuery)
            return DoEndpointUnitSingleQuery(endpointUnitSingleQuery);
        
        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EndpointUnitEntityQuery endpointUnitEntityQuery)
            return base.DoQueryEntities(endpointUnitEntityQuery);

        if (query is IEntityQuery<EndpointUnitListItemDto> itemQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(itemQuery);

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EndpointUnitEntityQuery endpointUnitEntityQuery)
            return DoEndpointUnitSingleEntityQuery(endpointUnitEntityQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the endpoint unit single query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException">Entity {0} with {1} id not found</exception>
    private IQueryResult DoEndpointUnitSingleQuery(EndpointUnitSingleQuery query)
    {
        Log.LogInfo("EndpointUnitId: ", query.EndpointUnitId);
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Get<EndpointUnitEntity>(query.EndpointUnitId);
        if (entity == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Entity {0} with {1} id not found", typeof(EndpointUnitEntity).EntityTypeName(), query.EndpointUnitId);

        var result = new EndpointUnitSingleQueryResult
        {
            Id = entity.Id,
            Identifier = entity.Identifier,
            DeviceName = entity.DeviceName,
            Type = entity.Type,
            Schema = entity.MetaData != null && entity.MetaData.MetaDataSchema != null ? 
            Mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>>(entity.MetaData.MetaDataSchema) : 
            new EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>(),
            SchemaValues = entity.MetaData != null ? entity.MetaData.MetaDataValues
            .Where(x => x.Property != null)
            .Select(x => new EndpointUnitMetaDataValueModel
            {
                Code = x.Property.Code,
                Value = x.Value
            }).ToList() :
            new List<EndpointUnitMetaDataValueModel>()
        };

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the endpoint unit single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoEndpointUnitSingleEntityQuery(EndpointUnitEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EndpointUnitEntity>();
        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);

        if (query.Identifier is not null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Identifier == query.Identifier);
        
        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous EndpointUnitEntity");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<EndpointUnitEntity, EndpointUnitEntity> queryOver,
        IEntityQuery query)
    {
        queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);

        if (query is EndpointUnitEntitiesQuery endpointUnitEntityQuery)
        {
            if (endpointUnitEntityQuery.Identifier is not null)
                queryOver.Where(t => t.Identifier == endpointUnitEntityQuery.Identifier);

            if (endpointUnitEntityQuery.MeasuredEndpointIdentifiers != null)
            {
                var ids = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ChannelEntity>()
                    .Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(endpointUnitEntityQuery.MeasuredEndpointIdentifiers)).SelectList(x => x.Select(y => y.Id)).List<int>().Select(x => x).ToArray();
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Channel.Id.IsIn(ids));
            }
        }

        if (query is EndpointUnitPagedEntityQuery modelCataloguePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(modelCataloguePagedEntityQuery.SearchText))
            {
                queryOver
                    .And(Restrictions
                        .On<EndpointUnitEntity>(x => x.DeviceName)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(modelCataloguePagedEntityQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere));
            }

            if (modelCataloguePagedEntityQuery.Type.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Type == modelCataloguePagedEntityQuery.Type);

            if (modelCataloguePagedEntityQuery.MeasuredEndpointId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Channel.Id == modelCataloguePagedEntityQuery.MeasuredEndpointId);
        }

        if (query is IPagedEntityQuery pagedQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pagedQuery.SearchText))
                queryOver
                   .And(Restrictions
                                .On<EndpointUnitEntity>(x => x.DeviceName)
                                .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere));
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<EndpointUnitEntity, EndpointUnitEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(EndpointUnitListItemDto))
        {
            EndpointUnitListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(x => x.DeviceName).WithAlias(() => alias.DeviceName)
                        .Select(x => x.Type).WithAlias(() => alias.TypeEnum)
            );
        }
        return null;
    }
}

using Autofac.Features.AttributeFilters;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.TenantIndependent;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.IoTDeviceTypes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.IoTDeviceTypes;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// IoTDeviceTypeQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices.IoTDeviceTypeEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto&gt;" />
public class IoTDeviceTypeQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<IoTDeviceTypeEntity, IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The ti dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDeviceTypeQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    public IoTDeviceTypeQueryHandler(
        [KeyFilter("DataReceiver")] IDbContext dbContext, 
        IMapper mapper, 
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache) 
        : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is DeviceCategoriesQuery)
            return DoDeviceCategoriesQuery();

        if (query is GetIoTDeviceTypeRefsQuery iotDeviceTypeRefQuery)
            return DoGetIoTDeviceTypeRefsQuery(iotDeviceTypeRefQuery);

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the device categories query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoDeviceCategoriesQuery()
    {
        var dtos = new List<DeviceCategoryDto>();
        var deviceCategories = _tiDictCache.GetItems(DictType.IoTDeviceCategory);

        IoTDeviceTypeEntity ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias = null!;
        TenantIndependentDictItemEntity tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias = null!;

        foreach (var deviceCategory in deviceCategories ?? Array.Empty<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>())
        {
            var devices = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>()
                .JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDeviceType, () => ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias)
                .JoinAlias(x => ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias.DeviceCategory, () => tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias)
                .Where(x => tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias.Id == deviceCategory.Id)
                .List();
            var dto = new DeviceCategoryDto 
            {
                Id = deviceCategory.Id,
                CategoryCode = deviceCategory.Code,
                CategoryName = deviceCategory.Value,
                Count = QueryHelper.GetDeviceCategoryCount(devices),
                Status = QueryHelper.GetDeviceStatus(devices)
            };

            dtos.Add(dto);
        }

        var result = new DeviceCategoriesQueryResult 
        {
            DeviceCategoryDtos = dtos
        };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the get io t device type refs query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entitiesQuery">The entities query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoGetIoTDeviceTypeRefsQuery(GetIoTDeviceTypeRefsQuery entitiesQuery)
    {
        TenantIndependentDictItemEntity tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceTypeEntity>()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.DeviceCategory, () => tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias)
            .Where(x => tenantIndependentDictItemEntityAlias.Id == entitiesQuery.DeviceCategoryId);

        var entityRefList = queryOver.List().Select(Mapper.Map<EntityRef<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>>).ToList();
        var result = new GetIoTDeviceTypeRefsQueryResult { DeviceTypeRefs = entityRefList };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IoTDeviceTypeQuery ioTDeviceTypeQuery)
        {
            return DoIoTDeviceTypeSingleEntityQuery(ioTDeviceTypeQuery);
        }
        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the io t device type single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoIoTDeviceTypeSingleEntityQuery(IoTDeviceTypeQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceTypeEntity>();
        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Code))
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Code == query.Code);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous IoTDeviceTypeQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd\BusinessLogic\QueryHandlers\EnergyContract\EnergyContractQueryHandler.cs

using System.Linq.Expressions;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.EnergyContract;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.SqlCommand;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.EnergyContract;

/// <summary>
/// EnergyContractQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyContract.EnergyContractEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract.EnergyContractEntityDto&gt;" />
public class EnergyContractQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<EnergyContractEntity, EnergyContractEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Supplier alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SupplierEntity _supplierAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Site alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionEntity _institutionAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Partner Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionValidityEntity _validityAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Partner Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionValidityEntity _subQueryAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergyContractQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public EnergyContractQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EnergyContractEntityQuery contractEntityQuery)
            return DoContractEntityQuery(contractEntityQuery);
        if (query is ValidEnergyContractEntityQuery validEnergyContractEntityQuery)
            return DoValidEnergyContractEntityQuery(validEnergyContractEntityQuery);
        if (query is NetworkUsageContractEntityQuery networkUsageContractEntityQuery)
            return DoNetworkUsageContractEntityQuery(networkUsageContractEntityQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entity count.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override long DoQueryEntityCount(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SingleValidNetworkUsageContractPerInstitutionQuery singleValidNetworkUsageContractPerSiteQuery)
            return DoSingleValidNetworkUsageContractPerInsitutionQuery(singleValidNetworkUsageContractPerSiteQuery);

        return base.DoQueryEntityCount(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the single valid network usage contract per site query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private long DoSingleValidNetworkUsageContractPerInsitutionQuery(SingleValidNetworkUsageContractPerInstitutionQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EnergyContractEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract)
            .Where(x => x.Institution.Id == query.InstitutionId)
            .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted)
            .Where(Restrictions.Where(ValidityIntersectionExpression(query)));

        if (query.ContractId != 0)
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Id != query.ContractId);

        return queryOver.RowCount();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the valid energy contract entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult DoValidEnergyContractEntityQuery(ValidEnergyContractEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entity =
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EnergyContractEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement && //TODO: érvényesség kezelés
                        x.Institution.Id == query.InstitutionId)
            .Take(1)
            .SingleOrDefault();
        var dto = Mapper.Map<EnergyContractEntityDto>(entity);
        var result = new EntityQuerySingleResult
        {
            Entity = dto
        };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EnergyContractEntityQuery contractEntityQuery)
            return DoContractEntitiesQuery(contractEntityQuery);
        if (query is EnergyContractEntityByInstitutionQuery contractEntityBySiteQuery)
            return DoContractEntityByInstitutionQuery(contractEntityBySiteQuery);

        return base.QueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IEntityQuery<EnergyContractListItemDto> itemQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(itemQuery);

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities<TResult>(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IEntityQuery<EnergyContractListItemDto> itemQuery)
            return base.DoQueryEntities<TResult>(query);

        return base.DoQueryEntities<TResult>(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the contract entities query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entitiesQuery">The entities query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoContractEntitiesQuery(EnergyContractEntityQuery entitiesQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EnergyContractEntity>();
        if (entitiesQuery.IsDeleted is not null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entitiesQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        var entities = queryOver.List();
        var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<EnergyContractEntityDto> { Items = entities.Select(CreateDto).ToArray() };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the contract entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoContractEntityQuery(EnergyContractEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EnergyContractEntity>();

        if (query.ContractId != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.ContractId);

        if (query.IsDeleted is not null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == query.IsDeleted);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous Contract");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the network usage contract entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoNetworkUsageContractEntityQuery(NetworkUsageContractEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NetworkUsageContractEntity>();

        if (query.InstitutionIdentifier != null)
        {
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Institution, () => _institutionAlias);
            queryOver.Where(x => _institutionAlias.Identifier == query.InstitutionIdentifier);
        }

        if (query.IsDeleted is not null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == query.IsDeleted);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous NetworkUsageContract");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };

        return null;
    }


    private QueryOver<InstitutionValidityEntity> MakeValiditySubquery()
    {
        return QueryOver.Of(() => _subQueryAlias)
                                .Where(() => _institutionAlias.Id == _subQueryAlias.Institution.Id)
                                .OrderBy(pr => pr.Institution.Id).Asc
                                .ThenBy(Projections.Conditional(
                                    Restrictions.And(
                                        Restrictions.Le(Projections.Property<InstitutionValidityEntity>(pr => pr.ValidFrom), DateTime.Today),
                                        Restrictions.Ge(Projections.Property<InstitutionValidityEntity>(pr => pr.ValidTo), DateTime.Today)
                                    ),
                                    Projections.Constant(1),
                                    Projections.Constant(0))).Desc
                                .ThenBy(Projections.Conditional(
                                    Restrictions.Lt(Projections.Property<InstitutionValidityEntity>(pr => pr.ValidTo), DateTime.Today),
                                    Projections.Constant(1),
                                    Projections.Constant(0))).Desc
                                .ThenBy(Projections.SqlFunction(
                                        "abs",
                                        NHibernateUtil.Double,
                                        Projections.SqlFunction("extract_epoch",
                                                                NHibernateUtil.Double,
                                                                Projections.SqlFunction("age",
                                                                                        NHibernateUtil.TimeSpan,
                                                                                        Projections.Property<InstitutionValidityEntity>(pr => pr.ValidTo),
                                                                                        Projections.Constant(DateTime.Today))))).Asc
                                .Select(Projections.Property(() => _subQueryAlias.Id))
                                .Take(1);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<EnergyContractEntity, EnergyContractEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(EnergyContractListItemDto))
        {
            EnergyContractListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(x => x.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                        .Select(x => x.ContractIssueDate).WithAlias(() => alias.ContractIssueDate)
                        .Select(x => x.ContractExpiryDate).WithAlias(() => alias.ContractExpiryDate)
                        .Select(x => x.EnergyContractType).WithAlias(() => alias.EnergyContractType)
                        .Select(x => _supplierAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Supplier)
                        .Select(x => _validityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Institution)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<EnergyContractEntity, EnergyContractEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EnergyContractPagedEntityQuery energyContractPagedQuery)
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(energyContractPagedQuery.Name))
            {
                queryOver
                   .And(Restrictions
                                .On<EnergyContractEntity>(x => x.Name)
                                .IsInsensitiveLike(energyContractPagedQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere)
                       );
            }
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(energyContractPagedQuery.Supplier))
            {
                queryOver
                   .And(Restrictions
                                .On<EnergyContractEntity>(x => _supplierAlias.Name)
                                .IsInsensitiveLike(energyContractPagedQuery.Supplier, MatchMode.Anywhere)
                       );
            }

            if (energyContractPagedQuery.From is not null)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.ContractIssueDate == energyContractPagedQuery.From.Value);
            }

            if (energyContractPagedQuery.To is not null)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.ContractExpiryDate == energyContractPagedQuery.To.Value);
            }

            if (energyContractPagedQuery.Status == EnergyContractStatusType.Active)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false &&
                                     x.ContractIssueDate <= DateTime.UtcNow &&
                                     (x.ContractExpiryDate == null || x.ContractExpiryDate > DateTime.UtcNow));
            }

            if (energyContractPagedQuery.Status == EnergyContractStatusType.Pending)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false &&
                                     x.ContractIssueDate > DateTime.UtcNow);
            }

            if (energyContractPagedQuery.Status == EnergyContractStatusType.Expired)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false &&
                                     x.ContractIssueDate <= DateTime.UtcNow &&
                                     x.ContractExpiryDate < DateTime.UtcNow);
            }

            if (energyContractPagedQuery.Status == EnergyContractStatusType.Terminated)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == true);
            }

            if (energyContractPagedQuery.Institution != null)
            {
                queryOver.Where(() => _institutionAlias.Id == int.Parse(energyContractPagedQuery.Institution));
            }

            if (energyContractPagedQuery.EnergyContractType is not null)
            {
                queryOver.And(Restrictions.On<EnergyContractEntity>(x => x.EnergyContractType).IsIn(energyContractPagedQuery.EnergyContractType));
            }
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<EnergyContractEntity, EnergyContractEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EnergyContractPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            var subQuery = MakeValiditySubquery();

            queryOver = queryOver
                .JoinAlias(x => x.Institution, () => _institutionAlias);

            queryOver = queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _institutionAlias.InstitutionValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuery));

            queryOver = queryOver
                .JoinAlias(x => x.Supplier, () => _supplierAlias);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Olyan entitások kereséséhez, amelyek a paraméterben átadott érvényesség kezdete, és vége idősávban érvényesek valamikor.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="interval">The interval.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public static Expression<Func<EnergyContractEntity, bool>> ValidityIntersectionExpression(IDateTimeInterval interval)
    {
        DateTime from = interval.From == null ? DateTime.MinValue : interval.From.Value;
        DateTime to = interval.To == null ? DateTime.MaxValue : interval.To.Value;

        return x =>
            ((x.ContractIssueDate <= from && x.ContractExpiryDate >= from) ||
            (x.ContractIssueDate <= to && x.ContractExpiryDate >= to) ||
            (x.ContractIssueDate >= from && x.ContractExpiryDate <= to));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the contract entity by institution query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entitiesQuery">The entities query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoContractEntityByInstitutionQuery(EnergyContractEntityByInstitutionQuery entitiesQuery)
    {
        InstitutionEntity institutionAlias = null!;


        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EnergyContractEntity>();


        queryOver.Where(x => institutionAlias.Identifier == entitiesQuery.InstitutionIdentifier);

        //if (entitiesQuery.ContractType.HasValue)
        queryOver.Where(x => x.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement);// entitiesQuery.ContractType);

        var entities = queryOver.List();
        var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto> { Items = Mapper.Map<IList<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto>>(entities).ToArray() };
        return result;
    }
}

public class InvoiceQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<InvoiceEntity, InvoiceEntityDto>
{

    /// Currency alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictItemEntity _currencyAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Energy contract alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly EnergyContractEntity _energyContractAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Site alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteEntity _institutionAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InvoiceQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public InvoiceQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, ILifetimeScope scope) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {

    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is InvoiceEntityQuery invoiceEntityQuery)
        {
            return DoInvoiceSingleEntityQuery(invoiceEntityQuery);
        }
        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the invoice single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoInvoiceSingleEntityQuery(InvoiceEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.TenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(query.TenantCode);
                var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
                DbContext = tenantDbContext;
            }

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InvoiceEntity>();
        if (query.IsDeleted.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == query.IsDeleted.Value);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.InvoiceIdentifier))
            queryOver.Where(x => x.InvoiceIdentifier == query.InvoiceIdentifier);
        
        if (query.Id is not null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous InvoiceEntity");

        DbContext.Commit();

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is InvoiceEntityQuery invoicesQuery)
            return DoInvoiceEntitiesQuery(invoicesQuery);

        if (query is IEntityQuery<InvoiceListItemDto> itemQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(itemQuery);

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the invoice entities query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoInvoiceEntitiesQuery(InvoiceEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InvoiceEntity>();

        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.EnergyContracts, () => _energyContractAlias);
        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => _energyContractAlias.Institution, () => _institutionAlias);

        if (query.InstitutionIdentifier != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => _institutionAlias.Identifier ==  query.InstitutionIdentifier);

        
        if (query.From.HasValue && query.To.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.AccountingPeriodStart <= query.To && x.AccountingPeriodEnd >= query.From);
        
        var entities = queryOver.List();
        if (entities != null)
        {
            EntityListItemQueryResult<InvoiceEntityDto> result = new();
            List<InvoiceEntityDto> tempList = new();
            foreach (InvoiceEntity e in entities)
            {
                tempList.Add(CreateDto(e));
            }
            result.Items = tempList.ToArray();
            return result;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities<TResult>(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        // TODO ez itt felesleges lenne?
        if (query is IEntityQuery<InvoiceListItemDto> itemQuery)
            return base.DoQueryEntities<TResult>(query) as IEntityQueryItemsResult<InvoiceListItemDto>;

        return base.DoQueryEntities<TResult>(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<InvoiceEntity, InvoiceEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(InvoiceListItemDto))
        {
            InvoiceListItemDto alias = null!;
            
            queryOver
                .SelectList(list => list
                    .Select(Projections.Group<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(Projections.Group<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceIdentifier)).WithAlias(() => alias.InvoiceIdentifier)
                    .Select(Projections.Group<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.TotalAmount)).WithAlias(() => alias.TotalAmount)
                    .Select(Projections.Group<InvoiceEntity>(x => _currencyAlias.Value)).WithAlias(() => alias.Currency)
                    .Select(Projections.Group<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.AccountingPeriodStart)).WithAlias(() => alias.InvoicePeriodStart)
                    .Select(Projections.Group<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.AccountingPeriodEnd)).WithAlias(() => alias.InvoicePeriodEnd)
                    .Select(Projections.SqlFunction("string_agg", NHibernateUtil.String,
                        Projections.Property<InvoiceEntity>(x => _energyContractAlias.Name),
                        Projections.Constant(", ")).WithAlias(() => alias.EnergyContract))

                // .Select(Projections.Conditional(
                //     Restrictions.LtProperty(
                //             Projections.Property<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceDistributorFee.AccountingPeriodStart), 
                //             Projections.Property<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceEnergyFee.AccountingPeriodStart)
                //         ),
                //     Projections.Property<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceDistributorFee.AccountingPeriodStart),
                //     Projections.Property<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceEnergyFee.AccountingPeriodStart))).WithAlias(() => alias.InvoicePeriodStart)
                //
                // .Select(Projections.Conditional(
                //     Restrictions.GtProperty(
                //         Projections.Property<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceDistributorFee.AccountingPeriodEnd),
                //         Projections.Property<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceEnergyFee.AccountingPeriodEnd)
                //     ),
                //     Projections.Property<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceDistributorFee.AccountingPeriodEnd),
                //     Projections.Property<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceEnergyFee.AccountingPeriodEnd))).WithAlias(() => alias.InvoicePeriodEnd)
            );
        }

        return null;

    {
        if (query is InvoicePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            queryOver = queryOver
                .JoinAlias(x => x.Currency, () => _currencyAlias)
                .JoinAlias(x => x.EnergyContracts, () => _energyContractAlias);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<InvoiceEntity, InvoiceEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
        
        if (query is InvoicePagedEntityQuery invoicePagedQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(invoicePagedQuery.InvoiceIdentifier))
            {
                queryOver
                    .And(Restrictions
                        .On<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceIdentifier)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(invoicePagedQuery.InvoiceIdentifier, MatchMode.Anywhere));
            }
            
            if (invoicePagedQuery.From.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.AccountingPeriodStart >= invoicePagedQuery.From);

            if (invoicePagedQuery.To.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.AccountingPeriodEnd < invoicePagedQuery.To);
        }

        if (query is IPagedEntityQuery pagedQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pagedQuery.SearchText))
                queryOver
                   .And(Restrictions
                                .On<InvoiceEntity>(x => x.InvoiceIdentifier)
                                .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere));
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Name))
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Name == query.Name);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous SupplierQuery");
        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    //
    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)

    }

    /// </summary>

    /// <returns>

    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities<TResult>(IEntityQuery query)

        // TODO ez itt felesleges lenne?
        if (query is IEntityQuery<SupplierListItemDto> itemQuery)

    /// <summary>

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<SupplierEntity, SupplierEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(SupplierListItemDto))
        {
            SupplierListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(x => x.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                    .Select(x => x.TaxIdentificationNumber).WithAlias(() => alias.TaxIdentificationNumber)
                    .Select(x => _headquartersAlias.FullAddress).WithAlias(() => alias.Headquarters)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>

    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<SupplierEntity, SupplierEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SupplierPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            queryOver = queryOver
                .JoinAlias(x => x.Headquarters, () => _headquartersAlias);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SupplierEntity, SupplierEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);

        if (query is SupplierQuery supplierQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(supplierQuery.Name))
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Name == supplierQuery.Name);
        }

        if (query is SupplierPagedEntityQuery supplierPagedQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(supplierPagedQuery.Name))
                queryOver
                    .And(Restrictions
                        .On<SupplierEntity>(x => x.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(supplierPagedQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));
            
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(supplierPagedQuery.TaxIdentificationNumber))
                queryOver
                    .And(Restrictions
                        .On<SupplierEntity>(x => x.TaxIdentificationNumber)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(supplierPagedQuery.TaxIdentificationNumber, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(supplierPagedQuery.Headquarters))
            {
                queryOver
                    .And(Restrictions
                        .On<SupplierEntity>(x => _headquartersAlias.FullAddress)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(supplierPagedQuery.Headquarters, MatchMode.Anywhere));
            }
        }

        if (query is IPagedEntityQuery pagedQuery)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pagedQuery.SearchText))
                queryOver
                    .And(Restrictions.Or(Restrictions.Or(
                                Restrictions
                                    .On<SupplierEntity>(x => x.Name)
                                    .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere),
                                Restrictions
                                    .On<SupplierEntity>(x => x.TaxIdentificationNumber)
                                    .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere)
                            ), Restrictions
                                .On<SupplierEntity>(x => x.Headquarters)
                                .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedQuery.SearchText, MatchMode.Anywhere)
                        )
                    );
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.EnergyPerformanceImport;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Import;
using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.EnergyPerformance;
public class EnergeticDataImportJobResultQueryHandler : ImportJobResultQueryHandlerBase<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>
{
    public EnergeticDataImportJobResultQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            ImportJobResultPagedEntityQuery<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult> itemQuery => DoPagedQueryEntities(itemQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoPagedQueryEntities(ImportJobResultPagedEntityQuery<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult> query)
    {
        IEntityQueryItemsResult<ImportJobResultListItemDto<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>>? result = null;

        //FROM
        var queryOver = GetQueryOver();

        //JOIN
        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        //WHERE
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<ImportJobResultListItemDto<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>> { RecordsTotal = SetUpRowCount(queryOver, query) };

        //PAGING
        if (!(query is IAllEntitiesQuery))
            ProductivityExtensions.When<IPagedEntityQuery>(query, q => SetQueryPaging(queryOver, q));

        //ORDER BY
        ProductivityExtensions.When<IPagedEntityQuery>(query, q => SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, q));


        var entityDtos = queryOver.List<ImportJobResultEntity>()
                                  .Select(CreateDto)
                                  .Where(x =>x.Data.SiteId == query.SiteId)
                                  .ToArray();
        result.Items = entityDtos.Select(Mapper.Map<ImportJobResultListItemDto<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>>).ToArray();
        return result;
    }
}

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoEnergyConsumptionSingleEntityQuery(EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity>();

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityQuery");

        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }

    private IQueryResult DoEnergyConsumptionDeviceDatesQuery(EnergyConsumptionDeviceDatesQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity>();

        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        SetupQuerySelect<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>(queryOver, query);

        var result = queryOver.List<DateOnly>();

        return new EnergyConsumptionDeviceDatesQueryResult() { InspectionDates = result };
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EnergyConsumptionDeviceDatesQuery dateQuery)
        {
            if (dateQuery.OrgunitBaseId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == dateQuery.OrgunitBaseId);
        }

        if (query is EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            if (entityQuery.InspectionDate.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.InspectionDate == entityQuery.InspectionDate);

            if (entityQuery.OrgunitBaseId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == entityQuery.OrgunitBaseId);
        }
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni, lsd OrgUnitQueryHandler
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// </summary>

    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity, EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is EnergyConsumptionDeviceDatesQuery) 
        {
            queryOver.Select(Projections.Distinct(Projections.Property<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntity>(p => p.InspectionDate)));
        }
        return null;
    }

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Common;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Common;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Favourites;

/// <summary>
/// FavouriteQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Common.FavouriteEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Common.FavouriteEntityDto&gt;" />
public class FavouriteQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<FavouriteEntity, FavouriteEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// Sec user entity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecUserEntity _secUserEntityAlias = null;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="FavouriteQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public FavouriteQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Not implemented EntityType!</exception>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is FavouriteEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            var entityQueryItemsResult = DoQueryEntities(entityQuery);
            var identifiers = entityQueryItemsResult.Items.Select(x => x.Identifier).ToArray();

            switch (entityQuery.Type)
            {
                case EntityType.Device:

                    var devices = 
                        DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>()
                        .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Identifier).IsIn(identifiers)
                        .List();

                    foreach (var listItemDto in entityQueryItemsResult.Items)
                    {
                        var device = devices.First(x => x.Identifier == listItemDto.Identifier);

                        listItemDto.Status = device.Status;
                        listItemDto.Name = device.DeviceName;
                        listItemDto.Icon = "devices";
                        listItemDto.Info = device.SerialNumber;
                        listItemDto.Type = EntityType.Device;
                    }

                    return entityQueryItemsResult;

                case EntityType.Site:

                    var sites =
                        DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>()
                        .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Identifier).IsIn(identifiers)
                        .List();

                    foreach (var listItemDto in entityQueryItemsResult.Items)
                    {
                        var site = sites.First(x => x.Identifier == listItemDto.Identifier);

                        //TODO: többszintű hierarchia miatti változások
                        //listItemDto.Status = GetSiteDeviceStatus(site.SiteLocations ?? Array.Empty<SiteLocationEntity>());
                        //listItemDto.Name = site.Name;
                        listItemDto.Icon = "home";
                        //listItemDto.Info = site.Address?.FullAddress;
                        listItemDto.Type = EntityType.Site;
                    }

                    return entityQueryItemsResult;

                default: throw new InvalidOperationException("Not implemented EntityType!");
            }
        }

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the site device status.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="siteLocations">The site locations.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static DeviceStatus GetSiteDeviceStatus(IList<SiteLocationEntity>? siteLocations)
    {
        var devices = 
            siteLocations?.Where(x => x.IoTDevices != null).SelectMany(x => x.IoTDevices).ToArray() ?? Array.Empty<DeviceEntity>();
        if (devices.Any(x => x.Status == DeviceStatus.Error))
            return DeviceStatus.Error;
        if (devices.Any(x => x.Status == DeviceStatus.Warning))
            return DeviceStatus.Warning;
        return DeviceStatus.Online;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<FavouriteEntity, FavouriteEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is FavouriteEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.User, () => _secUserEntityAlias);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<FavouriteEntity, FavouriteEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        if (query is FavouriteEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
            queryOver.Where(o => _secUserEntityAlias.GlobalId == _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId &&
                            o.Type == entityQuery.Type);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Not implemented EntityType!</exception>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<FavouriteEntity, FavouriteEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is FavouriteEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            switch (entityQuery.Type)
            {
                case EntityType.Device:
                case EntityType.Site:
                    FavouriteEntityListItemDto? alias = null;
                    queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                        list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                            .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                    );
                    break;
                default: throw new InvalidOperationException("Not implemented EntityType!");

            }
        }
        else
            return base.SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(queryOver, query);

        return null;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Import;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Import;
using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Import;
public abstract class ImportJobResultQueryHandlerBase<T> :  QueryHandlerBase<ImportJobResultEntity, ImportJobResultEntityDto<T>> where T : IValidationData
{
    protected readonly ImportJobResultEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    public ImportJobResultQueryHandlerBase(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    protected override IQueryOver<ImportJobResultEntity, ImportJobResultEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ImportJobResultEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            ImportJobResultEntityQuery<T> entityQuery => DoImportJobResultSingleEntityQuery(entityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    protected IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoImportJobResultSingleEntityQuery(ImportJobResultEntityQuery<T> siteQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ImportJobResultEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, siteQuery);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous OrgunitImportJobResultEntity");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<ImportJobResultEntity, ImportJobResultEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        switch (query)
        {
            case ImportJobResultEntityQuery<T> entityQuery:
                if (entityQuery.JobId.HasValue)
                    queryOver.Where(() => _rootAlias.JobId == entityQuery.JobId);
                break;

            case ImportJobResultPagedEntityQuery<T> pagedEntityQuery:
                queryOver.Where(() => _rootAlias.SecUser.Id == pagedEntityQuery.UserId);

                queryOver.Where(() => _rootAlias.JobType == pagedEntityQuery.JobType);

                if (pagedEntityQuery.Statuses != null && pagedEntityQuery.Statuses.Length > 0)
                    queryOver.Where(() => pagedEntityQuery.Statuses.Any(x => x == _rootAlias.Status));
                break;
        }
    }
}

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        var result = query switch
        {
            IEntityQuery<BuildingPartListItemDto> itemQuery => DoQueryEntities(itemQuery),
            BuildingPartMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery => DoMeasurementPointQuery(measurementPointsQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };

        #region jogosultság szerint szűrés
        RequiredSecOperationAttribute? secAttr = query.GetType().GetCustomAttribute<RequiredSecOperationAttribute>();
        if (secAttr is not null && result is not null)
        {
            var permissions = GetOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId, secAttr).GetAwaiter().GetResult() ?? [];
            var tenantPermissions = permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == null).ToList();

            if (tenantPermissions.Any(x => x.SecOpCodes.Contains(secAttr.SecOperationCode)))
            {
                return result; //ha már tenant szinten is van joga, akkor mindent visszaadhatunk
            }

            if (result is EntityQueryItemsResult<BuildingPartListItemDto> listItemResult)
            {
#if DEBUG
                System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch sw = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
#endif
                //var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissions(permissions, listItemResult);
                var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(permissions, listItemResult);
#if DEBUG
                sw.Stop();
                var el = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                Console.WriteLine($"FilterResultsByPermissions took {el} ms.");
#endif
                return filteredResult;
            }
            //TODO: lehetnek-e egyéb típusú resultok, ahol szűrne kell az eredményeket?
        }
        #endregion

        return result;
    }

    //Windsurf AI suggested optimization
    private static IEntityQueryItemsResult FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto> permissions, EntityQueryItemsResult<BuildingPartListItemDto> listItemResult)
    {
        #region prepropcess: Create mappings from items to buildingparts
        var buildingIdToBuildingParts = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.BuildingId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var siteIdToBuildingParts = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.SiteId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var institutionIdToBuildingParts = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.InstitutionId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());
       
        #endregion

        var finalBuildingPartIds = new HashSet<int>();

        #region Process permissions to collect all relevant IDs

        //by buildings...
        var buildingIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Building).Select(p => p.Building!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedBuildingPartIdssByBuildings = buildingIdToBuildingParts
            .Where(b2bp => buildingIdsWithPermission.Contains(b2bp.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalBuildingPartIds.UnionWith(permittedBuildingPartIdssByBuildings); //add to result

        //by sites...
        var siteIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Site).Select(p => p.Site!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedBuildingPartIdssBySites = siteIdToBuildingParts
            .Where(s2bp => siteIdsWithPermission.Contains(s2bp.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalBuildingPartIds.UnionWith(permittedBuildingPartIdssBySites); //add to result

        //by institutions...
        var institutionIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Institution).Select(p => p.Institution!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedBuildingPartIdssByInstituions = institutionIdToBuildingParts
            .Where(i2bp => institutionIdsWithPermission.Contains(i2bp.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalBuildingPartIds.UnionWith(permittedBuildingPartIdssByInstituions); //add to result

        #endregion

        // Apply filter directly with the pre-computed set
        listItemResult.Items = [.. listItemResult.Items.Where(x => finalBuildingPartIds.Contains(x.Id))];
        return listItemResult;
    }


    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    protected override IQueryOver<BuildingPartEntity, BuildingPartEntity> GetQueryOver()
