        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingPartEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (GetEntityIdsForSecOperation(query) is IEnumerable<int> ids)
        {
            CheckForMultipleOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, ids).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }
        else
        {
            var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
            CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }


        return query switch
        {
            BuildingPartParentsNamesQuery namesQuery => DoParentsNameQuery(namesQuery),
            BuildingPartPodsQuery buildingPartPodsQuery => DoPodsQuery(buildingPartPodsQuery),
            BuildingPartPagedEntityQuery buildingPartPagedEntityQuery => DoQueryEntities(buildingPartPagedEntityQuery),
            BuildingPartMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery => DoMeasurementPointQuery(measurementPointsQuery),
            OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<BuildingPartEntityDto> coordsQuery => DoCoordinatesInfoQuery(coordsQuery),

            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            //IEntityQuery<BuildingPartListItemDto> itemQuery => itemQuery.?????
            BuildingPartEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery => entityRefQuery.ParentId,
            BuildingPartParentsNamesQuery nameQuery => nameQuery.Id,
            BuildingPartEntityQuery entityQuery => entityQuery.Id,
            BuildingPartPodsQuery podsQuery => podsQuery.BuildingPartId,
            BuildingPartPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery => pagedEntityQuery.BuildingId,
            BuildingPartMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery => measurementPointsQuery.BuildingPartId,
            EntityByIdQuery<BuildingPartEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }
    protected override IEnumerable<int>? GetEntityIdsForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<BuildingPartEntityDto> coordsQuery => coordsQuery.OrgUnitIds,
            _ => null
        };
    }
    private IQueryResult DoCoordinatesInfoQuery(OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<BuildingPartEntityDto> coordsQuery)
    {
        MapCoordinatesInfoModel mapAlias = null!;
        var subQueryBuildingPartValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var query = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingPartEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => _validityAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Id)
            .IsIn(coordsQuery.OrgUnitIds)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity))
            .And(x => !_validityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Name)
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Lon).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Longitude)
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Lat).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Latitude))
            .TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>())
            .List<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>();

        return new MapCoordinatesInfoQueryResult
        {
            CoordinateInfos = query.ToList()
        };
    }
    private IQueryResult DoParentsNameQuery(BuildingPartParentsNamesQuery parentsNamesQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == parentsNamesQuery.Id);

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, parentsNamesQuery);

        BuildingPartParentsNamesQueryResult alias = null!;
        queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _siteAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteId)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName)
                .Select(x => _institutionAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionId)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionName)
                .Select(x => _buildingAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingId)
                .Select(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingName)
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartId)
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartName));

        var result = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<BuildingPartParentsNamesQueryResult>())
                              .SingleOrDefault<BuildingPartParentsNamesQueryResult>();
        return result;
    }

    private IQueryResult DoPodsQuery(BuildingPartPodsQuery podsQuery)
    {
        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingPartEntity>(() => buildingPartEntityAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == podsQuery.BuildingPartId);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .JoinAlias(x => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

        queryOver.Select(Projections.Distinct(
            Projections.SqlFunction("unnest", NHibernateUtil.String,
                Projections.SqlFunction("array_remove", NHibernateUtil.String,
                    Projections.SqlFunction("string_to_array", NHibernateUtil.String,
                        Projections.SqlFunction("CONCAT_WS", NHibernateUtil.String,
                            Projections.Constant(","),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<BuildingPartEntity>(x => buildingPartEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            ),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<FloorEntity>(x => floorEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            ),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<RoomEntity>(x => roomEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            )
                        ),
                        Projections.Constant(",")
                    ),
                    Projections.Constant("")
                )
            )
        ));

        return new PodsQueryResult()
        {
            PodList = queryOver.List<string>().ToList(),
        };
    }

    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoMeasurementPointQuery(BuildingPartMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery)
    {
        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartValidityEntity buildingPartValidityAlias = null!;
        FloorValidityEntity floorValidityAlias = null!;
        RoomValidityEntity roomValidityAlias = null!;
        
        // Create the base query with all joins
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingPartEntity>(() => buildingPartEntityAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == measurementPointsQuery.BuildingPartId);

        // Get buildingPart name for parent reference
        var buildingPartName = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingPartValidities, () => buildingPartValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => !buildingPartValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .Select(
                Projections.Property<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => buildingPartValidityAlias.Name))
            .SingleOrDefault<string>();

        var subQueryFloorValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<FloorValidityEntity>(x => floorEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

        // Query for floors
        var floorResults = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.FloorValidities, () => floorValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => floorValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryFloorValidity))
            .Where(() => floorEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !floorValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.Id)
                .Select(() => floorValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.Identifier)
            )
            .List<object[]>();
            
        var floorDtos = floorResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Floor,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { buildingPartName }
        }).ToList();

        // Query for rooms
        
        var subQueryRoomValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<RoomValidityEntity>(x => roomEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

        var roomResults = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.FloorValidities, () => floorValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => floorValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryFloorValidity))
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => roomEntityAlias.RoomValidities, () => roomValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => roomValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryRoomValidity))
            .Where(() => roomEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !roomValidityAlias.IsDeleted && !floorValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Id)
                .Select(() => roomValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Identifier)
                .Select(() => floorValidityAlias.Name)
            )
            .List<object[]>();
            
        var roomDtos = roomResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Room,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { buildingPartName, (string)row[4] }
        }).ToList();
    
        // Combine all measurement point DTOs
        var allMeasurementPoints = floorDtos
            .Concat(roomDtos)
            .ToList();

        // Apply sorting and paging
        if (measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn))
        {
            // Apply sorting based on property name using reflection
            var sortProperty = typeof(MeasurementPointListItemDto).GetProperty(
                measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn, 
                BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
                
            if (sortProperty != null)
            {
                if (measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending)
                {
                    allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                        .OrderBy(x => sortProperty.GetValue(x))
                        .ToList();
                }
                else
                {
                    allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                        .OrderByDescending(x => sortProperty.GetValue(x))
                        .ToList();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Default to Name if property not found
                allMeasurementPoints = measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending
                    ? allMeasurementPoints.OrderBy(x => x.Name).ToList()
                    : allMeasurementPoints.OrderByDescending(x => x.Name).ToList();
            }
        }

        // Apply paging if needed
        if (measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo != null)
        {
            var pageSize = measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10;
            var firstItem = measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.StartPage * pageSize;
            
            // Get total count before paging
            int totalCount = allMeasurementPoints.Count;
            
            // Apply paging
            allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                .Skip(firstItem)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToList();
            
            // Create result with paging info
            var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>
            {
                Items = allMeasurementPoints.ToArray(),
                RecordsTotal = totalCount
            };
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Create result without paging
        var resultNoPaging = new EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>
        {
            Items = allMeasurementPoints.ToArray()
        };
        
        return resultNoPaging;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<BuildingPartEntity, BuildingPartEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is BuildingPartEntityQuery)
        {
            var subQueryBuildingPartValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryBuildingValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity));

            queryOver.JoinEntityAlias(() => _buildingValidityAlias, () => _rootAlias.Building.Id == _buildingValidityAlias.Building.Id, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _buildingValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Building, () => _buildingAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
            
            //TODO: works?
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingAlias.Site, () => _siteAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
        }

        if (query is BuildingPartPagedEntityQuery || query is BuildingPartParentsNamesQuery)
        {
            var subQueryBuildingPartValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryBuildingValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _buildingAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQuerySiteValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _siteAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryInstitutionValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Building, () => _buildingAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingAlias.BuildingValidities, () => _buildingValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _buildingValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingAlias.Site, () => _siteAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _siteAlias.SiteValidities, () => _siteValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _siteValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuerySiteValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _siteAlias.Institution, () => _institutionAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _institutionAlias.InstitutionValidities, () => _institutionValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _institutionValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryInstitutionValidity));
        }

    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<BuildingPartEntity, BuildingPartEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(BuildingPartListItemDto))
        {
            BuildingPartListItemDto alias = default!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                .Select(x => x.IsDeleted).WithAlias(() => alias.IsDeleted)
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                .Select(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingName)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionName)
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.Building.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingId)
                .Select(x => _buildingAlias.Site.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteId)
                .Select(x => _siteAlias.Institution.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionId) //TODO: siteAlias már ok?
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            BuildingPartEntityQuery buildingPartQuery => DoBuildingPartSingleEntityQuery(buildingPartQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the buildingPart single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoBuildingPartSingleEntityQuery(BuildingPartEntityQuery query)
    {
        //AddressEntity addressAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartValidityEntity subValidityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias);

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Identifier) && Guid.TryParse(query.Identifier, out Guid guidIdentifier))
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == guidIdentifier);

        if (query.IsDeleted.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == query.IsDeleted);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).In(
                   QueryOver.Of(() => subValidityAlias)
                            .Where(() => subValidityAlias.BuildingPart.Id == _rootAlias.Id && !subValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
                            .Select(v => v.Id))).TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity);


        //TODO: ki kellett kommentelni a validity átalakítás közben
        //if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Name))
        //    queryOver.Where(x => x.Name == query.Name);
        //if (query.AddressId != null && query.AddressId > 0)
        //    queryOver = queryOver
        //    .JoinAlias(x => x.Address, () => addressAlias)
        //    .Where(x => addressAlias.Id == query.AddressId);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous BuildingPartQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<BuildingPartEntity, BuildingPartEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        switch (query)
        {
            case BuildingPartEntityQuery buildingPartQuery:
                if (buildingPartQuery.Id != null)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == buildingPartQuery.Id);

                if (buildingPartQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Building.Id == buildingPartQuery.ParentId);

                if (buildingPartQuery.ParentIdentifier.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(() => _buildingAlias.Identifier == buildingPartQuery.ParentIdentifier);

                if (buildingPartQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == buildingPartQuery.IsDeleted);
                break;

            case BuildingPartEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery:
                if (entityRefQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityRefQuery.IsDeleted);

                if (entityRefQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Building.Id == entityRefQuery.ParentId);
                break;

            case BuildingPartPagedEntityQuery buildingPartPagedEntityQuery:
                if (buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.HasValue) 
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == !buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.Value);
                if (buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)  //must support returning deleted, not-deleted, and all
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.IsDeleted.Value);
                if (buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.BuildingId.HasValue)
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.Building.Id == buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.BuildingId);
                if (buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.SiteId.HasValue)
                    queryOver.Where(x => _buildingAlias.Site.Id == buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.SiteId);
                if (buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId.HasValue)
                    queryOver.Where(x => _siteAlias.Institution.Id == buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId);
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.Name))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => _validityAlias.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.BuildingName))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.BuildingName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.SiteName))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.SiteName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(buildingPartPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                break;

            default:
                break;
        }



    }

}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// BuildingPartValidityQueryHandler
/// </summary>
public class BuildingPartValidityQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<BuildingPartValidityEntity, BuildingPartValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly BuildingPartValidityEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// BuildingPart alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly BuildingPartEntity _buildingPartAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BuildingPartValidityQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public BuildingPartValidityQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, IQueryService queryService, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            BuildingPartValidityEntityQuery buildingpartEntityQuery => buildingpartEntityQuery.BuildingPartId, //az orgunit kell, nem a validity-je!
            ValidityEntityQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntityDto> validityEntityQuery => validityEntityQuery.ParentId,
            EntityByIdQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<BuildingPartValidityEntity, BuildingPartValidityEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingPart, () => _buildingPartAlias);
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            BuildingPartValidityEntityQuery buildingPartEntityQuery => DoBuildingPartValidityEntityQuery(buildingPartEntityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoBuildingPartValidityEntityQuery(BuildingPartValidityEntityQuery buildingPartEntityQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = GetQueryOver();

        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);
        queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == buildingPartEntityQuery.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous BuildingPartValidityEntityQuery");
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where conditions
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<BuildingPartValidityEntity, BuildingPartValidityEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ValidityEntityQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntityDto> validityQuery)
        {
            if (validityQuery?.ParentId > 0)
                queryOver.Where(() => _buildingPartAlias.Id == validityQuery.ParentId);
            if (validityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == validityQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }
}

    /// <summary>

    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        // skip permissions check for administration query
        if (query is TenantBuildingEntityRefQuery refQuery)
            return DoTenantBuildingAdministrationRefQuery(refQuery);

        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        var result = query switch
        {
            BuildingPagedEntityQuery itemQuery => DoQueryEntities(itemQuery),
            BuildingMeasurementPointsQuery buildingMeasurementPointsQuery => DoMeasurementPointQuery(buildingMeasurementPointsQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };

        #region jogosultság szerint szűrés
        RequiredSecOperationAttribute? secAttr = query.GetType().GetCustomAttribute<RequiredSecOperationAttribute>();
        if (secAttr is not null && result is not null)
        {
            var permissions = GetOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId, secAttr).GetAwaiter().GetResult() ?? [];
            var tenantPermissions = permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == null).ToList();

            if (tenantPermissions.Any(x => x.SecOpCodes.Contains(secAttr.SecOperationCode)))
            {
                return result; //ha már tenant szinten is van joga, akkor mindent visszaadhatunk
            }

            if (result is EntityQueryItemsResult<BuildingListItemDto> listItemResult)
            {
#if DEBUG
                System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch sw = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
#endif
                //var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissions(permissions, listItemResult);
                var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(permissions, listItemResult);
#if DEBUG
                sw.Stop();
                var el = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                Console.WriteLine($"FilterResultsByPermissions took {el} ms.");
#endif
                return filteredResult;
            }
            //TODO: lehetnek-e egyéb típusú resultok, ahol szűrne kell az eredményeket?
        }
        #endregion

        return result;
    }

    //TODO: nem tudom, hogy ezt szebben, gyorabban is meg lehet-e oldani...
    private static IEntityQueryItemsResult FilterResultsByPermissions(List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto> permissions, EntityQueryItemsResult<BuildingListItemDto> listItemResult)
    {
        //közvetlenül megadott buildingek:
        var directBuildingIds = new HashSet<int>(permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Building).Select(x => x.Building!.Id));

        //közvetlenül megadott site-ok:
        var directSiteIds = new HashSet<int>(permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Site).Select(x => x.Site!.Id));
        //az eredményből jövő azon buildingek, amiknek az site-jára van joga:
        var sitesBuildingIds = new HashSet<int>(listItemResult.Items.Where(x => directSiteIds.Contains(x.SiteId)).Select(x => x.Id));

        //közvetlenül megadott institution-ök:
        var directInstitutionIds = new HashSet<int>(permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Institution).Select(x => x.Institution!.Id));
        //az eredményből jövő azon buildingek, amiknek az institution-jére van joga:
        var institutionsBuildingIds = new HashSet<int>(listItemResult.Items.Where(x => directInstitutionIds.Contains(x.InstitutionId)).Select(x => x.Id));

        //a közvetlen és az institution-ból örökölt site-ok egyesítése:
        var combinedIds = new HashSet<int>(directBuildingIds.Union(institutionsBuildingIds).Union(sitesBuildingIds));

        listItemResult.Items = [.. listItemResult.Items.Where(x => combinedIds.Contains(x.Id))];
        return listItemResult;
    }

    //Windsurf AI suggested optimization
    private static IEntityQueryItemsResult FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto> permissions, EntityQueryItemsResult<BuildingListItemDto> listItemResult)
    {
        #region prepropcess: Create mappings from items to buildings
        var siteIdToBuildings = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.SiteId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var institutionIdToBuildings = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.InstitutionId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        #endregion

        var finalBuildingIds = new HashSet<int>();

        #region Process permissions to collect all relevant IDs
        //by buildings directly...
        var buildingIdsWithPermission = permissions
            .Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Building)
            .Select(p => p.Building!.Id)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalBuildingIds.UnionWith(buildingIdsWithPermission); //add to result

        //by sites...
        var siteIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Site).Select(p => p.Site!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedBuildingPartIdssBySites = siteIdToBuildings
            .Where(s2b => siteIdsWithPermission.Contains(s2b.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalBuildingIds.UnionWith(permittedBuildingPartIdssBySites); //add to result

        //by institutions...
        var institutionIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Institution).Select(p => p.Institution!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedBuildingPartIdssByInstituions = institutionIdToBuildings
            .Where(i2b => institutionIdsWithPermission.Contains(i2b.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalBuildingIds.UnionWith(permittedBuildingPartIdssByInstituions); //add to result

        #endregion

        // Apply filter directly with the pre-computed set
        listItemResult.Items = [.. listItemResult.Items.Where(x => finalBuildingIds.Contains(x.Id))];
        return listItemResult;
    }

    private IQueryResult DoCoordinatesInfoQuery(OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<BuildingEntityDto> coordsQuery)
    {
        MapCoordinatesInfoModel mapAlias = null!;
        var subQueryBuildingValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var query = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingValidities, () => _validityAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Id)
            .IsIn(coordsQuery.OrgUnitIds)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity))
            .And(x => !_validityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Name)
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Lon).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Longitude)
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Lat).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Latitude))
            .TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>())
            .List<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>();

        return new MapCoordinatesInfoQueryResult
        {
            CoordinateInfos = query.ToList()
        };
    }
    private IQueryResult DoParentsNameQuery(BuildingParentsNamesQuery parentsNamesQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == parentsNamesQuery.Id);

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, parentsNamesQuery);

        BuildingParentsNamesQueryResult alias = null!;
        var a = queryOver.RowCount();
        queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _siteAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteId)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName)
                .Select(x => _institutionAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionId)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionName)
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingId)
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingName)
            );

        var result = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<BuildingParentsNamesQueryResult>())
                              .SingleOrDefault<BuildingParentsNamesQueryResult>();
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the tenant building administration query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantDbContext">The tenant database context.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>> DoTenantBuildingAdministrationRefQuery(TenantBuildingEntityRefQuery query)
    {
        using var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope();

        tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(query.TenantCode);
        var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        var queryOver = tenantDbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingEntity>();

        if (query.IsDeleted.HasValue)
            queryOver = query.IsDeleted.Value
                ? queryOver.Where(o => o.IsDeleted)
                : queryOver.Where(o => !o.IsDeleted);


        var items = queryOver.List().Select(x => new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto> { Id = x.Id, EntityDisplayName = x.Name }).ToArray();

        IEntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>>? result = new EntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>>();

        result.Items = items;

        return result;
    }

    private IQueryResult DoPodsQuery(BuildingPodsQuery podsQuery)
    {
        BuildingEntity buildingEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingEntity>(() => buildingEntityAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == podsQuery.BuildingId);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .JoinAlias(x => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .JoinAlias(x => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

        queryOver.Select(Projections.Distinct(
            Projections.SqlFunction("unnest", NHibernateUtil.String,
                Projections.SqlFunction("array_remove", NHibernateUtil.String,
                    Projections.SqlFunction("string_to_array", NHibernateUtil.String,
                        Projections.SqlFunction("CONCAT_WS", NHibernateUtil.String,
                            Projections.Constant(","),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<BuildingEntity>(x => buildingEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            ),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<BuildingPartEntity>(x => buildingPartEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            ),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<FloorEntity>(x => floorEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            ),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<RoomEntity>(x => roomEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            )
                        ),
                        Projections.Constant(",")
                    ),
                    Projections.Constant("")
                )
            )
        ));

        return new PodsQueryResult()
        {
            PodList = queryOver.List<string>().ToList(),
        };
    }

    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoMeasurementPointQuery(BuildingMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery)
    {
        BuildingEntity buildingEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingValidityEntity buildingValidityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartValidityEntity buildingPartValidityAlias = null!;
        FloorValidityEntity floorValidityAlias = null!;
        RoomValidityEntity roomValidityAlias = null!;
        
        // Create the base query with all joins
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingEntity>(() => buildingEntityAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == measurementPointsQuery.BuildingId);

        // Get building name for parent reference
        var buildingName = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingValidities, () => buildingValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => !buildingValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .Select(
                Projections.Property(() => buildingValidityAlias.Name)
            )
            .List<string>()
            .FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;

        // Let's use separate queries for each level to avoid null reference issues
        
        // Query for building parts
        var subQueryBuildingPartValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => buildingPartEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        
        var buildingPartResults = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => buildingPartValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity))
            .Where(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Id)
                .Select(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
                .Select(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Identifier)
            )
            .List<object[]>();
            
        var buildingPartDtos = buildingPartResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.BuildingPart,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { buildingName }
        }).ToList();
        
        // Query for floors
        var subQueryFloorValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<FloorValidityEntity>(x => floorEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        
        var floorQueryOver = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => buildingPartValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity))
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.FloorValidities, () => floorValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => floorValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryFloorValidity));
            
        var floorResults = floorQueryOver
            .Where(() => floorEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.Id)
                .Select(() => floorValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.Identifier)
                .Select(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Name)
            )
            .List<object[]>();
            
        var floorDtos = floorResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Floor,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { buildingName, (string)row[4] }
        }).ToList();
        
        // Query for rooms
        var subQueryRoomValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<RoomValidityEntity>(x => roomEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        
        var roomQueryOver = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => buildingPartValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity))
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.FloorValidities, () => floorValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => floorValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryFloorValidity))
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => roomEntityAlias.RoomValidities, () => roomValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => roomValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryRoomValidity));
            
        var roomResults = roomQueryOver
            .Where(() => roomEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Id)
                .Select(() => roomValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Identifier)
                .Select(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => floorValidityAlias.Name)
            )
            .List<object[]>();
            
        var roomDtos = roomResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Room,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { buildingName, (string)row[4], (string)row[5] }
        }).ToList();
    
        // Combine all measurement point DTOs
        var allMeasurementPoints = buildingPartDtos
            .Concat(floorDtos)
            .Concat(roomDtos)
            .ToList();

        // Apply sorting and paging
        if (measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn))
        {          
            // Apply sorting based on property name using reflection
            var sortProperty = typeof(MeasurementPointListItemDto).GetProperty(
                measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn, 
                BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
                
            if (sortProperty != null)
            {
                if (measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending)
                {
                    allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                        .OrderBy(x => sortProperty.GetValue(x))
                        .ToList();
                }
                else
                {
                    allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                        .OrderByDescending(x => sortProperty.GetValue(x))
                        .ToList();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Default to Name if property not found
                allMeasurementPoints = measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending
                    ? allMeasurementPoints.OrderBy(x => x.Name).ToList()
                    : allMeasurementPoints.OrderByDescending(x => x.Name).ToList();
            }
        }

        // Apply paging if needed
        if (measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo != null)
        {
            var pageSize = measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10;
            var firstItem = measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.StartPage * pageSize;
            
            // Get total count before paging
            int totalCount = allMeasurementPoints.Count;
            
            // Apply paging
            allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                .Skip(firstItem)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToList();
            
            // Create result with paging info
            var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>
            {
                Items = allMeasurementPoints.ToArray(),
                RecordsTotal = totalCount
            };
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Create result without paging
        var resultNoPaging = new EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>
        {
            Items = allMeasurementPoints.ToArray()
        };
        
        return resultNoPaging;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the building single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoBuildingSingleEntityQuery(BuildingEntityQuery query)
    {
        BuildingValidityEntity subValidityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias);

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Identifier) && Guid.TryParse(query.Identifier, out Guid guidIdentifier))
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == guidIdentifier);

        if (query.IsDeleted.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == query.IsDeleted);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).In(
                    QueryOver.Of(() => subValidityAlias)
                             .Where(() => subValidityAlias.Building.Id == _rootAlias.Id && !subValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
                             .Select(v => v.Id))).TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity);


        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous BuildingQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<BuildingEntity, BuildingEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        //SecUserEntity secUserEntityAlias = null;
        //AddressEntity addressAlias = null;


        switch (query)
        {
            case BuildingEntityQuery entityRefQuery:
                if (entityRefQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityRefQuery.IsDeleted);

                if (entityRefQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Site.Id == entityRefQuery.ParentId);

                if (entityRefQuery.ParentIdentifier.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(() => _siteAlias.Identifier == entityRefQuery.ParentIdentifier);
                break;

            case BuildingEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery:
                if (entityRefQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityRefQuery.IsDeleted);

                if (entityRefQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Site.Id == entityRefQuery.ParentId);
                break;

            case TenantBuildingEntityRefQuery administrationEntityRefQuery:
                if (administrationEntityRefQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == administrationEntityRefQuery.IsDeleted);
                if (administrationEntityRefQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Site.Id == administrationEntityRefQuery.ParentId);
                break;

            case BuildingPagedEntityQuery buildingPagedEntityQuery:
                if (buildingPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.HasValue)  //must support returning deleted, not-deleted, and all
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == !buildingPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.Value);
                if (buildingPagedEntityQuery.SiteId.HasValue)
                    queryOver.Where(x => _rootAlias.Site.Id == buildingPagedEntityQuery.SiteId);
                if (buildingPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId.HasValue)
                    queryOver.Where(x => _siteAlias.Institution.Id == buildingPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId);

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(buildingPagedEntityQuery.Name))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _validityAlias.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(buildingPagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(buildingPagedEntityQuery.Address))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _validityAlias.Address)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(buildingPagedEntityQuery.Address, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(buildingPagedEntityQuery.SiteName))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<SiteEntity>(x => _siteAlias.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(buildingPagedEntityQuery.SiteName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(buildingPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<InstitutionEntity>(x => _institutionAlias.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(buildingPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                break;

            default:
                break;
        }

    }

    protected override IQueryOver<BuildingEntity, BuildingEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<BuildingEntity, BuildingEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is BuildingEntityQuery)
        {
            var subQueryBuildingValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQuerySiteValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _siteAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Site, () => _siteAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinEntityAlias(() => _siteValidityAlias, () => _rootAlias.Site.Id == _siteValidityAlias.Site.Id, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _siteValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuerySiteValidity));
        }

        if (query is BuildingPagedEntityQuery || query is BuildingParentsNamesQuery)
        {
            var subQueryBuildingValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQuerySiteValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _siteAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryInstitutionValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Site, () => _siteAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _validityAlias.Address, () => _addressAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _siteAlias.SiteValidities, () => _siteValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                    .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _siteValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuerySiteValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _siteAlias.Institution, () => _institutionAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _institutionAlias.InstitutionValidities, () => _institutionValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                    .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _institutionValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryInstitutionValidity));
        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<BuildingEntity, BuildingEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(BuildingListItemDto))
        {
            var alias = new BuildingListItemDto();
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                .Select(x => x.IsDeleted).WithAlias(() => alias.IsDeleted)
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName)
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.Site.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteId)
                .Select(x => _siteAlias.Institution.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionId)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionName)
                .Select(x => _addressAlias.FullAddress).WithAlias(() => alias.Address)
            );
        }
        return null;
    }


}

using System.Collections;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System.TenantIndependent;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.BaseQueries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Building;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.OrgunitBase;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Site;
using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// SiteValidityQueryHandler
/// </summary>
public class BuildingValidityQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<BuildingValidityEntity, BuildingValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly BuildingValidityEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Building alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly BuildingEntity _buildingAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// The county alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictItemEntity _buildingProfileAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BuildingValidityQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService; 
    public BuildingValidityQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, IQueryService queryService, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            BuildingValidityEntityQuery buildingEntityQuery => buildingEntityQuery.BuildingId, //az orgunit kell, nem a validity-je!
            ValidityEntityQuery<BuildingValidityEntityDto> validityEntityQuery => validityEntityQuery.ParentId,
            EntityByIdQuery<BuildingValidityEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {    
        return query switch
        {
            MapRoomValiditiesForBuildingValidityQuery mapQuery => DoMapRoomValiditiesForBuildingValidityQuery(mapQuery),        
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<BuildingValidityEntity, BuildingValidityEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingValidityEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Building, () => _buildingAlias);
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            BuildingValidityEntityQuery buildingEntityQuery => DoSiteValidityEntityQuery(buildingEntityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }
    protected IQueryResult DoMapRoomValiditiesForBuildingValidityQuery(MapRoomValiditiesForBuildingValidityQuery query)
    {
        var buildingValidity = _queryService.GetById<BuildingValidityEntityDto>(query.ValidityId);
        var building = buildingValidity.Building;

        var validFrom = buildingValidity.ValidFrom;
        var validTo = buildingValidity.ValidTo;

        RoomEntity roomAlias = null;
        FloorEntity floorAlias = null;
        BuildingPartEntity partAlias = null;
        BuildingEntity buildingAlias = null;

        var roomIds = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => roomAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => roomAlias.Floor, () => floorAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorAlias.BuildingPart, () => partAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => partAlias.Building, () => buildingAlias)
            .Where(() => buildingAlias.Id == building.Id)
            .Select(r => r.Id)
            .List<int>();

        RoomValidityEntity roomValidityAlias = null;

        var childValidities = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => roomValidityAlias)
            .Where(() => roomValidityAlias.ValidFrom >= validFrom)
            .And(() => roomValidityAlias.ValidFrom <= validTo)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(() => roomValidityAlias.ParentId).IsIn((ICollection)roomIds)
            .List();

        return new MapSubValidityQueryResult<BuildingValidityEntityDto, RoomValidityEntityDto>
        {
            ParentValidity = Mapper.Map<BuildingValidityEntityDto>(buildingValidity),
            ChildValidites = Mapper.Map<List<RoomValidityEntityDto>>(childValidities)
        };
    }
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSiteValidityEntityQuery(BuildingValidityEntityQuery buildingEntityQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingValidityEntity>();

        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);

        if (buildingEntityQuery.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == buildingEntityQuery.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous BuildingValidityEntityQuery");
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<BuildingValidityEntity, BuildingValidityEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ValidityEntityQuery<BuildingValidityEntityDto> validityQuery)
        {
            if (validityQuery?.ParentId > 0)
                queryOver.Where(() => _buildingAlias.Id == validityQuery.ParentId);
            if (validityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == validityQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<BuildingValidityEntity, BuildingValidityEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingProfile, () => _buildingProfileAlias);
    }
}

using System.Reflection;
using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
