/// <summary>
/// FloorQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations.FloorEntity, FloorEntityDto&gt;" />
public class FloorQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<FloorEntity, FloorEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    ///Tenant dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly FloorEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Address alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly AddressEntity _addressAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Floor Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly FloorValidityEntity _floorValidityAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// BuildingPart Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly BuildingPartValidityEntity _buildingPartValidityAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Building Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly BuildingValidityEntity _buildingValidityAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// BuildingPart alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly BuildingPartEntity _buildingPartAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Building alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly BuildingEntity _buildingAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Site alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteEntity _siteAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Site Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteValidityEntity _siteValidityAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    ///  Institution alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionEntity _institutionAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Institution Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionValidityEntity _institutionValidityAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="FloorQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    public FloorQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IQueryService queryService,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
        _scope = scope;
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            IEntityQuery<FloorListItemDto> floorListItemQuery => DoQueryEntities(floorListItemQuery),
            FloorMeasurementPointsQuery floorMeasurementPointsQuery => DoMeasurementPointQuery(floorMeasurementPointsQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };

        return base.QueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        int? entityId = null;
        if (GetEntityIdsForSecOperation(query) is IEnumerable<int> ids)
        {
            CheckForMultipleOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, ids).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }
        else
        {
            entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
            CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }

        var result = query switch
        {
            FloorPodsQuery floorPodsQuery => DoPodsQuery(floorPodsQuery),
            FloorParentsNamesQuery namesQuery => DoParentsNameQuery(namesQuery),
            OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<FloorEntityDto> coordsQuery => DoCoordinatesInfoQuery(coordsQuery),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
        if (entityId is null)
        {
            return result;
        }
        #region jogosultság szerint szűrés
        RequiredSecOperationAttribute? secAttr = query.GetType().GetCustomAttribute<RequiredSecOperationAttribute>();
        if (secAttr is not null && result is not null)
        {
            var permissions = GetOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId, secAttr).GetAwaiter().GetResult() ?? [];
            var tenantPermissions = permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == null).ToList();

            if (tenantPermissions.Any(x => x.SecOpCodes.Contains(secAttr.SecOperationCode)))
            {
                return result; //ha már tenant szinten is van joga, akkor mindent visszaadhatunk
            }

            if (result is EntityQueryItemsResult<FloorListItemDto> listItemResult)
            {
#if DEBUG
                System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch sw = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
#endif
                //var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissions(permissions, listItemResult);
                var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(permissions, listItemResult);
#if DEBUG
                sw.Stop();
                var el = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                Console.WriteLine($"FilterResultsByPermissions took {el} ms.");
#endif
                return filteredResult;
            }
            //TODO: lehetnek-e egyéb típusú resultok, ahol szűrne kell az eredményeket?
        }
        #endregion

        return result;
    }
    private IQueryResult DoCoordinatesInfoQuery(OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<FloorEntityDto> coordsQuery)
    {
        MapCoordinatesInfoModel mapAlias = null!;
        var subQueryFloorValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<FloorValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var query = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<FloorEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.FloorValidities, () => _floorValidityAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Id)
            .IsIn(coordsQuery.OrgUnitIds)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _floorValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryFloorValidity))
            .And(x => !_floorValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _floorValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Name)
                .Select(x => _floorValidityAlias.Lon).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Longitude)
                .Select(x => _floorValidityAlias.Lat).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Latitude))
            .TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>())
            .List<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>();

        return new MapCoordinatesInfoQueryResult
        {
            CoordinateInfos = query.ToList()
        };
    }
    private IQueryResult DoParentsNameQuery(FloorParentsNamesQuery parentsNamesQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == parentsNamesQuery.Id);

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, parentsNamesQuery);

        FloorParentsNamesQueryResult alias = null!;
        queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _siteAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteId)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName)
                .Select(x => _institutionAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionId)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionName)
                .Select(x => _buildingAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingId)
                .Select(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingName)
                .Select(x => _buildingPartAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartId)
                .Select(x => _buildingPartValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartName)
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.FloorId)
                .Select(x => _floorValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.FloorName)
            );

        var result = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<FloorParentsNamesQueryResult>())
                              .SingleOrDefault<FloorParentsNamesQueryResult>();
        return result;
    }

    //Windsurf AI suggested optimization
    private static IEntityQueryItemsResult FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto> permissions, EntityQueryItemsResult<FloorListItemDto> listItemResult)
    {
        #region prepropcess: Create mappings from items to floors
        var buildingPartIdToFloors = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.BuildingPartId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var buildingIdToFloors = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.BuildingId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var siteIdToFloors = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.SiteId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var institutionIdToFloors = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.InstitutionId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        // Create mappings from BuildingPart to its parent Building (helper, because buildingpart is not in the permission)
        var buildingPartToParentBuilding = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.BuildingPartId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().BuildingId);

        #endregion

        var finalFloorIds = new HashSet<int>();

        #region Process permissions to collect all relevant IDs

        //by buildings...
        var buildingIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Building).Select(p => p.Building!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedFloorIdssByBuildings = buildingIdToFloors
            .Where(b2f => buildingIdsWithPermission.Contains(b2f.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalFloorIds.UnionWith(permittedFloorIdssByBuildings); //add to result

        //by buildingparts...
        //BuildingPart nincs már a permissionben, olyan mélyre nem nyúlik a jogosultság kezelés, ezért a buildingek alapján kell szűrni
        var buildingPartIdsWithPermission = buildingPartToParentBuilding
            .Where(kvp => buildingIdsWithPermission.Contains(kvp.Value))
            .Select(kvp => kvp.Key)
            .ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedFloorIdssByBuildingParts = buildingPartIdToFloors
            .Where(bp2f => buildingPartIdsWithPermission.Contains(bp2f.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalFloorIds.UnionWith(permittedFloorIdssByBuildingParts); //add to result

        //by sites...
        var siteIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Site).Select(p => p.Site!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedFloorIdssBySites = siteIdToFloors
            .Where(s2f => siteIdsWithPermission.Contains(s2f.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalFloorIds.UnionWith(permittedFloorIdssBySites); //add to result

        //by institutions...
        var institutionIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Institution).Select(p => p.Institution!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedFloorIdssByInstituions = institutionIdToFloors
            .Where(i2f => institutionIdsWithPermission.Contains(i2f.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalFloorIds.UnionWith(permittedFloorIdssByInstituions); //add to result

        #endregion

        // Apply filter directly with the pre-computed set
        listItemResult.Items = [.. listItemResult.Items.Where(x => finalFloorIds.Contains(x.Id))];
        return listItemResult;
    }


    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            //IEntityQuery<FloorListItemDto> floorListItemQuery => floorListItemQuery.?????
            FloorEntityQuery entityQuery => entityQuery.Id,
            FloorParentsNamesQuery nameQuery => nameQuery.Id,
            FloorPodsQuery podsQuery => podsQuery.FloorId,
            FloorPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery => pagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartId,
            FloorEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery => entityRefQuery.ParentId,
            FloorMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery => measurementPointsQuery.FloorId,
            EntityByIdQuery<FloorEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }
    protected override IEnumerable<int>? GetEntityIdsForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<FloorEntityDto> coordsQuery => coordsQuery.OrgUnitIds,
            _ => null
        };
    }


    private IQueryResult DoPodsQuery(FloorPodsQuery podsQuery)
    {
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<FloorEntity>(() => floorEntityAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == podsQuery.FloorId);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

        queryOver.Select(Projections.Distinct(
            Projections.SqlFunction("unnest", NHibernateUtil.String,
                Projections.SqlFunction("array_remove", NHibernateUtil.String,
                    Projections.SqlFunction("string_to_array", NHibernateUtil.String,
                        Projections.SqlFunction("CONCAT_WS", NHibernateUtil.String,
                            Projections.Constant(","),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<FloorEntity>(x => floorEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            ),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<RoomEntity>(x => roomEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            )
                        ),
                        Projections.Constant(",")
                    ),
                    Projections.Constant("")
                )
            )
        ));

        return new PodsQueryResult()
        {
            PodList = queryOver.List<string>().ToList(),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            FloorEntityQuery floorQuery => DoFloorSingleEntityQuery(floorQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the floor single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoFloorSingleEntityQuery(FloorEntityQuery query)
    {
        FloorValidityEntity subValidityAlias = null!;
        FloorValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<FloorEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Identifier) && Guid.TryParse(query.Identifier, out Guid guidIdentifier))
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == guidIdentifier);

        if (query.IsDeleted != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == query.IsDeleted);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.FloorValidities, () => validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
         .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).In(
            QueryOver.Of<FloorValidityEntity>(() => subValidityAlias)
                     .Where(() => subValidityAlias.Floor.Id == _rootAlias.Id && !subValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
                     .Select(v => v.Id))).TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous FloorQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<FloorEntity, FloorEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is FloorEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery)
        {
            if (entityRefQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityRefQuery.IsDeleted);

            if (entityRefQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.BuildingPart.Id == entityRefQuery.ParentId);
        }

        if (query is FloorEntityQuery floorQuery)
        {
            if (floorQuery.Id != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == floorQuery.Id);

            if (floorQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.BuildingPart.Id == floorQuery.ParentId);

            if (floorQuery.ParentIdentifier.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(() => _buildingPartAlias.Identifier == floorQuery.ParentIdentifier);

            if (floorQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == floorQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        if (query is FloorPagedEntityQuery floorPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (floorPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.HasValue)  //must support returning deleted, not-deleted, and all
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == !floorPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.Value);

            if (floorPagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _buildingPartValidityAlias.BuildingPart.Id == floorPagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartId);

            if (floorPagedEntityQuery.SiteId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _siteValidityAlias.Site.Id == floorPagedEntityQuery.SiteId);

            if (floorPagedEntityQuery.BuildingId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Building.Id == floorPagedEntityQuery.BuildingId);

            if (floorPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Institution.Id == floorPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId);


            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(floorPagedEntityQuery.Name))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<FloorValidityEntity>(x => _floorValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(floorPagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(floorPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(floorPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(floorPagedEntityQuery.SiteName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(floorPagedEntityQuery.SiteName, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(floorPagedEntityQuery.BuildingName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(floorPagedEntityQuery.BuildingName, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(floorPagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => _buildingPartValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(floorPagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni, lsd OrgUnitQueryHandler
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<FloorEntity, FloorEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<FloorEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<FloorEntity, FloorEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartAlias = null!;

        if (query is FloorEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            if (entityQuery.ParentIdentifier.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingPart, () => _buildingPartAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
            }
        }

        if (query is FloorPagedEntityQuery floorQuery || query is FloorParentsNamesQuery)
        {
            var subQueryFloorValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<FloorValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryBuildingPartValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => _buildingPartAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryBuildingValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _buildingAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQuerySiteValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _siteAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryInstitutionValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.FloorValidities, () => _floorValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _floorValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryFloorValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.BuildingPart, () => _buildingPartAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingPartAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => _buildingPartValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _buildingPartValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingPartAlias.Building, () => _buildingAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingAlias.BuildingValidities, () => _buildingValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _buildingValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingAlias.Site, () => _siteAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _siteAlias.SiteValidities, () => _siteValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _siteValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuerySiteValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _siteAlias.Institution, () => _institutionAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _institutionAlias.InstitutionValidities, () => _institutionValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _institutionValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryInstitutionValidity));

        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<FloorEntity, FloorEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(FloorListItemDto))
        {
            FloorListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                .Select(x => x.IsDeleted).WithAlias(() => alias.IsDeleted)
                .Select(x => _floorValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                .Select(x => _buildingPartValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartName)
                .Select(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingName)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionName)
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.BuildingPart.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartId)
                .Select(x => _buildingPartAlias.Building.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingId)
                .Select(x => _buildingAlias.Site.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteId)//TODO: így ok?
                .Select(x => _siteAlias.Institution.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionId) //TODO: így ok?
            );
        }
        return null;
    }

    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoMeasurementPointQuery(FloorMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery)
    {
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorValidityEntity floorValidityAlias = null!;
        RoomValidityEntity roomValidityAlias = null!;

        // Create the base query with all joins
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<FloorEntity>(() => floorEntityAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == measurementPointsQuery.FloorId);

        // Get floor name for parent reference
        var floorName = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.FloorValidities, () => floorValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => !floorValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .Select(
                Projections.Property<FloorValidityEntity>(x => floorValidityAlias.Name))
            .SingleOrDefault<string>();

        // Query for rooms
        var subQueryRoomValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<RoomValidityEntity>(x => roomEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

        var roomResults = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => roomEntityAlias.RoomValidities, () => roomValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => roomValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryRoomValidity))
            .Where(() => roomEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !roomValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Id)
                .Select(() => roomValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Identifier)
            )
            .List<object[]>();

        var roomDtos = roomResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Room,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { floorName }
        }).ToList();

        // Combine all measurement point DTOs
        var allMeasurementPoints = roomDtos.ToList();

        // Apply sorting and paging
        if (measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn))
        {
            // Apply sorting based on property name using reflection
            var sortProperty = typeof(MeasurementPointListItemDto).GetProperty(
                measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn,
                BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);

            if (sortProperty != null)
            {
                if (measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending)
                {
                    allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                        .OrderBy(x => sortProperty.GetValue(x))
                        .ToList();
                }
                else
                {
                    allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                        .OrderByDescending(x => sortProperty.GetValue(x))
                        .ToList();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Default to Name if property not found
                allMeasurementPoints = measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending
                    ? allMeasurementPoints.OrderBy(x => x.Name).ToList()
                    : allMeasurementPoints.OrderByDescending(x => x.Name).ToList();
            }
        }

        var totalCount = allMeasurementPoints.Count;

        // Apply paging
        if (measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo != null && measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize.HasValue)
        {
            int firstItem = measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.StartPage * measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize.Value;
            int pageSize = measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize.Value;
            allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                .Skip(firstItem)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToList();
        }

        return new EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>
        {
            Items = allMeasurementPoints.ToArray(),
            RecordsTotal = totalCount
        };
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.BaseQueries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Floor;
using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// SiteValidityQueryHandler
/// </summary>
public class FloorValidityQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<FloorValidityEntity, FloorValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly FloorValidityEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Floor alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly FloorEntity _floorAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="FloorValidityQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public FloorValidityQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, IQueryService queryService, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            FloorValidityEntityQuery floorEntityQuery => floorEntityQuery.FloorId, //az orgunit kell, nem a validity-je!
            ValidityEntityQuery<FloorValidityEntityDto> validityEntityQuery => validityEntityQuery.ParentId,
            EntityByIdQuery<FloorValidityEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<FloorValidityEntity, FloorValidityEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<FloorValidityEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Floor, () => _floorAlias);
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            FloorValidityEntityQuery floorEntityQuery => DoFloorValidityEntityQuery(floorEntityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoFloorValidityEntityQuery(FloorValidityEntityQuery floorEntityQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<FloorValidityEntity>();

        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);

        if (floorEntityQuery.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == floorEntityQuery.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous FloorValidityEntityQuery");
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<FloorValidityEntity, FloorValidityEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ValidityEntityQuery<FloorValidityEntityDto> validityQuery)
        {
            if (validityQuery?.ParentId > 0)
                queryOver.Where(() => _floorAlias.Id == validityQuery.ParentId);
            if (validityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == validityQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }
}

/// <summary>

public class InstitutionQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<InstitutionEntity, InstitutionEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantEntity _tenantEntityAlias = null;

    /// <summary>

    private readonly AddressEntity _addressAlias = null!;

    /*/// <summary>

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>
    /// Partner Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionValidityEntity _validityAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Partner Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionValidityEntity _subQueryAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Partner alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly PartnerEntity _partnerAlias = default!; //maybe we'll need it: _rootAlias
    /// <summary>
    /// Type alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictItemEntity _typeAlias = default!; //maybe we'll need it
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InstitutionQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    public InstitutionQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IQueryService queryService,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
        _scope = scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        // skip permissions check for administration query
        if (query is TenantInstitutionEntityRefQuery refQuery)
            return DoTenantInstitutionAdministrationRefQuery(refQuery);

        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        var result = query switch
        {
            IEntityQuery<InstitutionListItemDto> itemQuery => DoQueryEntities(itemQuery),

            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };

        #region jogosultság szerint szűrés
        // Rendszerszintű áthívásoknál nincs jogosultság kezelés miatti szűrés
        if (_securityContext.CurrentUser.IsSystem)
        {
            return result;
        }

        RequiredSecOperationAttribute? secAttr = query.GetType().GetCustomAttribute<RequiredSecOperationAttribute>();
        if (secAttr is not null && result is not null)
        {
            var permissions = GetOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId, secAttr).GetAwaiter().GetResult() ?? [];
            var tenantPermissions = permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == null).ToList();

            if (tenantPermissions.Any(x => x.SecOpCodes.Contains(secAttr.SecOperationCode)))
            {
                return result; //ha már tenant szinten is van joga, akkor mindent visszaadhatunk
            }

            //TODO: nem tudom, hogy ezt szebben, gyorabban is meg lehet-e oldani...
            //a lentebbi szinteken egyre bonyolultabb lesz, külön metódusba szerveztem ki (majd tesztelni kéne sok tesztadattal, és a teljesítményt is!)
            if (result is EntityQueryItemsResult<InstitutionListItemDto> listItemResult)
            {
                var permittedInstitutionIds = new HashSet<int>(permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Institution).Select(x => x.Institution!.Id));
                listItemResult.Items = [.. listItemResult.Items.Where(x => permittedInstitutionIds.Contains(x.Id))];
                return listItemResult;
            }
            //TODO: lehetnek-e egyéb típusú resultok, ahol szűrne kell az eredményeket?
        }
        #endregion


        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni, lsd OrgUnitQueryHandler

        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InstitutionEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

    /// <summary>

    /// result

    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)

        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        //flag
        return query switch
        {
            InstitutionCardsQuery institutionCardsQuery => DoInstitutionCardsQuery(institutionCardsQuery),
            InstitutionPartnerCardsQuery partnerCardsQuery => DoPartnerCardsQuery(partnerCardsQuery),

        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            //IEntityQuery<InstitutionListItemDto> institutionListItemQuery => institutionListItemQuery.????
            InstitutionEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery => null, //nincs szülője, ezért null
            TenantInstitutionEntityRefQuery administrationEntityRefQuery => null, //nincs szülője, ezért null
            InstitutionPagedEntityQuery institutionPagedEntityQuery => null, //nincs szülője, ezért null
            InstitutionCardsQuery institutionCardsQuery => institutionCardsQuery.InstitutionId,
            InstitutionEntityQuery institutionQuery => institutionQuery.Id,
            EntityByIdQuery<InstitutionEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            InstitutionPartnerCardsQuery partnerCardsQuery => null,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the institution cards query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="institutionCardsQuery">The institution cards query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoInstitutionCardsQuery(InstitutionCardsQuery institutionCardsQuery)
    {
        SiteEntity siteAlias = null!;
        BuildingEntity buildingEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;
        EnergyContractEntity energyContractAlias = null!;
        SiteLocationEntity siteLocationAlias = null!;
        DeviceEntity deviceAlias = null!;


        int energyContractCount = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<EnergyContractEntity>(() => energyContractAlias)
                                 .Where(x => x.Institution.Id == institutionCardsQuery.InstitutionId && !x.IsDeleted)
                                 .RowCount();

        // Create the base query with all joins
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InstitutionEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
                                 .Where(x => x.Id == institutionCardsQuery.InstitutionId)
                                 .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Sites, () => siteAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
                                 .Where(() => !siteAlias.IsDeleted);

        int sitesCount = queryOver.RowCount();

        // Query for buildings that are measurement points
        int buildingCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(() => siteAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => buildingEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !siteAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => buildingEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        // Query for building parts
        int buildingPartCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(() => siteAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !siteAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingPartEntityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        // Query for floors
        int floorCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(() => siteAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => floorEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint
                    && !siteAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingPartEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !floorEntityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        // Query for rooms
        int roomCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(() => siteAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => roomEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint
                    && !siteAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingPartEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !floorEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !roomEntityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        int measurementPointsCount = buildingCount + buildingPartCount + floorCount + roomCount;

        var result = new InstitutionCardsQueryResult
        {
            InstitutionCards = new()
            {
                Id = institutionCardsQuery.InstitutionId,
                MeasurementPointCount = measurementPointsCount,
                SiteCount = sitesCount,
                DeviceCount = 0,//TODO pótolni
                EnergyContractCount = energyContractCount
            }
        };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the partner current cards query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="currentCardsQuery">The partner current cards query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoPartnerCardsQuery(InstitutionPartnerCardsQuery currentCardsQuery)
    {
        SiteEntity siteAlias = null!;
        BuildingEntity buildingEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;

        // Create the base query with all joins
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InstitutionEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
                                 .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);

        int institutionsCount = queryOver.RowCount();

        int sitesCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Sites, () => siteAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => !siteAlias.IsDeleted)
            .RowCount();

        // Query for buildings that are measurement points
        int buildingCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Sites, () => siteAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => siteAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => !siteAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted && buildingEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => buildingEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        // Query for building parts
        int buildingPartCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Sites, () => siteAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => siteAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => !siteAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingPartEntityAlias.IsDeleted && buildingPartEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        // Query for floors
        int floorCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Sites, () => siteAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => siteAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => !siteAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingPartEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !floorEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && floorEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        // Query for rooms
        int roomCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Sites, () => siteAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => siteAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => !siteAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingPartEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !floorEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !roomEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && roomEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        int measurementPointsCount = buildingCount + buildingPartCount + floorCount + roomCount;
        int totalDeviceCount = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>()
            .Where(x=>!x.IsDeleted)
            .RowCount();

        var result = new InstitutionPartnerCardsQueryResult
        {
            Cards = new()
            {
                MeasurementPointCount = measurementPointsCount,
                InstitutionCount = institutionsCount,
                SiteCount = sitesCount, 
                DeviceCount = totalDeviceCount
            }
        };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the tenant institution administration query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantDbContext">The tenant database context.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>> DoTenantInstitutionAdministrationRefQuery(TenantInstitutionEntityRefQuery query)
    {
        using var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope();

        tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(query.TenantCode);
        var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        var queryOver = tenantDbContext.Session.QueryOver<InstitutionEntity>();

        if (query.IsDeleted.HasValue)
            queryOver = query.IsDeleted.Value
                ? queryOver.Where(o => o.IsDeleted)
                : queryOver.Where(o => !o.IsDeleted);


        var items = queryOver.List().Select(x => new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto> { Id = x.Id, EntityDisplayName = x.Name }).ToArray();

        IEntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>>? result = new EntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>>();

        result.Items = items;

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<InstitutionEntity, InstitutionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is InstitutionEntityQuery || query is InstitutionPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            var subQueryInstitutionValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);


            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.InstitutionValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryInstitutionValidity));
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => _validityAlias.Headquarters, () => _addressAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);


            //TODO: partnerből: kell?
            //queryOver.JoinEntityAlias(() => _tenantAlias, () => _rootAlias.TenantCode == _tenantAlias.Code, NHibernate.SqlCommand.JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<InstitutionEntity, InstitutionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(InstitutionListItemDto))
        {
            InstitutionListItemDto alias = default!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                .Select(x => x.IsDeleted).WithAlias(() => alias.IsDeleted)
                .Select(x => _validityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                .Select(x => _addressAlias.FullAddress).WithAlias(() => alias.Headquarters)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            InstitutionEntityQuery institutionQuery => DoInstitutionSingleEntityQuery(institutionQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the institution single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoInstitutionSingleEntityQuery(InstitutionEntityQuery query)
    {


        AddressEntity addressAlias = null!;
        InstitutionValidityEntity subValidityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InstitutionEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Identifier) && Guid.TryParse(query.Identifier, out Guid guidIdentifier))
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == guidIdentifier);

        if (query.IsDeleted != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == query.IsDeleted);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.InstitutionValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).In(
                    QueryOver.Of<InstitutionValidityEntity>(() => subValidityAlias)
                             .Where(() => subValidityAlias.Institution.Id == _rootAlias.Id && !subValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
                             .Select(v => v.Id))).TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity);

        //TODO: ki kellett kommentelni a validity átalakítás közben
        //if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Name))
        //    queryOver.Where(x => x.Name == query.Name);
        //if (query.AddressId != null && query.AddressId > 0)
        //    queryOver = queryOver
        //    .JoinAlias(x => x.Address, () => addressAlias)
        //    .Where(x => addressAlias.Id == query.AddressId);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous InstitutionQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<InstitutionEntity, InstitutionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        switch (query)
        {
            case InstitutionEntityQuery institutionQuery:
                if (institutionQuery.Id != null)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == institutionQuery.Id);
                if (institutionQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == institutionQuery.IsDeleted);
                break;

            case InstitutionEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery:
                if (entityRefQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityRefQuery.IsDeleted);
                break;

            case TenantInstitutionEntityRefQuery administrationEntityRefQuery:
                if (administrationEntityRefQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == administrationEntityRefQuery.IsDeleted);
                break;

            case InstitutionPagedEntityQuery institutionPagedEntityQuery:
                if (institutionPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.HasValue)  //must support returning deleted, not-deleted, and all
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == !institutionPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.Value);
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(institutionPagedEntityQuery.Name))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _validityAlias.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(institutionPagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(institutionPagedEntityQuery.Headquarters))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _addressAlias.FullAddress)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(institutionPagedEntityQuery.Headquarters, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                break;

            default:
                break;
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// InstitutionValidityQueryHandler
/// </summary>
public class InstitutionValidityQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<InstitutionValidityEntity, InstitutionValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionValidityEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Institution alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionEntity _institutionAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InstitutionValidityQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public InstitutionValidityQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, IQueryService queryService, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            InstitutionValidityEntityQuery institutionEntityQuery => institutionEntityQuery.InstitutionId, //az orgunit kell, nem a validity-je!
            ValidityEntityQuery<InstitutionValidityEntityDto> validityEntityQuery => validityEntityQuery.ParentId,
            EntityByIdQuery<InstitutionValidityEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<InstitutionValidityEntity, InstitutionValidityEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InstitutionValidityEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Institution, () => _institutionAlias);
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            InstitutionValidityEntityQuery institutionEntityQuery => DoInstitutionValidityEntityQuery(institutionEntityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoInstitutionValidityEntityQuery(InstitutionValidityEntityQuery institutionEntityQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InstitutionValidityEntity>();

        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);

        if (institutionEntityQuery.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == institutionEntityQuery.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous InstitutionValidityEntityQuery");
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where conditions
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<InstitutionValidityEntity, InstitutionValidityEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ValidityEntityQuery<InstitutionValidityEntityDto> validityQuery)
        {
            if (validityQuery?.ParentId > 0)
                queryOver.Where(() => _institutionAlias.Id == validityQuery.ParentId);
            if (validityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == validityQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// OrgunitBaseQueryHandler
/// </summary>
public class OrgunitBaseQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<OrgunitBaseEntity, OrgunitBaseEntityDto>
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeasurementPointQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public OrgunitBaseQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        IQueryService queryService) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Not implemented EntityType!</exception>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            OrgunitNameCascadeQuery nameQuery => DoOrgunitNameCascadeQuery(nameQuery),
            OrgunitBaseIdQuery IdQuery => DoIdQueryQuery(IdQuery),
            OrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQuery orgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQuery => DoOrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQuery(orgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQuery).RunSync(),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is OrgunitBaseEntityQuery entityQuery) 
        {
            return DoSingleEntityQuery(entityQuery);
        }
        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSingleEntityQuery(OrgunitBaseEntityQuery query)
    {
        MeasurementPointEntity alias = null!;
        MeasurementPointEntity sublias = null!;
        OrgunitBaseEntity rootAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => rootAlias);

        if (query.OrgunitId.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.OrgunitId);

        queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => rootAlias.MeasurementPoints, () => alias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin, Restrictions.Eq(Projections.Property(() => alias.IsDeleted), false));
        queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity);


        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous BuildingQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    private IQueryResult DoIdQueryQuery(OrgunitBaseIdQuery IdQuery)
    {
        var resultId = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<OrgunitBaseEntity>()
                                      .Where(x => x.Identifier == IdQuery.Identifier)
                                      .Select(x => x.Id)
                                      .List<int>().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous OrgnitBase");

        return new OrgunitBaseIdQueryResult()
        {
            Id = new EntityRef<OrgunitBaseEntityDto> { Id = resultId }
        };
    }

    protected override OrgunitBaseEntityDto CreateDto(OrgunitBaseEntity obj)
    {
        switch (obj.OrgunitType)
        {
            case OrgunitType.Institution:
                return Mapper.Map<InstitutionEntityDto>(obj);
            case OrgunitType.Site:
                return Mapper.Map<SiteEntityDto>(obj);
            case OrgunitType.Building:
                return Mapper.Map<BuildingEntityDto>(obj);
            case OrgunitType.BuildingPart:
                return Mapper.Map<BuildingPartEntityDto>(obj);
            case OrgunitType.Floor:
                return Mapper.Map<FloorEntityDto>(obj);
            case OrgunitType.Room:
                return Mapper.Map<RoomEntityDto>(obj);
            default:
                break;
        }

        return base.CreateDto(obj);
    }

    private IQueryResult DoOrgunitNameCascadeQuery(OrgunitNameCascadeQuery nameQuery)
    {
        var orgunit = DbContext.Session.Get<OrgunitBaseEntity>(nameQuery.OrgunitId) ?? throw new ArgumentException("A megadott topológiai elem nem létezik!");

        var parentNames = orgunit.OrgunitType switch
        {
            OrgunitType.Site => DoSiteParentsNamesQuery(nameQuery.OrgunitId),
            OrgunitType.Building => DoBuildingParentsNamesQuery(nameQuery.OrgunitId),
            OrgunitType.BuildingPart => DoBuildingPartParentsNamesQuery(nameQuery.OrgunitId),
            OrgunitType.Floor => DoFloorParentsNamesQuery(nameQuery.OrgunitId),
            OrgunitType.Room => DoRoomParentsNamesQuery(nameQuery.OrgunitId),
            _ => throw new ArgumentException("Instituiton do not have parent item!")
        };

        return parentNames;
    }

    private OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult DoSiteParentsNamesQuery(int orgunitId)
    {
        var result = _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new SiteParentsNamesQuery() { Id = orgunitId }).RunSync() as SiteParentsNamesQueryResult;
        return new OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult()
        {
            Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>() { Id = result.InstiutionId, EntityDisplayName = result.InstiutionName },
            Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>() { Id = result.SiteId, EntityDisplayName = result.SiteName },
        };
    }

    private OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult DoBuildingParentsNamesQuery(int orgunitId)
    {
        var result = _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new BuildingParentsNamesQuery() { Id = orgunitId }).RunSync() as BuildingParentsNamesQueryResult;
        return new OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult()
        {
            Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>() { Id = result.InstiutionId, EntityDisplayName = result.InstiutionName },
            Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>() { Id = result.SiteId, EntityDisplayName = result.SiteName },
            Building = new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>() { Id = result.BuildingId, EntityDisplayName = result.BuildingName },
        };
    }

    private OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult DoBuildingPartParentsNamesQuery(int orgunitId)
    {
        var result = _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new BuildingPartParentsNamesQuery() { Id = orgunitId }).RunSync() as BuildingPartParentsNamesQueryResult;
        return new OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult()
        {
            Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>() { Id = result.InstiutionId, EntityDisplayName = result.InstiutionName },
            Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>() { Id = result.SiteId, EntityDisplayName = result.SiteName },
            Building = new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>() { Id = result.BuildingId, EntityDisplayName = result.BuildingName },
            BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>() { Id = result.BuildingPartId, EntityDisplayName = result.BuildingPartName },
        };
    }

    private OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult DoFloorParentsNamesQuery(int orgunitId)
    {
        var result = _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new FloorParentsNamesQuery() { Id = orgunitId }).RunSync() as FloorParentsNamesQueryResult;
        return new OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult()
        {
            Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>() { Id = result.InstiutionId, EntityDisplayName = result.InstiutionName },
            Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>() { Id = result.SiteId, EntityDisplayName = result.SiteName },
            Building = new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>() { Id = result.BuildingId, EntityDisplayName = result.BuildingName },
            BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>() { Id = result.BuildingPartId, EntityDisplayName = result.BuildingPartName },
            Floor = new EntityRef<FloorEntityDto>() { Id = result.FloorId, EntityDisplayName = result.FloorName },
        };
    }

    private OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult DoRoomParentsNamesQuery(int orgunitId)
    {
        var result = _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new RoomParentsNamesQuery() { Id = orgunitId }).RunSync() as RoomParentsNamesQueryResult;
        return new OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult()
        {
            Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>() { Id = result.InstiutionId, EntityDisplayName = result.InstiutionName },
            Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>() { Id = result.SiteId, EntityDisplayName = result.SiteName },
            Building = new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>() { Id = result.BuildingId, EntityDisplayName = result.BuildingName },
            BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>() { Id = result.BuildingPartId, EntityDisplayName = result.BuildingPartName },
            Floor = new EntityRef<FloorEntityDto>() { Id = result.FloorId, EntityDisplayName = result.FloorName },
            Room = new EntityRef<RoomEntityDto>() { Id = result.RoomId, EntityDisplayName = result.RoomName },
        };
