    #region vertical traversal of orgunit hierarchy from bottom to top

    // Intermediate type for caching
    private record OrgunitCacheEntry(
        int Id,
        OrgunitType Type,
        Guid Identifier,
        string ValidName,
        int? ParentId = null
    );

    //az egyes (különböző szintű) orgunitok listája alapján felfelé be kell járni a hierarchiát és az összes szülőjét ki kell tölteni
    //az adott tábla struktúrához képest a lehető legoptimálisabb stratégiát használva, fix számű DB lekérdezéssel
    private async Task<OrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQueryResult> DoOrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQuery(OrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQuery query)
    {
        OrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQueryResult result = new();
        // If no OrgUnitIds are provided, return an empty result    
        if (query.OrgUnitIds.Count == 0)
            return result;

        // Step 1: Get initial orgunit entities grouped by type
        var orgunitEntities = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<OrgunitBaseEntity>()
            .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Id).IsIn(query.OrgUnitIds.ToArray())
            .ListAsync();
        var orgunitByType = orgunitEntities
            .GroupBy(x => x.OrgunitType)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(e => e.Id).ToList());

        // Step 2: Cache for all resolved orgunits - key: (id, type), value: cache entry
        var orgunitCache = new Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry>();

        // Step 3: Fetch initial entities with their valid names (batch by type)
        await FetchInitialEntitiesWithNames(orgunitByType, orgunitCache);

        // Step 4: Traversal order - from highest level down to lowest
        // We start with Sites because they only have Institution parents
        OrgunitType[] traversalOrder =
        [
            OrgunitType.Site,
            OrgunitType.Building,
            OrgunitType.BuildingPart,
            OrgunitType.Floor,
            OrgunitType.Room
        ];

        // Step 5: For each level, fetch unknown parents
        foreach (var currentType in traversalOrder)
        {
            await FetchParentsForType(currentType, orgunitCache);
        }

        // Step 5.1: Fetch any missing Institutions that were discovered as parents
        var institutionIds = orgunitCache.Values
            .Where(e => e.ParentId.HasValue && e.Type == OrgunitType.Site)
            .Select(e => e.ParentId!.Value)
            .Where(id => !orgunitCache.ContainsKey((id, OrgunitType.Institution)))
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        if (institutionIds.Count > 0)
        {
            await FetchInstitutionsWithNames(institutionIds, orgunitCache);
        }

        // Step 6: Transform to final result
        foreach (var orgunitId in query.OrgUnitIds)
        {
            var originalEntity = orgunitEntities.First(e => e.Id == orgunitId);
            var parentRefs = BuildOrgunitParentRefsFromCache(originalEntity, orgunitCache);
            result.Items.Add(parentRefs);
        }

        return result;
    }

    // Batch fetch methods for each type
    private async Task FetchInstitutionsWithNames(List<int> ids, Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry> cache)
    {
        if (ids.Count == 0) return;

        InstitutionEntity institutionAlias = null!;
        InstitutionValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;
        var subQueryValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => x.ParentId == institutionAlias.Id);

        var results = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<InstitutionEntity>(() => institutionAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(s => s.Id).IsIn(ids.ToArray())
            .JoinAlias(s => s.InstitutionValidities, () => validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryValidity))
            .Select(
                Projections.Property(() => institutionAlias.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => institutionAlias.Identifier),
                Projections.Property(() => validityAlias.Name)
            )
            .ListAsync<object[]>();

        foreach (var result in results)
        {
            //projection
            var entry = new OrgunitCacheEntry(
                Id: (int)result[0],
                Type: OrgunitType.Institution,
                Identifier: (Guid)result[1],
                ValidName: (string)result[2],
                ParentId: null
            );
            cache[(entry.Id, entry.Type)] = entry; //add-or-update to cache
        }
    }

    private async Task FetchSitesWithNames(List<int> ids, Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry> cache)
    {
        if (ids.Count == 0) return;

        SiteEntity siteAlias = null!;
        SiteValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;
        var subQueryValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => x.ParentId == siteAlias.Id);

        var results = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>(() => siteAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(s => s.Id).IsIn(ids.ToArray())
            .JoinAlias(s => s.SiteValidities, () => validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryValidity))
            .Select(
                Projections.Property(() => siteAlias.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => siteAlias.Identifier),
                Projections.Property(() => siteAlias.Institution.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => validityAlias.Name)
            )
            .ListAsync<object[]>();

        foreach (var result in results)
        {
            //projection
            var entry = new OrgunitCacheEntry(
                Id: (int)result[0],
                Type: OrgunitType.Site,
                Identifier: (Guid)result[1],
                ValidName: (string)result[3],
                ParentId: (int?)result[2]
            );
            cache[(entry.Id, entry.Type)] = entry; //add-or-update to cache
        }
    }

    private async Task FetchBuildingsWithNames(List<int> ids, Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry> cache)
    {
        if (ids.Count == 0) return;

        BuildingEntity buildingAlias = null!;
        BuildingValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;
        var subQueryValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => x.ParentId == buildingAlias.Id);

        var results = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingEntity>(() => buildingAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(s => s.Id).IsIn(ids.ToArray())
            .JoinAlias(s => s.BuildingValidities, () => validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryValidity))
            .Select(
                Projections.Property(() => buildingAlias.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => buildingAlias.Identifier),
                Projections.Property(() => buildingAlias.Site.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => validityAlias.Name)
            )
            .ListAsync<object[]>();

        foreach (var result in results)
        {
            var entry = new OrgunitCacheEntry(
                Id: (int)result[0],
                Type: OrgunitType.Building,
                Identifier: (Guid)result[1],
                ValidName: (string)result[3],
                ParentId: (int?)result[2]
            );
            cache[(entry.Id, entry.Type)] = entry;
        }
    }

    private async Task FetchBuildingPartsWithNames(List<int> ids, Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry> cache)
    {
        if (ids.Count == 0) return;

        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;
        var subQueryValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => x.ParentId == buildingPartAlias.Id);

        var results = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<BuildingPartEntity>(() => buildingPartAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(s => s.Id).IsIn(ids.ToArray())
            .JoinAlias(s => s.BuildingPartValidities, () => validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryValidity))
            .Select(
                Projections.Property(() => buildingPartAlias.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => buildingPartAlias.Identifier),
                Projections.Property(() => buildingPartAlias.Building.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => validityAlias.Name)
            )
            .ListAsync<object[]>();

        foreach (var result in results)
        {
            var entry = new OrgunitCacheEntry(
                Id: (int)result[0],
                Type: OrgunitType.BuildingPart,
                Identifier: (Guid)result[1],
                ValidName: (string)result[3],
                ParentId: (int?)result[2]
            );
            cache[(entry.Id, entry.Type)] = entry;
        }
    }

    private async Task FetchFloorsWithNames(List<int> ids, Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry> cache)
    {
        if (ids.Count == 0) return;

        FloorEntity floorAlias = null!;
        FloorValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;
        var subQueryValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<FloorValidityEntity>(x => x.ParentId == floorAlias.Id);

        var results = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<FloorEntity>(() => floorAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(s => s.Id).IsIn(ids.ToArray())
            .JoinAlias(s => s.FloorValidities, () => validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryValidity))
            .Select(
                Projections.Property(() => floorAlias.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => floorAlias.Identifier),
                Projections.Property(() => floorAlias.BuildingPart.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => validityAlias.Name)
            )
            .ListAsync<object[]>();

        foreach (var result in results)
        {
            var entry = new OrgunitCacheEntry(
                Id: (int)result[0],
                Type: OrgunitType.Floor,
                Identifier: (Guid)result[1],
                ValidName: (string)result[3],
                ParentId: (int?)result[2]
            );
            cache[(entry.Id, entry.Type)] = entry;
        }
    }

    private async Task FetchRoomsWithNames(List<int> ids, Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry> cache)
    {
        if (ids.Count == 0) return;

        RoomEntity roomAlias = null!;
        RoomValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;
        var subQueryValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<RoomValidityEntity>(x => x.ParentId == roomAlias.Id);

        var results = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomEntity>(() => roomAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(s => s.Id).IsIn(ids.ToArray())
            .JoinAlias(s => s.RoomValidities, () => validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryValidity))
            .Select(
                Projections.Property(() => roomAlias.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => roomAlias.Identifier),
                Projections.Property(() => roomAlias.Floor.Id),
                Projections.Property(() => validityAlias.Name)
            )
            .ListAsync<object[]>();

        foreach (var result in results)
        {
            var entry = new OrgunitCacheEntry(
                Id: (int)result[0],
                Type: OrgunitType.Room,
                Identifier: (Guid)result[1],
                ValidName: (string)result[3],
                ParentId: (int?)result[2]
            );
            cache[(entry.Id, entry.Type)] = entry;
        }
    }

    private async Task FetchInitialEntitiesWithNames(Dictionary<OrgunitType, List<int>> orgunitByType, Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry> cache)
    {
        foreach (var (type, ids) in orgunitByType)
        {
            switch (type)
            {
                case OrgunitType.Institution:
                    await FetchInstitutionsWithNames(ids, cache);
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.Site:
                    await FetchSitesWithNames(ids, cache);
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.Building:
                    await FetchBuildingsWithNames(ids, cache);
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.BuildingPart:
                    await FetchBuildingPartsWithNames(ids, cache);
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.Floor:
                    await FetchFloorsWithNames(ids, cache);
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.Room:
                    await FetchRoomsWithNames(ids, cache);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task FetchParentsForType(OrgunitType childType, Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry> cache)
    {
        // Get all entities of this type that are in cache
        List<OrgunitCacheEntry> childEntries = cache.Values.Where(e => e.Type == childType && e.ParentId.HasValue).ToList();

        if (childEntries.Count == 0)
            return;

        // Determine parent type and collect unknown parent IDs
        var (parentType, unknownParentIds) = childType switch
        {
            OrgunitType.Site => (OrgunitType.Institution,
                childEntries.Where(e => !cache.ContainsKey((e.ParentId!.Value, OrgunitType.Institution)))
                           .Select(e => e.ParentId!.Value).Distinct().ToList()),
            OrgunitType.Building => (OrgunitType.Site,
                childEntries.Where(e => !cache.ContainsKey((e.ParentId!.Value, OrgunitType.Site)))
                           .Select(e => e.ParentId!.Value).Distinct().ToList()),
            OrgunitType.BuildingPart => (OrgunitType.Building,
                childEntries.Where(e => !cache.ContainsKey((e.ParentId!.Value, OrgunitType.Building)))
                           .Select(e => e.ParentId!.Value).Distinct().ToList()),
            OrgunitType.Floor => (OrgunitType.BuildingPart,
                childEntries.Where(e => !cache.ContainsKey((e.ParentId!.Value, OrgunitType.BuildingPart)))
                           .Select(e => e.ParentId!.Value).Distinct().ToList()),
            OrgunitType.Room => (OrgunitType.Floor,
                childEntries.Where(e => !cache.ContainsKey((e.ParentId!.Value, OrgunitType.Floor)))
                           .Select(e => e.ParentId!.Value).Distinct().ToList()),
            _ => (OrgunitType.Institution, new List<int>())
        };

        if (unknownParentIds.Count == 0)
            return;

        // Fetch unknown parents
        switch (parentType)
        {
            case OrgunitType.Institution:
                await FetchInstitutionsWithNames(unknownParentIds, cache);
                break;
            case OrgunitType.Site:
                await FetchSitesWithNames(unknownParentIds, cache);
                break;
            case OrgunitType.Building:
                await FetchBuildingsWithNames(unknownParentIds, cache);
                break;
            case OrgunitType.BuildingPart:
                await FetchBuildingPartsWithNames(unknownParentIds, cache);
                break;
            case OrgunitType.Floor:
                await FetchFloorsWithNames(unknownParentIds, cache);
                break;
        }
    }

    private static OrgunitParentRefs BuildOrgunitParentRefsFromCache(OrgunitBaseEntity originalEntity, Dictionary<(int Id, OrgunitType Type), OrgunitCacheEntry> cache)
    {
        // Walk up the hierarchy using cache
        GuidEntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>? institution = null;
        GuidEntityRef<SiteEntityDto>? site = null;
        GuidEntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>? building = null;
        GuidEntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>? buildingPart = null;
        GuidEntityRef<FloorEntityDto>? floor = null;
        GuidEntityRef<RoomEntityDto>? room = null;

        var current = cache.GetValueOrDefault((originalEntity.Id, originalEntity.OrgunitType));

        while (current != null)
        {
            switch (current.Type)
            {
                case OrgunitType.Institution:
                    institution = new GuidEntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto> { Identifier = current.Identifier, EntityDisplayName = current.ValidName };
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.Site:
                    site = new GuidEntityRef<SiteEntityDto> { Identifier = current.Identifier, EntityDisplayName = current.ValidName };
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.Building:
                    building = new GuidEntityRef<BuildingEntityDto> { Identifier = current.Identifier, EntityDisplayName = current.ValidName };
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.BuildingPart:
                    buildingPart = new GuidEntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto> { Identifier = current.Identifier, EntityDisplayName = current.ValidName };
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.Floor:
                    floor = new GuidEntityRef<FloorEntityDto> { Identifier = current.Identifier, EntityDisplayName = current.ValidName };
                    break;
                case OrgunitType.Room:
                    room = new GuidEntityRef<RoomEntityDto> { Identifier = current.Identifier, EntityDisplayName = current.ValidName };
                    break;
            }

            // Move to parent
            current = current.ParentId.HasValue ? cache.GetValueOrDefault((current.ParentId.Value, GetParentType(current.Type))) : null;
        }

        return new OrgunitParentRefs(
            originalEntity.Id,
            originalEntity.OrgunitType,
            institution,
            site,
            building,
            buildingPart,
            floor,
            room
        );
    }

    private static OrgunitType GetParentType(OrgunitType childType) => childType switch
    {
        OrgunitType.Site => OrgunitType.Institution,
        OrgunitType.Building => OrgunitType.Site,
        OrgunitType.BuildingPart => OrgunitType.Building,
        OrgunitType.Floor => OrgunitType.BuildingPart,
        OrgunitType.Room => OrgunitType.Floor,
        OrgunitType.Institution => throw new InvalidOperationException("Institution is already the top level."),
        _ => throw new ArgumentException($"No parent type for {childType}")
    };


    #endregion //fabejárás felfelé vége.


    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<OrgunitBaseEntity, OrgunitBaseEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }

}

using System.Linq.Expressions;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel.Validity;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations
{
    public static class OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper
    {

        public static QueryOver<TValidity> CreateValiditySubQuery<TValidity>(Expression<Func<TValidity, bool>> expression) where TValidity : class, IValidityEntity
        {
            TValidity validityAlias = null!;
            return QueryOver.Of<TValidity>(() => validityAlias)
                                       .Where(expression)
                                       .OrderBy(pr => pr.ParentId).Asc
                                       .ThenBy(Projections.Conditional(
                                           Restrictions.And(
                                               Restrictions.Le(Projections.Property<IValidityEntity>(pr => pr.ValidFrom), DateTime.Today),
                                               Restrictions.Ge(Projections.Property<IValidityEntity>(pr => pr.ValidTo), DateTime.Today)
                                           ),
                                           Projections.Constant(1),
                                           Projections.Constant(0))).Desc
                                       .ThenBy(Projections.Conditional(
                                           Restrictions.Lt(Projections.Property<IValidityEntity>(pr => pr.ValidTo), DateTime.Today),
                                           Projections.Constant(1),
                                           Projections.Constant(0))).Desc
                                       .ThenBy(Projections.SqlFunction(
                                               "abs",
                                               NHibernateUtil.Double,
                                               Projections.SqlFunction("extract_epoch",
                                                                       NHibernateUtil.Double,
                                                                       Projections.SqlFunction("age",
                                                                                               NHibernateUtil.TimeSpan,
                                                                                               Projections.Property<IValidityEntity>(pr => pr.ValidTo),
                                                                                               Projections.Constant(DateTime.Today))))).Asc
                                       .Select(Projections.Property(() => validityAlias.Id))
                                       .Take(1);
        }
    }
}

public class RoomQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<RoomEntity, RoomEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    ///Tenant dictionary cache
    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>
    /// Scope

    /// </summary>

    /// Floor alias
    /// </summary>

    /// BuildingPart Validity alias
    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RoomQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    /// 
    public RoomQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IQueryService queryService,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)

        _scope = scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        var result = query switch
        {
            IEntityQuery<RoomListItemDto> roomListItemQuery => DoQueryEntities(roomListItemQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };

        #region jogosultság szerint szűrés
        RequiredSecOperationAttribute? secAttr = query.GetType().GetCustomAttribute<RequiredSecOperationAttribute>();
        if (secAttr is not null && result is not null)
        {
            var permissions = GetOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId, secAttr).GetAwaiter().GetResult() ?? [];
            var tenantPermissions = permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == null).ToList();

            if (tenantPermissions.Any(x => x.SecOpCodes.Contains(secAttr.SecOperationCode)))
            {
                return result; //ha már tenant szinten is van joga, akkor mindent visszaadhatunk
            }

            if (result is EntityQueryItemsResult<RoomListItemDto> listItemResult)
            {
#if DEBUG
                System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch sw = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
#endif
                //var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissions(permissions, listItemResult);
                var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(permissions, listItemResult);
#if DEBUG
                sw.Stop();
                var el = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                Console.WriteLine($"FilterResultsByPermissions took {el} ms.");
#endif
                return filteredResult;
            }
            //TODO: lehetnek-e egyéb típusú resultok, ahol szűrne kell az eredményeket?
        }
        #endregion

        return result;
    }

    //Windsurf AI suggested optimization
    private static IEntityQueryItemsResult FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto> permissions, EntityQueryItemsResult<RoomListItemDto> listItemResult)
    {
        #region prepropcess: Create mappings from items to rooms
        var floorIdToRooms = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.FloorId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var buildingPartIdToRooms = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.BuildingPartId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var buildingIdToRooms = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.BuildingId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var siteIdToRooms = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.SiteId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        var institutionIdToRooms = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.InstitutionId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());


        // Create mappings from BuildingPart to its parent Building (helper, because buildingpart is not in the permission)
        var buildingPartToParentBuilding = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.BuildingPartId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().BuildingId);

        // Create mappings from Floor to its parent BuildingPart (helper, because floor is not in the permission)
        var floorToParentBuildingPart = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.FloorId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().BuildingPartId);

        #endregion

        var finalRoomIds = new HashSet<int>();

        #region Process permissions to collect all relevant IDs

        //by buildings...
        var buildingIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Building).Select(p => p.Building!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedRoomIdssByBuildings = buildingIdToRooms
            .Where(b2f => buildingIdsWithPermission.Contains(b2f.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalRoomIds.UnionWith(permittedRoomIdssByBuildings); //add to result

        //by buildingparts...
        //BuildingPart nincs már a permissionben, olyan mélyre nem nyúlik a jogosultság kezelés, ezért a buildingek alapján kell szűrni
        var buildingPartIdsWithPermission = buildingPartToParentBuilding
            .Where(kvp => buildingIdsWithPermission.Contains(kvp.Value))
            .Select(kvp => kvp.Key)
            .ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedRoomIdsByBuildingParts = buildingPartIdToRooms
            .Where(bp2f => buildingPartIdsWithPermission.Contains(bp2f.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalRoomIds.UnionWith(permittedRoomIdsByBuildingParts); //add to result

        //by floors...
        //Floor nincs már a permissionben, olyan mélyre nem nyúlik a jogosultság kezelés, ezért a buildingek alapján kell szűrni
        var floorIdsWithPermission = floorToParentBuildingPart
            .Where(kvp => buildingPartIdsWithPermission.Contains(kvp.Value))
            .Select(kvp => kvp.Key)
            .ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedRoomIdsByFloors = floorIdToRooms
            .Where(f2r => floorIdsWithPermission.Contains(f2r.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalRoomIds.UnionWith(permittedRoomIdsByFloors); //add to result

        //by sites...
        var siteIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Site).Select(p => p.Site!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedRoomIdssBySites = siteIdToRooms
            .Where(s2f => siteIdsWithPermission.Contains(s2f.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalRoomIds.UnionWith(permittedRoomIdssBySites); //add to result

        //by institutions...
        var institutionIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Institution).Select(p => p.Institution!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedRoomIdssByInstituions = institutionIdToRooms
            .Where(i2f => institutionIdsWithPermission.Contains(i2f.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalRoomIds.UnionWith(permittedRoomIdssByInstituions); //add to result

        #endregion

        // Apply filter directly with the pre-computed set
        listItemResult.Items = [.. listItemResult.Items.Where(x => finalRoomIds.Contains(x.Id))];
        return listItemResult;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (GetEntityIdsForSecOperation(query) is IEnumerable<int> ids)
        {
            CheckForMultipleOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, ids).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }
        else
        {
            var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
            CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }

        return query switch
        {
            BuildingProfileByRoomQuery roomBuildingQuery => DoBuildingProfileByRoomQuery(roomBuildingQuery),
            RoomParentsNamesQuery namesQuery => DoParentsNameQuery(namesQuery),
            OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<RoomEntityDto> coordsQuery => DoCoordinatesInfoQuery(coordsQuery),
            RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQuery profileQuery => DoRoomProfilesByRoomValidityQuery(profileQuery),
            RoomProfilesByRoomValidityIntervalQuery intervalQuery => DoRoomProfilesByRoomValidityIntervalQuery(intervalQuery),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            //IEntityQuery<RoomListItemDto> roomListItemQuery => roomListItemQuery.???,
            RoomEntityQuery roomQuery => roomQuery.Id,
            RoomParentsNamesQuery nameQuery => nameQuery.Id,
            BuildingProfileByRoomQuery roomBuildingProfileQuery => roomBuildingProfileQuery.Id,
            RoomEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery => entityRefQuery.ParentId,
            RoomPagedEntityQuery roomPagedEntityQuery => roomPagedEntityQuery.FloorId,
            EntityByIdQuery<RoomEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQuery profilesQuery => null,
            RoomProfilesByRoomValidityIntervalQuery intervalQuery => null,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }
    protected override IEnumerable<int>? GetEntityIdsForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<RoomEntityDto> coordsQuery => coordsQuery.OrgUnitIds,
            _ => null
        };
    }

    private IQueryResult DoCoordinatesInfoQuery(OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<RoomEntityDto> coordsQuery)
    {
        MapCoordinatesInfoModel mapAlias = null!;
        var subQueryRoomValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<RoomValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var query = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.RoomValidities, () => _roomValidityAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Id)
            .IsIn(coordsQuery.OrgUnitIds)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _roomValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryRoomValidity))
            .And(x => !_roomValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _roomValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Name)
                .Select(x => _roomValidityAlias.Lon).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Longitude)
                .Select(x => _roomValidityAlias.Lat).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Latitude))
            .TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>())
            .List<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>();

        return new MapCoordinatesInfoQueryResult
        {
            CoordinateInfos = query.ToList()
        };
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            RoomEntityQuery roomQuery => DoRoomSingleEntityQuery(roomQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }
    private RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQueryResult DoRoomProfilesByRoomValidityQuery(RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQuery query)
    {
        // 1. Lekérjük a RoomValidityEntity-t
        var roomValidity = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomValidityEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Id == query.RoomValidityId)
            .Fetch(x => x.Room.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.BuildingValidities).Eager
            .SingleOrDefault();

        if (roomValidity == null)
        { 
            var allItems = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomProfileEntity>().List();
            return new RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQueryResult { RoomProfiles = allItems.Select(x => Mapper.Map<EntityRef<RoomProfileEntityDto>>(x)).ToList() };
        }


        var room = roomValidity.Room;
        var building = room.Floor.BuildingPart.Building;
        var buildingValidities = building.BuildingValidities;

        // 2. Kikeressük az érvényes épület-validitást
        var parentValidity = buildingValidities.Where(x=>!x.IsDeleted)
            .FirstOrDefault(x => roomValidity.ValidFrom >= x.ValidFrom && roomValidity.ValidFrom <= x.ValidTo);

        if (parentValidity == null)
            return new RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQueryResult { RoomProfiles = [] };


        // 3. Lekérjük a BuildingProfile-t és ahhoz tartozó RoomProfileEntity-ket
        TenantIndependentDictItemEntity? buildingProfileAlias = null;

        var items = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomProfileEntity>()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingProfiles, () => buildingProfileAlias)
            .Where(() => buildingProfileAlias!.Id == parentValidity.BuildingProfile.Id)
            .List();

        var dtos = items.Select(x => Mapper.Map<EntityRef<RoomProfileEntityDto>>(x)).ToList();

        return new RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQueryResult { RoomProfiles = dtos };
    }
    private RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQueryResult DoRoomProfilesByRoomValidityIntervalQuery(RoomProfilesByRoomValidityIntervalQuery query)
    {
        var room = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomEntity>()
          .Where(x => x.Id == query.RoomId)
          .Fetch(x => x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.BuildingValidities).Eager
          .SingleOrDefault();

        var building = room.Floor.BuildingPart.Building;
        var buildingValidities = building.BuildingValidities;

        var parentValidity = buildingValidities.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted)
           .FirstOrDefault(x => query.ValidFrom.ToLocalTime() >= x.ValidFrom && query.ValidFrom.ToLocalTime() <= x.ValidTo);
        if (parentValidity == null)
            return new RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQueryResult { RoomProfiles = [] };


        TenantIndependentDictItemEntity? buildingProfileAlias = null;

        var items = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomProfileEntity>()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingProfiles, () => buildingProfileAlias)
            .Where(() => buildingProfileAlias!.Id == parentValidity.BuildingProfile.Id)
            .List();

        var dtos = items.Select(x => Mapper.Map<EntityRef<RoomProfileEntityDto>>(x)).ToList();

        return new RoomProfilesByRoomValidityQueryResult { RoomProfiles = dtos };
    }
    private IQueryResult DoParentsNameQuery(RoomParentsNamesQuery parentsNamesQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == parentsNamesQuery.Id);

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, parentsNamesQuery);

        RoomParentsNamesQueryResult alias = null!;
        queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _siteAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteId)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName)
                .Select(x => _institutionAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionId)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionName)
                .Select(x => _buildingAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingId)
                .Select(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingName)
                .Select(x => _buildingPartAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartId)
                .Select(x => _buildingPartValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartName)
                .Select(x => _floorAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.FloorId)
                .Select(x => _floorValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.FloorName)
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.RoomId)
                .Select(x => _roomValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.RoomName)
            );

        var result = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<RoomParentsNamesQueryResult>())
                              .SingleOrDefault<RoomParentsNamesQueryResult>();
        return result;
    }

    private IQueryResult DoBuildingProfileByRoomQuery(BuildingProfileByRoomQuery query)
    {
        BuildingValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);
        
        var subQueryBuildingValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _buildingAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

        queryOver.JoinQueryOver(x   => x.Floor)
                 .JoinQueryOver(x => x.BuildingPart)
                 .JoinQueryOver(x => x.Building, () => _buildingAlias)
                 .JoinAlias(x => x.BuildingValidities, () => validityAlias)
                 .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity))
                 .Select(x => validityAlias.BuildingProfile);

        var buildingProfile = queryOver.SingleOrDefault<TenantIndependentDictItemEntity>();


        return new BuildingProfileByRoomQueryResult()
        {
            BuildingProfile = Mapper.Map<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>(buildingProfile)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the room single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoRoomSingleEntityQuery(RoomEntityQuery query)
    {
        RoomValidityEntity subValidityAlias = null!;
        RoomValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Identifier) && Guid.TryParse(query.Identifier, out Guid guidIdentifier))
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == guidIdentifier);

        if (query.IsDeleted != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == query.IsDeleted);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.RoomValidities, () => validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
         .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).In(
            QueryOver.Of<RoomValidityEntity>(() => subValidityAlias)
                     .Where(() => subValidityAlias.Room.Id == _rootAlias.Id && !subValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
                     .Select(v => v.Id))).TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous RoomQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<RoomEntity, RoomEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is RoomEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery)
        {
            if (entityRefQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityRefQuery.IsDeleted);

            if (entityRefQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Floor.Id == entityRefQuery.ParentId);
        }

        if (query is RoomEntityQuery roomQuery)
        {
            if (roomQuery.Id != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == roomQuery.Id);

            if (roomQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Floor.Id == roomQuery.ParentId);

            if (roomQuery.ParentIdentifier.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(() => _floorAlias.Identifier == roomQuery.ParentIdentifier);

            if (roomQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == roomQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        if (query is RoomPagedEntityQuery roomPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (roomPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.HasValue)  //must support returning deleted, not-deleted, and all
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == !roomPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.Value);

            if (roomPagedEntityQuery.FloorId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _rootAlias.Floor.Id == roomPagedEntityQuery.FloorId);

            if (roomPagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _floorAlias.BuildingPart.Id == roomPagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartId);

            if (roomPagedEntityQuery.BuildingId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _buildingPartAlias.Building.Id == roomPagedEntityQuery.BuildingId);

            if (roomPagedEntityQuery.SiteId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _buildingAlias.Site.Id == roomPagedEntityQuery.SiteId);

            if (roomPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _siteAlias.Institution.Id == roomPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(roomPagedEntityQuery.Name))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<RoomValidityEntity>(x => _roomValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(roomPagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(roomPagedEntityQuery.FloorName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<FloorValidityEntity>(x => _floorValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(roomPagedEntityQuery.FloorName, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(roomPagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => _buildingPartValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(roomPagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartName, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(roomPagedEntityQuery.BuildingName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(roomPagedEntityQuery.BuildingName, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(roomPagedEntityQuery.SiteName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(roomPagedEntityQuery.SiteName, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(roomPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(roomPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni, lsd OrgUnitQueryHandler
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<RoomEntity, RoomEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<RoomEntity, RoomEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is RoomEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            if (entityQuery.ParentIdentifier.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Floor, () => _floorAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
            }
        }

        if (query is RoomPagedEntityQuery || query is RoomParentsNamesQuery) 
        {
            var subQueryRoomValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<RoomValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryFloorValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<FloorValidityEntity>(x => _floorAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryBuildingPartValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => _buildingPartAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryBuildingValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => _buildingAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQuerySiteValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _siteAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryInstitutionValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.RoomValidities, () => _roomValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _roomValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryRoomValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Floor, () => _floorAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _floorAlias.FloorValidities, () => _floorValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _floorValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryFloorValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _floorAlias.BuildingPart, () => _buildingPartAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingPartAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => _buildingPartValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _buildingPartValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingPartAlias.Building, () => _buildingAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingAlias.BuildingValidities, () => _buildingValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _buildingValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _buildingAlias.Site, () => _siteAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _siteAlias.SiteValidities, () => _siteValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _siteValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuerySiteValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _siteAlias.Institution, () => _institutionAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _institutionAlias.InstitutionValidities, () => _institutionValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _institutionValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryInstitutionValidity));

        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<RoomEntity, RoomEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(RoomListItemDto))
        {
            RoomListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                .Select(x => x.IsDeleted).WithAlias(() => alias.IsDeleted)
                .Select(x => _roomValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                .Select(x => _floorValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.FloorName)
                .Select(x => _buildingPartValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartName)
                .Select(x => _buildingValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingName)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionName)
                //felfelé mutató navigációs id-k
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.Floor.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.FloorId)
                .Select(x => _floorAlias.BuildingPart.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingPartId)
                .Select(x => _buildingPartAlias.Building.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.BuildingId)
                .Select(x => _buildingAlias.Site.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteId)//TODO: így ok?
                .Select(x => _siteAlias.Institution.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionId) //TODO: így ok?
            );
        }
        return null;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

using Common.Shared.Entities;

using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Mapping.ByCode.Impl;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// SiteValidityQueryHandler
/// </summary>
public class RoomValidityQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<RoomValidityEntity, RoomValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly RoomValidityEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Room alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly RoomEntity _roomAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RoomValidityQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public RoomValidityQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, IQueryService queryService, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
    }
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {      
        return query switch
        {
            RoomProfileValidtiesByRoomQuery profileQuery => DoRoomProfileValiditesByRoomQuery(profileQuery),      
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }
    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            RoomValidityEntityQuery roomEntityQuery => roomEntityQuery.RoomId, //az orgunit kell, nem a validity-je!
            ValidityEntityQuery<RoomValidityEntityDto> validityEntityQuery => validityEntityQuery.ParentId,
            EntityByIdQuery<RoomValidityEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<RoomValidityEntity, RoomValidityEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomValidityEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Room, () => _roomAlias);
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            RoomValidityEntityQuery roomEntityQuery => DoRoomValidityEntityQuery(roomEntityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoRoomValidityEntityQuery(RoomValidityEntityQuery roomEntityQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomValidityEntity>();

        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);

        if (roomEntityQuery.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == roomEntityQuery.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous RoomValidityEntityQuery");
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }
    private IQueryResult DoRoomProfileValiditesByRoomQuery(RoomProfileValidtiesByRoomQuery query)
    {
        
        var room = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<RoomEntity>()
            .Fetch(r => r.Floor).Eager
            .Fetch(r => r.Floor.BuildingPart).Eager
            .Fetch(r => r.Floor.BuildingPart.Building).Eager
            .Where(r => r.Id == query.RoomId)
            .SingleOrDefault();

        if (room == null)
            throw new Exception($"Room with ID {query.RoomId} not found.");

        var building = room!.Floor!.BuildingPart!.Building;

        var buildingValidities = building!.BuildingValidities.Where(x=>!x.IsDeleted);
    

        RoomValidityEntity roomValidityAlias = null!;

        var roomValidities = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => roomValidityAlias)
            .Where(() => roomValidityAlias.ParentId == room.Id)           
            .List();
        
        var result = new RoomProfileValiditiesByRoomQueryResult
        {
            RoomsWarnings = roomValidities.Select(rv =>
            {
                var parentValidity = buildingValidities
                    .FirstOrDefault(x => rv.ValidFrom >= x.ValidFrom && rv.ValidFrom <= x.ValidTo);            

                return new EntityWarningModelBase<RoomValidityEntityDto, RoomValidityWithBuildingValidityInfoWarningContext>
                {
                    WarnedEntity = new EntityRef<RoomValidityEntityDto>
                    {
                        Id = rv.Id,
                        EntityDisplayName = rv.Name
                    },
                    WarningContext = new RoomValidityWithBuildingValidityInfoWarningContext
                    {
                        BuildingAndRoomProfileMismatch =  !(parentValidity is not null && rv.RoomProfile!.BuildingProfiles!.Any(x=>x.Id == parentValidity.BuildingProfile!.Id)),
                        BuildingAndRoomValidityIntervalMismatch = parentValidity?.ValidTo < rv.ValidTo,
                        ParentBuildingValidityId = parentValidity?.Id ?? 0,
                        ParentBuildingValidityValidFrom = parentValidity?.ValidFrom ?? DateTime.MinValue,
                        ParentBuildingValidityValidTo = parentValidity?.ValidTo ?? DateTime.MinValue,
                    }
                };
                //ezt majd közben kellene szűrni mert így feleslegesen tesszuk bele majd szurjuk ki a warning eseteket
            }).Where(x=> x.WarningContext.BuildingAndRoomProfileMismatch is true || x.WarningContext.BuildingAndRoomValidityIntervalMismatch is true)
        };

        return result;

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where conditions
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<RoomValidityEntity, RoomValidityEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ValidityEntityQuery<RoomValidityEntityDto> validityQuery)
        {
            if (validityQuery?.ParentId > 0)
                queryOver.Where(() => _roomAlias.Id == validityQuery.ParentId);
            if (validityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == validityQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// SiteLocationQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations.SiteLocationEntity, SiteLocationEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SiteLocationQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<SiteLocationEntity, SiteLocationEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Site alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteEntity _siteAlias = default!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Type alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictItemEntity _typeAlias = default!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SiteLocationQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    public SiteLocationQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SiteLocationPagedEntityQuery itemQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(itemQuery);

        return base.QueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            SiteLocationCardQuery siteLocationCardQuery => DoSiteLocationCardQuery(siteLocationCardQuery),
            SiteLocationDevicesQuery siteLocationDevicesQuery => DoSiteLocationDevicesQuery(siteLocationDevicesQuery),
            SiteLocationByIdentifierQuery siteLocationByIdentifierQuery => DoSiteLocationByIdentifierQuery(siteLocationByIdentifierQuery),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the site location by identifier query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="siteLocationByIdentifierQuery">The site location by identifier query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoSiteLocationByIdentifierQuery(SiteLocationByIdentifierQuery siteLocationByIdentifierQuery)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(siteLocationByIdentifierQuery.Identifier))
            return new SiteLocationByIdentifierQueryResult();

        Guid.TryParse(siteLocationByIdentifierQuery.Identifier, out Guid siteLocationIdentifier);

        var sitLocation = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteLocationEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Identifier == siteLocationIdentifier)
            .SingleOrDefault();

        return new SiteLocationByIdentifierQueryResult()
        {
            //TODO: hierarchia változás miatti átalakítások!!!
            //Site = new GuidEntityRef<SiteEntityDto>() { Identifier = sitLocation.Site.Identifier, EntityDisplayName = sitLocation.Site.Name },
            SiteLocation = new GuidEntityRef<SiteLocationEntityDto> { Identifier = sitLocation.Identifier, EntityDisplayName = "Site Location" }
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the site location card query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="siteLocationCardQuery">The site location card query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoSiteLocationCardQuery(SiteLocationCardQuery siteLocationCardQuery)
    {
        var deviceCategories = _tiDictCache.GetItems(DictType.IoTDeviceCategory);

        var queryOver =
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteLocationEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false)
                .Where(x => x.Id == siteLocationCardQuery.Id);

        var siteLocation = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous MeasurementLocationQuery");
        if (siteLocation == null)
            return new SiteLocationCardQueryResult { SiteLocationCard = null };

        var siteLocationCard = new SiteLocationCardDto();
        var deviceCategoryDtos = new List<DeviceCategoryDto>();

        List<DeviceEntity>? validDevices = siteLocation.IoTDevices?.Where(d => !d.IsDeleted).ToList();
        foreach (var deviceCategory in deviceCategories ?? Array.Empty<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>())
        {
            var deviceCategoryDto = new DeviceCategoryDto
            {
                Id = deviceCategory.Id,
                CategoryCode = deviceCategory.Code,
                CategoryName = deviceCategory.Value,
                Count = QueryHelper.GetDeviceCategoryCount(validDevices, deviceCategory.Id),
                Status = QueryHelper.GetDeviceStatus(validDevices, deviceCategory.Id)
            };

            deviceCategoryDtos.Add(deviceCategoryDto);
        }

        siteLocationCard = new SiteLocationCardDto
        {
            Id = siteLocation.Id,
            //Name = siteLocation.Name,
            //Type = siteLocation.Type?.Value,
            DeviceCategories = deviceCategoryDtos.ToArray()
        };

        var deviceStatuses = siteLocation?.IoTDevices?.Select(d => d.Status).ToList();
        if (deviceStatuses != null && deviceStatuses.Any())
            siteLocationCard.Status = deviceStatuses!.Contains(DeviceStatus.Online) ? DeviceStatus.Online : DeviceStatus.Offline;
        else
            siteLocationCard.Status = DeviceStatus.Unknown;

        return new SiteLocationCardQueryResult { SiteLocationCard = siteLocationCard };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az adott orgunit-hoz (Épület, Épületrész, stb.) tartozó eszközöket listázza (nem rekurzív módon)
    /// </summary>
    private IQueryResult DoSiteLocationDevicesQuery(SiteLocationDevicesQuery siteLocationDevicesQuery)
    {
        var queryOver =
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteLocationEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false &&
                            x.ParentOrgunitType == siteLocationDevicesQuery.ParentOrgUnitType);

        queryOver = siteLocationDevicesQuery.ParentOrgUnitType switch
        {
            OrgunitType.Building => queryOver.Where(x => x.Building.Id == siteLocationDevicesQuery.ParentId),
            OrgunitType.BuildingPart => queryOver.Where(x => x.BuildingPart.Id == siteLocationDevicesQuery.ParentId),
            OrgunitType.Floor => queryOver.Where(x => x.Floor.Id == siteLocationDevicesQuery.ParentId),
            OrgunitType.Room => queryOver.Where(x => x.Room.Id == siteLocationDevicesQuery.ParentId),
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid ParentOrgUnitType: {siteLocationDevicesQuery.ParentOrgUnitType}"),
        };

        var siteLocation = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous SiteLocationDevicesQuery");
        if (siteLocation == null)
            return new SiteLocationDevicesQueryResult();

        List<DeviceEntity> validDevices = siteLocation.IoTDevices?.Where(d => !d.IsDeleted).ToList() ?? [];

        return new SiteLocationDevicesQueryResult
        {
            SiteLocation = Mapper.Map<SiteLocationEntityDto>(siteLocation),
            DeviceDetails = validDevices.Select(Mapper.Map<SiteLocationDeviceDto>).ToList()
        };
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<SiteLocationEntity, SiteLocationEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(SiteLocationListItemDto))
        {
            SiteLocationListItemDto alias = default!;
            queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    //.Select(x => x.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                    //.Select(x => _siteAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName) //TODO: ki kellett kommentelni a validity átalakítás közben
                    //.Select(x => x.IsAggregationPoint).WithAlias(() => alias.IsAggregationPoint)
                    .Select(x => _typeAlias.Value).WithAlias(() => alias.Type)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<SiteLocationEntity, SiteLocationEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        //TODO: hierarchia változás miatti átalakítások!!!
        //queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Site, () => _siteAlias);

        //if (query is SiteLocationPagedEntityQuery)
        //{

        //}
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SiteLocationEntity, SiteLocationEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        queryOver.Where(x => !x.IsDeleted);
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is SiteLocationQuery siteLocationQuery)
        {
            if (siteLocationQuery.Id != null)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == siteLocationQuery.Id);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(siteLocationQuery.Identifier) && Guid.TryParse(siteLocationQuery.Identifier, out Guid siteLocationIdentifier))
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == siteLocationIdentifier);

            if(siteLocationQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                queryOver = siteLocationQuery.ParentOrgUnitType switch
                {
                    OrgunitType.Building => queryOver.Where(x => x.Building.Id == siteLocationQuery.ParentId),
                    OrgunitType.BuildingPart => queryOver.Where(x => x.BuildingPart.Id == siteLocationQuery.ParentId),
                    OrgunitType.Floor => queryOver.Where(x => x.Floor.Id == siteLocationQuery.ParentId),
                    OrgunitType.Room => queryOver.Where(x => x.Room.Id == siteLocationQuery.ParentId),
                    _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid ParentOrgUnitType: {siteLocationQuery.ParentOrgUnitType}"),
                };

            if (siteLocationQuery.ParentIdentifier.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.ParentIdentifier == siteLocationQuery.ParentIdentifier);
        }

        if (query is SiteLocationPagedEntityQuery siteLocationPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            //if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.Name))
            //    queryOver.And(Restrictions.On<SiteLocationEntity>(x => x.Name)
            //        .IsInsensitiveLike(siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            //TODO: ki kellett kommentelni a validity átalakítás közben
            //if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.SiteName))
            //    queryOver.And(Restrictions.On<SiteLocationEntity>(x => _siteAlias.Name)
            //        .IsInsensitiveLike(siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.SiteName, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            //if (siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.IsAggregationPoint is not null)
            //    queryOver.Where(x => x.IsAggregationPoint == siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.IsAggregationPoint);

            if (siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.Type is not null)
                queryOver.Where(x => _typeAlias.Id == siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.Type.Id);

            if (siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.SiteId is not null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => _siteAlias.Identifier == siteLocationPagedEntityQuery.SiteId);
        }

        //TODO: hierarchia változás miatti átalakítások!!!
        //if (query is SiteLocationEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery)
        //{
        //    //TODO:
        //    //if (entityRefQuery.IsDeleted != null)
        //    //    queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityRefQuery.IsDeleted);

        //    //if (entityRefQuery.SiteLocationManagerId.HasValue &&
        //    //    entityRefQuery.OnlyOwn.HasValue &&
        //    //    entityRefQuery.OnlyOwn.Value)
        //    //{
        //    //    queryOver =
        //    //        queryOver
        //    //        .JoinAlias(x => x.SiteLocationManager, () => secUserEntityAlias)
        //    //        .Where(x => secUserEntityAlias.Id == entityRefQuery.SiteLocationManagerId.Value);
        //    //}

        //    //if (entityRefQuery.SiteLocationManagerId.HasValue &&
        //    //    entityRefQuery.DoesNotHaveASiteLocationManager.HasValue &&
        //    //    entityRefQuery.DoesNotHaveASiteLocationManager.Value)
        //    //{
        //    //    queryOver =
        //    //        queryOver
        //    //        .Left
        //    //        .JoinAlias(x => x.SiteLocationManager, () => secUserEntityAlias)
        //    //        .Where(x => secUserEntityAlias.Id == entityRefQuery.SiteLocationManagerId.Value ||
        //    //                    secUserEntityAlias == null);
        //    //}
        //    //else if (entityRefQuery.DoesNotHaveASiteLocationManager.HasValue &&
        //    //         entityRefQuery.DoesNotHaveASiteLocationManager.Value)
        //    //{
        //    //    queryOver =
        //    //        queryOver
        //    //        .Where(x => x.SiteLocationManager == null);
        //    //}
        //}
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SiteLocationQuery measurementLocationQuery)
        {
            return DoMeasurementLocationSingleEntityQuery(measurementLocationQuery);
        }
        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the measurement location single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoMeasurementLocationSingleEntityQuery(SiteLocationQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteLocationEntity>();

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous MeasurementLocationQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }
}
