/// <summary>
/// SiteQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations.SiteEntity, SiteEntityDto&gt;" />
public class SiteQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<SiteEntity, SiteEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    ///Tenant dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Address alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly AddressEntity _addressAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Site Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteValidityEntity _siteValidityAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Institution alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionEntity _institutionAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Institution Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly InstitutionValidityEntity _institutionValidityAlias = null!;


    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SiteQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    public SiteQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IQueryService queryService,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
        _scope = scope;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        // skip permissions check for administration query
        if (query is TenantSiteEntityRefQuery refQuery)
            return DoTenantSiteAdministrationRefQuery(refQuery);

        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        var result = query switch
        {
            IEntityQuery<SiteListItemDto> itemQuery => DoQueryEntities(itemQuery),
            SiteMeasurementPointsQuery siteMeasurementPointsQuery => DoMeasurementPointQuery(siteMeasurementPointsQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };

        #region jogosultság szerint szűrés
        RequiredSecOperationAttribute? secAttr = query.GetType().GetCustomAttribute<RequiredSecOperationAttribute>();
        if (secAttr is not null && result is not null)
        {
            var permissions = GetOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId, secAttr).GetAwaiter().GetResult() ?? [];
            var tenantPermissions = permissions.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == null).ToList();

            if (tenantPermissions.Any(x => x.SecOpCodes.Contains(secAttr.SecOperationCode)))
            {
                return result; //ha már tenant szinten is van joga, akkor mindent visszaadhatunk
            }

            if (result is EntityQueryItemsResult<SiteListItemDto> listItemResult)
            {
#if DEBUG
                System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch sw = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
#endif
                //var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissions(permissions, listItemResult);
                var filteredResult = FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(permissions, listItemResult);
#if DEBUG
                sw.Stop();
                var el = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                Console.WriteLine($"FilterResultsByPermissions took {el} ms.");
#endif
                return filteredResult;
            }
            //TODO: lehetnek-e egyéb típusú resultok, ahol szűrne kell az eredményeket?
        }
        #endregion

        return result;
    }

    private static IEntityQueryItemsResult FilterResultsByPermissionsOptimized(List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto> permissions, EntityQueryItemsResult<SiteListItemDto> listItemResult)
    {
        #region prepropcess: Create mappings from items to sites
        var institutionIdToSites = listItemResult.Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.InstitutionId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Select(item => item.Id).ToList());

        #endregion

        var finalSiteIds = new HashSet<int>();

        #region Process permissions to collect all relevant IDs
        //by sites directly...
        var siteIdsWithPermission = permissions
            .Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Site)
            .Select(p => p.Site!.Id)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalSiteIds.UnionWith(siteIdsWithPermission); //add to result

        //by institutions...
        var institutionIdsWithPermission = permissions.Where(p => p.OrgunitType == OrgunitType.Institution).Select(p => p.Institution!.Id).ToHashSet();
        HashSet<int> permittedSitePartIdssByInstituions = institutionIdToSites
            .Where(i2s => institutionIdsWithPermission.Contains(i2s.Key))
            .SelectMany(x => x.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        finalSiteIds.UnionWith(permittedSitePartIdssByInstituions); //add to result

        #endregion

        // Apply filter directly with the pre-computed set
        listItemResult.Items = [.. listItemResult.Items.Where(x => finalSiteIds.Contains(x.Id))];
        return listItemResult;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (GetEntityIdsForSecOperation(query) is IEnumerable<int> ids)
        {
            CheckForMultipleOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query,ids).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }
        else
        {
            var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
            CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }

        return query switch
        {
            SiteParentsNamesQuery parentsNamesQuery => DoParentsNameQuery(parentsNamesQuery),
            SitePodsQuery podsQuery => DoPodsQuery(podsQuery),
            SiteWeatherQuery weatherQuery => DoSiteWeatherQuery(weatherQuery),
            SiteGuidEntityRefQuery siteGuidEntityRefQuery => DoSiteGuidEntityRefQuery(siteGuidEntityRefQuery),
            SiteCardsQuery siteCardsQuery => DoSiteCardsQuery(siteCardsQuery),
            SiteMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery => DoMeasurementPointQuery(measurementPointsQuery),
            OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<SiteEntityDto> coordsQuery => DoCoordinatesInfoQuery(coordsQuery),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    private IQueryResult DoCoordinatesInfoQuery(OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<SiteEntityDto> coordsQuery)
    {
        MapCoordinatesInfoModel mapAlias = null!;
        var subQuerySiteValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var query = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.SiteValidities, () => _siteValidityAlias)
            .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.Id)
            .IsIn(coordsQuery.OrgUnitIds)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _siteValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuerySiteValidity))
            .And(x => !_siteValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Name)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Lon).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Longitude)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Lat).WithAlias(() => mapAlias.Latitude))
            .TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>())
            .List<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>();

        return new MapCoordinatesInfoQueryResult
        {
            CoordinateInfos = query.ToList()
        };

    }
    private IQueryResult DoParentsNameQuery(SiteParentsNamesQuery parentsNamesQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == parentsNamesQuery.Id);

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, parentsNamesQuery);

        SiteParentsNamesQueryResult alias = null!;
        queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteId)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.SiteName)
                .Select(x => _institutionAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionId)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstiutionName)
            );

        var result = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<SiteParentsNamesQueryResult>())
                              .SingleOrDefault<SiteParentsNamesQueryResult>();
        return result;
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            //IEntityQuery<SiteListItemDto> siteListItemQuery => siteListItemQuery.???,
            SiteParentsNamesQuery siteParents => siteParents.Id,
            SiteEntityQuery siteQuery => siteQuery.Id,
            SitePodsQuery podsQuery => podsQuery.SiteId,
            SiteWeatherQuery weatherQuery => weatherQuery.SiteId,
            SitePagedEntityQuery sitePagedEntityQuery => sitePagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId,
            SiteEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery => entityRefQuery.ParentId,
            //SiteGuidEntityRefQuery siteGuidEntityRefQuery => siteGuidEntityRefQuery.????,
            SiteCardsQuery siteCardsQuery => siteCardsQuery.SiteId,
            SiteMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery => measurementPointsQuery.SiteId,
            EntityByIdQuery<SiteEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            //OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<SiteEntityDto> coordQuery => coordQuery.OrgUnitIds,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }
    protected override IEnumerable<int>? GetEntityIdsForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<SiteEntityDto> coordsQuery => coordsQuery.OrgUnitIds,
            _ => null
        };
    }

    private IQueryResult DoPodsQuery(SitePodsQuery podsQuery)
    {
        BuildingEntity buildingEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>()
                                         .Where(x => x.Id == podsQuery.SiteId);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .JoinAlias(x => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .JoinAlias(x => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .JoinAlias(x => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

        queryOver.Select(Projections.Distinct(
            Projections.SqlFunction("unnest", NHibernateUtil.String,
                Projections.SqlFunction("array_remove", NHibernateUtil.String,
                    Projections.SqlFunction("string_to_array", NHibernateUtil.String,
                        Projections.SqlFunction("CONCAT_WS", NHibernateUtil.String,
                            Projections.Constant(","),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<BuildingEntity>(x => buildingEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            ),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<BuildingPartEntity>(x => buildingPartEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            ),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<FloorEntity>(x => floorEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            ),
                            Projections.SqlFunction("NULLIF", NHibernateUtil.String,
                                Projections.Property<RoomEntity>(x => roomEntityAlias.PodIdentifiers),
                                Projections.Constant("")
                            )
                        ),
                        Projections.Constant(",")
                    ),
                    Projections.Constant("")
                )
            )
        ));

        return new PodsQueryResult()
        {
            PodList = queryOver.List<string>().ToList(),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the site unique identifier entity reference query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="siteGuidEntityRefQuery">The site unique identifier entity reference query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoSiteGuidEntityRefQuery(SiteGuidEntityRefQuery siteGuidEntityRefQuery)
    {
        GuidEntityRef<SiteEntityDto> guidRefAlias = null;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(siteGuidEntityRefQuery.TenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(siteGuidEntityRefQuery.TenantCode);
                var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
                DbContext = tenantDbContext;
            }

        var query = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false)
            .List();

        var result = new SiteGuidEntityRefQueryResult
        {
            Items = query.Select(Mapper.Map<GuidEntityRef<SiteEntityDto>>).ToArray()
        };

        //DbContext.Commit(); ???

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the tenant site administration query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantDbContext">The tenant database context.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>> DoTenantSiteAdministrationRefQuery(TenantSiteEntityRefQuery query)
    {
        using var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope();

        tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(query.TenantCode);
        var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        var queryOver = tenantDbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>();

        if (query.IsDeleted.HasValue)
            queryOver = query.IsDeleted.Value
                ? queryOver.Where(o => o.IsDeleted)
                : queryOver.Where(o => !o.IsDeleted);


        var items = queryOver.List().Select(x => new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto> { Id = x.Id, EntityDisplayName = x.Name }).ToArray();

        IEntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>>? result = new EntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>>();

        result.Items = items;

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sites the weather query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoSiteWeatherQuery(SiteWeatherQuery query)
    {
        SiteEntity siteEntityAlias = null;
        SiteLocationEntity siteLocationEntityAlias = null;
        DeviceEntity deviceEntityAlias = null;
        IoTDeviceTypeEntity ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias = null;

        var weatherIoTDeviceTypeCode = _scope.Config().GetStringValue("Weather.IoTDeviceTypeCode");

        var device =
            DbContext.Session.QueryOver<DeviceEntity>()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDeviceType, () => ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias)
            .Where(x => siteEntityAlias.Id == query.SiteId &&
                        ioTDeviceTypeEntityAlias.Code == weatherIoTDeviceTypeCode)
            .Take(1)
            .SingleOrDefault(); //?? helyette firstordefault
        var identifier = device?.Identifier;

        var json = identifier.HasValue ?
                DataReceiverApi().IoTData_GetCurrentIoTDataAsync(identifier.Value).RunSync() :
                "{}";
        var model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<CurrentWeatherDataModel>(json);

        var response = new SiteWeatherQueryResult
        {
            Model = model
        };
        return response;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Datas the receiver API.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static Modules.DataReceiver.DataReceiverApi DataReceiverApi()
    {
        var baseUrl = Config.GetStringValue("DataReceiverApiHost");
        var client = HttpClientExtensions.CreateClient();
        var fapi = client.GetApiClient<Modules.DataReceiver.DataReceiverApi>(x =>
        {
            x.BaseUrl = baseUrl;
        });
        client.Authenticate(fapi).RunSync();
        return fapi;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the site cards query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoSiteCardsQuery(SiteCardsQuery siteCardsQuery)
    {
        BuildingEntity buildingEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;

        // Create the base query with all joins
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
                                 .Where(x => x.Id == siteCardsQuery.SiteId);

        // Query for buildings that are measurement points
        int buildingCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => buildingEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !_rootAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => buildingEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        // Query for building parts
        int buildingPartCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !_rootAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingPartEntityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        // Query for floors
        int floorCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => floorEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint
                    && !_rootAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingPartEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !floorEntityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        // Query for rooms
        int roomCount = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => roomEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint
                    && !_rootAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !buildingPartEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !floorEntityAlias.IsDeleted
                    && !roomEntityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Id)
            )
            .RowCount();

        var result = new SiteCardsQueryResult
        {
            SiteCards = new()
            {
                Id = siteCardsQuery.SiteId,
                BuildingCount = buildingCount,
                BuildingPartCount = buildingPartCount,
                FloorCount = floorCount,
                RoomCount = roomCount
            }
        };
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Process measurement point query for a site
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="measurementPointsQuery">Query parameters</param>
    /// <returns>Query result with measurement points</returns>
    private IEntityQueryItemsResult DoMeasurementPointQuery(SiteMeasurementPointsQuery measurementPointsQuery)
    {
        BuildingEntity buildingEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingValidityEntity buildingValidityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartEntity buildingPartEntityAlias = null!;
        BuildingPartValidityEntity buildingPartValidityAlias = null!;
        FloorEntity floorEntityAlias = null!;
        FloorValidityEntity floorValidityAlias = null!;
        RoomEntity roomEntityAlias = null!;
        RoomValidityEntity roomValidityAlias = null!;
        SiteValidityEntity siteValidityAlias = null!;

        var subQueryBuildingValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingValidityEntity>(x => buildingEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var subQueryBuildingPartValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<BuildingPartValidityEntity>(x => buildingPartEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var subQuerySiteValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var subQueryInstitutionValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var subQueryFloorValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<FloorValidityEntity>(x => floorEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
        var subQueryRoomValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<RoomValidityEntity>(x => roomEntityAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

        // Create the base query with all joins
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
                                 .Where(x => x.Id == measurementPointsQuery.SiteId);

        // Get site name for parent reference
        var siteName = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.SiteValidities, () => siteValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => !siteValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .Select(
                Projections.Property(() => siteValidityAlias.Name)
            )
            .List<string>()
            .FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;

        // Query for buildings that are measurement points
        var buildingResults = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingValidities, () => buildingValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity))
            .Where(() => buildingEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !buildingValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => buildingEntityAlias.Id)
                .Select(() => buildingValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => buildingEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
                .Select(() => buildingEntityAlias.Identifier)
            )
            .List<object[]>();

        var buildingDtos = buildingResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Building,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { siteName }
        }).ToList();

        // Query for building parts
        var buildingPartQueryOver = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingValidities, () => buildingValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));

        buildingPartQueryOver.JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => buildingPartValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity));

        buildingPartQueryOver.Where(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !buildingPartValidityAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingValidityAlias.IsDeleted);

        var buildingPartResults = buildingPartQueryOver
       .SelectList(list => list
           .Select(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Id)
           .Select(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Name)
           .Select(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
           .Select(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Identifier)
           .Select(() => buildingValidityAlias.Name)
       )
       .List<object[]>();

        var buildingPartDtos = buildingPartResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.BuildingPart,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { siteName, (string)row[4] }
        }).ToList();

        // Query for floors
        var floorQueryOver = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingValidities, () => buildingValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));


        floorQueryOver
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => buildingPartValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingPartValidity));

        floorQueryOver
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.FloorValidities, () => floorValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => floorValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryFloorValidity));

        var floorResults = floorQueryOver
            .Where(() => floorEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !floorValidityAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingPartValidityAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.Id)
                .Select(() => floorValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
                .Select(() => floorEntityAlias.Identifier)
                .Select(() => buildingValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Name)
            )
            .List<object[]>();

        var floorDtos = floorResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Floor,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { siteName, (string)row[4], (string)row[5] }
        }).ToList();

        // Query for rooms
        var roomQueryOver = queryOver.Clone()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Buildings, () => buildingEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingValidities, () => buildingValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));

        roomQueryOver
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingEntityAlias.BuildingParts, () => buildingPartEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.BuildingPartValidities, () => buildingPartValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => buildingValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryBuildingValidity));


        roomQueryOver
            .JoinAlias(() => buildingPartEntityAlias.Floors, () => floorEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.FloorValidities, () => floorValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => floorValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryFloorValidity));


        roomQueryOver
            .JoinAlias(() => floorEntityAlias.Rooms, () => roomEntityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .JoinAlias(() => roomEntityAlias.RoomValidities, () => roomValidityAlias, JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => roomValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryRoomValidity));


        var roomResults = roomQueryOver
        .Where(() => roomEntityAlias.IsMeasurementPoint && !roomValidityAlias.IsDeleted && !floorValidityAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingPartValidityAlias.IsDeleted && !buildingValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
            .SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Id)
                .Select(() => roomValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.IsAggregationPoint)
                .Select(() => roomEntityAlias.Identifier)
                .Select(() => buildingValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => buildingPartValidityAlias.Name)
                .Select(() => floorValidityAlias.Name)
            )
            .List<object[]>();

        var roomDtos = roomResults.Select(row => new MeasurementPointListItemDto
        {
            Id = (int)row[0],
            Name = (string)row[1],
            IsAggregationPoint = (bool?)row[2],
            Identifier = (Guid)row[3],
            OrgunitType = OrgunitType.Room,
            ParentNames = new List<string> { siteName, (string)row[4], (string)row[5], (string)row[6] }
        }).ToList();

        // Combine all measurement point DTOs
        var allMeasurementPoints = buildingDtos
            .Concat(buildingPartDtos)
            .Concat(floorDtos)
            .Concat(roomDtos)
            .ToList();

        // Apply sorting and paging
        if (measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn))
        {
            // Apply sorting based on property name using reflection
            var sortProperty = typeof(MeasurementPointListItemDto).GetProperty(
                measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn,
                BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);

            if (sortProperty != null)
            {
                if (measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending)
                {
                    allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                        .OrderBy(x => sortProperty.GetValue(x))
                        .ToList();
                }
                else
                {
                    allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                        .OrderByDescending(x => sortProperty.GetValue(x))
                        .ToList();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Default to Name if property not found
                allMeasurementPoints = measurementPointsQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending
                    ? allMeasurementPoints.OrderBy(x => x.Name).ToList()
                    : allMeasurementPoints.OrderByDescending(x => x.Name).ToList();
            }
        }

        // Apply paging if needed
        if (measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo != null)
        {
            var pageSize = measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10;
            var firstItem = measurementPointsQuery.PagingInfo.StartPage * pageSize;

            // Get total count before paging
            int totalCount = allMeasurementPoints.Count;

            // Apply paging
            allMeasurementPoints = allMeasurementPoints
                .Skip(firstItem)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToList();

            // Create result with paging info
            var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>
            {
                Items = allMeasurementPoints.ToArray(),
                RecordsTotal = totalCount
            };

            return result;
        }

        // Create result without paging
        var resultNoPaging = new EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>
        {
            Items = allMeasurementPoints.ToArray()
        };

        return resultNoPaging;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            SiteEntityQuery siteQuery => DoSiteSingleEntityQuery(siteQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the site single entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSiteSingleEntityQuery(SiteEntityQuery query)
    {
        SiteValidityEntity subValidityAlias = null!;
        SiteValidityEntity validityAlias = null!;

        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Identifier) && Guid.TryParse(query.Identifier, out Guid guidIdentifier))
            queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier == guidIdentifier);

        if (query.IsDeleted != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == query.IsDeleted);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.SiteValidities, () => validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
         .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => validityAlias.Id).In(
            QueryOver.Of<SiteValidityEntity>(() => subValidityAlias)
                     .Where(() => subValidityAlias.Site.Id == _rootAlias.Id && !subValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
                     .Select(v => v.Id))).TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity);

        //TODO: ki kellett kommentelni a validity átalakítás közben
        //if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.Name))
        //    queryOver.Where(x => x.Name == query.Name);

        //if (query.AddressId != null && query.AddressId > 0)
        //    queryOver = queryOver
        //    .JoinAlias(x => x.Address, () => addressAlias)
        //    .Where(x => addressAlias.Id == query.AddressId);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous SiteQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SiteEntity, SiteEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is SiteEntityQuery siteQuery)
        {
            if (siteQuery.Id != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == siteQuery.Id);

            if (siteQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Institution.Id == siteQuery.ParentId);

            if (siteQuery.ParentIdentifier.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(() => _institutionAlias.Identifier == siteQuery.ParentIdentifier);

            if (siteQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == siteQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        if (query is SiteEntityRefQuery entityRefQuery)
        {
            if (entityRefQuery.IsDeleted != null)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == entityRefQuery.IsDeleted);

            if (entityRefQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Institution.Id == entityRefQuery.ParentId);
        }

        if (query is TenantSiteEntityRefQuery administrationEntityRefQuery)
        {
            if (administrationEntityRefQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == administrationEntityRefQuery.IsDeleted);

            if (administrationEntityRefQuery.ParentId.HasValue)
                queryOver = queryOver.Where(x => x.Institution.Id == administrationEntityRefQuery.ParentId);
        }


        if (query is SitePagedEntityQuery sitePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (sitePagedEntityQuery.IsActive.HasValue) //must support returning deleted, not-deleted, and all
                queryOver.Where(x => _rootAlias.IsDeleted == !sitePagedEntityQuery.IsActive.Value);

            if (sitePagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => _rootAlias.Institution.Id == sitePagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sitePagedEntityQuery.Address))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _addressAlias.FullAddress)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(sitePagedEntityQuery.Address, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sitePagedEntityQuery.Name))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(sitePagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sitePagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(sitePagedEntityQuery.InstitutionName, MatchMode.Anywhere));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni, lsd OrgUnitQueryHandler
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<SiteEntity, SiteEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<SiteEntity, SiteEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is SiteEntityQuery)
        {
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Institution, () => _institutionAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
        }

        if (query is SitePagedEntityQuery || query is SiteParentsNamesQuery)
        {
            var subQuerySiteValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);
            var subQueryInstitutionValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<InstitutionValidityEntity>(x => _institutionAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Institution, () => _institutionAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.SiteValidities, () => _siteValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _siteValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuerySiteValidity));

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _siteValidityAlias.Address, () => _addressAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);

            queryOver.JoinEntityAlias(() => _institutionValidityAlias, () => _rootAlias.Institution.Id == _institutionValidityAlias.Institution.Id, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _institutionValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQueryInstitutionValidity));

        }

        if (query is SiteGuidEntityRefQuery)
        {// because we need Site's Name from CurrentValidity in the result of a GuidEntityRefQuery
            var subQuerySiteValidity = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<SiteValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.Id);
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.SiteValidities, () => _siteValidityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _siteValidityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuerySiteValidity));
        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<SiteEntity, SiteEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(SiteListItemDto))
        {
            SiteListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                .Select(x => x.IsDeleted).WithAlias(() => alias.IsDeleted)
                .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionName)
                .Select(x => _rootAlias.Institution.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionId)
                .Select(x => _addressAlias.FullAddress).WithAlias(() => alias.Address)
            );
        }
        //if (query is )
        //{
        //    SiteListItemDto alias = null!;
        //    queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
        //        .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
        //        .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
        //        .Select(x => x.IsDeleted).WithAlias(() => alias.IsDeleted)
        //        .Select(x => _siteValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
        //        .Select(x => _institutionValidityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.InstitutionName)
        //        .Select(x => _addressAlias.FullAddress).WithAlias(() => alias.Address)
        //    );
        //}

        return null;
    }
}

using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// SiteValidityQueryHandler
/// </summary>
public class SiteValidityQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<SiteValidityEntity, SiteValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteValidityEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Site alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SiteEntity _siteAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SiteValidityQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public SiteValidityQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, IQueryService queryService, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            SiteValidityEntityQuery siteEntityQuery => siteEntityQuery.SiteId, //az orgunit kell, nem a validity-je!
            ValidityEntityQuery<SiteValidityEntityDto> validityEntityQuery => validityEntityQuery.ParentId,
            EntityByIdQuery<SiteValidityEntityDto> entityByIdQuery => entityByIdQuery.Id,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{query} is not supported."),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<SiteValidityEntity, SiteValidityEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteValidityEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Site, () => _siteAlias);
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        var entityId = GetEntityIdForSecOperation(query);
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, entityId).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        return query switch
        {
            SiteValidityEntityQuery siteEntityQuery => DoSiteValidityEntityQuery(siteEntityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoSiteValidityEntityQuery(SiteValidityEntityQuery siteEntityQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<SiteValidityEntity>();

        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);

        if (siteEntityQuery.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == siteEntityQuery.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous SiteValidityEntityQuery");
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where conditions
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SiteValidityEntity, SiteValidityEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ValidityEntityQuery<SiteValidityEntityDto> validityQuery)
        {
            if (validityQuery?.ParentId > 0)
                queryOver.Where(() => _siteAlias.Id == validityQuery.ParentId);
            if (validityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == validityQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// MeasurementPointQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="MeasurementPointEntityDto" />
public class MeasurementPointQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<MeasurementPointEntity, MeasurementPointEntityDto>
{
    private MeasurementPointEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    private MeasurementPointSettingEntity _settingAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>

        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>

    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Not implemented EntityType!</exception>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            MeasurementPointsByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery measurementPointEdmDevicesByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery =>
                GetMeasurementPointsByOrgunitBaseId(measurementPointEdmDevicesByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery)
                    .GetAwaiter()
                    .GetResult(),
            MeasurementPointByOrgUnitBaseIdEntityRefQuery measurementPointByOrgUnitBaseIdEntityRefQuery =>
                GetMeasurementPointsEntityRefByOrgunitBaseId(measurementPointByOrgUnitBaseIdEntityRefQuery)
                    .GetAwaiter()
                    .GetResult(),
            MeasurementPointChildrenQuery measurementPointChildrenQuery => GetMeasurementPointChildren(measurementPointChildrenQuery).RunSync(),
            MeasurementPointSelectListQuery measurementPointSelectListQuery => DoQueryEntities(measurementPointSelectListQuery),
            _ => base.DoQueryEntities(query)
        };
    }


    protected override IQueryOver<MeasurementPointEntity, MeasurementPointEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)

        return query switch
        {
            ActiveDeviceChannelsQuery activeDeviceChannelsQuery => DoQueryEntities(activeDeviceChannelsQuery),
            MeasuredPropertyChannelQuery measuredPropertyChannelsQuery => DoQueryEntities(measuredPropertyChannelsQuery),
            // MeasurementPointChildrenQuery measurementPointChildrenQuery => DoQueryEntities(measurementPointChildrenQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {

            MeasurementPointMapCoordinatesInfoQuery measurementPointCoordianteInfoQuery => DoMeasurementPointCoordianteInfoQuery(measurementPointCoordianteInfoQuery),
            MeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsQuery measurementPointParentOrgUnitsQuery => DoMeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsQuery(measurementPointParentOrgUnitsQuery).RunSync(),

            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    private async Task<MeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsQueryResult> DoMeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsQuery(MeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsQuery measurementPointParentOrgUnitsQuery)
    {
        MeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsQueryResult result = new();
        Guid[] measurementPointGuids = measurementPointParentOrgUnitsQuery.MeasurementPointIdentifiers.ToArray(); //Nhibernate prefers array

        var measurementPointEntities = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointEntity>()
            .WhereRestrictionOn(mp => mp.Identifier)
            .IsIn(measurementPointGuids)
            .And(x => !x.IsDeleted)
            .ListAsync();
        var parentOrgunitMappings = measurementPointEntities
            .ToDictionary(mp => mp.Identifier!.Value, mp => mp.OrgunitBase);

        //TODO: permission filtering -> later

        // Get distinct orgunit IDs to avoid querying for duplicates
        var distinctOrgunitIds = parentOrgunitMappings.Values.Select(x => x.Id).Distinct().ToList();
        OrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQuery parentsQuery = new() { OrgUnitIds = distinctOrgunitIds };
        if (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(parentsQuery) is not OrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQueryResult parentsResult)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("OrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQuery failed");
        }

        var parentsLookup = parentsResult.AsDictionary();

        // Process each measurement point and build its parent hierarchy
        foreach (var kvp in parentOrgunitMappings)
        {
            var measurementPointGuid = kvp.Key;
            var orgUnitBase = kvp.Value;

            if (parentsLookup.TryGetValue(orgUnitBase.Id, out var parentRefs))
            {
                result.ResultItems.Add(measurementPointGuid, new MeasurementPointParentHierarchy(
                    MeasurementPointIdentifier: measurementPointGuid,
                    InstitutionRef: parentRefs.Institution,
                    SiteRef: parentRefs.Site,
                    BuildingRef: parentRefs.Building,
                    BuildingPartRef: parentRefs.BuildingPart,
                    FloorRef: parentRefs.Floor,
                    RoomRef: parentRefs.Room
                ));
            }
            else
            {
                result.ResultItems.Add(measurementPointGuid, null);
                result.Errors.Add(measurementPointGuid, new Exception($"Parent hierarchy not found for orgunit {orgUnitBase.Id}"));
            }
        }

        // Handle measurement points that weren't found
        var notFoundGuids = measurementPointGuids.Except(parentOrgunitMappings.Keys).ToHashSet();
        if (notFoundGuids.Count != 0)
        {
            foreach (var guid in notFoundGuids)
            {
                result.ResultItems.Add(guid, null);
                result.Errors.Add(guid, new Exception($"MeasurementPoint with Guid {guid} not found or has no parent orgunit."));
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    private IQueryResult DoMeasurementPointCoordianteInfoQuery(MeasurementPointMapCoordinatesInfoQuery measurementPointCoordianteInfoQuery)
    {
        var mp = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointEntity>()
        .WhereRestrictionOn(mp => mp.Id)
        .IsIn(measurementPointCoordianteInfoQuery.MeasurementPointIds)
        .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted)
        .List();


        return new MapCoordinatesInfoQueryResult
        {
            CoordinateInfos = mp.Select(m => new MapCoordinatesInfoModel
            {
                Latitude = m.Lat!.Value,
                Longitude = m.Lon!.Value,
                Name = m.Name

            }).ToList()
        };
    }

    //Az aggregáció miatt a base osztályban lévő DoQueryEntities nem tudja jól belőni a RecordsTotal-t
    private IQueryResult DoMeasurementPointPagedQuery(MeasurementPointPagedEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

        SetupQuerySelect<MeasurementPointsListItemDto>(queryOver, query);

        //JOIN
        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        //WHERE
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        var result = new EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointsListItemDto>();

        //PAGING
        ProductivityExtensions.When<IPagedEntityQuery>(query, q => SetQueryPaging(queryOver, q));

        //ORDER BY
        ProductivityExtensions.When<IPagedEntityQuery>(query, q => SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, q));

        var items = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<MeasurementPointsListItemDto>()).List<MeasurementPointsListItemDto>().ToArray();

        result.Items = items;
        result.RecordsTotal = items.Length;

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets measurement points for an organization unit and its descendants.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>The query result.</returns>
    private async Task<IEntityQueryItemsResult> GetMeasurementPointsEntityRefByOrgunitBaseId(MeasurementPointByOrgUnitBaseIdEntityRefQuery query)
    {
        var measurementPoints = await ListAllMeasurementPointsByOrgUnitId(query.OrgunitBaseId, query.IsBilling);

        var items = measurementPoints.Select(x => new EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto> { Id = x.Id, EntityDisplayName = x.Name }).ToArray();

        IEntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>>? result = new EntityQueryItemsResult<EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>>();

        result.Items = items;

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets measurement points for an organization unit and its descendants.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>The query result.</returns>
    private async Task<IEntityQueryItemsResult> GetMeasurementPointsByOrgunitBaseId(MeasurementPointsByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery query)
    {
        var orgunitId = query.OrgUnitBaseId;

        var measurementPoints = await ListAllMeasurementPointsByOrgUnitId(orgunitId, isBilling: query.IsBilling);

        return new EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointEntityDto>
        {
            Items = measurementPoints.ToArray()
        };
    }

    private async Task<List<MeasurementPointEntityDto>> ListAllMeasurementPointsByOrgUnitId(int orgunitId, bool? isBilling = null)
    {
        var session = DbContext.Session;

        var institutionMeasurementPoints = await session.Query<MeasurementPointEntity>()
            .Where(mp =>
                !mp.IsDeleted &&
                (mp.OrgunitBase.Id == orgunitId ||
                GetSiteIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetBuildingIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetBuildingPartIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetFloorIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetRoomIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id))
            ).ToListAsync();

        var siteMeasurementPoints = await session.Query<MeasurementPointEntity>()
            .Where(mp =>
                !mp.IsDeleted &&
                (mp.OrgunitBase.Id == orgunitId ||
                GetBuildingIdsBySiteIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetBuildingPartIdsBySiteIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetFloorIdsBySiteIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetRoomIdsBySiteIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id))
            ).ToListAsync();

        var buildingMeasurementPoints = await session.Query<MeasurementPointEntity>()
            .Where(mp =>
                !mp.IsDeleted &&
                (mp.OrgunitBase.Id == orgunitId ||
                GetBuildingPartIdsByBuildingIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetFloorIdsByBuildingIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetRoomIdsByBuildingIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id))
            ).ToListAsync();

        var buildingPartMeasurementPoints = await session.Query<MeasurementPointEntity>()
            .Where(mp =>
                !mp.IsDeleted &&
                (mp.OrgunitBase.Id == orgunitId ||
                GetFloorIdsByBuildingPartIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id) ||
                GetRoomIdsByBuildingPartIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id))
            ).ToListAsync();

        var floorMeasurementPoints = await session.Query<MeasurementPointEntity>()
            .Where(mp =>
                !mp.IsDeleted &&
                (mp.OrgunitBase.Id == orgunitId ||
                GetRoomIdsByFloorIdSubquery(session, orgunitId).Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id))
            ).ToListAsync();

        var roomMeasurementPoints = await session.Query<MeasurementPointEntity>()
            .Where(mp => !mp.IsDeleted && mp.OrgunitBase.Id == orgunitId)
            .ToListAsync();

        var measurementPoints = institutionMeasurementPoints
            .Concat(siteMeasurementPoints)
            .Concat(buildingMeasurementPoints)
            .Concat(buildingPartMeasurementPoints)
            .Concat(floorMeasurementPoints)
            .Concat(roomMeasurementPoints)
            .DistinctBy(x => x.Id)
            .Select(x => Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointEntityDto>(x))
            .ToList();

        if (measurementPoints.Any())
        {
            var descendantMeasurementPoints = await GetDescendantMeasurementPoints(measurementPoints.Select(mp => mp.Id).ToList());
            measurementPoints.AddRange(descendantMeasurementPoints);

            if (isBilling is not null)
            {
                measurementPoints = measurementPoints
                                .Where(x => x.IsBilling == isBilling.Value)
                                .ToList();
            }

            measurementPoints = measurementPoints
                .DistinctBy(x => x.Id)
                .ToList();
        }

        return measurementPoints;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets all descendant measurement points by traversing the measurement point hierarchy.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="parentIds">The parent measurement point IDs.</param>
    /// <returns>All descendant measurement points in the hierarchy.</returns>
    private async Task<List<MeasurementPointEntityDto>> GetDescendantMeasurementPoints(List<int> parentIds)
    {
        if (parentIds == null || !parentIds.Any())
        {
            return new List<MeasurementPointEntityDto>();
        }

        var result = new List<MeasurementPointEntityDto>();
        var processedIds = new HashSet<int>(parentIds);
        var currentParentIds = new List<int>(parentIds);

        while (currentParentIds.Any())
        {
            var childPoints = await GetDirectChildMeasurementPoints(currentParentIds);
            if (!childPoints.Any())
            {
                break;
            }

            result.AddRange(childPoints);

            var nextLevelIds = childPoints.Select(mp => mp.Id).ToList();

            nextLevelIds = nextLevelIds.Where(id => !processedIds.Contains(id)).ToList();

            foreach (var id in nextLevelIds)
            {
                processedIds.Add(id);
            }

            currentParentIds = nextLevelIds;
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets direct child measurement points for the specified parent measurement points.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="parentIds">The parent measurement point IDs.</param>
    /// <returns>The direct child measurement points.</returns>
    private async Task<List<MeasurementPointEntityDto>> GetDirectChildMeasurementPoints(List<int> parentIds)
    {
        if (parentIds == null || !parentIds.Any())
        {
            return new List<MeasurementPointEntityDto>();
        }

        // Create aliases for the query
        var childAlias = null as MeasurementPointEntity;
        var parentAlias = null as MeasurementPointEntity;

        // Query for direct children where the parent ID is in the provided list
        var query = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointEntity>(() => childAlias)
            .JoinAlias(() => childAlias.ParentMeasurementPoint, () => parentAlias, NHibernate.SqlCommand.JoinType.InnerJoin)
            .Where(() => parentAlias.Id.IsIn(parentIds.ToArray()))
            .And(x => !x.IsDeleted);

        var childPoints = await query.ListAsync<MeasurementPointEntity>();
        return childPoints.Select(entity => Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointEntityDto>(entity)).ToList();
    }

    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<MeasurementPointEntity, MeasurementPointEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        switch (query)
        {
            case MeasurementPointPagedEntityQuery measurementPointPagedEntityQuery:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == measurementPointPagedEntityQuery.OrgunitBaseId)
                            .And(x => !x.IsDeleted);

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(measurementPointPagedEntityQuery.Name))
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<MeasurementPointEntity>(x => x.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(measurementPointPagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                break;

            case ActiveDeviceChannelsQuery activeDeviceChannelsQuery:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == activeDeviceChannelsQuery.MeasurementPointId)
                         .And(x => !x.IsDeleted)
                         .And(() => _deviceAlias.RemovalDate == null);

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(activeDeviceChannelsQuery.MeasuredPropertyName))
                {
                    queryOver.Where(x => _measuredPropertyAlias.MeasuredPropertyName == activeDeviceChannelsQuery.MeasuredPropertyName);
                }
                break;

            case MeasuredPropertyChannelQuery measuredPropertyChannelQuery:

                queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == measuredPropertyChannelQuery.MeasurementPointId)
                         .And(x => !x.IsDeleted);

                if (measuredPropertyChannelQuery.MeasuredPropertyId != 0)
                {
                    queryOver.Where(() => _measuredPropertyAlias.Id == measuredPropertyChannelQuery.MeasuredPropertyId);
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(measuredPropertyChannelQuery.MeasuredPropertyCode))
                {
                    queryOver.Where(() => _measuredPropertyAlias.Code == measuredPropertyChannelQuery.MeasuredPropertyCode);
                }
                break;

            case MeasurementPointEntityQuery measurementPointEntityQuery:
                if (measurementPointEntityQuery.OrgunitIds != null)
                    queryOver.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id).IsIn(measurementPointEntityQuery.OrgunitIds);

                if (measurementPointEntityQuery.IsBilling.HasValue)
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.IsBilling == measurementPointEntityQuery.IsBilling.Value);

                if (measurementPointEntityQuery.OnlyTopMeasurementHierarchyElement)
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint == null);

                break;
        }
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<MeasurementPointEntity, MeasurementPointEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is MeasurementPointPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            queryOver.JoinEntityAlias(() => _settingAlias, () => _rootAlias.Id == _settingAlias.MeasurementPoint.Id, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _settingAlias.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
        }
        if (query is ActiveDeviceChannelsQuery activeQuery)
        {
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => x.Devices, () => _deviceAlias);
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _deviceAlias.Channels, () => _channelAlias);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(activeQuery.MeasuredPropertyName))
            {
                queryOver.JoinEntityAlias(() => _settingAlias, () => _channelAlias.Id == _settingAlias.Channel.Id, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
                queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _settingAlias.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
            }
        }
        if (query is MeasuredPropertyChannelQuery)
        {
            queryOver.JoinEntityAlias(() => _settingAlias, () => _rootAlias.Id == _settingAlias.MeasurementPoint.Id);
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _settingAlias.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias);
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _settingAlias.Channel, () => _channelAlias);
        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<MeasurementPointEntity, MeasurementPointEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(MeasurementPointsListItemDto))
        {
            MeasurementPointsListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.UtilityType).WithAlias(() => alias.Type)
                .SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.PodId).WithAlias(() => alias.PodId)
                .SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementPointName)
                .Select(Projections.SqlFunction("string_agg",
                                                NHibernateUtil.String,
                                                Projections.Property<MeasuredPropertyEntity>(x => _measuredPropertyAlias.MeasuredPropertyName),
                                                Projections.Constant(", "))).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasuredPropertyName)
            );
        }
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(ActiveDeviceChannelListItemDto))
        {
            ActiveDeviceChannelListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => _channelAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(() => _channelAlias.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
                .Select(() => _channelAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.ChannelName)
            );
        }
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(ChannelListItemDto))
        {
            ChannelListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => _channelAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(() => _channelAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.ChannelName)
                .Select(() => _channelAlias.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.Identifier)
            );
        }

        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(MeasurementPointSelectListDto))
        {
            MeasurementPointSelectListDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => _rootAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(() => _rootAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                .Select(() => _rootAlias.IsBilling).WithAlias(() => alias.IsBilling)
            );
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves the children of a measurement point based on the provided query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query containing the criteria to retrieve the children of a measurement point.</param>
    /// <returns>A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains an
    /// <see cref="IEntityQueryItemsResult{MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto}"/> with the children of the measurement point.</returns>
    private async Task<EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto>> GetMeasurementPointChildren(MeasurementPointChildrenQuery query)
    {
        var result = new List<MeasurementPointEntityDto>();
        var processedIds = new HashSet<int>();
        var currentParentIds = new List<int> { query.MeasurementPointId };

        while (currentParentIds.Count != 0)
        {
            var childPoints = await GetDirectChildMeasurementPoints(currentParentIds);

            if (childPoints.Count == 0)
                break;

            var matchingChildPoints = childPoints
                .Where(x => x.MeasuredProperties.Any(mp => mp.Id == query.MeasuredPropertyId) &&
                            (query.MeasuredDataLabelId == null || x.Labels != null &&
                            x.Labels.Any(mp => mp.Id == query.MeasuredDataLabelId)))
                .ToList();

            result.AddRange(matchingChildPoints);

            var nextLevelIds = childPoints
                .Where(x => matchingChildPoints.All(y => x.Id != y.Id) &&
                            !processedIds.Contains(x.Id))
                .Select(mp => mp.Id).ToList();

            foreach (var point in childPoints)
            {
                processedIds.Add(point.Id);
            }

            currentParentIds = nextLevelIds;
        }

        if (result.Count == 0)
            return new EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto>()
            {
                Items = [],
                RecordsTotal = 0,
            };

        var listItems = MapMeasurementPointChildren(result.ToArray(), query.MeasuredDataLabelId);
        listItems = ApplySortingAndPaging(listItems, query);

        return new EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto>
        {
            Items = listItems,
            RecordsTotal = result.Count,
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A static mapper function to get MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto from MeasurementPointEntityDto
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dtos"></param>
    /// <param name="measuredDataLabelId"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto[] MapMeasurementPointChildren(MeasurementPointEntityDto[] dtos, int? measuredDataLabelId)
    {
        return (from point in dtos
                let labels = measuredDataLabelId == null
                    ? point.Labels.Select(x => x.Value).ToArray()
                    : point.Labels.Where(x => x.Id == measuredDataLabelId).Select(x => x.Value).ToArray()
                let orgNames = (OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult)(_queryService
                    .ExecuteQuery(new OrgunitNameCascadeQuery { OrgunitId = point.OrgunitBase.Id }).RunSync())
                select new MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto
                {
                    Id = point.Id,
                    InstitutionName = orgNames?.Institution?.EntityDisplayName,
                    SiteName = orgNames?.Site?.EntityDisplayName,
                    BuildingName = orgNames?.Building?.EntityDisplayName,
                    BuildingPartName = orgNames?.BuildingPart?.EntityDisplayName,
                    FloorName = orgNames?.Floor?.EntityDisplayName,
                    RoomName = orgNames?.Room?.EntityDisplayName,
                    MeasurementPointName = point.Name,
                    Identifier = point.Identifier,
                    MeasuredProperties = string.Join(", ", point.MeasuredProperties
                        .Select(x => x.MeasuredPropertyName).ToList()),
                    MeasuredDataLabel = string.Join(", ", labels),
                }).ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sorting without queryOver
    /// Caution! Do not use it with a large amount of data, reflection can be slow
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="result"></param>
    /// <param name="query"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto[] ApplySortingAndPaging(
        MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto[] result,
        MeasurementPointChildrenQuery query)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.SortingInfo.SortColumn))
        {
            var property = typeof(MeasurementPointChildrenListItemDto).GetProperty(query.SortingInfo.SortColumn);
            if (property != null)
            {
                result = query.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending
                    ? result.OrderBy(x => property.GetValue(x)).ToArray()
                    : result.OrderByDescending(x => property.GetValue(x)).ToArray();
            }
        }

        var pageSize = query.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10;
        var firstItem = query.PagingInfo.StartPage * pageSize;
        var pagedResult = result.Skip(firstItem).Take(pageSize).ToArray();

        return pagedResult;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
