using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.SqlCommand;
using NHibernate.Transform;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.MeasurementPoints;

/// <summary>
/// MeasurementPointSettingQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Common.MeasurementPointEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Common.MeasurementPointEntityDto&gt;" />
public class MeasurementPointSettingQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<MeasurementPointSettingEntity, MeasurementPointSettingEntityDto>
{

    private MeasurementPointSettingEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    private MeasuredPropertyEntity _measuredPropertyAlias = null!;

    private MeasurementPointEntity _measurementPointAlias = null!;

    private ChannelEntity _channelAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeasurementPointSettingQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public MeasurementPointSettingQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    protected override IQueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingEntity, MeasurementPointSettingEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Not implemented EntityType!</exception>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            MeasurementPointSettingEntityQuery pointQuery => DoQueryEntities(pointQuery),
            MeasuredPropertiesByMeasurementPointQuery propertyQuery => DoQueryEntities(propertyQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            SyncMeasurementPointSettingQuery syncQuery => DoSyncQueryEntities(syncQuery),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    private IQueryResult DoSyncQueryEntities(SyncMeasurementPointSettingQuery syncQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias);

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, syncQuery);

        MeasurementPointSettingSyncModel alias = null!;
        var models = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => _measurementPointAlias.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementPointIdentifier)
                .Select(() => _channelAlias.Identifier).WithAlias(() => alias.ChannelIdentifier)
                .Select(() => _rootAlias.MeasuredProperty.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasuredPropertyId)
                .Select(() => _rootAlias.MeasurementPoint.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementPointId)
                .Select(() => _rootAlias.Channel.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.ChannelId))
                .TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<MeasurementPointSettingSyncModel>()).List<MeasurementPointSettingSyncModel>();

        return new SyncMeasurementPointSettingQueryResult()
        {
            MeasurementPointSettingSyncModels = models.ToList(),
        };
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            MeasurementPointSettingEntityQuery settingQuery => DoMeasurementPointSettingEntityQuery(settingQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoMeasurementPointSettingEntityQuery(MeasurementPointSettingEntityQuery settingQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias);

        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, settingQuery);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous MeasurementPointSettingQuery");

        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingEntity, MeasurementPointSettingEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is MeasurementPointSettingEntityQuery entityQuery)
        {
            if (entityQuery.MeasurementPointId.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementPoint.Id == entityQuery.MeasurementPointId);
            }
            if (entityQuery.MeasuredPropertyId.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasuredProperty.Id == entityQuery.MeasuredPropertyId);
            }
        }
        else if (query is MeasuredPropertiesByMeasurementPointQuery propertyQuery)
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementPoint.Id == propertyQuery.MeasurementPointId);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingEntity, MeasurementPointSettingEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is MeasuredPropertiesByMeasurementPointQuery)
        {
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias);
        }
        if (query is SyncMeasurementPointSettingQuery)
        {
            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.MeasurementPoint, () => _measurementPointAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Channel, () => _channelAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingEntity, MeasurementPointSettingEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(EntityRef<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>))
        {
            EntityRef<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto> alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(() => _measuredPropertyAlias.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(() => _measuredPropertyAlias.MeasuredPropertyName).WithAlias(() => alias.EntityDisplayName)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

}

using AutoMapper;
using AutoMapper.QueryableExtensions;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

using NHibernate.Criterion;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.ModelCatalogue;

/// <summary>
/// ModelTimeSeriesQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.ModelCatalogue.ModelTimeSeriesEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.ModelCatalogue.ModelTimeSeriesEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ModelTimeSeriesQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<ModelTimeSeriesEntity, ModelTimeSeriesEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ModelTimeSeriesQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public ModelTimeSeriesQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ModelTimeSeriesMinModelsQuery minModelsQuery)
            return DoModelTimeSeriesMinModelsQuery(minModelsQuery);

        if (query is ModelTimeSeriesEntitiesQuery modelTimeSeriesEntitiesQuery)
            return DoModelTimeSeriesEntitiesQuery(modelTimeSeriesEntitiesQuery);

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the model time series entities query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoModelTimeSeriesEntitiesQuery(ModelTimeSeriesEntitiesQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ModelTimeSeriesEntity>();

        if (query.TimeSeriesIds is not null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(e => e.Identifier.IsIn(query.TimeSeriesIds));
        }

        var entities = queryOver.List();
        ModelTimeSeriesEntitiesQueryResult result = new ModelTimeSeriesEntitiesQueryResult() 
        {
            Result = new List<ModelTimeSeriesEntityDto> { } 
        };

        if (entities != null)
        {
            result.Result = entities.Select(x => CreateDto(x)).ToList();
            return result;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ModelTimeSeriesEntityQuery modelTimeSeriesEntityQuery)
            return DoModelTimeSeriesEntityQuery(modelTimeSeriesEntityQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the model time series minimum models query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoModelTimeSeriesMinModelsQuery(ModelTimeSeriesMinModelsQuery query)
    {
        var items = new List<ModelTimeSeriesMinModel>();
        if (query.DeviceIdentifier is not null)
        {
            items = DbContext.Session.Query<ModelTimeSeriesEntity>().Where(x =>
                    x.Channel.Device.Identifier == query.DeviceIdentifier)
                .ProjectTo<ModelTimeSeriesMinModel>(Mapper.ConfigurationProvider).ToList();
        }
        else if (query.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier is not null)
        {
            items = DbContext.Session.Query<ModelTimeSeriesEntity>().Where(x =>
                    x.Channel.Identifier == query.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier)
                .ProjectTo<ModelTimeSeriesMinModel>(Mapper.ConfigurationProvider).ToList();
        }
        return new ModelTimeSeriesMinModelsQueryResult { ModelTimeSeries = items };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the model time series entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult DoModelTimeSeriesEntityQuery(ModelTimeSeriesEntityQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ModelTimeSeriesEntity>();

        if (query.TimeSeriesId is not null)
        {
            queryOver.Where(e => e.Identifier == query.TimeSeriesId);
        }

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous ModelTimeSeriesEntity");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };

        return null;
    }
}

        }

            return DoTimeSeriesCatalogSchemaQuerySingleEntityQuery(timeSeriesCatalogSchemaQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the time series catalog schema query single entity query.
    /// </summary>

    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoTimeSeriesCatalogSchemaQuerySingleEntityQuery(TimeSeriesSchemaQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<TimeSeriesSchemaEntity>();

        SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous TimeSeriesCatalogSchemaQuery");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;

using AutoMapper;

/// <summary>
/// NotificationQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Notifications.NotificationEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Notifications.NotificationEntityDto&gt;" />
public class NotificationQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<NotificationEntity, NotificationEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// Secuser entity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecUserEntity secuserEntityAlias;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="NotificationQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public NotificationQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is NotificationEntitiesQuery notificationEntitiesQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(notificationEntitiesQuery);

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<NotificationEntity, NotificationEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is NotificationEntitiesQuery)
        {
            queryOver =
                queryOver
                    .JoinAlias(x => x.TargetUsers, () => secuserEntityAlias);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<NotificationEntity, NotificationEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is NotificationEntitiesQuery notiQuery)
        {
            queryOver =
                queryOver
                    .Where(x =>
                                secuserEntityAlias.GlobalId == _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId &&
                                x.ExpirationDate > DateTime.UtcNow &&
                                x.NotificationType == notiQuery.NotificationType);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni, lsd OrgUnitQueryHandler
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<NotificationEntity, NotificationEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NotificationEntity>()
                .OrderBy(x => x.IsRead)
                .Asc;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.OrgunitImport;
using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// SiteValidityQueryHandler
/// </summary>
public class OrgunitImportJobResultQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<OrgunitImportJobResultEntity, OrgunitImportJobResultEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly OrgunitImportJobResultEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="OrgunitImportJobResultQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public OrgunitImportJobResultQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<OrgunitImportJobResultEntity, OrgunitImportJobResultEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<OrgunitImportJobResultEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            OrgunitImportJobResultPagedEntityQuery itemQuery => DoQueryEntities(itemQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            OrgunitImportJobResultEntityQuery entityQuery => DoOrgunitImportJobResultSingleEntityQuery(entityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoOrgunitImportJobResultSingleEntityQuery(OrgunitImportJobResultEntityQuery siteQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<OrgunitImportJobResultEntity>(() => _rootAlias);

        SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, siteQuery);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous OrgunitImportJobResultEntity");

        if (entity != null)
            return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
            {
                Entity = CreateDto(entity)
            };
        return null;
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<OrgunitImportJobResultEntity, OrgunitImportJobResultEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        switch (query)
        {
            case OrgunitImportJobResultEntityQuery entityQuery:
                if (entityQuery.JobId.HasValue)
                    queryOver.Where(() => _rootAlias.JobId == entityQuery.JobId);
                break;

            case OrgunitImportJobResultPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery:
                queryOver.Where(() => _rootAlias.SecUser.Id == pagedEntityQuery.UserId);
                if (pagedEntityQuery.Statuses != null && pagedEntityQuery.Statuses.Length > 0)
                    queryOver.Where(() => pagedEntityQuery.Statuses.Any(x => x == _rootAlias.Status));

                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<OrgunitImportJobResultEntity, OrgunitImportJobResultEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is OrgunitImportJobResultPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            //TODO: kell-e?
        }
    }


    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<OrgunitImportJobResultEntity, OrgunitImportJobResultEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(OrgunitImportJobResultListItemDto))
        {
            var alias = new OrgunitImportJobResultListItemDto();
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.FileName).WithAlias(() => alias.FileName)
                .Select(x => x.InitiationDate).WithAlias(() => alias.InitiationDate)
                .Select(x => x.Status).WithAlias(() => alias.Status)
                .Select(x => x.ErrorList).WithAlias(() => alias.ErrorList)
                .Select(x => x.Data).WithAlias(() => alias.Data) //TODO: ezt lehet, hogy nem is kell kiszelektálni, mert nem kell a UI-ra
                //TODO: ez majd később kell:
                //.Select(x => new EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto> { Id = x.SecUser.Id, EntityDisplayName = x.SecUser.UserName }).WithAlias(() => alias.SecUser)
            );
        }
        return null;
    }

}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems.Partners;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Floor;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Partners;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.SqlCommand;
using NHibernate.Transform;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Partners;

/// <summary>
/// PartnerQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner.PartnerEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners.PartnerEntityDto&gt;" />
public class PartnerQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<PartnerEntity, PartnerEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the core database context.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The core database context.
    /// </value>
    private IDbContext CoreDbContext { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// Address alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly AddressEntity _addressAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantEntity _tenantAlias = null!;
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly PartnerEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Partner Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly PartnerValidityEntity _validityAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Partner Validity alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly PartnerValidityEntity _subQueryAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Maintainer alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly MaintainerEntity _maintainerAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PartnerQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public PartnerQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, ILifetimeScope scope,
        SecurityContext securityContex) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _securityContext = securityContex;
        //CoreDbContext = scope.ResolveKeyed<IDbContext>(DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is IEntityQuery<PartnerListItemDto> itemQuery)
            return DoQueryEntities(itemQuery);

        return base.QueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni, lsd OrgUnitQueryHandler
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<PartnerEntity, PartnerEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is PartnerEntityQuery partnerEntityQuery)
            return DoPartnerEntityQuery(partnerEntityQuery);

        return base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the partner entity query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult DoPartnerEntityQuery(PartnerEntityQuery query)
    {
        PartnerValidityEntity subValidityAlias = null!;
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerEntity>(() =>_rootAlias);

        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.TenantCode))
            queryOver.Where(t => t.TenantCode == query.TenantCode);

        if (query.PartnerId != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == query.PartnerId.Value);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.PartnerValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                 .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).In(
                        QueryOver.Of<PartnerValidityEntity>(() => subValidityAlias)
                                 .Where(() => subValidityAlias.Partner.Id == _rootAlias.Id && !subValidityAlias.IsDeleted)
                                 .Select(v => v.Id))).TransformUsing(Transformers.DistinctRootEntity);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(x => _validityAlias.Maintainer, () => _maintainerAlias);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous PartnerEntityQuery");
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }

    

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<PartnerEntity, PartnerEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(PartnerListItemDto))
        {
            PartnerListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list.Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(x => _validityAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
                    .Select(x => _addressAlias.FullAddress).WithAlias(() => alias.Headquarters)
                    .Select(x => _maintainerAlias.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Maintainer)
                    .Select(x => _tenantAlias.Status).WithAlias(() => alias.TenantStatus)
            );
        }
        return null;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<PartnerEntity, PartnerEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        if (query is PartnerEntityQuery || query is PartnerPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            var subQuery = OrgUnitValidityQueryHelper.CreateValiditySubQuery<PartnerValidityEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Id == x.ParentId);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.PartnerValidities, () => _validityAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin)
                     .Where(Subqueries.WhereProperty(() => _validityAlias.Id).Eq(subQuery));
            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => _validityAlias.Headquarters, () => _addressAlias);

            queryOver.JoinAlias(x => _validityAlias.Maintainer, () => _maintainerAlias);

            queryOver.JoinEntityAlias(() => _tenantAlias, () => _rootAlias.TenantCode == _tenantAlias.Code, NHibernate.SqlCommand.JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<PartnerEntity, PartnerEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is PartnerPagedEntityQuery partnerPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (partnerPagedEntityQuery.IsDeleted == false) 
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false);
                queryOver.Where(x => _tenantAlias.IsDeleted == false);
            }
            else if (partnerPagedEntityQuery.IsDeleted == true)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == true || _tenantAlias.IsDeleted == true);
            }

            if (partnerPagedEntityQuery.MaintainerId.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => partnerPagedEntityQuery.MaintainerId == _validityAlias.Maintainer.Id);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partnerPagedEntityQuery.Name))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<PartnerValidityEntity>(x => _validityAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(partnerPagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partnerPagedEntityQuery.Headquarters))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<PartnerEntity>(x => _addressAlias.FullAddress)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(partnerPagedEntityQuery.Headquarters, MatchMode.Anywhere));
        }
    }
}

using NHibernate;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Partners;

/// <summary>
/// PartnerValidityQueryHandler
/// </summary>
public class PartnerValidityQueryHandler : OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase<PartnerValidityEntity, PartnerValidityEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly PartnerValidityEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Partner alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly PartnerEntity _partnerAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PartnerValidityQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public PartnerValidityQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, IQueryService queryService, SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, queryService, securityContext)
    {
    }

    protected override int? GetEntityIdForSecOperation(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return null; //mivel itt partnereket (tenantokat) query-znek, ezért minden esetben null-ra, azaz a legfelső orgunit szülőre kell majd keresni
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Alias-t használó join-okhoz ezt kell felülbírálni
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IQueryOver<PartnerValidityEntity, PartnerValidityEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerValidityEntity>(() => _rootAlias)
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Partner, () => _partnerAlias);
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        //mivel itt partnereket (tenantokat) query-znek, ezért minden esetben null-ra, azaz a legfelső orgunit szülőre kell majd keresni
        CheckOrgUnitQueryPermissions(query, null).GetAwaiter().GetResult(); //TODO: lehet-e async?

        return query switch
        {
            PartnerValidityEntityQuery partnerEntityQuery => DoPartnerValidityEntityQuery(partnerEntityQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoPartnerValidityEntityQuery(PartnerValidityEntityQuery partnerEntityQuery)
    {
        AddressEntity addressAlias = null!;
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerValidityEntity>()
            .JoinAlias(x => x.Headquarters, () => addressAlias);

        queryOver.Where(t => !t.IsDeleted);

        if (partnerEntityQuery.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == partnerEntityQuery.Id);

        if (partnerEntityQuery.Identifier != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Identifier == partnerEntityQuery.Identifier);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous PartnerEntityQuery");
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where conditions
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<PartnerValidityEntity, PartnerValidityEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ValidityEntityQuery<PartnerValidityEntityDto> validityQuery) 
        {
            if (validityQuery?.ParentId > 0)
                queryOver.Where(() => _partnerAlias.Id == validityQuery.ParentId);
            if (validityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == validityQuery.IsDeleted);
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }

    
}

/// <summary>
/// Query handler for Maintainer-related queries
/// </summary>
public class MaintainerQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<MaintainerEntity, MaintainerEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Root alias
    /// </summary>
    private readonly MaintainerEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MaintainerQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    public MaintainerQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {


    }



    /// <summary>
    /// Entitások lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// entitások
    /// </returns>
    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            MaintainerPagedEntityQuery itemQuery => DoQueryEntities(itemQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };
    }


    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            MaintainerQuery singleQuery => DoMaintainerQuerySingleEntityQuery(singleQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }
    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoMaintainerQuerySingleEntityQuery(MaintainerQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MaintainerEntity>();

        if (query.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == query.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous MaintainerEntity");

        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }
   
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<MaintainerEntity, MaintainerEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is MaintainerQuery entityQuery)
        {
            if (entityQuery.Id.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.Id == entityQuery.Id);
        }
        else if (query is MaintainerPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (pagedEntityQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.IsDeleted == pagedEntityQuery.IsDeleted);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pagedEntityQuery.Name))
                queryOver.Where(
                    Restrictions.On<MaintainerEntity>(x => _rootAlias.Name)
                        .IsInsensitiveLike(pagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));
        }

        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<MaintainerEntity, MaintainerEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is MaintainerPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            MaintainerListItemDto alias = null!;
            queryOver = queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.Name).WithAlias(() => alias.Name)
            );
        }
        return null;
    }

    protected override IQueryOver<MaintainerEntity, MaintainerEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MaintainerEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query join.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<MaintainerEntity, MaintainerEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);
    }
   
}

    //called from OrgUnitQueryHandlerBase.QueryAllUserPermissionByOrgUnitType(...)
    private SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult DoSecRoleOrgunitAssignmentListQuery(SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentListQuery queryParams)
    {
        SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult result = new();

        var dbQuery = DbContext.Session.Query<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false
            && x.User.Id == queryParams.UserId);

        if (queryParams.RoleIds != null && queryParams.RoleIds.Count > 0)
        {
            dbQuery = dbQuery.Where(x => queryParams.RoleIds.Contains(x.Role.Id));
        }

        //szűrnünk kell azokra a role-okra, amik az aktuális pillanatban érvényesek, vagy a ValidTo null (végtelen érvényesség) 
        if (!queryParams.IncludeInvalidByCurrentDate)
        {
            //egész napra kerekítve kell vizsgálni az érvényességet
            var today = DateTime.Today;
            dbQuery = dbQuery.Where(x => x.ValidFrom.Date <= today &&
            (x.ValidTo == null || x.ValidTo.Value.Date >= today));
        }

        if (!queryParams.IgnoreOrgUnitFiltering && queryParams.TargetOrgUnitType is null)
        {
            dbQuery = dbQuery.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == null); //csak a null-okra szűrünk, mert ebben az esetben tenant szintű jogokat keresünk
            result.Items = [.. dbQuery.ToList().Select(Mapper.Map<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>)];
            return result; //és itt ki is lépünk, mert ha tenant szintű műveletekre keresünk, akkor nincs értelme további szűrésnek, úgyis minden alatta lévő orgunitra érvényes lesz
        }

        var allUserRoleAssignments = dbQuery.ToList(); //igazából mindent vissza kell adnunk, mert a későbbi szűrés során csak úgy tudjuk az ogunit hierarchia öröklődő jogait kezelni. nem?

        //TODO: caching (az érvényességet is figyelembe véve hogy kezeljük majd a cache-t???)

        result.Items = [.. allUserRoleAssignments.Select(Mapper.Map<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>)];
        return result;
    }

    private SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult DoSecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQuery(SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQuery queryParams)
    {
        SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult result = new();

        var dbQuery = DbContext.Session.Query<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.IsDeleted == false
            && x.User.Id == queryParams.UserId
            && queryParams.RoleIds.Contains(x.Role.Id));

        //szűrnünk kell azokra, amik az aktuális pillanatban érvényesek, vagy a ValidTo null (végtelen érvényesség) 
        if (!queryParams.IncludeInvalidByCurrentDate)
        {
            //egész napra kerekítve kell vizsgálni az érvényességet
            var today = DateTime.Today;
            dbQuery = dbQuery.Where(x => x.ValidFrom.Date <= today &&
            (x.ValidTo == null || x.ValidTo.Value.Date >= today));
        }

        if (queryParams.TargetOrgUnitType is null)
        {
            dbQuery = dbQuery.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == null); //csak a null-okra szűrünk, mert ebben az esetben tenant szintű jogokat keresünk
            result.Items = [.. dbQuery.ToList().Select(Mapper.Map<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>)];
            return result; //és itt ki is lépünk, mert ha tenant szintű műveletekre keresünk, akkor nincs értelme további szűrésnek, úgyis minden alatta lévő orgunitra érvényes lesz
        }

        var allUserRoleAssignments = dbQuery.ToList();
        //TODO: caching (az érvényességet is figyelembe véve hogy kezeljük majd a cache-t???)

        //a további szűrést memóriában végezzük:

        #region 1. konkrét orgunitra vonatkozó role-ok
        List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity> orgUnitRoles = [];
        if (queryParams.TargetOrgUnitType.HasValue)
        {
            orgUnitRoles = allUserRoleAssignments.Where(x =>
                x.OrgunitType == queryParams.TargetOrgUnitType && (
                queryParams.TargetOrgUnitType switch
                {
                    OrgunitType.Institution => x.Institution.Id == queryParams.TargetOrgUnitId,
                    OrgunitType.Site => x.Site.Id == queryParams.TargetOrgUnitId,
                    OrgunitType.Building => x.Building.Id == queryParams.TargetOrgUnitId,
                })).ToList();
        }
        #endregion

        #region 2. parent orgunit-okra vonatkozó role-ok
        List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity> parentOrgUnitRoles = [];
        if (queryParams.ParentOrgUnits.Count > 0)
        {
            foreach (var parentOrgUnit in queryParams.ParentOrgUnits)
            {
                var parentOrgUnitRolesQuery = allUserRoleAssignments.Where(x =>
                    x.OrgunitType == parentOrgUnit.Key && (
                    parentOrgUnit.Key switch
                    {
                        OrgunitType.Institution => parentOrgUnit.Value == x.Institution.Id,
                        OrgunitType.Site => parentOrgUnit.Value == x.Site.Id,
                        OrgunitType.Building => parentOrgUnit.Value == x.Building.Id,
                    }));
                parentOrgUnitRoles.AddRange(parentOrgUnitRolesQuery);
            }
        }
        parentOrgUnitRoles = parentOrgUnitRoles.DistinctBy(x => x.Id).ToList();
        #endregion

        #region 3. tenant-szintű jogok0
        var tenantRoles = allUserRoleAssignments.Where(x => x.OrgunitType == null).ToList();
        #endregion

        #region 4. összekombináljuk a három listát
        var resultItems = tenantRoles.Union(orgUnitRoles).Union(parentOrgUnitRoles).DistinctBy(x => x.Id).ToList();
        #endregion

        result.Items = [.. resultItems.Select(Mapper.Map<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>)];
        return result;


        //-------------- erdeti logika megfogalmazása:
        /* lekérdezni a user szerepköreit az alábbiak alapján:
         * - ha OrgunitType null, akkor a partner (legfelső) szintű jogosultságokra akarunk keresni, lényegtelen az OrgunitId
         * - ha nem null, akkor ez alapján döntjük el, hogy melyik mezőre szűrünk (Institution, Site, Building) az OrgunitId alapján
         * - OrgUnitId csak akkor lehet null, ha OrgunitType szintén null         
         * - Dictionary<OrgunitType, int> ParentOrgUnits alapján OR-al bővítjük az eredményt
         * - tehát: ha a usernek a keresett konkrét orgunit-ra van valamilyen szerepköre, azt belevesszük az eredményhalmazba.
         * -        azt is belevesszük az eredményhalmazba, ha a ParentOrgUnits-ban található orgunit-okra van valamilyen szerepköre.
         */

        /** TODO: habár az orgunit id-ra szűrögetést meg lehetne csinálni memóriában is valami logikával, lehet, hogy nem baj azért, ha nem olyan nagy listákat dobál vissza a db, amiben minden role-ja benne van.
        *   (jó kérdés, hogy mi a gyorsabb. egy egyszerű query, nagyobb eredménnyel, vagy egy bonyolultabb, és ezért lassabb query, de már sokkal konkrétabb eredménnyel. azért egy userhez olyan sokszáz role-t nem hiszem, hogy hozzárenelnének)
        *   EGYELŐRE A MEMÓRIÁBAN SZŰRÖGETÉST VALÓSÍTOTTAM MEG, A DB-BŐL LEJÖN A USER ÖSSZES SZEREPKÖR HOZZÁRENDELÉSE, AZ ÖSSZES ROLE-JA SZERINT
        **/

    }


    private OrgUnitParentHierarchyQueryResult DoOrgUnitParentHierarchyQuery(OrgUnitParentHierarchyQuery queryParams)
    {
        var hierarchy = new OrgUnitParentHierarchyQueryResult(queryParams.EntityId, queryParams.OrgunitType);

        switch (queryParams.OrgunitType)
        {
            case OrgunitType.Institution: //it has no parent orgunit
                return hierarchy;

            case OrgunitType.Site:
                // Site → Institution hierarchy
                var siteQuery = DbContext.Session.Query<SiteEntity>()
                    .Where(x => x.Id == queryParams.EntityId && !x.IsDeleted)
                    .Select(x => new
                    {
                        InstitutionId = x.Institution.Id
                    }).FirstOrDefault();

                if (siteQuery != null)
                {
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Institution, siteQuery.InstitutionId);
                }

                break;

            case OrgunitType.Building:
                // Building → Site → Institution hierarchy
                var buildingQuery = DbContext.Session.Query<BuildingEntity>()
                    .Where(x => x.Id == queryParams.EntityId && !x.IsDeleted)
                    .Select(x => new
                    {
                        SiteId = x.Site.Id,
                        InstitutionId = x.Site.Institution.Id
                    }).FirstOrDefault();

                if (buildingQuery != null)
                {
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Site, buildingQuery.SiteId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Institution, buildingQuery.InstitutionId);
                }
                break;

            case OrgunitType.BuildingPart:
                // BuildingPart → Building → Site → Institution hierarchy
                var buildingPartQuery = DbContext.Session.Query<BuildingPartEntity>()
                    .Where(x => x.Id == queryParams.EntityId && !x.IsDeleted)
                    .Select(x => new
                    {
                        BuildingId = x.Building.Id,
                        SiteId = x.Building.Site.Id,
                        InstitutionId = x.Building.Site.Institution.Id
                    }).FirstOrDefault();

                if (buildingPartQuery != null)
                {
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Building, buildingPartQuery.BuildingId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Site, buildingPartQuery.SiteId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Institution, buildingPartQuery.InstitutionId);
                }
                break;

            case OrgunitType.Floor:
                // Floor → BuildingPart → Building → Site → Institution hierarchy
                var floorQuery = DbContext.Session.Query<FloorEntity>()
                    .Where(x => x.Id == queryParams.EntityId && !x.IsDeleted)
                    .Select(x => new
                    {
                        BuildingPartId = x.BuildingPart.Id,
                        BuildingId = x.BuildingPart.Building.Id,
                        SiteId = x.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Id,
                        InstitutionId = x.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Institution.Id
                    }).FirstOrDefault();

                if (floorQuery != null)
                {
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.BuildingPart, floorQuery.BuildingPartId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Building, floorQuery.BuildingId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Site, floorQuery.SiteId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Institution, floorQuery.InstitutionId);
                }
                break;

            case OrgunitType.Room:
                // Room → Floor → BuildingPart → Building → Site → Institution hierarchy
                var roomQuery = DbContext.Session.Query<RoomEntity>()
                    .Where(x => x.Id == queryParams.EntityId && !x.IsDeleted)
                    .Select(x => new
                    {
                        FloorId = x.Floor.Id,
                        BuildingPartId = x.Floor.BuildingPart.Id,
                        BuildingId = x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.Id,
                        SiteId = x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Id,
                        InstitutionId = x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Institution.Id
                    }).FirstOrDefault();

                if (roomQuery != null)
                {
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Floor, roomQuery.FloorId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.BuildingPart, roomQuery.BuildingPartId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Building, roomQuery.BuildingId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Site, roomQuery.SiteId);
                    hierarchy.Parents.Add(OrgunitType.Institution, roomQuery.InstitutionId);
                }
                break;
        }

        return hierarchy;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity, SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is SecRoleOrgUnitEntityQuery secRoleOrgUnitEntityQuery)
        {
            if (secRoleOrgUnitEntityQuery.secUserIds.Any())
            {
                queryOver.Where(t =>
                t.User == null
                || t.User.Id.IsIn(secRoleOrgUnitEntityQuery.secUserIds));
            }
            if (secRoleOrgUnitEntityQuery.orgUnitIds.Any())
            {
                queryOver.Where(t =>

                    (t.Institution == null && t.Site == null && t.Building == null)
                    || (t.Institution != null && t.Institution.Id.IsIn(secRoleOrgUnitEntityQuery.orgUnitIds))
                    || (t.Site != null && t.Site.Id.IsIn(secRoleOrgUnitEntityQuery.orgUnitIds))
                    || (t.Building != null && t.Building.Id.IsIn(secRoleOrgUnitEntityQuery.orgUnitIds))
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>

/// </summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// </summary>

    [Description("Épületrészek")]

    public override OrgunitType OrgunitType => OrgunitType.Building;

    public override string Name => CurrentValidity.Name;

    /// <summary>
    /// Épület érvényességek
    /// </summary>
    [Inverse]
    [Description("Épület érvényességek")]
    public virtual IList<BuildingValidityEntity> BuildingValidities { get; set; } = [];

    [Description("Mérési hely-e?")]
    public virtual bool IsMeasurementPoint { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Elszámolási hely-e?
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Elszámolási hely-e?")]
    public virtual bool? IsAggregationPoint { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Pod azonosítók
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Pod azonosítók")]
    public virtual string? PodIdentifiers { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési hely típusa
    /// </summary>
    [DictCode("site_location_type")]
    [Description("Fizikai mérési hely típusa")]
    public virtual TenantIndependentDictItemEntity? Type { get; set; }

    public virtual BuildingValidityEntity CurrentValidity => BuildingValidities.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom < DateTime.Now && x.ValidTo > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                             BuildingValidities.OrderByDescending(x => x.ValidFrom).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                             BuildingValidities.OrderBy(x => x.ValidTo).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidTo < DateTime.Now)!;
}

    //TODO 2: a fenti TODO még akkor keletkezett, amikor úgy volt, hogy a SiteLocation egy-több relációban lesz az egyes szintekhez rendelve, azóta ez 1-1-re változott. 
    //      ezért már lehet, hogy nem is lesz szükség ezekre a navigációs property-kre. mivel nem hivatkozik rá semmi a kódban, ezért ki is kommenteltem. (így már egész biztos nem okosz mapping hibát sem)


    //TODO 3: kereshetőség miatt legyen mégis itt

    public virtual BuildingEntity? Building { get; set; }

    public virtual BuildingPartEntity? BuildingPart { get; set; }

    public virtual FloorEntity? Floor { get; set; }

    public virtual RoomEntity? Room { get; set; }

    [Required]
    [StringBasedEnum]
    public virtual OrgunitType ParentOrgunitType { get; set; }

    public virtual Guid ParentIdentifier { get; set; }


    /// <summary>
    /// A mérési helyen elhelyezett mérő IoT eszközök
    /// </summary>
    [Inverse]
    [Description("IoT mérő eszközök")]
    public virtual IList<DeviceEntity>? IoTDevices { get; set; }


    public virtual OrgunitBaseEntity? GetParentOrgUnit()
    {
        return ParentOrgunitType switch
        {
            OrgunitType.Building => Building,
            OrgunitType.BuildingPart => BuildingPart,
            OrgunitType.Floor => Floor,
            OrgunitType.Room => Room,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{ParentOrgunitType} can't have a SiteLocation!"),
        };
    }

}

using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.OrgUnitSecurity;

/// <summary>
/// Felhasználó szerepkör entitás
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel.TrackedEntityBase" />
[DeletionMode(DeletionMode.Logical)]
public class SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntity : TrackedEntityBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkör
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Description("Szerepkör")]
    public virtual SecRoleEntity? Role { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Felhasználó")]
    public virtual SecUserEntity? User { get; set; }


    /* -----------------
     * Magyarázat
     * Ha OrgUnitType null, akkor bármelyik tenanton belüli szervezeti egységre érvényes a jogosultság, amit a szerepkör biztosít.
     * Ebben az esetben az Institution, Site, Building mezők null értéket vesznek fel.
     * Egyéb esetben a három mező közül legalább egynek értéket kell kapnia, és hierarchiában felette lévőket is kitöltjük.
     
     * példa. ha meg van adva a Site OrgunitType, akkor a műveletek Site-okon végezhetők el. Az, hogy melyik Site-okon, attól függ, hogy melyik konkrét 
     * Institution vagy Site property-k vannak kitöltve. Ha a Site ki van töltve, akkor a művelet csak azon az egy konkrét Site-on végezhető el.
     * Ha Create műveletről van szó, akkor konkrét Site-nak nincs értelme, azt a felette lévő elemre, az Institution-re kell megadni.
     * Ha azt akarjuk, hogy bármely intézményre vonatkozzon, akkor null-t kell az Institution-ben és az OrgunitType-ban is megadni.
     * 
     * A többi elemi művelet már konkrét orgunit-ra is értelmezhető, de akár a feljebb lévő szintekre is.
     
     */

    /// <summary>
    /// Szervezeti egység típusa, (adathatókör)
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Szervezeti egység típusa")]
    [StringBasedEnum]
    public virtual OrgunitType? OrgunitType { get; set; } //null, ha mindenre érvényes a jogosultság (a teljesen szervezeti hierarchiára, tenanton belül)

    /// <summary>
    /// Adott Intézmény, amin a művelet elvégezhető
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Intézmény")]
    public virtual InstitutionEntity? Institution { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adott Telephely, amin a művelet elvégezhető
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Telephely")]
    public virtual SiteEntity? Site { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adott Épület, amin a művelet elvégezhető
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Épület")]
    public virtual BuildingEntity? Building { get; set; }





    /// <summary>
    /// Jogosultság érvényesség kezdete
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Description("Jogosultság érvényesség kezdete")]
    public virtual DateTime ValidFrom { get; set; } //TODO: ez csak dátum. a logikának majd kezelnie kell, hogy az adott nap elejét vegye figyelembe

    /// <summary>
    /// Jogosultság érvényesség vége
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Jogosultság érvényesség vége")]
    public virtual DateTime? ValidTo { get; set; } //TODO: ez csak dátum. a logikának majd kezelnie kell, hogy az adott nap végét vegye figyelembe

}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Helpers;

/// <summary>
///  AggregationHelper
/// </summary>
public static class AggregationHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the <see cref="AggregationHelper"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    static AggregationHelper()
    { }

    /// <summary>
    /// Visszaadja az összesített eszköz-státuszt.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="devices"></param>
    public static DeviceStatus GetDeviceStatus(IList<DeviceEntity>? devices, int? categoryId = null)
    {
        if (devices == null || devices.Count == 0)
            return DeviceStatus.Offline;

        List<DeviceEntity> filteredDevices;
        if (categoryId != null && categoryId > 0)
            filteredDevices = devices!.Where(d => d.IoTDeviceType?.DeviceCategory.Id == categoryId).ToList();
        else
            filteredDevices = devices!.ToList();

        if (filteredDevices.Any(d => d.Status == DeviceStatus.Error))
            return DeviceStatus.Error;
        if (filteredDevices.Any(d => d.Status == DeviceStatus.Warning))
            return DeviceStatus.Warning;
        if (filteredDevices.All(d => d.Status == DeviceStatus.Offline))
            return DeviceStatus.Offline;
        return DeviceStatus.Online;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Visszatérünk egy darabszámmal, ami egy listányi eszközből megadja, hogy adott
    /// kategóriába hány eszköz tartozik.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="devices">Eszközök listája, amelyeken számoljuk, 
    /// hogy hány tartozik a keresett kategóriába.</param>
    /// <param name="categoryId">Az adott DeviceCategory id azonosító.</param>
    public static int GetDeviceCategoryCount(IList<DeviceEntity>? devices, int? categoryId = null)
    {
        if (devices == null || devices.Count == 0)
            return 0;

        if (categoryId == null || categoryId == 0)
            return devices!.Count();

        return devices!.Where(d => d.IoTDeviceType?.DeviceCategory.Id == categoryId).Count();
    }

}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd\Helpers\BackendExcelImportHelper.cs

using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Utils.Excel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Helpers;

public static class BackendExcelImportHelper
{
    public static IEnumerable<ExcelImportErrorModel> ConvertImportErrors<T>(IList<ExcelImportError> errors)
    {
        foreach (var error in errors)
        {
            var (propNameTranslated, errMessage) = ExcelImportHelper.TranslateErrorDetails<T>(error);

            yield return new ExcelImportErrorModel
            {
                SheetTitle = error.SheetTitle,
                Row = error.Row,
                Column = error.Column,
                ColumnId = error.ColumnId,
                TargetPropertyName = propNameTranslated,
                OriginalValueAsString = error.OriginalValueAsString,
                ErrorMessage = errMessage,
            };
        }
    }

}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd\Helpers\JobHelper.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Npgsql;
using Quartz;
using Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore;
using Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.Common;
using Quartz.Impl.Triggers;
using Quartz.Simpl;
using Quartz.Spi;
using Quartz.Util;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// JobHelper
/// </summary>
public static class JobHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// JobStore
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly IJobStore JobStore;

    /// <summary>
    /// MyJobStore
    /// </summary>
    /// <seealso cref="Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.JobStoreCMT" />
    public class MyJobStore : JobStoreCMT
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MyJobStore"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        public MyJobStore()
        {
            ObjectSerializer = new JsonObjectSerializer();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the non managed TX connection.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Context not available.</exception>
        [Obsolete]
        protected override ConnectionAndTransactionHolder GetNonManagedTXConnection()
        {
            var ctx = DbContext.Current;
            if (ctx == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Context not available.");

            var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand();
            ctx.Session.Transaction.Enlist(cmd);

            var result = new ConnectionAndTransactionHolder(ctx.Session.Connection, cmd.Transaction);
            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Cleanup the given database connection.  This means restoring
        /// any modified auto commit or transaction isolation connection
        /// attributes, and then closing the underlying connection.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="conn"></param>
        /// <remarks>
        /// This is separate from closeConnection() because the Spring
        /// integration relies on being able to overload closeConnection() and
        /// expects the same connection back that it originally returned
        /// from the datasource.
        /// </remarks>
        /// <seealso cref="M:Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.JobStoreSupport.CloseConnection(Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.ConnectionAndTransactionHolder)" />
        protected override void CleanupConnection(ConnectionAndTransactionHolder conn) { }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the <see cref="JobHelper"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    static JobHelper()
    {
        JobStore = InitializeJobStore();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Posts the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="jobData">The job data.</param>
    public static void PostJob<T>(IDbContext dbContext, string key, IDictionary<string, object> jobData = null)
        where T : class
    {
        PostJob(typeof(T), dbContext, key, jobData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Posts the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jobType">Type of the job.</param>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="jobData">The job data.</param>
    /// <param name="setupTriggerAction">The setup trigger action.</param>
    public static void PostJob(Type jobType, IDbContext dbContext, string key,
        IDictionary<string, object> jobData = null, Action<TriggerBuilder> setupTriggerAction = null)
    {
        var jobKey = new JobKey(key, "EnergiaMenedzsment_FRAMEWORK");
        var job = JobBuilder.Create(jobType)
            .WithIdentity(jobKey)
            .UsingJobData(jobData == null ? new JobDataMap() : new JobDataMap(jobData))
            .RequestRecovery(false)
            .Build();

        var triggerKey = new TriggerKey(key, "EnergiaMenedzsment_FRAMEWORK");
        var triggerBuilder = TriggerBuilder.Create()
            .WithIdentity(triggerKey)
            .ForJob(jobKey);

        if (setupTriggerAction != null)
            setupTriggerAction(triggerBuilder);
        else
            triggerBuilder.StartNow();

        var trigger = triggerBuilder.Build();

        if (trigger is SimpleTriggerImpl simpletrigger)
            simpletrigger.SetNextFireTimeUtc(trigger.StartTimeUtc);

        if (trigger is CronTriggerImpl cronTrigger)
        {
            var exp = new CronExpression(cronTrigger.CronExpressionString);
            var nextValidTimeAfter = exp.GetNextValidTimeAfter(DateTime.UtcNow);
            if (nextValidTimeAfter != null)
            {
                var nextFireDate = nextValidTimeAfter.Value.UtcDateTime;
                cronTrigger.SetNextFireTimeUtc(nextFireDate);
            }
        }

        var dictionary = new Dictionary<IJobDetail, IReadOnlyCollection<ITrigger>>
        {
            {job, new HashSet<ITrigger> {trigger}}
        };

        using (new DbContext.DbContextSession(dbContext))
        {
            JobStore.StoreJobsAndTriggers(dictionary, true).RunSync();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the job store.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static IJobStore InitializeJobStore()
    {
        var connectionString = Config.GetStringValue("Db.ConnectionString", true);
        var dbProvider = new DbProvider("Npgsql", connectionString);
        DBConnectionManager.Instance.AddConnectionProvider("default", dbProvider);

        var result = new MyJobStore
        {
            InstanceName = Config.GetStringValue("Quartz.Scheduler.InstanceName", true),
            InstanceId = Config.GetStringValue("Quartz.Scheduler.InstanceId", true),
            TablePrefix = "qrtz_",
            DataSource = "default",
            Clustered = true,
            PerformSchemaValidation = false,
            DriverDelegateType = "Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.StdAdoDelegate, Quartz" // lsd: QuartzServiceBase.StartScheduler.  itt eredetileg ez volt: Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.SqlServerDelegate, Quartz    
        };
        result.Initialize(new SimpleTypeLoadHelper(), null).RunSync();
        
        if (result.ObjectSerializer != null)
            result.ObjectSerializer.Initialize();
        
        return result;
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using Common.Utils.Excel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Excel.ExcelPreprocessor.Attributes;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Interfaces;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.EnergyPerformance.Models;

[ExcelRowSkip(1)]
[ExcelSheet("_room_upload_")]

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport.Handlers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.OrgunitImport;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport;
public class OrgunitDataValidationHandler
{
    private readonly InstitutionValidationHandler _institutionHandler;
    private readonly SiteValidationHandler _siteHandler;
    private readonly BuildingValidationHandler _buildingHandler;
    private readonly BuildingPartValidationHandler _buildingPartHandler;
    private readonly FloorValidationHandler _floorHandler;
    private readonly RoomValidationHandler _roomHandler;

    public OrgunitDataValidationHandler(InstitutionValidationHandler institutionHandler,
                                        SiteValidationHandler siteHandler,
                                        BuildingValidationHandler buildingHandler,
                                        BuildingPartValidationHandler buildingPartHandler,
                                        FloorValidationHandler floorHandler,
                                        RoomValidationHandler roomHandler)
    {
        _institutionHandler = institutionHandler;
        _siteHandler = siteHandler;
        _buildingHandler = buildingHandler;
        _buildingPartHandler = buildingPartHandler;
        _floorHandler = floorHandler;
        _roomHandler = roomHandler;
    }

    public OrgunitImportDataValidationResult StartDataValidation(OrgunitImportFormatValidationResult result, List<ExcelImportErrorModel> errorlist)
    {
        _institutionHandler.StartValidation(result.InstitutionImportModels, errorlist);
        _siteHandler.StartValidation(result.SiteImportModels, errorlist, _institutionHandler.IdStore, _institutionHandler.ResultList);
        _buildingHandler.StartValidation(result.BuildingImportModels, errorlist, _siteHandler.IdStore, _siteHandler.ResultList);
        _buildingPartHandler.StartValidation(result.BuildingPartImportModels, errorlist, _buildingHandler.IdStore, _buildingHandler.ResultList);
        _floorHandler.StartValidation(result.FloorImportModels, errorlist, _buildingPartHandler.IdStore, _buildingPartHandler.ResultList);
        _roomHandler.StartValidation(result.RoomImportModels, errorlist, _floorHandler.IdStore, _floorHandler.ResultList);

        return new OrgunitImportDataValidationResult()
        {
            InstitutionEntityDtos = _institutionHandler.ResultList,
            SiteEntityDtos = _siteHandler.ResultList,
            BuildingEntityDtos = _buildingHandler.ResultList,
            BuildingPartEntityDtos = _buildingPartHandler.ResultList,
            FloorEntityDtos = _floorHandler.ResultList,
            RoomEntityDtos = _roomHandler.ResultList,
        };
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd\Import\OrgunitImport\Handlers\BaseValidationHandler.cs
