using System.Reflection;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Utils.Excel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Constants;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.Results;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport.Handlers;

public abstract class BaseValidationHandler<TEntityDto, TValidity, TModel> where TEntityDto : class, IEntityDto, new()
                                                                           where TModel : IImportModel
                                                                           where TValidity : class, IEntityDto
{
    private const int SKIPPED_ROWS = OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetHeaderRow + 1;

    private readonly SettlementCache _settlmentCache;
    private readonly StreetSuffixCache _streetSuffixCache;

    private readonly Lazy<IValidator<TEntityDto>> _entityDtoValidator;
    private readonly Lazy<IValidator<TValidity>> _validityValidator;

    private int _row;
    protected readonly List<ExcelImportErrorModel> _errorlist = [];
    protected readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    protected readonly ICommandService _commandService;

    public BaseValidationHandler(TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache,
                                 SettlementCache settlmentCache,
                                 StreetSuffixCache streetSuffixCache,
                                 Lazy<IValidator<TEntityDto>> validator,
                                 Lazy<IValidator<TValidity>> validityValidator,
                                 ICommandService commandService)
    {
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
        _settlmentCache = settlmentCache;
        _streetSuffixCache = streetSuffixCache;
        _entityDtoValidator = validator;
        _validityValidator = validityValidator;
        _commandService = commandService;
    }

    public Dictionary<string, EntityDtoIdPair<TEntityDto>> IdStore { get; } = new();
    public List<TEntityDto> ResultList { get; } = new();

    protected abstract string SheetTitle { get; }

    protected abstract Dictionary<string, string> ModelDtoMap { get; }

    protected abstract TValidity AssembleValidity(TModel model);

    protected abstract void AddMasterData(TEntityDto entityDto, TModel model);

    protected abstract void HandleAdditionToParent(TEntityDto entityDto, TModel model);

    protected abstract void HandleValidityAddition(TEntityDto entityDto, TValidity validity, int Id);
    
    protected abstract void HandleAdditionalValidityValidation(TValidity validity, TModel model);

    protected abstract IEntityDto QueryEntityDto(string identifier);

    protected abstract IEntityDto QueryParentEntityDto(string identifier);

    protected void AssembleEntityDto(IList<TModel> models)
    {
        for (_row = 0; _row < models.Count; _row++)
        {
            TValidity validity = AssembleValidity(models[_row]);
            if (IsNewMasterDataTest(models[_row]))
            {
                TEntityDto newItem = new TEntityDto();
                AddMasterData(newItem, models[_row]);
                HandleValidityAddition(newItem, validity, 0);

                HandleAdditionToParent(newItem, models[_row]);

                if (TryUpdateEntity(newItem, out TEntityDto? updated))
                {
                    IdStore.Add(models[_row].Id, new EntityDtoIdPair<TEntityDto>() { EntityDto = newItem, Id = updated.Id });
                    HandleAdditionalValidityValidation(validity, models[_row]);
                }
                else 
                {
                    IdStore.Add(models[_row].Id, new EntityDtoIdPair<TEntityDto>() { EntityDto = newItem});
                    HandleAdditionalValidityValidation(null, models[_row]);
                }
            }
            else 
            {
                var currentItem = IdStore[models[_row].Id];
                HandleValidityAddition(currentItem.EntityDto, validity, currentItem.Id);
                TryUpdateEntity(validity, out TValidity? _);

                HandleAdditionalValidityValidation(validity, models[_row]);
            }
        }
    }

    protected bool TryUpdateEntity<T>(T entityDto, out T? updatedEntityDto) where T : class, IEntityDto
    {
        try
        {
            updatedEntityDto = _commandService.UpdateEntity(entityDto);
            return updatedEntityDto != null;
        }
        catch (ValidationException validationException)
        {
            AddValidationError(validationException.Errors);
            updatedEntityDto = null;
            return false;
        }
    }

    protected EntityDtoIdPair<TParent> ResolveParentId<TParent>(IChildImportModel model,
                                         Dictionary<string, EntityDtoIdPair<TParent>> idStore,
                                         List<TParent> parentList) where TParent : class, IEntityDto, new()
    {
        if (model.ParentIdAsGuid.HasValue)
        {
            if (QueryParentEntityDto(model.ParentId) is TParent entityDto)
            {
                if (idStore.TryAdd(model.ParentIdAsGuid.Value.ToString(), new EntityDtoIdPair<TParent>() 
                {
                    EntityDto = entityDto,
                    Id = entityDto.Id
                }))
                {
                    parentList.Add(entityDto);
                }
                return idStore[model.ParentIdAsGuid.Value.ToString()];
            }
            else
            {
                var property = model.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(IChildImportModel.ParentId));
                AddErrorMessage(property, "A megadott szülő azonosító nem talalálható!", model.ParentId);

                return null;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            return idStore[model.ParentId];
        }
    }

    protected void AddErrorMessage(MemberInfo property, string errorMessage, string value)
    {
        var excelImport = property?.GetCustomAttribute<ExcelImportAttribute>();
        var display = property?.GetCustomAttribute<System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.DisplayAttribute>();
        _errorlist.Add(new ExcelImportErrorModel()
        {
            SheetTitle = SheetTitle,
            Row = _row + SKIPPED_ROWS,
            Column = excelImport?.ColumnIndex ?? -1,
            ColumnId = excelImport?.ColumnId ?? "Nem ismert!",
            OriginalValueAsString = value,
            TargetPropertyName = display?.Name ?? "Nem ismert!",
            ErrorMessage = errorMessage,
        });
    }

    protected void AddOrgunitValidityDtoData(OrgunitValidityDtoBase validity, IOrgunitValidityImportModel model)
    {
        validity.Name = model.Name;
        validity.EMail = model.EMail;
        validity.Telephone = model.Telephone;
        validity.BusinessIdentifier = model.BusinessIdentifier;
        validity.ValidFrom = model.ValidFrom;
        validity.ValidTo = model.ValidTo;
    }

    protected void AddGeoCoordData(IGeoCoord validity, IGeoCoord model)
    {
        validity.Lon = model.Lon;
        validity.Lat = model.Lat;
    }

    protected DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto? CreateAddress(IDomesticExtendedLotAddressImportModel model)
    {
        DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto address = new();
        int currentErrorCount = _errorlist.Count;

        if (TryResolveDictItemCode(DictType.County, model.County, out EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> countyRef))
        {
            address.County = countyRef;
        }
        else
        {
            var countyProperty = model.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(IDomesticExtendedLotAddressImportModel.County));
            AddErrorMessage(countyProperty, "A megadott megye nem létezik az adatbázisban!", model.County);
        }

        if (TryResolveDictItemCode(DictType.CountyDistrict, model.CountyDistrict, out EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> countyDistrictRef))
        {
            address.CountyDistrict = countyDistrictRef;
        }
        else
        {
            var countyDistrictProperty = model.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(IDomesticExtendedLotAddressImportModel.CountyDistrict));
            AddErrorMessage(countyDistrictProperty, "A megadott járás nem létezik az adatbázisban!", model.CountyDistrict);
        }

        if (TryResolveDictItemCode(DictType.ZipCode, model.ZipCode, out EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> zipCodeRef))
        {
            address.ZipCode = zipCodeRef;
        }
        else
        {
            var zipcodeProperty = model.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(IDomesticExtendedLotAddressImportModel.ZipCode));
            AddErrorMessage(zipcodeProperty, "A megadott irányítószám nem létezik az adatbázisban!", model.ZipCode);
        }

        if (TryResolveSettlementCode(model.Settlement, out EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto> settlementRef))
        {
            address.Settlement = settlementRef;
        }
        else
        {
            var settlementProperty = model.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(IDomesticExtendedLotAddressImportModel.Settlement));
            AddErrorMessage(settlementProperty, "A megadott település nem létezik az adatbázisban!", model.Settlement);
        }

        if (TryResolveStreetSuffixCode(model.StreetSuffix, out EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto> streetSuffixRef))
        {
            address.StreetSuffix = streetSuffixRef;
        }
        else
        {
            var streetSuffixProperty = model.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(IDomesticExtendedLotAddressImportModel.StreetSuffix));
            AddErrorMessage(streetSuffixProperty, "A megadott közterület jelleg nem létezik az adatbázisban!", model.StreetSuffix);
        }

        address.StreetName = model.StreetName;
        address.HouseNumber = model.HouseNumber;
        address.Building = model.Building;
        address.Stairway = model.Stairway;
        address.Floor = model.Floor;
        address.Door = model.Door;
        address.LotNumber = model.LotNumber;

        //if (_errorlist.Count == currentErrorCount)
        //{
        //    var validationResult = OnValidate(_addressValidator, address);
        //    if (!validationResult.IsValid)
        //    {
        //        AddValidationError(validationResult.Errors);
        //    }
        //}


        return address;
    }

    protected bool TryResolveDictItemCode(DictType type, string value, out EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> entityRef)
    {
        var item = _tiDictCache.GetItemByValue(type, value);
        if (item != null)
        {
            entityRef = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>() { Id = item.Id };
            return true;
        }
        else
        {
            entityRef = null;
            return false;
        }
    }


    private bool TryResolveSettlementCode(string settlementCode, out EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto> entityRef)
    {
        try
        {
            var settlement = _settlmentCache.GetByName(settlementCode);
            entityRef = new EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>() { Id = settlement.Id };
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            entityRef = null;
            return false;
        }
    }

    private bool TryResolveStreetSuffixCode(string streetSuffixCode, out EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto> entityRef)
    {
        var streetSuffix = _streetSuffixCache.GetByName(streetSuffixCode);
        if (streetSuffix != null)
        {
            entityRef = new EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>() { Id = streetSuffix.Id };
            return true;
        }
        else
        {
            entityRef = null;
            return false;
        }
    }

    private bool IsNewMasterDataTest(IImportModel model)
    {
        if (model.IdAsGuid.HasValue)
        {
            if (QueryEntityDto(model.Id) is TEntityDto entityDto)
            {
                if (IdStore.TryAdd(model.IdAsGuid.Value.ToString(), new EntityDtoIdPair<TEntityDto>() { EntityDto = entityDto, Id = entityDto.Id }))
                {
                    ResultList.Add(entityDto);
                }
                return false;
            }
            else
            {
                TEntityDto newItem = new TEntityDto();
                var property = model.GetType().GetProperty(nameof(IImportModel.Id));
                AddErrorMessage(property, "A megadott szülő azonosító nem talalálható!", model.Id);
                if (IdStore.TryAdd(model.IdAsGuid.Value.ToString(), new EntityDtoIdPair<TEntityDto>() { EntityDto = newItem }))
                {
                    ResultList.Add(newItem);
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            return !IdStore.ContainsKey(model.Id);
        }
    }

    protected void AddValidationError(IEnumerable<ValidationFailure> errors)
    {
        foreach (var error in errors)
        {
            var propertyInfo = typeof(TModel).GetProperty(ModelDtoMap[error.PropertyName]); 
            AddErrorMessage(propertyInfo, error.ErrorMessage, error.AttemptedValue?.ToString() ?? "");
        }
    }

    protected ValidationResult OnValidate<T>(Lazy<IValidator<T>> validator, T currentItem)
    {
        return validator.Value.Validate(currentItem,
                                        options => options.IncludeRuleSets("default", "BackEnd"));
    }
}

public class EntityDtoIdPair<T>
{
    public T EntityDto { get; set; }

    public int Id { get; set; }
}

        { nameof(DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto.Door), nameof(BuildingImportModel.Door) },

    };


    public BuildingValidationHandler(IQueryService queryService,
                                     TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache,
                                     SettlementCache settlmentCache,
                                     StreetSuffixCache streetSuffixCache,
                                     Lazy<IValidator<BuildingEntityDto>> validator,
                                     Lazy<IValidator<BuildingValidityEntityDto>> validityValidator,
                                     Lazy<IValidator<DomesticExtendedLotNumberAddressEntityDto>> addressValidator,
                                     ICommandService commandService)
        : base(tiDictCache, settlmentCache, streetSuffixCache, validator, validityValidator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _addressValidator = addressValidator;
    }

    public void StartValidation(IList<BuildingImportModel> models, List<ExcelImportErrorModel> errorlist,
        Dictionary<string, EntityDtoIdPair<SiteEntityDto>> parentIdStore, List<SiteEntityDto> parentList)
    {
        _parentIdStore = parentIdStore;
        _parentList = parentList;
        AssembleEntityDto(models);
        errorlist.AddRange(_errorlist);
    }

    protected override string SheetTitle => OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Building;

    protected override void AddMasterData(BuildingEntityDto entityDto, BuildingImportModel model)
    {
        entityDto.Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>();
        entityDto.IsAggregationPoint = model.IsAggregationPoint;
        entityDto.IsMeasurementPoint = model.IsMeasurementPoint;
    }

    protected override BuildingValidityEntityDto AssembleValidity(BuildingImportModel model)
    {
        BuildingValidityEntityDto validity = new();
        validity.Building = new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>();
        validity.Address = CreateAddress(model);
        AddOrgunitValidityDtoData(validity, model);
        AddGeoCoordData(validity, model);
        if (TryResolveDictItemCode(DictType.BuildingProfile, model.BuildingProfile?.ToLower(), out EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> profileRef))
        {
            validity.BuildingProfile = profileRef;
        }
        else
        {
            var profileProperty = typeof(BuildingImportModel).GetProperty(nameof(BuildingImportModel.BuildingProfile));
            AddErrorMessage(profileProperty, "A megadott épületprofil nem létezik az adatbázisban!", model.BuildingProfile);
        }
        return validity;
    }

    protected override void HandleValidityAddition(BuildingEntityDto entityDto, BuildingValidityEntityDto validity, int id)
    {
        validity.Building = new EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>() { Id = id };
        entityDto.BuildingValidities.Add(validity);
    }

    protected override void HandleAdditionToParent(BuildingEntityDto entityDto, BuildingImportModel model)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(model.ParentId))
        {
            EntityDtoIdPair<SiteEntityDto> parent = ResolveParentId(model, _parentIdStore, _parentList);

            if (parent != null)
            {
                entityDto.Site = new EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>() { Id = parent.Id };
                if (!parent.EntityDto.Buildings.Contains(entityDto))
                {
                    parent.EntityDto.Buildings.Add(entityDto);
                }
            }
            else 
            {
                ResultList.Add(entityDto);
            }
        }
    }

    protected override IEntityDto QueryEntityDto(string identifier)
    {
        _idQuery.Identifier = identifier;
        return _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(_idQuery).RunSync()?.Entity;
    }

    protected override IEntityDto QueryParentEntityDto(string identifier)
    {
        _parentQuery.Identifier = identifier;
        return _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(_parentQuery).RunSync()?.Entity;
    }

    protected override void HandleAdditionalValidityValidation(BuildingValidityEntityDto validity, BuildingImportModel model)
    {

        int currentErrorCount = _errorlist.Count;
        var address = CreateAddress(model);
        if (_errorlist.Count == currentErrorCount)
        {
            var validationResult = OnValidate(_addressValidator, address);
            if (!validationResult.IsValid)
            {
                AddValidationError(validationResult.Errors);
            }
        }
        if (validity != null)
        {
            validity.Address = address;
        }
    }
}

        //Intézménynek nincs szülője
    }

    protected override IEntityDto QueryEntityDto(string identifier)
    {
        _idQuery.Identifier = identifier;
        return _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(_idQuery).RunSync()?.Entity;
    }

    protected override IEntityDto QueryParentEntityDto(string identifier)
    {
        //Intézménynek nincs szülője
        return null;
    }

    protected override void HandleAdditionalValidityValidation(InstitutionValidityEntityDto validity, InstitutionImportModel model)
    {
        int currentErrorCount = _errorlist.Count;
        var address = CreateAddress(model);
        if (_errorlist.Count == currentErrorCount)
        {
            var validationResult = OnValidate(_addressValidator, address);
            if (!validationResult.IsValid)
            {
                AddValidationError(validationResult.Errors);
            }
        }

        if (validity != null) 
        { 
            validity.Headquarters = address;
        }
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Constants;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Floor;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Room;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Floor;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Room;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Import.OrgunitImport.Handlers;
public class RoomValidationHandler : BaseValidationHandler<RoomEntityDto, RoomValidityEntityDto, RoomImportModel>
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private Dictionary<string, EntityDtoIdPair<FloorEntityDto>> _parentIdStore;
    private List<FloorEntityDto> _parentList;

    private readonly RoomEntityQuery _idQuery = new();
    private readonly FloorEntityQuery _parentQuery = new();

    protected override Dictionary<string, string> ModelDtoMap { get; } = new Dictionary<string, string>
    {
        { nameof(RoomValidityEntityDto.Name), nameof(RoomImportModel.Name) },
        { nameof(RoomValidityEntityDto.Telephone), nameof(RoomImportModel.Telephone) },
        { nameof(RoomValidityEntityDto.EMail), nameof(RoomImportModel.EMail) },
        { nameof(RoomValidityEntityDto.BusinessIdentifier), nameof(RoomImportModel.BusinessIdentifier) },
        { nameof(RoomValidityEntityDto.ValidTo), nameof(RoomImportModel.ValidTo) },
        { nameof(RoomValidityEntityDto.ValidFrom), nameof(RoomImportModel.ValidFrom) },
        { nameof(RoomValidityEntityDto.Lat), nameof(RoomImportModel.Lat) },
        { nameof(RoomValidityEntityDto.Lon), nameof(RoomImportModel.Lon) },
        { nameof(RoomValidityEntityDto.RoomProfile), nameof(RoomImportModel.RoomProfile) },
        { nameof(RoomEntityDto.IsAggregationPoint), nameof(RoomImportModel.IsAggregationPoint) },
        { nameof(RoomEntityDto.IsMeasurementPoint), nameof(RoomImportModel.IsMeasurementPoint) },
    };

    public RoomValidationHandler(IQueryService queryService,
                                 TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache,
                                 SettlementCache settlmentCache,
                                 StreetSuffixCache streetSuffixCache,
                                 Lazy<IValidator<RoomEntityDto>> validator,
                                 Lazy<IValidator<RoomValidityEntityDto>> validityValidator,
                                 ICommandService commandService)
        : base(tiDictCache, settlmentCache, streetSuffixCache, validator, validityValidator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    public void StartValidation(IList<RoomImportModel> models, List<ExcelImportErrorModel> errorlist,
        Dictionary<string, EntityDtoIdPair<FloorEntityDto>> parentIdStore, List<FloorEntityDto> parentList)
    {
        _parentIdStore = parentIdStore;
        _parentList = parentList;
        AssembleEntityDto(models);
        errorlist.AddRange(_errorlist);
    }

    protected override string SheetTitle => OrgunitImportConstants.ExcelSheetNames.Room;

    protected override void AddMasterData(RoomEntityDto entityDto, RoomImportModel model)
    {
        entityDto.Floor = new EntityRef<FloorEntityDto>();
        entityDto.IsAggregationPoint = model.IsAggregationPoint;
        entityDto.IsMeasurementPoint = model.IsMeasurementPoint;
    }

    protected override RoomValidityEntityDto AssembleValidity(RoomImportModel model)
    {
        RoomValidityEntityDto validity = new();
        validity.Room = new EntityRef<RoomEntityDto>();
        AddOrgunitValidityDtoData(validity, model);
        AddGeoCoordData(validity, model);
        validity.RoomProfile = AddRoomProfile(model);
        return validity;
    }

    private EntityRef<RoomProfileEntityDto>? AddRoomProfile(RoomImportModel model)
    {
        var query = new RoomProfileEntityQuery() { Name = model.RoomProfile };
        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(query)?.Result?.Entity is RoomProfileEntityDto entityDto)
        {
            return new EntityRef<RoomProfileEntityDto>() { Id = entityDto.Id };
        }
        else 
        {
            var property = typeof(RoomImportModel).GetProperty(nameof(RoomImportModel.RoomProfile));
            AddErrorMessage(property, "A megadott helyiségtípus nem létezik az adatbázisban!", model.RoomProfile.ToString());
            return null;
        }
    }


    protected override void HandleValidityAddition(RoomEntityDto entityDto, RoomValidityEntityDto validity, int id)
    {
        validity.Room = new EntityRef<RoomEntityDto>() { Id = id };
        entityDto.RoomValidities.Add(validity);
    }

    protected override void HandleAdditionToParent(RoomEntityDto entityDto, RoomImportModel model)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(model.ParentId))
        {
            EntityDtoIdPair<FloorEntityDto> parent = ResolveParentId(model, _parentIdStore, _parentList);

            if (parent != null)
            {
                entityDto.Floor = new EntityRef<FloorEntityDto>() { Id = parent.Id };
                if (!parent.EntityDto.Rooms.Contains(entityDto))
                {
                    parent.EntityDto.Rooms.Add(entityDto);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                ResultList.Add(entityDto);
            }
        }
    }

    protected override IEntityDto QueryEntityDto(string identifier)
    {
        _idQuery.Identifier = identifier;
        return _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(_idQuery).RunSync()?.Entity;
    }

    protected override IEntityDto QueryParentEntityDto(string identifier)
    {
        _parentQuery.Identifier = identifier;
        return _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(_parentQuery).RunSync()?.Entity;
    }

    protected override void HandleAdditionalValidityValidation(RoomValidityEntityDto validity, RoomImportModel model)
    {
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandler.Security;

/// <summary>
/// Jelszó értesítés manager
/// </summary>
public class PasswordNotificationManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Forgottens the password.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="email">The username.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<PasswordCommandResult> ForgottenPassword(string email, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var _commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        var result = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ForgottenPasswordCommand
        {
            Email = email
        });

        var res = (PasswordCommandResult)result;

        //Email küldes a felhasználónak
        MailSending(res, dbContext);
        return res;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Expirings the password.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="email">The email.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<PasswordCommandResult> ExpiringPassword(ILifetimeScope scope, string email)
    {
        var _commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        var result = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ExpiringPasswordCommand
        {
            Email = email
        });

        var res = (PasswordCommandResult)result;

        //Email küldes a felhasználónak
        MailSending(res, dbContext);
        return res;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Passwords the change.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
    /// <param name="newPasswordAgain">The new password again.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommandResult> PasswordChange(string? newPassword, string? newPasswordAgain, string tenantCode, string token)
    {
        using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        var _commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        var result = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommand
        {
            NewPassword = newPassword,
            NewPasswordAgain = newPasswordAgain,
            TenantCode = tenantCode,
            Token = token
        });

        var res = (PasswordCommandResult)result;
        //Email küldes a felhasználónak
        MailSending(res, dbContext);

        SecUserEntityDto? user = null;
        scope.SetAnonymousContext(tenantCode);
        var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

        user = (SecUserEntityDto?)(await queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
        {
            Id = res.SecUserId,
            TenantCode = tenantCode
        }))?.Entity;



        return new ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommandResult()
        {
            User = user
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Forgottens the password.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="email">The email.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public async Task<PasswordCommandResult> NewUserRegistration(string email, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var _commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        var result = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreateSecUserTokenCommand
        {
            Email = email
        });

        var res = (PasswordCommandResult)result;

        //Email küldes a felhasználónak
        MailSending(res, dbContext);
        return res;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a notification job for sending mail to the user
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="result">The result.</param>
    private static void MailSending(PasswordCommandResult result, IDbContext dbContext)
    {
        //Email küldes a felhasználónak
        if (result != null && result.SendEmail)
        {
            CreateNotificationJob.PostJob(
                   result.SecurityContext,
                   dbContext,
                   result.Token,
                   new List<int>() { result.SecUserId },
                   result.Template);
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.BackEnd.Managers;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Messaging;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Services;

public class CommandServiceServer : ICommandService, ISecurable
{
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    public CommandServiceServer(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        IsCheckAccessEnabled = true;
    }

    public bool IsCheckAccessEnabled { get; set; }

    public Task<ICommandResult> ExecuteCommand(ICommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    public virtual Task<ICommandResult> ExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, string? dbContextKey = default)
    {
        ICommandResult result;
        var svc = ResolveService(command);

        // ******** EnergiaMenedzsment
        if (svc.TransactionMode != CommandHandlerTransactionMode.No)
        {
            // Main database
            IDbContext dbContext;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbContextKey))
            {
                dbContext = _scope.ResolveKeyed<IDbContext>(dbContextKey);
            }
            else
            {
                dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
            }

            // Messaging
            _scope.TryResolve(out IMessagingContext? messagingContext);


#pragma warning disable IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
            using (var tran = TransactionContext.Create(dbContext, svc.TransactionMode == CommandHandlerTransactionMode.Auto))
#pragma warning restore IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
            {
                result = svc.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);

                tran.Commit();
                if ((messagingContext?.Enabled ?? false) && messagingContext.IsInTransaction)
                    messagingContext.Commit();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            result = svc.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);
        }

        return Task.FromResult(result);
    }

    public void TryDbAction(Action action)
    {
        var dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        using (var tran = TransactionContext.Create(dbContext, true))
        {
            action.Invoke();

            tran.RollBack();
        }
    }

    public virtual ICommandHandler ResolveService(IEntityCommand command, string? key = null)
    {
        if (IsCheckAccessEnabled)
        {
            SecurityManager.CheckAccess(_scope, command);
        }

        if (key == null)
            return _scope.ResolveNamed<ICommandHandler>(command.EntityTypeName);

        if (_scope.IsRegisteredWithName<ICommandHandler>($"{key}.{command.EntityTypeName}"))
            return _scope.ResolveNamed<ICommandHandler>($"{key}.{command.EntityTypeName}");
        return null;
    }


}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.BackEnd.Managers;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Services;

/// <summary>
/// QueryServiceServer
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Services.IQueryService" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Security.ISecurable" />
public class QueryServiceServer : IQueryService, ISecurable
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is check access enabled.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// <c>true</c> if this instance is check access enabled; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool IsCheckAccessEnabled { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="QueryServiceServer"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public QueryServiceServer(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        IsCheckAccessEnabled = true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<IQueryResult> ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).ExecuteQuery(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<IEntityQuerySingleResult?> QuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).QuerySingleEntity(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<IEntityQueryItemsResult> QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).QueryEntities(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the entity count.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<long> QueryEntityCount(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).QueryEntityCount(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves the service.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual IQueryHandler ResolveService(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (IsCheckAccessEnabled)
        {
            var attrib = SecurityManager.GetAttribute(query);
            var securityContext = attrib == null || !attrib.NoCheck ? _scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>() : null;
            SecurityManager.CheckAccess(securityContext, query);
        }

        var svc = _scope.ResolveNamed<IQueryHandler>(query.EntityTypeName);
        var dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        dbContext.IsReadOnly = true;

        return svc;

    }

}

/// <summary>
/// AutofacBackEndModule
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Autofac.Module" />
public class AutofacBackEndModule : Module
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Override to add registrations to the container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder through which components can be
    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)

        // Ha másik modul is használ JsonAttribute-t akkor közösbe kiszervezni 
        NpgsqlConnection.GlobalTypeMapper.UseJsonNet(new[] 
        { 
            typeof(dynamic[]),
            typeof(List<string>),
            typeof(List<ExcelImportErrorModel>),
            typeof(OrgunitImportDataValidationResult),
        });

        //Database
        //EnergiaMenedzsment Database
        builder.RegisterType<DbContext>()
            .Keyed<IDbContext>("Framework")
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        //Core Database
        builder.RegisterType<CoreDbContext>()

using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Autofac;
using Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Caching;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using static Common.Shared.Constants;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundService;

public static class BackgroundServiceInitializer
{
    public static void Initialize(string[] args)
    {
        Log.Logger.UseBootstrapSerilog();

        var host = CreateHostBuilder(args).Build();
        AutofacScope.SetGlobal(host.Services.GetAutofacRoot());

        var configuration = AutofacScope.Global.Resolve<IConfiguration>();

        Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
        Log.LogInfo(
            $"EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework Background Service - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(BackgroundServiceInitializer))}");
        
        Log.LogInfo("DateTime Utc Now: {UtcNow}, DateTime Now: {Now}", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O"), DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O"));

        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Linux}");
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Windows}");

        Config.LocalProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);
        Config.Provider = new DbConfigProvider(AutofacScope.Global);

        host.Run();
    }

    public static void ConfigureContainer(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x =>
            x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common") ||
            x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework") ||
            AssemblyHelper.CheckAssemblyType(x, AssemblyType.DeviceType));
        builder.RegisterMaps();
    }

    public static IHostBuilder
        CreateHostBuilder(string[] args)
    {
        var host = Host.CreateDefaultBuilder(args);

        host.ConfigureServices(services =>
        {
            var builder = new ConfigurationBuilder()
             .SetBasePath(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory())
             .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
             .AddJsonFile("appsettings.Development.json", true)
             .AddEnvironmentVariables();

            var configuration = builder.Build();

            var redisSection = configuration.GetSection(RedisSettings.Redis);
            services.Configure<RedisSettings>(redisSection);
            var redisSettings = new RedisSettings();
            redisSection.Bind(redisSettings);

            services.ConfigureCaching(redisSettings);

            services.AddHttpClient(ModuleAuthClientNames.FrameworkAuthClient, client =>
            {
                client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(ModuleHostConfigKeys.FrameworkApiHost));
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("text/plain"));
                //client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("TODO..."));
            });

            services.AddModuleApiClients();
        });

        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)) host.UseSystemd();
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)) host.UseWindowsService();
        host.UseServiceProviderFactory(new AutofacServiceProviderFactory(ConfigureContainer));
        return host;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Services;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.BackgroundService.Wireup;

/// <summary>
/// AutofacFrameworkBackgroundService
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Autofac.Module" />
public class AutofacFrameworkBackgroundService : Module
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Override to add registrations to the container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder through which components can be
    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.RegisterSecurityContext();

        builder
            .RegisterType<DbContext>()
            .As<IDbContext>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        builder.RegisterType<QueryServiceServer>().As<IQueryService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<CommandServiceServer>().As<ICommandService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        builder.RegisterQuartzBackgroundService("Db.ConnectionString");

        builder.RegisterType<DeviceHealthCheckJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();

        builder.RegisterType<EmailSenderJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();

        builder.RegisterType<PasswordWarningJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();

        builder.RegisterType<ExpiredPasswordJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
    }
}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest;

public class ExtendedDbTestBase : FrameworkTestBase
{
    public readonly TenantIndependentDictCache TiCache;
    public readonly IMapper Mapper;
    public readonly StreetSuffixCache StreetSuffixCache;
    public readonly CountryCache CountryCache;
    public readonly SettlementCache SettlementCache;

    protected ExtendedDbTestBase(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture) : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
        TiCache = Scope.Resolve<TenantIndependentDictCache>();
        CountryCache = Scope.Resolve<CountryCache>();
        SettlementCache = Scope.Resolve<SettlementCache>();
        StreetSuffixCache = Scope.Resolve<StreetSuffixCache>();
        Mapper = Scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
    }

    public IQueryService PublicQueryService => QueryService;
    public ICommandService PublicCommandService => CommandService;
    public ILifetimeScope PublicScope => Scope;
}

public static class TestHelpers
{
    public static async Task<EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>> GetNewInstitutionRefAsync(this ExtendedDbTestBase testClass, AddressEntityDto? addressEntityDto = null)
    {
        var institutionCommand = new CreateInstitutionCommand
        {
            Name = nameof(GetNewInstitutionRefAsync)
        };

        if (await testClass.PublicCommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(institutionCommand) is CreateInstitutionCommandResult institutionCommandResult)
            return testClass.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>>(institutionCommandResult.InstitutionEntityDto);
        throw new TestClassException($"{nameof(GetNewInstitutionRefAsync)} - Entity not created");
    }

    public static async Task<EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto>> GetDevPartnerRefAsync(this ExtendedDbTestBase testClass)
    {
        if ((await testClass.PublicQueryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery { TenantCode = "dev" }))?.Entity is
            PartnerEntityDto partner)
            return testClass.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto>>(partner);
        throw new TestClassException($"{nameof(GetDevPartnerRefAsync)} - Entity not found");
    }

    public static async Task<EntityRef<SupplierEntityDto>> GetNewSupplierRefAsync(this ExtendedDbTestBase testClass, AddressEntityDto? addressEntityDto = null)
    {
        var supplierDto = new SupplierEntityDto
        {
            Name = nameof(GetNewSupplierRefAsync),
            TaxIdentificationNumber = "10034277-1-18",
            Headquarters = addressEntityDto ?? testClass.GetNewAddress<DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto>()
        };

        if (await testClass.PublicCommandService.CreateEntityAsync(supplierDto) is { } supplier)
            return testClass.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<SupplierEntityDto>>(supplier);
        throw new TestClassException($"{nameof(GetNewSupplierRefAsync)} - Entity not created");
    }

    public static TAddressDto GetNewAddress<TAddressDto>(this ExtendedDbTestBase testClass)
        where TAddressDto : AddressEntityDto
    {
        object? value = default(TAddressDto);
        
        if (typeof(TAddressDto) == typeof(ForeignAddressEntityDto))
        {
            value = new ForeignAddressEntityDto
            {
                //Country = testClass.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>(testClass.CountryCache.GetByCode("GB")),
                ForeignZipCode = "SW1A 0AA",
                ForeignAddress = "BIG BEN, London",
                ForeignSettlementName = "Luthon"
            };
        }
        
        else if (typeof(TAddressDto) == typeof(DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto))
        {
            value = new DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto
            {
                //Country = testClass.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>(testClass.CountryCache.GetByCode("HU")),
                Settlement = testClass.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>>(testClass.SettlementCache.GetByName("Budapest")),
                ZipCode = testClass.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>(testClass.TiCache.GetItem(DictType.ZipCode, "1117")),
                StreetSuffix = testClass.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>>(testClass.StreetSuffixCache.GetByCode("1")),
                StreetName = "Ráday",
                HouseNumber = "58"
            };
        }

        if (value is null)
            throw new NotImplementedException("Address type is not yet implemented");
        
        return (TAddressDto)value;
    }
    
    public static EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto> GetDefaultCurrency(this ExtendedDbTestBase testClass)
    {
        var currency = CacheHelper.GetPartnerDefaultCurrency(testClass.PublicScope);
        return testClass.Mapper.Map<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>(currency);
    }
}

            // Act
            var instance = new ProducerOrInverterQueryHandler(_dbContext.Object, _mapper.Object);

            // Assert
            instance.Should().NotBeNull();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CannotConstructWithNullDbContext()
        {
            new ProducerOrInverterQueryHandler(default(IDbContext), _mapper.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CannotConstructWithNullMapper()
        {
            new ProducerOrInverterQueryHandler(_dbContext.Object, default(IMapper));
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.UnitTest.Extensions;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using FluentAssertions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Xunit;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.BusinessLogicTest.Devices;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class ConsumerTest : FrameworkTestBase
{
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiCache;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    public ConsumerTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture)
        : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
        _tiCache = Scope.Resolve<TenantIndependentDictCache>();
        _mapper = Scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateConsumerMetaDataSchemaTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        int index = 1;

        // Consumer
        var consumer = CreateConsumer(index);
        var consumerResult = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(consumer);
        CheckConsumer(consumer, consumerResult);

        // Schema
        var schema = CreateSchema(index);
        var schemaResult = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(schema);
        CheckSchema(schema, schemaResult);

        // MetaData
        var metaData = CreateMetaData(schemaResult!, consumerResult!, index);
        var metaDataResult = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(metaData);
        CheckMetaData(metaData, metaDataResult);  
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ModifyConsumerMetaDataSchemaTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        // A teszt adatként insert scriptben szereplő sémák között a '2'-es id-ú elem a consumer-es.
        var source = QueryService.GetById<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>(2);
        
        source
            .Should()
            .NotBeNull();

        source.Type
            .Should()
            .Be(EndpointUnitType.Consumer);

        // Módosítás
        source.Name = "Teszt fogyasztó séma átnevezve";
        var result = await CommandService.UpdateEntityAsync(source);

        CheckSchema(source, result);
    }

    [Fact(Skip = "Kaszkád törlés?")]
    public async Task DeleteConsumerMetaDataSchemaTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var source = CreateSchema(2);

        var newlyCreated = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(source);

        newlyCreated
            .Should()
            .NotBeNull();

        CheckSchema(source, newlyCreated);

        // deleteNewlyCreated
        await CommandService.DeleteEntityAsync<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>(newlyCreated!.Id);

        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await QueryService.GetByIdAsync<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>(newlyCreated!.Id));
    }

    #region Helpers
    /// <summary>
    /// Returns with a Consumer DTO
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private ConsumerEntityDto CreateConsumer(int index = 1)
    {
        return new ConsumerEntityDto
        {
            DeviceName = "Unittest Consumer Entity 0" + index,
            MaxPerformance = 98d
        };
    }

    private EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto CreateSchema(int index = 1)
    {
        return new EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto
        {
            Name = "Unittest Consumer Schema 0" + index,
            Properties = new List<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto>
            {
                new EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto
                {
                    Code = "unittest_consumer_property_0" + index,
                    DictCode = null,
                    Description = "Lorem Ipsum",
                    EndpointUnitMetaDataSchema = null, // A mentés során beállítódik a séma referencia
                    Name = "Unittest Consumer Property 0" + index,
                    ValueType = MetadataType.Int
                },
                new EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto
                {
                    Code = "unittest_consumer_property_0" + (index + 1),
                    DictCode = null,
                    Description = "Lorem Ipsum" + (index + 1),
                    EndpointUnitMetaDataSchema = null, // A mentés során beállítódik a séma referencia
                    Name = "Unittest Consumer Property 0" + (index + 1),
                    ValueType = MetadataType.Int
                }
            },
            Type = EndpointUnitType.Consumer
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egy MetaData példányt ad vissza property értékekkel.
    /// </summary>
    private EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto CreateMetaData(EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto schema, ConsumerEntityDto consumer, int index = 1)
    {
        return new EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto
        {
            MetaDataSchema = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>>(schema),
            EndpointUnit = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitEntityDto>>(consumer),
            MetaDataValues = new List<EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntityDto>
            {
                new EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntityDto
                {
                    EndpointUnitMetaData = null, // A mentés során beállítódik a referencia
                    Property = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto>>(GetPropertyFromSchemaByCode(schema, "unittest_consumer_property_0" + index)),
                    Value = "5"
                },
                new EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntityDto
                {
                    EndpointUnitMetaData = null, // A mentés során beállítódik a referencia
                    Property = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto>>(GetPropertyFromSchemaByCode(schema, "unittest_consumer_property_0" + (index + 1))),
                    Value = "10"
                }
            }
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Séma és kód alapján visszatérünk egy Property-vel
    /// </summary>
    private EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto GetPropertyFromSchemaByCode(EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto schema, string code)
    {
        if (schema == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(schema));

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(code));

        if (schema.Properties == null || schema.Properties.Count == 0)
            throw new ArgumentException(nameof(schema.Properties));

        return schema.Properties!.First(p => p.Code == code);
    }
    #endregion Helpers

    #region Checkers
    /// <summary>
    /// Összehasonlítja a létrehozni kívánt séma adatait a létrehozott/módosított séma adataival
    /// </summary>
    private void CheckSchema(EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto source, EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto? result)
    {
        result.Should().NotBeNull();

        source.Should().BeEquivalentTo(result, o => o
            .EntityDtoAssertion()
            .Excluding(x => x!.Id)
            .Excluding(x => x!.Properties));

        // Properties
        source.Properties.Should().BeEquivalentTo(result!.Properties, o => o
            .EntityDtoAssertion()
            .Excluding(x => x.Path.EndsWith(".Id")));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Összehasonlítja a létrehozni kívánt fogyasztó endpointunit adatait a létrehozott/módosított endpointunit adataival
    /// </summary>
    private void CheckConsumer(ConsumerEntityDto source, ConsumerEntityDto? result)
    {
        result.Should().NotBeNull();

        source.Should().BeEquivalentTo(result, o => o
           .EntityDtoAssertion()
           .Excluding(x => x!.Identifier)
           .Excluding(x => x!.Id));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Összehasonlítja a létrehozni kívánt metadata adatait a létrehozott/módosított metadata adataival
    /// </summary>
    private void CheckMetaData(EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto source, EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto? result)
    {
        result.Should().NotBeNull();

        source.Should().BeEquivalentTo(result, o => o
            .EntityDtoAssertion()
            .Excluding(x => x!.Id)
            .Excluding(x => x!.MetaDataSchema)
            .Excluding(x => x!.MetaDataValues));

        // Schema
        source.MetaDataSchema.Should().BeEquivalentTo(result!.MetaDataSchema, o => o
            .EntityDtoAssertion()
            .Excluding(x => x.Path.EndsWith(".Id")));

        // Values
        source.MetaDataValues.Should().BeEquivalentTo(result!.MetaDataValues, o => o
            .EntityDtoAssertion()
            .Excluding(x => x.Path.EndsWith(".Id")));
    }
    #endregion Checkers
}

    {
        return new EndpointUnitMetaDataEntityDto
        {
            MetaDataSchema = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>>(schema),
            EndpointUnit = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitEntityDto>>(EnergyStorage),
            MetaDataValues = new List<EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntityDto>
            {

                {
                    EndpointUnitMetaData = null, // A mentés során beállítódik a referencia
                    Property = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto>>(GetPropertyFromSchemaByCode(schema, "unittest_energyStorage_property_0" + index)),
                    Value = "5"
                },
                new EndpointUnitMetaDataValueEntityDto
                {
                    EndpointUnitMetaData = null, // A mentés során beállítódik a referencia
                    Property = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto>>(GetPropertyFromSchemaByCode(schema, "unittest_energyStorage_property_0" + (index + 1))),

    /// Séma és kód alapján visszatérünk egy Property-vel
    /// </summary>
    private EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto GetPropertyFromSchemaByCode(EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto schema, string code)
    {
        if (schema == null)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(schema));

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(code));

        if (schema.Properties == null || schema.Properties.Count == 0)
            throw new ArgumentException(nameof(schema.Properties));

        return schema.Properties!.First(p => p.Code == code);
    }

    private static TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto CreateTimeOfUseTariffWeekdays()
    {
        var startDate = new DateTime(2000, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var endDate = new DateTime(2000, 12, 31, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        return new TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto
        {
            Days =  TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect.Monday | 
                    TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect.Tuesday | 
                    TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect.Wednesday | 
                    TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect.Thursday | 
                    TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect.Friday,
            PeriodStartDateTime = startDate,
            PeriodEndDateTime = endDate,
            TimeOfUseStartTime = new TimeSpan(0,0,0),
            TimeOfUseEndTime = new TimeSpan(23,59,59),
            Name = "Teszt díjsáv hétköznap",
            PurchasePrice = 500,
            TimeOfUseTariffType = TimeOfUseTariffType.Periodic
        };
    }

    private static TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto CreateTimeOfUseTariffWeekends()
    {
        var startDate = new DateTime(2000, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var endDate = new DateTime(2000, 12, 31, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        return new TimeOfUseTariffEntityDto
        {
            Days = TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect.Saturday | TimeOfUseTariffDaysInEffect.Sunday,
            PeriodStartDateTime = startDate,
            PeriodEndDateTime = endDate,
            TimeOfUseStartTime = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0),
            TimeOfUseEndTime = new TimeSpan(23, 59, 59),
            Name = "Teszt díjsáv hétvége",
            PurchasePrice = 300,
            TimeOfUseTariffType = TimeOfUseTariffType.Periodic
        };
    }

    #region Checkers

    /// <summary>
    /// Összehasonlítja a létrehozni kívánt entitás dto adatait a létrehozott/módosított entitás dto adataival
    /// </summary>
    private async Task CheckContract(EnergyContractEntityDto source, EnergyContractEntityDto? result)
    {
        result.Should().NotBeNull();

        if (source is NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto networkConnectionSource)
        {
            var networkConnectionResult = (result as NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto)!;

            networkConnectionResult.Should().BeEquivalentTo(networkConnectionSource, o => o
                .EntityDtoAssertion()
                .Excluding(x => x!.Id)
                .Excluding(x => x!.Partner)
                .Excluding(x => x!.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint));

            networkConnectionResult.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint.Should().NotBeNull().And
                .BeEquivalentTo(networkConnectionSource.LocationOfNetworkConnectionPoint, o => o.EntityDtoAssertion()
                    .Excluding(x => x.FullAddress)
                    .Excluding(x => x.Id));
        }

        if (source is NetworkUsageContractEntityDto networkUsageSource)
        {
            var networkUsageResult = (result as NetworkUsageContractEntityDto)!;

            networkUsageResult.Should().BeEquivalentTo(networkUsageSource, o => o
                .EntityDtoAssertion()
                .Excluding(x => x!.Id)
                .Excluding(x => x!.Partner));
        }

        if (source is PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto powerPurchaseSource)
        {
            var powerPurchaseResult = (result as PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto)!;

            powerPurchaseResult.Should().BeEquivalentTo(powerPurchaseSource, o => o
                .EntityDtoAssertion()
                .Excluding(x => x!.Id)
                .Excluding(x => x!.Partner)
                .Excluding(x => x.TimeOfUseTariffs));
        }

        if (source is IEnergyContractWithTimeOfUseTariffsEntityDto tariffsContractSource)
        {
            var tariffsContractResult = (result as IEnergyContractWithTimeOfUseTariffsEntityDto)!;

            tariffsContractResult.TimeOfUseTariffs.Should().NotBeEmpty().And
                .BeEquivalentTo(tariffsContractSource.TimeOfUseTariffs, o => o.EntityDtoAssertion()
                    .Excluding(x => x.Id)
                    .Excluding(x => x.Currency));
        }

        // Partner Ref
        result!.Partner.Should().BeEquivalentTo(await this.GetDevPartnerRefAsync());
    }

    #endregion Checkers
}

    private CreateInvoiceCommand GetCreateInvoiceCommand(EnergyContractEntityDto energyContractEntityDto)
    {

            EnergyContracts = new List<EntityRef<EnergyContractEntityDto>>
            {
                Mapper.Map<EntityRef<EnergyContractEntityDto>>(energyContractEntityDto)
            }
        };

        if (energyContractEntityDto.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement)
        {
            invoice.InvoiceEnergyFee = new InvoiceEnergyFeeEntityDto
            {
                EffectiveConsumptionValue = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                EnergyFee = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                ExciseTax = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                CashAndCashEquivalents = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                CoalIndustryRestructuringAid = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                SuppForSubsidizedElectricitySupply = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                SuppForLinkedProdStructureTrans = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                FeedInTariffCashAndCashEquivalent = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                PremiumCashAndCashEquivalent = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                VatPayableOnEnergyFeeAndExciseTax = Random.Shared.NextDouble(),
                TotalEnergyFees = Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 100
            };
        }

        if (energyContractEntityDto.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract)
        {
            invoice.InvoiceDistributorFee = new InvoiceDistributorFeeEntityDto

    private async Task<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto> GetEnergyContract()
    {
        var currency = this.GetDefaultCurrency();

        var partner = Mapper.Map<EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto>>((await QueryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery { TenantCode = "dev" })).Entity as PartnerEntityDto);

        var energyContract = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(new PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto
        {
            AccountingMethodType = AccountingMethodType.Profiled,
            Partner = partner,
            MonthlyAccountingStart = 1,
            Name = "Test energy contract",
            ContractIssueDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1),
            Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto> { Id = 1 },
            Supplier = await this.GetNewSupplierRefAsync(),
            Currency = new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>()
            {
                Id = currency.Id
            }
        });

        energyContract
            .Should()
            .NotBeNull();

        return energyContract!;
    }

    private void AssertInvoiceEquals(InvoiceEntityDto? result, CreateInvoiceCommand createCommand, EnergyContractEntityDto energyContractEntityDto)
    {
        result
            .Should()
            .NotBeNull();

        result!.InvoiceIdentifier
            .Should()
            .Be(createCommand.InvoiceIdentifier);

        result.AccountingPeriodStart
            .Should()
            .Be(createCommand.AccountingPeriodStart);

        result.AccountingPeriodEnd
            .Should()
            .Be(createCommand.AccountingPeriodEnd);

        result.IssueDate
            .Should()
            .Be(createCommand.IssueDate);

        result.PaymentDueDate
            .Should()
            .Be(createCommand.PaymentDueDate);

        result.PaymentCompletedDate
            .Should()
            .Be(createCommand.PaymentCompletedDate);

        result.EnergyContracts
            .Should()
            .HaveCount(1)
            .And
            .BeEquivalentTo(createCommand.EnergyContracts);

        result.TotalAmount
            .Should()
            .Be(createCommand.TotalAmount);

        result.Currency
            .Should()
            .NotBeNull();

        if (energyContractEntityDto is IEnergyContractWithTimeOfUseTariffsEntityDto tariffsEntityDto)
        {
            result.AccountingMethodType
                .Should()
                .Be(tariffsEntityDto.AccountingMethodType);
        }

        if (energyContractEntityDto.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement)
        {
            result.InvoiceEnergyFee
                .Should()
                .BeEquivalentTo(createCommand.InvoiceEnergyFee, o => o.EntityDtoAssertion());
        }

        if (energyContractEntityDto.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract)
        {
            result.InvoiceDistributorFee
                .Should()
                .BeEquivalentTo(createCommand.InvoiceDistributorFee, o => o.EntityDtoAssertion());
        }
    }

    private void AssertInvoiceEquals(InvoiceEntityDto? result, ModifyInvoiceCommand modifyCommand, EnergyContractEntityDto energyContractEntityDto)
    {
        result
            .Should()
            .NotBeNull();

        result!.InvoiceIdentifier
            .Should()
            .Be(modifyCommand.InvoiceIdentifier);

        result.AccountingPeriodStart
            .Should()
            .Be(modifyCommand.AccountingPeriodStart);

        result.AccountingPeriodEnd
            .Should()
            .Be(modifyCommand.AccountingPeriodEnd);

        result.IssueDate
            .Should()
            .Be(modifyCommand.IssueDate);

        result.PaymentDueDate
            .Should()
            .Be(modifyCommand.PaymentDueDate);

        result.PaymentCompletedDate
            .Should()
            .Be(modifyCommand.PaymentCompletedDate);

        result.TotalAmount
            .Should()
            .Be(modifyCommand.TotalAmount);
        
        if (energyContractEntityDto.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement)
        {
            result.InvoiceEnergyFee
                .Should()
                .BeEquivalentTo(modifyCommand.InvoiceEnergyFee, o => o.EntityDtoAssertion());
        }

        if (energyContractEntityDto.EnergyContractType == EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract)
        {
            result.InvoiceDistributorFee
                .Should()
                .BeEquivalentTo(modifyCommand.InvoiceDistributorFee, o => o.EntityDtoAssertion());
        }
    }

    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var supplierEntityDto = await CreateSupplier();
        
        var modifyEntity = new SupplierEntityDto
        {
            Id = supplierEntityDto.Id,
            Name = "Modified_Supplier_Name",
            TaxIdentificationNumber = "10034277-1-19",
            Headquarters = new DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto
            {
                //AddressType = AddressType.DomesticNonPOBoxAddress,
                //Country = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>(_countryCache.GetByCode("HU")),
                Settlement = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>>(_settlementCache.GetByName("Budapest")),
                ZipCode = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>(_tiCache.GetItem(DictType.ZipCode, "1117")),
                StreetSuffix = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>>(_streetSuffixCache.GetByCode("1")),
                StreetName = "Ráday",
                HouseNumber = "59"
            }
        };
        
        var modifyResult = await CommandService.UpdateEntityAsync(modifyEntity);

        modifyResult.Should().NotBeNull();
        modifyResult!.Name.Should().Be(modifyEntity.Name);
        modifyResult.TaxIdentificationNumber.Should().Be(modifyEntity.TaxIdentificationNumber);
        modifyResult.Name.Should().Be(modifyEntity.Name);

        modifyResult.Headquarters.Should().NotBeNull();
        modifyResult.Headquarters.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);
        modifyResult.Headquarters.AddressType.Should().Be(AddressType.DomesticNonPOBoxAddress);
        //modifyResult.Headquarters.Country.Should().BeEquivalentTo(modifyEntity.Headquarters.Country);

        var address = QueryService.GetById<AddressEntityDto>(modifyResult.Headquarters.Id) as DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto; 
        address.Should().NotBeNull();
        address.HouseNumber.Should().Be((modifyEntity.Headquarters as DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto)!.HouseNumber);
    }

            Headquarters = new DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto
            {
                //AddressType = AddressType.DomesticNonPOBoxAddress,
                //Country = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>(_countryCache.GetByCode("HU")),
                Settlement = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>>(_settlementCache.GetByName("Budapest")),
                ZipCode = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>(_tiCache.GetItem(DictType.ZipCode, "1117")),
                StreetSuffix = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>>(_streetSuffixCache.GetByCode("1")),
                StreetName = "Ráday",
                HouseNumber = "58"
            }
        };
        var createdSupplierEntityDto = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(supplierEntityDto);

        createdSupplierEntityDto.Should().NotBeNull();
        createdSupplierEntityDto!.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);
        createdSupplierEntityDto.Name.Should().Be(supplierEntityDto.Name);
        createdSupplierEntityDto.TaxIdentificationNumber.Should().Be(supplierEntityDto.TaxIdentificationNumber);
        createdSupplierEntityDto.Name.Should().Be(supplierEntityDto.Name);
        
        createdSupplierEntityDto.Headquarters.Should().NotBeNull();
        createdSupplierEntityDto.Headquarters.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);
        createdSupplierEntityDto.Headquarters.AddressType.Should().Be(AddressType.DomesticNonPOBoxAddress);
        //createdSupplierEntityDto.Headquarters.Country.Should().BeEquivalentTo(supplierEntityDto.Headquarters.Country);

        return createdSupplierEntityDto;
    }

    #endregion
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Common;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Site;
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.BusinessLogicTest.Favourites;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class FavouritesTest : FrameworkTestBase
{
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    public FavouritesTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture) : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
        _mapper = Scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CreateTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var created1 = CreateNew(EntityType.Device);
        var created2 = CreateNew(EntityType.Site);

        Assert.NotNull(created1);
        Assert.NotEqual(0, created1.Id);

        Assert.NotNull(created2);
        Assert.NotEqual(0, created2.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DeleteTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var created = CreateNew(EntityType.Device);

        CommandService.DeleteEntity<FavouriteEntityDto>(created.Id);

        var exception = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
        {
            QueryService.GetById<FavouriteEntityDto>(created.Id);
        });
        var expectedErrorMsg = $"Entity not found. Type: FavouriteEntity Id: {created.Id}";
        Assert.Equal(expectedErrorMsg, exception.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ReadTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var created1 = CreateNew(EntityType.Device);
        var created2 = CreateNew(EntityType.Site);

        var result1 = await QueryService.QueryEntities(new FavouriteEntityQuery
        {
            Type = EntityType.Device
        }) as EntityQueryItemsResult<FavouriteEntityListItemDto>;

        var result2 = await QueryService.QueryEntities(new FavouriteEntityQuery
        {
            Type = EntityType.Site
        }) as EntityQueryItemsResult<FavouriteEntityListItemDto>;

        Assert.Contains(result1.Items, r => r.Id == created1.Id);
        Assert.Contains(result2.Items, r => r.Id == created2.Id);
    }


    private FavouriteEntityDto CreateNew(EntityType entityType)
    {
        var user = QueryService.QueryEntities<SecUserEntityDto>()?.Items?.FirstOrDefault();
        var newDto = new FavouriteEntityDto 
        {
            Type = entityType,
            User = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>>(user)
        };

        switch (entityType)
        {
            case EntityType.Device:
                var device = QueryService.QueryEntities<DeviceEntityDto>()?.Items?.FirstOrDefault();
                newDto.Identifier = device.Identifier;
                break;
            case EntityType.Site:
                var site = QueryService.QueryEntities<SiteEntityDto>()?.Items?.FirstOrDefault();
                newDto.Identifier = site.Identifier;
                break;
            default: throw new NotImplementedException();
        }

        var created = CommandService.CreateEntity(newDto);
        return created;
    }
}

            ComplexAddress = "Modify_Incomplete_Address_Saves_ComplexAddress_Test"
        };
        
        var createdAddress = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(address);
        createdAddress.Should().BeEquivalentTo(address, o => o.EntityDtoAssertion()
            .Excluding(x => x.Id)
            .Excluding(x => x.FullAddress));

        address.Id = createdAddress!.Id;
        address.ComplexAddress = "Modify_Incomplete_Address_Saves_ComplexAddress_Test_Edited";

        var updatedAddress = await CommandService.UpdateEntityAsync(address);
        updatedAddress.Should().BeEquivalentTo(address, o => o.EntityDtoAssertion()
            .Excluding(x => x.FullAddress));
        updatedAddress!.FullAddress.Should().NotBeEmpty().And.NotBe(createdAddress.FullAddress);
    }

        var addressDto = CommandService.CreateEntity(new DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto
        {
            //Country = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>>(_countryCache.GetByCode("HU")),

            HouseNumber = "59"
        };

        var updatedAddressEntityDto = QueryService.GetById<AddressEntityDto>(updateResult.Id) as DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto;

        updatedAddressEntityDto.StreetName.Should().Be(updatedAddressDto.StreetName);
        updatedAddressEntityDto.HouseNumber.Should().Be(updatedAddressDto.HouseNumber);
    }
