using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using FluentAssertions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Notifications;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Xunit;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.BusinessLogicTest.Notifications;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class NotificationTest : FrameworkTestBase
{
    public NotificationTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture)
        : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateNotificationTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        var mapper = Scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
        var user = QueryService.QueryEntities<SecUserEntityDto>().Items.First();

        var source = new NotificationEntityDto
        {
            Title = "TestTitle",
            Description = "TestDescription",
            ExpirationDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1),
            NotificationSource = NotificationSource.TaskManager,
            NotificationState = NotificationState.Pending,
            NotificationType = NotificationType.Push,
            TargetUsers = new List<EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>>() 
            { 
                mapper.Map<EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>>(user) 
            }
        };

        var result = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(source);

        ValidateEquivalence(source, result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ModifyNotificationTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        CreateNotificationTest();

        var source = QueryService.QueryEntities<NotificationEntityDto>().Items.First();

        source
            .Should()
            .NotBeNull();

        source.Title = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        source.Description = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        source.NotificationState = NotificationState.InProgress;

        var result = await CommandService.UpdateEntityAsync(source);

        ValidateEquivalence(source, result);
    }

    private static void ValidateEquivalence(NotificationEntityDto source, NotificationEntityDto? result)
    {
        result
            .Should()
            .NotBeNull();

        result!.Title
            .Should()
            .Be(source.Title);

        result!.NotificationType
           .Should()
           .Be(source.NotificationType);

        result!.NotificationSource
           .Should()
           .Be(source.NotificationSource);

        result!.NotificationState
           .Should()
           .Be(source.NotificationState);

        result!.ExpirationDate
           .Should()
           .Be(source.ExpirationDate);

        result!.Title
              .Should()
              .Be(source.Title);

        result!.Description
          .Should()
          .Be(source.Description);

        result!.TargetUsers!.Should()
            .NotBeNull();
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using FluentAssertions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.BusinessLogicTest.Partner;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class PartnerStatisticsTest : DbTestsBase
{
    public PartnerStatisticsTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture) : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
    }

    [Fact(Skip = "Jelenleg a partner statisztika nincs használatban")]
    public async Task PartnerStatisticsCrudTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        
        // CREATE
        var newPartnerStatistics = new PartnerStatisticsEntityDto {Partner = new EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto> {Id = 1}, Date = DateTimeContext.Now};
        var newEntity = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(newPartnerStatistics);
        newEntity.Should().NotBeNull();
        newEntity!.Partner.Id.Should().Be(1);

        // READ
        var readEntity = await QueryService.GetByIdAsync<PartnerStatisticsEntityDto>(newEntity.Id);
        readEntity.Should().NotBeNull();
        readEntity.Id.Should().Be(newEntity.Id);

        // UPDATE
        newEntity.NumberOfUsers = 10;
        var updateEntity = await CommandService.UpdateEntityAsync(newEntity);
        updateEntity.Should().NotBeNull();
        updateEntity!.Id.Should().Be(newEntity.Id);
        updateEntity.NumberOfUsers.Should().Be(10);

        // DELETE
        await CommandService.DeleteEntityAsync<PartnerStatisticsEntityDto>(newEntity.Id);
        await  Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => QueryService.GetByIdAsync<PartnerStatisticsEntityDto>(newEntity.Id));
    }
}

        var result1 = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(userDto1);
        
        var random2 = RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(1000, 10000);
        var siteManagerRole = _roleCache.GetRoleByCode(Scope, nameof(SecRoleType.SiteManager));
        var userDto2 = new SecUserEntityDto()
        {
            GlobalId = Guid.NewGuid(), // TODO: backend generálja
            DateOfBirth = DateTime.Today,
            IsSystem = false, // TODO: backend beállítja false-ra

            Phone = "36201234120",

            FirstName = "Name",
            Roles = new[]
            {
                _mapper.Map<EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>>(siteManagerRole)
            },
            NewPassword  = "987654321ewq",
            NewPasswordAgain = "987654321ewq"
        };
        var result2 = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(userDto2);

        var allRef = (await QueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SecUserEntityRefQuery())).Items;
        allRef.Should().HaveCountGreaterThan(0);

        var siteManager = _roleCache.GetRoleByCode(Scope, nameof(SecRoleType.SiteManager));
        var siteManagerRef = (await QueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SecUserEntityRefQuery { RoleType = SecRoleType.SiteManager })).Items;
        siteManagerRef.Should().HaveCountGreaterThan(0);
        siteManagerRef.Should().OnlyHaveUniqueItems(x => x.Id);
        siteManagerRef.Select(x => 
                                    QueryService.GetById<SecUserEntityDto>(x.Id))
                                                .Should()
                                                .AllSatisfy(x => x.Roles.Select(r => r.Id).Contains(siteManager.Id));
    }

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;

using FluentAssertions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.BusinessLogicTest.Services;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class ServicesTest : FrameworkTestBase
{
    public ServicesTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture) : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetServicesTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        await CreateNewService();
        var services = (await QueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync<ServicesEntityDto>())?.Items;
        services.Should().NotBeNull().And.HaveCountGreaterThan(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetServiceTest()
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var newId = await CreateNewService();
        var service = await QueryService.GetByIdAsync<ServicesEntityDto>(newId);
        service.Should().NotBeNull();
        service.Id.Should().Be(newId);
    }

    private async Task<int> CreateNewService()
    {
        var newService = new ServicesEntity {Id = 0, Name = $"Name-{Guid.NewGuid()}", Code = 1};
        var dbContext = Scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        int? id;
        using (var transaction = dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction())
        {
            id = (int) await dbContext.Session.SaveAsync(newService);
            await transaction.CommitAsync();
        }
        
        return (int) id;
    }
}

using System;
using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using FluentAssertions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.Infrastructure;

public class FrameworkTestBase : DbTestsBase
{
    public FrameworkTestBase(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture)
        : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
    }

    protected override void Initialize(Action<ContainerBuilder>? action = null)
    {
        base.Initialize(builder =>
        {
            builder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common")
            || x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework"));
            builder.RegisterMaps();

        });

        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .SetBasePath(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory)
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.Development.json", true)
            .Build();
        Config.TestProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);
        Config.Provider = new DbConfigProvider(AutofacScope.Test);
        Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
    }

}

    {
        // Arrange
        byte[] fileBytes = System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes(fileWithErrosPath);
        List<ExcelImportErrorModel> errors = new();

        // Act
        var result = OrgunitImportDataProcessorJob.StartImportWithFormatValidation(fileBytes, errors);
        
        // Assert
        //we expect that the import can complete, but with some errors.
        result.Should().NotBeNull();
        errors.Should().NotBeNullOrEmpty(); //we expect errors

        foreach (var err in errors)
        {
            _output.WriteLine($"{err.SheetTitle}: {err.ColumnId}{err.Row} {err.OriginalValueAsString}  --> {err.TargetPropertyName} - {err.ErrorMessage}");
        }

        errors.Should().NotContain(errors => errors.ErrorMessage.StartsWith("Egyéb hiba történt")); //all format errors should be recognized to specific error (no default branch in switch)
    }

﻿using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.Services;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.UnitTest.Wireup;

public class AutofacBackEndUnitTestsModule : Module
{
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        //Database
        //EnergiaMenedzsment Database
        builder.RegisterType<DbContext>()
            .As<IDbContext>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        //Services
        builder.RegisterType<QueryServiceServer>().As<IQueryService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<CommandServiceServer>().As<ICommandService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        //Core Database
        builder.RegisterType<CoreDbContext>()
            .Keyed<IDbContext>(DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE)
            .Named<IDbContext>(DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE)
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }
}

﻿using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Caching;

/// <summary>
/// Ország cache
/// </summary>
public class IoTDeviceTypeCache : CoreEntityCache<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>
{

    /// <summary>
    /// Konstruktor
    /// </summary>
    public IoTDeviceTypeCache() : base(DefaultKeepPeriod)
    {
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ország lekérése iso3 kód alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="iso3"></param>
    public IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto? GetByCode(IComponentContext scope, string code)
    {
        return GetContent(scope).SingleOrDefault(x => x.Code == code);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ország lekérése ID alapján
    /// </summary>
    public IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto? GetById(IComponentContext scope, int id)
    {
        return GetContent(scope).SingleOrDefault(x => x.Id == id);
    }
}

using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel.Validity;
using Common.Shared.Commands;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.BaseClasses;
public class ValidityCommandBase<T> : EntityCommandBase<T>, IValidity where T : class
{
    public virtual string? Name { get; set; } 
    //TODO: ValidityCommandBase-ben nem biztos, hogy ez jó helyen van, mert nem tudjuk, hogy minden leszármazott osztáylnak egyformán lesz-e Name tulajdonsága.

    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség kezdete
    /// </summary>
    public DateTime ValidFrom { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség vége
    /// </summary>
    public DateTime ValidTo { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az érvényességi időket úgy állítja be, hogy egész napra konvertálja a dátum levágásával az időket. (a ValidTo-t felkerekíti egész napra, 23:59:59.9999...)
    /// </summary>
    public void SetValidityConvertToFullDay(DateTime validFrom, DateTime validTo)
    {
        ValidFrom = validFrom.Date;
        ValidTo = validTo.Date.AddDays(1).AddTicks(-1);
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.BaseClasses;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Interfaces;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location.Floor;

/// <summary>
/// CreateFloorCommand
/// </summary>
[RequiredSecOperation(typeof(FloorEntityDto), SecurityOperation.Create)]
public class CreateFloorCommand : ValidityCommandBase<FloorEntityDto>, IOrgunitValidityMetadata, IGeoCoord
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Név
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Telephely neve")]
    public override string? Name { get; set; }

    #region IGeoCoord
    /// <summary>
    /// Szélességi kör
    /// </summary>
    public double? Lat { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Hosszúsági kör
    /// </summary>
    public double? Lon { get; set; }
    #endregion

    /// <summary>
    /// E-mail
    /// </summary>
    public string? EMail { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Telefonszám
    /// </summary>
    public string? Telephone { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kapcsolattartó neve
    /// </summary>
    public string? ContactPersonName { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kapcsolattartó felhasználó
    /// </summary>
    public virtual EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>? ContactPerson { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Üzleti azonosító
    /// </summary>
    public string? BusinessIdentifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets whether this is a measurement point
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsMeasurementPoint { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets whether this is an aggregation point
    /// </summary>
    public bool? IsAggregationPoint { get; set; }

    //TODO: Ez még nincs letisztázva mi lesz ezzel a property-vel
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the type of the site location
    /// </summary>
    public int? TypeId { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény
    /// </summary>
    public virtual EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>? BuildingPart { get; set; }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.BaseClasses;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Institution;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Interfaces;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Location.Institution;

/// <summary>
/// CreateInstitutionCommand
/// </summary>
[RequiredSecOperation(typeof(InstitutionEntityDto), SecurityOperation.Create)]
public class CreateInstitutionCommand : ValidityCommandBase<InstitutionEntityDto>, IOrgunitValidityMetadata
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Név
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Intézmény neve")]
    public override string? Name { get; set; }

    #region IOrgunitValidityMetadata

    [DataMember]
    //[Required(ErrorMessage = "Intézmény azonosító")]
    public string? BusinessIdentifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény azonosító típusa
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public string? InstituteIdentificationType { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény azonosító
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public string? InstituteIdentification { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Székhely
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public AddressEntityDto? Headquarters { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    ///Email
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Email")]
    [DataMember]
    public string? EMail { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Telefon
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Telefon")]
    [DataMember]
    public string? Telephone { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kapcsolattartó felhasználó
    /// </summary>
    public virtual EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>? ContactPerson { get; set; }


    /// <summary>
    /// Kapcsolattartó neve
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public string? ContactPersonName { get; set; }

    #endregion


    /// <summary>
    /// Weboldal
    /// </summary>
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Weboldal")]
    [DataMember]
    public string? Website { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Leírás
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public string? Description { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adószám
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Adószám")]
    public string? TaxIdentificationNumber { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cégjegyzékszám
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public string? CompanyRegistrationNumber { get; set; }

}

    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    public bool IsMeasurementPoint { get; set; }

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    public bool? IsAggregationPoint { get; set; }

    //TODO: Ez még nincs letisztázva mi lesz ezzel a property-vel

    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DeleteMeasurementPointCommand"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    public DeleteMeasurementPointCommand(int id)
    {
        Id = id;
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.BaseClasses;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Partner;

/// <summary>
/// CreatePartnerCommand
/// </summary>
[RequiredSecOperation(typeof(PartnerEntityDto), SecurityOperation.Create)]
public class CreatePartnerCommand : ValidityCommandBase<PartnerEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Partner neve
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "Partner neve")]
    public override string? Name { get; set; }
    /// <summary>
    /// Partner leírása
    /// </summary>
    public string? Description { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Székhely
    /// </summary>
    public AddressEntityDto? Headquarters { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// E-mail
    /// </summary>
    public string? EMail { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Weboldal
    /// </summary>
    public string? Website { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Telefonszám
    /// </summary>
    public string? Telephone { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kapcsolattartó neve
    /// </summary>
    public string? ContactPersonName { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant kód
    /// </summary>
    public string? TenantCode { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adószám
    /// </summary>
    public string? TaxIdentificationNumber { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cégjegyzékszám
    /// </summary>
    public string? CompanyRegistrationNumber { get; set; }

    // Partner létrehozásakor nem lehet ContactPerson-t beállítani. (Ekkor még nem létezik)

    public string? PartnerAdminUser { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény azonosító típusa
    /// </summary>
    public string? InstituteIdentificationType { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény azonosító
    /// </summary>
    public string? InstituteIdentification { get; set; }

    public Guid? Identifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Központi intézményfenntartó
    /// </summary>
    public EntityRef<MaintainerEntityDto>? Maintainer { get; set; }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations;
public class OrgunitBaseEntityDto : TrackedEntityDtoBase, IGlobalIdentifier, IOrgunitType
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Szervezeti egység típus
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Szervezeti egység típus")]
    public virtual OrgunitType OrgunitType //TODO: convert to abstract to force derived types to specify it properly?
    {
        get
        {
            if (Enum.TryParse(this.EntityTypeName(), out OrgunitType orgunitTypeParsed))
                return orgunitTypeParsed;
            else
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Cannot automatically convert {this.GetType().Name} class by naming convention to OrgunitType enum!");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szervezeti egység neve
    /// </summary>
    public virtual string Name { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Globális azonosító
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Globális azonosító")]
    public Guid? Identifier { get; set; } //IGlobalIdentifier

    public List<MeasurementPointEntityDto> MeasurementPoints { get; set; }  

}

    public EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>? BuildingPart { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Helyiségek
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Helyiségek")]
    public IList<RoomEntityDto>? Rooms { get; set; } = [];

    /// <summary>
    /// Szint érvényességek
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Szint érvényességek")]
    public IList<FloorValidityEntityDto>? FloorValidities { get; set; } = [];


    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Mérési hely-e?")]
    public bool IsMeasurementPoint { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Elszámolási hely-e?
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Elszámolási hely-e?")]
    public bool? IsAggregationPoint { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Pod azonosítók
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Pod azonosítók")]
    public string? PodIdentifiers { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szervezeti egység neve
    /// </summary>
    public override string Name => CurrentValidity.Name;

    public FloorValidityEntityDto CurrentValidity => FloorValidities.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom < DateTime.Now && x.ValidTo > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                     FloorValidities.OrderByDescending(x => x.ValidFrom).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                     FloorValidities.OrderBy(x => x.ValidTo).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidTo < DateTime.Now)!;
}

using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Building;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.BuildingPart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Floor;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Room;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.SiteLocation;

/// <summary>
/// Fizikai mérési hely DTO (pl.: épület, terem, stb.)
/// </summary>
[DataContract]
public class SiteLocationEntityDto : TrackedEntityDtoBase, IGlobalIdentifier
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Globális azonosító
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Globális azonosító")]
    public Guid? Identifier { get; set; } //IGlobalIdentifier

    // /// <summary>
    // /// Szülő szervezeti egység
    // /// </summary>
    // [Required]
    // [DataMember]
    // public EntityRef<OrgunitDtoBase>? ParentOrgunit { get; set; } //ez ne legyen?

    [DataMember]
    public OrgunitType ParentOrgunitType { get; set; }

    public Guid ParentIdentifier { get; set; }

    #region OrgunitDtoBase konkrét típusok
    //TODO: ősosztályra nem tud mappolni az nhibernate, mert nincs ilyen tábla, de konkrét típusokra már igen. ezeket majd le kell kezelni, ahol használva lesz!

    /// <summary>
    /// Épület
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Épület")]
    public EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>? Building { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Épületrész
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Épületrész")]
    public EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>? BuildingPart { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szint
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Szint")]
    public EntityRef<FloorEntityDto>? Floor { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Helyiség
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Helyiség")]
    public EntityRef<RoomEntityDto>? Room { get; set; }

    #endregion




    /// <summary>
    /// A mérési hely státusza. Mappolás során állítjuk be.
    /// 
    /// Ha nincsenek eszközök egy mérési helyen, akkor: Ismeretlen,
    /// ha vannak, és egyik se online, akkor: Offline,
    /// illetve, ha van online eszköz, akkor: Online
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Státusz")]
    public DeviceStatus Status { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// A mérési helyen elhelyezett mérő IoT eszközök
    /// </summary>
    [Display(Name = "IoT mérő eszközök")]
    public IList<EntityRef<DeviceEntityDto>>? IoTDevices { get; set; }


    public string? GetParentName()
    {
        return ParentOrgunitType switch
        {
            OrgunitType.Building => Building.EntityDisplayName,
            OrgunitType.BuildingPart => BuildingPart.EntityDisplayName,
            OrgunitType.Floor => Floor.EntityDisplayName,
            OrgunitType.Room => Room.EntityDisplayName,
            _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{ParentOrgunitType} can't have a SiteLocation!"),
        };
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel.Validity;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Validity;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;

/// <summary>
/// Partner validity data that changes over time
/// </summary>
[DataContract]
public class PartnerValidityEntityDto : ValidityDtoBase, IEquatable<PartnerValidityEntityDto>, ILogicalDeleteEntity
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Partner neve
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Partner neve")]
    public string? Name { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Partner leírása
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Partner leírása")]
    public string? Description { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Székhely
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Székhely")]
    public AddressEntityDto? Headquarters { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// E-mail
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "E-mail")]
    public string? EMail { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Weboldal
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Weboldal")]
    public string? Website { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Telefonszám
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Telefonszám")]
    public string? Telephone { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kapcsolattartó neve
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Kapcsolattartó neve")]
    public string? ContactPersonName { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adószám
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Adószám")]
    public string? TaxIdentificationNumber { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cégjegyzékszám
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Cégjegyzékszám")]
    public string? CompanyRegistrationNumber { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény azonosító típusa
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The institute identifacion type.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Intézmény azonosító típusa")]
    public string? InstituteIdentificationType { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény azonosító
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The institute identifacion.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Intézmény azonosító")]
    public string? InstituteIdentification { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egyedi érvényesség azonosító. A public és tenant specifikus sémákban megegyezik. Törlést, módosítást követően szinkronítás elősegítő property.
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Technikai azonosító")]
    public Guid Identifier{ get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kapcsolattartó felhasználó
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Kapcsolattartó felhasználó")]
    public EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>? ContactPerson { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Partner reference
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public EntityRef<PartnerEntityDto>? Partner { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Központi intézményfenntartó
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Központi fenntartó")]
    public EntityRef<MaintainerEntityDto>? Maintainer { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Törlés dátuma
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public DateTime? Deleted { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Törölt-e?
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public bool IsDeleted { get; set; }

    public override IEntity Parent => Partner;

    public bool Equals(PartnerValidityEntityDto? other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;
        return Name == other.Name &&
               Headquarters?.FullAddress == other.Headquarters?.FullAddress &&
               EMail == other.EMail &&
               Telephone == other.Telephone &&
               Description == other.Description &&
               Website == other.Website &&
               ContactPerson?.Id == other.ContactPerson?.Id &&
               TaxIdentificationNumber == other.TaxIdentificationNumber &&
               CompanyRegistrationNumber == other.CompanyRegistrationNumber &&
               ValidFrom == other.ValidFrom &&
               ValidTo == other.ValidTo;
    }
}

/// </summary>

    #region IOrgunitValidityMetadata

    /// <summary>

    /// Kapcsolattartó neve
    /// </summary>

    public string? ContactPersonName { get; set; }

    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "E-mail")]
    public string? EMail { get; set; }

    [Display(Name = "Telefonszám")]
    public string? Telephone { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Üzleti azonosító

    #endregion

    [DataMember]

using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Exceptions;

/// <summary>
///  EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException
/// </summary>
[Serializable]
[JsonObject(MemberSerialization.OptOut)]
public class EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException : EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException
{
    public EnergiaMenedzsmentErrorCode ErrorCode { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException" /> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="errorCode">The error code</param>
    /// <param name="message">A message that describes the error.</param>
    [JsonConstructor]
    public EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException(EnergiaMenedzsmentErrorCode errorCode, string message)
        : base(message)
    {
        ErrorCode = errorCode;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="errorCode">The error code</param>
    /// <param name="message">The message.</param>
    /// <param name="innenException">The innen exception.</param>
    public EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException(EnergiaMenedzsmentErrorCode errorCode, string message, Exception innenException)
        : base(message, innenException)
    {
        ErrorCode = errorCode;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException" /> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="errorCode">The error code</param>
    /// <param name="message">A message that describes the error.</param>
    /// <param name="vals">Values</param>
    public EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException(EnergiaMenedzsmentErrorCode errorCode, string message, params object[] vals)
        : base(message, null, vals)
    {
        ErrorCode = errorCode;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="errorCode">The error code</param>
    /// <param name="message">The message.</param>
    /// <param name="innenException">The innen exception.</param>
    /// <param name="vals">Values</param>
    public EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException(EnergiaMenedzsmentErrorCode errorCode, string message, Exception innenException, params object[] vals)
        : base(message, innenException, vals)
    {
        ErrorCode = errorCode;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="info">The info.</param>
    /// <param name="ctxt">The CTXT.</param>
    protected EnergiaMenedzsmentFrameworkCodeException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext ctxt)
        : base(info, ctxt)
    {
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared\Filters\EnergyContractJsonConverter.cs

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.EnergyContract;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Filters;

/// <summary>
/// EnergyContractJsonConverter
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" />
public class EnergyContractJsonConverter : JsonConverter
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether this instance can convert the specified object type.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="objectType">Type of the object.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <c>true</c> if this instance can convert the specified object type; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </returns>
    public override bool CanConvert(Type objectType)
    {
        return objectType == typeof(EnergyContractEntityDto);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" /> can read JSON.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" /> can read JSON; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public override bool CanRead => true;
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether this <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" /> can write JSON.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    ///   <c>true</c> if this <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConverter" /> can write JSON; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public override bool CanWrite => false;

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new reader for the specified jObject by copying the settings
    /// from an existing reader.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="reader">The reader whose settings should be copied.</param>
    /// <param name="jToken">The jToken to create a new reader for.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// The new disposable reader.
    /// </returns>
    public static JsonReader CopyReaderForObject(JsonReader reader, JToken jToken)
    {
        JsonReader jTokenReader = jToken.CreateReader();
        jTokenReader.Culture = reader.Culture;
        jTokenReader.DateFormatString = reader.DateFormatString;
        jTokenReader.DateParseHandling = reader.DateParseHandling;
        jTokenReader.DateTimeZoneHandling = reader.DateTimeZoneHandling;
        jTokenReader.FloatParseHandling = reader.FloatParseHandling;
        jTokenReader.MaxDepth = reader.MaxDepth;
        jTokenReader.SupportMultipleContent = reader.SupportMultipleContent;
        return jTokenReader;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the specified j object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jObject">The j object.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected EnergyContractEntityDto Create(JObject jObject)
    {
        EnergyContractType contractType = EnergyContractType.NotDefined;
        string stringTypeValue = jObject["energyContractType"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
        bool isInt = int.TryParse(stringTypeValue, out int enumIntValue);
        if (isInt)
            contractType = (EnergyContractType)enumIntValue;
        else
            contractType = (EnergyContractType)Enum.Parse(typeof(EnergyContractType), stringTypeValue);

        // Eredeti kód:
        //var contractType = (EnergyContractType)int.Parse(jObject["energyContractType"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty);
        
        switch (contractType)
        {
            case EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement:
                return new PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto();
            case EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract:
                return new NetworkUsageContractEntityDto();
            case EnergyContractType.NetworkConnectionContract:
                return new NetworkConnectionContractEntityDto();
            default:
                return new EnergyContractEntityDto();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Reads the JSON representation of the object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="reader">The <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonReader" /> to read from.</param>
    /// <param name="objectType">Type of the object.</param>
    /// <param name="existingValue">The existing value of object being read.</param>
    /// <param name="serializer">The calling serializer.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// The object value.
    /// </returns>
    public override object ReadJson(JsonReader reader, Type objectType, object existingValue, JsonSerializer serializer)
    {
        if (reader.TokenType == JsonToken.Null)
            return null;
        var jObject = JObject.Load(reader);
        var target = Create(jObject);
        using JsonReader jObjectReader = CopyReaderForObject(reader, jObject);
        serializer.Populate(jObjectReader, target);
        return target;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Writes the JSON representation of the object.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="writer">The <see cref="T:Newtonsoft.Json.JsonWriter" /> to write to.</param>
    /// <param name="value">The value.</param>
    /// <param name="serializer">The calling serializer.</param>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public override void WriteJson(JsonWriter writer, object value, JsonSerializer serializer)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared\ListItems\EnergyContract\EnergyContractListItemDto.cs

using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.EnergyContract;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems.EnergyContract;

/// <summary>
/// Energiaszerződések
/// </summary>
[DataContract]
public class EnergyContractListItemDto : EntityListItemDtoBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Szerződés név
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Név")]
    public string? Name { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség kelte
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Érvényesség kelte")]
    public DateTime? ContractIssueDate { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség vége
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Érvényesség vége")]
    public DateTime? ContractExpiryDate { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szerződés típus
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Szerződés típus")]
    public EnergyContractType EnergyContractType { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Intézmény")]
    public string Institution { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szolgáltató
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Szolgáltató")]
    public string Supplier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Állapot
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Állapot")]
    public EnergyContractStatusType Status
    {
        get
        {
            if (ContractIssueDate <= DateTime.UtcNow && ContractExpiryDate > DateTime.UtcNow)
            {
                return EnergyContractStatusType.Active;
            }

            if (ContractIssueDate > DateTime.UtcNow)
            {
                return EnergyContractStatusType.Pending;
            }

            return EnergyContractStatusType.Expired;
        }
    }
}

    /// </summary>
    public int ContractId { get; set; }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összehasonlításra kerülő érvényességi tartomány kezdete
    /// </summary>
    public DateTime? From { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az összehasonlításra kerülő érvényességi tartomány vége
    /// </summary>
    public DateTime? To { get; set; }
}

    };

using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Building;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.BuildingPart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Floor;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Institution;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Room;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Site;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Room;

public class OrgunitParentsGuidEntityRefQueryResult : IQueryResult
{
    public List<OrgunitParentRefs> Items { get; set; } = [];

    //helper for lookup
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<int, OrgunitParentRefs> AsDictionary() => Items
        .DistinctBy(y => y.OrgUnitId)
        .ToDictionary(item => item.OrgUnitId)
        .AsReadOnly();
}

//FYI: this result includes the current orgunit too
public record OrgunitParentRefs(
    int OrgUnitId, //the originial orgUnit id, which parents are requested
    OrgunitType OrgunitType, //the type of the orgunit
    GuidEntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>? Institution,
    GuidEntityRef<SiteEntityDto>? Site,
    GuidEntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>? Building,
    GuidEntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>? BuildingPart,
    GuidEntityRef<FloorEntityDto>? Floor,
    GuidEntityRef<RoomEntityDto>? Room
);

using Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Site;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.Site;

/// <summary>
/// Telephely Query
/// </summary>
[RequiredSecOperation(typeof(SiteEntityDto), SecurityOperation.Read)]
public class SiteEntityQuery : EntityQuery<SiteEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Id
    /// </summary>
    public int? Id { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Globális telephely azonosító
    /// </summary>
    public string? Identifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény azonosító
    /// </summary>
    public int? ParentId { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény azonosító (guid)
    /// </summary>
    public Guid? ParentIdentifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Név
    /// </summary>
    public string? Name { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cím azonosító
    /// </summary>
    public int? AddressId { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Törölt-e?
    /// </summary>
    public bool? IsDeleted { get; set; }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Institution;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Site;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Building;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.BuildingPart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Floor;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Room;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.MeasurementPoint;

public class MeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsQueryResult : IQueryResult
{
    public Dictionary<Guid, MeasurementPointParentHierarchy?> ResultItems { get; set; } = [];
    //ha a guid-ra nincs találat, akkor dictionary-be null value-val kerül be a guid

    public Dictionary<Guid, Exception?> Errors { get; set; } = []; //itt pedig visszaadhatjuk az okot, hogy miért nem található. pl. lehet jogosultság probléma is

    public bool HasErrors => Errors.Count > 0;
}


//TODO: van egy legfelső szint, ami fölött nem lehet direkben mérési pont bekötve, talán building. ezt pontosítani kell még. akkor a SiteRef és BuildingRef sem lehet null
public record MeasurementPointParentHierarchy(
    Guid MeasurementPointIdentifier,
    GuidEntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>? InstitutionRef,
    GuidEntityRef<SiteEntityDto>? SiteRef,
    GuidEntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>? BuildingRef,
    GuidEntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>? BuildingPartRef,
    GuidEntityRef<FloorEntityDto>? FloorRef,
    GuidEntityRef<RoomEntityDto>? RoomRef
//the orgunit, where the measurementpont is located, and all of it's parents must be populated
);

using Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.ModelCatalogue;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.ModelCatalogue;

/// <summary>
/// Azokkal az uniózott ModelTimeSeries rekordokkal tér vissza, amelyek olyan Modellkatalógusokhoz vannak hozzárendelve,
/// amelyek bemeneti paraméterek töltségétől függően vagy: 
/// [-] A tenant összes érvényes IoTDevice vagy MeasuredEndpoint szintű modellkatalógusában regisztrálva vannak jelenleg, vagy
/// [-] Az adott Telephely alatti IoTDevice vagy MeasuredEndpoint szintű modellkatalógusában regisztrálva vannak jelenleg, vagy
/// [-] Az adott Mérési hely alatti IoTDevice vagy MeasuredEndpoint szintű modellkatalógusában regisztrálva vannak jelenleg.
/// </summary>
public class ModelTimeSeriesHighLevelModelCatalogueQuery : EntityQuery<ModelTimeSeriesEntityDto>
{
    // Amennyiben nincs töltve, és a SiteLocationIdentifier sem, 
    // akkor Tenant-szinten értelmezendő a keresés. (Minden alacsony szintű Modellkatalógusbeli
    // ModelTimeSeries rekordot kapjuk vissza
    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely azonosító. 
    /// </summary>
    public Guid? SiteIdentifier { get; set; }

    // Amennyiben nincs töltve, és a SiteIdentifier sem, 
    // akkor Tenant-szinten értelmezendő a keresés. (Minden alacsony szintű Modellkatalógusbeli
    // ModelTimeSeries rekordot kapjuk vissza
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési hely azonosító
    /// </summary>
    public Guid? SiteLocationIdentifier { get; set;}
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.ModelCatalogue;

/// <summary>
/// Idősoros adat model
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.ListItems.EntityListItemDtoBase" />
[DataContract]
public class ModelTimeSeriesMinModel : EntityListItemDtoBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Idősoros adat azonosító
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The identifier.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Idősoros adat azonosító")]
    public Guid? Identifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Idősoros adat mérési pont név
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The name of the measured endpoint.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Idősoros adat mérési pont név")]
    public string ChannelName { get; set; } = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Kategória
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The device category.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Kategória")]
    public string DeviceCategory { get; set; } = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Kategória kód
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The device category code.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Kategória kód")]
    public string DeviceCategoryCode { get; set; } = null!;

    /// <summary>
    ///Típus
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The type of the device.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember] 
    [Display(Name = "Típus")] 
    public string DeviceType { get; set; } = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Idősor Jellege
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The type of the time series.
    /// </value>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Idősor Jellege")]
    public TimeSeriesType TimeSeriesType { get; set; }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared\Validators\BaseValidators\ValidityEntityDtoValidator.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel.Validity;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.BaseQueries;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Validators.BaseValidators;
public class ValidityEntityDtoValidator<TEntityDto> : BaseDtoValidator<TEntityDto> where TEntityDto : class, IValidityEntityDto
{

    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// PartnerValidityEntityDtoValidator konstruktor
    /// </summary>
    public ValidityEntityDtoValidator(IQueryService queryService) : base()
    {
        _queryService = queryService;

        // Érvényességi időszak validációk
        RuleFor(t => t.ValidFrom).NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage("Az érvényesség kezdete kötelező!");

        RuleFor(t => t.ValidTo).NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage("Az érvényesség vége kötelező!");

        RuleFor(t => t.ValidTo)
            .Must((validity, validTo) => validTo > validity.ValidFrom)
            .WithMessage("Az érvényesség vége nem lehet korábbi, mint az érvényesség kezdete!");

        RuleFor(x => x)
            .MustAsync(CheckValidityOverlapping)
            .WithMessage("Az új érvényességi időszak nem lehet átfedésben meglévő időszakkal!")
            .WithName(nameof(IValidityEntityDto.ValidTo));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség átfedés ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    private async Task<bool> CheckValidityOverlapping(TEntityDto entityDto, CancellationToken token)
    {
        if (entityDto.Parent == null)
            return true;

        var existingValidities = (await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new ValidityEntityQuery<TEntityDto>
        {
            ParentId = entityDto.Parent.Id,
            IsDeleted = false,
        }, token)).Items;

        return !existingValidities.Where(existing => existing.Id != entityDto.Id).Any(existing =>
            ((entityDto.ValidFrom <= existing.ValidTo && entityDto.ValidTo >= existing.ValidFrom)));
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Institution;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations.Site;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.EnergyContract;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Validators.EnergyContract;

/// <summary>
/// Hálózat használati szerződések validátor
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Validators.EnergyContract.EnergyContractEntityDtoValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract.NetworkUsageContractEntityDto&gt;" />
public class NetworkUsageContractEntityDtoValidator : EnergyContractEntityDtoValidator<NetworkUsageContractEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="NetworkUsageContractEntityDtoValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public NetworkUsageContractEntityDtoValidator(IQueryService queryService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        RuleFor(x => x.Institution).MustAsync(SingleValidNetworkUsageContractPerSite).WithMessage("A megadott érvényességi időszakban már van rögzítve hálózathasználati szerződése a telephelynek!");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az adott intézményhez egyszerre csak egy élő hálózathasználati szerződés lehet.
    /// Amennyiben úgy próbál rögzíteni hálózathasználati szerződést és átfedésben van az érvényességi intervalluma egy másikkal, adjuk hibaüzenetet:
    /// "A megadott érvényességi időszakban már van rögzítve hálózathasználati szerződése az intézménynek!"
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dto">The dto.</param>
    /// <param name="institution">The site.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<bool> SingleValidNetworkUsageContractPerSite(NetworkUsageContractEntityDto dto, EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto> institution, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        long validContracts = await _queryService.QueryEntityCount(new SingleValidNetworkUsageContractPerInstitutionQuery 
        {
            InstitutionId = dto.Institution.Id, 
            ContractId = dto.Id, 
            From = dto.ContractIssueDate, 
            To = dto.ContractExpiryDate
        }, cancellationToken);
        return validContracts == 0;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Validators.MeasurementPoint;

/// <summary>
/// MeasurementPointEntityDtoValidator
/// </summary>

public class MeasurementPointEntityDtoValidator : BaseDtoValidator<MeasurementPointEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeasurementPointEntityDtoValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public MeasurementPointEntityDtoValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(p => p.PodId)
            .Matches(RegexConstants.PodIdRegex)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.PodId}' nem megfelelő POD-ID formátum.")
            .When(x => x.IsBilling);

        RuleFor(p => p.Lat)
            .InclusiveBetween(-90, 90)
            .When(p => p.Lat.HasValue)
            .WithMessage("A szélességi fok (Lat) értékének -90 és +90 között kell lennie.");

        RuleFor(p => p.Lon)
            .InclusiveBetween(-180, 180)
            .When(p => p.Lon.HasValue)
            .WithMessage("A hosszúsági fok (Lon) értékének -180 és +180 között kell lennie.");

        RuleFor(p => p.ParentMeasurementPoint)
            .Must((entity, parent) => parent == null || entity.Id != parent.Id)
            .WithMessage("A mérési pont nem lehet a saját szülője!")
            .When(p => p.ParentMeasurementPoint != null);
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Tenant.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Validators.Tenant.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// Mérési végpont validátor
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices.ChannelEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ChannelEntityDtoValidator : BaseDtoValidator<ChannelEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Qquery service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ChannelEntityDtoValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public ChannelEntityDtoValidator(IQueryService queryService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;

        RuleFor(m => m.Configuration).MustAsync(CheckForExistingConfigurationCode).WithMessage(x => "Egy vagy több adat csatorna konfigurációs érték nem lett megadva!");
    }

    private async Task<bool> CheckForExistingConfigurationCode(ChannelEntityDto entityDto, IList<ChannelConfigValueEntityDto> configCodes, CancellationToken token)
    {
        if (configCodes == null)
            return false;

        var parentDevice = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<DeviceEntityDto>(entityDto.Device.Id);

        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new DeviceConfigEntityQuery
        {
            IoTDeviceTypeId = parentDevice.IoTDeviceType.Id,
            ConfigType = DeviceConfigType.Channel
        });

        if (result?.Items is DeviceConfigEntityDto[] deviceConfigCodes)
        {
            foreach (var deviceConfig in deviceConfigCodes)
            {
                if (!configCodes.Any(x => x.Config.Id == deviceConfig.Id))
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

            foreach (var deviceConfig in deviceConfigCodes) 
            {
                if (!configCodes.Any(x => x.Config.Id == deviceConfig.Id)) 
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private async Task<bool> CheckForExistingDeviceTypeCode(IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto iotDeviceType, CancellationToken token)
    {
        return (await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>(iotDeviceType.Id)) != null;

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.OrgUnitSecurity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.OrgUnitSecurity;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Validators.TenantIndependent.OrgUnitSecurity;

public class SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDtoValidator : BaseDtoValidator<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    public SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDtoValidator(IQueryService queryService) : base()
    {
        _queryService = queryService;


        // Érvényességi időszak validációk
        RuleFor(t => t.ValidFrom).NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage("Az érvényesség kezdete kötelező!");

        RuleFor(t => t.ValidTo)
            .Must((validity, validTo) => validTo > validity.ValidFrom)
            .When(x => x.ValidTo.HasValue)
            .WithMessage("Az érvényesség vége nem lehet korábbi, mint az érvényesség kezdete!");


        //TODO: az átfedés vizsgálatot kikommenteltem, mert nem teljesen egyértelmű, hogy milyen esetekben kéne az átfedést megtiltani. (sok a tényező)
        //RuleFor(x => x)
        //    .MustAsync(CheckValidityOverlapping)
        //    .WithMessage("Az új érvényességi időszak nem lehet átfedésben meglévő időszakkal!");
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Érvényesség átfedés ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    private async Task<bool> CheckValidityOverlapping(SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto entityDto, CancellationToken token)
    {
        int? orgunitid = entityDto.OrgunitType switch
        {
            OrgunitType.Institution => entityDto.Institution?.Id,
            OrgunitType.Site => entityDto.Site?.Id,
            OrgunitType.Building => entityDto.Building?.Id,
            _ => null
        };

        var existingAssignments = (await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(
            new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQuery
            {
                UserId = entityDto.User.Id,
                RoleIds = new List<int> { entityDto.Role.Id },
                TargetOrgUnitType = entityDto.OrgunitType,
                TargetOrgUnitId = orgunitid,
                //IncludeInvalidByCurrentDate = true, //azoat is le akarjuk kérni, amik töröltek, azzal sem lehet átfedés?
            }
            , token)).Items;

        bool hasOverlapping = existingAssignments
            .Where(existing => existing.Id != entityDto.Id) //exclude the current one
            .Any(existing =>
                   entityDto.ValidFrom <= (existing.ValidTo ?? DateTime.MaxValue) // Handle null ValidTo as maximum date
                && (entityDto.ValidTo ?? DateTime.MaxValue) >= existing.ValidFrom // Handle null ValidTo in entityDto
                );

        return !hasOverlapping;
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Validators;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Validators.TenantIndependent.Partner;

/// Partner validátor
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners.PartnerEntityDto&gt;" />
public class PartnerEntityDtoValidator : BaseDtoValidator<PartnerEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PartnerEntityDtoValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public PartnerEntityDtoValidator() : base()
    {
        RuleFor(t => t.TenantCode).NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.TenantCode}' nem lehet üres!");
        RuleFor(t => t.TenantCode).Matches(RegexConstants.OnlyAlphanumeric_2_50)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.TenantCode}' nem megfelelő Tenantkód-formátum.");

        RuleFor(t => t.PartnerValidities)
            .NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage("Legalább egy érvényességi rekordnak lennie kell!");
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Partners;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Validators.BaseValidators;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Validators.TenantIndependent.Partner;

/// <summary>
/// Partner érvényességi adat validátor
/// </summary>
public class PartnerValidityEntityDtoValidator : ValidityEntityDtoValidator<PartnerValidityEntityDto>
{

    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// PartnerValidityEntityDtoValidator konstruktor
    /// </summary>
    public PartnerValidityEntityDtoValidator(IQueryService queryService) : base(queryService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;

        // Név validációk
        RuleFor(t => t.Name).MaximumLength(256)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.Name}' nem lehet hosszabb, mint 256 karakter!");

        // Adószám validációk
        RuleFor(t => t.TaxIdentificationNumber).NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.TaxIdentificationNumber}' nem lehet üres!");
        RuleFor(t => t.TaxIdentificationNumber).MaximumLength(64)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.TaxIdentificationNumber}' nem lehet hosszabb, mint 64 karakter!");

        // Cégjegyzékszám validációk
        RuleFor(t => t.CompanyRegistrationNumber).MaximumLength(64)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.CompanyRegistrationNumber}' nem lehet hosszabb, mint 64 karakter!");

        // Telefonszám validációk
        RuleFor(t => t.Telephone).MaximumLength(256)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.Telephone}' nem lehet hosszabb, mint 256 karakter!");
        RuleFor(p => p.Telephone).Matches(RegexConstants.PhoneNumberRegex)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.Telephone}' nem megfelelő telefonszám-formátum.");

        // Email cím validációk
        RuleFor(t => t.EMail).MaximumLength(256)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.EMail}' nem lehet hosszabb, mint 256 karakter!");
        RuleFor(p => p.EMail).Matches(RegexConstants.EmailAddress)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.EMail}' nem megfelelő emailcím-formátum.");

        // Website validáció
        RuleFor(t => t.Website).MaximumLength(256)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.Website}' nem lehet hosszabb, mint 256 karakter!");

        //Leírás validáció
        RuleFor(t => t.Description).MaximumLength(512)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.Description}' nem lehet hosszabb, mint 512 karakter!");
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Globalization;
using Autofac;
using Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.WebAPI.ErrorHandler;
using Common.WebAPI.Extensions;
using Common.WebAPI.Filters;
using Energiamenedzsment.Common.EdmInterface.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Security;
using FluentValidation.AspNetCore;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Infrastructure;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Converters;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Serialization;
using Serilog;
using Log = Common.Logic.Logging.Log;
using Common.Shared;

var allowSpecificOrigins = "_allowSpecificOrigins";

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Host.UseSerilog((context, configuration) => configuration.ReadFrom.Configuration(context.Configuration));

ConfigureConfiguration(builder.Configuration);

builder.Services.AddSingleton<ProblemDetailsFactory, EnergiaMenedzsmentProblemDetailsFactory>();

//Autofac configuration
builder.Host.ConfigureContainer<ContainerBuilder>(containerBuilder =>
{
    containerBuilder.RegisterAPISecurityContext();
    containerBuilder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x =>
        x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common") ||
        x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework") ||
        AssemblyHelper.CheckAssemblyType(x, AssemblyType.DeviceType));
    containerBuilder.RegisterMaps();
});
builder.Host.UseServiceProviderFactory(new AutofacServiceProviderFactory());

// Add services to the container.

JsonConvert.DefaultSettings = () =>
{
    var settings = new JsonSerializerSettings
    {
        ContractResolver = new CamelCasePropertyNamesContractResolver()
    };
    return settings;
};

builder.Services
    .AddControllers()
    .AddNewtonsoftJson(options => options
        .SerializerSettings
        .Converters
        .Add(new StringEnumConverter())
    )
    .AddFluentValidation(fv => ConfigureFluentValidation(fv));
// Learn more about configuring Swagger/OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/swashbuckle
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();


builder.Services.Configure<RouteOptions>(options => options.LowercaseUrls = true);
builder.Services.AddCustomizedSwagger(nameof(EnergiaMenedzsment), c =>
{
    c.DocumentFilter<SwaggerDocumentFilter>();
});

builder.Services.AddHealthChecks();

builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies());

// Adding Authentication  
builder.Services.AddEnergiaMenedzsmentAuthentication();

builder.Services.AddSpaStaticFiles(configuration =>
{
    configuration.RootPath = "ClientApp/dist";
});

builder.Services.AddDistributedMemoryCache();

builder.Services.AddHttpLogging(o => { });

builder.Services.AddSession(options =>
{
    options.IdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
    options.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;
    options.Cookie.IsEssential = true;
});

builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy(name: allowSpecificOrigins,
        corsBuilder =>
        {
            corsBuilder.WithOrigins(builder.Configuration["AccessControlAllowOrigin"].Split(',')).SetIsOriginAllowedToAllowWildcardSubdomains()
                   .AllowAnyHeader()
                   .AllowAnyMethod();
        });
});

var serviceCollection = new ServiceCollection();

serviceCollection.AddHttpClient<EdmInterfaceService>("EDM-API", client =>
{
    client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue("EnapMockApiHost"));
    client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("EnapMockApiHostTimeout"));
});

serviceCollection.AddHttpClient(Constants.ModuleNames.MonitoringWebApi, client =>
{
    client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(Constants.ModuleHostConfigKeys.MonitoringApiHost));
    client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(90);
});
serviceCollection.AddHttpClient(Constants.ModuleAuthClientNames.MonitoringAuthClient, client =>
{
    client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(Constants.ModuleHostConfigKeys.MonitoringApiHost));
    client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("text/plain"));
    //client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("TODO..."));
});

serviceCollection.AddHttpClient(Constants.ModuleAuthClientNames.FrameworkAuthClient, client =>
{
    client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(Constants.ModuleHostConfigKeys.FrameworkApiHost));
    client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("text/plain"));
    //client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("TODO..."));
});

serviceCollection.AddModuleApiClients();

builder.Host.ConfigureContainer<ContainerBuilder>(containerBuilder =>
{
    containerBuilder.Populate(serviceCollection);
});

foreach (var serviceDescriptor in serviceCollection)
{
    builder.Services.Add(serviceDescriptor);
}

var app = builder.Build();

app.Lifetime.ApplicationStopping.Register(OnShutdown);
AutofacScope.SetGlobal(app.Services.GetAutofacRoot());
Config.Provider = new DbConfigProvider(AutofacScope.Global);

app.UseCustomizedSwagger(builder.Configuration);

app.MapHealthChecks("/api/healthcheck");

var respondWithJsonErrorDetails = Config.GetBoolValue("IsErrorDetailsEnabled");
app.UseGlobalExceptionHandler("/Error", respondWithJsonErrorDetails);

app.UseMiddleware<ExceptionMiddleware>();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseRouting();


app.UseCors(allowSpecificOrigins);

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseSession();
app.UseHttpLogging();
app.UseMiddleware<SerilogMiddleware>();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.UseStaticFiles();
if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSpaStaticFiles();
}

app.MapControllers();

app.MapWhen(x => x.Request.Path.Value != null && !x.Request.Path.Value.StartsWith("/api"), builder =>
{
    builder.UseSpa(spa =>
    {
        // To learn more about options for serving an Angular SPA from ASP.NET Core,
        // see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=864501
        if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
        {
            spa.UseProxyToSpaDevelopmentServer("http://localhost:4200");
        }
    });
});

Log.LogInfo($"EnergiaMenedzsment Framework WebAPI - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(AuthenticateController))} started");
app.Run();


void ConfigureConfiguration(ConfigurationManager configuration)
{
    var cultureInfo = new CultureInfo("hu-HU");

    CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = cultureInfo;
    CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = cultureInfo;

    Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
    Config.LocalProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);

};

void ConfigureFluentValidation(FluentValidationMvcConfiguration fv)
{
    fv.RunDefaultMvcValidationAfterFluentValidationExecutes = false;
    fv.ValidatorOptions.LanguageManager.Culture = new CultureInfo("hu");
    fv.ImplicitlyValidateChildProperties = true;
    fv.ValidatorOptions.DisplayNameResolver = (_, member, _) => member?.GetAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? member?.Name;
}

void OnShutdown()
{
    Log.LogInfo($"EnergiaMenedzsment Framework WebAPI - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(AuthenticateController))} stopped");
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Tenant.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// MeasuredEndpointController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class ChannelController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ChannelController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public ChannelController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    #region MeasuredEndpoint API methods

    // GET: api/measured-endpoint/{measuredEndpointIdentifier}
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési végpont lekérdezése azonosítója alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="measuredEndpointIdentifier">Mérési végpont azonosító (GUID)</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{measuredEndpointIdentifier}", Name = "GetMeasuredEndpointByIdentifier")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "MeasuredEndpoint_GetMeasuredEndpointByIdentifier")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ChannelModel>> GetMeasuredEndpointByIdentifier(Guid measuredEndpointIdentifier, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new ChannelQuery
        {
            MeasuredEndpointIdentifier = measuredEndpointIdentifier,
            TenantCode = tenantCode
        }))?.Entity is not ChannelEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "MeasuredEndpoint" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<ChannelModel>(queryResponse);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/measured-endpoint/{measuredendpointid}/id
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési végpont lekérdezése id alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="measuredendpointid">The measuredendpointid.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("id/{measuredendpointid}", Name = "GetMEndpointById")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "MeasuredEndpoint_GetMEndpointById")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ChannelModel>> GetMEndpointById(int measuredendpointid)
    {
        var entityDto = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<ChannelEntityDto>(measuredendpointid);

        var result = _mapper.Map<ChannelModel>(entityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    #endregion
}
