using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// DeviceConfigsController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class DeviceConfigsController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// Device type cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IoTDeviceTypeCache _ioTDeviceTypeCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DeviceConfigsController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="ioTDeviceTypeCache">The io t device type cache.</param>
    /// <param name="tiCache">The ti cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public DeviceConfigsController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IoTDeviceTypeCache ioTDeviceTypeCache,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IMapper mapper)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        _ioTDeviceTypeCache = ioTDeviceTypeCache;
        _tiCache = tiCache;
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/deviceconfigs/device/{deviceTypeId}/config-list
    /// <summary>
    /// Azon DeviceConfigok lekérdezése egy név, és kód mezőt tartalmazó lista formájában,
    /// amelyek "Device" DeviceConfigType típusúak, és a DeviceTypeId-juk
    /// megegyezik a paraméterként átadott Id értékével.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceTypeId">The device type identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("device/{deviceTypeId}/config-list", Name = "GetDeviceDeviceConfigListById")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "DeviceConfigs_GetDeviceDeviceConfigListById")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DeviceConfigCodeModel[]>> GetDeviceDeviceConfigListById(int deviceTypeId)
    {
        if (deviceTypeId == 0)
            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Eszköztípus id megadása kötelező!"
            });

        var searchQuery = new DeviceConfigRefsQuery { DeviceTypeId = deviceTypeId, DeviceConfigType = DeviceConfigType.Device };
        var deviceConfigRefs = (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(searchQuery) as DeviceConfigRefsQueryResult)?.DeviceConfigCodeList.Select(_mapper.Map<DeviceConfigCodeModel>);

        var result = deviceConfigRefs;
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/deviceconfigs/measured-endpoint/{deviceTypeId}/config-list
    /// <summary>
    /// Azon DeviceConfigok lekérdezése egy név, és kód mezőt tartalmazó lista formájában,
    /// amelyek "MeasuredEndpoint" DeviceConfigType típusúak, és a DeviceTypeId-juk
    /// megegyezik a paraméterként átadott Id értékével.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceTypeId">The device type identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("measured-endpoint/{deviceTypeId}/config-list", Name = "GetMeasuredEndpointDeviceConfigListById")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "DeviceConfigs_GetMeasuredEndpointDeviceConfigListById")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DeviceConfigCodeModel[]>> GetMeasuredEndpointDeviceConfigListById(int deviceTypeId)
    {
        if (deviceTypeId == 0)
            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Eszköztípus id megadása kötelező!"
            });

        var searchQuery = new DeviceConfigRefsQuery { DeviceTypeId = deviceTypeId, DeviceConfigType = DeviceConfigType.Channel };
        var deviceConfigRefs = (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(searchQuery) as DeviceConfigRefsQueryResult)?.DeviceConfigCodeList;

        var result = deviceConfigRefs;
        return Ok(result);
    }
}

        return Ok(result);

    }

    // POST: api/devices/addbyorgunitguid
    /// <summary>
    /// Új eszköz létrehozás és orgunithoz való hozzárendelés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("addbyorgunitguid", Name = "PostDeviceByOrgunitGuid")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Devices_PostDeviceByOrgunitGuid")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DeviceModel>> PostDeviceByOrgunitGuid(CreateDeviceForOrgunitRequest request)
    {
        string? timeZoneCode = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.TimezoneCode) ? _scope.Config().GetStringValue("CurrentTimeZone") : request.TimezoneCode;
        AddDeviceToOrgunitLocationCommand createCommand = _mapper.Map<AddDeviceToOrgunitLocationCommand>(request);
        createCommand.Timezone = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>>(_tiCache.GetItem(DictType.TimeZone, timeZoneCode));
        var result = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(createCommand) as AddDeviceToOrgunitLocationCommandResult;

        if (result?.DeviceEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(result);

        var response = _mapper.Map<DeviceModel>(result.DeviceEntityDto);
        return Ok(response);
    }

    // PUT: api/devices
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz szerkesztés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id:int}", Name = "PutDevice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Devices_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DeviceModel>> Put(int id, ModifyDeviceRequest request)
    {
        var dto = _queryService.GetById<DeviceEntityDto>(id);

        if (dto == null)
            return BadRequest();

        if (dto.Id != request.Id)
            return BadRequest();

        dto = _mapper.Map(request, dto);
        var resultDto = await _commandService.UpdateEntityAsync(dto);

        if (resultDto == null)
            return BadRequest(request);

        var result = _mapper.Map<DeviceModel>(resultDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/devices/sync
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszközök lekérdezése sync-hez
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="syncDevicesRequest">The synchronize devices request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("sync", Name = "SyncDevices")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Devices_SyncDevices")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<DeviceSyncModel>>> SyncDevices(SyncDevicesRequest syncDevicesRequest)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(syncDevicesRequest.TenantCode)) 
        {
            using (var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(syncDevicesRequest.TenantCode);
                var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

                var response = await tenantQueryService.ExecuteQuery(new SyncDeviceQuery()
                {
                    From = syncDevicesRequest.From
                });

                if (response is null || response is not SyncDeviceQueryResult result)
                    return BadRequest(response);

                return Ok(result.Devices);
            }
        }

        throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Device Sync: Tenant code must be provided!");
    }

    // GET: api/devices/{deviceIdentifier}/channels
    /// <summary>
    /// Az eszközhöz rendelt mérési pontok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceIdentifier">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{deviceIdentifier}/channels", Name = "GetChannels")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Devices_GetChannels")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<ChannelModel>>> GetChannels(Guid deviceIdentifier, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        var result = new List<ChannelModel>();
        var searchQuery = new ChannelQuery
        {
            DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier,
            IsDeleted = false,
            TenantCode = tenantCode
        };

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
                var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

                if ((await tenantQueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(searchQuery))?.Items is not ChannelEntityDto[] mEDtos)
                    return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Channel" });
                result = mEDtos.Select(t => _mapper.Map<ChannelModel>(t))?.ToList();
            }
        else
        {
            if ((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(searchQuery))?.Items is not ChannelEntityDto[] channelEntityDtos)
                return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Channel" });
            result = channelEntityDtos.Select(t => _mapper.Map<ChannelModel>(t))?.ToList();
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/devices/{deviceId}/channels/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Az eszközhöz rendelt mérési pontok lekérdezése eszköz id alapján, entitásrefencia listában visszaadva.
    /// </summary>

        if (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(searchQuery) is not ChannelSingleQueryResult singleQueryResult)

        return Ok(result);

    [HttpPost("{deviceIdentifier}/channels", Name = "PostChannel")]

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Devices_PostChannel")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ChannelModel>> PostChannel(Guid deviceIdentifier, CreateChannelRequest request)
    {
        var command = _mapper.Map<CreateChannelCommand>(request);
        command.DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier;

        // A Mérési pont mentő felületen beállított mérési hely (és telephely) mentés során frissíti a kapcsolódó eszközhöz beállított mérési helyet.

        if (response?.ChannelEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<ChannelModel>(response.ChannelEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);

    /// <summary>
    /// Eszközhöz rendelt mérési pont szerkesztése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceIdentifier">The device identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="channelId">The measured endpoint identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{deviceIdentifier}/channels/{channelId}", Name = "PutChannel")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Devices_PutChannel")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<ChannelModel>> PutChannel(Guid deviceIdentifier, int channelId, ModifyChannelRequest request)
    {
        var command = _mapper.Map<ModifyChannelCommand>(request);
        command.Id = channelId;
        command.DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier;

        // A Mérési pont szerkesztő felületen módosított mérési hely (és telephely) mentés során frissíti a kapcsolódó eszközhöz beállított mérési helyet.
        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SingleDeviceEntityDtoQuery { DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier })
            .Result?.Entity is DeviceEntityDto device)
        {
            _commandService.UpdateEntity(device);
        }
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command) as ModifyChannelCommandResult;

        if (response?.ChannelEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<ChannelModel>(response.ChannelEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteChannelCommand

            DeviceIdentifier = deviceIdentifier
        }) as DeleteChannelCommandResult;

        return response == null || !response.IsSuccess ? (ActionResult<DeleteChannelCommandResult>)BadRequest(response) : (ActionResult<DeleteChannelCommandResult>)Ok(response);
    }

using AutoMapper;

/// <summary>
/// EndpointUnitsController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class EndpointUnitsController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="EndpointUnitsController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public EndpointUnitsController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/endpointunits
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes fogyasztó/termelő egység lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet(Name = "GetEndpointUnits")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EndpointUnits_GetEndpointUnits")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<EndpointUnitModel>>> GetEndpointUnits()
    {
        if ((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync<EndpointUnitEntityDto>())?.Items is not EndpointUnitEntityDto[] endpointUnitEntityDtos
            || endpointUnitEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "EndpointUnit" });

        var result = endpointUnitEntityDtos.Select(_mapper.Map<EndpointUnitModel>);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/endpointunits/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Az adott fogyasztó/termelő egység lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}", Name = "GetEndpointUnit")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EndpointUnits_GetEndpointUnit")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EndpointUnitWithSchemaModel>> GetEndpointUnit(int id)
    {
        var dto = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<EndpointUnitEntityDto>(id);
        if (dto == null)
            return NotFound(id);

        var result = await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new EndpointUnitSingleQuery
        {
            EndpointUnitId = id
        }) as EndpointUnitSingleQueryResult;

        var model = _mapper.Map<EndpointUnitWithSchemaModel>(result);

        return Ok(model);
    }


    // PUT: api/endpointunits/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Módosítja az adott ID-hez a fogyasztó/termelő egységet
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="modifyDeviceRequest">The modify device request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id}", Name = "ModifyEndpointUnit")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EndpointUnits_ModifyEndpointUnit")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EndpointUnitModel>> ModifyEndpointUnit(int id, ModifyEndpointUnitRequest modifyDeviceRequest)
    {
        ModifyEndpointUnitCommand command = _mapper.Map<ModifyEndpointUnitCommand>(modifyDeviceRequest);
        command.Id = id;

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command) as ModifyEndpointUnitCommandResult;

        if (response?.EndpointUnitEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<EndpointUnitModel>(response.EndpointUnitEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/endpointunits/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Törli az adott ID-hez a fogyasztó/termelő egységet
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Fogyasztó/termelő egység azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{id}", Name = "DeleteEndpointUnit")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EndpointUnits_DeleteEndpointUnit")]
    public async Task<ActionResult> DeleteEndpointUnit(int id)
    {
        await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteEndpointUnitCommand
        {
            EndpointUnitId = id
        });

        return Ok();
    }

    // GET: api/endpointunits/{id}/data
    /// <summary>
    /// Az adott fogyasztó/termelő egységhez tartozó metaadatok json formában.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="identifier">The identifier.</param>

    public async Task<ActionResult<object>> GetEndpointUnitData(Guid identifier)
    {
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new EndpointUnitEntityQuery { Identifier = identifier })).Entity is not EndpointUnitEntityDto endpointUnitEntityDto)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "EndpointUnit" });

        var res = await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new EndpointUnitMetaDataQuery { EndpointUnitId = endpointUnitEntityDto.Id }) as EndpointUnitMetaDataQueryResult;

        return Ok(res?.MetaDataJson);
    }

    // POST: api/endpointunits
    /// <summary>
    /// Új fogyasztó/termelő egység létrehozása
    /// </summary>

        if (response?.EndpointUnitEntityDto == null)

        var result = _mapper.Map<EndpointUnitModel>(response.EndpointUnitEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);

    // GET: api/endpointunits/meta-data-schema/entity-ref

    /// </summary>

    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]

    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityRef<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>[]>> GetMetaDataSchemaRefs(string? text)

        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SelectEntityRefQuery<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaEntityDto>

    // GET: api/endpointunits/endpoint-unit-metadata-schema/{schemaId}/properties
    /// <summary>

    {
        var properties = (await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertiesQuery
        {

        var result = _mapper.Map<List<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyModel>>(properties);

    // GET: api/endpointunits/list-items
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési végpont datatable
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dataTableRequest">The data table request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("list-items", Name = "GetEndpointUnitListItems")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EndpointUnit_GetEndpointUnitListItems")]
    public async Task<EntityListItemQueryResult<EndpointUnitListItemDto>?> Get([FromQuery] EndpointUnitDataTableRequest dataTableRequest)
    {
        EndpointUnitPagedEntityQuery query = new()
        {
            PagingInfo = new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = dataTableRequest.PageSize,
                StartPage = dataTableRequest.StartPage
            },
            SortingInfo = new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = dataTableRequest.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = dataTableRequest.SortDirection
            },
            SearchText = string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataTableRequest.SearchText) ? string.Empty : dataTableRequest.SearchText,
            Type = dataTableRequest.TypeFilter,
            MeasuredEndpointId = dataTableRequest.MeasuredEndpointIdFilter
        };
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        return result;
    }

    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetDeviceTypes")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDeviceTypes_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<IoTDeviceTypeModel>>> GetAll()
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>())?.Items is IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto[] iotDeviceTypes)
            || iotDeviceTypes == null
            || iotDeviceTypes.Length == 0)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "IoTDeviceType" });

        var result = iotDeviceTypes.Select(t => _mapper.Map<IoTDeviceTypeModel>(t));
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // GET: api/IoTDeviceTypes/{code}
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT Eszköztípus lekérdezése a kódja alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code">Az eszköztípus kódja</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{code}", Name = "GetDeviceType")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDeviceTypes_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDeviceTypeModel>> Get(string code)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code))
            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse()
            {
                Error = "Eszköztípus kód megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if (!((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new IoTDeviceTypeQuery { Code = code }))?.Entity is IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto iotDeviceTypeEntityDto)
            || iotDeviceTypeEntityDto == null
            || iotDeviceTypeEntityDto.Id == 0)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "IoTDeviceType" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<IoTDeviceTypeModel>(iotDeviceTypeEntityDto);
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // POST: api/IoTDeviceTypes/post
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT Eszköztípus létrehozás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "PostDeviceType")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDeviceTypes_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDeviceTypeModel>> Post(CreateIoTDeviceTypeRequest request)
    {
        var response = (IoTDeviceTypeCreateCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new IoTDeviceTypeCreateCommand
        {
            DeviceTypeName = request.DeviceTypeName,
            DeviceTypeCode = request.DeviceTypeCode,
            DeviceCategoryCode = request.DeviceCategoryCode
        });

        if (response == null || response.IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto == null)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<IoTDeviceTypeModel>(response?.IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto);
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // PUT: api/IoTDeviceTypes/{code}
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT Eszköztípus szerkesztés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code">Az IoT eszköztípus kódja</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{code}", Name = "PutDeviceType")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDeviceTypes_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDeviceTypeModel>> Put(string code, ModifyIoTDeviceTypeRequest request)
    {
        var response = (IoTDeviceTypeModifyCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new IoTDeviceTypeModifyCommand
        {
            DeviceTypeName = request.DeviceTypeName,
            DeviceTypeCode = code,
            DeviceCategoryCode = request.DeviceCategoryCode
        });

        if (response == null || response.IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto == null)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<IoTDeviceTypeModel>(response?.IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto);
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/IoTDeviceTypes/{code}
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT Eszköztípus törlése (logikai)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code">Az IoT eszköztípus kódja</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{code}", Name = "DeleteDeviceType")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDeviceTypes_Delete")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDeviceTypeDeleteCommandResult>> Delete(string code)
    {
        var response = (IoTDeviceTypeDeleteCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new IoTDeviceTypeDeleteCommand
        {
            DeviceTypeCode = code
        });

        if (response == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "IoTDeviceType" });

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response);

        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, response);
    }

    // GET: /api/iotdevicetypes/[code]/devices
    /// <summary>
    /// Megadott kóddal rendelkező összes eszköz lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code">The code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{code}/devices", Name = "GetDevicesByIotTypeCode")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDeviceTypes_GetDevicesByIotTypeCode")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<DeviceModel>>> GetDevicesByIotTypeCode(string code)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code))
            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Eszköztípus kód megadása kötelező!"
            });

        var searchQuery = new DeviceEntitiesQuery_Old {IoTDeviceTypeCode = code};
        if ((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(searchQuery))?.Items is not DeviceEntityDto[] deviceEntityDtos)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse {Type = "DeviceEntity"});

        var result = deviceEntityDtos.Select(d => _mapper.Map<DeviceModel>(d));
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: /api/iotdevicetypes/category/{deviceCategoryId}/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// IoTDeviceType referenciák deviceCategory id alapján.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceCategoryId">The device category identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("category/{deviceCategoryId}/entity-ref", Name = "GetDevicesRefByDeviceCategoryId")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTDeviceTypes_GetDevicesRefByDeviceCategoryId")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<EntityRef<IoTDeviceTypeModel>>>> GetDevicesRefByDeviceCategoryId(int deviceCategoryId)
    {
        if (deviceCategoryId == 0)
            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Eszköztkategória id megadása kötelező!"
            });

        var searchQuery = new GetIoTDeviceTypeRefsQuery { DeviceCategoryId = deviceCategoryId };
        var deviceTypeRefs = (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(searchQuery) as GetIoTDeviceTypeRefsQueryResult)?.DeviceTypeRefs;

        var result = deviceTypeRefs;
        return Ok(result);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Emissions.Requests;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Emissions;

/// <summary>
/// Co2eFactorsController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
[TenantCodeRequired(MustBeEmpty: true, IsRequired: false)]
public class Co2eFactorsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="Co2eFactorsController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public Co2eFactorsController(
        SecurityContext securityContext,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper
        )
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }



    // GET: api/Co2eFactors
    [HttpGet(Name = "GetCo2eFactorsList")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Co2eFactors_GetCo2eFactorsList")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<Co2eFactorListItemDto>>> GetCo2eFactorList([FromQuery] Co2eFactorDataTableRequest request)
    {
        request.IsDeleted = false;
        var query = _mapper.Map<Co2eFactorPagedEntityQuery>(request); //lapozási paramétereket a mapping profile lekezeli
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/Co2eFactors/all
    [HttpGet("all", Name = "GetAllCo2eFactors")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Co2eFactors_GetAllCo2eFactors")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IList<Co2eFactorModel>>> GetAllCo2eFactors()
    { //csak az IsDeleted szűrővel lekérve az összeset adjuk vissza. ezt az API-n keresztüli szinkronizáláshoz fogjuk használni. (az elemszám várhatóan nem sok)
      // a deletedet azért hardkódoltam, mert szerintem a többi modulban soha nem lesz szükség arra, hogy a törölt sorokat is lássa.
        var qry = new Co2eFactorEntityQuery { IsDeleted = false };
        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(qry);
        var models = result.Items.Select(_mapper.Map<Co2eFactorModel>).ToList();
        return Ok(models);
    }

    // GET: api/Co2eFactors/{id}
    [HttpGet("{id}", Name = "GetCo2eFactorById")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Co2eFactors_GetCo2eFactorById")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<Co2eFactorModel>> GetCo2eFactorById(int id)
    {
        var qry = new Co2eFactorSingleEntityQuery { Id = id, };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(qry))?.Entity is not Co2eFactorEntity queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Co2eFactor", Id = id.ToString() });

        var result = _mapper.Map<Co2eFactorModel>(queryResponse);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/Co2eFactors
    [HttpPost(Name = "CreateCo2eFactor")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Co2eFactors_CreateCo2eFactor")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<Co2eFactorModel>> CreateCo2eFactor([FromBody] CreateCo2eFactorRequest request)
    {
        CreateCo2eFactorCommand createCommand = _mapper.Map<CreateCo2eFactorCommand>(request);
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(createCommand, dbContextKey: DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE) as CreateCo2eFactorCommandResult;

        if (response?.Co2eFactorEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<Co2eFactorModel>(response.Co2eFactorEntityDto);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetCo2eFactorById), new { id = result.Id }, result);
    }

    // PUT: api/Co2eFactors/{id}
    [HttpPut("{id}", Name = "UpdateCo2eFactor")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Co2eFactors_UpdateCo2eFactor")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<Co2eFactorModel>> UpdateCo2eFactor(int id, [FromBody] ModifyCo2eFactorRequest request)
    {
        ModifyCo2eFactorCommand modifyCommand = _mapper.Map<ModifyCo2eFactorCommand>(request);
        modifyCommand.Co2eFactorId = id;

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(modifyCommand, dbContextKey: DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE) as ModifyCo2eFactorCommandResult;

        if (response?.Co2eFactorEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<Co2eFactorModel>(response.Co2eFactorEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/Co2eFactors/{id}
    [HttpDelete("{id}", Name = "DeleteCo2eFactor")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Co2eFactors_DeleteCo2eFactor")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteCo2eFactor(int id)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteCo2eFactorCommand
        {
            Co2eFactorId = id
        }, dbContextKey: DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE) as DeleteCo2eFactorCommandResult;

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
    }


}

        return Ok(updated);

    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="institutionIdentifier">The institution identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("institution/{institutionIdentifier}", Name = "GetContractsByInstitution")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EnergyContracts_GetContractsByInstitution")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[]>> GetContractsByInstitution(Guid institutionIdentifier, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
                var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

                var searchQuery = new EnergyContractEntityByInstitutionQuery
                {
                    InstitutionIdentifier = institutionIdentifier,
                };
                if ((await tenantQueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(searchQuery))?.Items is not PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[] dtos)
                    return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "PowerPurchaseAgreement" });

                return Ok(dtos);
            }
        else
        {
            var searchQuery = new EnergyContractEntityByInstitutionQuery
            {
                InstitutionIdentifier = institutionIdentifier,
            };
            if ((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(searchQuery))?.Items is not PowerPurchaseAgreementEntityDto[] dtos)
                return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "PowerPurchaseAgreement" });

            return Ok(dtos);
        }
    }

}

/// <summary>

[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class InvoicesController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InvoicesController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public InvoicesController(IQueryService queryService, ICommandService commandService, IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/invoices
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes számla lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetInvoices")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Invoices_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<InvoiceListItemDto>>> GetAll([FromQuery] InvoiceDataTableRequest request)
    {
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(new InvoicePagedEntityQuery
        {
            InvoiceIdentifier = request.InvoiceIdentifier,
            From = request.InvoicePeriodStart,
            To = request.InvoicePeriodEnd,
            
            PagingInfo = new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = request.PageSize,
                StartPage = request.StartPage
            },
            SortingInfo = new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = request.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = request.SortDirection
            }
        });

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/invoices/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Számla lekérdezése azonosító alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id:int}", Name = "GetInvoice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Invoices_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<InvoiceModel>> Get(int id)
    {
        var invoiceQuery = new InvoiceEntityQuery { Id = id, IsDeleted = false };
        
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(invoiceQuery))?.Entity is not InvoiceEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Invoice" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<InvoiceModel>(queryResponse);

        result.EnergyContracts = queryResponse.EnergyContracts
            .Select(c => _mapper.Map<EnergyContractEntityDto>(_queryService.GetById<EnergyContractEntityDto>(c.Id)))
            .ToList();
        
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/invoices/get-by-siteidentifier
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes számla lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("get-by-siteidentifier", Name = "GetInvoicesBySiteIdentifier")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Invoices_GetInvoicesBySiteIdentifier")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<InvoiceMinimalModel[]>> GetInvoicesBySiteIdentifier([FromQuery] InvoicesBySiteRequest request)
    {
        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new InvoiceEntityQuery
        {
            InstitutionIdentifier = string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.SiteIdentifier) ? null : new Guid(request.SiteIdentifier),
            From = request.InvoicePeriodStart, 
            To = request.InvoicePeriodEnd,
            IsDeleted = false,
            TenantCode = request.TenantCode
        });

        if (result != null && result.Items != null && result.Items.Length > 0)
            return Ok(result.Items.Select(x => _mapper.Map<InvoiceMinimalModel>(x)));

        else return Ok(new InvoiceMinimalModel[] { });
    }

    // POST: api/invoices/
    /// <summary>
    /// Új számla létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "PostInvoice")]

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Invoices_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<InvoiceEntityDto>> Post(CreateInvoiceRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreateInvoiceCommand
        {
            EnergyContracts = request.EnergyContracts,
            InvoiceDistributorFee = request.InvoiceDistributorFee,
            InvoiceEnergyFee = request.InvoiceEnergyFee,
            InvoiceIdentifier = request.InvoiceIdentifier,
            AccountingPeriodStart = request.AccountingPeriodStart,
            AccountingPeriodEnd = request.AccountingPeriodEnd,
            TotalAmount = request.TotalAmount,
            IssueDate = request.IssueDate,
            PaymentCompletedDate = request.PaymentCompletedDate,
            PaymentDueDate = request.PaymentDueDate
        }) as CreateInvoiceCommandResult;

        if (response?.InvoiceEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response.InvoiceEntityDto);
    }

    // PUT: api/invoices/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Számla szerkesztés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id:int}", Name = "PutInvoice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Invoices_Put")]

    {

            InvoiceDistributorFee = request.InvoiceDistributorFee
        }) as ModifyInvoiceCommandResult;

        if (response?.InvoiceEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response.InvoiceEntityDto);
    }

    // DELETE: api/invoices/{id}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.EnergyContracts;

/// <summary>
/// SuppliersController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class SuppliersController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>

    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/suppliers
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes szolgáltató lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetSuppliers")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Suppliers_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<SupplierListItemDto>>> GetAll([FromQuery] SupplierDataTableRequest request)
    {
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(new SupplierPagedEntityQuery
        {
            Name = request.Name,
            TaxIdentificationNumber = request.TaxIdentificationNumber,
            Headquarters = request.Headquarters,

            PagingInfo = new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = request.PageSize,
                StartPage = request.StartPage
            },
            SortingInfo = new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = request.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = request.SortDirection
            }
        });

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/suppliers/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Összes szolgáltató lekérdezése (EntityRef)
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("entity-ref", Name = "GetSuppliersEntityRef")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Suppliers_GetSuppliersEntityRef")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<EntityRef<SupplierEntityDto>>>> GetAllEntityRef()
    {
        var queryItemsResult = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SelectEntityRefQuery<SupplierEntityDto>());
        return Ok(queryItemsResult.Items);
    }

    // GET: api/suppliers/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Szolgáltató lekérdezése azonosító alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id:int}", Name = "GetSupplier")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Suppliers_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SupplierModel>> Get(int id)
    {
        var entity = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<SupplierEntityDto>(id);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SupplierModel>(entity);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/suppliers
    /// <summary>
    /// Új szolgáltató létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "PostSupplier")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Suppliers_PostSupplier")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SupplierModel>> PostEnergySupplier(SupplierRequest request)
    {
        if (request.Id != 0)
            return BadRequest();

        var dto = _mapper.Map<SupplierEntityDto>(request);
        var resultDto = await _commandService.CreateEntityAsync(dto);

        if (resultDto == null)
            return BadRequest(request);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SupplierModel>(resultDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/suppliers/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Szolgáltató módosítás ID alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id:int}", Name = "PutSupplier")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Suppliers_PutSupplier")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SupplierModel>> PutSupplier(int id, SupplierRequest request)
    {
        var dto = _queryService.GetById<SupplierEntityDto>(id);

        if (dto == null)
            return BadRequest();

        if (dto.Id != request.Id)
            return BadRequest();

        dto = _mapper.Map(request, dto);
        var resultDto = await _commandService.UpdateEntityAsync(dto);

        if (resultDto == null)
            return BadRequest(request);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SupplierModel>(resultDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/suppliers/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Szolgáltató törlés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{id:int}", Name = "DeleteSupplier")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Suppliers_DeleteSupplier")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SuccessResponse>> DeleteSupplier(int id)
    {
        await _commandService.DeleteEntityAsync<SupplierEntityDto>(id);

        return Ok(new SuccessResponse());
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models.EnergyPerformance;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.EnergyPerformance;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.HealthCheck;

[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class EnergyConsumptionDevicesController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="HealthCheckController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public EnergyConsumptionDevicesController(ICommandService commandService, IQueryService queryService, IMapper mapper) : base()
    {
        _mapper = mapper;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    [HttpPost("{orgunitId}/energy-consumption-device", Name = "CreateEnergyConsumptionDevice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EnergyConsumptionDevices_CreateEnergyConsumptionDevice")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel>> CreateEnergyConsumptionDevice([FromBody] CreateEnergyConsumptionDeviceRequest request, int orgunitId)
    {
        var command = _mapper.Map<CreateEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand>(request);
        command.OrgunitBase = new EntityRef<OrgunitBaseEntityDto>() { Id = orgunitId };
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command) as CreateEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommandResult;

        if (response?.EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel>(response.EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    [HttpPut("energy-consumption-device/{id}", Name = "EditEnergyConsumptionDevice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EnergyConsumptionDevices_EditEnergyConsumptionDevice")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel>> EditEnergyConsumptionDevice([FromBody] EditEnergyConsumptionDeviceRequest request,[FromRoute] int id)
    {
        var command = _mapper.Map<ModifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand>(request);
        command.EnergyConsumptionDeviceId = id;
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command) as ModifyEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommandResult;

        if (response?.EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel>(response.EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    [HttpDelete("energy-consumption-device/{id}", Name = "DeleteEnergyConsumptionDevice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EnergyConsumptionDevices_DeleteEnergyConsumptionDevice")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteEnergyConsumptionDevice([FromRoute] int id)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommand() { EnergyConsumptionDeviceId = id })
            as DeleteEnergyConsumptionDeviceCommandResult;

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok();
    }

    // GET: api/energyconsumptiondevices/id/energy-performance/dates
    /// <summary>
    /// Get building's energy consumption devices' inspection dates
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{id}/energy-performance/dates", Name = "GetEnergyConsumptionDevicesInspectionDates")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EnergyConsumptionDevices_GetEnergyConsumptionDevicesInspectionDates")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IList<DateOnly>>> GetEnergyConsumptionDevicesInspectionDates(int id)
    {
        if ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new EnergyConsumptionDeviceDatesQuery
        {
            OrgunitBaseId = id,
        })) is not EnergyConsumptionDeviceDatesQueryResult result)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "EnergyConsumptionDevice" });

        return Ok(result.InspectionDates.Select(x => x.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue)));
    }

    // GET: api/energyconsumptiondevices/{id}/energy-performance/
    /// <summary>
    /// Get building's energy consumption devices
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{id}/energy-performance", Name = "GetEnergyConsumptionDevices")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EnergyConsumptionDevices_GetEnergyConsumptionDevices")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto[]>> GetEnergyConsumptionDevices([FromQuery] DateTime inspectionDate, int id)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityQuery
        {
            InspectionDate = DateOnly.FromDateTime(inspectionDate),
            OrgunitBaseId = id,
        }))?.Items is EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto[] result))
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "EnergyConsumptionDevice" });

        return Ok(result.Select(_mapper.Map<EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel>));
    }

    // GET: api/energyconsumptiondevices/
    /// <summary>
    /// Fogyasztó lekérdezése id alapján
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{id}", Name = "GetEnergyConsumptionDevice")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "EnergyConsumptionDevices_GetEnergyConsumptionDevice")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel>> GetEnergyConsumptionDevice([FromRoute] int id)
    {
        var result = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<EnergyConsumptionDeviceEntityDto>(id);

        if (result == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Energy Consumption Device" });

        return Ok(_mapper.Map<EnergyConsumptionDeviceModel>(result));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Common;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Favourites;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;
using System.Net;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Favourites;

/// <summary>
/// FavouritesController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class FavouritesController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="FavouritesController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public FavouritesController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // POST: api/favourites
    /// <summary>
    /// Típus gyors lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "GetFavourites")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Favourites_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<FavouriteEntityListItemDto>>> GetAll(FavouritesRequest request)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new FavouriteEntityQuery 
        {
            Type = request.Type
        }))?.Items is FavouriteEntityListItemDto[] favouriteEntityListItemDtos)
            || favouriteEntityListItemDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Favourites" });

        var result = favouriteEntityListItemDtos;
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/favourites/post
    /// <summary>
    /// Gyors lekérdezés entitás létrehozás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("Post", Name = "PostFavourite")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Favourite_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<FavouriteModel>> Post(CreateFavouriteRequest request)
    {
        var dto = _mapper.Map<FavouriteEntityDto>(request);
        var response = await _commandService.CreateEntityAsync(dto);

        if (response == null)
            return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<FavouriteModel>(response);
        return StatusCode((int)HttpStatusCode.OK, result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/favourites/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Törli az adott ID-hez a gyors lekérdezés entitást
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Gyors lekérdezés entitás azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{id}", Name = "DeleteFavourite")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Favourites_DeleteFavourite")]
    public async Task<ActionResult> DeleteFavourite(int id)
    {
        await _commandService.DeleteEntityAsync<FavouriteEntityDto>(id);
        return Ok();
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// CommonDetailsController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/common-details")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class CommonDetailsController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CommonDetailsController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public CommonDetailsController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/commondetails/card-details
    /// <summary>
    /// Alapadatok kártya adatainak lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("card-details", Name = "GetCardDetails")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "CommonDetails_GetCardDetails")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IList<CommonCardDetailsModel>>> GetCardDetails()
    {
        var siteStatus = new CommonCardDetailsModel
        {
            Type = typeof(SiteEntityDto).EntityTypeName(),
            DisplayName = "Telephelyek",
            Count = await _queryService.GetCountAsync<SiteEntityDto>(new SiteEntityQuery { IsDeleted = false }),
            Status = DeviceStatus.Online
        };
        var siteLocationStatus = new CommonCardDetailsModel
        {
            Type = typeof(SiteLocationEntityDto).EntityTypeName(),
            DisplayName = "Mérési helyek",
            Count = await _queryService.GetCountAsync<SiteLocationEntityDto>(new SiteLocationQuery()),
            Status = DeviceStatus.Online
        };
        var deviceDeviceStatus =
            (await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new GetDevicesStatusQuery()) as GetDevicesStatusQueryResult)!.DeviceStatus;
        var deviceStatus = new CommonCardDetailsModel
        {
            Type = typeof(DeviceEntityDto).EntityTypeName(),
            DisplayName = "Eszközök",
            Count = await _queryService.GetCountAsync<DeviceEntityDto>(),
            Status = deviceDeviceStatus
        };
        var invoiceStatus = new CommonCardDetailsModel
        {
            Type = typeof(InvoiceEntityDto).EntityTypeName(),
            DisplayName = "Szerződések",
            Count = await _queryService.GetCountAsync<EnergyContractEntityDto>(),
            Status = DeviceStatus.Online
        };

        var cardDetails = new List<CommonCardDetailsModel> { siteStatus, siteLocationStatus, deviceStatus, invoiceStatus };

        return Ok(cardDetails);
    }

    // GET: api/commondetails/device-categories
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz kategória adatok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("device-categories", Name = "GetDeviceCategories")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "CommonDetails_GetDeviceCategories")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IList<CommonCardDetailsModel>>> GetDeviceCategories()
    {
        var result = ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new DeviceCategoriesQuery())) as DeviceCategoriesQueryResult)?.DeviceCategoryDtos;
        var models = result?.Select(_mapper.Map<CommonCardDetailsModel>).ToArray();

        return Ok(models);
    }

    // GET: api/commondetails/apiurls
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz kategória adatok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("apiurls", Name = "GetApiUrls")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "CommonDetails_GetApiUrls")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetApiUrls()
    {
        var data = new
        {
            production = Config.TryGetBoolValue("Production", true) ?? false,
            baseUrls = new
            {
                dataReceiver = Config.TryGetStringValue("DataReceiverApiHost", true) ?? "https://localhost:7156",
                framework = Config.TryGetStringValue("FrameworkApiHost", true) ?? "https://localhost:7017",
                monitoring = Config.TryGetStringValue("MonitoringApiHost", true) ?? "https://localhost:7288",
                modelling = Config.TryGetStringValue("PredictiveApiHost", true) ?? "https://localhost:7179",
            }
        };
        var serializedData = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(data);
        return new ContentResult { Content = serializedData, ContentType = "application/json", StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.OK };
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Configuration;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Helpers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Managers;

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.IoT;

/// <summary>
/// IoTDataController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class IoTDataController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The HTTP client
    /// </summary>
    private readonly EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient _httpClient;
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDataController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="httpClient">The HTTP client.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public IoTDataController(EnergiaMenedzsmentHttpClient httpClient, SecurityContext securityContext)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    // GET: api/IoTData
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT adatok lekérdezése DataReceiver-be proxyval
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetIoTData")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "IoTData_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IoTDataPagedEntityQueryResult?>> Get([FromQuery] IoTDataDataTableRequest request)
    {
        var baseUrl = Config.GetStringValue("DataReceiverApiHost");
        var result = await _httpClient.Get(request.ToUrl(baseUrl, "api/iotdata"), true,
            _securityContext.GetAccessToken());

        return Ok(JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<IoTDataPagedEntityQueryResult?>(result));
    }
}

public class BuildingPartsController : ControllerBase

    /// Query service

    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>

    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public BuildingPartsController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    #region CRUD + list

    // GET: api/buildingparts/getall
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes épületrész lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("all", Name = "GetAllBuildingParts")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<BuildingPartModel>>> GetAll()
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new BuildingPartEntityQuery { IsDeleted = false }))?.Items is BuildingPartEntityDto[] entityDtos)
            || entityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingPart" });

        var result = entityDtos.Select(t => _mapper.Map<BuildingPartModel>(t));
        return Ok(result);
    }


    // GET: api/buildingparts/{id}/buildingpart
    /// <summary>
    /// Épületrész lekérdezése azonosító alapján

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_GetById")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<BuildingPartModel>> GetById(int id)
    {
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new BuildingPartEntityQuery
        {
            Id = id,
            IsDeleted = false
        }))?.Entity is not BuildingPartEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingPart" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<BuildingPartModel>(queryResponse);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/buildingparts/
    /// <summary>
    /// Új épületrész létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "CreateBuildingPart")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<BuildingPartModel>> Post(CreateBuildingPartRequest request)
    {
        CreateBuildingPartCommand createCommand = _mapper.Map<CreateBuildingPartCommand>(request);
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(createCommand) as CreateBuildingPartCommandResult;

        if (response?.BuildingPartEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<BuildingPartModel>(response.BuildingPartEntityDto);
        return CreatedAtAction(
            nameof(GetById),
            new { id = result.Id },
            result);
    }

    // PUT: api/buildingparts/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Épületrész szerkesztés

    /// <param name="id">Épületrész azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id}", Name = "PutBuildingPart")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<BuildingPartModel>> Put(int id, ModifyBuildingPartRequest request)
    {
        ModifyBuildingPartCommand modifyCommand = _mapper.Map<ModifyBuildingPartCommand>(request);
        modifyCommand.BuildingPartId = id;
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(modifyCommand) as ModifyBuildingPartCommandResult;

        if (response?.BuildingPartEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<BuildingPartModel>(response.BuildingPartEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_Delete")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DeleteBuildingPartCommandResult>> Delete(int id)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteBuildingPartCommand
        {
            BuildingPartId = id
        }) as DeleteBuildingPartCommandResult;

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
