    /// Épületrészek lista elemek lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("guid-entity-ref")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_GetBuildingPartGuidEntityRef")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<GuidEntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>[]?>> GetBuildingPartGuidEntityRef([FromQuery] Guid? parentIdentifier)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new BuildingPartEntityQuery
        {
            IsDeleted = false,
            ParentIdentifier = parentIdentifier,
        }))?.Items is BuildingPartEntityDto[] buildingPartsEntityDtos)
            || buildingPartsEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingPart" });


        var result = buildingPartsEntityDtos.Select(x => _mapper.Map<GuidEntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>>(x));

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/buildingparts/{id}/getParentsEntityRefModelById
    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely entity-ref lista elemek lekérdezése.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/getparents", Name = "GetBuildingPartParentsEntityRefModelById")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_GetParentsEntityRefModelById")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<BuildingPartParentsEntityRefModel>> GetParentsEntityRefModelById(int id)
    {

        var bpQuery = new BuildingPartEntityQuery { Id = id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(bpQuery))?.Entity is not BuildingPartEntityDto buildingPartEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingPart" });

        var bQuery = new BuildingEntityQuery { Id = buildingPartEntity.Building.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(bQuery))?.Entity is not BuildingEntityDto buildingEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Building" });

        var sQuery = new SiteEntityQuery { Id = buildingEntity.Site.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(sQuery))?.Entity is not SiteEntityDto siteEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Site" });

        BuildingPartParentsEntityRefModel result = new BuildingPartParentsEntityRefModel
        {
            BuildingPart = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<BuildingPartEntityDto>>(buildingPartEntity),
            Building = buildingPartEntity.Building,
            Site = buildingEntity.Site,
            Institution = siteEntity.Institution,
        };

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/buildingparts/{id}/pods

    {
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new BuildingPartEntityQuery
        {
            Id = id,
            IsDeleted = false
        }))?.Entity is not BuildingPartEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingPart" });

        var result = queryResponse.PodIdentifiers?.Split(',') ?? [];
        return Ok(result);
    }

        ModifyBuildingPartPodsCommand modifyCommand = new ModifyBuildingPartPodsCommand()

        if (response is null || response.PodIdentifiers == null) //TODO: 0 db lehet, de null nem biztos
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response.PodIdentifiers);
    }

    // GET: api/buildingparts/{buildingPartId}/validity/{validityId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Get a specific buildingpart validity record
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="buildingPartId">BuildingPart record azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="validityId">Validity record azonosító</param>
    /// <returns>The buildingpart validity record</returns>
    [HttpGet("{buildingPartId}/validity/{validityId}", Name = "GetBuildingPartValidity")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(BuildingPartValidityModel), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<BuildingPartValidityModel>> GetBuildingPartValidity(int buildingPartId, int validityId)
    {
        var validityEntityDto = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<BuildingPartValidityEntityDto>(validityId);

        if (validityEntityDto == null || validityEntityDto.BuildingPart?.Id != buildingPartId)
            return NotFound();

        var result = _mapper.Map<BuildingPartValidityModel>(validityEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/buildingparts/{id}/validity
    /// <summary>
    /// Create a new buildingpart validity
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("{buildingPartId}/validity", Name = "PostBuildingPartValidity")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_PostBuildingPartValidity")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<BuildingPartValidityModel>> PostBuildingPartValidity(int buildingPartId, CreateOrUpdateBuildingPartValidityRequest request)
    {
        var createCommand = _mapper.Map<CreateBuildingPartValidityCommand>(request);
        createCommand.BuildingPartId = buildingPartId;
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(createCommand) as CreateBuildingPartValidityCommandResult;

        if (response == null || response.BuildingPartValidityEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<BuildingPartValidityModel>(response?.BuildingPartValidityEntityDto);

        return CreatedAtAction(
            nameof(GetBuildingPartValidity),
            new { validityId = result.Id, buildingPartId = result.BuildingPart.Id },
            result);
    }



    // PUT: api/buildingparts/{buildingPartId}/validity/{validityId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Update an existing buildingpart validity
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="buildingPartId">Épületrész azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="validityId">Érvényesség azonosító</param>
    [HttpPut("{buildingPartId}/validity/{validityId}", Name = "PutBuildingPartValidity")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_PutBuildingPartValidity")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<BuildingPartValidityModel>> PutBuildingPartValidity(int buildingPartId,int validityId, CreateOrUpdateBuildingPartValidityRequest request)
    {
        var modifyCommand = _mapper.Map<ModifyBuildingPartValidityCommand>(request);
        modifyCommand.ValidityId = validityId;
        modifyCommand.BuildingPartId = buildingPartId;

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(modifyCommand) as ModifyBuildingPartValidityCommandResult;

        if (response == null || response.BuildingPartValidityEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<BuildingPartValidityModel>(response?.BuildingPartValidityEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// </summary>

    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "BuildingParts_DeleteBuildingPartValidity")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DeleteBuildingPartValidityCommandResult>> DeleteBuildingPartValidity(int buildingPartId, int validityId)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteBuildingPartValidityCommand
        {
            ValidityId = validityId,
            BuildingPartId = buildingPartId,
        }) as DeleteBuildingPartValidityCommandResult;

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
    }

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]

    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>?>> GetMeasurementPoints(int id, [FromQuery] MeasurementPointsDataTableRequest request)
    {
        // Check if building part exists
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new BuildingPartEntityQuery
        {
            Id = id,
            IsDeleted = false
        }))?.Entity is not BuildingPartEntityDto buildingPart)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingPart" });
            
        var query = _mapper.Map<BuildingPartMeasurementPointsQuery>(request); // Mapping profile will handle paging parameters
        query.BuildingPartId = id;

        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        return Ok(result);
    }

/// <summary>
/// BuildingsController 
/// </summary>
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class BuildingsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    public BuildingsController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope)
    {
        _securityContext = lifetimeScope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/buildings/{id}/getparents
    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely entity-ref lista elemek lekérdezése.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/getparents", Name = "GetBuildingParentsEntityRefModelById")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Building_GetBuildingParentsEntityRefModelById")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<BuildingParentsEntityRefModel>> GetParentsEntityRefModelById(int id)
    {
        var bQuery = new BuildingEntityQuery { Id = id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(bQuery))?.Entity is not BuildingEntityDto buildingEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Building" });

        var sQuery = new SiteEntityQuery { Id = buildingEntity.Site.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(sQuery))?.Entity is not SiteEntityDto siteEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Site" });

        BuildingParentsEntityRefModel result = new BuildingParentsEntityRefModel
        {
            Building = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>>(buildingEntity),
            Site = buildingEntity.Site,
            Institution = siteEntity.Institution,
        };

        return Ok(result);
    }


    // GET: api/buildings
    /// <summary>

    /// <param name="buildingDataTableRequest">The building data table request.</param>

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]

    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<BuildingListItemDto>?>> GetBuildings([FromQuery] BuildingDataTableRequest buildingDataTableRequest)

        var query = _mapper.Map<BuildingPagedEntityQuery>(buildingDataTableRequest); //lapozási paramétereket a mapping profile lekezeli
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>

    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]

    {
        if ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new BuildingPodsQuery()
        {
            BuildingId = id,
        })) is not PodsQueryResult result)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingPods" });

        return Ok(result.PodList);

    // GET: api/buildings/{id}/measurement-points
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes mérési hely lekérdezése egy adott épülethez
    /// </summary>

    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Buildings_GetMeasurementPoints")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>?>> GetMeasurementPoints(int id, [FromQuery] MeasurementPointsDataTableRequest dataTableRequest)
    {
        // Check if building exists
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new BuildingEntityQuery
        {
            Id = id,
            IsDeleted = false
        }))?.Entity is not BuildingEntityDto building)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Building" });

        var query = _mapper.Map<BuildingMeasurementPointsQuery>(dataTableRequest);
        query.BuildingId = id;

        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/building/getBuildingEntityRef

    /// </summary>

    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Buildings_GetBuildingEntityRef")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>[]?>> GetBuildingEntityRef([FromQuery] int? parentId)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new BuildingEntityRefQuery
        {
            IsDeleted = false,
            ParentId = parentId,
        }))?.Items is EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto>[] entityRefs)
             || entityRefs == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Building" });

        return Ok(entityRefs);
    }

        {
            IsDeleted = false,
            ParentId = parentId,
            TenantCode = tenantCode

        var items = result?.Items;
        return Ok(items);

    private readonly Dictionary<int, IEnumerable<EntityRef<RoomProfileEntityDto>>> _roomProfilesMemo = new Dictionary<int, IEnumerable<EntityRef<RoomProfileEntityDto>>>();
    private async Task<IEnumerable<EntityRef<RoomProfileEntityDto>>?> GetGetRoomProfilesTypes(int buildingProfileId)
    {
        if (_roomProfilesMemo.TryGetValue(buildingProfileId, out var profiles))
            return profiles;

        if ((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new RoomProfilesByBuildingProfileQuery
        {
            BuildingProfileId = buildingProfileId
        })) is not RoomProfilesByBuildingProfileQueryResult result)
            return null;
        _roomProfilesMemo[buildingProfileId] = result.RoomProfiles;
        return result.RoomProfiles;
    }

    [HttpGet("room-validity-warnings/{buildingValidityId}", Name = "GetRoomValidtyWarnings")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "GetRoomValidtyWarnings")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<EntityWarningModelBase<RoomValidityEntityDto, RoomValidityWarningContext>>>?> GetRoomValidtyWarnings(int buildingValidityId)
    {
        if(await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new MapRoomValiditiesForBuildingValidityQuery
        { 
            ValidityId = buildingValidityId
        }) is not MapSubValidityQueryResult<BuildingValidityEntityDto,RoomValidityEntityDto> result)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingValidty" });

        var buildingValidity = result.ParentValidity;
        var validRoomProfilesTypes = await GetGetRoomProfilesTypes(buildingValidity.BuildingProfile!.Id);

        var warnedRoomProfiles = new List<EntityWarningModelBase<RoomValidityEntityDto, RoomValidityWarningContext>>();


        foreach (var roomValidity in result.ChildValidites)
        {
            var profileMismatch = !validRoomProfilesTypes.Any(t => t.Id == roomValidity.RoomProfile!.Id);
            var intervalMismatch = buildingValidity.ValidTo < roomValidity.ValidTo;

            if (!profileMismatch && !intervalMismatch)
                continue;

            warnedRoomProfiles.Add(new EntityWarningModelBase<RoomValidityEntityDto, RoomValidityWarningContext> 
            {
                WarnedEntity = new EntityRef<RoomValidityEntityDto> { Id = roomValidity.Id,EntityDisplayName = roomValidity.Name},
                WarningContext = new RoomValidityWarningContext 
                { 
                    BuildingAndRoomProfileMismatch = profileMismatch,
                    BuildingAndRoomValidityIntervalMismatch = intervalMismatch,
                }
            });
        }

        return Ok(warnedRoomProfiles);
    }

using Common.Logic.Extensions;

/// <summary>
/// CountriesController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class CountriesController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CountriesController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>

        IQueryService queryService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    // GET: api/countries/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes ország lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="text">The text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("entity-ref", Name = "GetCountries")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Countries_GetCountries")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>[]>> GetCountries(string? text)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SelectEntityRefQuery<CountryEntityDto>
        {
            Search = text
        }))?.Items is EntityRef<CountryEntityDto>[] countryEntityDtos)
            || countryEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Countries" });

        return Ok(countryEntityDtos);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// FloorsController
/// </summary>
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class FloorsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    public FloorsController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    // GET: api/floors/{id}/getparents
    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely entity-ref lista elemek lekérdezése.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/getparents", Name = "GetFloorParentsEntityRefModelById")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Floor_GetFloorParentsEntityRefModelById")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<FloorParentsEntityRefModel>> GetParentsEntityRefModelById(int id)
    {
        var fQuery = new FloorEntityQuery { Id = id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(fQuery))?.Entity is not FloorEntityDto floorEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Floor" });

        var bpQuery = new BuildingPartEntityQuery { Id = floorEntity.BuildingPart.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(bpQuery))?.Entity is not BuildingPartEntityDto buildingPartEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingPart" });

        var bQuery = new BuildingEntityQuery { Id = buildingPartEntity.Building.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(bQuery))?.Entity is not BuildingEntityDto buildingEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Building" });

        var sQuery = new SiteEntityQuery { Id = buildingEntity.Site.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(sQuery))?.Entity is not SiteEntityDto siteEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Site" });

        FloorParentsEntityRefModel result = new FloorParentsEntityRefModel
        {
            Floor = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<FloorEntityDto>>(floorEntity),
            BuildingPart = floorEntity.BuildingPart,
            Building = buildingPartEntity.Building,
            Site = buildingEntity.Site,
            Institution = siteEntity.Institution,
        };

        return Ok(result);
    }


    // GET: api/floors
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes szint lekérdezése - lapozható
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="floorDataTableRequest">The floor data table request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetFloors")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]

    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<FloorListItemDto>?>> GetFloors([FromQuery] FloorDataTableRequest floorDataTableRequest)
    {
        var query = _mapper.Map<FloorPagedEntityQuery>(floorDataTableRequest); //lapozási paramétereket a mapping profile lekezeli

        return Ok(result);

    {
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new FloorEntityQuery
        {
            Id = id,
            IsDeleted = false
        }))?.Entity is not FloorEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Floor" });

        var result = queryResponse.PodIdentifiers?.Split(',') ?? [];
        return Ok(result);
    }

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]

    {
        ModifyFloorPodsCommand modifyCommand = new ModifyFloorPodsCommand() 
        {
            PodIdentifiers = modifyPodIdentifiersRequest.PodIdentifiers,
            Id = id,
        };

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(modifyCommand) as ModifyPodsCommandResult;
        if (response is null || response.PodIdentifiers is null) // TODO: 0 db lehet, de null nem biztos
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response.PodIdentifiers);
    }

    /// </summary>

    /// <param name="validityId">Érvényesség azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="request">Updated floor validity data</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{floorId}/validity/{validityId}", Name = "PutFloorValidity")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Floors_PutFloorValidity")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<FloorValidityModel>> PutFloorValidity(int floorId, int validityId, CreateOrUpdateFloorValidityRequest request)
    {
        var modifyCommand = _mapper.Map<ModifyFloorValidityCommand>(request);
        modifyCommand.ValidityId = validityId;
        modifyCommand.FloorId = floorId;

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(modifyCommand) as ModifyFloorValidityCommandResult;

        if (response == null || response.FloorValidityEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<FloorValidityModel>(response?.FloorValidityEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// Szint érvényesség törlés

    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Floors_DeleteFloorValidity")]

    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteFloorValidityCommand
        {
            ValidityId = validityId,
            FloorId = floorId
        }) as DeleteFloorValidityCommandResult;

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
    }

    // GET: api/floors/{id}/measurement-points
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési helyek lekérdezése szint azonosító alapján
    /// </summary>

    /// <param name="request">Szűrési feltételek</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/measurement-points", Name = "GetFloorMeasurementPoints")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Floor_GetMeasurementPoints")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<MeasurementPointListItemDto>?>> GetMeasurementPoints(int id, [FromQuery] MeasurementPointsDataTableRequest request)
    {
        // Check if floor exists
        var floorQuery = new FloorEntityQuery { Id = id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(floorQuery))?.Entity is not FloorEntityDto)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Floor" });

        var query = _mapper.Map<FloorMeasurementPointsQuery>(request);
        query.FloorId = id;

        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(query);
        return Ok(result);
    }

[ApiController]

[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class InstitutionsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tenantIndependentDictCache;
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _lifetimeScope;
    private readonly IEdmInterfaceService _edmInterfaceService;


    public InstitutionsController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tenantIndependentDictCache,
        ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope,
        IEdmInterfaceService edmInterfaceService)
    {
        _securityContext = lifetimeScope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _tenantIndependentDictCache = tenantIndependentDictCache;
        _lifetimeScope = lifetimeScope;
        _edmInterfaceService = edmInterfaceService;
    }





    // GET: api/institutions
    /// <summary>

    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("all", Name = "GetAllInstitutions")]

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Institutions_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<InstitutionModel>>> GetAll()
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new InstitutionEntityQuery { IsDeleted = false }))?.Items is InstitutionEntityDto[] institutionEntityDtos)
            || institutionEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Institution" });

        var result = institutionEntityDtos.Select(x => _mapper.Map<InstitutionModel>(x)); //BUG: Missing type map configuration or unsupported mapping.
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény lista elemek lekérdezése (központi felületről)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("getinstitutionadministrationentityref")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Institutions_GetInstitutionAdministrationEntityRef")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>[]?>> GetInstitutionAdministrationEntityRef(string tenantCode)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        bool isCurrentUserGlobalUser = string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser?.TenantCode);

        if (currentUser is null || !isCurrentUserGlobalUser)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Institution" });

        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new TenantInstitutionEntityRefQuery
        {
            IsDeleted = false,
            TenantCode = tenantCode,
        });


        var items = result?.Items;
        return Ok(items);
    }

    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]

    // GET: api/institutions/{identifier}
    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény lekérdezése globális azonosító alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="identifier">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{identifier}", Name = "GetInstitution")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Institutions_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<InstitutionModel>> Get(string identifier, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        var result = new InstitutionModel();

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(identifier))
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Intézmény globális azonosító megadása Kötelező!"
            });

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
                var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

                if ((await tenantQueryService.QuerySingleEntity(new InstitutionEntityQuery
                {
                    Identifier = identifier,
                    IsDeleted = false
                }))?.Entity is not InstitutionEntityDto queryRes)
                    return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Institution" });
                result = _mapper.Map<InstitutionModel>(queryRes);
            }
        else
        {

            if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new InstitutionEntityQuery
            {
                Identifier = identifier,
                IsDeleted = false
            }))?.Entity is not InstitutionEntityDto queryResponse)
                return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Institution" });

            result = _mapper.Map<InstitutionModel>(queryResponse);
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// Az intézmény fenntartóhoz kapcsolódó entitások darabszámai
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("partnercards", Name = "GetCurrentPartnerCards")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Institutions_GetCurrentPartnerCards")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<PartnerCurrentCardModel>> GetCurrentPartnerCards()
    {
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            return BadRequest("Globális Adminisztrátorral a 'Saját partner módosítása' parancs nem hajtható végre!");

        var partnerEntityDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery { TenantCode = tenantCode }).Result?.Entity as PartnerEntityDto;
        if (partnerEntityDto == null || partnerEntityDto.IsDeleted)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Partner" });

        if (!((await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(new InstitutionPartnerCardsQuery() { })) is InstitutionPartnerCardsQueryResult partnerCurrentCardsResult)
            || partnerCurrentCardsResult == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "PartnerLocationCards" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<PartnerCurrentCardModel>(partnerCurrentCardsResult.Cards);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/institutions/{institutionId}/validity
    /// <summary>
    /// Create a new institution validity record
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="institutionId">Institution azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="institutionValidity">Institution validity data</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("{institutionId}/validity", Name = "CreateInstitutionValidity")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Institutions_CreateValidity")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<InstitutionValidityModel>> CreateInstitutionValidity(int institutionId, CreateOrUpdateInstitutionValidityRequest request)
    {
        var command = _mapper.Map<CreateInstitutionValidityCommand>(request);
        command.InstitutionId = institutionId;

        //BUG: address (FullAddress) nem jól megy át. ContactPerson ID sem.

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command) as CreateInstitutionValidityCommandResult;

        if (response == null || response.InstitutionValidityEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<InstitutionValidityModel>(response?.InstitutionValidityEntityDto);
        return CreatedAtAction(
            nameof(GetInstitutionValidity),
            new { institutionId, validityId = result.Id },
            result);
    }

    // GET: api/institutions/{institutionId}/validity/{validityId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Get a specific institution validity record
    /// </summary>

    /// <param name="validityId">Validity record azonosító</param>
    /// <returns>The institution validity record</returns>
    [HttpGet("{institutionId}/validity/{validityId}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(InstitutionValidityModel), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<InstitutionValidityModel>> GetInstitutionValidity(int institutionId, int validityId)
    {
        var validityEntityDto = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<InstitutionValidityEntityDto>(validityId);

        if (validityEntityDto == null || validityEntityDto.Institution?.Id != institutionId)
            return NotFound();

        var result = _mapper.Map<InstitutionValidityModel>(validityEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/institutions/{id}/contact
    /// <summary>
    /// Új intézmény módosítás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id}/contact", Name = "PutInstitutionContact")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Institutions_PutContact")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<InstitutionModel>> Put(int id, InstitutionContactModel request)
    {
        var dto = _queryService.GetById<InstitutionEntityDto>(id);

        if (dto == null)
            return BadRequest();

        if (dto.Id != request.Id)
            return BadRequest();

        dto = _mapper.Map(request, dto);
        var resultDto = await _commandService.UpdateEntityAsync(dto);

        if (resultDto == null)
            return BadRequest(request);

        var result = _mapper.Map<InstitutionBasicModel>(resultDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// <returns>Request ID for retrieving the data</returns>
    [HttpPost("edm/meteorology-data/request", Name = "RequestEDMMeterologyData")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "RequestEDMMeterologyData")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<Guid>> RequestEDMMeterologyData([FromBody] EDMMeteorologyDataRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var requestId = await _edmInterfaceService.RequestMeteorologyData(request.InstitutionId,
                                                                       request.Lat,
                                                                       request.Lng,
                                                                       request.Start.ToDateOnly(),
                                                                       request.End.ToDateOnly(),
                                                                       request.ForceRefresh);
            return Ok(requestId);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]

    public async Task<ActionResult<MeteoResponseModel>> GetEDMMeterologyDataById(Guid requestId)

            return Ok(response);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)

        }

    // GET: api/institutions/edm/meteorology-data
    /// <summary>
    /// Legacy endpoint that combines request and retrieval of meteorological data
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request parameters</param>
    /// <returns>Meteorological data</returns>
    [Obsolete("Use RequestEDMMeterologyData and GetEDMMeterologyDataById instead")]
    [HttpGet("edm/meteorology-data", Name = "GetEDMMeterologyData")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "GetEDMMeterologyData")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<MeteoResponseModel>> GetEDMMeterologyData([FromQuery] EDMMeteorologyDataRequest request)
    {
        if (request.Start > request.End)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = "A kezdő dátum nem lehet későbbi, mint a záró dátum!" });
        }

        if ((request.Start - request.End).TotalDays > 365)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = "A kezdő dátum és a záró dátum közti különbség nem lehet több mint egy év!" });
        }

        try
        {
            //OBSOLETE
            //var response = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeteorologyData(request.InstitutionId,
            //                                                           request.Lat,
            //                                                           request.Lng,
            //                                                           request.Start.ToDateOnly(),
            //                                                           request.End.ToDateOnly(),
            //                                                           request.ForceRefresh);

            var requestId = await _edmInterfaceService.RequestMeteorologyData(
                request.InstitutionId,
                request.Lat,
                request.Lng,
                request.Start.ToDateOnly(),
                request.End.ToDateOnly(),
                request.ForceRefresh,
                HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            var response = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeteorologyDataById(requestId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

            return Ok(response);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = ex.Message });
        }
    }
    #endregion

    // GET: api/institutions/sync-orgunits
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes intézmény lekérdezése szinkronizáció céljából
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet(FrameworkApi.Institution.GetInstitutionsSync, Name = "GetInstitutionsSync")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Institutions_GetInstitutionsSync")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<PartnerSyncModel>> GetInstitutionsSync()
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new InstitutionEntityQuery()))?.Items is InstitutionEntityDto[] institutionEntityDtos)
            || institutionEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Institution" });

        if (!((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery()))?.Entity is PartnerEntityDto partnerEntityDto)
            || partnerEntityDto == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Partner" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<PartnerSyncModel>(partnerEntityDto);
        result.Institutions = institutionEntityDtos.Select(_mapper.Map<InstitutionSyncModel>).ToList();

        return Ok(result);
    }
}

public class RoomProfilesController : ControllerBase
{

    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;

    // POST: api/roomProfiles
    [HttpPost(Name = "CreateRoomProfile")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "RoomProfiles_CreateRoomProfile")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<RoomProfileModel>> CreateRoomProfile([FromBody] CreateRoomProfileRequest request)
    {
        CreateRoomProfileCommand createCommand = _mapper.Map<CreateRoomProfileCommand>(request);
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(createCommand) as CreateRoomProfileCommandResult;

        if (response?.RoomProfileEntityDto == null)

    // PUT: api/roomProfiles/{id}
    [HttpPut("{id}", Name = "UpdateRoomProfile")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "RoomProfiles_UpdateRoomProfile")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<RoomProfileModel>> UpdateRoomProfile(int id, [FromBody] ModifyRoomProfileRequest request)
    {
        ModifyRoomProfileCommand modifyCommand = _mapper.Map<ModifyRoomProfileCommand>(request);
        modifyCommand.RoomProfileId = id;

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(modifyCommand) as ModifyRoomProfileCommandResult;

        if (response?.RoomProfileEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<RoomProfileModel>(response.RoomProfileEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/roomProfiles/{id}
    [HttpDelete("{id}", Name = "DeleteRoomProfile")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "RoomProfiles_DeleteRoomProfile")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteRoomProfile(int id)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteRoomProfileCommand
        {
            RoomProfileId = id
        }) as DeleteRoomProfileCommandResult;

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
    }


}

    // GET: api/rooms/{id}/getparents
    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely entity-ref lista elemek lekérdezése.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/getparents", Name = "GetRoomParentsEntityRefModelById")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Room_GetRoomParentsEntityRefModelById")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<RoomParentsEntityRefModel>> GetParentsEntityRefModelById(int id)
    {
        var rQuery = new RoomEntityQuery { Id = id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(rQuery))?.Entity is not RoomEntityDto roomEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Room" });

        var fQuery = new FloorEntityQuery { Id = roomEntity.Floor.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(fQuery))?.Entity is not FloorEntityDto floorEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Floor" });

        var bpQuery = new BuildingPartEntityQuery { Id = floorEntity.BuildingPart.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(bpQuery))?.Entity is not BuildingPartEntityDto buildingPartEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "BuildingPart" });

        var bQuery = new BuildingEntityQuery { Id = buildingPartEntity.Building.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(bQuery))?.Entity is not BuildingEntityDto buildingEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Building" });

        var sQuery = new SiteEntityQuery { Id = buildingEntity.Site.Id, IsDeleted = false };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(sQuery))?.Entity is not SiteEntityDto siteEntity)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Site" });

        RoomParentsEntityRefModel result = new RoomParentsEntityRefModel
        {
            Room = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<RoomEntityDto>>(roomEntity),
            Floor = roomEntity.Floor,
            BuildingPart = floorEntity.BuildingPart,
            Building = buildingPartEntity.Building,
            Site = buildingEntity.Site,
            Institution = siteEntity.Institution,
        };

        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Helyiségek lista elemek lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("guid-entity-ref")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Rooms_GetRoomGuidEntityRef")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<GuidEntityRef<RoomEntityDto>[]?>> GetRoomGuidEntityRef([FromQuery] Guid? parentIdentifier)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new RoomEntityQuery
        {
            IsDeleted = false,
            ParentIdentifier = parentIdentifier,
        }))?.Items is RoomEntityDto[] roomsEntityDtos)
            || roomsEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Room" });

        var result = roomsEntityDtos.Select(x => _mapper.Map<GuidEntityRef<RoomEntityDto>>(x));

        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public SettlementsController(SettlementZipCodeCache settlementZipCodeCache,
                                 SettlementCache settlementCache,
                                 IQueryService queryService)

        _settlementZipCodeCache = settlementZipCodeCache;
        _settlementCache = settlementCache;
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    // GET: api/settlements/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes település lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="text">The text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("entity-ref", Name = "GetSettlements")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Settlements_GetSettlements")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>[]>> GetSettlements(string? text)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SelectEntityRefQuery<SettlementEntityDto>
        {
            Search = text
        }))?.Items is EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>[] settlementEntityDtos)
            || settlementEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Settlements" });

        return Ok(settlementEntityDtos);
    }

    // GET: api/settlements/settlemententityrefbyzipcode
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes település lekérdezése
    /// </summary>

    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("settlemententityrefbyzipcode", Name = "GetSettlementSelectListByZipCode")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Settlements_GetSettlementSelectListByZipCode")]
    public IEnumerable<EntityRef<SettlementEntityDto>> GetSettlementSelectListByZipCode(string search, string zipCode)
    {

        return _settlementZipCodeCache.GetSettlementItemsByZipCode(search, zipCode).SelectListItemLimit();
    }

    // GET: api/settlements/zipcodeentityrefbysettlement

    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Settlements_GetZipCodeSelectListBySettlement")]

        return _settlementZipCodeCache.GetZipCodeItemsBySettlement(search, settlement).SelectListItemLimit();

    // GET: api/settlements/county-and-countydistrict

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Settlements_GetCountyAndCountyDistrictBySettlement")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<CountyAndCountyDistrictModel>> GetCountyAndCountyDistrictBySettlement([FromQuery] string settlement)
    {
        try
        {
            var settlementDto = _settlementCache.GetByName(settlement);
            var result = new CountyAndCountyDistrictModel()

                County = settlementDto.County,

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Locations.SiteLocation;

/// <summary>
/// SiteLocationsController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/site-locations")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class SiteLocationsController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SiteLocationsController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public SiteLocationsController(IQueryService queryService, ICommandService commandService, IMapper mapper, ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _scope = scope;
    }

    // GET: api/site-locations
    /// <summary>
    /// Fizikai mérési helyek lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="siteLocationDataTableRequest">The site location data table request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetSiteLocationsDataTable")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "SiteLocations_Get")]
    public async Task<EntityListItemQueryResult<SiteLocationListItemDto>?> Get([FromQuery] SiteLocationDataTableRequest siteLocationDataTableRequest)
    {
        var query = new SiteLocationPagedEntityQuery
        {
            PagingInfo = new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = siteLocationDataTableRequest.PageSize,
                StartPage = siteLocationDataTableRequest.StartPage
            },
            SortingInfo = new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = siteLocationDataTableRequest.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = siteLocationDataTableRequest.SortDirection
            },
            Name = siteLocationDataTableRequest.Name,
            SiteName = siteLocationDataTableRequest.SiteName,
            IsAggregationPoint = siteLocationDataTableRequest.IsAggregationPoint,
            Type = siteLocationDataTableRequest.Type,
            SiteId = siteLocationDataTableRequest.SiteId
        };
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        return result;
    }

    // GET: api/site-locations/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési hely lekérdezése id alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Mérési hely azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}", Name = "GetSiteLocationById")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "SiteLocations_GetSiteLocation")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteLocationModel>> Get(int id)
    {
        if (id <= 0)
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "SiteLocation azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if ((await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<SiteLocationEntityDto>(id)) is not SiteLocationEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SiteLocation" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<SiteLocationModel>(queryResponse);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/site-locations/{sitelocationIdentifier}/byidentifier
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési hely lekérdezése sitelocationIdentifier alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="sitelocationIdentifier">The sitelocation identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{sitelocationIdentifier}/byidentifier", Name = "GetSiteLocationBySitelocationIdentifier")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "SiteLocations_GetSiteLocationBySitelocationIdentifier")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteLocationModel>> GetSiteLocationBySitelocationIdentifier(string sitelocationIdentifier, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        var result = new SiteLocationEntityDto();

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
                var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

                if (!((await tenantQueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SiteLocationQuery { Identifier = sitelocationIdentifier }))?.Items is SiteLocationEntityDto[] siteEntitys)
              || siteEntitys == null)
                    return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SiteLocation" });

                result = siteEntitys.FirstOrDefault();
            }
        else
        {

            if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SiteLocationQuery { Identifier = sitelocationIdentifier }))?.Items is SiteLocationEntityDto[] siteEntityDtos)
                 || siteEntityDtos == null)
                return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SiteLocation" });

            result = siteEntityDtos.FirstOrDefault();
        }
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/site-locations/{parentIdentifier}/by-parent-identifier
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési hely lekérdezése sitelocationIdentifier alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="sitelocationIdentifier">The sitelocation identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{parentIdentifier}/by-parent-identifier", Name = "GetSiteLocationByParentIdentifier")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "SiteLocations_GetSiteLocationByParentIdentifier")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteLocationModel>> GetSiteLocationByParentIdentifier(Guid parentIdentifier)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SiteLocationQuery { ParentIdentifier = parentIdentifier }))?.Entity is SiteLocationEntityDto siteLocationEntity)
              || siteLocationEntity == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SiteLocation" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<GuidEntityRef<SiteLocationEntityDto>>(siteLocationEntity);

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/site-locations/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Fizikai mérési hely törlés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{id:int}", Name = "DeleteSiteLocation")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "SiteLocations_Delete")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SuccessResponse>> Delete(int id)
    {
        await _commandService.DeleteEntityAsync<SiteLocationEntityDto>(id);

        return Ok(new SuccessResponse());
    }

    // PUT: api/site-locations/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Fizikai mérési hely szerkesztés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Telephely azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id}", Name = "PutSiteLocationSiteLocation")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "SiteLocations_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteLocationModel>> Put(int id, ModifySiteLocationRequest request)
    {
        ModifySiteLocationCommand modifyCommand = _mapper.Map<ModifySiteLocationCommand>(request);
        modifyCommand.SiteLocationId = id;
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(modifyCommand) as ModifySiteLocationCommandResult;

        if (response?.SiteLocationEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SiteLocationModel>(response.SiteLocationEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/site-locations/{id}/devices/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz entitás referenciák lekérdezése, egy adott mérési helyhez kapcsolódóan.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Mérési hely azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/devices/entity-ref", Name = "GetDeviceRefsBySiteLocationId")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "SiteLocations_GetDeviceRefsBySiteLocationId")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<EntityRef<DeviceModel>>>> GetDeviceRefsBySiteLocationId(int id)
    {
        if (id <= 0)
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "SiteLocation azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if ((await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<SiteLocationEntityDto>(id)) is not SiteLocationEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SiteLocation" });

        var result = (queryResponse.IoTDevices?.Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<DeviceModel>>));
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/site-locations/{id}/devices/guid-entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz GUID entitás referenciák lekérdezése, egy adott mérési helyhez kapcsolódóan.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Mérési hely azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/devices/guid-entity-ref", Name = "GetDeviceGuidRefsBySiteLocationId")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "SiteLocations_GetDeviceGuidRefsBySiteLocationId")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<GuidEntityRef<DeviceModel>>>> GetDeviceGuidRefsBySiteLocationId(int id)
    {
        if (id <= 0)
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "SiteLocation azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new DeviceEntitiesQuery_Old()
        {
            SiteLocationId = id
        }))?.Items is DeviceEntityDto[] deviceEntityDtos)
            || deviceEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Device" });

        var result = (deviceEntityDtos.Select(_mapper.Map<GuidEntityRef<DeviceEntityDto>>));
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/site-locations/{id}/card
    /// <summary>
    /// A mérési hely lekérdezése kártyanézethez.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/card", Name = "GetSiteLocationCard")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]

    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tenantIndependentDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// Lifetime scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _lifetimeScope;
    /// <summary>
    /// Excel preprocessor
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IExcelTemplateWorkExecuter _excelPreprocessor;



    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SitesController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantIndependentDictCache">The tenant independent dictionary cache.</param>
    /// <param name="lifetimeScope">The lifetime scope.</param>
    public SitesController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tenantIndependentDictCache,
        ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope,
        IExcelTemplateWorkExecuter excelPreprocessor)
    {
        _securityContext = lifetimeScope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _tenantIndependentDictCache = tenantIndependentDictCache;
        _lifetimeScope = lifetimeScope;
        _excelPreprocessor = excelPreprocessor;
    }

    // GET: api/sites/getall
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes telephely lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("all", Name = "GetAllSites")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<SiteModel>>> GetAll()
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SiteEntityQuery { IsDeleted = false }))?.Items is SiteEntityDto[] siteEntityDtos)
            || siteEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Site" });

        var result = siteEntityDtos.Select(t => _mapper.Map<SiteModel>(t));
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/sites/{identifier}
    
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely lekérdezése globális azonosító alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="identifier">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{identifier}", Name = "GetSite")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteModel>> Get(string identifier, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        var result = new SiteModel();

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(identifier))
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Site globális azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
                var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

                if ((await tenantQueryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SiteEntityQuery
                {
                    Identifier = identifier,
                    IsDeleted = false
                }))?.Entity is not SiteEntityDto queryRes)
                    return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Site" });
                result = _mapper.Map<SiteModel>(queryRes);
            }
        else
        {

            if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SiteEntityQuery
            {
                Identifier = identifier,
                IsDeleted = false
            }))?.Entity is not SiteEntityDto queryResponse)
                return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Site" });

            result = _mapper.Map<SiteModel>(queryResponse);
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/sites/basic-data
    /// <summary>
    /// Új telephely létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("basic-data", Name = "PostSiteBasicData")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_PostBasicData")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteModel>> Post(SiteBasicModel request)
    {
        if (request.Id != 0)
            return BadRequest();

        var dto = _mapper.Map<SiteEntityDto>(request);
        var resultDto = await _commandService.CreateEntityAsync(dto);

        if (resultDto == null)
            return BadRequest(request);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SiteModel>(resultDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/sites/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely szerkesztés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Telephely azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id}", Name = "PutSite")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteModel>> Put(int id, ModifySiteRequest request)
    {
        ModifySiteCommand modifyCommand = _mapper.Map<ModifySiteCommand>(request);
        modifyCommand.SiteId = id;
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(modifyCommand) as ModifySiteCommandResult;

        if (response?.SiteEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SiteModel>(response.SiteEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/sites/{id}/basic-data
    /// <summary>
    /// Új telephely módosítás
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id}/basic-data", Name = "PutSiteBasicData")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_PutBasicData")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteModel>> Put(int id, SiteBasicModel request)
    {
        var dto = _queryService.GetById<SiteEntityDto>(id);

        if (dto == null)
            return BadRequest();

        if (dto.Id != request.Id)
            return BadRequest();

        dto = _mapper.Map(request, dto);
        var resultDto = await _commandService.UpdateEntityAsync(dto);

        if (resultDto == null)
            return BadRequest(request);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SiteBasicModel>(resultDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési hely entity-ref lista elemek lekérdezése.
    /// </summary>

    [HttpGet("getsiteadministrationentityref")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_GetSiteAdministrationEntityRef")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityRef<SiteEntityDto>[]?>> GetSiteAdministrationEntityRef([FromQuery] int? parentId, [FromQuery] string tenantCode)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        bool isCurrentUserGlobalUser = string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser?.TenantCode);

        if (currentUser is null || !isCurrentUserGlobalUser)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Site" });

        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new TenantSiteEntityRefQuery
        {
            IsDeleted = false,
            ParentId = parentId,
            TenantCode = tenantCode
        });


        var items = result?.Items;
        return Ok(items);
    }

    // GET: api/sites/{id}/locations/{siteLocationId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési hely lekérdezése azonosító alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Telephely azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="siteLocationId">Mérési hely azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/locations/{siteLocationId}", Name = "GetSiteLocation")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_GetSiteLocation")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteLocationModel>> GetSiteLocation(int id, int siteLocationId)
    {
        if (id == 0)
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Site azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if (siteLocationId == 0)
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "SiteLocation azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SiteLocationQuery { Id = siteLocationId,/* SiteId = id*/ }))?.Entity is not SiteLocationEntityDto queryResponse)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SiteLocation" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<SiteLocationModel>(queryResponse);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/sites/[id]/locations
    /// <summary>
    /// Új mérési hely létrehozása adott telephelyhez
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("{id}/locations", Name = "PostSiteLocation")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_PostSiteLocation")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteLocationModel>> PostSiteLocation(int id, CreateSiteLocationRequest request)
    {
        if (request.Site?.Id != id)
            return BadRequest(request);

        var dto = _mapper.Map<SiteLocationEntityDto>(request);

        var created = await _commandService.CreateEntityAsync(dto);

        if (created == null)
            return BadRequest(created);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SiteLocationModel>(created);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/sitelocations/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési hely szerkesztés adott telephelyen
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Telephely azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="siteLocationId">Mérési hely azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id}/locations/{siteLocationId}", Name = "PutSiteLocation")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_PutSiteLocation")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SiteLocationModel>> PutSiteLocation(int id, int siteLocationId, ModifySiteLocationRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifySiteLocationCommand
        {
            SiteId = id,
            SiteLocationId = siteLocationId,
            Name = request.Name,
            Lat = request.Lat,
            Lon = request.Lon,
            SiteLocationType = request.Type,
            IsAggregationPoint = request.IsAggregationPoint
        }) as ModifySiteLocationCommandResult;

        if (response?.SiteLocationEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SiteLocationModel>(response.SiteLocationEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/sitelocations/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési hely törlés
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Telephely azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="siteLocationId">Mérési hely azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{id}/locations/{siteLocationId}", Name = "SiteDeleteSiteLocation")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_DeleteSiteLocation")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<DeleteSiteLocationCommandResult>> DeleteSiteLocation(int id, int siteLocationId)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteSiteLocationCommand
        {
            SiteId = id,
            SiteLocationId = siteLocationId
        }) as DeleteSiteLocationCommandResult;

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
    }


    // GET: api/sites/{id}/devices
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes IoT eszköz lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">Telephely azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}/devices", Name = "GetSiteDevices")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_GetSiteDevices")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<DeviceModel>>> GetSiteDevices(int id, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        var result = new List<DeviceModel>();

        if (id == 0)
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse
            {
                Error = "Site azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            using (var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
                var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

                if (!((await tenantQueryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new DeviceEntitiesQuery_Old()
                {
                    SiteId = id
                }))?.Items is DeviceEntityDto[] deviceDtos)
             || deviceDtos == null)
                    return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Device" });

                result = deviceDtos.Select(t => _mapper.Map<DeviceModel>(t)).ToList();
            }
        else
        {
            if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new DeviceEntitiesQuery_Old()
            {
                SiteId = id
            }))?.Items is DeviceEntityDto[] deviceEntityDtos)
                || deviceEntityDtos == null)
                return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Device" });

            result = deviceEntityDtos.Select(t => _mapper.Map<DeviceModel>(t)).ToList();
        }
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>

    }

    /// Get a specific site validity record
    /// </summary>
