    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{siteId}/validity/{validityId}", Name = "GetSiteValidity")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]

    //GET /api/sites/energetic-template/download
    [HttpGet("energetic-template/download/{siteId}", Name = "GetEnergeticTemplate")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_GetEnergeticTemplate")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetEnergeticTemplateExcel(int siteId)
    {
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SiteEntityQuery
        {
            Id = siteId,
            IsDeleted = false
        }))?.Entity is not SiteEntityDto siteDto)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Site" });

        IEnumerable<EnergeticDataTemplateTable> energeticTable = siteDto.Buildings!
         .SelectMany(building => building.BuildingParts!
             .SelectMany(part => part.Floors!
                 .SelectMany(floor => floor.Rooms!
                     .Select(room => new EnergeticDataTemplateTable
                     {
                         BuildingGuid = building.Identifier.ToString()!,
                         BuildingId = building.Id,
                         RoomGuid = room.Identifier.ToString()!,
                         RoomId = room.Id,
                         BuildingName = building.Name,
                         BuildingPartName = part.Name,
                         FloorName = floor.Name,
                         RoomName = room.Name,
                     })
                 )
             )
         );

        var openingsCondition = _tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.OpenningsCondition);
        var openingsMaterial = _tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.WindowMaterial);
        var openingsShading = _tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.OpenningsShading);
        var lightingType = _tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.LightingType);
        var lightingConrollability = _tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.LightingControllability);
        var consumptionType = _tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.ConsumtionDeviceType);
        var estabilishedSubMetering = _tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.EstablishedSubMetering);
        var remoteControl = _tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.RemoteControl);
        var typeOfEnergyCarrier = _tenantIndependentDictCache.GetItems(DictType.EnergyCarrierType);

        var work = new EnergeticDataTemplateWork
        {
            InstitutionName = siteDto.Institution!.EntityDisplayName!,
            InstitutionId = siteDto.Institution!.Id,
            SiteId = siteDto.Id,
            SiteName = siteDto.Name,
            EnergeticData = energeticTable,
            OpeningsMaterial = openingsMaterial!,
            OpeningsCondition = openingsCondition!,
            OpeningsShading = openingsShading!,
            LightingType = lightingType!,
            LightingConrollability = lightingConrollability!,
            ConsumptionType = consumptionType!,
            EstablishedSubMetering = estabilishedSubMetering!,
            RemoteControl = remoteControl!,
            TypeOfEnergyCarrier = typeOfEnergyCarrier!,
        };

        var assembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
        var bytes = _excelPreprocessor.Execute(work,assembly);

        return File(bytes, "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", "energetika_sablon.xlsx");
    }

    //POST /api/sites/id/energetic-data/upload
    /// <summary>
    /// Uploads an Excel file.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="file">The Excel file to upload.</param>
    [HttpPost("{siteId}/energetic-data/upload", Name = "PostEnergeticExcel")]
    [Consumes("multipart/form-data")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_PostEnergeticExcel")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> PostEnergeticExcel([FromForm] EnergeticDataExcelUploadModel upload, [FromRoute] int siteId)
    {
        var file = upload.ExcelFile;
        if (file == null || file.Length == 0)
            return BadRequest("No file uploaded.");

        IFormFile excel = upload.ExcelFile;

        var ext = Path.GetExtension(excel.FileName);
        var allowedMimeType = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet";
        var allowedExtension = ".xlsx";
        if (excel.ContentType != allowedMimeType)
            return BadRequest($"Invalid file type: {excel.ContentType}. Only .xlsx files are allowed.");
        if (ext != allowedExtension)
            return BadRequest($"Invalid file type: {ext}. Only .xlsx files are allowed.");

        var command = new EnergeticUploadImportCommand
        {
            ImportFile = file,
            SiteId = siteId
        };

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);
        if (response is not UploadImportCommandResult result)
        { 
            return BadRequest("Error during file upload.");
        }

        return Ok(result.JobId);

    }

    // GET: api/sites/energetic-data-jobs/{siteId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Get Import Job Results for the current user
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("energetic-data-jobs/{siteId}", Name = "GetEnergeticImportJobs")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sites_GetEnergeticImportJobs")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<ImportJobResultListItemDto<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>>?>> GetEnergetricImportJobs(int siteId)
    {
        var u = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        var userQuery = new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
        {
            GlobalId = u.GlobalId,
            TenantCode = u.TenantCode,
            IsDeleted = false
        };
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(userQuery))?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto user)
            return BadRequest($"Invalid user with global id: '{userQuery.GlobalId}'");

        var query = new ImportJobResultPagedEntityQuery<EnergeticDataImportValidationResult>
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            SiteId = siteId
        };

        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        return Ok(result);
    }
}

    }

    // GET: api/street-suffix/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes közterület jelleg lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="text">The text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("entity-ref", Name = "GetStreetSuffexes")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "StreetSuffix_GetStreetSuffexes")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>[]>> GetStreetSuffexes(string? text)
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SelectEntityRefQuery<StreetSuffixEntityDto>
        {
            Search = text
        }))?.Items is EntityRef<StreetSuffixEntityDto>[] streetSuffixesEntityDtos)
            || streetSuffixesEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "StreetSuffix" });

        return Ok(streetSuffixesEntityDtos);
    }
}

    // GET: api/measurementpoints/{orgunitid}/{edmdevices}
    /// <summary>
    /// Get EDM device data for measurement points for an organization unit and its descendants
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="orgUnitBaseId">The organization unit ID</param>
    /// <param name="activeOnly">Whether to only return active devices</param>
    /// <returns>List of measurement point EDM device data</returns>
    [HttpGet("{orgUnitBaseId}/edmdevices", Name = "GetEdmDevicesByOrgunitBaseId")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "MeasurementPoints_GetEdmDevicesByOrgunitBaseId")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<MeasurementPointEdmDeviceDto>>> GetEdmDevicesByOrgunitBaseId([FromRoute] int orgUnitBaseId, [FromQuery] bool activeOnly = false)
    {
        var query = new MeasurementPointsByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery
        {
            OrgUnitBaseId = orgUnitBaseId,
            IsBilling = true //csak a főmérőket akarjuk látni
        };

        var measurementPoints = await _queryService.QueryEntities(query) as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointEntityDto>;

        if (measurementPoints == null)
        {
            return NotFound();
        }

        var podIdentifiers = measurementPoints
            .Items
            .Select(mp => mp.PodId)
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Distinct()
            .ToArray();

        var edmResult = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMasterData(podIdentifiers);

        if (edmResult != null && activeOnly)
        {
            edmResult = edmResult
                .Where(x => x.InstallationDate.Date <= DateTimeContext.Now.Date && (!x.RemovalDate.HasValue || x.RemovalDate >= DateTimeContext.Now.Date))
                .ToList();
        }

        edmResult = edmResult?
            .OrderBy(x => x.InstallationDate)
            .ToList();

        var result = edmResult?.Select(edmDevice =>
        {
            var mapped = _mapper.Map<MeasurementPointEdmDeviceDto>(edmDevice);
            var measurementPoint = measurementPoints.Items.FirstOrDefault(mp => mp.PodId == edmDevice.PodID);

            if (measurementPoint != null)
            {
                mapped.MeasurementDescriptors = measurementPoint.MeasuredProperties.Select(x => x.MeasuredPropertyName).ToList();
            }

            return mapped;
        }).ToList();

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/measurementpoints/{orgunitid}/{devices}
    /// <summary>
    /// Get device data for measurement points for an organization unit and its descendants
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="orgUnitBaseId">The organization unit ID</param>
    /// <param name="activeOnly">Whether to only return active devices</param>
    /// <returns>List of measurement point device data</returns>
    [HttpGet("{orgUnitBaseId}/devices", Name = "GetDevicesByOrgunitBaseId")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "MeasurementPoints_GetDevicesByOrgunitBaseId")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<MeasurementPointDeviceDto>>> GetDevicesByOrgunitBaseId([FromRoute] int orgUnitBaseId, [FromQuery] bool activeOnly = false)
    {
        var query = new MeasurementPointsByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery
        {
            OrgUnitBaseId = orgUnitBaseId,
            IsBilling = false //csak az almérőket akarjuk látni
        };

        var measurementPoints = await _queryService.QueryEntities(query) as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointEntityDto>;

        if (measurementPoints?.Items == null)
        {
            return NotFound();
        }

        var deviceIds = measurementPoints.Items
            .SelectMany(x => x.Devices)
            .Select(x => x.Id)
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        var devices = (await _queryService.QueryEntities(new DeviceEntitiesByIdListQuery
        {
            DeviceIds = deviceIds,
            ActiveOnly = activeOnly
        })) as EntityListItemQueryResult<DeviceEntityDto>;

        var result = devices?.Items.Select(device =>
        {
            var mapped = _mapper.Map<MeasurementPointDeviceDto>(device);
            var measurementPoint = measurementPoints.Items.FirstOrDefault(mp => mp.Id == device.MeasurementPoint?.Id);

            if (measurementPoint != null)
            {
                mapped.UtilityType = measurementPoint.UtilityType.ToString();
                mapped.MeasurementDescriptors = measurementPoint.MeasuredProperties.Select(x => x.MeasuredPropertyName).ToList();
            }

            return mapped;
        }).ToList();

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/measurementpoints/{globalId}/
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérési pont detail végpont
    [HttpGet("{globalId:guid}", Name = "GetByGlobalId")]

    // GET: api/measurementpoints/{measurementPointId}/edm-channel-id/{measuredPropertyId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Channel ID lekérdezése és visszaadása EDM interfésztől measurement point ID alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{measurementPointId}/edm-channel-id/{measuredPropertyId}", Name = "GetMeasurementPointEdmChannelId")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "MeasurementPoints_GetMeasurementPointEdmChannelId")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<MeasurementPointEdmChannelIdDto>> GetMeasurementPointEdmChannelId([FromRoute] int measurementPointId, [FromRoute] int measuredPropertyId)
    {
        var entityQuery = new EntityByIdQuery<MeasurementPointEntityDto> { Id = measurementPointId };
        var measurementPoint = (await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(entityQuery) as EntityQuerySingleResult)?.Entity as MeasurementPointEntityDto;
        var measuredProperty = _queryService.GetById<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>(measuredPropertyId);

        if (measurementPoint == null || !measurementPoint.IsBilling || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(measurementPoint.PodId) || measuredProperty == null || !measuredProperty.ObisCodes.Any())
        {
            return NotFound();
        }

        var edmResult = await _edmInterfaceService.GetEDMDevices(measurementPoint.PodId);

        var deviceChannelId = edmResult.Devices
                .SelectMany(device => device.DataChannels
                    .Where(dc => measuredProperty.ObisCodes.Contains(dc.ObisCode))
                    .Select(dc => dc.DataChannelId))
            .FirstOrDefault();

        if (deviceChannelId == default)
        {
            return NotFound();
        }

        return Ok(new MeasurementPointEdmChannelIdDto
        {
            ChannelId = deviceChannelId
        });
    }

    private async Task<IList<PeakValueCardDetailsModel>> GetBillingMeasurementPointPeaks(int orgunitId)
    {
        var query = new MeasurementPointsByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery
        {
            OrgUnitBaseId = orgunitId,
            IsBilling = true
        };

        var measurementPoints = await _queryService.QueryEntities(query) as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointEntityDto>;

        // Csak azokra a csatornákra van szükség, amik hatásos energiafogyasztást mérnek 
        var billingMeasurementPoints = measurementPoints.Items.Where(m => m.MeasuredProperties.Any(p => p.Code == MeasuredPropertyCode.ACTIVE_ELECTRICITY_CONSUMPTION.ToString())).ToList();

        if (billingMeasurementPoints == null || billingMeasurementPoints.Count == 0)
            return new List<PeakValueCardDetailsModel>();

        var obisCodes = (_queryService.QueryEntities(new MeasuredPropertyEntityQuery { Code = MeasuredPropertyCode.ACTIVE_ELECTRICITY_CONSUMPTION.ToString() })?.Result as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>)?.Items.FirstOrDefault()?.ObisCodes;
        if (obisCodes == null) throw new NullReferenceException($"Obis code not found");

        var podIdentifiers = billingMeasurementPoints
            .Select(mp => mp.PodId)
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Distinct()
            .ToArray();

        // Get all devices
        var edmResult = await _edmInterfaceService.GetEDMDevices(podIdentifiers);

        // Create a flat list of device channels with their associated PodId
        var deviceChannels = edmResult
            .SelectMany(edmDevice => edmDevice.Devices
                .SelectMany(device => device.DataChannels
                    .Where(dc => obisCodes.Contains(dc.ObisCode))
                    .Select(dc => new
                    {
                        PodId = edmDevice.Pod,
                        DataChannel = dc
                    })))
            .ToList();

        var dateFrom = new DateOnly(DateTime.Now.Year, DateTime.Now.Month, 1);
        var dateTo = dateFrom.AddMonths(1);
        var requestMap = new List<(string PodId, int DataChannelId, Guid RequestId)>();

        // First loop: Request measurements for all channels
        foreach (var item in deviceChannels)
        {
            try
            {
                var requestId = await _edmInterfaceService.RequestMeasurements(item.DataChannel.DataChannelId, dateFrom, dateTo);
                requestMap.Add((item.PodId, item.DataChannel.DataChannelId, requestId));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.LogError($"Error requesting measurements for DataChannelId: {item.DataChannel.DataChannelId}. {ex}");
            }
        }

        var requestResults = new List<(string PodId, int DataChannelId, double MaxValue, DateTime PeakTime)>();

        // Second loop: Get results for all requests
        foreach (var (podId, dataChannelId, requestId) in requestMap)
        {
            try
            {
                var results = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurementResults(requestId);
                if (results?.Any() == true)
                {
                    var maxResult = results.SelectMany(r => r.Measurements).OrderByDescending(r => r.Value).First();
                    requestResults.Add((podId, dataChannelId, maxResult.Value, maxResult.MeasurementDate));
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.LogError($"Error getting results for DataChannelId: {dataChannelId}. {ex}");
            }
        }

        // Map results to measurement points
        var result = new List<PeakValueCardDetailsModel>();

        foreach (var measurementPoint in billingMeasurementPoints)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(measurementPoint.PodId))
                continue;

            var pointResults = requestResults
                .Where(r => r.PodId == measurementPoint.PodId)
                .ToList();

            if (!pointResults.Any())
                continue;

            var maxResult = pointResults
                .OrderByDescending(r => r.MaxValue)
                .First();

            var cardDetail = new PeakValueCardDetailsModel
            {
                Id = measurementPoint.Id,
                IsConsumption = true,
                MeasurementPointName = measurementPoint.Name,
                IsMainMeter = true,
                PeakTime = maxResult.PeakTime,
                PeakValue = (decimal)maxResult.MaxValue,
                // Add other properties as needed
            };

            result.Add(cardDetail);
        }

        return result;
    }

    // GET: api/measurementpoints/peak-value-cards/{orgunitId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Csúcsteljesítmény kártya adatainak lekérdezése intézményi hierarchia elemhez
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("billing-measurement-points-measurements-by-channels", Name = "GetBillingMeasurementPointMeasurementsByChannels")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "MeasurementPoints_GetBillingMeasurementPointMeasurementsByChannels")]

    public async Task<IList<MeasurementResponseModel>> GetBillingMeasurementPointMeasurementsByChannels(DateTime dateFrom, DateTime dateTo)
    {
        var query = new MeasurementPointEntityQuery
        {
            IsBilling = true
        };

        var measurementPoints = await _queryService.QueryEntities(query) as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointEntityDto>;

        // Csak azokra a  mérőkre van szükség, amik hatásos energiafogyasztást mérnek 
        var billingMeasurementPoints = measurementPoints?.Items.Where(m => m.MeasuredProperties.Any(p => p.Code == MeasuredPropertyCode.ACTIVE_ELECTRICITY_CONSUMPTION.ToString())).ToList();

        if (billingMeasurementPoints == null || billingMeasurementPoints.Count == 0)
            return new List<MeasurementResponseModel>();

        var obisCodes = (_queryService.QueryEntities(new MeasuredPropertyEntityQuery { Code = MeasuredPropertyCode.ACTIVE_ELECTRICITY_CONSUMPTION.ToString() })?.Result as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>)?.Items.FirstOrDefault()?.ObisCodes;
        if (obisCodes == null) throw new NullReferenceException($"Obis code not found");


        var podIdentifiers = billingMeasurementPoints
            .Select(mp => mp.PodId)
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
            .Distinct()
            .ToArray();

        // Get all devices
        var edmResult = await _edmInterfaceService.GetEDMDevices(podIdentifiers);

        // Create a flat list of device channels with their associated PodId
        var deviceChannels = edmResult
            .SelectMany(edmDevice => edmDevice.Devices
                .SelectMany(device => device.DataChannels
                    .Where(dc => obisCodes!.Contains(dc.ObisCode))
                    .Select(dc => new
                    {
                        PodId = edmDevice.Pod,
                        DataChannel = dc
                    })))
            .ToList();


        var requestMap = new List<(string PodId, int DataChannelId, Guid RequestId)>();

        // First loop: Request measurements for all channels
        foreach (var item in deviceChannels)
        {
            try
            {
                var requestId = await _edmInterfaceService.RequestMeasurements(item.DataChannel.DataChannelId, dateFrom.ToDateOnly(), dateTo.ToDateOnly());
                requestMap.Add((item.PodId, item.DataChannel.DataChannelId, requestId));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.LogError($"Error requesting measurements for DataChannelId: {item.DataChannel.DataChannelId}. {ex}");
            }
        }

        var response = new List<MeasurementResponseModel>();

        // Second loop: Get results for all requests
        foreach (var (podId, dataChannelId, requestId) in requestMap)
        {
            try
            {
                var channelResult = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurementResults(requestId);
                if (channelResult?.Any() == true)
                {
                    channelResult.ForEach(cr =>
                    {
                        cr.PodIdentifier = podId;
                    });
                    response = response.Concat(channelResult).ToList();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.LogError($"Error getting results for DataChannelId: {dataChannelId}. {ex}");
            }
        }
        return response;
    }



    private async Task<IList<PeakValueCardDetailsModel>> GetNonBillingMeasurementPointPeaks(int orgunitId)
    {
        var query = new MeasurementPointsByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery
        {
            OrgUnitBaseId = orgunitId,
            IsBilling = false
        };

        var measurementPoints = await _queryService.QueryEntities(query) as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointEntityDto>;


        var result = new List<PeakValueCardDetailsModel>();

        foreach (var measurementPoint in measurementPoints.Items)
        {

            var channels = new List<Guid>();

            // Csak azokra a csatornákra van szükség, amik hatásos energiafogyasztást mérnek 
            var channelResult = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new MeasuredPropertyChannelQuery() { MeasurementPointId = measurementPoint.Id, MeasuredPropertyCode = MeasuredPropertyCode.ACTIVE_ELECTRICITY_CONSUMPTION.ToString() });
            var channel = channelResult?.Items?.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Identifier.HasValue);
            if (channel != null)
                channels.Add(channel.Identifier.Value);
            var peaks = await _monitoringApiService.GetActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels(channels);

            var peak = peaks?.FirstOrDefault();

            if (peak != null)
            {
                var card = new PeakValueCardDetailsModel
                {
                    Id = measurementPoint.Id,
                    IsConsumption = true,
                    IsMainMeter = false,
                    MeasurementPointName = measurementPoint.Name,
                    PeakTime = peak.PeakTimeUtc.ToLocalTime(),
                    PeakValue = peak.PeakValue
                };
                result.Add(card);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    private async Task<IList<PeakValueCardDetailsModel>> GetMeasurementPointPeaks(int orgunitId)
    {


        var query = new MeasurementPointsByOrgUnitBaseIdQuery
        {
            OrgUnitBaseId = orgunitId
        };

        var measurementPoints = await _queryService.QueryEntities(query) as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasurementPointEntityDto>;
        var subMeterChannels = new List<KeyValuePair<MeasurementPointEntityDto, List<Guid>>>();
        var mainMeterChannels = new List<KeyValuePair<MeasurementPointEntityDto, List<int>>>();

        foreach (var measurementPoint in measurementPoints.Items)
        {
            // Csak azokra a csatornákra van szükség, amik hatásos energiafogyasztást mérnek
            var channelResult = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new MeasuredPropertyChannelQuery() { MeasurementPointId = measurementPoint.Id, MeasuredPropertyCode = MeasuredPropertyCode.ACTIVE_ELECTRICITY_CONSUMPTION.ToString() });

            if (measurementPoint.IsBilling)
            {
                var channelIds = channelResult?.Items?.Where(x => x.Id != 0).Select(x => x.Id).ToList();
                if (channelIds != null)
                    mainMeterChannels.Add(new KeyValuePair<MeasurementPointEntityDto, List<int>>(measurementPoint, channelIds));
            }
            else
            {
                var channelGuids = channelResult?.Items?.Where(x => x.Identifier.HasValue).Select(x => (Guid)x.Identifier!).ToList();
                if (channelGuids != null)
                    subMeterChannels.Add(new KeyValuePair<MeasurementPointEntityDto, List<Guid>>(measurementPoint, channelGuids));
            }
        }

        var result = new List<PeakValueCardDetailsModel>();

        var subMeterChannelIdentifiers = subMeterChannels.SelectMany(x => x.Value).Distinct();
        if (subMeterChannelIdentifiers.Any())
        {
            var subMeterPeaks = await _monitoringApiService.GetActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels(subMeterChannelIdentifiers);
            result = result.Concat(subMeterPeaks.Select(peak => MapToResponse(peak, subMeterChannels.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Value.Contains(peak.ChannelIdentifier)).Key))).ToList();
        }


        var mainMeterChannelIds = mainMeterChannels.SelectMany(x => x.Value).Distinct();
        if (mainMeterChannelIds.Any())
        {
            var mainMeterPeaks = await _monitoringApiService.GetActualMonthlyMainMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels(mainMeterChannelIds);
            result = result.Concat(mainMeterPeaks.Select(peak => MapToResponse(peak, mainMeterChannels.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Value.Contains(peak.ChannelId)).Key))).ToList();
        }

        return result;

        static PeakValueCardDetailsModel MapToResponse(EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Models.MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel peak, MeasurementPointEntityDto measurementPoint)
        {
            if (peak == null) return null;

            return new PeakValueCardDetailsModel
            {
                Id = measurementPoint.Id,
                IsConsumption = true,
                IsMainMeter = measurementPoint.IsBilling,
                MeasurementPointName = measurementPoint.Name,
                PeakTime = peak.PeakTimeUtc.ToLocalTime(),
                PeakValue = peak.PeakValue
            };
        }
    }

    /// Delete a measurement point by ID
    /// </summary>

    /// <returns>Result of the delete operation</returns>
    [HttpDelete("{id}", Name = "DeleteMeasurementPoint")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]

    {

    private async Task<MapCoordinatesInfoQueryResult?> GetCoordinatesForOrgUnit<T>(List<int> orgUnitIds) where T : OrgunitBaseEntityDto
    {
        return (MapCoordinatesInfoQueryResult?)await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(
            new OrgUnitMapCoordinatesInfoBaseQuery<T> { OrgUnitIds = orgUnitIds });
    }

    [HttpPost("MapCoordinates", Name = nameof(GetMapCoordinates))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "MeasurementPoints_GetMapCoordinates_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<MapCoordinatesInfoModel>>> GetMapCoordinates([FromBody] MapCoordinatesInfoRequest request)
    {
        var measurementPointIds = request.LocatableIds
             .Where(x => x.MeasurementPointId is not null)
             .Select(x => x.MeasurementPointId!.Value)
             .ToList();

        var orgUnitIds = request.LocatableIds
            .Where(x => x.OrgUnitId is not null)
            .Select(x => x.OrgUnitId!.Value)
            .ToList();

        var measurementPointCoordinatesRes = (MapCoordinatesInfoQueryResult?)await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(
            new MeasurementPointMapCoordinatesInfoQuery { MeasurementPointIds = measurementPointIds });

        var siteCoordinatesRes = await GetCoordinatesForOrgUnit<SiteEntityDto>(orgUnitIds);
        var buildingCoordinatesRes = await GetCoordinatesForOrgUnit<BuildingEntityDto>(orgUnitIds);
        var buildingPartCoordinatesRes = await GetCoordinatesForOrgUnit<BuildingPartEntityDto>(orgUnitIds);
        var roomCoordinatesRes = await GetCoordinatesForOrgUnit<RoomEntityDto>(orgUnitIds);
        var floorCoordinatesRes = await GetCoordinatesForOrgUnit<FloorEntityDto>(orgUnitIds);

        var allResults = new object?[]
        {
            measurementPointCoordinatesRes,
            siteCoordinatesRes,
            buildingCoordinatesRes,
            buildingPartCoordinatesRes,
            roomCoordinatesRes,
            floorCoordinatesRes,
        };

        if (allResults.Any(r => r is null))
        {
            return BadRequest();
        }

        var coords = measurementPointCoordinatesRes!.CoordinateInfos
             .Concat(siteCoordinatesRes!.CoordinateInfos)
             .Concat(buildingCoordinatesRes!.CoordinateInfos)
             .Concat(buildingPartCoordinatesRes!.CoordinateInfos)
             .Concat(roomCoordinatesRes!.CoordinateInfos)
             .Concat(floorCoordinatesRes!.CoordinateInfos);

        return Ok(coords);

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A mérési pont alá tartozó almérők lekérdezése
    /// </summary>

    // GET api/measurementpoints/{orgunitId}/device-categories
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz kategóriák lekérdezése (almérő, szenzor)
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{orgunitId:int}/device-categories", Name = nameof(GetDeviceCategoriesByOrgUnit))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = $"MeasurementPoints_{nameof(GetDeviceCategoriesByOrgUnit)}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<DeviceCategoryModel>>> GetDeviceCategoriesByOrgUnit(
        [FromRoute] int orgunitId,
        DateOnly? fromDate,
        DateOnly? toDate,
        int? measuredPropertyId,
        int? technologyId
        )
    {
        /*
        Működés:
        A megadott paraméterek alapján ki kell választani a mérési pontokból azokat az eszközöket, amik aktívak a 
        szűrt időszakban (felszerelési dátum és leszerelési dátum alapján). Az eszközökből ezután le kell kérdezni 
        a típusokat (iot_device_type), és azon keresztül a categóriákat (device_category_id). Az eredmény egy 
        distinct dict_item lista, amely az aktív eszközök kategóriáját tartalmazza.
        */

        var query = new DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQuery
        {
            OrgUnitId = orgunitId,
            MeasuredPropertyId = measuredPropertyId,
            TechnologyId = technologyId,
            From = fromDate?.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue),
            To = toDate?.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MaxValue),
        };

        var result = await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query);
        if (result is DeviceCategoriesByOrgUnitQueryResult queryResult)
        {
            List<DeviceCategoryModel> deviceCategories = queryResult.DeviceCategories
                .Select(x => new DeviceCategoryModel(x.DeviceCategoryId, x.DeviceCategoryName))
                .ToList();

            return Ok(deviceCategories);
        }

        return BadRequest();
    }


    // GET api/measurementpoints/{orgunitId}/device-types
    /// <summary>
    /// Eszköz típusok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{orgunitId:int}/device-types", Name = nameof(GetDeviceTypesByOrgUnit))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]

    public async Task<ActionResult<List<DeviceTypeModel>>> GetDeviceTypesByOrgUnit(

        DateOnly? fromDate,
        DateOnly? toDate,
        int? measuredPropertyId = null,
        int? technologyId = null,
        int? deviceCategoryId = null)
    {
        /*
        Működés:
        Hasonló, mint az előző esetben (GetDeviceCategoriesByOrgUnit). 
        A kiválasztott kategóriákhoz tartozó eszköz típusokat listázza.
        */

        var query = new DeviceTypesByOrgUnitQuery
        {
            OrgUnitId = orgunitId,
            MeasuredPropertyId = measuredPropertyId,
            TechnologyId = technologyId,
            From = fromDate?.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue),
            To = toDate?.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MaxValue),
            DeviceCategoryId = deviceCategoryId
        };

        var result = await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query);
        if (result is DeviceTypesByOrgUnitQueryResult queryResult)
        {
            List<DeviceTypeModel> deviceTypes = queryResult.DeviceTypes
                .Select(x => new DeviceTypeModel(x.DeviceTypeId, x.DeviceTypeName))
                .ToList();

            return Ok(deviceTypes);
        }

        return BadRequest();
    }

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Notifications;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using NHibernate;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Notifications;

/// <summary>
/// NotificationController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class NotificationController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="NotificationController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public NotificationController(
      IQueryService queryService,
      ICommandService commandService,
      IMapper mapper,
      ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _scope = scope;
    }

    // POST: api/notification/{id}/set-read
    /// <summary>
    /// Értesítés olvasottra állítása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("{id}/set-read", Name = "SetNotificationRead")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Notification_SetNotificationRead")]
    public async Task<ActionResult> SetNotificationRead(int id)
    {
        var cmd = new SetNotificationReadCommand
        {
            Id = id
        };

        await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(cmd);

        return Ok();
    }

    // POST: api/notification/post
    /// <summary>
    /// Értesítés létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("Post", Name = "PostNotification")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Notification_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<NotificationModel>> Post(CreateNotificationRequest request, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        NotificationEntityDto? response = null;
        var dto = _mapper.Map<NotificationEntityDto>(request);

        dto.ExpirationDate =
            request.ExpirationMinutes.HasValue
                ? DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(request.ExpirationMinutes.Value)
                : DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(Config.GetIntValue("NotificationExpirationMinutes"));

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
        {
            using (var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
                var tenantCommandService = tenantScope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
                response = await tenantCommandService.CreateEntityAsync(dto);
            }
        }
        else
            response = await _commandService.CreateEntityAsync(dto);

        if (response == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<NotificationModel>(response);
        return Ok(result);
    }


    // POST: api/notification/create-alert
    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztási értesítések létrehozása (egy request-ből több DTO)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    [HttpPost("create-alerts", Name = "CreateAlertNotifications")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Notification_CreateAlertNotifications")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateAlertNotifications(CreateAlertNotificationRequest request, string? tenantCode = null)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
        {
            return BadRequest();
        }

        var expiresAt = request.ExpirationMinutes.HasValue ?
            DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(request.ExpirationMinutes.Value) :
            DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(Config.GetIntValue("NotificationExpirationMinutes"));

        //userenként külön értesítés entitást veszünk fel, mert mindenki a sajátját fogja majd olvasottnak jelölni.
        List<NotificationEntityDto> allNotificationDtos = [];
        foreach (var user in request.TargetUsers)
        {
            var dto = _mapper.Map<NotificationEntityDto>(request);
            dto.TargetUsers = [user];
            dto.ExpirationDate = expiresAt;
            dto.ExternalEmailAddresses = null;
            allNotificationDtos.Add(dto);

            //PUSH ÜZENET MELLÉ A BELSŐS FELHASZNÁLÓKNAK EMAILT IS KELL KÜLDENI - ez egy új notification entitás lesz
            var internalUserEmailNotificationDto = _mapper.Map<NotificationEntityDto>(request);
            internalUserEmailNotificationDto.TargetUsers = [user];
            internalUserEmailNotificationDto.NotificationType = NotificationType.Email;
            internalUserEmailNotificationDto.ExpirationDate = expiresAt;
            internalUserEmailNotificationDto.ExternalEmailAddresses = null;
            allNotificationDtos.Add(internalUserEmailNotificationDto);
        }

        //a külsős emailekre külön értesítés entitásokat hozunk létre, TargetUsers nélkül.
        HashSet<string> externalEmails = request.EmailRecipients?.Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Select(x => x.Trim()).ToHashSet() ?? [];
        foreach (string email in externalEmails)
        {
            var dtoForExternalEmail = _mapper.Map<NotificationEntityDto>(request);
            dtoForExternalEmail.TargetUsers = new List<EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>>();
            dtoForExternalEmail.ExpirationDate = expiresAt;
            dtoForExternalEmail.ExternalEmailAddresses = email;
            allNotificationDtos.Add(dtoForExternalEmail);
        }

        using var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope();

        tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
        var tenantCommandService = tenantScope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        var dbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        string templateName = $"{request.AlertDataType}AlertTemplate"; //TODO: erre normális megoldást találni, pl. enum alapján lekérdezni a template nevét
        var template = await dbContext.Session.QueryOver<TemplateEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Name == templateName)
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync();
        if (template is null)
        {
            return BadRequest($"There is no template for {request.AlertDataType}");
        }

        List<NotificationEntityDto?> commandResults = [];
        foreach (var dto in allNotificationDtos)
        {
            if (dto.NotificationType == NotificationType.Email)
            {
                dto.Title = templateName; // !!! fontos, ez alapján listázza az emailküldő !!! 
                dto.HtmlTemplateId = template.Id; // Set the template ID for the email notification (push won't need this)
                dto.NotificationState = NotificationState.Pending; //ezt valamiért be kellett állítani újra?
            }

            var result = await tenantCommandService.CreateEntityAsync(dto);
            commandResults.Add(result);
            //TODO: hibakezelés: egy request->response-ba hogy adjuk vissza, ha valamelyik command hibára futott? nem mintha foglalkozna vele a másik modul.
        }

        return Ok();
    }

    private static async Task<List<SecUserEntity>> LoadUsersAsync(IDbContext dbContext, IEnumerable<EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>> dtoUserRefs)
    {
        var result = new List<SecUserEntity>();
        foreach (var dtoUser in dtoUserRefs)
        {
            var secUserEntity = await dbContext.Session.LoadAsync<SecUserEntity>(dtoUser.Id);
            if (secUserEntity is not null)
            {
                result.Add(secUserEntity);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    // GET: api/notification
    /// <summary>
    /// A bejelentkezett felhasználó értesítései
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetNotifications")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Notifications_GetNotifications")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<NotificationModel[]>> GetNotifications()
    {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new NotificationEntitiesQuery() { NotificationType = Common.Shared.Enums.Notifications.NotificationType.Push }))
                ?.Items is NotificationEntityDto[] notificationEntityDtos)
            || notificationEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Notifications" });

        var models = notificationEntityDtos?.Select(_mapper.Map<NotificationModel>).ToArray();
        return Ok(models);
    }
}

    [HttpGet("{partnerId}", Name = "GetPartner")]

            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse()

            });

        if (!((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery

            PartnerId = partnerId

            || partnerEntityDto == null
            || partnerEntityDto.Id == 0)

    // GET: api/partners/{partnerId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Partner lekérdezése azonosító alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="partnerId">Partner azonosító</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{partnerId}/tenant", Name = "GetTenantPartner")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Partners_GetTenantPartner")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<PartnerModel>> GetTenantPartner(int partnerId)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode))
            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse()
            {
                Error = "Nem engedélyezett művelet!"
            });

        if (partnerId == 0)
            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse()
            {
                Error = "Partner azonosító megadása kötelező!"
            });

        if (!((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery
        {
            PartnerId = partnerId
        }))?.Entity is PartnerEntityDto partnerEntityDto)
            || partnerEntityDto == null
            || partnerEntityDto.Id == 0)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Partner" });

        var tenantCode = partnerEntityDto.TenantCode;
        await using (var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
        {
            scope.SetSecurityContext(SecurityContext.Create(
                scope,
                _securityContext.CurrentUser.Clone(tenantCode),
                sessionId: _securityContext.SessionId,
                clientIp: _securityContext.ClientIp));
            var qs = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
            var partnerQueryResult = await qs.QuerySingleEntity(new PartnerEntityQuery()
            {
                TenantCode = tenantCode
            });
            if (partnerQueryResult?.Entity == null)
                return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Partner" });
            else
                partnerEntityDto = (PartnerEntityDto)partnerQueryResult.Entity;
        }

        var result = _mapper.Map<PartnerModel>(partnerEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/partners/
    /// <summary>
    /// Új tenant partner létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "PostPartner")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Partners_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<PartnerModel>> Post(CreatePartnerRequest request)
    {
        var user = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecUserSingleEntityQuery() { Email = request.AdministratorEmail }).RunSync()?.Entity as SecUserEntityDto;
        if (user!=null)
        {
            if (user.IsDeleted)
            {
                return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse()
                {
                    Error = $"A megadott e-mail címhez ({request.AdministratorEmail}) egy inaktív felhasználó tartozik. Inaktív felhasználó nem adható meg adminisztrátorként."
                });
            }

            if (user.IsLocked)
            {
                return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest, new ErrorResponse()
                {
                    Error = $"A megadott e-mail címhez ({request.AdministratorEmail}) egy zárolt felhasználó tartozik. Zárolt felhasználó nem adható meg adminisztrátorként."
                });
            }
        }

        var parnerAdministrator = new PartnerAdminUserEntityDto()
        {
            AdministratorFirstName = request.AdministratorFirstName,
            AdministratorLastName = request.AdministratorLastName,
            AdministratorEmail = request.AdministratorEmail,
            AdministratorPhone = request.AdministratorPhone,
        };

        var response = (CreatePartnerCommandResult)await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreatePartnerCommand
        {
            Name = request.Name,
            Description = request.Description,
            Headquarters = request.Headquarters,
            EMail = request.EMail,
            Website = request.Website,
            Telephone = request.Telephone,
            ContactPersonName = request.ContactPersonName,
            TenantCode = request.TenantCode,
            TaxIdentificationNumber = request.TaxIdentificationNumber,
            CompanyRegistrationNumber = request.CompanyRegistrationNumber,
            PartnerAdminUser = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(parnerAdministrator),
            ValidFrom = request.ValidFrom,
            ValidTo = request.ValidTo,
            InstituteIdentification=request.InstituteIdentification,
            InstituteIdentificationType=request.InstituteIdentificationType,
            Maintainer = request.Maintainer
        });

        if (response == null || response.PartnerEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<PartnerModel>(response?.PartnerEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

        if (fileBytes != null)

        return NotFound("Az Import template excel nem található.");
    }

    // POST: api/partners/import-template/upload
    /// <summary>
    /// Get the template excel, which can be used to import data
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("import-template/upload", Name = "PostOrgunitImport")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Partners_PostOrgunitImport")]
    public async Task<ActionResult> PostOrgunitImport(IFormFile orgunitImport)
    {
        if (orgunitImport == null || orgunitImport.Length == 0)
            return BadRequest("No file uploaded.");

        // validate file type (without opening it)
        var ext = Path.GetExtension(orgunitImport.FileName);
        var allowedMimeType = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet";
        var allowedExtension = ".xlsx";
        if (orgunitImport.ContentType != allowedMimeType)
            return BadRequest($"Invalid file type: {orgunitImport.ContentType}. Only .xlsx files are allowed.");
        if (ext != allowedExtension)
            return BadRequest($"Invalid file type: {ext}. Only .xlsx files are allowed.");

        var command = new UploadOrgunitCommand
        {
            OrgunitImport = orgunitImport
        };

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);
        if (response is not UploadOrgunitCommandResult result)
        { //TODO: ha command hiba van, akkor mit tudnánk visszadni üzenetként?
            return BadRequest("Error during file upload.");
        }

        return Ok(result.JobId);
    }

            return BadRequest($"Invalid user with global id: '{userQuery.GlobalId}'");

        var query = new OrgunitImportJobResultPagedEntityQuery
        {

            //Statuses = ... egyelőre mindent, aztán lehet majd finomítani...
        };

        return Ok(result);
    }

using Common.WebAPI.Filters;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.PDFGenerator.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.PdfExample;

/// <summary>
/// PdfExampleController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[AllowAnonymous]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class PdfExampleController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// PDF generator
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IPdfGenerator _pdfGenerator;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PdfExampleController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="pdfGenerator">The PDF generator.</param>
    public PdfExampleController(IPdfGenerator pdfGenerator)
    {
        _pdfGenerator = pdfGenerator;
    }

    // Böngésző elindításához:
    // cd energiamenedzsment/Docker/pdfgenerator
    // docker compose up --detach
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the PDF.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet]
    [SwaggerOptions(IsVisible = false)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetPdf()
    {
        _pdfGenerator.SetHeader(new List<string> { "Header_Col_1", "Header_Col_2" });

        _pdfGenerator.AddRow(new List<string> { "Row_1-Col_1", "Row_1-Col_2" });
        _pdfGenerator.AddRow(new List<string> { "Row_2-Col_1", "Row_2-Col_2" });

        var pdfContent = await _pdfGenerator.GenerateAsync();

        if (pdfContent is null)
            return NoContent();
        
        return File(pdfContent, "application/pdf", "converted.pdf");
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.SecRole;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Security;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Roles;

/// <summary>
/// RolesController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class RolesController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// Role cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly RoleCache _roleCache;

    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RolesController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="roleCache">The role cache.</param>
    public RolesController(
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        IMapper mapper,
        RoleCache roleCache,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService)
    {
        _securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        _scope = scope;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _roleCache = roleCache;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    // GET: api/roles
    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkörök lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetRoles")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_GetRoles")]
    public ActionResult<IList<SecRoleModel>> GetRoles()
    {
        var roles = _roleCache.GetContent(_scope).Select(_mapper.Map<SecRoleModel>);
        return Ok(roles);
    }

    // GET: api/roles/datatable
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes szerepkör lekérdezése - lapozható
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="rolesDataTableRequest">The role data table request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("datatable", Name = "GetRolesDataTable")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_GetRolesDataTable")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<SecRoleListItemDto>?>> GetRolesDataTable([FromQuery] RoleDataTableRequest rolesDataTableRequest)
    {
        var query = _mapper.Map<RolePagedEntityQuery>(rolesDataTableRequest); //lapozási paramétereket a mapping profile lekezeli
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/roles/operations
    /// <summary>
    /// Biztonsági műveletek lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("operations", Name = "GetOperations")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_GetOperations")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<SecOperationsByCategoryListItemDto>>> GetOperations()
    {
        var query = new OperationEntityQuery();
        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(query);

        var groupedResult = result.Items
            .GroupBy(op => op.Category.Id)
            .Select(g => new SecOperationsByCategoryListItemDto
            {
                CategoryId = g.Key,
                CategoryName = g.First().Category.Value ?? string.Empty,
                Operations = g.Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<SecOperationEntityDto>>).ToList()
            })
            .OrderBy(x => x.CategoryName)
            .ToList();

        return Ok(groupedResult);
    }

    // GET: api/getrole-bycode-or-roletype
    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkör lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="code">The code.</param>
    /// <param name="secRoleType">Type of the sec role.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("getrole-bycode-or-roletype", Name = "GetRoleByCodeOrRoleType")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_RoleByCodeOrRoleType")]
    public ActionResult<SecRoleModel> GetRoleByCodeOrRoleType(string? code, string? secRoleType, string? tenantCode)
    {
        SecRoleEntityDto role = null;
        if (code == null && secRoleType == null)
            return BadRequest("Szerepkör kód vagy szerepkör típus megadása kötelező");

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(secRoleType))
        {
            Enum.TryParse(secRoleType, out SecRoleType roleType);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
                role = _roleCache.GetRoleByCodeOrType(_scope, code, roleType);
            else
            {
                using (var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
                {
                    tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
                    var _queryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
                    
                    var secRole = _queryService.QueryEntities<SecRoleListItemDto>(new RoleBySecRoleTypeEntityQuery()
                    {
                        SecRoleType = roleType,
                    }).Items?.FirstOrDefault();

                    if (secRole == null)
                        return null;

                    return Ok(new SecRoleModel()
                    {
                        Id = secRole.Id,
                        RoleCode = secRole.RoleCode,
                        RoleName = secRole.RoleName,
                        SecRoleType = roleType
                    });
                }
            }                
        }
        else
            role = _roleCache.GetRoleByCodeOrType(_scope, code, null);

        if (role == null)
            return null;

        return Ok(_mapper.Map<SecRoleModel>(role));
    }

    // GET: api/roles/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes szerepkör lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="text">The text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("entity-ref", Name = "GetEFRoles")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_GetEFRoles")]
    public ActionResult<EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>[]> GetEFRoles(string? text)
    {
        var roles = 
            _roleCache
            .GetContent(_scope)
            .Where(x => x.RoleName.ToLower().Contains((text ?? "").ToLower()) && !x.IsDeleted)
            .Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>>);
        return Ok(roles);
    }

    // GET: api/roles/administration/entity-ref
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes érvényes szerepkör lekérdezése adott tenanthoz adminisztrációs célokkal
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="text">The text.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("administration/entity-ref", Name = "GetAdministrationEFRoles")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_GetAdministrationEFRoles")]
    public ActionResult<EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>[]> GetAdministrationEFRoles(string tenantCode, string? text)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        bool isCurrentUserGlobalUser = string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser?.TenantCode);

        if (currentUser is null || !isCurrentUserGlobalUser || string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Roles" });

        using (var tenantScope = _scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
        {
            tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
            //var tenantRoleCache = tenantScope.Resolve<RoleCache>();

            var roles =
            _roleCache
            .GetContent(tenantScope)
            .Where(x => x.RoleName.ToLower().Contains((text ?? "").ToLower()) && !x.IsDeleted)
            .Select(_mapper.Map<EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>>);
            return Ok(roles);
        }
    }

    // GET: api/roles/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkör lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}", Name = "GetRole")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_GetRole")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecRoleModel>> GetRole(int id)
    {
        var response = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<SecRoleEntityDto>(id);

        if (response is null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecRoleEntityDto>(response);

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/roles
    /// <summary>
    /// Create a new role
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "PostRole")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecRoleModel>> Post(CreateRoleRequest request)
    {
        var createCommand = _mapper.Map<CreateSecRoleCommand>(request);
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(createCommand) as CreateSecRoleCommandResult;

        if (response?.SecRoleEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecRoleModel>(response.SecRoleEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/roles
    /// <summary>
    /// Update an existing role
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPut("", Name = "PutRole")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecRoleModel>> Put(ModifyRoleRequest request)
    {
        var updateCommand = _mapper.Map<ModifySecRoleCommand>(request);
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(updateCommand) as ModifySecRoleCommandResult;

        if (response?.SecRoleEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecRoleModel>(response.SecRoleEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/roles/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Delete a role
    /// </summary>
    [HttpDelete("{id}", Name = "DeleteRole")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_Delete")]
    public async Task<ActionResult> DeleteRole(int id)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteSecRoleCommand
        {
            RoleId = id
        }) as DeleteSecRoleCommandResult;

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
    }

    // POST: api/roles/sync-sercroleorgunits
    /// <summary>
    /// Az összes jogosultság lekérdezése szinkronizáció céljából
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost(FrameworkApi.SecRoleOrgUnit.SyncSecRoleOrgUnit, Name = "sync-secroleorgunits")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Roles_SecRoleOrgUnitsSync")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<SecRoleOrgUnitSyncModel>>> SecRoleOrgUnitsSync(SyncSecRoleOrgunitRequest request)
   {
        if (!((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SecRoleOrgUnitEntityQuery { orgUnitIds = request.orgUnitIds, secUserIds = request.secUserIds }))?.Items is SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto[] secRoleOrgUnitEntityDtos)
            || secRoleOrgUnitEntityDtos == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecRoleOrgUnit" });

        var result = secRoleOrgUnitEntityDtos.Select(_mapper.Map<SecRoleOrgUnitSyncModel>).ToList();
        return Ok(result);
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Authentication;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Security;

/// <summary>
/// AuthenticateController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers.UserAuthenticateControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class AuthenticateController : UserAuthenticateControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// Cmmand service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AuthenticateController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="roleCache">The role cache.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="securityCache">The security cache.</param>
    public AuthenticateController(
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ILifetimeScope scope,
        RoleCache roleCache,
        SecurityContext securityContext,
        TenantSecurityCache securityCache) : base(commandService,queryService, scope, roleCache, securityCache, securityContext)
    {
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the current user.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [Route("")]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Authenticate_Current")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<UserAuthModel>> GetCurrentUser()
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        var roleTypes = new List<SecRoleType>();
        foreach (var currentUserRole in currentUser.Roles)
        {
            var role = _roleCache.GetRoleByCode(this._scope, currentUserRole);
            if (role is not null && !roleTypes.Contains(role.SecRoleType))
                roleTypes.Add(role.SecRoleType);
        }

        TenantEntityDto? tenantDto = default;
        var tenantCode = currentUser.TenantCode;
        if (tenantCode is not null)
        {
            var tenantQuery = new TenantEntityQuery { TenantCode = currentUser.TenantCode, OnlyValidResults = true };
            tenantDto = (await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(tenantQuery))?.Entity as TenantEntityDto;
        }
        
        return Ok(new UserAuthModel()
        {
            GlobalId = currentUser.GlobalId,
            Roles = currentUser.Roles,
            TenantName = tenantDto?.Name,
            TenantCode = tenantDto?.Code,
            RoleTypes = roleTypes.ToArray()
        });
    }

}

public class MaintainersController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    public MaintainersController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper)
    {

        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("data-table", Name = "GetMaintainers")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]

    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<MaintainerListItemDto>>> GetMaintainers([FromQuery] MaintainerDataTableRequest maintainerDataTableRequest)
    {

        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        return Ok(result);
    }


    // GET: api/maintainers/
    /// <summary>
    /// Get maintainer
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{id}", Name = "GetMaintainer")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Maintainers_GetMaintainer")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<MaintainerModel>> GetMaintainer([FromRoute] int id)
    {
        var result = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<MaintainerEntityDto>(id);

        if (result == null)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "Maintainer" });

        return Ok(_mapper.Map<MaintainerModel>(result));
    }


    // Post: api/maintainers/
    /// <summary>
    /// Post maintainer
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "CreateMaintainer")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Maintainers_CreateMaintainer")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<MaintainerModel>> CreateMaintainer([FromBody] CreateMaintainerRequest request)
    {
        var command = _mapper.Map<CreateMaintainerCommand>(request);
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command) as CreateMaintainerCommandResult;

        if (response?.MaintainerEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<MaintainerModel>(response.MaintainerEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // Put: api/maintainers/
    /// <summary>
    /// Put maintainer
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPut("{id}", Name = "EditMaintainer")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Maintainers_EditMaintainer")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<MaintainerModel>> EditMaintainer([FromRoute]int id, [FromBody] EditMaintainerRequest request)
    {
        var command = _mapper.Map<ModifyMaintainerCommand>(request);
        command.Id = id;
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command) as ModifyMaintainerCommandResult;

        if (response?.MaintainerEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<MaintainerModel>(response.MaintainerEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);   
    }
    
    // DELETE: api/maintainers/
    /// <summary>
    /// Delete maintainer
    /// </summary>
    [HttpDelete("{id}", Name = "DeleteMaintainer")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Maintainers_DeleteMaintainer")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteMaintainer(int id)
    {
        var delCommand = new DeleteMaintainerCommand { Id = id };
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(delCommand) as DeleteMaintainerCommandResult;

        if (response is null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok(response);
    }

    // GET: api/maintainers/entity-ref-list
    /// <summary>
    /// Közintézményi fenntartók entity ref-s lista lekérdezés
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("entity-ref-list", Name = "GetMaintainersEntityRef")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Maintainers_GetMaintainersEntityRef")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityRef<MaintainerEntityDto>[]>> GetMaintainersEntityRef()
    {
        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new MaintainerEntityRefQuery());

        if (result?.Items == null)
            return BadRequest();

        return Ok(result.Items);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Services;

/// <summary>
/// ServicesController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
