using Autofac;
using Autofac.Core.Lifetime;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Queries.Devices.Channels;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Sync
{
    /// <summary>
    /// SyncController
    /// </summary>
    /// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Controllers.SyncControllerBase" />
    [ApiController]
    [Produces("application/json")]
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
    public class SyncController : SyncControllerBase
    {
        private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
        private readonly ILifetimeScope _lifetimeScope;
        private readonly IMapper _mapper;
        private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SyncController"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
        /// <param name="lifetimeScope">The lifetime scope.</param>
        public SyncController(
            ICommandService commandService,
            IQueryService queryService,
            ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope,
            IMapper mapper,
            SecurityContext securityContext
            ) : base(commandService, lifetimeScope)
        {
            _queryService = queryService;
            _lifetimeScope = lifetimeScope;
            _mapper = mapper;
            _securityContext = securityContext;
        }





        // POST: api/sync/ListHierarchyByChannels
        /// <summary>
        /// Listázza a ChannelId-k alapján a hozzárendelt szervezeti hierarchiát és a mérési pontokat.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpPost("ListHierarchyByChannels", Name = "ListHierarchyByChannels")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
        [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Sync_ListHierarchyByChannels")]

        public async Task<ActionResult<Dictionary<Guid, ChannelOrgunitHierarchyCommonModel?>>> ListHierarchyByChannels([FromBody] IEnumerable<Guid> ChannelIdentifiers, [FromQuery] string? tenantCode = null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
                tenantCode = HttpContext?.User.Claims.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == "tenantcode")?.Value ?? null;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
                return BadRequest("Tenant code is required.");

            if (ChannelIdentifiers == null || !ChannelIdentifiers.Any())
                return BadRequest("Channel identifiers are required.");

            //TODO: tenantCode-nak megfelelő queryService-t kell feloldani. ha job hívja, akkor is jól működik, és ha user a UI-ról, akkor is?
            using var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope();
            tenantScope.SetSecurityContext(SecurityContext.Create(
               tenantScope,
               _securityContext.CurrentUser.Clone(tenantCode),
               sessionId: _securityContext.SessionId,
               clientIp: _securityContext.ClientIp));

            var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();            

            Dictionary<Guid, ChannelOrgunitHierarchyCommonModel?> results = [];
            //run on queryservice in foreach
            foreach (var channelId in ChannelIdentifiers.Distinct())
            {
                var hierarchyResult = await tenantQueryService.ExecuteQuery(new HierarchyAndMeasuredPropertyQuery() { ChannelIdentifier = channelId});
                if (hierarchyResult != null && hierarchyResult is HierarchyAndMeasuredPropertyQueryResult result) //TODO: handle channel not found
                {
                    results.Add(channelId, result.ChannelOrgunitHierarchyCommonModel);
                }
                else
                {
                    //if channelId was not found, add an empty result with the channelId
                    results.Add(channelId, null);
                }
            }

            return Ok(results);
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// TenantController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class TenantController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TenantController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="lifetimeScope">The lifetime scope.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public TenantController(SecurityContext securityContext, IQueryService queryService, IMapper mapper, ICommandService commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
        _commandService = commandService;
    }

    // GET: api/tenant/currentName
    /// <summary>
    /// A belépett felhasználó teant nevének lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.ArgumentNullException">TenantCode is required!</exception>
    [HttpGet("currentName", Name = "GetCurrentTenantName")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Tenant_GetCurrentName")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<string>> GetCurrentName()
    {
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            throw new ArgumentNullException($"TenantCode is required!");

        var tenantDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TenantEntityQuery
        {
            TenantCode = tenantCode,
            OnlyValidResults = true
        }).Result?.Entity as TenantEntityDto;

        return Ok(tenantDto?.Name);
    }

    // GET: api/tenant/{partnerId}/status-by-partnerid
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant státuszának lekérdezése partnerId alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="partnerId">The partner identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{partnerId}/status", Name = "GetStatusByPartnerId")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Tenant_GetStatusByPartnerId")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TenantStatus>> GetStatusByPartnerId(int partnerId)
    {
        var tenantDto = _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new TenantEntityQuery
        {
            PartnerId = partnerId,
            OnlyValidResults = true
        }).Result?.Entity as TenantEntityDto;

        return Ok(tenantDto?.Status);
    }

    // GET: api/tenant/
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenantok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("", Name = "GetAll")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Tenant_GetAll")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TenantModel[]>> GetAll()
    {
        if ((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new TenantEntityQuery
        {
            OnlyValidResults = true
        }))?.Items is not TenantEntityDto[] resultDtos)
        return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse
        {
            Type = "Tenant"
        });
        
        var result = resultDtos.Select(t => _mapper.Map<TenantModel>(t)).ToArray();

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/tenant/sync-tenant
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenantok szinkronizálása
    /// </summary>

    [HttpPost(FrameworkApi.Tenant.SyncTenant, Name = "SyncTenants")]

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Tenant_SyncTenants")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<TenantModel>>> SyncTenants(SyncTenantRequest request)
    {
        if ((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new TenantEntityQuery { From = request.From}))?.Items is not TenantEntityDto[] resultDtos)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse
            {
                Type = "Tenant"
            });

        var result = resultDtos.Select(_mapper.Map<TenantSyncModel>);

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/tenant/current
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant státuszának lekérdezése partnerId alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("current", Name = "GetCurrentTenant")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Tenant_GetCurrentTenant")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TenantModel>> GetCurrentTenant()
    {
        string? tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tenantCode))
            return BadRequest("Current user's tenant code not awailable.");

        if ((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new TenantEntityQuery
        {
            OnlyValidResults = true,
            TenantCode = tenantCode
        }))?.Items is not TenantEntityDto[] resultDtos)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse
            {
                Type = "Tenant"
            });

        var result = _mapper.Map<TenantModel>(resultDtos.FirstOrDefault());

        return Ok(result);
    }
}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Controllers.Users;

/// <summary>
/// UsersController
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ControllerBase" />
[Authorize]
[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class UsersController : ControllerBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Command service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Mapper
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// Lifetime scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _lifetimeScope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="UsersController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="lifetimeScope">The lifetime scope.</param>
    public UsersController(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope)
    {
        _securityContext = lifetimeScope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        _queryService = queryService;
        _commandService = commandService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _lifetimeScope = lifetimeScope;
    }

    // POST: api/users
    /// <summary>
    /// Új felhasználó létrehozása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "PostUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> Post(CreateUserRequest request)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        // global user is creating a global user
        bool isCurrentUserGlobalUser = string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser?.TenantCode);

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreateSecUserCommand
        {
            FirstName = request.FirstName,
            LastName = request.LastName,
            EMail = request.EMail,
            Phone = request.Phone,
            Roles = request.RoleOrgUnits?.Select(r => new EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto> { Id = r.Role.Id }).ToArray(),
            TenantCode = currentUser?.TenantCode
        }) as CreateSecUserCommandResult;

        if (response?.SecUserEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        // Create SecRoleOrgunitAssignment if we have role data
        // if global user is creating a global user, we skip to persist org unit assigments
        if (!isCurrentUserGlobalUser && request.RoleOrgUnits != null && request.RoleOrgUnits.Count > 0)
        {
            await CreateOrUpdateRoleAssignments(request.RoleOrgUnits, response.SecUserEntityDto, _queryService, _commandService);
        }

        // send new user notification
        var passwordNotificationManager = new PasswordNotificationManager();
        await passwordNotificationManager.NewUserRegistration(response.SecUserEntityDto.EMail, _lifetimeScope);


        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(response.SecUserEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/users/administration
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó adatok létrehozása globális adminisztrátorral, vagy erre jogosult szerepkörrel.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("administration/tenant/{tenantCode}", Name = "AdministrationPostUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_AdministrationPost")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> AdministrationPost(string tenantCode, CreateUserRequest request)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        bool isCurrentUserGlobalUser = string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser?.TenantCode);

        if (currentUser is null || !isCurrentUserGlobalUser || string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecUser" });

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new CreateSecUserCommand
        {
            FirstName = request.FirstName,
            LastName = request.LastName,
            EMail = request.EMail,
            Phone = request.Phone,
            Roles = request.RoleOrgUnits?.Select(r => new EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto> { Id = r.Role.Id }).ToArray(),
            TenantCode = tenantCode
        }) as CreateSecUserCommandResult;

        if (response?.SecUserEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        // Create SecRoleOrgunitAssignment if we have role data
        if (request.RoleOrgUnits != null && request.RoleOrgUnits.Count > 0)
        {
            using var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope();
            tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
            var tenantCommandService = tenantScope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
            var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

            await CreateOrUpdateRoleAssignments(request.RoleOrgUnits, response.SecUserEntityDto, tenantQueryService, tenantCommandService);
        }

        // send new user notification
        var passwordNotificationManager = new PasswordNotificationManager();
        await passwordNotificationManager.NewUserRegistration(response.SecUserEntityDto.EMail, _lifetimeScope);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(response.SecUserEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// Felhasználók lekérdezése

    // GET: api/users/administration
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználók lekérdezése globális adminisztrátorral, vagy erre jogosult szerepkörrel.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="Common.Shared.Exceptions.EnergiaMenedzsmentException">A '{tenantCode}' séma nem létezik az adatbázisban!</exception>
    [HttpGet("administration", Name = "AdministrationGetUsers")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_AdministrationGetUsers")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<SecUserListItemDto>?>> AdministrationGetUsers([FromQuery] UserDataTableRequest userDataTableRequest)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        bool isCurrentUserGlobalUser = string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser?.TenantCode);

        if (currentUser is null || !isCurrentUserGlobalUser)
        {
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecUser" });
        }

        IEntityQueryItemsResult<SecUserListItemDto>? response = null;
        var query = _mapper.Map<SecUserPagedEntityQuery>(userDataTableRequest); //lapozási paramétereket a mapping profile lekezeli

        try
        {
            using var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope();
            if (_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode == null && _securityContext.CurrentUser.Roles.Contains(SecRoleType.Adminisztrator.ToString()))
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(userDataTableRequest.Tenant);
            }

            var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
            response = await tenantQueryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Log.LogError($"[{nameof(UsersController)}]-{nameof(AdministrationGetUsers)}(tenant: {userDataTableRequest.Tenant}) - Hiba történt: {e}");
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentException($"A '{userDataTableRequest.Tenant}' séma nem létezik az adatbázisban!");
        }

        if (response is null || response.Items is not SecUserListItemDto[] secUserListItemDtos)
        {
            return BadRequest(response);
        }

        return Ok(response);
    }

    // GET: api/users/byemail
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a user by email address.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="email">The email address to search for.</param>
    /// <returns>The user information if found.</returns>
    [HttpGet("byemail", Name = "GetUserByEmail")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_GetUserByEmail")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> GetUserByEmail([FromQuery] string email)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(email))
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = "Email cannot be empty." });

        // Query for the user by email
        var queryResponse = await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
        {
            //IsDeleted = false,
            Email = email
        });

        if (queryResponse?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto userEntity)
            return Ok(new SecUserModel());

        // Map the entity to the model
        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(userEntity);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/users/administration/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó adatok módosítása globális adminisztrátorral, vagy erre jogosult szerepkörrel.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="tenantCode">The tenant code.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("administration/{id}/tenant/{tenantCode}", Name = "AdministrationPutUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_AdministrationPut")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> AdministrationPut(int id, string tenantCode, ModifyUserRequest request)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        bool isCurrentUserGlobalUser = string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser?.TenantCode);

        if (currentUser is null || !isCurrentUserGlobalUser || string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecUser" });

        SecUserModel result = null!;

        using (var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope())
        {
            tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenantCode);
            var tenantCommandService = tenantScope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
            var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

            var response = await tenantCommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifyTenantSecUserAdministrationCommand
            {
                Id = id,
                FirstName = request.FirstName,
                LastName = request.LastName,
                EMail = request.EMail,
                Telephone = request.Phone,
                Roles = request.RoleOrgUnits?.Select(r => new EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto> { Id = r.Role.Id }).ToArray(),
                TenantCode = tenantCode,
                TwoFactorAuthentication = request.TwoFactorAuthentication
            }) as ModifySecUserCommandResult;

            if (response?.SecUserEntityDto is null)
                return BadRequest(response);

            await CreateOrUpdateRoleAssignments(request.RoleOrgUnits, response.SecUserEntityDto, tenantQueryService, tenantCommandService);

            result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(response.SecUserEntityDto);
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/user
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{id}", Name = "GetUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_GetUser")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> GetUser(int id)
    {
        var response = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<SecUserEntityDto>(id);

        if (response is null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(response);

        // fill user's roles by current user's global or tenant scope

        if (_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode is not null)
        {
            result.Roles = await ListUserRolesByCurrentUserTenant(result.Id, result.Tenants);
        }
        // Globális felhasználók esetén a korábbi szerepköröket (sec_user_roles tábla) vesszük figyelembe, nem az orgunitos összerendelést
        else
        {
            result.Roles = response.Roles.Select(x => new SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto { Id = x.Id, Role = x }).ToList();
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/users/{id}
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó adatok módosítása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPut("{id}", Name = "PutUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> Put(int id, ModifyUserRequest request)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;
        // global user is creating a global user
        bool isCurrentUserGlobalUser = string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUser?.TenantCode);

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifySecUserCommand
        {
            Id = id,
            FirstName = request.FirstName,
            LastName = request.LastName,
            EMail = request.EMail,
            Telephone = request.Phone,
            Roles = request.RoleOrgUnits?.Select(r => new EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto> { Id = r.Role.Id }).ToArray(),
            TwoFactorAuthentication = request.TwoFactorAuthentication
        }) as ModifySecUserCommandResult;

        if (response?.SecUserEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        // Create SecRoleOrgunitAssignment if we have role data
        // if global user is modifying a global user, we skip to persist org unit assigments
        if (!isCurrentUserGlobalUser && request.RoleOrgUnits != null)
        {
            await CreateOrUpdateRoleAssignments(request.RoleOrgUnits, response.SecUserEntityDto, _queryService, _commandService);
        }

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(response.SecUserEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/users/{id}/password
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó jelszavának módosítása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The identifier.</param>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost("{id}/password", Name = "PostPassword")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_PostPassword")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> PostPassword(int id, ModifyUserPasswordRequest request)
    {
        ModifySecUserPasswordCommandResult? response = null;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.Tenant))
        {

            response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifySecUserPasswordCommand
            {
                Id = id,
                NewPassword = request.NewPassword,
                NewPasswordAgain = request.NewPasswordAgain
            }) as ModifySecUserPasswordCommandResult;
        }
        else
        {
            using var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope();

            // Csak global admin esetén adunk tenant admin jogot a jelszócserére
            if (_securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode == null && _securityContext.CurrentUser.Roles.Contains(SecRoleType.Adminisztrator.ToString()))
            {
                tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(request.Tenant);
            }
            var tenantCommandService = tenantScope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
            response = await tenantCommandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifySecUserPasswordCommand
            {
                Id = id,
                NewPassword = request.NewPassword,
                NewPasswordAgain = request.NewPasswordAgain
            }) as ModifySecUserPasswordCommandResult;
        }

        if (response?.SecUserEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(response.SecUserEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // POST: api/users/renewtoken
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó jelszavának módosítása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [HttpPost("renewtoken", Name = "Renewtoken")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_Renewtoken")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<AuthModel>> Renewtoken(ModifyUserPasswordAndReNewTokenRequest request)
    {
        var fPwManager = new PasswordNotificationManager();
        var response = await fPwManager.PasswordChange(request.NewPassword, request.NewPasswordAgain, request.TenantCode, request.Token) as ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenCommandResult;

        if (response?.User == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        if (response.User.TwoFactorStatus == TwoFactorStatus.Off)
        {
            var expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(Config.GetIntValue("JWT.TokenValidityInMinutes"));
            return Ok(new AuthModel()
            {
                Token = SecurityHelper.CreateToken(
                    new SecUser(
                            response.User.GlobalId,
                            response.User.EMail,
                            request.TenantCode,
                            response.User.EMail,
                            response.User.EMail,
                            response.User.RoleCodes,
                            response.User.OrgUnits,
                            response.User.IsSystem
                        ), expires
                    ),
                Expiration = expires
            });
        }
        else
        {
            var modelstate = new ModelStateDictionary();
            modelstate.AddModelError("TwoFactorChecker", CryptHelper.Encrypt(response.User.EMail));
            return BadRequest(modelstate);
        }
    }

    // GET: api/users/token/{token}/type/{tokenType}
    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó lekérdezése globális adminisztrátorral, vagy erre jogosult szerepkörrel.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <param name="tokenType">The token type.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [HttpGet("token/{token}/type/{tokenType}", Name = "GetUserByToken")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_GetUserByToken")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TokenModel>> GetUserByToken([FromRoute(Name = "token")] string token, [FromRoute(Name = "tokenType")] TokenType tokenType)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecUser" });

        TokenModel result = null!;

        var response = (await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecUserByTokenEntityQuery
        {
            Token = token,
            TokenType = tokenType
        }))?.Entity as SecUserEntityDto;

        if (response == null)
            return null;

        result = new TokenModel()
        {
            UserName = $"{response.LastName} {response.FirstName}",
            LastName = response.LastName,
            FirstName = response.FirstName,
            Email = response.EMail,
            Phone = response.Phone,
            Id = response.Id,
            Token = token
        };

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/users/current
    /// <summary>
    /// A bejelentkezett felhasználó adatainak lekérése
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("current", Name = "GetCurrentUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_GetCurrentUser")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>> GetCurrentUser()
    {
        var globalId = _securityContext.CurrentUser.GlobalId;
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;

        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecAuthEntityQuery { GlobalId = globalId }))?.Entity is not SecUserEntityDto secUserEntityQuery)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse { Type = "SecUser" });

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(secUserEntityQuery);
        result.TenantCode = tenantCode;

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tenantCode))
        {
            // Get user's role assignments
            var query = new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentListQuery()
            {
                UserId = secUserEntityQuery.Id,
                IncludeInvalidByCurrentDate = true,
                IgnoreOrgUnitFiltering = true
            };

            var queryResponse = await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query) as SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult;
            var roleAssignments = queryResponse?.Items;

            if (roleAssignments != null && roleAssignments.Any())
            {
                // Use AutoMapper to map from SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto to SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto
                result.Roles = roleAssignments.Select(assignment => _mapper.Map<SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto>(assignment)).ToList();
            }
            else
            {
                result.Roles = new List<SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto>();
            }
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/users/current
    /// <summary>
    /// A bejelentkezett felhasználó adatainak módosítása
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [HttpPut("current-new", Name = "PutNewlyRegisteredCurrentUser")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_PutNewlyRegisteredCurrentUser")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<SecUserModel>?> PutNewlyRegisteredCurrentUser(ModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentUserRequest request)
    {
        var tokenResponse = (await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecUserByTokenEntityQuery
        {
            Token = request.Token,
            TokenType = TokenType.NewUserRegistration
        }))?.Entity as SecUserEntityDto;

        if (tokenResponse == null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new ModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentSecUserCommand
        {
            FirstName = request.FirstName,
            LastName = request.LastName,
            Telephone = request.Phone,
            NewPassword = request.NewPassword,
            NewPasswordAgain = request.NewPasswordAgain,
            Token = request.Token
        }) as ModifySecUserCommandResult;

        if (response?.SecUserEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<SecUserModel>(response.SecUserEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>

    [HttpPost(FrameworkApi.User.SyncUser, Name = "SyncUsers")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_SyncUsers")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IEnumerable<SecUser>>> SyncUsers(SyncSecUserRequest request)
    {
        if ((await _queryService.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SecUserEntityQuery { From = request.From }))?.Items is not SecUserEntityDto[] resultDtos)
            return NotFound(new NotFoundResponse
            {
                Type = "User"
            });

        var result = resultDtos.Select(_mapper.Map<SecUserSyncModel>);

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // GET: api/users/userisvalid
    /// <summary>
    /// Ha az aktuális felhasználó dátum szerint érvényes jelszóval rendelkezik 'IGAZ' értéket ad
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("userisvalid", Name = "UserIsValid")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Users_UserIsValid")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<bool>> UserIsValid()
    {
        var expirationTimeSpan = Config.TryGetTimeSpanValue("PasswordPolicy.ExpirationTimeSpan", true) ?? TimeSpan.FromDays(90);
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;

        var response = await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new SecUserSingleEntityQuery
        {
            GlobalId = currentUser.GlobalId,
            TenantCode = currentUser.TenantCode
        });
        var result = response?.Entity as SecUserEntityDto;

        if (result is null)
            return BadRequest(result);

        var valid = result.PasswordLastModify > DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-expirationTimeSpan.Days);

        return Ok(valid);
    }

    private async Task CreateOrUpdateRoleAssignments(IList<SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto> roles, SecUserEntityDto user, IQueryService queryService, ICommandService commandService)
    {
        // Get current role assignments for the user to compare with new ones
        var query = new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentListQuery()
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            IncludeInvalidByCurrentDate = true,
            IgnoreOrgUnitFiltering = true
        };

        var queryResponse = await queryService.ExecuteQuery(query) as SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult;
        var currentAssignments = queryResponse?.Items ?? new List<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>();

        // Process each role from the input
        foreach (var role in roles)
        {
            var userRoleRef = user.Roles.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Id == role.Role.Id);
            if (userRoleRef == null)
                continue;

            var assignmentDto = new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto
            {
                Id = role.Id ?? 0,
                Role = new EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>
                {
                    Id = userRoleRef.Id,
                    EntityDisplayName = userRoleRef.EntityDisplayName
                },

                User = new EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>
                {
                    Id = user.Id
                },

                OrgunitType = GetOrgunitTypeForSecRoleAssigment(role.Site, role.Building),

                //idők kovertálása nap elejére, végére
                ValidFrom = role.ValidFrom.Date,
                ValidTo = role.ValidTo.HasValue ? role.ValidTo.Value.Date.AddDays(1).AddTicks(-1) : null,
            };

            if (role.Institution != null)
            {
                assignmentDto.Institution = new SimpleEntityRef
                {
                    Id = role.Institution.Id
                };
            }

            if (role.Site != null)
            {
                assignmentDto.Site = new SimpleEntityRef
                {
                    Id = role.Site.Id
                };
            }

            if (role.Building != null)
            {
                assignmentDto.Building = new SimpleEntityRef
                {
                    Id = role.Building.Id
                };
            }

            // Check if a similar assignment already exists
            var existingAssignment = currentAssignments.FirstOrDefault(a => a.Id == assignmentDto.Id);

            if (existingAssignment != null)
            {
                // Update existing assignment if needed
                if (existingAssignment.ValidFrom != assignmentDto.ValidFrom ||
                    existingAssignment.ValidTo != assignmentDto.ValidTo ||
                    existingAssignment.Institution?.Id != assignmentDto.Institution?.Id ||
                    existingAssignment.Site?.Id != assignmentDto.Site?.Id ||
                    existingAssignment.Building?.Id != assignmentDto.Building?.Id
                    )
                {
                    // Update the assignment
                    existingAssignment.ValidFrom = assignmentDto.ValidFrom;
                    existingAssignment.ValidTo = assignmentDto.ValidTo;

                    existingAssignment.Institution = assignmentDto.Institution;
                    existingAssignment.Site = assignmentDto.Site;
                    existingAssignment.Building = assignmentDto.Building;

                    // Create and execute update command using the entity's ID

                    await commandService.UpdateEntityAsync<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>(existingAssignment);
                }

                // Mark this assignment as processed
                currentAssignments.Remove(existingAssignment);
            }
            else
            {
                // Create new assignment
                var createCommand = new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentCreateCommand()
                {
                    Role = assignmentDto.Role,
                    User = _mapper.Map<EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>>(user),
                    ValidFrom = assignmentDto.ValidFrom,
                    ValidTo = assignmentDto.ValidTo,
                    Institution = assignmentDto.Institution,
                    Site = assignmentDto.Site,
                    Building = assignmentDto.Building,
                    OrgunitType = assignmentDto.OrgunitType
                };

                // Create the assignment in database
                await commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(createCommand);
            }
        }

        // Delete any remaining assignments that are no longer needed
        foreach (var assignmentToDelete in currentAssignments)
        {
            await commandService.DeleteEntityAsync<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>(assignmentToDelete.Id);
        }
    }

    private OrgunitType? GetOrgunitTypeForSecRoleAssigment(EntityRef<SiteEntityDto?> site, EntityRef<BuildingEntityDto?> building)
    {
        OrgunitType? orgUnitType = null;
        if (building != null)
        {
            orgUnitType = OrgunitType.Building;
        }
        else if (site != null)
        {
            orgUnitType = OrgunitType.Site;
        }

        return orgUnitType;
    }

    private async Task<List<SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto>> ListSecRoleOrgUnits(int userId, IQueryService queryService)
    {
        List<SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto> result = new();

        var query = new SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentListQuery()
        {
            UserId = userId,
            IncludeInvalidByCurrentDate = true,
            IgnoreOrgUnitFiltering = true
        };

        var queryResponse = await queryService.ExecuteQuery(query) as SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityQueryResult;
        var roleAssignments = queryResponse?.Items;

        if (roleAssignments != null && roleAssignments.Any())
        {
            // Use AutoMapper to map from SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto to SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto
            result = roleAssignments.Select(assignment => _mapper.Map<SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto>(assignment)).ToList();
        }

        return result;
    }

    private async Task<List<SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto>> ListUserRolesByCurrentUserTenant(int userId, List<TenantEntityDto> userTenantList)
    {
        var currentUser = _securityContext.CurrentUser;

        List<SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto> userRoleOrgUnits = null;

        if (userTenantList != null && userTenantList.Count > 0)
        {
            List<TenantEntityDto> userTenantsToGetRolesFrom = new List<TenantEntityDto>();

            // Check if global or tenant scope needed
            if (currentUser?.TenantCode != null)
            {
                // restrict to current user's tenant scope only
                userTenantsToGetRolesFrom = userTenantList.Where(t => t.Code == currentUser.TenantCode).ToList();
            }

            userRoleOrgUnits = new List<SecRoleOrgUnitEntityDto>();
            foreach (var tenant in userTenantList)
            {
                using (var tenantScope = _lifetimeScope.BeginLifetimeScope())
                {
                    tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(tenant.Code);
                    var tenantCommandService = tenantScope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
                    var tenantQueryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();

                    userRoleOrgUnits.AddRange(await ListSecRoleOrgUnits(userId, tenantQueryService));
                }
            }
        }

        return userRoleOrgUnits;
    }

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// CreateDeviceRequestValidator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices.CreateDeviceRequest&gt;" />
public class CreateDeviceRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<CreateDeviceRequest>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CreateDeviceRequestValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public CreateDeviceRequestValidator(
        IQueryService queryService,
        ILifetimeScope scope) : base()
    {
        _queryService = queryService;

        // IoTDeviceType kód
        RuleFor(x => x.IoTDeviceTypeId).MustAsync(IoTDeviceTypeExist).WithMessage($"{nameof(DeviceEntityDto.IoTDeviceType)} nem található!");
    }

    private async Task<bool> IoTDeviceTypeExist(int id, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var ioTDeviceTypeEntity = await _queryService.GetByIdAsync<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>(id, token);
        return ioTDeviceTypeEntity is not null && !ioTDeviceTypeEntity.IsDeleted;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// ModifyDeviceRequestValidator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices.ModifyDeviceRequest&gt;" />
public class ModifyDeviceRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<ModifyDeviceRequest>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantIndependentDictCache _tiDictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Database context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDbContext _dbContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ModifyDeviceRequestValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public ModifyDeviceRequestValidator(
        IQueryService queryService,
        TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope) : base()
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _tiDictCache = tiDictCache;
        _dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        // IoTDeviceType EntityRef
        RuleFor(x => x).CustomAsync(IoTDeviceTypeRefExist);

        // IoTDeviceType kód
        //RuleFor(x => x.IoTDeviceTypeCode).Must(IoTDeviceTypeExist).WithMessage($"{nameof(DeviceEntityDto.IoTDeviceType)} nem található!");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ioes the t device type reference exist.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    private async Task IoTDeviceTypeRefExist(ModifyDeviceRequest request, CustomContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var ioTDeviceTypeEntity = await _dbContext.Session.GetAsync<IoTDeviceTypeEntity>(request.IoTDeviceType.Id, cancellationToken);
        if (ioTDeviceTypeEntity is null || ioTDeviceTypeEntity.IsDeleted)
            context.AddFailure(nameof(ModifyDeviceRequest.IoTDeviceType), $"{nameof(DeviceEntityDto.IoTDeviceType)} nem található!");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Timezones the exist.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="timezoneCode">The timezone code.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private bool TimezoneExist(string? timezoneCode)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(timezoneCode))
            return false;

        var timezone = _tiDictCache.GetItem(DictType.TimeZone, timezoneCode);
        return timezone != null && !timezone.IsDeleted;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ioes the t device type reference exist.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ioTDeviceType">Type of the io t device.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private bool IoTDeviceTypeRefExist(EntityRef<IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto>? ioTDeviceType)
    {
        if (ioTDeviceType == null)
            return false;

        var ioTDeviceTypeEntity = _dbContext.Session.Query<IoTDeviceTypeEntity>().SingleOrDefault(d => d.Id == ioTDeviceType.Id);
        return ioTDeviceTypeEntity is not null && !ioTDeviceTypeEntity.IsDeleted;
    }

    /*private bool IoTDeviceTypeExist(string? ioTDeviceTypeCode)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ioTDeviceTypeCode))
            return true;
        
        var ioTDeviceTypeEntity = _dbContext.Session.Query<IoTDeviceTypeEntity>().SingleOrDefault(d => d.Code == ioTDeviceTypeCode);
        return ioTDeviceTypeEntity is not null && !ioTDeviceTypeEntity.IsDeleted;
    }*/
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI\Models\EnergyContract\InvoiceRequestValidator.cs
====================================================================================================

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.EnergyContract;
using NHibernate.Linq;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.EnergyContract;

/// <summary>
/// InvoiceRequestValidator
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;T&gt;" />
public class InvoiceRequestValidator<T> : BaseDtoValidator<T> where T : IInvoiceRequest
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Database context
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly IDbContext DbContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InvoiceRequestValidator{T}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public InvoiceRequestValidator(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        DbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        When(x => x.EnergyContracts is not null, () =>
        {
            RuleFor(x => x).CustomAsync(EnergyContractsValid);
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Energys the contracts valid.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    private async Task EnergyContractsValid(T request, CustomContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var requestIds = request.EnergyContracts.Select(e => e.Id);
        var energyContracts = await DbContext.Session.Query<EnergyContractEntity>().Where(e => requestIds.Contains(e.Id)).ToListAsync(cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
        if (energyContracts.Count != requestIds.Count())
        {
            context.AddFailure(nameof(CreateInvoiceRequest.EnergyContracts), "Érvénytelen energiaszerződés azonosító");
            return;
        }

        if (energyContracts.Count is <= 0 or >= 3)
        {
            context.AddFailure(nameof(CreateInvoiceRequest.EnergyContracts), "Érvénytelen számú energiaszerződés");
            return;
        }

        if (energyContracts.Count > 1 && energyContracts[0].EnergyContractType == energyContracts[1].EnergyContractType)
        {
            context.AddFailure(nameof(CreateInvoiceRequest.EnergyContracts),
                "Az energiaszerződéseknek különböző típúsúnak kell lenniük");
            return;
        }

        if (energyContracts.Any(e => e.Supplier.Id != energyContracts[0].Supplier.Id))
        {
            context.AddFailure(nameof(CreateInvoiceRequest.EnergyContracts),
                "Energiaszerződések szolgáltatóinak azonosaknak kell lenniük");
            return;
        }

        var validTypes = new List<EnergyContractType> { EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract, EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement };
        if (energyContracts.Any(e => !validTypes.Contains(e.EnergyContractType)))
        {
            context.AddFailure(nameof(CreateInvoiceRequest.EnergyContracts), "Érvénytelen energiaszerződés típusok");
        }
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI\Models\EnergyContract\InvoiceWithRequestWithFeesValidator.cs
====================================================================================================

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.EnergyContract;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums.EnergyContract;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.EnergyContract;

/// <summary>
/// InvoiceWithRequestWithFeesValidator
/// </summary>
/// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.EnergyContract.InvoiceRequestValidator&lt;T&gt;" />
public class InvoiceWithRequestWithFeesValidator<T> : InvoiceRequestValidator<T> where T: IInvoiceWithRequestWithFees
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InvoiceWithRequestWithFeesValidator{T}"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public InvoiceWithRequestWithFeesValidator(ILifetimeScope scope) : base(scope)
    {
        When(x => x.EnergyContracts is not null, () =>
        {
            When(x => EnergyContractIsOfType(x.EnergyContracts, EnergyContractType.PowerPurchaseAgreement), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(m => m.InvoiceEnergyFee).NotEmpty();
                RuleFor(m => m.InvoiceEnergyFee).SetValidator(new BaseDtoValidator<InvoiceEnergyFeeEntityDto>()!);
            });

            When(x => EnergyContractIsOfType(x.EnergyContracts, EnergyContractType.NetworkUsageContract), () =>
            {
                RuleFor(m => m.InvoiceDistributorFee).NotEmpty();
                RuleFor(m => m.InvoiceDistributorFee).SetValidator(new BaseDtoValidator<InvoiceDistributorFeeEntityDto>()!);
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Energys the type of the contract is of.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="energyContracts">The energy contracts.</param>
    /// <param name="contractType">Type of the contract.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private bool EnergyContractIsOfType(List<EntityRef<EnergyContractEntityDto>> energyContracts, EnergyContractType contractType)
    {
        var requestIds = energyContracts.Select(e => e.Id);
        return DbContext.Session.Query<EnergyContractEntity>().Any(e => requestIds.Contains(e.Id) && e.EnergyContractType == contractType);
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI\Models\EnergyPerformance\CreateRoomEnergeticDataRequestValidator.cs

using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Models;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Rooms;

/// <summary>
/// CreateRoomRequestValidator
/// </summary>

public class CreateRoomEnergeticDataRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<CreateRoomEnergeticDataRequest>
{
    public CreateRoomEnergeticDataRequestValidator()
    {

        RuleFor(x => x)
            .Must(CheckForAtLeastOneFilledOut)
            .WithMessage("Legalább egy nem-kötelező adatot szükséges kitölteni!");
    }

    private bool CheckForAtLeastOneFilledOut(CreateRoomEnergeticDataRequest request)
    {
        return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.OpeningsGlassThickness) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.IsItPossibleToUpgradeOpenings) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.HeatEmittersType) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.HeatEmittersRegulation) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ExistingMetersSensorsActuators) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.MeterInstallationConditions) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.DataConnectionConditions) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.EnsuringPowerSupply) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.RequiredForBasicSetup) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.RequiredForMediumSetup) ||
               !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.RequiredForFullSetup) ||
               request.RoomUsefulFloorArea != default ||
               request.RoomCeilingHeight != default ||
               request.RoomBoundaryAndOpeningStructuresSurfaceArea != default ||
               request.AllWindowArea != default ||
               request.LightnigIntensity != default ||
               request.LightingPowerConsumption != default ||
               request.HeatEmitterPerformance != default ||
               request.NumberOfHeatEmitters != default ||
               request.LightingControllability != default ||
               request.LightingType != default ||
               request.OpeningsShading != default ||
               request.OpeningsCondition != default ||
               request.WindowFrameAndDoorMaterial != default;
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI\Models\Locations\CreateSiteLocationRequestValidator.cs
====================================================================================================

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Locations.Requests.SiteLocation;
using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.Validators;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// CreateSiteLocationRequestValidator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;CreateSiteLocationRequest&gt;" />
public class CreateSiteLocationRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<CreateSiteLocationRequest>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Database context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDbContext _dbContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CreateSiteLocationRequestValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public CreateSiteLocationRequestValidator(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        RuleForEach(x => x.Devices).CustomAsync(DeviceBeUsable);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Devices the be usable.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="deviceEntityRef">The device entity reference.</param>
    /// <param name="context">The context.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    private async Task DeviceBeUsable(EntityRef<DeviceEntityDto> deviceEntityRef, CustomContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var device = await _dbContext.Session.GetAsync<DeviceEntity>(deviceEntityRef.Id, cancellationToken);
        if (device is null)
        {
            context.AddFailure(nameof(CreateSiteLocationRequest.Devices),
                $"Nem található eszköz {deviceEntityRef.Id} azonosítóval");
            return;
        }
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI\Models\Locations\SiteBasicModelValidator.cs
====================================================================================================

using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Validators.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Locations.Model;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// SiteBasicModelValidator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;SiteBasicModel&gt;" />
public class SiteBasicModelValidator : BaseDtoValidator<SiteBasicModel>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SiteBasicModelValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    /// <param name="tiDictCache">The ti dictionary cache.</param>
    /// <param name="kozteruletJellegCache">The kozterulet jelleg cache.</param>
    public SiteBasicModelValidator(Lazy<IQueryService> queryService, ILifetimeScope scope, TenantIndependentDictCache tiDictCache, StreetSuffixCache kozteruletJellegCache) : base()
    {
        When(x => x.Address is DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto, () => RuleFor(x => x.Address as DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDto).SetValidator(new DomesticLotNumberAddressEntityDtoValidator()!));
        When(x => x.Address is DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto, () => RuleFor(x => x.Address as DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDto).SetValidator(new DomesticNonPOBoxAddressEntityDtoValidator(tiDictCache, kozteruletJellegCache)!));
        When(x => x.Address is DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto, () => RuleFor(x => x.Address as DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDto).SetValidator(new DomesticPOBoxAddressEntityDtoValidator()!));
        When(x => x.Address is DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto, () => RuleFor(x => x.Address as DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDto).SetValidator(new DomesticPostOfficeNotificationAddressEntityDtoValidator()!));
        When(x => x.Address is ForeignAddressEntityDto, () => RuleFor(x => x.Address as ForeignAddressEntityDto).SetValidator(new ForeignAddressEntityDtoValidator()!));
    }
}

    public virtual string? ContactPersonName { get; set; }

    [DataMember]
    public virtual string? Telephone { get; set; }

    #region IGeoCoord

    /// Szélességi kör
    /// </summary>

    [DataMember]

    /// <summary>

    /// Cím (szövegesen)
    /// </summary>

    /// </summary>
    public double? Lat { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Hosszúsági kör
    /// </summary>
    public double? Lon { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// E-mail
    /// </summary>
    public string? EMail { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Telefonszám
    /// </summary>
    public string? Telephone { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kapcsolattartó neve
    /// </summary>
    public string? ContactPersonName { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Kapcsolattartó felhasználó
    /// </summary>
    public virtual EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>? ContactPerson { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény
    /// </summary>
    public virtual EntityRef<InstitutionEntityDto>? Institution { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Üzleti azonosító
    /// </summary>
    public string? BusinessIdentifier { get; set; }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Mappings.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// MeasuredEndpointMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class ChannelMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ChannelMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public ChannelMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<ChannelModel, ChannelEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<ChannelEntityDto, ChannelGuidRefsAndDeviceTypeModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredEndpointGuidRefs, y => y.MapFrom(z => new GuidEntityRef<ChannelEntityDto>()
            {
                Identifier = z.Identifier,
                EntityDisplayName = z.Name
            }));

        CreateMap<ChannelListItemDto, MinimalChannelListItemDtoModel>();

        CreateMap<ChannelListItemDto, ChannelMasterDataModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredProperty, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.MeasuredPropertyId.HasValue ? new EntityRef<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>() 
            { 
                Id = z.MeasuredPropertyId.Value,
                EntityDisplayName = z.MeasuredProperty
            }
                                                                                                  : null));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Mappings.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// DeviceConfigMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class DeviceConfigMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DeviceConfigMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public DeviceConfigMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<DeviceConfigModel, DeviceConfigEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<DeviceConfigEntityDto, DeviceConfigModel>();
        CreateMap<DeviceConfigModel, EntityRef<DeviceConfigModel>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name!);

        CreateMap<DeviceConfigCodeModel, DeviceConfigCodeDto>();
        CreateMap<DeviceConfigCodeDto, DeviceConfigCodeModel>();
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI\Models\Mappings\Devices\DeviceMappings.cs
====================================================================================================

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Commands.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Mappings.Devices;

/// <summary>
/// DeviceMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class DeviceMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DeviceMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public DeviceMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<DeviceModel, DeviceEntityDto>().ReverseMap();

        CreateMap<DeviceDto, SingleDeviceModel>();
        CreateMap<DeviceEntityDto, SyncDeviceModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.SerialNumber, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.SerialNumber))
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceTypeCode, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) =>
            {
                if (d.Configuration == null) d.Configuration = new List<ConfigValueModel>();
            });

        CreateMap<CreateDeviceRequest, DeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.IoTDeviceType, y => y.MapFrom(z => new IoTDeviceTypeEntityDto() { Id = z.IoTDeviceTypeId}))
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoint, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>() { Id = z.MeasurementPointId }));

        CreateMap<ModifyDeviceRequest, DeviceEntityDto>();

        CreateMap<DeviceEntityDto, EntityRef<DeviceModel>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        CreateMap<EntityRef<DeviceEntityDto>, EntityRef<DeviceModel>>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Id))
            .ForMember(x => x.EntityDisplayName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.EntityDisplayName));

        CreateMap<EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyEntityDto, EndpointUnitMetaDataPropertyModel>();
        
        CreateMap<CreateEndpointUnitRequest, CreateEndpointUnitCommand>()
            .ForMember(x => x.EntityTypeName, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<ModifyEndpointUnitRequest, ModifyEndpointUnitCommand>()
            .ForMember(x => x.EntityTypeName, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Id, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaModel, EndpointUnitMetaDataSchemaDto>();

        CreateMap<DeviceEntityDto, GuidEntityRef<DeviceModel>>()
            .CreateToGuidEntityRefMap(x => x.DeviceName!);

        CreateMap<CreateDeviceForOrgunitRequest, AddDeviceToOrgunitLocationCommand>();

        CreateMap<DeviceDto, GPSLocationModel>();

        //A eszköz típusa értéket egyenlőre nem tudjuk honnan, milyen értékkészletből kell szedni, addig is constans stringet adunk vissza.
        CreateMap<DeviceEntityDto, DeviceDtoModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceType, y => y.MapFrom(z => "Fogyasztás mérő"));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Shared.Types;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Commands.Emissions.Co2eFactor;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Emission;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Emissions.Requests;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Mappings.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// Co2eFactorMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class Co2eFactorMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="Co2eFactorMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public Co2eFactorMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<Co2eFactorModel, Co2eFactorEntityDto>();
        CreateMap<Co2eFactorEntityDto, Co2eFactorModel>();

        //CreateMap<Co2eFactorEntityDto, Co2eFactorListItemDto>(); backend handles

        //request -> query
        CreateMap<CreateCo2eFactorRequest, CreateCo2eFactorCommand>();
        CreateMap<ModifyCo2eFactorRequest, ModifyCo2eFactorCommand>()
            .ForMember(s => s.Co2eFactorId, d => d.Ignore());

        CreateMap<Co2eFactorDataTableRequest, Co2eFactorPagedEntityQuery>()
            //initialize pagination and sorting
            .ForMember(dest => dest.PagingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = src == null ? 10 : src.PageSize,
                StartPage = src == null ? 0 : src.StartPage
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SortingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = src == null ? nameof(Co2eFactorDataTableRequest.ValidFrom) : src.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = src == null ? SortDirection.Ascending : src.SortDirection
            }));

    }
}

            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<OrgunitBaseEntityDto>() { Id = z.OrgunitBaseId}))
                          .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoint, y => y.MapFrom(z =>
                                z.MeasurementPointId == 0
                                ? null
                                : new EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>() { Id = z.MeasurementPointId }
                            ));

        CreateMap<ModifyMeasurementPointRequest, ModifyMeasurementPointCommand>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.MapFrom(z => new EntityRef<OrgunitBaseEntityDto>() { Id = z.OrgunitBaseId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoint, y => y.MapFrom(z =>
                z.MeasurementPointId == 0
                    ? null
                    : new EntityRef<MeasurementPointEntityDto>() { Id = z.MeasurementPointId }
            ));

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointTableRequest, MeasurementPointPagedEntityQuery>()
            //initialize pagination and sorting
            .ForMember(dest => dest.PagingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = src == null ? 10 : src.PageSize,
                StartPage = src == null ? 0 : src.StartPage
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SortingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = src == null ? nameof(BuildingDataTableRequest.Name) : src.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = src == null ? SortDirection.Ascending : src.SortDirection
            }));

        CreateMap<MeasuredPropertyPairRequest, MeasurementPointSettingCommand>();

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointEntityDto, MeasurementPointPropertiesLabelsModel>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.MeasuredProperties, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.MeasuredProperties
                                                                  .Select(mp => mp.MeasuredPropertyName)
                                                                  .ToList()))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Labels, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Labels
                                                                  .Select(mp => mp.Value)
                                                                  .ToList()));

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointEntityDto, MeasurementPointModel>();

        CreateMap<OrgunitNameCascadeQueryResult, OrgunitParentsModel>()
            .ForMember(x => x.SiteName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Site.EntityDisplayName))
            .ForMember(x => x.InstiutionName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Institution.EntityDisplayName))
            .ForMember(x => x.BuildingPartName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.BuildingPart.EntityDisplayName))
            .ForMember(x => x.BuildingName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Building.EntityDisplayName))
            .ForMember(x => x.FloorName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Floor.EntityDisplayName))
            .ForMember(x => x.RoomName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Room.EntityDisplayName));

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsQueryResult, MeasurementPointParentOrgUnitsModel>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ResultItems, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.ResultItems))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Errors, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Errors));
    }
}

            .ForMember(x => x.Roles, y => y.Ignore())  // Ignore, vagy AfterMapping-gal mappoljuk az id lista alapján?

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Mappings.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// User mappings
/// </summary>
public class UserMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="UserMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public UserMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<SecUserEntityDto, SecUserListItemDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Email, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.EMail));
            //.ForMember(dest => dest.Identifier, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.GlobalId));

        //request -> query
        CreateMap<UserDataTableRequest, SecUserPagedEntityQuery>()
            //initialize pagination and sorting
            .ForMember(dest => dest.PagingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = src == null ? 10 : src.PageSize,
                StartPage = src == null ? 0 : src.StartPage
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SortingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = src == null ? nameof(UserDataTableRequest.LastName) : src.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = src == null ? SortDirection.Ascending : src.SortDirection
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.IsDeleted, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.IsActive.HasValue ? !src.IsActive.Value : (bool?)null));
    }

public class InstitutionValidityMappings : Profile

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="InstitutionValidityMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public InstitutionValidityMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<InstitutionValidityEntityDto, InstitutionValidityModel>().ReverseMap();

        CreateMap<CreateOrUpdateInstitutionValidityRequest, CreateInstitutionValidityCommand>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.InstitutionId, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) => d.SetValidityConvertToFullDay(s.ValidFrom, s.ValidTo));
        CreateMap<CreateOrUpdateInstitutionValidityRequest, ModifyInstitutionValidityCommand>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ValidityId, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((s, d) => d.SetValidityConvertToFullDay(s.ValidFrom, s.ValidTo));

        CreateMap<InstitutionValidityEntityDto, InstitutionValiditySyncModel>();
    }
}
