using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Locations.Requests.Building;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.MeasurementPoints.Requests;
public class CreateMeasurementPointRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<CreateMeasurementPointRequest>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// CreateMeasurementPointRequestValidator
    /// </summary>
    public CreateMeasurementPointRequestValidator()
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CreateMeasurementPointRequestValidator"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        RuleFor(x => x.PodId)
            .Matches(RegexConstants.PodIdRegex)
            .WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.PodId}' nem megfelelő POD-ID formátum.")
            .When(x => x.IsBilling);

        RuleFor(p => p.Lat)
            .InclusiveBetween(-90, 90)
            .When(p => p.Lat.HasValue)
            .WithMessage("A szélességi fok (Lat) értékének -90 és +90 között kell lennie.");

        RuleFor(p => p.Lon)
            .InclusiveBetween(-180, 180)
            .When(p => p.Lon.HasValue)
            .WithMessage("A hosszúsági fok (Lon) értékének -180 és +180 között kell lennie.");
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Framework\EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI\Models\ModelCatalogue\ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenRequestValidator.cs
====================================================================================================

using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.OneTimeToken;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.ModelCatalogue;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.UserManagement;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.ModelCatalogue;

/// <summary>
/// ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenRequestValidator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentValidation.AbstractValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.UserManagement.ModifyUserPasswordAndReNewTokenRequest&gt;" />
public class ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<ModifyUserPasswordAndReNewTokenRequest>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Database context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDbContext _dbContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// Is valid
    /// </summary>
    private bool isVAlid = false;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenRequestValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public ModifyUserPasswordAndRenewTokenRequestValidator(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword).NotNull().WithMessage("Az új jelszó megadása kötelező!");
        RuleFor(x => x.NewPasswordAgain).NotNull().WithMessage("Az új jelszó ismételt megadása kötelező!");

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword)
            .MinimumLength(12)
            .WithMessage("Az új jelszónak legalább 12 karakter hosszúnak kell lennie!")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword));

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPasswordAgain)
            .MustAsync(PwIsEqual)
            .WithMessage("Az ismételten megadott jelszó nem egyezik meg az eredetivel!")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPasswordAgain));

        //RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword)
        //     .MustAsync(SpecialChar)
        //     .WithMessage("A jelszónak legalább egy speciális karaktert tartalmaznia kell!")
        //     .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword));

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword)
            .MustAsync(SequentialChar)
            .WithMessage("A jelszó nem tartalmazhat egymást követő karaktereket! ")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword));

        //RuleSet("BackEnd", () =>
       // {
            RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword)
            .MustAsync(PassworInUsed)
            .WithMessage("A megadott jelszó megegyezik egy korábban regisztrált jelszóval!")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPasswordAgain) && isVAlid && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Token));
       // });
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Passwors the in used.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<bool> PassworInUsed(ModifyUserPasswordAndReNewTokenRequest request, string newPassword, CancellationToken token)
    {
        List<SecUserPasswordHistory> passwords = new List<SecUserPasswordHistory>();
        OneTimeTokenEntity secUser = null;
        using (var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope())
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.TenantCode))
            {
                tenantScope.SetAnonymousContext(request.TenantCode);
                var tenantDbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
                secUser = tenantDbContext.Session.Query<OneTimeTokenEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Token == request.Token)
                .SingleOrDefault();


                passwords = (List<SecUserPasswordHistory>)tenantDbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserPasswordHistory>()
                    .Where(x => x.User.Id == secUser.Id)
                    .OrderBy(x => x.PasswordChangeDate)
                    .Desc
                    .Take(5)
                    .List();
            }
            else
            {

                secUser = _dbContext.Session.Query<OneTimeTokenEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Token == request.Token)
            .SingleOrDefault();


                passwords = (List<SecUserPasswordHistory>)_dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserPasswordHistory>()
                    .Where(x => x.User.Id == secUser.Id)
                    .OrderBy(x => x.PasswordChangeDate)
                    .Desc
                    .Take(5)
                    .List();
            }
            
        }         

        if (passwords == null || !passwords.Any())
            return true;

        foreach(var pw in passwords.Select(x => x.Password))
        {
            if (PasswordHelper.VerifyPassword(pw, newPassword))
                return false;
        }

        return true;

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egymást követő karakterek ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<bool> SequentialChar(string newPassword, CancellationToken token)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < newPassword.Length - 2; i++)
            if (+newPassword[+i + 1] == +newPassword[i] + 1 &&
                +newPassword[+i + 2] == +newPassword[i] + 2) return isVAlid = false;

        return isVAlid = true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A jelszónak minimum egy speciális karaktert tartalmazni kell
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<bool> SpecialChar(string newPassword, CancellationToken token)
    {
         return isVAlid =  Regex.IsMatch(newPassword, "[~`!@#$%^&*()-_+={}[]|\\;:\"<>,./?]", RegexOptions.None, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000));        
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jelszó és jelszó ismétlés egyezőség ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="newPasswordAgain">The new password again.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<bool> PwIsEqual(ModifyUserPasswordAndReNewTokenRequest request, string newPasswordAgain, CancellationToken token)
    {
        return isVAlid = newPasswordAgain == request.NewPassword;
    }

   }

using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.ModelCatalogue;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.UserManagement;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.ModelCatalogue;

/// <summary>
/// ModifyUserPasswordRequestValidator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="FluentValidation.AbstractValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.UserManagement.ModifyUserPasswordRequest&gt;" />
public class ModifyUserPasswordRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<ModifyUserPasswordRequest>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Database context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IDbContext _dbContext;
    /// <summary>
    /// Is valid
    /// </summary>
    private readonly bool _isVAlid = false;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ModifyUserPasswordRequestValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public ModifyUserPasswordRequestValidator(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword).NotNull().WithMessage("Az új jelszó megadása kötelező!");
        RuleFor(x => x.NewPasswordAgain).NotNull().WithMessage("Az új jelszó ismételt megadása kötelező!");

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword)
            .MinimumLength(12)
            .WithMessage("Az új jelszónak legalább 12 karakter hosszúnak kell lennie!")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword));

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPasswordAgain)
            .Must(PwIsEqual)
            .WithMessage("Az ismételten megadott jelszó nem egyezik meg az eredetivel!")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPasswordAgain));

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword)
            .Must(SequentialChar)
            .WithMessage("A jelszó nem tartalmazhat egymást követő karaktereket! ")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword));

            RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword)
            .MustAsync(PassworInUsed)
            .WithMessage("A megadott jelszó megegyezik egy korábban regisztrált jelszóval!")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPasswordAgain) && _isVAlid);
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Passwors the in used.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<bool> PassworInUsed(ModifyUserPasswordRequest request, string? newPassword, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var passwords = await _dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserPasswordHistory>()
             .Where(x => x.User.Id == request.Id)
             .OrderBy(x => x.PasswordChangeDate)
             .Desc
             .Take(5)
             .ListAsync(token);

        if (passwords == null || !passwords.Any())
            return true;

        foreach(var pw in passwords.Select(x => x.Password))
        {
            if (PasswordHelper.VerifyPassword(pw, newPassword))
                return false;
        }

        return true;

    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egymást követő karakterek ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static bool SequentialChar(string? newPassword)
    {
        if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(newPassword)) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < newPassword.Length - 2; i++)
            if (+newPassword[+i + 1] == +newPassword[i] + 1 &&
                +newPassword[+i + 2] == +newPassword[i] + 2) return false;

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A jelszónak minimum egy speciális karaktert tartalmazni kell
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static bool SpecialChar(string newPassword)
    {
         return Regex.IsMatch(newPassword, "[~`!@#$%^&*()-_+={}[]|\\;:\"<>,./?]", RegexOptions.None, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000));        
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jelszó és jelszó ismétlés egyezőség ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="newPasswordAgain">The new password again.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static bool PwIsEqual(ModifyUserPasswordRequest request, string? newPasswordAgain)
    {
        return newPasswordAgain == request.NewPassword;
    }

   }

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Autofac;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Security;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.UserManagement;

/// <summary>
/// CreateUserRequestValidator
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Validators.BaseDtoValidator&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.UserManagement.CreateUserRequest&gt;" />
public class CreateUserRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<CreateUserRequest>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly Lazy<IQueryService> _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    ///Role cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly RoleCache _roleCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CreateUserRequestValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="roleCache">The role cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public CreateUserRequestValidator(
        Lazy<IQueryService> queryService,
        SecurityContext securityContext,
        RoleCache roleCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
        _roleCache = roleCache;
        _scope = scope;

        // Telefonszám
        RuleFor(p => p.Phone).Matches(RegexConstants.PhoneNumberRegex).WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.Phone}' nem megfelelő telefonszám-formátum.");

        // Email-cím
        RuleFor(p => p.EMail).Matches(RegexConstants.EmailAddress).WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.EMail}' nem megfelelő email cím-formátum.");
        RuleFor(m => m.EMail).MustAsync(CheckEMail).WithMessage(x => $"Ez az email cím már foglalt.");


    }

    ///// <summary>
    ///// Musts the have at least one site if role is site manager.
    ///// </summary>
    ///// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    ///// <param name="siteIds">The site ids.</param>
    ///// <returns></returns>
    //private bool MustHaveAtLeastOneSiteIfRoleIsSiteManager(CreateUserRequest request, int[]? siteIds)
    //{
    //    var siteManager = _roleCache.GetRoleByCode(_scope, nameof(SecRoleType.SiteManager));
    //    if (siteManager == null)
    //        return true;

    //    var hasSiteManagerRole = (request?.Roles?.Select(r => r.Id)?.Contains(siteManager.Id)) ?? false;
    //    if (!hasSiteManagerRole)
    //        return true;

    //    var hasSiteIds = siteIds?.Length > 0;
    //    return hasSiteIds;
    //}

    ///// <summary>
    ///// Musts the not have site managers.
    ///// </summary>
    ///// <param name="siteIds">The site ids.</param>
    ///// <returns></returns>
    //private bool MustNotHaveSiteManagers(int[]? siteIds)
    //{
    //    if (siteIds != null)
    //        foreach (var siteId in siteIds)
    //        {
    //            var site = _queryService.Value.GetById<SiteEntityDto>(siteId);
    //            //TODO:
    //            //if (site.SiteManager != null)
    //            //    return false;
    //        }

    //    return true;
    //}

    /// <summary>
    /// Email érvényesség ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="email">The email.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<bool> CheckEMail(CreateUserRequest request, string? email, CancellationToken token)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(email))
            return true;

        // Ha az email valakinek már van, akkor megnézzük, hogy az enyém-e
        var userList = await GetUsersByEmail(request, token);
        return userList == null || userList.Count == 0;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the users by email.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<IList<SecUserEntityDto>?> GetUsersByEmail(CreateUserRequest request, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        return (await _queryService.Value.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SecUserEntityQuery
        {
            TenantCode = tenantCode,
            EMail = request.EMail,
            IsDeleted = false
        }, token))?.Items;
    }


}

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Autofac;

using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;

{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly Lazy<IQueryService> _queryService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Security context
    /// </summary>
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;
    /// <summary>
    ///Role cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly RoleCache _roleCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentUserRequestValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    /// <param name="roleCache">The role cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public ModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentUserRequestValidator(
        Lazy<IQueryService> queryService,
        SecurityContext securityContext,
        RoleCache roleCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
        _roleCache = roleCache;
        _scope = scope;

        // Telefonszám
        RuleFor(p => p.Phone).Matches(RegexConstants.PhoneNumberRegex).WithMessage(x => $"A(z) '{x.Phone}' nem megfelelő telefonszám-formátum.");

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword).NotNull().WithMessage("Az új jelszó megadása kötelező!");
        RuleFor(x => x.NewPasswordAgain).NotNull().WithMessage("Az új jelszó ismételt megadása kötelező!");

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword)
            .MinimumLength(12)
            .WithMessage("Az új jelszónak legalább 12 karakter hosszúnak kell lennie!")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword));

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPasswordAgain)
            .Must(PwIsEqual)
            .WithMessage("Az ismételten megadott jelszó nem egyezik meg az eredetivel!")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPasswordAgain));

        RuleFor(x => x.NewPassword)
            .Must(SequentialChar)
            .WithMessage("A jelszó nem tartalmazhat egymást követő karaktereket! ")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.NewPassword));

    }

    //}

    //private bool MustNotHaveSiteManagers(int[]? siteIds)
    //{

    //            //if (site.SiteManager != null)
    //            //    return false;
    //        }

    //    return true;
    //}

    /// <summary>
    /// Email érvényesség ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="email">The email.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<bool> CheckEMail(CreateUserRequest request, string? email, CancellationToken token)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(email))
            return true;

        // Ha az email valakinek már van, akkor megnézzük, hogy az enyém-e
        var userList = await GetUsersByEmail(request, token);
        return userList == null || userList.Count == 0;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the users by email.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="token">The token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<IList<SecUserEntityDto>?> GetUsersByEmail(CreateUserRequest request, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode;
        return (await _queryService.Value.QueryEntitiesAsync(new SecUserEntityQuery
        {
            TenantCode = tenantCode,
            EMail = request.EMail,
            IsDeleted = false
        }, token))?.Items;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Egymást követő karakterek ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static bool SequentialChar(string newPassword)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < newPassword.Length - 2; i++)
            if (+newPassword[+i + 1] == +newPassword[i] + 1 &&
                +newPassword[+i + 2] == +newPassword[i] + 2) return false;

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A jelszónak minimum egy speciális karaktert tartalmazni kell
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="newPassword">The new password.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static bool SpecialChar(string newPassword)
    {
        return Regex.IsMatch(newPassword, "[~`!@#$%^&*()-_+={}[]|\\;:\"<>,./?]", RegexOptions.None, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1000));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jelszó és jelszó ismétlés egyezőség ellenőrzése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="newPasswordAgain">The new password again.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static bool PwIsEqual(ModifyNewlyRegisteredCurrentUserRequest request, string newPasswordAgain)
    {
        return newPasswordAgain == request.NewPassword;
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
using Common.EDM_Models.MasterData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock.Configuration;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock;

public class MasterdataMockService
{
    private readonly MockConfig _mockConfig;


    public MasterdataMockService(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _mockConfig = configuration.GetValue<MockConfig>("MockConfig") ?? new MockConfig();
    }

    // Adjusted caching logic for MemoryCache
    private static readonly MemoryCache _podsCache = new(new MemoryCacheOptions());
    private static T GetFromCache<T>(MemoryCache cache, string key, Func<T> factory)
    {
        if (cache.TryGetValue(key, out T value))
        {
            return value;
        }
        var newValue = factory();
        cache.Set(key, newValue);
        return newValue;
    }

    public async Task<MasterDataResponse> GetMockData(IEnumerable<string> podNos)
    {
        var resultCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxResultCount);
        var channelCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxChannelCount);
        var result = new MasterDataResponse
        {
            UnknownPods = podNos.Where(x => x.Contains("unk", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)).ToList()
        };

        var knownPodNames = podNos.Except(result.UnknownPods).ToList();
        foreach (var podName in knownPodNames)
        {
            //cache the created pod, so the next request with the same id will return the same pod object
            EdmDeviceModel pod = GetFromCache(_podsCache, podName, () => CreateMockPod(resultCount, channelCount, podName));
            result.KnownPods.Add(pod);
        }

        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return result;
    }

    private EdmDeviceModel CreateMockPod(int resultCount, int channelCount, string podName)
    {
        var pod = new EdmDeviceModel(podName);
        var obisKeys = OBISCodeDict.Keys.ToArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < resultCount; i++)
        {
            DateOnly fromDate = GetRandomDateOnly()!.Value;
            var device = new EdmDeviceDetails
            {
                DeviceType = GetRandomDeviceType(),
                SerialNumber = GetRandomSN(),
                InstallationDate = fromDate,
                RemovalDate = GetRandomDateOnly(_mockConfig.DeviceRemovalDateNullable, fromDate), //if DeviceRemovalDateNullable==true, then about 50% of the dates will be null                    
                DataChannels = []
            };
            for (int j = 0; j < channelCount; j++)
            {
                // Deterministic channelId and obiscode based on podName, device index, and channel index - instead of random, so test results can be repeated
                int channelId = 1 + (DeterministicHash($"{podName}:{i}:{j}") % 99); // 1-99
                int obisIndex = DeterministicHash($"obis:{podName}:{i}:{j}") % obisKeys.Length;
                var obiscode = obisKeys[obisIndex];
                var obisCodeValue = OBISCodeDict[obiscode];
                device.DataChannels.Add(new EdmDataChannel
                {
                    ObisCode = obiscode,
                    DataChannelId = channelId,
                    DataChannel = $"mock_{obisCodeValue}",
                    IntegrationPeriod = "10",
                    Unit = GetRandomUnit()
                });
            }
            pod.Devices.Add(device);
        }
        return pod;
    }

    // Deterministic hash function for consistent results (Java String hashCode algorithm)
    private static int DeterministicHash(string input)
    {
        unchecked
        {
            int hash = 23;
            foreach (char c in input)
            {
                hash = hash * 31 + c;
            }
            return Math.Abs(hash);
        }
    }

    private string GetRandomDeviceType()
    {
        return Random.Shared.GetItems(_mockConfig.PossibleDeviceTypes, 1).FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private string GetRandomUnit()
    {
        return Random.Shared.GetItems(_mockConfig.PossibleUnits, 1).FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
    }


    private string GetRandomSN()
    {
        return Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
    }

    private static DateOnly? GetRandomDateOnly(bool nullable = false, DateOnly? minimumDate = null)
    {
        if (nullable)
        {
            if (Random.Shared.Next(0, 100) > 50)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
        //because if we're randomizing the "to" value for a "from-to" range, then the "to" must be larger, than the "from"
        DateTime rndDate = minimumDate.HasValue
            ? DateTime.Today.AddDays(Random.Shared.Next(1, 365))
            : DateTime.Today.AddDays(Random.Shared.Next(-365, 365));
        return DateOnly.FromDateTime(rndDate);
    }

    // found a possible specification of OBIS codes: https://onemeter.com/docs/device/obis/#summary-codes
    //we can use a nice 
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> OBISCodeDict = new()
    {
        { "1-0:1.8.0", "A+" },
        {"1-0:2.8.0", "A-" },
        {"1-0:1.7.0", "A+ (T1)" },
    //{ "1.8.0", "A+" },
    //{ "1.8.1", "A+ (T1)" },
    //{ "1.8.2", "A+ (T2)" },
    //{ "1.8.3", "A+ (T3)" },
    //{ "1.8.4", "A+ (T4)" },
    //{ "2.8.0", "A-" },
    //{ "2.8.1", "A- (T1)" },
    //{ "2.8.2", "A- (T2)" },
    //{ "2.8.3", "A- (T3)" },
    //{ "2.8.4", "A- (T4)" },
    //{ "15.8.0/F.8.0", "|A|" },
    //{ "15.8.1/F.8.1", "|A| (T1)" },
    //{ "15.8.2/F.8.2", "|A| (T2)" },
    //{ "15.8.3/F.8.3", "|A| (T3)" },
    //{ "15.8.4/F.8.4", "|A| (T4)" },
    //{ "21.8.0", "A+ (L1)" },
    //{ "41.8.0", "A+ (L2)" },
    //{ "61.8.0", "A+ (L3)" },
    //{ "22.8.0", "A- (L1)" },
    //{ "42.8.0", "A- (L2)" },
    //{ "62.8.0", "A- (L3)" },
    //{ "35.8.0", "|A| (L1)" },
    //{ "55.8.0", "|A| (L2)" },
    //{ "75.8.0", "|A| (L3)" }
    };

}

using Common.EDM_Models.Measurement;
using Common.EDM_Models.MeteorologyData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock.Configuration;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock.Services;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock;


public class MeasurementsMockService
{

    private readonly MockConfig _mockConfig;

    private readonly Dictionary<Guid, (DateTime Start, DateTime End)> _guidDatePairs = [];

    private readonly Dictionary<Guid, (int DataChannelId, DateTime Start, DateTime End)> _guidChannelDatePairs = [];

    private readonly MockDataService _mockDataService;

    public MeasurementsMockService(IConfiguration configuration, MockDataService mockDataService)
    {
        _mockConfig = configuration.GetValue<MockConfig>("MockConfig") ?? new MockConfig();
        _mockDataService = mockDataService;

        if (!_mockDataService.Initialized)
            _mockDataService.InitializeInMemoryMockData();
    }

    public async Task<Guid> GetMockDataRequestId(int dataChannelId, DateTime from, DateTime to)
    {
        to = to.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);
        var generatedGuid = Guid.NewGuid();
        _guidChannelDatePairs.Add(generatedGuid, (dataChannelId, from, to));
        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return generatedGuid;
    }

    public async Task<List<MeasurementResponseModel>?> GetMockData(Guid guid)
    {
        if (!_guidChannelDatePairs.TryGetValue(guid, out (int DataChannelId, DateTime Start, DateTime End) data))
        {
            return null;
        }

        List<MeasurementResponseModel> result = [];
        if (data.DataChannelId == 0)
            return result;

        var rawData = _mockDataService.QueryDataByChannel(data.DataChannelId, data.Start, data.End);
        if (rawData is null || !rawData.Any())
        {
            return result;
        }

        // we'll batch the raw data by days and add as many items in the result, each day having probably several measurements

        // Ensure rawData is ordered by MeasurementTime before batching
        var orderedRawData = rawData.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementTime).ToList();
        var batch = new MeasurementResponseModel
        {
            DataChannelId = data.DataChannelId, //fixed
            Measurements = [],
            PodIdentifier = null, //TODO...
        };

        int dayOfYear = orderedRawData.First().MeasurementTime.DayOfYear;
        foreach (var item in orderedRawData)
        {
            if (item.MeasurementTime.DayOfYear != dayOfYear)
            {
                dayOfYear = item.MeasurementTime.DayOfYear;
                //new day, add the previous batch to the result
                result.Add(batch);
                //start a new batch
                batch = new MeasurementResponseModel
                {
                    DataChannelId = data.DataChannelId, //fixed
                    Measurements = [],
                };
            }
            batch.Measurements.Add(
                new MeasurementDataModel
                {
                    MeasurementDate = item.MeasurementTime,
                    State = GetRandomState(),
                    Value = item.Value
                });
        }
        // Add the last batch 
        result.Add(batch);
        
        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return result;


        //---------------OLD:
        /*var resultCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxResultCount);
        for (int i = 0; i < resultCount; i++)
        {
            var item = new MeasurementResponseModel
            {
                DataChannelId = data.DataChannelId, //fixed
                Measurements = [],
            };

            var measurementCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxMeasurementCount);
            for (int j = 0; j < measurementCount; j++)
            {
                item.Measurements.Add(
                    new MeasurementDataModel
                    {
                        MeasurementDate = GetRandomDateTime(data.Start, data.End),
                        State = GetRandomState(),
                        Value = Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 99.9d //TODO: range of randomized value
                    });
            }
            item.Measurements = item.Measurements.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToList(); //nicer, than random order
            result.Add(item);
        }

        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return result;*/
    }

    public async Task<Guid> GetMeteorologyDataRequestId(DateTime from, DateTime to)
    {
        to = to.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);
        var generatedGuid = Guid.NewGuid();
        _guidDatePairs.Add(generatedGuid, (from, to));
        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return generatedGuid;
    }

    public async Task<MeteoResponseModel?> GetMeteorologyDataById(Guid guid)
    {
        if (!_guidDatePairs.TryGetValue(guid, out (DateTime Start, DateTime End) interval))
        {
            return null;
        }

        var result = new MeteoResponseModel
        {
            Data = [],
        };

        var resultCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxResultCount);
        for (int i = 0; i < resultCount; i++)
        {
            var meteoReading = new MeteoReading
            {
                Timestamp = GetRandomDateTime(interval.Start, interval.End),
                MeteoParams = []
            };

            var measurementCount = Random.Shared.Next(1, _mockConfig.MaxMeasurementCount);
            for (int j = 0; j < measurementCount; j++)
            {
                meteoReading.MeteoParams.Add(
                    new MeteorologyDataModel
                    {
                        Temperature = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 80d - 20, 1), // Range: -20 to 60°C
                        Humidity = Random.Shared.Next(0, 101), // Range: 0% to 100%
                        AmountOfPrecipitation = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 50, 1), // Range: 0 to 50 mm
                        SolarRadiation = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 1200, 1), // Range: 0 to 1200 W/m²
                        AtmosphericPressure = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 50 + 950, 1), // Range: 950 to 1000 hPa
                        WindSpeed = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 40, 1), // Range: 0 to 40 m/s
                        WindDirection = Random.Shared.Next(0, 360), // Range: 0 to 359 degrees
                        EarthTemperature = Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 50d - 10, 1) // Range: -10 to 40°C
                    });
            }
            result.Data.Add(meteoReading);
        }

        result.Data = result.Data.OrderBy(x => x.Timestamp).ToList(); //nicer, than random order

        await Task.CompletedTask; //fake async
        return result;
    }

    private string GetRandomState()
    {
        return Random.Shared.GetItems(_mockConfig.PossibleStates, 1).FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private static DateTime GetRandomDateTime(DateTime start, DateTime end)
    {
        long range = (end - start).Ticks;
        return new DateTime(start.Ticks + (long)(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * range));
    }
}

using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Serilog;
using Common.EDM_Models.MasterData;
using Common.EDM_Models.Measurement;
using Common.EDM_Models.MeteorologyData;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock.Configuration;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock;

public class Program
{
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

        // Configure Serilog
        builder.Host.UseSerilog((context, configuration) =>
            configuration.ReadFrom.Configuration(context.Configuration));

        // Add services to the container.
        builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

        // Learn more about configuring Swagger/OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/swashbuckle
        builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
        builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();
        builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();
        builder.Services.Configure<MockConfig>(builder.Configuration.GetSection("MockConfig"));


        builder.Services.AddSingleton<MockDataService>();
        builder.Services.AddScoped<MasterdataMockService>();
        builder.Services.AddSingleton<MeasurementsMockService>();

        // Configure JSON options for minimal API
        builder.Services.ConfigureHttpJsonOptions(options =>
        {
            options.SerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonStringEnumConverter());
        });


        var app = builder.Build();

        Log.Information($"EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock Service - v{GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(Program))}");
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)) Log.Information($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Linux}");
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)) Log.Information($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Windows}");

        app.UsePathBase("/api/v1"); // as of SGC fix 2025-05-20

        // Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
        if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
        {
            app.UseSwagger();
            app.UseSwaggerUI();
        }

        app.UseHttpsRedirection();

        app.UseAuthorization();


        app.MapGet("/master-data", async (MasterdataMockService masterdataService, [FromQuery] string podNos) =>
        {
            podNos ??= "";
            MasterDataResponse data = await masterdataService.GetMockData(podNos.Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries));
            return Results.Ok(data);
        })
        .Produces<MasterDataResponse>(StatusCodes.Status200OK)
        .WithName("GetMasterData")
        .WithOpenApi();


        app.MapPost("/measurements", async (MeasurementsMockService measurementService, int dataChannelId, DateTime start, DateTime end, bool forceRefresh = false) =>
        {
            if (start > end)
            {
                return Results.BadRequest(new { Error = "From date must not be larger than To date!" });
            }

            if (forceRefresh) //fake delay 30-60 sec
            {
                await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(30000, 60000));
            }

            Guid uuid = await measurementService.GetMockDataRequestId(dataChannelId, start, end);
            return Results.Ok(new UuidResponse(uuid));
        })
        .Produces<UuidResponse>(StatusCodes.Status200OK)
        .WithName("GetMeasurementsRequestId")
        .WithOpenApi();

        app.MapGet("/measurements", async (MeasurementsMockService measurementService, Guid guid) =>
        {
            IList<MeasurementResponseModel> data = await measurementService.GetMockData(guid);

            return Results.Ok(data);
        })
        .Produces<IList<MeasurementResponseModel>>(StatusCodes.Status200OK)
        .WithName("GetMeasurements")
        .WithOpenApi();

        app.MapPost("/meteo-data", async (MeasurementsMockService measurementService, Guid institutionId, string lat, string lng, DateTime start, DateTime end, bool forceRefresh = false) =>
        {
            if (start > end)
            {
                return Results.BadRequest(new { Error = "From date must not be larger than To date!" });
            }

            if ((end - start).TotalDays > 365)
            {
                return Results.BadRequest(new { Error = "More than 1 year difference is not allowed between \"To\" and \"From\" date" });
            }

            if (forceRefresh) //fake delay 10-20 sec
            {
                await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(10000, 20000));
            }

            Guid uuid = await measurementService.GetMeteorologyDataRequestId(start, end);
            return Results.Ok(new UuidResponse(uuid));
        })
        .Produces<UuidResponse>(StatusCodes.Status200OK)
        .WithName("GetMeterologyDataRequestId")
        .WithOpenApi();

        app.MapGet("/meteo-data", async (MeasurementsMockService measurementService, Guid id, bool ignoreCache = false) =>
        {
            if (ignoreCache) //fake delay 10-20 sec
            {
                await Task.Delay(Random.Shared.Next(10000, 20000));
            }

            var result = await measurementService.GetMeteorologyDataById(id);

            return Results.Ok(result);
        })
        .Produces<MeteoResponseModel>(StatusCodes.Status200OK)
        .WithName("GetMeterologyData")
        .WithOpenApi();

#if DEBUG
        // Generate mock data files if the command line argument is present - as files are included in the build, they should be deployed, so no need to regenerate every time, we can use the same data everywhere.
        if (Environment.GetCommandLineArgs().Contains("generatemockfiles"))
        {
            var mockDataService = app.Services.GetRequiredService<MockDataService>();
            mockDataService.GenerateYearlyMockDataFiles(MockDataService.MockDataDirectory);
        }
#endif

        app.Run();
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the informational version of the specified type's assembly.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="type">The type to get the assembly from.</param>
    /// <returns>The informational version or the file version if informational version is not available.</returns>
    private static string GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(Type type)
    {
        var assembly = type.Assembly;
        string version = assembly
            .GetCustomAttribute<AssemblyInformationalVersionAttribute>()?
            .InformationalVersion
            ?? assembly.GetName().Version?.ToString()
            ?? "1.0.0";

        return version;
    }

    private record UuidResponse(Guid uuid);

}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.EDM.WebAPI.Mock.Services;

public class MockDataService(IOptions<MockConfig> mockConfig)
{
    public const string MockDataDirectory = "./App_Data/MockDataFiles";

    /*
     TODO: elérkezett az idő, hogy olyan adatokat mockoljunk, ami már nem random generált értékeket ad vissza egy adatsorban, hanem
     egy előre legenerált pl. éves adatsorból ad vissza a kérésnek megfelelően az intervallum és channel alapján.

    használat: 
    - egyszer legeneráljuk az adatsort tartalmazó fájlokat, ezek aztán már minden buildben benne lesznek.
    - a "generatemockfiles" paraméteres szekcióra nincs is szükség a kitelepített verzióban, a kész fájlok ott lesznek.
    - lekéréskor a memóriába betöltött adatokból adunk vissza.
    - speciális logika: 
      - mivel csak 0-9-ig generálunk channeleket, minden egyéb channel id-nak csak az utolsó számjegyét vesszük. pl. channel 123 -> 3, 457 -> 7, stb.
      - az adatgenerálás csak egy teljes évet tartalmazott. ha ez előtt vagy utáni dátumot kérnek le, akkor is úgy adjuk vissza az értéket, mintha a kért évben lenne, nem pedig az aktuálisban.
        (tehát 2022.02.03. kéréshez a 2025.02.03. adatait adjuk vissza, mert 2025-ben generáltuk a listát)
      - viszont a kért tartományban egy teljes adatsort vissza kell adni, így meg kell ismételni az adatokat, ha átnyúlik éveken a kért tartomány

     */

    private List<ChannelMeasurements> _inMemoryMockData = [];
    public IReadOnlyList<ChannelMeasurements> InMemoryMockData => _inMemoryMockData;
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<int, List<MeasurementRecord>> InMemoryChannelData =>
        InMemoryMockData.ToDictionary(cm => cm.ChannelId, cm => cm.Measurements).AsReadOnly();

    public bool Initialized { get; private set; } = false;
    public void InitializeInMemoryMockData()
    {
        _inMemoryMockData.Clear();
        var files = Directory.GetFiles(MockDataDirectory, "channel_*.csv");

        string pattern = @"channel_(\d+)";
        foreach (var file in files)
        {
            string fn = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file);
            var channelId = int.Parse(Regex.Match(fn, pattern).Groups[1].Value);
            var channelData = LoadFromFile(file, channelId);
            _inMemoryMockData.Add(channelData);
        }

        Initialized = true;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// A memóriában tárolt mock adatokból lehet lekérdezni. Viszont speciálisan kezeljük az évet, mivel csak 1 évnyi adatot mockolunk. 
    /// Ha a kért időszak kívül esik, akkor úgy teszünk, mintha az előző vagy a következő évben is ugyanezek az adatok lennének.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="channelId">only the last digit is used!!! we only mocked 10 channels (0-9)</param>
    /// <param name="start">this date is inclusive</param>
    /// <param name="end">this date is exlusive</param>

    public IEnumerable<MeasurementRecord> QueryDataByChannel(int channelId, DateTime start, DateTime end)
    {
        if (!Initialized)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("You must call InitializeInMemoryMockData method first");
        }
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThanOrEqual(start, end);


        // Only channels 0-9 are valid, so we take the last digit
        int actualChannelId = channelId % 10;


        int storedYear = InMemoryChannelData[actualChannelId].FirstOrDefault()?.MeasurementTime.Year
            ?? throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("No data available for the specified channel.");
        //should be the same for the end, as generated data is 1 complete year!

        //split request range by years:
        List<(DateTime start, DateTime end)> yearlyBatches = SplitByYear(start, end);
        foreach (var yearBatch in yearlyBatches)
        {
            DateTime adjustedStart = new DateTime(
                storedYear, yearBatch.start.Month, yearBatch.start.Day,
                yearBatch.start.Hour, yearBatch.start.Minute, yearBatch.start.Second, yearBatch.start.Millisecond,
                DateTimeKind.Unspecified);
            DateTime adjustedEnd = new DateTime(
                storedYear, yearBatch.end.Month, yearBatch.end.Day,
                yearBatch.end.Hour, yearBatch.end.Minute, yearBatch.end.Second, yearBatch.end.Millisecond,
                DateTimeKind.Unspecified);

            var batchResult = InMemoryChannelData[actualChannelId]
                .Where(m => m.MeasurementTime >= adjustedStart && m.MeasurementTime < adjustedEnd)
                .OrderBy(m => m.MeasurementTime);

            foreach (var x in batchResult)
            {
                //adjust the years of the result
                int yearDiff = yearBatch.start.Year - storedYear;
                yield return MeasurementRecord.Shift(x, yearDiff);
            }
        }
    }

    public static List<(DateTime Start, DateTime End)> SplitByYear(DateTime start, DateTime end)
    {
        var result = new List<(DateTime Start, DateTime End)>();

        for (int year = start.Year; year <= end.Year; year++)
        {
            DateTime batchStart = year == start.Year
                ? start
                : new DateTime(year, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Unspecified);

            DateTime batchEnd = year == end.Year
                ? end
                : new DateTime(year, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0).AddYears(1).AddTicks(-1); // precise max time for the year

            result.Add((batchStart, batchEnd));
        }

        return result;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Generates a series of randomized data points within a specified time range, with 15 minutes increments.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="start">the first item in the series</param>
    /// <param name="end">this is exlusively the end of the series. this timestamp will not appear in the results</param>
    public static IEnumerable<MeasurementRecord> GetRandomizedDataSeries(DateTime start, DateTime end, double minValue, double maxValue)
    {
        var interval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15); //15 perces gyakoriságú adatokat fogunk generálni
        var current = start;
        while (current < end)
        {
            yield return new MeasurementRecord(current, Random.Shared.NextDouble() * (maxValue - minValue) + minValue);
            current += interval;
        }
    }

    public record MeasurementRecord(DateTime MeasurementTime, double Value)
    {
        public string ToCsvLine()
        => string.Format("{0:o};{1}",
                         MeasurementTime, //ISO 8601 format
                         Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) //enforced dot as decimal separator
            );

        public static MeasurementRecord FromString(string s)
        {
            var parts = s.Split(';');
            return parts.Length != 2
                ? throw new FormatException("Invalid format for MeasurementRecord. Expected 'Time;Value' format.")
                : new MeasurementRecord(DateTime.Parse(parts[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                                         double.Parse(parts[1], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        }

        public static MeasurementRecord Shift(MeasurementRecord original, int yearDiff)
            => new(original.MeasurementTime.AddYears(yearDiff), original.Value);
    }

    public record ChannelMeasurements(int ChannelId, List<MeasurementRecord> Measurements);

    public static void SaveToFile(string path, ChannelMeasurements channelData)
    {
        using var writer = File.CreateText(path);
        foreach (var measurement in channelData.Measurements)
        {
            writer.WriteLine(measurement.ToCsvLine());
        }
        writer.Flush();
    }

    public ChannelMeasurements LoadFromFile(string path, int channelId)
    {
        if (File.Exists(path))
        {

            var measurements = new List<MeasurementRecord>();
            using var reader = File.OpenText(path);
            string? line;
            while ((line = reader.ReadLine()) != null)
            {
                measurements.Add(MeasurementRecord.FromString(line));
            }
            return new ChannelMeasurements(channelId, measurements);
        }
        else
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("The specified file does not exist.", path);
        }
    }


    public void GenerateYearlyMockDataFiles(string targetDir)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(targetDir))
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(targetDir);
        }

        var startDate = new DateTime(DateTime.Now.Year, 1, 1);
        var endDate = startDate.AddYears(1).AddTicks(-1);

        for (int channelId = 0; channelId <= 9; channelId++) // Generating 10 channels as an example
        {
            double min = mockConfig.Value.ChannelMinMaxRanges.TryGetValue(channelId, out var range) ? range.min : 0;
            double max = mockConfig.Value.ChannelMinMaxRanges.TryGetValue(channelId, out range) ? range.max : 1000;

            var measurements = GetRandomizedDataSeries(startDate, endDate, min, max).ToList();
            var channelData = new ChannelMeasurements(channelId, measurements);
            string filePath = Path.Combine(targetDir, $"channel_{channelId}.csv");
            SaveToFile(filePath, channelData);
        }
    }
}

﻿using FluentAssertions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Model.WebAPI.Test;

public static class FrameworkTestBaseExt
{
    private const string LoginUrl = "/api/apiauthenticate/auth";

    public static async Task RunTestAsAdmin(Func<HttpClient, Task> testFunction)
    {
        await RunTestAsUser(testFunction, "ZeBgOaUca");
    }

    public static async Task RunTestAsUser(Func<HttpClient, Task> testFunction, string apiKey)
    {
        var application = new WebApplicationFactory<Program>();
        HttpClient? client = null;
        try
        {
            client = await GetClient(application, apiKey);
            await testFunction(client);
        }
        finally
        {
            client?.Dispose();
            await application.DisposeAsync();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns with a HttpClient instance.
    /// </summary>
    private static async Task<HttpClient> GetClient(WebApplicationFactory<Program> application, string apiKey)
    {
        var client = application.CreateClient();
        // Login
        var loginAsAdminResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(LoginUrl, new APIAuthModel
        {
            APIKey = apiKey
        });

        loginAsAdminResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        var content = await loginAsAdminResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        var token = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<AuthModel>(content);
        token.Should().NotBeNull();
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " + token!.Token);
        return client;
    }
}

    #region Checkers
    /// <summary>
    /// Egy friss DTO model catalogue és egy adatbázisból lekért model catalogue összehasonlítása, hogy
    /// a mezők egyeznek-e.
    /// </summary>
    private void CheckModelCatalogue(ModelCatalogueEntityDto source, ModelCatalogueEntityDto? result)
    {
        result.Should().NotBeNull();

        source.Should().BeEquivalentTo(result, o => o
            .EntityDtoAssertion()
            .Excluding(x => x!.Identifier)

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Net.Mime;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Antlr.Runtime.Misc;
using Common.Shared.Models.Authentication;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Authentication;
using FluentAssertions;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Test;

public static class FrameworkTestBaseExt
{
    private const string LoginUrl = "/api/authenticate/login";

    public static async Task RunTestAsAdmin(Func<HttpClient, Task> testFunction)
    {
        await RunTestAsUser(testFunction, "admin@dev", "Abc12345");
    }

    public static async Task RunTestAsUser(Func<HttpClient, Task> testFunction, string username, string password)
    {
        var application = new WebApplicationFactory<Program>();
        HttpClient? client = null;
        try
        {
            client = await GetClient(application, username, password);
            await testFunction(client);
        }
        finally
        {
            client?.Dispose();
            await application.DisposeAsync();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns with a HttpClient instance.
    /// </summary>
    private static async Task<HttpClient> GetClient(WebApplicationFactory<Program> application, string username,
        string password)
    {
        var client = application.CreateClient();
        // Login
        var loginAsAdminResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(LoginUrl, new LoginModel
        {
            Email = username,
            Password = password
        });

        loginAsAdminResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        var content = await loginAsAdminResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        var token = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<AuthModel>(content);
        token.Should().NotBeNull();
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", "Bearer " + token!.Token);
        return client;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// POST body with correct derived type property
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task<HttpResponseMessage> PostWithDerivedProperty(this HttpClient client, string requestUri, object content)
    {
        var strContent = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(content);        
        return await client.PostAsync(requestUri, new StringContent(strContent, Encoding.UTF8, MediaTypeNames.Application.Json));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// PUT body with correct derived type property
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task<HttpResponseMessage> PutWithDerivedProperty(this HttpClient client, string requestUri, object content)
    {
        var strContent = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(content);        
        return await client.PutAsync(requestUri, new StringContent(strContent, Encoding.UTF8, MediaTypeNames.Application.Json));
    }
}

    //    return newEntity;
    //}
    
    private async Task<SiteModel> CreateNewSite(HttpClient client, string? name = null, AddressEntityDto? address = null,
        double? latValue = null, double? longValue = null)
    {
        CountryCache tiCache = Scope.Resolve<CountryCache>();
        var mo = tiCache.GetByCode("HU");

        if (address == null)
            address = new IncompleteAddressEntityDto { ComplexAddress = "TestCreate", /*Country = new EntityRef<CountryEntityDto> { Id = mo.Id, EntityDisplayName = mo.Name }*/ };

        name ??= Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        latValue ??= RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(-180, 180);
        longValue ??= RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(-180, 180);

        // Step 1. - Create Site
        var createResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(SiteUrl, new CreateSiteRequest
        {
            Name = name,
            Lat = (double) latValue,
            Lon = (double) longValue,
            Address = address
        });
        var createContent = await createResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        createResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        createContent.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        // A frissen lekérdezése
        var newEntity = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SiteModel>(createContent);
        newEntity.Should().NotBeNull();
        newEntity!.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);
        return newEntity;
    }
    
}

        var siteModel = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SiteModel>(content);
        siteModel.Should().NotBeNull();

    /// <summary>
    /// DELETE Site Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task DeleteSiteAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var newId = (await CreateNewSite(client)).Id;

        // Delete Site test
        var deleteResponse = await client.DeleteAsync(SiteUrl + "/" + newId);
        var content = await deleteResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        deleteResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        var deleteCommandResult = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<DeleteSiteCommandResult>(content);
        deleteCommandResult.Should().NotBeNull();
        deleteCommandResult!.IsSuccess.Should().BeTrue();
    }

    private async Task<SiteModel> CreateNewSite(HttpClient client, string? name = null, AddressEntityDto? address = null,
        double? latValue = null, double? longValue = null)
    {
        name ??= Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        CountryCache tiCache = Scope.Resolve<CountryCache>();
        var mo = tiCache.GetByCode("HU");

        if (address == null)
            address = new IncompleteAddressEntityDto { ComplexAddress = "TestModify", /*Country = new EntityRef<CountryEntityDto> { Id = mo.Id, EntityDisplayName = mo.Name }*/ };

        latValue ??= RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(-180, 180);
        longValue ??= RandomHelper.GetRandomInt(-180, 180);

        // Step 1. - Create Site
        var createResponse = await client.PostWithDerivedProperty(SiteUrl, new CreateSiteRequest
        {
            Name = name,
            Lat = (double) latValue,
            Lon = (double) longValue,
            Address = address
        });
        var createContent = await createResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        createResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        createContent.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        // A frissen lekérdezése
        var newEntity = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SiteModel>(createContent);
        newEntity.Should().NotBeNull();
        newEntity!.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);
        return newEntity;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using FluentAssertions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.BackEnd.DomainModel.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Test.Infrastructure;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Test.Services;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class ServiceTest : FrameworkTestBase
{
    private const string ServiceUrl = "/api/services";

    public ServiceTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture) : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
    }

    [Fact]
#pragma warning disable S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    public async Task GetServicesTest()
#pragma warning restore S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    {
        await FrameworkTestBaseExt.RunTestAsAdmin(GetServicesAsync);
    }

    private async Task GetServicesAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        await CreateNewService();

        var response = await client.GetAsync(ServiceUrl);
        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        var serviceModels = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<List<ServiceModel>>(content);
        serviceModels.Should().NotBeNull().And.HaveCountGreaterThan(0);
    }

    private async Task<int> CreateNewService()
    {
        var newService = new ServicesEntity {Id = 0, Name = $"Name-{Guid.NewGuid()}", Code = 1};
        var dbContext = Scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        int? id;
        using (var transaction = dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction())
        {
            id = (int) await dbContext.Session.SaveAsync(newService);
            await transaction.CommitAsync();
        }

        return (int) id;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using FluentAssertions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Models.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Test.Infrastructure;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Test.System;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class DictItemTest : FrameworkTestBase
{
    private const string DictItemUrl = "/api/dictitems";

    public DictItemTest(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture) 
        : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
    }

    [Fact]
#pragma warning disable S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    public async Task GetDictItemTest()
#pragma warning restore S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    {
        await FrameworkTestBaseExt.RunTestAsAdmin(GetDictItemAsync);
    }

    [Fact]
#pragma warning disable S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    public async Task ModifyDictItemTest()
#pragma warning restore S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    {
        await FrameworkTestBaseExt.RunTestAsAdmin(ModifyDictItemAsync);
    }

    [Fact]
#pragma warning disable S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    public async Task ModifyDictItemTestWhenSystem()
#pragma warning restore S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    {
        await FrameworkTestBaseExt.RunTestAsAdmin(ModifyDictItemWhenSystemAsync);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// GET DictItem test (Get one)
    /// </summary>
    private async Task GetDictItemAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var id = 1;
        var response = await client.GetAsync(DictItemUrl + "/" + id);
        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        var siteModel = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<DictItemModel>(content);
        siteModel.Should().NotBeNull();
        siteModel!.Id.Should().Be(id);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// PUT (Modify) DictItem Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task ModifyDictItemAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var newDict = await CreateNewDict();
        var newDictItem = await CreateNewDictItem(newDict.Id);

        var value = "new_dict_value";
        var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync(DictItemUrl + "/" + newDictItem.Id, new ModifyDictItemRequest
        {
            Value = value
        });
        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        var siteModel = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<DictItemModel>(content);
        siteModel.Should().NotBeNull();
        siteModel!.Value.Should().Be(value);
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// PUT (Modify) DictItem Should fail when dict is system
    /// </summary>
    private async Task ModifyDictItemWhenSystemAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var id = 1;
        var value = "new_dict_value";
        try
        {
            HttpResponseMessage? response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync(DictItemUrl + "/" + id, new ModifyDictItemRequest
            {
                Value = value
            });

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            var innMsg = ex.InnerException?.Message;
            innMsg.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();
            innMsg.Should().ContainAll("DictItemEntity", $"{id}", "is system");
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<DictEntityDto> CreateNewDict(string? code = null, string? name = null, bool isSystem = false)
    {
        var uuid = Guid.NewGuid();
        code ??= $"{uuid}_code";
        name ??= $"{uuid}_name";

        var createResult = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(new DictEntityDto
        {
            Code = code,
            Name = name,
            IsSystem = isSystem
        });

        createResult.Should().NotBeNull();
        createResult!.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);
        createResult.Code.Should().Be(code);
        createResult.Name.Should().Be(name);
        createResult.IsSystem.Should().Be(isSystem);
        return createResult;
    }
    
    private async Task<DictItemEntityDto> CreateNewDictItem(int dictId, string? code = null, string? value = null)
    {
        var uuid = Guid.NewGuid();
        code ??= $"{uuid}_code";
        value ??= $"{uuid}_value";
    
        var createResult = await CommandService.CreateEntityAsync(new DictItemEntityDto
        {
            Dict = new EntityRef<DictEntityDto>{Id = dictId},
            Code = code,
            Value = value
        });
    
        createResult.Should().NotBeNull();
        createResult!.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);
        createResult.Dict.Id.Should().Be(dictId);
        createResult.Code.Should().Be(code);
        createResult.Value.Should().Be(value);
        return createResult;
    }
}

    }
    
    private async Task<DictItemModel> CreateNewDictItem(HttpClient client, int dictId, string? code = null, string? value = null)
    {
        var uuid = Guid.NewGuid();
        code ??= $"{uuid}_code";
        value ??= $"{uuid}_value";
        
        // Step 1. - Create Site
        var createResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync($"{DictUrl}/{dictId}/dictitems", new CreateDictItemRequest

        });

        newEntity.Should().NotBeNull();
        newEntity!.Id.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);
        newEntity.Code.Should().Be(code);
        newEntity.Value.Should().Be(value);
        return newEntity;
    }

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;

    /// <summary>
    /// GET DeviceTypes test (Get all)
    /// </summary>
    private async Task GetDeviceTypesAsync(HttpClient client, string token)
    {
        var response = await client.GetAsync(DeviceType_URL);

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should()
            .NotBeNull()
            .And
            .NotBeEmpty();

        response.StatusCode.Should()
            .Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);

        List<IoTDeviceTypeModel>? deviceTypeModelList = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<List<IoTDeviceTypeModel>>(content);

        deviceTypeModelList.Should()
            .NotBeNull();

        Assert.True(deviceTypeModelList.Count > 0);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// GET DeviceType test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task GetDeviceTypeAsync(HttpClient client, string token)
    {

        var response = await client.GetAsync(DeviceType_URL + "/" + deviceTypeCode);

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should()
            .NotBeNull()

            .NotBeEmpty();

    /// <summary>
    /// POST (Create) DeviceType Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task CreateDeviceTypeAsync(HttpClient client, string token)
    {
        // Post DeviceType create test
        var response = await client.PostAsync(DeviceType_URL,
        new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new CreateIoTDeviceTypeRequest()
        {
            DeviceTypeName = "UnitTest (TM) Consumption meter Type",
            DeviceTypeCode = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
            DeviceCategoryCode = "consumption_meter"
        }), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should()
            .NotBeNull()
            .And
            .NotBeEmpty();

        response.StatusCode.Should()
            .Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// PUT (Modify) DeviceType Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task ModifyDeviceTypeAsync(HttpClient client, string token)
    {
        // Post DeviceType create test
        var deviceTypeCode = "test_consumption_meter_01";
        var response = await client.PutAsync(DeviceType_URL + "/" + deviceTypeCode,
        new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new CreateIoTDeviceTypeRequest()
        {
            DeviceTypeName = "Modified DeviceType Name",
            DeviceTypeCode = deviceTypeCode,
            DeviceCategoryCode = "consumption_meter"
        }), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should()
            .NotBeNull()
            .And
            .NotBeEmpty();

        response.StatusCode.Should()
            .Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// DELETE DeviceType Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task DeleteDeviceTypeAsync(HttpClient client, string token)
    {
        // Step 1. - Create DeviceType
        var response = await client.PostAsync(DeviceType_URL,
        new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new CreateIoTDeviceTypeRequest()
        {
            DeviceTypeName = "UnitTest (TM) Consumption meter Type2",
            DeviceTypeCode = "test_consumption_meter_04",
            DeviceCategoryCode = "consumption_meter"
        }), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));

        var createdDeviceTypeContent = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // A frissen generált iot eszköztípus kódjának lekérdezése
        var deviceTypeCode = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<IoTDeviceTypeModel>(createdDeviceTypeContent)?.Code;

        deviceTypeCode.Should()
           .NotBeNull()
           .And
           .NotBeEmpty();

        // Delete DeviceType create test
        var deleteResponse = await client.DeleteAsync(DeviceType_URL + "/" + deviceTypeCode);
        var content = await deleteResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should()
            .NotBeNull()
            .And
            .NotBeEmpty();

        deleteResponse.StatusCode.Should()
            .Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
    }

        : base(dataBaseFixture)

    public async Task AutoRegisterDevicesTest()
    {
        await FrameworkTestBaseExt.RunTestAsAdmin(AutoRegisterDevicesAsync);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// POST Auto Register Devices Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task AutoRegisterDevicesAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var createResponse = await client.PostAsync($"{SmappeDevicesUrl}/autoregistration", null);
        var createContent = await createResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        createResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        createContent.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        // A eszközök lekérdezése
        var devices = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<List<DeviceModel>>(createContent);
        devices.Should().NotBeNull();
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.UnitTest.Infrastructure;
using FluentAssertions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.TimeSeries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Test.Infrastructure;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Xunit;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Test.TimeSeries;

[Collection("Database collection")]
public class TimeSeriesTests : FrameworkTestBase
{
    private const string TimeSeriesCatalogUrl = "/api/timeseriescatalog";

    public TimeSeriesTests(DatabaseFixture dataBaseFixture) : base(dataBaseFixture)
    {
    }

    [Fact]
#pragma warning disable S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    public async Task GetTimeSeriesCatalogSchemasTest()
#pragma warning restore S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    {
        await FrameworkTestBaseExt.RunTestAsAdmin(GetTimeSeriesCatalogSchemasAsync);
    }

    [Fact]
#pragma warning disable S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    public async Task GetTimeSeriesCatalogSchemaTest()
#pragma warning restore S2699 // Tests should include assertions
    {
        await FrameworkTestBaseExt.RunTestAsAdmin(GetTimeSeriesCatalogSchemaAsync);
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     GET TimeSeriesCatalogSchema test (Get all)
    /// </summary>
    private async Task GetTimeSeriesCatalogSchemasAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var response = await client.GetAsync(TimeSeriesCatalogUrl);
        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        var modelList = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<List<TimeSeriesCatalogSchemaListModel>>(content);
        modelList.Should().NotBeNull().And.HaveCountGreaterThan(0);
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     GET TimeSeriesCatalogSchema test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task GetTimeSeriesCatalogSchemaAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));

        var code = "weather";
        var response = await client.GetAsync($"{TimeSeriesCatalogUrl}/{code}");
        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        var model = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<TimeSeriesSchemaModel>(content);
        model.Should().NotBeNull();
        model!.Code.Should().Be(code);
    }
}
