    /// <summary>
    ///     GET Users test (Get all)
    /// </summary>
    private async Task GetUsersAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        var response = await client.GetAsync(USERS_URL);

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);

        var userModelList = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<List<SecUserModel>>(content);

        userModelList.Should().NotBeNull().And.HaveCountGreaterThan(0);
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     PUT (Modify) User Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task ModifyUserAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        var newlyCreatedUserId = await CreateNewUser(client);

        // Post User create test
        var modifiedLastName = $"Új{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Replace(" - ", "")}";
        var modifiedFirstName = $"Elek_{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Replace(" - ", "")}";
        var modifiedTelephone = "209876543";

        var response = await client.PutAsync($"{USERS_URL}/{newlyCreatedUserId}",
            new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new ModifyUserRequest
            {
                FirstName = modifiedFirstName,
                LastName = modifiedLastName,
                Phone = modifiedTelephone
            }), Encoding.UTF8, MediaTypeNames.Application.Json));

        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        var secUserModel = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SecUserModel>(content);
        secUserModel?.FirstName.Should().BeEquivalentTo(modifiedFirstName);
        secUserModel?.LastName.Should().BeEquivalentTo(modifiedLastName);
        secUserModel?.Phone.Should().BeEquivalentTo(modifiedTelephone);

    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     DELETE User Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task DeleteUserAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        var newlyCreatedUserId = await CreateNewUser(client);

        // Delete User create test
        var deleteResponse = await client.DeleteAsync(USERS_URL + "/" + newlyCreatedUserId);
        var content = await deleteResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        deleteResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
    }
    
    /// <summary>
    ///     POST (Modify) User password Test
    /// </summary>
    private async Task ModifyUserPasswordAsync(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        var newlyCreatedUserId = await CreateNewUser(client);
        
        // Jelszó módosítása
        var response = await client.PostAsync($"{USERS_URL}/{newlyCreatedUserId}/password",
            new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new ModifyUserPasswordRequest
            {
                NewPassword = "newPassword.",
                NewPasswordAgain = "newPassword."
            }), Encoding.UTF8, MediaTypeNames.Application.Json));

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
    }

    private async Task<int?> CreateNewUser(HttpClient client)
    {
        Scope.SetSecurityContext(MockDevTenantSecurityContextFactory(Scope));
        // Step 1. - Create User
        var response = await client.PostAsync(USERS_URL,
            new StringContent(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new CreateUserRequest
            {
                LastName = "Teszt",
                FirstName = "Elek",
                Phone = "201234567",
                EMail = $"teszt{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Replace("-", "")}@elek.com",
            }), Encoding.UTF8, MediaTypeNames.Application.Json));

        var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        content.Should().NotBeNull().And.NotBeEmpty();

        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);

        // A frissen generált user id-jának lekérdezése
        var newlyCreatedUserId = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SecUserModel>(content)?.Id;

        newlyCreatedUserId.Should().NotBeNull().And.BeGreaterThan(0);

        return newlyCreatedUserId;
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Managers.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Alert;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// AlertJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.MonitoringTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class AlertJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant mode
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

#if DEBUG
    //HACK for testing
    protected override string CronExpression => "0 * * * * ?"; //every minute
#endif

    /// <summary>
    /// Method to run according to the CronExpression.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The lifetime scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        Log.LogInfo($"{JobName} Processing alerts for tenant {dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName}...");

        var alertManager = scope.Resolve<IAlertManager>();

        var currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow.Date;

        var alertsToProcess = dbContext.Session.Query<AlertEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.IsActive && !x.IsDeleted && x.ValidFromUtc < currentDate && (x.ValidToUtc == null || x.ValidToUtc.Value >= currentDate))
            .ToList();

        foreach (var alert in alertsToProcess)
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"{JobName} Processing alert {alert.AlertIdentifier} (#{alert.Id})...");
            try
            {

                alertManager.ProcessAlert(alert, tenantCode: dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                var logMessage = $"{JobName} Error processing alert {alert.AlertIdentifier} (#{alert.Id}) for tenant {dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName}: {ex}";
                Log.LogError(logMessage);
                Console.Error.WriteLine(logMessage);
            }

            Log.LogInfo($"{JobName} Processed alert {alert.AlertIdentifier} (#{alert.Id}).");
        }

        Log.LogInfo($"{JobName} Finished processing alerts for tenant {dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName}.");
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Services.Co2eCalculation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Consumption;
using NHibernate.Linq;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class Co2RecalculationJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    const string entityName = "Co2Recalculation";

    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    //HACK for testing
#if DEBUG
    protected override string CronExpression => "0 * * * * ?"; //every minute
#endif


    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
        var _queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        var co2eCalculatorService = scope.Resolve<ICo2eCalculatorService>();


        
        try
        {
            var syncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                            .Where(x => x.EntityName == entityName).SingleOrDefault();
            if (syncInfo == null)
            {
                Log.LogError($"Syncronization object '{entityName}' was not found! ");
                return;
            }


            var changedCo2eFactorsResult = _queryService.QueryEntities(
                new ChangedCo2eFactorsQuery
                {
                    FromDate = syncInfo.LastSyncDate ?? DateTime.Now.AddDays(-1),
                    Category = Co2eFactorCategory.Consumption /* TODO:jelenleg csak fogyasztás típusú tényezőt kezelünk, de majd el kell tudni dönteni a MeasurementDescriptor alapján, hogy melyik kategória! */
                })?
            .Result as EntityQueryItemsResult<Co2eFactorEntityDto>;


            foreach (Co2eFactorEntityDto co2eFactor in changedCo2eFactorsResult?.Items ?? Array.Empty<Co2eFactorEntityDto>())
            {
                CheckValidTo(_queryService, co2eFactor);

                UpdateNormalizedConsumptionsWithAnonymusObject(dbContext, co2eFactor);
                //UpdateNormalizedConsumptionsUsingAssignments(dbContext, co2eFactor);
                //UpdateNormalizedConsumptionsInBatches(dbContext, co2eCalculatorService, co2eFactor);
            }

            UpdateSyncInfo(dbContext, syncInfo);
            dbContext.Commit();

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}(tenant: {dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName}): {ex}");
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}(tenant: {dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName}): {ex}");
        }
    }

    private static void UpdateNormalizedConsumptionsUsingAssignments(IDbContext dbContext, Co2eFactorEntityDto co2eFactor)
    {

        dbContext.Session.Query<NormalizedConsumptionEntity>()
                            .Where(x => co2eFactor.ValidFrom.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue) <= x.MeasuredAtUtc && x.MeasuredAtUtc <= co2eFactor.ValidTo!.Value.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue))
                            .UpdateBuilder()
                            .Set(x => x.Co2eValue, x => x.Value.HasValue ?
                                                Math.Round((decimal)x.Value! * co2eFactor.Factor / 1000, 9) :
                                                    null)
                            .Set(x => x.LastModifiedAt, DateTime.UtcNow)
                            .Update();

        dbContext.Session.Flush();
    }

    private void UpdateNormalizedConsumptionsInBatches(IDbContext dbContext, ICo2eCalculatorService co2eCalculatorService, Co2eFactorEntityDto co2eFactor)
    {
        
        var entitiesToUpdate = dbContext.Session.Query<NormalizedConsumptionEntity>()
                                                .Where(x => co2eFactor.ValidFrom.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue) <= x.MeasuredAtUtc &&
                                                        x.MeasuredAtUtc <= co2eFactor.ValidTo!.Value.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue))
                                                .ToList();


        int batchSize = int.TryParse(Config.TryGetStringValue($"{JobName}.BatchSize"), out var parsedBatchSize) ? parsedBatchSize : 2000;
        var totalProcessed = 0;
        var totalBatches = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)entitiesToUpdate.Count / batchSize);

        Log.LogInfo($"Starting to save {entitiesToUpdate.Count} recalculated consumptions in batches of {batchSize}");
        for (int i = 0; i < totalBatches; i++)
        {
            var batch = entitiesToUpdate
                            .Skip(i * batchSize)
                            .Take(batchSize)
                            .ToList();

            try
            {
                foreach (var entity in batch)
                {
                    entity.Co2eValue = co2eCalculatorService.CalculateCo2e((decimal?)entity.Value, co2eFactor.Factor, true);
                    entity.LastModifiedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    dbContext.Session.Update(entity);
                }

                dbContext.Session.Flush();
                totalProcessed += batch.Count;
                Log.LogDebug($"Successfully saved batch {i + 1}/{totalBatches}. Processed {totalProcessed}/{entitiesToUpdate.Count} records.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                dbContext.RollBack();
                Log.LogError($"Error saving batch {i + 1}/{totalBatches}. Batch size: {batch.Count}", ex);
                throw;
            }
        }
    }

    private static void UpdateNormalizedConsumptionsWithAnonymusObject(IDbContext dbContext, Co2eFactorEntityDto co2eFactor)
    {

        dbContext.Session.Query<NormalizedConsumptionEntity>()
                .Where(x => co2eFactor.ValidFrom.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue) <= x.MeasuredAtUtc && x.MeasuredAtUtc <= co2eFactor.ValidTo!.Value.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue))
                .Update(x => new
                {
                    Co2eValue = x.Value.HasValue ?
                                        Math.Round((decimal)x.Value! * co2eFactor.Factor / 1000, 9) :
                                        (decimal?)null,
                    LastModifiedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                }
                );
        dbContext.Session.Flush();

    }

    private static void UpdateSyncInfo(IDbContext dbContext, SyncObjectEntity syncInfo)
    {
        //update the last sync date
        syncInfo.LastSyncDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
        dbContext.Session.Update(syncInfo);
        dbContext.Session.Flush();
    }


    private static void CheckValidTo(IQueryService _queryService, Co2eFactorEntityDto coe2Factor)
    {
        if (coe2Factor.ValidTo == null)
        {
            //lekérdezzük a biztonság kedvéért az idősorban következő bejegyzést és annak a kezdődátumát állítjuk végdátumnak (elvileg ilyen nem lehet)
            var nextEntry = (_queryService.QueryEntities(new Co2eFactorEntityQuery { Category = coe2Factor.Category, IsDeleted = false })?.Result as EntityQueryItemsResult<Co2eFactorEntityDto>)?.Items
                .Where(x => coe2Factor.ValidFrom < x.ValidFrom)
                .OrderBy(x => x.ValidFrom)
                .FirstOrDefault();

            if (nextEntry == null)
            {
                coe2Factor.ValidTo = DateTime.Now.ToDateOnly();
            }
            else
            {
                coe2Factor.ValidTo = nextEntry.ValidTo!.Value.AddDays(-1);
            }
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// MonitoringSyncUserJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.MonitoringTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class MonitoringSyncUserAndTenantJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant mode
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantIndependent;

    //Hack for testing
    protected override string CronExpression => "1 * * * * ?";

    private FrameworkApiClientService _frameworkApiClientService;
    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        Log.LogInfo("MonitoringSyncUserAndTenantJob started");

        var securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        var mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
        var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        _frameworkApiClientService = scope.Resolve<FrameworkApiClientService>();

        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();


        try
        {
            using (dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction())
            {
                var timeStamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
                var syncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                                .Where(x => x.EntityName == SyncObjectConstants.UserTenant).List().FirstOrDefault();
                if (syncInfo != null && syncInfo.LastModifiedDate.HasValue &&
                    (!syncInfo.LastSyncDate.HasValue || syncInfo.LastSyncDate < syncInfo.LastModifiedDate))
                {

                    var request = new SyncTenantRequest() { From = syncInfo.LastSyncDate ?? DateTime.MinValue };
                    //TODO: A job futása miért nem async Task-os?
                    var tenants = _frameworkApiClientService.Post<SyncTenantRequest, IEnumerable<TenantSyncModel>>($"{FrameworkApi.Tenant.SyncTenant_FullRoute}", request).RunSync();
                    var tenantEntityDtos = tenants.Select(mapper.Map<TenantEntityDto>).ToList();
                    var localTenants = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<TenantSyncedEntity>().List();

                    ListHelper.SyncChildren(commandService,
                                            tenantEntityDtos,
                                            localTenants,
                                            (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                                            dto =>
                                            {
                                                var newDtoItem = commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                                                return dbContext.Session.Load<TenantSyncedEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                            },
                                            withDelete: false);

                    var syncUserRequest = new SyncSecUserRequest() { From = syncInfo.LastSyncDate ?? DateTime.MinValue };
                    var users = _frameworkApiClientService.Post<SyncSecUserRequest, IEnumerable<SecUserSyncModel>>($"{FrameworkApi.User.SyncUser_FullRoute}", syncUserRequest).RunSync();
                    var userEntityDtos = users.Select(mapper.Map<SecUserSyncedEntityDto>).ToList();
                    var localUsers = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserSyncedEntity>().List();

                    ListHelper.SyncChildren(commandService,
                                            userEntityDtos,
                                            localUsers,
                                            (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                                            dto =>
                                            {
                                                var newDtoItem = commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                                                return dbContext.Session.Load<SecUserSyncedEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                            },
                                            withDelete: false);

                    syncInfo.LastSyncDate = timeStamp;
                    dbContext.Session.Update(syncInfo);
                    dbContext.Commit();
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("MonitoringSyncUserAndTenantJob sync", ex);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.LogInfo("MonitoringSyncUserAndTenantJob finished");
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Helpers.PeakCalculation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services.PeakConsumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Consumption;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class PeakMainMeterConsumptionCalculationJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    const string entityName = "PeakMainMeterConsumption";

    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    //HACK for testing
#if DEBUG
    protected override string CronExpression => "0 * * * * ?"; //every minute
#endif

    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();

        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var syncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                        .Where(x => x.EntityName == entityName).SingleOrDefault();

        if (syncInfo == null)
        {
            Log.LogError($"Syncronization object '{entityName}' was not found! ");
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            var currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var today = DateTime.Today;
            DateTime intervalStart = syncInfo.LastSyncDate
                ?? DateTime.UtcNow.AddMonths(-2); // ha még nem futott a job, akkor 2 hónappal korábbi elemektől kezdve nézzük.

            var peakService = scope.Resolve<IPeakMainMeterConsumptionService>();
            var data = peakService.GetDataAsync(intervalStart).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

            //group by channel, and calculate peaks for each channel and for each interval
            //then insertorupdate the peaks into the database
            List<PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntityDto> calculatedPeaks = [];

            var grpByChannel = data.GroupBy(x => x.DataChannelId);

            foreach (var channelGroup in grpByChannel)
            {
                var channelId = channelGroup.Key;
                var channelData = channelGroup.SelectMany(x => x.Measurements).ToList();


                foreach (PeakType peakType in Enum.GetValues(typeof(PeakType)))
                {
                    //generates empty period data for each peak type
                    var peaks = PeakCalculationHelpers.GenerateEmptyIntervalsByType<PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntityDto>(intervalStart, currentDate, peakType);

                    //fill periods with calculated data
                    PeakCalculationHelpers.CalculateMainMeterPeaksForChannelAndPeakType(channelData, peaks, channelId, channelGroup.First().PodIdentifier, peakType);


                    //peaks = peaks.Where(x => x.PeakValue != 0).ToList();
                    calculatedPeaks.AddRange(peaks);
                }


                //insert or update the peaks into the database
                peakService.InsertOrUpdatePeaksAsync(calculatedPeaks);

                //if completed, update the sync date
                syncInfo.LastSyncDate = currentDate;
                dbContext.Session.Update(syncInfo);
                dbContext.Commit();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}(tenant: {dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName}): {ex}");
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}(tenant: {dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName}): {ex}");
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Emissions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Resolutions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Consumption;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// Generikus osztály az időintervallumos aggregációkra
/// </summary>
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class PeriodicConsumptionNormalizationJob<TPeriodicEntity> : MonitoringTimerServiceBase where TPeriodicEntity : IPeriodicConsumptionEntity
{
    private IQueryService _queryService;
    private IResolutionHandler _resHandler;
    private IResolutionHandlerFactory _resFactory;
    private INormalizationService<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, TPeriodicEntity> _normalizationService;
    private IDbContext _dbContext;

    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;
    // Az entity név a generikus paraméterből jön.

    private string _entityNameForSyncObject => $"{typeof(TPeriodicEntity).Name.Replace("Entity", "")}";
    //adatbázisban a confignál és Quartz bejegyzéseknel fontos ez a property, mert generikusság esetén szétesik a GetType.Name alapértelmezett működéssel.

    protected override string JobName => $"{_entityNameForSyncObject}Job";

    private AggregationLevel GetAggregationLevelByPeriodicEntity()
    {
        return typeof(TPeriodicEntity) switch
        {
            Type t when t == typeof(NormalizedConsumptionHourlyEntity) => AggregationLevel.OneHour,
            Type t when t == typeof(NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity) => AggregationLevel.OneDay,
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"Ismeretlen aggregációs enum {typeof(TPeriodicEntity).Name} számára")
        };
    }

#if DEBUG
    protected override string CronExpression => "0 * * * * ?"; //every minute
#endif

    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        var periodicType = typeof(TPeriodicEntity);

        Log.LogInfo($"PeriodicConsumptionNormalizationJob({typeof(TPeriodicEntity).Name}) started");

        var securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        _queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        _resFactory = scope.Resolve<IResolutionHandlerFactory>();
        //itt később  szükséges a CreateResolutionHandler és GetAggregationLevelByPeriodicEntity metodusokat bővíteni ha más Periodic entity lesz hozzáadva
        _resHandler = _resFactory.CreateResolutionHandler(GetAggregationLevelByPeriodicEntity());

        _normalizationService = scope.Resolve<INormalizationService<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, TPeriodicEntity>>();
        _dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var syncInfo = _dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                        .Where(x => x.EntityName == _entityNameForSyncObject).SingleOrDefault();

        if (syncInfo is null)
        {
            syncInfo = new SyncObjectEntity
            {
                EntityName = _entityNameForSyncObject,
                LastModifiedDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
                LastSyncDate = DateTime.MinValue
            };

            _dbContext.Session.Save(syncInfo);
            _dbContext.Commit();
            Log.LogInfo($"Created new SyncObjectEntity for '{_entityNameForSyncObject}'");
        }

        var consumptionCo2eFactorQuery = new Co2eFactorEntityQuery { IsDeleted = false };
        var queryResult = _queryService.QueryEntities(consumptionCo2eFactorQuery).GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        IEnumerable<Co2eFactorEntityDto>? co2eConsumptionFactorSeries = null;

        if (queryResult is IEntityQueryItemsResult<Co2eFactorEntityDto> itemsResult)
        {
            co2eConsumptionFactorSeries = itemsResult.Items;
        }

        var currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow;

        try
        {
            var buckets = GetAggregatableDataBlocks(syncInfo.LastSyncDate!.Value);

            if (buckets.Count > 0) // ha volt bármi amit frissíteni kellett akkor update.
            {
                // feloldjuk a dictionaryt időbucketek szerint aggregálunk
                foreach (var (channelId, timeGroups) in buckets)
                {
                    var minDateTime = timeGroups.Min(x => x.Key);
                    var maxDateTime = timeGroups.Max(x => x.Key);

                    //fetch any existing records for the given channelid so that
                    //Session.SaveOrUpdate doesn't have to query them one by one to determine whether to use insert or update
                    var existingRecords = _dbContext.Session.Query<TPeriodicEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.ChannelIdentifier == channelId && x.MeasuredAtUtc >= minDateTime && x.MeasuredAtUtc <= maxDateTime)
                        .ToList();

                    foreach (var (timeBucket, entries) in timeGroups)
                    {
                        // az AggregationMethod egyelőre hard coded, ez később változni fog, beszéltük, hogy db szinten még variálás lesz.
                        var normalizedEntity = _normalizationService.NormalizeSingle(entries, timeBucket, AggregationMethod.Average);
                        decimal? factor = co2eConsumptionFactorSeries!.FindByDate(DateOnly.FromDateTime(normalizedEntity.MeasuredAtUtc), Co2eFactorCategory.Consumption)?.Factor;
                        normalizedEntity.Co2eValue = CalculateCo2eValue(normalizedEntity, factor);
                        normalizedEntity.ChannelIdentifier = channelId;

                        var existingEntity = existingRecords.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Equals(normalizedEntity));
                        if (existingEntity != null)
                        {
                            existingEntity.Value = normalizedEntity.Value;
                            existingEntity.Co2eValue = normalizedEntity.Co2eValue;
                            existingEntity.LastModifiedAtUtc = normalizedEntity.LastModifiedAtUtc;
                            _dbContext.Session.Update(existingEntity);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            _dbContext.Session.Save(normalizedEntity);
                        }
                    }
                }

                syncInfo.LastSyncDate = currentDate;
                _dbContext.Session.Update(syncInfo);
                _dbContext.Commit();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError($"{_entityNameForSyncObject}", ex);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"{_entityNameForSyncObject} finished");
        }
    }

    private decimal? CalculateCo2eValue(IPeriodicConsumptionEntity entity, decimal? factor)
    {
        // US: #212
        if (entity.Value.HasValue && factor.HasValue)
        {
            return Math.Round((decimal)entity.Value * factor.Value / 1000, 9);
        }
        else
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private Dictionary<Guid, Dictionary<DateTime, List<NormalizedConsumptionEntity>>> GetAggregatableDataBlocks(DateTime syncTime)
    {
        // 1. lépés: módosult rekordok kiszedése
        var modified = _dbContext.Session.Query<NormalizedConsumptionEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.LastModifiedAt > syncTime)
            .ToList();

        // 2. lépés: affected bucketek kiszámítása minden ChannelId-re (mérés kezdete alapján kerekítve)
        var affectedBuckets = modified
            .Select(x => new
            {
                x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier,
                TimeBucketStart = _resHandler.GetClosestDateTime(x.MeasuredAtUtc, RoundingDirection.Floor)
            })
            .Distinct()
            .Select(x => new
            {
                x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier,
                TimeBucketStart = x.TimeBucketStart,
                TimeBucketEnd = GetBucketEnd(x.TimeBucketStart)
            })
            .ToList();

        if (!affectedBuckets.Any())
        {
            return new(); // nincs mit feldolgozni
        }

        // 3. lépés: minden ide eső rekord kiszedése (a kerekített bucket idők alapján)
        var allRelevant = new List<NormalizedConsumptionEntity>();
        foreach (var bucket in affectedBuckets)
        {
            var records = modified
                .Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier == bucket.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier &&
                            x.MeasuredAtUtc > bucket.TimeBucketStart &&
                            x.MeasuredAtUtc <= bucket.TimeBucketEnd)
                .ToList();

            allRelevant.AddRange(records);
        }

        // 4. lépés: csoportosítás Channel + bucket szerint
        var result = allRelevant
            .GroupBy(x => new
            {
                x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier,
                TimeBucket = _resHandler.GetClosestDateTime(x.MeasuredAtUtc, RoundingDirection.Ceiling)
            })
            .OrderBy(x => x.Key.TimeBucket)
            .GroupBy(g => g.Key.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier)
            .ToDictionary(
                g => g.Key,
                g => g.ToDictionary(
                    x => x.Key.TimeBucket,
                    x => x.ToList()
                )
            );

        return result;
    }

    // bucket záró dátum kiszámítása
    private DateTime GetBucketEnd(DateTime currentBucket)
    {
        var aggregationLevel = GetAggregationLevelByPeriodicEntity();
        return aggregationLevel switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.OneHour => currentBucket.AddHours(1),
            AggregationLevel.OneDay => currentBucket.AddDays(1),
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"Unsupported aggregation level: {aggregationLevel}")
        };
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// SyncConsumptionJobData
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.MonitoringTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SyncConsumptionDataJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Base URL.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The base URL.
    /// </value>
    private static string BaseUrl => Config.GetStringValue("DataReceiverApiHost");

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant mode
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    //HACK for testing
#if DEBUG
    protected override string CronExpression => "0 */2 * * * ?";
#endif

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();

        var syncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                        .Where(x => x.EntityName == "SyncConsumption").SingleOrDefault();

        if (syncInfo == null) 
        {
            Log.LogError($"Syncronization object \"SyncConsumption\" was not found! ");
            return;
        }   

        try
        {
            var dataReceiverApi = GetApiClient(dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName);
            var time = DateTime.UtcNow;

            var newConsumptions = dataReceiverApi.Consumption_GetNormalizedConsumptionDataAsync(new DateTimeOffset(time))
                                                 .RunSync();

            foreach (var consumption in newConsumptions)
            {
                var entity = new NormalizedConsumptionEntity() 
                {
                    DataQuality = (Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.DataQuality)consumption.DataQuality,
                    MeasuredEndpointIdentifier = consumption.ChannelIdentifier,
                    MeasuredAtUtc = consumption.MeasuredAtUtc.UtcDateTime,
                    Value = consumption.Value,
                    LastModifiedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    Co2eValue = consumption.Co2eValue.HasValue ? Convert.ToDecimal(consumption.Co2eValue) : null,
                };
                dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(entity);
            }

            dbContext.Commit();

            if (newConsumptions.Any()) 
            {
                dataReceiverApi.Consumption_DeleteNormalizedConsumptionDataAsync(new DateTimeOffset(time));
                syncInfo.LastSyncDate = time;
                dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(syncInfo);
                dbContext.Commit();
            }

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}(tenant: {dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName}): {ex}");
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}(tenant: {dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName}): {ex}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the API client.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static DataReceiverApi GetApiClient(string tenantCode)
    {
        var client = HttpClientExtensions.CreateClient();
        var dataReceiverApi = client.GetApiClient<DataReceiverApi>(x => x.BaseUrl = BaseUrl);
        client.Authenticate(dataReceiverApi, tenantCode: tenantCode).RunSync();
        return dataReceiverApi;
    }
}

/// <summary>

/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.MonitoringTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SyncConsumptionJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Base URL.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The base URL.
    /// </value>
    private static string BaseUrl => Config.GetStringValue("DataReceiverApiHost");

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant mode
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    //HACK for testing
    //protected override string CronExpression => "0/20 * * * * ?";

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        return;
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        var tenant = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

        try
        {
            var dbSession = dbContext.Session;

            var iotDevices = dbSession.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.Smappee.GetEntityCode())
                .List();

            var dataReceiverApi = GetApiClient(securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode);
            foreach ( var iotDevice in iotDevices )
            {
                var newConsumptions = dataReceiverApi.ProcessIoTDataToConsumption_GetAsync(
                        deviceGlobalId: iotDevice.Identifier,
                        tenantCode: dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName).RunSync();

                if (!newConsumptions.MeasurementDate.Any())
                    continue;

                for (var i = 0; i < newConsumptions.MeasurementDate.Count; i++)
                {
                    // Ha hiányosak az azonosítók, az hiba
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(newConsumptions.DeviceIdentifier) ||
                        string.IsNullOrEmpty(newConsumptions.SiteLocationIdentifier) ||
                        string.IsNullOrEmpty(newConsumptions.SiteIdentifier) ||
                            string.IsNullOrEmpty(newConsumptions.ChannelIdentifier.ElementAtOrDefault(i)))
                    {
                        Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): Hiányos adatok.");
                        continue;
                    }

                    var newConsumptionEntity = new ConsumptionEntity
                    {
                        DeviceIdentifier = new Guid(newConsumptions.DeviceIdentifier),
                        SiteLocationIdentifier = new Guid(newConsumptions.SiteLocationIdentifier),
                        SiteIdentifier = new Guid(newConsumptions.SiteIdentifier),
                        MeasuredEndpointIdentifier = new Guid(newConsumptions.ChannelIdentifier.ElementAt(i)),
                        TimeUnit = (Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel)(int)newConsumptions.TimeUnit.ElementAt(i),
                        Active = newConsumptions.Active.ElementAtOrDefault(i),
                        Current = newConsumptions.Current.ElementAtOrDefault(i),
                        LineVoltage = newConsumptions.LineVoltages.ElementAtOrDefault(i),
                        PhaseVoltage = newConsumptions.PhaseVoltages.ElementAtOrDefault(i),
                        Reactive = newConsumptions.Reactive.ElementAtOrDefault(i),
                        Voltage = newConsumptions.Voltages.ElementAtOrDefault(i),
                        MeasurementDate = newConsumptions.MeasurementDate.ElementAtOrDefault(i).UtcDateTime,
                        Consumption = newConsumptions.RelativeConsumption.ElementAtOrDefault(i),
                        CalculatedFeeOut = newConsumptions.CalculatedFeeOut.ElementAtOrDefault(i),
                        PurchasePrice = newConsumptions.PurchasePrice.ElementAtOrDefault(i),
                    };

                    dbSession.Save(newConsumptionEntity);
                }
            }
            dbContext.Commit();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) 
        {
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}");
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}"); 
        }
    }

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.MeasurementPointSync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// SyncDeviceJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.MonitoringTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SyncDeviceJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant mode
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    private FrameworkApiClientService _frameworkApiClientService;

    protected override string CronExpression => "0/20 * * * * ?";

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        Log.LogInfo("SyncDeviceJob started");

        var securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        var mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
        var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        var queryService = scope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        _frameworkApiClientService = scope.Resolve<FrameworkApiClientService>();

        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();


        try
        {
            using (dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction())
            {
                var timeStamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
                var syncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                                .Where(x => x.EntityName == SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync).List().FirstOrDefault();

                if (syncInfo != null && syncInfo.LastModifiedDate.HasValue &&
                    (!syncInfo.LastSyncDate.HasValue || syncInfo.LastSyncDate < syncInfo.LastModifiedDate))
                {
                    var orgunitIds = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntity>().Select(x => x.Id).List<int>();
                    var measurementPoints = _frameworkApiClientService.Post<SyncMeasurementPointsRequest, IList<MeasurementPointSyncModel>>
                        (FrameworkApi.MeasurementPoint.GetByOrgunitIds_FullRoute,
                         new SyncMeasurementPointsRequest() { OrgunitIds = orgunitIds.ToList()},
                         securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).RunSync()!;

                    var partnerId = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerSyncedEntity>().Where(x => x.TenantCode == securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).Select(x => x.Id).SingleOrDefault<int>();

                    var measurementPointEntityDtos = measurementPoints.Select(x => mapper.Map<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x, opt =>
                    {
                        opt.Items[SyncObjectConstants.UseManualId] = true;
                        opt.Items[SyncObjectConstants.TenantCode] = partnerId;
                    })).ToList();

                    var localMeasurementPoints = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
                                                                  .Where(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint == null)
                                                                  .List();

                    //Ez a metódus végzi a mérésipontok szinkronizálását
                    ListHelper.SyncChildren(commandService,
                                            measurementPointEntityDtos,
                                            localMeasurementPoints,
                                            (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                                            dto =>
                                            {
                                                var newDtoItem = commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                                                return dbContext.Session.Load<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                            });

                    //Mérési pont, mért jellemző, channelId kapcsoló tábla szinkronizációja
                    var measurementPointSettings = _frameworkApiClientService.Get<IList<MeasurementPointSettingSyncModel>>
                       (FrameworkApi.MeasurementPoint.SyncMeasurementPointSetting_FullRoute,
                        securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).RunSync()!;

                    var allMeasurementPointIds = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>().Select(x => x.Id).List<int>();

                    foreach (var settingModel in measurementPointSettings)
                    {
                        //Csak az átszinkronizált mérési pontok kapcsolatai tudjuk beállítani
                        if (allMeasurementPointIds.Any(x => x == settingModel.MeasurementPointId))
                        {
                            var setting = new MeasurementPointSettingSyncedMonitoringEntity()
                            {
                                MeasurementPoint = dbContext.Session.Load<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>(settingModel.MeasurementPointId),
                                MeasuredProperty = dbContext.Session.Load<MeasuredPropertyEntity>(settingModel.MeasuredPropertyId),
                                Channel = settingModel.ChannelId.HasValue ? dbContext.Session.Load<IoTMeasuredEndpointEntity>(settingModel.ChannelId) : null,
                            };
                            dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(setting);
                        }
                    }

                    //szinkronizálás a public sémába is
                    using (var publicScope = scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
                    {
                        publicScope.SetSystemContext();
                        var publicCommandService = publicScope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
                        var publicDbContext = publicScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

                        var publicPartnerId = publicDbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerSyncedEntity>()
                                                                     .Where(x => x.TenantCode == securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode)
                                                                     .Select(x => x.Id)
                                                                     .SingleOrDefault<int>();

                        //Újra mappolás Id-k nélkül
                        measurementPointEntityDtos = measurementPoints.Select(x => mapper.Map<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x, opt =>
                        {
                            opt.Items[SyncObjectConstants.UseManualId] = false;
                            opt.Items[SyncObjectConstants.TenantCode] = publicPartnerId;
                        })).ToList();

                        PartnerSyncedEntity alias = null!;
                        var publicMeasurementPoints = publicDbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
                                                                             .JoinAlias(x => x.Partner, () => alias)
                                                                             .Where(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint == null)
                                                                             .And(() => alias.TenantCode == securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).List();


                        ListHelper.SyncChildren(publicCommandService,
                                                measurementPointEntityDtos,
                                                publicMeasurementPoints,
                                                (x, y) => x.Identifier == y.Identifier,
                                                dto =>
                                                {
                                                    var newDtoItem = publicCommandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                                                    return publicDbContext.Session.Load<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                                },
                                                (dto, originalEntity) => dto.Id = originalEntity.Id);

                        var allMeasurementPointIdentifiers = publicDbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>().Select(x => x.Identifier).List<Guid>();
                        foreach (var settingModel in measurementPointSettings)
                        {
                            //Csak az átszinkronizált mérési pontok kapcsolatai tudjuk beállítani
                            if (allMeasurementPointIdentifiers.Any(x => x == settingModel.MeasurementPointIdentifier))
                            {
                                var setting = new MeasurementPointSettingSyncedMonitoringEntity()
                                {
                                    MeasuredProperty = publicDbContext.Session.Load<MeasuredPropertyEntity>(settingModel.MeasuredPropertyId),
                                    MeasurementPoint = publicDbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>().Where(x => x.Identifier == settingModel.MeasurementPointIdentifier).SingleOrDefault(),
                                    Channel = settingModel.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue ? publicDbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTMeasuredEndpointEntity>().Where(x => x.Identifier == settingModel.ChannelIdentifier).SingleOrDefault()
                                                                                      : null,
                                };
                                publicDbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(setting);
                            }
                        }
                        publicDbContext.Commit();
                    }
                    ;

                    syncInfo.LastSyncDate = timeStamp;
                    dbContext.Session.Update(syncInfo);
                    dbContext.Commit();
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("Device sync", ex);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.LogInfo("SyncDeviceJob finished");
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants.EndpointConstants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.OrgunitSync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Partner;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Partner;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// SyncDeviceJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.MonitoringTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SyncOrgunitJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant mode
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    protected override string CronExpression => "0 * * * * ?";

    private FrameworkApiClientService _frameworkApiClientService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        Log.LogInfo("SyncOrgunitJob started");

        var securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        var mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
        var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        _frameworkApiClientService = scope.Resolve<FrameworkApiClientService>();

        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();


        try
        {
            using (dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction())
            {
                var timeStamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
                var syncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                                .Where(x => x.EntityName == SyncObjectConstants.OrgunitSyncronization).List().FirstOrDefault();

                if (syncInfo != null && syncInfo.LastModifiedDate.HasValue &&
                    (!syncInfo.LastSyncDate.HasValue || syncInfo.LastSyncDate < syncInfo.LastModifiedDate))
                {
                    //TODO: A job futása miért nem async Task-os?
                    var partnerModel = _frameworkApiClientService.Get<PartnerSyncModel>($"{FrameworkApi.Institution.GetInstitutionsSync_FullRoute}", securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).RunSync();

                    //A tenant sémába való beszúrásnál manuálisan adjuk meg az Id-t
                    var partnerEntityDto = mapper.Map<PartnerSyncedEntityDto>(partnerModel, opt => opt.Items[SyncObjectConstants.UseManualId] = true);

                    var localpartner = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerSyncedEntity>().List();

                    ListHelper.SyncChildren(commandService,
                                            [partnerEntityDto],
                                            localpartner,
                                            (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                                            dto =>
                                            {
                                                var newDtoItem = commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                                                return dbContext.Session.Load<PartnerSyncedEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                            });

                    //A mérési pont hierarchia szinkronizációt élesítjük, mert új orgunit válhattak elérhetővé
                    var deviceSyncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                                                .Where(x => x.EntityName == SyncObjectConstants.MeasurementPointSync).List().Single();
                    deviceSyncInfo.LastModifiedDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    dbContext.Session.Update(deviceSyncInfo);

                    //szinkronizálás a public sémába is
                    using (var publicScope = scope.BeginLifetimeScope()) 
                    {
                        publicScope.SetSystemContext();
                        var publicCommandService = publicScope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
                        var publicDbContext = publicScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

                        //Újra mappolás Id-k nélkül
                        partnerEntityDto = mapper.Map<PartnerSyncedEntityDto>(partnerModel, opt => opt.Items[SyncObjectConstants.UseManualId] = false);

                        var publicPartner = publicDbContext.Session.QueryOver<PartnerSyncedEntity>()
                                                                     .Where(x => x.TenantCode == partnerEntityDto.TenantCode).List();


                        ListHelper.SyncChildren(publicCommandService,
                                                [partnerEntityDto],
                                                publicPartner,
                                                (x, y) => x.TenantCode == y.TenantCode,
                                                dto =>
                                                {
                                                    var newDtoItem = publicCommandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                                                    return publicDbContext.Session.Load<PartnerSyncedEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                                }, (dto, originalEntity) =>
                                                {
                                                    dto.Id = originalEntity.Id;
                                                });
                    };

                    syncInfo.LastSyncDate = timeStamp;
                    dbContext.Session.Update(syncInfo);
                    dbContext.Commit();
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("Orgunit sync", ex);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.LogInfo("SyncOrgunitJob finished");
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.DataReceiver;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Consumption;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// SyncOtherJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.MonitoringTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SyncOtherJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Base URL.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The base URL.
    /// </value>
    private static string BaseUrl => Config.GetStringValue("DataReceiverApiHost");

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant mode
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        SyncOtherConsumptionMeters(scope);
        SyncOtherSolarPanels(scope);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Synchronizes the other consumption meters.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    private void SyncOtherConsumptionMeters(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var tenant = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncOtherJob)}(tenant: {tenant}) - Start {nameof(SyncOtherConsumptionMeters)}...");

        try
        {
            var dbSession = dbContext.Session;
            var code = IoTDeviceType.OtherConsumptionMeter.GetEntityCode();

            var iotDevices = dbSession.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.DeviceTypeCode == code)
                .List();
            Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncOtherJob)}(tenant: {tenant}),{nameof(SyncOtherConsumptionMeters)} - '{code}' IoTDevice found: {iotDevices.Count}");

            if (iotDevices.Any())
            {
                var dataReceiverApi = GetApiClient();

                Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncOtherJob)}(tenant: {tenant}),{nameof(SyncOtherConsumptionMeters)} - Syncing '{code}' IoTData...");

                foreach (var device in iotDevices)
                {
                    dbSession = dbContext.Session;
                    var newRecords = dataReceiverApi.IoTOtherDataForSync_GetAsync(
                        deviceGlobalId: device.Identifier,
                        source: IoTDataSourceType.OtherConsumptionMeterImport,
                        tenantCode: dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName).RunSync();

                    Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncOtherJob)}(tenant: {tenant}),{nameof(SyncOtherConsumptionMeters)} - IoTDevice:{device.Id}, '{code}' IoTData record found: {newRecords.Data.Count}");

                    if (!newRecords.Data.Any())
                        continue;


                    foreach (var item in newRecords.Data)
                    {
                        var newConsumptionEntity = new ConsumptionEntity
                        {
                            DeviceIdentifier = device.Identifier!.Value,
                            MeasuredEndpointIdentifier = item.ChannelIdentifier,
                            Active = item.Power,
                            Current = 0,
                            LineVoltage = 0,
                            PhaseVoltage = 0,
                            Reactive = 0,
                            Voltage = 0,
                            MeasurementDate = item.MeasurementDate.UtcDateTime,
                            Consumption = item.Energy,
                            CalculatedFeeOut = item.CalculatedFee,
                            PurchasePrice = item.PowerPrice,
                            TimeUnit = (Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel)((int)item.TimeUnit)
                        };

                        dbSession.Save(newConsumptionEntity);
                    }
                    dbContext.Commit();
                }
            }


        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}_{nameof(SyncOtherConsumptionMeters)}(tenant: {tenant}) : {ex}");
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}_{nameof(SyncOtherConsumptionMeters)}(tenant: {tenant}) : {ex}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Synchronizes the other solar panels.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    private void SyncOtherSolarPanels(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var tenant = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";
        Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncOtherJob)}(tenant: {tenant}) - Start {nameof(SyncOtherSolarPanels)}...");

        try
        {
            using var dbSession = dbContext.Session;
            var code = IoTDeviceType.OtherSolarPanel.GetEntityCode();

            var iotDevices = dbSession.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.DeviceTypeCode == code)
                .List();
            Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncOtherJob)}(tenant: {tenant}),{nameof(SyncOtherSolarPanels)} - '{code}' IoTDevice found: {iotDevices.Count}");

            if (iotDevices.Any())
            {
                var dataReceiverApi = GetApiClient();

                Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncOtherJob)}(tenant: {tenant}),{nameof(SyncOtherSolarPanels)} - Syncing '{code}' IoTData...");

                foreach (var device in iotDevices)
                {
                    var newRecords = dataReceiverApi.IoTOtherDataForSync_GetAsync(
                        deviceGlobalId: device.Identifier,
                        source: IoTDataSourceType.OtherSolarPanelImport,
                        tenantCode: dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName).RunSync();

                    Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncOtherJob)}(tenant: {tenant}),{nameof(SyncOtherSolarPanels)} - IoTDevice:{device.Id}, '{code}' IoTData record found: {newRecords.Data.Count}");

                    if (!newRecords.Data.Any())
                        continue;


                    foreach (var item in newRecords.Data)
                    {
                        var newProductionEntity = new ProductionEntity
                        {
                            DeviceIdentifier = device.Identifier!.Value,
                            MeasuredEndpointIdentifier = item.ChannelIdentifier,
                            Power = item.Power,
                            PowerUnit = item.Unit == Unit.W ? "W" : "kW",
                            Energy = item.Energy,
                            EnergyUnit = item.Unit == Unit.W ? "Wh" : "kWh",
                            MeasurementDate = item.MeasurementDate.UtcDateTime,
                            CalculatedFeeIn = item.CalculatedFee,
                            PowerInPrice = item.PowerPrice,
                            TimeUnit = (Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel)((int)item.TimeUnit)
                        };

                        dbSession.Save(newProductionEntity);
                    }
                }
            }

            dbContext.Commit();

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}_{nameof(SyncOtherSolarPanels)}(tenant: {tenant}) : {ex}");
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}_{nameof(SyncOtherSolarPanels)}(tenant: {tenant}) : {ex}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the API client.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static DataReceiverApi GetApiClient()
    {
        var client = HttpClientExtensions.CreateClient();
        var dataReceiverApi = client.GetApiClient<DataReceiverApi>(x => { x.BaseUrl = BaseUrl; });
        client.Authenticate(dataReceiverApi).RunSync();
        return dataReceiverApi;
    }
}

using System;
using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Sync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Caching;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.DataReceiver;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

/// <summary>
/// SyncProductionJob
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.MonitoringTimerServiceBase" />
[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SyncProductionJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Base URL.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The base URL.
    /// </value>
    private static string BaseUrl => Config.GetStringValue("DataReceiverApiHost");
    /// <summary>
    /// Tenant mode
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// The tenant running mode.
    /// </value>
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    /// <summary>
    /// Elapseds the specified scope.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        var tenant = dbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName ?? "";

        try
        {
            var dbSession = dbContext.Session;

            IoTDeviceEntity ioTDeviceEntity = null!;
            var localMeasuredEndpoints = dbSession.QueryOver<IoTMeasuredEndpointEntity>()
                .JoinAlias(x => x.IoTDevice, () => ioTDeviceEntity)
                .Where(x => x.Identifier != null && ioTDeviceEntity.DeviceTypeCode == IoTDeviceType.SolarEdge.GetEntityCode())
                .List();

            DateTime lastProduction = default;
            if (localMeasuredEndpoints.Any())
            {
                var dataReceiverApi = GetApiClient();

                Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncProductionJob)}(tenant: {tenant}) - Syncing IoTData...");

                foreach (var measuredEndpoint in localMeasuredEndpoints)
                {
                    var newProductions = dataReceiverApi.IoTProductionDataForSync_GetAsync(
                        deviceGlobalId: measuredEndpoint.IoTDevice.Identifier,
                        channelIdentifier: measuredEndpoint.Identifier,
                        tenantCode: tenant).RunSync();

                    Log.LogDebug($"{nameof(SyncProductionJob)}(tenant: {tenant}) - measuredEndpoint:{measuredEndpoint.Id}, IoTData record found: {newProductions.Data.Count}");

                    if (!newProductions.Data.Any())
                        continue;


                    foreach (var item in newProductions.Data)
                    {
                        var newProductionEntity = new ProductionEntity
                        {
                            DeviceIdentifier = measuredEndpoint.IoTDevice.Identifier!.Value,
                            MeasuredEndpointIdentifier = measuredEndpoint.Identifier,
                            Power = item.Power,
                            PowerUnit = item.PowerUnit,
                            Energy = item.Power * 0.25,
                            EnergyUnit = item.EnergyUnit,
                            MeasurementDate = item.MeasurementDate.UtcDateTime,
                            CalculatedFeeIn = item.CalculatedFeeIn,
                            PowerInPrice = item.PowerInPrice,
                            TimeUnit = (Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel)(int)item.TimeUnit
                        };

                        dbSession.Save(newProductionEntity);
                    }

                    var lastProductionInBatch = newProductions.Data.Max(x => x.MeasurementDate).DateTime;
                    if (lastProductionInBatch > lastProduction)
                        lastProduction = lastProductionInBatch;
                }
            }

            dbContext.Commit();

        }
        catch (Exception ex) 
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}"); 
            Log.LogError($"{JobName}(tenant: {tenant}): {ex}"); 
        }   
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the API client.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static DataReceiverApi GetApiClient()
    {
        var client = HttpClientExtensions.CreateClient();
        var dataReceiverApi = client.GetApiClient<DataReceiverApi>(x => { x.BaseUrl = BaseUrl; });
        client.Authenticate(dataReceiverApi).RunSync();
        return dataReceiverApi;
    }
}

using Autofac;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Requests;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using Quartz;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundServices.Jobs;

[DisallowConcurrentExecution]
public class SyncSecRoleOrgunitAssignmentJob : MonitoringTimerServiceBase
{
    protected override TenantRunningMode TenantRunningMode => TenantRunningMode.TenantDependent;

    protected override string CronExpression => "0 * * * * ?";

    private FrameworkApiClientService _frameworkApiClientService;

    protected override void Elapsed(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        Log.LogInfo("SyncSecRoleOrgunitAssignmentJob started");
        
        var securityContext = scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
        var mapper = scope.Resolve<IMapper>();
        var commandService = scope.Resolve<ICommandService>();
        _frameworkApiClientService = scope.Resolve<FrameworkApiClientService>();

        using var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        try
        {
            using (dbContext.Session.BeginTransaction())
            {
                var timeStamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
                var secRoleOrgUnitSyncInfo = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                    .Where(x => x.EntityName == SyncObjectConstants.SecRoleOrgunitSync)
                    .List()
                    .FirstOrDefault()
                    ?? new SyncObjectEntity
                    {
                        EntityName = SyncObjectConstants.SecRoleOrgunitSync,
                        LastModifiedDate = timeStamp
                    };

                SyncObjectEntity? userSyncInfo;
                using (var publicScope = scope.BeginLifetimeScope())
                {
                    publicScope.SetSystemContext();                   
                    var publicDbContext = publicScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

                    userSyncInfo = publicDbContext.Session.QueryOver<SyncObjectEntity>()
                    .Where(x => x.EntityName == SyncObjectConstants.UserTenant)
                    .List()
                    .FirstOrDefault();
                }

                if (secRoleOrgUnitSyncInfo.LastModifiedDate.HasValue &&
                    (!secRoleOrgUnitSyncInfo.LastSyncDate.HasValue || secRoleOrgUnitSyncInfo.LastSyncDate < secRoleOrgUnitSyncInfo.LastModifiedDate || (userSyncInfo != null && userSyncInfo.LastSyncDate > secRoleOrgUnitSyncInfo.LastSyncDate)))
                {

                    var request = new SyncSecRoleOrgunitRequest() { 
                        orgUnitIds= dbContext.Session.QueryOver<OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntity>().List().Select(x=>x.Id).ToList(),
                        secUserIds= dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecUserSyncedEntity>().List().Select(x => x.Id).ToList(),
                    };

                    var frameworkSecRoleOrgunits = _frameworkApiClientService.Post<SyncSecRoleOrgunitRequest,List<SecRoleOrgUnitSyncModel>>($"{FrameworkApi.SecRoleOrgUnit.SyncSecRoleOrgUnit_FullRoute}",request, securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).RunSync();

                    var secRoleOrgunitEntityDtos = frameworkSecRoleOrgunits.Select(mapper.Map<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>).ToList();

                    var localSecRoleOrgUnits = dbContext.Session.QueryOver<SecRoleOrgUnitSyncedEntity>().List();

                    ////Ez a metódus végzi a szinkronizálást
                    ListHelper.SyncChildren(commandService,
                                            secRoleOrgunitEntityDtos,
                                            localSecRoleOrgUnits,
                                            (x, y) => x.Id == y.Id,
                                            dto =>
                                            {
                                                var newDtoItem = commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                                                return dbContext.Session.Load<SecRoleOrgUnitSyncedEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                                            });

                    secRoleOrgUnitSyncInfo.LastSyncDate = timeStamp;
                    dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdate(secRoleOrgUnitSyncInfo);
                    dbContext.Commit();
                }

            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError("SecRoleOrgunit sync", ex);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.LogInfo("SyncSecRoleOrgunitAssignmentJob finished");
        }
    }
}
