using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Commands;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert;
using FluentValidation;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Alert;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.Alert;

/// <summary>
/// AlertCommandHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Alert.AlertEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert.AlertEntityDto&gt;" />
public class AlertCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<AlertEntity, AlertEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AlertCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public AlertCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<AlertEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    public override ICommandResult DoExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command)
    {
        return command switch
        {
            CreateAlertCommand createAlertCommand => DoCreateAlertCommand(createAlertCommand).RunSync(),
            ModifyAlertCommand modifyAlertCommand => DoModifyAlertCommand(modifyAlertCommand).RunSync(),
            DeleteAlertCommand deleteAlertCommand => DoDeleteAlertCommand(deleteAlertCommand).RunSync(),
            AlertActivateDeactivateCommand activteCommand => DoAlertActivateDeactivateCommand(activteCommand).RunSync(),
            _ => base.DoExecuteEntityCommand(command),
        };
    }

    private async Task<ICommandResult> DoAlertActivateDeactivateCommand(AlertActivateDeactivateCommand activteCommand)
    {
        if (activteCommand.AlertId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(activteCommand.AlertId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new AlertEntityQuery { Id = activteCommand.AlertId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not AlertEntityDto alertEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Alert Id. There is no AlertEntity with Id: '{activteCommand.AlertId}'");

        if(alertEntity.IsActive == activteCommand.IsActive)
            throw new ArgumentException($"A riasztás már a kért státuszban van!");

        alertEntity.IsActive = activteCommand.IsActive;

        var alertEntityDto = await _commandService.UpdateEntityAsync(alertEntity);
        return new AlertActivateDeactivateCommandResult { AlertEntityDto = alertEntityDto };
    }

    private async Task<ICommandResult> DoDeleteAlertCommand(DeleteAlertCommand deleteAlertCommand)
    {
        if (deleteAlertCommand.AlertId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(deleteAlertCommand.AlertId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new AlertEntityQuery { Id = deleteAlertCommand.AlertId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not AlertEntityDto alertEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Alert Id. There is no AlertEntity with Id: '{deleteAlertCommand.AlertId}'");

        /// Törlés validáció: Amennyiben a riasztáshoz tartozik legalább egy riasztási esemény is, az riasztás nem törölhető. Ebben az esetben figyelmeztető üzenetet adjunk!
        if ((alertEntity.AlertEvents != null &&
            alertEntity.AlertEvents.Any()))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("Az riasztás nem törölhető!");
        }

        var alertEntityDto = await _commandService.DeleteEntityAsync<AlertEntityDto>(deleteAlertCommand.AlertId);
        return new DeleteAlertCommandResult { IsSuccess = alertEntityDto == null || alertEntityDto.IsDeleted };
    }

    private async Task<ICommandResult> DoModifyAlertCommand(ModifyAlertCommand modifyAlertCommand)
    {
        if (modifyAlertCommand.AlertId == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modifyAlertCommand.AlertId), "Missing argument");

        if (_queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new AlertEntityQuery { Id = modifyAlertCommand.AlertId, IsDeleted = false }).Result?.Entity is not AlertEntityDto alertEntity)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid Alert Id. There is no AlertEntity with Id: '{modifyAlertCommand.AlertId}'");

        Mapper.Map(modifyAlertCommand, alertEntity);

        var alertEntityDto = await _commandService.UpdateEntityAsync(alertEntity);
        return new ModifyAlertCommandResult { AlertEntityDto = alertEntityDto };
    }

    private async Task<ICommandResult> DoCreateAlertCommand(CreateAlertCommand command)
    {
        var entityDto = Mapper.Map<AlertEntityDto>(command);
        entityDto.AlertIdentifier = GenerateAlertIdentifier();

        var alertEntityDto = await _commandService.CreateEntityAsync(entityDto);
        return new CreateAlertCommandResult { AlertEntityDto = alertEntityDto };
    }

    private string GenerateAlertIdentifier()
    {
        return $"RIA-{DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd_HH:mm:ss}";
    }

    protected override AlertEntity ApplyDto(AlertEntityDto source, AlertEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        MergeList(source.SubscribedUsers, entity.SubscribedUsers, (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id, entityRef => entityRef.Id);

        return entity;
    }
}

    /// <summary>

    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto OnEntityCreated(BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto createdEntity, BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto source)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto EntityPostEvent(BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto savedEntityDto, BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        entity.BuildingPartValidities ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.BuildingPartValidities,
                     entity.BuildingPartValidities,
                     (x, y) => x.Identifier == y.Identifier,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<BuildingPartValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     },
                     (dto, originalEntity) =>
                     {
                         dto.Id = originalEntity.Id;
                         dto.BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>() { Id = entity.Id };
                     });

        entity.Floors ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Floors,
                     entity.Floors,
                     (x, y) => x.Identifier == y.Identifier,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     },
                     (dto, originalEntity) =>
                     {
                         dto.Id = originalEntity.Id;
                         dto.BuildingPart = new EntityRef<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>() { Id = entity.Id };
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity ApplyDto(BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto source, BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.Building, entity, source.Building);

        return entity;
    }
}

    /// <param name="originalEntityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="updatedEntityDto"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto originalEntityDto, InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto OnEntityCreated(InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto createdEntity, InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto source)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);

        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitys the post event.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="savedEntityDto">The saved entity dto.</param>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto EntityPostEvent(InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto savedEntityDto, InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        entity.InstitutionValidities ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.InstitutionValidities,
                     entity.InstitutionValidities,
                     (x, y) => x.Identifier == y.Identifier,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<InstitutionValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     },
                     (dto, originalEntity) =>
                     {
                         dto.Id = originalEntity.Id;
                         dto.Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>() { Id = entity.Id };
                     });

        entity.Sites ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Sites,
                     entity.Sites,
                     (x, y) => x.Identifier == y.Identifier,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     },
                     (dto, originalEntity) =>
                     {
                         dto.Id = originalEntity.Id;
                         dto.Institution = new EntityRef<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>() { Id = entity.Id };
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity ApplyDto(InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto source, InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.Partner, entity, source.Partner);

        return entity;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.MeasurementPoint;

/// <summary>
/// IoT eszköz command handler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT.IoTDeviceEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.IoTDeviceEntityDto&gt;" />
public class IoTDeviceCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<IoTDeviceEntity, IoTDeviceEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDeviceCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public IoTDeviceCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<IoTDeviceEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    protected override IoTDeviceEntityDto OnEntityCreated(IoTDeviceEntityDto createdEntity, IoTDeviceEntityDto source)
    {
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(IoTDeviceEntityDto originalEntityDto, IoTDeviceEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
    }

    private IoTDeviceEntityDto EntityPostEvent(IoTDeviceEntityDto savedEntityDto, IoTDeviceEntityDto source)
    {
        var savedEntity = DbContext.Session.Load<IoTDeviceEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        savedEntity.MeasuredEndpoints ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.MeasuredEndpoints,
                     savedEntity.MeasuredEndpoints,
                     (x, y) => x.Identifier == y.Identifier,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.IoTDevice = new EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto> { Id = savedEntity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<IoTMeasuredEndpointEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     },
                     (dto, entity) =>
                     {
                         dto.Id = entity.Id;
                         dto.IoTDevice ??= new EntityRef<IoTDeviceEntityDto> { Id = savedEntity.Id };
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(savedEntity, savedEntityDto);
        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override IoTDeviceEntity ApplyDto(IoTDeviceEntityDto source, IoTDeviceEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.MeasurementPoint, entity, source.MeasurementPoint);

        return entity;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.MeasurementPoint;

/// <summary>
/// IoT eszköz command handler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers.CommandHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.BackEnd.DomainModel.IoT.IoTDeviceEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.Shared.Entities.IoT.IoTDeviceEntityDto&gt;" />
public class MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringCommandHandler : CommandHandlerBase<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity, MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The query service
    /// </summary>
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="IoTDeviceCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    protected override MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto OnEntityCreated(MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto createdEntity, MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto source)
    {
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto originalEntityDto, MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
    }

    private MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto EntityPostEvent(MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto savedEntityDto, MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto source)
    {
        var savedEntity = DbContext.Session.Load<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        savedEntity.ChildMeasurementPoints ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.ChildMeasurementPoints,
                     savedEntity.ChildMeasurementPoints,
                     (x, y) => x.Identifier == y.Identifier,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.ParentMeasurementPoint = new EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> { Id = savedEntity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     },
                     (dto, entity) =>
                     {
                         dto.Id = entity.Id;
                         dto.ParentMeasurementPoint ??= new EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> { Id = savedEntity.Id };
                     });

        savedEntity.Devices ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Devices,
                     savedEntity.Devices,
                     (x, y) => x.Identifier == y.Identifier,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.MeasurementPoint = new EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> { Id = savedEntity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<IoTDeviceEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     },
                     (dto, entity) =>
                     {
                         dto.Id = entity.Id;
                         dto.MeasurementPoint ??= new EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> { Id = savedEntity.Id };
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(savedEntity, savedEntityDto);
        return savedEntityDto;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Applys the dto.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="source">The source.</param>
    /// <param name="destination">The destination.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity ApplyDto(MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto source, MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);

        LoadRef(x => x.OrgunitBase, entity, source.OrgunitBase);
        LoadRef(x => x.Partner, entity, source.Partner);
        LoadRef(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, entity, source.ParentMeasurementPoint);

        MergeList(source.Labels, entity.Labels, (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id, entityRef => entityRef.Id);

        ListHelper.MergeList(source.MeasuredProperties, entity.MeasuredProperties, (s, d) => s.Id == d.Id,
            (src) => DbContext.Session.Get<MeasuredPropertyEntity>(src.Id));

        return entity;
    }
}

    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public PartnerSyncedCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<PartnerSyncedEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
    }

    protected override PartnerSyncedEntity ApplyDto(PartnerSyncedEntityDto source, PartnerSyncedEntity destination)
    {
        var entity = base.ApplyDto(source, destination);
        return entity;
    }

    protected override void OnEntityUpdated(PartnerSyncedEntityDto originalEntityDto, PartnerSyncedEntityDto updatedEntityDto)
    {
        base.OnEntityUpdated(originalEntityDto, updatedEntityDto);
        EntityPostEvent(updatedEntityDto, originalEntityDto);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felüldefiniálható logika, amely az entitás adatbázisszintű létrejöttét követően fut meg.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="createdEntity">A frissen létrejött entitás DTO, amely már a DB-ből érkezik.</param>
    /// <param name="source">A mentésre került forrás DTO</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    protected override PartnerSyncedEntityDto OnEntityCreated(PartnerSyncedEntityDto createdEntity, PartnerSyncedEntityDto source)
    {
        base.OnEntityCreated(createdEntity, source);
        return EntityPostEvent(createdEntity, source);
    }

    private PartnerSyncedEntityDto EntityPostEvent(PartnerSyncedEntityDto savedEntityDto, PartnerSyncedEntityDto source)
    {
        var entity = DbContext.Session.Load<PartnerSyncedEntity>(savedEntityDto.Id);

        entity.Institutions ??= [];
        SyncChildren(source.Institutions,
                     entity.Institutions,
                     (x, y) => x.Identifier == y.Identifier,
                     dto =>
                     {
                         dto.Partner = new EntityRef<PartnerSyncedEntityDto> { Id = entity.Id };
                         var newDtoItem = _commandService.CreateEntity(dto);
                         return DbContext.Session.Load<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity>(newDtoItem!.Id);
                     },
                     (dto, originalEntity) =>
                     {
                         dto.Id = originalEntity.Id;
                         dto.Partner = new EntityRef<PartnerSyncedEntityDto>() { Id = entity.Id };
                     });

        savedEntityDto = Mapper.Map(entity, savedEntityDto);

        return savedEntityDto;
    }
}

public class TenantSyncedCommandHandler : TenantCommandHandler<TenantSyncedEntity>

    /// Query service
    /// </summary>

    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TenantSyncedCommandHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="accessLogger">The access logger.</param>
    /// <param name="validator">The validator.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    public TenantSyncedCommandHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        Lazy<IAccessLogger> accessLogger,
        Lazy<IValidator<TenantEntityDto>> validator,
        IQueryService queryService,
        ICommandService commandService,
        SecurityContext securityContext) : base(dbContext, mapper, accessLogger, validator, queryService,commandService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Az entitás létrehozásakor megfutó metódus.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entityDto"></param>
    /// <param name="domainEntity"></param>
    protected override void OnEntityCreating(TenantEntityDto entityDto, TenantSyncedEntity domainEntity) 
    {
        base.OnEntityCreating(entityDto, domainEntity);
        DbContext.AddDisposeAction(() =>
        {
            using var scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
            scope.SetSecurityContext(SecurityContext.Create(scope,
                        _securityContext.CurrentUser.Clone(null),
                        sessionId: _securityContext.SessionId,
                        clientIp: _securityContext.ClientIp));
            var dbContext = scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
            StoredFunctionHelper.RunStoredFunction(dbContext, StoredFunctionNames.CombinedHourlyNormalizedConsumption);
            StoredFunctionHelper.RunStoredFunction(dbContext, StoredFunctionNames.CombinedDailyNormalizedConsumption);
            dbContext.Commit(); 
        });
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Services.ApiClientServices;
using Common.Shared.Diagnostics;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Alerts;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.Notifications;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Services.FrameworkApi;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Enums;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Managers.Alert;

/// <summary>
/// AlertManagerBase
/// </summary>
public class AlertManagerBase : IAlertManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Database context
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly IDbContext _dbContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    private readonly NotificationService _notificationService;
    private readonly DataReceiverApiClientService _dataReceiverApiClientService;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AlertManagerBase"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public AlertManagerBase(IDbContext dbContext, IQueryService queryService, IMapper mapper, NotificationService notificationService, DataReceiverApiClientService dataReceiverApiClientService)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _queryService = queryService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
        _dataReceiverApiClientService = dataReceiverApiClientService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Processes the alert.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="alert">The alert.</param>
    public async Task ProcessAlert(AlertEntity alert, string tenantCode)
    {
        var measurementExtremes = await GetMeasurementExtremesSinceLastCheck(alert, tenantCode);

        if (measurementExtremes == null)
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"Could not get latest measured extremes for Alert with identifier: '{alert.Identifier}'. DataPointIdentifier: {alert.DataPointIdentifier}.");
            return;
        }

        var triggerAlert = false;
        var triggerValue = 0m;
        var triggerDateTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
        switch (alert.Operator)
        {
            case AlertOperator.LessThanOrEqual:
                triggerAlert = measurementExtremes.MinValue <= alert.Threshold;
                triggerValue = measurementExtremes.MinValue;
                triggerDateTime = measurementExtremes.MinMeasuredAtUtc;
                break;
            case AlertOperator.GreaterThanOrEqual:
                triggerAlert = measurementExtremes.MaxValue >= alert.Threshold;
                triggerValue = measurementExtremes.MaxValue;
                triggerDateTime = measurementExtremes.MaxMeasuredAtUtc;
                break;
            default:
                throw new NotSupportedException($"AlertOperator {alert.Operator.GetDisplayName()} is not supported!");
        }

        if (triggerAlert)
        {
            if (alert.SubscribedUsers?.Any() == true)
            {
                foreach (var user in alert.SubscribedUsers)
                {
                    var newAlertEvent = new AlertEventEntity()
                    {
                        Alert = alert,
                        CreatedAtUtc = DateTimeContext.Now,
                        AlertText = alert.AlertText,
                        User = user,
                        Threshold = alert.Threshold,
                        MeasuredAtUtc = triggerDateTime,
                        TriggerValue = triggerValue
                    };

                    await _dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdateAsync(newAlertEvent);
                    Log.LogInfo($"New AlertEventEntity created for the following Alert and user with global id: {alert.Identifier}, {user.GlobalId}.");
                }

                var targetUsers = alert.SubscribedUsers
                        .Where(x => !x.IsDeleted)
                        .Select(x => new EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>
                        {
                            Id = x.Id,
                            EntityDisplayName = x.EMail
                        })
                        .ToList();

                await CreateAlertEventNotification(alert, tenantCode, triggerValue, triggerDateTime, targetUsers, externalEmailAddresses: null, notificationType: NotificationType.Push);
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(alert.ExternalEmailAddresses))
            {
                var dto = _mapper.Map<AlertEntityDto>(alert);

                if (dto.ExternalEmailAddresses.Any())
                {
                    var newAlertEvent = new AlertEventEntity()
                    {
                        Alert = alert,
                        CreatedAtUtc = DateTimeContext.Now,
                        AlertText = alert.AlertText,
                        Recipients = alert.ExternalEmailAddresses,
                        Threshold = alert.Threshold,
                        MeasuredAtUtc = triggerDateTime,
                        TriggerValue = triggerValue
                    };

                    await _dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdateAsync(newAlertEvent);
                    Log.LogInfo($"New AlertEventEntity created for the following Alert and e-mail addresses: {alert.Identifier}, {alert.ExternalEmailAddresses}.");

                    await CreateAlertEventNotification(alert, tenantCode, triggerValue, triggerDateTime, targetUsers: [], alert.ExternalEmailAddresses, NotificationType.Email);
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"No Alert was created for '{alert.Identifier}'. Conditions not met.");
        }

        alert.LastCheckedAtUtc = DateTimeContext.Now;
        await _dbContext.Session.SaveOrUpdateAsync(alert);
        _dbContext.Commit();
    }

    private async Task<NotificationModel?> CreateAlertEventNotification(
        AlertEntity alert,
        string tenantCode,
        decimal triggerValue,
        DateTime triggerDateTime,
        List<EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>> targetUsers,
        string? externalEmailAddresses,
        NotificationType notificationType
        )
    {
        var notificationPayload = new ConsumptionAlertNotificationPayload
        {
            Addressee = "Címzett", //ha nem emailcím, akkor a user nevét kell majd a modelbe tenni, ezt majd a FW-ben feloldjuk a SecUser-ből.
            MeasurementPointName = "Test Measurement Point", //TODO populate with actual value after sync job is implemented
            MeasuredPropertyName = "Test Measured Property", //TODO populate with actual value after sync job is implemented

            AlertText = alert.AlertText,
            Threshold = alert.Threshold,
            TriggerValue = triggerValue,
            MeasuredAtUtc = triggerDateTime
        };

        var notificationRequest = new CreateAlertNotificationRequest()
        {
            TargetUsers = targetUsers,
            EmailRecipients = externalEmailAddresses,
            Description = alert.AlertText,
            Title = alert.Name,
            NotificationType = notificationType,
            AlertDataType = alert.DataType,
            Payload = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(notificationPayload),
            ExpirationMinutes = 30 //TODO: ideiglenes érték (régi rendszerben: Alert.AlarmDuration -ból jött) (ha ez túl kicsi, akkor az email küldő job már nem kapja fel)
        };

        try
        {
            Log.LogInfo($"Creating new user-specific notifications for the following Alert: {alert.Identifier}...");
            var notification = await _notificationService.CreateAlertNotifications(tenantCode, notificationRequest);
            Log.LogInfo($"New user-specific notifications created for the following Alert: {alert.Identifier}.");

            return notification;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.LogError($"Failed to create new user-specific notifications for the following Alert: {alert.Identifier}: {ex}");
        }

        return null;
    }

    private async Task<MeasurementExtremes?> GetMeasurementExtremesSinceLastCheck(AlertEntity alert, string tenantCode)
    {
        switch (alert.DataType)
        {
            case AlertDataType.Consumption:
                var request = new Modules.DataReceiver.MeasurementExtremesRequest
                {
                    TenantCode = tenantCode,
                    DataPointIdentifiers = new List<Guid> { alert.DataPointIdentifier },
                    SinceUtc = new DateTimeOffset(alert.LastCheckedAtUtc.HasValue ? alert.LastCheckedAtUtc.Value : alert.Created!.Value)
                };

                var response = await _dataReceiverApiClientService.Post<Modules.DataReceiver.MeasurementExtremesRequest, List<MeasurementExtremes>>("/api/consumption/consumption-extremes", request, tenantCode);
                var extremes = response.SingleOrDefault(x => x.DataPointIdentifier == alert.DataPointIdentifier);
                return _mapper.Map<MeasurementExtremes>(extremes);
            //case AlertDataType.NormalizedConsumption:
            //TODO get value from database using QueryService
            default:
                throw new NotSupportedException($"AlertDataType {alert.DataType.GetDisplayName()} is not supported!");
        }
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.OrgUnitSecurity;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings;

/// <summary>
/// Deviza mapping
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class SyncMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="SyncMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public SyncMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<Modules.Framework.SyncSecUserModel, SecUserEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Created, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.CreatorUser, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Modified, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ModifierUser, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Tenants, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Roles, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Password, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.LockerUser, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.PasswordLastModify, y => y.MapFrom(z => ToDateTime(z.PasswordLastModify)))
            .ForMember(x => x.DateOfBirth, y => y.MapFrom(z => ToDateTime(z.DateOfBirth)))
            .ForMember(x => x.Locked, y => y.MapFrom(z => ToDateTime(z.Locked)))
            .ForMember(x => x.SecUserPasswordHistories, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.WarningMail, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.QRCode, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.TwoFactorOptions, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.TwoFactorSharedSecret, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.TwoFactorStatus, y => y.Ignore())
            ;

        CreateMap<Modules.Framework.TenantModel, TenantEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Created, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.CreatorUser, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Modified, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ModifierUser, y => y.Ignore())
            ;

        CreateMap<TenantSyncModel, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security.TenantEntityDto>()
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<SecUserSyncModel, SecUserSyncedEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Roles, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Roles.Select(x => new SecRoleEntityDto { Id = x })))
            .ForMember(x => x.Tenants, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Tenants.Select(x => new EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security.TenantEntityDto { Id = x })));

        CreateMap<SecRoleOrgUnitSyncModel, SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>()
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        CreateMap<SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto, SecRoleOrgUnitSyncedEntity>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.OrgunitType, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.OrgunitType))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ValidFrom, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.ValidFrom))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ValidTo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.ValidTo))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Role, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.User, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Institution, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Site, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Building, y => y.Ignore())
            ;

        CreateMap<SecRoleOrgUnitSyncedEntity,SecRoleOrgunitAssignmentEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Role, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.User, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Institution, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Site, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Building, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Role = c.Mapper.Map(src.Role.UnProxy(), dest.Role);
                dest.User = c.Mapper.Map(src.User.UnProxy(), dest.User);
                dest.Institution = c.Mapper.Map(src.Institution.UnProxy(), dest.Institution);
                dest.Site = c.Mapper.Map(src.Site.UnProxy(), dest.Site);
                dest.Building = c.Mapper.Map(src.Building.UnProxy(), dest.Building);
            });

        CreateMap<SecRoleOrgUnitSyncedEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();
 
        CreateMap<SecRoleEntity, EntityRef<SecRoleEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.RoleName);

         CreateMap<SecUserSyncedEntity, EntityRef<SecUserEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.EMail);

        CreateMap<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity, SimpleEntityRef>();

        CreateMap<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity, SimpleEntityRef>();

        CreateMap<BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity, SimpleEntityRef>();
            

    }

    private DateTime? ToDateTime(DateTimeOffset? dto)
    {
        return dto?.DateTime;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Commands;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.ListItems.Alert;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Alert;

/// <summary>
/// AlertMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class AlertMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AlertMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public AlertMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> EntityDto
        CreateMap<AlertEntity, AlertEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ExternalEmailAddresses, opt => opt.MapFrom(
                src => src.ExternalEmailAddresses
                    .Split(",", StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
                    .Select(email => email.Trim()) // Trim whitespace from 'a@b.c, x@y.z'
                    .ToList()))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ModifiedBy, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.ModifierUser!.LoginName));

        // EntityDto -> Entity
        CreateMap<AlertEntityDto, AlertEntity>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SubscribedUsers, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ExternalEmailAddresses, opt => opt.MapFrom(
                src => string.Join(",", src.ExternalEmailAddresses.Select(email => email.Trim()))))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Identifier, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.AlertEvents, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .IgnoreTrackedEntityProperties();

        //LogObject
        CreateMap<AlertEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<AlertEntityDto, AlertListItemDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.MeasurementPointName, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.DataPointName, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.DataPointIdentifier, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ModifierUserEmail, opt => opt.Ignore());

        CreateMap<AlertEventEntity, AlertEventEntityDto>()
            .ForPath(dest => dest.Alert.AlertEvents, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Alert, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Alert));

        CreateMap<AlertEntity, EntityRef<AlertEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Identifier.ToString());

        CreateMap<CreateAlertCommand, AlertEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.DataPointIdentifier, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.ChannelIdentifier))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SubscribedUsers, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.SubscribedUsers.Select(x => new SecUserSyncedEntityDto()
            {
                Id = x
            })));

        CreateMap<ModifyAlertCommand, AlertEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.DataPointIdentifier, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.ChannelIdentifier))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SubscribedUsers, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.SubscribedUsers.Select(x => new SecUserSyncedEntityDto()
            {
                Id = x
            })));

        CreateMap<Modules.DataReceiver.MeasurementExtremes, Common.Shared.Models.Alerts.MeasurementExtremes>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MinMeasuredAtUtc, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.MinMeasuredAtUtc.UtcDateTime))
            .ForMember(x => x.MaxMeasuredAtUtc, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.MaxMeasuredAtUtc.UtcDateTime));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.OrgunitSync.BuildingPart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Locations.Validities;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.Locations;

/// <summary>
/// BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringMappings()
    {
            // Entity -> EntityDto
            CreateMap<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity, BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Building, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.BuildingPartValidities, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Floors, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Building = c.Mapper.Map(src.Building.UnProxy(), dest.Building);
                if (src.Floors != null)
                    dest.Floors = src.Floors.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
                if (src.BuildingPartValidities != null)
                    dest.BuildingPartValidities = src.BuildingPartValidities.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<BuildingPartValiditySyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.MeasurementPoints != null)
                    dest.MeasurementPoints = src.MeasurementPoints.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
            });

        CreateMap<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        // EntityDto -> Entity
        CreateMap<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto, BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Building, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Floors, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.BuildingPartValidities, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto, EntityRef<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);

        CreateMap<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);


        CreateMap<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);

        CreateMap<BuildingPartSyncModel, BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dst => dst.Building, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dst => dst.OrgunitType, opt => opt.MapFrom(_ => OrgunitType.BuildingPart))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Id, opt => opt.MapFrom((src, dest, destMember, context) =>
            {
                return (bool)context.Items[SyncObjectConstants.UseManualId] ? src.Id : 0;
            }));
    }
}

            .ForMember(x => x.Sites, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.InstitutionValidities, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto, EntityRef<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);

        CreateMap<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);

        CreateMap<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity, SimpleEntityRef>()
            .ForMember(x => x.EntityDisplayName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.CurrentValidity.Name));

        CreateMap<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);

        CreateMap<InstitutionSyncModel, InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>()

/// <summary>
/// RoomSyncedMonitoringMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class RoomSyncedMonitoringMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="RoomSyncedMonitoringMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public RoomSyncedMonitoringMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> EntityDto
        CreateMap<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity, RoomSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Floor, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.RoomValidities, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Floor = c.Mapper.Map(src.Floor.UnProxy(), dest.Floor);
                if (src.RoomValidities != null)
                    dest.RoomValidities = src.RoomValidities.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<RoomValiditySyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.MeasurementPoints != null)
                    dest.MeasurementPoints = src.MeasurementPoints.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
            });

        CreateMap<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        // EntityDto -> Entity
        CreateMap<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntityDto, RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Floor, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.RoomValidities, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntityDto, EntityRef<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
        .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);

        CreateMap<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);

        CreateMap<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);

        CreateMap<RoomSyncModel, RoomSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dst => dst.Floor, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dst => dst.OrgunitType, opt => opt.MapFrom(_ => OrgunitType.Room))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Id, opt => opt.MapFrom((src, dest, destMember, context) =>

            }));

            .ForMember(x => x.Institution, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Buildings, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.SiteValidities, y => y.Ignore())

                if (src.MeasurementPoints != null)
                    dest.MeasurementPoints = src.MeasurementPoints.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
            });

        // EntityDto -> Entity
        CreateMap<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntityDto, SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Institution, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Buildings, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.SiteValidities, y => y.Ignore());

            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity, SimpleEntityRef>()
            .ForMember(x => x.EntityDisplayName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.CurrentValidity.Name));


        CreateMap<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntityDto, EntityRef<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.CurrentValidity.Name);

        CreateMap<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()

/// <summary>
/// BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> DTO
        CreateMap<BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity, BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Building, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.BuildingProfile, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Building = c.Mapper.Map(src.Building.UnProxy(), dest.Building);
                if (src.BuildingProfile != null)
                    dest.BuildingProfile = c.Mapper.Map(src.BuildingProfile.UnProxy(), dest.BuildingProfile);
            });

        CreateMap<BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        // Dto -> Entity
        CreateMap<BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringEntityDto, BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Building, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.BuildingProfile, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<BuildingValiditySyncModel, BuildingValiditySyncedMonitoringEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dst => dst.Building, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dst => dst.BuildingProfile, opt => opt.MapFrom(y => y.BuildingProfileId.HasValue ? new EntityRef<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>() { Id = y.BuildingProfileId.Value } : null))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Id, opt => opt.MapFrom((src, dest, destMember, context) =>
            {
                return (bool)context.Items[SyncObjectConstants.UseManualId] ? src.Id : 0;
            }));
    }
}

            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<DeviceSyncModel, IoTDeviceEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceTypeCode, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceTypeCode))
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceTypeName, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceTypeName))
            .ForMember(x => x.DeviceCategory, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.IoTDeviceCategory))
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredEndpoints, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.Channels))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Id, opt => opt.MapFrom((src, dest, destMember, context) =>
            {
                return (bool)context.Items[SyncObjectConstants.UseManualId] ? src.Id : 0;
            }));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Logging;
using Common.BackEnd.Constants;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi.MeasurementPointSync;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Partner;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.MeasurementPoint;

public class MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity, MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ChildMeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Partner, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Devices, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Labels, y => y.Ignore())
            .MaxDepth(2)
            .PreserveReferences()
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                dest.Partner = c.Mapper.Map(src.Partner.UnProxy(), dest.Partner ?? new EntityRef<PartnerSyncedEntityDto>());
                dest.OrgunitBase = c.Mapper.Map(src.OrgunitBase.UnProxy(), dest.OrgunitBase ?? new EntityRef<OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>());
                if (src.ParentMeasurementPoint != null)
                {
                    dest.ParentMeasurementPoint = c.Mapper.Map(src.ParentMeasurementPoint.UnProxy(), dest.ParentMeasurementPoint ?? new EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>());
                }
                if (src.ChildMeasurementPoints != null)
                    dest.ChildMeasurementPoints = src.ChildMeasurementPoints.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.MeasuredProperties != null)
                    dest.MeasuredProperties = src.MeasuredProperties.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.Devices != null)
                    dest.Devices = src.Devices.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<IoTDeviceEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.Labels != null)
                    dest.Labels = src.Labels.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
            });

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity, EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto, EntityRef<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.Name);

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto, MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Partner, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.ChildMeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredProperties, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Devices, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.Labels, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<MeasurementPointSyncModel, MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.OrgunitBase, y => y.MapFrom(z => new OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntityDto() { Id = z.OrgunitBaseId }))
            .ForMember(x => x.ParentMeasurementPoint, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.ParentMeasurementPointId.HasValue ? new MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto() { Id = z.ParentMeasurementPointId.Value } : null))
            .ForMember(x => x.Labels, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.LabelIds.Select(x => new TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto() { Id = x })))
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasuredProperties, y => y.MapFrom(z => z.MeasuredProperties.Select(x => new MeasuredPropertyEntityDto() { Id = x })))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Id, opt => opt.MapFrom((src, dest, destMember, context) =>
            {
                return (bool)context.Items[SyncObjectConstants.UseManualId] ? src.Id : 0;
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Partner, opt => opt.MapFrom((src, dest, destMember, context) =>
            {
                return new PartnerSyncedEntityDto() { Id = (int)context.Items[SyncObjectConstants.TenantCode] };
            }));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.ListItems.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Models;
using OtpNet;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.Mappings.MeasurementPoints;
public class OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewMappings : Profile
{
    public OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntity, OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntityDto>().ReverseMap();

        CreateMap<OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntityDto, DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.ChannelIdentifier))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.UnitOfMeasure, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.UnitOfMeasure ?? string.Empty))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.TopologyData, opt => opt.MapFrom(src =>
                new DevicesAggregatedDataResultTopologyData(
                    src.InstitutionName ?? string.Empty,
                    src.SiteName ?? string.Empty,
                    src.BuildingName ?? string.Empty,
                    src.BuildingPartName ?? string.Empty,
                    src.FloorName ?? string.Empty,
                    src.RoomName ?? string.Empty
                )))

            .ForMember(dest => dest.DeviceData, opt => opt.MapFrom(src =>
                new DevicesAggregatedDataResultDeviceData(
                    src.DeviceCategory ?? string.Empty,
                    src.DeviceType ?? string.Empty,
                    src.AggregationMethod.GetDisplayName() ?? src.AggregationMethod.ToString()
                )))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.MeasurementPointData, opt => opt.MapFrom(src =>
                new DevicesAggregatedDataResultMeasurementPointData(
                    src.MeasurementPointIdentifier ?? string.Empty,
                    src.MeasurementPointName ?? string.Empty,
                    src.MeasuredProperty ?? string.Empty,
                    src.Technologies ?? string.Empty
                )))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.TodaysData, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.LastDaysData, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Last7DaysData, opt => opt.Ignore());

        CreateMap<AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto, DevicesAggregatedDataResultTodaysData>();
        CreateMap<AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto, DevicesAggregatedDataResultLastDaysData>();
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringMappings
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="AutoMapper.Profile" />
public class PartnerSyncedMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="PartnerSyncedMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public PartnerSyncedMappings()
    {
        // Entity -> EntityDto
        CreateMap<PartnerSyncedEntity, PartnerSyncedEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Institutions, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore())
            .AfterMap((src, dest, c) =>
            {
                if (src.Institutions != null)
                    dest.Institutions = src.Institutions.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x)).ToList();

                if (src.MeasurementPoints != null)
                    dest.MeasurementPoints = src.MeasurementPoints.UnProxyList().Select(x => c.Mapper.Map<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntityDto>(x)).ToList();
            });

        CreateMap<PartnerSyncedEntity, LogObject>()
            .MappingLogObject();

        CreateMap<PartnerSyncedEntity, EntityRef<PartnerSyncedEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.TenantCode);

        // EntityDto -> Entity
        CreateMap<PartnerSyncedEntityDto, PartnerSyncedEntity>()
            .ForMember(x => x.Institutions, y => y.Ignore())
            .ForMember(x => x.MeasurementPoints, y => y.Ignore());

        CreateMap<PartnerSyncedEntityDto, EntityRef<PartnerSyncedEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.TenantCode);

        CreateMap<PartnerSyncedEntity, EntityRef<PartnerSyncedEntityDto>>()
            .CreateToEntityRefMap(x => x.TenantCode);

        CreateMap<PartnerSyncModel, PartnerSyncedEntityDto>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Id, opt => opt.MapFrom((src, dest, destMember, context) =>
            {
                return (bool)context.Items[SyncObjectConstants.UseManualId] ? src.Id : 0;
            }));
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

using NHibernate.SqlCommand;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Alert;

/// <summary>
/// AlertEventQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Alert.AlertEventEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert.AlertEntityDto&gt;" />
public class AlertEventQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<AlertEventEntity, AlertEventEntityDto>
{
    private readonly AlertEventEntity _rootAlias = null!;
    private readonly SecUserEntity _userAlias = null!;
    private readonly AlertEntity _alertAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AlertEventQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public AlertEventQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper)
        : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    protected override IQueryOver<AlertEventEntity, AlertEventEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryJoin(IQueryOver<AlertEventEntity, AlertEventEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryJoin(queryOver, query);

        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.User, () => _userAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
        queryOver.JoinAlias(() => _rootAlias.Alert, () => _alertAlias, JoinType.LeftOuterJoin);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using NHibernate;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.ListItems.Alert;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Alert;
using NHibernate.Criterion;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Alert;

/// <summary>
/// AlertQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Alert.AlertEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert.AlertEntityDto&gt;" />
public class AlertQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<AlertEntity, AlertEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AlertQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public AlertQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper)
        : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            PagedEntityQuery<AlertEntityDto, AlertListItemDto> alertListItemQuery => DoQueryEntities(alertListItemQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query),
        };
    }

    protected override IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoQuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            AlertEntityQuery alertQuery => DoAlertEntityQuery(alertQuery),
            _ => base.DoQuerySingleEntity(query)
        };
    }

    private IEntityQuerySingleResult? DoAlertEntityQuery(AlertEntityQuery alertQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<AlertEntity>();

        if (alertQuery.IsDeleted.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.IsDeleted == alertQuery.IsDeleted);

        if (alertQuery.Id != null)
            queryOver.Where(t => t.Id == alertQuery.Id);

        var entity = queryOver.List().SingleOrDefaultEx("Ambiguous AlertEntityQuery");
        return new EntityQuerySingleResult()
        {
            Entity = CreateDto(entity)
        };
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<AlertEntity, AlertEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        switch (query)
        {
            case AlertPagedEntityQuery alertPagedEntityQuery:
                if (alertPagedEntityQuery.InstitutionId.HasValue)
                {
                    //TODO implement filtering by institution
                }

                if (alertPagedEntityQuery.SiteId.HasValue)
                {
                    //TODO implement filtering by site
                }

                if (alertPagedEntityQuery.BuildingId.HasValue)
                {
                    //TODO implement filtering by building
                }

                if (alertPagedEntityQuery.BuildingPartId.HasValue)
                {
                    //TODO implement filtering by building part
                }

                if (alertPagedEntityQuery.FloorId.HasValue)
                {
                    //TODO implement filtering by floor
                }

                if (alertPagedEntityQuery.RoomId.HasValue)
                {
                    //TODO implement filtering by room
                }

                if (alertPagedEntityQuery.MeasurementPointId.HasValue)
                {
                    //TODO implement filtering by measurement point
                }

                if (alertPagedEntityQuery.MeasuredPropertyId.HasValue)
                {
                    //TODO implement filtering by measured property
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(alertPagedEntityQuery.AlertIdentifier))
                {
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<AlertEntity>(x => x.AlertIdentifier)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(alertPagedEntityQuery.AlertIdentifier, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                }

                if (alertPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.HasValue)
                {
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.IsActive == alertPagedEntityQuery.IsActive.Value);
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(alertPagedEntityQuery.Name))
                {
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<AlertEntity>(x => x.Name)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(alertPagedEntityQuery.Name, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(alertPagedEntityQuery.ModifierUserEmail))
                {
                    queryOver.Where(
                        Restrictions.On<AlertEntity>(x => x.ModifierUser.LoginName)
                            .IsInsensitiveLike(alertPagedEntityQuery.ModifierUserEmail, MatchMode.Anywhere));
                }

                break;
        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<AlertEntity, AlertEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(AlertListItemDto))
        {
            AlertListItemDto? listItemAlias = null!;

            queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Id).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.Id)
                .Select(x => x.AlertIdentifier).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AlertIdentifier)
                .Select(x => x.Identifier).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.Identifier) //IGlobalIdentifier
                .Select(x => x.Name).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.Name)
                .Select(x => x.ModifierUser.LoginName).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.ModifierUserEmail)
//                .Select(x => x.MeasurementPointName).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.DataPointIdentifier) //TODO filterezés measurement point name alapján, majd ha lesz sync
                .Select(x => x.DataPointIdentifier).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.DataPointIdentifier)

                //TODO: ezeket a property-ket majd akkor tudjuk lekérni, ha lesznek Framework-ből szinkronizált adatok, akkor kell rá majd join, és akkor lekérdezhető
                //.Select(x => x.MeasurementPointName).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.MeasurementPointName)
                //.Select(x => x.DataPointName).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.DataPointName)

                .Select(x => x.IsActive).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.IsActive)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Queries.Production;
using FluentNHibernate.Utils;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.Transform;
using NHibernate.Type;
using NHibernate.Util;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Consumption;

/// <summary>
/// ConsumptionQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;ConsumptionEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Consumption.ConsumptionEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ConsumptionQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntityDto>
{
    private record AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord(Guid? ChannelId, string? PodId, DateTime MeasuredAtUtc, decimal? Value, decimal? Co2eValue);

    private const string CONSUMPTION_CHART_X_AXIS_DATETIME_FORMAT = "yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm";
    private const string CONSUMPTION_CHART_X_AXIS_DATE_FORMAT = "yyyy.MM.dd";

    /// <summary>
    /// Guids
    /// </summary>
    private Guid[] _guids = Array.Empty<Guid>();
    /// <summary>
    /// Measurement from date
    /// </summary>
    private DateTime? _measurementFromDate;
    /// <summary>
    /// Measurement to date
    /// </summary>
    private DateTime? _measurementToDate;
    /// <summary>
    /// Projection
    /// </summary>
    private IProjection? _projection = default;
    /// <summary>
    /// Query service
    /// </summary>
    private IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly IConsumptionAggregationService _consumptionAggregationService;
    private readonly IResolutionHandlerFactory _resolutionHandlerFactory;
    private readonly IEdmInterfaceService _edmInterfaceService;
    private readonly ICo2eCalculatorService _co2ECalculatorService;
    private IReadOnlyList<Co2eFactorEntityDto> _co2eFactorSeries;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ConsumptionQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The query service.</param>
    public ConsumptionQueryHandler(
        IDbContext dbContext,
        IMapper mapper,
        IQueryService queryService,
        IConsumptionAggregationService consumptionAggregationService,
        IResolutionHandlerFactory resolutionHandlerFactory,
        IEdmInterfaceService edmInterfaceService,
        ICo2eCalculatorService co2ECalculatorService
        )
        : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _queryService = queryService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(queryService));
        _consumptionAggregationService = consumptionAggregationService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(consumptionAggregationService));
        _resolutionHandlerFactory = resolutionHandlerFactory ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(resolutionHandlerFactory));
        _edmInterfaceService = edmInterfaceService;
        _co2ECalculatorService = co2ECalculatorService;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
