            AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery subMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery => DoExecuteAggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery(subMeterAggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery).GetAwaiter().GetResult(),
            ConsumptionEnergyPriceQuery consumptionEnergyPriceQuery => DoExecuteConsumptionEnergyPriceQuery(consumptionEnergyPriceQuery),
            ConsumptionProductionQuery consumptionDataQuery => DoExecuteConsumptionDataQuery(consumptionDataQuery),
            ConsumptionSummaryDataQuery consumptionSummaryDataQuery => DoExecuteConsumptionSummaryDataQuery(consumptionSummaryDataQuery),
            _ => base.ExecuteQuery(query)
        };
    }

    private async Task<AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQueryResult> DoExecuteAggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery(AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery query)
    {
        var session = DbContext.Session;
        MeasuredPropertyEntity measuredProperty = await session.GetAsync<MeasuredPropertyEntity>(query.MeasuredPropertyId)!;
        List<AggregatedConsumptionIntermediateResult> intermediateResult = await _consumptionAggregationService.GetAggregationIntermediateResult(query);

        var channelIdList = intermediateResult
            .SelectMany(x => x.ChannelIds)
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        var data = new List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord>();

        if (query.IsBilling)
        {
            //főmérős lekérdezés, populate data from EDM
            data = await GetMainMeterMeasurements(query, intermediateResult, measuredProperty);
        }
        else
        {
            data = await GetSubMeterMeasurements(query, channelIdList);
        }

        var (minDateTime, maxDateTime) = GetAggregationMinAndMaxDateTimes(query.From, query.To, query.Aggregation);

        var dates = new List<DateTime>();
        var currentDate = minDateTime;

        while (currentDate <= maxDateTime)
        {
            dates.Add(currentDate);

            currentDate = query.Aggregation switch
            {
                AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => currentDate.AddMinutes(5),
                AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => currentDate.AddMinutes(15),
                AggregationLevel.OneHour => currentDate.AddHours(1),
                AggregationLevel.OneDay => currentDate.AddDays(1),
                _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"{nameof(AggregationLevel)}.{query.Aggregation} is not supported!"),
            };
        }

        var xAxisFormat = GetConsumptionChartXAxisFormatString(query.Aggregation);

        var model = new ChartModel()
        {
            Title = $"{(query.IsBilling ? "Főmérő" : "Almérő")} diagram",
            Unit = "kW", //TODO honnan jöjjön? device configban van, de hogy jön a device a measurement pointhoz és a topológia elemekhez?
            XAxisValues = dates.Select(date => date.ToString(xAxisFormat)).ToList()
        };

        foreach (var intermediateResultItem in intermediateResult)
        {
            var filteredData = data
                .Where(x => (x.ChannelId.HasValue && intermediateResultItem.ChannelIds.Contains(x.ChannelId.Value)) || intermediateResultItem.PodIds.Contains(x.PodId))
                .ToList();

            var values = dates
                .Select(dateTime => filteredData.FirstOrDefault(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == dateTime)?.Value ?? 0m)
                .Select(x => Convert.ToDecimal(x) as decimal?)
                .ToList();

            model.Items.Add(new ChartItemModel()
            {
                ChartType = ChartType.Line,
                Datas = values,
                Name = intermediateResultItem.Name
            });
        }

        return new AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQueryResult
        {
            ChartModel = model,
            MeasuredPropertyName = measuredProperty.MeasuredPropertyName,
            MeasurementUnit = "kW" //TODO retrieve from db somehow
        };
    }

    private static string GetConsumptionChartXAxisFormatString(AggregationLevel aggregation)
    {
        switch (aggregation)
        {
            case AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
            case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
            case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                return CONSUMPTION_CHART_X_AXIS_DATETIME_FORMAT;
            case AggregationLevel.OneDay:
            case AggregationLevel.OneWeek:
            case AggregationLevel.OneMonth:
            case AggregationLevel.OneYear:
                return CONSUMPTION_CHART_X_AXIS_DATE_FORMAT;
            default:
                return CONSUMPTION_CHART_X_AXIS_DATETIME_FORMAT;
        }
    }

    private async Task<List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord>> GetMainMeterMeasurements(
        AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery query,
        List<AggregatedConsumptionIntermediateResult> intermediateResult,
        MeasuredPropertyEntity measuredProperty
        )
    {
        var podIdList = intermediateResult
            .SelectMany(x => x.PodIds!)
            .Where(podId => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(podId))
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        //query all active co2efactors from core db
        _co2eFactorSeries = await _co2ECalculatorService.GetCo2eConsumptionFactorSeries();

        var measurementPointsEntities = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.IsBilling == true && x.PodId != null && x.PodId != "")
            .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.PodId).IsIn(podIdList)
            .List().ToList();


        List<Task<Guid>> edmTasks = [];
        Dictionary<int, string> podIdChannelIdMap = [];
        foreach (var podId in podIdList)
        {
            var edmDataChannel = await GetEdmDataChannel(measuredProperty.Code, podId);
            int? dataChannelId = edmDataChannel?.DataChannelId;
            if (dataChannelId == null)
            {
                //not found...
                continue;
            }
            podIdChannelIdMap[dataChannelId.Value] = podId;

            edmTasks.Add(_edmInterfaceService.RequestMeasurements(
                dataChannelId.Value,
                query.From.ToDateOnly(),
                query.To.ToDateOnly(),
                forceRefresh: false,
                cancellationToken: query.CancellationToken));
        }
        await Task.WhenAll(edmTasks);
        List<Guid> edmRequestIds = [.. edmTasks.Select(task => task.Result)];

        //get all results:
        var resultTasks = new List<Task<List<MeasurementResponseModel>>>();
        foreach (var req in edmRequestIds.Where(r => !r.Equals(Guid.Empty)))
        {
            resultTasks.Add(_edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurementResults(req, query.CancellationToken));
        }
        await Task.WhenAll(resultTasks);
        //we received all data

        Dictionary<int, List<MeasurementResponseModel>> edmResultsByChannel = [];
        edmResultsByChannel = resultTasks
            .SelectMany(task => task.Result)
            .GroupBy(m => m.DataChannelId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.ToList());
        List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord> transformedData = [];
        foreach (var channel in edmResultsByChannel)
        {
            if (channel.Value.Count < 1)
                continue; //no data

            if (!podIdChannelIdMap.TryGetValue(channel.Key, out var podIdFromChannelMap))
            { //not found...
                continue;
            }

            AggregationMethod aggregationMethod = measuredProperty.AggregationMethod;

            Co2eFactorCategory co2EFactorCategory = Co2eFactorCategory.Consumption;
            if (measuredProperty.IsConsumption.HasValue)
            {
                co2EFactorCategory = measuredProperty.IsConsumption.Value
                    ? Co2eFactorCategory.Consumption
                    : Co2eFactorCategory.Production;
            }
            
            //egy channel több listában kaphat mérések listáját. az EDM Mock API-ban napi bontást csináltam, de nem tudjuk, a valós EDM hogy fog visszaadni adatokat.
            //itt a napi bontást összemergeltem egy listába:
            var channelMeasurements = channel.Value.SelectMany(m => m.Measurements).OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToList();

            var normalizedMeasurements = NormalizeMainMeterMeasurements(channelMeasurements,
                query.Aggregation,
                aggregationMethod: aggregationMethod,
                co2eFactorCategory: co2EFactorCategory,
                channelId: Guid.Empty,  //channelId nem fog kelleni!
                podId: podIdFromChannelMap
                );
            transformedData.AddRange(normalizedMeasurements);
        }

        return transformedData; // ez a több csatornát vegyesen tartalmazza
    }

    private async Task<EdmDataChannel?> GetEdmDataChannel(string measuredPropertyCode, string podId)
    {
        var obisCodesQueryRes = await _queryService.QueryEntities(
            new MeasuredPropertyEntityQuery
            {
                Code = measuredPropertyCode
            });

        var obisCodes = (obisCodesQueryRes as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>)?
            .Items.FirstOrDefault()?
            .ObisCodes;

        if (obisCodes == null || obisCodes.Count < 1)
            return null; //not found

        var edmDeviceRes = await _edmInterfaceService.GetEDMDevices(podId);

        if (edmDeviceRes.Devices.Count > 1)
            Log.LogWarning("More than one device found for the given POD!");

        if (edmDeviceRes.Devices.First().DataChannels.Count > 1)
            Log.LogWarning("More than one data channel found for the given Device!");

        EdmDataChannel? dataChannel = edmDeviceRes
            .Devices.First()
            .DataChannels.FirstOrDefault(x => obisCodes.Contains(x.ObisCode));

        return dataChannel;
    }

    private static List<MeasurementDataModel> EnsureDataContinuity(List<MeasurementDataModel> channelMeasurements, AggregationLevel aggregation)
    {
        List<MeasurementDataModel> continuityData = [];
        DateTime firstTimeStamp = channelMeasurements.Min(x => x.MeasurementDate);
        DateTime lastTimeStamp = channelMeasurements.Max(x => x.MeasurementDate);

        /*logic:
         - slice the data between firstTimeStamp and lastTimeStamp by aggregation. (ensure complete intervals, so 15 min must be from 10:00-10:14:59.9999)
         - if there are gaps in the data, fill them with null (0) values.
         */
        TimeSpan interval = aggregation switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
            AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15),
            AggregationLevel.OneHour => TimeSpan.FromHours(1),
            AggregationLevel.OneDay => TimeSpan.FromDays(1),
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"AggregationLevel of {aggregation} is not supported!"),
        };
        DateTime currentTimeStamp = firstTimeStamp.GetPreviousBoundary(interval);
        DateTime lastTimeStampBoundary = lastTimeStamp.GetNextBoundary(interval).AddTicks(-1);
        while (currentTimeStamp < lastTimeStampBoundary)
        {
            DateTime nextTimeStamp = currentTimeStamp.Add(interval);
            var intervalData = channelMeasurements.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= currentTimeStamp && x.MeasurementDate < nextTimeStamp); //exlude the next, because it should be the next interval start
            if (!intervalData.Any())
            {
                //if no measurement found, add a 0 value
                continuityData.Add(new MeasurementDataModel
                {
                    MeasurementDate = currentTimeStamp,
                    Value = 0,
                    Co2e = null,
                });
            }
            else
            {
                continuityData.AddRange(intervalData);
            }

            currentTimeStamp = currentTimeStamp.Add(interval);
        }

        return continuityData;
    }


    private List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord> NormalizeMainMeterMeasurements(
        List<MeasurementDataModel> channelMeasurements,
        AggregationLevel aggregationLevel,
        AggregationMethod aggregationMethod,
        Co2eFactorCategory co2eFactorCategory,
        Guid channelId,
        string? podId = null
        )
    {
        //ki kell egészíteni az idősport az Aggregation szerinti gyakoriságra, ha hiányos, mondjuk null értékekkel.
        channelMeasurements = EnsureDataContinuity(channelMeasurements, aggregationLevel);

        TimeSpan interval = aggregationLevel switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
            AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15),
            AggregationLevel.OneHour => TimeSpan.FromHours(1),
            AggregationLevel.OneDay => TimeSpan.FromDays(1),
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"AggregationLevel of {aggregationLevel} is not supported!"),
        };
        List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord> result = [];
        DateTime startTime = channelMeasurements.Min(cm => cm.MeasurementDate);
        DateTime endTime = channelMeasurements.Max(cm => cm.MeasurementDate);
        DateTime currentTime = startTime.GetPreviousBoundary(interval);
        DateTime lastTimeBoundary = endTime.GetNextBoundary(interval).AddTicks(-1);

        //looping through data
        while (currentTime < lastTimeBoundary)
        {
            var intervalData = channelMeasurements
                .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= currentTime && x.MeasurementDate < currentTime.Add(interval))
                .ToList();

            decimal aggregatedValue = AggregationHelper.Aggregate<MeasurementDataModel, decimal>(
                intervalData,
                x => Convert.ToDecimal(x.Value),
                aggregationMethod)
                ?? 0m; // default to 0 if no data is available

            result.Add(new AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord(
                channelId,
                podId,
                currentTime,
                aggregatedValue,
                Co2eValue: _co2ECalculatorService.CalculateCo2e(aggregatedValue, currentTime, co2eFactorCategory, _co2eFactorSeries)
                ));

            currentTime += interval;
        }

        return result;
    }

    private async Task<List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord>> GetSubMeterMeasurements(AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery query, List<Guid> channelIdList)
    {
        List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord> transformedData = query.Aggregation switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => await GetAggregatedFifteenMinData(query, channelIdList),
            AggregationLevel.OneHour => await GetAggregatedHourlyData(query, channelIdList),
            AggregationLevel.OneDay => await GetAggregatedDailyData(query, channelIdList),
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"AggregationLevel of {query.Aggregation} is not supported!"),
        };
        return transformedData;
    }


    private async Task<List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord>> GetAggregatedFifteenMinData(AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery query, List<Guid> channelIdList)
    {
        var fifteenMinData = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.IsIn(channelIdList))
                        .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc >= query.From.Date && x.MeasuredAtUtc.Date <= query.To.Date)
                        .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc()
                        .ListAsync();

        return fifteenMinData
            .Select(x => new AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord(x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier, null, x.MeasuredAtUtc, Convert.ToDecimal(x.Value), x.Co2eValue))
            .ToList();
    }

    private async Task<List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord>> GetAggregatedHourlyData(AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery query, List<Guid> channelIdList)
    {
        var hourlyData = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionHourlyEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.ChannelIdentifier.IsIn(channelIdList))
                .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc >= query.From.Date && x.MeasuredAtUtc.Date <= query.To.Date)
                .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc()
                .ListAsync();

        return hourlyData
            .Select(x => new AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord(x.ChannelIdentifier, null, x.MeasuredAtUtc, Convert.ToDecimal(x.Value), x.Co2eValue))
            .ToList();
    }

    private async Task<List<AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord>> GetAggregatedDailyData(AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery query, List<Guid> channelIdList)
    {
        var dailyData = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.ChannelIdentifier.IsIn(channelIdList))
                        .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc >= query.From.Date && x.MeasuredAtUtc.Date <= query.To.Date)
                        .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc()
                        .ListAsync();

        return dailyData
            .Select(x => new AggregableConsumptionMeasurementRecord(x.ChannelIdentifier, null, x.MeasuredAtUtc.Date, Convert.ToDecimal(x.Value), x.Co2eValue))
            .ToList();
    }


#pragma warning disable S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
#pragma warning restore S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    {
        // Excel export rekordok lekérdezése
        if (query is ConsumptionExportEntityQuery exportQuery)
        {
            Aggregate_inner(exportQuery.SpatialAggregation, exportQuery.Identifiers);

            if (_guids.Any())
            {
                var consumptionList = (EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionListItemDto>)DoQueryEntities(exportQuery);
                if (exportQuery.NeedProductionData.HasValue && !exportQuery.NeedProductionData.Value)
                {
                    consumptionList.Items.Where(x => x.EnergyProduced == null).Each(x => x.EnergyProduced = 0);
                    consumptionList.Items.Where(x => x.Production == null).Each(x => x.Production = 0);
                    return consumptionList;
                }

                var production = _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(new ProductionExportEntityQuery
                {
                    Aggregation = exportQuery.Aggregation,
                    From = exportQuery.Aggregation != null && exportQuery.Aggregation.Value == AggregationLevel.OneDay ? exportQuery.From?.ToLocalTime() : exportQuery.From,
                    Identifiers = exportQuery.Identifiers,
                    To = exportQuery.To,
                    SpatialAggregation = exportQuery.SpatialAggregation,
                    PagingInfo = new PagingInfo
                    {
                        PageSize = exportQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize,
                        StartPage = exportQuery.PagingInfo.StartPage
                    },
                    SortingInfo = new SortingInfo()
                    {
                        SortColumn = exportQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn,
                        SortDirection = exportQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection
                    },
                    NeedProductionData = exportQuery.NeedProductionData

                })?.Result;

                var result = consumptionList.Items.ToList();
                int addedProduction = 0;
                //Ha vannak termelsi adatok
                if (production != null && Array.Exists(production.Items, x => x != null))
                {
                    if (exportQuery.OnlyProductionData.HasValue && exportQuery.OnlyProductionData.Value ||
                        result == null || !result.Any())
                    {
                        result = new List<ConsumptionListItemDto>();
                        foreach (var item in production.Items)
                            result.Add(new ConsumptionListItemDto()
                            {
                                NoNeedConvert = true,
                                MeasurementDate = item.MeasurementDate,
                                Current = 0,
                                Active = 0,
                                Reactive = 0,
                                Voltage = 0,
                                Linevoltage = 0,
                                Phasevoltage = 0,
                                RelativeConsumption = 0,
                                EnergyProduced = item.Energy,
                                Production = item.Power,
                                AggregationLevel = exportQuery.Aggregation,
                            });

                        consumptionList.Items = result.ToArray();
                        consumptionList.RecordsTotal = result.Count;
                        return consumptionList;
                    }
                    int counter = 0;
                    foreach (var item in production.Items)
                    {
                        var index = result.FindIndex(x => x.MeasurementDate == item.MeasurementDate);
                        if (index == -1)
                        {
                            result.Insert(counter, new ConsumptionListItemDto()
                            {
                                NoNeedConvert = true,
                                MeasurementDate = item.MeasurementDate,
                                Current = 0,
                                Active = 0,
                                Reactive = 0,
                                Voltage = 0,
                                Linevoltage = 0,
                                Phasevoltage = 0,
                                RelativeConsumption = 0,
                                EnergyProduced = item.Energy.Round(3),
                                Production = item.Power.Round(3),
                                AggregationLevel = exportQuery.Aggregation
                            });
                            addedProduction++;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            result[counter].EnergyProduced = 0;
                            result[counter].Production = 0;
                        }
                        counter++;
                    }
                }

                consumptionList.RecordsTotal += addedProduction;
                consumptionList.Items = result.Take(consumptionList.RecordsTotal).ToArray();
                consumptionList.Items.Where(x => x.EnergyProduced == null).Each(x => x.EnergyProduced = 0);
                consumptionList.Items.Where(x => x.Production == null).Each(x => x.Production = 0);
                return consumptionList;
            }
            else
                return new EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<ConsumptionListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };
        }

        if (query is ConsumptionEnergyPriceExportEntityQuery energyPriceExportQuery)
        {
            Aggregate_inner(energyPriceExportQuery.SpatialAggregation, energyPriceExportQuery.Identifiers);

            if (_guids.Any())
            {
                var consumptionListItemResults = DoQueryEntities(energyPriceExportQuery) as EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto>;


                var productionEnergyPriceExportEntityQuery = new ProductionEnergyPriceExportEntityQuery
                {
                    Aggregation = energyPriceExportQuery.Aggregation,
                    SpatialAggregation = energyPriceExportQuery.SpatialAggregation,
                    From = energyPriceExportQuery.Aggregation != null && energyPriceExportQuery.Aggregation.Value == AggregationLevel.OneDay ? energyPriceExportQuery.From?.ToLocalTime() : energyPriceExportQuery.From,
                    To = energyPriceExportQuery.To,
                    Identifiers = energyPriceExportQuery.Identifiers,
                    IsDeleted = energyPriceExportQuery.IsDeleted,
                    PagingInfo = energyPriceExportQuery.PagingInfo,
                    SearchText = energyPriceExportQuery.SearchText,
                    SortingInfo = energyPriceExportQuery.SortingInfo
                };

                var productionListItemResults = _queryService.QueryPagedEntities(productionEnergyPriceExportEntityQuery);

                if (consumptionListItemResults != null && consumptionListItemResults.Items.Length > 0)
                {
                    if (productionListItemResults != null && productionListItemResults.Items.Any())
                        foreach (var p in productionListItemResults.Items)
                        {
                            var consumptionDto = Array.Find(consumptionListItemResults.Items, c => c.MeasurementDate == p.MeasurementDate);
                            if (consumptionDto != null)
                            {
                                consumptionDto.CalculatedFeeIn = p.CalculatedFeeIn;
                                consumptionDto.PowerInPrice = p.PowerInPrice;
                                consumptionDto.Power = p.Power;
                            }
                        }
                }
                else
                {
                    List<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto> items = new() { };
                    if (productionListItemResults != null && productionListItemResults.Items.Any())
                    {
                        foreach (var p in productionListItemResults.Items)
                        {
                            var consumptionDto = new ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto
                            {
                                CalculatedFeeIn = p.CalculatedFeeIn,
                                PowerInPrice = p.PowerInPrice,
                                Power = p.Power,
                                MeasurementDate = p.MeasurementDate,
                                CalculatedFeeOut = 0,
                                PurchasePrice = 0,
                                RelativeConsumption = 0,
                                NoNeedConvert = true
                            };
                            items.Add(consumptionDto);
                        }
                    }
                    consumptionListItemResults = new EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto> { Items = items.ToArray(), RecordsTotal = items.Count };
                }


                return consumptionListItemResults;
            }
            else
                return new EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };
        }

        if (query is ConsumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            Aggregate_inner(consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation, consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Identifiers);

            if (_guids.Any())
            {
                var consumptionListItemResults = DoQueryEntities(consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery) as EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto>;


                var productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery = new ProductionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery
                {
                    Aggregation = consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Aggregation,
                    SpatialAggregation = consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation,
                    From = consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Aggregation != null && consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Aggregation.Value == AggregationLevel.OneDay ?
                    consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.From?.ToLocalTime() : consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.From,
                    To = consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.To,
                    Identifiers = consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Identifiers,
                    IsDeleted = consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.IsDeleted,
                    PagingInfo = consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.PagingInfo,
                    SearchText = consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SearchText,
                    SortingInfo = consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo
                };

                var productionListItemResults = _queryService.QueryPagedEntities(productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery);

                if (consumptionListItemResults != null && consumptionListItemResults.Items.Length > 0)
                {
                    if (productionListItemResults != null && productionListItemResults.Items.Any())
                        foreach (var p in productionListItemResults.Items)
                        {
                            var consumptionDto = consumptionListItemResults?.Items.FirstOrDefault(c => c.MeasurementDate == p.MeasurementDate);
                            if (consumptionDto != null)
                            {
                                consumptionDto.CalculatedFeeIn = p.CalculatedFeeIn;
                                consumptionDto.PowerInPrice = p.PowerInPrice;
                                consumptionDto.Power = p.Power;
                            }
                        }
                }
                else
                {
                    List<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto> items = new() { };
                    if (productionListItemResults != null && productionListItemResults.Items.Any())
                    {
                        foreach (var p in productionListItemResults.Items)
                        {
                            var consumptionDto = new ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto
                            {
                                CalculatedFeeIn = p.CalculatedFeeIn,
                                PowerInPrice = p.PowerInPrice,
                                Power = p.Power,
                                MeasurementDate = p.MeasurementDate,
                                CalculatedFeeOut = 0,
                                PurchasePrice = 0,
                                RelativeConsumption = 0,
                                NoNeedConvert = true,
                                AggregationLevel = p.AggregationLevel
                            };
                            items.Add(consumptionDto);
                        }
                    }
                    consumptionListItemResults = new EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto> { Items = items.ToArray(), RecordsTotal = items.Count };
                }


                return consumptionListItemResults;
            }
            else
                return new EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };
        }

        if (query is ConsumptionPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery)
        {
            Aggregate_inner(pagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation, pagedEntityQuery.Identifiers);

            if (_guids.Any())
            {
                var consumptionList = (EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionListItemDto>)DoQueryEntities(pagedEntityQuery);

                for (var i = 0; i < consumptionList.Items.Length; i++)
                    DivideSum(consumptionList.Items[i], pagedEntityQuery.Aggregation ?? AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);

                if (pagedEntityQuery.NeedProductionData.HasValue && !pagedEntityQuery.NeedProductionData.Value)
                {
                    consumptionList.Items.Where(x => x.EnergyProduced == null).Each(x => x.EnergyProduced = 0);
                    consumptionList.Items.Where(x => x.Production == null).Each(x => x.Production = 0);

                    consumptionList.Items.Each(x =>
                    {
                        x.Production = x.Production.Round(3);
                        x.Active = x.Active.Round(3);
                        x.Current = x.Current.Round(3);
                        x.Linevoltage = x.Linevoltage.Round(3);
                        x.Phasevoltage = x.Phasevoltage.Round(3);
                        x.EnergyProduced = x.EnergyProduced.Round(3);
                        x.Reactive = x.Reactive.Round(3);
                        x.RelativeConsumption = x.RelativeConsumption.Round(3);
                        x.Voltage = x.Voltage.Round(3);
                    });

                    return consumptionList;
                }

                var production = _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(new ProductionPagedEntityQuery
                {
                    Aggregation = pagedEntityQuery.Aggregation,
                    From = pagedEntityQuery.From,
                    Identifiers = pagedEntityQuery.Identifiers,
                    To = pagedEntityQuery.To,
                    SpatialAggregation = pagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation,
                    PagingInfo = new PagingInfo
                    {
                        PageSize = pagedEntityQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize,
                        StartPage = pagedEntityQuery.PagingInfo.StartPage
                    },
                    SortingInfo = new SortingInfo()
                    {
                        SortColumn = pagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo.SortColumn,
                        SortDirection = pagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo.SortDirection
                    },
                    NeedProductionData = pagedEntityQuery.NeedProductionData

                })?.Result;

                var result = consumptionList.Items.ToList();
                int addedProduction = 0;
                //Ha vannak termelsi adatok
                if (production != null && Array.Exists(production.Items, x => x != null))
                {
                    if (pagedEntityQuery.OnlyProductionData.HasValue && pagedEntityQuery.OnlyProductionData.Value ||
                        result == null || !result.Any())
                    {
                        result = new List<ConsumptionListItemDto>();
                        foreach (var item in production.Items)
                        {
                            DateTime date = default;
                            if (pagedEntityQuery.Aggregation == AggregationLevel.OneDay)
                                date = item.MeasurementDate.Date;
                            else
                                date = item.MeasurementDate;

                            var proditem = new ConsumptionListItemDto()
                            {
                                NoNeedConvert = true,
                                MeasurementDate = date,
                                Current = 0,
                                Active = 0,
                                Reactive = 0,
                                Voltage = 0,
                                Linevoltage = 0,
                                Phasevoltage = 0,
                                RelativeConsumption = 0,
                                EnergyProduced = item.Energy.Round(3),
                                Production = item.Power.Round(3),
                                AggregationLevel = item.AggregationLevel //AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes                                
                            };

                            result.Add(proditem);
                        }
                        consumptionList.Items = result.ToArray();
                        consumptionList.RecordsTotal = production.RecordsTotal;
                        return consumptionList;
                    }
                    int counter = 0;
                    foreach (var item in production.Items)
                    {
                        var index = result.FindIndex(x => x.MeasurementDate == item.MeasurementDate);
                        if (index == -1)
                        {
                            result.Insert(counter, new ConsumptionListItemDto()
                            {
                                NoNeedConvert = true,
                                MeasurementDate = item.MeasurementDate,
                                Current = 0,
                                Active = 0,
                                Reactive = 0,
                                Voltage = 0,
                                Linevoltage = 0,
                                Phasevoltage = 0,
                                RelativeConsumption = 0,
                                EnergyProduced = item.Energy.Round(3),
                                Production = item.Power.Round(3),
                                AggregationLevel = AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes
                            });
                            addedProduction++;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            result[counter].EnergyProduced = 0;
                            result[counter].Production = 0;
                        }
                        counter++;
                    }
                }

                consumptionList.RecordsTotal += addedProduction;
                consumptionList.Items = result.Take(pagedEntityQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize ?? 10).ToArray();
                consumptionList.Items.Where(x => x.EnergyProduced == null).Each(x => x.EnergyProduced = 0);
                consumptionList.Items.Where(x => x.Production == null).Each(x => x.Production = 0);
                return consumptionList;
            }
            else
                return new EntityListItemQueryResult<ConsumptionListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<ConsumptionListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };
        }

        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Aggregates, inner method in order to reduce complexity and code duplications.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="spatialAggregation">The spatial aggregation.</param>
    /// <param name="identifiers">The identifiers.</param>
    private void Aggregate_inner(SpatialAggregationLevel? spatialAggregation, Guid[]? identifiers)
    {
        if (identifiers?.Any() == true || spatialAggregation == SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant)
        {
            var iotDeviceQueryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>();
            var iotMeasuredEndpointQueryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTMeasuredEndpointEntity>();
            switch (spatialAggregation)
            {
                //case SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant:
                //    // Ilyenkor minden rekordot felhasználunk, nem szűrünk térben, mert
                //    // a teljes tenantra vonatkozó adatok kellenek (minden telephely-é).
                //    _guids = iotDeviceQueryOver.Select(x => x.SiteIdentifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                //    break;
                //case SpatialAggregationLevel.Site:
                //    iotDeviceQueryOver = iotDeviceQueryOver.Where(x => x.SiteIdentifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                //    _guids = iotDeviceQueryOver.Select(x => x.SiteIdentifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                //    break;
                //case SpatialAggregationLevel.SiteLocation:
                //    iotDeviceQueryOver = iotDeviceQueryOver.Where(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                //    _guids = iotDeviceQueryOver.Select(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                //    break;
                case SpatialAggregationLevel.MeasuredEndpoint:
                    iotMeasuredEndpointQueryOver = iotMeasuredEndpointQueryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                    _guids = iotMeasuredEndpointQueryOver.Select(x => x.Identifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                    break;
                case SpatialAggregationLevel.Device:
                default:
                    iotDeviceQueryOver = iotDeviceQueryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                    _guids = iotDeviceQueryOver.Select(x => x.Identifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                    break;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            _guids = Array.Empty<Guid>();
        }
    }

#pragma warning disable S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    /// <summary>
    /// Does the execute consumption summary data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="consumptionSummaryDataQuery">The consumption summary data query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoExecuteConsumptionSummaryDataQuery(ConsumptionSummaryDataQuery consumptionSummaryDataQuery)
#pragma warning restore S3776 // Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
    {
        var year = DateTime.UtcNow.Year;
        var month = DateTime.UtcNow.Month;
        var lastDay = DateTime.UtcNow.Day;
        var startDate = new DateTime(year, month, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
        var endDate = new DateTime(year, month, lastDay, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        var lastDate = startDate.AddMonths(-1);
        var lastStartDate = lastDate;
        var lastMonthLastDayday = DateTime.DaysInMonth(lastStartDate.Year, lastStartDate.Month);
        var lastEndDate = new DateTime(lastStartDate.Year, lastStartDate.Month, lastMonthLastDayday, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        var query = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>();
        var productionQuery = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ProductionEntity>();
        var queryLastMonth = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ConsumptionEntity>();
        var productionLastQuery = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<ProductionEntity>();

        if (consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers == null || !consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers.Any())
            return new ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult()
            {
                CO2 = 0,
                LastMonthConsumption = 0,
                RelativeConsumption = 0,
                ConsumptionDifference = 0,
                Production = 0,
                LastMonthProduction = 0,
                ProductionDifference = 0
            };

        if (consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers != null && consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers.Any())
        {
            consumptionSummaryDataQuery.SpatialAggregation ??= SpatialAggregationLevel.Device;

            if (consumptionSummaryDataQuery.SpatialAggregation != null &&
            (
                consumptionSummaryDataQuery.SpatialAggregation == SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant ||
                (
                    consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers != null &&
                    consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers.Any()
                )
            ))
                switch (consumptionSummaryDataQuery.SpatialAggregation)
                {
                    case SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant:
                        // Ilyenkor minden rekordot felhasználunk, nem szűrünk térben, mert
                        // a teljes tenantra vonatkozó adatok kellenek (minden telephely-é).
                        break;
                    case SpatialAggregationLevel.Site:
                        query = query.Where(x => x.SiteIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        queryLastMonth = queryLastMonth.Where(x => x.SiteIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        productionQuery = productionQuery.Where(x => x.SiteIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        productionLastQuery = productionLastQuery.Where(x => x.SiteIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        break;
                    case SpatialAggregationLevel.SiteLocation:
                        query = query.Where(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        queryLastMonth = queryLastMonth.Where(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        productionQuery = productionQuery.Where(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        productionLastQuery = productionLastQuery.Where(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        break;
                    case SpatialAggregationLevel.MeasuredEndpoint:
                        query = query.Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        queryLastMonth = queryLastMonth.Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        productionQuery = productionQuery.Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        productionLastQuery = productionLastQuery.Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        break;
                    case SpatialAggregationLevel.Device:
                    default:
                        query = query.Where(x => x.DeviceIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        queryLastMonth = queryLastMonth.Where(x => x.DeviceIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        productionQuery = productionQuery.Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        productionLastQuery = productionLastQuery.Where(x => x.DeviceIdentifier.IsIn(consumptionSummaryDataQuery.Identifiers));
                        break;
                }
        }

        ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult alias = null!;
        ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult alias2 = null!;
        ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult alias3 = null!;


        queryLastMonth
          .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= lastStartDate && x.MeasurementDate <= lastEndDate)
          .SelectList(list => list
          .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(y => y.Active * (1.0 / 12.0))).WithAlias(() => alias2.LastMonthConsumption));


        if (consumptionSummaryDataQuery.CO2Multiplier != null)
            query
           .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= startDate && x.MeasurementDate <= endDate)
           .SelectList(list => list
           .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(y => y.Active * (1.0 / 12.0))).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
           .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(y => y.Active * (1.0 / 12.0) * consumptionSummaryDataQuery.CO2Multiplier.Value)).WithAlias(() => alias.CO2));
        else
            query
           .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= startDate && x.MeasurementDate <= endDate)
           .SelectList(list => list
           .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(y => y.Active * (1.0 / 12.0))).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
           .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(y => y.Active * (1.0 / 12.0) * 0.35)).WithAlias(() => alias.CO2));


        productionQuery
          .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= startDate && x.MeasurementDate <= endDate)
          .SelectList(list => list
          .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(y => y.Energy * (1.0 / 4.0))).WithAlias(() => alias.Production));

        productionLastQuery
          .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= lastStartDate && x.MeasurementDate <= lastEndDate)
          .SelectList(list => list
          .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(y => y.Energy * (1.0 / 4.0))).WithAlias(() => alias3.LastMonthProduction));

        var consumptionCO2Result = query.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult>()).SingleOrDefault<ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult>();

        var lastMonthConsumptionResult = queryLastMonth.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult>()).SingleOrDefault<ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult>();
        consumptionCO2Result.ConsumptionDifference = lastMonthConsumptionResult.LastMonthConsumption == null || lastMonthConsumptionResult.LastMonthConsumption == 0 || consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption == null ||
            consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption == 0 ? 0 : ((consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption / lastMonthConsumptionResult.LastMonthConsumption) * 100).Round(3);


        var productionResult = productionQuery.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult>()).SingleOrDefault<ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult>();
        consumptionCO2Result.Production = productionResult.Production.Round(3);
        var lastMonthProductionResult = productionLastQuery.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult>()).SingleOrDefault<ConsumptionSummaryDataQueryResult>();
        consumptionCO2Result.ProductionDifference = lastMonthProductionResult.LastMonthProduction == null || lastMonthProductionResult.LastMonthProduction == 0 || consumptionCO2Result.Production == null ||
            consumptionCO2Result.Production == 0 ? 0 : ((consumptionCO2Result.Production / lastMonthConsumptionResult.LastMonthProduction) * 100).Round(3);

        var consuption = consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption == null || consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption == 0 ? 0 : consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption;
        var production = consumptionCO2Result.Production == null || consumptionCO2Result.Production == 0 ? 0 : consumptionCO2Result.Production;
        consumptionCO2Result.MJ = (consuption - production) == 0 ? 0 : ((consuption - production) * 3.6).Round(3);

        consumptionCO2Result.CO2 = consumptionCO2Result.CO2.Round(3);
        consumptionCO2Result.LastMonthConsumption = consumptionCO2Result.LastMonthConsumption.Round(3);
        consumptionCO2Result.LastMonthProduction = consumptionCO2Result.LastMonthProduction.Round(3);
        consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption = consumptionCO2Result.RelativeConsumption.Round(3);

        return consumptionCO2Result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the execute consumption data query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="consumptionDataQuery">The consumption data query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoExecuteConsumptionDataQuery(ConsumptionProductionQuery consumptionDataQuery)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(consumptionDataQuery.TenantCode))
        {
            using var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
            tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(consumptionDataQuery.TenantCode);
            DbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
            _queryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        }

        var queryOver = GetQueryOver();

        var consumption = new ConsumptionProductionQueryResult();

        // Ha a térbeli aggregáció enum null => hiba
        // Ha a térbeli aggregáció NEM tenant-szintű és az Identifiers tömb null vagy üres => hiba.
        // Ha a térbeli aggregáció tenant-szintű, akkor nem kellenek azonosítók, mert minden érvényes
        // rekord szükséges a számításhoz.

        if (consumptionDataQuery.SpatialAggregation != null &&
            (
                consumptionDataQuery.SpatialAggregation == SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant ||
                (
                    consumptionDataQuery.Identifiers != null &&
                    consumptionDataQuery.Identifiers.Any()
                )
            )
        )
            SetupQueryWhere_inner(queryOver, consumptionDataQuery.Identifiers, consumptionDataQuery.SpatialAggregation);
        else
            return consumption;

        if (consumptionDataQuery.From.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= consumptionDataQuery.From.Value);

        if (consumptionDataQuery.To.HasValue)
            if (consumptionDataQuery.NotFullday)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= consumptionDataQuery.To.Value);
            else
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= consumptionDataQuery.To.Value.GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay()); //.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);

        DoAggregation(queryOver, consumptionDataQuery.Aggregation ?? AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);

        var consumptionList = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ConsumptionListItemDto>())
            .OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate)
            .Asc
            .List<ConsumptionListItemDto>();

        //if(consumptionDataQuery.Aggregation == AggregationLevel.OneDay) CorrectDailyData(consumptionDataQuery, consumptionList);

        for (var i = 0; i < consumptionList.Count; i++)
            DivideSum(consumptionList[i], consumptionDataQuery.Aggregation ?? AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);

        if (consumptionDataQuery.NeedProductionData.HasValue && consumptionDataQuery.NeedProductionData.Value)
        {
            var production = (_queryService.QueryEntities(new ProductionPagedEntityQuery
            {
                Aggregation = consumptionDataQuery.Aggregation,
                From = consumptionDataQuery.From,
                Identifiers = consumptionDataQuery.Identifiers,
                To = consumptionDataQuery.To,
                SpatialAggregation = consumptionDataQuery.SpatialAggregation
            })?.Result as EntityListItemQueryResult<ProductionListItemDto>)?.Items?.ToList();

            if (production != null && production.Count > 0)
            {
                foreach (var p in production)
                {
                    var foundConsumption = consumptionList.FirstOrDefault(c => c.MeasurementDate == p.MeasurementDate);
                    if (foundConsumption != null)
                    {
                        foundConsumption.EnergyProduced = p.Energy;
                        foundConsumption.Production = p.Power;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        consumptionList.Add(new ConsumptionListItemDto
                        {
                            NoNeedConvert = true,
                            MeasurementDate = p.MeasurementDate,
                            Current = 0,
                            Active = 0,
                            Reactive = 0,
                            Voltage = 0,
                            Linevoltage = 0,
                            Phasevoltage = 0,
                            RelativeConsumption = 0,
                            Production = p.Power,
                            EnergyProduced = p.Energy
                        });
                    }
                }

                consumptionList = consumptionList.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToList();
            }
        }



        if (consumptionList != null)
        {
            // Vegyük az adatok között szereplő legkisebb felbontási értéket.
            // Ha ez 5perc, akkor minden időbeli aggregációs szintet engedhetünk, de ha ennél nagyobb
            // (pl.: 15 perc, vagy 1 óra, vagy 1 nap) akkor az ennél kisebb felbontásokat nem szabad engedni,
            // ezeket ki kellene szűrni az opciók közül.
            // Példa: Ha csak 1 órás felbontású fogyasztási/termelési "nyers" adatok vannak, akkor nem
            // lehet ezeket a chart-on, 5 perces felbontással megjeleníteni. De 1 napra aggregálhatunk.
            List<AggregationLevel> allUnits = Enum.GetValues<AggregationLevel>().OrderBy(x => x).ToList();
            AggregationLevel smallestDataSourceUnit = consumptionList
                .Select(x => x.TimeUnit)
                .Distinct()
                .OrderBy(x => x)
                .FirstOrDefault();

            List<AggregationLevel> excludedUnits = allUnits.Where(u => u < smallestDataSourceUnit).ToList();

            consumption = new ConsumptionProductionQueryResult()
            {
                MeasurementDate = consumptionList.Select(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToList(),
                Current = consumptionList.Select(x => x.Current.Round(3) ?? 0).ToList(),
                Active = consumptionList.Select(x => x.Active.Round(3) ?? 0).ToList(),
                Reactive = consumptionList.Select(x => x.Reactive.Round(3) ?? 0).ToList(),
                Voltages = consumptionList.Select(x => x.Voltage.Round(3) ?? 0).ToList(),
                LineVoltages = consumptionList.Select(x => x.Linevoltage.Round(3) ?? 0).ToList(),
                PhaseVoltages = consumptionList.Select(x => x.Phasevoltage.Round(3) ?? 0).ToList(),
                RelativeConsumption = consumptionList.Select(x => x.RelativeConsumption.Round(3) ?? 0).ToList(),
                Energy = consumptionList.Select(x => x.EnergyProduced.Round(3) ?? 0).ToList(),       // Production.Energy
                Power = consumptionList.Select(x => x.Production.Round(3) ?? 0).ToList(),         // Production.Power
                ExcludedTimeUnits = excludedUnits
            };
        }

        DbContext.Commit();
        DbContext.Dispose();

        return consumption;
    }

    private void CorrectDailyData(ConsumptionProductionQuery query, IList<ConsumptionListItemDto> consumptionList)
    {
        if (!query.From.HasValue || !consumptionList.Any()) return;
        var list = consumptionList.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Take(2).ToArray();
        if (query.From.Value > list[0].MeasurementDate)
        {
            consumptionList.First(x => x.Id == list[1].Id).Current += list[0].Current;
            consumptionList.First(x => x.Id == list[1].Id).Active += list[0].Active;
            consumptionList.First(x => x.Id == list[1].Id).Reactive += list[0].Reactive;
            consumptionList.First(x => x.Id == list[1].Id).RelativeConsumption += list[0].RelativeConsumption;

            consumptionList.Remove(list[0]);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Divides the sum.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="x">The x.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">The aggregation.</param>
    private static void DivideSum(ConsumptionListItemDto x, AggregationLevel aggregation)
    {
        x.Active /= DetermineCount(x.TimeUnit, aggregation);
        x.Reactive /= DetermineCount(x.TimeUnit, aggregation);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the execute consumption energy price query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoExecuteConsumptionEnergyPriceQuery(ConsumptionEnergyPriceQuery query)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.TenantCode))
        {
            using var tenantScope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
            tenantScope.SetTenantAdminUserContext(query.TenantCode);
            DbContext = tenantScope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
            _queryService = tenantScope.Resolve<IQueryService>();
        }

        var queryOver = GetQueryOver();

        var result = new ConsumptionEnergyPriceQueryResult();

        // Ha a térbeli aggregáció enum null => hiba
        // Ha a térbeli aggregáció NEM tenant-szintű és az Identifiers tömb null vagy üres => hiba.
        // Ha a térbeli aggregáció tenant-szintű, akkor nem kellenek azonosítók, mert minden érvényes
        // rekord szükséges a számításhoz.

        if (query.SpatialAggregation != null &&
            (
                query.SpatialAggregation == SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant ||
                (
                    query.Identifiers != null &&
                    query.Identifiers.Any()
                )
            )
        )
            SetupQueryWhere_inner(queryOver, query.Identifiers, query.SpatialAggregation);
        else
            return result;

        FilterByMeasurementDate_inner(queryOver, query.From, query.To, query.Aggregation);

        DoEnergyPriceAggregation(queryOver, query.Aggregation ?? AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);

        var consumptionRes = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto>())
            .OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc.List<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto>();

        // Production lekérdezés
        var productionRes = (_queryService.ExecuteQuery(new ProductionEnergyPriceQuery
        {
            Aggregation = query.Aggregation,
            SpatialAggregation = query.SpatialAggregation,
            From = query.From,
            To = query.To,
            Identifiers = query.Identifiers
        }).Result as ProductionEnergyPriceQueryResult)?.Items;

        // Production merge
        if (productionRes != null && productionRes.Count > 0)
        {
            if (consumptionRes != null && consumptionRes.Count > 0)
                foreach (var p in productionRes)
                {
                    var c = consumptionRes.FirstOrDefault(cr => cr.MeasurementDate == p.MeasurementDate);
                    if (c != null)
                    {
                        c.Power = p.Power;
                        c.PowerInPrice = p.PowerInPrice;
                        c.CalculatedFeeIn = p.CalculatedFeeIn;
                    }
                }
            else
            {
                consumptionRes = new List<ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto> { };
                foreach (var p in productionRes)
                {
                    ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto c = new()
                    {
                        MeasurementDate = p.MeasurementDate,
                        Power = p.Power,
                        PowerInPrice = p.PowerInPrice,
                        CalculatedFeeIn = p.CalculatedFeeIn,
                        CalculatedFeeOut = 0,
                        PurchasePrice = 0,
                        RelativeConsumption = 0
                    };
                    consumptionRes.Add(c);
                }
            }
        }

        consumptionRes.Each(x =>
        {
            result.MeasurementDate.Add(x.MeasurementDate);
            result.CalculatedFeeIn.Add(x.CalculatedFeeIn?.Round(3) ?? 0);
            result.CalculatedFeeOut.Add(x.CalculatedFeeOut.Round(3) ?? 0);
            result.RelativeConsumption.Add(x.RelativeConsumption.Round(3) ?? 0);
            result.PurchasePrice.Add(x.PurchasePrice ?? 0);
            result.PowerInPrice.Add(x.PowerInPrice ?? 0);
        });

        DbContext.Commit();
        DbContext.Dispose();

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up row count.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    public override int SetUpRowCount(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ConsumptionPagedEntityQuery consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            return SetupRowCount_inner(queryOver, consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery.Identifiers, consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery.Aggregation);
        }

        if (query is ConsumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            return SetupRowCount_inner(queryOver, consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Identifiers, consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Aggregation);
        }

        return base.SetUpRowCount(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the row count, inner method in order to reduce complexity and code duplications.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="identifiers">The identifiers.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">The aggregation.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private int SetupRowCount_inner(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver, Guid[]? identifiers, AggregationLevel? aggregation)
    {
        var sql = GetGeneratedSql(queryOver);
        sql = sql[sql.IndexOf(" FROM ")..];
        if (_measurementFromDate != null || _measurementToDate != null)
        {
            var sqlBody = sql[..sql.IndexOf(" GROUP ")];
            sqlBody = sqlBody.Replace("and this_.measurement_date >= ?", string.Empty);
            sqlBody = sqlBody.Replace("and this_.measurement_date <= ?", string.Empty);
            var sqlGroup = sql[sql.IndexOf(" GROUP ")..];
            if (_measurementFromDate != null)
                sqlBody += $" and this_.measurement_date >= :from";
            if (_measurementToDate != null)
                sqlBody += $" and this_.measurement_date <= :to";

            if (identifiers == null || identifiers.Length == 0)
                sqlBody = sqlBody.Replace("this_.measurement_date >= ?  and ", string.Empty);

            sqlGroup = sqlGroup.Replace("::int", "");
            sql = sqlBody + " " + sqlGroup;
        }

        ISQLQuery sqlQuery = aggregation switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes or AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes or AggregationLevel.OneDay or AggregationLevel.OneHour => DbContext
                                    .Session
                                    .CreateSQLQuery($"SELECT COUNT(t1.*) FROM ({"SELECT min(this_.consumption_id) as y0_ " + sql}) AS t1"),
            _ => DbContext
                                    .Session
                                    .CreateSQLQuery($"SELECT COUNT(t1.*) FROM ({"SELECT this_.measurement_date as y0_ " + sql}) AS t1"),
        };
        var index = 0;
        if (identifiers != null && _guids != null)
            foreach (var guid in _guids)
                sqlQuery.SetParameter(index++, guid, NHibernateUtil.Guid);

        if (_measurementToDate != null)
            sqlQuery.SetParameter("to", _measurementToDate.Value, NHibernateUtil.DateTime);
        if (_measurementFromDate != null)
            sqlQuery.SetParameter("from", _measurementFromDate.Value, NHibernateUtil.DateTime);

        var result = sqlQuery.UniqueResult<long>();
        return (int)result;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(ConsumptionListItemDto))
        {
            DoAggregation(queryOver, (query as IAggregation)?.Aggregation ?? AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);
        }

        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto))
        {
            DoEnergyPriceAggregation(queryOver, (query as IAggregation)?.Aggregation ?? AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes);
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver,
        IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        if (query is ConsumptionPagedEntityQuery consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery.Identifiers != null &&
                consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery.Identifiers.Any() &&
                _guids != null && _guids.Any())
            {
                SetupQueryWhere_inner(queryOver, _guids, consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation);
            }

            FilterByMeasurementDate_inner(queryOver, consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery.From, consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery.To, consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery.Aggregation);
        }

        if (query is ConsumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Identifiers != null &&
                consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Identifiers.Any() &&
                _guids != null && _guids.Any())
            {
                SetupQueryWhere_inner(queryOver, _guids, consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation);
            }

            FilterByMeasurementDate_inner(queryOver, consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.From, consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.To, consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Aggregation);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Filters the by measurement date inner.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="from">From.</param>
    /// <param name="to">To.</param>
    private void FilterByMeasurementDate_inner(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver, DateTime? from, DateTime? to, AggregationLevel? aggregationLevel)
    {
        if (from.HasValue)
        {
            _measurementFromDate = from.Value;
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= _measurementFromDate);
        }

        if (to.HasValue)
        {
            _measurementToDate = to.Value.GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay();
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= _measurementToDate);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query where inner.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="identifiers">The identifiers.</param>
    /// <param name="spatialAggregation">The spatial aggregation.</param>
    private void SetupQueryWhere_inner(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver, Guid[]? identifiers, SpatialAggregationLevel? spatialAggregation)
    {
        if (spatialAggregation == null) return;
        switch (spatialAggregation)
        {
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant:
                // Ilyenkor minden rekordot felhasználunk, nem szűrünk térben, mert
                // a teljes tenantra vonatkozó adatok kellenek (minden telephely-é).
                break;
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.Site:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.SiteIdentifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                break;
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.SiteLocation:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                break;
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.MeasuredEndpoint:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                break;
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.Device:
            default:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.DeviceIdentifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the aggregation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">The aggregation.</param>
    private void DoAggregation(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver, AggregationLevel aggregation)
    {
        ConsumptionListItemDto alias = null!;

        switch (aggregation)
        {
            case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                               "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) + date_part('minute', measurement_date)::int / 15 * interval '15 min' AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) + date_part('minute', measurement_date)::int / 15 * interval '15 min'",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)

                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Current)).WithAlias(() => alias.Current)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Active)).WithAlias(() => alias.Active)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Reactive)).WithAlias(() => alias.Reactive)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Voltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Voltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.LineVoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Linevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.PhaseVoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Phasevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Consumption)).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                        .Select(Projections.Group<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.TimeUnit)).WithAlias(() => alias.TimeUnit)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
               );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneDay:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('day', measurement_date AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Budapest') AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('day', measurement_date AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Budapest')",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date").WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate))

                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Current)).WithAlias(() => alias.Current)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Active)).WithAlias(() => alias.Active)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Reactive)).WithAlias(() => alias.Reactive)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Voltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Voltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.LineVoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Linevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.PhaseVoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Phasevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Consumption)).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                        .Select(Projections.Group<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.TimeUnit)).WithAlias(() => alias.TimeUnit)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date)",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)

                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Current)).WithAlias(() => alias.Current)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Active)).WithAlias(() => alias.Active)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Reactive)).WithAlias(() => alias.Reactive)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Voltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Voltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.LineVoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Linevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.PhaseVoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Phasevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Consumption)).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                        .Select(Projections.Group<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.TimeUnit)).WithAlias(() => alias.TimeUnit)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
            default:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections.Group<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.MeasurementDate), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Current)).WithAlias(() => alias.Current)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Active)).WithAlias(() => alias.Active)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Reactive)).WithAlias(() => alias.Reactive)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Voltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Voltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.LineVoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Linevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.PhaseVoltage)).WithAlias(() => alias.Phasevoltage)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Consumption)).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                        .Select(Projections.Group<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.TimeUnit)).WithAlias(() => alias.TimeUnit)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Megállapítja az átlagszámításokhoz az osztót. Ha kissebb aggregálási érték lenne kiválaszva, mint az adat
    /// időegysége, illetve ha egyeznek, az osztó 1
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="timeUnit">Az adat időegysége.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">A felületen kiválasztott aggregáció.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// Az osztó értékét adja vissza
    /// </returns>
    private static double DetermineCount(AggregationLevel timeUnit, AggregationLevel aggregation)
    {
        int tu = timeUnit switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => 5,
            AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => 15,
            AggregationLevel.OneHour => 60,
            AggregationLevel.OneDay => 1440,
            _ => 5,
        };

        int agg = aggregation switch
        {
            AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes => 5,
            AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes => 15,
            AggregationLevel.OneHour => 60,
            AggregationLevel.OneDay => 1440,
            _ => 5,
        };

        return tu >= agg ? 1.0 : agg / (double)tu;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the energy price aggregation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">The aggregation.</param>
