    private void DoEnergyPriceAggregation(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver, AggregationLevel aggregation)
    {
        ConsumptionEnergyPriceListItemDto alias = null!;

        switch (aggregation)
        {
            case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                              "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) + date_part('minute', measurement_date)::int / 15 * interval '15 min' AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) + date_part('minute', measurement_date)::int / 15 * interval '15 min'",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)

                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.CalculatedFeeOut)).WithAlias(() => alias.CalculatedFeeOut)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.PurchasePrice)).WithAlias(() => alias.PurchasePrice)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Consumption)).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneDay:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                list
                    .Select(Projections.Min<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                    .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                        .SqlGroupProjection(
                            "date_trunc('day', measurement_date AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Budapest') AS aggr_measurement_date",
                            "date_trunc('day', measurement_date AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Budapest')",
                            new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                            new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date").WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate))

                    .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.CalculatedFeeOut)).WithAlias(() => alias.CalculatedFeeOut)
                    .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.PurchasePrice)).WithAlias(() => alias.PurchasePrice)
                    .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Consumption)).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                    .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date)",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date"))
                        .WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)

                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.CalculatedFeeOut)).WithAlias(() => alias.CalculatedFeeOut)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.PurchasePrice)).WithAlias(() => alias.PurchasePrice)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Consumption)).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
            default:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(_projection = Projections.Alias(Projections.Group<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.MeasurementDate), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.CalculatedFeeOut)).WithAlias(() => alias.CalculatedFeeOut)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.PurchasePrice)).WithAlias(() => alias.PurchasePrice)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ConsumptionEntity>(x => x.Consumption)).WithAlias(() => alias.RelativeConsumption)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query sort.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="sortableColumns"></param>
    protected override void SetUpQuerySort(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver, IPagedEntityQuery query, IDictionary<string, IProjection>? sortableColumns = null)
    {
        if (query is ConsumptionPagedEntityQuery consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            SetupQuerySort_inner(queryOver, consumptionDataPagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo, query, sortableColumns);
        }
        else if (query is ConsumptionExportEntityQuery exportQuery)
        {
            SetupQuerySort_inner(queryOver, exportQuery.SortingInfo, query, sortableColumns);
        }
        else if (query is ConsumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            SetupQuerySort_inner(queryOver, consumptionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo, query, sortableColumns);
        }
        else if (query is ConsumptionEnergyPriceExportEntityQuery consumptionEnergyPriceExportQuery)
        {
            SetupQuerySort_inner(queryOver, consumptionEnergyPriceExportQuery.SortingInfo, query, sortableColumns);
        }

        else
            base.SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query, sortableColumns);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query sort inner.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="sortingInfo">The sorting information.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="sortableColumns">The sortable columns.</param>
    private void SetupQuerySort_inner(IQueryOver<ConsumptionEntity, ConsumptionEntity> queryOver, SortingInfo sortingInfo, IPagedEntityQuery query, IDictionary<string, IProjection>? sortableColumns)
    {
        if (sortingInfo?.SortColumn == null)
            sortingInfo = new SortingInfo()
            {
                SortColumn = nameof(ConsumptionEntity.MeasurementDate),
                SortDirection = SortDirection.Descending
            };
        if (sortingInfo.SortColumn == nameof(ConsumptionEntity.MeasurementDate))
        {
            var sort = queryOver.OrderBy(_projection);
            switch (sortingInfo.SortDirection)
            {
                case SortDirection.Ascending:
                    sort.Asc();
                    break;
                case SortDirection.Descending:
                    sort.Desc();
                    break;
            }
        }
        else base.SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query, sortableColumns);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the date.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="date">The date.</param>
    /// <param name="time">The time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public DateTime SetDate(DateTime date, TimeSpan time)
    {
        return new DateTime(date.Year, date.Month, date.Day, time.Hours, time.Minutes, time.Seconds, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }

    private (DateTime, DateTime) GetAggregationMinAndMaxDateTimes(DateTime from, DateTime to, AggregationLevel aggregationLevel)
    {
        var resolutionHandler = _resolutionHandlerFactory.CreateResolutionHandler(aggregationLevel);
        var minDateTime = resolutionHandler.GetClosestDateTime(from, Common.Shared.Enums.RoundingDirection.Ceiling);
        var maxDateTime = resolutionHandler.GetClosestDateTime(to, Common.Shared.Enums.RoundingDirection.Floor);

        return (minDateTime, maxDateTime);
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

/// <summary>
/// NormalizedConsumptionDailyQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Consumption.NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntityDto&gt;" />
public class NormalizedConsumptionDailyQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity, NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntityDto>
{
    private NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="NormalizedConsumptionDailyQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    public NormalizedConsumptionDailyQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper)
        : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }

    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is SummaryTableAggregateDataQuery<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntityDto> summaryTableAggregateDataQuery)
            return DoSummaryTableAggregateDataQuery(summaryTableAggregateDataQuery).RunSync();

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    private async Task<IQueryResult> DoSummaryTableAggregateDataQuery(SummaryTableAggregateDataQuery<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntityDto> query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc > query.From)
                                         .And(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc < query.To)
                                         .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.ChannelIdentifier).IsIn(query.ChannelIds);


        SetupSelect(queryOver, query.AggregationMethod, false, query.ChannelIds);
        var result = await queryOver.SingleOrDefaultAsync<AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto>();

        return new SummaryTableAggregateDataQueryResult() { AggregatedData = result };
    }

    private void SetupSelect(IQueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity, NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity> queryOver, AggregationMethod method, bool groupByChannel, List<Guid> channelIds = null)
    {
        AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto listItemAlias = null!;
        NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity subAliasLast = null!;
        NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity subAliasFirst = null!;
        QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity, NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity> subQueryLast = CreateLastMeasuredSubQuery(groupByChannel, channelIds, subAliasLast);
        QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity, NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity> subQueryFirst = CreateFirstMeasuredSubQuery(groupByChannel, channelIds, subAliasFirst);

        queryOver.SelectList(list =>
        {
            if (groupByChannel)
            {
                list.SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.ChannelIdentifier).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.ChannelId);
            }
            list.SelectMax(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.MaxValue)
                .SelectMin(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.MinValue)
                .SelectAvg(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AverageValue)
                .SelectSubQuery(subQueryLast).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.LastMeasuredValue);
            switch (method)
            {
                case AggregationMethod.Average:
                    list.SelectAvg(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AggregatedValue);
                    break;
                case AggregationMethod.Sum:
                    list.SelectSum(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AggregatedValue);
                    break;
                case AggregationMethod.TakeFirst:
                    list.SelectSubQuery(subQueryFirst).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AggregatedValue);
                    break;
                case AggregationMethod.TakeLast:
                    list.SelectSubQuery(subQueryLast).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AggregatedValue);
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentException("Undefined aggregation method is not allowed!");
            }

            return list;
        }).TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto>());
    }

    private QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity, NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity> CreateFirstMeasuredSubQuery(bool groupByChannel, List<Guid> channelIds, NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity subAliasFirst)
    {
        var subQueryFirst = QueryOver.Of(() => subAliasFirst);
        if (groupByChannel)
        {
            subQueryFirst.Where(() => subAliasFirst.ChannelIdentifier == _rootAlias.ChannelIdentifier);
        }
        else
        {
            subQueryFirst.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.ChannelIdentifier).IsIn(channelIds);
        }
        subQueryFirst.OrderBy(() => subAliasFirst.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc
                     .Select(x => x.Value)
                     .Take(1);
        return subQueryFirst;
    }

    private QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity, NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity> CreateLastMeasuredSubQuery(bool groupByChannel, List<Guid> channelIds, NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity subAliasLast)
    {
        var subQueryLast = QueryOver.Of(() => subAliasLast);
        if (groupByChannel)
        {
            subQueryLast.Where(() => subAliasLast.ChannelIdentifier == _rootAlias.ChannelIdentifier);
        }
        else
        {
            subQueryLast.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.ChannelIdentifier).IsIn(channelIds);
        }
        subQueryLast.OrderBy(() => subAliasLast.MeasuredAtUtc).Desc
                    .Select(x => x.Value)
                    .Take(1);
        return subQueryLast;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.Consumption;

/// <summary>
/// NormalizedConsumptionQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="QueryHandlerBase{T,TDto}.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Consumption.NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto&gt;" />
/// <seealso cref="NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto" />
public class
    NormalizedConsumptionQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto>
{
    private readonly IEdmInterfaceService _edmInterfaceService;

    private readonly ICo2eCalculatorService _co2ECalculatorService;

    private readonly MeasuredPropertyEntity? _measuredPropertyAlias = null;

    private readonly MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity? _measurementPointAlias = null;

    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    private readonly IEdmHelperService _edmHelperService;

    private const string _subMetersSumName = "Almérők összesen";

    private NormalizedConsumptionEntity _rootAlias = null!;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="NormalizedConsumptionQueryHandler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="edmInterfaceService"></param>
    /// <param name="co2eCalculatorService"></param>
    /// <param name="securityContext"></param>
    /// <param name="edmHelperService"></param>
    public NormalizedConsumptionQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper,
        IEdmInterfaceService edmInterfaceService, ICo2eCalculatorService co2eCalculatorService,
        SecurityContext securityContext, IEdmHelperService edmHelperService)
        : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _edmInterfaceService = edmInterfaceService;
        _co2ECalculatorService = co2eCalculatorService;
        _securityContext = securityContext;
        _edmHelperService = edmHelperService;
    }

    protected override IQueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> GetQueryOver()
    {
        return DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity>(() => _rootAlias);
    }

    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ResidualConsumptionChartQuery residualConsumptionEntityQuery)
            return DoResidualConsumptionChartQuery(residualConsumptionEntityQuery).RunSync();

        if (query is AggregatedDataReportForChannelsQuery aggregatedDataReportForChannelsQuery)
           return  DoAggregatedDataReportForChannelsQuery(aggregatedDataReportForChannelsQuery).RunSync();

        if (query is SummaryTableAggregateDataQuery<NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto> summaryTableAggregateDataQuery)
            return DoSummaryTableAggregateDataQuery(summaryTableAggregateDataQuery).RunSync();

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    public override IEntityQueryItemsResult QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            NormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery normalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery => DoQueryEntities(
                normalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery),
            ResidualConsumptionChartQuery residualConsumptionEntityQuery => DoQueryEntities(
                residualConsumptionEntityQuery),
            _ => base.QueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Entitás lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">lekérdezés</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult? DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return query switch
        {
            EdmNormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery edmNormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery =>
                DoEdmNormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery(edmNormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery)
                    .GetAwaiter()
                    .GetResult(),

            ResidualConsumptionPagedEntityQuery residualConsumptionPagedEntityQuery =>
                DoResidualConsumptionPagedEntityQuery(residualConsumptionPagedEntityQuery).RunSync(),

            ResidualConsumptionSummaryPagedEntityQuery residualConsumptionSummaryPagedEntityQuery =>
                DoResidualConsumptionSummaryPagedEntityQuery(residualConsumptionSummaryPagedEntityQuery).RunSync(),

            _ => base.DoQueryEntities(query)
        };
    }

    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(
        IQueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        if (query is NormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery normalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier == normalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery.ChannelId);

            if (normalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery.From.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x =>
                    x.MeasuredAtUtc >= normalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery.From.Value.ToUniversalTime());
            }

            if (normalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery.To.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x =>
                    x.MeasuredAtUtc <= normalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery.To.Value.ToUniversalTime());
            }
        }

        if (query is NormalizedConsumptionForIntervalQuery normalizedConsumptionForIntervalQuery)
        {
            if (normalizedConsumptionForIntervalQuery.From.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x =>
                    x.MeasuredAtUtc >= normalizedConsumptionForIntervalQuery.From.Value.ToUniversalTime());
            }

            if (normalizedConsumptionForIntervalQuery.To.HasValue)
            {
                queryOver.Where(x =>
                    x.MeasuredAtUtc <= normalizedConsumptionForIntervalQuery.To.Value.ToUniversalTime());
            }
        }
    }

    protected override void SetUpQuerySort(
        IQueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query);

        if (query is NormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery normalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            queryOver.OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc);
        }
    }

    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(
        IQueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(NormalizedConsumptionListItemDto))
        {
            NormalizedConsumptionListItemDto? listItemAlias = null;

            queryOver.SelectList(list => list
                .Select(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.Value)
                .Select(x => x.Co2eValue).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.Co2eValue)
                .Select(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.MeasuredAtUtc)
                .Select(x => x.DataQuality).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.DataQuality)
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    private async Task<IEntityQueryItemsResult<EdmNormalizedConsumptionListItemDto>>
        DoEdmNormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery(EdmNormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery entityQuery)
    {
        var requestId = await _edmInterfaceService.RequestMeasurements(entityQuery.ChannelId,
            DateOnly.FromDateTime(entityQuery.From), DateOnly.FromDateTime(entityQuery.To));

        var edmResults = new List<MeasurementResponseModel>();
        var maxTries = 10; //TODO better polling logic
        var tryCount = 0;

        do
        {
            try
            {
                edmResults = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurementResults(requestId);
                if (edmResults?.Any() == true)
                {
                    break;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.LogError($"Error getting results for DataChannelId: {entityQuery.ChannelId}. {ex}");
            }
        } while (tryCount++ < maxTries);

        var fullResult = new List<EdmNormalizedConsumptionListItemDto>();

        var co2eFactorSeries = await _co2ECalculatorService.GetCo2eConsumptionFactorSeries();
        var co2eFactorCategory =
            entityQuery.IsConsumption ? Co2eFactorCategory.Consumption : Co2eFactorCategory.Production;

        if (edmResults != null && edmResults.Any())
        {
            foreach (var edmResult in edmResults.SelectMany(x => x.Measurements))
            {
                fullResult.Add(new EdmNormalizedConsumptionListItemDto
                {
                    Value = edmResult.Value,
                    Co2eValue = _co2ECalculatorService.CalculateCo2e((decimal)edmResult.Value,
                        edmResult.MeasurementDate, co2eFactorCategory, co2eFactorSeries),
                    MeasuredAtUtc = edmResult.MeasurementDate.ToUniversalTime()
                });
            }
        }

        var result = new List<EdmNormalizedConsumptionListItemDto>();
        if (entityQuery.PagingInfo?.PageSize != null)
        {
            result = fullResult
                .OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc)
                .Skip(entityQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize.Value * entityQuery.PagingInfo.StartPage)
                .Take(entityQuery.PagingInfo.PageSize.Value)
                .ToList();
        }

        return new EntityListItemQueryResult<EdmNormalizedConsumptionListItemDto>()
        {
            Items = result.Select(x => Mapper.Map<EdmNormalizedConsumptionListItemDto>(x)).ToArray(),
            RecordsTotal = fullResult.Count
        };
    }


    private async Task<IQueryResult> DoResidualConsumptionChartQuery(
        ResidualConsumptionChartQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (query.Aggregation == AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes)
            throw new NotSupportedException("Aggregation level not supported");

        var settings = await GetSettings(query.MeasuredPropertyId, query.MeasurementPointIdentifier,
            query.SubMeasurementPointIdentifiers, cancellationToken);

        if (settings == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Settings not found");
        
        var stepSize = AggregationHelper.ConvertToTimeSpan(query.Aggregation);
        
        var allDates = DateHelper.GetDateTimes(query.From.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue),
            query.To.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue), stepSize);
        
        var res = new ChartModel
        {
            Title = "Maradék fogyasztás grafikon",
            XAxisValues = allDates
                .Select(x => x.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"))
                .ToList(),
            Unit = "kWh"
        };

        var subSettings = settings
            .Where(x => x.MeasurementPoint.Identifier.ToString() != query.MeasurementPointIdentifier)
            .Where(x => x.Channel != null)
            .ToList();

        foreach (var subSetting in subSettings)
        {
            var data = await GetNotBillingConsumptionData(allDates, subSetting.Channel!.Identifier!.Value, 
                query.Aggregation, cancellationToken);
        
            var existingItem = res.Items.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Name == subSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name);
            if (existingItem == null)
            {
                res.Items.Add(new ChartItemModel
                {
                    ChartType = ChartType.Line, 
                    Name = subSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name, 
                    Datas = data
                });
            }
            else
            {
                existingItem.Datas = existingItem.Datas
                    .Zip(data, (x, y) => (decimal?)(x == null && y == null 
                        ? null 
                        : (x ?? 0) + (y ?? 0)))
                    .ToList();
            }
        }

        res.Items.Add(new ChartItemModel()
        {
            ChartType = ChartType.Line,
            Name = _subMetersSumName,
            Datas = res.Items
                .Select(x => x.Datas)
                .Aggregate((a, b) => a
                    .Zip(b, (x, y) => (decimal?)((x ?? 0) + (y ?? 0))) //pl. 5 + null = null miatt
                    .ToList())
        });

        var mainSettings = settings
            .Where(x => x.MeasurementPoint.Identifier.ToString() == query.MeasurementPointIdentifier)
            .ToArray();

        if (mainSettings[0].MeasurementPoint.PodId == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("MeasurementPoint has no pod id");

        foreach (var mainSetting in mainSettings)
        {
            List<decimal?> data;
            if (mainSetting.MeasurementPoint.IsBilling)
            {
                data = await GetBillingConsumptionData(allDates, query.From.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue), 
                    query.To.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue), mainSetting.MeasurementPoint.PodId!, query.Aggregation, cancellationToken);
            }
            else
            {
                var channelIdentifier = mainSetting.Channel?.Identifier;
                if (channelIdentifier == null)
                    throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("MeasurementPoint has no channel id");
            
                data = await GetNotBillingConsumptionData(allDates, channelIdentifier.Value, query.Aggregation, cancellationToken);
            }
            
            // Ha több technológia is van, akkor össze adjuk az adatokat
            var existingItem = res.Items.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Name == mainSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name);
            if (existingItem == null)
            {
                res.Items.Add(new ChartItemModel
                {
                    ChartType = ChartType.IntermediateArea, 
                    Name = mainSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name, 
                    Datas = data
                });
            }
            else
            {
                existingItem.Datas = existingItem.Datas
                    .Zip(data, (x, y) => (decimal?)(x == null && y == null 
                        ? null 
                        : (x ?? 0) + (y ?? 0)))
                    .ToList();
            }
        }

        res.IntermediateArea =
            [new IntermediateAreaModel {Index1 = res.Items.Count - 2, Index2 = res.Items.Count - 1,}];

        var result = Mapper.Map<ChartModelQueryResult>(res);
        return result;
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Vissza adja az adott almérőhöz és dátumokhoz tartozó fogyasztási értékeket vagy null-t, ha nincs adat
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dates">A dátumok</param>
    /// <param name="channelIdentifier">Csatorna azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="aggregationLevel">Aggregációs szint</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancel token</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<List<decimal?>> GetNotBillingConsumptionData(DateTime[] dates, Guid channelIdentifier,
        AggregationLevel aggregationLevel, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var data = new List<decimal?>();
        switch (aggregationLevel)
        {
            case AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
                throw new NotSupportedException("Not supported");
            case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var normalizedConsumption = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == dateTime &&
                                    x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier == channelIdentifier)
                        .Select(x => x.Value)
                        .Take(1)
                        .SingleOrDefaultAsync<double?>(cancellationToken);
                    data.Add(normalizedConsumption.HasValue ? Convert.ToDecimal(normalizedConsumption.Value) : null);
                }
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var normalizedConsumption = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionHourlyEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc == dateTime &&
                                    x.ChannelIdentifier == channelIdentifier)
                        .Select(x => x.Value)
                        .Take(1)
                        .SingleOrDefaultAsync<decimal?>(cancellationToken);
                    data.Add(normalizedConsumption);
                }
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneDay:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var normalizedConsumption = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc.Date == dateTime.Date &&
                                    x.ChannelIdentifier == channelIdentifier)
                        .Select(x => x.Value)
                        .Take(1)
                        .SingleOrDefaultAsync<decimal?>(cancellationToken);
                    data.Add(normalizedConsumption);
                }
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneWeek:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var normalizedConsumptions = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc >= dateTime &&
                                    x.MeasuredAtUtc < dateTime.AddDays(7) &&
                                    x.ChannelIdentifier == channelIdentifier)
                        .Select(x => x.Value)
                        .ListAsync<decimal?>(cancellationToken);
                    
                    data.Add(normalizedConsumptions.Sum());
                }
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneMonth:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var normalizedConsumptions = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc >= dateTime &&
                                    x.MeasuredAtUtc < dateTime.AddMonths(1) &&
                                    x.ChannelIdentifier == channelIdentifier)
                        .Select(x => x.Value)
                        .ListAsync<decimal?>(cancellationToken);
                    
                    data.Add(normalizedConsumptions.Sum());
                }
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneYear:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var normalizedConsumptions = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity>()
                        .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc >= dateTime &&
                                    x.MeasuredAtUtc < dateTime.AddYears(1) &&
                                    x.ChannelIdentifier == channelIdentifier)
                        .Select(x => x.Value)
                        .ListAsync<decimal?>(cancellationToken);
                    
                    data.Add(normalizedConsumptions.Sum());
                }
                break;
            default:
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(aggregationLevel), aggregationLevel, null);
        }

        return data;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Vissza adja a főmérőhöz tartozó fogyasztási értékeket az EDM-en keresztül, vagy null-t, ha nincs adat
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dates"></param>
    /// <param name="from"></param>
    /// <param name="to"></param>
    /// <param name="podId"></param>
    /// <param name="aggregationLevel"></param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private async Task<List<decimal?>> GetBillingConsumptionData(DateTime[] dates, DateTime from, DateTime to,
        string podId, AggregationLevel aggregationLevel,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var res = new List<decimal?>();
        var responseModels = await _edmHelperService.GetMeasurements(podId,
            from.ToDateOnly(), to.ToDateOnly(), false, cancellationToken);

        var measurements = responseModels
            .SelectMany(x => x.Measurements)
            .ToArray();

        if (measurements.Length == 0)
            return res;
        
        switch (aggregationLevel)
        {
            case AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
                throw new NotSupportedException("Not supported");
            case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
                var measuredValues = dates
                    .Where(x => x >= from && x <= to) // Az interface DateOnly miatt
                    .Select(dateTime => measurements.FirstOrDefault(x => x.MeasurementDate == dateTime))
                    .Select(measurement => (decimal?)measurement?.Value ?? null);
                res.AddRange(measuredValues);
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var sum = measurements
                        .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= dateTime &&
                                    x.MeasurementDate < dateTime.AddHours(1))
                        .Select(measurement => (decimal?)measurement.Value)
                        .Sum();
                    res.Add(sum);
                }
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneDay:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var sum = measurements
                        .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= dateTime &&
                                    x.MeasurementDate < dateTime.AddDays(1))
                        .Select(measurement => (decimal?)measurement.Value)
                        .Sum();
                    res.Add(sum);
                }
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneWeek:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var sum = measurements
                        .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= dateTime &&
                                    x.MeasurementDate < dateTime.AddDays(7))
                        .Select(measurement => (decimal?)measurement.Value)
                        .Sum();
                    res.Add(sum);
                }
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneMonth:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var sum = measurements
                        .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= dateTime &&
                                    x.MeasurementDate < dateTime.AddMonths(1))
                        .Select(measurement => (decimal?)measurement.Value)
                        .Sum();
                    res.Add(sum);
                }
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneYear:
                foreach (var dateTime in dates)
                {
                    var sum = measurements
                        .Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= dateTime &&
                                    x.MeasurementDate < dateTime.AddYears(1))
                        .Select(measurement => (decimal?)measurement.Value)
                        .Sum();
                    res.Add(sum);
                }
                break;
            default:
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(aggregationLevel), aggregationLevel, null);
        }

        return res;
    }

    private async Task<IEntityQueryItemsResult<ChartTableItemModel>> DoResidualConsumptionPagedEntityQuery(ResidualConsumptionPagedEntityQuery query)
    {
        var chartData = (ChartModelQueryResult) await DoResidualConsumptionChartQuery(new ResidualConsumptionChartQuery()
        {
            MeasurementPointIdentifier = query.MeasurementPointIdentifier,
            SubMeasurementPointIdentifiers = query.SubMeasurementPointIdentifiers,
            Aggregation = query.Aggregation!.Value,
            MeasuredPropertyId = query.MeasuredPropertyId,
            From = query.From,
            To = query.To,
        });
        
        var res = new List<ChartTableItemModel>();
        var resCount = chartData.XAxisValues.Count > query.PagingInfo.PageSize!.Value 
            ? query.PagingInfo.PageSize.Value 
            : chartData.XAxisValues.Count;
        
        for (var i = 0; i < resCount; i++)
        {
            var date = DateTime.Parse(chartData.XAxisValues[i]);
            var item = new ChartTableItemModel
            {
                Id = -1, // Muszáj Id-val rendelkezzen hogy lehessen használni PagedEntityQuery result-ként
                DateTime = date
            };

            var consumptions = chartData
                .Items.Select(x => new ChartTableItemValueModel()
                {
                    MeasurementPointName = x.Name,
                    Value = query.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending 
                        ? decimal.Round(x.Datas[i] ?? 0, 3) 
                        : decimal.Round(x.Datas[x.Datas.Count - i - 1] ?? 0, 3)
                });
            item.Values.AddRange(consumptions);
            res.Add(item);
            
            var mainGuid = Guid.Parse(query.MeasurementPointIdentifier);
            var mainPointName = await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Identifier == mainGuid)
                .Select(x => x.Name)
                .Take(1)
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync<string>();
            
            var mainMeterData = chartData
                .Items
                .Single(x => x.Name == mainPointName);
            
            var mainMeterValue = query.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending
                ? mainMeterData.Datas[i] ?? 0
                : mainMeterData.Datas[mainMeterData.Datas.Count - i - 1] ?? 0;
            
            var differenceItems = GetDifferenceItems(chartData, mainMeterValue, query.SortingInfo.SortDirection, i);
            item.Values.Add(differenceItems.Item1);
            
            var percentages = chartData
                .Items
                .Where(x => x.Name != mainPointName)
                .Select(x => new ChartTableItemValueModel()
                {
                    MeasurementPointName = $"{x.Name}, %",
                    Value = query.SortingInfo.SortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending 
                        ? decimal.Round(((x.Datas[i] / mainMeterValue) ?? 0) * 100, 3)
                        : decimal.Round(((x.Datas[x.Datas.Count - i - 1] / mainMeterValue) ?? 0) * 100, 3)
                });
            item.Values.AddRange(percentages);
            item.Values.Add(differenceItems.Item2);
        }

        return new EntityListItemQueryResult<ChartTableItemModel>()
        {
            Items = res.ToArray(),
            RecordsTotal = chartData.XAxisValues.Count
        };
    }

    private async Task<IEntityQueryItemsResult<ResidualConsumptionSummaryListItemDto>> DoResidualConsumptionSummaryPagedEntityQuery(
        ResidualConsumptionSummaryPagedEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (query.Aggregation == AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes)
            throw new NotSupportedException("Aggregation level not supported");
        
        var stepSize = AggregationHelper.ConvertToTimeSpan(query.Aggregation!.Value);
        
        var allDates = DateHelper.GetDateTimes(query.From.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue), query.To.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue),
            stepSize);

        var settings = await GetSettings(query.MeasuredPropertyId, query.MeasurementPointIdentifier,
            query.SubMeasurementPointIdentifiers, cancellationToken);

        if (settings == null)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Settings not found");
        
        var mainSettings = settings
            .Where(x => x.MeasurementPoint.Identifier.ToString() == query.MeasurementPointIdentifier)
            .ToArray();

        if (mainSettings.Length == 0)
            throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("Main measurement point setting not found");
        
        decimal? mainDataSum = 0;
        foreach (var mainSetting in mainSettings)
        {
            if (mainSetting.MeasurementPoint.PodId == null)
                throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("MeasurementPoint has no pod id");

            List<decimal?> mainData;
            if (mainSetting.MeasurementPoint.IsBilling)
            {
                mainData = await GetBillingConsumptionData(allDates, query.From.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue), 
                    query.To.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue), mainSetting.MeasurementPoint.PodId, query.Aggregation.Value, cancellationToken);
            }
            else
            {
                var channelIdentifier = mainSetting.Channel?.Identifier;
                if (channelIdentifier == null)
                    throw new EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException("MeasurementPoint has no channel id");
                
                mainData = await GetNotBillingConsumptionData(allDates, channelIdentifier.Value, query.Aggregation.Value, cancellationToken);
            }
            
            mainDataSum += mainData.Sum();
        }
        
        var fapi = ApiHelper.FrameworkApi(DbContext.DatabaseNodeContext.SchemaName);
        var mainOrgUnitNames = await fapi.MeasurementPoints_GetOrgunitNamesAsync(mainSettings[0].MeasurementPoint.OrgunitBase.Id, cancellationToken);
        var res = new List<ResidualConsumptionSummaryListItemDto>()
        {
            new ResidualConsumptionSummaryListItemDto()
            {
                Meter = mainSettings[0].MeasurementPoint.Name,
                Site = mainOrgUnitNames.SiteName,
                Building = mainOrgUnitNames.BuildingName,
                BuildingPart = mainOrgUnitNames.BuildingPartName,
                Floor = mainOrgUnitNames.FloorName,
                Room = mainOrgUnitNames.RoomName,
                Identifier = mainSettings[0].MeasurementPoint.Identifier,
                ConsumptionSum = mainDataSum.HasValue ? decimal.Round(mainDataSum.Value, 3) : mainDataSum, 
                ConsumptionPercentage = null,
                IsBillingPoint = mainSettings[0].MeasurementPoint.IsBilling,
            }
        };
        
        
        var subSettings = settings
            .Where(x => x.MeasurementPoint.Identifier.ToString() != query.MeasurementPointIdentifier)
            .Where(x => x.Channel != null)
            .ToList();

        foreach (var subSetting in subSettings)
        {            
            var data = await GetNotBillingConsumptionData(allDates, subSetting.Channel.Identifier.Value,
                query.Aggregation!.Value, cancellationToken);
            var subDataSum = data.Sum();
            
            var existingItem = res.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Identifier == subSetting.MeasurementPoint.Identifier);
            if (existingItem == null)
            {
                var orgUnitNames = await fapi.MeasurementPoints_GetOrgunitNamesAsync(subSetting.MeasurementPoint.OrgunitBase.Id, cancellationToken);
                res.Add(new ResidualConsumptionSummaryListItemDto()
                {
                    Meter = subSetting.MeasurementPoint.Name,
                    Site = orgUnitNames.SiteName,
                    Building = orgUnitNames.BuildingName,
                    BuildingPart = orgUnitNames.BuildingPartName,
                    Floor = orgUnitNames.FloorName,
                    Room = orgUnitNames.RoomName,
                    Identifier = subSetting.MeasurementPoint.Identifier,
                    ConsumptionSum = subDataSum.HasValue ? decimal.Round(subDataSum.Value, 3) : subDataSum, 
                    ConsumptionPercentage = subDataSum == null || mainDataSum == null
                        ? null 
                        : subDataSum == 0 || mainDataSum == 0 
                            ? 0
                            : decimal.Round((subDataSum.Value / mainDataSum.Value) * 100, 3),
                    IsBillingPoint = subSetting.MeasurementPoint.IsBilling
                });
            }
            else
            {
                existingItem.ConsumptionSum += subDataSum.HasValue ? decimal.Round(subDataSum.Value, 3) : subDataSum;
                existingItem.ConsumptionPercentage = existingItem.ConsumptionSum == null || mainDataSum == null
                    ? null
                    : existingItem.ConsumptionSum == 0 || mainDataSum == 0
                        ? 0
                        : decimal.Round((existingItem.ConsumptionSum.Value / mainDataSum.Value) * 100, 3);
            }
        }

        return new EntityQueryItemsResult<ResidualConsumptionSummaryListItemDto>()
        {
            Items = res.ToArray(),
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Segéd fv a főmérő és az almérők összegének különbségének számítására
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="chartData"></param>
    /// <param name="mainMeterValue"></param>
    /// <param name="sortDirection"></param>
    /// <param name="i"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static (ChartTableItemValueModel, ChartTableItemValueModel) GetDifferenceItems(ChartModelQueryResult chartData, decimal mainMeterValue, SortDirection sortDirection, int i)
    {
        var subMetersSumData = chartData
            .Items
            .Single(x => x.Name == _subMetersSumName);
            
        var subMetersSum = sortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending
            ? subMetersSumData.Datas[i] ?? 0
            : subMetersSumData.Datas[subMetersSumData.Datas.Count - i - 1] ?? 0;

       var difference = mainMeterValue - subMetersSum;

       return (new ChartTableItemValueModel
           {
               MeasurementPointName = "Különbség", Value = decimal.Round(difference, 3)
           },
           new ChartTableItemValueModel
           {
               MeasurementPointName = "Különbség, %", Value = decimal.Round((difference / mainMeterValue) * 100, 3)
           });
    }

    private async Task<MeasurementPointSettingSyncedMonitoringEntity[]?> GetSettings(int? measuredPropId, string mainIdentifier,
        string[] subIdentifiers, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var mainGuid = Guid.Parse(mainIdentifier);
        var subGuids = subIdentifiers.Select(Guid.Parse).ToArray();
        
        var measuredPropIds = new List<int>();
        
        if (measuredPropId == null)
        {
            var mainPoint = (await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
                .Where(x => x.Identifier == mainGuid)
                .Take(1)
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken));
            
            measuredPropIds.AddRange(mainPoint.MeasuredProperties.Select(x => x.Id));
        }
        else
        {
            measuredPropIds.Add(measuredPropId.Value);
        }

        var disj = Restrictions.Disjunction();
        disj.Add(Restrictions.Eq(Projections.Property(() => _measurementPointAlias!.Identifier), mainGuid));
        disj.Add(Restrictions.In(Projections.Property(() => _measurementPointAlias!.Identifier), subGuids));
        var settings = (await DbContext.Session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSettingSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
                .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasurementPoint, () => _measurementPointAlias)
                .Left.JoinAlias(x => x.MeasuredProperty, () => _measuredPropertyAlias)
                .Where(Restrictions.In(Projections.Property(() => _measuredPropertyAlias!.Id), measuredPropIds))
                .Where(disj)
                .ListAsync(cancellationToken))
            .ToArray();

        return settings;
    }

    private async Task<IQueryResult> DoAggregatedDataReportForChannelsQuery(AggregatedDataReportForChannelsQuery query)
    {
        var listItems = new List<AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto>();
        foreach (AggregationMethod method in Enum.GetValues(typeof(AggregationMethod)))
        {
            if(method == AggregationMethod.Undefined)
                continue;

            var channelIdentifiers = query.Channels.Where(x => x.AggregationMethod == method).Select(x => x.ChannelId).ToList();

            var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias)
                                             .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc > query.From)
                                             .And(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc < query.To)
                                             .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier).IsIn(channelIdentifiers);

            SetupSelect(queryOver, method, true);

            var result = await queryOver.ListAsync<AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto>();
            listItems.AddRange(result);
        }

        return new AggregatedDataReportForChannelsQueryResult() { AggregatedData = listItems};
    }

    private async Task<IQueryResult> DoSummaryTableAggregateDataQuery(SummaryTableAggregateDataQuery<NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto> query)
    {
        var queryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver(() => _rootAlias)
                                         .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc > query.From)
                                         .And(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc < query.To)
                                         .WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier).IsIn(query.ChannelIds);


        SetupSelect(queryOver, query.AggregationMethod, false, query.ChannelIds);
        var result = await queryOver.SingleOrDefaultAsync<AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto>();

        return new SummaryTableAggregateDataQueryResult() { AggregatedData = result };
    }

    private void SetupSelect(IQueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> queryOver, AggregationMethod method, bool groupByChannel, List<Guid> channelIds = null)
    {
        AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto listItemAlias = null!;
        NormalizedConsumptionEntity subAliasLast = null!;
        NormalizedConsumptionEntity subAliasFirst = null!;
        QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> subQueryLast = CreateLastMeasuredSubQuery(groupByChannel, channelIds, subAliasLast);
        QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> subQueryFirst = CreateFirstMeasuredSubQuery(groupByChannel, channelIds, subAliasFirst);

        queryOver.SelectList(list =>
        {
            if (groupByChannel)
            {
                list.SelectGroup(() => _rootAlias.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.ChannelId);
            }
            list.SelectMax(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.MaxValue)
                .SelectMin(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.MinValue)
                .SelectAvg(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AverageValue)
                .SelectSubQuery(subQueryLast).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.LastMeasuredValue);
            switch (method)
            {
                case AggregationMethod.Average:
                    list.SelectAvg(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AggregatedValue);
                    break;
                case AggregationMethod.Sum:
                    list.SelectSum(x => x.Value).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AggregatedValue);
                    break;
                case AggregationMethod.TakeFirst:
                    list.SelectSubQuery(subQueryFirst).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AggregatedValue);
                    break;
                case AggregationMethod.TakeLast:
                    list.SelectSubQuery(subQueryLast).WithAlias(() => listItemAlias.AggregatedValue);
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentException("Undefined aggregation method is not allowed!");
            }

            return list;
        }).TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto>());
    }

    private QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> CreateFirstMeasuredSubQuery(bool groupByChannel, List<Guid> channelIds, NormalizedConsumptionEntity subAliasFirst)
    {
        var subQueryFirst = QueryOver.Of(() => subAliasFirst);
        if (groupByChannel)
        {
            subQueryFirst.Where(() => subAliasFirst.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier == _rootAlias.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier);
        }
        else
        {
            subQueryFirst.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier).IsIn(channelIds);
        }
        subQueryFirst.OrderBy(() => subAliasFirst.MeasuredAtUtc).Asc
                     .Select(x => x.Value)
                     .Take(1);
        return subQueryFirst;
    }

    private QueryOver<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionEntity> CreateLastMeasuredSubQuery(bool groupByChannel, List<Guid> channelIds, NormalizedConsumptionEntity subAliasLast)
    {
        var subQueryLast = QueryOver.Of(() => subAliasLast);
        if (groupByChannel)
        {
            subQueryLast.Where(() => subAliasLast.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier == _rootAlias.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier);
        }
        else
        {
            subQueryLast.WhereRestrictionOn(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier).IsIn(channelIds);
        }
        subQueryLast.OrderBy(() => subAliasLast.MeasuredAtUtc).Desc
                    .Select(x => x.Value)
                    .Take(1);
        return subQueryLast;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.MeasurementPoint;

    public OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper) : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException">Not implemented EntityType!</exception>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntity, OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);

        switch (query)
        {
            case AggregatedDataReportDeviceDetailsQuery orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery:
                if (orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.OrgUnitId != 0)
                {
                    var orgUnitId = orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.OrgUnitId;
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.InstitutionId == orgUnitId ||
                                x.SiteId == orgUnitId ||
                                x.BuildingId == orgUnitId ||
                                x.BuildingPartId == orgUnitId ||
                                x.FloorId == orgUnitId ||
                                x.RoomId == orgUnitId
                    );
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.DeviceCategory))
                {
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.DeviceCategory == orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.DeviceCategory);
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.DeviceType))
                {
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.DeviceType == orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.DeviceType);
                }

                if (orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.MeasuredPropertyId != null && orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.MeasuredPropertyId != 0)
                {
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasuredPropertyId == orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.MeasuredPropertyId);
                }

                if (orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.TechnologyId != null && orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.TechnologyId != 0)
                {
                    queryOver.Where(x =>  x.TechnologyIds.IsLike($"%{orgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyQuery.TechnologyId}%"));
                }

                break;
        }
    }
}

using Autofac;

using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
