/// <summary>
/// ProductionQueryHandler
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.ProductionEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Production.ProductionEntityDto&gt;" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers.QueryHandlerBase&lt;EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.ProductionEntity, EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Production.ProductionEntityDto&gt;" />
public class ProductionQueryHandler : QueryHandlerBase<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntityDto>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Dictionary cache
    /// </summary>
    private readonly TenantDictCache _dictCache;
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;
    /// <summary>
    /// Guids
    /// </summary>
    private Guid[] _guids = Array.Empty<Guid>();
    /// <summary>
    /// Measurement from date
    /// </summary>
    private DateTime? _measurementFromDate;
    /// <summary>
    /// Measurement to date
    /// </summary>
    private DateTime? _measurementToDate;
    /// <summary>
    /// Projection
    /// </summary>
    IProjection projection = default;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ProductionQueryHandler" /> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="dictCache">The dictionary cache.</param>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public ProductionQueryHandler(IDbContext dbContext, IMapper mapper, TenantDictCache dictCache,
        ILifetimeScope scope)
        : base(dbContext, mapper)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        _dictCache = dictCache;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// result
    /// </returns>
    public override IQueryResult ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ProductionEnergyPriceQuery productionEnergyPriceQuery)
            return DoExecuteProductionEnergyPriceQuery(productionEnergyPriceQuery);

        if (query is ProductionQuery productionQuery)
            return DoExecuteProductionQuery(productionQuery);

        return base.ExecuteQuery(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the execute production energy price query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoExecuteProductionEnergyPriceQuery(ProductionEnergyPriceQuery query)
    {
        var queryOver = GetQueryOver();

        var result = new ProductionEnergyPriceQueryResult();

        // Ha a térbeli aggregáció enum null => hiba
        // Ha a térbeli aggregáció NEM tenant-szintű és az Identifiers tömb null vagy üres => hiba.
        // Ha a térbeli aggregáció tenant-szintű, akkor nem kellenek azonosítók, mert minden érvényes
        // rekord szükséges a számításhoz.

        if (query.SpatialAggregation != null &&
            (
                query.SpatialAggregation == SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant ||
                (
                    query.Identifiers != null &&
                    query.Identifiers.Any()
                )
            )
        )
            switch (query.SpatialAggregation)
            {
                case SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant:
                    // Ilyenkor minden rekordot felhasználunk, nem szűrünk térben, mert
                    // a teljes tenantra vonatkozó adatok kellenek (minden telephely-é).
                    break;
                case SpatialAggregationLevel.Site:
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.SiteIdentifier.IsIn(query.Identifiers));
                    break;
                case SpatialAggregationLevel.SiteLocation:
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier.IsIn(query.Identifiers));
                    break;
                case SpatialAggregationLevel.MeasuredEndpoint:
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.IsIn(query.Identifiers));
                    break;
                case SpatialAggregationLevel.Device:
                default:
                    queryOver.Where(x => x.DeviceIdentifier.IsIn(query.Identifiers));
                    break;
            }
        else
            return result;

        if (query.From.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= query.From.Value);

        if (query.To.HasValue)
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= query.To.Value.GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay()); //queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= query.To.Value.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1));

        DoEnergyPriceAggregation(queryOver, query);

        var productionRes = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto>())
            .OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).Asc.List<ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto>();

        result.Items = productionRes.ToList();

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the query entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override IEntityQueryItemsResult DoQueryEntities(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ProductionExportEntityQuery exportQuery)
        {
            Aggregate_inner(exportQuery.SpatialAggregation, exportQuery.Identifiers);

            if (_guids.Any())
                return DoQueryEntities(exportQuery) as EntityListItemQueryResult<ProductionListItemDto>;
            else
                return new EntityListItemQueryResult<ProductionListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<ProductionListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };
        }

        if (query is ProductionEnergyPriceExportEntityQuery energyPriceExportQuery)
        {
            Aggregate_inner(energyPriceExportQuery.SpatialAggregation, energyPriceExportQuery.Identifiers);

            if (_guids.Any())
                return DoQueryEntities(energyPriceExportQuery) as EntityListItemQueryResult<ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto>;
            else
                return new EntityListItemQueryResult<ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };
        }

        if (query is ProductionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            Aggregate_inner(productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation, productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Identifiers);

            if (_guids.Any())
            {
                var productionListItemResults = DoQueryEntities(productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery) as EntityListItemQueryResult<ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto>;
                return productionListItemResults;
            }
            else
                return new EntityListItemQueryResult<ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };
        }

        if (query is ProductionPagedEntityQuery pagedEntityQuery)
        {
            Aggregate_inner(pagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation, pagedEntityQuery.Identifiers);

            if (_guids.Any())
                return DoQueryEntities(pagedEntityQuery) as EntityListItemQueryResult<ProductionListItemDto>;
            else
                return new EntityListItemQueryResult<ProductionListItemDto>()
                {
                    Items = Array.Empty<ProductionListItemDto>(),
                    RecordsTotal = 0
                };

        }
        return base.DoQueryEntities(query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Aggregates, inner method in order to reduce complexity and code duplications.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="spatialAggregation">The spatial aggregation.</param>
    /// <param name="identifiers">The identifiers.</param>
    private void Aggregate_inner(SpatialAggregationLevel? spatialAggregation, Guid[]? identifiers)
    {
        if (identifiers?.Any() == true || spatialAggregation == SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant)
        {
            var iotDeviceQueryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTDeviceEntity>();
            var iotMeasuredEndpointQueryOver = DbContext.Session.QueryOver<IoTMeasuredEndpointEntity>();
            switch (spatialAggregation)
            {
                //case SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant:
                //    _guids = iotDeviceQueryOver.Select(x => x.SiteIdentifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                //    break;
                //case SpatialAggregationLevel.Site:
                //    iotDeviceQueryOver = iotDeviceQueryOver.Where(x => x.SiteIdentifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                //    _guids = iotDeviceQueryOver.Select(x => x.SiteIdentifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                //    break;
                //case SpatialAggregationLevel.SiteLocation:
                //    iotDeviceQueryOver = iotDeviceQueryOver.Where(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                //    _guids = iotDeviceQueryOver.Select(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                //    break;
                case SpatialAggregationLevel.MeasuredEndpoint:
                    iotMeasuredEndpointQueryOver = iotMeasuredEndpointQueryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                    _guids = iotMeasuredEndpointQueryOver.Select(x => x.Identifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                    break;
                case SpatialAggregationLevel.Device:
                default:
                    iotDeviceQueryOver = iotDeviceQueryOver.Where(x => x.Identifier.IsIn(identifiers));
                    _guids = iotDeviceQueryOver.Select(x => x.Identifier).List<Guid>().ToArray();
                    break;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            _guids = Array.Empty<Guid>();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the query select.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="TResult">The type of the result.</typeparam>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    protected override Func<object[], TResult>? SetupQuerySelect<TResult>(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(ProductionListItemDto))
        {
            DoAggregation(queryOver, query as IAggregation);
        }

        if (typeof(TResult) == typeof(ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto))
        {
            DoEnergyPriceAggregation(queryOver, query as IAggregation);
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query where.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    protected override void SetUpQueryWhere(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver,
        IEntityQuery query)
    {
        base.SetUpQueryWhere(queryOver, query);
        if (query is ProductionPagedEntityQuery productionPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (productionPagedEntityQuery.Identifiers != null &&
                productionPagedEntityQuery.Identifiers.Any() &&
                this._guids.Any() &&
                productionPagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation != null)
            {
                SetupQueryWhere_inner(queryOver, productionPagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation);
            }

            FilterByMeasurementDate_inner(queryOver, productionPagedEntityQuery.From, productionPagedEntityQuery.To);
        }

        if (query is ProductionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            if (productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Identifiers != null &&
                productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Identifiers.Any() &&
                this._guids.Any() &&
                productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation != null)
            {
                SetupQueryWhere_inner(queryOver, productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SpatialAggregation);
            }

            FilterByMeasurementDate_inner(queryOver, productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.From, productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.To);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the filter by aggregation, inner method of SetupQueryWhere in order to reduce complexity and code duplications.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query to filter.</param>
    /// <param name="spatialAggregation">The spatial aggregation.</param>
    private void SetupQueryWhere_inner(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver, SpatialAggregationLevel? spatialAggregation)
    {
        switch (spatialAggregation)
        {
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant:
                break;
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.Site:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.SiteIdentifier.IsIn(this._guids));
                break;
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.SiteLocation:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.SiteLocationIdentifier.IsIn(this._guids));
                break;
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.MeasuredEndpoint:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier.IsIn(this._guids));
                break;
            case SpatialAggregationLevel.Device:
            default:
                queryOver.Where(x => x.DeviceIdentifier.IsIn(this._guids));
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Filters the by measurement date inner.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="from">From.</param>
    /// <param name="to">To.</param>
    private void FilterByMeasurementDate_inner(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver, DateTime? from, DateTime? to)
    {
        if (from.HasValue)
        {
            _measurementFromDate = from.Value;
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= _measurementFromDate);
        }

        if (to.HasValue)
        {
            _measurementToDate = to.Value.GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay(); //.Value.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1);
            queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= _measurementToDate);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the execute production query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="productionQuery">The production query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private IQueryResult DoExecuteProductionQuery(ProductionQuery productionQuery)
    {
        var queryOver = GetQueryOver();

        var result = new ProductionQueryResult();

        if (productionQuery.SpatialAggregation != null &&
            (
                productionQuery.SpatialAggregation == SpatialAggregationLevel.Tenant ||
                (
                    productionQuery.Identifiers != null &&
                    productionQuery.Identifiers.Any()
                )
            )
        )
                SetupQueryWhere_inner(queryOver, productionQuery.SpatialAggregation);
        else
            return result;

        if (productionQuery.From.HasValue)
            if (productionQuery.NotFullday)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= productionQuery.From.Value);
            else
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate >= productionQuery.From.Value.Date);

        if (productionQuery.To.HasValue)
            if (productionQuery.NotFullday)
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= productionQuery.To.Value);
            else
                queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= productionQuery.To.Value.GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay()); //queryOver.Where(x => x.MeasurementDate <= productionQuery.To.Value.AddDays(1).AddSeconds(-1));

        DoAggregation(queryOver, productionQuery);

        var productionList = queryOver.TransformUsing(Transformers.AliasToBean<ProductionListItemDto>())
           .OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate)
           .Asc
           .List<ProductionListItemDto>();

        result = new ProductionQueryResult()
        {
            MeasurementDate = productionList.Select(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToList(),
            Power = productionList.Select(x => x.Power ?? 0).ToList(),
            Energy = productionList.Select(x => x.Energy ?? 0).ToList()
        };

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the aggregation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">The aggregation.</param>
    private void DoAggregation(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver, IAggregation aggregation)
    {
        ProductionListItemDto alias = null!;

        switch (aggregation.Aggregation)
        {
            case AggregationLevel.OneDay:               
                    queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                         .Select(Projections.Min<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                         .Select(projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('day', measurement_date) AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('day', measurement_date)",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date").WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate))
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Power)).WithAlias(() => alias.Power)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Energy)).WithAlias(() => alias.Energy)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation.Aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                    );                
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date)",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Power)).WithAlias(() => alias.Power)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Energy)).WithAlias(() => alias.Energy)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation.Aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
            default:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(projection = Projections.Alias(Projections.Group<ProductionEntity>(x => x.MeasurementDate), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Power)).WithAlias(() => alias.Power)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Energy)).WithAlias(() => alias.Energy)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation.Aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Does the energy price aggregation.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">The aggregation.</param>
    private void DoEnergyPriceAggregation(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver, IAggregation aggregation)
    {
        ProductionEnergyPriceListItemDto alias = null!;

        switch (aggregation.Aggregation)
        {
            case AggregationLevel.OneDay:                
                    queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                         .Select(Projections.Min<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                         .Select(projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('day', measurement_date) AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('day', measurement_date)",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date").WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate))
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Power)).WithAlias(() => alias.Power)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Energy)).WithAlias(() => alias.Energy)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(x => x.CalculatedFeeIn)).WithAlias(() => alias.CalculatedFeeIn)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ProductionEntity>(x => x.PowerInPrice)).WithAlias(() => alias.PowerInPrice)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation.Aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                    );                
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(projection = Projections.Alias(Projections
                            .SqlGroupProjection(
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date) AS aggr_measurement_date",
                                "date_trunc('hour', measurement_date)",
                                new[] { "aggr_measurement_date" },
                                new IType[] { NHibernateUtil.DateTime }), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Power)).WithAlias(() => alias.Power)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Energy)).WithAlias(() => alias.Energy)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(x => x.CalculatedFeeIn)).WithAlias(() => alias.CalculatedFeeIn)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ProductionEntity>(x => x.PowerInPrice)).WithAlias(() => alias.PowerInPrice)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation.Aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
            case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
            default:
                queryOver.SelectList(list =>
                    list
                        .Select(Projections.Min<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Id)).WithAlias(() => alias.Id)
                        .Select(projection = Projections.Alias(Projections.Group<ProductionEntity>(x => x.MeasurementDate), "aggr_measurement_date")).WithAlias(() => alias.MeasurementDate)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Power)).WithAlias(() => alias.Power)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(x => x.Energy)).WithAlias(() => alias.Energy)
                        .Select(Projections.Sum<ProductionEntity>(x => x.CalculatedFeeIn)).WithAlias(() => alias.CalculatedFeeIn)
                        .Select(Projections.Avg<ProductionEntity>(x => x.PowerInPrice)).WithAlias(() => alias.PowerInPrice)
                        .Select(Projections.Constant(aggregation.Aggregation).WithAlias(() => alias.AggregationLevel))
                );
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up query sort.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="sortableColumns"></param>
    protected override void SetUpQuerySort(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver, IPagedEntityQuery query, IDictionary<string, IProjection>? sortableColumns = null)
    {
        if (query is ProductionPagedEntityQuery productionPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            SetupSort_Inner(queryOver, productionPagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo, query, sortableColumns);
        }

        if (query is ProductionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            SetupSort_Inner(queryOver, productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.SortingInfo, query, sortableColumns);
        }

        else if (query is ProductionEnergyPriceExportEntityQuery productionEnergyPriceExportEntityQuery)
        {
            SetupSort_Inner(queryOver, productionEnergyPriceExportEntityQuery.SortingInfo, query, sortableColumns);
        }

        else
            base.SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query, sortableColumns);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the sorting, inner method of SetUpQuerySort in order to reduce complexity and code duplications.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="sortingInfo">The sorting information.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="sortableColumns">The sortable columns.</param>
    private void SetupSort_Inner(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver, SortingInfo sortingInfo, IPagedEntityQuery query, IDictionary<string, IProjection>? sortableColumns)
    {
        if (sortingInfo?.SortColumn == null)
            sortingInfo = new SortingInfo()
            {
                SortColumn = nameof(ProductionEntity.MeasurementDate),
                SortDirection = SortDirection.Descending
            };
        if (sortingInfo.SortColumn == nameof(ProductionEntity.MeasurementDate))
        {
            var sort = queryOver.OrderBy(projection);
            switch (sortingInfo.SortDirection)
            {
                case SortDirection.Ascending:
                    sort.Asc();
                    break;
                case SortDirection.Descending:
                    sort.Desc();
                    break;
            }
        }
        else base.SetUpQuerySort(queryOver, query, sortableColumns);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets up row count.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns>
    /// <br />
    /// </returns>
    public override int SetUpRowCount(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver, IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (query is ProductionPagedEntityQuery productionPagedEntityQuery)
        {
            return SetupRowCount_Inner(queryOver, productionPagedEntityQuery.Identifiers, productionPagedEntityQuery.Aggregation);
        }

        if (query is ProductionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery)
        {
            return SetupRowCount_Inner(queryOver, productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Identifiers, productionEnergyPricePagedEntityQuery.Aggregation);
        }


        return base.SetUpRowCount(queryOver, query);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Setups the row count, inner method of SetUpRowCount in order to reduce complexity and code duplications.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="queryOver">The query over.</param>
    /// <param name="identifiers">The identifiers.</param>
    /// <param name="aggregation">The aggregation.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private int SetupRowCount_Inner(IQueryOver<ProductionEntity, ProductionEntity> queryOver, Guid[]? identifiers, AggregationLevel? aggregation)
    {
        var sql = GetGeneratedSql(queryOver);
        sql = sql.Substring(sql.IndexOf(" FROM "));
        ISQLQuery sqlQuery = default;
        if (_measurementFromDate != null || _measurementToDate != null)
        {
            var sqlBody = sql.Substring(0, sql.IndexOf(" GROUP "));
            sqlBody = sqlBody.Replace("and this_.measurement_date >= ?", string.Empty);
            sqlBody = sqlBody.Replace("and this_.measurement_date <= ?", string.Empty);
            var sqlGroup = sql.Substring(sql.IndexOf(" GROUP "));
            if (_measurementFromDate != null)
                sqlBody += $" and this_.measurement_date >= :from";
            if (_measurementToDate != null)
                sqlBody += $" and this_.measurement_date <= :to";

            if (identifiers == null || identifiers.Length == 0)
                sqlBody = sqlBody.Replace("this_.measurement_date >= ?  and ", string.Empty);

            sqlGroup = sqlGroup.Replace("::int", "");
            sql = sqlBody + " " + sqlGroup;
        }

        switch (aggregation)
        {
            case AggregationLevel.FiveMinutes:
            case AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes:
            case AggregationLevel.OneDay:
            case AggregationLevel.OneHour:
                sqlQuery = DbContext
                    .Session
                    .CreateSQLQuery($"SELECT COUNT(t1.*) FROM ({"SELECT min(this_.production_id) as y0_ " + sql}) AS t1");
                break;
            default:
                sqlQuery = DbContext
                    .Session
                    .CreateSQLQuery($"SELECT COUNT(t1.*) FROM ({"SELECT this_.measurement_date as y0_ " + sql}) AS t1");
                break;
        }
        var index = 0;
        if (identifiers != null)
            foreach (var guid in this._guids)
                sqlQuery.SetParameter(index++, guid, NHibernateUtil.Guid);

        if (_measurementToDate != null)
            sqlQuery.SetParameter("to", _measurementToDate.Value, NHibernateUtil.DateTime);
        if (_measurementFromDate != null)
            sqlQuery.SetParameter("from", _measurementFromDate.Value, NHibernateUtil.DateTime);

        var result = sqlQuery.UniqueResult<long>();
        return (int)result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets the date.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="date">The date.</param>
    /// <param name="time">The time.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public DateTime SetDate(DateTime date, TimeSpan time)
    {
        return new DateTime(date.Year, date.Month, date.Day, time.Hours, time.Minutes, time.Seconds, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    }
}

using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DataAccess;

/// <summary>
/// DbContext
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.DbContextBase" />
public class DbContext : DbContextBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="DbContext"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="securityContext">The security context.</param>
    public DbContext(SecurityContext securityContext)
        : base(new DatabaseNodeContext(
            DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_Monitoring,
            securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode))
    {

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel;

/// <summary>
/// Almérő fogyasztási csúcsértékek
/// </summary>
[TableName(TableName = "peak_submeter_consumption")]
public class PeakSubMeterConsumptionEntity : DomainModelBase
{
    //composite PK: ChannelIdentifier, PeakType, PeriodStart

    [Required]
    public virtual Guid ChannelIdentifier { get; set; }

    [Required]
    public virtual DateTime PeakTimeUtc { get; set; } // melyik 15 perces időszak (eleje) 

    [Required]
    //[StringBasedEnum] nem stringes, mert sok helyet foglalna a sok sor miatt a db-ben. és a query is sokkal hatékonyabb, ha nem stringeket kell összehasonlítani!
    public virtual DataQuality DataQuality { get; set; } // a PeakValue-hoz tartozó quality

    [Required]
    public virtual decimal PeakValue { get; set; }

    [Required]
    //[StringBasedEnum]
    public virtual PeakType PeakType { get; set; }

    [Required]
    public virtual DateTime PeriodStart { get; set; }

    [Required]
    public virtual DateTime PeriodEnd { get; set; }

    [Required]
    public virtual DateTime LastModifiedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;



    public override bool Equals(object obj)
    {
        return obj is PeakSubMeterConsumptionEntity other &&
               ChannelIdentifier.Equals(other.ChannelIdentifier) &&
               PeakType.Equals(other.PeakType) &&
               PeriodStart.Equals(other.PeriodStart);
    }

    public override int GetHashCode()
    {
        return HashCode.Combine(ChannelIdentifier, PeakType, PeriodStart);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Riasztás entitás
/// </summary>
public class AlertEntity : TrackedEntityBase, IGlobalIdentifier
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Globális azonosító
    /// </summary>
    public virtual Guid? Identifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztás azonosítója
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Riasztás azonosítója")]
    [MediumStringLength]
    public virtual string AlertIdentifier { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztás megnevezése
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Riasztás megnevezése")]
    [MediumStringLength]
    public virtual string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztás leírása
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Riasztás leírása")]
    public virtual string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztás szövege
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Riasztás szövege")]
    public virtual string AlertText { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Küszöbérték
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Küszöbérték")]
    public virtual decimal Threshold { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Művelet
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Művelet")]
    [StringBasedEnum]
    public virtual AlertOperator Operator { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adattípus
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Adattípus")]
    [StringBasedEnum]

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    [Description("Riasztási időszak vége")]
    public virtual DateTime? ValidToUtc { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Feliratkozott felhasználók
    /// </summary>
    [ManyToMany(tableName: "alert_subscribed_users", 
        keyColumnName: "alert_id", 
        relatedColumnName: "sec_user_id",
        foreignKeyName: "alert_subscribed_users_measurement_alert_id_fkey",
        relatedForeignKeyName: "alert_subscribed_users_sec_user_id_fkey")

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    [Description("Külső e-mail címek. Vesszővel elválasztva.")]

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>
    [Inverse]

    /// <summary>

    /// </summary>

               ChannelIdentifier.Equals(other.ChannelIdentifier) &&

    }

/// <summary>
/// Épületrész
/// </summary>
public class BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity : OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntity
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Épület
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Description("Épület")]
    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "building_synced_monitoring")]
    public virtual BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity Building { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Szintek
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Inverse]
    [Description("Szintek")]
    [CustomForeignKey(ForeignKeyColumnName = "building_part_synced_monitoring_id", 
                      ForeignKeyConstraintName = "fk_building_part_floor_id")]
    public virtual IList<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity> Floors { get; set; }

    public override string Name => CurrentValidity.Name;

    public override OrgunitType OrgunitType => OrgunitType.BuildingPart;

    /// <summary>
    /// Épületrész érvényességek
    /// </summary>
    [Inverse]
    [Description("Épületrész érvényességek")]
    [CustomForeignKey(ForeignKeyColumnName = "building_part_synced_monitoring_id", 
                      ForeignKeyConstraintName = "fk_building_part_building_part_validity_id")]
    public virtual IList<BuildingPartValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity> BuildingPartValidities { get; set; } = [];


    public virtual BuildingPartValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity CurrentValidity => BuildingPartValidities.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom < DateTime.Now && x.ValidTo > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                                                 BuildingPartValidities.OrderByDescending(x => x.ValidFrom).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                                                 BuildingPartValidities.OrderBy(x => x.ValidTo).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidTo < DateTime.Now)!;
}

/// </summary>
public class SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity : OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntity
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Intézmény
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Description("Intézmény")]
    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "institution_synced_monitoring")]
    public virtual InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity Institution { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Épületek
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Inverse]
    [Description("Épületek")]
    [CustomForeignKey(ForeignKeyColumnName = "site_synced_monitoring_id", ForeignKeyConstraintName = "fk_site_building_id")]
    public virtual IList<BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity> Buildings { get; set; }

    [Required]
    [Description("Szervezeti egység típus")]
    public override OrgunitType OrgunitType => OrgunitType.Site;

    [Description("Szervezeti egység neve")]
    public override string Name => CurrentValidity.Name;

    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely érvényességek
    /// </summary>
    [Inverse]
    [Description("Telephely érvényességek")]
    [CustomForeignKey(ForeignKeyColumnName = "site_synced_monitoring_id", ForeignKeyConstraintName = "fk_site_site_validity_id")]
    public virtual IList<SiteValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity> SiteValidities { get; set; } = [];

    public virtual SiteValiditySyncedMonitoringEntity CurrentValidity => SiteValidities.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom < DateTime.Now && x.ValidTo > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                                         SiteValidities.OrderByDescending(x => x.ValidFrom).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                                         SiteValidities.OrderBy(x => x.ValidTo).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidTo < DateTime.Now)!;
}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;

public class MeasurementPointSettingSyncedMonitoringEntity : DomainModelBase
{
    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "measurement_point_synced_monitoring")]
    public virtual MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity MeasurementPoint { get; set; }

    public virtual MeasuredPropertyEntity MeasuredProperty { get; set; }

    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "iot_measured_endpoint")]
    public virtual IoTMeasuredEndpointEntity? Channel { get; set; }

    public override bool Equals(object obj)
    {
        if (ReferenceEquals(this, obj)) return true;
        if (obj is not MeasurementPointSettingSyncedMonitoringEntity other) return false;

        return MeasurementPoint?.Id == other.MeasurementPoint?.Id
                && MeasuredProperty?.Id == other.MeasuredProperty?.Id;
    }

    public override int GetHashCode()
    {
        return HashCode.Combine(MeasurementPoint.Id, MeasuredProperty.Id);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.DomainModel;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;

/// <summary>
/// Felhasználó szerepkör entitás
/// </summary>
[PrimaryKeyGeneration(IdGenerationStrategy.Assigned)]
[TableName(TableName = "sec_role_orgunit_assignment")]
public class SecRoleOrgUnitSyncedEntity : EntityBase
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Szerepkör
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Description("Szerepkör")]
    public virtual SecRoleEntity? Role { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Felhasználó
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Felhasználó")]
    public virtual SecUserSyncedEntity? User { get; set; }


    /* -----------------
     * Magyarázat
     * Ha OrgUnitType null, akkor bármelyik tenanton belüli szervezeti egységre érvényes a jogosultság, amit a szerepkör biztosít.
     * Ebben az esetben az Institution, Site, Building mezők null értéket vesznek fel.
     * Egyéb esetben a három mező közül legalább egynek értéket kell kapnia, és hierarchiában felette lévőket is kitöltjük.
     
     * példa. ha meg van adva a Site OrgunitType, akkor a műveletek Site-okon végezhetők el. Az, hogy melyik Site-okon, attól függ, hogy melyik konkrét 
     * Institution vagy Site property-k vannak kitöltve. Ha a Site ki van töltve, akkor a művelet csak azon az egy konkrét Site-on végezhető el.
     * Ha Create műveletről van szó, akkor konkrét Site-nak nincs értelme, azt a felette lévő elemre, az Institution-re kell megadni.
     * Ha azt akarjuk, hogy bármely intézményre vonatkozzon, akkor null-t kell az Institution-ben és az OrgunitType-ban is megadni.
     * 
     * A többi elemi művelet már konkrét orgunit-ra is értelmezhető, de akár a feljebb lévő szintekre is.
     
     */

    /// <summary>
    /// Szervezeti egység típusa, (adathatókör)
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Szervezeti egység típusa")]
    [StringBasedEnum]
    public virtual OrgunitType? OrgunitType { get; set; } //null, ha mindenre érvényes a jogosultság (a teljesen szervezeti hierarchiára, tenanton belül)

    /// <summary>
    /// Adott Intézmény, amin a művelet elvégezhető
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Intézmény")]
    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "institution_synced_monitoring")]
    public virtual InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity? Institution { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adott Telephely, amin a művelet elvégezhető
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Telephely")]
    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "site_synced_monitoring")]
    public virtual SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity? Site { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adott Épület, amin a művelet elvégezhető
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Épület")]
    [PropertyName(PropertyName = "building_synced_monitoring")]
    public virtual BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity? Building { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Jogosultság érvényesség kezdete
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [Description("Jogosultság érvényesség kezdete")]
    public virtual DateTime ValidFrom { get; set; } //TODO: ez csak dátum. a logikának majd kezelnie kell, hogy az adott nap elejét vegye figyelembe

    /// <summary>
    /// Jogosultság érvényesség vége
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Jogosultság érvényesség vége")]
    public virtual DateTime? ValidTo { get; set; } //TODO: ez csak dátum. a logikának majd kezelnie kell, hogy az adott nap végét vegye figyelembe

}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Monitoring\EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd\Helpers\JobHelper.cs
====================================================================================================

using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Npgsql;
using Quartz;
using Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore;
using Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.Common;
using Quartz.Impl.Triggers;
using Quartz.Simpl;
using Quartz.Spi;
using Quartz.Util;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// JobHelper
/// </summary>
public static class JobHelper
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The job store
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly IJobStore JobStore;

    /// <summary>
    /// MyJobStore
    /// </summary>
    /// <seealso cref="Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.JobStoreCMT" />
    public class MyJobStore : JobStoreCMT
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="MyJobStore"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        public MyJobStore()
        {
            ObjectSerializer = new BinaryObjectSerializer();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the non managed TX connection.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <exception cref="System.InvalidOperationException">Context not available.</exception>
        [Obsolete]
        protected override ConnectionAndTransactionHolder GetNonManagedTXConnection()
        {
            var ctx = DbContext.Current;
            if (ctx == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Context not available.");

            var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand();
            ctx.Session.Transaction.Enlist(cmd);

            var result = new ConnectionAndTransactionHolder(ctx.Session.Connection, cmd.Transaction);
            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Cleanup the given database connection.  This means restoring
        /// any modified auto commit or transaction isolation connection
        /// attributes, and then closing the underlying connection.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="conn"></param>
        /// <remarks>
        /// This is separate from closeConnection() because the Spring
        /// integration relies on being able to overload closeConnection() and
        /// expects the same connection back that it originally returned
        /// from the datasource.
        /// </remarks>
        /// <seealso cref="M:Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.JobStoreSupport.CloseConnection(Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.ConnectionAndTransactionHolder)" />
        protected override void CleanupConnection(ConnectionAndTransactionHolder conn) { }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the <see cref="JobHelper"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    static JobHelper()
    {
        JobStore = InitializeJobStore();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Posts the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <typeparam name="T"></typeparam>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="jobData">The job data.</param>
    public static void PostJob<T>(IDbContext dbContext, string key, IDictionary<string, object> jobData = null)
        where T : class
    {
        PostJob(typeof(T), dbContext, key, jobData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Posts the job.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="jobType">Type of the job.</param>
    /// <param name="dbContext">The database context.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <param name="jobData">The job data.</param>
    /// <param name="setupTriggerAction">The setup trigger action.</param>
    public static void PostJob(Type jobType, IDbContext dbContext, string key,
        IDictionary<string, object> jobData = null, Action<TriggerBuilder> setupTriggerAction = null)
    {
        var jobKey = new JobKey(key, "EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring");
        var job = JobBuilder.Create(jobType)
            .WithIdentity(jobKey)
            .UsingJobData(jobData == null ? new JobDataMap() : new JobDataMap(jobData))
            .RequestRecovery(false)
            .Build();

        var triggerKey = new TriggerKey(key, "EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring");
        var triggerBuilder = TriggerBuilder.Create()
            .WithIdentity(triggerKey)
            .ForJob(jobKey);

        if (setupTriggerAction != null)
            setupTriggerAction(triggerBuilder);
        else
            triggerBuilder.StartNow();

        var trigger = triggerBuilder.Build();

        if (trigger is SimpleTriggerImpl simpletrigger)
            simpletrigger.SetNextFireTimeUtc(trigger.StartTimeUtc);

        if (trigger is CronTriggerImpl cronTrigger)
        {
            var exp = new CronExpression(cronTrigger.CronExpressionString);
            var nextValidTimeAfter = exp.GetNextValidTimeAfter(DateTime.UtcNow);
            if (nextValidTimeAfter != null)
            {
                var nextFireDate = nextValidTimeAfter.Value.UtcDateTime;
                cronTrigger.SetNextFireTimeUtc(nextFireDate);
            }
        }

        var dictionary = new Dictionary<IJobDetail, IReadOnlyCollection<ITrigger>>
        {
            {job, new HashSet<ITrigger> {trigger}}
        };

        using (new DbContext.DbContextSession(dbContext))
        {
            JobStore.StoreJobsAndTriggers(dictionary, true).RunSync();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes the job store.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    private static IJobStore InitializeJobStore()
    {
        var connectionString = Config.GetStringValue("Db.ConnectionString", true);
        var dbProvider = new DbProvider("Npgsql", connectionString);
        DBConnectionManager.Instance.AddConnectionProvider("Main", dbProvider);

        var schedulerName = Config.GetStringValue("Quartz.Scheduler.InstanceName", true);
        var result = new MyJobStore
        {
            InstanceName = schedulerName,
            TablePrefix = "qrtz_",
            DataSource = "Main",
            Clustered = true,
            PerformSchemaValidation = false,
            DriverDelegateType = "Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.StdAdoDelegate, Quartz" // lsd: QuartzServiceBase.StartScheduler.  itt eredetileg ez volt: Quartz.Impl.AdoJobStore.SqlServerDelegate, Quartz    
        };
        result.Initialize(new SimpleTypeLoadHelper(), null).RunSync();
        return result;
    }
}

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.Framework;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Consumption;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Helpers.PeakCalculation;
public static class PeakCalculationHelpers
{

    #region public helpers
    /// <summary>
    /// Legenerál egy folytonos <see cref="PeakSubMeterConsumptionEntityDto"/> listát az adott peakType-hoz, a from-to közé eső időszakban.
    /// A lista adatai nincsenek még kitöltve, csak a <see cref="PeakSubMeterConsumptionEntityDto.PeriodStart"/> és <see cref="PeakSubMeterConsumptionEntityDto.PeriodEnd"/> mezők.
    /// A lista ki lesz egészítve az adott <see cref="PeakType"/> szerinti egész intervallumokkal, tehát a napi, heti, havi vagy éves bontásnak megfelelően.
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException" />
    public static List<T> GenerateEmptyIntervalsByType<T>(DateTime from, DateTime to, PeakType peakType) where T: IPeakMeterConsumptionEntityDto, new()
    {
        if (from > to)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("A kezdő dátum nem lehet nagyobb a végdátumnál.", nameof(from));
        }

        var start = GetIntervalSart(from, peakType);
        var end = GetIntervalEnd(to, peakType);
        //az időszakokat mindig kiegészítjük egésszé

        HashSet<T> intervalss = [];
        for (var date = start; date <= end; date = IncrementDateTimeByPeakType(date, peakType))
        {
            intervalss.Add(new T
            {
                PeakType = peakType,
                PeriodStart = date,
                PeriodEnd = GetIntervalEnd(date, peakType),
            });
        }

        return intervalss.ToList();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// <paramref name="source"/> adatokból elvégzi a csúcsérték számításokat, az értékeket a <paramref name="intervals"/> listába írja, a megadott <paramref name="channelId"/> és <paramref name="peakType"/> szerint.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="intervals">Az intervallumnak folytonosnak kell lennie!</param>
    /// <exception cref="InvalidOperationException"></exception>
    public static void CalculateSubMeterPeaksForChannelAndPeakType(IEnumerable<NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto> source, List<PeakSubMeterConsumptionEntityDto> intervals, Guid channelId, PeakType peakType)
    {
        if (!source.Any() || intervals.Count < 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (source.Any(s => s.Value == null))
        {
            //már a normalizált adatok közül is csak olyat szabadott lekérdezni, aminek van értéke.
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Source data must not contain null values!");
        }

        //forrásból a channelId-hez tartozó adatokat szűrjük le, és a megfelelő intervallumokhoz rendeljük hozzá
        var sourceByChannel = source.Where(x => x.ChannelIdentifier == channelId);


        var intervalsToRemove = new List<PeakSubMeterConsumptionEntityDto>();

        //kiszámoljuk az összes intervallumhoz tartozó csúcsértéket
        foreach (var interval in intervals.Where(d => d.PeakType == peakType)) //filter to be sure
        {
            var data = sourceByChannel
                .Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc >= interval.PeriodStart && x.MeasuredAtUtc <= interval.PeriodEnd);
            if (data.Any())
            {

                var peakMeasurement = data.MaxBy(x => x.Value!); //null értékeket itt már nem tartalmazhat! (a nullosokat nem tekinthetjük 0-nak, mert azzal egy csupa negatív számból álló sorozatnál 0-t generálnánk max-nak, ami logikailag hibás)
                //frissítjük a DTO értékeit
                interval.ChannelIdentifier = channelId;
                interval.PeakValue = (decimal)peakMeasurement!.Value!.Value; //muszáj nem-null értéknek lennie
                interval.PeakTimeUtc = peakMeasurement!.MeasuredAtUtc; //a csúcsérték a mérés időpontját megörökli (az időszakon belül ekkor volt a csúcs)
                interval.DataQuality = peakMeasurement!.DataQuality;
                interval.LastModifiedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            }
            else
            {
                //throw new InvalidOperationException($"No data found for channel {channelId} in the interval {interval.PeriodStart} - {interval.PeriodEnd}.");
                intervalsToRemove.Add(interval);
            }                    
        }
        //delete the intervals that have no data
        intervals.RemoveAll(x => intervalsToRemove.Contains(x));
    }

    public static void CalculateMainMeterPeaksForChannelAndPeakType(IEnumerable<MeasurementDataModel> source, List<PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntityDto> intervals, int channelId, string podIdentifier, PeakType peakType)
    {
        if (!source.Any() || intervals.Count < 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        //if (source.Any(s => s.Value == null))
        //{
        //    //már a normalizált adatok közül is csak olyat szabadott lekérdezni, aminek van értéke.
        //    throw new InvalidOperationException("Source data must not contain null values!");
        //}
        //Ide már szűrt értékek kerülnek amik channelId-hez tartoznak, illetve a modell sem tartalmaz jelenleg channel azonosítót. 
        //forrásból a channelId-hez tartozó adatokat szűrjük le, és a megfelelő intervallumokhoz rendeljük hozzá
        //var sourceByChannel = source.Where(x => x. == channelId);

        var intervalsToRemove = new List<PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntityDto>();

        //kiszámoljuk az összes intervallumhoz tartozó csúcsértéket
        foreach (var interval in intervals.Where(d => d.PeakType == peakType)) //filter to be sure
        {
            var data = source
                .Where(x => x.Timestamp >= interval.PeriodStart && x.Timestamp <= interval.PeriodEnd);
            if (data.Any())
            {
                var peakMeasurement = data.MaxBy(x => x.Value!); //null értékeket itt már nem tartalmazhat! (a nullosokat nem tekinthetjük 0-nak, mert azzal egy csupa negatív számból álló sorozatnál 0-t generálnánk max-nak, ami logikailag hibás)
                                                                 //frissítjük a DTO értékeit
                interval.ChannelIdentifier = channelId;
                interval.PeakValue = (decimal)peakMeasurement!.Value!; //muszáj nem-null értéknek lennie
                interval.PeakTimeUtc = peakMeasurement!.Timestamp.UtcDateTime; //a csúcsérték a mérés időpontját megörökli (az időszakon belül ekkor volt a csúcs)
                interval.LastModifiedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                interval.PodIdentifier = podIdentifier;
            }
            else
            {
                intervalsToRemove.Add(interval);
                //throw new InvalidOperationException($"No data found for channel {channelId} in the interval {interval.PeriodStart} - {interval.PeriodEnd}.");
            }
        }
        //delete the intervals that have no data
        intervals.RemoveAll(x => intervalsToRemove.Contains(x));
    }
    #endregion



    #region private helpers
    /// <summary>
    /// <paramref name="peakType"/> típusának megfelelően növeli a <see cref="DateTime"/> értékét."/>
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException"></exception>
    private static DateTime IncrementDateTimeByPeakType(DateTime dateTime, PeakType peakType)
    {
        return peakType switch
        {
            PeakType.Daily => dateTime.AddDays(1),
            PeakType.Weekly => dateTime.AddDays(7),
            PeakType.Monthly => dateTime.AddMonths(1),
            PeakType.Yearly => dateTime.AddYears(1),
            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(peakType), peakType, $"Érvénytelen {nameof(peakType)}")
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// <paramref name="peakType"/> típusának megfelelően a dátumhoz meghatározza az intervallum kezdetét.
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException"></exception>
    public static DateTime GetIntervalSart(DateTime dateTime, PeakType peakType)
    {
        return peakType switch
        {
            PeakType.Daily => dateTime.TruncateToDayStart(),
            PeakType.Weekly => dateTime.TruncateToWeekStart(),
            PeakType.Monthly => dateTime.TruncateToMonthStart(),
            PeakType.Yearly => dateTime.TruncateToYearStart(),
            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(peakType), peakType, $"Érvénytelen {nameof(peakType)}")
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// <paramref name="peakType"/> típusának megfelelően a dátumhoz meghatározza az intervallum végét.
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException"></exception>
    public static DateTime GetIntervalEnd(DateTime dateTime, PeakType peakType)
    {
        return peakType switch
        {
            PeakType.Daily => dateTime.TruncateToDayEnd(),
            PeakType.Weekly => dateTime.TruncateToWeekStart().AddDays(7).AddTicks(-1),
            PeakType.Monthly => dateTime.TruncateToMonthStart().AddMonths(1).AddTicks(-1),
            PeakType.Yearly => dateTime.TruncateToYearStart().AddYears(1).AddTicks(-1),
            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(peakType), peakType, $"Érvénytelen {nameof(peakType)}")
        };
    }
    #endregion
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.CommandHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.BackEnd.Managers;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Commands.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Messaging;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services;

/// <summary>
/// CommandServiceServer
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Services.ICommandService" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Security.ISecurable" />
public class CommandServiceServer : ICommandService, ISecurable
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CommandServiceServer"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public CommandServiceServer(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        IsCheckAccessEnabled = true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is check access enabled.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// <c>true</c> if this instance is check access enabled; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool IsCheckAccessEnabled { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="System.NotImplementedException"></exception>
    public Task<ICommandResult> ExecuteCommand(ICommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the entity command.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual Task<ICommandResult> ExecuteEntityCommand(IEntityCommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, string? dbContextKey = default)
    {
        ICommandResult result;
        var svc = ResolveService(command);

        // ******** EnergiaMenedzsment
        if (svc.TransactionMode != CommandHandlerTransactionMode.No)
        {
            // Main database
            IDbContext dbContext;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbContextKey))
            {
                dbContext = _scope.ResolveKeyed<IDbContext>(dbContextKey);
            }
            else
            {
                dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
            }

            // Messaging
            _scope.TryResolve(out IMessagingContext? messagingContext);

#pragma warning disable IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
            using (var tran = TransactionContext.Create(dbContext, svc.TransactionMode == CommandHandlerTransactionMode.Auto))
#pragma warning restore IDE0063 // Use simple 'using' statement
            {
                result = svc.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);

                tran.Commit();
                if ((messagingContext?.Enabled ?? false) && messagingContext.IsInTransaction)
                    messagingContext.Commit();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            result = svc.ExecuteEntityCommand(command);
        }

        return Task.FromResult(result);
    }

    public void TryDbAction(Action action)
    {
        var dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        using (var tran = TransactionContext.Create(dbContext, true))
        {
            action.Invoke();

            tran.RollBack();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves the service.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="command">The command.</param>
    /// <param name="key">The key.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual ICommandHandler ResolveService(IEntityCommand command, string? key = null)
    {
        if (IsCheckAccessEnabled)
        {
            SecurityManager.CheckAccess(_scope, command);
        }

        if (key == null)
            return _scope.ResolveNamed<ICommandHandler>(command.EntityTypeName);
        if (_scope.IsRegisteredWithName<ICommandHandler>($"{key}.{command.EntityTypeName}"))
            return _scope.ResolveNamed<ICommandHandler>($"{key}.{command.EntityTypeName}");
        return null;
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.BusinessLogic.QueryHandlers;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.BackEnd.Managers;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.Security;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services;

/// <summary>
/// QueryServiceServer
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Common.Logic.Services.IQueryService" />
/// <seealso cref="Common.Shared.Security.ISecurable" />
public class QueryServiceServer : IQueryService, ISecurable
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Scope
    /// </summary>
    protected readonly ILifetimeScope _scope;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is check access enabled.
    /// </summary>
    /// <value>
    /// <c>true</c> if this instance is check access enabled; otherwise, <c>false</c>.
    /// </value>
    public bool IsCheckAccessEnabled { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="QueryServiceServer"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="scope">The scope.</param>
    public QueryServiceServer(ILifetimeScope scope)
    {
        _scope = scope;
        IsCheckAccessEnabled = true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Executes the query.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<IQueryResult> ExecuteQuery(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).ExecuteQuery(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the single entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<IEntityQuerySingleResult?> QuerySingleEntity(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).QuerySingleEntity(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the entities.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<IEntityQueryItemsResult> QueryEntities(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).QueryEntities(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queries the entity count.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public Task<long> QueryEntityCount(IEntityQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(ResolveService(query).QueryEntityCount(query));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves the service.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="query">The query.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    public virtual IQueryHandler ResolveService(IEntityQuery query)
    {
        if (IsCheckAccessEnabled)
        {
            var attrib = SecurityManager.GetAttribute(query);
            var securityContext = attrib == null || !attrib.NoCheck ? _scope.Resolve<SecurityContext>() : null;
            SecurityManager.CheckAccess(securityContext, query);
        }

        var svc = _scope.ResolveNamed<IQueryHandler>(query.EntityTypeName);
        var dbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();
        dbContext.IsReadOnly = true;

        return svc;

    }

}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.ListItems.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Models;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Queries.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Queries.MeasurementPoints;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services.Aggregation;

public interface IAggregatedDataReportService
{
    Task<List<SummaryTableDatatModel>> GetSummaryTableData(DevicesAggregatedDataTableRequest request);
    Task<List<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel>> GetAggregatedDataReportDataItems(DevicesAggregatedDataTableRequest request);
}

public class AggregatedDataReportService : IAggregatedDataReportService
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;
    private readonly IDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;

    public AggregatedDataReportService(IQueryService queryService, IMapper mapper, IDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _mapper = mapper;
    }

    public async Task<List<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel>> GetAggregatedDataReportDataItems(DevicesAggregatedDataTableRequest request)
    {

        var query = new AggregatedDataReportDeviceDetailsQuery
        {
            OrgUnitId = request.OrgUnitId,
            MeasuredPropertyId = request.MeasuredProperty?.Id,
            TechnologyId = request.Technology?.Id,
            DeviceCategory = request.DeviceCategory?.DeviceCategoryName,
            DeviceType = request.DeviceType?.DeviceTypeName
        };
        List<OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntityDto> endpoints = (await _queryService.QueryEntities(query) as EntityQueryItemsResult<OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntityDto>)?.Items?.ToList() ?? new List<OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntityDto>();

        var result = endpoints.Select(_mapper.Map<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel>).ToList();

        var channelItems = endpoints
            .Where(endpoint => endpoint.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
            .Select(endpoint => new AggregatedDataReportForChannelsQueryChannelItem
            {
                ChannelId = endpoint.ChannelIdentifier!.Value,
                UnitOfMeasure = endpoint.UnitOfMeasure,
                AggregationMethod = endpoint.AggregationMethod
            })
            .ToList();


        DateTime toDate = DateTime.Today.AddDays(1);

        //Mai nap adatainak aggregálásának kezelése
        var todayAggregatedValues = await QueryAggregatedDataAsync(channelItems, DateTime.Today, toDate);
        result.ForEach(x =>
        {
            var todayData = todayAggregatedValues.FirstOrDefault(y => y.ChannelId == x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier);
            if (todayData != null)
            {
                x.TodaysData = _mapper.Map<DevicesAggregatedDataResultTodaysData>(todayData);
            }
        });

        //Tegnapi adatok aggregálásának kezelése
        if (request.AggregationYesterday)
        {
            var lastDayAggregatedValues = await QueryAggregatedDataAsync(channelItems, DateTime.Today.AddDays(-1), toDate);
            result.ForEach(x =>
            {
                var lastDayData = lastDayAggregatedValues.FirstOrDefault(y => y.ChannelId == x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier);
                if (lastDayData != null)
                {
                    x.LastDaysData = _mapper.Map<DevicesAggregatedDataResultLastDaysData>(lastDayData);
                }
            });
        }

        //Egy hetes aggregálás kezelése
        if (request.AggregationLast7Days)
        {
            var last7DayAggregatedValues = await QueryAggregatedDataAsync(channelItems, DateTime.Today.AddDays(-7), toDate);
            result.ForEach(x =>
            {
                var last7DayData = last7DayAggregatedValues.FirstOrDefault(y => y.ChannelId == x.MeasuredEndpointIdentifier);
                if (last7DayData != null)
                {
                    x.Last7DaysData = _mapper.Map<DevicesAggregatedDataResultLastDaysData>(last7DayData);
                }
            });
        }
        // Apply sorting if specified
        result = ApplyDevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder(request.ListOrder, result);

        return result;
    }

    private async Task<IList<AggreagatedDataReportListItemDto>> QueryAggregatedDataAsync(List<AggregatedDataReportForChannelsQueryChannelItem> items, DateTime fromDate, DateTime toDate)
    {
        var channelsQuery = new AggregatedDataReportForChannelsQuery
        {
            From = fromDate,
            To = toDate,
            Channels = items
        };

        return ((AggregatedDataReportForChannelsQueryResult)await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(channelsQuery)).AggregatedData;
    }

    private static List<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel> ApplyDevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder(DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder listOrder, List<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel> items)
    {
        return listOrder switch
        {
            DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder.TopologyThenDevice => items.OrderBy(r => r.TopologyData)
                                                                       .ThenBy(r => r.DeviceData)
                                                                       .ToList(),
            DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder.DeviceThenTopology => items.OrderBy(r => r.DeviceData)
                                                                               .ThenBy(r => r.TopologyData)
                                                                               .ToList(),
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"Sort order '{listOrder}' is not supported.")
        };
    }

    public async Task<List<SummaryTableDatatModel>> GetSummaryTableData(DevicesAggregatedDataTableRequest request)
    {
        DateTime toDate = DateTime.Today.AddDays(1);
        var filterQuery = new AggregatedDataReportDeviceDetailsQuery
        {
            OrgUnitId = request.OrgUnitId,
            MeasuredPropertyId = request.MeasuredProperty?.Id,
            TechnologyId = request.Technology?.Id,
            DeviceCategory = request.DeviceCategory?.DeviceCategoryName,
            DeviceType = request.DeviceType?.DeviceTypeName
        };
        List<OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntityDto> endpoints = (await _queryService.QueryEntities(filterQuery) as EntityQueryItemsResult<OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntityDto>)?.Items?.ToList() ?? new List<OrgUnitMeasurementPointHierarchyViewEntityDto>();

        var grouped = endpoints.GroupBy(item => new
        {
            item.InstitutionId,
            item.InstitutionName,
            item.SiteId,
            item.SiteName,
            item.BuildingId,
            item.BuildingName,
            item.BuildingPartId,
            item.BuildingPartName,
            item.FloorId,
            item.FloorName,
            item.RoomId,
            item.RoomName
        }).ToList();

        List<SummaryTableDatatModel> result = [];
        foreach (var group in grouped)
        {
            var summaryTableDataModel = new SummaryTableDatatModel()
            {
                TopologyData = new DevicesAggregatedDataResultTopologyData
                    (
                        group.Key.InstitutionName, group.Key.SiteName, group.Key.BuildingName, group.Key.BuildingPartName, group.Key.FloorName, group.Key.RoomName
                    )
            };

            var nestedGroups = group.GroupBy(x => new { x.DeviceCategory, x.DeviceType, x.AggregationMethod, x.MeasuredProperty, x.IsBilling });
            foreach (var nestedGroup in nestedGroups)
            {
                var summaryTableDetailModel = new SummaryTableDetailDatatModel()
                {
                    AggregationMethod = nestedGroup.Key.AggregationMethod,
                    DeviceCategory = nestedGroup.Key.DeviceCategory,
                    DeviceType = nestedGroup.Key.DeviceType,
                    MeasuredProperty = nestedGroup.Key.MeasuredProperty
                };

                summaryTableDataModel.DetailDatatModels.Add(summaryTableDetailModel);
                //A főmérőhöz nem tudunk adatokat számolni
                if (nestedGroup.Key.IsBilling.HasValue && !nestedGroup.Key.IsBilling.Value)
                {
                    var channelIdentifiers = nestedGroup
                        .Where(x => x.ChannelIdentifier.HasValue)
                        .Select(x => x.ChannelIdentifier!.Value)
                        .ToList();

                    //Ha nincs csatorna azonosító beállítva, akkor nem tudunk aggregált adatokat számolni
                    if (channelIdentifiers.Count == 0)
                        continue;

                    var query = new SummaryTableAggregateDataQuery<NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto>()
                    {
                        ChannelIds = channelIdentifiers,
                        AggregationMethod = nestedGroup.Key.AggregationMethod,
                        From = DateTime.Today,
                        To = toDate,
                    };

                    //TODO: Ennek querynek a Daily táblán kéne lefutni: double - decimal converzió hiba miatt nem lehetséges egyenlőre
                    var dailyQuery = new SummaryTableAggregateDataQuery<NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto>()
                    {
                        ChannelIds = channelIdentifiers,
                        AggregationMethod = nestedGroup.Key.AggregationMethod,
                        From = DateTime.Today.AddDays(-7),
                        To = toDate,
                    };
                    var aggregatedData = ((SummaryTableAggregateDataQueryResult)await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query)).AggregatedData;
                    summaryTableDetailModel.TodaysData = _mapper.Map<DevicesAggregatedDataResultTodaysData>(aggregatedData);

                    //Előző napi adatok aggregálása
                    if (request.AggregationYesterday)
                    {
                        query.From = DateTime.Today.AddDays(-1);
                        var yesterDayAggregatedData = ((SummaryTableAggregateDataQueryResult)await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query)).AggregatedData;
                        summaryTableDetailModel.LastDaysData = _mapper.Map<DevicesAggregatedDataResultLastDaysData>(yesterDayAggregatedData);
                    }

                    //Előző heti adatok aggregálása
                    if (request.AggregationLast7Days)
                    {
                        var last7DaysAggregatedData = ((SummaryTableAggregateDataQueryResult)await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(dailyQuery)).AggregatedData;
                        summaryTableDetailModel.Last7DaysData = _mapper.Map<DevicesAggregatedDataResultLastDaysData>(last7DaysAggregatedData);
                    }
                }
            }
            result.Add(summaryTableDataModel);
        }
        return result;
    }
}
