using System.Linq;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Queries.Consumption;
using NHibernate;
using NHibernate.Criterion;
using NHibernate.Linq;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services.Aggregation;

public interface IConsumptionAggregationService
{
    Task<List<AggregatedConsumptionIntermediateResult>> GetAggregationIntermediateResult(AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery query);
}

public class ConsumptionAggregationService : IConsumptionAggregationService
{
    private readonly IDbContext _dbContext;

    public ConsumptionAggregationService(IDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(dbContext));
    }

    public async Task<List<AggregatedConsumptionIntermediateResult>> GetAggregationIntermediateResult(AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery query)
    {
        var session = _dbContext.Session;

        var measuredProperty = await session
            .Query<MeasuredPropertyEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Id == query.MeasuredPropertyId)
            .SingleAsync();

        var orgUnitIdsWithMeasuredDataIds = query.OrgUnitSelections
            .Where(x => !x.MeasurementPointId.HasValue && x.OrgUnitId.HasValue)
            .ToList();

        var orgUnitIds = orgUnitIdsWithMeasuredDataIds
            .Select(x => x.OrgUnitId!.Value)
            .ToList();

        // Institutions: Only query by direct ID match
        var institutions = await session.Query<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .Where(x => orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Id))
            .ToListAsync();

        // Sites: Query by direct ID match OR by institution parent ID
        var sites = await session.Query<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .Where(x => orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Id) || orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Institution.Id))
            .ToListAsync();

        // Buildings: Query by direct ID match OR by site parent ID OR by institution grandparent ID
        var buildings = await session.Query<BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .Where(x => orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Site.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Site.Institution.Id))
            .ToListAsync();

        // BuildingParts: Query by direct ID match OR by any parent ID up the hierarchy
        var buildingParts = await session.Query<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .Where(x => orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Building.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Building.Site.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Building.Site.Institution.Id))
            .ToListAsync();

        // Floors: Query by direct ID match OR by any parent ID up the hierarchy
        var floors = await session.Query<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .Where(x => orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.BuildingPart.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.BuildingPart.Building.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Institution.Id))
            .ToListAsync();

        // Rooms: Query by direct ID match OR by any parent ID up the hierarchy
        var rooms = await session.Query<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .Where(x => orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Floor.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Floor.BuildingPart.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Id) || 
                        orgUnitIds.Contains(x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Institution.Id))
            .ToListAsync();

        var orgUnitsById = new Dictionary<int, OrgunitBaseSyncedMonitoringEntity>();

        foreach (var institution in institutions)
        {
            orgUnitsById.Add(institution.Id, institution);
        }

        foreach (var site in sites)
        {
            orgUnitsById.Add(site.Id, site);
        }

        foreach (var building in buildings)
        {
            orgUnitsById.Add(building.Id, building);
        }

        foreach (var buildingPart in buildingParts)
        {
            orgUnitsById.Add(buildingPart.Id, buildingPart);
        }

        foreach (var floor in floors)
        {
            orgUnitsById.Add(floor.Id, floor);
        }

        foreach (var room in rooms)
        {
            orgUnitsById.Add(room.Id, room);
        }

        var distinctOrgUnitIdList = orgUnitsById
            .Select(x => x.Key)
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        var allOrgUnitMeasurementPoints = await session.Query<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .Where(mp => distinctOrgUnitIdList.Contains(mp.OrgunitBase.Id))
            .ToListAsync();

        var institutionMeasurementPoints = allOrgUnitMeasurementPoints.Where(x => institutions.Any(y => x.OrgunitBase.Id == y.Id)).ToList();
        var siteMeasurementPoints = allOrgUnitMeasurementPoints.Where(x => sites.Any(y => x.OrgunitBase.Id == y.Id)).ToList();
        var buildingMeasurementPoints = allOrgUnitMeasurementPoints.Where(x => buildings.Any(y => x.OrgunitBase.Id == y.Id)).ToList();
        var buildingPartMeasurementPoints = allOrgUnitMeasurementPoints.Where(x => buildingParts.Any(y => x.OrgunitBase.Id == y.Id)).ToList();
        var floorMeasurementPoints = allOrgUnitMeasurementPoints.Where(x => floors.Any(y => x.OrgunitBase.Id == y.Id)).ToList();
        var roomMeasurementPoints = allOrgUnitMeasurementPoints.Where(x => rooms.Any(y => x.OrgunitBase.Id == y.Id)).ToList();

        var intermediateResult = new List<AggregatedConsumptionIntermediateResult>();

        foreach (var orgUnitSelectionItem in orgUnitIdsWithMeasuredDataIds)
        {
            var orgUnit = orgUnitsById[orgUnitSelectionItem.OrgUnitId!.Value];

            var measurementPoints = GetMeasurementPointsForOrgUnit(
                orgUnitSelectionItem.OrgUnitId!.Value,
                measuredProperty.Id,
                orgUnitSelectionItem.MeasuredDataId,
                institutions,
                sites,
                buildings,
                buildingParts,
                floors,
                rooms,
                institutionMeasurementPoints,
                siteMeasurementPoints,
                buildingMeasurementPoints,
                buildingPartMeasurementPoints,
                floorMeasurementPoints,
                roomMeasurementPoints
            );

            var channelIds = measurementPoints
                .SelectMany(x => x.Settings)
                .Where(x => x.Channel != null)
                .Select(x => x.Channel!.Identifier)
                .Where(x => x.HasValue)
                .Select(x => x!.Value)
                .ToList();

            var podIds = measurementPoints
                .Select(x => x.PodId)
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .Distinct()
                .ToList();

            intermediateResult.Add(new AggregatedConsumptionIntermediateResult
            {
                Name = orgUnit.Name,
                OrgUnitId = orgUnitSelectionItem.OrgUnitId!.Value,
                ChannelIds = channelIds,
                PodIds = podIds
            });
        }

        var explititlySelectedMeasurementPointIds = query.OrgUnitSelections
            .Where(x => x.MeasurementPointId.HasValue)
            .Select(x => x.MeasurementPointId!.Value)
            .ToList();

        var explicitlySelectedMeasurementPoints = await session.QueryOver<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
            .Where(x => x.Id.IsIn(explititlySelectedMeasurementPointIds))
            .ListAsync();

        foreach (var measurementPoint in explicitlySelectedMeasurementPoints)
        {
            var channelIds = measurementPoint.Settings
                .Where(x => x.Channel != null)
                .Select(x => x.Channel!.Identifier)
                .Where(x => x.HasValue)
                .Select(x => x!.Value)
                .ToList();

            intermediateResult.Add(new AggregatedConsumptionIntermediateResult
            {
                Name = measurementPoint.Name,
                MeasurementPointId = measurementPoint.Id,
                ChannelIds = channelIds,
                PodIds = new List<string> { measurementPoint.PodId }.Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)).ToList()
            });
        }

        return intermediateResult;
    }

    private static List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> GetMeasurementPointsForOrgUnit(
    int orgUnitId,
    int measuredPropertyId,
    int? measuredDataId,
    IList<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntity> institutions,
    IList<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity> sites,
    IList<BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildings,
    IList<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingParts,
    IList<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity> floors,
    IList<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity> rooms,
    List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> institutionMeasurementPoints,
    List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> siteMeasurementPoints,
    List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingMeasurementPoints,
    List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingPartMeasurementPoints,
    List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> floorMeasurementPoints,
    List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> roomMeasurementPoints)
{
    var selectedMeasurementPoints = new List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>();

    // Check if orgUnitId is an Institution
    var matchingInstitution = institutions.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == orgUnitId);
    if (matchingInstitution != null)
    {
        var measurementPoints = GetMeasurementPointsForInstitution(
            orgUnitId, measuredPropertyId, measuredDataId, sites, buildings, buildingParts, floors, rooms,
            institutionMeasurementPoints, siteMeasurementPoints, buildingMeasurementPoints, 
            buildingPartMeasurementPoints, floorMeasurementPoints, roomMeasurementPoints);
        selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(measurementPoints);
        return selectedMeasurementPoints;
    }

    // Check Sites: orgUnitId is a Site OR sites belong to an institution with orgUnitId
    var matchingSites = sites.Where(x => x.Id == orgUnitId || x.Institution.Id == orgUnitId).ToList();
    foreach (var site in matchingSites)
    {
        var measurementPoints = GetMeasurementPointsForSite(
            site.Id, measuredPropertyId, measuredDataId, buildings, buildingParts, floors, rooms,
            siteMeasurementPoints, buildingMeasurementPoints, buildingPartMeasurementPoints, 
            floorMeasurementPoints, roomMeasurementPoints);
        selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(measurementPoints);
    }

    // Check Buildings: orgUnitId is a Building OR buildings belong to parent entities with orgUnitId
    var matchingBuildings = buildings.Where(x => x.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                                 x.Site.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                                 x.Site.Institution.Id == orgUnitId).ToList();
    foreach (var building in matchingBuildings)
    {
        var measurementPoints = GetMeasurementPointsForBuilding(
            building.Id, measuredPropertyId, measuredDataId, buildingParts, floors, rooms,
            buildingMeasurementPoints, buildingPartMeasurementPoints, floorMeasurementPoints, roomMeasurementPoints);
        selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(measurementPoints);
    }

    // Check BuildingParts: orgUnitId is a BuildingPart OR building parts belong to parent entities with orgUnitId
    var matchingBuildingParts = buildingParts.Where(x => x.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                                         x.Building.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                                         x.Building.Site.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                                         x.Building.Site.Institution.Id == orgUnitId).ToList();
    foreach (var buildingPart in matchingBuildingParts)
    {
        var measurementPoints = GetMeasurementPointsForBuildingPart(
            buildingPart.Id, measuredPropertyId, measuredDataId, floors, rooms,
            buildingPartMeasurementPoints, floorMeasurementPoints, roomMeasurementPoints);
        selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(measurementPoints);
    }

    // Check Floors: orgUnitId is a Floor OR floors belong to parent entities with orgUnitId
    var matchingFloors = floors.Where(x => x.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                           x.BuildingPart.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                           x.BuildingPart.Building.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                           x.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                           x.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Institution.Id == orgUnitId).ToList();
    foreach (var floor in matchingFloors)
    {
        var measurementPoints = GetMeasurementPointsForFloor(
            floor.Id, measuredPropertyId, measuredDataId, rooms, floorMeasurementPoints, roomMeasurementPoints);
        selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(measurementPoints);
    }

    // Check Rooms: orgUnitId is a Room OR rooms belong to parent entities with orgUnitId
    var matchingRooms = rooms.Where(x => x.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                         x.Floor.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                         x.Floor.BuildingPart.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                         x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                         x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Id == orgUnitId || 
                                         x.Floor.BuildingPart.Building.Site.Institution.Id == orgUnitId).ToList();
    foreach (var room in matchingRooms)
    {
        var measurementPoints = roomMeasurementPoints
            .Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == room.Id
                        && x.MeasuredProperties.Any(measuredProperty => measuredProperty.Id == measuredPropertyId)
                        && (measuredDataId == null || x.Labels.Any(measuredData => measuredData.Id == measuredDataId)))
            .ToList();
        selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(measurementPoints);
    }

    return selectedMeasurementPoints;
}

    private static List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> GetMeasurementPointsForInstitution(
        int orgUnitId,
        int measuredPropertyId,
        int? measuredDataId,
        IList<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity> sites,
        IList<BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildings,
        IList<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingParts,
        IList<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity> floors,
        IList<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity> rooms,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> institutionMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> siteMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingPartMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> floorMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> roomMeasurementPoints)
    {
        var selectedMeasurementPoints = new List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>();

        // First check if the institution itself has measurement points with the required property
        var institutionMeasurementPointsWithProperty = institutionMeasurementPoints
            .Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == orgUnitId
                        && x.MeasuredProperties.Any(measuredProperty => measuredProperty.Id == measuredPropertyId)
                        && (measuredDataId == null || x.Labels.Any(measuredData => measuredData.Id == measuredDataId)))
            .ToList();

        if (institutionMeasurementPointsWithProperty.Any())
        {
            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(institutionMeasurementPointsWithProperty);
            return selectedMeasurementPoints;
        }

        // If institution doesn't have the required measurement points, traverse each site subtree
        var institutionSites = sites.Where(x => x.Institution.Id == orgUnitId).ToList();

        foreach (var site in institutionSites)
        {
            var siteMeasurementPointsForSubtree = GetMeasurementPointsForSite(
                site.Id,
                measuredPropertyId,
                measuredDataId,
                buildings,
                buildingParts,
                floors,
                rooms,
                siteMeasurementPoints,
                buildingMeasurementPoints,
                buildingPartMeasurementPoints,
                floorMeasurementPoints,
                roomMeasurementPoints);

            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(siteMeasurementPointsForSubtree);
        }

        return selectedMeasurementPoints;
    }

    private static List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> GetMeasurementPointsForSite(
        int siteId,
        int measuredPropertyId,
        int? measuredDataId,
        IList<BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildings,
        IList<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingParts,
        IList<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity> floors,
        IList<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity> rooms,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> siteMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingPartMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> floorMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> roomMeasurementPoints)
    {
        var selectedMeasurementPoints = new List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>();

        // Check if the site itself has measurement points with the required property
        var siteMeasurementPointsWithProperty = siteMeasurementPoints
            .Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == siteId
                && x.MeasuredProperties.Any(measuredProperty => measuredProperty.Id == measuredPropertyId)
                && (measuredDataId == null || x.Labels.Any(measuredData => measuredData.Id == measuredDataId)))
            .ToList();

        if (siteMeasurementPointsWithProperty.Any())
        {
            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(siteMeasurementPointsWithProperty);
            return selectedMeasurementPoints;
        }

        // If site doesn't have the required measurement points, traverse each building subtree
        var siteBuildings = buildings.Where(x => x.Site.Id == siteId).ToList();

        foreach (var building in siteBuildings)
        {
            var buildingMeasurementPointsForSubtree = GetMeasurementPointsForBuilding(
                building.Id,
                measuredPropertyId,
                measuredDataId,
                buildingParts,
                floors,
                rooms,
                buildingMeasurementPoints,
                buildingPartMeasurementPoints,
                floorMeasurementPoints,
                roomMeasurementPoints);

            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(buildingMeasurementPointsForSubtree);
        }

        return selectedMeasurementPoints;
    }

    private static List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> GetMeasurementPointsForBuilding(
        int buildingId,
        int measuredPropertyId,
        int? measuredDataId,
        IList<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingParts,
        IList<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity> floors,
        IList<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity> rooms,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingPartMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> floorMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> roomMeasurementPoints)
    {
        var selectedMeasurementPoints = new List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>();

        // Check if the building itself has measurement points with the required property
        var buildingMeasurementPointsWithProperty = buildingMeasurementPoints
            .Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == buildingId
                        && x.MeasuredProperties.Any(measuredProperty => measuredProperty.Id == measuredPropertyId)
                        && (measuredDataId == null || x.Labels.Any(measuredData => measuredData.Id == measuredDataId)))
            .ToList();

        if (buildingMeasurementPointsWithProperty.Any())
        {
            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(buildingMeasurementPointsWithProperty);
            return selectedMeasurementPoints;
        }

        // If building doesn't have the required measurement points, traverse each building part subtree
        var buildingBuildingParts = buildingParts.Where(x => x.Building.Id == buildingId).ToList();

        foreach (var buildingPart in buildingBuildingParts)
        {
            var buildingPartMeasurementPointsForSubtree = GetMeasurementPointsForBuildingPart(
                buildingPart.Id,
                measuredPropertyId,
                measuredDataId,
                floors,
                rooms,
                buildingPartMeasurementPoints,
                floorMeasurementPoints,
                roomMeasurementPoints);

            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(buildingPartMeasurementPointsForSubtree);
        }

        return selectedMeasurementPoints;
    }

    private static List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> GetMeasurementPointsForBuildingPart(
        int buildingPartId,
        int measuredPropertyId,
        int? measuredDataId,
        IList<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity> floors,
        IList<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity> rooms,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> buildingPartMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> floorMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> roomMeasurementPoints)
    {
        var selectedMeasurementPoints = new List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>();

        // Check if the building part itself has measurement points with the required property
        var buildingPartMeasurementPointsWithProperty = buildingPartMeasurementPoints
            .Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == buildingPartId
                        && x.MeasuredProperties.Any(measuredProperty => measuredProperty.Id == measuredPropertyId)
                        && (measuredDataId == null || x.Labels.Any(measuredData => measuredData.Id == measuredDataId)))
            .ToList();

        if (buildingPartMeasurementPointsWithProperty.Any())
        {
            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(buildingPartMeasurementPointsWithProperty);
            return selectedMeasurementPoints;
        }

        // If building part doesn't have the required measurement points, traverse each floor subtree
        var buildingPartFloors = floors.Where(x => x.BuildingPart.Id == buildingPartId).ToList();

        foreach (var floor in buildingPartFloors)
        {
            var floorMeasurementPointsForSubtree = GetMeasurementPointsForFloor(
                floor.Id,
                measuredPropertyId,
                measuredDataId,
                rooms,
                floorMeasurementPoints,
                roomMeasurementPoints);

            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(floorMeasurementPointsForSubtree);
        }

        return selectedMeasurementPoints;
    }

    private static List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> GetMeasurementPointsForFloor(
        int floorId,
        int measuredPropertyId,
        int? measuredDataId,
        IList<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity> rooms,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> floorMeasurementPoints,
        List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity> roomMeasurementPoints)
    {
        var selectedMeasurementPoints = new List<MeasurementPointSyncedMonitoringEntity>();

        // Check if the floor itself has measurement points with the required property
        var floorMeasurementPointsWithProperty = floorMeasurementPoints
            .Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == floorId
                        && x.MeasuredProperties.Any(measuredProperty => measuredProperty.Id == measuredPropertyId)
                        && (measuredDataId == null || x.Labels.Any(measuredData => measuredData.Id == measuredDataId)))
            .ToList();

        if (floorMeasurementPointsWithProperty.Any())
        {
            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(floorMeasurementPointsWithProperty);
            return selectedMeasurementPoints;
        }

        // If floor doesn't have the required measurement points, check each room
        var floorRooms = rooms.Where(x => x.Floor.Id == floorId).ToList();

        foreach (var room in floorRooms)
        {
            var roomMeasurementPointsWithProperty = roomMeasurementPoints
                .Where(x => x.OrgunitBase.Id == room.Id
                            && x.MeasuredProperties.Any(measuredProperty => measuredProperty.Id == measuredPropertyId)
                            && (measuredDataId == null || x.Labels.Any(measuredData => measuredData.Id == measuredDataId)))
                .ToList();

            selectedMeasurementPoints.AddRange(roomMeasurementPointsWithProperty);
        }

        return selectedMeasurementPoints;
    }

    private static IQueryable<int> GetSiteIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> institutionIds) =>
        session.Query<SiteSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(s => institutionIds.Contains(s.Institution.Id))
               .Select(s => s.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetBuildingIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> institutionIds) =>
        session.Query<BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(b => GetSiteIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(session, institutionIds).Contains(b.Site.Id))
               .Select(b => b.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetBuildingPartIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> institutionIds) =>
        session.Query<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(bp => GetBuildingIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(session, institutionIds).Contains(bp.Building.Id))
               .Select(bp => bp.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetFloorIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> institutionIds) =>
        session.Query<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(f => GetBuildingPartIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(session, institutionIds).Contains(f.BuildingPart.Id))
               .Select(f => f.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetRoomIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> institutionIds) =>
        session.Query<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(r => GetFloorIdsByInstitutionIdSubquery(session, institutionIds).Contains(r.Floor.Id))
               .Select(r => r.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetBuildingIdsBySiteIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> siteIds) =>
        session.Query<BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(b => siteIds.Contains(b.Site.Id))
               .Select(b => b.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetBuildingPartIdsBySiteIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> siteIds) =>
        session.Query<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(bp => GetBuildingIdsBySiteIdSubquery(session, siteIds).Contains(bp.Building.Id))
               .Select(bp => bp.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetFloorIdsBySiteIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> siteIds) =>
        session.Query<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(f => GetBuildingPartIdsBySiteIdSubquery(session, siteIds).Contains(f.BuildingPart.Id))
               .Select(f => f.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetRoomIdsBySiteIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> siteIds) =>
        session.Query<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(r => GetFloorIdsBySiteIdSubquery(session, siteIds).Contains(r.Floor.Id))
               .Select(r => r.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetBuildingPartIdsByBuildingIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> buildingIds) =>
        session.Query<BuildingPartSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
           .Where(bp => buildingIds.Contains(bp.Building.Id))
           .Select(bp => bp.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetFloorIdsByBuildingIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> buildingIds) =>
        session.Query<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(f => GetBuildingPartIdsByBuildingIdSubquery(session, buildingIds).Contains(f.BuildingPart.Id))
               .Select(f => f.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetRoomIdsByBuildingIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> buildingIds) =>
        session.Query<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(r => GetFloorIdsByBuildingIdSubquery(session, buildingIds).Contains(r.Floor.Id))
               .Select(r => r.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetFloorIdsByBuildingPartIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> buildingPartIds) =>
        session.Query<FloorSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
           .Where(f => buildingPartIds.Contains(f.BuildingPart.Id))
           .Select(f => f.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetRoomIdsByBuildingPartIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> buildingPartIds) =>
        session.Query<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
               .Where(r => GetFloorIdsByBuildingPartIdSubquery(session, buildingPartIds).Contains(r.Floor.Id))
               .Select(r => r.Id);

    private static IQueryable<int> GetRoomIdsByFloorIdSubquery(ISession session, List<int> floorIds) =>
        session.Query<RoomSyncedMonitoringEntity>()
           .Where(r => floorIds.Contains(r.Floor.Id))
           .Select(r => r.Id);

using Common.EDM_Models.Measurement;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Enums;
using Common.Shared.Exceptions;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Energiamenedzsment.Common.EdmInterface.Abstractions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Queries.MeasuredProperty;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services.EDM;

/// <summary>
/// EDM lekérdező helper függvények
/// </summary>
/// <param name="queryService"></param>
/// <param name="edmInterfaceService"></param>
public class EdmHelperService(IQueryService queryService, IEdmInterfaceService edmInterfaceService) : IEdmHelperService
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Főmérő fogyasztási adatok lekérdezése EDM-ből
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="podId">POD azonosító</param>
    /// <param name="from">Kezdeti dátum</param>
    /// <param name="to">Vég dátum</param>
    /// <param name="forceRefresh">Kényszerített frissítés</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancel token</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    /// <exception cref="EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException"></exception>
    /// <exception cref="NullReferenceException"></exception>
    public async Task<List<MeasurementResponseModel>> GetMeasurements(string podId, DateOnly? from, DateOnly? to,
        bool forceRefresh = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var obisCodesQueryRes = await queryService.QueryEntities(
            new MeasuredPropertyEntityQuery
            {
                Code = nameof(MeasuredPropertyCode.ACTIVE_ELECTRICITY_CONSUMPTION)
            },
            cancellationToken);
        
        var obisCodes = (obisCodesQueryRes as EntityQueryItemsResult<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>)?
            .Items.FirstOrDefault()?
            .ObisCodes;
        
        if (obisCodes == null) 
            throw new NullReferenceException("Obis code not found");

        var edmDeviceRes = await edmInterfaceService.GetEDMDevices(podId, cancellationToken);
        
        if (edmDeviceRes.Devices.Count > 1)
            Log.LogWarning("More than one device found for the given POD!");
        
        if (edmDeviceRes.Devices.First().DataChannels.Count > 1)
            Log.LogWarning("More than one data channel found for the given Device!");

        var dataChannelId = edmDeviceRes
            .Devices.FirstOrDefault(x => x.DataChannels.Any(d=> obisCodes.Contains(d.ObisCode)))?
            .DataChannels.FirstOrDefault(x => obisCodes.Contains(x.ObisCode))?
            .DataChannelId;

        if (dataChannelId == null)
        {
            Log.LogWarning("No data channel found for the given POD and Obis code!");
            return [];
        }
        
        var requestId = await edmInterfaceService.RequestMeasurements(dataChannelId.Value, from, to, forceRefresh, cancellationToken);
        return await edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurementResults(requestId, cancellationToken);
    }
}

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Services.Normalization;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Resolutions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel.Consumption;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services.Normalization;
public class ConsumptionNormalizationPeriodicService<TPeriodicEntity> : DataNormalizationService<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, TPeriodicEntity, DateTime> 
    where TPeriodicEntity : IPeriodicConsumptionEntity, new()
{
    public override IEnumerable<TPeriodicEntity> Normalize(IEnumerable<NormalizedConsumptionEntity> data, IResolutionHandler resolution, AggregationMethod method)
    {
        return data.GroupBy(entry => resolution.GetClosestDateTime(entry.MeasuredAtUtc, RoundingDirection.Ceiling))
                   .Select(groupList => NormalizeSingle(groupList, groupList.Key, method));
    }

    public override TPeriodicEntity NormalizeSingle(IEnumerable<NormalizedConsumptionEntity> data, DateTime timestamp, AggregationMethod method)
    {
        return new TPeriodicEntity
        {
            LastModifiedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            MeasuredAtUtc = timestamp,
            Value = (decimal)_aggregateEnumerableDictionary[method](data)!,
        };
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.DomainModel.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Modules.Framework;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DomainModel;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Consumption;
using NHibernate.Linq;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services.PeakConsumption;
public class PeakMainMeterConsumptionService(
    IDbContext dbContext,
    IMapper mapper,
    SecurityContext securityContext,
    ILogger<PeakMainMeterConsumptionService> logger
    ) : IPeakMainMeterConsumptionService
{
    private readonly string _baseUrl = Config.GetStringValue("FrameworkApiHost");
    public async Task<List<MeasurementResponseModel>> GetDataAsync(DateTime from)
    {

        using var client = HttpClientExtensions.CreateClient();
        var fapi = client.GetApiClient<FrameworkApi>(x => x.BaseUrl = _baseUrl);

        client.Authenticate(fapi, tenantCode: securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode).RunSync();

        using var _scope = AutofacScope.Global.BeginLifetimeScope();
        var lastDate = DateTime.MinValue;
        _scope.SetAnonymousContext(null);

        using var independentDbContext = _scope.Resolve<IDbContext>();

        var result = await fapi.MeasurementPoints_GetBillingMeasurementPointMeasurementsByChannelsAsync(from,DateTime.Now);
        return result.ToList();
    }

    public async Task<List<PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntityDto>> GetPeakMainMeterConsumptionsByChannelListAsync(IEnumerable<int> channels, PeakType peakType, DateTime from, DateTime to)
    {
        if (from > to)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("A kezdő dátum nem lehet nagyobb a végdátumnál.", nameof(from));
        if (channels is null || channels.Count() == 0)
            throw new ArgumentNullException("Legalább egy csatorna azonosító megadása kötelező.", nameof(channels)); ;

        List<int> channelIds = channels.ToHashSet().ToList(); //unique

        var entities = await dbContext.Session.Query<PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntity>()
            .Where(x => channelIds.Contains(x.ChannelIdentifier))
            .Where(x => x.PeakType == peakType)
            .Where(x => x.PeriodStart >= from && x.PeriodStart <= to)
            .OrderBy(x => x.ChannelIdentifier)
            .ThenBy(x => x.PeriodStart) //időrendben
            .ToListAsync();
        var dtos = entities.Select(mapper.Map<PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntityDto>).ToList();
        return dtos;
    }

    public void InsertOrUpdatePeaksAsync(List<PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntityDto> calculatedPeaks)
    {
        if (calculatedPeaks == null || calculatedPeaks.Count == 0)
        {
            return; //nincs mit csinálni
        }

        logger.LogDebug("{svcname} started with {count}.", nameof(InsertOrUpdatePeaksAsync), calculatedPeaks.Count);
        try
        {

            var peakKeys = calculatedPeaks
                .Select(p => Tuple.Create(p.ChannelIdentifier, p.PeakType, p.PeriodStart))
                .ToHashSet();

            // Az összes érintett csatorna + időintervallum
            var affectedChannelIds = calculatedPeaks.Select(p => p.ChannelIdentifier).Distinct().ToList();
            var minPeriod = calculatedPeaks.Min(p => p.PeriodStart);
            var maxPeriod = calculatedPeaks.Max(p => p.PeriodStart);

            //előszűrés SQL oldalon
            var query = dbContext.Session.Query<PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntity>()
                .Where(p =>
                    affectedChannelIds.Contains(p.ChannelIdentifier) &&
                    p.PeriodStart >= minPeriod &&
                    p.PeriodStart <= maxPeriod);
            var existingPeaks = query.ToList(); 
            var existingDict = existingPeaks
                .Where(p => peakKeys.Contains(Tuple.Create(p.ChannelIdentifier, p.PeakType, p.PeriodStart)))
                .ToDictionary(p => (p.ChannelIdentifier, p.PeakType, p.PeriodStart));



            foreach (var calculatedPeakDto in calculatedPeaks)
            {
                var existingPeak = existingDict.Values
                    .FirstOrDefault(p => p.ChannelIdentifier == calculatedPeakDto.ChannelIdentifier &&
                                         p.PeakType == calculatedPeakDto.PeakType &&
                                         p.PeriodStart == calculatedPeakDto.PeriodStart);

                if (existingPeak is not null)
                {
                    if (calculatedPeakDto.PeakValue > existingPeak.PeakValue)
                    {
                        existingPeak.PeakValue = calculatedPeakDto.PeakValue;
                        existingPeak.PeakTimeUtc = calculatedPeakDto.PeakTimeUtc;
                        existingPeak.LastModifiedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                        dbContext.Session.Update(existingPeak); //update existing entity with new peak value
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    var entity = new PeakMainMeterConsumptionEntity
                    {
                        ChannelIdentifier = calculatedPeakDto.ChannelIdentifier,
                        PodIdentifier=calculatedPeakDto.PodIdentifier,
                        PeakType = calculatedPeakDto.PeakType,
                        PeriodStart = calculatedPeakDto.PeriodStart,
                        PeriodEnd = calculatedPeakDto.PeriodEnd,
                        PeakValue = calculatedPeakDto.PeakValue,
                        PeakTimeUtc = calculatedPeakDto.PeakTimeUtc,                       
                        LastModifiedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,                        
                    };
                    dbContext.Session.Save(entity); //insert new entity
                }
            }
            dbContext.Session.Flush(); //flush the session to persist changes
            logger.LogInfo($"Successfully updated {calculatedPeaks.Count} peak consumption records.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            logger.LogError(ex, $"Error updating peak consumption records: {ex.Message}");
            throw;
        }
    }
}

using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Autofac;
using Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Caching;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using static Common.Shared.Constants;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundService;

public static class BackgroundServiceInitializer
{
    public static void Initialize(string[] args)
    {
        var host = CreateHostBuilder(args).Build();
        AutofacScope.SetGlobal(host.Services.GetAutofacRoot());

        var configuration = AutofacScope.Global.Resolve<IConfiguration>();

        Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
        Log.LogInfo( $"EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring Background Service - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(BackgroundServiceInitializer))}");


        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Linux}");
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)) Log.LogInfo($"OSPlatform: {OSPlatform.Windows}");

        Config.LocalProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);
        Config.Provider = new DbConfigProvider(AutofacScope.Global);

        host.Run();
    }

    public static void ConfigureContainer(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring"));
        builder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common"));
        builder.RegisterMaps();
    }

    public static IHostBuilder
        CreateHostBuilder(string[] args)
    {
        var host = Host.CreateDefaultBuilder(args);

        host.ConfigureServices(services =>
        {
            var builder = new ConfigurationBuilder()
             .SetBasePath(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory())
             .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
             .AddJsonFile("appsettings.Development.json", true);

            var configuration = builder.Build();

            var redisSection = configuration.GetSection(RedisSettings.Redis);
            services.Configure<RedisSettings>(redisSection);
            var redisSettings = new RedisSettings();
            redisSection.Bind(redisSettings);

            services.ConfigureCaching(redisSettings);

            //Keyed HTTP clients
            services.AddHttpClient(ModuleNames.FrameworkWebAPI, client =>
            {
                client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(ModuleHostConfigKeys.FrameworkApiHost));
                //client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("TODO..."));
            });
            services.AddHttpClient(ModuleAuthClientNames.FrameworkAuthClient, client =>
            {
                client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(ModuleHostConfigKeys.FrameworkApiHost));
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("text/plain"));
                //client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("TODO..."));
            });

            services.AddModuleApiClients();
        });

        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Linux)) host.UseSystemd();
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)) host.UseWindowsService();
        host.UseServiceProviderFactory(new AutofacServiceProviderFactory(ConfigureContainer));
        return host;
    }
}

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.BackgroundService.Wireup;

/// <summary>
/// AutofacMonitoringBackgroundService
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Autofac.Module" />
public class AutofacMonitoringBackgroundService : Module
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Override to add registrations to the container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder through which components can be
    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.RegisterSecurityContext();

        builder
            .RegisterType<DbContext>()
            .As<IDbContext>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        builder.RegisterType<QueryServiceServer>().As<IQueryService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<CommandServiceServer>().As<ICommandService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        //consumption services
        builder.RegisterType<PeakSubMeterConsumptionService>().As<IPeakSubMeterConsumptionService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<PeakMainMeterConsumptionService>().As<IPeakMainMeterConsumptionService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<Co2eCalculatorService>().As<ICo2eCalculatorService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        builder.RegisterQuartzBackgroundService("MonitoringDb.ConnectionString");

        //Log
        builder.RegisterType<DefaultAccessLogger>().As<IAccessLogger>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterGeneric(typeof(SerilogLogger<>)).As(typeof(ILogger<>)).InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        //Jobs
        builder.RegisterType<SyncDeviceJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SyncOrgunitJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SyncConsumptionJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SyncConsumptionDataJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SyncProductionJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SyncOtherJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<MonitoringSyncUserAndTenantJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();

        builder.RegisterType<ResolutionHandlerFactory>().As<IResolutionHandlerFactory>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<PeakSubMeterConsumptionCalculationJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<PeakMainMeterConsumptionCalculationJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<AlertJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<Co2RecalculationJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<SyncSecRoleOrgunitAssignmentJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<RunStoredFunctionsJob>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();

        //Időintervallumos normalizációs jobokhoz 
        builder.RegisterType<ConsumptionNormalizationPeriodicService<NormalizedConsumptionHourlyEntity>>().As<INormalizationService<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionHourlyEntity>>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<ConsumptionNormalizationPeriodicService<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity>>().As<INormalizationService<NormalizedConsumptionEntity, NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity>>().SingleInstance();

        builder.RegisterType<PeriodicConsumptionNormalizationJob<NormalizedConsumptionHourlyEntity>>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
        builder.RegisterType<PeriodicConsumptionNormalizationJob<NormalizedConsumptionDailyEntity>>().As<IHostedService>().SingleInstance();
    }
}

    {

        {

        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()

            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.Development.json", true)
            .Build();
        Config.TestProvider = new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);
        Config.Provider = new DbConfigProvider(AutofacScope.Test);
        Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
    }

﻿using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.UnitTest.Wireup;

public class AutofacBackEndUnitTestsModule : Module
{
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        //Database
        //EnergiaMenedzsment Database
        builder.RegisterType<DbContext>()
            .As<IDbContext>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        //Core Database
        builder.RegisterType<CoreDbContext>()
            .Keyed<IDbContext>(DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE)
            .Named<IDbContext>(DatabaseNodeContext.DB_CODE_EnergiaMenedzsment_CORE)
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        //Services
        builder.RegisterType<QueryServiceServer>().As<IQueryService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<CommandServiceServer>().As<ICommandService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using Common.Shared.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Security;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Enums;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert;

[DataContract]
[TSGeneratorOptions]
public class AlertEntityDto : LogicalDeleteEntityDtoBase, IGlobalIdentifier
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Globális azonosító
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public Guid? Identifier { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztás azonosítója
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public string AlertIdentifier { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztás megnevezése
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztás leírása
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztás szövege
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    public string AlertText { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Küszöbérték
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    public decimal Threshold { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Művelet
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    public AlertOperator Operator { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adattípus
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    public AlertDataType DataType { get; set; }


    /// <summary>
    /// Mért adat azonosítója
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    public Guid DataPointIdentifier { get; set; } // aka. channelid

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztás lejárata
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    public DateTime ValidFromUtc { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztási időszak vége
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public DateTime? ValidToUtc { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Feliratkozott felhasználók
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public List<SecUserSyncedEntityDto> SubscribedUsers { get; set; } = [];

    /// <summary>
    /// E-mail értesítés
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Required]
    public bool IsEmailNotification { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Külső e-mail címek
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public List<string> ExternalEmailAddresses { get; set; } = [];

    /// <summary>
    /// Riasztási események
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Belső riasztási események")]
    public IList<AlertEventEntityDto> AlertEvents { get; set; } = [];

    /// <summary>
    /// Aktív-e a riasztás
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Aktív-e a riasztás")]
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Módosította
    /// </summary>
    [Description("Módosította")]
    public string ModifiedBy { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}

{

                                                    BuildingPartValidities.OrderBy(x => x.ValidTo).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidTo < DateTime.Now)!;

    /// </summary>

    /// Intézmény
    /// </summary>
    [Required]
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Intézmény")]
    public EntityRef<InstitutionSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> Institution { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Épületek
    /// </summary>
    // [Required]
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Épületek")]
    public IList<BuildingSyncedMonitoringEntityDto> Buildings { get; set; } = [];

    /// <summary>
    /// Telephely érvényességek
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    [Display(Name = "Telephely érvényességek")]
    public IList<SiteValiditySyncedMonitoringEntityDto> SiteValidities { get; set; } = [];

    /// <summary>
    /// Szervezeti egység neve
    /// </summary>
    public string Name => CurrentValidity.Name;

    public SiteValiditySyncedMonitoringEntityDto CurrentValidity => SiteValidities.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom < DateTime.Now && x.ValidTo > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                    SiteValidities.OrderByDescending(x => x.ValidFrom).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidFrom > DateTime.Now) ??
                                                    SiteValidities.OrderBy(x => x.ValidTo).FirstOrDefault(x => x.ValidTo < DateTime.Now)!;
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Monitoring\EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared\Models\DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel.cs

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Models;


//ez az egész összegyűjtött adatkupacnak a flattenelt megfelelője, amit a UI táblázatba ki kirakunk, és excelbe is ki lehet exportálni majd
//TODO: ahogy a US-ben is el van szeparálva logikailag és vizuálisan, én is külön record-okra bontottam az adatokat, így talán átláthatóbb. UI szempontból majd meg kell beszélni, hogy jó-e, vagy jobb lenne inkább teljesen flat struktúrát visszaadni. (lehet, hogy excel export miatt jobb lenne a flat, mert nem biztos, hogy kezelni tudja ezt)
public class DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel
{
    public required Guid MeasuredEndpointIdentifier { get; set; } //ez a MeasuredEndpointIdentifier azonosítója. lehet, hogy nem lesz rá szükség, de én meghagynám a lehetőségét, hogy a UI-on ez alapján lehessen pl. egy műveletet végezni a sorokon
    public string? UnitOfMeasure { get; set; }
    // # HEADER (szövegek)
    public required DevicesAggregatedDataResultTopologyData TopologyData { get; set; }
    public required DevicesAggregatedDataResultDeviceData DeviceData { get; set; }
    public required DevicesAggregatedDataResultMeasurementPointData MeasurementPointData { get; set; }

    // # DETAILS (számok)
    // ## Mai adatok:
    public required DevicesAggregatedDataResultTodaysData TodaysData { get; set; }
    // ## Tegnapi adatok (ha aggregationYesterday==true):
    public DevicesAggregatedDataResultLastDaysData? LastDaysData { get; set; }
    // ## Előző 7 napos adatok (ha aggregationLast7Days==true):
    public DevicesAggregatedDataResultLastDaysData? Last7DaysData { get; set; } //mivel ugyanazok az adatok, mint a tegnapi típus, ezért szerintem erre felesleges külön osztály

}
public enum DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder // TODO: US alapján ezt lehet még finomítani
{
    TopologyThenDevice = 1, //Topológia majd eszközök (eszköz név? vagy mire gondolt?)
    DeviceThenTopology = 2, // Eszköz kategória, típus, majd topológia
}

public record DevicesAggregatedDataResultTopologyData(string InstitutionName, string SiteName, string BuildingName, string BuildingPartName, string FloorName, string RoomName) : IComparable<DevicesAggregatedDataResultTopologyData>
{
    //this simplifies the sorting logic by providing a string representation of the topology path
    public int CompareTo(DevicesAggregatedDataResultTopologyData? other)
    {
        string thisPath = $"{InstitutionName} {SiteName} {BuildingName} {BuildingPartName} {FloorName} {RoomName}";
        string otherPath = $"{other?.InstitutionName} {other?.SiteName} {other?.BuildingName} {other?.BuildingPartName} {other?.FloorName} {other?.RoomName}";
        return string.Compare(thisPath, otherPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }
}

public record DevicesAggregatedDataResultDeviceData(string DeviceCategoryName, string DeviceTypeName, string AggregationMethod) : IComparable<DevicesAggregatedDataResultDeviceData>
{
    //this simplifies the sorting logic by providing a string representation of the device data
    public int CompareTo(DevicesAggregatedDataResultDeviceData? other)
    {
        string thisData = $"{DeviceCategoryName} {DeviceTypeName} {AggregationMethod}";
        string otherData = $"{other?.DeviceCategoryName} {other?.DeviceTypeName} {other?.AggregationMethod}";
        return string.Compare(thisData, otherData, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }
}

//TODO: ide a GUID-os identifier kell, vagy más? US képernyőképen szöveg van, pl. mpa1
public record DevicesAggregatedDataResultMeasurementPointData(string Identifier, string Name, string MeasuredProperty, string Technology);

public record DevicesAggregatedDataResultTodaysData(string LastMeasuredValue, string AggregatedValue, string MinValue, string MaxValue);

public record DevicesAggregatedDataResultLastDaysData(string AggregatedValue, string MinValue, string MaxValue, string AverageValue);

    //public DateOnly FromDate { get; set; }
    //public DateOnly ToDate { get; set; }
    public EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel AggregationLevel { get; set; } = EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes; //ez most jelenleg fixen 15 perc

    //Eszköz jellemzők:
    public EntityRef<EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.MeasurementPoint.MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>? MeasuredProperty { get; set; }
    public EntityRef<EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.System.TenantIndependentDictItemEntityDto>? Technology { get; set; }
    public DeviceCategoryModel? DeviceCategory { get; set; }
    public DeviceTypeModel? DeviceType { get; set; }


    public DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder ListOrder { get; set; } = DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder.TopologyThenDevice;

    //Megjelenítendő időszakok aggregációi:
    public bool AggregationYesterday { get; set; }
    public bool AggregationLast7Days { get; set; }

    public int OrgUnitId { get { return RoomId ?? FloorId ?? BuildingPartId ?? BuildingId ?? SiteId ?? InstitutionId ?? 0; } }


    public global::Common.Shared.Enums.OrgunitType OrgUnitType
    {
        get 
        {
            return RoomId != null ? global::Common.Shared.Enums.OrgunitType.Room
                 : FloorId != null ? global::Common.Shared.Enums.OrgunitType.Floor
                 : BuildingPartId != null ? global::Common.Shared.Enums.OrgunitType.BuildingPart
                 : BuildingId != null ? global::Common.Shared.Enums.OrgunitType.Building
                 : SiteId != null ? global::Common.Shared.Enums.OrgunitType.Site
                 : global::Common.Shared.Enums.OrgunitType.Institution;
        } 
    }
}

    public List<DateTime> MeasurementDate { get; set; } = new List<DateTime>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Termelési teljesítmény
    /// </summary>
    public List<double> Power { get; set; } = new List<double>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Termelt energia
    /// </summary>
    public List<double> Energy { get; set; } = new List<double>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Az eredmények között megtalálható felbontás. Ha pl nincs 5 perces felbontású adatunk,
    /// akkor ne is jelenítsünk meg 5 perces felbontást, mint választható opciót.
    /// </summary>
    public List<AggregationLevel> ExcludedTimeUnits { get; set; } = new List<AggregationLevel> { };
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Globalization;
using Autofac;
using Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Common.Logic.Configuration;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Helpers;
using Common.Logic.Logging;
using Common.Logic.Wireup;
using Common.Shared.Caching;
using Common.WebAPI.ErrorHandler;
using Common.WebAPI.Extensions;
using Common.WebAPI.Filters;
using FluentValidation.AspNetCore;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.WebAPI.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Controllers.Security;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Infrastructure;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Converters;
using Serilog;
using Log = Common.Logic.Logging.Log;
using Energiamenedzsment.Common.EdmInterface.Services;
using static Common.Shared.Constants;

var allowSpecificOrigins = "_allowSpecificOrigins";

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Host.UseSerilog((context, configuration) => configuration.ReadFrom.Configuration(context.Configuration));

ConfigureConfiguration(builder.Configuration);

//Autofac configuration
builder.Host.ConfigureContainer<ContainerBuilder>(containerBuilder =>
{
    containerBuilder.RegisterAPISecurityContext();
    containerBuilder.LoadAndRegisterAssemblies(x => x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common") || x.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring"));
    containerBuilder.RegisterMaps();
});
builder.Host.UseServiceProviderFactory(new AutofacServiceProviderFactory());

// Add services to the container.

builder.Services.AddSingleton<ProblemDetailsFactory, EnergiaMenedzsmentProblemDetailsFactory>();

builder.Services
    .AddControllers()
    .AddNewtonsoftJson(options => options
        .SerializerSettings
        .Converters
        .Add(new StringEnumConverter())
    )
    .AddFluentValidation(fv => ConfigureFluentValidation(fv));
// Learn more about configuring Swagger/OpenAPI at https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/swashbuckle
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.Configure<RouteOptions>(options => options.LowercaseUrls = true);
builder.Services.AddCustomizedSwagger(nameof(EnergiaMenedzsment), c =>
{
    c.DocumentFilter<SwaggerDocumentFilter>();
});

builder.Services.AddHealthChecks();

builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies());

var redisSection = builder.Configuration.GetSection(RedisSettings.Redis);
builder.Services.Configure<RedisSettings>(redisSection);
var redisSettings = new RedisSettings();
redisSection.Bind(redisSettings);

builder.Services.ConfigureCaching(redisSettings);

// Adding Authentication  
builder.Services.AddEnergiaMenedzsmentAuthentication();

builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy(name: allowSpecificOrigins,
        corsBuilder =>
        {
            corsBuilder.WithOrigins(builder.Configuration["AccessControlAllowOrigin"].Split(',')).SetIsOriginAllowedToAllowWildcardSubdomains()
                   .AllowAnyHeader()
                   .AllowAnyMethod();
        });
});

var serviceCollection = new ServiceCollection();

serviceCollection.AddHttpClient<EdmInterfaceService>("EDM-API", client =>
{
    //TODO: add /api/v1 to the base address in configuration!!!

    client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue("EnapMockApiHost"));
    client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("EnapMockApiHostTimeout"));
});

//Keyed HTTP clients
serviceCollection.AddHttpClient(ModuleNames.FrameworkWebAPI, client =>
{
    client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(ModuleHostConfigKeys.FrameworkApiHost));
    //client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("TODO..."));
});
serviceCollection.AddHttpClient(ModuleAuthClientNames.FrameworkAuthClient, client =>
{
    client.BaseAddress = new Uri(Config.GetStringValue(ModuleHostConfigKeys.FrameworkApiHost));
    client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("text/plain"));
    //client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Config.GetIntValue("TODO..."));
});


builder.Host.ConfigureContainer<ContainerBuilder>(containerBuilder =>
{
    containerBuilder.Populate(serviceCollection);
});

foreach (var serviceDescriptor in serviceCollection)
{
    builder.Services.Add(serviceDescriptor);
}

var app = builder.Build();

app.Lifetime.ApplicationStopping.Register(OnShutdown);
AutofacScope.SetGlobal(app.Services.GetAutofacRoot());
Config.Provider = new DbConfigProvider(AutofacScope.Global);

// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
app.UseCustomizedSwagger(builder.Configuration);

app.MapHealthChecks("/api/healthcheck");

app.UseMiddleware<ExceptionMiddleware>();


app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseRouting();

app.UseCors(allowSpecificOrigins);

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();

Log.LogInfo($"EnergiaMenedzsment Monitoring WebAPI - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(AuthenticateController))} started");
app.Run();


void ConfigureConfiguration(ConfigurationManager configuration)
{
    var cultureInfo = new CultureInfo("hu-HU");

    CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = cultureInfo;
    CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = cultureInfo;

    Log.Logger.UseSerilog(configuration);
    Config.LocalProvider ??= new DotNetCoreConfigProvider(configuration);
}

;

void ConfigureFluentValidation(FluentValidationMvcConfiguration fv)
{
    fv.RunDefaultMvcValidationAfterFluentValidationExecutes = false;
    fv.ValidatorOptions.LanguageManager.Culture = new CultureInfo("hu");
    fv.ImplicitlyValidateChildProperties = true;
    fv.ValidatorOptions.DisplayNameResolver = (_, member, _) => member?.GetAttribute<DisplayAttribute>()?.Name ?? member?.Name;
}

void OnShutdown()
{
    Log.LogInfo( $"EnergiaMenedzsment Monitoring WebAPI - v{AssemblyHelper.GetAssemblyInformationalVersion(typeof(AuthenticateController))} stopped");
}

using Autofac;
using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Security;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Shared.Queries;
using Common.WebAPI.Models;
using Common.WebAPI.Models.Response;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Services.FrameworkApi;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Commands;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.ListItems.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Alerts;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Alerts.Requests;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Annotations;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Controllers.Alerts;

[ApiController]
[Produces("application/json")]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[SwaggerResponse(StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, type: typeof(ProblemDetails))]
public class AlertsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IQueryService _queryService;

    private readonly ICommandService _commandService;

    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    private readonly ILifetimeScope _lifetimeScope;
    private readonly SyncService _syncService;
    private readonly SecurityContext _securityContext;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AlertsController"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="commandService">The command service.</param>
    /// <param name="queryService">The lifetime scope.</param>
    public AlertsController(
        ICommandService commandService,
        IQueryService queryService,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILifetimeScope lifetimeScope,
        SyncService syncService
        )
    {
        _commandService = commandService;
        _queryService = queryService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _lifetimeScope = lifetimeScope;
        _syncService = syncService;
        _securityContext = lifetimeScope.Resolve<SecurityContext>();
    }

    // POST: api/alerts/
    /// <summary>
    /// Create a new alert
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("", Name = "Post")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Alerts_Post")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<AlertModel>> Post(CreateAlertRequest request)
    {
        var createCommand = _mapper.Map<CreateAlertCommand>(request);
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(createCommand) as CreateAlertCommandResult;

        if (response == null || response.AlertEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<AlertModel>(response?.AlertEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/alerts/{alertId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Update an existing alert
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPut("{alertId}", Name = "Put")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Alerts_Put")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<AlertModel>> Put(ModifyAlertRequest request, [FromRoute] int alertId)
    {
        var modifyCommand = _mapper.Map<ModifyAlertCommand>(request);
        modifyCommand.AlertId = alertId;

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(modifyCommand) as ModifyAlertCommandResult;

        if (response == null || response.AlertEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<AlertModel>(response?.AlertEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    // DELETE: api/alerts/{alertId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Deleting a alert by id
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{alertId}", Name = "Delete")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Alerts_Delete")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(int alertId)
    {
        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(new DeleteAlertCommand
        {
            AlertId = alertId,
        }) as DeleteAlertCommandResult;

        if (response == null || !response.IsSuccess)
            return BadRequest(response);

        return Ok();
    }

    // GET: api/alerts/{alertId}
    /// <summary>
    /// Get alert by id
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet("{alertId}", Name = "Get")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Alerts_Get")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<AlertGetModel>> Get(int alertId)
    {
        if ((await _queryService.QuerySingleEntity(new AlertEntityQuery { Id = alertId, IsDeleted = false }))?.Entity is not AlertEntityDto alertEntityDto)
        {
            return NotFound("Alert");
        }

        var result = _mapper.Map<AlertGetModel>(alertEntityDto);

        string tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Tenant code is required.");
        var token = HttpContext.Request.Headers["Authorization"].FirstOrDefault()?.Split(" ").Last();
        var hierarchyFwApiResult = await _syncService.ListHierarchyByChannels(tenantCode, token, [result.ChannelIdentifier]);
        if (hierarchyFwApiResult != null) 
        {
            if (hierarchyFwApiResult.TryGetValue(result.ChannelIdentifier, out ChannelOrgunitHierarchyCommonModel model)) 
            {
                _mapper.Map(model, result);
            }
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// GET: api/Alerts
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet(Name = "GetAlertsList")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Alerts_GetAlertsList")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemQueryResult<AlertListItemDto>>> GetAlertsList([FromQuery] AlertDataTableRequest request)
    {
        var query = _mapper.Map<AlertPagedEntityQuery>(request); //lapozási paramétereket a mapping profile lekezeli
        var result = await _queryService.QueryPagedEntitiesAsync(query);
        //BUG: szerintem itt nincs lekezelve, hogy csak a saját riasztás definícióit listázhassa. mi számít sajátnak?


        //TODO: ideiglenesen a FW-be áthívva tudjuk lekérni a MeasurementPointName-t és a DataPointName-t, amíg nincs szinkronizálás
        //mérési pont neve
        //mért jellemző neve
        // channel alapján

        List<Guid> channelIds = result?.Items.Select(x => x.DataPointIdentifier).Where(x => x.HasValue).Select(x => x.Value).Distinct().ToList() ?? [];

        string tenantCode = _securityContext.CurrentUser.TenantCode ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Tenant code is required.");
        var token = HttpContext.Request.Headers["Authorization"].FirstOrDefault()?.Split(" ").Last();
        var hierarchyFwApiResult = await _syncService.ListHierarchyByChannels(tenantCode, token, channelIds);

        foreach (var item in result?.Items ?? [])
        {
            if (item.DataPointIdentifier.HasValue)
            {
                if (hierarchyFwApiResult.TryGetValue(item.DataPointIdentifier.Value, out var h))
                {
                    if (h is not null) //akkor lehetne null, ha nem létező guid-dal hívtunk át esetleg, ezért erre is kell ellenőrzés
                    {
                        //TODO: ezeket kell kigyűjteni?
                        item.MeasurementPointName = h.MeasurementPointName;
                        item.DataPointName = h.MeasuredPropertyName;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        //TODO: mit adjunk vissza, ha a FW API nem talált a guid alapján ilyeneket?
                        item.MeasurementPointName = "N/A";
                        item.DataPointName = "N/A";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    // PUT: api/alerts/activate-deactivate
    [HttpPut("{alertId}/activate-deactivate", Name = "AlertActivateDeactivate")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "Alerts_AlertActivateDeactivate")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AlertActivateDeactivate(int alertId, [FromQuery] bool isActive)
    {
        var command = new AlertActivateDeactivateCommand()
        {
            AlertId = alertId,
            IsActive = isActive
        };

        var response = await _commandService.ExecuteEntityCommand(command) as AlertActivateDeactivateCommandResult;

        if (response == null || response.AlertEntityDto == null)
            return BadRequest(response);

        var result = _mapper.Map<AlertModel>(response?.AlertEntityDto);
        return Ok(result);
    }
}

    /// <param name="edmInterfaceService">The EDM interface service.</param>
    /// <param name="mapper">The mapper.</param>
    /// <param name="pdfGenerator">The PDF generator.</param>
    public ConsumptionController(IQueryService queryService,
        IEdmInterfaceService edmInterfaceService,
        IMapper mapper,
        IPeakSubMeterConsumptionService peakSubMeterConsumptionService,
        IPeakMainMeterConsumptionService peakMainMeterConsumptionService,
        IPdfGenerator pdfGenerator, IAggregatedDataReportService aggregatedDataReportService)
    {
        _queryService = queryService;
        _edmInterfaceService = edmInterfaceService;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _peakSubMeterConsumptionService = peakSubMeterConsumptionService;
        _peakMainMeterConsumptionService = peakMainMeterConsumptionService;
        _pdfGenerator = pdfGenerator;
        _aggregatedDataReportService = aggregatedDataReportService;

    }

    {

            SpatialAggregation = request.SpatialAggregation,
            NeedProductionData = request.NeedProductionData,
            TenantCode = request.TenantCode

        return Ok(result);
    }

    #region Task #406 - Maradékfogyasztás - Exportálás xlsx
    //POST /api/consumption/dsodatatable/export
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost("dsodatatable/export", Name = nameof(GetDsoDataTableExport))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = nameof(GetDsoDataTableExport))]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDsoDataTableExport([FromBody] ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest request)
    {
        var query = _mapper.Map<ResidualConsumptionChartQuery>(request);
        var result = await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query) as ChartModelQueryResult;
        //TODO: coudn't test, because the query throws nullref exception because channels always null. bad test data???
        var chartModel = _mapper.Map<ChartModel>(result);

        List<ChartTableItemModel> items = ConvertChartModelToChartTableModel(chartModel).Items;

        var names = items
            .SelectMany(item => item.Values)
            .Select(value => value.MeasurementPointName)
            .Distinct()
            .ToArray();

        var measuredProperty = _queryService.GetById<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>(request.MeasuredPropertyId);

        var header = new MeasurementExcelExportHeader
        {
            MeasuredPropertyName = measuredProperty.MeasuredPropertyName ?? string.Empty,
            MeasurementUnit = chartModel.Unit,
        };

        var excelBytes = await ExcelExporthelpers.CreateExcelExportFileAsync(items, header);

        return File(excelBytes,
                    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
                    "measurements.xlsx");
    }
