    #region Task #407 - Maradékfogyasztás - Exportálás pdf
    //POST /api/consumption/dsodatatable/pdfexport
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost("dsodatatable/pdfexport", Name = nameof(GetDsoDataTablePdfExport))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = nameof(GetDsoDataTablePdfExport))]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDsoDataTablePdfExport([FromForm] ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest request, IFormFile imageForPdf)
    {
        var query = _mapper.Map<ResidualConsumptionChartQuery>(request);
        var result = await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query) as ChartModelQueryResult;
        //TODO: coudn't test, because the query throws nullref exception because channels always null. bad test data???
        var chartModel = _mapper.Map<ChartModel>(result);

        List<ChartTableItemModel> items = ConvertChartModelToChartTableModel(chartModel).Items;

        var names = items
            .SelectMany(item => item.Values)
            .Select(value => value.MeasurementPointName)
            .Distinct()
            .ToArray();

        var measuredProperty = _queryService.GetById<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>(request.MeasuredPropertyId);

        var header = new MeasurementExcelExportHeader
        {
            MeasuredPropertyName = measuredProperty.MeasuredPropertyName ?? string.Empty,
            MeasurementUnit = chartModel.Unit,
        };

        MeasurementExportRow[] exportData = ExcelExporthelpers.ConvertToMeasurementTableRowsWithDynamicGeneric<ChartTableItemModel, ChartTableItemValueModel>(items).ToArray();
        var pdfData = await ExcelManager.GetPDFData(exportData);

        var measurementPointNames = items.FirstOrDefault()?.Values
            ?.Select(value => value.MeasurementPointName)
            ?.Distinct()
            ?.ToArray() ?? Array.Empty<string>();

        //Set table header row
        if (pdfData != null && pdfData.Any())
        {
            var pdfHeader = new List<string> { "Mérés időpontja" }.Concat(measurementPointNames).ToList();
            _pdfGenerator.SetHeader(pdfHeader);
            pdfData.Remove(pdfData.First());
        }

        //Set table data rows
        foreach (var row in pdfData!)
            _pdfGenerator.AddRow(row);

        //Basic infos on first page
        DateTime fromDt = request.From.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue);
        DateTime toDt = request.To.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MaxValue);
        //TODO: header is correct?
        _pdfGenerator.SetMonitoringHeader(new Common.PDFGenerator.Models.PdfMonitoringHeaderModel()
        {
            MeasurementPointName = string.Join(",", measurementPointNames),
            MeasuredPropertyName = measuredProperty?.MeasuredPropertyName ?? string.Empty,
            MeasurementUnit = chartModel.Unit,
            From = fromDt.SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate(),
            To = toDt.GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay(), //TODO: check this, I have no ide what it expects
            Aggregation = request.Aggregation.GetDisplayName(),
        });

        //Set chart image if provided
        if (imageForPdf != null && imageForPdf.Length > 0)
            using (var ms = new MemoryStream())
            {
                imageForPdf.CopyTo(ms);
                var fileBytes = ms.ToArray();
                var base64 = Convert.ToBase64String(fileBytes);
                _pdfGenerator.SetChartImage("data:image/png;base64," + base64);
            }

        var pdfContent = await _pdfGenerator.GenerateAsync();

        if (pdfContent is null)
            return BadRequest("PDF content generation failed."); // Indicate an error instead of NoContent

        return File(pdfContent, "application/pdf", "converted.pdf");
    }


    #endregion

    /// <summary>
    /// Common method to handle PDF export for both main and sub-meters
    /// </summary>
    private async Task<IActionResult> CreateAggregatedConsumptionChartTableDataPdfExportFile(
        ConsumptionChartRequest request,
        IFormFile imageForPdf, bool isMainMeter)
    {
        var query = _mapper.Map<AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery>(request);
        query.IsBilling = isMainMeter;

        var queryResult = await _queryService.ExecuteQuery(query) as AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQueryResult;

        List<ChartTableItemModel> items = ConvertChartModelToChartTableModel(queryResult!.ChartModel).Items;

        MeasurementExportRow[] exportData = ExcelExporthelpers.ConvertToMeasurementTableRowsWithDynamicGeneric<ChartTableItemModel, ChartTableItemValueModel>(items).ToArray();

        var pdfData = await ExcelManager.GetPDFData(exportData);

        var measurementPointNames = items.FirstOrDefault()?.Values
            ?.Select(value => value.MeasurementPointName)
            ?.Distinct()
            ?.ToArray() ?? Array.Empty<string>();

        //Set table header row
        if (pdfData != null && pdfData.Any())
        {
            var header = new List<string> { "Mérés időpontja" }.Concat(measurementPointNames).ToList();
            _pdfGenerator.SetHeader(header);
            pdfData.Remove(pdfData.First());
        }

        //Set table data rows
        foreach (var row in pdfData!)
            _pdfGenerator.AddRow(row);

        var measuredProperty = _queryService.GetById<MeasuredPropertyEntityDto>(request.MeasuredPropertyId);

        //Basic infos on first page
        _pdfGenerator.SetMonitoringHeader(new Common.PDFGenerator.Models.PdfMonitoringHeaderModel()
        {
            MeasurementPointName = string.Join(",", measurementPointNames),
            MeasuredPropertyName = measuredProperty?.MeasuredPropertyName ?? string.Empty,
            MeasurementUnit = queryResult.ChartModel.Unit,
            From = request.From.SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate(),
            To = request.From == request.To ? request.To!.GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay() : request.To.SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate(),
            Aggregation = request.Aggregation.GetDisplayName(),
        });

        //Set chart image if provided
        if (imageForPdf != null && imageForPdf.Length > 0)
            using (var ms = new MemoryStream())
            {
                imageForPdf.CopyTo(ms);
                var fileBytes = ms.ToArray();
                var base64 = Convert.ToBase64String(fileBytes);
                _pdfGenerator.SetChartImage("data:image/png;base64," + base64);
            }

        var pdfContent = await _pdfGenerator.GenerateAsync();

        if (pdfContent is null)
            return BadRequest("PDF content generation failed."); // Indicate an error instead of NoContent

        return File(pdfContent, "application/pdf", "converted.pdf");
    }

    // GET: api/Consumption/ConsumptionDataTable/export
    /// <summary>
    /// Consumption adatok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [ApiExplorerSettings(IgnoreApi = true)]
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpGet("ConsumptionDataTable/export", Name = "ExportConsumptionDataTable")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "ExportConsumptionDataTable")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ExportConsumptionDataTable([FromQuery] NormalizedConsumptionDataTableRequest request)
    {
        var mappedRequest = _mapper.Map<NormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery>(request);
        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntities(mappedRequest) as IEntityQueryItemsResult<NormalizedConsumptionListItemDto>;

        // TODO request bővítés (ExportMonitoringBasicDataModel)
        var dataModel = new ExportMonitoringHeaderModel()
        {
            MeasurementPointName = "",
            From = request.From.SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate(),
            To = request.From == request.To ? request.To!.Value.GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay() : request.To.SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate(),
            Aggregation = request.Aggregation?.GetDisplayName(),
        };

        var export = await ExcelManager.Export(result?.Items, exportDataModel: dataModel);

        return File(export, "application/octet-stream");
    }

    // GET: api/Consumption/ConsumptionDataTable/pdfexport
    /// <summary>
    /// IoT adatok lekérdezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <param name="imageForPdf">The image for PDF.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [ApiExplorerSettings(IgnoreApi = true)]
    [HttpPost("ConsumptionDataTable/pdfexport", Name = "ExportToPdfConsumptionDataTable")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "ExportToPdfConsumptionDataTable")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ExportToPdfConsumptionTable([FromQuery] NormalizedConsumptionDataTableRequest request, IFormFile imageForPdf)
    {
        var mappedRequest = _mapper.Map<NormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery>(request);
        var result = await _queryService.QueryEntities(mappedRequest) as IEntityQueryItemsResult<NormalizedConsumptionListItemDto>;

        var pdfData = await ExcelManager.GetPDFData(result.Items);

        if (pdfData != null && pdfData.Any())
        {
            _pdfGenerator.SetHeader(pdfData.FirstOrDefault());
            pdfData.Remove(pdfData.FirstOrDefault());
        }

        foreach (var row in pdfData)
            _pdfGenerator.AddRow(row);

        _pdfGenerator.SetMonitoringHeader(new Common.PDFGenerator.Models.PdfMonitoringHeaderModel()
        {
            MeasurementPointName = "",
            From = request.From.SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate(),
            To = request.From == request.To ? request.To!.Value.GetUTCFromHungarianLocalTimeEndOfDay() : request.To.SetDateTimeTakingIntoCurrentdate(),
            Aggregation = request.Aggregation?.GetDisplayName(),
        });


        if (imageForPdf != null && imageForPdf.Length > 0)
            using (var ms = new MemoryStream())
            {
                imageForPdf.CopyTo(ms);
                var fileBytes = ms.ToArray();
                var base64 = Convert.ToBase64String(fileBytes);
                _pdfGenerator.SetChartImage("data:image/png;base64," + base64);
            }

        var pdfContent = await _pdfGenerator.GenerateAsync();

        if (pdfContent is null)
            return BadRequest("PDF content generation failed."); // Indicate an error instead of NoContent

        return File(pdfContent, "application/pdf", "converted.pdf");
    }

    private static List<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel> ApplyDevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder(DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder listOrder, List<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel> items)
    {
        return listOrder switch
        {
            DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder.TopologyThenDevice => items.OrderBy(r => r.TopologyData)
                                                                       .ThenBy(r => r.DeviceData)
                                                                       .ToList(),
            DevicesAggregatedDataSortOrder.DeviceThenTopology => items.OrderBy(r => r.DeviceData)
                                                                               .ThenBy(r => r.TopologyData)
                                                                               .ToList(),
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"Sort order '{listOrder}' is not supported.")
        };
    }

    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost(nameof(GetDevicesAggregatedDataExcelExport), Name = nameof(GetDevicesAggregatedDataExcelExport))]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = nameof(GetDevicesAggregatedDataExcelExport))]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDevicesAggregatedDataExcelExport([FromBody] DevicesAggregatedDataTableRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var excelExtraHeader = new DevicesAggregatedDataExportHeader { AggregationYesterday = request.AggregationYesterday, AggregationLast7Days = request.AggregationLast7Days };

            var reportData = await _aggregatedDataReportService.GetAggregatedDataReportDataItems(request);          
            var baseTableExcelItems = reportData.Select(x => _mapper.Map<DevicesAggregatedDataBaseTableExportRow>(x));

            var summaryTableReportData = await _aggregatedDataReportService.GetSummaryTableData(request);
            var summaryTableExcelItems = summaryTableReportData.Select(x => _mapper.Map<DevicesAggregatedDataSummaryTableExportRow>(x)).ToList();

            var multiSheetExcelBytes = await ExcelManager.GetAggregatedDataReportExcel(baseTableExcelItems, summaryTableExcelItems, excelExtraHeader);


            return File(multiSheetExcelBytes,
                    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
                    "devices_aggregated_data.xlsx");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = ex.Message });
        }     
    }

    // GET: api/consumption/edm-measurements
    /// <summary>
    /// Mérő és inverter mérési adatok lekérdezése ENAP IF
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpGet("edm-measurements", Name = "GetEDMMeasurements")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "GetEDMMeasurements")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EDMMeasurementsQueryResult?>> GetEDMMeasurements([FromQuery] EDMMeasurementsRequest request)
    {
        if (request.FromDate.HasValue && request.ToDate.HasValue && request.FromDate > request.ToDate)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = "A kezdő dátum nem lehet későbbi, mint a záró dátum!" });
        }

        try
        {
            //var response = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurements(request.DataChannelId, request.FromDate.ToDateOnly(), request.ToDate.ToDateOnly(), request.ForceRefresh); OBSOLETE
            var requestId = await _edmInterfaceService.RequestMeasurements(request.DataChannelId, request.FromDate.ToDateOnly(), request.ToDate.ToDateOnly(), request.ForceRefresh, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            var response = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurementResults(requestId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

            if (response is null)
            {
                return NotFound(null); //TODO: mit adjunk vissza, ha null?
                //return Ok(new EDMMeasurementsQueryResult()); //empty response?
            }

            var dataChannels = response.Where(x => x.DataChannelId == request.DataChannelId).ToList();
            if (dataChannels.Count == 0)
            {
                return Ok(new EDMMeasurementsQueryResult()); //empty response
            }

            return Ok(new EDMMeasurementsQueryResult
            {
                Values = dataChannels.SelectMany(dc => dc.Measurements.Select(m => m.Value)).ToList(),
                MeasurementDates = dataChannels.SelectMany(dc => dc.Measurements.Select(m => m.MeasurementDate)).OrderBy(x => x).ToList(),
            });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    // GET: api/consumption/edm-measurements-table
    /// <summary>
    /// EDM mérési adatok táblázatos lekérésének kezdeményezése
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">A lekérési kérés paraméterei</param>
    /// <returns>A lekérés azonosítója</returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpGet("edm-measurements-table-request", Name = "RequestEDMMeasurementsTable")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "RequestEDMMeasurementsTable")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<Guid>> RequestEDMMeasurementsTable([FromQuery] EDMMeasurementsDataTableRequest request)
    {
        if (request.FromDate.HasValue && request.ToDate.HasValue && request.FromDate > request.ToDate)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = "A kezdő dátum nem lehet későbbi, mint a záró dátum!" });
        }

        try
        {
            var requestId = await _edmInterfaceService.RequestMeasurementsTable(
                request.DataChannelId,
                request.FromDate.ToDateOnly(),
                request.ToDate.ToDateOnly(),
                request.ForceRefresh);
            return Ok(requestId);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    // GET: api/consumption/edm-measurements-table/{requestId}
    /// <summary>
    /// EDM mérési adatok táblázatos lekérése a kérés azonosító alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="requestId">A lekérés azonosítója</param>
    /// <param name="request">A táblázatos megjelenítés paraméterei</param>
    /// <returns>Mérési adatok listája lapozható formában</returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpGet("edm-measurements-table/{requestId}", Name = "GetEDMMeasurementTableResults")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "GetEDMMeasurementTableResults")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<EntityListItemPlainQueryResult<MeasurementModel>>> GetEDMMeasurementTableResults(
        Guid requestId,
        [FromQuery] EDMMeasurementsDataTableRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurementTableResults(requestId);

            if (response is null)
            {
                return NotFound(null);
            }

            int pageSize = request.PageSize ?? 10;
            var firstItem = request.StartPage * pageSize;

            var listItemQueryResult = new EntityListItemPlainQueryResult<MeasurementModel>();
            var flattenedArray = response.Where(x => x.DataChannelId == request.DataChannelId)
                                       .SelectMany(m => m.Measurements
                                            .Select(measurement => new MeasurementModel
                                            {
                                                MeasurementDate = measurement.MeasurementDate,
                                                Value = measurement.Value
                                            }))
                                       .ToArray();

            listItemQueryResult.RecordsTotal = flattenedArray.Length;

            if (request.SortDirection == SortDirection.Descending)
            {
                flattenedArray = flattenedArray.OrderByDescending(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToArray();
            }
            else
            {
                flattenedArray = flattenedArray.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToArray();
            }

            var listItems = flattenedArray.Skip(firstItem).Take(pageSize).ToArray();

            listItemQueryResult.Items = listItems;

            return Ok(listItemQueryResult);
        }
        catch (EnergiaMenedzsmentBusinessLogicException ex)
        {
            return NotFound(ex.Message);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    // GET: api/consumption/edm-measurements-table
    /// <summary>
    /// EDM mérési adatok táblázatos lekérdezése (elavult)
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">A lekérési kérés paraméterei</param>

    {

        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = "A kezdő dátum nem lehet későbbi, mint a záró dátum!" });
        }

        try
        {
            //var response = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurements(request.DataChannelId, request.FromDate.ToDateOnly(), request.ToDate.ToDateOnly(), request.ForceRefresh); OBSOLETE
            var requestId = await _edmInterfaceService.RequestMeasurements(request.DataChannelId, request.FromDate.ToDateOnly(), request.ToDate.ToDateOnly(), request.ForceRefresh, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            var response = await _edmInterfaceService.GetMeasurementResults(requestId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

            if (response is null)
            {
                return NotFound(null);
            }

            int pageSize = request.PageSize ?? 10;
            var firstItem = request.StartPage * pageSize;

            var listItemQueryResult = new EntityListItemPlainQueryResult<MeasurementModel>();
            var flattenedArray = response.Where(x => x.DataChannelId == request.DataChannelId)
                                       .SelectMany(m => m.Measurements
                                            .Select(measurement => new MeasurementModel
                                            {
                                                MeasurementDate = measurement.MeasurementDate,
                                                Value = measurement.Value
                                            }))
                                       .ToArray();

            listItemQueryResult.RecordsTotal = flattenedArray.Length;

            if (request.SortDirection == SortDirection.Descending)
            {
                flattenedArray = flattenedArray.OrderByDescending(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToArray();
            }
            else
            {
                flattenedArray = flattenedArray.OrderBy(x => x.MeasurementDate).ToArray();
            }

            var listItems = flattenedArray.Skip(firstItem).Take(pageSize).ToArray();

            listItemQueryResult.Items = listItems;
            return Ok(listItemQueryResult);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    #endregion


    #region Almérő csúcsérték

    // POST: api/Consumption/ActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels/
    /// <summary>
    /// Aktuális havi csúcsértékek lekérdezése channel lista alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost("ActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels", Name = "ActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "ActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IList<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel>>> ActualMonthlySubMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels([FromBody] List<Guid> channelIdentifiers)
    {
        if (channelIdentifiers is null || channelIdentifiers.Count == 0)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = "Empty Channel identifiers" });
        }

        DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        DateTime from = PeakCalculationHelpers.GetIntervalSart(now, PeakType.Monthly);
        DateTime to = PeakCalculationHelpers.GetIntervalEnd(now, PeakType.Monthly);

        List<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel> result = [];
        /*foreach (var channelId in channelIdentifiers) a foreach helyett egy tömeges query-t küldünk
        {
            var dto = (await _peakSubMeterConsumptionService.GetPeakSubMeterConsumptionsAsync(channelId, PeakType.Monthly, from, to))
                .SingleOrDefault(); //mert egy konkrét hónapot kérünk le, így egy adott channel-hez csak egy rekord tartozik
            result.Add(_mapper.Map<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel>(dto));
        }*/

        var dtoGrp = (await _peakSubMeterConsumptionService.GetPeakSubMeterConsumptionsByChannelListAsync(channelIdentifiers, PeakType.Monthly, from, to))
            .GroupBy(x => x.ChannelIdentifier);
        foreach (var grp in dtoGrp)
        {
            var dto = grp.SingleOrDefault();  //mert egy konkrét hónapot kérünk le, így egy adott channel-hez csak egy rekord tartozik.
            //TODO: ha mégsem, az baj... majd le kell kezelni.
            result.Add(_mapper.Map<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel>(dto));
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    #region Főmérő csúcsérték


    // POST: api/Consumption/ActualMonthlyMainMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels/
    /// <summary>
    /// Aktuális havi csúcsértékek lekérdezése channel lista alapján
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The request.</param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [EnableCors("corsapp")]
    [HttpPost("ActualMonthlyMainMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels", Name = "ActualMonthlyMainMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ErrorResponse), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(NotFoundResponse), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [SwaggerOperation(OperationId = "ActualMonthlyMainMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IList<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel>>> ActualMonthlyMainMeterPeakConsumptionsByChannels([FromBody] List<int> channelIds)
    {
        if (channelIds is null || channelIds.Count == 0)
        {
            return BadRequest(new ErrorResponse { Error = "Empty Channel Ids" });
        }

        DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        DateTime from = PeakCalculationHelpers.GetIntervalSart(now, PeakType.Monthly);
        DateTime to = PeakCalculationHelpers.GetIntervalEnd(now, PeakType.Monthly);

        List<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel> result = [];

        var dtoGrp = (await _peakMainMeterConsumptionService.GetPeakMainMeterConsumptionsByChannelListAsync(channelIds, PeakType.Monthly, from, to))
            .GroupBy(x => x.ChannelIdentifier);
        foreach (var grp in dtoGrp)
        {
            var dto = grp.SingleOrDefault();  //mert egy konkrét hónapot kérünk le, így egy adott channel-hez csak egy rekord tartozik.
            //TODO: ha mégsem, az baj... majd le kell kezelni.
            result.Add(_mapper.Map<MonthlyPeakConsumptionModel>(dto));
        }

        return Ok(result);
    }

    #endregion

    #region private helpers



    private static ChartTableModel ConvertChartModelToChartTableModel(ChartModel chartModel, ConsumptionChartRequest? request = null)
    {
        var chartTableModel = new ChartTableModel();

        for (var i = 0; i < chartModel.XAxisValues.Count; i++)
        {
            var rawDateTime = chartModel.XAxisValues[i];

            var parsedDateTime = DateTime.Parse(rawDateTime, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            var values = new List<ChartTableItemValueModel>();

            foreach (var item in chartModel.Items)
            {
                values.Add(new ChartTableItemValueModel
                {
                    MeasurementPointId = 0, //TODO nem is biztos, hogy kell ez ide
                    MeasurementPointName = item.Name,
                    Value = item.Datas[i] ?? 0m,
                });
            }

            chartTableModel.Items.Add(new ChartTableItemModel
            {
                DateTime = parsedDateTime,
                Values = values
            });
        }

        if (request != null)
        {
            chartTableModel.RecordsTotal = chartTableModel.Items.Count();
            //apply paging in memory if needed
            chartTableModel.Items = chartTableModel.Items
                .Skip(request.PageSize * request.PageIndex)
                .Take(request.PageSize)
                .ToList();
        }

        return chartTableModel;
    }



    #endregion


}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Shared.Types;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.FrameworkApi;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Commands;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.ListItems.Alert;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Alerts;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Alerts.Requests;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Mappings.Alert;

public class AlertMappings : Profile
{
    public AlertMappings()
    {
        #region Alert mappings:

        ////CreateMap<AlertEntityDto, AlertListItemDto>(); backend handles

        CreateMap<AlertDataTableRequest, AlertPagedEntityQuery>()
            //initialize pagination and sorting
            .ForMember(dest => dest.PagingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = src == null ? 10 : src.PageSize,
                StartPage = src == null ? 0 : src.StartPage
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SortingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = src.SortColumn == null ? nameof(AlertListItemDto.Name) : src.SortColumn, //TODO:  listázza ki a riasztások egyes mezőit az utolsó módosítás időpontja alapján -> de nincs a dto-n ilyen
                SortDirection = src == null ? SortDirection.Ascending : src.SortDirection
            }));

        CreateMap<CreateAlertRequest, CreateAlertCommand>();
        CreateMap<ModifyAlertRequest, ModifyAlertCommand>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.AlertId, opt => opt.Ignore());

        CreateMap<AlertEntityDto, AlertModel>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ChannelIdentifier, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.DataPointIdentifier))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SubscribedUsers, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.SubscribedUsers.Select(x => x.Id)));

        CreateMap<ChannelOrgunitHierarchyCommonModel, AlertGetModel>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ChannelIdentifier, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Operator, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.DataType, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Threshold, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Name, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Description, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.AlertText, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ValidFromUtc, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ValidToUtc, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SubscribedUsers, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ExternalEmailAddresses, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.IsActive, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.AlertIdentifier, opt => opt.Ignore())
            .ForMember(dest => dest.ModifiedBy, opt => opt.Ignore());

        CreateMap<AlertEntityDto, AlertGetModel>()
           .ForMember(dest => dest.ChannelIdentifier, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.DataPointIdentifier))
           .ForMember(dest => dest.SubscribedUsers, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.SubscribedUsers.Select(x => x.Id)))
           .ForMember(dest => dest.InstitutionId, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.InstitutionName, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.SiteId, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.SiteName, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.BuildingId, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.BuildingName, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.BuildingPartId, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.BuildingPartName, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.FloorId, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.FloorName, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.RoomId, opt => opt.Ignore())
           .ForMember(dest => dest.RoomName, opt => opt.Ignore())

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Shared.Types;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Chart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Queries.Chart;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Mappings.Consumption;

/// <summary>
/// Consumption mappings
/// </summary>
public class ConsumptionMappings : Profile
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ConsumptionMappings"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public ConsumptionMappings()
    {
        CreateMap<NormalizedConsumptionDataTableRequest, NormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery>()
            //initialize pagination and sorting
            .ForMember(dest => dest.PagingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = src == null ? 10 : src.PageSize,
                StartPage = src == null ? 0 : src.StartPage
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SortingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = src.SortColumn == null ? nameof(NormalizedConsumptionListItemDto.MeasuredAtUtc) : src.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = src == null ? SortDirection.Ascending : src.SortDirection
            }));

        CreateMap<EdmNormalizedConsumptionDataTableRequest, EdmNormalizedConsumptionPagedEntityQuery>()
            //initialize pagination and sorting
            .ForMember(dest => dest.PagingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = src == null ? 10 : src.PageSize,
                StartPage = src == null ? 0 : src.StartPage
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SortingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = src == null ? nameof(EdmNormalizedConsumptionListItemDto.MeasuredAtUtc) : src.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = src == null ? SortDirection.Ascending : src.SortDirection
            }));

        CreateMap<NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto, NormalizedConsumptionListItemDto>();

        CreateMap<ResidualConsumptionRequest, ResidualConsumptionChartQuery>();
        CreateMap<ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest, ResidualConsumptionChartQuery>();
        
        CreateMap<
                ChartModelQueryResult, ChartModel>()
            .ReverseMap();

        CreateMap<ConsumptionChartRequest, AggregatedConsumptionChartDataQuery>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.From, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => ConvertUtcToLocalDate(src.From)))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.To, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => ConvertUtcToLocalDate(src.To)))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.IsBilling, opt => opt.Ignore());

        CreateMap<ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest, ResidualConsumptionPagedEntityQuery>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.PagingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = src == null ? 10 : src.PageSize,
                StartPage = src == null ? 0 : src.StartPage
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SortingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = src == null ? nameof(EdmNormalizedConsumptionListItemDto.MeasuredAtUtc) : src.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = src == null ? SortDirection.Ascending : src.SortDirection
            }));

        CreateMap<ResidualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequest, ResidualConsumptionSummaryPagedEntityQuery>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.PagingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new PagingInfo
            {
                PageSize = src == null ? 10 : src.PageSize,
                StartPage = src == null ? 0 : src.StartPage
            }))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SortingInfo, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => new SortingInfo
            {
                SortColumn = src == null ? nameof(EdmNormalizedConsumptionListItemDto.MeasuredAtUtc) : src.SortColumn,
                SortDirection = src == null ? SortDirection.Ascending : src.SortDirection
            }));;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Converts a UTC DateTime to a local date and time in the server's timezone.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="utcDateTime">The UTC DateTime to convert</param>
    /// <returns>A DateTime representing the datetime in the server's local timezone</returns>
    private static DateTime ConvertUtcToLocalDate(DateTime utcDateTime)
    {
        if (utcDateTime.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc)
        {
            var localDateTime = utcDateTime.ToLocalTime();
            return localDateTime;
        }
        
        if (utcDateTime.Kind == DateTimeKind.Unspecified)
        {
            var utcSpecified = DateTime.SpecifyKind(utcDateTime, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            var localDateTime = utcSpecified.ToLocalTime();
            return localDateTime;
        }
        
        return utcDateTime;
    }
}

using AutoMapper;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Export;

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Mappings.Consumption;

public class DevicesAggregatedDataExportMappings:Profile
{
    public DevicesAggregatedDataExportMappings() 
    {
        CreateMap<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel, DevicesAggregatedDataBaseTableExportRow>()
        //// Topology data
        .ForMember(dst => dst.InstitutionName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.InstitutionName))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.SiteName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.SiteName))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.BuildingName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.BuildingName))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.BuildingPartName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.BuildingPartName))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.FloorName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.FloorName))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.RoomName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.RoomName))
        //// Device data
        .ForMember(dst => dst.DeviceCategoryName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.DeviceData.DeviceCategoryName))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.DeviceTypeName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.DeviceData.DeviceTypeName))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.AggregationMethod, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.DeviceData.AggregationMethod))
        //// Measurement point data
        .ForMember(dst => dst.Identifier, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.MeasurementPointData.Identifier))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.MeasurementPointName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.MeasurementPointData.Name))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.MeasuredProperty, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.MeasurementPointData.MeasuredProperty))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.Technology, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.MeasurementPointData.Technology))
        //// Units
        .ForMember(dst => dst.UnitOfMeasure, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.UnitOfMeasure??string.Empty))
        //// Today's data
        .ForMember(dst => dst.LastMeasuredValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TodaysData.LastMeasuredValue))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.TodaysAggregatedValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TodaysData.AggregatedValue))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.TodaysMinValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TodaysData.MinValue))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.TodaysMaxValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TodaysData.MaxValue))
        // Yesterday's data (optional)
        .ForMember(dst => dst.YesterdaysAggregatedValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.LastDaysData != null ? src.LastDaysData.AggregatedValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.YesterdaysMinValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.LastDaysData != null ? src.LastDaysData.MinValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.YesterdaysMaxValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.LastDaysData != null ? src.LastDaysData.MaxValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.YesterdaysAverageValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.LastDaysData != null ? src.LastDaysData.AverageValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty))
        // Last 7 days data (optional)
        .ForMember(dst => dst.Last7DaysAggregatedValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Last7DaysData != null ? src.Last7DaysData.AggregatedValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.Last7DaysMinValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Last7DaysData != null ? src.Last7DaysData.MinValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.Last7DaysMaxValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Last7DaysData != null ? src.Last7DaysData.MaxValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty))
        .ForMember(dst => dst.Last7DaysAverageValue, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Last7DaysData != null ? src.Last7DaysData.AverageValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty));
        ;

        CreateMap<SummaryTableDatatModel, DevicesAggregatedDataSummaryTableExportRow>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.InstitutionName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.InstitutionName))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.SiteName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.SiteName))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.BuildingName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.BuildingName))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.BuildingPartName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.BuildingPartName))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.FloorName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.FloorName))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.RoomName, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TopologyData.RoomName))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Items, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.DetailDatatModels.Select(detail => new DevicesAggregatedDataSummaryTableExportRowListItem
            {
                // Device data
                DeviceCategoryName = detail.DeviceCategory,
                DeviceTypeName = detail.DeviceType,
                AggregationMethod = detail.AggregationMethod.GetDisplayName()?? detail.AggregationMethod.ToString(),

                // Measurement point data
                MeasuredProperty = detail.MeasuredProperty,

                // Units (ez az adat hiányozhat a SummaryTableDetailDatatModel-ből, ha igen, akkor pótolni kell)
                UnitOfMeasure = string.Empty, // Itt lehet, hogy kiegészítésre van szükség

                // Today's data
                LastMeasuredValue = detail.TodaysData!=null?detail.TodaysData.LastMeasuredValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,
                TodaysAggregatedValue = detail.TodaysData != null ? detail.TodaysData.AggregatedValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,
                TodaysMinValue = detail.TodaysData != null ? detail.TodaysData.MinValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,
                TodaysMaxValue = detail.TodaysData != null ? detail.TodaysData.MaxValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,

                // Yesterday's data (optional)
                YesterdaysAggregatedValue = detail.LastDaysData != null ? detail.LastDaysData.AggregatedValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,
                YesterdaysMinValue = detail.LastDaysData != null ? detail.LastDaysData.MinValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,
                YesterdaysMaxValue = detail.LastDaysData != null ? detail.LastDaysData.MaxValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,
                YesterdaysAverageValue = detail.LastDaysData != null ? detail.LastDaysData.AverageValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,

                // Last 7 days data (optional)
                Last7DaysAggregatedValue = detail.Last7DaysData != null ? detail.Last7DaysData.AggregatedValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,
                Last7DaysMinValue = detail.Last7DaysData != null ? detail.Last7DaysData.MinValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,
                Last7DaysMaxValue = detail.Last7DaysData != null ? detail.Last7DaysData.MaxValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty,
                Last7DaysAverageValue = detail.Last7DaysData != null ? detail.Last7DaysData.AverageValue ?? string.Empty : string.Empty


            }).ToList()));



        CreateMap<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel, SummaryTableDetailDatatModel>()
            .ForMember(dest => dest.DeviceCategory, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.DeviceData.DeviceCategoryName))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.DeviceType, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.DeviceData.DeviceTypeName))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.AggregationMethod, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => MapAggregationMethodFromString(src.DeviceData.AggregationMethod)))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.MeasuredProperty, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.MeasurementPointData.MeasuredProperty))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.TodaysData, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TodaysData))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.LastDaysData, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.LastDaysData))
            .ForMember(dest => dest.Last7DaysData, opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Last7DaysData));


        CreateMap<DevicesAggregatedDataResultModel, SummaryTableDatatModel>()
            .ConvertUsing((src, dst, ctx) =>
            {

                //// Csoportosítás topológia adatok alapján (feltételezve, hogy minden elem ugyanabba a topológiába tartozik)
                //var firstItem = src.First();

                var result = new SummaryTableDatatModel
                {
                    TopologyData = src.TopologyData,
                    DetailDatatModels = new List<SummaryTableDetailDatatModel>()
                    {   
                        new SummaryTableDetailDatatModel
                        {
                            DeviceCategory = src.DeviceData.DeviceCategoryName,
                            DeviceType = src.DeviceData.DeviceTypeName,
                            AggregationMethod = MapAggregationMethodFromString(src.DeviceData.AggregationMethod),
                            MeasuredProperty = src.MeasurementPointData.MeasuredProperty,
                            TodaysData = src.TodaysData,
                            LastDaysData = src.LastDaysData,
                            Last7DaysData = src.Last7DaysData 
                        }
                    }
                };        

                return result;
            });    

    }


    private static EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationMethod MapAggregationMethodFromString(string aggregationMethodStr)
    {

        if (Enum.TryParse<EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationMethod>(aggregationMethodStr, true, out var result))
        {
            return result;
        }

        return EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationMethod.Undefined;
    }

}

using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Alerts.Requests;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Alerts.Validators;

/// <summary>
/// CreateAlertRequestValidator
/// </summary>
public class CreateAlertRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<CreateAlertRequest>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="CreateAlertRequestValidator"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    public CreateAlertRequestValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(t => t.ValidToUtc).Must((request, validTo) => !validTo.HasValue || validTo > request.ValidFromUtc)
                                  .WithMessage("Az érvényesség vége nem lehet korábbi, mint az érvényesség kezdete!");

        RuleFor(t => t.SubscribedUsers).Must((request, users) => users.Count > 0 || request.ExternalEmailAddresses.Count > 0)
                                       .WithMessage("Legalább egy felhasználót vagy egy külsős email címet meg kell adni!");
    }
}

using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Models.Chart;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Models;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Consumption;

/// <summary>
/// ConsumptionChartRequest
/// </summary>
public class ConsumptionChartRequest
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Topológia elem illetve mérési pont lista
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public List<OrgUnitSelection> OrgUnitSelections { get; set; } = [];

    /// <summary>
    /// Mért jellemző azonosító
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public int MeasuredPropertyId { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Aggregált időtartomány kezdete
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public DateTime From { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Aggregált időtartomány vége
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public DateTime To { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Aggregáció szintje
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]
    public AggregationLevel Aggregation { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Aktuális lap indexe
    /// </summary>
    [DataMember]

using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Consumption.Validators;

public class ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequestValidator : BaseDtoValidator<ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest>
{
    public ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequestValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.From)
            .LessThan(DateTime.Now.Date.ToDateOnly())
            .WithMessage("A \"Kezdete\" dátum csak lezárt (múltbeli) napra vonatkozhat!");
        
        RuleFor(x => x.To)
            .LessThan(DateTime.Now.Date.ToDateOnly())
            .WithMessage("A \"Vége\" dátum csak lezárt (múltbeli) napra vonatkozhat!");

        RuleFor(x => x.From)
            .LessThan(x => x.To)
            .WithMessage("A \"Kezdete\" dátum nem lehet későbbi, mint a \"Vége\" dátum!");
    }
}

using Autofac;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using Common.Logic.Services;
using Common.Logic.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.DataAccess;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Services;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Alerts.Requests;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Alerts.Validators;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Models.Consumption.Validators;
using FluentValidation;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI.Wireup;

/// <summary>
/// AutofacFrontEndModule
/// </summary>
/// <seealso cref="Autofac.Module" />
public class AutofacFrontEndModule : Module
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Override to add registrations to the container.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="builder">The builder through which components can be
    /// registered.</param>
    /// <remarks>
    /// Note that the ContainerBuilder parameter is unique to this module.
    /// </remarks>
    protected override void Load(ContainerBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.RegisterType<QueryServiceServer>().As<IQueryService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<CommandServiceServer>().As<ICommandService>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder
            .RegisterType<DbContext>()
            .As<IDbContext>()
            .InstancePerLifetimeScope();

        builder.RegisterType<CreateAlertRequestValidator>().As<IValidator<CreateAlertRequest>>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<ModifyAlertRequestValidator>().As<IValidator<ModifyAlertRequest>>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        
        builder.RegisterType<ResidualConsumptionRequestValidator>().As<IValidator<ResidualConsumptionRequest>>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequestValidator>().As<IValidator<ResidualConsumptionDataTableRequest>>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
        builder.RegisterType<ResidualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequestValidator>().As<IValidator<ResidualConsumptionSummaryDataTableRequest>>().InstancePerLifetimeScope();
    }
}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Monitoring\Test\EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Logic.UnitTests\DataGenerator.cs
====================================================================================================

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Consumption;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;

namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Logic.UnitTests;

public static class DataGenerator
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Generate test data for the given days, ending with today.
    /// </summary>
    public static List<NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto> Generate(int days, double minValue, double maxValue)
    {
        DateTime startMoment = DateTime.UtcNow.Date.AddDays(-days);
        List<NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto> data = [];
        Guid id = Guid.NewGuid();

        //creating all time slices between the startDay and now.
        List<DateTime> fifteenMinuteStarts = [];
        for (DateTime time = startMoment; time <= DateTime.UtcNow; time = time.AddMinutes(15))
        {
            fifteenMinuteStarts.Add(time);
        }

        foreach (var interval in fifteenMinuteStarts)
        {
            var dto = new NormalizedConsumptionEntityDto
            {
                ChannelIdentifier = id,
                AggregationLevel = Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData.AggregationLevel.FifteenMinutes,
                LastModified = DateTime.UtcNow,
                DataQuality = GetRandomDataQuality(66),
                Value = GetRandomValue(minValue, maxValue),
                MeasuredAtUtc = interval,
                Co2eValue = 0, //most nem érdekes
            };
            data.Add(dto);
        }

        return data;
    }

    public static DataQuality GetRandomDataQuality(int percentValid = 66)
    {
        if (percentValid < 0 || percentValid > 100)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(percentValid), "Percent must be between 0 and 100.");
        }
        if (percentValid == 100)
        {
            return DataQuality.Valid;
        }

        var values = Enum.GetValues<DataQuality>();
        var randomValue = Random.Shared.Next(0, 100);
        if (randomValue < percentValid)
        {
            return DataQuality.Valid;
        }
        else
        {
            return values[Random.Shared.Next(values.Length)];
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generate a random value between the specified min and max.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="min">The minimum value. (inclusive)</param>
    /// <param name="max">The maximum value. (exclusive)</param>
    /// <returns>A random double value between min and max.</returns>
    public static double GetRandomValue(double min, double max)
    {
        if (min >= max)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Min must be less than max.");
        }
        return Math.Round(Random.Shared.NextDouble() * (max - min) + min, 10);
    }

}

📄 FILE: Source\Server\Modules\Monitoring\Test\EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Logic.UnitTests\PeakCalculationTests.cs
====================================================================================================

using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums.IoTData;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.BackEnd.Helpers.PeakCalculation;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Shared.Entities.Consumption;
using Xunit;


namespace EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.Logic.UnitTests;

public class PeakCalculationTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void CanGenerateTestData()
    {
        // Arrange
        int days = 45;
        double minValue = 0.0d;
        double maxValue = 5000d;

        // Act
        var result = DataGenerator.Generate(days, minValue, maxValue);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.True(result.Count > 96 * days); // 96 intervals in a day  today has some extra intervals too
        Assert.All(result, dto => Assert.InRange(dto.Value.Value, minValue, maxValue)); //fails if Value is null, but should not happen on normalized data
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CanCalculateDailyPeak()
    {
        // Arrange
        int days = 45;
        double minValue = 0.0d;
        double maxValue = 5000d;
        var data = DataGenerator.Generate(days, minValue, maxValue);
        var currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
        DateTime intervalStart = data.OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).First().MeasuredAtUtc.Date; // Start from the first date in the data
        Guid channelId = data.First().ChannelIdentifier; // Use the first channel ID from the data

        // Act
        var dailyPeaks = PeakCalculationHelpers.GenerateEmptyIntervalsByType<PeakSubMeterConsumptionEntityDto>(intervalStart, currentDate, PeakType.Daily);
        PeakCalculationHelpers.CalculateSubMeterPeaksForChannelAndPeakType(data, dailyPeaks, channelId, PeakType.Daily);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(dailyPeaks);
        Assert.True(dailyPeaks.Count > 0);
        Assert.All(dailyPeaks, peak => 
        {
            Assert.Equal(PeakType.Daily, peak.PeakType);
            Assert.Equal(channelId, peak.ChannelIdentifier);
            Assert.True(peak.PeakValue >= (decimal)minValue); //inclusive
            Assert.True(peak.PeakValue < (decimal)maxValue); //exclusive
            //Assert.NotEqual(DataQuality.Unknown, peak.DataQuality);
        });

        // Assert that the peak values are calculated correctly
        // For example, you can check if the peak value is the maximum value for that day
        foreach (var peak in dailyPeaks)
        {
            var dailyData = data.Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc.Date == peak.PeriodStart.Date && x.ChannelIdentifier == channelId);
            var expectedPeakValue = dailyData.Max(x => x.Value);
            Assert.Equal(expectedPeakValue, (double)peak.PeakValue);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CanCalculateMonthlyPeak()
    {
        // Arrange

    [Fact]
    public void CanCalculateDailyPeakWithGaps()
    {
        // Arrange
        int days = 180;
        double minValue = 0.0d;
        double maxValue = 3000d;
        var data = DataGenerator.Generate(days, minValue, maxValue);
        var currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
        DateTime intervalStart = data.OrderBy(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc).First().MeasuredAtUtc.Date; // Start from the first date in the data
        Guid channelId = data.First().ChannelIdentifier; // Use the first channel ID from the data

        //remove some data: but the time intervals must be continuos, so we zero the value and set the DataQuality to Missing for every monday's data
        var mondaysData = data.Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc.DayOfWeek == 0); //zero out every mondays' data
        foreach (var item in mondaysData)
        {
            item.Value = 0; //zero out the value
            item.DataQuality = DataQuality.Missing;
        }

        // Act
        var dailyPeaks = PeakCalculationHelpers.GenerateEmptyIntervalsByType<PeakSubMeterConsumptionEntityDto>(intervalStart, currentDate, PeakType.Daily);
        PeakCalculationHelpers.CalculateSubMeterPeaksForChannelAndPeakType(data, dailyPeaks, channelId, PeakType.Daily);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(dailyPeaks);
        Assert.True(dailyPeaks.Count > 0);
        Assert.All(dailyPeaks, peak =>
        {
            Assert.Equal(PeakType.Daily, peak.PeakType);
            Assert.Equal(channelId, peak.ChannelIdentifier);
            Assert.True(peak.PeakValue >= (decimal)minValue); //inclusive
            Assert.True(peak.PeakValue < (decimal)maxValue); //exclusive
        });

        // Assert that the peak values are calculated correctly
        // For example, you can check if the peak value is the maximum value for that day
        foreach (var peak in dailyPeaks)
        {
            var dailyData = data.Where(x => x.MeasuredAtUtc.Date == peak.PeriodStart.Date && x.ChannelIdentifier == channelId);
            var expectedPeakValue = dailyData.Max(x => x.Value);
            Assert.Equal(expectedPeakValue, (double)peak.PeakValue);
        }
    }
}

#pragma warning disable S3903 // Types should be defined in named namespaces
class Build : NukeBuild
#pragma warning restore S3903 // Types should be defined in named namespaces
{
    /// Support plugins are available for:
    ///   - JetBrains ReSharper        https://nuke.build/resharper
    ///   - JetBrains Rider            https://nuke.build/rider

    //public static int Main() => Execute<Build>(x => x.GitlabBuild);

    public const string dotNetVersion = "net8.0";
    public const string swaggerCliVersion = "7.2.0"; //see version in "<PackageDownload Include="Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Cli" Version="[X.X.X]" />" in the Tools.Builder.csproj file

    public Build()
    {
        MinVerTasks.MinVerLogger = (_, text) => Log.Information(text);
        NpmTasks.NpmLogger = (_, text) => Log.Information(text);
    }

    [Parameter("Configuration to build - Default is 'Debug' (local) or 'Release' (server)")]

    MinVer Version => MinVerTasks.MinVer(x => x.SetTagPrefix("v").SetFramework(dotNetVersion)).Result;

    [NuGetPackage("Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.Cli", "dotnet-swagger.dll", Framework = dotNetVersion, Version = swaggerCliVersion)]
    readonly Tool SwashbuckleCli;

Target GenerateOpenApiJson => _ => _
    .Unlisted()
    .After(Compile)
    .Executes(() =>
    {
        var openApiProjects = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            { "EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI", "FrameworkApi.json" },
            { "EnergiaMenedzsment.DataReceiver.WebAPI", "DataReceiverApi.json" },
            { "EnergiaMenedzsment.Monitoring.WebAPI", "MonitoringApi.json" },
            { "EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Puppeteer.WebAPI", "PuppeteerApi.json" },
        };

        var outputProject = Solution.AllProjects.Single(x => x.Name == "EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd");
        var outputPathBase = outputProject.Directory / "OpenAPIs";

        foreach (var project in Solution.AllProjects.Where(x => openApiProjects.Keys.Any(y => x.Name == y)))
        {
            // Read the ApiVersion from appsettings.json
            var appsettingsPath = project.Directory / "appsettings.json";
            var apiVersion = "v1"; // Default fallback version
            
            if (File.Exists(appsettingsPath))
            {
                try
                {
                    // Parse the JSON file
                    var json = System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(appsettingsPath));
                    
                    // Try to get the ApiVersion property
                    if (json.RootElement.TryGetProperty("ApiVersion", out var versionElement))
                    {
                        apiVersion = $"v{versionElement.GetString()}";
                        Log.Information($"Found API version {apiVersion} for {project.Name}");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Log.Warning($"ApiVersion not found in appsettings.json for {project.Name}, using default: {apiVersion}");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Log.Warning($"Error reading appsettings.json for {project.Name}: {ex.Message}. Using default version: {apiVersion}");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Log.Warning($"appsettings.json not found for {project.Name}, using default version: {apiVersion}");
            }

            var binPath = project.Directory / "bin" / Configuration / dotNetVersion / $"{project.Name}.dll";
            var jsonFile = openApiProjects[project.Name];
            var jsonPath = outputPathBase / jsonFile;

            SwashbuckleCli(arguments: $"tofile --output {jsonPath} {binPath} {apiVersion}",
                workingDirectory: project.Directory);
        }
    });

    Target SwaggerCodegenAngular => _ => _
        .Unlisted()
        .After(GenerateOpenApiJson)
        .Executes(() =>
        {
            var sourceOpenApIsProject = Solution.AllProjects.Single(x => x.Name == "EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.BackEnd");
            var sourceJsonPathBase = sourceOpenApIsProject.Directory / "OpenAPIs";
            var generatedOutputPathBase = RootDirectory / "Source" / "ClientApp" / "Framework" / "src" / "app" /
                                          "core" / "generated";

            var swaggerDocs = new (string sourceJsonFile, string generatedOutputDir)[]
            {
                ("FrameworkApi.json", "swaggerGeneratedApi"),
                ("DataReceiverApi.json", "swaggerGeneratedApiDataReceiver"),
                ("MonitoringApi.json", "swaggerGeneratedApiMonitoring"),
            };

            foreach ((string sourceJsonFile, string generatedOutputDir) in swaggerDocs)
            {
                var sourceJson = sourceJsonPathBase / sourceJsonFile;
                var generatedOutputPath = generatedOutputPathBase / generatedOutputDir;

                DockerTasks.DockerRun(s => s
                    .EnableRm()
                    .AddVolume($"{sourceJson}:/local/in/swagger.json")
                    .AddVolume($"{generatedOutputPath}:/local/out")
                    .SetImage("swaggerapi/swagger-codegen-cli-v3:latest")
                    .SetCommand("generate")
                    .SetArgs("-i", "/local/in/swagger.json", "-l", "typescript-angular", "-o", "/local/out/"));

#if DEBUG
                // restore problemDetails manually
                var processStartInfo = new ProcessStartInfo("git", "restore model/problemDetails.ts")
                {
                    WorkingDirectory = generatedOutputPath
                };

                System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(processStartInfo).WaitForExit();
#endif
            }
        });

    Target GenerateOpenApiClients => _ => _
        .DependsOn(Clean)
        .DependsOn(Compile)
        .DependsOn(GenerateOpenApiJson)
        .DependsOn(SwaggerCodegenAngular);

    Target PublishAzurePackages => _ => _
        .DependsOn(Clean)
        .DependsOn(Compile)
        .Executes(() =>
        {
            void CopyDb(AbsolutePath outputPath)
            {
                CopyDirectoryRecursively(SourceDirectory / "DB",
                    outputPath / "DB");
                CopyDirectoryRecursively(SourceDirectory / "Modules" / "DataReceiver" / "DB",
                    outputPath / "Modules" / "DataReceiver" / "DB");
                CopyDirectoryRecursively(SourceDirectory / "Modules" / "Framework" / "DB",
                    outputPath / "Modules" / "Framework" / "DB");
                CopyDirectoryRecursively(SourceDirectory / "Modules" / "Monitoring" / "DB",
                    outputPath / "Modules" / "Monitoring" / "DB");
            }

            var publishName = $"{ProjectName.ToLowerInvariant()}-{Version.Version}-azure-{Environment}";
            var publishDirectory = PublishedDirectory / publishName;

            // Ebben a ciklusban dolgozzuk fel az Azure AppService-nek szánt projekteket
            foreach (var project in Solution.AllProjects.Where(x =>
                         bool.Parse(x.GetProperty("X_AzureAppServicePublish") ?? bool.FalseString)))
            {
                var outputArtifactName = $"{publishName}-{project.Name}";
                var outputPath = ArtifactsDirectory / outputArtifactName;

                DotNetPublish(s => s
                    .SetConfiguration(Configuration.Release)
                    .SetOutput(outputPath)
                    .SetProperty("EnvironmentName", Environment)
                    .EnableNoRestore()
                    .SetProject(project.Path));

                outputPath.GlobFiles("appsettings.Development.json").ForEach(x => x.DeleteFile());

                // Az Azure AppService alá tartozó WebJob-okat egy adott mappába kell tenni az AppService-en belül
                if (project.GetProperty("X_AzureWebJob") is { } webJob)
                {
                    var webJobProject = Solution.AllProjects.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Name == webJob) ??
                                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                            $"{project.Name}: project referred to by X_AzureWebJob property '{webJob}' not found");

                    var webJobPath = outputPath / "app_data" / "Jobs" / "Continuous" / webJobProject.Name;

                    DotNetPublish(s => s
                        .SetConfiguration(Configuration.Release)
                        .SetOutput(webJobPath)
                        .SetProperty("EnvironmentName", Environment)
                        .EnableNoRestore()
                        .SetProject(webJobProject.Path));

                    webJobPath.GlobFiles("appsettings.Development.json").ForEach(x => x.DeleteFile());

                    var runCmd = webJobPath / "run.cmd";
                    runCmd.WriteAllText($"dotnet {webJobProject.Name}.dll %\n");

                    // Az adott projektnek szüksége van a DB és Migrations mappákra (ez itt most csak a webjobokra fut
                    // meg, de ez kiemelhető ha később igény lesz arra, hogy bármilyen projektre lefutthasson ez a task)
                    if (bool.Parse(webJobProject.GetProperty("X_NeedsDbMigrations") ?? bool.FalseString))
                    {
                        CopyDb(webJobPath);
                    }
                }

                if (project.GetProperty("X_AngularProject") is { } angularPath)
                {
                    var angularAbsPath = project.Path / angularPath;
                    var buildOutputPath = project.GetProperty("X_AngularOutputPath") ??
                                          throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                              $"{project.Name}: X_AngularOutputPath property is required if X_AngularProject is true");

                    var buildAbsOutputPath = outputPath / buildOutputPath;

                    NpmTasks.NpmInstall(s => s.SetProcessWorkingDirectory(angularAbsPath));

                    NpmTasks.NpmRun(s => s
                        .SetCommand("ng")
                        .SetArguments("build", "--output-path", buildAbsOutputPath, "--configuration",
                            Environment.ToLowerInvariant())
                        .SetProcessWorkingDirectory(angularAbsPath));
                }

                outputPath.ZipTo(publishDirectory / $"{outputArtifactName}.zip",
                    compressionLevel: CompressionLevel.SmallestSize, fileMode: FileMode.Create);
            }

            // FluentMigration és a DB mappa csomagolása
            {
                var fluentMigrationProject =
                    Solution.AllProjects.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Name == "Tools.FluentMigration") ??
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "Tools.FluentMigration project not found in solution");

                var outputArtifactName = $"{publishName}-{fluentMigrationProject.Name}";
                var outputPath = ArtifactsDirectory / outputArtifactName;

                DotNetPublish(s => s
                    .SetConfiguration(Configuration.Release)
                    .SetOutput(outputPath)
                    .SetProperty("EnvironmentName", Environment)
                    .EnableNoRestore()
                    .SetProject(fluentMigrationProject.Path));

                outputPath.GlobFiles("appsettings.Development.json").ForEach(x => x.DeleteFile());

                CopyDb(outputPath);

                outputPath.ZipTo(publishDirectory / $"{outputArtifactName}.zip",
                    compressionLevel: CompressionLevel.SmallestSize, fileMode: FileMode.Create);
            }

            // FileSystemTasks.CopyFileToDirectory(RootDirectory / "CHANGELOG.md", outputPath);
        });
}

using FluentNHibernate.Cfg;
using FluentNHibernate.Cfg.Db;
using NHibernate.Dialect;
using NHibernate.Engine;
using NHibernate.Util;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.Loader;
using Common.BackEnd.DataAccess.Mapping;
using Common.BackEnd.Domain.Attributes;


try
{
    if (args.Length < 2)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Invalid usage.");
        return;
    }

    var assemblyList = new Dictionary<string, Assembly>();

    var destDir = args[0];

    var mainAssembly = args[1];
    assemblyList.Add(mainAssembly, null);

    var onlyTenant = args.Length > 2 && args[2] == "--tenant";

    if (!onlyTenant && args.Length > 2)
    {
        var additionalAssemblies = args[2].Split(';');
        additionalAssemblies.ToList().ForEach(x => assemblyList.Add(x, null));
        onlyTenant = args.Length > 3 && args[3] == "--tenant";
    }

    

    var baseDir = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;

    foreach (var assemblyListItem in assemblyList.Keys.ToArray())
    {
        var assembly = LoadAssembly(Path.Combine(baseDir, assemblyListItem));
        assemblyList[assemblyListItem] = assembly;
    }

    var config = CreateConfiguration(assemblyList.Values.ToArray());

    var dialect = Dialect.GetDialect(config.Properties);
    string defaultCatalog = PropertiesHelper.GetString("default_catalog", config.Properties, null);

    var defaultSchema = "{schema}";

    var type = config.GetType();

    // Get IMapping
    var mappingProp = type.GetField("mapping", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
    if (mappingProp == null)
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Mapping prop not exists");
    var mapping = mappingProp.GetValue(config) as IMapping;

    // SecondPassCompile
    var secondPassCompileMethod = type.GetMethod("SecondPassCompile",
        BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
    secondPassCompileMethod?.Invoke(config, null);

    // Get TableMappings
    var tableMappingsProp = type.GetProperty("TableMappings", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
    if (tableMappingsProp == null)
        throw new InvalidOperationException("TableMappings prop not exists");
    if (!(tableMappingsProp.GetValue(config) is IEnumerable<NHibernate.Mapping.Table> tableMappings))
        throw new InvalidOperationException("TableMappings not exists");

    mainAssembly = mainAssembly.Replace(".dll", "");

    foreach (var tableMap in tableMappings)
    {
        var classMaps = config.ClassMappings.Where(x => x.Table == tableMap).ToList();
        if (classMaps.Count == 1 && classMaps[0].EntityName.EndsWith("Ref"))
            continue;

        if (classMaps.Count == 1 && classMaps[0].MappedClass.GetCustomAttribute<NoTableAttribute>() != null)
            continue;

        if (onlyTenant && classMaps.Count == 1 && classMaps[0].MappedClass.GetCustomAttribute<TenantIndependentAttribute>() != null)
            continue;

        if (config.ClassMappings.Any(x => x.Table == tableMap && x.ClassName.Contains(mainAssembly) ||
            config.CollectionMappings.Any(y => y.CollectionTable == tableMap && y.OwnerEntityName.Contains(mainAssembly))))
        {
            var strings = GenerateTableSql(tableMap, dialect, mapping, defaultCatalog, defaultSchema,
                config.CollectionMappings.Any(y => y.CollectionTable == tableMap));

            var subDir = "Tables";

            var tableName = tableMap.Name;
            tableName = tableName.Replace("\"", "");

            string fileName = Path.Combine(destDir, subDir, tableName + ".sql");
            File.WriteAllLines(fileName, strings);
            Console.WriteLine(fileName);

        }
    }

    Console.WriteLine("Script generated from assembly: {0}", mainAssembly);


}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine("ERROR: " + ex);
}





//Functions, methods...




NHibernate.Cfg.Configuration CreateConfiguration(IEnumerable<Assembly> assemblies)
{
    var dbConfiguration =
        PostgreSQLConfiguration.Standard
            .Dialect<PostgreSQL82Dialect>();

    var config = Fluently.Configure().Database(dbConfiguration);
    var database = config.Database(dbConfiguration);

    var mappings = CoreFluentMapper.MapFromAssemblies(database, assemblies.ToArray());

    var configuration = mappings.BuildConfiguration();
    return configuration;
}

Assembly LoadAssembly(string codeBase)
{
    var result = AssemblyLoadContext.Default.LoadFromAssemblyPath(codeBase);
    return result;
}

List<string> GenerateTableSql(NHibernate.Mapping.Table table,
    Dialect dialect, IMapping mapping, string defaultCatalog, string defaultSchema, bool isCollection)
{

    var strings = new List<string>();

    var script = CS(table.SqlCreateString(dialect, mapping, defaultCatalog, defaultSchema));

    var tags = script.Replace(",", ",^").Split('^').ToList();

    if (tags.Any(x => !x.Contains("_id ")))
    {
        // Id-k előre kerülnek...
        var idColumns = new List<string>();

        var idColumn = tags.FindLast(x => x.Contains("_id int4"));
        while (idColumn != null)
        {
            idColumns.Insert(0, idColumn);
            tags.Remove(idColumn);

            idColumn = tags.FindLast(x => x.Contains("_id int4"));
        }

        if (idColumns.Count > 0)
        {
            var idx = 0;
            var serialColumn = tags.SingleOrDefault(x => x.Contains(" serial "));
            if (serialColumn != null)
            {
                idx = tags.IndexOf(serialColumn) + 1;
            }

            tags.InsertRange(idx, idColumns);
        }
    }

    if (tags.Any(x => x.Contains("create table")))
    {
        // create table kerül legelőre...

        var createLine = tags.Single(x => x.Contains("create table"));

        strings.Insert(0, createLine);
        tags.Remove(createLine);
    }

    tags.ForEach(strings.Add);

    if (isCollection && table.ColumnIterator.Count() == 2 && !script.Contains("primary key"))
    {
        strings.Add("");
        var pksb = string.Format("alter table {0}.{1} add constraint {2} primary key ({3});",
            defaultSchema, table.Name, table.Name + "_pkey", string.Join(",", table.ColumnIterator.Select(x => x.Name).ToArray()));
        strings.Add(pksb);
    }

    strings.Add("");

    if (dialect.SupportsForeignKeyConstraintInAlterTable)
    {
        strings.AddRange(table.ForeignKeyIterator.Select(fk => CS(fk.SqlCreateString(dialect, mapping, defaultCatalog, defaultSchema))));
    }
    strings.AddRange(table.IndexIterator.Select(index => CS(index.SqlCreateString(dialect, mapping, defaultCatalog,
            defaultSchema))));

    strings.Add("");


    return strings;
}

string CS(string statement)
{
    return statement + ";";
}
