﻿using System.Text;


try
{
    if (args.Length < 3)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Usage: dbmake.exe <path> <directory file name> <output file name>");
        throw new ApplicationException("invalid arguments");
    }

    string sep = Environment.NewLine;


    Console.WriteLine("Creating db script (" + args[1] + "): " + args[2]);

    using (StreamWriter resfile =
        new StreamWriter(args[0] + args[2], false, Encoding.GetEncoding("utf-8")))
    {

        string prefix = "";
        string dirsfile = args[0] + args[1];
        if (args[1].IndexOf('*') > 0)
        {
            prefix = args[1].Replace("*", "");
            dirsfile = args[0] + prefix + "dirs.txt";
        }


        if (!File.Exists(dirsfile) && prefix.Length > 0)
            dirsfile = args[0] + " dirs.txt";
        CheckFile(dirsfile);

        using (StreamReader fdirs = File.OpenText(dirsfile))
        {
            while (!fdirs.EndOfStream)
            {
                string fpath = args[0] + fdirs.ReadLine() + "/";
                string filesfile = fpath + prefix + "files.txt";
                if (!File.Exists(filesfile) && prefix.Length > 0)
                    filesfile = fpath + "files.txt";
                CheckFile(filesfile);

                using (StreamReader ffiles = File.OpenText(filesfile))
                {
                    while (!ffiles.EndOfStream)
                    {
                        string sfile = fpath + ffiles.ReadLine();
                        CheckFile(sfile);
                        using (StreamReader file = new StreamReader(sfile,
                            Encoding.GetEncoding("utf-8")))
                        {
                            resfile.WriteLine(file.ReadToEnd());
                        }
                    }

                    resfile.WriteLine(sep);
                }
            }
        }

        /*if (isora)
            resfile.WriteLine("exit");*/

    }

    Console.WriteLine(args[2] + " created.");

    return 0;
}

catch (Exception ex)
{
    Console.ForegroundColor = ConsoleColor.Red;
    Console.Error.WriteLine("ERROR: " + ex.Message);
    Console.ResetColor();
    return 1;
}




//Functions, methods...



void CheckFile(string filepath)
{
    //Console.WriteLine(filepath); 
    if (!File.Exists(filepath))
        throw new ApplicationException(string.Format("'{0}' file doesn't exists", filepath));

}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.Shared.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using Common.Shared.ListItems;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities.Locations;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities.Devices;
using EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models.Devices;
using Tools.TSGenerator.Generator;
using Tools.TSGenerator.Templates;
using Tools.TSGenerator.Types;

namespace Tools.TSGenerator;

class Program
{
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        if (args.Length == 0 || args[0].IndexOfAny(Path.GetInvalidPathChars()) >= 0)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Invalid argument. First argument should be a valid file path.");
        }

        var outputFolder = args[0];
        var dtoTypesMetadata = MetadataHelper.GetDtoTypesMetadata<IModel>(typeof(IDictEntity).Assembly.ExportedTypes);
        var commonTypesMetadata = MetadataHelper.GetDtoTypesMetadata<IModel>(typeof(AddressEntityDto).Assembly.ExportedTypes);
        var sharedTypesMetadata = MetadataHelper.GetDtoTypesMetadata<IModel>(typeof(DeviceEntityDto).Assembly.ExportedTypes);
        var webTypesMetadata = MetadataHelper.GetDtoTypesMetadata<IModel>(typeof(CreateDeviceRequest).Assembly.ExportedTypes);
        dtoTypesMetadata.AddRange(webTypesMetadata);
        dtoTypesMetadata.AddRange(sharedTypesMetadata);
        dtoTypesMetadata.AddRange(commonTypesMetadata);

        foreach (var tsType in dtoTypesMetadata.Where(t => t.Kind == DtoTypeKind.Class || t.Kind == DtoTypeKind.Interface))
        {
            if (tsType.Type.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(EntityListItemDtoBase))) continue;

            var options = tsType.Type.GetCustomAttribute<TSGeneratorOptionsAttribute>(false);
            if (options == null) continue;

            var outputDir = Path.Combine(outputFolder, tsType.TypeScriptPath);
            if (!Directory.Exists(outputDir)) Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDir);

            if (!typeof(EntityListItemDtoBase).IsAssignableFrom(tsType.Type) && !tsType.Name.StartsWith("EntityRef") 
                && (options.Exclude & TSFileTypes.Form) != TSFileTypes.Form)
            {
                var formGenerator = new FormGenerator { DtoTypes = dtoTypesMetadata, CurrentType = tsType };
                File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(outputDir, tsType.TypeScriptName + "Form.ts"), formGenerator.TransformText().Trim());
            }
        }

        foreach (var tsType in dtoTypesMetadata.Where(t => t.Kind == DtoTypeKind.Enum))
        {
            var options = tsType.Type.GetCustomAttribute<TSGeneratorOptionsAttribute>(false);
            if (options == null) continue;
            var enumGenerator = new EnumGenerator { DtoTypes = dtoTypesMetadata, CurrentEnum = tsType };
            var outputDir = Path.Combine(outputFolder, tsType.TypeScriptPath);
            if (!Directory.Exists(outputDir)) Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDir);
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(outputDir, tsType.TypeScriptName + ".ts"), enumGenerator.TransformText().Trim());
        }

    }

}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.Serialization;
using AutoMapper.Internal;
using Common.Shared.Attributes;
using Tools.TSGenerator.Types;

namespace Tools.TSGenerator.Generator;

public static class MetadataHelper
{
    public static DtoTypeList<DtoType> GetDtoTypesMetadata<T>(IEnumerable<Type> types)
    {
        IList<DtoType> dtoList = types
            .Where(t => !t.IsAbstract) // We are not interested in abstract classes
            .Where(t => t.GetCustomAttribute<DataContractAttribute>() != null)
            .Where(t => t.IsEnum || (typeof(T).IsAssignableFrom(t)))
            .Select(t => new DtoType
            {
                Type = t,
                Namespace = t.GetNamespace(),
                // struct => interface
                // class => class
                // enum => enum. Must check for enum first because it is a ValueType and we want to avoid enums to be generated as interfaces
                Kind = t.IsEnum
                        ? DtoTypeKind.Enum
                        : t.IsValueType
                            ? DtoTypeKind.Interface
                            : DtoTypeKind.Class,
                Members = t.IsEnum // For enum types we should get its values except the "value__" field
                    ? t.GetFields()
                        .Where(f => f.GetCustomAttribute<DataMemberAttribute>() != null && f.Name != "value__")
                        .Where(f => f.GetCustomAttribute<TSPropertyAttribute>() == null || !f.GetCustomAttribute<TSPropertyAttribute>()!.Skip)
                        .Select(f => new DtoMember
                        {
                            DeclaringType = t,
                            Field = f,
                            Name = f.Name,
                            Type = f.FieldType
                        })
                    : t.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)
                        .Where(p => p.GetCustomAttribute<DataMemberAttribute>() != null)
                        .Where(f => f.GetCustomAttribute<TSPropertyAttribute>() == null || !f.GetCustomAttribute<TSPropertyAttribute>()!.Skip)
                        .Select(p => new DtoMember
                        {
                            DeclaringType = t,
                            Field = p,
                            Name = p.Name,
                            Type = p.PropertyType
                        })
            })
            .ToList();
        var dtoTypeList = new DtoTypeList<DtoType>();
        dtoTypeList.AddRange(dtoList);
        return dtoTypeList;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a corresponding TypeScript type for a given .NET type
    /// </summary>
    public static string GetTypeScriptTypeName(Type type)
    {
        var numberTypes = new HashSet<Type>
        {
            typeof(sbyte), typeof(byte), typeof(short),
            typeof(ushort), typeof(int), typeof(uint),
            typeof(long), typeof(ulong), typeof(float),
            typeof(double), typeof(decimal)
        };
        var stringTypes = new HashSet<Type>
        {
            typeof(char), typeof(string), typeof(Guid)
        };

        var result = "";

        if ((type.IsGenericType && type.GetInterface(nameof(IEnumerable)) != null) || type.IsNullableType())
        {
            if (!typeof(IEnumerable<object>).IsAssignableFrom(type) && type.GetGenericArguments().Length > 1)
            {
                throw new Exception(string.Format("The generic type {0} must implement IEnumerable<T> and must have no more than 1 generic argument.", type.FullName));
            }
            // strip the generic type leaving the first generic argument
            type = type.GetGenericArguments()[0];
        }
        else if (type.IsGenericType)
        {
            if (!typeof(IEnumerable<object>).IsAssignableFrom(type) && type.GetGenericArguments().Length > 1)
            {
                throw new Exception(string.Format("The generic type {0} must implement IEnumerable<T> and must have no more than 1 generic argument.", type.FullName));
            }
            // strip the generic type leaving the first generic argument
            type = type.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
        }

        // Check if it is a primitive type
        if (numberTypes.Contains(type)) result = "number";
        else if (stringTypes.Contains(type)) result = "string";
        else if (type == typeof(bool)) result = "boolean";
        else if (type == typeof(DateTime)) result = "Date";
        // It is enum/class/struct -> return its name as-is
        else result = type.GetTypeName();

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns a corresponding TypeScript type for a given .NET type
    /// </summary>
    public static string FullGetTypeScriptTypeName(Type type)
    {
        var result = GetTypeScriptTypeName(type);

        var isCollectionType = false;
        // Check if it is a generic. We support only generics which are compatible with IEnumerable<T> and have only one generic argument
        if (type.IsGenericType && type.GetInterface(nameof(IEnumerable)) != null)
        {
            if (!typeof(IEnumerable<object>).IsAssignableFrom(type) && type.GetGenericArguments().Length > 1)
            {
                throw new Exception(string.Format("The generic type {0} must implement IEnumerable<T> and must have no more than 1 generic argument.", type.FullName));
            }
            isCollectionType = true;
        }
        else if (type.IsGenericType)
        {
            var tsGenOptions = type.GetCustomAttribute<TSGeneratorOptionsAttribute>();
            if (tsGenOptions != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tsGenOptions.CustomImport)) 
                result = $"{result}<{string.Join(", ", type.GenericTypeArguments.Select(x => x.GetTypeName()))}>";
        }

        if (isCollectionType) result += "[]";

        return result;
    }

    public static string GetTypeName(this Type type)
    {
        var result = string.Empty;
        if (type.IsGenericType) return type.Name.Remove(type.Name.IndexOf('`'));
        else result = type.Name;
        return result.Replace("ListItemDto", "ListItem").Replace("EntityDto", "").Replace("Dto", "");
    }

    private static string GetTypeBaseName(this Type type)
    {
        var result = string.Empty;
        if (type.IsGenericType) return type.Name.Remove(type.Name.IndexOf('`'));
        else result = type.Name;
        return result.Replace("ListItemDto", "").Replace("EntityDto", "").Replace("DataTableRequest", "");
    }

    private static string GetNamespace(this Type type)
    {
        var result = type.Namespace
            .Replace("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Enums", "")
            .Replace("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared.Entities", "")
            .Replace("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Entities", "")
            .Replace("EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Entities", "")
            .Replace("EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.Enums", "")
            .Replace("EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.Shared.ListItems", "")
            .Replace("EnergiaMenedzsment.Framework.WebAPI.Models", "")
            .Replace("EnergiaMenedzsment.Common.Shared", "");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result)) result = !type.IsEnum ? type.GetTypeBaseName() : "";
        result = result.Trim('.');
        return result;
    }

}

﻿namespace Tools.TSGenerator.Generator;

public static class TypeScriptConverterExtension
{
    public static string ToJSPropertyName(this string propertyName)
    {
        var parts = propertyName.Split('.');
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.Length; i++)
        {
            // var str = parts[i];
            // var newStr = string.Empty;
            // for (var j = 0; j < str.Length - 1; j++)
            // {
            //     if (j == 0 || (char.IsUpper(str[j]) && char.IsUpper(str[j + 1])))
            //         newStr += char.ToLowerInvariant(str[j]);
            // }
            // newStr += str.Substring(newStr.Length);
            var newStr = char.ToLower(propertyName[0]) + propertyName[1..];
            parts[i] = newStr;
        }
        return string.Join(".", parts);
    }

    public static string ToJSFilename(this string propertyName)
    {
        return ToJSPropertyName(propertyName);
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using AutoMapper.Internal;
using Common.Logic.Extensions;
using Common.Shared.Attributes;
using Common.Shared.Entities;
using Common.Shared.Entities.Attributes;
using Tools.TSGenerator.Generator;

namespace Tools.TSGenerator.Types;


public class DtoMember
{
    public string OriginalName { get; private set; }

    public string Name
    {
        get
        {
            if (Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(Field, typeof(TSPropertyAttribute)) is TSPropertyAttribute attribute)
                return attribute.Name;
            
            return this.OriginalName.ToJSPropertyName();
        }
        set => this.OriginalName = value;
    }

    public string DisplayName => Field.GetCustomAttributes<DisplayAttribute>().FirstOrDefault()?.Name;

    public Type DeclaringType { get; set; }

    public MemberInfo Field { get; set; }

    public Type Type { get; set; }
    public DtoType DtoType { get; set; }
    public string TypeName => MetadataHelper.GetTypeScriptTypeName(Type);
    public string TypeScriptTypeName => MetadataHelper.FullGetTypeScriptTypeName(Type);

    public string DefaultTSValue
    {
        get
        {
            if (Type.IsNullableType() || (Type.IsClass
                                      && Type.Assembly.FullName.StartsWith("EnergiaMenedzsment.")))
                return "null";
            if (Type.IsLogicalType())
                return Field.GetMemberValue(Activator.CreateInstance(DeclaringType))?.ToString().ToLower() ?? "false";
            if (Type.IsNumericType())
                if (!DeclaringType.IsGenericType)
                    return Field.GetMemberValue(Activator.CreateInstance(DeclaringType))?.ToString() ?? "0";
                else
                {
                    Type[] typeArgs = { typeof(EntityDtoBase) };
                    var constructedType = DeclaringType.MakeGenericType(typeArgs);
                    var instance = Activator.CreateInstance(constructedType);
                    var propertyInfo = instance.GetType().GetProperty(Field.Name);
                    return propertyInfo.GetValue(instance)?.ToString() ?? "0";
                }
            if (Type.IsEnum)
                return $"{DtoType.Name}.{DtoType.Members.FirstOrDefault().OriginalName}";
            return "''";
        }
    }

    public bool IsReadonly
    {
        get
        {
            var readonlyAttr = Field
                .GetCustomAttributes(typeof(System.ComponentModel.ReadOnlyAttribute), true)
                .FirstOrDefault() as System.ComponentModel.ReadOnlyAttribute;
            return readonlyAttr?.IsReadOnly ?? false;
        }
    }

    public bool IsRequired => Field.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(RequiredAttribute), true).Any();

    public bool DateTimeValidation => Field.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DateTimeValidatorAttribute), true).Any();

    public bool IsNonPrimitiveArray => Type.IsCollection() && Type.IsGenericType && Type.GetGenericArguments().All(x => !x.IsPrimitive);

    public int? MaxLength
    {
        get
        {
            var stringLength = Field.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(StringLengthAttribute), true).FirstOrDefault() as StringLengthAttribute;
            return stringLength?.MaximumLength;
        }
    }

    public int? MinLength
    {
        get
        {
            var stringLength = Field.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(StringLengthAttribute), true).FirstOrDefault() as StringLengthAttribute;
            return stringLength?.MinimumLength;
        }
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Common.Shared.Attributes;
using Tools.TSGenerator.Generator;

namespace Tools.TSGenerator.Types;

public class DtoType
{
    private readonly List<string> _defaultNamespaces = new List<string> { "Common", "Framework" };
    public string Namespace { get; set; }
    public string ApiFolder
    {
        get
        {
            var namesPace = Type.Namespace!.Split(".")[1];
            return _defaultNamespaces.Contains(namesPace) ? "" : namesPace;
        }
    }

    public string TypeScriptPath { get { return (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(this.Namespace) ? this.Namespace.Replace(".", "/") + "/" : "").ToLower(); } }
    public string RelativeRootPath => string.Concat(Enumerable.Repeat("../", this.Namespace.Split('.').Length));
    public string TypeScriptName
    {
        get
        {
            if (Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(Type, typeof(TSPropertyAttribute)) is TSPropertyAttribute
                attribute)
                return attribute.Name;

            return this.Name.ToJSFilename();
        }
    }
    public string Name => Type.GetTypeName();
    public Type Type { get; set; }
    public DtoTypeKind Kind { get; set; }
    public IEnumerable<DtoMember> Members { get; set; }
    public string CustomImport { get; set; }
}

﻿using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Common.Shared.Attributes;

namespace Tools.TSGenerator.Types;

public class DtoTypeList<T> : List<T>
    where T : DtoType
{

    public DtoType GetReference(string typeName)
    {
        return this.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Name == typeName);
    }

    public IEnumerable<DtoType> GetReferences(DtoType dtoType)
    {
        IList<DtoType> result = new List<DtoType>();
        foreach (var member in dtoType.Members)
        {
            var reference = GetReference(member.TypeName);
            if (reference == null)
            {
                var tsGenOptions = member.Type.GetCustomAttribute<TSGeneratorOptionsAttribute>();
                if (tsGenOptions != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tsGenOptions.CustomImport))
                {
                    member.DtoType = new DtoType()
                    {
                        CustomImport = tsGenOptions.CustomImport
                    };
                    reference = member.DtoType;
                }
            }
            if (reference != null)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(reference.CustomImport) && result.Where(x => string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.CustomImport)).All(x =>
                     x.TypeScriptPath + x.TypeScriptName != reference.TypeScriptPath + reference.TypeScriptName))
                {
                    if (reference.Type != dtoType.Type)
                        result.Add(reference);
                }
                else 
                {
                    if (result.All(x => x.CustomImport != reference.CustomImport))
                        result.Add(reference);
                    if (member.Type.IsGenericType && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(member.DtoType?.CustomImport))
                    {
                        foreach (var typeGenericTypeArgument in member.Type.GenericTypeArguments)
                        {
                            reference = this.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Type.FullName == typeGenericTypeArgument.FullName);
                            if (reference != null)
                                if (reference.Type != dtoType.Type && result.Where(x => string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.CustomImport)).All(x =>
                                    x.TypeScriptPath + x.TypeScriptName != reference.TypeScriptPath + reference.TypeScriptName))
                                    result.Add(reference);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

}
